name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: On the morning of New Year's Day, the 7:30 alarm went off. Lei Mingxuan got up on time, quickly put on his sportswear, drank a few sips of warm water in the living room to wake his body, and prepared for a morning run.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: New Year's Day morning run
description: Lei Mingxuan set off from Shanggang Community, jogged along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui Central Green Park, and completed a 3-kilometer morning run at a pace of about 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, braving the cold wind at minus 2 degrees Celsius. On the park path, he felt the crisp morning air of the New Year. After the run, his body was warm and he felt refreshed.
location: Lujiazui Center Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: New Year breakfast and family greetings
description: After his morning run, he went home to find that his mother had already cooked black sesame glutinous rice balls, symbolizing family reunion. His father was also up early. The family exchanged Happy New Year wishes and shared breakfast in the warmth. Lei Mingxuan chatted with his father about the store inventory as they ate, and the atmosphere was cozy.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up, changing clothes, and tidying up
description: Lei Mingxuan took a hot shower and changed into cargo pants, a thick hoodie, and a long black down jacket. He took out two new blind boxes from the shoe cabinet in the entryway, planning to open them at the shop. After checking his phone, keys, and wallet, he was all set to go.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Walked to the store and bought coffee.
description: Lei Mingxuan walked from Shanggang Community to Super Brand Mall, replied to a few WeChat messages on the way, passed a convenience store, and finally bought an iced Americano at Manner Coffee on the basement level of Super Brand Mall, ready to start work.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Year-end data inventory, phase one
description: Lei Mingxuan came to the clothing store A-208 on the second floor of Super Brand Mall. After lightly wiping off the dust, he turned on the computer and the cashier system, and exported the 2024 annual sales transactions, inventory changes, purchase orders, and supplier reports. While drinking coffee, he checked item by item, focusing on the sales difference between spring/summer and autumn/winter collections, recorded data anomalies, and began analyzing where the problem lay.
location: Clothing store, No. A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch
description: Feeling hungry at noon, Lei Mingxuan went down to B1 of Super Brand Mall and quickly ordered a bowl of signature pork cartilage ramen at Ajisen Ramen. After finishing, he felt his energy restored.
location: Ajisen Ramen, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Social interaction and rest
description: Back at the store, Lei Mingxuan took advantage of the post-meal break to send New Year greetings to key contacts. He sent voice messages to Zhou Tao and Wu Fang wishing them a happy New Year's Day and prosperous business, sent a 66.66 yuan red packet to Zheng Kai, and also sent greetings to Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu. Then he took a photo of the mall crowd outside the window and posted it on Moments, writing: "Happy New Year! Today's inventory is now live. Wishing all you bosses a thriving and prosperous year!"
location: Store A-208 and corridor, 2nd floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Year-End Data Review Phase 2 and Retrospective
description: In the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan entered the verified data into Excel and prepared an annual profit statement. He noticed that fourth-quarter profit had dropped significantly due to rising rent and excessive clearance discounts, and jotted down initial improvement ideas in his notebook, such as optimizing purchase frequency and trying live-streaming to clear inventory. During this period, he refilled his water twice, occasionally stood up to stretch, and remained focused on his work.
location: Clothing store, No. A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Short break and refueling
description: His thoughts were stuck, so Lei Mingxuan paused his work and went downstairs to Starbucks on the first floor of Super Brand Mall, buying a hot latte and a muffin. He sat at the window bar, watching the heavy traffic in Lujiazui, and reorganized his financial report approach in his mind.
location: Starbucks Coffee, 1F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Wrap-up work and store tidying
description: Back at the store, Lei Mingxuan turned his newly thought-out 2025 operation ideas (such as introducing designer streetwear brands and trying a Douyin shop) into memo bullet points. Then he checked the day's accounts, confirmed everything was correct, inspected the store's water and electricity, cleaned up, and finally pulled down the rolling shutter door to head home.
location: Clothing store, No. A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Walk home and pick up the package.
description: Walking out of Super Brand Mall, a cold wind blew and the streets had returned to calm. Lei Mingxuan walked along Lujiazui West Road and Pudong Avenue, turned into the Cainiao Station in Shanggang Community, and picked up a limited-edition designer toy blind box he had bought online. Feeling elated, he walked home with light, brisk steps.
location: Cainiao Station, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family New Year dinner
description: Upon opening the door, the aroma of food filled the air. Mother had prepared braised pork belly, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, steamed sea bass, and spare rib soup. Father opened a bottle of treasured yellow rice wine, and Lei Mingxuan joined in with a small half glass. The family of three sat around the table, clinked glasses, and chatted about everyday life; work worries dissolved in the warmth of home.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Chatting in the living room and unboxing blind boxes
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the dishes, then joined his parents on the sofa to watch TV. His father chatted about the neighborhood gossip about adding an elevator, while his mother scrolled through food tutorials on Douyin. Lei Mingxuan took out the blind box he had just picked up and opened it on the spot. Happily surprised to draw the hidden figure, he gleefully took a photo and sent it to Yuanzi to show off.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: After washing up, Lei Mingxuan changed into pajamas and lay down in bed. He scrolled through Moments and liked some posts, then watched half an episode of the new anime Frieren: Beyond Journey's End. Although his body was tired, the warmth of home quickly relaxed him.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Setting the alarm and going to bed.
description: Lei Mingxuan set the alarm for 9:00 the next day, turned off the light, and closed his eyes. Images of the hidden edition blind box and his parents' smiling faces flashed through his mind, and he fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment and satisfaction.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Waking up and washing up
description: The alarm went off, and he sprang up out of bed. While washing up, he looked in the mirror. Last night's sleep was decent, and the fatigue from New Year's Day was mostly gone.
location: Bathroom, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Quarter, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Warm-up and heading out
description: Changed into workout clothes and did a quick stretch. My mother was busy in the kitchen, so I said hello and headed out.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning run at Lujiazui Greenbelt
description: Jogged to the park (about 15 minutes) and started running. The temperature was around 2 degrees, but I warmed up as I ran. I ran 3 kilometers at my own pace, with a pace of 5 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer, slightly faster than on New Year's Day. After the run, I stretched my legs on a stone bench by the road.
location: Main walkway of Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Walk home
description: After his run, he walked back along Pudong Avenue, letting the cold wind dry the sweat on his body. Passing the bun shop at the entrance of the residential area, he bought two pork buns to have as an extra breakfast.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Breakfast and Casual Chat with Dad
description: I took a shower and changed into casual going-out clothes. Sitting down at the dining table, my mother had already set out fried rice cakes, hot soy milk, and freshly bought meat buns. My father was reading the news on his phone and casually said, 'The green vegetables at the market are selling for 3.5 yuan this morning.' I responded while eating, but my mind had already drifted to today's sales data.
location: Restaurant, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commute and buy coffee
description: I rode a shared bike along Shangcheng Road and Yincheng Middle Road to the foot of Jin Mao Tower, parked it, and went into the Manner Coffee on Level B1. I ordered an iced Americano. While waiting for the coffee, I glanced at my watch; it was not yet 9:20.
location: Manner Coffee (Jinmao Store), B1, Jinmao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Walk to the shop.
description: Holding the coffee, walk from Jin Mao Tower across the skybridge to the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall; the store is not far from the elevator entrance.
location: REAL MX, Room A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Opening the store and in-depth data analysis
description: He opened earlier than usual. He turned on the computer and opened the ledger, exported the data from October to December 2024, and compared it with the same period in 2023. The declining profit figures were glaring. Customer churn rate and new-customer acquisition cost became the two main pain points. He marked the printed report with a red pen and stuck it on the first page of the ledger. A little after 10, Zheng Kai from the mall property passed by and greeted him.
location: Cashier counter inside [REAL MX], A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and exchange with store staff.
description: He had Xiao Lin, the shop assistant, watch the store and went down to Food Republic on B1. Today he ordered a curry beef brisket rice and watched live-streaming cases of clothing stores on Douyin while eating. After finishing, he brought Xiao Lin a cup of a grape drink loaded with pulp on the way back. Back in the store, he asked her, “Xiao Lin, have you heard any feedback from regular customers lately? Any complaints about the styles or the service?”
location: Food Republic (Shanghai Tower Branch), No. 501 Yincheng Middle Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Mind the store and receive customers
description: He covered Xiao Lin's lunch break. The store had just opened for the afternoon and there were few customers. While arranging the new styles on the mannequins, he helped two or three customers try on clothes and made one sale — a hoodie. During free moments, he processed three online store orders on his phone and printed out the shipping labels.
location: REAL MX, Room A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Visit neighboring merchants to learn from their experience
description: He picked up the iced Americano and wandered over to Lao Wang, the owner of the shoe store next door. Lao Wang was scrolling through Douyin, so he sat down on the sofa in his store and laid out the bottleneck he had identified in the morning, seriously asking about Douyin live streaming. Lao Wang was very candid, shared the lessons he had learned from his mistakes over the past three months, and also recommended a few fashion bloggers he thought were good.
location: Trendy Sneaker Club, Unit B-206, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Study the model of internet-famous stores in Hangzhou
description: Back in my own shop, I sat behind the cash register, opened my phone, and carefully studied the "online seeding + offline experience" model that Li Na had mentioned. I searched for the names of several popular internet-famous stores in Hangzhou, focusing on their Xiaohongshu and WeChat official accounts, and studied their photography styles and copywriting.
location: Inside the REAL MX store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Changing clothes preparation and temporary adjustments
description: He looked at the time and decided to go roller skating early. He greeted the store clerk Xiao Lin, asked her to look after the store, then went to the storage room to put on his roller skates and put his belongings and phone into his backpack.
location: In-store warehouse of [REAL MX], 2F, Unit A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Rollerblading along the riverside boardwalk to unwind
description: He skated directly onto the riverside promenade from the side of Super Brand Mall. The river breeze was strong in the evening, but the sensation of the wind stirred up by his skates made him feel great. He skated back and forth along the boardwalk four times, worked up a sweat, and left all the afternoon's anxiety behind.
location: Binjiang Avenue, from the Super Brand Mall section to the Dongchang Road Wharf section, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Cleaned up the store and prepared to close
description: Skated back to the store and changed back into flat shoes. Store clerk Xiao Lin reported the day's sales; I briefly checked the numbers and asked her to put away the clothes. I organized the account books and computer, checked the power, and then locked the store door.
location: Inside the REAL MX store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Return home.
description: He took a shared bike out of the mall garage and rode home along Lujiazui Ring Road. It was a bit cold on the way, but his mind was still replaying the livestream tips that Lao Wang from the shoe store next door had shared.
location: Super Brand Mall parking lot, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China to Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Dinner and family conversation
description: Arrived home. Today my mother made my favorite braised pork and braised bamboo shoots. At the dinner table, I proactively brought up the declining profits to my father. My father put down his chopsticks and said slowly, 'When the water rises, the boat rises; when the water falls, the boat sinks. Don't fear big waves — the key is to keep a steady hand on the tiller. Think about how to connect your store with online sales.' My mother also advised me to put health first. This meal made me feel much more reassured.
location: Restaurant, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Personal time and organizing notes
description: Helped his mother clear the table, then returned to his room. Instead of immediately contacting Li Na, he opened the memo on his phone and organized the core data he analyzed today, the advice from Lao Wang, and the influencer store cases he had noted into a simple thought note.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: In-depth WeChat conversation with Li Na
description: After sorting out my notes, I sent a WeChat message to my childhood friend Li Na: "Sister Na, I need your help!" Li Na replied instantly, and the two of us switched to a voice call. I explained the analysis and bottlenecks in detail. From her Internet-industry perspective, she strongly suggested making short videos and highly recommended the "online seeding + offline experience" model, sending me several links to Hangzhou cases she thought were reliable. Her exaggerated laughter cracked me up. By the time we hung up, I felt much clearer about the way forward.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Scrolling on my phone and washing up
description: After the call, I tapped open a few links Li Na had sent and thought about the first adjustments to try tomorrow. I got up to wash up, still thinking about the framing of those videos while brushing my teeth.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Fiddling with art toys and falling asleep
description: I turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on. I took out the “Dawn” series blind box and studied the design of the hidden figure closely. The exquisite mechanical feel lifted my mood quite a bit. At 23:30, I turned off the light, thinking about having a few more words with Zhou Tao tomorrow, and also letting off steam with Fei Ge when I play ball at Yuanshen this weekend. Then I fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning preparation and commute
description: The alarm went off at 7:50. Lei Mingxuan washed his face with cold water and did a quick morning routine. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had already put warm milk and boiled eggs on the table. After breakfast, he deliberately changed into the store's new black turtleneck sweater and oversized denim jacket, ready to shoot a short video. He left at 8:10, walked 5 minutes to the bus stop, took bus No. 939, rode for about 22 minutes, and arrived at Super Brand Mall around 8:32. On the way, he opened his phone's memo and sorted out the script framework for the short video.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Early arrival at the store and greeting preparation
description: Arrived at the store half an hour earlier than usual. Lei Mingxuan turned on the lights, adjusted the air conditioning, then pulled over the mobile clothes rack, rearranged the window mannequin's outfit, and put the new batch of American vintage sweatshirts that arrived yesterday in the most prominent position. While working, he played a hip-hop playlist on his phone, feeling a bit lighter than yesterday.
location: Mingxuan Ji store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Idea organization and initial transformation plan draft
description: Lei Mingxuan opened his notebook behind the counter and, while watching the store, repeatedly noted down his thoughts: 1. Pick three hoodies as the featured items for short videos; 2. Design a simple 'store check-in + online interaction' activity; 3. Jot down several Douyin hashtags he wanted to try. His thoughts gradually became clearer, and he drew a checkmark in the corner of the notebook, indicating that the initial draft of the plan was taking shape.
location: Mingxuan Ji store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Had a phone call with supplier Wu Fang.
description: Lei Mingxuan called Wu Fang on WeChat and opened directly: “Sister Fang, I have to trouble you again.” He briefly explained that he wanted to introduce some industrial-style trendy accessories to enhance men's outfit combinations. Wu Fang was very straightforward and recommended three items: an aged silver Cuban link chain, a titanium steel cross bracelet, and a nylon woven wristband, and sent product photos. He noted down the wholesale prices and minimum order quantities, and agreed to look at samples next Monday. The call was efficient and lasted 20 minutes.
location: Mingxuan Ji store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: First attempt at short video shooting
description: While the store was empty, Lei Mingxuan mustered his courage and propped his phone up on the counter stand. He changed into a distressed washed hoodie and, under the light at the store entrance, showed the camera three hoodie-and-accessory outfit combinations. The first take was stuttered, the second was unnatural, and the third was barely acceptable. He shot a 15-second clip showing details and another clip of him turning around to show the back. When he finished, he let out a long sigh of relief, feeling like he had accomplished something major.
location: The "Mingxuan Collection" store at A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the corridor at the store entrance.

name: Lunch, reading, and relaxation
description: Lei Mingxuan locked the store door and walked 14 minutes to the Food Republic on level B1 of Shanghai Tower, where he ordered a plate of old Shanghai-style fried noodles with fried pork chop. After eating, he walked back to Super Brand Mall and, on the way, stopped at the POP MART store on B2. After browsing for ten minutes, he bought a newly released Molly Space Series blind box. He opened it on the way back to the store and got the Capsule model, and he really liked its workmanship and color scheme. Back in the store, he read half an hour of Ming Dynasty 1566 on his Kindle, temporarily setting aside his business anxieties.
location: Food Republic (Shanghai Tower Store), No. 501 Yincheng Middle Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; and POP MART (Super Brand Mall Store), B2, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon reception and deep contemplation
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic picked up. Lei Mingxuan received two groups of customers: the man in a couple was interested in the hoodie he was wearing, so he took the opportunity to show the matching new bracelet; a young office worker shopping alone tried on two T-shirts and bought one. Between serving customers, he opened the memo on his phone and recorded customer feedback — 'want more distinctive designs' and 'the cotton could be better.' At the same time, he searched for Douyin accounts of several menswear space design studios in Shanghai to study their video styles and copywriting.
location: Mingxuan Ji store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Hot drink recharge and peer research
description: There were few customers in the shop at the moment, so Lei Mingxuan decided to clear his head. He went to Seesaw Coffee on the third floor of the mall, ordered a hot latte (less sugar), and sat in a corner seat. He opened WeChat, scrolled through several popular curated fashion shops in Hangzhou and Guangzhou from his follow list, and carefully studied their Moments and Xiaohongshu posts and image styles, focusing on how they displayed clothing details and created atmosphere. He took notes on his phone and screenshotted a few images for reference.
location: Seesaw Coffee, 3F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return to the store, dynamic adjustment and routine maintenance
description: After finishing coffee and returning to the store, he felt much more energized. Business was steady in the afternoon. While handling several online inquiries on his phone, Lei Mingxuan also imported the short video footage he had shot that morning into a mobile editing app and took a rough look at it. He also used his spare time to do a small inventory check of the store, noting down several hoodie styles that were out of stock in popular sizes because customers asked about them often, and planned to contact Zhou Tao in Hangzhou that evening to restock.
location: Mingxuan Ji store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening rush hour and preparing to close the store.
description: Evening rush hour arrived, and several customers who had just gotten off work came into the store. He closed a deal on a basic sweatshirt and a coat. Lei Mingxuan seized the opportunity and proactively chatted with a customer who looked like a designer. The customer recommended a local Shanghai buyer community, and Lei Mingxuan scanned the QR code to join. After 19:00, foot traffic gradually thinned. He greeted property manager Zheng Kai, who was passing by, and chatted a bit about the mall's weekend events. After that, he cleaned up, tidied the fitting room, counted the day's revenue, and took a night photo of the store before closing.
location: Mingxuan Ji store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: The way home after closing the store
description: Lei Mingxuan turned off the lights, locked the door, and walked out of Super Brand Mall. The evening breeze hit his face, refreshing him. He followed Lujiazui West Road, then turned onto Pudong Avenue, and walked about 27 minutes back to Shanggang Community. On the way, he opened the blind box, examined it carefully, took a photo, and sent it to the "Designer Toy Squad" group chat.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and chess with my father
description: When he got home, his mother had already heated up the meal, including braised hairtail fish, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and a bowl of hot soup. While eating, Lei Mingxuan chatted with them about his "first experience" shooting a short video today. His father Lei Jianguo put down his chopsticks and said with a smile, "If you want to do it, just do it. Nobody starts off smoothly. When we were doing technical innovation at the factory, we were also crossing the river by feeling the stones." Warmth rose in his heart. After dinner, he took the initiative to bring out the chessboard from the cabinet and played three games with his father. He didn't do much winning in the first two, but in the third he calmed down and won with a "cannon behind the horse" move. His father nodded repeatedly, saying that the experience from his youth had not been wasted on him. This gradually freed up Lei Mingxuan's thinking.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime editing and personal time
description: After washing up, Lei Mingxuan stayed in his room and imported today's short video clips into the CapCut app. He picked a clip showing the details of the hoodie, added simple instrumental music and the caption 'New fall/winter style, something special,' and scheduled it to publish at 8 a.m. the next day. Then he opened Douyin and spent half an hour scrolling through local store-exploration short videos to get a feel, liking a few good ones. He posted the photo of the 'Capsule' blind box he unboxed during the day to the 'Trendy Toys Squad' group chat. Gao Yuan replied instantly: 'Nice! The water-ripple finish with this color scheme is sick!' He was in a great mood and chatted with Gao Yuan for a while.
location: At home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai - my own room

name: Falling asleep
description: He put away his phone, turned off the light, and lay down. Although the pressure from business was still there, Lei Mingxuan had taken his first step today in making short videos, and playing chess with his father had improved his mindset a lot. He was still somewhat confused, but he began to have a vague sense of direction. He closed his eyes and quickly fell asleep.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast with family
description: On Saturday, he slept in naturally. After waking up at 9, he habitually checked the data for the Douyin outfit video he had scheduled to post the night before. Seeing over 1,000 views and active interaction, he casually replied to comments. Then he washed up and had breakfast with his mother, Wang Xiuying, enjoying egg pancakes, freshly ground soy milk, and salted duck eggs made by his mother. During the meal, he chatted with her and mentioned his plan to go play ball at Yuanshen in the afternoon and his craving for braised pork belly at dinner. His mother smiled and agreed, reminding him to watch his knees.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, Shanggang Residential Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning personal leisure and creative research.
description: After breakfast, he unboxed designer toys in the living room. He opened a Molly Space series blind box, got the 'Capsule' figure, carefully placed it in the display cabinet, took a photo, and sent it to the designer toy fan group. He then studied shop tour videos of curated boutiques on Xiaohongshu, analyzing camera movement and copywriting, and noted down takeaways to prepare for shooting short videos for his own store. Next, he brewed some tea and took a break, and while scrolling through Bilibili he saw a local China-chic multi-brand store with creative displays. He saved the video and sent a voice message recommending it to his cousin Shen Jie, who works in buying and design in Hangzhou.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and basketball gear preparation
description: At noon, he had a simple meal of pickled greens and shredded pork noodles with his mother, deliberately not eating too much to leave room for the afternoon exercise. After eating, he returned to the bedroom, changed into a quick-drying sports T-shirt, basketball shorts, and AJ basketball shoes, checked the basketball's air pressure and adjusted it to the best feel, and neatly placed a large water bottle, towel, Snickers, knee pads, ice pack, and other equipment into his sports bag, fully preparing for the afternoon basketball activity.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, dining room and bedroom at home.

name: Going to Yuanshen Sports Center and warming up
description: At 1 p.m., he put on his earphones, listened to music, and walked from home to Yuanshen Sports Center. As he walked, he thought about coordination tactics with his basketball buddies. About 15 minutes later, he arrived at the outdoor basketball court and met his friend Xie Fei and the other players. They greeted each other with fist bumps and small talk, joking while warming up and stretching, teasing each other about their physical condition. Then they did warm-up exercises like shuttle runs to fully loosen up.
location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Basketball game and post-game relaxation
description: At 2 p.m., they started a 4v4 half-court game. Lei Mingxuan relied on his physical advantage to battle aggressively in the paint, and the game was quite intense. During water breaks on the sideline, he exchanged ideas with Xie Fei about transforming the select shop. Xie Fei suggested strengthening online short-video marketing to drive traffic. After the game, he did a proper leg stretch and applied an ice pack to his right knee to protect the joint. Then he and Xie Fei agreed to play again next Wednesday night, and he joked that Xie Fei should treat him to barbecue.
location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return-trip supplies and relaxing at home
description: After the race, he walked back home along the same route. At the Yanqin Grocery Store near the neighborhood, he bought a bottle of iced Gatorade and a Snickers, and sat on a bench outside the store to quickly refuel. Once home, he immediately took a hot shower to wash off the sweat, changed into comfortable loungewear, relaxed on the sofa, tasted the honeydew melon and dragon fruit his mother had prepared, replied to WeChat messages, and built up energy for dinner.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store near Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; and Shanggang Community at No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner time
description: At 6 p.m., I had dinner with my parents. My mother made her specialty Shanghai-style braised pork, stir-fried choy sum, and tomato egg soup. My father Lei Jianguo opened a bottle of yellow wine, and the two of us chatted over the meal. He asked about my basketball and gave steady advice on my idea of transforming the store. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, home dining room

name: Evening entertainment and online socializing
description: After dinner, he voluntarily cleared the dishes, then curled up on the living room sofa and watched Demon Slayer: Hashira Training Arc on the projector, discussing the plot enthusiastically with his friend Gao Yuan from Hangzhou on WeChat. After finishing the anime, he sent a voice message to his billiard buddy Han Dong, making an appointment to play billiards at World Plaza on Wednesday evening, continuing to enjoy a relaxing weekend night.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening planning and bedtime preparation.
description: Back in the bedroom, I used my tablet to list next week's to-dos, including a video call with Wu Fang to look at samples, brainstorming short-video topics, and reviewing billiards techniques. Then I browsed a designer toy forum and kept an eye on new release announcements. Before bed, I made a cup of hot milk, did some simple neck and shoulder exercises, and checked Douyin data again. Seeing the likes close to 400, I was satisfied, set an alarm for 11 p.m., and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lazy wake-up and a loving brunch
description: On Sunday morning, the alarm went off at 9:30, but the bed was cozy. After lingering in bed for a while, he smelled the aroma of pan-fried pork buns wafting from the kitchen and only then got up to wash up. When he sat down at the table, his mother, Wang Xiuying, had already prepared pan-fried pork buns with crispy bottoms and full meat fillings, plus hot soy milk. Lei Mingxuan ate six in one go, wiped his mouth contentedly, and felt that the weekend had truly begun.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Accompanied mother to the vegetable market and discussed family matters
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan proactively walked with his mother about 15 minutes to the Pushang vegetable market to buy groceries and also aid digestion. His mother was in a good mood, picking fresh winter bamboo shoots and pork belly while discussing preparations for the Spring Festival goods. Lei Mingxuan hooked his arm through his mother's, helped her carry the shopping bags, and bought a bag of hot sugar-roasted chestnuts for her when passing the chestnut stall.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning Home and Preparing
description: After returning home, Lei Mingxuan helped his mother carry the groceries into the kitchen, where his father Lei Jianguo was preparing his specialty dishes. He washed his hands, brewed a cup of tea, sat on the living room sofa, and scrolled through the comments on his shop's Douyin account, replying to several fans who had asked about sizes.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family Lunch: Local Shanghainese Flavor
description: At noon, his father served carefully prepared Shanghai-style braised pork and salted pork and bamboo shoot soup. The braised pork was glossy red and rich without being greasy; the soup was deliciously fresh, and the bamboo shoots were tender and crisp. Lei Mingxuan was full of praise. He peeled a few sugar-roasted chestnuts to accompany his meal, but to control his weight he only took an extra half bowl of rice, explaining to his parents that he needed to watch out since he had been exercising less lately.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday rest and entertainment.
description: After the meal, Lei Mingxuan helped his mother clear the dishes, then curled up on the living room sofa to watch an NBA replay. After a while, his eyelids grew heavy, so he closed his eyes and took a half-hour nap. After the short rest, he felt much more energetic in the afternoon.
location: Living room sofa at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon rollerblading: speed and cold wind
description: After his lunch break, Lei Mingxuan put on roller skates and protective gear and headed to the Lujiazui Riverside Central Walkway. It takes about 45 minutes on foot from home, but only about ten minutes on roller skates. That afternoon it was cloudy and windy, with temperatures of 2-8°C, a bit chilly. He adjusted his breathing and skated along the riverside path, listening to the sound of wheels and wind, admiring the Bund buildings across the Huangpu River, feeling relaxed.
location: Lujiazui Riverside Center Promenade, No. 1-12, Lane 257, Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Unboxing blind boxes and a new favorite
description: After roller skating, Lei Mingxuan went home, poured a glass of warm water, and went into the study to unbox the two SP-series blind boxes that had arrived two days earlier. He pulled the Painter style and the Dancer style, both finely crafted. He eagerly rearranged the display cabinet, put the new blind boxes in a prominent position, took close-up photos with his phone, and sent them to the Trendy Toy Squad group chat to show off.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading novels and brainstorming video ideas
description: After fiddling with the blind boxes, Lei Mingxuan curled up in his chair and used his iPad to continue reading the final chapters of The Longest Day in Chang'an. When he finished, to prepare for the next day's video sample viewing with Fang Jie from Guangzhou and the short-video topic selection for the store, he opened Bilibili to watch unboxing and display videos by creators, jotting down ideas in his notebook, including 'combining industrial-style outfits with designer toys and figures' and 'one minute to learn how to decorate a store corner with blind boxes.'
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dinner and casual family chat.
description: At dinner, his mother stir-fried a few light dishes and served them with the leftover braised pork and salted pork and bamboo shoot soup from noon. While eating, Lei Mingxuan chatted with his parents about today's roller skating experiences and blind box styles. His father reminded him to ask more about materials and craftsmanship when talking to the Guangzhou supplier tomorrow, and not to be fooled.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online anime exchange and tactical discussion
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan went back to the study, opened QQ, and chatted with his close friend Gao Yuan in Hangzhou about the anime they were following, The Undying Girl's Murder Farce. The two had opposite views on where the plot was heading and had a heated discussion in the chat window for over an hour. Gao Yuan also recommended several new anime with good art and storylines, and Lei Mingxuan noted them down one by one to watch this week.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reviewing the store and making plans.
description: After talking with Gao Yuan, Lei Mingxuan opened his MacBook, logged into the store backend, and checked this week's sales data and inventory. Combining the transformation ideas discussed earlier with Fei Ge and the video call with Fang Jie the next day, he created a new document in Notes to organize the key points for communication: sample minimum order quantity, discount policy, whether complete outfit solutions can be provided, etc.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation and stretching
description: Lei Mingxuan left his desk and went to the living room to watch the news with his parents. His mother peeled an apple for him. During the commercial break, he spread a yoga mat on the floor and did a set of stretches to relax his sore calves after the afternoon roller skating, and planned to resume his morning run the next day.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Washing up
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, Lei Mingxuan weighed himself. At 80 kilograms, it was about the same as yesterday, showing that his diet control was working. He looked at his belly in the mirror and resolved to go to the gym near the Standard Chartered Bank Tower more often next week.
location: Bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Saying goodnight and falling asleep
description: After turning off the lights and lying down, Lei Mingxuan went over the next day's to-do list in his mind: arrive at the Super Brand Mall store before 9 a.m., have a video call with Sister Fang to look at samples at 10, sort the shelves in the afternoon, and maintain his roller skates in the evening... As he thought, he gradually fell asleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up in the morning and family breakfast
description: At 8 a.m. on Monday, the phone alarm rang on time. Outside, the sky was gloomy with a light drizzle, and it felt damp and cold. Lei Mingxuan turned over and sat up. He did a few minutes of simple stretching in bed to wake his body, then used the scale on the nightstand to weigh himself. It showed 80.1 kg, which meant he had maintained it well. He then went into the bathroom and took a hot shower, letting the steam dispel his sleepiness. After drying off, he put on a thick turtleneck sweater and jeans. When he came to the dining room, his mother, Wang Xiuying, had already cooked hot plain rice congee, served with soy-pickled cucumbers and pork floss. Lei Mingxuan sat down and ate a bowl, and his stomach immediately warmed up. His father, Lei Jianguo, was reading a newspaper nearby and casually asked whether the store would be busy today. Lei Mingxuan replied that he had to video call Sister Fang in Guangzhou in the morning to look at new samples. His parents nodded to show they understood.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking commute to the store
description: At 8:50, Lei Mingxuan cleaned up the dishes, checked the communication points he had organized in his phone memo the night before, grabbed a folding umbrella, put on his windproof and waterproof shell jacket, locked the door, and walked to Super Brand Mall. There was a strong wind on the way, but with his coat wrapped tight he didn't feel too cold, and he was already thinking through the day's work arrangements.
location: Along the route from Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to 168 West Lujiazui Road

name: Store opening preparation and display arrangement.
description: Arrived at his shop, Room A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall at 9:05. The first thing after opening the door was to turn on the heating. The shop felt a bit stuffy after being closed for the two weekend days, so Lei Mingxuan took out his phone, connected to the Bluetooth speaker, and played an upbeat playlist to refresh the mood. Using the time before opening, he started organizing the shelves, unpacking the American vintage sweatshirts that had arrived last week one by one, ironing out the wrinkles with a steam garment steamer, and placing them in the most prominent spot at the entrance. Then he wiped the display case glass and adjusted the display angles of the designer toys and accessories to ensure a balanced visual effect.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Video call with a Guangzhou supplier to check samples
description: At 9:40, Lei Mingxuan sent a WeChat message to Guangzhou supplier Wu Fang (Sister Fang) ahead of time to confirm the video call time, and she replied that it was convenient. At 9:50, he sat down at the counter and opened the video call. With a Guangzhou wholesale stall in the background, Sister Fang enthusiastically showed three industrial-style samples: an aged metal necklace, a techwear belt buckle, and a minimalist ring. Lei Mingxuan looked carefully and asked about the materials, plating process, wear resistance, minimum order quantity, and mixed-batch policy for each item. Sister Fang answered fluently, saying all these styles were designed for young people and had no durability issues. In the end, Lei Mingxuan made a preliminary decision to test the waters with 20 pieces of each style and asked Sister Fang to send the formal quotation to WeChat. After ending the video call, he recorded the key points and items to confirm (such as delivery lead time) in his memo.
location: In front of the counter of Store A-208 on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Attending to regular customers and online operations
description: At 10:40, two regular customers who had been in a few times before pushed the door open, wanting to pick out new clothes for the New Year. Lei Mingxuan immediately went up to greet them and, based on their body types and styles, recommended the newly arrived black tech down jackets and thick hoodies, and offered styling advice. After trying them on, one of the women bought a down jacket, and the other also added a pair of cargo pants. After making the sale, he felt a bit better. After seeing the customers off, Lei Mingxuan returned to the counter and, during the lull, replied to several online inquiries and updated the store's WeChat Moments post for today.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Workday lunch and ski plan response
description: Near noon, Lei Mingxuan decided to go eat. He locked the store door first and went to the Kajiken Nagoya Ramen at the food court on B1 of the mall, ordering a hot bowl of tonkotsu chashu ramen with a soft-boiled egg. After sitting down in a corner, he ate noodles while scrolling through his phone. He first quickly skimmed the store's backend sales data, then opened the “Pudong Inline Skating Street Cruise Group” and happened to see a group member, Song Jia (Jiajia), post a message suggesting a weekend ski trip to Anji, along with a preliminary plan and a link to a ski resort introduction. Lei Mingxuan felt a spark of interest, quickly wolfed down the noodles, and immediately replied in the group, “I'm in! Count me in!” He then privately messaged Song Jia to confirm the details. Song Jia replied that the plan was set for January 11 to 12, the Pudong meeting point was at the exit of Century Park Metro Station, and they had chosen Anji Guanyintang Ski Resort, which is beginner-friendly. Lei Mingxuan agreed at once and asked her to send him the exact meeting time once it was confirmed, instantly feeling excited. After that, he cleared his tray, left the food court, and returned to the store.

participant.name: Song Jia
participant.relation: Fellow members of the roller skating group

location: Kajiken Nagoya Ramen, food court, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return to the store
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to the store from the food court, put his backpack under the counter, and although he had not officially started work yet, he had already begun calculating in his mind what equipment he needed to prepare for the weekend skiing.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon: looking after the shop and researching skiing guides
description: In the afternoon, several groups of walk-in customers came one after another. Some just browsed around. A young man tried on a hoodie but didn't buy it. Lei Mingxuan skillfully recommended matching styles; although the man didn't buy anything, Lei felt relaxed. When the store wasn't busy, Lei Mingxuan took out his phone and immersed himself in researching skiing guides for Anji. He opened Xiaohongshu and Douyin and searched keywords such as "Anji Guanyintang Skiing" and "Beginner Ski Equipment Checklist", browsing several guide posts. The more he watched, the more excited he became. He opened his phone notes and began listing the equipment he needed: ski goggles, knee pads, gloves, thick sports socks, windproof masks, and so on. He focused on ski goggles, adding several products from Decathlon and Nanen to his shopping cart to compare prices and specifications.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store, tidying up, and posting on social media
description: At 5:20 p.m., Lei Mingxuan glanced out the window. The rain had stopped, but the sky was overcast and the streetlights were just coming on. Even though the store had no big orders that day, his mood was completely ignited by the weekend skiing plans. He began tidying the counter early, counting the day's revenue, and recording it in the ledger. Then he took out his phone, used the newly arranged display as a backdrop, took several photos of the newly arrived hoodies and cargo pants, carefully edited them, and posted to his Moments: 'New stock has arrived, gearing up for the weekend!' along with a snow mountain emoji. Before long, friends such as Qian Duoduo and Song Jia liked it and left comments.

participant.name: Song Jia
participant.relation: Fellow members of the roller skating group

location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After work, returning home and shopping at a convenience store
description: At 6 p.m., the mall traffic gradually thinned, and Lei Mingxuan decided to close the store early. He gave the floor a quick sweep, turned off the display lights, checked the power one last time, and wrote a small list of things to handle tomorrow, sticking it on the cash register. At 6:10 he locked the store door on time and headed home. On the way, he stopped at the FamilyMart convenience store at the corner (Zhangyang Third Store), bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea, and continued walking home.
location: FamilyMart (Zhangyang No. 3 Store), Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Resting at home and family dinner
description: About 20 minutes later, Lei Mingxuan arrived home. The warmth in the hallway and the aroma of home-cooked food made him feel very relaxed. His mother was setting out bowls and chopsticks, and several home-style dishes were already on the table, with a steaming pot of pork rib soup standing out. Lei Mingxuan changed into loungewear and sat down at the dining table, then eagerly told his parents about his plan to go skiing in Anji over the weekend. His mother was a little worried and reminded him to keep warm because it was cold outside; his father put down his chopsticks and, with a serious expression, told him to take it easy on the slopes and stay safe. Lei Mingxuan smiled and assured his father that he would wear all his protective gear and follow the coach's instructions. His mother then asked if he needed to bring some thick socks. He said no, but felt a warm surge in his heart.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening family time and helping with cleanup
description: During the meal, Lei Mingxuan had an extra bowl of rice and chatted with his parents about the day's events at the store and his excitement about responding to his friend's ski plan; the atmosphere was harmonious. After the meal, he voluntarily helped his mother clear the table and wash the dishes. Then he watched TV news with his parents in the living room for a while, and while doing so, finished the sugar-free oolong tea he had just bought.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep gear research and relaxation
description: At 8 p.m., Lei Mingxuan returned to his room, took a shower, changed into loose home wear, and lay comfortably on his bed. He opened JD.com and Taobao on his phone and began seriously researching ski equipment: he compared several pairs of ski goggles from Decathlon and Nanen again, hesitated for a while, and decided to ask Song Jia or other experienced friends the next day before placing an order. He also looked at knee pads and gloves and added them to his favorites. Because he had been sitting for long periods and walking a lot, his lower back felt a little sore, so he got up and paced around the room for ten minutes, doing a few bends and stretches, and felt his muscles and joints loosen up. At 9 p.m., he leaned against the headboard, opened his memo, and confirmed the next day's (January 7) tasks: first, wait for the formal quotation sent by Sister Fang; second, update the new product information on the store's online page. Then he enthusiastically reviewed the weekend skiing guide over and over, feeling delighted.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wash up and get ready for bed
description: At 9:30 p.m., Lei Mingxuan put down his phone and went to the bathroom to wash up. Looking at himself in the mirror, his face still carried the anticipation of weekend skiing.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: Lei Mingxuan set an alarm for 8 a.m. the next morning, then turned off the light and lay down. Even with his eyes closed, his mind was still imagining the thrill of speeding down the ski slope on the weekend. In this excited and expectant mood, drowsiness gradually crept in, and he fell asleep peacefully.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and breakfast
description: At 7:50 in the morning, you woke up to the sound of rain, lingered in bed for 5 minutes, then got up and washed up. Your mother, Wang Xiuying, had already prepared steaming hot soy milk and freshly fried dough sticks. While eating breakfast, you browsed ski equipment reviews on your phone and confirmed that the items in your shopping cart from last night were correct.
location: Room 502, No. 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting and shopping on the way
description: You put on a waterproof shell jacket, took a folding umbrella, and walked from home to the clothing store at Super Brand Mall. On the way, at the Jin Mao Tower convenience store on Lujiazui Ring Road, you bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea and a pack of mints to refresh yourself.
location: Convenience store at Jin Mao Tower, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai (on the walking commute)

name: Store morning meeting and organizing new arrivals.
description: After arriving at Lei Mingxuan's clothing store on the second floor of Super Brand Mall, you turn on the lights and start the cash register system. Together with employee Xiao Lin, you unpack the newly arrived fleece hoodies, trim loose threads, and check styles and quantities. You guide Xiao Lin to refold and display the dark green and oatmeal-colored featured items, and adjust the mannequins in the window, changing them into warm-toned scarves to highlight the winter warmth theme.
location: No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Unit A-208, Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

name: Collaborative tasks and sample review
description: While there were no customers in the store for the moment, you sat at the cashier counter organizing the industrial-style sample photos you had looked at yesterday with Guangzhou supplier Wu Fang, including antique-finish necklaces and tech belts. You sent the photos to your cousin Shen Jie via WeChat and sent a voice message asking which styles would match the hoodies and cargo pants in the store. Then you contacted supplier Wu Fang again to follow up on the quotation.
location: No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Unit A-208, Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

name: Discussed a co-branded event with the owner of the neighboring milk tea shop
description: You wandered over to the milk tea shop at A-207 next door and chatted with the owner, Brother Li, who was testing a new flavor. You proposed a joint promotion: customers buying milk tea could get a discount coupon at the clothing store, or buying clothes would come with a free hot drink. The two of you reached an agreement on a plan to “share discounts with each other’s receipts,” and you planned to design the promotional poster after returning to the store.
location: Milk tea shop, No. A-207, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lunch
description: You went alone to Fujian Authentic Shaxian Snacks on the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall, ordered steamed dumplings and a tea tree mushroom stew pot, and quickly finished them in a corner. While eating, you browsed the ski group chat on your phone. Seeing everyone discussing the weekend snow conditions, you felt excited about skiing.
location: Fujian Authentic Shaxian Snacks, No. 538 Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon at the shop and hosting regular customers
description: After the meal, you returned to the store and let Xiao Lin go eat. In the afternoon, there weren't many customers. While watching the store, you compared several ski goggles (Decathlon G-SKI and Nanen) and protective gear in terms of price, reviews, and anti-fog performance, then added them to the cart. Around 14:00, a regular customer of designer toys you had arranged to meet arrived. You led him to the display cabinet, unboxed the newly received SP series blind boxes, and the two of you chatted happily about hidden figures and industry trends.
location: No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Unit A-208, Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

name: Placed an order for ski equipment.
description: After seeing off the regular customer, you decided to follow through on buying ski gear. You ordered Decathlon G-SKI sports sunglasses (299 yuan) on Taobao. Then on JD.com, you found the protective gear set recommended by your friend Song Jia. After carefully comparing customer photos and sizes, you placed the order as well. Both orders used standard shipping and are expected to arrive Thursday. After handling the orders, you felt even more excited about the upcoming ski trip.
location: No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Unit A-208, Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

name: Preparing for the evening rush and tidying the store.
description: The rain was gradually easing, and the evening rush hour was approaching. You and Xiao Lin together re-steamed and re-hung the clothes customers had tried on in the afternoon, counted inventory, and noted the styles that needed restocking next week. During a lull, you stood at the store entrance, watching the pedestrian flow increase, and mulled over the specific implementation of the co-branded event.
location: No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Unit A-208, Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

name: Left work early to go to Decathlon.
description: You asked Xiao Lin to stay and watch the store until 8 p.m., and left work early yourself. You drove from Super Brand Mall to the Decathlon Jinqiao store at 600 Lantian Road, planning to try on ski goggles in person.
location: Decathlon Jinqiao Store, 600 Lantian Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (on the way)

name: Trying on ski goggles at Decathlon
description: After arriving at the Decathlon Jinqiao store, you went straight to the ski goggles section, only to find that the G-SKI model you wanted was sold out, with only a display unit left. You tried on the sample, confirmed the size and fit, noted the model number, and felt relieved that you had already placed the order online.
location: Decathlon Jinqiao Store, 600 Lantian Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Driving home
description: You drove back to the Shanggang residential community from Decathlon. The rain had stopped, and the air was filled with the smell of damp earth. You parked in the community's underground garage and went upstairs.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: When you got home, your father Lei Jianguo had already made stir-fried rice cakes with cabbage and shredded pork, and tomato and egg soup. The family sat around the table eating. You talked about the store that day and the idea for the co-branding event. Your father said you could try it, and your mother told you not to stay up late.
location: Dining room at home, Room 502, No. 12, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Confirm the order and report progress to friends.
description: After the meal, you went into the study, opened your laptop, and confirmed that the orders on Taobao and JD.com had all been shipped. Then you sent a message to your friend Song Jia on WeChat, telling her that the ski goggles and protective gear had been ordered, and asking which slope at Anji Guanyintang Ski Resort was suitable for beginners, hoping for a recommendation.
location: Home study, Room 502, No. 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online Socializing and Confirming Cooperation
description: You saw the long voice message from your cousin Shen Jie, and thought the techwear belt buckles and minimalist rings were pretty good, worth testing with a small batch. You replied with thanks and decided to arrange the order this week. Afterwards, you also contacted your cousin Yang Fan, who is equally into skiing, to ask if he had plans to go skiing this weekend, telling him that you had already bought your gear.
location: Home study, Room 502, No. 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Home workout.
description: You changed into sports shorts, spread out a yoga mat in the living room, and, thinking that the weekend skiing would require stamina, decided to do some exercise. First, do 3 sets of push-ups (15 each), then a 2-minute plank, and finally spend 10 minutes stretching your leg muscles and back. After a bit of exercise, you were slightly sweaty and felt your muscles and joints loosened up.

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and rest

location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Yuanshen Sports Center basketball competition
description: Took a taxi about 15 minutes to the basketball court at Yuanshen Sports Center. My basketball buddies Xie Fei, Brother Fei and others were already warming up. We played 4v4 half-court games today; I was hot in the paint and kept scoring on strong post moves. During a break, I told Brother Fei about the declining foot traffic at my clothing store. He suggested trying some small events in the store to attract people, such as sneaker culture exchanges. After the games, we stretched together. Xie Fei said he would bring a new friend next Saturday, and I said he was more than welcome.
location: No. 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Yuanshen Sports Center Basketball Court

name: Returned home to bathe and rest
description: Sweaty after playing ball, I took a taxi home, and on the way I felt great with the window open and the wind blowing. Once home, I first gulped down a big glass of water, then took a hot shower and felt comfortable all over. I changed into clean casual hoodie and jeans, ready for the evening hotpot gathering.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Long hot pot conversation with childhood friend Zhang Wei
description: After resting at home for a while, I walked to Machang Old Hot Pot (Lujiazui branch). By the time I arrived, my childhood friend Zhang Wei had already ordered the half-spicy, half-mild hot pot base and a few bottles of beer. As we chatted warmly while boiling tripe, I explained in detail the recent drop in customer traffic at my clothing store. Zhang Wei, truly a marketing man, opened my eyes with his words: he suggested that I build a personal brand and attract young people through short videos on Douyin and Xiaohongshu. He also did the math for me, noting that if I wanted a full upgrade, I would need to set aside at least 200,000 to 300,000 yuan. I jotted down several key points in my phone memo, including renovation style and online operation ideas. Zhang Wei also mentioned that he might be sent on assignment to Singapore in March, and I joked that we would need to get together a few more times before he left. That hot pot meal was thoroughly enjoyable and rewarding.
location: Machang Old Hotpot (Lujiazui Branch), Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went home and recorded ideas for the store transformation
description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Wei, I walked home, and the cold wind made my head clearer. As soon as I got home, I opened my laptop and typed up Zhang Wei's suggestions point by point into a document titled “Store Transformation Action Plan,” with keywords including personal IP, a 200,000-300,000 yuan budget, and Douyin/Xiaohongshu. I then searched Bilibili and Xiaohongshu for short-video operation cases about clothing store renovations and community cafés, and thought about spatial design inspiration. Meanwhile, I received a WeChat message from Zhou Tao, a collaborating fabric supplier, saying that samples of five functional-fabric styles had been shipped from Hangzhou and were expected to arrive at the store on Monday. I replied with thanks and felt even more excited about the store transformation.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Excited planning before bed
description: After washing up, I lay in bed with my mind full of what the renovated store would look like. I went over next week's plan in my head: on Monday, study the fabric samples carefully after they arrive; on Tuesday, go to Julu Road to browse concept stores for inspiration; on Wednesday, invite my cousin Shen Jie to dinner and talk about product selection. The more I thought about it, the more excited I got. I kept scrolling on my phone until almost 1 a.m. before dozing off.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: He woke up naturally to the sound of pattering rain, put on a robe, and walked to the kitchen, where his mother, Wang Xiuying, was cooking noodles with greens and shredded pork; the broth smelled of lard and chopped scallions. He had a glass of warm water first, then sat down at the dining table. While eating noodles, he chatted with his mother about what he had gained from the hotpot dinner with Zhang Wei the night before, and his mother teased him for coming home late. During the meal, he received a WeChat reply from his cousin Shen Jie, who asked about afternoon tea next week; he replied and set it for Saturday afternoon. He then continued chatting with his mother over small talk. His mother said she wanted to buy spring bamboo shoots after the rain stopped, and he promised to accompany her. He ate a full bowl of noodles and added half a bowl of soup. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home (kitchen and dining room) in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Planning the budget for the clothing store transformation in the study.
description: After entering the study, I opened my laptop, set up a small whiteboard, and began systematically planning the budget for transforming the clothing store into a collection store combining "mountain-style techwear + coffee + personal IP". I listed several core dimensions: renovation and merchandise, 150,000 yuan, for remodeling the store's functional zones, purchasing new mountain-style techwear samples, and upgrading display props; coffee equipment and materials, 25,000 yuan, to buy a used entry-level commercial espresso machine, a burr grinder, and cups and consumables; initial short-video investment, 30,000 yuan, for a smartphone gimbal, fill lights, simple set props, and a small amount of feed-ad testing costs; and a revolving reserve fund of 45,000 yuan. I opened Excel and broke down each item into specific line entries, noted the funding sources — 150,000 yuan of existing store cash-flow surplus and 100,000 yuan from personal savings account. During this, I poured myself a cup of jasmine tea, and by 11 o'clock I completed the initial budget framework.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Call cousin Shen Jie and unwind
description: He called his cousin Shen Jie and excitedly told her about his transformation idea of "mountain-style functional fashion + coffee + personal IP", mentioning that after talking with Zhang Wei last night, the thinking was clearer. Shen Jie was very interested on the other end of the line, praised the idea as very trendy and exactly hitting young people's itch point. The two agreed to meet for a detailed discussion next Saturday afternoon (January 18) at a coffee concept store called "Yilingwu" on Julu Road in Jing'an District. Shen Jie said she had a few good domestic designer brand resources and could bring materials and case studies. The call lasted about 18 minutes, and both kept saying yes. After hanging up, he curled up on the living room sofa to relax, picked up his phone, scrolled through Bilibili's homepage, saw a short video titled "Mountain-style clothing item recommendations", and casually saved it to favorites. Then he went into the kitchen to help his mother check the heat of the Yanduxian soup. His mother taught him to use chopsticks to poke the bamboo shoot tips to judge doneness, and he took the chance to sip some broth, praising it repeatedly.
location: Home study, living room sofa, and kitchen, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family lunch.
description: At noon, his mother brought out a big pot of steaming yanduxian. The broth was milky white, and spring bamboo shoots and cured pork complemented each other perfectly. His father, Lei Jianguo, also sat down, and the family of three chatted while eating. He drank two bowls of the soup and ate rice to his heart's content, along with the dishes his father picked for him. After the meal, he took the initiative to help his mother clear the dishes, then went back to the bedroom for a nap.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday break and phone browsing
description: Before his lunchtime nap, he leaned half-reclined against the headboard and browsed Xiaohongshu, specifically searching for mountain-style store decoration cases. He focused on several renovation vlogs with over 10,000 likes and jotted down in his notes app the method of pairing natural wood-colored shelves with green plants. He also sent a WeChat message to Xiao Lin, the store clerk, telling her that he would be at the store the next afternoon and reminding her to be on the lookout the next morning for the fabric samples sent by Zhou Tao. Then he took a proper nap of about 25 minutes. When he woke up, he felt much more refreshed and no longer groggy.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Change clothes and head out to the barbershop
description: Changed into a dark gray hoodie, black cargo pants, and sneakers, and grabbed a black long-handled umbrella at the entrance. Before leaving, her mother told her to come back early and said dinner would be steamed sea bass; she agreed. Walking through the central garden of Shanggang Community, with the rain not heavy, she walked under the umbrella. On the way, she ran into Aunt Zhang from the neighborhood walking her dog, greeted her, and arrived at Lao Chen's Barbershop at the east gate of the community about 10 minutes later.
location: Internal roads and central garden, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Haircut and chat.
description: Walking into his usual barbershop run by Lao Chen, the barber Lao Chen greeted him, “Mingxuan is here! A little shorter today?” He said that just thinning it out and trimming it to look sharper would be fine. During the haircut, they talked about Lao Chen's son having recently started roller skating, so they exchanged views on roller skate selection and protective gear recommendations. He mentioned that he had bought a set of Decathlon protective gear last week, and Lao Chen nodded repeatedly and took notes. After the cut, he looked in the mirror and felt much more refreshed, and paid 35 yuan by scanning the QR code with satisfaction.
location: Old Chen's Barbershop, East Gate, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Collected store design inspiration after returning home.
description: After getting a haircut, walked home slowly. The rain had stopped and the air was fresh. Passing by the convenience store at the entrance of the community, bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea and a pack of mints. Back home, went straight to the study, used the iPad Pro to systematically browse Pinterest and Xiaohongshu, searching keywords such as "mountain-style clothing store decor," "techwear store design," "coffee + clothing concept store," and swiped through a large number of real case photos. While viewing, took notes in the memo app, jotting down a Chongqing store's combination of gray micro-cement walls with metal hanging rods, and a Hangzhou store's idea of setting up a coffee bar in the corner with moss and rocks as landscape decoration. Bookmarked nearly 30 cases, planning to send them to Shen Jie next week for discussion. During this, brewed a cup of black tea, drinking and browsing, and the ideas became clearer.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Opening blind boxes and organizing the display cabinet
description: He came out of the study to clear his head and walked to the designer toy display cabinet in the living room, where nearly twenty blind boxes from the SP series were already on display. He opened a 'Winter Limited' series blind box that he hadn't had time to open before, and pulled the hidden 'Snowfield Hunter' figure. He got excited instantly, took a photo, and posted it in the designer toy group to show off. Then he spent more than twenty minutes rearranging the display cabinet, putting the new pieces in prominent positions, and also filmed a 5-second display video for Moments with the caption 'New member reporting in,' which earned quite a few likes.
location: In front of the living room display cabinet at home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and helping in the kitchen
description: I went into the kitchen to help mother pick vegetables. She was preparing steamed sea bass, garlic water spinach, and tomato egg drop soup. While picking vegetables, we chatted about getting a haircut in the afternoon and searching for cases. Mother smiled and praised me for being energetic. At dinner, the family sat around the table. I picked up the sea bass belly meat and, while eating, talked to my father about the plan to visit supplier Zhou Tao in Hangzhou next week. Father had worked in purchasing when he was young and shared his business trip experience: first impressions matter when talking to people, your attitude should be sincere but not too soft. I listened carefully, nodding and taking notes. Father also said I could borrow his Passat if I went to Hangzhou; I smiled and said I'd see. The dinner was plentiful and warm. I ate one and a half bowls of rice and drank two bowls of soup.
location: The kitchen and dining room at home in Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-meal rest and phone socializing
description: After dinner, he sat on the living room sofa and scrolled through his phone. He first replied to the @message in the designer toy group, then saw his childhood friend Zhang Wei's WeChat Moments post about watching a movie at home, and commented, “Staying in on Sunday too?” After that, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu for a while and looked at the titles of recommended videos about “building a personal IP” on Bilibili, getting warmed up for the evening course.
