location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Prepare study supplies
description: Walking into the study, he opened his laptop and found the link to the 'Introduction to Short Video Marketing' course he had favorited on Bilibili. He took out a new notebook and two pens of different colors, refilled the teacup on the desk with hot water, and got everything ready before the lesson.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Watch a short video marketing course and take notes.
description: He started from the first lesson of the course. The videos were 45 minutes long in total and covered the algorithm logic of platforms and the foundation of content planning. While listening, he took notes, writing down key points such as "completion rate is the core of initial screening," "the first 3 seconds need a hook," and "a consistent persona matters more than vertical content." He kept pausing to digest key concepts and then noted them down in his own words. Midway through the course, he went to the living room to pour a glass of warm water. By 9:30 p.m., he had finished three lessons and filled five full pages of his notebook, including key points like "define your persona tags before starting an account" and "the three elements of BGM selection." He found it very rewarding.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sort out learning insights and the next day's plan
description: Instead of immediately closing the laptop, he sorted out the key points learned this evening in his memo and planned the next day's work: after arriving at the store at 10 AM, first receive the fabric samples sent by Zhou Tao, photograph and record each one; then check with Xiao Lin on the window display progress; in the afternoon, find time to start drafting a script for a 30-second self-introduction short video. He wrote all this in his phone memo and set a 9:30 reminder for tomorrow's to-do list to make sure everything was well organized.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up
description: They went to the bathroom to wash their face and brush their teeth, carefully cleansed their face with facial cleanser, and applied moisturizing lotion. While brushing their teeth, they looked at their newly cut hair in the mirror and nodded in satisfaction, feeling refreshed and energetic.
location: Bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading before bed and preparing for sleep
description: After changing into his pajamas, he leaned back against the headboard and picked up The Siege of Kaifeng, reading about 15 pages. When he reached the chapter on Li Gang defending the city, he fell into thought. At around 10:40 p.m., he closed the book, placed it on the bedside table, and picked up his phone to set the alarm for 8:30 the next morning. He made sure to confirm two items: "pick up samples at the store in the morning" and "add keywords for the short-video script to the memo." Then he sent a WeChat message to Xiao Lin, the store clerk, saying he would arrive at the store at around 10:30 the next day, and that the samples should be unpacked and not left lying around. Xiao Lin replied, "Got it, boss." He turned off the main light and left only the bedside lamp on. Reflecting, he felt that although he hadn't gone far today, everything that needed to be done was done—budget, inspiration, and study had all made progress—and he felt at ease. Lying on his side, listening to the rain outside gradually fade, he fell into a light sleep within a few minutes.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wash-up and social coordination
description: After the alarm went off, Lei Mingxuan got up quickly and washed up to refresh himself. He then coordinated with his friends Song Jia and Xie Fei in the skiing group about the timing for next Saturday's ski trip to Anji, successfully arranging the morning session. Meanwhile, he sent a WeChat message to his cousin Shen Jie to meet at "105" on Julu Road at two o'clock Saturday afternoon, making initial arrangements for the weekend activities.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Having breakfast with mother and sharing work inspiration
description: Lei Mingxuan had breakfast with his mother, Wang Xiuying. Over the meal, he talked about the techwear fabric samples sent today by Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao, and his idea of creating a camping-style coffee corner in the shop. His mother smiled and gave him encouragement and support, and the family atmosphere was warm.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking Commute and Exercise Fuel
description: Wearing a black hoodie and cargo pants and carrying a backpack, he set off from home and walked along Pudong Avenue to his workplace, Super Brand Mall. Passing by Jin Mao Tower, he bought two bottles of Gatorade sports drink at the FamilyMart convenience store on the B1 floor to build up energy reserves for the afternoon run.
location: FamilyMart, B1, Jin Mao Tower, No. 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Opening the shop and inspecting fabric samples.
description: After arriving at Super Brand Mall, he opened the rolling shutter door and turned on the lights, and tidied up the cashier area. At 9:40, the SF Express courier delivered the package on time. Lei Mingxuan opened it right away and received five samples of functional fabric (three water-repellent nylon and two stretch composite fabrics). He photographed them from different angles with his phone, recorded the weight, feel, and color, and saved them to the 'sample library' on his phone with sources noted, preparing for future product development.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Discussed store renovation inspiration with creative partner Qian Duoduo
description: Qian Duoduo arrived at the store on time wearing a self-designed mountain-style vest, and the two sat on the sofa for an in-depth exchange. Qian Duoduo showed photos from recent visits to distinctive coffee shops in Shanghai (such as O.P.S. on Yongjia Road and Sansan Dejiu on Julu Road), sharing experience in attracting young people with specialty drinks, stories, and check-in appeal. Lei Mingxuan, in turn, showed collected store decoration photos of brands such as Arc’teryx and The North Face. The two hit it off and settled on a preliminary plan to create a camping-style coffee bar in the corner of the store, blending mountain-style functional wear aesthetics with a community coffee atmosphere.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Coordinate weekend plans online
description: After seeing Qian Duoduo off, Lei Mingxuan immediately searched for "mountain-style techwear store design" on his phone and saved photos of brand stores like DOE and Element as references. Then he saw Song Jia confirm in the skiing group that the morning session was feasible, so he messaged his cousin Shen Jie to finalize the meeting at Julu Road at 2 p.m. on Saturday. Shen Jie replied "OK," and the two weekend activities were finally linked up.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Healthy light lunch and a nap
description: Locked the store door, went down to the Super Bowl light meal shop on B1 of Super Brand Mall, and ordered a teriyaki chicken breast salad (light dressing) and a freshly squeezed kale and pear juice. While eating, I browsed cases on Xiaohongshu about 'mountain-style outfits' and 'community coffee shops' for inspiration. After the meal, I leaned back in the chair and rested with my eyes closed for ten minutes to regain energy for the afternoon run.
location: Super Bowl Light Food Restaurant, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Changing running gear and handing over to the store staff
description: After returning to the store, he changed into Asics running shoes, put his phone in an armband, and brought a bottle of Gatorade. Before leaving, he specifically told staff member Xiao Lin to look after the store and to contact him if customers had problems while trying on clothes, ensuring that the store ran normally during the running break.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Jogging along the Huangpu River waterfront for exercise.
description: Entered the riverside trail from the south gate of Super Brand Mall and jogged toward Dongchang Road. The first two kilometers were at about 6 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer with steady breathing; in the last two kilometers, his legs felt slightly heavy and the pace dropped to 6 minutes 40 seconds. At the turnaround point (near Dongchang Road), he stopped to drink half a bottle of sports drink and stretched his hamstrings. The total distance was 4 kilometers at an average pace of 6 minutes 35 seconds, and he felt refreshed both physically and mentally after the run.
location: Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (turnaround section from Super Brand Mall to Dongchang Road)

name: Rest after running and share ideas for the coffee corner
description: He ran back to the shop, sweating heavily. After a quick rinse and change, he put on a clean white cotton T-shirt. The shop assistant Xiao Lin was curious about Qian Duoduo's visit, so Lei Mingxuan shared the camping-style bar counter concept in detail. Inspired, Xiao Lin suggested a 'cart coffee corner' idea (pour-over kettle + folding chair). Lei Mingxuan thought it was feasible and immediately noted down this specific plan in his phone's memo.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Managing the store, receiving customers, and teasing new products on WeChat Moments
description: In the afternoon, he ran the store as usual and received three or four groups of customers in succession. For one young man wearing a hoodie, he styled the newly arrived techwear-style cargo pants and closed the sale. Taking advantage of the great light at 4:30, he used the phone's Pro mode to take texture close-ups of the fabric samples, with the caption: "Mountain-style techwear samples have arrived—the texture is incredible! I'm planning something big—guess what I'm up to?" He added the store location and posted it on Moments to build hype for the brand's next move.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store management during evening rush hour and community coffee research.
description: As evening rush hour foot traffic increased, Lei Mingxuan served young parents with children and office workers getting off work, and used his spare time on his laptop to process 3 orders on the online store backend (two with free shipping, one requiring an address change). Next, he watched a video by Bilibili blogger Coffee Old Zhang analyzing community coffee shop operations, carefully noting key points such as custom signature drinks, community maintenance, and Xiaohongshu check-in design, and reviewed previously saved notes on mountain-style techwear styling to build knowledge for integrated store operations.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store and final confirmation of weekend activities
description: At 7:30 p.m. sharp, he pulled down the rolling shutter door and closed the store. When he reached the entrance of Super Brand Mall, he sent a voice message to his cousin Shen Jie, confirming they would meet at "105" on Julu Road at 2 p.m. Saturday. Then he sent a message in the skiing group to sign up for the morning session and said he was busy in the afternoon and couldn't attend lunch. Song Jia and Xie Fei both replied "Got it." After all weekend activities were arranged, he walked home.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Had dinner with parents and reported on work progress
description: When he got home, his mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared dinner, including braised pork, which Lei Mingxuan loved. At the dinner table, he reported in detail to his father Lei Jianguo and his mother that the five fabric samples received that day were of good quality and that cooperation with supplier Zhou Tao looked promising. His father reminded him to be steady and prudent in business. Lei Mingxuan nodded and took the advice. The family of three chatted over dinner.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Study room brand naming and spatial design research
description: After the meal, I went into the home study, opened my laptop, and browsed "mountain-style techwear + coffee" interior design cases on Pinterest, saving more than 20 inspiration images. Then I used Excel to organize the expenses and ideas from the afternoon, and opened Xiaohongshu to search for "Xiafei Ji"—finding that it had not been registered yet, I was quietly delighted. Next, I hand-drew a sketch for merging the store in my notebook: a mountain-style clothing rack on the left, a camping-style coffee bar on the right, and natural wood-colored shelves connecting them in the middle, gradually making the store transformation plan more concrete.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: First experience with pour-over coffee and Moments interactions
description: After the research came to a stop for the moment, he remembered the coffee corner idea they had talked about during the day and, on a whim, got out a simple pour-over kettle and a pack of Yirgacheffe coffee beans in the home kitchen to try brewing. Because he poured the water in too forcefully, the coffee overflowed and tasted bitter. Lei Mingxuan photographed the messy counter and posted it on WeChat Moments with a self-deprecating caption: “My inspiration concentration is very low today—my pour-over failed. Requesting guidance from the masters.” His friend Qian Duoduo instantly commented, teasing him, and promised to teach him on-site next time. The online interaction was light and fun.
location: Home kitchen at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Finalizing the core brand name and planning for the next day
description: Lying in bed and unable to fall asleep, I kept weighing brand names. In the end, I formally wrote 'Brand name: Xiafei Collection (XIAFEI COLLECTION)' in my phone memo and added the design concept: 'An urban functional-wear hub that combines Shanghai-style elegance with the spirit of mountains and wilderness.' Then I organized all of the day's fabric sample photos and materials into a newly created folder called 'Store Transformation 2025', confirmed the next day's plan (Tuesday: go to Julu Road to browse select shops such as DOE and Element for display and product-selection inspiration), and then turned off the light and fell asleep with peace of mind.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run recovery and breakfast
description: Lei Mingxuan got up when the alarm went off at 7:50 a.m., put on his running shoes, and walked to Lujiazui Central Green Park for a 5 km jog, keeping a steady pace of 6 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. The soreness in his leg muscles eased. After doing post-run stretching at 8:20, he returned to his home in Shanggang Residential Area, took a hot shower, and changed into home clothes. At 8:30, his mother Wang Xiuying had prepared egg pancakes and soy milk. He ate while chatting about the day's shooting plan at the store.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and home at the Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Store opening preparations and commute.
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan changed into carefully chosen casual clothes, took his backpack, and left home. He took Metro Line 2 from Dongchang Road Station, got off at Lujiazui Station three stops later, crossed the circular footbridge, and arrived at Super Brand Mall at 9:00. He bought a tall latte at the Starbucks downstairs, then took the escalator to the second floor and unlocked the door of store A-208 with his key.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Styling outfits and shooting at the mall
description: After entering the store, Lei Mingxuan played light music, adjusted the mannequins and display racks, and cleared a white wall as the main shooting backdrop. From the inventory, he selected three mountain-style functional outfits: a khaki hardshell jacket with black cargo pants and a dark hiking hat; an army-green vest layered over a white T-shirt with khaki cargo shorts; and a navy-blue softshell jacket with grey jogger pants and a sports waist bag. At 9:40, he spread the pieces flat in the store and photographed the details. At 10:20, he asked Xiao Lin, the mall cleaner, to help take full-length and half-length photos of the three outfits in front of the light-colored brick wall and glass railing on the fourth-floor atrium, using the mall's soft lighting to create a tough, rugged look.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the atrium on the 4th floor.

name: Lunch, photo editing, and copywriting.
description: After the shoot, Lei Mingxuan returned to the store and ordered the signature miso ramen from the Japanese ramen restaurant at IFC Mall through a food delivery app. The order arrived at 12:10. While eating, he batch-processed photos with the Xingtu app, adjusting them all to a dark green cool tone to enhance the techwear feel, and added a white "A-208 Style Lab" watermark to the bottom right corner of each photo. He also picked out his favorite single-item shots and full-outfit looks, and planned the nine-grid layout and caption for his Moments post.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: New Product Teaser Release and Midday Engagement
description: At 13:00, publish the edited nine-grid photos and copy '【Style Upgrade Preview】The mountain-style techwear trend is coming. Are you ready? New arrivals coming soon, stay tuned~' to the store's WeChat official account and personal WeChat Moments. After publishing, refresh the feed; regular customer Qian Duoduo immediately replied with a comment saying she's looking forward to it, and Lei Mingxuan replied, 'Your suggestions deserve the credit~', then replied to other customers' and friends' likes and comments one by one.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mind the store and integrate business ideas
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic in the store was light. Lei Mingxuan first replied to all online inquiries about the new product launch time. At 14:30, two male college students came in and were interested in the outdoor jackets. He enthusiastically introduced them and had them try on the first outfit. They each bought an outdoor jacket of the same style in different colors on the spot. At 15:00, taking advantage of the quiet store, he used a tablet to integrate the mountain-style urban functional outfit ideas with suggestions from Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie, and wrote down the initial concept and sketches for the "coffee experience area" in his memo. Then he sorted the sales receipts and cleaned the store.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting and seeking work advice
description: At 17:30, Lei Mingxuan closed the store and got off work. After walking out of Super Brand Mall, he sent a WeChat voice message to Qian Duoduo asking for details on outdoor techwear style brand matching and recommendations for outdoor-style coffee shops. Qian Duoduo shared links to niche European brands and recommended the 'Grain' coffee shop on Julu Road. Then he took Metro Line 2 to go home. After exiting the station at 18:10, he called his cousin Shen Jie on the way to discuss cases and risks of the 'clothing store + coffee experience' model. Shen Jie thought the direction was feasible and proactively offered to help contact an outdoor apparel factory.
location: Street side near Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and transition discussion
description: At 18:30, he returned home in Shanggang Community. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had already made braised pork belly, oil-braised bamboo shoots, and tomato and egg soup. At the dinner table, Lei Mingxuan showed his parents the photos he had taken that day and enthusiastically described the store's transformation plan of “mountain-style functionality + coffee experience.” His father, Lei Jianguo, reminded him not to put all his capital into it, while his mother was more concerned about whether he had eaten a proper lunch and kept putting food on his plate.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Studying a short video marketing course
description: After dinner he rested for half an hour. At 20:00, Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop in the study, logged into the short-video marketing course platform, and studied Lesson 1, "Content Planning and Positioning." He listened carefully to the explanations of audience profiling and topic selection, then, based on his store's style, wrote down the keywords "Shanghai urban outdoor," "commuter outfits," and "weekend micro-vacation" in his notebook, and noted the successful cases mentioned in the courseware.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Billiards relaxation and socializing
description: At 21:20, billiards buddy Han Dong called to invite him to play pool. Lei Mingxuan changed into a hoodie and drove to Gentleman Billiards Club on B1 of World Plaza. The two played a few games of American eight-ball, chatting and laughing. Han Dong teased that his copywriting was getting more and more literary. Lei Mingxuan smiled and invited him to come and support future store events. Lei Mingxuan won two out of three games and felt great.
location: Gentleman Billiards Club, B1, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home and bedtime preparations.
description: At 23:00, after finishing the billiards session, Lei Mingxuan drove back to Shanggang Community, washed up quietly, and changed into pajamas. Lying in bed, he reviewed the photos he had taken that day and unconsciously smiled. Finally, he set the alarm for 8:00 the next morning and fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment about running the store. His weight before bed was 79.9 kg.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and doing recovery stretches
description: The 8 a.m. alarm went off; his lower back still ached slightly, so he canceled the running plan. On the yoga mat in the bedroom, he completed 20 minutes of core and hip stretches, and his muscles felt noticeably looser. His mother, Wang Xiuying, made small wontons with a fried egg. After breakfast, he applied moisturizer to relieve facial tightness, changed into a black hoodie and a tech vest, and got ready to go out.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute by bicycle.
description: Because the weather was cold and gloomy, I didn’t drive. I scanned a shared bike on Pudong Avenue and rode to Super Brand Mall. The cold wind kept me alert. I arrived at the mall’s back door around 8:55, locked the bike, and entered the second-floor store through the staff passage.
location: During a bike ride from Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store display update and soft opening
description: After arriving at the store, he opened the rolling shutter door, turned on the air conditioning and lights, selected the shell jackets and cargo pants that needed clearance from yesterday's mountain-style photos, and hung them on the display rack. He handwrote a 'Techwear Experience Price' promotion sign. Starting at 9:30, customers gradually came in. He attended to them while observing their feedback to gather market reactions for future product selection.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Receiving fabric samples
description: At 11:30, he received a WeChat message from supplier Zhou Tao saying that the samples had arrived at the property management office. After asking the neighboring shop assistant to watch the store, he hurried to the property management office on the first floor, signed for the sample box from Zheng Kai, and carried it back to the store, full of anticipation for the new fabric.
location: 1st Floor, Property Management Office, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Unpacking and inspecting samples and communicating via WeChat
description: Back at the store, immediately opened the box and inspected the five fabric sample cards. Held them up to the light and rubbed them to feel the drape and rebound. Initially selected the slightly stretchy water-repellent fabric and the honeycomb-textured, wear-resistant military green fabric. Took photos and videos and sent them via WeChat to his younger cousin Shen Jie for advice.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch time
description: Had the store clerk Xiao Lin watch the shop and went alone to the Japanese ramen restaurant on the B1 level of the mall for rich tonkotsu ramen with fried chicken. During the meal, I watched short videos on display psychology on my phone and noted key points for optimizing store space.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant at B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preliminary product selection and deepening of the 'Xiafei Collection' plan
description: After the meal, he returned to the store and, using the low-traffic period, formally decided to use the slightly stretchy water-repellent fabric for the spring jackets and the honeycomb abrasion-resistant fabric for the work pants, based on the fabric feel. He then pulled out the 'Xiafeiji' renovation draft to further develop the design: on A4 paper, he drew the coffee bar entrance, movable island shelves, a cement-textured accent wall, and the track lighting layout, and listed a preliminary budget, including about 5,000 yuan for bar equipment, 7,000 yuan for lighting and shelving, and 15,000 yuan for wall labor.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In-store customer service and learning during breaks
description: In the afternoon, two groups of customers came in. The first was two male college students who, after trying on clothes, bought an army-green hiking jacket paired with cargo pants and a bucket hat. The second was a man in his thirties who showed interest in lightweight outdoor jackets. He introduced the new collection to him and took his contact information to notify him of new arrivals. During a lull in traffic, he opened his iPad and continued watching a video on display psychology on Bilibili, jotting down notes on display techniques.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Before leaving work: stocktaking and plan update
description: As closing time approached, he began the daily inventory check, using the inventory software to deduct the day's sales and reconciling cash with system stock. He packed up the fabric samples and the notebook filled with plans for "Xiafei Ji" to take home, and in his phone memos he highlighted the naming of "Xiafei Ji" and the decision on two core fabrics.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Communicating the renovation plan with store clerk Xiao Lin
description: One hour before closing, by the cash register, he showed Xiao Lin fabric samples and a sketchbook, explaining in detail the overall concept from the transformation to mountain-style functional fashion, adding a coffee bar, to lighting and display. He also asked Xiao Lin to help contact an acquaintance who does interior decoration to provide a quote reference for the mall store renovation. Xiao Lin agreed to get in touch right away.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store and the ride home
description: At 18:00, I closed the store with Xiao Lin and rode a shared bike home. I reached the community entrance in 5 minutes and bought a bottle of iced Pocari Sweat at Yanqin Grocery Store to relieve fatigue.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store on Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Family dinner
description: When he got home, his mother, Wang Xiuying, had already prepared Shanghai-style braised pork and scallion-braised crucian carp, and his father, Lei Jianguo, was watching the news in the living room. After washing his hands, he helped his mother set out the bowls and chopsticks. The family of three sat around the table for dinner, chatting only about amusing things at the mall, with a relaxed and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening in-depth talk and support from parents
description: After dinner, he cleared the table and solemnly placed the fabric samples, notebook, and draft sketches on the coffee table in the living room. He explained to his father in detail the naming of 'Xiafeiji', the mountain-style functional positioning, and the renovation plan to add a coffee bar, letting his father feel the fabric texture firsthand, and honestly answering questions about costs, payback period, and other risks. His father agreed with the direction and reminded him to proceed steadily, and on the spot promised to provide 50,000 yuan in startup funding, which greatly encouraged Lei Mingxuan.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Wash up, moisturize, and personal care
description: After talking with his father, he took a shower to wash away the fatigue and noticed that his face was still dry. At this point, his mother handed him a new moisturizer. He carefully applied it to his face and hands, and his skin became noticeably more comfortable.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-Bedtime Planning and Light Reading
description: Before bed, checked the wealth-management app, and the fund account rose slightly for a small gain. Recorded the day's key decisions in the phone memo: two types of fabric, the new store name, and father's 50,000-yuan support. Read a few pages of The Longest Day in Chang'an, gradually felt sleepy, turned off the light, and went to bed.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning home activities and breakfast
description: At 7 a.m. the alarm went off. Lei Mingxuan did 15 minutes of Cat-Cow and Downward-Facing Dog stretches in bed to relieve lower back soreness. Then he went to the bathroom to wash up and applied the moisturizer his mother had given him. Afterward he went downstairs to the dining room, where his mother had prepared pan-fried buns and small fresh pork wontons. His father drank soy milk while chatting about the property management repairing pipes in the community. The family had breakfast together in a warm atmosphere.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the store
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan put on his commuting bag, got on his electric scooter, and headed west along Pudong Avenue toward Super Brand Mall. The weather was dry, the north wind slightly cool, and sunlight filtered through the clouds. He arrived at No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Super Brand Mall, in about 15 minutes.
location: Along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (cycling route)

name: Store opening preparation, fabric sample testing, and communication
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan changed into his work uniform, turned on the speaker to play Citypop music, styled the main mountain-style functional push item—an olive-green hardshell jacket and khaki multi-pocket cargo pants—on the mannequin by the door, and checked that all online orders from the previous day had been signed for. He then took out five fabric samples sent by Zhou Tao, focusing on testing the micro-stretch water-repellent fabric and the honeycomb abrasion-resistant fabric: he used his phone's fill light to photograph the front, back, and cross-section of each sample, used a small spray bottle to simulate a water splash test on the water-repellent fabric with excellent results, and scraped the honeycomb fabric with a key to observe its abrasion resistance. He carefully recorded all parameters and the feel of the fabrics in his memo. After completing the tests, he sent the videos and conclusions to his cousin Shen Jie via WeChat. Both were very satisfied with the wrinkle resistance of the micro-stretch fabric and agreed to finalize the version in person on Saturday.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Serving customers and handling orders.
description: While communicating with Shen Jie, two male customers who looked like college students were drawn into the store by the jackets. Lei Mingxuan greeted them warmly. Both were satisfied after trying them on; one purchased directly, and the other added his WeChat Work and said he would bring friends next time. Meanwhile, Lei Mingxuan also found time to pack an online hoodie order, carefully folding and bagging it.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and midday break
description: At noon the shop was not busy, so Lei Mingxuan walked to the Japanese ramen restaurant he often visits on the lower ground floor of IFC Mall, ordered a signature tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg, and the hot broth with chewy noodles was very satisfying. After eating, he did not return to the shop immediately; instead, he sat on a lounge chair in the atrium of Super Brand Mall for about 15 minutes, scrolling through designer toy news on his phone, enjoying some idle time.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant, B1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; Atrium, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Riverside jogging.
description: Lei Mingxuan set off from the East Gate of Super Brand Mall and headed straight for the Pudong Riverside Promenade. After changing into running shoes and a windproof jacket, he set his sports watch to a 5 km goal and ran along the river at a pace of about 6 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer. The outdoor temperature was 3–7°C, with a north wind adding to the experience, and the open views along the way took in Lujiazui's iconic buildings. After the run, he did ten minutes of serious stretching and relaxation on the observation deck.
location: Riverside Promenade, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (east side of Super Brand Mall)

name: Returned to the shop to rest after a light jog
description: After stretching, Lei Mingxuan took a sweaty back-view selfie and posted it on Moments with the location: “Running in winter makes my lungs feel clean. #RiversideTrail #RunningCheckIn.” Then he slowly walked back to the store, wiped his face with a wet towel, and drank most of a glass of warm water to calm down from the workout.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operation and customer interaction
description: When he returned to the shop, two customers were already looking at clothes, and Lei Mingxuan made recommendations based on their needs. Around 3 p.m., Qian Duoduo, a regular customer, came after seeing his Moments post. Lei Mingxuan showed her the fabric samples being tested and the shop renovation sketches. Qian Duoduo excitedly offered suggestions on colors and display, and helped reply to online styling inquiries. After 4 p.m., Xiao Lin, the sales assistant, arrived, and Lei Mingxuan handed her the newly organized merchandise to put on the shelves and restock.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closed the store and commuted home
description: At 5:30, Lei Mingxuan closed the shop on time, confirmed the next day's arrangements with Xiao Lin, then hopped on his e-bike and headed home along Pudong Avenue. During evening rush hour, traffic was heavy and streetlights were already on. Passing the convenience store at the entrance of Shanggang Residential Community, he bought a bottle of ice-cold Pocari Sweat to reward himself.
location: Along the route from Lujiazui West Road to Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (cycling route)

name: Family dinner
description: When he got home, his mother had already made dinner: braised pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. While eating, Lei Mingxuan shared with his parents the results of today's fabric testing and Qian Duoduo's renovation suggestions. His father expressed support and encouraged him to go ahead with the plan once it was confirmed.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Take a short-video marketing course.
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan cleared the dining table, returned to the study, opened his laptop, put on headphones, and focused intently on the final chapter of the short-video course, "Platform Algorithms and Practical Cases." He carefully noted the core recommendation logic, tag settings, and data analysis methods. After 90 minutes, he completed the entire course and added three pages of notes.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online social sharing and video concept planning
description: After the course ended, Lei Mingxuan started a voice call in the “Xiafeiji Passionate Makeover Group” and shared his learning takeaways with friends Li Na, Zhang Wei, and others, focusing on how to re-edit the vlog by combining the earlier skiing footage with store ad placements. Li Na suggested trying to film a short store-exploration video with a phone next time they checked out the “Grain” coffee shop. Everyone talked with great enthusiasm.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: After chatting with his friend, Lei Mingxuan took a hot shower to wash away the fatigue. His mother knocked on the door on time and brought him moisturizer; he smiled and exaggeratedly applied a thick layer. Then he leaned against the headboard and scrolled through sneaker and designer toy release news for a while, and flipped through a few pages of The Longest Day in Chang'an. At 23:30, drowsiness hit, and he turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Get up and prepare breakfast
description: At 7 a.m., his phone alarm went off right on time. Lei Mingxuan turned over, dismissed the alarm, and opened the curtains. It was cloudy outside with a gentle breeze; the weather forecast showed a temperature of 4–8°C for the day. He pulled on a hoodie and walked out of the bedroom. The aroma of small wontons was already wafting from the kitchen. His mother, Wang Xiuying, saw him and called out, 'Up already? The wontons will be ready soon—I bought fresh shepherd's purse and pork filling today.' Lei Mingxuan replied, then went to the bathroom to wash up, ready to start a new day.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and micro-learning
description: The family sat around the dining table. While eating steaming hot wonton soup, Lei Mingxuan took out his phone and opened the notes from last night's short-video marketing course, quickly scanned a few key algorithm points, and used voice-to-text in his memo to jot down the core concept: "completion rate > engagement rate > conversion rate". While eating, he chatted briefly with his mother about the day's store arrangements and said he had invited his cousin Shen Jie for coffee in the afternoon.
location: Dining room, Room 501, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute prep and departure
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan changed into a mountain-style techwear outfit he planned to feature today: a dark gray softshell jacket paired with olive cargo pants. He checked the backpack for his keys, power bank, spray bottle for testing fabric, and magnifying glass. After confirming everything was there, he put on his helmet, got on his electric bicycle, and set off from the community along Pudong Avenue toward Lujiazui, riding against the cool morning breeze in high spirits.
location: Along the route from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Opening the store and adjusting displays
description: After arriving at Super Brand Mall, Lei Mingxuan skillfully opened the store door and turned on the lights and the cash register system. Taking advantage of the few customers right after the mall opened, he spent half an hour adjusting the shelves, placing the three mountain-style sample outfits he had put together yesterday in the most prominent central position of the store, with tactical waist bags and carabiners beside them as decorative accents. The whole look immediately became more rugged.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handling online tasks and organizing thoughts
description: Back at the cash register, Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop and first handled several online orders that had come in while he was asleep last night, printing out the shipping labels. Then he opened WeChat and sent a message to his cousin Shen Jie: 'Jiejie, how about meeting at the Starbucks on Century Avenue at 2:30 this afternoon? I'll treat you to coffee. There are a few things I'd like to get your professional opinion on.' A few minutes later, Shen Jie replied: 'OK, see you on time! I also happen to have something good to show you.'
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Fabric Sample Testing and Screening
description: Lei Mingxuan spread the five techwear fabric samples that had arrived the previous day on the workbench. First, he felt the thickness and texture of each fabric with his hands; then he sprayed them evenly with a spray bottle to test water resistance, and repeatedly scraped them with the tip of a key to test tear resistance. While doing this, he shot close-up videos with his phone and wrote data in his notebook: 'Honeycomb fabric: full marks for abrasion resistance, 80 points for waterproofing, but a bit stiff to the touch; DuPont paper: excellent waterproofing, but breathability is questionable; softshell fleece: best elasticity.' In the end, he initially shortlisted three candidates — slightly stretchy water-repellent fabric, honeycomb abrasion-resistant fabric, and softshell fleece — and specifically took a nice photo of the DuPont paper sample to post to the regular customers' group, asking: 'Bosses, what do you think of using this new fabric for summer techwear vests? It's waterproof and quick-drying, just not very breathable.' Soon, people in the group replied and started discussing.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch time
description: At 11:30, Lei Mingxuan turned off the store’s background music, hung up a sign reading “Lunch break, open at 1 o’clock”, and walked to the noodle shop he often went to in the food court on B1 of Super Brand Mall. While waiting for his order, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu for a while, searching for keywords like “gorpcore” and “urban outdoor” to check the latest fashion trends and hot items.
location: Noodle shop in the food court on B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lunch break and catching up on gaps.
description: After eating, Lei Mingxuan returned to the store and did not start working right away. He leaned back on the bean bag sofa in the store, rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes, and set an alarm on his phone. After the nap, he was full of energy. He rechecked the list of key points to discuss with Shen Jie in the afternoon: outdoor fashion trends, supply chain resources, and the strengths and weaknesses of the store's product selection. He also organized the sample photos he planned to show her into an album on his phone.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycle to the agreed meeting place
description: At 1:30 p.m., Lei Mingxuan locked up the shop, got on his electric bike, and set off from Super Brand Mall, riding along Lujiazui Ring Road toward Century Link Plaza at 1192 Century Avenue, enjoying the early spring afternoon breeze along the way and feeling happy.
location: Along the route from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Century Link Plaza, No. 1192 Century Avenue

name: Afternoon tea with Shen Jie
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived 10 minutes early, ordered an iced Americano, and took a window seat for two. Shen Jie arrived on time, wearing a neatly tailored black coat and holding a tablet. After ordering some small cakes, they got straight to business. Shen Jie first shared several European and American brand cases she had been following, noting that the 'Urban Outdoor' trend was moving from professional outdoor fields into everyday styling. She then opened her tablet and showed a few viral Xiaohongshu images: 'Look, this "light functional" concept sells best — it doesn't need to be too hardcore, but it needs to have a sense of design. The cargo pants and windbreakers in your store can tie in perfectly.' Lei Mingxuan listened carefully and kept asking questions. Shen Jie pushed several business cards of reliable outdoor fabric suppliers she had collected to him, and suggested that in the early stage he could experiment with small batches and multiple styles. Lei Mingxuan also showed her a video he had taken of DuPont Tyvek fabric samples. Shen Jie's eyes lit up: 'This is quite interesting. For vests or small sling bags, young people will definitely like it. Be bold with the colors!' The hour-and-a-half exchange was full of useful information.
location: Starbucks Coffee, 1F, Century Link Mall, 1192 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Saying goodbye and returning to the store
description: The two said goodbye at the entrance of Starbucks. Shen Jie still had to go back to the office to handle work, so she walked straight to the metro station. Lei Mingxuan, in high spirits and feeling his mind had broadened, got on his e-bike and rode back to Super Brand Mall the same way.
location: Along the route from Century Link Mall, No. 1192 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: In-depth fabric testing and solution optimization
description: Back at the store, Lei Mingxuan first recorded the key points from his discussion with Shen Jie in the memo app on his phone. Then, following the morning's ideas, he tested the three candidate fabrics more carefully: he used a water cup to simulate splashing, measured the stretch range of the fabrics with a ruler, and compared the weight and drape of the different fabrics. He not only recorded objective data, but also, in line with Shen Jie's suggestion of 'light functional wear,' began thinking about what styles of clothing he could make with these fabrics. For example, he planned to use the slightly stretchy water-repellent fabric for a short jacket with a detachable hood, the honeycomb abrasion-resistant fabric for a multi-pocket utility vest, and the softshell fleece for a stand-collar sweatshirt. He sketched a few simple drawings in his work notebook and annotated colors and trims.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Tidying up store affairs and reviewing the day
description: At 5:30, Lei Mingxuan began to take stock of the day's arrivals and put the tested fabric samples back in order. On the whiteboard in the store, he wrote tomorrow's to-do list: “1. Confirm the official order for the fabric samples; 2. Follow up on the coffee experience area plan; 3. Contact the renovation contractor for a quote.” Then he wiped the shelves and the cash register with a cloth, and looking at today's readjusted display, he felt a great sense of accomplishment.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store and cycling home.
description: At exactly 18:00, Lei Mingxuan turned off the store's power and pulled down the rolling shutter door. He put on his helmet, got on his electric bike, and rode home along the familiar route. It was the evening rush hour, and the streets were bustling with traffic, yet he felt especially lighthearted.
location: Along the route from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Family dinner
description: When he got home, his mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared dinner, with braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and a bowl of tomato egg drop soup on the table. At dinner, Lei Mingxuan excitedly told his parents about the results of his afternoon discussion with Shen Jie and his design ideas for the new product. After listening, his father Lei Jianguo rarely praised him: “Hmm, you have ideas, but it’s good to keep a steady pace.” His mother put a piece of braised pork in his bowl: “Eat more, so you have energy to build your career.” The family was warm and harmonious.
location: Room 501, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going out to keep an appointment
description: After lunch, he rested for half an hour. His friend Han Dong sent a message on WeChat: "Lao Lei, 8 o'clock at the usual place, in?" Lei Mingxuan immediately replied: "Let's go!" He changed into light running shoes, said goodbye to his parents, went out, rode his electric bicycle, and headed to World Square at 855 Pudong South Road.
location: Along the route from Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to World Plaza, No. 855 South Pudong Road

name: Billiards match time
description: When they arrived at the billiards club, Han Dong had already booked a table. The two were old rivals, so without small talk they started playing American eight-ball. Lei Mingxuan was in good form today, with extraordinary accuracy, clearing the table twice in a row. Although Han Dong lost, he was not annoyed, and the two chatted while playing. In the end, Lei Mingxuan won 5 games and Han Dong won 2. After two hours of play, both were fully satisfied.
location: Shenshi Billiards Club, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Late-night snack and chat
description: After playing, the two went together to Wufang Noodle House (Dongchang Branch) near the club for a late-night snack, each ordering a bowl of scallion-oil noodles with a fried egg. While eating, Lei Mingxuan told Han Dong about his plan to organize a skiing trip: "The ski season is almost over. I was thinking of finding a weekend to go to an indoor ski resort in Anji or Shaoxing for a couple of days. What do you think?" Han Dong's eyes lit up at the mention of skiing: "Sure! I've been wanting to get some exercise. You pick the time, and I'll bring Zhang Wei along!"
location: Wufang Noodle Shop (Dongchang Branch), near Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home and washing up
description: After the late-night snack, the two said goodbye at the intersection. Lei Mingxuan rode his bike home against the night wind. When he got home, he washed up quietly to avoid waking his parents, who were already asleep. As usual, he applied moisturizer to his face and felt refreshed all over.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, from Dongchang Road to Room 501, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Relaxing before bed
description: Lei Mingxuan leaned against the headboard, opened his iPad, and watched the latest episode of a funny Japanese anime. After finishing it, he picked up his phone and jotted down in his memo: '1.18-1.19 contact Shen Jie to finalize the draft. On the afternoon of 1.19, go to "Grain" on Julu Road to check out the coffee space.' Putting down the phone, he turned off the light, savored the fulfilling day, and gradually fell asleep with confidence and anticipation for the future. Weight 80.4 kg.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, No. 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Early Morning Preparation
description: As soon as the alarm went off, Lei Mingxuan got up quickly and began preparing for the Anji ski trip. After washing up, he put on thermal quick-dry clothing and checked the ski gear he had packed the night before: ski suit, protective gear, helmet, action camera, spare batteries, power bank, gloves, and ski goggles. After confirming everything was complete, he put on his large backpack and was energetically ready to head out.
location: Room 502, No. 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pick up childhood friend Zhang Wei
description: Lei Mingxuan drove and arrived on time at the entrance of 1266 Jinqiao Road, Pudong New Area, and sent a WeChat message to Zhang Wei. Zhang Wei, carrying a large backpack, got into the car and excitedly patted Lei Mingxuan's shoulder. The two were full of anticipation for the day's skiing, and the atmosphere in the car was lively.
location: Entrance of No. 1266 Jinqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pick up basketball buddy Han Dong
description: Lei Mingxuan and Zhang Wei drove along the elevated road to the northwest corner of the intersection of Hongmei Road and Caobao Road in Minhang District to pick up Han Dong. Han Dong brought a large bag of snacks and drinks, threw it in the back seat, and announced that he was covering the day's energy supply. Rock music played in the car, and the three of them were full of laughter and cheerful chatter.
location: Northwest corner of the intersection of Hongmei Road and Caobao Road, Minhang District, Shanghai

name: Pick up roller-skating partner Song Jia
description: The group finally arrived at the entrance of Vanke City Garden, Lane 2929, Qixin Road, Minhang District, to pick up Song Jia. Song Jia, dressed in professional outdoor gear, got in the car and teased the three male companions, while Lei Mingxuan joked that he needed this veteran alpine skier to give him tips on snowboarding. With everyone onboard, the trip to Anji officially began.
location: At the entrance of Vanke City Garden, Lane 2929, Qixin Road, Minhang District, Shanghai.

name: Drive to Anji Cloud Grassland
description: Starting from Shanghai, take the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway and then the Hangzhou-Changxing Expressway to Anji, Zhejiang, covering about 2.5 hours in total. Lei Mingxuan drives, Han Dong handles navigation, and Zhang Wei and Song Jia sit in the back seat chatting and laughing. Along the way, they pass the Changxing Service Area, stop for 10 minutes to rest, get out to stretch, and buy hot coffee to refresh themselves. After that, they continue driving and arrive smoothly at Anji Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort.
location: G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway to S14 Hangzhou-Changxing Expressway, heading to Anji County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Arrived at the ski resort, purchased tickets and rented equipment.
description: After arriving at Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort, the four went straight to the ticket hall and bought full-day ski tickets including ski equipment. Lei Mingxuan skillfully rented a snowboard, snowboard boots, and a helmet, while Song Jia helped the beginners check their protective gear. After changing into the equipment in the changing area, Lei Mingxuan clipped the action camera onto his helmet, ready to record the skiing process.
location: Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort Ticket Hall, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Hiring a coach to learn snowboarding basics
description: Lei Mingxuan stepped onto a snowboard for the first time and specially hired an instructor. On the beginner slope, the instructor taught him techniques in turn: how to fall safely, get up, do a heelside traverse, and make falling-leaf turns. Lei Mingxuan fell more than a dozen times, but every time he got up he felt he had improved a little. Zhang Wei and Han Dong were skiing in the nearby ski area, occasionally gliding over to laugh at his awkwardness, while Song Jia encouraged him and pointed out problems with his center of gravity.
location: Beginner slope at Cloud Grassland Ski Resort, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Lunch break and observing ski wear
description: At noon, the four met at the restaurant in the ski area rest zone and ordered beef noodles and hot cocoa. Lei Mingxuan replayed the video of himself falling using his helmet camera, and everyone was doubled over with laughter. During the meal, his professional habit kicked in as he observed the ski jackets of skiers around him, noting waterproof zippers, pocket designs, and fabric seams, and mulling over outdoor techwear items the store could introduce in the future.
location: Restaurant in the rest area of Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Afternoon independent sliding practice.
description: After the morning's learning session, Lei Mingxuan practiced alone in the afternoon. He could barely glide a short distance using the falling-leaf technique, and even tried edge changes once or twice, though both ended in falls. But the sense of speed fascinated him. One backward fall was especially hard, and it hurt so much he could barely stand up; afterward, he noticeably restrained his movements. By 15:30, all four were exhausted and decided to call it a day.
location: Beginner slope at Cloud Grassland Ski Resort, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Returning equipment and preparing to head back
description: The group limped in line to return their ski equipment. After taking off the protective gear, every bone in their bodies seemed to protest. They changed into casual clothes, rehydrated, packed up their belongings, and prepared for the return to Shanghai.
location: Yunshang Grassland Ski Resort Ticket Hall, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Return to Shanghai and take friends home.
description: Since Lei Mingxuan was fatigued from driving and had hip pain, Zhang Wei volunteered to be the driver. The car returned to Shanghai via the Hangzhou-Changsha Expressway and the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway. On the way, they made a brief stop at a service area at 17:30. At 18:30, they dropped Han Dong off at Hongmei Road in Minhang; at 19:00, they dropped Zhang Wei off at Jinqiao Road in Pudong; finally, Song Jia took a taxi home from Jinqiao. Along the way, they talked about the funny falls during skiing and planned the next trip.
location: Expressway from Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province to Shanghai (Hangzhou–Changxing Expressway S14, Shanghai–Chongqing Expressway G50)

name: Arrived home and roughly edited the video
description: Lei Mingxuan returned home to Shanggang Community, his whole body nearly falling apart. He collapsed on the sofa for five minutes, then charged his phone and action camera and imported the day's videos and photos into his phone. He picked the three funniest falling clips and one barely successful sliding clip, and used an app for simple editing.
location: Room 502, No. 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dinner and family interaction
description: Lei Mingxuan shared the edited video to his WeChat Moments and a friends group chat, with a caption expressing that he wouldn't admit defeat. He rolled up his pant leg to show his mother the bruise on his thigh. His mother fussed over him worriedly as she brought out reheated braised pork and tomato egg soup. Lei Mingxuan ate while animatedly recounting the thrilling skiing experience, spending a warm dinner with his parents.
location: Room 502, No. 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online interaction
description: Likes and comments on his Moments surged, and friends teased him about whether his butt was okay. While replying to comments, he also exchanged ugly skiing photos with Zhang Wei, Han Dong, Song Jia and others in the group chat, and the atmosphere was lively.
location: Room 502, No. 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stretching and relaxing
description: Lei Mingxuan laid out a yoga mat in the living room and, despite full-body soreness, carefully did several sets of stretching exercises targeting the legs and hips to relieve a day of skiing fatigue and promote recovery.
location: Room 502, No. 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: After enjoying a comfortable hot shower, Lei Mingxuan felt much of his energy restored. After the shower, he applied the medicated patches his mother had prepared to his buttocks and thighs, and jotted down today's insights on ski jacket design in his phone's memo app, accumulating inspiration for the store's future product selection. Before bed, he weighed himself: 80.0kg.
location: Bathroom, Room 502, No. 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading and rest before bed
description: Lying in bed, Lei Mingxuan picked up 'The Longest Day in Chang'an' and flipped through a few pages, but drowsiness soon hit. After turning off the light, he savored the wind on the ski slope and the embarrassment of falling, and fell into a deep sleep with a satisfied smile.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Natural awakening and morning reset
description: The alarm didn't go off. Lei Mingxuan woke up naturally, feeling sore all over, especially in his thighs and buttocks — a 'souvenir' from yesterday's skiing. He sat up slowly, stretched, picked up his phone and scrolled through Moments. Seeing that his skiing post had received more than thirty likes, he continued watching short videos and stayed in bed for half an hour before slowly getting up.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Breakfast, housework, and personal interests
description: Lei Mingxuan walked into the dining room in his pajamas. His mother Wang Xiuying had already cooked his favorite small wontons. While eating, he told her about yesterday's embarrassing skiing incident. His mother nagged him to pay attention to safety and brought out safflower oil. After the meal, he voluntarily cleared the dishes and then watered the pothos and snake plant on the balcony. The movement pulled at his bruise, making him wince. Afterwards, he returned to his bedroom, opened a new “Steampunk” blind box, and placed the mechanical pigeon figurine into the display cabinet, feeling delighted.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Online store maintenance and social interaction
description: Lei Mingxuan sat down at the computer in his study, opened the store backend to check messages and orders he had missed yesterday, and replied to a regular customer's inquiries. He organized the address information of the three customers who placed orders yesterday in the regular customer group, preparing to ship from the store tomorrow. During this time, he also exchanged a few messages with his cousin Shen Jie on WeChat and felt full of anticipation for finalizing the fabric design next week.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family lunch.
description: Father Lei Jianguo came back from grocery shopping, and mother prepared a lunch of braised pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. Lei Mingxuan ate with his parents and mentioned his idea of setting aside a coffee experience area in the store. His father supported it but reminded him to budget carefully, and his mother ladled him some soup to nourish his health.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch break and plan adjustment
description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan dozed on the sofa for half an hour. When he woke up, considering his sore body, he decided to fine-tune his plan: instead of driving to Julu Road, he cycled to the Pudong Riverside Promenade for a slow, relaxing walk, and would do focused store-visit research in the afternoon.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Slow walking on the riverside path and online store browsing
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into a windbreaker and athletic pants, went out, scanned the code to unlock a shared bike, and rode five minutes to the riverside promenade. He walked slowly along the river, breathing in the moist air and observing pedestrians and cargo ships on the river. When he got tired, he sat on a bench and watched an old man fly a kite, feeling much lighter. Then he took out his phone, opened Dianping and Xiaohongshu, searched for the "Grain" coffee shop, and browsed the environment, menu, and reviews in detail, studying the spatial layout and customer flow design. He screenshotted and saved over a dozen reference images, then searched for the "coffee + retail" model of two or three other distinctive community coffee shops, preparing for a field visit next week.
location: Lujiazui Riverside Promenade (section near Dongchang Road Green Space to Qichangzhan Ferry Terminal), Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Edited a short ski video.
description: After returning home, Lei Mingxuan turned on his computer and editing software, and transferred about 30GB of snowboarding footage to the computer via WeChat File Transfer Assistant. After a quick review, he picked out the highlight shots: the nervousness of standing on a snowboard for the first time, the excitement of successfully doing a falling leaf, the miserable sight of himself falling flat on his back, and his friends' graceful riding. He spent over an hour carefully editing a 1-minute 15-second short video, added energetic BGM, and wrote copy that cleverly incorporated the concepts of outdoor sports and "windproof and waterproof" clothing. During editing, his buttocks became sore from sitting too long, so he stood up and moved around several times.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Dinner and evening family time
description: At dinner, his mother made Shanghainese braised pork belly and steamed sea bass. Lei Mingxuan enthusiastically showed his parents the video clips he had just edited at the dinner table, and his father found them interesting too. After dinner, he cleared the dishes, made tea, and watched the historical drama Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty with his parents. During the show, his mother brought over red date and white fungus soup. While watching, he posted the skiing video to his WeChat Moments, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin from his phone, with the caption: ‘First time snowboarding - I may be bad at it, but it was fun! To avoid falling this hard next time, I must get the store's new autumn/winter windproof and waterproof hard shells!’ The video soon received likes and comments from friends and customers, and he replied and interacted while watching TV.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: After watching the show, Lei Mingxuan returned to the bedroom and took a careful shower to avoid touching the bruises. After coming out, he applied safflower oil to himself and gently massaged. He changed into pajamas and leaned against the headboard, scrolling through short videos for a while. Seeing that the video he had just posted had over 100 likes, he felt quite satisfied. He also noted two things in his phone memo: organize and ship online orders after arriving at the store tomorrow; and shortlist three cafés to visit next week.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Preparing for sleep
description: Feeling drowsy, Lei Mingxuan put down his phone, turned off the desk lamp, and shifted into a sleeping position that didn't hurt. Thinking back on the fulfilling day, he felt satisfied and relaxed, and soon fell fast asleep.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Getting up and indoor stretching
description: The alarm went off right at 7:00 in the morning. Although there was still bruising on the back of my thigh, I got up anyway to keep my exercise habit. I did 20 minutes of upper body stretching and 10 minutes of light yoga on the bed, focusing on mobilizing my shoulders, neck, and back, being careful not to strain my leg, and waking the body up gently.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Breakfast, commute preparation, and en route shopping
description: After stretching, I took a shower. My mother, Wang Xiuying, had already cooked steaming hot shepherd's purse wontons and fried a poached egg, and she told me to dress warmly because it was cold. While eating, I checked the stats for the skiing video I posted last night on my phone; it had more than 30 likes and was well received. After eating, I changed into the store's new mountain-style techwear long-sleeved T-shirt and cargo pants, grabbed my key pouch, and headed out. At the Yanqin General Store by the community gate, I bought a bottle of iced cola and prepared to drive to the store.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China; home and Yanqin Grocery Store

name: Drive to the Super Brand Mall store
description: Drove from Shanggang Community to Super Brand Mall, listening to morning news and traffic radio on the way. Arrived at the B2 parking garage of Super Brand Mall after about 28 minutes and parked the car.
location: Underground parking garage, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Opening the store and morning preparation
description: After arriving at the store, turn on the lights and start equipment, quickly check the three online orders packed the day before (two outdoor windbreakers, one pair of cargo pants), verify the addresses and shipping labels, and place the packages at the front desk. Then log in to BOSS Zhipin and 51job recruitment platforms on your phone to prepare for upcoming recruitment.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning work: publish recruitment and adjust display
description: During my most productive morning hours, I posted a part-time shop assistant job listing on the computer, specifying the working hours, hourly wage, and the requirement of 'interest in outdoor functional style,' and set up automatic resume screening rules. Then I adjusted the store display: I moved aside the heavy coats featured last week, hung the carefully selected slightly stretchy water-repellent short jackets and honeycomb-fabric cargo pants in the most prominent spot on the center island, and placed a few fabric samples and a handwritten card reading 'Fabric Field Test' on the worktable beside them to attract customers' attention.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Handle miscellaneous tasks and application replies in spare moments
description: While sitting down to rest, I checked the recruitment backend on my phone and saw that three resumes had already come in. I quickly replied to two suitable candidates and arranged for them to come to the store for interviews at 10 a.m. tomorrow. At that moment, regular customer Qian Duoduo sent a WeChat message asking whether the new styles had arrived, and I replied in time.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and business district survey
description: At noon I didn't go to my usual ramen shop. Instead, I went to the newly opened 'Jing Dong' Japanese grilled meat rice bowl on B1 of Super Brand Mall and ordered a signature set. While eating, I scrolled through Xiaohongshu, focusing on a few store-visit posts about 'community cafe + select shop' venues, thinking about the possibility of transforming my own store.
location: Jingdon Japanese Grilled Meat Rice Bowl, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: After-dinner walk to digest and online replies
description: Back at the store, I stood to help digestion while replying to messages in the customer group about the ski video and answering two sizing questions. In addition, I saw a private message on a short-video platform; the other person asked about the specific parameters of the windproof jacket, so I took a close-up photo of the tag details and sent it over.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon: watching the store, sales, and data sorting.
description: The afternoon store traffic was good. I received two groups of customers: the first was two young men who were very interested in the techwear jackets displayed on the center island. I explained in detail the fabric's waterproof and abrasion-resistant properties. They tried them on, were very satisfied, and directly bought one in black. The second group was a regular customer who came to pick up a reserved hat. During a lull, I opened a spreadsheet on the computer and organized last week's sales data, finding that basic undershirts were the main sales driver, while inquiries about techwear products had risen noticeably.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening recharge and review
description: The store was empty for the moment, so I sat on a bar stool to rest and browsed the Pop Mart group; someone was sharing tips on the new blind boxes. After that, I spent 10 minutes quickly reviewing the afternoon's customer service process and saved the techniques for explaining "tear-resistant fabric" in my phone's memo app so I can introduce it better to customers in the future.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Published ski short videos and interacted with viewers to drive sales.
description: At 5 p.m., the golden hour for online promotion, I posted the one-minute skiing video I had carefully edited the day before with the caption: "【Boss Lei is hooked】#Techwear #SkiOutfit, who says you can't have both style and warmth?" to the store's WeChat group and Moments. As soon as it was posted, the group became lively. Regular customer Qian Duoduo was the first to comment: "Boss Lei is personally promoting it, now I want to buy it even more!" I immediately joined the interaction, replying to seven or eight questions about sizing and waterproofing, and on the spot converted two online pre-orders for winter techwear jackets. The customers completed the transactions directly via WeChat transfer.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Closing the store and heading back
description: After finishing the last few things, I loaded the outgoing parcels into my car and drove home from Super Brand Mall. I listened to a podcast on the way and was in a good mood, arriving at the neighborhood about 28 minutes later.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: When I got home, my mother Wang Xiuying had already made Shanghai-style braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. At the dinner table, I took the initiative to share the progress of the day with my father Lei Jianguo and my mother: the job posting had been released, the skiing video was getting good feedback, and two pieces of clothing had been sold. My father told me not to work too hard, and asked about the progress of the store renovation. The whole family sat together, and the atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening: spending time with parents and handling personal matters.
description: After dinner, I watched a health and wellness program on Beijing TV with my parents. While watching, I used mobile banking to check the tech-themed fund I hold; it had risen slightly by 0.4% today. After the show, I chatted with my parents about amusing moments from serving customers today, and the living room was filled with a warm family atmosphere.
location: Home living room, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening personal time: bath, self-care, and planning
