description: After returning to my room, I first took a hot bath to relax, then carefully applied safflower oil to the bruise on the back of my thigh. After that, I leaned against the headboard and spent a while on my iPad browsing the latest anime updates on Bilibili. Then I opened the notes app on my phone and listed tomorrow's work plan: interview part-time staff in the morning, contact the courier for pickup in the afternoon, and follow up on previous pre-orders.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep.
description: In order to fall asleep before 11:00, I put down my phone half an hour early and did a simple set of pre-sleep stretches. After turning off the lights, I reflected on the day: recruitment had made progress, video conversion was good, and performance was satisfactory, leaving me with a sense of accomplishment. At about 23:15, I fell asleep contentedly.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning health activities
description: After getting up, did 20 minutes of full-body stretching on the bedroom floor to wake up the body and relieve the bruising on the legs from yesterday's skiing. Then washed up, applied moisturizer, and put on a black fleece sweatshirt.
location: Room 302, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: Mother Wang Xiuying specially made large wontons filled with shepherd's purse and pork, and fried a sunny-side-up egg. As I ate, I chatted with her about my plan to interview five people that day, and she smiled and encouraged me to eat more.
location: Dining room at home, Room 302, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Driving commute and store opening preparations
description: He took his commuter bag and umbrella, went down to the basement garage to get the car, drove along Pudong Avenue and turned onto Yincheng Middle Road toward Super Brand Mall, and arrived at the B2 parking lot at 8:03. He then took the elevator to the store on the second floor. After opening the door, he turned on the lights, air conditioning, and music, arranged the round table and chairs for the interview, wiped them clean, and ensured the environment was tidy.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Recruitment preparation and communication with suppliers
description: I opened the recruitment platform and received 4 new resumes. Together with the candidates already scheduled, after screening, I called a part-time candidate with sports brand experience and arranged an interview at 10:45. Then I called Zhou Tao, a supplier in Hangzhou, to follow up on the pre-ordered short jacket made of slightly stretchy water-repellent fabric, and confirmed that the goods had been shipped and were expected to arrive in Shanghai the day after tomorrow. Afterward, I used the spare time to organize key interview questions and recorded in my memo the customers' questions about outdoor clothing from the comments section of the skiing video.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Interview two part-time applicants
description: The first applicant (male, born after 2000) came to interview for the part-time store assistant position. I asked about his retail experience and understanding of street fashion. His performance was basic, and he lacked a concept of outdoor apparel, but he is suitable for basic sales and stocking. The second applicant was a student from the nearby university town; they were lively and communicative, but had no clothing sales experience, so they could serve as a backup. After the two interviews, I organized the interview notes.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Customer reception and online interaction
description: I received a young couple. The girl was interested in the cargo pants from the Moments post. I enthusiastically introduced the style and fabric. Although the sale was not completed, we added each other on WeChat and I sent photos of similar styles.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and a walk after the meal
description: He went to the Jingyuehui Roast Duck fast-food restaurant on B1 of Super Brand Mall and ordered a Beijing-style duck rice dish with duck bone soup. After eating, he didn't return immediately but strolled up the escalator from B1 to the 2nd floor to help digest his food while thinking about the afternoon interview arrangements, especially looking forward to the candidate with sports brand experience.
location: Jingyuehui Roast Duck Fast Food, B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Interviewing the Third and Fourth Candidates
description: First, interviewed Candidate A (with retail experience), whose performance was mediocre and understanding of outdoor trends was average. After the interview, took a short break, drank some tea, and noted down thoughts. Then interviewed Candidate B (with clothing sales experience), who had a slightly lower educational background and reacted indifferently to the topic of 'mountain-style techwear'. Overall, B was moderate and did not fully match the store's transformation direction.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepare for and interview key Candidate C

location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

description: Back in his room, Lei Mingxuan washed up briefly and applied moisturizer. Lying in bed, he first read The Qingming Scroll Code on his Kindle for a while, then scrolled through a few videos on Bilibili about driving store traffic. At 23:15, he turned off the light and went to sleep, feeling at ease and ready for the new day.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake up, weigh in, stretch, and have breakfast
description: I got up right at 7 a.m. Today was the last working day before the Chinese New Year, and I was excited, so I didn't linger in bed. After getting up, I weighed myself first: 80.6 kg, the same as yesterday. I secretly felt relieved that last night's shengjianbao hadn't caused any weight gain. Then I did 10 minutes of stretching on the bedroom floor, loosening up my neck, shoulders, and lower back, and felt my body unfold. After washing up, I went to the dining room, where my mother Wang Xiuying had prepared breakfast: hot rice porridge, pickled vegetables, fried eggs, and frozen soup dumplings. While eating, I chatted with my mother. I mentioned that we'd go to the supermarket together in the afternoon to buy Chinese New Year goods. She again talked about how a relative's daughter had come back to work after graduate school. I smiled and changed the subject with 'We'll talk about that when the time comes.' I finished breakfast quickly and got ready to go to work.
location: Home bedroom and dining room, No. XX, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Driving to the store and making pre-opening preparations
description: Put on the black workwear jacket from his own shop, grabbed his car keys and commuter bag, and headed out. He started the family car in the underground garage, drove out of Shanggang Community, and went along Pudong Avenue toward Lujiazui. On the way, he played the history podcast "Talking About Along the River During the Qingming Festival" over the car's Bluetooth, while mentally reviewing today's to-do list: take inventory, post the holiday notice, and hand over work to shop assistant Lin Yue. After arriving at the underground parking lot of Super Brand Mall and parking, he entered through the shop's back door, turned on the air conditioner and ambient lighting, quickly warming up the quiet store. He then logged into the customer WeChat group on his phone and drafted a teaser message: "Hey everyone, today is the last day our little shop is open before the New Year. Tonight I'll post the new service rules for the Spring Festival holiday in this group. Stay tuned~" to build anticipation for the follow-up notice.
location: Starting from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, drive along Pudong Avenue and finally arrive at the underground parking lot of Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. The store address is Mingxuan Men's Wear, Store A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road.

name: Preparing the store for the Spring Festival holiday and conducting a full inventory
description: In the morning, I devoted myself to the final store tidy-up before the Spring Festival. First, I took inventory and adjusted the displays: I pulled out the stock sheet and iPad, carefully counted all items, checked quantities, and noted missing sizes. I changed the season's jackets and sweaters off the mannequins and placed several newly arrived lightweight down jackets in prominent positions in preparation for the warmer weather after the holiday. Next, I organized the warehouse and planned the spring new arrivals: I regrouped the warehouse samples by category, put the three key spring fabric swatches (slightly stretchy water-repellent fabric, honeycomb abrasion-resistant fabric, and soft-shell fleece) into boxes and labeled them. On the whiteboard, I wrote the key points for the post-holiday 'Spring New Arrival Launch Plan': hot-selling hoodies, techwear-style pants, and co-branded accessories. Finally, I used Word on the computer to typeset the Spring Festival holiday notice. It read: 'The store will be closed from January 25 to February 4, 2025, and will officially reopen on February 5 (the eighth day of the first lunar month).' I also emphasized that 'online customer service will be available throughout the holiday.' I printed two copies—one to post on the store door, and one for the files. Then, with the notice and New Year poster, I used the slogan 'Like us and we'll stay open for three days; there's a surprise when we reopen' and officially posted it to all customer groups and Moments. I also liked and interacted with returning customers who had liked the ski viral video from the previous two days, replying to their comments.
location: In the store and warehouse of 'Mingxuan Men's Wear', Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Treated himself to lunch at IFC Mall
description: After a busy morning, I walked from Super Brand Mall across the skybridge to the IPPUDO ramen shop on the B1 floor of IFC Mall. I ordered a bowl of signature tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg and a serving of Japanese fried dumplings. Without having to rush, I slowly enjoyed the last work meal treating myself before the New Year. While eating, I scrolled through my phone and saw that the holiday notice already had over a dozen likes and messages saying 'Boss, Happy New Year,' which made me feel pleased.
location: Ippudo Ramen, B1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handed over holiday online work with store clerk Lin Yue
description: After lunch, returned to the shop, and Lin Yue had already arrived. The two met on the fitting bench in the shop's rest area and got straight to the point: "Xiao Lin, on the last day before the New Year, let's finalize the holiday online work." First confirmed the schedule: I would handle online responses from January 25 to 28, and Lin Yue would take over after January 29. Emphasized details: one selected product review or outfit recommendation with real photos must be posted on Moments every day; product inquiries in the customer group must be responded to within 10 minutes, and if unable to reply, a message must be left; once again confirmed the warehouse key and the storage location of high-value samples. Then used my phone to show Lin Yue how to quickly generate personalized response scripts, and answered questions about inventory samples. Lin Yue asked how to handle a customer who needed to pick up goods on the last day before the New Year. I clearly instructed that anything that can be handled today should be handled today, and before leaving, asked Lin Yue to watch the shop.
location: In the rest area of “Mingxuan Men's Wear”, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store wrap-up and welcoming regular customers
description: While I was assigning tasks, a regular customer, Feng Xiaoyu, walked in and greeted me warmly. She took a liking to a new hoodie. I got her the right size and recommended pairing it with cargo pants. She tried it on, was very satisfied, and paid directly by scanning the QR code. I asked Lin Yue to wrap it for her and promised, 'It'll be perfect for wearing during Chinese New Year; if there are any quality issues, come to me anytime.' After seeing the customer off, I checked again that the holiday notice at the door was firmly posted, gave the spare key to Lin Yue, locked the storage room door, and finally looked around the store to make sure all the power was off except for one light, completing the final tasks before the new year.
location: “Mingxuan Menswear,” Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove home and confirmed the plan with a close friend by phone
description: Drove back to Shanggang Community from the Super Brand Mall underground parking lot, along Century Avenue. On the way, I called my friend Han Dong via Bluetooth, confirming the plan to meet at the usual place by the riverside at 1:30 p.m. tomorrow to go roller skating. Han Dong said no problem and asked about the latest new movies and dinner plans; I said we'd decide later. After hanging up, my mood fully switched into holiday mode.
location: Starting from the underground parking lot of Super Brand Mall at 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, drive along Century Avenue back to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Pick up his mother and go to the supermarket to buy Chinese New Year goods.
description: Parked the car at the entrance of the residential community. Mother Wang Xiuying was already waiting downstairs with a small shopping bag. After picking her up, we drove all the way to the East Zone of Pushang Department Store on Changli Road. Once inside the supermarket, we went straight to the New Year goods section and picked out large gold-embossed Spring Festival couplets, big red 'Fu' characters, mixed candies, melon seeds and nuts, as well as the glutinous rice flour Mother specifically asked for to make tangyuan. In the fresh food section, Mother chose a large pomfret and a few jin of pork ribs as the main dishes for the New Year's Eve dinner. While shopping, we chatted about the arrangements for paying New Year visits to my maternal uncle's and paternal aunt's homes, and the atmosphere was lively. After finishing the shopping, we loaded the purchases into the car.
location: Starting from the entrance of Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, drive to the East Zone of Pushang Department Store, No. 321-337 Changli Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Arrived home to sort out the New Year goods and prepare dinner
description: Drove back home from the supermarket to Shanggang Community and carried all the purchased New Year goods upstairs. Father Lei Jianguo was watching the news in the living room; he got up and helped put the Spring Festival couplets and blessing characters on the balcony. I organized the ingredients that needed to be kept fresh into the refrigerator, while Mother began washing vegetables and cutting meat to prepare dinner. The family worked together, and the New Year atmosphere grew stronger.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. XX, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Tidy up the bedroom and study in preparation for a thorough cleaning
description: Taking advantage of his mother's cooking time, he returned to his bedroom and study to prepare for the evening's big cleanup. First, he cleared away the scattered receipts and flyers on the desk; then he opened the wardrobe, picked out a few old T-shirts and jeans he would clearly never wear again, put them into a clean canvas bag, and planned to throw them out along the way when going out tomorrow, as a warm-up for decluttering.
location: Bedroom and study at home, No. XX, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Simple fat-burning exercise in the living room
description: With 20 minutes until dinner, he did a simple fat-burning exercise in the open space of the living room to maintain his exercise habit. He completed 1 minute of jumping jacks, 30 squats, and a set of planks. Although the intensity was low, he worked up a light sweat — it was the only aerobic exercise of the day.
location: Home living room, No. XX, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Sharing work accomplishments at a family dinner
description: At the dinner table, his mother had prepared oil-braised shrimp, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and the leftover pork rib soup from noon. While eating, he reported the day's store closing progress to his parents: “The store is all arranged, the holiday is set, and Lin Yue has been briefed. Starting tomorrow, I've arranged to go rollerblading along the riverside with Dongzi, and the day after tomorrow to visit my uncle's family for New Year...” His father nodded with satisfaction and asked about the store insurance and lease; he answered each question. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room at No. XX, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Year-end cleaning and blind box display cabinet refresh
description: After dinner, full of energy, I began the long-awaited year-end cleaning. First, I spent 45 minutes organizing the Pop Mart blind box display cabinet in the bedroom: I took out all of the dozens of figures, rearranged them on the desk in the 'red-gold-black' New Year color scheme, placed the limited editions and zodiac figures in the center position, and gave the display wall a fresh new look. Then I continued cleaning out drawers and bookshelves, threw away old socks, broken phone cases, and expired fashion magazines, and pulled out a few old clothes from the wardrobe, stuffing them into the canvas tote bag I had prepared earlier, completing the decluttering. Looking at the tidy room and the refreshed blind box wall, I felt especially pleased.
location: Bedroom and study at home, No. XX, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and nighttime skincare
description: He placed the packed old clothes by the door for recycling the next day, then went to the bathroom to shower. The hot water washed away the day's fatigue. After the shower, he carefully applied moisturizer in front of the mirror, continuing the skincare routine he had started in mid-January, and felt his skin was in good condition.
location: Bathroom at home, No. XX, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Online interactions and reading before bed.
description: After getting into bed, he picked up his phone first, checked the more than thirty likes and New Year greetings under the daytime holiday notice on Moments, and replied to each one with thanks. Then he took a quick look through the regular customers group to confirm there were no urgent messages, and sent Han Dong a sticker that said, “See you tomorrow afternoon at the usual place.” After that, he opened his Kindle and continued reading The Qingming Scroll Code for about half an hour before drowsiness set in.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, No. XX, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Set up tomorrow's schedule and go to bed
description: Turned off the Kindle, set the phone alarm for 7:30 tomorrow morning (noting 'pack old clothes and head out'), and added tomorrow's schedule reminders: deliver old clothes before 10 a.m., and go rollerblading with Han Dong at the riverside at 1:30 p.m. After everything was ready, I turned off the light and quickly fell asleep, looking forward to the holiday—a fulfilling day came to a close.
location: Home bedroom at No. XX, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting up, weight monitoring, and morning wake-up
description: On the first day of the holiday, Lei Mingxuan slept in until he naturally woke up. Outside the window the northeast wind howled and the sky was grayish white. After getting up, he stood barefoot on the digital scale and saw his weight at 80.5 kilograms, reminding himself to keep exercising during the holiday. He then went to the bathroom to wash up, applied moisturizer in front of the mirror, and checked his wrist that had been splashed with oil yesterday—no trace remained. He changed into his workout clothes, went to the living room, poured a glass of warm water, and drank it slowly, getting ready for his morning run.
location: Bedroom, bathroom, and living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run in the neighborhood and old clothes recycling
description: Lei Mingxuan pushed open the unit door, and the cold wind rushed in, so he quickly zipped up his jacket. He jogged 2 kilometers on the garden path in the residential area, gradually warming up and loosening his muscles. After the run, he went to the waste-sorting recycling point at the east gate and put a bag of old T-shirts and jeans he had sorted out last night into the used-clothing recycling bin, practicing environmental protection.
location: Garden walkway and east gate recycling point, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Watering flowers on the balcony and reporting to his mother.
description: Back home, Lei Mingxuan went to the balcony to water several pots of pothos and spider plants. His gaze fell on his mother's beloved Christmas cactus, and he noticed red flower buds the size of rice grains had sprouted, looking full of life. While pouring water into the pots, he called out to the kitchen: “Mom, your Christmas cactus has buds—bright red and so lively!” Hearing this in the kitchen, his mother was overjoyed.
location: Balcony at home, Shanggang Residential Area, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Helping in the kitchen to prepare the New Year's Eve dinner and handling work messages
description: His mother was in the kitchen preparing ingredients for fried meatballs and egg dumplings. Lei Mingxuan washed his hands and helped out. He blanched the pork ribs and put them in a clay pot to simmer, and followed his mother's example to learn how to make egg dumplings: greasing a metal ladle with pork fat, pouring in beaten egg, swirling it evenly, and adding the meat filling. His mother also talked about how, when she was a child during the Chinese New Year, her father brought home frozen meat from Shiliupu Wharf. The kitchen was filled with the warmth of home. Lei Mingxuan deliberately wore the fleece jacket he had bought for his parents to keep oil splatters off his clothes. In the middle of it all, he took out his phone and saw the new outfit matching photos sent by store clerk Lin Yue. He forwarded them to the regular customers group with the caption: 'New battle gear for the New Year - wear it on the fifth day to welcome the God of Wealth. If you get it, DM me.' Someone in the group replied quickly, and he smiled and responded, 'On it,' keeping the store's group chat lively.
location: Home kitchen and living room, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family lunch and trying new flavors
description: At lunchtime, his mother brought the freshly fried meatballs and nicely colored egg dumplings to the table, and also stir-fried two quick dishes. The three of them sat around the table. His father, Lei Jianguo, sipped half a liang of baijiu with the meatballs, while Lei Mingxuan and his mother praised the taste as they ate. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday rest and reading warm-up
description: After tidying up after the meal, Lei Mingxuan curled up on the living room sofa, made himself a cup of hot tea, took out his Kindle, and started reading a historical novel about the Maritime Silk Road in Ming Dynasty Shanghai. When he read the passage about merchant ships coming and going at Wusongkou, he took photos of a few pages with his phone, planning to share them in his Moments later.
location: Living room sofa at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon gear organization and light meal preparation
description: Lei Mingxuan dug out the roller skating bag from the corner and checked the wheels and bearings to make sure they were in good condition. He took a carton of milk and the cherries he had bought the day before from the fridge, put them in a fresh-keeping bag, and packed them into his backpack as supplies for the exercise session. Before leaving, he also sent a message in the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group chat: “Guys, I’m going street skating along the river this afternoon. I’ve invited Han Dong. Anyone want to join?”
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Cycling to the Pudong Riverside.
description: Since driving was inconvenient on Riverside Avenue, Lei Mingxuan scanned a shared bike and rode from the entrance of his residential compound eastward along Pudong Avenue, arriving at the entrance to Riverside Avenue (near Qichangzhan Ferry) after about 20 minutes.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area (cycling route from No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, to the Qichangzhan Ferry section of Binjiang Avenue)

name: Riverside Inline Skating and Long-Missed Exhilaration
description: Han Dong was already stretching by the ferry dock. When the two met, they playfully punched each other's shoulders, then put on their roller skates and skated along the wide riverside avenue toward Lujiazui. The river wind was strong, but skating warmed them up and felt exhilarating. They chatted while skating, from funny stories about closing the shop yesterday to Spring Festival plans, occasionally stopping to take photos of the river view and the winter scenery of the Bund on the other side. Lei Mingxuan remembered the snacks he had stocked up on during Double 11 and joked to Han Dong that he was going home today to polish off a bag of potato chips. Han Dong laughed at him for being greedy and making excuses.
location: Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (along the section from Qichangzhan Ferry to Lujiazui)

name: Rest at a coffee shop and Spring Festival plans
description: After skating for nearly two hours, the two were tired and bought two hot lattes outside the M Stand store on the LG floor of Lujiazui Center, sitting on a bench to rest. Lei Mingxuan sipped his coffee and asked Han Dong: "When are you free after the Spring Festival? There will definitely be few people at my billiards hall on the evening of the fifth day of the Lunar New Year. Want to play a couple of games of billiards?" Han Dong thought for a moment and said okay, and would confirm for sure on the fourth day.
location: Rest area outside the M Stand coffee shop, LG floor, Lujiazui Center, Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling back and shopping along the way
description: After parting ways with Han Dong, Lei Mingxuan rode a shared bike along Pudong South Road toward home. When he passed the fruit stand at the community gate, he stopped and bought some strawberries and green grapes, planning to eat them after dinner.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai (cycling route from Lujiazui Center to Shanggang Community) and the fruit stall at the entrance of Shanggang Community

name: Sharing and organizing snacks after returning home.
description: Back home, Lei Mingxuan felt a little hungry. He took out the potato chips he had stocked up on during Double 11 from the bedside table in the bedroom, tore open the bag, and ate a small portion. Then he walked to the living room and held out the chips to his mother, who was picking vegetables: 'Mom, try these chips. New flavor, pretty crispy.' His mother smiled and picked up two slices, and only then did he seal the rest and put it back on the coffee table. Later, while tidying the room, he found a pack of sandwich cookies on the bedside table. He weighed it in his hand and decided to save it as a late-night snack for New Year's Eve.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing the car and helping Dad
description: Father Lei Jianguo was downstairs wiping down his old Buick, getting ready to visit relatives on Chinese New Year's Eve tomorrow. Lei Mingxuan changed into an old jacket and went downstairs, took the bucket and rag, and wiped the car together with his father. As the father and son worked and chatted, he mentioned that he planned to go play billiards on the fifth day of the New Year; his father reminded him not to drink too much.
location: Ground parking lot, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dinner and casual family chat.
description: Dinner was leftover pork rib soup, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and fried meatballs from lunch. The family of three chatted while eating. Lei Mingxuan mentioned that during the afternoon roller skating he saw many people running along the river. His father also said the New Year's Eve dinner should be prepared earlier. After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the table.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Immersive reading time
description: After showering and changing into comfortable pajamas, Lei Mingxuan curled up on the living room sofa, set his phone to silent, left only a floor lamp on, and focused on continuing to read the historical novel. He was completely immersed in the story; when he reached exciting parts, he used his phone to jot down keywords and page numbers to savor later. An hour and a half passed in a flash, and before he knew it, he had finished one-third of the remaining content.
location: Living room sofa at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Online Socializing and Holiday Planning
description: Putting down the Kindle, Lei Mingxuan picked up his phone and replied to a few friends' 'Happy New Year' private messages. In the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat, he saw a funny video posted by Zhang Wei and replied 'hahahaha'. Then he opened Bilibili and watched the latest vlog and donkey hoof trimming videos from the UP creators he follows, easily passing the time. After that, he posted a nine-grid Moments post with the photos of the riverside view he took in the afternoon, captioning it: 'Day one of the holiday, starting with the wind by the river.'
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and skincare.
description: After finishing the day's activities, Lei Mingxuan went into the bathroom to wash up carefully. After cleansing his face with facial cleanser, he carefully applied toner and moisturizer, completing his daily skincare routine.
location: Bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading to fall asleep
description: Lying in bed, Lei Mingxuan glanced at the unopened sandwich cookies, resisted the impulse, and put them and the potato chips in the back of the snack cabinet. He opened WeChat to confirm that the store's customer service group was normal, checked tomorrow's schedule—mainly helping his father put up Spring Festival couplets and going to the market to pick up the pre-ordered fish—then set his alarm for 8:30. After turning off the main light and leaving only the bedside night light on, he picked up his Kindle and read a novel for fifteen minutes until drowsiness set in. He closed the book, turned off the light, and fell asleep peacefully amid the faint sound of firecrackers.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and personal care.
description: Woke up naturally at 7:30 in the morning, went to the bathroom first, then weighed myself at 80.6 kg, 0.1 kg more than yesterday. Then I brushed my teeth, washed my face, applied moisturizer, and tidied my hair to get ready for the second day of the Chinese New Year.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Putting up Spring Festival couplets with my father
description: Took out the Spring Festival couplets and the 'Fu' character from the living room cabinet. Father made paste from flour, and the two of them cleaned off the old couplets, wiped the door frames, and put up the new couplets and the upside-down 'Fu' stickers. The home was filled with a strong festive New Year atmosphere.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Accompanied his mother to buy groceries and had breakfast
description: Walked about 15 minutes with my mother to Pushang Vegetable Market. My mother picked up the pre-ordered big bream and bought shepherd's purse and tofu, while I bought fried rice cake and soy milk at the market entrance for breakfast and ate them on the way.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home to tidy up and paying New Year calls to neighbors
description: After returning home, he put the fish in the kitchen, changed into a dry T-shirt, sat on the sofa to rest, and scrolled through his phone to reply to New Year greetings. When he went downstairs to take out the trash, he met Aunt Wang, a first-floor neighbor, and they exchanged New Year greetings and had a brief chat.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and downstairs

name: Reviewing family finances and store plans with father
description: Father brewed tea, took out the account book, bank statements, and an abacus. I moved a chair to sit opposite him and used a mobile bookkeeping app to cross-check the family expenses simultaneously. Then I opened my laptop to show the store's annual report, revenue and profit, and the plan for a new year brand collection store. Father gave steady and down-to-earth advice.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family marriage-urging episode and preparing lunch
description: After finishing the accounts, my mother brought over some oranges and then immediately urged me to get married, which caused some unhappiness. My father smoothed things over. I slipped into the kitchen, put on gloves, and prepared the big bream — scaling it, gutting it, and marinating it. My mother came in too and listened to opera while preparing lunch, and the atmosphere gradually relaxed.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family lunch time
description: On the table were braised bream in soy sauce, shepherd's purse and tofu soup, and stir-fried choy sum. The family tacitly avoided sensitive topics. My father talked about old times, and the atmosphere warmed up. I ate two bowls of rice and took the initiative to wash the dishes after the meal.
location: Dining Room, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Quarter, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Planning the afternoon schedule at noon
description: After washing the dishes and returning to my room, I felt restless and wanted to go out for some fresh air. After checking, I learned that the billiards hall at World Plaza was open, so I decided to go play billiards alone in the afternoon to relax.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drive alone to play pool and unwind
description: Dressed in a thick down jacket, he left the house, stopped at the small supermarket near the community gate to buy an iced Coke Zero and salt-and-pepper peanuts, and drove to Ball Power Billiards Club in the basement of World Plaza. He got a table for American eight-ball, focused on practicing fundamentals and black-eight game scenarios, and played some smooth rounds. During the session, he received a WeChat message from his childhood friend Zhang Wei, and they agreed to talk on the phone in the evening. Afterward, he stopped at the Sinopec gas station on Pucheng Road to fill up and then drove home.
location: Ball Power Billiards Club, Basement Level 1, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home and chatting with his mother.
description: When I got home, my mother was watching TV in the living room and asked where I had gone in the afternoon. I told her I went to play ball and mentioned that Zhang Wei would call in the evening. Mother handed me an orange, and the atmosphere eased.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon leisure reading and snacks
description: Back in my room, continued reading the climax of the "Red Umbrella Case" in The Qingming Scroll Code on my Kindle, enjoying iced cola and peanuts as I read, completely relaxed.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: For dinner I had soup rice cakes with leftover food from lunch, and afterward I volunteered to do the dishes; my father watched the news while I talked about playing ball in the afternoon, and the atmosphere was peaceful.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Simple evening exercise
description: Half an hour after dinner, did stretching and a few push-ups in the living room to loosen up.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handling online store matters
description: Logged into the store backend on his phone, checked orders and inquiries, replied to regular customers' New Year greetings, and sent red envelopes in the customer group to liven up the atmosphere.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Had a phone call with childhood friend Zhang Wei.
description: Zhang Wei called. I complained about being pressured to get married, and he laughed heartily and shared his coping methods, then told me the good news that they are expecting their second child and that he will soon be posted to Singapore. We chatted for nearly forty minutes and agreed to get together properly before he leaves.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening bath and skincare
description: Took a hot shower; after thorough cleansing, applied toner, lotion, and eye cream to complete the daily skincare routine.
location: Bathroom, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxed by catching up on anime before bed.
description: Changed into pajamas and curled up in bed, opened Bilibili and watched two consecutive episodes of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, smiling knowingly at the marriage-pressure scene in the show.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading before bed and falling asleep.
description: After turning off the light, read a novel on Kindle for another ten-odd minutes until my eyes grew heavy; set the alarm for 8:30 the next morning, charged the phone, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and washing up
description: At 7 a.m. on Monday morning, sunlight woke me through the gap in the curtains. Because I went to bed early last night, I felt energetic today. After a quick wash-up, I changed into a thick athletic hoodie and a down vest, ready to head out.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go out to buy breakfast
description: He put on his shoes and went downstairs, walking to the "Yanqin Grocery Store" at the entrance of the alley. He happened to see Aunt Zhu sitting in the doorway sunning herself and picking vegetables. She smiled and greeted him, "Mingxuan, you're up so early today!" "Morning, Granny! I'm going to buy some buns." I returned her smile, bought two pork buns and a cup of hot soy milk, paid with my phone, and carried them back.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store at the alley entrance, Shanggang Residential Quarter, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Eat breakfast and handle store messages.
description: Returned home, sat at the dining table, drinking hot soy milk and eating baozi. Meanwhile, I opened my phone, logged into the store's WeChat backend, and saw that several regular customers had left messages overnight asking about Spring Festival business hours. I replied to each: "Dear, we open on the eighth day of the new year; come visit after the holiday!" I also scrolled through WeChat Moments and liked a few friends' posts showing off New Year goods.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Confirmed the gathering in a group chat with old friends.
description: After breakfast, my phone went 'ding ding' — the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group was active. Chen Hao suggested in the group: 'Guys, how about getting together on the evening of the third day of the New Year? It's rare that everyone is in Shanghai this year.' I replied immediately: 'Definitely! I vote for Huixiang Restaurant for Shanghainese cuisine, my treat!' Liu Yang, who's far away in Shenzhen, also sent a voice message: 'Nice, Boss Lei is generous! I just got some limited-edition designer toys and I'll bring them to show you.' The three of us quickly agreed: 6 p.m. on the third day of the first lunar month (January 31), at Huixiang Restaurant.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go to the food market to stock up on Chinese New Year goods.
description: The weather was nice, so I decided to walk to the market to buy New Year goods. The plane trees beside the sidewalk were bare, and the winter sunlight felt comfortable on my skin. The market was bustling with noise and full of a strong festive atmosphere. Following my mother's instructions, I bought fresh winter bamboo shoots and snow peas. I also saw bright red strawberries and bought a box on impulse. Finally, I queued at the cooked food counter and bought half a jin of braised beef, planning to add it to lunch.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go home and reserve a restaurant for the gathering
description: Back home, I put the groceries into the fridge by category and changed into comfortable loungewear. Remembering the gathering we had just confirmed, I immediately opened the review app on my phone, found the number for Huixiang Lou, and called. I spoke to the owner in Shanghainese: "Boss Wang, happy New Year! Please save me a large private room for the third day of the new year (January 31) at 6 p.m. There will be 6 of us, the usual dishes, around 250 yuan per person." The owner agreed readily. After hanging up, I sent a screenshot of the successful reservation to the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat, and Chen Hao immediately sent a sticker saying "Boss is awesome."
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handled online shop work.
description: Taking advantage of my good morning focus, I sat down at the desk, opened my laptop, and logged into the store's supplier backend. I sent final pre-holiday confirmation messages to Brother Tao in Hangzhou and Sister Fang in Guangzhou, verifying the shipping times for the first batch of spring styles after the holiday. I also replied to inquiries on several online platforms, and finally checked all the store's auto-replies and coupon settings to ensure smooth operation during the holiday.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Had Japanese ramen for lunch.
description: After finishing work, I got hungry right on schedule. I put on my coat and decided to go out to find something to eat. I strolled to the nearby IFC Mall, went straight down to B1, and went to the usual Japanese ramen shop. I ordered a signature rich tonkotsu ramen. The steaming hot broth with a soft-boiled egg and nori warmed me all over after a bowl.
location: Japanese Ramen Restaurant, B1, International Finance Center Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Jogging in the park.
description: After leaving the mall, I walked along Lujiazui Ring Road for a few minutes and arrived at Lujiazui Central Green Park. I sat down on a bench at the entrance, took off my coat, and changed into the sweatpants and running shoes I had brought with me. After a few simple warm-up moves, I loosened up my ankles and knees. The park's paths were clean and the sunshine was mild. I opened the workout app and started jogging according to plan, keeping a steady pace of about 6:20 per kilometer. Breathing the crisp winter air, I felt great all over as I ran. Passing by the small hill and the lake, I saw quite a few elderly people taking walks and people walking their dogs. After finishing 3 kilometers, I did 10 minutes of stretching in the small plaza by the lake and worked up a light sweat.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went home to shower and change clothes
description: After the run, I walked home. Once inside, I quickly took a hot shower and changed into a clean casual hoodie and jeans. I felt refreshed and ready to handle things with renewed energy.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Inspect the store and send well wishes to customers
description: After changing clothes, I strolled over to the store in Super Brand Mall. Although it was on holiday, I came by out of habit to check things. I opened the rolling shutter door with the key and checked that the water, electricity, and displays were all in good condition. Then I sat in the store, logged into the store's WeChat on my phone, and sent customized Spring Festival greetings to the last batch of VIP regular customers.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: A Starbucks break for thinking and planning
description: After finishing customer service work, I locked the store door, went down to the Starbucks on the first floor, and bought a medium iced Americano. I found a seat by the window, took out the notebook I carried with me, and started sketching. I took out the 'Xiafei Collection' transformation plan I had organized earlier and pondered it again, planning to contact coffee equipment suppliers after the holiday. Outside the window, the Lujiazui street scene bustled by, but my thoughts were especially clear.
location: Starbucks Coffee, 1st Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Browsing the mall and pulling blind boxes
description: After finishing my coffee, I decided to wander around the mall casually to soak in the pre-Spring Festival atmosphere. The mall was decorated with lanterns and colorful banners everywhere, with festive music playing. I walked to the Pop Mart vending machine on the third floor, and my fingers itched to pull a blind box from a new series. I got lucky — I pulled the 'Koi' design. Feeling great, I took a selfie and posted it to the 'Art Toy Enthusiasts Group'.
location: Third floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pack up takeout and go home.
description: Walked around the mall until 4:30, then remembered that he hadn't brought anything for his mother today. So he went to the nearby "Lujiazui Center Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant" and ordered takeout of her favorite Shanghai-style braised pork and a serving of stir-fried clover. Carrying the takeout box, he strolled leisurely home.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, 889 South Pudong Road, Lujiazui Center, Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: When I got home, Mom had already stir-fried several vegetable dishes, and I took out the hearty takeout dishes I had packed. Dad beamed when he saw them: The son really knows what your mom is thinking! At the table, I briefly mentioned treating people to dinner on the evening of the third day of the Lunar New Year. Mom asked, You are treating again? How many people? I said, Just three old friends, at Huixiang Restaurant. Dad nodded: Good, old classmate friendships should be maintained. The meal was very pleasant, and no one brought up yesterday's topic of urging marriage again today.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxing in the living room watching TV with mother
description: After the meal, I took the initiative to wash the dishes. After cleaning up the kitchen, my mother had already cut up some fruit and was curled up on the sofa watching an opera program. I sat over beside her, eating oranges, and chatted with her about this and that. I showed her the 'koi fish' blind box I had drawn in the afternoon, and she said, 'Pretty, and it's a good sign!'
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Browsing Bilibili and studying Japanese
description: Stayed with mom until 7:30, then went back to my room. I scrolled through Bilibili for a while and watched the latest episode of the new anime I had been looking forward to since last night, Frieren: Beyond Journey's End. The bullet comments were full of 'Frieren is cute.' After that, I opened the Duolingo app and spent 20 minutes learning some practical Japanese phrases about 'asking directions,' preparing for a possible future ski trip to Japan.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparations and New Year's greetings to cousin.
description: He closed the Duolingo app and got up to wash up. After lying in bed, he remembered that last night he had only sent a brief New Year's WeChat message, which felt a bit too casual. So he edited a long WeChat message and sent it to his cousin Shen Jie: 'Jiejie, happy New Year! Are you busy today? It's settled – let's meet at Uncle's place on the second day of the New Year (January 30) and chat more. I've brought you something nice!' As soon as it was sent, Shen Jie replied with a voice message: 'Ha, bro! I was just about to ask you to watch a show! Never mind about gifts. See you on the second day! Get some rest too!'
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Scrolling through WeChat Moments before bed.
description: After replying to Shen Jie with a 'good night' sticker, I habitually scrolled through my Moments. I saw that my childhood friend Zhang Wei had posted that he went fishing today and had a great catch. I clicked like and commented, 'Awesome! Let's go together after the New Year!' I also saw someone in the roller skating group sharing a video of night skating along Binjiang Avenue, which made me eager, and I decided I must go skating once after the holiday.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep
description: After looking at his phone, he turned the screen to the lowest brightness and set the alarm for 7:30 tomorrow morning. He had exercised today and handled quite a few things, so his body was a little tired, but his mood was very relaxed. Turning off the bedside lamp, he soon fell asleep in the warmth of the quilt.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting up and morning routine
description: The 7:30 alarm went off right on time. After getting up, he went to the bathroom to wash his face with cold water and stepped on the scale to weigh himself; it read 80.8 kg, and he silently reminded himself to be restrained at tonight's New Year's Eve dinner. Back in the bedroom, he changed into a loose grey cotton hoodie, picked up his phone to scroll through his Moments feed, and casually liked a photo of morning light.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Purchasing missed New Year goods at the food market.
description: Walked about 15 minutes to Pushang Vegetable Market. The market was crowded with people and full of New Year atmosphere. I went to the dried goods section and bought half a jin of rock sugar in lumps, then picked out two fat winter bamboo shoots at the usual vegetable stall, and also bought snow peas and a box of strawberries. While paying, I ran into Aunt Zhu from the neighboring alley, who was also shopping. She smiled and said, "Xiao Lei, you're helping with the grocery shopping today? That's so filial." I quickly smiled back and said, "Happy New Year, Auntie! Helping my mom lighten the load a bit." Then I carried a big bag of New Year goods home.
location: Pushang Market on Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Go home to put away New Year goods and have a simple breakfast.
description: After arriving home, I put the rock sugar, winter bamboo shoots, and other purchases in the kitchen. Seeing this, my mother said repeatedly, "Perfect, perfect, just what we needed!" I casually peeled a strawberry and ate it, and my mother lightly tapped the back of my hand to remind me to wash my hands. After washing my hands, I went to the dining room. My father had already cooked white congee, and my mother brought out steamed meat buns and pickled vegetables. The three of us sat around the table eating breakfast. While drinking congee, I made an appointment with my father to put up Spring Festival couplets together later, and he smiled and nodded.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Putting up Spring Festival couplets and Fu characters to decorate the home.
description: After breakfast, I took out Spring Festival couplets, "Fu" character stickers, transparent tape, and scissors from the storage cabinet, and my father brought a small stool. First, we compared the positions on both sides of the living room door, using a phone level to ensure they were aligned; my father was in charge of passing the tape and pressing them down. After finishing the door, I pasted a large "Fu" character upside down on the entryway wall, and also stuck a pair of small "Fu" characters on the glass balcony door. Father muttered, "That spot was a bit crooked last year," and I smiled and assured him it would be straight this year. Mother saw this from the kitchen and smiled contentedly.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family leisure and preparations for the New Year's Eve dinner
description: After putting up the Spring Festival couplets, I took off my coat and went to the kitchen to help my mother. She was preparing the sea bass, so I took over the snow peas to string and wash them. As she worked, my mother chatted about my cousin Shen Jie's new job and praised her sharp eye as a buyer. I casually replied that on the second day of the New Year, when we went to my uncle's home, I would talk with her about my ideas for the store transformation. After washing the vegetables, I helped set the table for the evening meal with bowls, chopsticks, and red wine glasses — three place settings in total, neatly arranged.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Midday break and phone social media time.
description: After a busy stretch, I sat down on the living room sofa and took out my phone to relax. Opening WeChat, I saw that Chen Hao had posted a "Happy New Year's Eve" sticker in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group, and Liu Yang had followed with photos from a designer toy expo—it was very lively. I replied, "Talk tonight, wait until I've sent out the red packets!" Then I spent about 12 minutes scrolling through clips of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End on Bilibili as a midday break.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon rest and handling personal matters
description: Afternoon sunlight spilled into the bedroom. He lay down on the bed for a 20-minute nap and felt much more refreshed after waking up. He got up, opened his phone memo, and noted a few ideas about the transformation of the clothing store "Xiafei Ji," such as adding a display rack for designer toys in the store. Then he looked through the designer toy preview link Liu Yang had sent in the morning, quickly browsing a few pictures of unreleased blind boxes. They looked good, and he planned to discuss them with Liu Yang in the evening.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Help mother prepare the New Year's Eve dinner.
description: Starting at two o'clock in the afternoon, my mother showed off her skills in the kitchen. She first simmered a 'family reunion' clay-pot stew with egg dumplings, meatballs, vermicelli, and Chinese cabbage, and the aroma filled the air. My father was peeling garlic and cutting scallions on the side, while I ran errands and plated the dishes: lining the plate for the steamed sea bass with ginger slices and trimming the whiskers off the oil-braised shrimp. My mother asked me to taste a piece of braised pork that had just come out of the wok. I chewed, gave a thumbs-up, and told her the cooking was superb, and she beamed with joy. All afternoon, the sounds of the spatula and laughter were interwoven in the kitchen, filled with the strong flavor of the New Year.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pre-dinner tidying and changing clothes preparation
description: At 5 p.m., my mother said the dishes were almost ready. I placed cold dishes such as four-joy marinated gluten and sweet-and-sour spare ribs on the table one by one, and opened a bottle of Shikumen yellow wine, setting it beside my father's seat. Then I returned to my room, found a dark red hoodie, and changed into it for a festive touch. I ran my fingers through my hair, applied a little hairspray, and tidied up. When I returned to the living room, my father had already turned the TV to the Spring Festival Gala warm-up program and was softly humming a tune, looking quite content.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: New Year's Eve dinner and family reunion
description: Dinner started at 18:00 sharp. The table was filled with my mother's signature dishes: eight glistening pieces of Shanghainese braised pork, steamed sea bass, oil-braised shrimp, pan-fried pork buns, a family-reunion clay pot, and stir-fried clover. I poured half a glass of yellow wine for my father and half for myself; my mother toasted with tea instead. The three of us raised our glasses and wished each other "Happy New Year and smooth business!" Father asked about the shop's transformation, and I explained the "Xiafei Collection" plan in detail; Mother said she fully supported it. I ate two big bowls of rice with the braised pork, and Mother kept urging me to eat more fish. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious, and the earlier bit about being urged to get married melted away.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Watching the Spring Festival Gala and sending New Year red envelopes
description: At 20:00, the Spring Festival Gala started on time. The family moved to the sofa in the living room, and my mother put out a fruit tray with sunflower seeds, peanuts, and sugar tangerines. I picked up my phone, opened the WeChat chat with store clerk Lin Yue, entered a red envelope of 888 yuan with an encouraging message. Lin Yue immediately replied with thanks and we wished each other good luck. Then in the 'Xiafei Ji' customer WeChat group, I edited a New Year greeting message and sent two rounds of lucky money red envelopes totaling 500 yuan. The group instantly became lively, and regular customers sent their blessings one after another.

participant.name: Group members in the customer group

location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Continuing to watch the Spring Festival Gala and exchanging ideas about designer toys
description: After sending the red envelopes, he continued lounging on the sofa watching the Spring Festival Gala. The sketch 'How Can That Be the Same?' had his mother rocking with laughter, and his father commented that this year's comedy acts were decent. Around 9:30 p.m., his phone buzzed. Liu Yang sent the trendy toy materials in the group chat - a Baidu Netdisk link containing sample images of Pop Mart collaboration blind boxes and a video from the Shenzhen Pop Toy Fair exhibition. He put on his earphones and eagerly browsed through them, then typed back, 'Damn, that Skull Cat collab is so cool! Let's talk all about it at the gathering on the third day of the New Year.' He also asked when his company's AR game would enter open beta. Liu Yang replied instantly and promised to give him a beta key. After chatting, it was almost 10 p.m., so he put down his phone and continued watching TV with his parents.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: New Year's Eve vigil, chatting, and family time
description: It was almost 11 p.m., and my parents were feeling sleepy; my mother was leaning on the sofa yawning. I suggested they go to bed first, but my father waved his hand and said he would stay up a little longer. I got up and went to the kitchen to boil water, poured a cup of hot water for each of my parents, and made myself a cup of Biluochun tea. The three of us drank tea and chatted about interesting stories from past New Year celebrations. When the conversation turned to the embarrassing incident of Mother burning the New Year cake last year, I joked, "Surplus every year — scorched, that is," which made the old couple laugh heartily. Outside the window came the occasional sound of firecrackers, and my mother softly sighed that another year had arrived.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Midnight countdown and family photo on WeChat Moments.
description: At around 23:45, I picked up my phone, opened the camera, and called my parents over to sit on the sofa. I adjusted the angle and took several family photos: one of us sitting upright, one of my mother smiling and making a heart with her hands, and one of my father catching the moment I looked down at the screen. At midnight, the host on TV began the countdown and dense fireworks sounded outside the window. I chose the most harmonious family photo and posted it to Moments with the caption "May every year bring good health, Happy Chinese New Year's Eve! Wishing the family health and all the best in the new year!" It immediately received more than a dozen likes. My childhood friend Zhang Wei commented "Happy New Year", and I replied with a fist-and-palm salute emoji.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Wrapping up the New Year's Eve vigil and going to bed
description: After 12:30, my parents couldn't hold on any longer and went to bed first. I stayed alone in the living room, turned down the TV volume, scrolled on my phone for a while, and watched the WeChat group gradually fall silent. I reopened the art toy video Liu Yang had sent and watched the last few minutes. At 1:00 AM, I stretched, turned off the TV and the main living room light, went back to the bedroom, changed into pajamas, and set the alarm to wake up naturally the next day. Lying in bed, I silently repeated to myself that this year I must get the "Xiafei Collection" going and also lose weight. With a smile, I slowly drifted off to sleep.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Get up, wash up, and ease the hangover
description: Woke up at nine in the morning in a dull state from a hangover. Because I had stayed up until past one o'clock for New Year's Eve and eaten quite a few melon seeds and candies, my throat was dry. I pulled on a thick hoodie, went to the bathroom, and washed my face with cold water to wake myself up. The sunlight outside the window was nice, but the weather forecast said 1-8°C with wind, so I need to wear thick clothes when going out.
location: Bedroom and bathroom in Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drank strong tea to refresh himself and helped his mother sort out New Year greeting gifts.
description: Walking into the living room, his mother had already brewed Longjing tea and handed him a cup while nagging about staying up late. As he drank tea, he inventoried the New Year gifts: two boxes of Brain Gold, one bird's nest gift box plus a fruit basket, and several boxes of pastries. Together with his mother, they sorted them into canvas bags and planned a route that would first go to his uncle's home in Jinqiao and then to his aunt's home.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove with his father to his uncle's house to pay a New Year visit
description: Once everything was ready, my father put on the new down jacket, I put on my black hardshell jacket and a beanie, and we carried the gift bags and drove to my uncle's house. On the way, my father asked about the red envelopes sent last night. I boasted about sending a generous 888 yuan, and my father smiled approvingly. Nostalgic golden oldies played in the car, filling it with the festive spirit of the New Year.
location: Driving from Shanggang Residential Quarter, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Jinqiao New City, Jinqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wishing Uncle and Aunt a happy New Year, chatting and catching up.
description: Arrived at my uncle's house, and my aunt greeted me warmly. I paid New Year's respects to my uncle and aunt and handed them gifts. My uncle pulled me to sit with him on the sofa, talked about his retirement life, and asked in detail about my clothing store business. I reported last year's performance and proposed the idea of transforming it into a "mountain-style techwear + coffee concept store." Although my uncle doesn't know much about fashion, he strongly supported it and encouraged me to be bold. My cousin hadn't come home, so we just chatted about everyday things.
location: Living room, Room 301, Building 13, Jinqiao New City, Jinqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Hearty lunch at my uncle's house
description: At noon, my aunt brought out her signature dishes: braised pork hock, stir-fried pea shoots, and oil-braised bamboo shoots. The pork hock was stewed so tender and flavorful that I couldn't help going for a second bowl of rice. My uncle opened a bottle of aged yellow wine and drank with my father; I also had a small sip to warm myself. The atmosphere at the table was lively and warm.
location: Dining room, Room 301, No. 13, Jinqiao New City, Jinqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drive to my aunt's house to pay a New Year's visit.
description: After the meal, I had tea and rested for a while, then said goodbye and headed to my aunt's house. On the way, I felt quite drowsy and dozed against the car window. My father drove steadily, and I was half asleep, not feeling too well.
location: Driving from Jinqiao New City on Jinqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Zhangyang Community, Lane 600, Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Pay a New Year visit to my aunt's family and play games with my younger male cousin.
description: When I arrived at my aunt's house, my aunt and uncle were watching the Spring Festival opera gala. After paying New Year's greetings and giving gifts, my younger cousin Yang Fan eagerly dragged me to play Honor of Kings. We lost two games in a row, and my cousin mocked me for being terrible, so I used the excuse of taking a phone call and slipped back to the living room to chat with the elders.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, Room 502, No. 14, Lane 600, Yuanshen Road, Zhangyang Community, living room

name: Driving back home
description: After saying goodbye to his aunt's family, he drove home with his father. On the way, he could finally clear his mind; the Lunar New Year's Day visiting routine was basically done, and the mission was accomplished.
location: Driving from Zhangyang Community, Lane 600, Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: A midday nap to recharge.
description: Returned home, took off my coat, set the alarm for 4:30, and fell straight asleep. Because I had stayed up late and visiting relatives was exhausting, I slept soundly and felt much better after waking up.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Exercise time: playing Ring Fit Adventure
description: After waking up, I didn't want to keep lying around. Thinking about the braised pork hock and snacks, I turned on the Switch and played Ring Fit Adventure for 20 minutes, broke into a light sweat, and felt great. Just so that when I see Shen Jie tomorrow, she won't say I've gained weight again.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon tea time, interacted with friends on WeChat
description: After exercising, I washed my face, cut a few slices of the osmanthus sugar lotus root my mother made, brewed a cup of Tieguanyin tea, and enjoyed afternoon tea on the sofa. At the same time, I opened my phone and sent voice New Year greetings to Zhang Wei and Li Na in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group. Zhang Wei posted photos of dumplings his wife made, Li Na complained that her mother's dumpling filling was too salty, and we agreed to get together after the New Year at Huixiang Restaurant.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Light family dinner
description: At dinner, my mother made blanched prawns, cucumber salad, stir-fried asparagus, and pork rib and radish soup, saying it was to cut the grease for us. I drank two big bowls of soup and ate a lot of vegetables, but didn't touch rice. I felt my stomach much less burdened.
location: Dining room, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Watched Spring Festival TV with his mother and interacted on his phone.
description: In the evening I accompanied my mother in the living room watching Dragon TV's Spring Festival special gala, and she knitted as she watched. I curled up beside her scrolling through my phone, replying to New Year greetings and red packets from colleagues and classmates on Moments. I saw Qian Duoduo's blind box video, liked it, and left a comment. I had some pine nuts in the meantime and reminded myself not to touch sunflower seeds or candy again.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Catch up on anime and plan tomorrow's schedule
description: After saying goodnight to his mother, he returned to his room, opened Bilibili, and watched two episodes of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End. Afterward, he jotted down in his phone memo the topics to discuss tomorrow when visiting his uncle's home to see Shen Jie, mainly asking for advice on coffee equipment selection and space design ideas.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wash up before bed
description: At 10:30, he turned off the computer and went to the bathroom to wash up. Thinking that his weight had probably gone up again, he couldn't help sighing. After brushing his teeth, he said to himself in the mirror that he needed to perk up to meet Shen Jie tomorrow and not let her think he had wasted the Chinese New Year holiday. He set the alarm for 8:30 the next morning, turned off the light, and got into bed.
location: Bathroom, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going to bed and falling asleep.
description: Lying in bed, he scrolled through Moments and saw Chen Hao posting photos of his cat, and smiled. Then he closed his eyes and fell deeply asleep in the lingering festive atmosphere of Chinese New Year's Eve and the first day of the new year, along with the warmth of family.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: After the alarm went off, Lei Mingxuan got up, washed up briefly, and drank a glass of warm water. Today he was going to his uncle's home to pay a New Year call, so he specially picked out a new black hoodie with dark gray casual pants. After weighing himself at 81.2 kg, he wrote 'resume running after the holiday' in his phone memo.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going out for shopping and family breakfast
description: Lei Mingxuan went out to buy New Year gifts. He first walked to Pushang Vegetable Market to buy two boxes of imported cherries and a box of Aksu apples, weighing about 10 jin in total, and then bought a box of American ginseng tablets for his uncle at the Yanqin Grocery Store at the entrance of the residential community. After shopping, he went home. His mother had prepared steaming Shanghai wontons and fried eggs. The family ate breakfast, confirmed the departure time, and moved the prepared fruit, health products, and two bottles of Wuliangye to the door, ready to set off.
location: Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Yanqin Grocery Store, and home at Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove to maternal uncle's home.
description: Father drove, with Lei Mingxuan and his mother in the back seat, from Shanggang Community in Pudong to his maternal uncle's home in Hengchangli, Changning District. Traffic was moderate. Lei Mingxuan spent the ride thinking about the key points of his discussion with Shen Jie, while his mother chatted with his father about the younger cousin's high school entrance exam scores. After arriving, since parking was limited, his father parked in the underground garage at Jing An Kerry Centre, and the family walked to Hengchangli.
location: Jing An Kerry Centre parking lot and Hengchang Lane, near Yuyuan Road, Changning District, Shanghai

name: Arrived at my maternal uncle's home to pay New Year's greetings and exchange pleasantries.
description: Arrived at Uncle's home in Hengchang Li, and Aunt opened the door to welcome them. The whole family exchanged New Year greetings in a lively atmosphere. Lei Mingxuan gave the prepared gifts, and Uncle was very happy. Everyone sat around the living room drinking tea and chatting. Uncle asked with concern about the store business, and Lei Mingxuan briefly mentioned that he was planning an upgrade. The younger male cousin was playing a mobile game nearby, and the younger female cousin Shen Jie was also present; the two exchanged glances, planning to talk in detail later.
location: At Uncle's home, Hengchang Lane, Yuyuan Road, Changning District, Shanghai

name: In-depth discussion with Shen Jie about the store transformation
description: While the elders chatted, Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie went to the sofa area on the living room balcony for an in-depth discussion. Shen Jie showed her collection of outfit examples from Paris Fashion Week and Korean niche brands in the outdoor techwear style, and suggested "move fast in small steps" — starting by testing the waters with 20-30 T-shirts and jackets. They focused on equipment selection for the coffee area; Shen Jie recommended several Italian semi-automatic espresso machine and pour-over kettle brands, and promised to compile a supplier whitelist after returning to the company. Lei Mingxuan quickly recorded the key points in his phone memo.
location: Sofa area on the living room balcony at uncle's home, Hengchang Li, Yuyuan Road, Changning District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and casual family chat
description: Lunch was cooked by his aunt, and the table was full of dishes, including the steamed mandarin fish that Lei Mingxuan had been craving, with tender, fresh flesh. They ate and chatted, the conversation moving from work to the younger cousin's school advancement, then to the aunt's square-dancing life after retirement. Lei Mingxuan was in a good mood and felt his store transformation plan had become clearer.
location: Uncle's Home Restaurant, Hengchangli, Yuyuan Road, Changning District, Shanghai

name: Noon break and recording the funding plan.
description: After the meal, everyone rested separately.
