Lei Mingxuan went to the sun-filled enclosed balcony, sat down on the lounge chair, and opened the notes app on his phone to arrange the shop-upgrade funding plan: after the New Year, redeem a 50,000-yuan index fund and suspend purchases of mystery boxes and games to reduce expenses, with the goal of replenishing the special fund to 250,000 yuan before March. He took a screenshot of the plan and sent it to his own WeChat backup.
location: Balcony of the living room at Uncle's home, Hengchangli, Yuyuan Road, Changning District, Shanghai.

name: Drove back after the New Year visit
description: After the rest, Lei Mingxuan and his parents said goodbye to his uncle's family. His aunt handed them a box of homemade eight-treasure rice, and Shen Jie patted his shoulder and said they would wait for his news after the New Year. The family walked to the parking lot at Jing'an Kerry Centre to pick up the car and drove back to Pudong.
location: On the drive from Hengchangli, Yuyuan Road, Changning District, Shanghai, and the Jing'an Kerry Center parking lot to Shanggang Community, Pudong New District

name: Interacting with friends on the way back
description: There was some traffic congestion on the way back. Lei Mingxuan sent voice messages in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group, sharing how satisfying the steamed mandarin fish was at his uncle's house at noon, and asking about his friends' New Year greetings. He also tagged Zhang Wei and Li Na, arranging to meet at Huixianglou after the New Year.
location: In the car traveling from Changning District, Shanghai, to Pudong New Area.

name: Go home to handle finances for the store upgrade
description: After arriving home, Lei Mingxuan put the eight-treasure rice in the refrigerator, took a short break, and went into the study. Using the mobile banking app, he opened a “Store Upgrade Special Fund” demand savings account and transferred 150,000 yuan from the main account. Then he opened the “Family Asset Management_2025” Excel spreadsheet on his laptop, added a row to record the special fund, filled in the last digits of the account number, the initial amount, and remarks, and uploaded the file to Baidu Netdisk for backup.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon leisure and contacting suppliers
description: After finishing the financial work, Lei Mingxuan rested on the living room sofa. While browsing Bilibili, he saw a night skating video shared by the roller skating group for the Spring Festival, and he liked and commented on it. Then he watched the new episode of 'Frieren: Beyond Journey's End'. After that, he remembered Shen Jie's suggestion and used WeChat to contact Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao, asking whether he could provide fabric samples in a mountain-style techwear look after the New Year. Zhou Tao replied that he would pay attention after the holiday, and the two agreed to talk in detail on the tenth day of the first lunar month.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Helping mother prepare dinner and the family dinner
description: Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to help in the kitchen, snapping snow peas and peeling garlic, and shared with his mother the discussion he had with Shen Jie that morning; his mother expressed support. At dinner, the family of three tasted the braised pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and eight-treasure rice given by his aunt. Lei Mingxuan expressed his determination to make a big push after the Chinese New Year. His father reminded him to manage finances carefully, and the atmosphere at the dinner table was harmonious.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-dinner cleanup and family movie night.
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan cleared the table and washed the dishes. Then he connected the projector in the living room, used the Taopiaopiao app to buy a popular Lunar New Year comedy film, and cast it to the screen, pouring tea for his parents. The family of three curled up on the sofa to watch the movie, with constant laughs, and father and son occasionally joked about the plot. After the film ended, the family chatted about the plot for a while, and Lei Mingxuan explained the parts his mother hadn't understood. After his parents went back to their room, he packed up the projection equipment.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest.
description: Lei Mingxuan went back to his room, washed up, changed into his pajamas, and lay down on the bed. He first browsed Bilibili for a while, set an alarm for 5:30 p.m. the next day, and made a note in his memo about meeting Chen Hao and Liu Yang at Huixiang Restaurant at 6 p.m. Then he replied to a few friends' New Year blessing messages on WeChat, completed his daily Japanese check-in task on Duolingo, and read a few pages of the e-book 'Sichuan Cuisine Anecdotes from the Republican Era.' After turning off the light, he thought back on the fulfilling day and fell asleep with anticipation.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning activities and breakfast
description: After waking up naturally, I stayed in bed for five minutes scrolling through Moments and saw a lot of people posting party photos. I got up, washed up, and weighed myself: 81.6kg. I silently noted that I had broken my diet last night and would need to make up for it with a run tomorrow. My mother had prepared heated wontons and poached eggs. Sitting at the table, I ate while browsing fashion official accounts on my iPad, focusing on the 2025 spring/summer outdoor techwear trend predictions and collaboration item analyses. I took screenshots of useful images and paragraphs and saved them to my phone's Notes app.
location: Room 101, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organizing business notes and transformation strategy.
description: Back in the study, he turned on his computer, created a folder named "2025 Store Transformation - Mountain-Style Techwear," integrated Shen Jie's research outline with the news images saved in the morning, and used mind-mapping software to organize the target customer profile (urban outdoor enthusiasts aged 26-35), price range (300-800 yuan), and initial product selection direction (lightweight jackets, multi-pocket vests, techwear pants). His thinking was clearer than ever.
location: Home study, Room 101, No. 6, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family lunch.
description: Mother made a big pot of steaming yangchun noodles; the broth was delicious and the noodles were chewy. I ate two big bowls, soup and all, and praised Mother's cooking. Father asked about the afternoon plans, and I told him I was meeting Chen Hao and Liu Yang for dinner in the evening. Father nodded and said they were good brothers, so we should catch up properly.
location: Home dining room, Room 101, No. 6, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Watching anime after lunch to help digest.
description: After helping my mother clear the table, I returned to the living room and cast an episode of the new anime Frieren: Beyond Journey's End I've been following to the projector. Seeing the memories of Frieren and the heroes, I couldn't help but be moved by the power of time.
location: Living room of the home, Room 101, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Short nap during lunch break
description: Because I went to bed late last night and got up early this morning, I felt a bit sleepy. I set an alarm for 14:20, put on an eye mask, and took a forty-minute nap in bed to store up energy for the evening gathering.
location: In the bedroom at home, Room 101, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Had a voice call with his younger female cousin Shen Jie.
description: In the study, I used WeChat voice to talk with Shen Jie for nearly half an hour and shared the mind map I had organized in the morning. Shen Jie was pleasantly surprised and added a few niche Korean outdoor brands with stronger design sensibilities that she had recently been following. The two agreed to visit the outdoor multi-brand stores at iapm Mall and Jing'an Kerry Centre in the first week after the Spring Festival holiday.
location: Home study, Room 101, No. 6, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ring Fit workout and downtime
description: After hanging up the phone, I turned on the Switch and played Ring Fit Adventure for 30 minutes, doing some squats and stretches. I worked up a light sweat and felt my body loosen up. Then I curled back onto the sofa and scrolled through Xiaohongshu for a while, checking out customer photos of mountain-style outfits for styling inspiration.
location: Living room of the home, Room 101, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Carefully prepare to go out
description: Started getting ready for the evening gathering. Took a shower and changed into the outfit I had planned earlier: a grey fleece-lined T-shirt underneath, a black utility tech vest over it, dark khaki work pants, and my favorite limited-edition sneakers. I looked in the mirror and felt it was both stylish and comfortable.
location: In the bedroom at home, Room 101, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went to the restaurant and set up the private room.
description: Walked about 7 minutes to Huixiang Restaurant, greeting my parents along the way. After arriving, confirmed the private room and ordered several signature Shanghainese dishes: oil-burst shrimp, sizzling eel in oil, stir-fried clover, and grandma's braised pork. I asked for two bottles of Shanghai old wine and a few bottles of beer to chill first, and had the server bring four cold appetizers first (four-treasure bran puff, Indian aster with dried tofu, vegetarian goose, and drunken edamame).
location: Huixianglou Local Shanghai Cuisine Restaurant (Pudong Avenue Branch), No. 215 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Spring Festival dinner with high school classmates
description: Chen Hao arrived first, and the two gave each other a bear hug. Liu Yang arrived shortly after, and the three sat together in a lively atmosphere. They tasted authentic local Shanghai cuisine. Liu Yang brought sample figurines from a Chinese-style IP; they examined them closely and discussed the possibility of co-branded T-shirts. Chen Hao shared the livestreaming base model in Hangzhou, and Mingxuan carefully recorded it in his phone's memo. He also fully laid out his plan to transform the store toward a mountain-style techwear look, earning cheers and advice from his buddies, such as partnering with local outdoor clubs and finding KOCs on Xiaohongshu to create buzz. They drank nearly two bottles of beer and a few cups of huangjiu; his face was slightly red but his mind remained clear.
location: Private room at Huixiang Lou Shanghainese Restaurant (Pudong Avenue Branch), No. 215 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After paying the bill, stroll around my alma mater
description: As the gathering was drawing to a close, Mingxuan stood up to pay the bill. Then the three of them walked along Pudong Avenue toward Jianping Middle School, enjoying the slightly cool evening breeze and chatting about old times on the way home from school—buying fried chicken strips and stealing glances at girls from the neighboring class.
location: Along Pudong Avenue and Gushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Group photo and reminiscing at the alma mater gate
description: Arriving outside the gate of Shanghai Jianping Middle School, the fence was locked; through the gaps they saw the empty playground and the familiar basketball hoops. The three chatted about the embarrassing old days of skipping class to play ball and being made to stand in the hallway as punishment, laughing uncontrollably. They took out their phones and, with the alma mater's gate as the backdrop, took the first group photo of the 2025 Spring Festival.
location: Outside the gate of Shanghai Jianping Middle School, 517 Gushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Said goodbye to the brothers and went home alone
description: Said goodbye to Chen Hao and Liu Yang at the school gate, agreeing to meet again during next year's Spring Festival. After watching them take a taxi away, he walked home slowly alone with warmth and satisfaction, sobering up along the way, replaying the evening's moments in his mind.
location: Along the way from No. 517 Gushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Organized photos and posted them to Moments.
description: Tiptoeing back to the room, he selected tonight's photos (the Huixianglou sign, the dinner dishes, and the campus group photo), applied a nostalgic filter using a mobile photo-editing app, added the caption 'Friends for ten years, still young at heart. This year we have a new shared challenge. Brothers, let's charge into 2025!', tagged the location as Huixianglou and Jianping Middle School, and tapped send.
location: Home, Room 101, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: WeChat group chat interaction
description: After posting on Moments, received many likes. Opened the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat, saw Chen Hao share a photo of himself grinning foolishly, Liu Yang added "Next year I'll bring back a project proposal!" Chatted warmly in the group for a bit, full of anticipation for the future.
location: In the bedroom at home, Room 101, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wash up and go to bed
description: Went to the bathroom to wash up. Looking at my slightly tipsy but beaming self in the mirror, I lay down on the bed. Though my body was tired, my mind was excited, and I savored the details of the day. I set an alarm for 9 a.m. tomorrow, thinking that after the New Year it's time to settle down and focus on work. Then I fell into a deep sleep feeling fulfilled and happy.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Room 101, Building 6, Shanggang Residential Quarter, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bid farewell to high school classmates in the early morning.
description: In the early hours, after a long talk at the school gate of their alma mater with high school classmates Chen Hao and Liu Yang, they hugged each other goodbye. Liu Yang took a taxi back to Jinqiao, Chen Hao walked to a hotel near Century Avenue, and he himself planned to walk home. The weather was cold, but their hearts were warm. They exchanged New Year wishes and agreed to stay in touch.
location: At the school gate of Dongchang Middle School Affiliated with East China Normal University, No. 354 Laoshan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Returned home late at night, washed up, and went to bed.
description: Walked home alone from his alma mater; there were few pedestrians on the road, only streetlights and the occasional taxi. He quickly walked into Shanggang Community; the security guard Uncle Wang was dozing in the guard booth and was not disturbed. He entered the house quietly; his parents were already asleep. After a simple wash in the dark, he went straight to bed and soon fell asleep.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning lie-in: going back to sleep after the alarm rings
description: The phone alarm rang at 8 a.m. After waking up, he had planned to go for a morning run, but through the window he saw the sky outside was gloomy and the plane trees swaying wildly in the wind. It felt freezing, so he decided to cancel the running plan at Lujiazui Greenbelt. He turned off the alarm, pulled the blanket over his head, and continued sleeping, waking naturally at 10:20, fully rested in both body and mind.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Enjoy brunch after waking up naturally
description: Woke up naturally at 10:20, dawdled under the covers for a few minutes, then got up and washed up. Mother had gone to the vegetable market, and father was watching the news in the living room. I warmed up three custard buns, boiled a soft-boiled egg, and brewed a cup of drip-bag coffee. I ate slowly by myself, with the lingering taste of last night's gathering, and spent a leisurely brunch time.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Retouched photos, posted them on Moments, and scrolled camping videos.
description: Carrying his coffee back to the room, he touched up the group photo taken at the school gate last night, added a warm-toned filter, and posted it to WeChat Moments with the caption: 'The old rule at the school gate - when everyone is together, the photo is complete. Happy New Year, brothers!' He tagged Chen Hao and Liu Yang. Then he scrolled through Bilibili review videos of camping gear to prepare for the market trip in the afternoon.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family lunch and travel planning.
description: My mother came back from grocery shopping and prepared lunch. I helped peel garlic and, while doing so, chatted about last night's gathering and Liu Yang's company's idea for a designer toy collaboration. I told my father I wanted to go to the riverside outdoor market in the afternoon to look at gear. Lunch included braised pork belly, scallion-braised sea cucumber, and stir-fried tatsoi. The three of us sat around the table, and I poured yellow wine for my father; the atmosphere was relaxed. After the meal, I cleared the dishes on my own.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stopped by a grocery store on the way out and bought a blind box
description: Put on a thick hardshell jacket, take a thermos cup, and head out. After going downstairs, I first stopped by Yanqin Grocery Store at the entrance of the residential community and bought a bottle of mineral water and a box of mint candies. I spent 59 yuan on a blind box from the Molly's Day series at the Pop Mart self-service machine next to the cash register, opened it on the spot and got Painting Molly. I took a photo and sent it to the trendy toy sharing group.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store, ground-floor commercial unit, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling to the Pudong riverside
description: I scanned a shared bike at the entrance of the residential complex, rode along Pudong Avenue, turned right onto Yincheng Middle Road, and continued all the way to the riverside promenade. The wind was strong and my face felt a bit stiff from the wind, but the sun was bright and the river glittered. After about 20 minutes of riding, my whole body warmed up, and I arrived near Binjiang Park.
location: Riverside walkway, Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Browsing the riverside outdoor market, shopping, and enjoying hot coffee
description: Arrived at the outdoor market in Binjiang Park. Many white tents were set up on site, and it was bustling. With a clear goal, I headed straight for the camping gear booths. At the Naturehike booth, I asked in detail about the tent's windproof and waterproof specifications and felt the fabric with my own hands; at the Fire-Maple booth, I tested the weight of the stove burner in my hand. Taking advantage of the booth discount, I bought a "Yunshang" two-person tent and a "Xinghuo" stove set. After shopping, I wandered to the coffee stall and drank a hot Americano, feeling very satisfied.
location: Outdoor market in Binjiang Park, 2967 Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk home
description: Carrying the newly bought outdoor gear, he walked back to Shanggang Community along the riverside walkway, taking about half an hour. Although the gear was somewhat heavy, he was in a good mood. When he got home, he quietly put the gear in his room.
location: The walking route from Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Organize new gear and take commemorative photos
description: He closed the bedroom door and, unable to wait, spread the tent out on the floor to try setting it up, studied how to thread the poles, and confirmed that all accessories were present. Then he took out the stove head and flat gas canister, screwed them together, and tested the feel. Afterward, he took several close-up photos of the gear with his phone and placed it on the bay window with the street view below as the background, full of the flavor of daily life.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: His mother prepared a lavish dinner, specially stir-frying pea shoots. The family sat around the table. He couldn't help showing his father photos of the gear on his phone and telling him about the interesting vendors at the market. His father teased whether the car could fit so much stuff, and his mother joked that he was just in it for the novelty. The dinner atmosphere was warm.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure: browsing Bilibili and studying Japanese.
description: Returned to the study, leaned back in the chair, and scrolled through Bilibili, watching two episodes of the new anime Delicious in Dungeon. Then opened the Duolingo app to complete the day's Japanese check-in task, focusing on vocabulary about camping and outdoor gear to improve language skills.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Share gear in the sports buddy group and plan camping activities
description: At 8 p.m., on time, sent photos and voice messages of the tent and stove in the "Pudong Billiards King Competition" WeChat group, describing how the market visit went. Han Dong immediately replied, teasing him about becoming an outdoor blogger; Qin Lang asked whether the stove could cook hot pot. Seizing the opportunity, he suggested a glamping barbecue by the Taipu River after spring. Both were interested, and they agreed to make specific plans after the New Year.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Nighttime reading and inspiration notes
description: Feeling delighted, I took "Anecdotes of Sichuan Cuisine in the Republic of China" from the bookshelf and read it propped against the headboard for nearly an hour. When I got excited by the reading, I took out my iPad and jotted down scattered ideas in Notes about adding outdoor elements to the store and a future road trip route in western Sichuan, preparing for later creative implementation.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wash up and prepare for bed
description: Got up, brushed my teeth, and washed my face; stepped on the scale, which showed 81.5 kg, the same as yesterday, and silently resolved to do some push-ups and HIIT at home tomorrow. Took out the hoodie and casual pants to wear the next day and laid them on the chair, checked the phone charging cable, and set the alarm, completing the pre-bedtime routine.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: Lying in bed, I replayed in my mind the excitement of hunting for treasures at the market during the day and the lively discussions in the billiards friends group. I turned over, put the Dimoo blind box I bought today on the nightstand, and soon fell fast asleep along with the sound of the wind howling outside the window.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up, breakfast, and Japanese check-in
description: After the alarm rang, I woke up naturally. Although I went to bed late last night, I was in good spirits. After washing up, my mother had already heated up white congee, fried two eggs, and prepared some pickled vegetables. While eating, I completed today's Japanese check-in on the Duolingo app, reviewing shopping phrases like 'Welcome' and 'Is there a discount?' I felt my pronunciation getting smoother and smoother.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk to the store, opening blind boxes along the way.
description: He put on his jacket and went out. First he walked 5 minutes to Yanqin Grocery Store at the entrance of the neighborhood to buy water. Seeing the newly arrived Pop Mart Chinese New Year series blind boxes at the door, he couldn't resist drawing one again. Unfortunately, it was a common one, 'A Raccoon in a Tang Suit,' so he couldn't show it off to the big shots in the group. He continued walking for 10 minutes, crossed the footbridge, and arrived at Super Brand Mall.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: New Year Store Opening and Market Research
description: After arriving at the store, he first put up his own 'Business Prosperity' couplet and the God of Wealth sticker he bought yesterday to add some festive atmosphere to the shop. He gave the floor a quick sweep and symbolically opened the rolling shutter door to 'open for business.' Since there were few customers, he began sorting through the winter stock, scanning the hoodies and down jackets in broken sizes or dated styles into a discount list, planning to run a special promotion after the New Year. In the corridor, he ran into Zheng Kai, the mall property manager; they exchanged belated New Year greetings and chatted a bit about the mall's post-Spring Festival activity plans. Around 10:30, he wandered through a few menswear streetwear and sports multi-brand stores in the mall, focusing on outdoor functional displays and spring new arrivals. He took a few photos of styling inspiration on his phone, mentally planning the renovation of his store's 'Urban Outdoor' section.
location: Shop A-208, Level 2, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and extended thoughts from market research
description: Leaving Super Brand Mall, he walked across the footbridge to IFC. He went straight to the familiar Soul Ramen and ordered a bowl of the signature tonkotsu ramen, adding a soft-boiled egg. While waiting, he looked through the shop photos he had just taken, noted display inspiration for outdoor techwear style and cargo pants paired with shell jackets in his phone memo, and sketched a simple store renovation layout. When the ramen arrived, it was steaming hot with rich broth; one bowl warmed him all over.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant, B2 Floor, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drive home
description: After lunch, I went to the mall's underground parking lot to get the car. The drive home took only 5 minutes, which served as a good buffer for post-meal digestion.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Learning a camping setup tutorial.
description: Changed into loose loungewear, opened the iPad, and searched Bilibili to carefully study beginner camping tutorials. He focused on the Yunshang tent setup video and the stove safe-use guide. He took out the guy lines and tent pegs bought yesterday, and repeatedly practiced tying the 'engineering butterfly' knot and adjusting knots on the floor, imitating the slow-motion footage several times until it felt right, then nodded with satisfaction.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drive to the park
description: Change into sports gear, bring a water bottle, and drive five minutes to the west gate of the park.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, No. 1388 Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon jog and ideas for the transformation
description: Although it was cloudy, there was little wind and the temperature was around 5°C, perfect for running. I ran 4 kilometers at a comfortable pace, worked up a light sweat, and felt that the fatigue accumulated over the past few days had melted away. While resting in the stretching area by the lake, drinking water, I thought about the direction of the store's transformation: should I tear everything down and start over, or first use the row of hooks by the window near the entrance to create an "urban outdoor functional" themed display? I took a photo of that area with my phone and marked it with revision ideas.
location: Rubberized running track at Lujiazui Central Green Park, 1388 Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drive home, shower, and rest.
description: After jogging, I drove home, took a hot shower in the bathroom, changed into clean loungewear, and felt completely refreshed.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Receiving and researching supplier information
description: Coming out of the bathroom, I was drying my hair when I saw the phone screen light up—it was voice and text messages from my cousin Shen Jie. She shared contact information, brand introductions, and screenshots of quotations from three outdoor-style suppliers. I quickly replied with a fist-and-palm salute emoji, then carefully browsed each message and saved the materials of the two brands she strongly recommended, “Mountain Wild” and “Freedom Road,” with notes such as “great value for money” and “style match.” I replied to Shen Jie: “Awesome! Cousin Jie, you’re my lucky star! I’ll treat you to a meal after the New Year!”
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Family chores and preparing talking points for the transformation
description: Walking out of the bedroom, he found his mother in the kitchen trimming vegetables and washing pork ribs, preparing to make braised pork ribs and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. He took the initiative to help peel garlic and peel celtuce. While working, he mulled over how to naturally bring up the idea of introducing outdoor clothing to his father. He ran through the risk points his father might raise, such as "unreliable" and "overstocking," and came up with a response: "First test the waters with ten styles, hang them in the area by the entrance, without taking up the main shelves."
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and discussion about the store's transformation
description: The family of three sat down to dinner on time. On the table were his mother's signature braised pork ribs, stir-fried lettuce, and a bowl of egg drop soup. At the table they chatted about the weather, saying that running in the wind today hadn't felt cold. In the middle of the meal, he naturally brought it up: “Dad, I've been thinking about bringing some urban outdoor-style clothes into our store—the kind that young people wear for camping these days. They're different from ordinary sportswear on the market; the cut and fabric are quite refined.” His father put down his chopsticks, picked up a rib, and said slowly while gnawing on it: “Oh, the pricier kind? Your idea does keep up with the trends. But don't bite off more than you can chew. Take a little money, order a small batch of a dozen or so styles as a trial, and see whether these young people in Pudong will pay for them. Don't end up with a warehouse full of unsold goods—that's real money.” He nodded happily: “Yeah, that's exactly what I thought. We'll make a special display on the wall by the entrance, so it won't take up much space. The risk is manageable.” His father grunted “Mm,” which counted as official approval.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Post-meal tidying and parent-child time
description: After dinner, I hurried to help my mother clear the dishes, wipe the table, and wash the bowls. Then I returned to the living room, turned on the projector, and watched an episode of the Bilibili documentary Sichuan Flavor World with my parents. It tells stories of Sichuan cuisine and the streets of Chengdu, which happened to echo the related historical novel I've been reading recently.
location: Kitchen and living room at home in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening recharge and leisure
description: Back in the bedroom, I first took out the ledger and recorded today's expenses: water (3 yuan), blind box (59 yuan), and lunch (38 yuan). Then I leaned against the headboard, picked up Anecdotes of Sichuan Cuisine in the Republican Era and read two chapters. It mentioned that during the Republican period, the Chengdu restaurant Jufengyuan made chicken tofu blossom by mashing chicken breast into a paste and shaping it like tofu, which was extremely refined; I was amazed and searched for modern recipes. Before bed, I scrolled through my phone again and replied to messages from friends in the Pudong Three Musketeers group. Everyone was again talking about going to see a show at the newly opened livehouse after the Spring Festival.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: I put down my phone and went to wash up. After brushing my teeth, I stepped on the scale: 81.8 kg. Sure enough, the braised pork at dinner did not go to waste — I was 0.3 kg heavier than yesterday. I set the alarm for 8 a.m. tomorrow, lay down, and reviewed today's events: the day's business started smoothly, camping skills acquired, Shen Jie's resources were in place, and Dad supported the idea of the transformation. I felt grounded, as if everything was moving in the right direction, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, washing up, and breakfast.
description: Mingxuan lingered in bed after the alarm went off, scrolled through his phone to check the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group, liked Zhang Wei's night-running route map from last night, and flipped through the supplier materials sent by his cousin Shen Jie. After getting up and washing up, he found a small pimple on his face. Then he went to the kitchen to heat up the pork buns and soy milk his mother Wang Xiuying had left for breakfast, and while eating, he sent Li Na a WeChat message: "New day, let's go go go!"
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Try setting up the tent at home and do initial research on suppliers.
description: After his parents went out to pay New Year visits, Mingxuan moved the sofa aside in the living room, spread out an old bedsheet, took out the newly bought Yunshang two-person tent, and tried setting it up following a Bilibili tutorial. The first setup took about forty minutes. After succeeding, he took it down and set it up again; the second time took only half an hour, much more smoothly. Afterwards, he recorded the key points in his phone memo: "Insert the tent stakes at a 45-degree angle, and pull the guy lines tight into triangles." He then opened the three supplier documents Shen Jie had sent — a Hangzhou lightweight domestic brand, a Guangzhou workwear techwear brand, and a Nantong professional fabric supplier — and focused on their flagship products, styles, and minimum order quantities. His initial impression was that the Hangzhou one matched his store transformation ideas better in terms of positioning and price, and he made simple notes.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and watching camping videos
description: Mingxuan reheated the tomato scrambled eggs and shredded pork with green peppers his mother Wang Xiuying had cooked before going out, and had them with a bowl of rice for lunch. While eating, he scrolled through Bilibili on his tablet and watched two instructional videos, "Winter Solo Camping Warmth Tips" and "Emergency Tent Troubleshooting", and found both very practical.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: In the afternoon, played chess with his father and spent time with family.
description: After lunch, he was about to go back to his room to rest when he heard his parents come back early. His father, Lei Jianguo, was in a good mood after visiting friends, and Mingxuan took the opportunity to suggest a game of Chinese chess; his father readily agreed. They set up the board in the living room and played three games: in the first, Mingxuan lost due to carelessness; in the second, after his father gave him a handicap of a rook, a knight, and a cannon, Mingxuan narrowly evened the score; in the third, Mingxuan thought carefully and won narrowly with a double rook checkmate. His father smiled, patted him on the shoulder, and praised his improved chess play, while his mother, Wang Xiuying, watched the two of them and beamed.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Systematically researching hand-drip coffee, purchasing equipment, and brainstorming store transformation
description: After returning to the bedroom, Mingxuan remembered the pour-over coffee tutorials he had collected on Bilibili. He spent nearly two hours systematically learning from multiple videos, from bean selection, grind size, and water temperature control to pouring techniques, and noted down key steps such as 'bloom for 30 seconds' and 'circular pouring'. Then on Taobao he compared and selected basic models including a V60 dripper, gooseneck kettle, server, and hand grinder, and finally ordered a well-reviewed starter set. While savoring the coffee knowledge, he reorganized the supplier information provided by Shen Jie, categorizing the three suppliers by style in his phone notes, and brainstormed a new idea: to turn the store into an 'outdoor functionality + urban camping' experience space, with a pour-over coffee lounge inside, under the concept of 'outdoor select store + coffee'. Although he felt it would be hard to realize, he marked it as a key direction.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Helping in the kitchen, family dinner, and formally proposing the store transformation plan
description: His mother was preparing ingredients in the kitchen. Mingxuan took the initiative to help her peel garlic and clean vegetables, while chatting about the interesting coffee research from the afternoon. His mother, Wang Xiuying, laughed and said he was obsessed with another newfangled thing. Mingxuan took the opportunity to let his mother know that he planned to formally share his transition plan that evening. At dinner, his mother specially made his favorite braised pork belly and oil-braised bamboo shoots. At the table, Mingxuan first talked about the details of setting up the tent in the morning. His father, Lei Jianguo, teased him for being too playful. When the mood was right, Mingxuan put down his chopsticks and seriously explained to his parents the situation of the three suppliers Shen Jie had introduced, his ideas for renovating the store, and the risk-control strategy of first testing the waters with a small batch of 150,000 yuan. After a pause, his father nodded and said that since he had a plan in mind, he should go try it; if he lost money, it would be tuition. A man must take responsibility. His mother also reminded him to do the math carefully and not act impulsively. Mingxuan felt a weight off his shoulders and was especially grounded. After dinner, he helped his mother clean up the dishes, then sat on the living room sofa with his parents watching Dragon TV news and the anti-Japanese war drama Snow Leopard. While watching TV, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu, looking at pour-over coffee equipment and outdoor outfit posts.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Share today’s achievements on social media
description: Back in his bedroom, Mingxuan sent the finished photos of today's tent setup and screenshots of the pour-over coffee equipment he had ordered to the 'Three Musketeers of Pudong' group chat, and said excitedly, 'Guys, I feel like I'm going to open a new battlefield - a camping coffee shop that also sells clothes!' His friend Zhang Wei replied instantly, 'Boss Lei, are you going to transform into a blogger?' Li Na asked which coffee machine he planned to buy. Mingxuan shared with them how smoothly his conversation with his parents had gone today, and everyone was happy for him.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Bookkeeping and organizing supplier information
description: Mingxuan opened a bookkeeping app to record today's expenses: mainly the 528 yuan hand-drip coffee equipment set purchased on Taobao. Then he created a new 'Supplier Evaluation Sheet' in Excel on his computer, and filled in detailed data such as the information on the three suppliers Shen Jie provided, product features, preliminary intention evaluations, and minimum order quantities, preparing for future contact and cooperation.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening weigh-in, washing up, leisure time, and going to bed
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, he weighed himself and saw 81.7kg, the same as yesterday. Mingxuan was pleased that he hadn't gained weight from eating braised pork. Then he lay in bed and watched two episodes of the new anime Frieren: Beyond Journey's End on his tablet, feeling relaxed in body and mind. Next, he opened the store's merchant backend and gave it a quick check, confirming there were no unread customer inquiries. After turning off the light, although his body was lying down, his mind was still excited. Reviewing the day: he had successfully mastered the new tent, talked to his parents about the transformation plan and received their support, and also gotten into the new hobby of pour-over coffee and ordered the gear. He felt life was steadily moving forward. With a sense of contentment and anticipation for tomorrow, he gradually fell asleep.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast
description: After the phone alarm rang at 9:30, he stayed in bed browsing WeChat groups and Moments and saw the ball-game friends group still discussing yesterday's plans to play ball. Then he got up, washed up, and splashed cold water on his face to wake up. He took two steamed pork buns from the fridge and heated them in the microwave. While eating breakfast, he kept scrolling on his phone and replied to his friend Zhang Wei's invitation to play billiards in the evening, saying he would decide after checking out the riverside in the afternoon. He finished quickly and briefly rinsed the cups and plates.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Researched pour-over coffee equipment
description: After brewing tea in the study, he opened his laptop and started researching beginner pour-over equipment using saved links. On Bilibili, he watched comparison reviews of pour-over kettles and drippers from brands like Timemore, Hario, and Fellow; on Xiaohongshu, he searched for user posts about “how to choose your first pour-over setup.” After watching four videos and comparing two long posts, he made a list in his memo app: Timemore cold brew jug set, Hario V60 plastic dripper, and Fellow Stagg EKG temperature-controlled kettle. He also specifically searched for discussions about whether a temperature-controlled kettle was necessary and decided to visit a physical store to feel the products before making a decision. At 12:00 he closed his laptop, feeling that he had done thorough research.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and rest
description: Heated up yesterday's braised pork and stir-fried choy sum made by his mother in the microwave, ate alone at the dining table, then cleaned up the kitchen. After eating, he leaned back on the sofa, scrolled on his phone for 15 minutes, and rested a bit.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepare to go out and drive to the store.
description: Changed into a thick fleece hoodie, windproof jacket, jeans, and sneakers; checked his phone, wallet, and keys; picked up the car keys and decided to drive. Went downstairs to the community ground parking lot, started the car, turned up the air conditioning, and set the navigation to Caf More, a coffee equipment store on Pudong South Road. After about a 22-minute drive, he arrived at the destination and parked in the ground parking lot.
location: Caf More Specialty Coffee Equipment, Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: On-site visit to a coffee equipment store
description: Walking into Caf More, lit by warm yellow lights, he went straight to the pour-over equipment area, weighing pour-over kettles of different materials and closely examining the Hario V60 dripper. A male clerk with black-framed glasses came up proactively, demonstrated the three-stage water pouring process, and guided him to smell the dry aroma of three single-origin beans: washed Yirgacheffe, natural-process Huakui, and honey-processed Costa Rica. He paid special attention to the Fellow temperature-controlled kettle priced at around 1,500 yuan and asked about its difference from domestic temperature-controlled kettles. The clerk suggested that beginners first use a kettle with good temperature control. He gained a clearer sense of which cost-effective model to choose.

participant.name: Shop assistant.
participant.relation: Clerk at a coffee equipment store

location: Caf More Specialty Coffee Equipment, Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stop by Yaohan for a casual browse on the way and drive to the riverside.
description: Walked about 3 minutes from the coffee shop to Shanghai No. 1 Yaohan. At the POP MART vending machine on level B1, scanned the code and paid 59 yuan to draw a blind box, getting a Leisurely Mocha. Then returned to the parking lot, drove along Puming Road, and after about 16 minutes arrived at a small ground parking lot near the entrance of the Nanmatou Road riverside walkway, and parked.
location: Entrance to the Riverside Promenade, Nanmatou Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walked to inspect the campsite
description: Put on the hood of your windproof jacket, walk south along the riverside boardwalk for about 4 kilometers, and observe and photograph 3 to 4 lawns suitable for setting up tents along the way. Pay special attention to a sheltered, flat sloping lawn near the entrance of Bailianjing Park, with benches nearby. Take a photo and note: 'Great location, close to parking lot and restrooms, flat ground.' As you walk, feel the outdoor winter conditions and imagine camping in a hardshell jacket and cargo pants.
location: Riverside walkway on Nanmatou Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Nanmatou Road to Bailianjing Park section)

name: Drove home, rested, and organized the materials.
description: As dusk fell, he drove about 20 minutes back to Shanggang Community. Once home, he imported the photos of the coffee shop's equipment and the riverside lawn from his phone to his computer, created a new folder named 'Day_2025-02-04' and stored them there by category. He took off his coat and washed his face with hot water, feeling comfortable.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading and catching up on anime in free time.
description: Relaxing on the living room sofa, I browsed Bilibili on my phone and continued following the anime series "Frieren: Beyond Journey's End."
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Dinner with parents and cleaning up
description: His mother Wang Xiuying had prepared braised pork with dried bamboo shoots, stir-fried crown daisy, and tomato egg drop soup. At the dinner table, his father Lei Jianguo asked where he had been that day. Mingxuan reported on what he had gained from checking out stores and inspecting the riverside in the afternoon. His mother asked with concern about the store's transformation, and Mingxuan said he had already communicated with his cousin Shen Jie and planned to start contacting suppliers for samples next week. After the meal, he took the initiative to wash the dishes and tidy the kitchen, while his parents went to the living room to watch TV.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online Product Selection Exchange with Cousin Shen Jie
description: In the study, he had an in-depth WeChat voice call with his younger cousin Shen Jie. They went through supplier information, and he proposed the idea of combining outdoor techwear style with urban camping, sharing the results of his field visit to the riverside lawn. Shen Jie recommended hardshell jackets and cargo pants as entry points, emphasizing SKUs such as ‘a budget-friendly alternative to a well-known brand's 3-in-1 hardshell jacket’ and ‘multi-pocket tapered cargo pants.’ They discussed focusing on two selling points: ‘mountain-style aesthetics’ and ‘functional and practical wear.’ They decided that next Monday Mingxuan would contact Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao to inquire about prices and place orders for fabric samples for the hardshell jackets and cargo pants (micro-stretch water-repellent and honeycomb wear-resistant fabric), and Shen Jie would be responsible for organizing the initial product selection document. The call lasted 45 minutes and left their thinking clearer.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organize notes and work plan
description: In the phone memo app, created a new "Store Product Selection Memo" and recorded the key points from the discussion with Shen Jie, the sample list for contacting Zhou Tao (two styles each of outdoor jackets and cargo pants, including colors and sizes), and the details to confirm with Shen Jie before the weekend. At the same time, opened the expense-tracking app and logged the 59 yuan spent on today's blind box under the "Personal Entertainment" category.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leisure, entertainment, and light exercise
description: On the living room floor, he followed Keep for a 15-minute shoulder-neck stretch and core activation session. Then he turned on the TV, connected the Switch, and played The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom for about an hour, exploring a newly discovered sky island shrine. He felt relaxed in both body and mind.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Took a shower in the bathroom, humming to relax. After drying off, applied body lotion and hand cream. Returned to the bedroom, changed into pajamas, dimmed the bedside lamp, and got ready for sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Shanggang Residential Quarter, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: In bed, he picked up the book Anecdotes of Sichuan Cuisine in the Republic of China he was reading and continued for about half an hour from the bookmark. When drowsiness came, he put the book down, turned off the lamp, reviewed the key points for contacting suppliers next Monday, then pulled up the quilt and fell asleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: On the cold morning of February 5, 2025, Lei Mingxuan was woken up by his alarm at 8:45. The temperature was only 2°C. He got up quickly, and while washing up in the bathroom, he glanced at the mirror and noticed his weight of 81.8 kg, silently resolving to go for a run today. He changed into thick work clothes—a fleece jacket paired with jeans. Then he went to the dining area, where his mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared steaming hot pork buns and soy milk. While eating breakfast, he scrolled through his phone, saw a billiards video shared by his friend Zhang Wei in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group, and replied with a thumbs-up emoji. After finishing, he pocketed his keys and phone, and his mother gave her usual reminder: "Be careful on the road."
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, Building 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Drove to the store.
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan drove his white Volkswagen Tharu to the store at Super Brand Mall. He set off from Pudong Avenue, turned onto Century Avenue, and since the morning rush hour was nearly over, traffic was light, so it took only 15 minutes to reach the Super Brand Mall underground parking lot. After parking, he walked into the mall's second floor and began the pace of a new workday.
location: Drive from Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the underground parking lot of Super Brand Mall.

name: Store opening preparation and morning operations.
description: After arriving at Store A-208 on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, Lei Mingxuan pulled up the rolling shutter, turned on the lights and air conditioning, and played upbeat music. He first wiped down the display counters and shelves with a damp cloth, then vacuumed the floor. Next, he checked the online store backend and found two orders from last night for basic T-shirts, so he decided to handle them in the afternoon. Taking advantage of the sparse morning crowd, he pulled out winter coats and fleece jackets from the storage room, counted them against the system data, and picked out several thick ski jackets in broken sizes and samples, hanging them in the 'Featured Discount' area at the entrance with handwritten 20%-off tags, hoping to recover cash quickly. During this time, a middle-aged man carrying a briefcase stopped in the hardshell jacket section. Lei Mingxuan proactively introduced the product's waterproof rating, and the customer said he would consider it before leaving.
location: Inside Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At noon, Lei Mingxuan ordered a signature tonkotsu ramen takeout from the Japanese ramen restaurant at IFC Mall at the store checkout counter. While eating, he opened Bilibili on his phone and finished watching the 'techwear spring styling' video he had saved yesterday, gaining quite a bit of inspiration from it. He planned to discuss new fabric directions with supplier Zhou Tao later. After the meal, he leaned back in his chair and dozed for more than twenty minutes. Around 1 p.m., a young couple came into the store. The woman was very interested in a pair of multi-pocket cargo pants. Lei Mingxuan went over and introduced them enthusiastically. The two added him on WeChat and said they would decide after going back to think about it.
location: Inside Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Contact supplier Zhou Tao.
description: Taking advantage of a moment with no customers in the store, Lei Mingxuan called Zhou Tao, a supplier in Hangzhou. After a brief exchange of pleasantries, he got straight to the point and asked about the progress of the outdoor composite fabric samples mentioned earlier. Zhou Tao replied that he already had several sample fabrics with a cotton-feel nylon finish and windproof, moisture-permeable properties, and would send them out via SF Express in the next couple of days. Lei Mingxuan also asked about this spring's color trends. Zhou Tao suggested that for the mountain-style look, he could focus on safe colors such as khaki, military green, and black-gray, and could also try low-saturation blue-gray. The call lasted about ten minutes, and the content gave him more confidence in the upcoming product selection.
location: Inside Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and closing preparation
description: After finishing the call with Zhou Tao, Lei Mingxuan was in a good mood and began handling the two online orders: he printed shipping labels with the thermal printer, folded the T-shirts, put them into express bags, and affixed the tracking numbers. He then walked around the store, arranging the sweaters in a color gradient and putting the hoodies back in order by size. In between, he received several customers who were browsing the mall before closing time. Around 15:45, he picked up his phone and took a few photos in front of the newly arranged 'Clearance Area' and 'Featured Area,' then posted on WeChat Moments: 'Thursday's results, stocking up for spring.' Soon, his friend Qian Duoduo and his cousin Shen Jie liked the post, and Lin Jing commented, 'The discount area looks nice.' He replied with a mischievous emoji. Because foot traffic that day was average, he decided to close the store half an hour early. He quickly shut down the system, locked the cash register, pulled down the rolling shutter, changed in the store into a quick-dry long-sleeve T-shirt, running pants, and running shoes, put his phone and keys into a waist bag, and headed to the green space for a run.
location: Inside Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Running at Lujiazui Central Green.
description: Lei Mingxuan walked 5 minutes from Super Brand Mall to Lujiazui Central Green Park, did a few minutes of warm-up, then ran 3 laps along the circular path, about 3 km in total. Though his pace wasn't fast, running on the winter evening made his whole body feel great. After the run, he walked one lap to cool down, photographed the evening sky with his phone, and sent it to his classmate Zhao Min with the message, “Off work, come get some exercise.” Zhao Min quickly replied “Nice,” and the two exchanged a few words.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Driving home
description: After running, Lei Mingxuan was in a good mood. He walked slowly back to the parking lot and then drove back home on Pudong Avenue. While waiting at a red light, he saw Zhao Min had sent another message: 'I'm still at work overtime, so envious.' He replied by voice message: 'I'll treat you to ramen next week.' The traffic was smooth along the way, and listening to music, he soon arrived back at Shanggang Community.
location: Drove from the Lujiazui Central Green parking lot back to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Returning home, washing up, and having dinner with the family.
description: After arriving home, Lei Mingxuan immediately took a hot shower and changed into comfortable loungewear, feeling completely revived. Passing through the living room, his father Lei Jianguo was watching the opening credits of CCTV News, and his mother Wang Xiuying was busy in the kitchen. Dinner was plentiful, with red-braised pork with eggs, river crucian carp in scallion oil, stir-fried spinach, and tomato and egg soup. The atmosphere at the table was warm. He told his parents about the progress he had made today contacting the supplier, saying the samples would arrive soon. His father nodded and said, 'It's good that you have a clear plan,' and his mother told him not to overwork himself.
location: Bathroom and dining room at home, Building 12, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Check the online store backend and reply to messages
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan went into the study, opened his laptop, and confirmed that the online orders placed in the afternoon had been picked up by the courier. Then he posted a message in the VIP customer group: "Spring new products are being prepared. If you have needs, you can message me privately to lock in early discounts." A few regular customers saw it and privately messaged to ask about styles and prices, and he replied to each one.
location: Study at home, Building 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organizing blind boxes and casual reading
description: Back in the bedroom, Lei Mingxuan took out the Pop Mart blind boxes he had recently collected, including the "Leisurely Mocha" he had drawn yesterday. He wiped each one clean with a soft cloth, then rearranged them on the display shelf by the bedside table, trying out a staggered arrangement of heights. He took a filtered photo and sent it to the "Designer Toy Collector Group" with the message "Give my little darlings a new formation before the weekend." Lin Jing replied instantly, "Mocha bro is debuting at the center!", which got several fellow collectors chatting. After that, he curled up in bed and scrolled through Bilibili for a while, finished the outfit video he had saved at noon, and then watched an episode of the anime Frieren: Beyond Journey's End. Before sleeping, he picked up the book Anecdotes of Sichuan Cuisine in the Republic of China from his bedside and read the chapter on the evolution of "twice-cooked pork," finding it very interesting.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Chatting with Zhao Min on WeChat and going to sleep
description: Just before ten in the evening, Lei Mingxuan received a WeChat message from Zhao Min. She asked, “Hey, are you free on Saturday or Sunday? There’s an exhibition called ‘Urban Oasis’ at the China Art Museum. I think it would suit an outdoor person like you. Afterward, we can find a place to eat at nearby Nanmatou.” Lei Mingxuan smiled and replied, “How about Sunday, 3 p.m.?” Zhao Min readily agreed. He added, “After the exhibition, let’s go eat around Laomatou. I remember there’s a fusion restaurant with good reviews.” They said goodnight to each other. He set his alarm for 8:45 the next morning, turned off the light, and went to sleep. At that moment he felt very grounded—the day had brought steady work progress, refreshing exercise, and an upcoming weekend date.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and family breakfast
description: Got up after the phone alarm rang at 8:50, opened the curtains to feel the sunlight, did some simple shoulder and neck exercises, then went to the bathroom to wash up. While washing up, checked the logistics information on his phone, confirmed that the fabric samples had arrived at the local delivery point, and checked the store's transaction records on the financial app. Then went to the dining room to have breakfast with his mother, Wang Xiuying, eating white porridge, fried eggs, and pickled mustard tuber. They talked about his plans to research new fabrics and hire people, and his mother reminded him to take care of his health.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leave home to pick up packages and commute.
description: Put on a jacket, grab the car keys, and head out. Go to the community parcel locker, enter the pickup code to retrieve the SF Express package, open and inspect three composite fabric samples. After checking the color and feel, take photos and send them to Zhou Tao to confirm the quality. Then put the samples in the car, drive along Pudong Avenue and Lujiazui Ring Road to Super Brand Mall, and park near the elevator entrance on the B2 parking level.
location: Shanggang Community express locker, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and driving to the B2 parking lot of Super Brand Mall

name: Store opening preparation and fabric research
description: From the parking lot to the store on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, he greeted the cleaner, opened the doors, turned on the lights, air conditioning, and music, sorted the previous day's receipts, and mopped the floor. Then he brewed tea, took out fabric samples, and laid them on the display table. He photographed them in natural light, recording each sample's thickness, hand feel, color, and suitable product categories. He also flipped through mountain-style outfit lookbooks and jotted down styling ideas, preparing for the afternoon discussion with Zhang Wei.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Watching the store, handling online business, and lunch
description: At noon, foot traffic in the mall increased. While greeting customers entering the store, he also replied to inquiries from two online-store customers and confirmed online orders. At 12:00, he ordered Japanese pork cartilage ramen takeout on his phone and, while eating in the store, scrolled through Xiaohongshu posts by outdoor outfit bloggers, further strengthening his resolve to transform toward the mountain-style direction.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organizing inventory and brainstorming transformation plans
description: After the meal, I went into the back storage and spent over an hour organizing the seasonal inventory. I picked out the down jackets and cotton coats that needed to be discounted, ironed them with a garment steamer, and hung them in the special-offer area at the entrance. At the same time, I sorted out in my phone's memo the key points from the afternoon discussion with Zhang Wei, including the online display platform, the types of KOL partners, and the pricing strategy for the first batch of spring windbreaker jackets.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Childhood friend Zhang Wei dropped by the store to catch up.
description: My childhood friend Zhang Wei arrived at the store on time and complained about gaining weight during the Spring Festival. After pouring tea, we sat in the rest area and discussed in detail the idea of transforming into mountain-style clothing. I showed the fabric samples I had researched in the morning. Zhang Wei, drawing on his FMCG experience, suggested making video showcases on Douyin and Xiaohongshu, and recommended the contact information of a friend who runs Xiaohongshu operations in the outdoor vertical.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mind the store and refine hiring requirements
description: After Zhang Wei left, he returned to the cash register, served several customers looking at jackets, and observed mall traffic. In between, he used his phone memo to refine the sales associate job requirements, including more than one year of apparel retail experience, a love of outdoor techwear style, flexibility with shift schedules, basic photography skills preferred, and an outgoing personality.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closed the shop and drove home.
description: Reconciled the day's sales details, turned off the lights, clocked out, pulled down the rolling shutter, and ended the business day. Went to the B2 parking lot, got the car, drove along Lujiazui Ring Road onto Pudong Avenue, and arrived at the downstairs of Shanggang Community in about 15 minutes to park.
location: B2 parking lot, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanggang Residential Quarter, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Family dinner and pre-class preparation
description: When he got home, his mother had dinner ready: braised pork, oil-braised prawns, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. During the meal, he proactively brought up Zhang Wei's visit to the shop and relayed his friend's approval of the transformation idea. His father, Lei Jianguo, happily drank yellow wine, and his mother urged him to eat more and not overwork, creating a relaxed atmosphere for their later discussion about hiring.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Formally discuss hiring store staff
description: After clearing the dishes, he showed his parents the job requirements on his phone while sitting on the living room sofa. His father worried that young people might be unstable, while his mother supported hiring young people to bring energy. After discussion, the family reached an agreement and scheduled one interview for next Monday and one for Wednesday.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Post recruitment information online
description: Returned to the bedroom, opened the laptop, and posted a detailed job listing on BOSS Zhipin, specifying salary and position requirements. Then posted a Moments update with photos of the store, emphasizing the Lujiazui location and welcoming people who love outdoor techwear style to chat.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Catching up on anime and organizing thoughts on new series
description: Leaning against the headboard, opened Bilibili to catch up on the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End. Moved by the plot, I jotted down the segment about "time and companionship" in my phone memo, planning to use it as inspiration for the shop's copy or as talking points with customers.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stretching and exercise for stress relief
description: In the open area of the living room, he did 15 minutes of shoulder, neck, and leg stretches to relieve a day of standing fatigue, then opened Keep and followed a 10-minute total-body fat-burning workout. After breaking a light sweat, he felt his stress melt away.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and bedtime reading
description: After showering, changed into pajamas, leaned against the headboard, turned on the bedside lamp, and read The Longest Day in Chang'an for about an hour, immersed in the tight plot and taking a break from the busyness of business.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Closed the book, turned off the desk lamp, and reviewed the day in the darkness: the samples were satisfactory, Zhang Wei's advice was pertinent, and the job posting had been published. Feeling grounded, peacefully looking forward to the new hire joining, he turned over and gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Got up at 8:30 AM, turned off the alarm, stayed in bed for a few more minutes, and mentally reviewed the day's interview and training plan, feeling confident. It was early spring, 4-11 degrees, partly cloudy.
location: Room 502, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and a brief family chat
description: His mother Wang Xiuying prepared breakfast: white congee, fried eggs, and rose-flavored fermented bean curd. As he ate, Mingxuan told his mother that he had to interview and train a new shop assistant in the morning, and his mother told him not to worry.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting and thinking on the way
description: Put on the newly arrived military-green outdoor jacket sample and headed out, driving from Shanggang Community to Super Brand Mall. On the way, he played a Bilibili video about outdoor store displays via his phone's Bluetooth, listening and thinking about the day's training focus.
location: In Pudong New Area, Shanghai, on the way driving from Shanggang Residential Community to Super Brand Mall.

name: Store opening preparation and interview setup
description: Arrived at Jingmei Jia, Store A-208 on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, pulled up the rolling shutter door, and started the system. Quickly wiped down the display stand, changed the background music to light electronic music, brewed tea in the rest area, prepared two paper cups, and waited for the applicant Xiao Lin.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Jingmeijia

name: Interviewed and hired the new shop assistant Xiao Lin.
description: Xiao Lin arrived at the store on time, and the interview lasted about 45 minutes. He had previously worked at an outdoor brand store and was familiar with brands such as Patagonia and Snow Peak. Mingxuan focused on asking about his understanding of "mountain-style aesthetics." His answer of low saturation plus functional design matched Mingxuan's thoughts, and he communicated enthusiastically. Mingxuan decided on the spot to hire him and told him to officially start work next Monday (February 10).
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Jingmeijia

name: Handle daily store affairs.
description: After the interview went smoothly, Mingxuan opened the backend to update online inventory data, and used his work phone to contact previous customers who had asked about mountain-style cargo pants, welcoming them to come check out the new sample styles.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Jingmeijia

name: Lunch and new store inspection
description: Went to the newly opened “Butao” ramen shop on the LG1 floor of IFC Mall, and ordered a signature black garlic oil ramen. After eating, he walked around the mall, observing the display layouts and lighting atmosphere of menswear brands such as Ami and Maison Margiela, and quietly noted details worth borrowing.
location: Butao Ramen, LG1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: On the way back to the store.
description: Walked back from IFC Mall to Super Brand Mall, reviewing the key points of the afternoon training along the way and building a clear process in my mind.
location: On the way walking from IFC Mall to Super Brand Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Noon preparation and window display adjustment
description: Back at the store, he spent half an hour adjusting the window mannequin's outfit. He put the khaki cargo-pants sample that arrived yesterday on the mannequin, paired it with the store's original white hoodie and a navy jacket, making the whole look better fit the mountain style.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Jingmeijia

name: Provide one-on-one training to Xiao Lin, the new store clerk
description: At 1:30 p.m., Xiao Lin arrived at the store as promised. Mingxuan gave him systematic one-on-one training, starting with store display principles (color coordination and customer flow), then taught him step by step how to operate the cash register system, including discounts, member points, and the return and exchange process. He then demonstrated how to fold and organize clothes quickly and neatly. Xiao Lin was attentive and took notes from time to time.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Jingmeijia

name: Teaching and learning from each other, sharing outdoor knowledge
description: During a training break, they rested in the store. Xiao Lin shared knowledge he had accumulated at his previous employer: how to distinguish the waterproof ratings between Gore-Tex Paclite and Pro, and why Snow Peak titanium cups are so sought after. Mingxuan, combining his store experience, discussed young people's consumer psychology of 'looks are justice'. This exchange benefited both of them greatly.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Jingmeijia

name: Training summary and building a mentor-mentee relationship
description: After the training, Mingxuan fully affirmed Xiaolin's performance and arranged for him to start next week by receiving simple clients and helping with displays. The two added each other on WeChat, pulled Xiaolin into the store work group, agreed to spend half an hour every Friday afternoon reviewing, and established a mentoring relationship that was both teacher and friend.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Jingmeijia

name: Closing the store and commuting home
description: Closed the store a little early and pulled down the rolling shutter door, feeling pleased. On the drive home, called his childhood friend Zhang Wei via car Bluetooth to share the good news of hiring a capable assistant. The two agreed to get together again on the weekend if they were free.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai, on the way driving back from Super Brand Mall to Shanggang Community

name: Resting at home and short exercise
description: After arriving home, changed into workout clothes and did a 20-minute Keep core and shoulder-neck stretching routine in the living room, feeling much relieved. While mother was cooking, took a warm shower and changed into loungewear.
location: Room 502, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner to share good news
description: For dinner, his mother made braised pork belly and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Mingxuan vividly described the interview experience and Xiao Lin's performance. His father, Lei Jianguo, rarely showed an approving smile, and his mother happily put several pieces of braised pork into his bowl. The whole family was warm and harmonious.
