location: Living room, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening study and lesson preparation
description: First completed the daily Japanese study check-in on the Duolingo app. Then opened the computer, downloaded a template for a 'Store New Employee Training Assessment Form' suitable for retail stores from Bilibili, slightly modified it, and prepared to establish a standardized assessment system with Xiao Lin next week.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Deep rest and inspiration gathering
description: Leaned back in the study chair and used the tablet to browse the official Weibo and Xiaohongshu accounts of brands such as Helly Hansen and Arc'teryx, researching the latest spring product lines and saving display photos for inspiration. Then caught up on episode 12 of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and daily review
description: After washing up, he lay in bed, thinking back on today's fulfilling interview and training and the joy he shared with his parents, and felt a sense of accomplishment. He weighed 81.6 kg, jotted down tomorrow's to-dos in his phone memo, and turned off the lights and fell asleep around 22:15.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sleeping in, washing up, and having a simple brunch
description: On Sunday morning, he woke up naturally at nine, and stayed in bed comfortably scrolling through his phone. He checked WeChat Moments, saw Zhang Wei's early-morning rant in the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group, replied to arrange a ball game, and also watched short videos recommending outdoor camping gear. Then he got up, washed up, changed into loungewear, took fresh pork buns and milk from the fridge, microwaved frozen wontons, had a simple brunch, and left the dishes soaking in the sink to wash at noon.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Immersive reading on the balcony and store inspiration notes.
description: Sitting on a recliner on the balcony, read Practical New Retail for Physical Stores, focusing on the chapters on community marketing and experiential consumption. While reading, he used a red pen to mark notes in his notebook. Drawing on the Patagonia community model Xiaolin had mentioned earlier, he wrote down specific ideas such as 'attracting customers through themed night skating events,' 'adding a camping coffee corner in the store,' and 'offering members the right to authenticate sneakers/gear,' opening up new business thinking.
location: Balcony at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Packing up and getting ready to go out
description: After finishing reading, he stretched, confirmed the location of Museum of Art Pudong that friend Zhao Min had sent, took the roller skating bag from the bedroom, checked the wheel brakes, and put in a replacement sweatband and clean socks. He put on his backpack, black windbreaker and sneakers, greeted his mother who had come back from grocery shopping, told her about his plan to go out to see the exhibition, and left.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Took a taxi to the art museum and refined the display sketch while waiting.
description: After leaving the residential area, I took a taxi to the Pudong Art Museum and added display inspiration notes to my phone memo on the way. After arriving, I sat by the window at Seesaw Coffee on the first floor, ordered a hot latte, and pulled out my sketchbook to further refine the sketch of the store's 'functional camping corner'. Outside the window were views of the Huangpu River and Lujiazui. At 12:50, Zhao Min arrived; we chatted casually. She teased me about my mood that day and treated me to a drink.
location: Seesaw Coffee, 1st Floor, Pudong Art Museum, No. 2777 Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Visited the contemporary fiber art exhibition and had post-exhibition exchange at a café
description: Zhao Min and Lei Mingxuan entered Exhibition Hall 2 of the Pudong Art Museum to visit the Contemporary Fiber Art Exhibition. Zhao Min interpreted the colors and materials of the works from a buyer's perspective, while Lei Mingxuan shot close-ups of the textures and videos of the rotating installations as reference for the store's soft furnishing. After viewing, they had lime mint sparkling water at the MAP Lounge on the second floor, continuing to discuss fabrics and store foot traffic. Zhao Min suggested setting up a This Week's Inspiration Corner to let customers touch fabric swatches, and Lei Mingxuan noted it down immediately.
location: Exhibition Hall 2 and the second-floor MAP Lounge, Museum of Art Pudong, 2777 Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Moved to the riverside walkway to prepare for roller skating.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhao Min, I walked south along the riverside path, enjoying the afternoon sunshine and breeze. I found a bench in a quiet spot, took off my sneakers, put on my roller skates, checked the gear, tightened the laces, and warmed up my ankles to get ready for the rollerblading ahead.
location: Riverside walkway in Pudong New Area, Shanghai (section near Super Brand Mall).

name: Riverside roller skating relaxation and camping terrain survey.
description: Putting on knee pads and a helmet, he glided south along the non-slip trail, trying to weave around cones while avoiding the crowds. Though a bit rusty, he kept laughing. He slowed down and stopped by the sloped lawn at Laobaidu Riverside Green Space, carefully checking the sunlight and wind protection conditions. He judged the spot suitable for setting up a tent, but noted that weekends with many dog walkers should be avoided, gaining practical experience for future camping activities.
location: Laobaidu Riverside Greenbelt, Weifang West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buy ingredients on the way back, then go home to shower and rest
description: After roller skating, he changed back into sneakers near Super Brand Mall, hailed a ride on his phone, and returned to Shanggang Community. On the way, he stopped at Yanqin Grocery Store next to the community to buy tomatoes, cilantro, and grapes for his mother. After getting home, he handed the groceries to his mother, who was preparing dinner, took a hot shower, changed into clean loungewear, and felt completely refreshed.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the nearby Yanqin Grocery Store

name: Family dinner and sharing the day's experiences
description: Sat around the dinner table with my parents; on the table were braised pork belly, stir-fried gai lan, and tomato-egg soup. While eating, I shared what I'd gained from the exhibition, describing the fiber art installation as 'a melting tundra,' and mentioned Zhao Min's 'inspiration corner' suggestion and the store's camping corner plan. My father Lei Jianguo encouraged me to try boldly and was willing to provide financial support, while my mother Wang Xiuying kept adding food to my bowl and telling me to eat more.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Family couch time and replying to social media messages
description: After proactively washing the dishes, he brewed a pot of jasmine tea, his mother's favorite, and watched the Chinese Poetry Conference in the living room with his parents. During it, he used his phone to reply to Zhang Wei's invitation to play ball next week in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat, and also replied to Li Na's message, enjoying a warm family time.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Joined an online coffee lovers group to learn and exchange
description: After returning to his room, he unpacked the newly arrived pour-over coffee equipment and set up the V60 dripper and server. Through a QR code shared by a friend, he joined the online coffee group "Modu Slow Brew." He browsed the group files for beginner bean recommendations and an equipment list to avoid pitfalls, carefully studied two months of chat history covering water temperature, pouring techniques, and other terms, and added the group owner's recommended Ethiopian natural Sidama beans to his Taobao favorites, planning to buy them next week.

participant.name: Member of the Magic City Slow Brew group

location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening stretching, relaxation, and reading before bed
description: After leaving the coffee group, he did fifteen minutes of yoga stretching at his desk, focusing on relaxing his thighs, calves, and lower back. Then he soaked his feet in hot water and applied a face mask to fully relax. Leaning against the headboard, he continued reading the content about storytelling packaging to enhance product added value from "New Retail Practice for Physical Stores," and next to the "campsite corner" plan he wrote keywords in pencil such as "stories behind the gear" and "creating styling scenes."
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing for sleep
description: Close the book, turn off the lights, and keep only the bedside nightlight. Lying down, I review the day's riverside camping site inspection and what I learned from the coffee group. Thinking that Xiao Lin, the shop assistant, will officially start tomorrow and give me more time to explore new directions, I feel full of anticipation for the store's future. I gradually fall asleep, fulfilled and content.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning activities: yoga, washing up, and breakfast.
description: After the alarm went off, Lei Mingxuan first did 30 minutes of stretching in the living room following the Keep beginner yoga course. When it was done, he took a selfie and posted it to WeChat Moments as a check-in. Then he showered and washed up, changed into a comfortable hoodie, and went downstairs to have breakfast with his mother, Wang Xiuying. His mother served steaming hot pan-fried pork buns and milk, and told him to dress warmly. Lei Mingxuan scrolled through his phone while eating, checking the likes and comments on Moments, and saved a beginner's guide to avoiding pitfalls in the pour-over coffee group.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: Lei Mingxuan brought the Offline Store Display Bible, and after saying goodbye to his parents, he rode a shared bike while holding an umbrella to Lujiazui Metro Station, took Metro Line 2 one stop to Lujiazui Station, and after exiting the station, walked across the circular pedestrian bridge to Super Brand Mall. After arriving at the store, he turned on the lights and the cash register system, adjusted the warm spotlights to create a cozy atmosphere, hung out the new jackets, and rearranged the displays.
location: Lei Mingxuan's clothing store, 3F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Follow up on Xiao Lin's work and window display adjustments
description: Xiao Lin arrived at work on time. Lei Mingxuan asked her to receive customers independently first, while he observed from the side and affirmed her explanation of the selling points of outdoor functional fabrics. Then the two of them used white artificial snow, foam boards, and ski props to create a ski scene in the window display, making the flagship ski down jacket the visual focal point, so that the window echoed the rainy weather.
location: Lei Mingxuan's clothing store, 3F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunchtime food hunt and relaxation
description: Lei Mingxuan walked alone to the Ippudo ramen shop on the basement level of IFC Mall, ordered a bowl of signature tonkotsu ramen and fried dumplings. While waiting, he scrolled through WeChat and chatted briefly with Zhang Wei and Li Na in the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group chat. After the hot soup went down, he felt refreshed.
location: Ippudo Ramen, B1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Conceptualizing the 'Mountain Style' display plan
description: In the afternoon there were fewer customers. Lei Mingxuan opened his iPad Pro behind the cashier counter, searched for display inspiration for outdoor multi-brand stores, and sketched a "Mountain-style" themed area: he planned to use light-colored wood flooring to raise the platform, along with artificial plants, camping folding tables, and outdoor shelves to display shell jackets, hiking shoes, and climbing backpacks. Xiao Lin, while cleaning nearby, suggested adding a small projector to loop mountain scenery videos. Lei Mingxuan thought it was a great idea.
location: Lei Mingxuan's clothing store, 3F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Process online orders and shipments
description: Lei Mingxuan went to the convenience store at Jin Mao Tower and bought an energy drink, then packed the three online orders, walked to the smart locker at Lujiazui Metro Station, scanned the express code, and stored the packages so the courier could pick them up in the evening.
location: Luggage lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station, No. 158 Huayuanshiqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: On the way home from work and grocery shopping
description: After the handover with Xiao Lin, Lei Mingxuan left work early and walked with an umbrella to the Pushang Vegetable Market. Following what he had thought of the night before, he bought strawberries, dragon fruit, cucumbers, and cherry tomatoes. When he saw fresh winter bamboo shoots, he picked up two as well, planning to have his mother make salted pork and bamboo shoot soup.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go home for dinner with family
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived home and handed the ingredients to his mother. He chatted with his father Lei Jianguo in the living room about the day at the store, and his father encouraged him to take it slow. For dinner, his mother made braised pork belly, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and scallion oil noodles. The family of three ate and chatted. Lei Mingxuan shared his idea of learning hand-brewed coffee; his father laughed that he was just a flash in the pan, while his mother said she supported him.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In-depth research on pour-over coffee sets
description: After cleaning up after dinner, Lei Mingxuan returned to his study, asked in the pour-over coffee group for a beginner set under 500 yuan, and group friends enthusiastically recommended the Hero S01 beginner set and the Timemore Chestnut C2 hand grinder. He also went to Bilibili to watch unboxing reviews, and eventually added both products to his shopping cart, planning to place the order the next day.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leisure and entertainment: games and WeChat group chats
description: Lei Mingxuan played two games of NBA 2K to relax, then chatted with Zhang Wei and Li Na in the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group, shared his new store display ideas, and his friends agreed to come to the store on the weekend.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading and washing up before bed
description: After showering and brushing his teeth, Lei Mingxuan changed into pajamas, lay in bed, and read The Offline Store Display Bible, focusing on the chapter on customer flow design to gather material for optimizing the display plan.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Lei Mingxuan put his phone on silent, set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning, reviewed the fulfilling day, felt satisfied, stretched, and got ready for sleep.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake up, wash up, and have breakfast with family
description: At 7:50 the alarm went off in the morning. After lazing in bed for ten minutes, I got up at exactly 8 o'clock and deliberately put on a bright orange hoodie. After washing up, I went downstairs to have breakfast with my parents. My mother made her signature pan-fried buns, and I enjoyed them heartily while praising her cooking. The atmosphere at the table was pleasant. Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to test the waters and invited his parents to take a walk in Century Park together.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk with parents to Century Park
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan put on a coat and headed out with his parents, walking to Century Park. He deliberately walked on the outside and slowed his pace to match his parents'. Along the way, he brought up funny stories about the shop assistant Xiao Lin to cheer up his mother, and when they passed the Minsheng Road bun shop, he bought shepherd's purse and pork buns as snacks. The sunshine was warm, and the three of them enjoyed their walk.
location: From Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Gate 1, Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Century Park lakeside heart-to-heart conversation for family ice-breaking.
description: After entering Century Park, Lei Mingxuan suggested sitting on a bench beside Jingtian Lake. He sincerely apologized to his parents, saying that last month when they urged him to get married, he had raised his voice too much and made them worry. He then took the initiative to share his plan to partially shift the clothing store's style toward 'mountain style' and his idea of going camping in western Sichuan, and promised to seriously think about major life matters. His mother was moved to tears and said she only wanted him to be safe and happy; his father also patted him on the shoulder, and the family conflict was resolved.
location: Bench beside Jingtian Lake, Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Strolled in Century Park and returned home happily
description: After feeling completely relaxed, the family of three continued walking in the park. His mother, in high spirits, hummed Sweet Honey. Then they walked back home along the same route. Lei Mingxuan held his mother's arm, while his father asked about the sourcing channel for the store's outdoor jackets. Lei Mingxuan explained in detail the new product line from his supplier, Brother Tao.
location: Return from Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to home at Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family lunch and midday rest.
description: After returning home, his mother happily made Lei Mingxuan’s favorite Shanghai-style braised pork and scallion oil noodles. He ate two big bowls and kept praising them. Neighbor Aunt Zhu came over to borrow soy sauce, and Lei Mingxuan greeted her with a smile. After the meal, he helped his mother clear the table, watched the midday news with his father, then went to his room, changed into his work shirt, checked his phone and power bank, and prepared for going to the store in the afternoon.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ride a shared bike to the clothing store at Super Brand Mall.
description: I went out, scanned a shared bike, and rode along the route to Lujiazui Super Brand Mall. On the way, at a traffic light intersection, I took a photo of the blue sky and white clouds and posted it to Moments: 'Today is sunny and warm; harmony in the family brings prosperity.'
location: From Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Clothing store work and handover
description: Arrived at the ‘ING’ clothing store on the 3rd floor of Super Brand Mall; shop assistant Xiao Lin was attending to customers. Lei Mingxuan first reviewed the POS machine sales records and online orders, then discussed restocking needs and regular customers' outdoor hardshell jacket requirements with Xiao Lin, making detailed notes in preparation to contact suppliers. Together they took photos of spring outfit combinations, and after retouching the images, he sent them to customer groups and Moments.
location: "ING" Clothing Store, 3F-12, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Convenience store break and mall survey
description: As the number of customers in the store dwindled, Lei Mingxuan asked Xiao Linzi to watch the store and went to the convenience store on B1 of Super Brand Mall to buy a bottle of oolong tea. Then he detoured to the mall atrium and carefully studied the displays of the newly opened outdoor multi-brand store, looking for inspiration for his 'mountain-style' concept.
location: Level B1 and atrium, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Processing online orders and storing courier packages at the metro station
description: Back at the store, I processed 4 online orders on my phone, then took the packages and walked to Lujiazui Metro Station, placing them in the storage lockers for the courier to pick up. After returning to the store, I cleaned with Xiao Lin and briefly listed the display adjustment plan for tomorrow.
location: Super Brand Mall 3F-12, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the storage locker at Lujiazui Metro Station, 158 Huayuan Shiqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Rode a shared bike home after work
description: After handing over to Xiao Lin, he left work and rode a shared bike home again. Passing a fruit stall on the way, he bought strawberries and sugarcane, which his mother loves.
location: From Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to home at Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Warm family dinner
description: When he got home, dinner was already on the table. Lei Mingxuan put the strawberries on the table, and his mother was very happy. The dinner atmosphere was warm; the family chatted about the day's fun at the park and work at the store, and his father even shared his thoughts on the “mountain-style” transformation plan, laughing and talking.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: After-meal chores and waiting for the courier
description: I helped my mother clear the dishes and wash fruit, then sat on the living room sofa chatting with her. When I checked my phone, I saw the delivery status showed Out for delivery. I felt a little excited and waited for the doorbell to ring.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Unboxing and researching a pour-over coffee set
description: The courier rang the doorbell, and Lei Mingxuan couldn't wait to tear open the package. Inside were a pour-over kettle, a V60 dripper, a server, a thermometer, and light-roast Yirgacheffe beans. He studied the parts against the instruction manual and weighed the beans with a kitchen scale, planning to try brewing a cup tomorrow morning. His mother smiled on the side and said he was tinkering with new gadgets again.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening reading and social chat
description: Back in the bedroom, I slumped on the sofa scrolling through my phone. I sent photos of the coffee set to the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group chat, which drew some friendly teasing from friends. Then I flipped through The Offline Store Display Bible, focusing on the “Traffic Flow Design” chapter. Combined with the outdoor store displays I had seen at the mall that afternoon, it sparked new ideas, and I noted them in my phone's memo app.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wash up before bed
description: After washing up, I changed into pajamas and lay in bed. Thinking back on the day, from breaking the ice with family to receiving the coffee set, I felt fulfilled and satisfied, and looked forward to tomorrow.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Planned for tomorrow and went to sleep.
description: Before going to bed, he did a final check of the studio group and client messages, confirmed there were no special arrangements for tomorrow, then put down his phone, let out a long sigh of relief, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Early morning first experience with pour-over coffee.
description: In the morning, the alarm clock went off and it was gloomy and cold outside. Lei Mingxuan stepped on the scale and weighed himself (81.9 kg), feeling a bit frustrated. But he couldn't worry about that. He took out the pour-over coffee set that arrived last night, followed the video tutorial, and seriously began his first-ever pour-over coffee. Although the water flow was unsteady and the coffee bed collapsed, when that fresh fruity and floral sour aroma spread out, he excitedly took a photo and posted it to WeChat Moments and a coffee group with the caption: “New toy check-in! My first cup ever, and the taste is surprisingly decent!”
location: Home kitchen, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up, breakfast, and family conversation.
description: After washing up, his mother Wang Xiuying had already laid out pan-fried buns and white rice porridge. He drank the freshly brewed coffee and chatted with his father Lei Jianguo about the progress of the store's transformation. His father expressed support and reassurance, but told him not to overwork himself. His mother, on the other hand, nagged that it would get colder on the weekend and reminded him to wear his thermal leggings.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commuting to work and depositing the day's revenue
description: Lei Mingxuan got on his electric scooter, put on his helmet and cotton gloves, and set off from Pudong Avenue toward the store in Lujiazui. On the way, he deliberately stopped for 3 minutes at the ATM in HSBC Tower, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, and deposited last night's revenue. Then he continued riding to the back door of Super Brand Mall, parked, and went upstairs through the staff entrance.
location: From Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, passing by the HSBC Building ATM at 8 Lujiazui East Road.

name: Arrive at the store and start work mode
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan turned on the lights, opened the cashier system, and checked the online orders to be shipped that day. Store clerk Xiao Lin had already arrived, and they greeted each other. He watered the potted plants by the window and wrote down in his notebook the customer need that Xiao Lin had recorded yesterday (a dark-blue technical vest).
location: Store, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Store space adjustment: moving shelves
description: To make room for the future 'Mountain Techwear' themed zone, Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin emptied the two double-door stainless steel racks at the back of the store and carefully moved them against the wall. While moving them, Xiao Lin suggested adjusting the angle of the ceiling lights so they would shine directly on the new products. Lei Mingxuan thought it was a good idea and made a note of it. After freeing up about 5 square meters, he measured the space with a tape measure and began mentally mapping out the future display plan.
location: Store, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Go to IFC Mall for a ramen lunch.
description: His stomach was growling with hunger. Lei Mingxuan stretched his muscles, told Xiao Lin to watch the shop, then walked across the Lujiazui circular footbridge to the Japanese ramen shop on B1 of IFC. He ordered a bowl of the classic Akamaru ramen, added a soft-boiled egg and nori, and ate until he felt warm all over.
location: Japanese Ramen Restaurant, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Starbucks Americano and competitor observation
description: After finishing the ramen, Lei Mingxuan took a detour to the Starbucks on the first floor of Super Brand Mall. He ordered a tall Americano and sat in a spot where he could clearly see the barista's work at the counter. While sipping his coffee, he watched the barista's smooth, flowing motions: grinding beans, distributing the coffee grounds, tamping, extracting, steaming milk... He silently compared them with his own pour-over from that morning, noted a few key points, and used them as reference to improve his coffee-making skills.
location: Starbucks Coffee, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Return to the store to handle deliveries and chores
description: After finishing his coffee, Lei Mingxuan walked back to the store with the empty cup. On the way, he picked up a package at the mall's service counter—a new batch of packaging bags ordered last week. Back at the store, he opened the package, sorted and put away the bags, replied to several online customer inquiries, and packed two orders for same-day shipping.
location: Store, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Receiving and screening fabric sample books
description: The thick fabric sample book sent by supplier Zhou Tao from Hangzhou finally arrived. Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin excitedly spread it open on the checkout counter. It contained a variety of outdoor functional fabrics, including water-repellent, breathable membrane, Coolmax, and more. The two flipped through it while discussing, and used sticky notes to mark more than a dozen candidate fabrics with good colors, hand feel, and value for money, preliminarily shortlisting materials suitable for the new spring/summer products.
location: Store, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Collecting packages and drafting end-of-work plans
description: After the excitement, it was back to daily chores. Lei Mingxuan affixed shipping labels to the two packages he had packed in the afternoon, ready to send them off together early the next morning. At the same time, he opened the backend of the online platform, summarized the several new orders placed today, and once again confirmed the detailed requirements for the dark blue techwear vest a regular customer was looking for.
location: Store, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Design the display for the mountain-style techwear theme area
description: With the sample book in hand, inspiration struck. Lei Mingxuan took out paper and pen, sat down in the newly cleared space, and began drawing the display layout for the outdoor techwear themed area. He planned to use metal grid panels with wooden shelves, cover the floor with a gravel-textured rug, and add two spotlights to create an outdoor atmosphere. He deliberately included the adjustable-angle pendant light that Xiao Lin had suggested earlier, further refining the design plan.
location: Store, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Took a short break and looked around a convenience store.
description: After half an hour of brainstorming, Lei Mingxuan's head was beginning to throb, so he decided to go out for some air. He said hello to Xiao Lin, strolled over to the Lawson convenience store in the lobby of the adjacent Jin Mao Tower office building, bought a bottle of Suntory oolong tea, and glanced at the magazine rack by the entrance to see if there were any new outdoor trend magazines and to pick up some industry news.
location: Convenience store in the office lobby of Jin Mao Tower, No. 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Go grocery shopping at the vegetable market on the way home from work
description: After returning to the shop and going over the next day's matters, Lei Mingxuan got off work, hopped on his electric scooter, and made a detour to Pushang Vegetable Market. Remembering his mother had said the rice at home was almost gone, he first bought a 10 kg bag of pearl rice, then bought fresh asparagus, white mushrooms, and half a three-yellow chicken, planning to have his mother make three-cup chicken for dinner as an extra dish.
location: Pushang Vegetable Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Going home for a brief rest.
description: After arriving home, Lei Mingxuan put the rice and vegetables away, greeted his mother, who was already busy in the kitchen, and suggested making three-cup chicken. He then went back to his room, changed into comfortable loungewear, collapsed onto the sofa and scrolled through his phone for a while, replied to a few WeChat messages, and checked the Moments post about pour-over coffee he had posted that morning, which had received quite a few likes and comments.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Discussed fabric selection over the phone with cousin Shen Jie
description: After resting enough, Lei Mingxuan picked up the sample book and called his cousin Shen Jie via video. He held the sample book up to the camera and flipped through it page by page, focusing on the dozen or so fabrics they had initially shortlisted. The two discussed the breathability index and waterproof ratings of each fabric from a professional perspective, and agreed to first request several large samples to inspect in person. They made an appointment for Shen Jie to come to the store on the weekend to review the large samples together.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Communicated sample feedback with supplier Zhou Tao.
description: After hanging up with his cousin, Lei Mingxuan immediately sent a WeChat voice message to supplier Zhou Tao, thanking him for the sample booklet he had sent and letting him know he had initially shortlisted several fabrics he was very satisfied with. He asked Zhou Tao to send physical swatches of these fabrics tomorrow or the day after so he could further confirm the colors and hand feel, and then sent over the fabric numbers he had marked.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family dinner and today's recap.
description: The family finally sat down to dinner together. His mother had made fresh asparagus stir-fried with mushrooms, plus the three-cup chicken Lei Mingxuan had asked for. At the dinner table, he reported the day's progress to his parents, especially the sample book. Although his father Lei Jianguo didn't know much about fabrics, he was glad his son was so devoted, and suggested putting a tent or folding chairs in the new area to create atmosphere. Lei Mingxuan found the idea very down-to-earth and decided to look for a second-hand folding chair.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Spending time with family after dinner
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan rushed to wash the dishes and let his mother rest. Then he watched the news with his parents in the living room for a while and chatted about everyday life. For once, he didn't look at his phone; instead he listened to his father talk about the technical innovations he had led at the factory in his youth, found it quite interesting, and enjoyed a warm family moment.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Nighttime study and organization
description: After returning to his room, Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop. He first wrote up today's work insights, recording the key points of fabric selection and the ideas behind the display sketches. Then he opened the coffee group, looked at everyone's comments on his morning pour-over coffee photo, carefully studied brewing videos by several experts, and noted key parameters—water temperature, grind size, and pouring technique—ready to try again tomorrow.
location: Home study, Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and rest
description: After washing up, Lei Mingxuan changed into pajamas and lay in bed. He routinely scrolled through Xiaohongshu and WeChat Moments, liked a few friends' posts, then showed off today's sample book to Zhang Wei and Li Na in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat and arranged the next get-together. Finally, he opened a new book about outdoor aesthetics, read for about ten minutes until his eyelids grew heavy, and turned off the light to sleep right on time at 23:45.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Waking up and washing up
description: Got up at 8:40 in the morning; sunlight shone into the bedroom through the gap in the curtains. After stretching, Lei Mingxuan went to the bathroom to wash up. Seeing his somewhat puffy face in the mirror, he remembered playing billiards with friends late into the night. While brushing his teeth, he checked the day's customer traffic forecast for Super Brand Mall on his phone, preparing for the weekend's store operations.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast.
description: Lei Mingxuan had breakfast with his mother Wang Xiuying, who prepared shengjian buns and small wontons. During the meal, they discussed the plan for the Lantern Festival that evening. His mother said that making tangyuan at home would be more lively, and mentioned that his father was going to buy shepherd's purse and winter bamboo shoots to make shepherd's purse and tofu soup. Lei Mingxuan offered to buy the ingredients himself.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online work communication
description: Before going out, Lei Mingxuan communicated with his cousin Shen Jie via WeChat about the weekend arrival time at the store and received the streetwear outfit photos she sent. At the same time, he confirmed the logistics information for the waterproof fabric samples with supplier Zhou Tao, learned that they were expected to arrive tomorrow, and left a message saying he would check the samples immediately upon arrival and finalize the sample garments as soon as possible.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Purchased ingredients for the Lantern Festival at the market
description: Lei Mingxuan walked 10 minutes to Pushang Vegetable Market to buy ingredients for the Lantern Festival. At the dried goods stall, he bought water-ground glutinous rice flour and black sesame filling; at the butcher's, he bought half a jin of braised beef his father loved. Seeing fresh shepherd's purse, he also bought half a jin. Finally, at the fruit stall, he selected strawberries and baba oranges and returned home fully loaded.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pour-over coffee at home.
description: After returning from the vegetable market, Lei Mingxuan sorted the ingredients into categories in the kitchen, then took out a coffee grinder and the Ethiopian 'Huakui' coffee beans purchased online, and made a pour-over using 88°C water with a slow, circular, small-stream technique. The bloom was ideal, and the brewed coffee had strawberry and cream notes. After tasting, he took a photo and sent it to his friends group to share a sense of accomplishment.
location: Kitchen and study, Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch: Ippudo Ramen
description: Lei Mingxuan rode his e-bike to IFC Mall and had lunch alone at Ippudo on the B1 floor, ordering the Shiromaru Motoaji ramen with a soft-boiled egg and seaweed. While eating, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu, looking at Japanese workwear and outdoor-style outfit combinations for inspiration for the store display.
location: Ippudo Ramen, B1 Level, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Scouted outdoor brands and coffee equipment stores, and sent an express package.
description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan first went to the newly opened outdoor brand multi-label store on the fourth floor of Super Brand Mall. He carefully examined the rack displays, folding methods, and camping scene display area, photographing layout details for reference. Then he rode his e-bike to the GCE coffee equipment specialty store on Shangcheng Road, chatted with the staff about pour-over kettles and drippers, and added them on WeChat. Finally, he shipped a T-shirt that needed a size exchange at a Hive Box locker at Lujiazui Metro Station.
location: Lujiazui area, Pudong New Area, Shanghai: Super Brand Mall (168 Lujiazui West Road), GCE coffee equipment store on Shangcheng Road, and Hive Box locker at Lujiazui Metro Station (158 Huayuanshiqiao Road)

name: Visit the second-hand market to hunt for folding chairs.
description: Lei Mingxuan rode his e-bike to Xie Wen Flea Market on Qishan Road, found the owner Wang he had contacted before, and took a liking to a Kermit chair in fairly good condition. After bargaining, he bought it for 150 yuan and established a long-term partnership with Owner Wang for recycling used folding chairs.
location: Xie Wen Secondhand Market, No. 1508 Qishan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buy a pancake to reward himself
description: After leaving the flea market, Lei Mingxuan saw a Shandong multi-grain pancake stall with a long queue at the intersection of Qishan Road and Jiaodong Road. He also bought one with an extra egg, extra crispy wafer, and extra spicy, and ate it while riding his e-bike as an afternoon snack. After arriving home, he sent a WeChat message from downstairs to let his mother know he was back.
location: Authentic Shandong multigrain pancake stall at the intersection of Qishan Road and Jiaodong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (later returned to Shanggang Residential Community)

name: Help prepare the Lantern Festival dinner.
description: Lei Mingxuan came home, put on an apron, and helped his mother Wang Xiuying prepare the Lantern Festival dinner. His mother made shepherd's purse and tofu soup and stir-fried shrimp, while Lei Mingxuan was in charge of rolling tangyuan with glutinous rice flour and black sesame filling. His father Lei Jianguo also helped by arranging dishes and slicing spiced beef, and listened to Lei Mingxuan tell the story of finding the camping chair at a bargain that afternoon. The kitchen had a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: The whole family spent the Lantern Festival dinner together.
description: Lei Mingxuan and his parents sat around the dining table for a Lantern Festival dinner. On the table were homemade tangyuan and frozen tangyuan, along with dishes such as braised beef in soy sauce, shepherd's purse and tofu soup, and stir-fried shrimp. The TV was playing the Lantern Festival Gala. His mother put food on his plate, his father praised the braised beef, and the whole family was happy together.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After dinner, had a long talk with parents about career transition and handling their pressure to get married.
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the dishes, then explained in detail to his father in the living room the transformation plan for the store's 'Mountain Lifestyle Area,' showed the display photos taken in the afternoon, and discussed online-offline integrated strategies. His father expressed support but reminded him to control costs. When his mother tried to bring up the topic of blind dates, Lei Mingxuan skillfully turned the conversation to the family's plan to camp in western Sichuan, successfully defusing the pressure to get married.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Accompanied parents watching the news and eating fruit.
description: Lei Mingxuan sat on the living room sofa with his parents watching CCTV News, chatting while peeling ponkan oranges and sharing them with everyone, enjoying a relaxing family moment.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organize work notes and hobbies in the study
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to the study, opened his computer, and created a new folder named “20250212 Field Visit.” He organized the photos of outdoor store displays he had taken during the day and added keywords to the WeChat remark for Boss Wang of the secondhand shop. He recorded his thoughts on the coffee shop visits and the pour-over kettle model he wanted to buy, then entered the data and water-pouring route diagram from his second brew into the pour-over log in Excel.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime yoga
description: Lei Mingxuan spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and followed Keep for a session of bedtime yin yoga, stretching and relaxing his shoulder and leg muscles to relieve the fatigue of being out and about all day.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wash up and get ready for bed
description: After yoga, Lei Mingxuan took a hot shower, dried his hair, and lay down on the bed. He sent a Lantern Festival good-night voice message in the friends' group, then set his phone to silent mode and prepared to sleep.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: After turning off the light, Lei Mingxuan reviewed tomorrow's tasks in his mind, including going to the store to draft the initial display plan for the mountain-style section, waiting for fabric samples, and discussing with Shen Jie. He gradually fell asleep with anticipation for the store's transformation.
location: Room 502, Building 6, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake up, wash up, and have breakfast
description: After the alarm rang, he lay in bed for a while. Remembering that he needed to finalize the fabric, he got up quickly, washed up, and changed into a comfortable hoodie. Then he went to the dining room to enjoy the pan-fried pork buns and wonton soup his mother had made, while trying to brew coffee with his newly purchased French press, and chatted with his parents for a bit.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the clothing store at Super Brand Mall.
description: Rode a shared bike to Qixia Road on Dongfang Road, transferred to Metro Line 2, got off at Lujiazui Station, and walked to the clothing store inside Super Brand Mall. The whole trip took about 40 minutes, and he was getting ready to open the store.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Video call with the supplier to select outdoor-style fabrics
description: In the store's work area, he spread out the sample swatches and video-called supplier Zhou Tao in Hangzhou, carefully examining the texture of the khaki water-repellent fabric and the black abrasion-resistant nylon. He finally confirmed three main materials, paid the deposit via online banking, and recorded it in his purchasing notebook.
location: Clothing store inside Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preliminary plan for the mountain-style section display.
description: After hanging up the video call, I used a tape measure to measure the reserved space for the mountain-style area in the store, drew a rough draft on paper, and conceived a design combining metal grid panels with natural wood shelves, laying a gravel-textured rug on the floor and placing Kermit chairs, giving the overall style a natural outdoor feel.
location: Clothing store inside Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch: Japanese ramen
description: The rain eased, so I walked to the nearby IFC Mall. At a Japanese ramen shop, I ordered a special miso ramen with a soft-boiled egg and ate it hot to replenish my energy.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant, ifc Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handle online orders and store affairs
description: After returning to the store, print and package several orders from the online platform, prepare to hand them to Shansong for delivery, and water the evergreen in the store to keep it green.
location: Clothing store inside Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went to Huai Guo Jiu to hunt for bargains and returned
description: After greeting store clerk Xiao Lin, he went out, took Metro Line 2 to East Nanjing Road Station, transferred to Line 10 to Laoximen Station, and walked to Huaiguojiu. At the secondhand market, he found a vintage-style wrought iron shelf, bargained with the owner, and settled at 110 yuan. He asked the owner to call a Shansong courier to send it directly back to the store. Then he took the Metro back to Super Brand Mall the same way.
location: Shanghai Huaihai Secondhand Market (Huaiguojiu), No. 1 South Zhongshan Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: Video call with my cousin Shen Jie to discuss the mountain-style area display
description: Opened WeChat to video call with fashion consultant cousin Shen Jie, pointed the phone at the empty wall in the mountain-style section to show the current state. Shen Jie suggested using a rock-texture backdrop and a vintage camping lantern. Lei Mingxuan took notes while listening, planning to have Xiao Lin buy the backdrop and to install the shelving himself.
location: The mountain-style section of the clothing store inside Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Assign tasks and organize work plan
description: After the video call, he sent Shen Jie's suggestions and the Taobao link to Xiao Lin, the shop assistant, and asked him to order the backdrop cloth before the end of his shift. He then listed the confirmed fabrics, the shelf he found online, and the backdrop cloth budget in his purchasing notebook, preparing a preliminary cost estimate.
location: Clothing store inside Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ride a shared bike home after work.
description: After work, I explained the store-closing tasks to the staff, then rode a shared bike home along Riverside Avenue, enjoying the breeze and the river view on the way to relax.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buying groceries on the way
description: Passing by Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road, he remembered that his mother had said she wanted to eat spring bamboo shoots, so he went in and picked out a few tender shoots and a piece of pork belly, planning to make oil-braised bamboo shoots for dinner.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and relaxing in the living room
description: After arriving home, he handed the groceries to his mother. She made braised pork chops and garlic lettuce. Lei Mingxuan cleaned the spring bamboo shoots and asked his mother to stir-fry them into oil-braised bamboo shoots. At dinner, he showed his father the iron shelf he had found, and his father offered to help reinforce it. After the meal, the family of three sat in the living room watching TV and chatting. His father watched the news, his mother scrolled through health-preservation videos on her phone, and Lei Mingxuan leaned back on the sofa to relax and keep them company.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Soaking feet and reconciling with good friend Han Dong over a voice call.
description: He decided to try soaking his feet before bed for wellness. In the bathroom, he filled a basin a little more than half full of hot water and added a mugwort pack. As soon as he put his feet in, a wave of warmth surged up. Halfway through, his friend Han Dong sent a voice message complaining about always being stood up lately. Lei Mingxuan called him right back, apologized jokingly, and explained the recent progress of the store transformation. The two chatted about basketball and daily life for half an hour, agreed to play at Yuanshen next week when the weather was good, and their relationship was repaired. The whole foot-soaking and phone call were relaxing.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, bathroom/bedroom at home in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Home strength training
description: After the foot bath, he felt refreshed all over. He laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did 20 minutes of push-ups, planks, and squats, working toward his goal of lowering his BMI.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Organizing the mountain-style area plan on the computer
description: After exercising, went to the study and organized all the day's ideas, costs, and division of labor for the mountain-style area into a detailed proposal document, and searched online for display reference images to prepare for subsequent implementation.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and relaxing before bed
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, I lay in bed thinking about having to keep an eye on the backdrop delivery tomorrow. I scrolled through Moments for a while, then turned off the light and fell asleep, bringing a fulfilling day to an end.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting up, morning meditation, and breakfast
description: At 8:50 in the morning, the phone alarm went off. Chen Chen meditated in bed for 5 minutes to adjust his mindset for the new day. After getting up, the scale showed 82 kg, and he realized he needed to strengthen his exercise routine, resolving to add more yoga time over the weekend. After washing up, he had breakfast with his mother Wang Guilan: white congee, fried eggs, and pickled cucumber, simple and tasty. At the table, Chen Chen announced his plan to close the store early and go home to cook in the afternoon; his mother was worried but also gratified.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the store
description: Chen Chen changed into a dark blue technical vest and cargo pants, took some small props for shooting, walked five minutes to Pudong Avenue Metro Station, and took Line 2 to Lujiazui. In the train car, he browsed WeChat Moments and liked posts about Valentine's Day gifts. After leaving the station, he walked three minutes to the store at Super Brand Mall.
location: Metro Line 2, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Pudong Avenue Station to Lujiazui Station)

name: Store opening and Valentine's Day themed operations
description: Chen Chen opened the rolling shutter door, started up the system, handled the three online order inquiries from last night that had not been answered, and promised one customer expedited shipping. Using the quiet morning hours, he put together three mountain-style date looks: an army-green windbreaker over a white T-shirt, khaki cargo pants with a black vest, and a khaki trench coat. He shot them in front of the white wall in the shop, using a vintage wrought-iron shelf as the backdrop. After retouching the photos, he wrote a WeChat Moments caption emphasizing the mountain-style outfits and the techwear vibe, and received likes and inquiries from regular customers.
location: Store on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and restaurant exploration
description: Chen Chen went to Menya Musashi on B1 of IFC and ordered a bowl of black garlic oil tonkotsu ramen. While waiting in line, he browsed the surrounding designer toy stores and saw Pop Mart's new blind box. He resisted the urge to buy, took a photo, and sent it to the Pudong Three Musketeers group. While eating noodles, he replied to his friend Shen Jie's messages, confirming that she would arrive at the store around 2 p.m. tomorrow.
location: Menya Musashi, B1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning to the store to wrap up and preparing to close
description: Chen Chen returned to the store, sent a voice message to supplier Zhou Tao to confirm the fabric samples and delivery time, and also messaged Shen Jie to confirm the meeting from 2 p.m. to 3 p.m. the next day. After handling the packing of the last two online orders and filling in the express waybills, he checked the payment QR code and the packed parcels, put up a Temporarily Closed sign, locked the rolling shutter door, and prepared to close early.
location: Store on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rode an electric scooter to the market and did grocery shopping
description: Chen Chen got on the electric moped at the shop entrance and sped straight along Lujiazui Ring Road, Century Avenue, Zhangyang Road, and Dongchang Road to Pushang Vegetable Market. He asked Old Zhang at the meat stall how to choose the best lower pork belly for braised pork. Old Zhang skillfully cut off a piece and praised Chen Chen for his filial piety. Then he bought shepherd's purse, scallions, old ginger, yellow wine, rock sugar, light soy sauce, fresh yeast, cinnamon bark, and star anise, and returned fully loaded.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling Home
description: Chen Chen hung the groceries on the handlebars of his electric bike and rode home carefully, passing Dongchang Road, Zhangyang Road, and Pudong Avenue before arriving at Shanggang Residential Complex. When he pushed open the door, his mother was sitting in the living room watching TV.
location: On the way to Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing ingredients and cooking independently.
description: Chen Chen changed into loungewear, tied on an apron, and started cooking. First, he blanched the pork belly in cold water, cut it into chunks, stir-fried it until golden brown, added rock sugar to make caramel, then splashed in rice wine, dark soy sauce, and hot water, and simmered it over low heat. Meanwhile, he kneaded dough and let it rest, chopped shepherd's purse, and mixed it with the meat filling. When his mother offered to help, he politely declined. After the braised pork had simmered for a full hour, he started making pan-fried buns. With skilled hands, he neatly lined up 20 little white buns. Then he put the buns into the pan, sprinkled them with sesame seeds and chopped scallions, and turned up the heat to reduce the braised pork sauce. The cooking was complete.
location: The kitchen at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Gratitude dinner and family time.
description: Father Chen Jianguo came home from work and was amazed to see a table full of dishes. Chen Chen invited his parents to sit down and picked braised pork for his mother. After tasting it, her eyes reddened and she praised her son for growing up. Father sipped the yellow rice wine and nodded repeatedly. Chen Chen raised his glass, thanked his parents for their hard work over the years, and said he would continue to work hard to run the shop well. The atmosphere was warm and moving, and the family enjoyed a cozy dinner together.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: After-dinner clean-up and family chat.
description: Chen Chen took the initiative to clear the dishes, wipe the table, and sweep the floor, then brewed a pot of Pu'er tea and chatted with his parents in the living room. He showed the newly arrived fabric sample book from the store and briefly talked about tomorrow's plan. His mother proposed holding a monthly "Family Food Day", and Chen Chen agreed; his father suggested going fishing on the weekend, and Chen Chen also agreed, then mentioned that he had arranged to play ball with his friend Han Dong on the weekend.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Replying to messages and group chats
description: Chen Chen leaned back on the sofa scrolling through WeChat Moments, liking couple posts showing off their romance, and replying to a few customer inquiries. In the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group, Chen Chen shared the experience of cooking for their parents today and asked if everyone wanted to get dinner tomorrow night. The group immediately became lively.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: At-home yoga
description: Chen Chen changed into sports clothes, did 25 minutes of home yoga on a yoga mat, and added 10 minutes of core training. Sweating heavily, Chen Chen felt comfortable and took a step toward weight control.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Learning pour-over coffee
description: Chen Chen took out the Timemore C3S grinder and V60 dripper to prepare tomorrow's brewing parameters. After seeing a new grind setting shared by friends in the coffee group, he decided to try grind size 20 clicks and water temperature 92°C tomorrow. He recorded the plan in his notebook: Ethiopian Huakui, 20 clicks, 92°C, bloom for 30 seconds, pour in two stages.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Soaking feet and washing up
description: Chen Chen soaked his feet in hot water with a mugwort pack, relaxed his whole body, and used his phone's memo app to record tomorrow's to-do items: wait for Shen Jie, research pour-over coffee, review the business, and arrange a dinner group. After soaking his feet, he brushed his teeth, washed his face, and changed into pajamas.
location: Home bathroom, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing for bed and going to sleep
description: Chen Chen lay in bed, recalling his parents' happy smiles and the freshly made pan-fried buns from tonight, feeling a solid sense of happiness. He casually replied to his basketball buddy Han Dong about meeting at the court this weekend, then glanced at his inventory notes. Afterward, he turned off the light, adjusted to a comfortable position, and quickly fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The phone alarm rang right on time. Lei Mingxuan stretched; outside the window, the sun was shining brightly. He got up, washed up, changed into a workout T-shirt and shorts, and got ready for the morning ritual ahead. Looking at himself in the mirror, he thought, “A new day—let's go!”
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pour-over coffee practice
description: Lei Mingxuan took out the newly arrived Ethiopian 'Huakui' coffee beans, weighed out 15 g, and ground them to a medium-fine grind. He heated the water to 92°C, used the three-pour method, deliberately slowed his swirling pace, and kept the water flow steady. The brew finished in 2 minutes 10 seconds, 10 seconds more consistent than yesterday. On tasting, the acidity was bright and fruity, but the astringency at the finish remained. He recorded a video and sent it to the coffee group chat. The group replied, 'Nice improvement, keep it up!' He decided to make this 20-minute practice his daily morning ritual.
location: Home kitchen, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Basic indoor workout.
description: Lei Mingxuan unrolled his yoga mat on the wooden living room floor and did three sets of wide push-ups, three sets of bodyweight squats, and two sets of sit-ups. He was slightly sweaty and felt a clear muscle pump. He glanced at the scale showing 82.1kg and silently thought that with the weather warming up, he had to put morning runs on the schedule.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Shower, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: After showering, Lei Mingxuan changed into a clean white cotton T-shirt, black cargo pants, and a khaki trench coat, then went to the dining room. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had already made pan-fried buns and white rice porridge. As he ate, he chatted with her about his plans for the day; his mother said she would buy a sea bass to steam for dinner. After the meal, he checked the items in his backpack and kissed his mother on the cheek before heading out.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Take the subway to the Shanghai Museum.
description: Lei Mingxuan walked to Shangcheng Road Metro Station and took Line 2 to People's Square. The carriage was not crowded. While scrolling through Moments, he saw his cousin Shen Jie's roller skating video, liked it, and commented, then replied to several client inquiries. About 35 minutes later, he arrived at People's Square Station, exited from Exit 1, and walked to the south gate of the Shanghai Museum.
location: Shanghai Metro Line 2 (Shangcheng Road Station to People's Square Station)

name: Visit the 'Ancient Egyptian Civilization Exhibition'.
description: Lei Mingxuan passed through security and entered the special exhibition area of the Shanghai Museum, where he spent nearly two and a half hours immersed in the dimly lit galleries. He carefully studied the patterns of Tutankhamun's golden mask, the wear marks on the statue of Ramesses II, and the bead colors and tassel structure of the pharaoh's necklace, taking dozens of high-definition detail photos with his phone. Inspired, he began planning to apply ancient Egyptian geometric lines to the embroidered design of the store's backpacks.
location: Shanghai Museum, 201 People's Avenue, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and selecting cultural creative souvenirs
description: Lei Mingxuan walked out of the museum, went to the B1 level of Raffles City, bought an eel rice set meal, ate it quickly, then returned to the museum's cultural and creative shop. He carefully selected a papyrus bookmark printed with hieroglyphs and the Eye of Horus, and a small gold-plated Anubis pendant. After checking the craftsmanship, he carefully put them into the inner compartment of his backpack, planning to decorate the new military-green techwear backpack in the store.
location: Raffles City Shanghai, No. 268 Middle Tibet Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China, and the Shanghai Museum Cultural and Creative Store.

name: Took the metro to the Super Brand Mall store.
description: Lei Mingxuan took Metro Line 2 from People's Square Station to Lujiazui. On the train, he jotted rough notes in his phone memo about the visual symbols and material pairing inspirations from the museum. The train headed east, and skyscrapers flashed past the window.
location: Shanghai Metro Line 2 (People's Square Station to Lujiazui Station)

name: Arrive at the store early to organize materials
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at his own store in Super Brand Mall and swiped his card to enter. The displays were neatly arranged. He put down his backpack, opened his computer, and transferred the museum photos from his phone via WeChat, then filed them into three folders: "Clothing Details," "Accessory Design," and "Spatial Textures."
location: Own store in Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Discussed product selection and display with his cousin.
description: Cousin Shen Jie bustled into the store. Lei Mingxuan showed her the museum photos and the Anubis pendant, and the two discussed the idea of decorating the pendant on the shoulder straps of a khaki trench coat. Then they took out the newly arrived water-repellent fabric samples and had a lively discussion about color, stiffness, and breathability. From the beaded necklace picture, they hit upon the inspiration of color-blocked piping, and finalized the details of the mountain-style featured styles and the display cabinet adjustment plan. Lei Mingxuan gave Shen Jie a papyrus bookmark as an inspirational gift.
location: Own store in Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Handle store online affairs and wrap up
description: After Shen Jie left, Lei Mingxuan returned to the computer to handle reminder messages for unpaid orders in the backend. He packed two packages to be sent to Hangzhou and Nanjing respectively. Finally, he organized his ideas for display changes and key points for fabric communication into a to-do list, sent it to his partner Zhou Tao, and left a message about scheduling a phone call next week.
location: Own store in Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Close the store and walk home
description: Lei Mingxuan closed the shop on time and chose to walk home slowly along the Lujiazui Riverside Boulevard. The setting sun shone on the river as he felt a sense of fulfillment from the day's cultural activities and work discussions. On the way, he casually ordered fresh groceries via an app for delivery.
location: On the way walking from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the Shanggang Residential Community.

name: Family dinner and preparation
description: After arriving home, Lei Mingxuan washed his hands and helped peel garlic. While sharing with his mother Wang Xiuying an amusing story about the gilded patterns on the mummy coffin at the museum, he turned to his father Lei Jianguo and suggested that his father go fishing with him next week. His father readily agreed. On the dinner table were steamed sea bass, dry-fried green beans, tomato scrambled eggs, and garlic water spinach freshly stir-fried by Lei Mingxuan. He poured yellow rice wine for his father and drank cola himself, and the family enjoyed a harmonious atmosphere. His mother again brought up the weekend family food day, and Lei Mingxuan smiled and promised to show off some Sichuan cooking next week.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Organize inspiration and design notes
description: After the meal, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the dishes, then made a cup of tea and returned to the study. He opened his laptop, and referring to photos of ancient Egyptian textures, drew several clothing structure line sketches and accessory matching drafts in his sketchbook, then attached them to a small magnetic blackboard. Afterwards, he saw his friend Han Dong inviting people to play billiards in the group chat, and he immediately replied: see you at the usual place in half an hour.
location: Home study, Shanggang Residential Quarter, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Playing billiards with friends
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into his sneakers and rode a shared bike for 8 minutes to reach the World Plaza billiard hall. Han Dong and Qin Lang were already there. The three played three games of American eight-ball, and Mingxuan, with a hot hand, won two. While playing, they shared their thoughts on the Egypt exhibition and the store transformation plan, and Han Dong praised it repeatedly. Afterward, they agreed to meet again at Yuanshen Sports Center.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, B1, World Plaza, No. 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Return home and relax with a foot soak
description: After saying goodbye to his friends, Lei Mingxuan rode his bike home, boiled water, and put a mugwort pack in it to soak his feet. Leaning on the sofa with his feet in the warm, slightly bitter water, he scrolled through WeChat for a while and saved a few grinding reference images shared by experts in the coffee group.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pre-sleep preparation and review
description: Lei Mingxuan poured out the foot-soaking water, washed up, and changed into pajamas. In the Pour-Over Coffee Diary app, he recorded the parameters to adjust tomorrow (water temperature down to 90). Then he said goodnight to his parents, opened Bilibili to watch a video on ancient Egyptian jewelry craftsmanship, and turned off the lights at 23:00 sharp to sleep, bringing a fulfilling day to an end.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning wake-up and fat-loss motivation.
description: Woke up at 8:15 in the morning and weighed himself: 82.0 kg. He pinched the belly fat and resolved to adjust his diet starting today. After getting dressed, he talked with his mother, Wang Xiuying, and suggested a light dinner of steamed fish and blanched vegetables. She agreed and proactively offered to adjust the daily menu, increasing the proportion of steaming and boiling. Then they had breakfast together. After the meal, he took out his newly purchased pour-over kettle and practiced brewing Ethiopian Huakui coffee. The water temperature was 90°C and the pour was slower. The finish was slightly astringent, but the acidity was bright; it was better than yesterday. He took a photo and sent it to the coffee group and Moments to share his practice progress.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-departure preparation and a short yoga session
description: After changing into a dark gray hoodie, black cargo pants, and an army green outdoor jacket, he saw the yoga mat before leaving and remembered his weight problem. He put down his bag, did 10 minutes of stretching and 5 minutes of plank, moving his shoulders and back, and felt his body loosen up. Then he picked up his phone and keys, said goodbye to his mother, and went out.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Cycling commute to Super Brand Mall
description: Rented a shared bike at the community gate and rode along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui Ring Road. Today was overcast turning to cloudy, 4-9°C, north wind slightly cold. Pulled up the hood of my windbreaker. Arrived at Super Brand Mall in about 15 minutes, entered through the staff entrance, and took the escalator up to the third-floor store.
location: From Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Morning store work and design ideas.
description: After arriving at the store, I turned on the lights, opened the cash register system, checked the previous day's orders, watered the plants, and wiped down the counter and the coffee table in the rest area. I rearranged the newly arrived thin spring clothing by low-saturation color scheme, separating dark colors from bright ones, took photos, and sent them to the customer group. Then, in the rest area, I went through the details of the ancient Egyptian accessories photographed at the Shanghai Museum yesterday, focusing on scarabs, lotus patterns, and blue-green tones. I noted the color scheme 'papyrus + turquoise + gold thread accents' in my phone memo and hand-drew a simple sketch of the jacket lining, annotating the design inspiration 'metal buttons simulate amulets.' Soon after, a young couple came in. The girl was interested in an army-green utility vest; I proactively introduced its waterproof features and pocket design. The boy liked the lightweight jacket. In the end, I sold one vest, added the boy on WeChat, and told him that the new mountain-style items would arrive next week.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, 3F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch: Japanese ramen at IFC
description: He locked the store door and walked to the adjacent IFC Mall. At LG1, he ordered a bowl of Akamaru Ramen with a soft-boiled egg at Ippudo. While waiting, he scrolled through his phone, replied to comments on his coffee photo in Moments, and responded to a WeChat message from his billiards buddy Han Dong inviting him to play. During the meal, he observed what nearby customers were wearing, then returned to the store.
location: Ippudo, LG1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday coffee break and pour-over practice
description: On the way back to the store, he bought a tall Americano at Starbucks on the first floor of Super Brand Mall, sat in a corner to observe the barista's technique, compared it with his own brewing method from the morning, and noted the improvement point: “the bloom waiting time after pouring water can be extended by 5 seconds.” He replied to questions in the coffee group, watched two videos of expert brewers, and returned to the store before 12:45.
location: Starbucks, 1st Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
