name: Receiving close friend Qian Duoduo and discussing creative ideas for the store
description: Qian Duoduo arrived at the store on time carrying a Pop Mart shopping bag. The two of them opened blind boxes in the lounge area. She was the penultimate one to reveal a hidden figure and pounded the table in excitement; I took photos to record it. After opening the boxes, Qian Duoduo noticed the camping chairs and trekking poles in the corner and suggested setting up an outdoor experience corner, with folding tables and chairs and mood lights to show off the mountain style, and also to display designer toys. I thought the idea was reliable, noted the key points in my phone memo, and the two discussed the layout and product selection for nearly twenty minutes.
location: Rest area of Lei Mingxuan's clothing store, 3rd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon shop operations and order processing
description: After Qian Duoduo left, he replied to customer inquiries and handled two online orders (one UV-protection jacket and one camping hat). He printed shipping labels on the computer, packed the items, and prepared them for shipment the next day. He checked supplier Zhou Tao's WeChat messages and confirmed that the fabric samples could be shipped before the end of the month. He recorded a short video of the new spring clothing and posted it to the customer group and his Moments.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, 3F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycled to the market to buy healthy ingredients
description: After closing the shop, I took a shared bike to Pushang Food Market on Dongchang Road, arriving in about 10 minutes. At the seafood stall, I picked a live sea bass and asked the vendor to clean it. Then I bought broccoli, lettuce, scallions, ginger, steamed fish soy sauce, and a pack of brown rice, deliberately avoiding the greasy pork belly and ribs. After shopping, I was ready to go home.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home and a short rest
description: Walked from the vegetable market back home to Shanggang Community, greeted my father who was reading the newspaper in the living room, and put the groceries in the kitchen. Went to my room to change out of my coat, drank some water, and sat on the sofa scrolling through my phone for a while, replying to a few messages.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cooked a low-fat dinner with my mother
description: Put on an apron and divided the work with my mother: I washed and cut the broccoli and lettuce, while she prepared the sea bass, lightly pan-fried sliced ginger in a little oil, then drizzled soy sauce and steamed the fish. I blanched the vegetables. The whole meal was oil-free and sugar-free, while the rice cooker cooked brown rice. We worked well together; my mother smiled and said this meal was one she could enjoy without guilt, and I agreed that we should have it at least twice a week.
location: Home kitchen at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family fat-loss dinner and conversation at the table.
description: Father Lei Jianguo looked at the table full of light dishes and sat down with satisfaction. After tasting, he praised the sea bass as fresh but not greasy. Everyone ate and chatted. I brought up the outdoor experience area idea proposed by Qian Duoduo. Father reminded me to test with low cost first. I said I planned to use the store's existing folding chairs and camping lights to set up the scene without spending extra money. The atmosphere was pleasant, and Father made an exception to have another half bowl of brown rice.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-meal cleanup and family communication
description: While clearing the dishes after the meal, I used a marker to write 'eat until 70% full' on a note on the refrigerator, and my mother nodded in agreement. After tidying the kitchen, I sat down next to my father and explained in detail the store's positioning as an outdoor-techwear style shop for the second half of the year and the logic behind product selection. My father asked serious questions about fabric stability, price range, and other matters, and finally patted me on the shoulder to show support, saying he could help if I was short-handed.
location: Home kitchen and living room, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Home strength training
description: After changing into sportswear, he did 20 push-ups on the living room yoga mat, three sets of planks (45 seconds each), one set of squats, and a simple HIIT circuit (four sets of jumping jacks and high knees, 30 seconds each). After breaking a light sweat, he drank a glass of warm water and felt comfortable.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Foot Soaking Relaxation and Ancient Egyptian-Inspired Design
description: He boiled hot water and added a mugwort pack to soak his feet. Meanwhile, he used a tablet to import museum photos and drawing software to sketch a color scheme for the jacket lining. He settled on five colors: sandy green, turquoise, dark blue, off-white, and gold, and saved the initial design as “Nile Pattern_V1.” After the foot soak, he dried off and relaxed his whole body.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online social engagement and customer group maintenance.
description: Leaning against the headboard, he replied to customer inquiries about spring clothing, sent today's spring clothing display photos in the customer group with the caption “The weather will be better on the weekend, welcome to try them on,” and received likes. Afterwards, in the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group, he responded to Zhang Wei's badminton invitation and shared the fun story of unboxing blind boxes with Qian Duoduo.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Free reading and inspirational browsing.
description: After changing into pajamas, I leafed through the traffic flow planning chapter of 'The Offline Store Display Bible,' then searched on my phone for reference images and videos of mountain-style outdoor experience areas on Xiaohongshu, and saved two arrangement examples for reference.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and getting ready for bed.
description: In the bathroom, I washed my face carefully and applied moisturizing lotion. Back in the bedroom, I placed tomorrow's T-shirt and sweatpants on the back of a chair, put my phone on silent, turned off the bedside lamp, and got ready to sleep.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: After lying down, I reviewed the day: I had kept my promise of a fat-reduction dinner, adopted Qian Duoduo's advice, talked through the transformation direction with my father, and the design sketch had begun to take shape. With a sense of reassurance, I gradually fell asleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and preparation
description: At 5:30 in the morning, the phone alarm went off on time, and Lei Mingxuan quickly got up. He washed up quickly, changed into a thick hardshell jacket and cargo pants, and got ready to leave. His mother had already prepared plain congee and fried eggs. He ate a few bites in a hurry, stuffed a carton of milk and soda crackers into his backpack, and also brought a lightweight down jacket to cope with Hangzhou's changeable weather.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Metro commute to Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station
description: At 5:45, Lei Mingxuan walked about 5 minutes to Yuanshen Road Metro Station, swiped his card to enter, and took Line 2 bound for Hongqiao at 6:00. There were not many passengers in the carriage. He sat down in a corner, took out his phone to reconfirm the gate information for train G7332, and thought about the key points for today's negotiation.
location: From Yuanshen Road Metro Station (Line 14), Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station (Metro Line 2).

name: Breakfast at Hongqiao Railway Station and high-speed rail boarding
description: After arriving at Shanghai Hongqiao Station, Lei Mingxuan bought a triangular rice ball and a cup of hot soy milk at FamilyMart, and quickly ate them in a corner of the waiting hall. He then followed the guide board to Gate B12, scanned his ID card to enter, and boarded train G7332 on time.
location: Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station, 1500 Shengui Road, Minhang District, Shanghai

name: Work and rest on the high-speed train
description: The train departed on schedule, and Lei Mingxuan took a window seat and stowed his backpack. He took out his tablet, reviewed fabric test data and design sketches, and, combined with patterns photographed at the exhibition in Egypt last week, wrote down ideas for modifying the jacket lining and the inner pocket zipper in his notes app. After finishing, he put on earphones, listened to a podcast, and rested with his eyes closed for about an hour.
location: G7332 high-speed train, Shanghai Hongqiao Station to Hangzhou East Station

name: Arrived at Hangzhou East Railway Station and took a taxi.
description: The train arrived at Hangzhou East Railway Station on time at 8:30. Lei Mingxuan followed the outbound crowd to the taxi waiting area at the West Square, entered the destination "Hangzhou Chunxian Garments Co., Ltd., Building 2, No. 6, Jiuhuan Road, Shangcheng District" into a ride-hailing app, and quickly got a ride. He took an Express car to Jiubao.
location: West Square, Hangzhou East Railway Station, No. 1 Tiancheng Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: On the way, had a phone call with supplier Zhou Tao.
description: In the taxi, Lei Mingxuan called supplier Zhou Tao to inform him that he was about to arrive. Zhou Tao responded warmly, saying he was already waiting in the sample room and mentioned that he was pleased with the new fabric. After hanging up, Lei Mingxuan scrolled through store photos on his phone, thinking about how to pair product selection with display.
location: In a taxi, traveling from Hangzhou East Railway Station to Jiuhuan Road, Shangcheng District

name: Product selection and negotiation with supplier Zhou Tao
description: Arriving at Hangzhou Chunxian Clothing Co., Ltd., Zhou Tao was already waiting at the door. The two went straight to the sample room, which was full of hardshell jackets, cargo pants, and functional vests. Lei Mingxuan carefully felt the fabrics, repeatedly tested the smoothness of the zippers, and had Zhou Tao put on a sample garment and perform a wide range of movements. In the end, they finalized four hardshell jackets (including a custom version incorporating an ancient Egyptian color scheme), three cargo pants with multiple pockets, and two outdoor vests. They calculated in detail the fabric weight, accessory brands (requiring all YKK zippers), and the minimum order quantity. Zhou Tao promised to prioritize production and gave them a sample card of the newly developed lightweight windproof fabric.
location: Sample Room, Hangzhou Chunxian Garments Co., Ltd., Building 2, No. 6 Jiuhuan Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Working lunch with Zhou Tao
description: At noon, Zhou Tao took Lei Mingxuan to his usual Luji Noodle Restaurant (Old Hanghai Road Branch). The two ordered the signature tofu fish head and soy-sauce duck. While eating, they talked about recent trends in the outdoor market. Zhou Tao mentioned that last year's "lightweight camping" series had received a good market response. Lei Mingxuan gained a lot of inspiration for product selection and matching, and noted the key points in his phone memo.
location: Lu Ji Noodle Restaurant (Lao Hanghai Road Branch), Lao Hanghai Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Took a taxi to Xihu District
description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan bid farewell to Zhou Tao and called a ride-hailing car at the entrance of the noodle shop, setting the destination to Tongpu Road in Xihu District. Leaning against the car window, he watched the streetscape and planned his route for visiting shops in the afternoon.
location: Taxi, from Lu Ji Noodle House, Old Hanghai Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, to Tongpu Road, Xihu District

name: Looking for equipment display inspiration at Bajiao Cup Coffee Shop
description: Arriving at Tongpu Road, Lei Mingxuan first walked into the trendy coffee shop ALAMB Octagonal Cup Coffee. He ordered an Ethiopian hand-drip, observed the barista's technique, and used his phone to photograph the counter layout and lighting design, drawing inspiration for the store's future “outdoor experience corner.”
location: ALAMB Octagonal Cup Coffee (Tongpu Road Branch), No. 19-1 Tongpu Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Visiting independent bookstores and design shops
description: After finishing his coffee, Lei Mingxuan strolled leisurely around Tongpu Road. He walked into One Way Space Bookstore, flipped through outdoor photography albums, found multiple color schemes for outdoor gear, and photographed them. Then he entered a designer select shop, where he found an unusual pour-over coffee server and planned to use it as a display prop. He also chatted with the shop owner and noted down the store's information.
location: Tongpu Road and surrounding area, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang (One-Way Space Bookstore, designer select shops, etc.)

name: Cycling to a dinner appointment
description: Near five o'clock, Lei Mingxuan received a message from his cousin Yang Fan, confirming dinner at a Japanese ramen shop on Wensan West Road. He scanned a shared bike and rode about 15 minutes to arrive at Wensan West Road.
location: Shared bike, riding from Tongpu Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou to Wensan West Road.

name: Had a ramen dinner with his cousin Yang Fan
description: When Lei Mingxuan arrived, Yang Fan was already waiting at the store entrance. They each ordered a bowl of the signature char siu tonkotsu ramen, plus Japanese fried dumplings and soda. During the meal, Yang Fan was very interested in the mountain-style transformation of his cousin's store, and proposed a simplified technical solution using “Xiaohongshu product recommendation copy + direct purchase via mini-program,” and recommended a useful WeChat store plugin. The two had a pleasant conversation and even took photos that they sent to the “Happy Family” family group, drawing likes from the elders.
location: A Japanese ramen shop on Wensan West Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Took a taxi to the hotel and checked in
description: After dinner, Yang Fan rode his electric bike home. Lei Mingxuan took a taxi to the pre-booked Yaqi Business Hotel (Qingtai Street Branch). In the car, he confirmed with the front desk that a room was available. After arriving, he checked in smoothly, got the room card, and carefully placed the samples, sample cards, and pour-over sharing kettle collected today on the table.
location: Taxi, from Wensan West Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, to Yaqi Business Hotel on Qingtai Street, Shangcheng District

name: Evening work organization and family video call
description: After boiling water, Lei Mingxuan began organizing the product selection notes from the day at Zhou Tao's factory, entering the selected fabric sample card information, design revision ideas, minimum order quantities, and unit prices into an Excel spreadsheet. Once finished, he video-called his parents to report that he was safe and share the day's results, reassuring them.
location: Room at Yaqi Business Hotel, Qingtai Street, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Relaxing with a Foot Soak and Planning the Itinerary
description: After hanging up, Lei Mingxuan took out a travel-size mugwort pack and soaked his feet in warm water to relieve the fatigue of a day of rushing around. While soaking his feet, he booked the earliest high-speed train ticket, G7349, returning to Shanghai around noon the next day on his phone, and added the same coffee beans he had seen at the café to his shopping cart to replenish supplies for his home-brewed coffee.
location: Room at Yaqi Business Hotel, Qingtai Street, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Organizing photos and online pre-promotion for new products
description: After soaking his feet, Lei Mingxuan imported today's photos of fabric details, the equipment store, and the coffee shop into his phone. He selected four close-up shots of the outerwear fabric and cargo pants details and sent them to the store's regular-customer WeChat group, with a caption previewing that new products would arrive soon. Several regular customers in the group expressed interest, and he replied to each of them.
location: Room at Yaqi Business Hotel, Qingtai Street, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Stretching and rest before bed.
description: Before going to sleep, Lei Mingxuan did a set of bedtime stretches on the bed, focusing on relaxing his legs and shoulders. Afterward, he turned off the lamp, reviewed the day's itinerary, felt satisfied with the pace and results, and gradually fell asleep looking forward to the return trip the next day.
location: Room at Yaqi Business Hotel, Qingtai Street, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Morning preparations and breakfast
description: After getting up in the hotel room, first weighed myself—82.1 kg—then washed my face with cold water. Went to the dining area for a light breakfast of white congee and a boiled egg. Afterward, returned to the room, wrapped the pour-over kettle and fabric sample cards in clothes, placed them in the suitcase, and checked the high-speed rail ticket info.
location: Yaqi Business Hotel (West Lake Qingtai Street Branch), Qingtai Street, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Check out and head to Hangzhou East Railway Station
description: After checking out, he hailed a ride on his phone and took a car to Hangzhou East Railway Station. On the way, he chatted with the Didi driver about Hangzhou traffic and weather. After about a 38-minute drive, he arrived at the departure level, spending over 40 yuan.
location: Hangzhou East Railway Station, No. 1 Tiancheng Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Waiting at Hangzhou East Railway Station and social media operations.
description: Swiped ID card to enter the waiting hall, found a seat and sat down. He liked the restaurant exploration photos from last night's Hangzhou Moments post, sent a voice message in the core customer group previewing new products, and chatted privately with an old customer inquiring about a shell jacket, agreeing on a weekend fitting.
location: Waiting hall, Hangzhou East Railway Station, No. 1 Tiancheng Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Took the G7349 high-speed train back to Shanghai.
description: On time, passed through the ticket check and boarded, found an aisle seat. First used the phone's memo app to organize the social media traffic ideas Yang Fan had mentioned, then scrolled through Xiaohongshu to save several outfit and color scheme ideas from outdoor bloggers, and finally put on earphones, listened to a podcast, and dozed off for about half an hour.
location: Train G7349 (Hangzhou East Railway Station to Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station)

name: Lunch at Shanghai Hongqiao Station
description: After the high-speed train arrived at Hongqiao Station on time, he ordered a white-cut chicken rice set meal at a Chinese fast-food restaurant on the departure level inside the station, specifically requesting less oil and less salt, and ate only half the rice. While eating, he also browsed the travel backpacks in the store.
location: A Chinese fast-food restaurant on the departure level of Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station, 1500 Shengui Road, Minhang District, Shanghai

name: Take a taxi back to the Super Brand Mall store.
description: Took a taxi directly from Hongqiao Station to Super Brand Mall. On the way, I used my phone to tell my cousin Shen Jie that I had returned to Shanghai. Due to light traffic congestion, the trip took 61 minutes, the fare was about 75 yuan, and I arrived at the taxi drop-off area on B1 of the mall.
location: Taxi drop-off area, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Unboxing, organizing samples, and taking photos.
description: After arriving at the store, he turned on the air conditioning and lighting system, took out the four shell jackets and cargo pants brought back from Hangzhou, and used a handheld garment steamer to iron out creases one by one. After carefully checking the stitching and zipper waterproof strips and confirming the quality was flawless, he did multi-angle styled shoots pairing the khaki shell jacket with black cargo pants, taking overall look photos and close-up detail shots.
location: Inside the store at Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Finalize the new product launch plan and the WeChat Moments warm-up
description: He imported the sample photos into his computer, made simple brightness adjustments to preserve the real texture, and confirmed the price ranges for the Friday launch: 799-999 yuan for waterproof jackets and 399-499 yuan for cargo pants. He wrote a WeChat Moments post with the caption 'Back from stocking up in Hangzhou, items are now on display...' and published it with a nine-grid photo layout. He quickly received several likes and inquiries.
location: Inside the store at Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Discuss products over the phone with cousin Shen Jie
description: Shortly after posting on Moments, his cousin Shen Jie sent a WeChat message. He called her back immediately, sent her photos of the four jacket styles, and discussed the pricing. Shen Jie thought the military green style could be paired with an earth-tone belt to make it more fashionable. He noted the suggestion in his memo and planned to implement it later.
location: Inside the store at Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mall competitor research
description: Taking advantage of the lighter afternoon foot traffic, he went downstairs to the B1 outdoor multi-brand store and sports brand area to do research. He touched the fabric textures of several competing hardshell jackets, looked through price tags, then went upstairs to the streetwear stores to observe window displays, and photographed styling details worth referencing with his phone, providing material for adjusting his own display.
location: B1 and other floors of Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Light dinner at the mall
description: At a light meal restaurant on the B1 floor, he ordered a salmon and avocado salad and a glass of freshly squeezed juice. It was light and filling, and while dining, he organized the key points from the research he had just done into the notes app on his phone.
location: A light-fare restaurant on B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Return to the store to organize work and search for online materials.
description: After returning to the store, I filed the sample photos and competitor research images taken that day into the 'February New Arrivals' folder, opened the computer, and based on the pricing and Shen Jie's suggestions, began building the copy framework for the listing detail pages. Then I searched Xiaohongshu for 'outdoor experience area layout' cases and saved them, preparing for the later discussion with Qian Duoduo.
location: Inside the store at Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closed the store, returned to Shanggang Community, and helped a neighbor
description: At 19:45, he closed the store on time and rode his e-bike about 10 minutes back to Shanggang Residences. At the entrance, he ran into Auntie Zhu Xiuying carrying several heavy shopping bags. He stepped forward to take the heaviest bag for her, and as they walked he chatted with her. He learned that Auntie Zhu had made her own red-bean paste qingtuan, and she warmly gave him a box to bring to his parents. He walked her all the way to the elevator before heading home.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sharing Hangzhou experiences with parents over dinner
description: After arriving home, his mother had left steamed sea bass and blanched choy sum for him. In the dining room, while eating dinner and flipping through photos on his phone, he animatedly told his parents about the Hangzhou trip—discussing business with Zhou Tao, visiting OWSPACE, and getting advice from Yang Fan. His father nodded and advised him to be steady in his steps, while his mother asked whether he had been eating meals on time while away. The family was warm and happy.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening exercise and relaxing foot soak
description: After dinner, helped clear the table and wash the dishes, then laid out a yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of stretching and several sets of planks. This noticeably relieved the lower back soreness from days of visiting markets. Afterwards, went to the bathroom and soaked his feet in hot water with a mugwort pack for 20 minutes, feeling completely refreshed.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handling mobile phone matters before bed and going to sleep
description: He leaned against the bed in the bedroom and replied one by one to comments on WeChat Moments and customers' size inquiries. Then he scrolled through Xiaohongshu, saved screenshots of outdoor experience area decoration cases he liked, set the alarm for 8 a.m. the next day, applied some face cream, turned off the light at 22:45, adjusted his sleeping position, and quickly fell asleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off, and Mingxuan stayed in bed for five minutes. Outside the window, the sky was gray, rainy weather. He put on loungewear, washed his face and did his skincare routine, and heard the sound of his mother busy in the kitchen.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Breakfast and family interaction
description: Mother Wang Xiuying made Mingxuan's favorite small wontons with fresh pork filling and fried eggs. Mingxuan talked about what he had seen and heard in Hangzhou while eating, saying the new products would be on shelves Friday. His mother was happy to hear it and reminded him to take care of himself. Mingxuan cleared away the dishes and chopsticks on his own.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pour-over coffee
description: After changing clothes, Mingxuan made himself a cup of pour-over coffee in the living room. Smelling the aroma of the coffee, he felt completely awake; this was his ritual for starting the day's work.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commuting to the store
description: Mingxuan put on an olive green tactical vest and windproof shell jacket, put on a helmet, and rode his e-bike from home in the light rain. About 15 minutes later, he arrived at Super Brand Mall and entered through the staff entrance.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Opening the store and organizing samples
description: Mingxuan opened the store door and the lighting control system, took out the sample windbreaker and cargo pants he had brought back from Hangzhou last night, carefully ironed them with the garment steamer, hung them in the "New Arrivals" section, and meticulously adjusted the outfit on the mannequin.
location: Inside the store at Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Trained store clerk Xiao Lin.
description: Xiao Lin arrived at the shop on time. Mingxuan took him to the new arrivals area and explained everything item by item, from fabric and fit to styling scenarios. He had Xiao Lin try on the army-green outdoor jacket and introduced it in the tone of attending to a customer. Xiao Lin took the initiative to suggest shooting a few short videos and posting them on Xiaohongshu and Douyin as a teaser. Mingxuan thought it was a good idea and let him improvise.
location: Inside the store at Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Handling online work tasks
description: After the training, Mingxuan took out his phone to reply to messages. First, he sent a voice message to the regular customer Qian Duoduo, inviting her to come see the display renovation on the weekend. Then he urged the fabric supplier Zhou Tao: "Brother Tao, please make sure to get that batch of fabric shipped out by the end of the month; the deposit has been paid."
location: Inside the store at Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Lunch and inspiration gathering
description: Mingxuan asked Xiao Lin to watch the store, and he walked through the Lujiazui skyway to Menya Musashi in the basement of IFC. He ordered the signature black garlic ramen with a rich broth. As he ate, he scrolled through new outdoor brand looks on his phone for inspiration.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant, B1 floor, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Data Analysis and Visual Merchandising
description: Back at the store, Mingxuan opened Excel and exported the sales report for the first two weeks of February. He found that winter clothes sold quickly but had low gross margins, while inquiries about small accessories such as outdoor waist bags that complement shell jackets rose noticeably. He opened Procreate, referred to a Japanese 'mountain-style camping' lookbook image, and drew a display sketch using old wooden crates, artificial plants, and climbing rope.
location: Inside the store at Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Treasure hunt in the mall to find accessories.
description: Struck by inspiration, Mingxuan asked Xiao Lin to watch the store while he wandered around the sports floor and trendy general store in the mall. He paid attention to the materials and colors of backpacks, belts, and hats, and liked several earth-tone metal-buckle belts. He took photos of them, planning to use them as candidates for next week's purchasing.
location: Inside Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Playing basketball with friends
description: When it was about time, Mingxuan rode his e-bike to Yuanshen Sports Center. Xie Fei and the others had already started playing, and as soon as he got on the court he took off his jacket and joined in. Running, passing, shooting — his touch was good today; he sank a few three-pointers, worked up a good sweat, and felt great.
location: Basketball Court, Yuanshen Sports Center, 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Bought fruit at the market
description: After exercising, I washed my face, then detoured on my bike to Pushang Vegetable Market. At the fruit stall, I picked out a few fresh, juicy tangerines, planning to eat them with my parents in the evening.
location: Pushang Market on Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Returned home to bathe and rest
description: After getting home, I put the fruit in the fridge, then took a shower in the bathroom to wash off the smell of sweat. After changing into loose sweatpants and a T-shirt, I felt completely relaxed.
location: Home, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Family dinner
description: His mother Wang Xiuying made the steamed sea bass and blanched choy sum that Mingxuan had ordered, and thoughtfully reduced the portions, smiling, “Aren’t you trying to lose fat?” Mingxuan sincerely praised his mother's cooking. During the meal, he proactively shared the results of the Hangzhou business trip and how Xiao Lin's training had gone that day; his father Ming Jianguo nodded repeatedly as he listened.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family binge-watching time.
description: After dinner, Mingxuan took the initiative to wash the dishes and cut up the tangerine. His father switched to the spy drama he had been following. Mingxuan sat on the carpet to watch with him. When the plot got tense, his mother, as expected, started again: "You're almost 32. Xiaolin is even younger than you. Do you have a girlfriend or not? Take it seriously!" Mingxuan felt a bit annoyed, but he restrained himself and said, "Mom, my store just got on the right track. I have to stock all the new products this month. How can I have the time? Let's talk about it in the summer." His mother looked displeased after hearing that.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Mended ties with his mother.
description: Seeing that his mother was unhappy, Mingxuan felt a little guilty too. As soon as the episode ended, he took the initiative to sit beside her, peeled a tangerine and handed it to her: "Mom, have some fruit. I was rude just now. I know you mean well for me. I have this under control. Can you let me get the store in order first?" His mother took the orange and her expression softened. His father helped smooth things over beside them.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Foot-soaking relaxation and inspiration gathering
description: After returning to his room, Mingxuan took out the foot bath bucket and added hot water and a mugwort pack. Soaking his feet relieved much of the day's fatigue. He scrolled through Xiaohongshu, following mountain-style outfit and display bloggers, and saved many outfit and prop styling photos as material for the weekend's display plan.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Pre-sleep preparation and group chat
description: After soaking his feet, Mingxuan did a few sets of planks and stretching. He went over tomorrow's tasks in his mind: confirming the details for Friday's new product launch and replying to a regular customer's fitting appointment. He picked up his phone and saw Zhang Wei organizing a weekend karaoke session in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat. He replied: 'I might need to change the store display on the weekend; let's plan after that!'
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Going to bed
description: Turned off the bedside lamp and closed his eyes. Although there was a small rift with his mother, seeing the lively chat in the group and the finished display plan on his phone made Mingxuan feel more secure about the store's next steps. Today was fulfilling, and he fell asleep with expectations for the future.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Wake-up and morning routine
description: Lei Mingxuan woke up to his alarm at 07:45, got up, and washed up. Stepping on the scale, he found he weighed 82.2 kg and felt he had overeaten the night before; he made a determined expression at the mirror to restrain himself. His mother, Wang Xiuzhen, had already prepared boiled eggs and multigrain porridge in the living room, and his father, Lei Jianguo, was watching the morning news. Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to greet his mother, easing yesterday's little friction, and the atmosphere at home was warm and harmonious.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pour-over coffee practice
description: While his parents were watching the news, Lei Mingxuan went into the study to practice pour-over coffee. Using a new sharing pitcher and thermometer, he brewed Ethiopian Hambela coffee beans at 90°C water temperature, with 15 g of coffee, a 1:15 water-to-coffee ratio, a 30-second bloom, and a total brew time of 2 minutes 15 seconds. The astringency in the finish was noticeably improved this time, and the acidity and sweetness were balanced. In a good mood, he noted the parameters in his notebook and wrote: clean finish, progress!
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing for and conducting the IP co-branding call
description: In his study, Lei Mingxuan turned on his tablet and organized the "IP Co-branding Plan" folder, which contained screenshots and style analysis images of Chinese-style games such as Xuan-Yuan Sword and GuJian, and listed the core questions. At exactly 9:00, he called his friend Liu Yang, who works at a Shenzhen game company, via WeChat voice, asking in detail about the external IP licensing process, licensing fee threshold (30,000–80,000 yuan), minimum order quantity, and design modification flexibility. Liu Yang agreed to submit an initial letter of interest to the copyright department next Monday. Lei Mingxuan recorded the entire call (having informed the other party), and quickly noted that the review cycle would be about one month and that store materials and a brand introduction would be required. The call ended at 9:45.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Record preliminary IP collaboration ideas
description: After hanging up the phone, Lei Mingxuan was struck by inspiration and used Procreate to create a mind map centered on "Xiafei Collection x Ancient-Style Game: Mountain Wilderness Swordsman." He planned the clothing elements (wuxia-style frog buttons, silk wrist guards, sword tassel ornaments), packaging design (bamboo-slip-style hang tags, paper bags foldable into sword-shaped cases), and promotional formats (short videos combining real store scenes with game CG, Xiaohongshu outfit notes on "ancient people time-traveling to modern mountain style"). He was very satisfied with the concept and felt he had found the next-stage breakout point for the brand.

Four new jackets and three cargo pants have arrived, with tough fabrics and Chinese-style details. See you tomorrow!” He attached photos and a blurry concept image of a “mountain trail scene.” Regular customers in the group liked and asked questions, and he replied to each one warmly.

Qian Duoduo arrived quickly, and Lei Mingxuan enthusiastically helped her try on two styles—military green and khaki—explaining the fabric and design in detail. She was very satisfied with the military green one but decided to wait until tomorrow to buy it once it was officially on the shelves, and she looked forward to the weekend's display renovation. After seeing Qian Duoduo off, Lei Mingxuan felt a strong sense of accomplishment.

Xiao Lin excitedly agreed over the phone.

He showed the sample photos on his phone and excitedly described his idea for a collaboration with an ancient-style game IP. Zhang Wei suggested using Xiaohongshu to promote it through a story-style post titled "If an ancient-style young swordsman came to buy mountain-style outfits", believing it would be more popular than plain product images. Lei Mingxuan confided that his mother had urged him to get married yesterday; Zhang Wei laughed and reassured him. At 20:45, they said goodbye at the entrance to the residential community and agreed to meet again on the weekend. Lei Mingxuan walked about 15 minutes and arrived home in the Shanggang Residential Community at 21:00.

I wet the filter paper with warm water, added the coffee grounds, and zeroed the scale. My hand trembled slightly when I first controlled the water flow, but I kept the stream even. During the bloom, the coffee bed swelled evenly. The brewing process took about 2 minutes 30 seconds, and the extracted liquid was quite dark in color. On tasting it, the acidity and bitterness intertwined, and the layering was noticeably better than with the previous basic equipment. I recorded the parameters in my notebook: water temperature 87°C, grind size on the finer side, brewing time 2 minutes 28 seconds.

After the run, he was drenched in sweat, sat on a bench to stretch, and recorded this difficult comeback in Keep. Then Lei Mingxuan took a selfie with the phone's front camera and posted a WeChat Moments entry visible only to himself: 2 km, 16 min 30 sec, fitness hit rock bottom, but this is the beginning of a comeback. He used this method to motivate himself and make the next cycle reminder more ritualistic.

Lei Mingxuan listened carefully, noting down the points like an apprentice. Then they went to the vegetable section, and his mother showed him how to pick tender greens (bright green leaves, thick and crisp stalks). He helped carry the basket, cracking jokes now and then, which made his mother laugh and scold him for being 'all talk.' The whole trip was relaxed and enjoyable; in the end, they bought ribs, winter melon, greens, and a few local side dishes.

His father, Old Lei, didn't go to play chess today and sat in the living room reading the newspaper, occasionally poking his head in to ask, "Is it ready yet?" After the soup had simmered in the clay pot for an hour, it was milky white in color and fragrant. At lunch, Lei Mingxuan drank two large bowls of soup, repeatedly praising his mother's cooking, and proactively made an agreement with his parents: "From now on, I'll go grocery shopping with you every weekend — consider it a fixed plan!" His parents exchanged smiles and said yes over and over.

Come to the World Plaza Billiards Hall next to my store, and I’ll show you what a professional referee can do!” University classmate Zhao Min sent a link to an “Arcade City” exhibition and asked if I wanted to go. I replied: “New spring arrivals come in next week; I’ll check after I’m done. This weekend works for me, let’s do it!” Qianqian sent a message: “Boss, do you have any new summer T-shirts? Want some oversized ones.” I replied: “A batch arrives Wednesday, with loose fits; I’ll set one aside for you when you come!” Once I had replied to everyone, my social circle was properly maintained.

On the way, he placed an order on the Meituan Paotui app, assigning a courier to go to Daming Optical in Sanye Glasses City on East Nanjing Road to pick up the pre-ordered reading glasses and deliver them directly to the community gatehouse. location: On the walking route from No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to No. 168, Lujiazui West Road.

name: Arrive at the store to tidy up and inspect materials.
description: After arriving at the store, he met with Xiao Lin and confirmed that yesterday's takings were correct. Then the logistics worker delivered the custom artificial turf and wood-grain background boards. They put on gloves and unpacked them with Xiao Lin, carefully checked the turf's pile density and the seams of the background boards, and confirmed there was no color difference or damage. He used the phone memo app to record the quantity and condition of the materials and took photos for records.
location: Lei Mingxuan Outdoor Equipment Store, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organizing the purchase order list
description: On the warehouse computer, he opened the product images and records of mountain-style clothing sent by Tao Ge from Hangzhou, and in an Excel spreadsheet filled in one by one the first batch of ordered styles (windbreaker jackets, workwear vests, multi-pocket cargo pants), colors (military green, sand, black-gray), and quantities of 50 pieces per size. He calculated the total cost at about 28,000 yuan and double-checked it repeatedly to make sure it was correct.
location: Warehouse of Lei Mingxuan Outdoor Equipment Store, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168, Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Finalized purchase order by phone
description: Contacted Zhou Tao of Hangzhou Taosheng Apparel via a WeChat call. After exchanging pleasantries, he got straight to the point, confirmed the order quantity and styles, and finalized the March 20 delivery date and 30% advance payment terms. The other party readily agreed and guaranteed shipment on time. After the call, he felt much more relieved.
location: Lei Mingxuan's outdoor equipment store counter, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Transferring the deposit and recording it in the ledger.
description: Open mobile banking and transfer the 8400 yuan deposit to Zhou Tao's company account. After the payment succeeds, take a screenshot, save the screenshot and order details in the dedicated album '[Purchasing] 2025', then take out the paper purchase ledger and neatly write on the March 6 page: 'Hangzhou Taosheng Apparel - mountain-style order deposit - 8400 yuan'.
location: Lei Mingxuan's outdoor equipment store counter, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning business operations and community plan refinement
description: While greeting the occasional customer, he refined the WeChat community operation plan in his phone memo, opening with the slogan "Mingxuan Outdoor Gear Depot — not just selling clothes, but sharing a lifestyle attitude." He planned the "Wednesday Styling Lab" for sharing practical mountain-style outfit tips and the "Friday Gear Insider Sale" flash events, then sent the draft to his college classmate Zhao Min for feedback.
location: Lei Mingxuan Outdoor Equipment Store, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and information intake
description: Had Xiao Lin watch the store, went downstairs alone to Shaxian Snacks on the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall, ordered steamed dumplings and duck leg rice, scrolled through WeChat Moments while eating to check on competitors' updates, browsed a few outdoor brands' official accounts to learn about trends, and replied to Qian Duoduo in the group chat, agreeing to meet at the store after 3 p.m. Friday to see the new styles.
location: Shaxian Snacks, basement level 1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon business operations and new product preparation
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic was steady. While receiving customers, he prepared for Qian Duoduo's visit the next day. He selected the featured mountain-style jackets and workwear vests from the warehouse, carefully ironed them with a steam iron, and matched them with pants and accessories to create 'urban commuter' and 'outdoor techwear' looks. He hung them on the racks in the main feature area in the center of the store, and placed accessories such as tactical belts and multi-function sling bags on the display table.
location: Lei Mingxuan Outdoor Equipment Store, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Coffee time and poster sketch.
description: While the store was quiet, he went to Starbucks on the first floor of Super Brand Mall, bought a tall hot Americano, and sat by the window, using his tablet to open Canva to design a community promotional poster. He selected the store's mountain-style outfit sample photos, placed the slogan in bold in the center, added the group QR code and the guiding text “Wednesday Style Lab: First Episode Preview,” and quickly completed a rough draft of the poster.
location: Starbucks Coffee, 1st Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening peak business and community promotion
description: During the evening rush, mall foot traffic increased. Standing energetically at the store entrance, I proactively greeted young people interested in mountain style and enthusiastically introduced the merits of the freshly ironed new jackets. When I ran into a regular customer, I took the chance to invite her to scan a QR code to join the community group. She readily agreed. While adding each other as friends, I was already planning another warm-up post on WeChat Moments for later.
location: Lei Mingxuan Outdoor Equipment Store, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Confirm the weekend coffee date
description: He received a poster from college classmate Zhao Min for a specialty coffee tasting event (Saturday, March 8 at 2 p.m., fee 80 yuan). Remembering their previously unconfirmed meeting, he immediately replied that he would attend, transferred 80 yuan, and also asked her whether she would come to the store tomorrow at 3 p.m. when Qian Duoduo was visiting, to help give her opinion.
location: Lei Mingxuan Outdoor Equipment Store, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reconciled the accounts and closed the store
description: After the evening rush, I checked the day's business revenue with Xiao Lin, handled online orders, and packed the packages to be sent the next day. After confirming the accounts were correct, I let Xiao Lin leave first. Then I carefully checked the power, pulled down the rolling shutter door, and locked up the shop.
location: Lei Mingxuan Outdoor Equipment Store, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go home for dinner with family
description: Walked back home on Pudong Avenue. As soon as I entered, I smelled the aroma of braised pork. At the dinner table, I enthusiastically told my parents about the day's material inspection and community plans. My father praised my drive, and my mother served me food and told me not to be too tired. The three of us had a relaxed and pleasant dinner together.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation and hobby time
description: Changed into pajamas, brewed a pot of tea, soaked his feet in hot water, and opened the tablet to watch two episodes of the new anime "Frieren: Beyond Journey's End." Then, out of habit, browsed the new blind box release calendar on Pop Mart's official mini program.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Yoga stretching and washing up.
description: After soaking my feet, I felt a bit stiff. I spread a yoga mat in the living room and did 20 minutes of gentle yoga, focusing on stretching my shoulders, neck, and back to relieve the day's fatigue. After working up a light sweat, I went to the bathroom to wash up and get ready for bed.
location: Living room and bathroom at home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep planning, reading, and falling asleep
description: Leaning against the headboard, I listed the next day's to-dos in my phone's memo: 1. Qian Duoduo will come to the store to see new products at 3 p.m.; 2. Finalize the community poster and send it to the advertising agency for graphic design; 3. Confirm the specific location and time of Saturday's coffee tasting event. Then I read about half an hour of *1587, A Year of No Significance*, put down the book at 22:30, turned off the light, and fell asleep with satisfaction and anticipation.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast
description: The phone alarm went off on time. Lei Mingxuan got up and washed up. His mother Wang Xiuying had prepared pan-fried pork buns and hot soy milk, and his father Lei Jianguo was watching the morning news. Lei Mingxuan chatted with his mother while eating breakfast. She brought up the weekend blind date, but he brushed it off by saying that tomorrow there was a coffee tasting event and some female participants would be there. After eating, he put the dishes into the kitchen sink.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling commute and industry podcast
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into a black hoodie and cargo pants, put on a backpack, earphones, and a sports watch, unlocked a shared bike with his phone, and rode along Zhangyang Road toward Lujiazui. On the way, he listened to the trendy podcast "The Layering Rules of Urban Outdoor Style" and noted key points about color schemes and fabric matching.
location: On a bike ride from Zhangyang Road to Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Arriving at the store to prepare and inspect materials
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at Super Brand Mall and entered Unit A-208 on the second floor through the staff entrance. He turned on the computer and the cash register system, and moved the 'Spring New Arrivals' standee to the door. Then he went to the mall's courier point and brought back two boxes of display materials. He opened them with a utility knife and checked the material and dimensions of the acrylic shelf, custom hangers, and new posters, confirming they were all correct.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations and initial display adjustments.
description: Lei Mingxuan started the store operations work, moved the mannequin against the wall to the central island position, and used a tape measure to measure the wall dimensions to plan the installation points for new shelving. During this time, property manager Zheng Kai came by and reminded him about the mall fire drill next weekend. Returning customer Qian Duoduo (24 years old, internet operations) came to pick up her reserved outdoor jacket. Lei Mingxuan chatted with her about the popularity of the "mountain style" aesthetic, learned that her friends had started wearing pocket cargo pants, and gained display inspiration.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and activity arrangements
description: After locking up the store, Lei Mingxuan walked to the Japanese ramen restaurant on B1 of the IFC Mall and ordered a tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While eating, he observed the outfits of the diners around him, then went to the windows of several streetwear multi-brand stores and outdoor brands to study display color schemes and mannequin styling, taking photos on his phone for reference. Afterwards, in the rest area, he contacted his college classmate Zhao Min to confirm the coffee tasting session tomorrow afternoon from 3 to 5, with 10 people. Zhao Min suggested a "coffee + fashion" crossover event, and Lei Mingxuan noted it in his memo and marked "bring business cards."
location: B1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In-store display renovation and physical labor
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to the store, changed into a spare T-shirt, and officially began the display makeover. He labored to move several heavy wooden mannequins to new positions, used a level to adjust the height of the metal shelves, and refolded and rehung clothes by color scheme. It went on for more than an hour; drenched in sweat, he felt satisfied looking at the new layout.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Client follow-up and brainstorming
description: Lei Mingxuan brewed a cup of drip-bag coffee to take a break and posted a preview of the display rearrangement on Moments in his private community. Feng Xiaoyu, a regular customer (35, white-collar worker at a foreign company), brought a friend into the store and said she liked the adjusted sense of space. Lei Mingxuan received them and helped them try on new spring hoodies. During the chat, he learned that they planned to go to an outdoor market on the weekend; inspired, he added “weekend market” to the store’s backup options for expansion.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handling online orders and packaging
description: After seeing off Feng Xiaoyu, Lei Mingxuan turned on his computer to handle online platform orders. After confirming that the shipping addresses were correct, he printed the waybills. He took out the corresponding items from the warehouse, carefully checked sizes and defects, packed and sealed them after verification, packed 5 parcels in total, and stacked them neatly at the shop entrance.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store daily closing and commute preparation
description: Lei Mingxuan swept the shop floor, tidied the hangers in the fitting room, checked and replied to unread messages, counted the cash at the register and recorded it in the accounts, locked the shop door, put on his backpack and picked up two small express packages, ready to leave work.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Delivered express packages and did shopping on the way.
description: Lei Mingxuan walked to the storage lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station and put the courier packages from online orders into the express locker. He then walked home along Zhangyang Road, stopping at Yanqin Grocery Store to buy a large bottle of mineral water, a quick-dry towel, and a sports drink.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (on the way, via the locker at Lujiazui Metro Station)

name: Walk home and change clothes.
description: Lei Mingxuan walked about 10 minutes from Yanqin Grocery Store to home, changed into loose sweatpants and casual shoes, and organized the items he had purchased.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: At dinner, mother Wang Xiuying prepared braised pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato egg drop soup. The family of three ate while watching the TV news. Lei Mingxuan shared the store's progress and plans for a coffee tasting event, and his father expressed support.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Heading to the billiards hall
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into a clean quick-dry T-shirt and a trendy branded jacket, took his pool cue bag, said goodbye to his parents, and rode a shared bike to World Plaza Pool Hall.
location: While cycling from Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to World Plaza, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Playing billiards with friends
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at the billiards hall on B1 of World Plaza, where his friends Han Dong and Qin Lang were already waiting. The three played American eight-ball, and Lei Mingxuan drew cheers with a jump shot on his opening shot. During a break, he shared his experience getting an amateur billiards referee certificate the previous weekend, mentioning the professional players and quirky rules featured in the training. Qin Lang also talked about his designer toy collection and next week's limited-time designer toy exhibition, and they agreed to go together.
location: World Square Billiards Hall, B1, World Square, No. 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return trip and convenience store shopping.
description: Returning home after a satisfying time, Lei Mingxuan walked back and bought fresh milk at the FamilyMart convenience store at the entrance of the residential complex. After getting home, he prepared to soak his feet.
location: FamilyMart near Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening foot soak and family chat.
description: Lei Mingxuan heated water to soak his feet, relieving fatigue. While soaking, he watched an episode of a new anime on his phone and browsed Pop Mart blind boxes in his Taobao favorites without placing an order. Afterwards, he went to the living room and saw his mother reading. He shared with her the trend elements he had seen at IFC and Zhao Min's coffee collaboration idea. His mother reminded him to pay attention to etiquette at tomorrow's tasting event and to bring a gift.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (bathroom and living room)

name: Evening preparation and sleep.
description: Lei Mingxuan set the alarm for 07:30 the next day, turned on the bedside lamp, ended a fulfilling day in quiet peace, and quickly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Building 12, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up, morning routine, and family breakfast.
description: Woke up at exactly 7:30 a.m., feeling refreshed. After a quick wash, did a 10-minute stretch in the living room to wake up the body. Mother had prepared pan-fried buns and soy milk; while eating, chatted with father about today's billiards training schedule, in a relaxed atmosphere. Before going out, reminded mother that I would cook tonight, so she didn't need to prepare dinner.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Biking to Yuanshen Sports Center
description: Put on a sports jacket and helmet, rode the electric scooter from home along Pudong Avenue and Zhangyang Road. The morning breeze was pleasant. Reached Yuanshen Sports Center after about 25 minutes, parked in the non-motorized vehicle parking area, and locked it.
location: Along the route from Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to No. 1458 Zhangyang Road

name: Attend the billiards referee training course
description: Entered the classroom on the second floor of the billiards hall at Yuanshen Sports Center, signed in, and attended the second week of the billiards referee training course, themed "Analysis of Controversial Cases". The instructor played match videos, and the group discussed the basis for rulings. He found his judgment on borderline calls was not precise enough, took careful notes, and consulted the instructor about two specific cases during the break. He ended the group discussion early around 11:45, explained the situation, and picked up this week's self-study materials and the link for the online course homework.
location: Billiards hall, 2nd floor, Yuanshen Sports Center, 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handle the outstanding purchase payment and call the supplier.
description: After the class ended, I didn't go straight to lunch. Instead, I sat down on a bench in the little garden at Yuanshen Sports Center. I opened the mobile banking app and paid the supplier Zhou Tao the 3500 yuan final payment for the spring new-season purchase, then sent him a screenshot to confirm. After that, I called Zhou Tao; we confirmed the payment had arrived and agreed that he would send the shipping order number for the supplementary order next Monday.
location: The small garden at Yuanshen Sports Center, 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lanzhou beef noodle lunch and confirmation of the tasting event itinerary
description: I rode my e-bike to the Lanzhou beef noodle restaurant near Yuanshen Road, ordered a bowl of extra-thin pulled noodles and a side dish. While eating, I sent a voice message on WeChat to my college classmate Zhao Min, telling her the training was over and to meet at "Bean Dance" at 1:30 PM. Zhao Min replied to confirm. Lunch was taken care of.
location: China Lanzhou Beef Noodles (Yuanshen Road Branch), Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling to the "Bean Dance" café
description: Starting from Yuanshen Road, rode the electric scooter along Zhangyang Road and arrived at the “Bean Dance” cafe at the entrance of the alley in less than 10 minutes. Parked the scooter on the non-motor vehicle rack nearby, confirmed the small sign at the door, and felt satisfied with the cafe's quiet atmosphere.
location: Along the route from Yuanshen Road to No. 3, Lane 1550, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Immersive specialty coffee tasting experience
description: I saw Zhao Min already waiting by the bar. After checking in, I received a tasting cup and a scoring sheet. The barista Xiao Ma was gentle and courteous. He first demonstrated pour-over brewing, then served five coffees in turn: Ethiopia, Costa Rica, Colombia, Brazil, and Guatemala. With Zhao Min's help, I learned to taste by slurping and took notes like "citrus, tea, nuts, caramel finish". I felt like a whole new world had opened up—coffee could be so varied in flavor.
location: Douwu Coffee, No. 3, Lane 1550, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ask the barista about pour-over coffee equipment and add each other on WeChat.
description: During the free-exchange portion of the tasting event, I took the initiative to ask Xiao Ma for beginner pour-over equipment recommendations. Xiao Ma enthusiastically introduced the Hario V60 dripper and the Timemore Chestnut C grinder, shared short brewing videos, and explained how water temperature affects flavor. We hit it off, and Xiao Ma praised my talent in bar-side tasting, so we added each other on WeChat with the note set to Bean Dance Coffee Barista Xiao Ma.
location: Bar counter of Douwu Cafe, No. 3, Lane 1550, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shared insights with Zhao Min and said goodbye.
description: After the event, she walked out of the café side by side with Zhao Min and chatted for another ten minutes at the door. She remarked that she used to think coffee was just bitter water, but today she realized it was a treasure. Zhao Min told her that Xiao Ma had a good reputation and she could ask him for advice, and they agreed that next time Zhao Min would take her to the utensil shop on Xiangyang South Road. She thanked Zhao Min for the introduction and they parted happily.
location: At the entrance of Douwu Coffee, No. 3, Lane 1550 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk to Pushang Vegetable Market
description: After parting ways with Zhao Min, I walked to Pushang Wet Market as planned. According to the navigation, the walk would take about 15 minutes. I enjoyed the street views along the way and savored the leisurely Saturday afternoon.
location: Along Zhangyang Road Lane 1550, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Dongchang Road

name: Bought seasonal vegetables and festive flowers at the market.
description: Walked into the Pushang Vegetable Market, picked a fresh sea bass and asked the vendor to clean it, bought tender asparagus that his mother loves and garlic scapes that his father likes. Seeing the small flower stall, he remembered that today was Women's Day, so he spent 50 yuan on a bouquet of light purple forget-me-nots, planning to surprise his mother.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk home
description: Carrying vegetables in his left hand and holding flowers in his right, he walked about 15 minutes following the navigation and arrived home at Lane 136, Pudong Avenue. The smell of cooking from each household drifted through the stairwell, and he felt a strong sense of reassurance.
location: Along the route from Dongchang Road to No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Presenting flowers to his mother, his father announcing the good news, and preparing dinner
description: Upon entering, he handed his mother the forget-me-nots and wished her a happy Women's Day; she took the flowers in pleasant surprise. His father, Lei Jianguo, sitting in the living room reading the newspaper, smiled and announced that the housing subsidy from his former work unit had been approved at 28,000 yuan. He took out 10,000 yuan to put into the family travel fund to support the Western Sichuan road trip plan for the second half of the year. Overjoyed and surprised, he thanked them repeatedly. After going to his room to change into loungewear, he went to the kitchen to prepare dinner.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepared a holiday dinner for his mother
description: Hadn't cooked seriously in a long time, but I still have the fundamentals. Skillfully cleaned the sea bass and scored it, stuffed it with ginger slices and scallion segments, drizzled with steamed fish soy sauce, and put it in the steamer. While the fish was steaming, quickly prepped asparagus and garlic scapes, stir-frying them to keep the vegetables crisp, green, and sweet. Mother also prepared braised chicken wings and tomato egg drop soup.
location: Home kitchen at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family holiday dinner
description: Brought the steamed sea bass, stir-fried asparagus, and stir-fried pork with garlic scapes to the table, along with the braised chicken wings and tomato egg soup Mother had made, and the family of three sat around the table. Raised drinks to toast Mother for the holiday and let her have the first bite of fish. Mother praised the cooking, and Father said it was lighter and less greasy than Mother's stir-fry. While eating, they shared stories from the coffee tasting event, and the atmosphere was warm and cozy.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-dinner cleanup and keeping my parents company.
description: Took the initiative to clear the table and let my tired mother rest. Watched the rerun of "News Broadcast" with my father and listened to him talk about retired employees' benefits. Meanwhile, my mother put forget-me-nots in a small glass bottle to decorate the living room.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Learned about pour-over coffee online from a barista.
description: Back in the bedroom, he saw that Xiao Ma had accepted the friend request. He sent a message to thank him and ask about things to note regarding accessories for the recommended equipment. Xiao Ma replied that the filter paper needs to be V60-specific, the C2 grinder is good enough, and shared three short brewing tutorial videos. He watched the videos carefully and noted key data in his phone's notepad: water temperature 92°C, coffee-to-water ratio 1:15, and a 30-second bloom, then finalized the purchase list for next week.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxed with a foot soak while browsing coffee bean knowledge.
description: Prepared hot water, added a mugwort foot-soaking bag, and comfortably leaned against the headboard to soak my feet while browsing the coffee bean knowledge shared by Xiao Ma in his Moments. I read a popular science article about the relationship between roast level and flavor and found it very interesting.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: After soaking my feet, brushing my teeth, and washing my face, I got into bed and said goodnight to my parents. I opened my phone, set a 30-minute timer on Pomodoro Todo, and started re-reading the first page of the e-book The Science of Water in Coffee. At 23:15, I turned off my phone, savoring the tender sea bass, the fruity aroma of the coffee, and my father's surprise, and fell asleep to the sound of the wind outside the window.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning activation and getting ready to go out
description: When the morning alarm went off, Mingxuan quickly got up and prepared for the billiards referee practical assessment. In the living room, he did body-weight squats and push-ups to the music to activate his body. Then he washed up and encouraged himself in the mirror.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Simple family meal and casual chat
description: Mother had prepared breakfast: white congee, pan-fried dumplings, and pickled vegetables. Mingxuan ate quickly, chatted with his mother about the weather and sleep, and told her about today's billiards assessment.
location: Home kitchen at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk to the assessment venue
description: Mingxuan put on his earphones, listened to electronic music, walked out of the residential complex, headed west along Pudong Avenue, crossed Fushan Road, and walked about 20 minutes to Yuanshen Sports Center.
location: Pudong Avenue to Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Took part in the billiards referee training practical assessment (morning).
description: Mingxuan arrived at the billiards training hall at Yuanshen Sports Center, checked in, changed into a training vest, and took part in the simulated match refereeing assessment. He strictly followed the standard procedures for positioning, score calling, and foul judging, received scores and comments from the instructor, and noted suggestions about 'rest placement' and 'ball possession calls.'
location: Billiards Training Hall, Shanghai Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mid-assessment break and phone communication.
description: During a break in the assessment, Mingxuan drank some water and rested in the rest area. He sent a voice message to his friend Han Dong to confirm their meeting, then checked WeChat and handled an online store customer's inquiry about sizes.
location: Rest area, training hall, Shanghai Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk to the sparring spot
description: Mingxuan walked quickly out of Yuanshen Sports Center, headed south on Yuanshen Road, turned right onto Pudong South Road, and arrived at World Plaza after about a 10-minute walk.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai, from Yuanshen Road to Pudong South Road

name: Warm-up game of American eight-ball with Han Dong.
description: At the Gentleman's Billiard Hall on B1 of World Square, Mingxuan met up with Han Dong, and the two immediately played a game of American eight-ball as a warm-up. Mingxuan had good feel, potting consecutive balls on the break, while Han Dong was relaxed.
location: Gentleman Billiards Hall, B1, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and interest sharing, with a minor disagreement
description: After finishing the game, the two went to the Knight Burger shop downstairs for a quick meal. Mingxuan excitedly shared his experience at yesterday's coffee tasting, but Han Dong responded dismissively, saying, 'Only posers go to that.' The atmosphere instantly turned awkward. Mingxuan felt hurt inside and eventually changed the subject to the new billiard tables at the pool hall. Han Dong didn't notice his displeasure.
location: Knight Burger Restaurant, B1, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Brief rest and reflection.

He didn't smoke, but instead reflected on the conversation with Han Dong just now, feeling the disappointment and fatigue that came from the differences in perception between their interest circles.

Along the way, he replayed his conversation with Han Dong and mentally reviewed it, deciding not to proactively arrange a ball game for the time being and to give each other space.
