description: Mingxuan went to the kitchen to help his mother with the cooking. Later, his father Lei Jianguo came back, and the three of them discussed the 28,000 yuan housing subsidy that had arrived last week. Father wants to self-drive through western Sichuan after retirement; mother leans toward saving; Mingxuan supports father but suggests making a good plan.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Shanggang Residential Quarter, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner included braised pork belly, stir-fried asparagus, and tomato egg drop soup—all dishes Mingxuan loves. The family of three chatted while eating in a relaxed atmosphere, and the conversation turned to the spring new arrivals in Mingxuan's online store and amusing anecdotes from the neighborhood.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-dinner leisure and watching TV with Mom
description: After dinner, Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the dishes, then accompanied his mother in the living room watching a family drama, chatting about the plot and the characters' outfits, enjoying a relaxed time with his mother.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Asked a barista online for pour-over coffee techniques.
description: Mingxuan returned to the bedroom, contacted barista Xiao Ma, shared the assessment photos, and asked for specific pour-over coffee parameters. Xiao Ma answered in detail, and Mingxuan took careful notes. He then added the recommended entry-level hand-crank coffee grinder and drip filter cone to his Taobao shopping cart, but did not buy them immediately.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Soaking feet and browsing online communities.
description: Mingxuan soaked his feet in hot water to relax. At the same time, he scrolled through his phone, checked billiards group event updates, browsed new-product unboxings in the trendy toy community, and restrained his urge to shop.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading for knowledge and interest
description: After soaking his feet, Mingxuan leaned against the headboard, flipped through the Billiards Competition Rules Manual, reviewed the ambiguous rulings from today's assessment, and also read an article in Outdoor Adventure magazine about camping in Anji, Zhejiang, doing homework for a future road trip.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation and meditation.
description: Mingxuan turned off the overhead light, left only the bedside lamp on, put on an eye mask, meditated for a few minutes, cleared his mind, and drifted off to sleep peacefully.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning activities and determination to lose fat
description: At 6:50 a.m., he woke up naturally with the help of his phone alarm and biological clock, feeling full of energy. After doing simple stretches in bed, he completed 15 minutes of gentle Cat-Cow and Child's Pose on the yoga mat in the living room to relieve the stiffness in his neck and shoulders from the weekend billiards assessment. At breakfast, his mother Wang Xiuying prepared plain congee, pickled vegetables, and boiled eggs. During the meal, Mingxuan proactively shared the fat-loss knowledge he had learned from a podcast and announced that he would officially start losing fat from today, requesting less oil and salt. His mother expressed support and agreed to make light dishes for dinner. Mingxuan also checked the weather on his phone and confirmed that today would be cloudy turning sunny, 9-17°C, suitable for outdoor activities.
location: Shanggang Community (home), No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling commute and industry podcast
description: At the entrance of the residential community, he scanned a QR code to unlock a shared bike and rode west along Zhangyang Road, wearing Bluetooth earphones and listening to the podcast 'Apparel Entrepreneurship Insider', which was about 2025 spring/summer menswear trends and private-domain traffic tactics. While riding, he thought about how to integrate an emotional connection strategy into that day's community launch plan.
location: Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (cycling route from Shanggang Community to Super Brand Mall)

name: Store opening preparations and organizing new stock
description: After arriving at the store in Super Brand Mall, I cleaned up and turned on the lights with store assistant Xiao Lin. I used Canva to design and print a QR code standee with the store logo and the words 'Xiafei Ji Trendy Friends Club,' and placed it at the cashier counter and fitting room. I finalized three invitation scripts (humorous, benefits-based, and emotional), set up the group announcement and new-member welcome message, made Xiao Lin an admin, and tested the group features. Then I unpacked, steamed, and styled the new spring lightweight techwear jackets, Japanese-style cargo pants, and cotton-linen shirts that arrived over the weekend, hung them in a well-arranged way in the main display area, took nine detail shots and overall outfit photos, edited them with the Xingtu app and posted them to Moments with a spring filter, and selected 20 VIP customers with high private-domain activity as the first batch of invitees.
location: Xiafei Collection, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Client reception and community pre-warming
description: Individual customers kept coming in, and Mingxuan and Xiao Lin received them warmly. A guy who called himself A-Ray, a Xiaohongshu outfit blogger, was very interested in a Japanese-style utility vest. Mingxuan actively introduced the design and styling ideas and chatted with him, learning that he had about 5,000 followers and focused on men's everyday outfits. They exchanged contact info, and Mingxuan invited him to come take photos at the store later, offering venue and clothing support. While looking for a size for a regular customer, he took the opportunity to verbally promote the upcoming WeChat group, confirming regular customers' interest.
location: Xiafei Collection, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and competitor research in the business district.
description: Walked about 8.7 minutes to the Japanese ramen restaurant “Menya Musashi Tiger Cave” on LG1 of the IFC Mall and ordered the signature rich tonkotsu ramen (with ajitama egg and chashu). While waiting, he observed the newly opened mountain-style clothing store “Shanyin” next door, focusing on how it used raw wood and green plants to create an outdoor camping-style display, and took photos. After finishing lunch quickly, he also walked around ZARA and UNIQLO to compare the season's trending colors and fabrics as a reference for product selection.
location: The Menya Musashi Tiger Cave Japanese ramen restaurant on LG1 of IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, and the surrounding clothing stores.

name: Focused push on community invitations and order processing.
description: After returning to the store, he began sending personalized WeChat invitations one by one to the 20 preselected VIP customers according to the contact list. He started with greetings, then introduced the value of the community (weekly first picks of new arrivals, exclusive member discounts, styling consultant services), and finally attached the QR code, with a sincere and unobtrusive tone. Shortly after 2 p.m., a regular customer, “Qian Duoduo,” was the first to respond and joined the group. Mingxuan immediately sent a welcome message and a customized red envelope in the group, and then more than a dozen regular customers joined one after another. By 3:30 p.m., the community had 22 people, and Mingxuan seized the moment to mention that exclusive benefits would be announced that evening. Meanwhile, he handled inquiries for 3 online orders and packed the packages to be shipped. By 5 p.m., the group had reached 28 people, exceeding expectations.
location: Xiafei Collection, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing up and getting ready to leave work
description: Checked today's revenue and inventory with Xiao Lin, confirmed that the community group had reached 28 members, exceeding expectations. Shared a brief summary of store operations insights with Xiao Lin and arranged for her to keep the group active tomorrow. Counted the 3 packages to be shipped, took out my phone to check the availability of lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station, and confirmed an empty locker was available.
location: Xiafei Collection, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-work commute and package delivery
description: Taking the three packed parcels, walked to the basement level of Super Brand Mall, through underground Exit 5 directly to Lujiazui Metro Station (about 9.6 minutes on foot). In front of the Hive Box lockers in the station, skillfully entered the order number, scanned the code, and made the drop-off. After finishing, left the station, scanned a shared bike, and rode home.
location: Hive Box express locker inside Lujiazui Metro Station, No. 158 Huayuanshiqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Arriving home and family time
description: When he got home, his mother, Wang Xiuying, was preparing dinner in the kitchen. After changing clothes, Mingxuan took the initiative to go into the kitchen to help wash vegetables, and took the opportunity to formally ask to learn to cook light dishes, saying that he was starting his fat-loss plan from today. His father, Lei Jianguo, watching the news in the living room, also said a few words of encouragement after hearing this.
location: Shanggang Community (home), No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and fat-loss coaching
description: Dinner was a fat-loss meal specially prepared by mother: steamed sea bass, blanched okra, mushroom and greens, tomato egg drop soup, and multigrain rice. During the meal, Mingxuan explained in detail to his parents the principles of fat loss and his target of 1,600-1,800 kcal. While eating, his mother dictated the key steps for steaming fish and blanching vegetables (the fish should be placed on scallion and ginger to remove fishy smell; after water boils, steam on high heat for 8 minutes; blanch okra in water with salt and oil to keep it bright green), and Mingxuan recorded everything in his phone memo.
location: Shanggang Community (home), No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening health management and planning
description: After the meal, he took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes. Then he went back to his room and, using the information on the Boohee Health app, hand-wrote a one-week fat-loss menu: breakfast each day consisted of multigrain porridge/whole-wheat bread + eggs + milk; lunches were varied (Monday: chicken breast salad, Tuesday: steamed fish + multigrain rice, Wednesday: beef + broccoli, etc.); dinner was strictly limited to protein and vegetables, with daily intake not exceeding 1,800 kcal. He then took the menu to the kitchen, put it on the refrigerator door with a fridge magnet, and asked his parents, who were watching TV, to supervise him. Afterward, he went back to the bedroom, created a folder named Mingxuan's Diet Diary in his phone memo, recorded the ingredients and estimated calories of tonight's dinner (about 550 kcal), and did 15 minutes of mindfulness meditation to clear his mind and restore inner calm.
location: Shanggang Community (home), No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wind-down relaxation and planning for tomorrow
description: He followed the "Soothing Bedtime Yoga" session from Keep on the yoga mat in his bedroom, mainly doing Cow Face Pose to relax his shoulders and neck, Rocking Pose to relieve his lower back, and Legs-Up-the-Wall Pose to help him sleep. Then he soaked his feet for 20 minutes in hot water with a mugwort pack, feeling completely relaxed. Meanwhile, he scrolled through his phone for a while and replied to Zhang Wei's message in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group, saying he had been cutting fat recently and would arrange a game in a few days. Before bed, he checked the group chat, and seeing that the community had grown to 30 members, he closed his phone with satisfaction. Lying in bed, he briefly planned the next day's work: organizing the community's first-week activity plan in the morning and contacting supplier Zhou Tao in the afternoon about restocking new items. With anticipation, he fell asleep before 23:10.
location: Shanggang Residential Quarter, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (home, bedroom)

name: Morning health management and family breakfast
description: Mingxuan was woken by the alarm at 7 a.m. and did brief neck stretches in bed to relieve the stiffness from the night before. After washing up, he stepped on the scale, saw that he weighed 80.7 kg, and walked into the kitchen. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had already prepared his fat-loss breakfast, including boiled eggs, whole-wheat toast, and a small bowl of unsweetened yogurt. While eating, he proudly shared with his mother that the community had successfully gained 28 new members the previous day, and she smiled and praised him for doing well. During breakfast, following the food diary requirement, he photographed and recorded the calories of the meal. His father, Lei Jianguo, was also present, and the whole family enjoyed the morning together.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Walking commute and podcast learning
description: Mingxuan changed into a lightweight black cotton jacket, put on his earphones, and, taking advantage of the fine weather, chose to walk to the store at Super Brand Mall. He set out from Shanggang Community, passed Qichangzhan Road and Puming Road, and walked along the riverside promenade, the trip taking about 27 minutes in total. On the way, he listened to a podcast about community operations and quietly noted two interaction tips to prepare for the day's community operations.
location: Qichangzhan Road, Puming Road and the Riverside Walkway in Pudong New Area, Shanghai (walking commute route from Shanggang Community to Super Brand Mall)

name: Store opening preparation and inventory check
description: After arriving at the store, Mingxuan turned on the store lighting and the cash register system, and first processed yesterday's reconciliation statement to confirm the sales figures were correct. Then he checked the inventory of key new arrivals, especially the upcoming mountain-style jackets, and found two best-selling sizes were running low, so he noted "Need to contact Zhou Tao" in his phone memo. Using the quiet time before opening, he turned the community engagement scripts he had conceived last night and the detail photos of the mountain-style jackets into a text-and-image post, saving it in his phone album for later. Since store clerk Xiao Lin was on leave, he had to handle all of the day's store work by himself.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Posted an interactive topic for the community's debut.
description: At exactly 10:00 AM, Mingxuan posted today's topic in the WeChat group 'Mingxuan's Mountain-Style Outdoor Collection Store': 'Spring jackets: waterproof or breathable?' He also attached close-up photos of the jacket's waterproof zipper and breathable mesh that he had just taken using the light in the store. After the message was sent, the customer 'Qian Duoduo' responded immediately, sending a photo of her jacket soaked through during an outdoor hike last week. The group quickly became lively. Mingxuan timely announced a little surprise bonus: 'Share an outdoor photo of your favorite jacket, and one winner will receive the same breathable cap.' Within just 10 minutes, five customers privately messaged him to place orders or ask questions.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online client maintenance and initial supplier outreach
description: Mingxuan replied to discussions in the community group while also communicating in depth with a customer who placed an order via private message about sizing and styling suggestions. The customer, Qian Duoduo, wanted to buy the gray mountain-style jacket in size M. After checking inventory, Mingxuan reserved one for her and promised to ship it in the afternoon. When customer traffic was quiet, he sent a WeChat message to supplier Zhou Tao asking about the progress of shipping fabric swatches for the spring new arrivals, and emphasized, "The community has responded well. If any of the new styles are suitable for a promotion, let me know in advance."
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handling the midday customer flow alone and a healthy lunch

He received three groups of customers in a row and patiently recommended windproof jackets and quick-dry pants suitable for spring outdoor activities. In the midst of the busy period, he used his phone to order a 'Chicken Avocado Salad' (with a note: less dressing) from a light meal shop downstairs at Super Brand Mall, and asked the merchant to deliver it to the store's rest area. It wasn't until 1:30 p.m. that he had time to eat the already slightly cold salad, and he recorded the estimated calories in his diet diary app. Despite being busy, he still stuck to his healthy eating plan.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

Then Feng Xiaoyu, a regular customer, came to pick up the reserved black cargo pants. He received her warmly and chatted about the coffee shop he had recommended last time. After seeing Feng Xiaoyu off, he opened a memo on his phone and added content to the draft of the "Community Debut Event Plan." Drawing on the success of the morning's interactive topics, he sketched out the prototype of a "Weekend Mountain-Style Outfit Challenge," planning to encourage customers to visit the store to try on clothes and take photos to share.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Supplier Follow-up and Inventory Management
description: Mingxuan directly called supplier Zhou Tao on WeChat voice and learned that the fabric samples had been sent via SF Express yesterday afternoon and were expected to arrive tomorrow. He confirmed that he would inspect them immediately upon receipt and again expressed his hope that the new styles would receive campaign support. After hanging up, he used the store computer to make a restocking plan for the hot-selling styles that had been found to have tight inventory in the morning, and checked the online sales report. Noticing that searches for a dark blue windproof vest had recently increased, he noted the trend in his product-selection memo.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Receive in-store customers and handle online inquiries

Mingxuan received two batches of walk-in customers, patiently answering questions about fabrics and washing methods, and recommended a similar soft-shell jacket to a man who wanted to buy a travel hardshell jacket, successfully completing a sale. During this time, he also found time to reply to 3 online inquiries from Xiaohongshu and the Taobao shop, answering routine questions about sizes and returns/exchanges.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

Carrying his bag, he went downstairs to a long-established deli on Basement Level 1 of Super Brand Mall and, according to his mother Wang Xiuying's preferences, bought half a jin of duck gizzards and a box of cold dressed vegetarian chicken — a little surprise for the family he had planned yesterday. Afterward, he returned to the store for the final closing check.
location: No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, B1 deli area of Super Brand Mall and Shop A-208 on Level 2

name: Unwind by cycling home from work

The whole trip took about 13 minutes. The evening breeze was gentle; he used this time to clear his mind while thinking about the community's plan for tomorrow and the mini-program ideas he needed to discuss with his cousin Yang Fan that evening.
location: Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong South Road, and Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (cycling route from Super Brand Mall to Shanggang Community)

name: Family dinner and sharing updates
description: After arriving home, Mingxuan handed the duck gizzards to his mother, and his mother Wang Xiuying was indeed delighted. At the dinner table, Mingxuan shared how lively today's community debut had been. His father Lei Jianguo also felt a sense of achievement because the “community playbook” he had suggested earlier had been adopted by his son and shown results. Dinner was steamed sea bass, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and multigrain porridge — light and healthy. After dinner, Mingxuan took the initiative to wash the dishes and chopsticks, and the family enjoyed a happy time together.
location: Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Weight reflection and evening community maintenance
description: After returning to his bedroom, Mingxuan first stepped on the scale and was slightly annoyed to find the number had not gone down. He opened the diet diary app and carefully logged the calorie details of today's lunch salad and dinner, adding the note, "Tomorrow I must be stricter; lunch can't be delayed until 1:30 again." Then, in the WeChat group, he posted a photo taken at the store in the afternoon of the setting sun shining through the floor-to-ceiling window onto a softshell jacket, with the caption: "A softshell jacket blessed by light today." The post once again attracted likes and inquiries from several night-owl customers.
location: Bedroom, Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Had a video call with his cousin Yang Fan to discuss the mini program.
description: Mingxuan had a video call with his cousin Yang Fan. First, he shared how lively the community group had been today, then got down to business, asking whether the idea of "using a mini program for member points and daily activities, without making it too complicated" was feasible. After listening, Yang Fan gave three suggestions: first, build the core functions around "community + live-streaming reservations"; second, use ready-made SaaS tools to build quickly and avoid developing from scratch; and third, it could be mounted under an existing official account. The two chatted for about forty minutes. Mingxuan felt much clearer and jotted down two keywords on paper: "SaaS tools + official account."
location: Bedroom, Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Foot-soaking relaxation and reading

While soaking his feet, he flipped through the newly purchased Outdoor Exploration magazine, read a review of lightweight hiking gear, and compared the product selection ideas in the article with the items in his own store. Afterward, he put down his phone and did five minutes of abdominal breathing on the bed to prepare for sleep.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, Pudong Avenue, Lane 136, No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Building 5, Room 304, bathroom and bedroom

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Mingxuan turned off the light and prepared for sleep. He ran through tomorrow's plan in his mind: in the morning he might need to handle the fabric samples that arrived; in the afternoon, a client had booked an appointment to try on new styles at the store; he also needed to contact the courier to send out today's orders. Although he was slightly annoyed about his weight, his schedule for tomorrow was still clear. With anticipation for the new day and a sense of drive, he fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom, Room 304, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

After the run, completed 3 sets of push-ups (15 reps each), 3 sets of squats (20 reps each), and 2 sets of planks (1 minute each) on the lawn.

After breakfast, he checked his backpack, rode his electric bike to Super Brand Mall for work, and felt the gentle breeze on his face along the way, which was very relaxing. He arrived at the store around 8:30, opened the ERP system and WeChat, and browsed last night's online orders and customer messages.

location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

While eating, I observed the outfit styles of the young office workers around me and took photos of their accessory combinations as inspiration for the community. After the meal, I walked slowly back to the store to aid digestion, and replied to private messages from several VIP customers. One of them was interested in the new mountain-style jacket, so I sent more detail photos in a private chat and scheduled a weekend try-on.
location: LG1, Shanghai ifc Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; then returned to Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

After repeatedly previewing the result, he scheduled it to publish at 15:00, and prepared a group announcement for the later bonus preview.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Process online orders and publish the countdown.

After returning to the store, I drank water and rested, repeatedly checked the community backend status, communicated with my cousin Yang Fan, and checked the publishing time, feeling nervous and excited.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai; on the way to the luggage lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station, 158 Huayuan Shiqiao Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

I used the outfit formulas from the community to recommend looks for them and successfully sold one jacket and one pair of cargo pants. Qian Duoduo, a regular customer, came by; we talked about the community content and her interest in the Friday flash sale, and exchanged info about an outdoor market. The atmosphere was friendly.

location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, family breakfast, and daily planning
description: He woke up naturally at 7 a.m. and weighed in at 80.5 kg. After washing up, he did 10 minutes of jumping jacks and dynamic stretching on the balcony to activate his body. Breakfast was his mother Wang Xiuying's specialty pan-fried buns with hot soy milk, and the family chatted while eating. At the table, Lei Mingxuan mentioned that he was going to pick up his referee certificate today, and also said that Zhang Wei had gone to Singapore and that he might go on a self-driving trip to western Sichuan alone. His father Lei Jianguo, as usual, reminded him to pay attention to safety. After the meal, he spent 10 minutes on his phone handling the voting data from the store's online community, and sent a message to property manager Zheng Kai to confirm that he would definitely attend tomorrow's (March 17) exchange meeting on time, while also asking about the general process of the discussion session.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Cycled to the training center and attended the last session of the referee training.
description: At 7:50, Lei Mingxuan set off from home on his electric scooter, heading along Pudong Avenue to Yuanshen Sports Center at No. 1458 Zhangyang Road. The two-kilometer ride took only 8 minutes, and he arrived just before 8:00. After parking, he entered the billiards training hall classroom, greeted familiar classmates, and took a front-row seat. Today was the last half-day of the referee training course. The teacher went through advanced refereeing techniques and common mistakes. During the break, Lei Mingxuan pulled the teacher aside to ask about a confusion from the previous day's mock exam regarding the placement of a "free ball." After the teacher explained in detail, he suddenly understood. He also chatted again with his classmate Brother Li, whom he had previously talked about pour-over coffee with. Brother Li recommended a Colombian Huila bean, saying it had bright acidity and was good for beginners. The two agreed to bring their own pour-over creations next time to taste each other's.
location: Yuanshen Sports Center, 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Lunch, review, and pre-exam composure.
description: At noon, after the class ended, Lei Mingxuan walked alone to the China Lanzhou Beef Noodle Restaurant behind the Yuanshen Sports Center (No. 1-12, Lane 810, Shenjianong Road) and ordered a bowl of beef noodles with an egg. While eating, he took out his phone and quickly organized into his memo the key written-test points the teacher had emphasized that morning and the framework for answering case-analysis questions. After finishing, he leaned back in his chair, closed his eyes, and silently recited the free-throw rules for 15 minutes, running the key points through his mind again. At 13:00, he walked back to the sports center, found a quiet spot in the main hall's rest area, put on his earphones, and listened to a few soothing folk songs to calm his heartbeat. Then he closed his eyes and simulated the complete process of the afternoon practical assessment in his mind, imagining himself calm and composed, making final mental preparations for the exam.
location: China Lanzhou Beef Noodles (Minsheng Road Branch), No. 1-12, Lane 810, Shenjianong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 1458 Zhangyang Road

name: Participated in the referee qualification written exam and practical assessment and was awarded a certificate.
description: At 14:00, the written test began on time in the designated classroom. As expected, the question types the teacher had emphasized that morning appeared on the paper. Lei Mingxuan answered smoothly, finishing the multiple-choice and case analysis questions within 40 minutes. After carefully checking that no questions were missed, he submitted his paper early at 14:45. After handing in the paper, he went directly to the practical assessment area next door and voluntarily raised his hand to go first. He took a deep breath, stood at the billiards table, and officiated with clear hand gestures and precise calls. In particular, he acted decisively on a controversial snooker ruling and won an on-the-spot nod of approval from the assessor. After the entire process was completed, the assessor announced that he had passed the assessment and issued him the amateur referee certificate from the Chinese Billiards Association. The moment he got the red booklet, he was thrilled and immediately took a photo and posted it to the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group, mentioning Qin Lang and saying, 'Old Qin, your buddy got the certificate! Schedule a billiards game next week — my treat!'
location: Yuanshen Sports Center, 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Riding to Super Brand Mall to celebrate and explore trendy toys
description: At 15:45, Lei Mingxuan left Yuanshen Sports Center, got on his electric scooter and rode along Zhangyang Road to Super Brand Mall at 168 Lujiazui West Road. After a few minutes' ride, he parked his scooter in the ground parking lot behind the mall at 16:00. Entering the mall, he headed straight to the Pop Mart store on the second floor. As a reward to himself, he carefully selected from the new 'SPACE MOLLY' series, picked a blind box by feel, and also grabbed a new 'MOLLY' city-exclusive hanging card and paid. Then he strolled around the mall, bought an iced Americano at Manner Coffee on the B1 floor, sat at the counter scrolling through his phone, replying to likes and comments on his Moments about getting the certificate, enjoying a relaxed celebration.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home, unboxing packages, first pour-over coffee practice, and family dinner.
description: At 17:00, after finishing his coffee, Lei Mingxuan got on his e-bike and headed home. On the way, he received a text alert from a parcel locker saying the pour-over set had arrived. He arrived home at 17:10 and immediately grabbed his phone and went downstairs to pick up the package. He opened the box, took out the Hario V60 dripper, pour-over kettle, matching grinder, and digital scale one by one, and arranged them neatly on the beverage counter. Then he washed his hands, opened a tutorial video by barista Xiao Ma on Bilibili, heated water, weighed the beans, and ground them with a hand grinder, watching the grounds fall like coarse granulated sugar. He folded the filter paper and rinsed the dripper with hot water, poured in the grounds and leveled them. During the first pour for blooming, he watched the coffee grounds bubble and puff up while silently counting 30 seconds. Then he started pouring in circles, but because his wrist was unsteady, the water flow was sometimes strong and sometimes weak. In the end the coffee was over-extracted and tasted bitter. He didn't mind at all, took a photo, and posted it on Moments with the caption: 'The first pour-over of my life. Indeed, bitterness is the undertone of adulthood. Keep practicing!' His mother, Wang Xiuying, heard him and came over to take a sip. Frowning, she said, 'Why does this taste like Chinese medicine? It's so bitter!' He burst out laughing. At 18:30, the family dinner began. He had told his mother in advance to keep it light, so the table had blanched shrimp, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and a small bowl of multigrain rice. Lei Mingxuan drank the bitter coffee as a pre-dinner 'aperitif' while showing off to his parents the referee certificate he had received that afternoon and the blind box he had just bought. His father, Lei Jianguo, didn't know much about designer toys but happily congratulated him. He strictly controlled his portions of shrimp and rice, keeping the dinner calorie count around 550 kcal.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Reply to Zheng Kai's message and prepare talking points
description: At 19:30, Lei Mingxuan returned to his study and looked through several WeChat messages that property manager Zheng Kai had sent in the evening, covering the specific agenda for tomorrow's (March 17) exchange meeting. He immediately replied to confirm attendance and relayed a customer's suggestion that the rest area had too few charging outlets. Then he opened his iPad and organized the past week's rough foot traffic data and the community group's poll results for ‘mountain-style jackets’ into a table. Around the two core topics — ‘how the community can drive low-price foot traffic offline’ and ‘how to satisfy young customers' curiosity-driven demand for new categories’ — he wrote down three key points in his notebook, fully preparing for tomorrow's exchange.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

He was multitasking, scrolling through WeChat Moments to check friends' likes and amusing comments on his pour-over debut, while chatting with Qin Lang in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group. They set a date for next Wednesday evening to play billiards at 'World Square Billiards Hall'. Afterwards, he opened the 'SPACE MOLLY' blind box he bought that afternoon. He had good luck and got the style he liked. Although it wasn't the hidden edition, he was still happy and immediately took a photo to send to his collector friend Lin Jing, who replied, 'Nice luck!'
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

He felt incredibly fulfilled. At exactly 23:00, he turned off his phone, put on his eye mask, listened to the occasional sound of cars passing outside the window, and fell into a contented sleep.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).
