name: Morning work and community operations
description: After store clerk Xiao Lin came on duty, they checked the sizes and colors of the corporate group-buy orders together. When they found a missing color, they contacted Zhou Tao, the supplier in Hangzhou, via WeChat to arrange a stock transfer, and confirmed the replenishment progress with Sister Fang in Guangzhou. Afterwards, they handled community operations: they posted photos of pour-over coffee and new arrivals styled together in the customer group as a teaser, and privately replied to customer Qian Duoduo's inquiry.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and financial management discussion
description: Walked to the Vietnamese pho restaurant on B1 of the IFC mall for a meal. While checking mobile banking, I noticed the technology-themed fund was down, so I immediately called financial advisor Xu Feng for advice. Following his suggestion, I decided to keep the position unchanged and noted a memo about setting aside working capital.
location: B1, Shanghai IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Visit the owner of an outdoor equipment store.
description: After the meal, he returned to B1 of Super Brand Mall and, as scheduled, discussed cooperation for the weekend mountain-style lifestyle market with the owner of an outdoor equipment store. He gave a detailed introduction to the market concept, timing, booth fees, and community traffic-generation plan. The owner agreed to participate and display camping gear.
location: B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Visit an independent coffee shop owner
description: Went to a Japanese-style independent coffee shop on the 3rd floor of Super Brand Mall and showed the owner a hand-drawn activity area layout. The owner became interested in the outdoor pour-over experience area, said they would be willing to sponsor SOE beans and bear part of the booth fee, and basically reached an agreement.
location: 3rd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Visit craft workshops and bookstores
description: On the 4th floor of Super Brand Mall, he visited a handmade leather goods shop and a city-themed bookstore one after another. He discussed an on-site DIY keychain activity with the leather shop owner, and talked with the bookstore's planner about using bookshelves as the entrance installation for the market. Both merchants agreed to participate and bring specialty items.
location: 4th Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168, Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon in-store work and exercise
description: Returned to the shop to process online orders, packed the parcels and sent them to the Hive Box at Lujiazui Metro Station, and bought an iced Americano to refresh. Then used a yoga mat in the shop for 15 minutes of shoulder, neck, and leg stretching, and organized the business cards and notes from the afternoon discussions with Xiao Lin for filing, while also announcing the evening billiards activity in the community group.
location: Shop A-208, Floor 2, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the Hive Box locker at Lujiazui Metro Station

name: Shopping after work and heading home
description: After work, walked home and on the way went to Yanqin Grocery Store on Laoshan Road, where she picked out a foot bath bucket with massage rollers for her mother to replace the old leaking one at home.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store near Laoshan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Arrive home, rest, and chat with family
description: Back home, he gave the foot bath bucket to his mother, who complained on the surface but was very happy. He reported the progress of the market negotiations to his parents; his father urged him to act steadily. Then he ate some fruit and changed into clothes for going out.
location: Home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Departing for the billiard hall and warming up
description: Changed into sneakers and walked to the billiards hall at World Square. After arriving early, I warmed up in the rest area by stretching my legs and rotating my wrists and shoulders to get ready for billiards.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Billiards, socializing, and relaxation.
description: I met up with childhood friends Han Dong and Qin Lang for an American eight-ball match. While playing, we caught up on each other's news. Han Dong shared his experience taking certification exams, and I talked about my successful afternoon negotiation with the merchants. That evening my touch was good and I won more than I lost, releasing the day's work fatigue through exercise.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walked home and bought fruit on the way.
description: After billiards, I said goodbye to friends and walked home. On the way, I passed a fruit stall near Pushang Vegetable Market, picked out a pineapple for my mother, asked the vendor to peel it, and brought it back to share with the family.
location: Fruit stall near Pushang Vegetable Market, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Yoga relaxation and personal planning.
description: After getting home, take a shower first, then soak your feet in the newly bought foot bath bucket while following Keep for a 20-minute yoga stretch, focusing on relaxing the leg and back muscles. After soaking, record the day's diet and plan important matters in the phone memo, such as merchant intent confirmation letters to follow up on the next day.
location: Home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep leisure and bedtime
description: After getting into bed, I browsed the latest posts on the Pop Mart community, chatted online with my friend Lin Jing about our blind box experiences, and shared pictures of limited editions with each other. Then I turned off the lights, reviewed the day's progress on the market fair, felt confident about the month-end sales push, and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting up, washing up, and morning preparation
description: After the alarm went off, he sat up directly and felt quite refreshed. After a quick wash, he changed into a loose T-shirt and sweatpants, preparing for the physical work expected today.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Had breakfast with my mother and discussed the evening arrangements
description: When he came downstairs, his mother had already laid out breakfast: white congee, pickled vegetables, and boiled eggs. As he ate, he told her that the store would be doing inventory tonight, so he might be home late and she didn't need to wait for him for dinner. His mother, as usual, reminded him to eat on time, and he agreed to everything.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the store
description: After breakfast, he picked up his commuter bag and phone and headed out. At the entrance of the residential community, he scanned a shared bike and rode along Zhangyang Road for about 15 minutes, passing through several familiar streets, and arrived at Super Brand Mall around 8:40.
location: From Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Arrived at the store and prepared for the morning ritual.
description: After arriving at the store, he turned on the air conditioner and the rolling shutter door. First he boiled water and made himself a cup of pour-over coffee. While drinking the coffee, he opened his computer, clicked send on the WeChat official account article he had edited the night before, reminding regular customers that the new spring items had been restocked.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Processing online orders and shipping
description: He checked the online backend and saw two new orders. He skillfully took the products off the shelf, carefully checked sizes and styles, wrapped them in bubble wrap, and put them into express bags. He scanned the orders, printed the shipping labels, and pasted them on, then scheduled a SF Express pickup through the mini program. The courier arrived 10 minutes later. He handed the packages to the courier and updated the shipping status.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Packing up out-of-season items to free up storage space
description: One of today's highlights. He walked into the warehouse and picked out all the out-of-season items such as heavy coats and fleece jackets. He squatted on the floor, carefully folded each piece, and packed them into large vacuum storage bags, writing the item names and quantities on the bags with a marker. Then he neatly placed the storage bags on the high shelves in the warehouse, leaving the prime space freed up for the new spring and summer items. After about an hour and a half of physical work, he was sweating, and he considered it his exercise for the day done in advance.
location: Warehouse area of Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and industry observation
description: Feeling hungry, he left the shop and walked about 8 minutes through the connecting corridor to IFC. He went straight to his usual Japanese ramen shop and ordered a bowl of signature tonkotsu ramen plus a soft-boiled egg. While waiting, he scrolled through the supplier group chat and several fashion industry forums. He saw a new fabric sample photo posted by Zhou Tao and made a mental note of it.
location: Japanese Ramen Restaurant, B1, International Finance Center Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Comprehensive inventory count and checking of spring stock
description: Back at the store, he took out a notebook and pen and began the day's most important work. He counted the spring inventory one by one by category (T-shirts, shirts, cargo pants, jackets). After each stack, he recorded the count in the notebook. The results were as he had expected: only 2 pairs of small-size cargo pants remained, and several bright-colored windbreaker jackets were also running low, with only single digits left. He also noted several slow-moving styles that had been piling up for a long time. After counting, he looked at the data in the notebook and already had a clear idea of the restocking plan.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reviewing data and preparing a procurement plan
description: After completing the inventory count, he returned to the computer. He opened the purchase-sale-inventory spreadsheet and entered the handwritten data row by row, marking bestsellers such as small-size cargo pants and bright jackets with prominent stars. Next, he exported sales details from January to March and quickly created a pivot table. The chart clearly showed that small-size cargo pants and bright jackets were the absolute main drivers of sales growth. After confirming it was correct, he drafted a purchasing adjustment plan in his notebook: add orders for bestsellers and cut orders for slow movers.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Roaming the store and receiving regular customers
description: Just as he was about to submit the purchase order, regular customer Qian Duoduo strolled in. She was interested in a few of the newly displayed sample pieces, so he put down his computer and chatted with her about recent styling trends and restocking ideas. She showed him a few outfit-matching examples from Xiaohongshu, and they exchanged ideas for over ten minutes. After seeing her off, he glanced at the time and decided to handle the order first.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Adjust supplier restocking orders.
description: He logged in to Taosheng Apparel's procurement platform and found the order he had placed earlier that had not been shipped yet. Based on the afternoon's analysis and contingency plan, he clearly wrote in the remarks field: add 30 size S cargo pants and 20 bright-color windbreaker jackets. Then he glanced at the other slow-moving styles, decisively checked off reducing the corresponding quantities, and submitted the changes in one smooth motion.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handling urgent customer orders and wrap-up work
description: As he was about to leave work, his phone buzzed with a message from a regular customer. She urgently needed a size L coat in a specific style for an event tomorrow. He searched the stock and found there was only one in the store, so he packed it right away and called an on-demand courier for express delivery. Afterwards, he spent half an hour restoring the display areas that had been messed up during inventory, sweeping and mopping the floor, and tidying the fitting room.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Late-night overtime meal and business reflection.
description: It was almost 9 p.m. by the time he finished; his stomach was growling. He placed an order on the convenience store's mini program on his phone, ordering two rice balls and two tea eggs. After the delivery arrived, he sat in the fitting area of the store and ate them with a cup of warm water. While eating, he calculated: next week he had to completely reduce the space for slow-moving items and leave all the freed-up space for the newly arrived best sellers.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closed the shop and cycled home
description: After finishing the meal and clearing the table, he turned off all the lights and equipment in the store, pulled down the roller shutter door, and locked it. He hopped on a shared bike and rode home against the evening breeze. There were few cars on the road, so he rode fast and reached the community entrance in about ten minutes.
location: From Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to home at Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: After getting home, he took off his dusty clothes and took a hot shower, feeling completely relaxed. After showering, he collapsed onto the living room sofa, scrolled through his phone for a while, checked anime updates on Bilibili, and chatted with friends in the group about the weekend billiards game.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation and review
description: At 11 o'clock, he put down his phone and quickly ran through tomorrow's to-do list in his mind: notify Zhou Tao about shipping the goods, and keep an eye on discounted tour group information. Although he was exhausted today, all the troublesome tasks had been completed, and he felt very at ease. He got into bed, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, and preparation to go out
description: At 7:00 a.m. the alarm went off. Mingxuan lay in bed for 5 more minutes, then came across Song Jia's riverside night-view photo from last night and immediately felt motivated. After washing up, his mother had already prepared fried egg toast and milk. Seeing the nice weather, she reminded Mingxuan to get some sun. Mingxuan mentioned that he was going to the riverside for night skating in the evening; his mother, as usual, told him to be safe. Mingxuan smiled and agreed, then quickly finished breakfast. Afterward, he changed into the wool-blend knit sweater and casual pants he had prepared the day before, slung on his commuter bag, checked his keys, phone, and power bank, wheeled out his electric bike, put on his helmet, and got ready to leave.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ride an electric bike to Super Brand Mall.
description: Mingxuan rode his e-bike through the morning rush hour traffic, turning from Pudong Avenue onto Lujiazui Ring Road, and arrived at Super Brand Mall after about 25 minutes. While waiting at a red light, he used voice input on his phone to reply to supplier Zhou Tao, confirming that the restocking order had been received and saying he would follow up on the logistics in the morning.
location: Along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui West Road in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store opening preparation and merchandise organization
description: Mingxuan arrived at store A-208 in Super Brand Mall. After opening, he turned on the lights and added water to the coffee machine. He opened his computer to check online orders and logistics status, then organized the newly arrived pure cotton white T-shirts and linen shirts, hung them in the corresponding sections, and adjusted the window mannequin outfits, switching to light colors more in line with the spring/summer vibe.
location: Store A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Submit the spring co-branded market proposal to the property manager
description: At exactly 9:00, Mingxuan took three printed copies of the "2025 Spring Merchant Co-branded Market Plan" to the mall management office on Level B1 of Super Brand Mall. The property manager, Zheng Kai, received him warmly. Mingxuan explained in detail his ideas about setting up pop-up stalls along the circular route through the atrium, partnering with merchants on threshold-based discount coupons, and using the mall's big screen for live streaming to build pre-event buzz. Zheng Kai listened and nodded, thought the concept was solid, and scheduled a formal review for next Friday afternoon, when they would coordinate the public area schedule. Mingxuan felt the plan was progressing more smoothly than expected.
location: Mall Management Office, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning shop operations: contacting suppliers and test-shooting short videos.
description: Mingxuan returned to the store and logged into the Taosheng platform, where he saw that Zhou Tao had confirmed the restocking order (small-size cargo pants +30, bright-color windbreaker jackets +20) and generated a shipping order. He called Zhou Tao to confirm that the latest arrival time would be next Tuesday at the latest. Then he packed two urgent same-city deliveries, affixed SF Express electronic waybills, and waited for pickup. Between serving customers who dropped by the store, Mingxuan used his phone to shoot short video material for a “Night Ski LOOK” he had styled, accumulating content for the store’s account. Jazz music played in the store, and the atmosphere was relaxed.
location: Store A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go to IFC for a Japanese ramen lunch.
description: Mingxuan walked about 10 minutes to Ippudo on the basement level of IFS, and ordered a bowl of the signature Akamaru Shinji ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While eating, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu and bookmarked several posts about Anji canyon rafting to prepare for the May Day trip.
location: Ippudo, B1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon rest and May Day trip planning
description: Mingxuan returned to the shop and brewed a cup of drip coffee. With few customers around, he opened the memo app on his phone to brainstorm alternative May Day routes. Besides Thousand Island Lake and Anji, he also thought of the Hui-Hang Ancient Trail as a place to combine hiking and roller skating. After that, he sent his mother a WeChat message saying he wouldn't be home for dinner and was going roller skating at the riverside with friends.
location: Store A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations: spring new-arrival displays and customer service
description: Mingxuan unpacked and organized the newly arrived bright-colored spring outdoor jackets, displayed them by color in the most prominent spot in the store, set up a fill light, and used his phone to take nine new-arrival photos in a consistent style. He captioned them “Spring Escape Plan: Volume 1” and posted them to his Moments and the regular-customer WeChat group. Regular customer Qian Duoduo saw it, came to the store to try on the orange one, and bought it on the spot. She also suggested introducing a frisbee co-branded version, and Mingxuan noted the suggestion. After that, he continued receiving customers and organizing sales data. Noticing that the jackets were well received, he decided to contact Zhou Tao the next day to restock. Before closing, he cleaned the store and watered the green plants to prepare for weekend business.
location: Store A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closed the store, went home, changed clothes, and checked roller skating gear
description: Mingxuan hung up the temporarily closed sign in advance, checked the water, electricity, doors and windows, then rode his electric bike home. On the way, he stopped at Yanqin Grocery at the entrance to the community to buy mineral water and electrolyte powder. After getting home, he quickly changed into a quick-dry shirt and sports shorts, used WD-40 to lubricate the roller skate bearings, packed a power bank, earphones, a spare T-shirt and other items into his backpack, ate an energy gel, and got ready to leave.
location: Home at Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and along the route

name: Rode the e-bike to Lujiazui Riverside Park to meet up.
description: Mingxuan left at 18:15, rode his electric bike along Pudong Avenue and turned onto Binjiang Avenue, arriving at the entrance of Lujiazui Riverside Park about 15 minutes later. Along the riverbank there were many joggers and walkers; the breeze brushed his face, and he felt at ease. He parked near the entrance and walked toward the meeting point.
location: Entrance to Lujiazui Riverside Park, Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Riverside night roller skating and socializing: group warm-up, 12 km night skate, and group chat discussion
description: Mingxuan met Song Jia, A Jie, Xiao Lu, and four others—eight people in total—at the yacht marina plaza. Song Jia was stretching; they greeted each other and warmed up together, and Song Jia used a massage gun to relax Mingxuan's calves. At around 19:20, they started night skating along the riverside promenade toward Nanpu Bridge, covering about 12 kilometers in total. Along the way, A Jie shared a rafting route around Qiandao Lake, and Xiao Lu filmed with a GoPro while teaching Mingxuan composition techniques. Midway, they rested briefly under Nanpu Bridge. After the skating session, everyone sat beside the viewing platform, resting and discussing plans for the May Day holiday. Mingxuan suggested creating a group chat, and Song Jia immediately set up the WeChat group “Shanghai Roller Skating Travel Squad.” A Jie posted route screenshots in the group, and the atmosphere was lively.
location: Lujiazui Riverside Park and Nanpu Bridge along Riverside Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home, late-night review, and going to bed
description: After saying goodbye to his friends, Mingxuan rode his e-bike back to his home in Shanggang Community. After a quick shower, he lay on the sofa, looked at the photos and videos everyone had posted in the group, and posted a few close-ups Xiao Lu had taken of him to Moments. Seeing the group discussion about needing new protective gear for Anji, Mingxuan opened Taobao and ordered a top-grade pair of knee pads and palm guards. Before bed, he set an alarm for Saturday at 8:30. Reflecting on how smoothly the plan had progressed today, the new friends he had made, and the good response to the store's outdoor jackets, he gradually fell asleep looking forward to the May Day trip.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Natural wake-up, morning preparation, and breakfast
description: On Saturday morning, Lei Mingxuan woke up naturally and felt refreshed after last night's roller skating. After washing up, he drank a glass of warm water and then had breakfast with his parents. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared white porridge, fried eggs, and steamed buns. His father, Lei Jianguo, was watching the morning news. During breakfast, Lei Mingxuan shared amusing stories about the new friends he had met while roller skating the night before, and his parents were pleased with his colorful life.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walked with his mother to the vegetable market to shop, then went home to prepare the spring vegetables.
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan and his mother Wang Xiuying carried reusable bags and walked to the Pushang Food Market. On the way, he talked about how the clothing store's community customers had praised the outdoor jackets, and his mother felt gratified. At the market, his mother taught him how to pick fresh spring bamboo shoots: choose short, thick ones with tightly wrapped husks and clean white bottoms. He learned clumsily, drawing kind laughter from his mother and the vegetable-selling aunt. Then they bought tender broad beans. When they reached the fruit area, his mother stopped at the Hongyan strawberry stall, and Lei Mingxuan immediately bought two boxes of large, red strawberries. His mother complained that they were expensive, but her eyes were smiling. He helped his mother carry the vegetables and they walked home together. After arriving home, he shelled broad beans and peeled spring bamboo shoots in the kitchen with his parents. His father asked about Qingming Festival plans, and his mother teased that his heart had already flown to Thousand Island Lake. The kitchen was filled with a relaxed family atmosphere.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road and home in Shanggang Community

name: Personal free time: phone socializing and planning
description: His parents watched TV in the living room, while Lei Mingxuan returned to his own room and browsed his phone. In the roller-skating travel group, he saw beautiful photos of the loop around Thousand Island Lake shared by his friend A Jie. He was excited by them and replied that he would confirm the itinerary after the Qingming Festival. Then, in the designer toy group, he found someone selling a rare blind box. He immediately sent a private message and successfully negotiated the price down to buy it.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family lunch and basketball game coordination
description: At lunchtime, his mother Wang Xiuying used the spring bamboo shoots and fava beans bought in the morning to make salted pork and bamboo shoot soup and fava beans with scallion oil. The family of three had lunch together. After the meal, Lei Mingxuan called his friend Xie Fei to discuss the 4-on-4 basketball game at Yuanshen Sports Center the next day. Xie Fei agreed to contact Da Liu and Pangzi, and they agreed to finalize the roster in the group chat in the evening. After a brief chat, they hung up.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove to the car maintenance center
description: Lei Mingxuan said goodbye to his family and drove to Fuhai Auto Care Center on Chengfeng Road in Pudong. It was his first time at this shop. He had booked the 1:30 p.m. maintenance by phone through Dianping. Along the way, he passed Zhangyang Road, South Yanggao Road, and Luoshan Elevated Road, and arrived in about 40 minutes with music playing.
location: Fuhai Auto Care Center, Chengfeng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Car maintenance and reading time.
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan discussed the maintenance items with the mechanic: changing the engine oil (Castrol Edge 5W-30), oil filter, and air filter, and checking the brake pads and tires. The mechanic suggested replacing the cabin air filter, and he agreed. While the car was being serviced, he sat on the sofa in the waiting area, took out his copy of “The Longest Day in Chang'an”, and immersed himself in the tense story of Zhang Xiaojing chasing down clues, reading for nearly an hour.
location: Fuhai Auto Care Center, Chengfeng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Paid the maintenance fee and went to visit the designer toy concept store.
description: After the maintenance was completed, the mechanic told him that the brake pads and tires were still in acceptable condition. Lei Mingxuan paid 1,260 yuan by credit card (including engine oil, the three filters, and the cabin air filter), and added the mechanic on WeChat so he could make future appointments. He then drove to the Xingji Geek digital and trendy toy gift store in Minhang District that he had been eyeing for a long time, a drive of about 50 minutes. When he arrived, he found that besides the usual blind boxes and figures, the store also had trendy toys and limited-edition prints by independent designers, with a unique style. He lingered for forty or fifty minutes, took many photos, and paid special attention to several cyberpunk mecha figures. He also chatted with a store clerk and suggested holding a weekend co-branded pop-up event; the clerk said she would need to report it to the store manager.
location: Xingji Geek Digital & Designer Toy Gift Shop, Yindu Road, Minhang District, Shanghai

name: Ride along Pudong Riverside Avenue to unwind
description: After leaving the designer toy store, Lei Mingxuan didn't rush home; instead he drove onto the Pudong Riverside Avenue. He rolled down all the windows to feel the spring breeze, while Coldplay's 'Viva La Vida' played in the car. Looking at the broad Huangpu River and the International Architecture Complex on the Bund on the opposite bank, he felt relaxed in body and mind, recovering from car maintenance and store visits, and enjoyed the rare weekend leisure.
location: Binjiang Avenue, No. 2967 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Returning home and helping prepare dinner.
description: After the drive, Lei Mingxuan contentedly drove back to his home in Shanggang Residential Community on Pudong Avenue. When he arrived, his mother Wang Xiuying was already busy in the kitchen. He changed into loungewear and went into the kitchen to help prepare vegetables. While working, he showed his mother photos of the mecha figures he had taken at the trendy toy store that afternoon. Although she didn't quite understand them, she still praised them as “pretty neat”.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and TV news
description: The family of three sat around the dining table. His mother specially added an extra dish, and his father Lei Jianguo opened a bottle of yellow rice wine. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan mentioned tomorrow morning's basketball game, and his mother reminded him to bring a towel and water. After dinner, the whole family watched the news together. Lei Mingxuan sent a message in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group to confirm the game, and both Chen Hao and Liu Yang replied.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Home bedtime yoga stretching
description: To help digest dinner and relieve the muscle tension from yesterday's roller skating, Lei Mingxuan laid out a yoga mat in the living room and followed the Keep app to do a 10-minute pre-sleep stretch, focusing on his calves, hips, and back. After finishing, he felt relaxed and had loosened his muscles for tomorrow's basketball game.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening personal leisure activities and billiards match confirmation
description: After taking a shower, Lei Mingxuan returned to his room and watched two episodes of the anime “Frieren: Beyond Journey's End.” Then he did several social activities on his phone: in the roller skating group, he confirmed with A Jie and others the plan to scout the route at Thousand Island Lake on the weekend after Qingming Festival; he posted the photos he took at the art toy store that afternoon to the Art Toy Addicts group, sparking lively discussion; he replied to Shen Jie's WeChat message to discuss whether to go see the emerging designer exhibition together tomorrow. At 10:30 p.m., Xie Fei posted the 12-man roster in the basketball group, and they did a team draw over voice chat. Lei Mingxuan and Xie Fei were placed in opposing groups. After the call, he set the alarm for 8:30 the next morning, packed his jersey, basketball shoes, towel, water bottle, and Red Bull, and put them by the door. Then he turned off the lights and went to bed, mentally planning how to defend against Xie Fei's drives and three-pointers.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation and heading to the court.
description: At 8 a.m. the alarm went off on time. Lei Mingxuan washed up quickly, changed into the Lakers purple jersey and knee pads. His mother Wang Xiuying prepared whole-wheat toast and warm milk. He ate two slices of toast and a banana, while stuffing his basketball, towel, and water bottle into his sports bag. Before leaving, he made a shooting gesture at the living room mirror, and his mother urged him with a smile, 'Hurry up, don't keep them waiting.' Then, Lei Mingxuan walked out of Shanggang Community, turned east along Pudong Avenue onto Yuanshen Road, and walked about 15 minutes in the morning light to Yuanshen Sports Center. On the way, he sent his basketball buddy Xie Fei a voice message: 'I'm here, where are you?' The whole process was relaxed and full of anticipation.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Yuanshen Sports Center, 655 Yuanshen Road

name: Basketball game and post-game plans
description: At exactly 9 o'clock, basketball buddies Xie Fei and Zhao Zilong were already shooting hoops. Once everyone had arrived, the group warm-up began: two slow laps around the court, dynamic stretching, and group shooting drills. Teams were drawn by lot. Lei Mingxuan, Xie Fei, Zhao Zilong, and Wang Hao were placed on the red team against the blue team. The game used a four-quarter format. In the first quarter, Lei Mingxuan scored 6 consecutive points with his speed and drives, putting the red team ahead. In the third quarter, his stamina dropped and his legs felt heavy; continuous running made him short of breath, and he committed two passing turnovers, letting the blue team take the lead. In the final 3 minutes of the fourth quarter, he fought hard to grab a key offensive rebound and scored on a putback with defenders contesting, helping the red team regain their footing. The red team eventually won narrowly, 62:58. Lei Mingxuan finished the game with 8 points, 4 rebounds, and 2 assists. After the game, he called everyone to form a circle at the sideline for leg stretches, focusing on loosening the quadriceps and calves while reviewing the highlights. Xie Fei suggested a fixed game every Sunday, and everyone agreed. Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to handle the organizing, promising to start a poll in the group chat after returning to set next week's time.
location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home to rest and planning at noon.
description: After walking home, Lei Mingxuan took off his soaked jersey and took a warm shower. Then he mixed a glass of protein powder in the kitchen and took out a jar of overnight oats from the fridge for lunch. After eating, he posted a few retouched photos taken by his basketball friends to the 'Yuanshen Weekend Ball Game' WeChat group and started a poll chain for 'next Sunday afternoon court time.' Then he drew the bedroom curtains, lay down on the bed, and used a map app on his phone to study the 'Qiandao Lake Inline Skating Route' he had saved earlier, carefully checking the viewpoints and photo spots, and wrote a simple route itinerary in his Notes app to prepare for the Qingming holiday. Around 13:20, drowsiness hit, and he put down his phone and slept soundly for half an hour.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Strolling around Century Link Plaza and enjoying coffee time
description: After the nap, feeling refreshed, Lei Mingxuan changed into casual sweatpants and a T-shirt, rented a shared bike, and rode along Zhangyang Road for about 15 minutes to Century Link Plaza. Instead of visiting the familiar brand stores, he was attracted by the newly opened Black Diamond outdoor sports experience store. He tried on several sports sunglasses with interest, flipped through a trail-running photo book, and asked the in-store coach how to scientifically improve his running pace, preparing for resuming his morning runs. Afterwards, he went to M Stand coffee on the B1 floor, ordered an iced Americano, and sat by the window opening his Kindle to continue reading The Longest Day in Chang'an. During that time, he saw that the vote in his basketball group chat had ended, with everyone agreeing on the same time next Sunday, so he casually replied with a 'Got it' sticker in the group on behalf of Xie Fei to confirm.
location: Century Link Plaza, 1192 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and its B1-level M Stand Coffee

name: Go home for dinner with family
description: After finishing his coffee, Lei Mingxuan rode a shared bike home, feeling good at the thought that his mother might have made his favorite dishes. When he got home, his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying were preparing the meal, so he washed his hands and joined in to help. On the table were Shanghai-style red-braised pork and sautéed seasonal vegetables. While eating, he talked about the morning's basketball game: "Mom, in the third quarter today I almost gave away a sure win; my legs really couldn't keep up." His mother said with concern, "I think you just haven't been exercising enough. Don't overdo it. Take it slow and get your body back in shape first." His father chuckled on the side: "Playing ball relies on your brain; you also need to learn to manage your energy wisely. Don't just rely on brute force." Lei Mingxuan nodded silently, his resolve to resume morning runs growing stronger inside.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening relaxation and rest
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to help clear the table and wash the dishes. Then he returned to the living room, opened the Mint Health app, and entered all of the day's meals (bread, banana, oat cup, braised pork with rice) and exercise (basketball), carefully counting calories. Next, he did 15 minutes of targeted leg stretches on the yoga mat, focusing on relaxing his quadriceps and Achilles tendons to relieve post-exercise soreness. Then he turned on the PS5 and played NBA 2K25 for 40 minutes, enjoying the transition from playing in reality to playing virtually. At around 21:30, he went to wash up. Looking at himself in the mirror, he felt a little tired but very fulfilled. After lying in bed, he opened WeChat and replied to the confirmation message for Sunday's activity in the ball friends group with an emoji sticker. He also saw a few voice messages from his younger cousin Shen Jie sent in the afternoon about cooperation on the store's online branch. He didn't reply right away, deciding to discuss the details at the store tomorrow. At 22:30, he turned off the lights and fell asleep on time, and his body, which had been busy all day, finally got complete rest.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting up, washing up, family breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: After the alarm went off, I got up and first weighed myself: 80.3 kg, the same as yesterday. I felt relaxed but also under pressure. After washing up, I went to the dining room to eat the small wontons and pan-fried dumplings my mother had made. My father was eating mantou while watching the morning news. As I ate, I replied to the health post my mother sent in the group and checked the weather forecast (cloudy, 17-24°C), deciding to wear a light jacket. After eating, I went back to my room and changed into a black work jacket and gray casual pants. Before leaving, I looked at my phone and replied to my cousin Shen Jie: "Jie, I was too tired from playing basketball last night and fell asleep. I'm really serious about the online branch store. Do you have time to come by the store today? Let's talk in person." Then I put my keys, phone, and store access card in my pocket and got ready to go out.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Residential Area, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk to the shop.
description: On the way to the store on foot, I put on wireless earbuds and mentally rehearsed the outfit copy for today's shoot, considering three looks: a khaki workwear jacket, a denim shirt layered over a hoodie, and a light coach jacket, as well as using a Fujifilm film-style filter.
location: Along the route from Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Store opening preparation and inventory check
description: After arriving at the Super Brand Mall store, turn on the lights, start the computer, check the cash register and the previous day's transactions. Tidy the checkout counter, open the inventory management software to confirm that the SKUs and size stock of the three mountain-style outfits are sufficient. Then move the fill light and tripod to the fitting room, adjust the lighting angle, and prepare for the shoot.
location: Shop A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Choosing outfits and arranging the scene
description: He took three coordinated outfits from the rack: a khaki workwear jacket, a denim shirt layered over a hoodie, and a dark blue lightweight coach jacket. He hung them on a rolling rack and picked out outdoor-style backpacks and hats as accessories. In front of the solid-color curtain in the fitting room, he added a small camping folding chair as an accent to create a mountain-style camping atmosphere.
location: Shop A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shooting a short video showcasing outfits.
description: Used an iPhone on a tripod to shoot. For the first outfit, a khaki workwear jacket, explained its windproof and water-repellent fabric and multi-pocket design while putting it on, suitable for camping and hiking; the second outfit, a denim shirt layered with a hoodie, demonstrated the spring layering rule with rich layers; the third outfit, a coach jacket, emphasized its lightweight and versatile nature, suitable for commuting and casual wear. Each group was kept to about 30 seconds, and after two NG takes, satisfactory footage was obtained.
location: Shop A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Edit and publish the video
description: Used the CapCut app to quickly edit, selected the best clips from each set, added the unified title "Spring New Arrivals in Mountain Utility Style", paired it with light Lo-fi Hip Hop background music, adjusted brightness, and published directly to Xiaohongshu. Simultaneously posted to Moments: "Three new spring mountain-style outfits, watch the 30-second video for styling ideas. If you like them, send a private message or come try them on in store."
location: Shop A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Replying to online inquiries and communications.
description: After the video was posted, the phone kept vibrating. While tidying up the filming equipment, he checked the messages. Received 12 private messages and 5 new followers, and replied one by one to customers' questions about oversized sizing, fabric wrinkling, color choices, etc. At the same time, received a voice message from cousin Shen Jie, saying she would be free from 3:30 to 4:00 PM to come to the store and talk about the online branch store in person. Replied with an OK emoji.
location: Shop A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch time
description: Locked the store, walked to the B1 floor of IFC Mall, went to Ippudo Ramen, ordered a bowl of Akamaru ramen with a soft-boiled egg and Japanese pan-fried dumplings. While waiting, saw that the Xiaohongshu video already had over 100 likes and more than 30 comments. Replied one by one to size and price inquiries, and recommended the partnered courier's WeChat to a customer asking about shipping.
location: Ippudo Ramen at B1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bought coffee
description: After the meal, I walked over to Manner Coffee on B1 of Jin Mao Tower and waited in line to buy an iced Americano. While waiting, I quickly jotted down the screened potential customer information in my phone's memo app, ready to organize it into a customer intent list when I returned to the store.
location: Manner Coffee, B1, Jin Mao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Receiving walk-in customers and handling online orders
description: Back at the store, customer traffic increased in the afternoon. I greeted customers while sipping an iced Americano. A young couple was interested in the khaki utility jacket, so I enthusiastically helped the guy try it on and offered styling advice. In between, I handled new online inquiries and sent a WeChat message to supplier Zhou Tao asking whether the goods ordered last week had been shipped. Zhou Tao replied, "They will be shipped this afternoon and arrive tomorrow!"
location: Shop A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Met with cousin Shen Jie to discuss online branch store plans.
description: Cousin Shen Jie arrived on time. Lei Mingxuan poured her water, and the two sat down in the rest area. Lei Mingxuan explained in detail that he wanted to open an online branch store but was unsure whether to choose a Douyin store or a Xiaohongshu store, and whether to sell products first or create outfit content first. Shen Jie analyzed the traffic logic of the two platforms and suggested starting with Xiaohongshu, using outfit content to attract targeted followers and then funneling them to the store. After nearly an hour of conversation, Lei Mingxuan noted down the key points, and his thoughts became clear.
location: Shop A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Processing online orders and closing up the store
description: After seeing off Shen Jie, handled three or four new online orders from the afternoon: organized the information, printed shipping labels, and carefully folded the clothes into dust bags and shipping boxes. Then cleaned the store, vacuumed the floor, and tidied up the fitting room and put photography props back in place.
location: Shop A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Close the store and walk home
description: Turned off the power, locked the rolling shutter door, and walked home to relax. On the way, he replied to a few customer private messages that had not been answered in time, confirming sizes and delivery times.
location: Along the route from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Family Dinner and Evening Chat
description: When he got home, his mother was preparing dinner in the kitchen and his father was watching the news in the living room. Dinner included braised pork belly, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. At the table, he shared about filming videos today and discussing the online branch with his cousin. His mother supported it but reminded him not to be too aggressive, and his father reminded him that the car insurance was about to expire and needed to be renewed.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Residential Area, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening weigh-in, planning the morning run, and replying to my cousin
description: After dinner, he went back to his room and weighed himself. The body fat scale showed 80.8 kg, the same as last night. Since he had lacked energy during yesterday's ball game and his weight hadn't dropped, he felt more psychological pressure. He therefore decided to go for a morning run. He opened Amap to plan a route: from the residential compound, along the Zhangjiabang River, to Lujiazui Central Green Park, about 5.2 kilometers in total. He took a screenshot, saved it, and set it as his phone wallpaper. Afterward, he sent a message to his cousin Shen Jie to thank her for her advice, decided to focus on Xiaohongshu, and invited her to be a strategic consultant. Shen Jie replied, 'No problem.'
location: Room 502, Building 3, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Residential Area, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stretching and showering
description: His legs were sore from playing ball yesterday, so he rolled out a yoga mat and did a serious 15-minute leg stretch. After the muscles felt relieved, he took a shower and washed away the day's fatigue.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Residential Area, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure and planning tomorrow's tasks
description: After taking a shower, he curled up on the living room sofa. First, he opened Honor of Kings to claim the daily mission rewards and felt excited about the new season preview. Then he browsed CapCut to learn camera movement techniques for outfit videos. He also checked the "Magic City Trendy Toys Enthusiasts Group" to see members showing off the Dimoo special exhibition limited edition. Afterward, he went back to the study and used his phone memo to plan tomorrow: 1. Get up early and start running at 7 a.m.; 2. Go to the store and contact Zhou Tao to confirm the arrival of the goods; 3. In the afternoon, ask Zheng Kai, the mall property manager, about the venue application process for next month's market event.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Residential Area, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening bedtime
description: Back in the bedroom, I looked at the morning running route on the new wallpaper to encourage myself. I filled the water glass on the nightstand, set the alarm for 6:45 the next morning, turned off the light, and lay down. Reviewing the day: the video was well received, online inquiries went smoothly, the conversation with Shen Jie was fruitful, and tomorrow's running route was set. I slowly drifted off to sleep, full of anticipation.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Residential Area, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, morning run, and breakfast.
description: Lei Mingxuan got up at 7:10 a.m., drank warm water, and did squats and chest-opening exercises to wake up his body. Then he changed into workout clothes and went for a 5-kilometer run at Lujiazui Central Green Park, breathing in the morning air and taking photos to post on WeChat Moments. After the run, he returned to his home in Shanggang Community, showered, and had breakfast with his mother, Wang Xiuying (boiled eggs and small wontons). During the meal, he mentioned that new stock was arriving at the store that day and he might be home late.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Lujiazui Central Green Park

name: Commute and morning store preparation
description: Lei Mingxuan walked to his store at Super Brand Mall, observing the Lujiazui morning rush scene along the way. After arriving, he turned on the lights, started the cashier system, inspected the display cabinets, and, using the time before the delivery arrived, did warm-up exercises such as push-ups and planks in the store, preparing for a day of business.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Receiving new stock, quality inspection, and display and marketing.
description: The courier delivered three large boxes of new outdoor-style goods. Lei Mingxuan carefully opened the boxes and inspected the quality of the khaki and olive-green windbreakers and cargo pants. After confirming that the zippers, loose threads, and fabrics were flawless, he attached custom price tags. He then styled and displayed the clothes on mannequins and shelves, took textured photos and short videos, and posted them on Moments and the VIP customer group for promotion, with the caption: "Mountain-style players, assemble! The first batch of functional hard goods is in store. The feel is unbeatable. First come, first served!"
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and shopping en route.
description: Lei Mingxuan walked to the Ippudo ramen restaurant in IFC Mall and ordered a bowl of tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg and fried chicken for lunch. While eating, he replied on his phone to questions about sizes and prices in the VIP customer group, and also sent a real-shot video of the new arrivals to the regular customer Qian Duoduo. After the meal, he bought an iced Americano at Manner downstairs. On the way back to the store, he stopped by a FamilyMart near Jin Mao Tower and bought Snickers, electrolyte powder, and gummy candies.
location: IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and FamilyMart (World Financial Center Branch 2), No. 100 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Noon operations and customer reception
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic increased. Two young regular customers who had seen the preview on WeChat Moments came in, tried on the clothes, and each bought a hardshell jacket. Regular customer Qian Duoduo messaged via WeChat to reserve a weekend visit and asked to hold a small size in the khaki cargo pants. Lei Mingxuan tried to contact Feng Xiaoyu in Suzhou; the voice call didn't go through, so he sent a message saying the new arrivals were in stock and inviting her to check them out when she came to Shanghai. During this time, he continued serving customers who came into the store.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sales organization and online matters
description: During his free time, Lei Mingxuan sorted out the afternoon sales records (3 waterproof jackets sold), opened Taobao to search for outdoor coffee pots to prepare for the evening research, and reviewed the autumn fabric color cards sent by supplier Zhou Tao to plan next month's ordering approach. He also handled online order inquiries and maintained his work pace.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing up the shop and heading home after closing.
description: Lei Mingxuan started tidying up the display area, used a lint roller to clean dust off the mannequins, put merchandise back in place, and deducted the day's sales inventory from the system. At 17:30 he pulled down the roller shutter to close the store on time, then walked home, enjoying the Lujiazui street scene along the way and sending his mother a WeChat message to say he was almost home.
location: Super Brand Mall at No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Family dinner
description: When Lei Mingxuan returned home in Shanggang Community, his mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared dinner, including scallion-braised pork ribs, stir-fried shrimp, and choy sum. The family of three sat together. He excitedly shared the good momentum of new products selling well; his father Lei Jianguo reminded him to pay attention to after-sales service, while his mother asked how his morning running was going. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Relaxing and resting after the meal
description: After the meal, Lei Mingxuan helped his mother clear the table, then returned to his room and played soft music. He put his morning sportswear into the washing machine and did full-body stretches to ease muscle fatigue. Lying in bed, he browsed the roller skating group chat discussing Saturday's riverside event. Without replying, he rested quietly.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Researching road-trip guides for western Sichuan
description: Lei Mingxuan brewed a pot of Dongding oolong tea and focused in his study on researching self-driving routes in western Sichuan. Using a mind map, he organized information such as road conditions on the Zheduo Mountain section of National Highway 318, the difference between the long and short hiking routes at Yading in Daocheng, accommodation recommendations at various altitudes, and altitude sickness medication (acetazolamide). He also marked several glamping sites and took three pages of notes.
location: Home study in the Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Nighttime online shopping, socializing, and sleep
description: After researching the guide, Lei Mingxuan searched on Taobao and favorited desired items such as a titanium pour-over coffee set and an outdoor inflatable pillow. Shortly after, his friend Shen Jie called him via voice call and they chatted for half an hour. She confirmed that she would come help at the store during the Qingming holiday, and they discussed the style of the online branch. After hanging up, Lei Mingxuan washed up, wrote down three key items for tomorrow (following up on Qian Duoduo's appointment, inquiring about the mall market stall, and weighing himself after the morning run), then turned off the lights and fell asleep.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Morning adaptive jogging and stretching.
description: The alarm went off on time. Sleepy but determined, I got up, put on running shoes and quick-dry clothes, and walked 5 minutes to Lujiazui Central Green Park. I jogged 3 km along the park path, keeping the pace around 7 minutes per km, mainly to warm up. After the run, I did proper post-run stretching by the lawn, focusing on loosening my calves and quadriceps, which were a bit tight from moving boxes yesterday. Completed the morning workout alone.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, No. 160, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Taking a shower, eating a high-protein breakfast, and getting ready before heading out
description: Returned home and took a shower, feeling refreshed. Mother had prepared my favorite soy milk and crispy egg-filled pancake. I also added a portion of boiled chicken breast strips cut last night to ensure protein intake. After the meal, I checked my phone, replied to several WeChat messages I hadn't looked at last night, and confirmed that the two cargo pants that supplier Zhou Tao was going to send today were already on the way. Made all the preparations before going out.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuted to the store and talked with his younger female cousin.
description: Set off on foot from home and headed to the store at Super Brand Mall. On the way, I sent a voice message to my cousin Shen Jie, confirming that she would come to the store to help at 9:30 a.m. on Qingming Festival day, and asked her to help me think about how to take photos for the online branch store promotion. The route passed along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui West Road.
location: Along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui West Road in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations: morning meeting, receiving goods, display, and regular customer care
description: After arriving at the store, I opened the computer to review yesterday's sales report and stepped on the body fat scale to weigh in (80.4 kg, same as yesterday). I had a brief morning meeting with staff member Xiao Lin and divided up today's tasks. Just then, a courier delivered a new batch of products (lightweight sun-protection jackets) that had arrived the day before. After unboxing and quality inspection, I personally hung them in the most prominent spot. During this time, Zheng Kai, the mall property manager, passed by and chatted for a bit about a vacant booth for next month's mall market event, asking if I wanted to go for it. I said I'd think it over and get back to him. I focused on running the store and maintaining relationships with regular customers.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Trying a new restaurant for lunch.
description: Today I didn't go to Ippudo. Instead, I tried the newly opened "Chao Jie" on B1 of Super Brand Mall, ordering a bowl of their signature Chaoshan beef ball kway teow. While waiting for the meal, I used my phone to search Taobao for several outdoor coffee kettles I had previously liked. I added the ones that fit the needs of a Western Sichuan road trip in both appearance and weight to my cart, intending to decide after seeing the reactions to my post tonight. After the meal, I bought a sugar-free iced Americano at a milk tea shop on B1.
location: Chao Jie Restaurant, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In the afternoon, handled store operations and asked for help on an online forum.
description: After the afternoon customer traffic picked up, the regular customer Qian Duoduo arrived at the store as promised. She tried on the khaki cargo pants and immediately ordered them, and he rounded down the price. When she saw the newly hung sun-protection jackets, her eyes lit up, and she suggested making a short styling video about “early spring outdoor sun protection.” He thought it was a good idea and chatted with her a bit more. After seeing her off, he received two more groups of young people trying on outdoor jackets. During lulls in customer traffic, he squeezed in time to search for previously saved posts on Qyer and Mafengwo with his phone, and in his memo he wrote a detailed outline of questions about the Western Sichuan Small Loop. Around 14:00, taking advantage of the store being temporarily empty, he opened his laptop and, following the outline he had drafted that afternoon, posted a detailed self-driving trip plan for the Western Sichuan Small Loop on the two major forums, Qyer and Mafengwo, focusing on route planning, altitude acclimatization, and vehicle requirements. Shortly after the post was published, several fellow travelers replied. Around 16:00, he proactively sent a private message to one of the travelers who had given the most detailed reply, with the username “Highland Traveler,” briefly describing his plan and thanking him for his answers. The other person was very warm and not only shared his experience driving an SUV along the same route last year, but also specifically mentioned a detailed road-trip supplies checklist and strategies for dealing with bad weather. They added each other on WeChat and agreed that he could ask for advice later if any questions came up. He felt it was very rewarding.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing up the shop and purchasing ingredients.
description: After handling the last batch of online orders, he packed up three express parcels and notified the courier to pick them up. He closed the store on time at 18:30. On his walk home, he called his father and asked what home-style dish he wanted to eat. His father said he wanted some sliced boiled mutton, so he stopped by the Pushang Food Market not far from home on the way, carefully picked a fine piece of lamb leg from a familiar mutton stall, and prepared ingredients for the family dinner.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road

name: Family dinner and everyday small talk
description: When he got home, his mother had already put steaming hot dishes on the table. The dinner atmosphere was relaxed. They shared Qian Duoduo's styling suggestions for sun-protective clothing and also mentioned the news about next month's mall market booth. His father praised the white-cut mutton while reminding him to keep a close eye on inventory when stocking new goods and not to overstock. The family of three chatted over dinner, enjoying warm family time.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Nighttime relaxation and physical recovery.

On the way, I reviewed the day: trademark registration launched successfully, the spring promotion plan was finalized, and family relationships were harmonious. I felt everything was on track and especially at ease.

name: Family dinner and sharing good news
description: By the time I got home, my parents were busy in the kitchen, and the table was set with three dishes and a soup: my mother's signature Shanghainese braised pork belly, stir-fried asparagus, stir-fried tomatoes with eggs, and seaweed egg drop soup. At the table I took the initiative to share that I had officially submitted the trademark application for “Xiafei Ji” that day. My parents were very happy when they heard it, and my father rarely said, “Steady and sure, do a good job.” Hearing that made my heart warm.

Han Dong had already booked a table and was waiting for me. He told me he had asked about it in the afternoon, and the weekend afternoon special package was indeed a good deal. We played American eight-ball. My first few shots felt good, but Han Dong's defense was too solid, and in the end he beat me 5 to 3. During the game we talked about the Western Sichuan travel fund plan, and he said that once I set off, I should bring back a stone from Western Sichuan for him. After playing, I went to the front desk to confirm the weekend afternoon private booking discount, added the boss on WeChat, and planned to invite Qin Lang and the others to come together on the weekend.

After showering, I curled up on the sofa, scrolled Bilibili on my phone to watch commentary on the new anime Kaiju No. 8, then browsed Xiaohongshu for unboxing videos of several new designer toys, and also checked my WeChat Moments.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

It showed the package had been picked up and was expected to arrive tomorrow afternoon. Then I browsed the store's VIP customer group and replied to several customers' questions about tomorrow's business hours. I turned off the lights at exactly 11 pm and went to sleep, ending a day that marked the opening of a new chapter in April.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning stretching and personal hygiene.

While eating, he shared the good news of yesterday’s trademark submission for “Xiafei Ji” with his mother. She reminded him to keep a close eye on the follow-up procedures, and he felt warmth in his heart.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

He then held a meeting with clerk Xiao Lin and discussed in detail the mechanics of the "Qingming spring outing outfit mystery box": the boxes came in two tiers, 299 yuan and 499 yuan, each containing 1 main spring outfit item, 2 random accessories, and 1 no-minimum discount coupon. While waiting for his food, he posted a screenshot (with key information blurred) of the approved trademark registration for "Xiafeiji" that he had looked up earlier, with the caption: "New name, new story. He added hashtags such as '#QingmingOutfit #SoloCamping #Techwear' and posted them to his Moments and VIP customer group. Around 15:00, he privately messaged two regular customers, Qian Duoduo and Zhao Min, on WeChat: he recommended parent-child sweatshirts and wide-leg pants to Qian Duoduo, and sent Zhao Min some urban light-outdoor outfit pictures. Both said they would come to the store to try things on over the weekend. After 16:00, he worked with Xiao Lin to refine the event poster's layout and copy, and after finalizing it, they published it on their own promotional channels.

Then he packed up his personal belongings and left work half an hour early, ready to go home and join the family's qingtuan making.

At his regular dried-goods store, he bought salted egg yolks (20 yuan), pork floss (15 yuan), and red bean paste fillings (8 yuan) for his mother to use when making qingtuan. After shopping, he rode back to his home in Shanggang Community.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Making qingtuan at home and recording stories
description: After arriving home, Lei Mingxuan changed into home clothes, washed his hands, and went into the kitchen to help his mother Wang Xiuying make qingtuan. He was responsible for dividing the mugwort glutinous rice dough into portions and wrapping in the filling of chopped spring bamboo shoots, pickled vegetables, and minced meat prepared by his mother, as well as the store-bought salted egg yolk and pork floss. During the process, he guided his mother into telling stories about his grandmother setting up a stall at the alley entrance when she was young. While the qingtuan were steaming, he used his phone's memo app to record details from his mother's stories, including "a honeycomb briquette stove, three children, and shredded radish pancakes at 0.5 yuan each." When his father Lei Jianguo came home, the qingtuan had just come out of the steamer, and the family sat together to taste them. Lei Mingxuan was full of praise for his mother's cooking.
location: Kitchen and dining room, home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family chat and future planning
description: After dinner, the family sat in the living room drinking tea to digest. Lei Mingxuan shared the details of the store's "Spring Outing Outfit Blind Box" event for the Qingming Festival holiday, as well as his idea of using the new brand "Xiafei Ji" to combine clothing with outdoor scenarios, such as making traditional snacks at home. His father, Lei Jianguo, reminded him to mind costs and inventory risks and not to chase gimmicks. His mother, however, was concerned about whether he could rest well.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Personal time and material sorting
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to the bedroom, opened his laptop, and expanded the keywords recorded that night into an essay of about 500 Chinese characters, focusing on his mother's smile while kneading dough and the emotion she expressed when telling stories about her grandmother. When he finished, he published the article on his personal writing WeChat public account.
location: Bedroom at home in Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and Pre-Sleep Preparation

After that, he set an alarm, applied body lotion, and turned off the lights to sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Get up, wash up, and load the offerings into the car
description: In the early morning, I was woken up by my mother. After washing up briefly, I went downstairs. My father had already checked the car. I packed the green rice balls, flowers, incense candles, red paint, and other offerings I had prepared the night before into an eco-friendly bag. My mother prepared an extra box of green rice balls to give to Aunt Zhu, the neighbor. I ate a bowl of small wontons cooked by my mother for breakfast.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drive to the family cemetery
description: I drove, carrying my parents, setting off from home on Pudong Avenue, taking the Luoshan Road elevated road and then the Outer Ring Expressway to Jielong Ancient Garden. The rain had stopped on the way; my parents chatted in the back seat about memories of rain during Qingming in past years, and the atmosphere was calm. The trip took about 54 minutes, and we arrived at the cemetery parking lot at 8:34.
location: From Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Jielong Ancient Garden, No. 759, Jielong First Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Qingming Festival tomb-sweeping ceremony.
description: In Jielong Ancient Garden, I found the family grave marker. I carefully wiped the dust and moss off the tombstone with a damp cloth and an old toothbrush, then traced the faded inscriptions with red paint. My mother laid out green rice balls, fruit, and flowers, lit incense and candles, and softly talked about the family's recent news and her longing for the ancestors. My father silently added soil. Standing before the tombstone, my respect for the ancestors' entrepreneurial spirit and my intention to write the family story into a novel grew even stronger.
location: Jielong Ancient Garden, 759 Jielong First Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Take photos as a memento and clean up the offerings.
description: After the ceremony, I took a commemorative photo with my phone of the skyline visible through the pine and cypress branches, looking toward the old lane. Then I cleaned up the leftover incense, candle remnants, and offerings with my parents, took away the trash, and kept the surroundings tidy.
location: Jielong Ancient Garden, 759 Jielong First Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returned home.
description: Drove back home along the same route. On the way, I told my parents I wanted to write a story about the Lei family, from a stall at the alley entrance to the present. My father supported the idea, and my mother enthusiastically recalled many details about my grandmother that could be added. Arrived downstairs at 10:40.
location: From Jielong Ancient Garden, 759 Jielong First Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Rest and neighborly greetings.
description: After arriving home, I went upstairs to rest and have some water, while my mother took the green rice balls to the neighboring alley to give to Aunt Zhu and chat about Qingming tomb sweeping. In my room, I opened my laptop and checked and replied to a few comments and private messages in the official account backend about how the 'Xiafei Ji' stories resonated.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Outline and develop the novel's structure

At the same time, I searched Xiaohongshu and writing platforms for keywords such as Shanghai lane stories and family oral history, and saved two creative posts about capturing details.

name: Family lunch.

My father reminded me that a story must be truthful to be touching, and my mother happily said she could provide material anytime. After the meal, I took the initiative to clear the dishes, and I told my mother I wanted to eat the yanduxian she makes in the evening.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

I brought the result to my father, who had just gotten off work, to taste. He jokingly said it was even worse than Chinese herbal medicine, which made me laugh out loud.
