name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, and going out
description: On Saturday morning, Lei Mingxuan lounged in bed for a bit before getting up to wash up. He laid a yoga mat on the living room floor and stretched seriously for 20 minutes to loosen up. His mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared steaming wontons and a fried egg. As he ate breakfast, he checked the weather on his phone (cloudy to clear, 16-24°C) and briefly replied to messages in the basketball group chat. After breakfast, he put on a sports T-shirt, shorts, and the climbing shoes he hadn't worn in a while, packed his phone, earphones, water bottle, and waist pack, then went out, scanned a code to unlock a shared bike, and rode leisurely along Pudong Avenue toward Century Avenue for about 20 minutes, enjoying the morning breeze.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the cycling segment along Pudong Avenue

name: Indoor rock climbing experience.
description: Lei Mingxuan cycled to the "Rock Point" indoor climbing gym on the 3rd floor of Century Link Plaza and met up with Zhao Min. Zhao Min had already completed the formalities and helped him pick up a chalk bag and climbing shoes. The two first did a full warm-up of shoulders, back, and fingers. Lei Mingxuan then started with the easiest V0 route in the bouldering area. His first two attempts were a bit rusty, but he made it to the top on the third. With Zhao Min's encouragement, he took on the green V2 route, which tested coordination and core strength. After three attempts, on the last one, at the moment when his dynamic grip nearly slipped, he adjusted his center of gravity and successfully hit the top finishing hold. After landing, his forearms were sore but he was extremely excited. Zhao Min recorded the whole session. The two rested and drank water, and Zhao Min praised him as "gifted," and they agreed to try V3 next time.
location: Rock Point Indoor Climbing Gym, 3rd Floor, Century Link Plaza, No. 1192 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return trip after rock climbing and socializing on the subway.
description: After climbing, Lei Mingxuan used a massage gun to relax his forearms, stretched again, and said goodbye to Zhao Min. He walked a few minutes to Century Avenue Station, took Metro Line 2 back toward Pudong Avenue. The car wasn't crowded. He picked three climbing photos AirDropped by Zhao Min and the 8-second short video of conquering V2, retouched and color-graded them on his phone, then posted on Moments with the caption: "Unlocked a new map—first bouldering experience, V2 conquered! The long-missed full-body soreness—I can feel my adventurous DNA stirring again. Thanks to Coach Zhao for the guidance throughout!" After posting, he gradually received likes and comments from Zhang Wei, Li Na, and others. He replied to each with a smile, feeling happy.
location: Century Avenue Metro Station in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and inside a Metro Line 2 train (from Century Avenue Station to Pudong Avenue Station)

name: Lunch at home
description: When Lei Mingxuan got home, it was time for dinner. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had made her signature scallion oil noodles and stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and his father, Lei Jianguo, had just come back from a stroll. The three sat around the table. As Lei Mingxuan ate the chewy noodles, he gestured animatedly while telling his parents about the morning's rock climbing, especially the tension and excitement of conquering the V2. His father, Lei Jianguo, commented, "This sport is great—it uses your brain and works your whole body." His mother, Wang Xiuying, smiled and told him not to go too wild in the afternoon and to get some rest.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Compilation and review of industrial and commercial annual report materials.
description: After a half-hour rest following the meal, Lei Mingxuan went into the study and began working on the store's annual report. He pulled up four documents on the computer: the 2024 Annual Operating Revenue Details, the Summary of Tax Payment Vouchers, the Employee Social Insurance Payment Records, and the Fixed Assets and Inventory List. He printed them one by one and carefully compared them against the scanned invoices to verify that the revenue and tax figures matched, and confirmed that the social insurance headcount and base amounts were correct. Finally, he organized all the paper documents into a kraft paper file bag labeled “2024 Industrial and Commercial Annual Report,” ready to submit at the administrative service center next week. The whole process was meticulous and focused, laying a solid foundation for the clothing store's compliant operations.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon Rest and Social Interaction
description: After finishing the annual report work, Lei Mingxuan went to the living room, collapsed onto the sofa, and scrolled through his phone to relax. His rock-climbing Moments post had already accumulated nearly 40 likes, with even a few regular clients liking it. He replied to comments with interest and privately messaged Zhao Min to thank her for today's invitation and guidance. Zhao Min replied instantly, saying he had “made remarkable progress and could take on harder routes next time.” He generously replied, “Absolutely!” In the relaxed and pleasant online interaction, he fully unwound both physically and mentally.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Pour-over coffee practice
description: After resting, Lei Mingxuan took out the new Ethiopian Yirgacheffe beans he had bought the day before and began pour-over practice in the kitchen/dining area. He strictly followed the calibrated “optimal parameters”: water temperature 90, medium-fine grind, 15 grams of beans, 30-second bloom, and three-stage circular pouring. The whole brewing process was focused and steady, with a stable wrist. When extraction was complete, a cup of coffee with jasmine aroma and citrus sweet-sour notes appeared before him. The taste was clean with a distinct lingering sweetness, and he felt it was more successful than any previous attempt. Excitedly, he poured a small cup for his mother Wang Xiuying, who was watching TV in the living room. Her eyes lit up, and she praised, “This is delicious! Not sour, not bitter, and a little sweet — much better than the one bought yesterday!” Boosted by his mother's approval, he immediately took a photo and sent it to Zhao Min to show off. Zhao Min liked it instantly and replied, “Impressive, Mingxuan! The crema looks great! You're ready to graduate!”
location: Home (kitchen and dining room) in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Meal preparation, walking, and shopping
description: After the coffee practice, Lei Mingxuan went into the kitchen and offered to help prepare dinner. His mother, Wang Xiuying, planned to make braised spring bamboo shoots and sweet-and-sour spare ribs, so he skillfully peeled the bamboo shoots and cut them into roll-cut chunks, while his mother blanched the ribs beside him. They chatted while working. Lei Mingxuan shared with his mother his detailed idea of upgrading his clothing store into a "buyer-driven multi-brand store." Although she did not fully understand it, she expressed support and reminded him to plan his finances carefully and not to be too rash. After the ingredients were mostly prepped, he changed into casual shoes and went downstairs. He first took two slow laps around the community garden to stretch out his shoulders, which were stiff from rock climbing, then walked to the nearby Pushang Vegetable Market. There he bought three jin of freshly available local loquats at the fruit stall, and at a deli he bought the smoked fish his father loved. He carried the items home in a happy mood.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai - home kitchen, community garden, and Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road.

name: Dinner, family conversation, and watching anime
description: Back home, his father Lei Jianguo had already brewed tea. The family of three sat around the dining table and enjoyed a hearty dinner: sweet-and-sour spare ribs, braised spring bamboo shoots, stir-fried asparagus, and smoked fish. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan mentioned that he would referee at World Square Billiards Hall tomorrow afternoon, that his cousin Shen Jie would come to the store in the afternoon, and that the restocking shipment from Guangzhou would arrive soon. His father reminded him not to forget to go to the store to receive the goods, and his mother told him to come home for lunch tomorrow. After dinner, Lei Mingxuan voluntarily cleared the dishes, then returned to the living room, turned on the TV to cast, and immersed himself in two episodes of a recently popular comedic slice-of-life anime, giggling at the lighthearted plot to ease the fatigue of the day.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening socializing, studying, and relaxation

Zhang Wei complained that his legs were so sore after leg training that he was shaking when walking. Li Na showed off the limited-edition figurine she had just received. The group was full of lively banter. Lei Mingxuan cracked jokes and shared his insights on rock climbing and pour-over coffee. Afterwards, he went into his study, opened the notebook containing the billiards referee rules he had copied down in advance, reviewed the key points, and rehearsed the officiating process for the next day's amateur match. Then he left the study, soaked his hands and feet in hot water to relieve the soreness from rock climbing, and opened Bilibili to watch an informative video about “lighting layout and display techniques for clothing stores” to accumulate knowledge for optimizing the store. He then browsed Xiaohongshu and liked several techwear outfit posts.
location: Home study, bathroom, etc., Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening wash-up and bedtime reading
description: Lei Mingxuan got up and went to the bathroom to wash up carefully, applied a little moisturizing lotion, then returned to the bedroom. He set the alarm for 9 a.m. the next day and charged his phone. Before bed, he reviewed the day's experiences: from the challenge of rock climbing and the success of pour-over coffee to the warm company of family, he felt full of contentment. He opened the bedside novel 'Dreaming Back to the Foreign Concessions', immersed himself in reading a chapter, then turned off the lights around 11 p.m. and fell asleep peacefully.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

My body felt much looser.

location: Balcony at Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

His mother reminded him not to skimp on lunch. After the meal, he changed into a black T-shirt and cargo pants, grabbed his action camera, backpack, and baseball cap, and headed out feeling fresh.

name: Refereeing an amateur billiards friendly match and post-match exchange
description: Arrived early at World Plaza Billiards Hall and, together with organizer Li Qiang, inspected the cloth and pockets of three American nine-ball tables to confirm they met standards. They also did a final run-through of the schedule, bracket, and scoring rules, and he proactively chatted with several players warming up; the atmosphere was good. At 9 a.m. the competition officially began, and he served as the head referee, responsible for calls and scoring on all three tables. Throughout the four-round knockout tournament, he stayed focused, moved decisively, and announced every call clearly. In particular, on one disputed shot he firmly ruled 'foul: the cue ball made first contact,' earning respect from both sides. During a break between games, he explained the 'three balls across the line' break technique to a few newcomers and received praise. After the match, in the rest area, event planner Huang Lei came over to greet him, handed him a business card, spoke highly of his refereeing, and proposed inviting him to referee his company's team-building events or collaborate on clothing procurement. He smiled and said they could talk, exchanged WeChat contacts, but did not agree immediately. Afterwards, he helped Li Qiang clean up the tables, scoreboard, and bottled water, and briefly reviewed the event. Li Qiang thanked him for his professional performance, and he in turn thanked Li Qiang for the invitation, agreeing to cooperate next time. The whole morning was both enjoyable and full of new possibilities.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: New arrival inspection and shelving at the store
description: At 1:30 p.m., he returned to the store on the second floor of Super Brand Mall. The property management had received several boxes of 'mountain-style functional' restock items on his behalf, and they were already at the warehouse door, sent by Wu Fang. He opened the boxes to check: 8 olive-green multi-pocket utility vests, 6 khaki detachable functional pants, and 12 windproof long-sleeved T-shirts, all with correct styles, colors, and sizes. He then hung the new items in the mountain-style section, adjusted the lighting and displays, and opened the cashier system to update inventory. At 2:30 p.m., his cousin Shen Jie arrived in a simple off-white outfit. After seeing the new arrivals, she suggested putting together a set of looks with oversized hoodies and cargo pants to post on WeChat Moments. They took several outfit photos with their phones, and he nodded repeatedly, taking her suggestion.

Then he tried a slow, small stream poured in circles, which took 2 minutes 30 seconds. After inviting mother Wang Xiuying to taste, she felt the second brew was smoother and more gently acidic. Lei Mingxuan decided to make the slow small-stream circular pour his new standard technique.

Then Mingxuan turned the store's spotlights to maximum brightness and used his phone's portrait mode to shoot close-ups of the central display stand and the side-hanging pieces. He guided Lin Zi to photograph mannequin outfits from multiple angles, emphasizing the texture of the outdoor jacket fabric and the backpack's carrying system. Mingxuan also modeled himself, using a rowing machine's driving posture to simulate loaded hiking and striking several dynamic poses with trekking poles.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Wrapping up the photo shoot and shipping packages.
description: As the light faded, Lei Mingxuan and Lin Zi finished shooting all the material. Mingxuan felt in good form today and captured several great poster-quality shots. After organizing the material, he noticed the hardshell jacket from the day-before-yesterday's return/exchange (with a buckle defect) was still in the store. So he confirmed the details with Lin Zi, took the jacket downstairs, walked to the Hive Box self-service lockers inside Lujiazui Metro Station, scanned the waybill number, and completed the shipment.
location: Hive Box Express Locker, Lujiazui Metro Station, No. 158 Huayuanshiqiao Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Pre-closing tidying and online warm-up
description: Back at the store, Lei Mingxuan and Lin Zi restored the displays that had been disturbed during the photo shoot, put all the merchandise back in place, and checked the tags. Mingxuan opened his phone gallery, selected 3 comparison photos of the display before and after and 2 model outfit photos, lightly edited them with Xingtu, and posted them on Xiaohongshu with the caption 'Sunlight just right, mountain-style gear refreshed with urban functional vibes.' Then he sent a set of photos in the store's WeChat customer group with the note 'Online first release tomorrow, take a sneak peek today,' and set up a 0-yuan lucky draw for a 50-yuan no-threshold coupon, which immediately drew comments and interactions from several regular customers.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Closing the store and returning home, family dinner, and evening rest.
description: At 18:00 closed the store on time. Lei Mingxuan hung the closed sign, said goodbye to Lin Zi, took Metro Line 2 from Lujiazui Station to Dongchang Road Station, and returned home to Shanggang Community. He arrived home at 18:30. His mother and father had already prepared dinner, which was steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and mixed grain rice. While eating, Mingxuan shared the display photos he had taken today with his parents. His father said, "It looks like the real thing," while his mother asked whether he wanted to bring some fruit to the store tomorrow. After dinner, he rested for half an hour, then handled phone messages and saw that the Xiaohongshu note posted in the afternoon had received 12 likes and 3 comments. One of the comments asked how to buy the hardshell jacket, and he immediately replied with the store address. Then he changed into professional fitness shorts and a quick-dry tank top, placed a sports towel, water bottle, and folding yoga mat in his bag, and prepared to go out to exercise.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening fitness training and cycling home at night.
description: Lei Mingxuan walked 5 minutes from home and arrived at the community gym on B1 of the Standard Chartered Bank Building at 20:00 sharp. He adjusted the seat position of the rowing machine and set it for a 30-minute constant-resistance workout, paying special attention to his power rhythm and feeling the engagement of his glutes and posterior chain. His movements became much smoother, and after 30 minutes he was drenched in sweat. After the workout, he immediately laid out a yoga mat in the locker room, opened a yoga tutorial video on his phone, and did 20 minutes of static stretching and core strengthening focused on the hip flexors and lower back. He felt the soreness in his body effectively relieved. At 21:00 he left the gym, feeling refreshed. Instead of walking straight home, he scanned a code to unlock a shared bike and rode slowly along Century Avenue for 15 minutes back home.
location: Community gym at B1, Standard Chartered Bank Tower, No. 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pour-over coffee and full-day record
description: After arriving home, Lei Mingxuan took a warm shower. Then in the kitchen, he washed and preheated his beloved Hario V60 dripper, weighed out 15 grams of lightly roasted Ethiopia Yirgacheffe beans, boiled water, and brewed the coffee. He focused on controlling the water stream, watched the CO2 bubbles released during the bloom, then poured in the water slowly. When he took a sip, bright citrus acidity and a faint jasmine floral aroma blossomed in his mouth. Then he picked up his phone and logged the day's meals (breakfast: oatmeal, egg, kiwi; lunch: beef brisket rice in clear soup; dinner: steamed fish, broccoli, mixed-grain rice) and exercise details (30-minute morning run, 30 minutes on the rowing machine, 20 minutes of yoga) in the Health app, checked the calorie deficit, and nodded with satisfaction.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Bedtime reading
description: At 22:00, Lei Mingxuan put down his phone, turned on the bedside lamp, and read a few pages of The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry, which he was currently reading, feeling the protagonist's inner journey on his long walk and imagining that his physical reserve for a self-driving trip through western Sichuan had taken another step forward. At 22:30, he turned off the light on time and fell into a deep sleep with the satisfaction of a full and productive day.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning run and social sharing
description: The 06:55 alarm went off. He got up and changed into his workout gear. At 07:05 he left home and jogged to Lujiazui Central Green Park, completing a 5 km run at a pace of 6 minutes 10 seconds per kilometer. After the run, he stretched on a park bench, took photos of the lawn and the Lujiazui buildings, and shared them in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat with the caption 'Friday opener, full of energy!'
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go home, wash up, and have breakfast
description: Arrived home at 07:45 and took a shower to freshen up. My mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared breakfast: fresh pork wontons and a fried egg. I chatted with her while eating and mentioned that today the store would be running a new product promotion, so it might be busy.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the store
description: Left at 08:30, walked to Lujiazui Metro Station, took Metro Line 2 to Lujiazui Station, and then walked to Super Brand Mall after exiting the station.
location: Lujiazui Metro Station in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the area along the metro line.

name: Opening preparations and handover
description: Arrived at Store A-208 on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall at 09:00, checked the themed display area 'Urban Function for Mountain Hiking' and confirmed the props were intact. Told shop assistant Xiao Lin today's work priorities: focus on online promotion in the morning, and have her keep an eye on the store and online inquiries.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online promotion and interaction for new mountain-style products.
description: Starting at 09:15, he used his computer to write the new-product introduction copy, drawing on the comparison video, outfit photos, and fabric detail shots taken yesterday. He approached it from two angles — outdoor aesthetic inspiration and hardcore technical support — polished the text for nearly two hours, and laid it out in the Xingtu app. At 11:40 he posted it on time to Moments, the VIP customer group, and the store community, with the caption: “Friday drop! The full mountain-style new collection has launched. Lao Lei personally tested it — urban functionality knows no limits! Book an in-store fitting, or drop a comment or DM me!” After posting, the response on Moments and in the groups was enthusiastic. Qian Duoduo instantly replied asking about the shell jacket size, and Feng Xiaoyu sent a private message saying she would bring friends next week. Lei Mingxuan replied to each one and logged the appointments.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and online replies.
description: At 12:05, went down to Xinwang Restaurant on B1 of Super Brand Mall, ordered beef chow fun and iced lemon tea. While eating, scrolled through his phone and replied to new messages asking about sizes.
location: Xinwang Tea Restaurant, B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store work and closing
description: Returned to the store at 13:00, first checked the online inquiries with Xiao Lin and coached her on how to reply to questions about the fabric's water-repellent rating. From 13:30 to 15:00, he received an appointment customer, Qian Duoduo. She tried on two hardshell jackets. Lei Mingxuan recommended the sand-colored one and taught her how to stow the hood. Qian Duoduo finally ordered the hardshell jacket and a pair of techwear pants. During a lull in business from 15:00 to 15:30, he used his phone's memo to note the items needed for tomorrow's outing: sunscreen, hat, folding chair, picnic mat, thermos, and a light jacket. From 15:30 to 16:30, he had a video call with customer Feng Xiaoyu, showing the pocket design of the techwear vest; she said she would come to the store next Tuesday to try it on. From 16:30 to 17:30, he initiated interaction in the customer group, asking everyone to leave comments about their ideal styling scenarios. From 17:30 to 18:00, he sorted out today's appointment records and orders and tidied the displays together with Xiao Lin. He closed the store on time at 18:00 and said goodbye to Xiao Lin.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home and buying fruit
description: At 18:10, I set off from Super Brand Mall, took Metro Line 2 and transferred to Line 6 to Yuanshen Sports Center Station, then walked home after exiting the station. On the way, I stopped by Guobo City Fresh Fruit (Zhaoyuan Road store) at the entrance of the residential area and bought a bag of the tangerines my mother likes to eat, arriving home at 18:40.
location: Guobo Urban Fresh Fruit (Zhaoyuan Road Store), Zhaoyuan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: As he pushed open the door, the aroma of braised pork was already wafting from the kitchen. Lei Mingxuan washed his hands, put on an apron, and was in charge of cutting water spinach. While working, he told his mother about the response to today's online promotion, mentioning that Qian Duoduo had bought clothes. His mother chuckled when she heard this, and his father Lei Jianguo, in the living room, rarely praised him, saying "the approach is on the right track."
location: Home kitchen at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening yoga stretching
description: After the meal, he rested for 20 minutes and watched TV with his parents for a while. Then he returned to his bedroom, spread out the yoga mat, opened Keep, and followed along with a 20-minute yin yoga session, focusing on stretching the back of the thighs, hips, and shoulders to relieve the fatigue of standing all day.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pour-over coffee practice and flavor notes
description: After yoga, I went to the kitchen, took out Ethiopian Yirgacheffe coffee beans, and practiced the three-stage pour-over method with the Hario V60. Water temperature 92, bloom for 30 seconds, total pour 300g, extraction 2 minutes 30 seconds. The brewed coffee had bright citrus acidity and improved body. In the coffee diary, I recorded the parameters and flavors: citrus, jasmine, with caramel sweetness in the aftertaste.
location: Home kitchen at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Social media review and bedtime reading
description: After putting away the coffee equipment, he went back to the study. He checked WeChat Moments and saw 80+ likes and 3 new appointments. He opened Xiaohongshu to check the post data and replied to comments. At 21:00, he picked up The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry, leaned against the headboard, and read for half an hour.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: At 21:30, I washed up and applied basic moisturizer. Back in the bedroom, I put my phone on silent and thought back on a fulfilling day: the promotion was successful, the family was warm, and both body and mind were nourished. At 23:00, I turned off the lights and went to sleep.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sleep
description: Turn off the lights on time, fall asleep, enter deep sleep, and recharge for tomorrow's family outing and next week's work.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake up naturally, morning preparation, and energy replenishment
description: Lei Mingxuan woke up naturally on Saturday morning. The sky outside was bright, perfect for going out. He skipped his morning run, washed up briefly, drank some water, ate the sandwich and milk he had prepared the night before, and packed beef jerky, nuts, and electrolyte drink into his backpack to prepare for a spring outing in Suzhou.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Enjoyed the hearty breakfast his mother prepared
description: Lei Mingxuan came into the living room. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had already pan-fried scallion pancakes, cooked plain rice porridge, and prepared fried eggs with dried radish. His father, Lei Jianguo, neatly dressed, was watching the news and urged him to eat quickly. Lei Mingxuan ate while chatting with his parents about preorders for new products on the online store. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Residential Quarter, 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pre-departure checks and loading the car
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan loaded the backpack, picnic mat, and camera into the trunk of the car. His mother changed into spring clothes, and his father put on casual leather shoes and prepared a thermos of hot tea. Once everything was ready, Lei Mingxuan locked the front door, started the car, and set the navigation to Humble Administrator's Garden.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, and the parking space downstairs

name: Drive to Suzhou
description: Lei Mingxuan drove from Shanggang Community, taking the Inner Ring Elevated Road onto the Shanghai-Nanjing Expressway. Traffic was heavy on Saturday, with about 15 minutes of slow movement on the Huaqiao section. Teresa Teng's old songs played in the car. He and his mother chatted about the funny incident of a friend coming to the store to try on clothes, and his father also asked about the store's operations. The whole ride was full of laughter and cheerful talk.
location: From Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, traveling on the Shanghai-Nanjing Expressway (G42) from Shanghai to Suzhou.

name: Visit the Humble Administrator’s Garden.
description: After Lei Mingxuan parked the car in a parking lot near Lion Grove Garden, the family of three entered the Humble Administrator's Garden. In April, the azaleas and wisteria in the garden were in full bloom. Lei Mingxuan acted as a tour guide, explaining the subtlety of the borrowed view of North Temple Pagoda from Yuanxiang Hall and the story behind Lotus Breeze Pavilion. His mother happily asked him to take photos, and his father also took the initiative to have a photo taken with his mother in front of Small Flying Rainbow. The family was in high spirits.
location: Humble Administrator's Garden, No. 178 Dongbei Street, Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China

name: Strolling along Pingjiang Road
description: After leaving the Humble Administrator's Garden, the three walked across Baita East Road and headed south along Pingjiang Road. The old street's stone-paved path was warm and pleasant, and hand-pulled boats glided on the river. They visited several Suzhou embroidery fan shops and cultural creative stores, then Lei Mingxuan, following the guide, turned into an alley and found a highly rated restaurant online.
location: Pingjiang Road Historical and Cultural Block, Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China (from Baita East Road to the southern section)

name: Family lunch: savoring authentic Suzhou flavors.
description: The three sat down at Wu Ji Xiaoyuan Restaurant in an alley on Pingjiang Road. Lei Mingxuan ordered squirrel-shaped mandarin fish, water shield and shredded pork soup, sizzling eel, and shepherd's purse wontons, and proactively poured tea and served food for his parents. During the meal, his mother talked about Lei Mingxuan's mischievous childhood stories, and his father also teased him; the family enjoyed a warm and happy time together.
location: Wu Ji Xiaoyuan Restaurant in a small alley on the south side of Pingjiang Road, Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China

name: After-dinner digestion and surprise dessert.
description: After the meal, the three of them took a walk along Pingjiang Road to aid digestion. Lei Mingxuan led his parents into the Taohuayuanji handmade yogurt shop in a side alley and ordered sweet osmanthus fermented rice yogurt. His mother tasted it and praised it endlessly. The three sat by the riverside window watching sightseeing boats, enjoying a slow, leisurely time.
location: Taohuayuan Ji Handmade Yogurt Shop in a side alley off Pingjiang Road, Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China

name: City walk along Jinji Lake and family portrait photo
description: Lei Mingxuan drove to the Jinji Lake scenic area and strolled along the lakeside walkway, enjoying the city skyline and the shimmering lake. In front of the Yuanrong Sculpture, he asked a passerby to take a family photo of the three of them; his father wore a relaxed smile, and his mother leaned close beside him. Lei Mingxuan set the group photo as his phone wallpaper.
location: Jinji Lake Scenic Area (near the Ferris wheel on the east section of Suzhou Avenue), Suzhou Industrial Park, Wuzhong District, Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China

name: Drove back to Shanghai.
description: On the way back, they took the Shanghai-Nanjing Expressway, and traffic was smooth. His mother flipped through photos in the back seat while his father took a nap. Lei Mingxuan made a brief stop at the Yangcheng Lake service area so his parents could stretch, and bought local specialty snacks. Piano music played in the car, and the atmosphere was peaceful.
location: China's G42 Shanghai-Nanjing Expressway, Suzhou to Shanghai section, passing Yangcheng Lake Service Area.

name: Return home, rest, and tidy up a bit
description: Arrived home safely in the evening. Mother sorted the items brought back, and father watered the potted plants on the balcony. Lei Mingxuan put away the picnic mat and backpack. His phone showed 18,000 steps, and feeling his calves sore, he rested for a while.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Warm family dinner
description: Mother simply stir-fried tomato and eggs and a plate of fresh vegetables, and reheated the pork rib soup. The family of three sat around the table. Father remarked that today's squirrel-shaped mandarin fish was more authentic than Songhelou's, and Mother praised the yogurt from Pingjiang Road. Lei Mingxuan served his parents soup and dishes, enjoying family time.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Residential Quarter, 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening relaxation: organizing photos and light stretching.
description: Lei Mingxuan sat on the sofa, imported the photos from his phone to his tablet, selected nine to lightly retouch, and planned to post them on Xiaohongshu. He then spread a yoga mat in the living room and performed about 15 minutes of active stretching, focusing on loosening the hips, hamstrings, and calves.
location: Home living room, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pour-over coffee and bedtime reading
description: After taking a shower and changing into loungewear, Lei Mingxuan brewed a cup of single-origin light-roast coffee from Suzhou in his study by hand, savoring the citrus and jasmine aromas and lively acidity. He read “The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry” while drinking coffee, immersed in the book.
location: The study at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Bedtime preparation and restful sleep
description: Lei Mingxuan checked the store group and backend messages, replied to regular customers' inquiries, and confirmed the next day's restocking list. Then he turned off the lights and reflected on a fulfilling day: his parents' smiles, the family photo at Jinji Lake, and his mother's satisfaction, falling asleep peacefully with gratitude.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: On a Grain Rain morning, a light rain was drizzling outside the window. You woke up naturally, feeling a bit sore from yesterday's trip to Suzhou. You did a 5-minute cat stretch in bed to wake up your spine, then got out of bed, laid out a yoga mat in the living room, and did 10 minutes of downward dog, glute bridges, and twisting stretches to release the tight hip flexors and backs of your legs, setting a foundation for the new day.
location: Room 302, Building 7, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go to the morning market to buy seasonal ingredients
description: You put on your waterproof jacket, grabbed your cloth bag and folding umbrella, and walked 15 minutes to Pushang Market. You headed straight to the familiar stall and picked fresh spring bamboo shoots with soil on them (2), green clover (half a catty), tender shepherd's purse (a bunch), and leafy lettuce (2). You chatted with the vendor you knew and bought some water chestnuts and local strawberries on the spur of the moment. Carrying your full haul, you walked home contentedly.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Putting away ingredients and sharing photos.
description: After getting home, you wrapped the roots of the spring bamboo shoots in damp paper towels and put them in the refrigerator, and put the other vegetables away by category. Then you sat down on the sofa, opened your phone's photo album, and picked out a few photos taken yesterday by Jinji Lake in Suzhou — especially the family portrait and the close-up of your mom smiling brightest. You casually sent them to the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat with the caption: 'Grain Rain day — yesterday's achievements, today I'll arrange it at home.'
location: Room 302, Building 7, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the store
description: You change into a light casual blazer and jeans and bring your notebook. Leaving home, you walk to the Zhangyang Road Minsheng Road bus stop, take Bus 610 or Pudong Bus 62, get off at the Lujiazui Ring Road stop, and walk into Super Brand Mall. Taking the bus on a rainy day saves you the trouble of finding parking and getting wet.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Basic store operations and customer relationship maintenance
description: After arriving at the store, you open your computer and order a Manner latte delivery from B1 of the mall. You see that the Moments post and community promotion data released yesterday look good (over 80 likes, plus 2 new customer fitting appointments). While organizing yesterday's fitting records, you reply on WeChat to regular customer Feng Xiaoyu's question about the new sun-protection jackets. Property manager Zheng Kai stops by, chats a bit about yesterday's trip to Suzhou, and also asks about the venue arrangement for next weekend's mall event.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and communicating with store staff
description: At 12:00, you went to B1 and had a bowl of the signature Akamaru ramen with an extra soft-boiled egg. After eating, you wandered around the mall and looked at the display styles of other menswear stores. At 13:00, you returned to the store. Xiao Lin had just finished eating, so you chatted with her for a while and asked how the feedback from last week's online event was, laying the groundwork for the afternoon's delegation.
location: Ippudo Ramen, B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store employee authorization and operations guidance
description: With low customer traffic in the afternoon, shop assistant Xiao Lin plucked up her courage and formally asked you to let her handle the daily operation of the store's WeChat Moments. You listened carefully, and thinking that you had indeed been spread too thin lately, readily agreed: 'Okay, this matter is up to you. I'll check the data on weekends. Starting today, use your own phone to try it, and I'll teach you how to read the data.' Then you spent 30 minutes guiding Xiao Lin on how to use the phone's portrait mode to photograph clothing details and shared several key copywriting points for the 'mountain-style' customer group. Xiao Lin was eager to try and immediately started practicing by photographing the newly displayed mountain-style display in the store.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In-depth guidance and online interaction follow-up
description: Xiao Lin finished shooting the first set of products (3 new items, including a khaki hardshell jacket and a UV-protection jacket) and completed the initial draft of the copy. After you reviewed it, you helped her adjust the wrinkles and lighting angle on one of the garments, and suggested she combine 'mountain style' and 'urban commute' in the writing. You asked her to send you the first Moments post for a preview, and after you made a few edits, she clicked send. Afterward, you helped her briefly group her past VIP customers. At 4 p.m., you used the store phone to reply to a customer who had made an appointment in the morning, answering their question about windproof performance, and arranged for them to come to the store tomorrow afternoon to try it on.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home
description: You patted Xiao Lin on the shoulder with satisfaction and said, 'Not bad. I'll look at today's data over the weekend. If there are any issues, find me in the group chat.' Then you closed the shop and left. You took Line 2 from Lujiazui Metro Station, transferred to Line 6 at Century Avenue Station, got off at Deping Road Station, and walked home 10 minutes later.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-rain walk and stretching on the riverside promenade
description: Back home, you changed into workout clothes and running shoes, then walked 27 minutes with an umbrella to the Laobaidu Riverside Promenade. The air after the rain was especially fresh, and a thin mist hung over the river. Instead of walking fast, you strolled for 40 minutes along the riverside path at a relaxed pace. On the way, you stopped briefly at the "Laobaidu" observation deck and took a few atmospheric photos of the river view. Afterward, you did 10 minutes of full-body stretching on a bench beside the path, focusing on releasing the sore and swollen quadriceps and calves from yesterday's hike.
location: Laobaidu Riverside Greenbelt, Weifang West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cooking a Grain Rain Family Feast
description: You get home, put on an apron, and start preparing the ingredients. You peel the spring bamboo shoots and cut them into roll-cut chunks, blanch them in cold water to remove the bitter taste; clean the clover; chop the shepherd's purse and cook it with shredded tofu into a soup. You make four dishes: oil-braised spring bamboo shoots, clover with scallion oil, shepherd's purse and tofu soup, and stir-fried shredded asparagus lettuce, deliberately using less oil and salt. Your father brings out his treasured yellow rice wine and has a small drink.
location: Kitchen and dining room, Room 302, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and evening weigh-in
description: The family of three sat around the dining table. The moment his mother tasted the first bite of braised bamboo shoots, she praised: 'So fresh! Even better than what restaurants make!' His father also added half a bowl of rice. While eating, you shared the amusing story of Xiao Lin volunteering on his own at the shop today, and your parents were pleased that you knew how to delegate. After the meal, you cleared the dishes, then stood barefoot on the scale in the bedroom: 78.3 kg, the same as yesterday—you've controlled it well these past few days.
location: Room 302, Building 7, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pour-over coffee practice and recording
description: You boiled the water and ground a batch of Yunnan washed beans (light roast) that you bought back from Suzhou yesterday. Today you focused on the stability of your circling motion when pouring water, to ensure even extraction. You brewed with a small stream and slow circles, then smelled the wet aroma, which had citrus and malty sweetness. After a few sips, the cup was clean with a long finish. You jotted down today's coffee-to-water ratio (1:15) and brew time (2'10") in your flavor notebook.
location: Pour-over coffee corner in the living room, Room 302, Building 7, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leisure and social time before bed
description: You leaned against the headboard, scrolled through your phone for a while, and replied to a few likes and comments on today's Moments post. Then your friend 'Xiaofan' pulled you into two rounds of Honor of Kings on WeChat (ranked matches, one win and one loss), and you chatted casually while playing. At 22:00, you put down your phone, turned off the light, listened to the rain gradually fading outside the window, and fell asleep contentedly.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 7, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Shanggang Residential Community

name: Morning run and breakfast.
description: I got up at 7 a.m., put on quick-dry sportswear, and walked to Lujiazui Central Green Park for a morning run. I ran 5.5 kilometers at a pace of 6 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer. I returned home at 8:10. My mother had prepared large wontons with shepherd's purse and pork and freshly squeezed orange juice for breakfast. While eating, I replied to a customer's price inquiry on my phone.

I sent workout data screenshots to the "Hardcore Fat Loss Camp" and "Pudong Three Musketeers" groups, and got likes and encouragement from my friends Zhang Wei and Xie Fei.

Then he opened his computer to confirm the Tuesday fabric-sample handoff process and wrote out the next day's work list; he entered his dinner data into the health app and confirmed that his calorie intake was within the planned range.
location: Bedroom/study at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up, soaking feet, and relaxing into sleep before bed
description: After washing up in the bathroom, he heated hot water to soak his feet and sat on the sofa browsing Autohome's Western Sichuan self-driving forum to check the latest road conditions. After soaking his feet, his whole body relaxed. He went into the bedroom, turned off the light, lay down, set his phone to Do Not Disturb, relaxed his muscles, and prepared for sleep, feeling at ease about the Western Sichuan preparations and progress on shop matters. He fell asleep late at night.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning weigh-in and yoga stretching after waking up
description: At 6:55 a.m., Lei Mingxuan was naturally woken by his body clock and felt refreshed. He stepped on the electronic scale, weighing 78.0 kg, which remained stable. Opening the window, he felt the humid, cloudy air after the rain and did 5 minutes of abdominal breathing. At 7:15, he did a 15-minute Hatha yoga stretch on the yoga mat in his bedroom, focusing on releasing tension in his neck, shoulders, and hips, to prepare for the day.
location: Room 1202, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Hand-brew coffee and breakfast planning
description: After yoga, he moved into his workday coffee ritual. He hand-ground Yirgacheffe coffee beans, slowly poured water from a thin-spout kettle, and made a fragrant cup of pour-over coffee. Carrying the coffee to the balcony, he observed the morning scene of the alley while mentally planning the day's priorities: mountain-style new products and online branch research. At 8:05, the breakfast prepared by his mother Wang Xiuying was already on the table: rice porridge, pickled vegetables, fried eggs, and pan-fried buns. He quickly finished breakfast and jotted down his to-dos in his phone's memo: check mountain-style new products, browse Taobao and Douyin store admission policies, and make a comparison table in the evening to contact Shen Jie.
location: Room 1202, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting ready to go out and commuting by car
description: Changed into a casual suit, grabbed his commuter bag and car keys. Before leaving, he took a photo of the monstera on the balcony, quickly edited it, and posted it on Moments: “Good morning, the vitality of a cloudy day.” At 8:25, he drove out of the residential community parking lot, drove onto Pudong Avenue, turned onto Century Avenue, and played post-rock music via Bluetooth on the way. While waiting at a red light, he quickly scrolled through messages in the Pudong Three Musketeers group and replied to Li Na's question about weekend windbreakers, telling her he was free Saturday morning.
location: From the parking lot of Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, to the parking lot of Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and online research.
description: Arrived at the Xiafei Ji store on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, first did a routine walk-through and adjusted the mannequin styling. At 9:30, store clerk Lin Xiaoyu arrived. The two checked the SKUs of the new mountain-style series, rearranged them in prime display areas, and adjusted the spotlights. When foot traffic increased, they attended to customers; in between, they used their phones to browse Taobao and Douyin store onboarding policies in fragments and noted key information in a notepad.
location: Xiafei Collection, Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and industry news catch-up
description: He let Lin Xiaoyu go eat first, walked to Food Republic on the B1 level of Shanghai Tower, and ordered a claypot rice with black bean spare ribs, finishing it quickly. While waiting, he scrolled through local fashion industry community groups and read an article on Huxiu about low-cost tactics for private-domain e-commerce mini-programs in the clothing sector.
location: Food Republic Shanghai Central Store, No. 501 Yincheng Middle Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Noon yoga for shoulder and neck stretching
description: After lunch had settled, he spread out a yoga mat in the open space behind the cash register and did a 15-minute stretch for his shoulders, neck, and spine. Regular customer Qian Duoduo and her friend came in and jokingly called him a workaholic. He stood up to respond and then recommended the new tech vest to them.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon: minding the store, in-depth customer reception, and online planning
description: In the afternoon, most of the effort went into in-depth customer service. For Qian Duoduo and a friend, he introduced the new functional vest's waterproof zipper and detachable brim design; the two tried it on and paid promptly. At 3 p.m., Feng Xiaoyu, a regular customer who works in HR, sent a WeChat message asking about cargo-pants styling. He took a try-on photo and recommended a hoodie in the same color. While Lin Xiaoyu was assisting customers, he used the cash register computer to organize the e-commerce information from his phone notepad into Excel, initially dividing it into three columns—Taobao, Douyin Shop, and WeChat Mini Program—and listing comparison items such as cost and deposit.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store closing procedures and customer flow adjustment
description: In the evening, as customer traffic decreased, I began closing up the store. I confirmed the accounts and packed two pieces of clothing from online pre-sales awaiting shipment. In the parking lot, I sent a voice message to my cousin Shen Jie, asking to consult the e-commerce comparison table in the evening, and Shen Jie readily agreed.
location: From the parking lot of Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the Xiafei Ji store

name: After-work commute and car refueling
description: Drove home, passing Sinopec Xiangshan Gas Station on Yushan Road, and topped up the tank on the spur of the moment to prepare for the weekend activities. After filling up, got out of the car to stretch, saw the clear night sky, and felt in a good mood.
location: Sinopec Xiangshan Gas Station, No. 1928 Yushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dinner and family briefing
description: Got home just in time for dinner. Mom made scallion-roasted pork chops and stir-fried pea shoots. At the table, we talked about the interesting customers in the store and how the new mountain-style products were popular, and I brought up the idea of an online branch store. Father Lei Jianguo asked about the progress. He said he would make a detailed table after discussing it with Shen Jie in the evening. Father nodded approvingly, saying it's better to be prudent.
location: Room 1202, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In-depth research on e-commerce platforms and creation of comparison tables
description: After the meal, took fruit into the study and officially began researching online branch stores. Opened laptop and phone, carefully studied backend policies of Taobao, Douyin Shop, and WeChat Mini Store, covering deposit, commission rates, withdrawal rules, etc. Used Excel to create a comparison table of the pros and cons of online branch store platforms, comparing in detail from dimensions such as cost, difficulty, suitability for new product launches, and convenience of private-domain conversion.
location: Study, Room 1202, Building 2, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Consulted my cousin Shen Jie and determined the direction for testing the waters
description: After completing the form, he immediately contacted his cousin Shen Jie via WeChat voice. Based on Xiafei Ji's brand tone, she suggested starting with a WeChat Mini Program first, which is low-cost and can convert existing physical store customers into private traffic. She also suggested considering content seeding on Xiaohongshu and setting up an enterprise account. Lei Mingxuan recorded the suggestions in detail, highlighted the two directions of WeChat Mini Program and Xiaohongshu, and agreed to discuss in person the next afternoon when she came to the store to try on sun-protective clothing.
location: Study, Room 1202, Building 2, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Discussed with his father and sought his support
description: After the voice call ended, he took the tablet to the living room and showed the spreadsheet and Shen Jie's suggestions to his father, who was watching sports news. His father put on reading glasses, browsed carefully, then reminded him to be prudent and not to invest a lot of money at the start, suggesting that he first build a membership system to retain regular customers. Lei Mingxuan said he planned to test the waters with a mini program and control inventory costs. His father patted him on the shoulder and encouraged him to try boldly.
location: Living room, Room 1202, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening foot-soaking inspiration, washing up, reading, and going to bed
description: In high spirits, he soaked his feet in hot water while opening his phone memo to note down the first-phase feature ideas for the WeChat Mini Program: new-product reservations, an online-offline integrated membership points system, limited-time discounts, in-store pickup, same-city flash delivery, and even an outfit-sharing UGC module. After washing up, he leaned against the headboard and read One Man's Pilgrimage for 15 minutes, letting the story settle his entrepreneurial excitement. At 11:15 p.m. he turned off the light and went to bed, falling asleep with a sense of accomplishment and anticipation for tomorrow.
location: Room 1202, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Lei Mingxuan woke up naturally and weighed 78.2 kg. He did some simple stretches, then checked the camping gear he had prepared last night, confirming the pour-over kettle, windproof stove, tent, and other items were all in order. He drank a glass of warm water and ate a banana to store up energy for the upcoming camping trip.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Simple breakfast and loading equipment into the car
description: Lei Mingxuan quickly finished the sandwich and milk his mother made, then carried the camping gear and plenty of drinking water downstairs in batches, carefully placing them in the trunk and back seat of the car, making sure they were fixed firmly and would not affect driving safety.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the community parking lot.

name: Pick someone up and buy breakfast.
description: Lei Mingxuan drove off, first stopping at his usual breakfast shop on Dongchang Road to buy four portions of stuffed glutinous rice rolls, salty soy milk, and tea eggs, then picked up Zhang Wei, Zhao Min, Ma Lei, and Han Dong one by one. Everyone ate breakfast in the car while excitedly discussing the day's camping plans, and the atmosphere was lively. Lei Mingxuan noticed that the vehicle's power response remained responsive even when fully loaded, and was satisfied with the road-condition simulation for the western Sichuan trip.
location: Breakfast shop at the intersection of Dongchang Road and Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the residential areas along the route (Rushan Third Village, Fushen Community, Weishan New Village).

name: Drove to Fengxian Bay Forest Park.
description: Setting off from Weishan New Village, they entered the S32 Shenjiahu Expressway. Lei Mingxuan turned on navigation and played a playlist everyone liked. Along the way they chatted and laughed. Ma Lei shared the flavor profile of a high-altitude Yunnan coffee bean he had been researching, Lei Mingxuan talked about his anticipation for a self-drive trip to western Sichuan, and Han Dong chimed in with a funny story his friend encountered on National Highway 318.
location: From Weishan New Village, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, he took the S32 Shen-Jia-Hu Expressway to Shanghai Bay National Forest Park at 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District.

name: Arriving at the campsite and setting up the tent
description: After arriving at Shanghai Bay National Forest Park and completing the entrance procedures, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to carry the heaviest equipment case, scouted the area around the campsite, and found a prime spot that was flat and shaded by trees. Everyone worked together, divided tasks, and quickly set up the two-person tent, canopy, and rest area. Lei Mingxuan tested the new sleeping bag's packability and insulation, and used a mobile app to record the campsite's coordinates and altitude.
location: Designated campsite at Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Core equipment test: field test of the windproof stove.
description: After the tent was set up, Lei Mingxuan could hardly wait to set up the windproof stove. Han Dong helped find some stones to reinforce the stove body and then tested the ignition—the blue flame was very stable in the breeze. After that, he filled the kettle and timed it; the water came to a full boil after about 8 minutes. The result far exceeded expectations, and Lei Mingxuan felt confident about how this stove would perform on the plateau.
location: Shanghai Bay National Forest Park Campground, No. 1677, Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Camp lunch and rest
description: Everyone sat around on the picnic mat and took out the lunch they had brought: bread, ham, canned fruit, and snacks. Lei Mingxuan used a pour-over coffee kettle to brew a simple drip-bag coffee for each person. Everyone ate and chatted, and Zhao Min took several photos of the camp food and posted them on Moments.
location: Shanghai Bay National Forest Park Campground, No. 1677, Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Special event: outdoor pour-over coffee instruction and hands-on practice
description: After lunch, Ma Lei officially started the class. He brought out coffee grounds in three grind sizes—coarse, medium, and fine—and a portable pour-over kettle, explaining how wind, water flow, and grind size affect flavor. Lei Mingxuan practiced with full concentration, trying to counter gusts of wind with a small water stream and a low pouring point. The first two cups had unstable water flow; on the third cup, he found the right feel, and the coffee he brewed had obvious floral and fruity notes, earning unanimous praise from Ma Lei and his friends.
location: Shanghai Bay National Forest Park Campground, No. 1677, Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Handling store matters
description: While resting in the tent, Lei Mingxuan contacted shop assistant Xiao Lin by phone, asked about the day's foot traffic and online orders, and reminded her again that after Shen Jie arrived at the store in the afternoon, she should let Shen Jie try on the newly arrived mint green sun-protective jacket and take photos to send via WeChat. Xiao Lin replied that everything was normal.
location: Inside a tent at the campsite of Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Park hiking and nature observation
description: Hiked along the lakeside trail, enjoying the wetland and forest scenery. Lei Mingxuan used his phone to identify flowers and grasses as he walked, and spotted a wildflower called 'February Orchid'. Zhao Min shared how to use low angles and backlight to create a sense of depth in forest photos, and took some cool photos for Lei Mingxuan. Along the way, they came across an egret and everyone watched it quietly for a while.
location: Forest trails and lakeshore, Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Return to the campsite and prepare a campfire dinner
description: Back at the campsite, everyone divided the work and cooperated. Zhang Wei and Han Dong were in charge of making the fire, while Ma Lei and Zhao Min washed the fruit and utensils. Lei Mingxuan sorted the brought barbecue, rice cakes, and vegetables onto plates, and checked the battery levels of the portable lantern and power bank again.
location: Shanghai Bay National Forest Park Campground, No. 1677, Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Campfire night chat and story sharing
description: The bonfire blazed, sparks flew into the night sky, and everyone sat around it. While grilling meat and rice cakes, Lei Mingxuan shared embarrassing stories from his childhood playing "war" in the alleyways with his childhood pals, making everyone laugh. Ma Lei told an unusual story about getting lost in the mountains of Yunnan while searching for coffee beans and accidentally wandering into a minority village. Han Dong talked about repairing a 20-year-old Santana whose owner was a deeply sentimental old professor. The conversation drifted from self-driving trips in western Sichuan to everyone's life dreams, and the firelight reddened every face.
location: Beside the campfire at the campsite, Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, No. 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Communicate with friends online.
description: Crawling into the tent for a short rest, Lei Mingxuan opened his phone and saw Zhang Wei saying in the group chat that today's BBQ get-together was great, and replied, 'Let's meet again at the restaurant on the weekend.' Then Haozi sent an invitation to team up for gaming. Lei Mingxuan told him that the signal was poor while camping in the suburbs, and they agreed to play tomorrow night instead; Haozi said okay.
location: Inside a tent at the campsite of Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Stargazing and solitude record
description: Lying in the tent, through the mesh top he could see the brilliant starry sky unpolluted by city lights. Lei Mingxuan opened the memo app on his phone and recorded detailed notes on today's gear test, especially the performance of the windproof stove in real outdoor conditions and the key points for water control when making pour-over coffee in a windy environment. Then he opened the e-book The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry and read a few pages, feeling an unprecedented sense of relaxation and fulfillment.
location: Inside a tent at the campsite of Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: After a quick wash, Lei Mingxuan climbed into his sleeping bag. Though his body was a little tired, he felt mentally satisfied. He remembered that before returning to the store the next morning, he needed to briefly go over the initial thoughts on the online branch store with Shen Jie. He adjusted his sleeping position, closed his eyes, and, listening to the faint sounds of insects outside the tent, soon fell asleep.
location: Shanghai Bay National Forest Park Campground, No. 1677, Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Morning jog by the lake.
description: After waking naturally, I changed into my workout clothes and jogged alone about 5 kilometers along the dirt track by the lake in Shanghai Bay National Forest Park. The morning air was filled with moisture and the scent of grass and trees, the morning mist over the lake had not yet lifted, and the birdsong was clear. I adjusted my breathing and pace, enjoyed the solitude of nature, stopped at a viewing platform, and did a set of stretches.
location: Lakeside trail, Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, No. 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Enjoying a lakeside pour-over coffee alone.
description: After my morning run, I returned to the tent to get the portable pour-over coffee kit and prepared to brew coffee on a flat rock by the lake. I rinsed and preheated the equipment with lake water, ground the coffee beans, then focused on pouring water, watching the grounds bloom evenly as the aroma filled the air. This time the water stream was steadier than yesterday's, and the flavor was clean. I recorded my insights to gain experience for my future role as the outdoor coffee person.
location: Lakeside stone viewing platform, Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, No. 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Camp breakfast and equipment check
description: Back at the campsite, the companions woke up one after another, used water heated over last night's campfire to make oatmeal and coffee, and shared bread and fruit. While eating, they cleaned up the pour-over coffee gear, checked their tents for damage and missing stakes, and helped companions take down the tarp, sorting and packing all personal gear.
location: Beside the camp tent, Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Break camp and restore the campsite.
description: Everyone divided the work to take down the tent, fold the tables and chairs, and check for forgotten items. I was responsible for sorting and packing all household waste and discarded packaging to ensure the campsite was left without a trace. After clearing the area, I walked around the campsite to confirm nothing was left behind, loaded the waterproof-packed gear into the car one by one, and finally counted the tent, sleeping bags, stove, gas canisters, pour-over coffee set, folding chairs, etc. — nothing was missing.
location: Campsite at Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Driving back and reviewing lessons learned
description: I drove the car, taking the S4 Shanghai-Jinshan Expressway and then the Outer Ring Expressway back to Pudong. On the way, everyone summarized the gains and losses of the camping trip. Ma Lei shared his outdoor pour-over coffee experience, Zhang Wei complained that the moisture-proof mat was too thin, and I evaluated the gear performance: the waterproof stove boiled water efficiently enough, the sleeping bag's temperature rating was comfortable, the tent had good wind resistance, and my physical fitness stood the test, laying a foundation for the western Sichuan road trip.
location: En route from Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, No. 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Service-area lunch and social catch-up
description: We stopped at the service area on the Pudong section of the G15 Shenhai Expressway to rest. After using the restroom, everyone went into a fast-food restaurant for lunch. I ordered a bowl of braised beef noodles. While eating, I replied to work messages from the shop clerk Xiao Lin on my phone, sent a voice message to my cousin Shen Jie to arrange a talk about the online store, and asked Zhang Wei what time he would come to the shop for a meal on the weekend, keeping up my regular social and work contacts.
location: A service area on the G15 Shenhai Expressway (Pudong Nanhui section), Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returned home and unloaded goods
description: Back home in Shanggang Community, he piled the camping gear on the balcony, handed the local new rice he had brought back from Fengxian to his parents, and briefly greeted his parents, who were about to go out, to reassure them.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Showering and doing laundry.
description: He took off his dirty clothes and put them in the washing machine with disinfectant, then took a hot shower to wash away the dust and fatigue from camping, and changed into clean home clothes.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon nap
description: After taking a shower, I drew the curtains, lay in bed and took a one-hour nap, letting my body recover quickly through sleep and eliminating the fatigue accumulated from camping.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: At-home flow yoga recovery
description: After waking up, I spread out my yoga mat in the living room and followed a vinyasa flow video on my phone, focusing on stretching the backs of my legs, hips, and back that had become tight from running and carrying camping gear. After 20 minutes, my body became loose and flexible again, and my mind was fully alert.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Drying gear and organizing digital files
description: Hang the washed clothes out on the balcony to dry, dry the tent in the sheltered, wind-protected area of the balcony, and hang up the sleeping bag and moisture-proof mat to air out. At the same time, use his phone to import the camping photos to his laptop, select great shots of the scenery, gear, and campfire chats, do simple color correction, and prepare to share them on Moments.
location: Home balcony and living room, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Residential Quarter, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Social replies and news browsing
description: Snuggled on the sofa and replied one by one to the WeChat messages from the past half day: Xiao Lin, the shop assistant, reported that store traffic was normal; my cousin Shen Jie replied with a voice message saying she could talk in detail on the phone in the evening; Zhang Wei agreed to come to the store on Friday. Then I browsed the western Sichuan road trip guides on Xiaohongshu and saved two posts about plateau driving and lightweight gear to prepare for the self-driving trip.
location: Sofa at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and sharing fun camping stories
description: Mother prepared a hearty dinner: steamed sea bass, garlic stir-fried water spinach, braised pork ribs, and tomato egg drop soup. I cast camping photos to the TV for my parents, explaining the details of setting up the tent, brewing coffee, and grilling meat skewers over the campfire. Mother was very interested, while Father focused on the safety gear. I promised that for the self-driving trip to western Sichuan, I would bring a GPS, a first-aid kit, and a satellite phone.
location: Dining room and living room of the family home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Family leisure and online branch planning
description: After dinner, I watched the news with my parents for a while, then returned to the study and called my cousin Shen Jie to discuss in detail the platform for opening an online branch of the clothing store. Shen Jie suggested starting with a WeChat mini program with a more precise customer base. I thought it made sense, and we agreed to further refine the functional modules in the store tomorrow. After hanging up, I got out the previous platform comparison table and made supplementary notes.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Social time: playing games together and sharing in group chats
description: Shared the camping photos in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group, drawing likes and teasing from friends. Then made plans with Haozi to play two rounds of Honor of Kings together, chatting about the Western Sichuan trip while playing. After the game, confirmed with Zhang Wei in the group the time for him to come to the store for lunch on Friday.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, reading, and going to sleep
description: After washing up, I soaked my feet, picked up 'The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry' and read a few pages. Thinking about the upcoming self-driving trip to western Sichuan, I felt full of anticipation. After closing the book, I opened the memo app and recorded today's pour-over coffee-to-water ratio, water temperature, and bloom time. Then I turned off the light and went to bed, quickly falling asleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and organizing camping gear.
description: The alarm went off on time. My body was still a bit sore, but I felt energetic. First I opened the window for ventilation, brought in the camping gear (tent, sleeping bag, ground pad) that had been dried in Fengxian from the balcony, shook off the dust, wiped down the poles, and neatly stored them in the gear bag. I also cleaned the titanium cup, pour-over kettle, and stove burner. My mother was already in the kitchen preparing breakfast: pan-fried buns with millet porridge, warm and comforting.
location: Home at Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute Ride to Super Brand Mall
description: Changed into the store's work uniform (black work pants, gray T-shirt, with a baseball cap), got on the mountain bike from the community bike shed, rode west along Pudong Avenue, passed through Lujiazui Ring Road, and arrived at Super Brand Mall. The ride took about 15 minutes and served as a morning warm-up.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai, from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Store reopening and sales data analysis
description: After arriving at the store, I first watered the pothos and monstera, then logged into the backend system to pull up last weekend's (April 26-27) sales records, focusing on analyzing the sales and customer profiles of the new mountain-style techwear line. Jackets and Martin boots sold well. Around 10 a.m., staff member Xiao Lin came in. I listened to her report on weekend foot traffic and try-on rates, and assigned her to sort out out-of-stock sizes in the warehouse in preparation for contacting supplier Zhou Tao for restocking.
location: Inside the Xiafei Ji store at A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and browsing guides
description: Asked Xiao Lin to watch the store, and went to "Hefu Noodles" on B1 of Super Brand Mall, ordering a bowl of tomato pork cartilage noodles with a marinated egg. While waiting, I browsed my saved Western Sichuan self-driving guide on my phone and took screenshots of the road condition maps for Lenggacuo and Genie's Eye.
location: Hefu Noodles, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Refining the Western Sichuan Itinerary and Organizing the Supplies List
description: Back in the store's break area, taking advantage of the light lunchtime foot traffic, he opened Amap and a self-driving forum to confirm the loop: Shanghai–Chengdu–Kangding–Xinduqiao–Litang–Daocheng Yading–Danba–Chengdu. He zoomed in on the Lenggacuo and Genie's Eye areas to check the latest road conditions, estimated daily driving distances and planned stopovers, and put together an electronic packing list, itemizing the medicine, food, and other items to buy in the evening.
location: Rest area of the Xiafei Collection store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walked around the store and interacted with customers.
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic in the mall picked up, and I inspected the displays in the store. I ran into regular customer Feng Xiaoyu, an HR at a foreign company in Suzhou, who was trying on the newly arrived mountain-style shell jacket.
