I gave a detailed introduction to the Teflon water-repellent fabric and recommended pairing it with tech cargo pants in the same color, closing the full-outfit sale. After seeing off Sister Xiaoyu, I took a photo of the outfit with my phone and posted it to the store's VIP group.
location: Inside the Xiafei Ji store at A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Weighted stair-climbing physical training
description: After greeting Xiao Lin, he changed into sneakers, put on a hiking backpack containing about 12 kg of bottled water, and went to level B2 to start weighted stair climbing using the fire escape stairs in the safety passage. He chose B2 to the 7th floor as a loop and completed 4 sets in total. The first two sets were paced, and the last two were pushed to exhaustion. His heart rate peaked at 178, and his leg muscles felt intensely sore but satisfying.
location: Fire stairwell of Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (B2 to 7F)

name: Shower recovery and return trip preparations
description: After training, he cycled to Standard Chartered Bank Tower, went to the shower room in the basement gym to wash up, and changed into clean clothes. After coming out, he bought a bottle of Gatorade from the vending machine to quickly replenish electrolytes.
location: Gym, Standard Chartered Bank Tower, No. 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: High-altitude supplies procurement.
description: Rode from the Standard Chartered Bank Building to Yanqin Grocery Store on Dongchang Road, and shopped precisely according to the list on his phone: Gaoyuan'an capsules, cold medicine, Band-Aids, glucose oral liquid, and other medicines; compressed biscuits, energy bars, Snickers, a large bottle of Nongfu Spring water, and other food; plus the UCC drip-bag coffee he usually drinks. Self-checkout came to 287 yuan in total.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organizing supplies at home and purchasing insurance online
description: Carried two large bags of supplies home, spread them all out on the living room coffee table, and sorted them into the hiking duffel bags. His mother curiously came over to look. While answering her, he opened his laptop, compared budget hotels near Chengdu Wuhou Shrine on Mafengwo, booked a room rated 8.9 for the first night, and bought a 12-day comprehensive self-driving travel accident insurance policy online. Finally, he sent a screenshot of the order to the Lei Family Love group.
location: Home at Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: Mother prepared braised pork, stir-fried asparagus, and tomato egg drop soup. The family of three sat around the dining table. Father asked about the day's training, and mother repeatedly reminded him to be safe on the road and not to eat random things. Lei Mingxuan nodded along while showing the medicine and food he had bought to reassure his parents.
location: Home at Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Remote consultation with Qin Lang on Western Sichuan experience
description: After dinner, he returned to his bedroom and had a video call on WeChat with his basketball friend Qin Lang in Hangzhou. Qin Lang had just completed a self-drive tour of the western Sichuan loop last year. He shared the location of a little-known viewing spot for Mount Gongga in Xinduqiao, recommended two offline map apps, 2bulu and Ovital Interactive Map, and particularly reminded him that the section from Litang to Daocheng has several gravel roads, so he must check his tires and bring snow chains. Lei Mingxuan listened and took careful notes in his notebook.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening Leisure: Anime and Blind Boxes
description: After hanging up the video call, made a cup of low-caffeine drip coffee and leaned back on the bed. First, popped into the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group to reply to Zhang Wei's question about weekend activities. Then opened Bilibili to catch up on two new episodes of 'Frieren: Beyond Journey's End', and logged into the Pop Mart mini-program to check in and browse guides for the new 'Molly X Steampunk' series blind boxes.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Pre-Bedtime Checklist Verification and Gear Check
description: He opened the bedside drawer, took out the draft itinerary for western Sichuan, and added the Liangbulu app and tire chains recommended by Qin Lang to the electronic packing list. He checked off all the to-do items one by one: gear was packed, the route was refined, insurance was purchased, and medication was arranged. He decided to order the tire chains on JD.com the next day for direct delivery to the store.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: He turned off the desk lamp, and the room went pitch black. Reflections of Lengga Lake and the Eye of Genie surfaced in his mind. Though his body was tired, he felt calm and full of anticipation, and soon drifted off to sleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Morning preparation and breakfast
description: After getting up, Lei Ming first boiled water, brewed himself the last full pour-over coffee with Colombian coffee beans, savoring the balanced caramel sweetness, and washed the equipment, packing the V60 dripper, hand grinder, a bag of Kenyan beans, and a collapsible kettle into the coffee bag in the trunk. Then he quickly washed up. His mother Wang Xiuying had prepared breakfast — two golden fried eggs and a bowl of small wontons. While eating, Lei Ming listened to his mother's reminders to be careful when going out and report his safety every day. After breakfast, he ordered snow chains on the JD app, with the delivery address set to "Store A-208, Super Brand Mall", expected to arrive in the afternoon. Then he browsed his electronic memo to confirm the pace of today's to-do items.
location: Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove to Super Brand Mall
description: Lei Ming changed into light casual clothes, put on his commuter bag, and drove off from Zhangyang Huayuan, going along Pudong Avenue and turning onto Zhangyang Road. About 15 minutes later he arrived at Super Brand Mall and parked in the underground parking lot.
location: Underground parking lot, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store work briefing and clearance-sale preparations
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Ming went into the warehouse with shop assistant Lin Xiao and, using the computer inventory list, counted the unsold basic T-shirts and jeans and made a clearance list. He instructed Lin Xiao to draft a promotion plan of '20% off for two items, 30% off for three items' and had Lin Xiao write a WeChat Moments teaser post stressing 'Boss is on a business trip, limited-time offer.' Then, Lei Ming took a spare key and a sticky note with emergency contact numbers to the property management office to find Manager Zheng Kai, asking him to help keep an eye on the store during the trip. Zheng Kai readily agreed.
location: Shop A-208, Floor 2, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and picking up the parcel with snow chains
description: After finishing the work handover, Lei Ming had a simple bowl of beef brisket noodles at the food court on B1 of Super Brand Mall. After the meal, he received a text message from the parcel locker telling him that the tire chains had arrived, so he went to the parcel pickup point on the mall's first floor and collected the package.
location: B1 food court and first-floor express parcel collection point, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Drove back home
description: Lei Ming drove back to Zhangyang Garden carrying the snow chains. After arriving home, he set the package down in the living room and planned to load the car in one batch in the afternoon.
location: On the way from No. 168 Lujiazui West Road to Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Comprehensively pack personal luggage and gear
description: After returning home at noon, Lei Ming laid out an electronic checklist and packed quick-dry clothes, warm fleece, a hardshell jacket, hiking shoes, a toiletry bag, a power bank, a camera, and a first-aid kit one by one into a 30L hiking backpack and a 20L duffel bag. He carefully wrapped the pour-over coffee set, a camping stove burner, and a small bag of coffee beans in soft cloth and put them in a dedicated box in the trunk. Finally, he picked up the Japanese vocabulary flashcards from his desk and tucked them into a compartment of the backpack, planning to study in spare moments on the road. The entire packing process was orderly, and the final total weight was kept under 30 kilograms.
location: Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday yoga stretching
description: After packing for a long time, Lei Ming felt soreness in his lower back and thighs, so he spread out a yoga mat on the living room floor and did a 15-minute Sun Salutation sequence, focusing on stretching his hamstrings and lower back. The tightness eased, helping him adjust his body for tomorrow's highland hike.
location: Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Vehicle inspection and preparation before departure.
description: At 2 p.m., Lei Ming brought snow chains and luggage in the trunk to the underground garage. He first used a tire pressure gauge to inflate all four tires to the standard pressure, then opened the hood to check the oil, coolant, and washer fluid levels, confirming everything was normal. He then checked that the spare tire, jack, and tool kit were in place. After loading the luggage and snow chains properly into the car, he sat in the driver's seat and imported the pre-downloaded offline map pack for western Sichuan and a playlist of more than 300 folk-rock songs into the car system via Bluetooth. Once everything was ready, he took a photo of the trunk with the luggage and posted it to the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat with the caption: "All ready, ready for takeoff!" and received likes and best wishes from his friends.
location: Underground parking garage of Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went home to rest and checked in with the family group chat
description: After checking the vehicle, Lei Ming went home, took a quick shower, and changed into clean loungewear. He opened the family WeChat group and officially announced that they would set off tomorrow morning. His father Lei Jianguo replied, 'Drive slowly and be safe on the road.' His mother Wang Xiuying asked him to send a message every day to report that he was safe, and said she would pack a box of pan-fried buns tonight as breakfast for tomorrow.
location: Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Have dinner with the family
description: Since they were leaving early the next morning, dinner was held earlier today. Mother Wang Xiuying prepared a table full of dishes, including braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. The family of three sat around the table. Father Lei Jianguo asked in detail about the route and weather in western Sichuan and warned Lei Ming not to get too excited on the plateau and to move slowly, while his mother kept putting food in his bowl. The dinner atmosphere was warm, full of family concern.
location: Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Final luggage packing and route check
description: After dinner, after helping his mother clear the table, Lei Ming returned to his room, took out the small notebook given by his friend Qin Lang, and carefully checked key information again, including the photo spots at Lenggacuo and the gravel road conditions from Litang to Daocheng. He also opened his phone and scrolled through several short videos of self-driving trips in western Sichuan to familiarize himself with the terrain and scenery along the way, adjusting his mood to the best state.
location: Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Forced rest and reading.
description: Despite his inner excitement, Lei Ming forced himself to enter a resting state. He made a cup of hot tea, leaned against the headboard, and read a few pages of the travelogue 'Self-Driving Tour of Western Sichuan's Hidden Places,' familiarizing himself again with the local customs and things to note along the route, building up his knowledge for the trip.
location: Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation.
description: At 6:20 in the evening, Lei Ming set an alarm for 5:00 a.m. and put his phone on the desk away from the bedside. He checked the straps on his backpack and the zippers on his suitcase again to make sure he could grab them and leave in the morning. Then he scrolled through his phone for a while, watching a few billiards technique and roller skating videos to relax his mind.
location: Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go to bed early
description: Considering that he would be driving all day tomorrow, Lei Ming decided to rest early. He turned off the light and lay in bed, telling himself that he was fully prepared and that a good night's sleep was the beginning of the adventure. Listening to the evening breeze outside the window, he gradually relaxed and stored up energy for the long drive tomorrow.
location: Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm went off, and I got up 15 minutes earlier than usual, wanting to control the pace before departure. After getting up, I opened the window for ventilation, and seeing the sky outside was clear despite being cloudy, I felt in a good mood. After washing up, I went to the kitchen, where my mother was already steaming shengjian buns. She had gotten up early specially to make them for me, and told me, 'Be careful on the road tomorrow, and eat a few more.' I acknowledged and helped ladle out two bowls of plain congee.
location: Home at No. 12, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Eating breakfast at home
description: I sat face to face with my mother eating breakfast. The pan-fried buns had crispy bottoms and juicy fillings, paired with white rice porridge. I chatted about the store's arrangements for today, told her I would be back on time in the evening, and asked her and my father not to worry. After finishing, I proactively put the dishes and chopsticks into the sink and gave them a quick rinse.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - dining room at home, No. 12, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road

name: Commute to the store
description: Grabbed the commuting bag and checked my phone and keys. Before leaving, I looked at the luggage bag that had been packed yesterday by the entrance, feeling reassured. Went down to the basement garage, started the car, and set the navigation to 'No. 168 West Lujiazui Road.' The traffic was a bit heavy, but I wasn't annoyed; I listened to the morning radio and drove to the Super Brand Mall underground parking lot, arriving at a little past 8:20.
location: Underground parking lot, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buying coffee and getting ready for the store
description: After parking the car, I first went to the Starbucks on the B1 level and, as usual, ordered a medium hot latte. When paying, I said to the young man at the counter, "Today's my last day at work; tomorrow I'm going out to have fun." He smiled and wished me a pleasant trip. I took the coffee upstairs to the second floor, took out the key, opened the store door, turned on the lights and air conditioning, looked around to confirm last night's cleaning was fine, and then powered on the cash register and computer for the day.
location: Starbucks, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Morning store operations
description: The morning mall traffic was light, so it was a good time to focus on store affairs. First, he watered two small pots of mint and pothos by the windowsill. Then, according to the clearance plan made with Xiaolin yesterday, he moved the key mountain-style T-shirts and slow-moving denim shorts to prominent positions. At exactly 10 o'clock, store clerk Xiaolin arrived on time. He briefly emphasized today's work priorities: focus on outfit coordination in the morning, and pay attention to community reactions in the afternoon. He received several returning customers who came for weekend repeat purchases, chatting with them about the newly arrived accessories and tomorrow's travel plans.
location: "Xiafei Ji", A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch
description: Several groups of customers came to the shop at noon, and it didn't lighten up until 12 o'clock. I let Xiao Linzi go eat first and keep an eye on the shop for a while. I went down to B1 and, instead of the usual Starbucks, chose an 'Old Shanghai Scallion Oil Noodles' shop, ordering the signature noodles plus a fried pork chop. As I ate, I took out my phone and confirmed with Xiao Lin on WeChat the article to be posted that afternoon, telling her to get ready.
location: Food court, B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday rest and a stroll
description: After lunch, instead of going straight back to the store, I first took a stroll around the mall to digest my food and also checked out the displays and foot traffic of other menswear stores, silently comparing them with my own. Then I went to the exhibition area in the atrium downstairs, looked at the newly installed installation for a while, and took a photo.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and community warm-up
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic began to pick up. He took the lead himself, put together several mountain-style outfits for a few customers, recommended some newly arrived techwear vests and cargo shorts, and closed two sales. During this time, a colleague of Sister Feng Xiaoyu, a regular customer, came over, saying she had been recommended by Feng and wanted to see the same hiking jacket. He received her warmly and closed the sale. When the flow of customers eased slightly, he had Xiaolinzi post a few photos of today's styled new arrivals in the VIP group and tease, “The store has prepared a wave of surprise rewards, to be revealed later,” as a warm-up for the upcoming post. He also took time to go to the property management office, handed the spare key to Zheng Kai again, and asked him to keep an eye on the surveillance cameras during the May Day holiday.
location: "Xiafei Ji", A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Publish the clearance pre-sale promo post
description: Before closing, I took out my phone and sent Xiao Linzi the clearance presale post, coupon links, and a few close-up photos that Xiao Lin and I had finalized last night, all at once. I asked her to immediately publish them in the official community and on her Moments, and watched her do it. "Go ahead and post," I said. Watching her press send, the task was successfully completed.
location: "Xiafei Ji", A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wrap-up and preparation before closing
description: After posting the article, I let Xiao Linzi leave work first. I began organizing the change at the cash register and confirmed the accounts were correct. I took out my phone and photographed today's in-store displays as part of the monthly review materials. Then I exported the sales record sheet that needed review from the cash register system and transferred it to my computer.
location: "Xiafei Ji", A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Monthly store sales data review and analysis
description: Pull the rolling shutter door down halfway, leaving only the row of lights above his head on, and open the laptop. Open the April sales record sheet in Excel and begin the monthly review. Clean up the data one by one, filter out a few return records, then separate them into the Mountain-style functional wear series and the basics. Use formulas and pivot tables to calculate sales, share, gross profit, and inventory turnover rate, and reach a key conclusion: the new mountain-style products raised the average order value by 15%, but inventory of several basic T-shirts and jeans is really piling up. Based on the review data, start fine-tuning the May strategy. Open a notepad and the laptop and write down the key points: the main promotion strategy is deep matching of mountain-style clothing and accessories to increase cross-selling; the clearance strategy is to design a bundle set promotion with a spend-based discount for those slow-moving jeans and T-shirts instead of simply discounting them, and set aside one piece for a flash sale to attract traffic. He thinks and writes, his ideas gradually become clear, and he highlights the key points in red on the notepad.
location: "Xiafei Ji", A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Close the Store and Confirm the Trip
description: Wrapping up work, he stretched and looked at the already somewhat empty mall corridor, yet felt deeply fulfilled. He carefully checked the store's main power switch and confirmed the windows were locked. Standing at the store entrance, he took one last look at the 'Xiafeiji' sign and silently said to it, 'April, you've worked hard.' Then he pulled down the rolling shutter door, locked it with a click, took out his phone, and snapped a photo of the storefront with its lights on. When he went downstairs, he met the security guard on patrol, greeted him, and wished him a happy holiday.
location: "Xiafei Ji", A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Driving home and interacting with friends
description: He went to the parking lot, started the car, and drove out of Super Brand Mall. Just as he entered the Yan'an East Road Tunnel, his phone rang—it was a WeChat voice message from his billiards buddy Han Dong. He answered through the car's Bluetooth, and a loud, excited voice came through: 'Brother Xuan! Safe travels tomorrow! Off to western Sichuan! You must report to us when you get back!' He replied with a smile, 'You bet! Just wait for me to come back with local specialties—see you at the billiard hall!' After that, he also gave a brief voice update on the day's work progress in the 'Three Musketeers of Pudong' group chat.
location: On the way from Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road.

name: Arrived home, posted a memo, and washed up
description: After arriving home, the light in my parents' room was already off, but the night light in the living room was on, and a glass of water was left on the table. I tiptoed back to my room, took out the "Handover Memorandum" I had written earlier from my bag, which listed the key work points for May for Xiao Lin, supplier contact information, key clearance plans, and the location of the spare key. I went to the kitchen and stuck it on the refrigerator door in the most visible spot with a fridge magnet. Then I grabbed some clean clothes and took a quick shower in the bathroom.
location: Home at No. 12, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation and relaxation
description: After taking a shower, he came out in his pajamas, feeling refreshed. He checked the things he needed to bring for the early-morning departure: the backpack on the passenger seat, the suitcase and gear bag in the trunk, glasses, thermos, and power bank. Everything was ready. He lay down in bed and set the alarm for 5 a.m. Although he was tired, he still felt a bit excited. He opened his phone and scrolled through two short videos about western Sichuan, his heart full of anticipation for the upcoming trip. He turned off the light, closed his eyes, listened to the occasional sound of cars outside, and gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 12 Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning pour-over coffee and breakfast
description: You woke up with the anticipation of opening new coffee beans. In the kitchen, you took out the Colombian Huila coffee beans prepared for the western Sichuan road trip, weighed out 15 grams, used a medium grind, and did a three-stage extraction with water at 92°C. The first sip was bright in acidity but had a slightly astringent finish, so you decided to grind a bit finer tomorrow morning. After washing up, you had breakfast with the pan-fried buns and soy milk prepared by your mother Wang Xiuying, and thought that starting the first day of May with a cup of coffee was not bad.
location: Home kitchen at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Discuss postponing the trip and store plans with parents
description: You sat in the living room and called your father Lei Jianguo over as well, then formally opened up: “Mom and Dad, I've thought carefully about the western Sichuan trip. Let's postpone it for now. The store is about to get new arrivals, and I also need to meet Tao Ge after the holiday. Let's wait until autumn.” Your father nodded and said it's good to be more prudent. Your mother Wang Xiuying breathed a sigh of relief and smiled, saying she'd make a nice meal for the two of you at noon. You also sent a message in the family group chat to let everyone know the decision, and felt a weight off your shoulders.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Commuting and taking care of store business
description: You changed into a loose T-shirt and sweatpants, got a shared bike at the neighborhood entrance, and rode west along Pudong Avenue, arriving at Super Brand Mall about 15 minutes later. After arriving at the store, you opened your computer, organized the data from last night's review and the May clearance strategy (20% off for two items, 30% off for three items) into a document, sent it to supplier Zhou Tao, and left a message about planning the summer new-arrival schedule after the holiday. At 8:30, store clerk Xiao Lin came on duty. You had her sort out the pre-sale orders packed the day before and prepare to call a courier, while you walked around the racks thinking about display positions for the new arrivals, straightening a few crooked T-shirts along the way.
location: Inside the 'Xiafeiji' store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Plan the Shanghai-Hangzhou billiards friendly match
description: You sat down behind the cash register, opened the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group, and pulled Han Dong and Qin Lang into a voice call. The three of you discussed enthusiastically for half an hour and decided the match would be held at 2 p.m. on May 24 at the World Square Billiard Hall, using American eight-ball rules. You took charge of venue coordination, Han Dong contacted the Hangzhou players, and Qin Lang drew up the match process. After finalizing everything, a wave of social excitement surged up.
location: Inside the 'Xiafeiji' store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Labor Day family dinner with parents
description: After you finished explaining the work to your store clerk Xiao Lin, you cycled back home to pick up your parents, and the whole family took a taxi to the Shanghainese restaurant "Xiangfang" in Lujiazui Center. You ordered sautéed eel with hot oil, oil-braised shrimp, crab meat tofu, sautéed seasonal vegetables, and sweet rice balls in fermented rice wine. During the meal, you talked about your billiards tournament plan. Your father smiled, which was rare, and said it was good for young people to have a social life, while your mother kept putting food on your plate. The warm lunch made you completely relaxed.
location: "Xiangfang" Shanghai Local Cuisine Restaurant, 7th Floor, Lujiazui Center Mall, 889 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon reading and handling customer inquiries
description: After lunch, you walked about 12 minutes back home, moved a lounge chair onto the balcony, and sunlight filtered through the plane tree leaves outside the window. You opened the e-book of The Longest Day in Chang'an on your phone, immersed in Zhang Xiaojing's adventure. Your phone kept vibrating; you found time to reply to WeChat messages from regular customers Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu—one asking about denim jacket sizes, the other sending an outfit-help request. You patiently offered advice and chatted about the recent Clean Fit trend.
location: Balcony at home, Shanggang Residential Area, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Had an in-depth conversation with my father about future plans.
description: You have a deeper conversation with your father about your travel plans and store plans, showing him the store's summer new-arrival plan, the meeting notes with Zhou Tao, and the autumn route map for western Sichuan (Lenggacuo, Genie's Eye) from your phone memo. Your father puts on his reading glasses, reads carefully, and pats you on the shoulder: "You're an adult now, and you know what you're doing. I'm reassured." This conversation puts you completely at ease, and your anxiety is swept away.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening walk and reflection around the community and the green park
description: You put on your running shoes, first took a leisurely couple of laps around the neighborhood, then walked about 14 minutes to Lujiazui Central Green Park. While enjoying the evening breeze and sunset, you ran through the store's summer featured items in your mind: linen shirts, wide-leg pants, and printed T-shirts, and even drafted the Moments post copy for the new arrivals. After walking for half an hour, you walked back home the same way.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dinner and family relaxation
description: After the walk, mother had already prepared dinner. Today it was father's specialty scallion-oil noodles, with tomato and egg soup and several side dishes. You ate very quickly, thinking about the billiards game in the evening. After dinner, you went back to your room, played on your phone for a while, drank some water, and took a short rest.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Practice billiards at the billiard hall and finalize competition details
description: After dinner, you walked about 11 minutes to the familiar World Square billiard hall. Han Dong had already arrived. You opened a table and warmed up with a game of American eight-ball. Meanwhile, Qin Lang connected via WeChat video call, live-streaming the match and giving remote guidance. You were in good form today and won two games in a row. During breaks, you and Han Dong finalized the details and venue reservation for the May 24 match. He patted his chest and assured that the organizational matters were on him.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Nighttime washing up, entertainment, and pre-bed preparation
description: You walked about 11 minutes from the billiards hall back home and took a refreshing shower. After changing into loungewear and lying in bed, you first opened Bilibili and watched an episode of the new anime Kaiju No. 8, then browsed the Pop Mart mini-program to look at newly released blind boxes. You didn't order any, but it was quite relaxing. Before bed, you took out your notebook, jotted down the key points from today's conversations with your father and Zhou Tao, as well as ideas for the summer shop display, and sent Zhou Tao a WeChat message to confirm the shipping time for the new product samples. After turning off the bedside lamp, even though you didn't go to Western Sichuan, the effort you made for the shop and your social circle made this Labor Day feel more valuable than a trip. With peace of mind, you soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run of 6 km and stretching by the river
description: After waking up naturally, it was cloudy outside and felt comfortable. I put on my workout gear, warmed up briefly at home for 5 minutes, and then went out. I jogged 6 kilometers along the Zhangjiabang Riverbank next to the neighborhood, with a steady pace of 6 minutes per kilometer, taking about 36 minutes. After the run, my heart and lungs felt comfortable. I did 15 minutes of static stretching beside a bench on the riverbank, focusing on relaxing my calves and posterior chain.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the Zhangjiabang Riverbank (from Pudong Avenue to Minsheng Road)

name: Fine-tuning morning pour-over coffee
description: After showering, changed into loungewear and went to the kitchen coffee corner, took out Colombian Huila coffee beans, and adjusted the hand grinder two clicks finer from yesterday's medium setting to a medium-fine grind (close to fine sugar). Used 92-degree water and 15 g of beans, bloomed with 30 g of water for 30 seconds, then poured in three stages to 240 g, with a total extraction time of 2 minutes 40 seconds. This time the acidity was brighter and the astringency in the finish was reduced, but the sweetness had not fully come through. Recorded the parameters and planned to adjust the water temperature to 90 tomorrow. While drinking, I also checked the store surveillance.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and casual chat
description: His mother had prepared breakfast: a bowl of small wontons and a fried egg. While eating, he chatted with his mother about yesterday's coffee being astringent and today's adjustment insights; his mother smiled and said he was fastidious, then went to the balcony to water the flowers. After the meal, he returned to the bedroom to change into going-out clothes and rinsed the coffee cup clean.
location: Home Chinese Restaurant, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycle commute to the store
description: Ride a shared bicycle east along Pudong Avenue, pass Yuanshen Road, go around the Lujiazui roundabout, and arrive at Super Brand Mall after about 20 minutes. Park the bicycle at the mall's designated non-motor vehicle parking area and enter through the staff entrance.
location: Cycling from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Yoga stretching and relaxation at the store
description: During the holiday morning, before mall foot traffic arrived, and taking advantage of the fact that staff member Xiao Lin had not yet come in, he played a 15-minute yoga video for the neck, shoulders, and upper back in the open space by the fitting room at the back of the store, doing restorative stretching to ease the tightness in his neck and shoulders after the morning run, with emphasis on relaxing the neck, shoulders, and hips. After finishing, he felt his back was loosened up.
location: Fitting room in the rear area of the 'Xiafei Collection' clothing store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Holiday store operations and display adjustments
description: After store clerk Xiao Lin came on duty at 9:30, Xiao Lin first reviewed yesterday's sales report. On the first day of the holiday, foot traffic and revenue rose about 30% compared with an ordinary weekend, but the sell-through rate of the new summer techwear styles was lower than expected. Xiao Lin picked out several slow-moving spring items to return to the warehouse and arrange stock transfers. Then, together with Xiao Lin, Lei Mingxuan rearranged the newly arrived summer techwear: he moved the featured styles to the mannequin by the entrance, adjusted the lighting to highlight the fabric's high-tech feel, and placed basic T-shirts with them in the middle of the shelves. At the same time, he adjusted the POP posters in the accessories area next to the checkout counter to make the overall display more coordinated.
location: Xiafei Ji clothing store, A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch at International Finance Centre: signature tonkotsu ramen
description: The noon customer flow was steady; Xiao Lin watched the store. Walked through the Lujiazui skyway for about 9 minutes to the “Cui Ramen” restaurant on B2 of the International Finance Centre. Ordered the signature tonkotsu ramen with an added soft-boiled egg. While waiting for the food, scrolled through Xiaohongshu to save interesting display ideas and replied to billiards buddy Han Dong’s WeChat message about preparations for the May 24 billiards tournament.
location: Cui Ramen, B2, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Short afternoon rest at the store
description: After lunch, he returned to the store. As afternoon drowsiness set in, he closed his eyes and took a 20-minute nap on the staff rest chair in the back area of the store. He set a 10-minute alarm to wake up, and after washing his face, he felt refreshed.
location: Staff rest area, Xiafei Ji clothing store, 2nd Floor, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon customer relationship maintenance and sales
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic gradually increased. While serving walk-in customers, I also followed up with regular customers on WeChat: I sent Feng Xiaoyu in Suzhou photos and styling suggestions for the new shirts, and she said she would come to Shanghai next week to try them on; I recommended the new techwear-style vest to Qian Duoduo in Jing'an District, received favorable feedback, and arranged for her to visit the store after the holiday. During this time, I proactively introduced the fabric and styling of the cargo shorts to a young customer who was hesitating, and successfully closed the sale. I also found time to shoot three short detail videos of the adjusted display and posted them to the store's WeChat group.
location: Xiafei Ji clothing store, A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting home after work
description: At 16:30, after telling Xiao Lin to check inventory, clean the floor, and activate the alarm system before closing, he left the store. He rode a shared bike back along the same route. Passing Rushan Road, he noticed a line at a newly opened deli and noted the location, planning to visit another day. He arrived home at 17:00.
location: Cycling from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Pre-meal help and rest
description: After returning home, his mother was busy in the kitchen. He helped wash a bunch of greens, then went to his room to change into loungewear. He sat on the living room sofa watching the news channel on TV and replied to several customer inquiries on WeChat.
location: At home: No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner time
description: Mother brought out Shanghai-style braised pork, stir-fried clover, and tomato and egg soup, and Father had already opened the rice wine. During the meal, Father asked about the store's business that day. Lei Mingxuan briefly reported on the holiday foot traffic and feedback on the new clothing, saying the spring transformation had been preliminarily validated, which reassured Father. The atmosphere was relaxed, and Mother reminded everyone to take care of their health.
location: Home Chinese Restaurant, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-meal leisure and ordering delivered drinks.
description: After the meal, he proactively cleared the dishes and took them to the kitchen, then returned to the living room and changed the TV to the sports channel to watch snooker. At the same time, he opened a food delivery app on his phone and ordered two cups of the signature lemon tea from Nishang Chawu as drinks.
location: Living room at home, 2-51, Shanggang Residential Quarter, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online entertainment and blind box socializing
description: After the delivery arrived, she took the lemon tea into the study. She first logged into Bilibili to catch up on the latest episode of Kaiju No. 8, enjoying the danmaku comments to relax. Then she browsed the Pop Mart mini-program and tried to pull the hidden figure from the newly released “Space Series” without success, so she chatted with fellow collector Lin Jing (Jingjing) in the online group about blind-box pulling experiences and comforted each other.
location: Home study, Room 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Organize data and read before bed.
description: Opened Excel on the computer and entered the tag prices and sell-through data for the new styles recorded during the day, updating the store's summer new-arrival schedule. Then he closed the laptop, washed up briefly, changed into pajamas, read two chapters of The Longest Day in Chang'an in bed, grew drowsy, turned off the light, and rested.
location: Study and bedroom at home, 2-51 Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Early-morning wake-up, weighted stair climbing, and alternating hot and cold showers.
description: On Saturday he slept in naturally and got up at 6:30. He opened the curtains to see good weather—sunny turning cloudy—and felt in a good mood. He simply put on a quick-dry T-shirt and shorts, took a couple of sips of warm water, and filled his 10 kg hiking backpack with water bottles. He left the house right at 6:40 and began weighted stair-climbing training in the stairwell of Building 2 in the neighborhood, climbing 20 floors per set for 3 sets, with 3-minute rests on the rooftop platform between sets, gazing out at Lujiazui. His heart rate stayed in the 150-160 range, and his clothes were soaked with sweat. After finishing the last set at 7:40, he leaned against the wall panting heavily, feeling a strong sense of accomplishment. At 7:45 he returned home, went straight to the bathroom, first used hot water to open his pores, then cold water to tighten them, alternating twice, and instantly felt refreshed. Then he did simple stretches for the front of his thighs and calves, and his body was completely loosened up.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Hearty breakfast and casual chat with family.
description: His mother Wang Xiuying had already pan-fried shengjian buns and cooked white rice porridge and tea eggs. Lei Mingxuan wolfed down the shengjian and told his mother that he had arranged to play billiards with his playing partner Han Dong that afternoon and would bring back something delicious for dinner. His mother smiled and told him not to drink too many cold drinks; Lei Mingxuan readily agreed.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Early morning pour-over coffee experiment
description: After breakfast, he cleaned up the dishes, and Lei Mingxuan started today's coffee experiment. After boiling water, he used a digital scale to accurately weigh 15 grams of Colombian Huila beans and set the grind to medium-fine. Today he adjusted the water temperature to 90°C and used a three-stage pour, with a total extraction time of 2 minutes 35 seconds. The moment it entered his mouth, the acidity became bright and lively, the previous astringency disappeared, but the body was lacking. He wrote in his notebook: "90°C water temperature + medium-fine grind, acidity noticeably improved, sweetness average, body lacking. Tomorrow try 90°C water temperature, but adjust the grind half a notch finer to see if the extraction rate can be increased."
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leisurely morning: scrolling on my phone and receiving a package.
description: After finishing his coffee, Lei Mingxuan curled up on the living room sofa and opened his phone. He first replied to Zhang Wei's rant in the Pudong Three Musketeers group, then scrolled through customer feedback in the shop's VIP group. Just then the doorbell rang — it was the new Dimoo blind box he had snagged on the Pop Mart mini-program the day before yesterday. He opened it excitedly. Although it wasn't a hidden edition, the red panda design was quite cute, so he took a few photos and sent them to the collector exchange group.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Accompanied My Father to the Food Market to Shop for Groceries
description: Watching his mother busy making lunch in the kitchen, Lei Mingxuan volunteered to go to the vegetable market with his father, Lei Jianguo. The father and son rode shared bikes for a few minutes and arrived at the familiar Pushang Vegetable Market. Lei Mingxuan carried shopping bags for his father and watched him skillfully bargain in Shanghainese with familiar stall owners, picking out several bunches of green water spinach and lively white shrimp. This simple scene of everyday life made him feel especially grounded.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family lunch.
description: Back home, his mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared her signature dishes: oil-braised shrimp, sweet and sour spare ribs, and stir-fried amaranth. The family of three sat around the table. While eating, Lei Mingxuan shared his new discovery about hand-brewed coffee and mentioned that he was going to play billiards with Han Dong in the afternoon. His father told him not to drink too many iced drinks, and he nodded with a smile.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and getting ready to go out
description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan lounged on the sofa to digest for a while, then went back to the bedroom, drew the curtains, set a 1-hour alarm, and took a comfortable nap. When he woke up, he felt refreshed. He changed into a loose athletic T-shirt and shorts, grabbed his cue stick and wrist guard, put his phone and some change in his pocket, and left on time at 13:30.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon billiards time: walking to meet up, playing a few games, and refueling with milk tea
description: Lei Mingxuan walked 11 minutes to the billiard hall on B1 of World Plaza. Han Dong was already waiting at their usual spot, with two bottles of sparkling water on the table. The two directly started a game of American eight-ball. Lei Mingxuan was on a hot streak today, making several beautiful combination shots and bank shots. Han Dong refused to be outdone and, while playing, talked about his recently modified second-hand Golf, which had new shock absorbers and wheels. In the end, Lei Mingxuan won narrowly by 6:4, and after the game they were thoroughly pleased. Afterwards, both were a little thirsty, so they took the elevator down to B1 of Lujiazui Center, and at a newly opened milk tea shop each ordered a Bold Grape and a Succulent Peach. They sat down to rest and chat, venting about recent work and worries.
location: B1, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycled to buy cooked food and went home.
description: After saying goodbye to Han Dong, Lei Mingxuan scanned a shared bike and deliberately detoured to Lao Wang Ji Cooked Food Shop on Rushan Road. A small queue was waiting outside, and the aroma of braised food was mouthwatering. He bought a portion of the signature soy-braised beef, half a roast duck, and his mother's favorite four-joy braised gluten, hoping to add a dish to dinner and make his parents happy. With the deli food hanging on the handlebars, he rode home leisurely, the late-summer breeze feeling pleasant on his face.
location: Lao Wang Ji Delicatessen, No. 132, Rushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Helped mother prepare dinner
description: Lei Mingxuan handed the cooked food to his mother Wang Xiuying, who was busy in the kitchen. His mother grumbled that he was wasting money, but the smile on her face could not be hidden. Lei Mingxuan helped plate the roast duck and slice the soy-braised beef, chatting with his mother about the interesting things from today's billiards game while working.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: At the dinner table, besides the tomato scrambled eggs and luffa soup made by his mother, the braised beef and roast duck bought from outside became the main characters. Father Lei Jianguo tasted the beef and nodded in praise. The family chatted while eating; his mother also asked whether to bring some roast duck to cousin Shen Jie. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-dinner pastime: scrolling videos and checking out trendy toys
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan voluntarily took on the dishwashing. After cleaning up, he returned to the living room, lay on the sofa, and scrolled through funny videos and game recordings on Bilibili. He also opened the Pop Mart mini-program to check this week's new product previews, and browsed the hidden-style figure gallery he hadn't pulled before, just to feast his eyes.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Anime time: catching up on Demon Slayer and discussing it online
description: Back in the bedroom, he turned off the main light and kept only the floor lamp by the bed, put on Bluetooth earphones, opened Bilibili to watch the latest episode of April's new anime Demon Slayer: Swordsmith Village Arc. The hype battle scenes were a blast for Lei Mingxuan. After finishing, he switched to the WeChat group 'Shanghai Anime Fan Group' and had a passionate voice chat with his friend Gao Yuan about the plot and power-level settings for nearly half an hour.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparations and phone scrolling
description: After finishing the anime, Lei Mingxuan washed up in the bathroom, changed into his pajamas, and lay down on the bed. He picked up his phone and scrolled through Xiaohongshu for a while, checking fashion trends and new posts from art toy bloggers. He also sent several messages with tomorrow's work arrangements in the store operations group.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Make the coffee plan for tomorrow and go to sleep.
description: At 22:30, Lei Mingxuan turned off his phone, but his mind was still on tomorrow's pour-over experiment. He picked up the small notebook on his bedside table and wrote down today's results with 90°C water temperature and tomorrow's new plan using 91°C with a medium-fine grind. After writing, he felt his thoughts were clearer. He turned off the bedside lamp, closed his eyes contentedly, and drifted off to sleep.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and refreshing
description: Woken by his phone alarm at 6:30 in the morning, he lingered in bed briefly, lay there browsing his phone, and confirmed that the weather today was overcast and suitable for warehouse work. Then he rubbed his eyes, stretched, and got up to start a new day.
location: Bedroom, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning pour-over practice: attempting the one-pour method.
description: In the kitchen at home, boiled water and weighed coffee beans. Today tried 90°C water temperature and the single-pour technique, with an extraction time of 2 minutes 10 seconds, focusing on steady water flow. After tasting, the acidity stood out but the layers were thin. Recorded the experiment notes in the phone memo app, and decided to return to segmented pouring the next day and slightly adjust the grind size.
location: Kitchen, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast with parents and neighbor interactions
description: His mother, Wang Xiuying, prepared a breakfast of scallion oil noodles and soft-boiled eggs. During the meal, the neighbor Aunt Zhu Xiuying brought over some home-grown scallions and chatted with his mother about everyday matters. After eating, he greeted Aunt Zhu and asked her to keep an eye on the downstairs deliveries, then got ready to go out.
location: Restaurant, 2-51 Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycle commute to the store
description: Changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and cargo pants, scanned a shared bike at the neighborhood gate, rode west along Pudong Avenue. Weekend traffic was smooth, and I arrived at Super Brand Mall in about 15 minutes for work.
location: Along the route from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Organize summer sales data and prepare key points for supplier communication
description: After arriving at the store, I immediately turned on the computer, exported the sales reports for the past two months, and analyzed the SKU performance of T-shirts, sun-protection jackets, and lightweight pants, breaking down the data by fabric, color, and price range. I looked through WeChat feedback from the long-time customer Qian Duoduo and took into consideration her request for T-shirts with techwear-style pockets. I summarized all key points into a concise Excel sheet as the core outline for tomorrow's video meeting with supplier Zhou Tao. During a break, I fetched water in the hallway, saw the next-door milk tea shop with a queue, and felt the Sunday customer flow intensity.
location: Office of Store A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lunch: Japanese ramen
description: After shutting down the computer, told the shop assistant Xiao Chen that he was going out. Walked about 8 minutes through an underground passage to the Japanese ramen shop on the basement level of IFC Mall, ordered the signature tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg, and browsed *Demon Slayer* discussion threads while eating, enjoying a short break.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant, B1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store warehouse organization and inventory count
description: After the meal, he returned to the store, changed into work clothes, and entered the warehouse with shop assistant Xiao Chen. They first packed up out-of-season slow-moving styles and attached return labels; then inventoried the shelf stock item by item, checked the system data on a tablet, and immediately noted when two best-selling styles were missing sizes in certain colors. He moved the newly arrived T-shirts to free up space. Although his lower back was sore, he persisted and finished, clearing storage space for the new goods arriving at the end of the month.
location: Store Warehouse A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Roller skating on Binjiang Road and contacting friends
description: After finishing warehouse work, I changed into roller skates and skated 5 minutes from Super Brand Mall to the Pudong Riverside Promenade (Minsheng Road to Dongchang Road section). It was overcast, with a cool river breeze. I skated back and forth along the path twice, and the soreness in my body completely disappeared. While resting on a bench, I contacted my roller skating friend Song Jia on WeChat to invite her to skate together; she was out shopping, so she said next time. I continued skating for half an hour and went home satisfied.
location: Binjiang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Minsheng Road to Dongchang Road section)

name: Buy cooked food and bike home.
description: At the restroom at the end of Binjiang Road, he washed his face and changed back into his casual shoes. He then took a shared bike to Boss Shan's roujiamo shop on Rushan Road, bought two roujiamo and a serving of liangpi, exchanged a few pleasantries with the owner, and had them packed. He rode another 10 minutes back home, fulfilling his father's wish to eat from Boss Shan's shop.
location: Shan Laoban (Rushan Road store), No. 71 Rushan Road, to Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Rest and hand over the spoils
description: After arriving home, I gave the roujiamo and liangpi to my mother Wang Xiuying, who was preparing dinner, in response to my father's repeated reminders. I returned to the bedroom, changed into loungewear, drank some water to rest, and got ready for dinner.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Hearty family dinner
description: Mother also made stir-fried clover and scrambled eggs with shrimp, so the table was set with roujiamo, liangpi, and pork rib soup. The family ate and chatted. I shared that during the warehouse inventory, I found blue T-shirts were selling well and needed restocking. Father Lei Jianguo taught me the secret of staying on top of restocking. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Restaurant, 2-51 Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-meal daily routine and work preparation.
description: After the meal, he volunteered to wash the dishes, then went to the study and turned on the computer. He entered the afternoon inventory data into the system to generate a restocking order and organized the materials for tomorrow's video conference with supplier Zhou Tao. He sent Brother Tao a WeChat message in advance saying the materials were ready, attached the restocking list, and received an OK reply.
location: Study, 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure: watching anime and browsing designer toys
description: In the bedroom, opened Bilibili to watch the latest episode of "Demon Slayer: Swordsmith Village Arc". When the protagonist used a new move, he excitedly took a screenshot and shared it in the anime group, discussing it online with group friend Gao Yuan. After watching, he browsed the Pop Mart mini program and ordered a Molly figurine as a reward for a hard day's work.
location: Bedroom, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wash up and prepare for bed
description: Went to the bathroom to shower; the hot water relieved the fatigue from moving things. After a simple skincare routine, returned to the bedroom. Since today was physically demanding and there is a meeting tomorrow, I decided to rest early and set the alarm for 21:40.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went to bed early
description: Turned off the lights and lay down, reviewing the day: the coffee experiment was fruitful, work data was organized clearly, the warehouse was cleaned up, I brought favorite foods for my parents, and in the evening I caught up on anime and bought a figure. Though tired, I felt fulfilled and satisfied, and fell asleep quickly.
location: Bedroom, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run 6 kilometers.
description: The alarm rang at 6:30 a.m. After washing up and changing into running shoes, I jogged from home to Lujiazui Central Green Park. I completed a 6 km run along the park's fitness trail at a pace of 6 minutes per kilometer. After the run, I stretched on a bench to relieve the muscle soreness from yesterday's moving goods.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shower and pour-over coffee practice.
description: After returning from his morning jog, he first took a cold shower and changed into dry loungewear. Then in the kitchen he set up his hand-drip coffee equipment, adjusted the grind size between medium-fine and medium, used water at 90°C, and poured in three stages (40g for a 30-second bloom, then two pours of 55g each), for a total extraction time of 2 minutes 30 seconds. After tasting, the acidity was bright and the sweetness was improved, but there was a slight greenness. He took notes and planned to extend the bloom time tomorrow. Finally, he drank a small half cup and left the rest to cool.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: His mother Wang Xiuying prepared small wontons, fried eggs, and pickled vegetables. During breakfast, he chatted with his father Lei Jianguo about the afternoon meeting with supplier Zhou Tao to discuss summer orders. His father reminded him to pay attention to contract details, and his mother told him to eat more vegetables at lunch.
location: Home Chinese Restaurant, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycled to Super Brand Mall
description: After breakfast, he went back to his room, changed into a T-shirt and casual pants, and grabbed the canvas bag of materials. After saying goodbye to his parents, he went downstairs and scanned a shared bike at the gate of the residential compound to head to Super Brand Mall. With few people on the road due to the adjusted holiday, he rode along Pudong Avenue for about 15 minutes, the spring breeze brushing his face.
location: Along the route from Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store inventory check and meeting preparation
description: After arriving at the store, I checked overall cleanliness and displays. At the computer, I reviewed the sales data and customer feedback forms organized yesterday, making final preparations for the afternoon meeting with suppliers. Then I went into the warehouse to verify the two best-selling styles with incomplete sizes that Xiao Chen had counted the day before last, and noted the restocking styles and quantities that needed to be prioritized in communication.
location: Xiafeiji store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Tried a Sichuan-style noodle shop for lunch.
description: Locked the store door, went down to B1, and for a change of taste went to the newly opened Bashi Sichuan Noodle Shop, where I ordered the signature dan dan noodles and red-oil wontons. The noodles were chewy, numbing, spicy, fresh, and fragrant; I ate until sweat broke out on my forehead and felt mentally refreshed.
location: Bashi Sichuan Noodle Restaurant, B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Resting after the meal and inspecting the store
description: After eating, returned to the store and took a 20-minute nap on the rest chair behind the cash register, scrolling through her phone to check mall promotions. Around 1 p.m., she strolled along the second-floor corridor to observe the foot traffic and displays of other stores on the same floor, jotting down some promotion ideas.
location: The Xiafei Collection store and corridor on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepare for the video conference
description: Returned to the office behind the store, set up the computer, charger, and notebook in advance, and ensured a stable network. Sent a WeChat message to supplier Zhou Tao in Hangzhou to confirm the 2 p.m. meeting and received a positive reply.
location: Xiafei Ji store office, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Video conference with supplier Zhou Tao to finalize the summer order.
description: At exactly 14:00, he had a video call with Zhou Tao. Zhou Tao showed samples of the new techwear lightweight jackets and quick-dry pants. Based on the store's positioning and customer feedback, Lei Mingxuan asked about the fabric's waterproof and breathable properties, pocket design, and stitching details, and proposed changing one dark gray style to light khaki. In the end, five new styles were finalized, with an initial batch of 300 pieces and a shipping date of May 25.
location: Online (Lei Mingxuan is at the Xiafei Collection office in Super Brand Mall, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; Zhou Tao is in Hangzhou)
