His father, Lei Jianguo, also advised him to pay attention to his health, but he snapped back emotionally, 'So what if I eat it once?' This made his mother cry, and he went back to his room dejected, leaving the fried chicken untouched.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After calming down, reflected on health issues and browsed health information.
description: At 20:45, after calming down, he felt deeply guilty. He opened Keep to check today's exercise calories, compared them with the calories from fried chicken, and blamed himself. In Keep's diet management feature, he looked at fat-loss meal recommendations, searched for "digestive care" and "high-protein, low-fat recipes," read related articles, and made up his mind to seriously manage his health.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening billiards practice.
description: At 21:15 he went out and walked to the World Square billiards hall. Seeing that his friend Han Dong had posted on Moments that he had replaced the billiard table cloth, he replied, “Wait for me! I'll be right there!” He played three games of American eight-ball with Han Dong. Because his mood was low, he was actually more focused, practicing long-shot attacks and cue ball positioning, and won half and lost half.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home to take a shower and making a diet plan
description: At 22:15, walked home. After a hot shower, sat on the edge of the bed, opened the Boohee Health app, and set daily calorie and macronutrient goals based on his height, weight, and target weight of 75 kg. He recorded tomorrow's three-meal plan (breakfast: oatmeal with milk + eggs; lunch: chicken breast salad; dinner: steamed fish + vegetables), and saved a fat-loss meal tutorial on Bilibili.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Record tomorrow's to-dos and read
description: At 22:45, I opened Notion and listed the key tasks for tomorrow: follow up on the scented candle order, reply to Zhou Tao's email about fabric color fastness, and prepare the materials list for the weekend event. After that, I leaned against the headboard and read Volume 3 of A Song of Ice and Fire, the section about Jon Snow at Castle Black. The text gradually calmed me down.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepare for bed and apologize to mother
description: At 23:15, after putting down the book, picked up the phone and sent a WeChat message to mother to apologize, saying that he was the one in the wrong today, promising to start recording his three meals with an app from tomorrow and eat properly, asking her not to be angry. After sending the message, he saw that she was typing but got no reply, and understood that she might still be angry. Then he turned off the light and lay down. Though feeling a bit heavy-hearted, he was determined to change and eventually fell asleep after tossing and turning.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and weight-loss breakfast
description: The phone alarm rang. Lei Mingxuan pressed it off but didn't get up right away. He still felt a lump in his chest from last night's argument, but the weather outside looked nice, so he resolved to start the new day according to his weight loss plan. After washing up, he went to the kitchen to prepare the standard breakfast: 30 grams of oatmeal soaked in hot milk, and two soft-boiled eggs. His mother, Wang Xiuying, was already in the kitchen, and the atmosphere between them was tense. Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to talk to her and prepared it himself, recording the calories with the Boohee Health app.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Morning run and getting ready to go home and shower.
description: After putting on his running shoes, Lei Mingxuan went out to Lujiazui Central Green Park for a morning run. The camphor trees in the park gave off a fresh scent. He cleared his mind and ran 4.5 kilometers, feeling his frustration evaporate with his sweat. After the run, he went home, took a hot shower, changed into a clean black T-shirt and shorts, sprayed on sport cologne, and brought his self-brewed oolong tea and a water bottle. As he was getting ready to leave, he hoped he might run into his mother and ease the tension between them, but she never came out of her room.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - Lujiazui Central Green Park on Lujiazui Ring Road, and home in Shanggang Residential Area

name: Clothing store work and lunch
description: Lei Mingxuan took a shared bike to Super Brand Mall, entered through the staff passage and went upstairs, arriving at the store a little after 8:00. He turned on his computer and the POS terminal to analyze sales data and inventory, used his phone to edit photos of the White Tea Breeze scented candles, wrote the teaser copy for the Mother's Day event, and scheduled it to be sent via the official account and WeChat Moments. After the mall opened at 10:00, he played music to welcome customers. At noon, he went to the B1 floor, packed a chicken breast and vegetable salad from Light Food Diary, and brought it back to the store to eat, browsing Xiaohongshu while eating to find outfit inspiration. In the afternoon, he organized the merchandise bought from Guangzhou last week, set up wall displays and coordinated outfits, coached the part-time shop assistant Xiao Wang on greeting customers, checked logistics waybills in the storeroom, and replied on WeChat to a regular customer asking about the arrival of Wu Fang's accessories. Around 14:30, he handed over to Xiao Wang, closed the store early, and prepared to leave.
location: RE MX clothing store, Shop A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Light Food Diary on the B1 level

name: Choosing a birthday gift for his father
description: Lei Mingxuan walked to the boutique cultural and creative store on the first floor of the HSBC Building at Shanghai ifc mall to pick out a birthday gift. He was drawn to a portable walnut box tea set containing a white porcelain teapot and two cups painted with plum blossoms. Feeling it would suit his father, who loves tea and often plays chess with old friends by the flower beds in the residential area, and finding the price reasonable, he bought it and asked the clerk to wrap it elegantly. After making the purchase, he felt at ease.
location: Quyue Gift Shop, 1st Floor, HSBC Building, Shanghai ifc Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shopping for ingredients at the market
description: After coming out of the ifc mall, Lei Mingxuan walked to the Pushang Market on Dongchang Road. Following the recipe he saw yesterday, he bought a live sea bass, winter melon, fish maw, tomatoes, and eggs to prepare for the family reconciliation dinner in the evening, then carried the groceries and walked home.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went home to drop things off and received a message from his mother about a blind date
description: Lei Mingxuan pushed the door open and arrived home. The house was quiet, and his parents were not there. He put the groceries and gifts away. Just as he was about to rest, his phone rang. It was a WeChat message from his mother Wang Xiuying, telling him that she had arranged a blind date with Aunt Zhang's daughter at the private room in Lujiazui Center at 7 PM and asking him not to be late. Lei Mingxuan immediately felt annoyed, believing his mother was ignoring his efforts to smooth things over during the day and continuing to pressure him. His emotions burst out instantly.
location: At home: No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family conflict erupts
description: Mother just returned home and asked whether he had received the WeChat message. Lei Mingxuan burst into an argument, accusing his mother of making a surprise visit today right after they had argued yesterday, saying he had planned to cook and give gifts to create reconciliation, but it was ruined. Agitated, he canceled the planned Mogan Mountain camping trip and refused the blind date. After his father came home and witnessed the quarrel, he remained silent. Lei Mingxuan threw down his keys, shouted, and then slammed the door and went into his room.
location: Living room at home, 2-51, Shanggang Residential Quarter, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cooling off alone and adjusting the plan
description: Lei Mingxuan paced back and forth in his room, feeling wronged and believing that his efforts that day were not understood. He opened his phone and canceled the Mogan Mountain homestay reservation and called off the pool appointment with his friend Han Dong. After calming down, he recalled yesterday's reflection and decided that arguing couldn't solve the problem. Since the camping trip had fallen through, he would use cooking as an opportunity to break the ice. He decided to cook according to the original plan and express his attitude through his actions.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Taking the initiative to cook a family reconciliation dinner
description: Lei Mingxuan walked out of the room and went straight to the kitchen, put on an apron, and started preparing ingredients. His mother followed him in with red-rimmed eyes. Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to ask how to make steamed sea bass, and the rift between mother and son began to dissolve as they cooked together. Dinner was completed: steamed sea bass, winter melon and fish maw soup, and tomato scrambled eggs. At the dinner table, Lei Mingxuan sincerely apologized to his mother and expressed his hope for understanding, promising to take weight loss seriously and to consider matters of the heart. His mother was moved to tears and served him food. Lei Mingxuan gave his father a portable tea set he had bought in advance as a birthday gift for next week. His father smiled in pleasant surprise, and the family atmosphere turned warm.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-dinner family time and relaxation
description: After dinner, the family of three watched TV together. Lei Mingxuan used his new tea set to brew Lapsang Souchong for his father and talked about hosting a dinner for his father's birthday. Around 9 o'clock he went back to his room and told Han Dong on WeChat what had happened that evening; Han Dong said he understood. Lei Mingxuan opened Bilibili to watch the new episode of Demon Slayer, and his mood improved.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Exercise, logging, and planning
description: Lei Mingxuan took out his Switch and played Fitness Boxing 2 for half an hour, working up a sweat. After washing up, he opened the memo app on his phone to record important items: confirm the scented candle delivery, arrange for store staff to prepare Mother's Day event materials, and consider taking his parents on a short trip nearby as an alternative to camping. Then, remembering that Mother's Day was approaching, he ordered a pair of gold earrings online for his mother as a surprise. After finishing the planning, he felt the relationship repair was back on track.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep reading and falling asleep
description: Lei Mingxuan scrolled through his phone for a while, saw Mother's Day-related posts, and after confirming that the earrings had been ordered, felt tired. He closed the book and turned off the light, reflecting that although today had been rough, it ended well, and looked forward to a new day.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm rang on time at 6:30 in the morning. He felt well-rested, with a sense of excitement about the upcoming reconciliation plan. He changed into the athletic short-sleeve shirt and shorts he had prepared the night before and stepped on the scale — 77.7 kg, the same as yesterday, with his basal metabolism holding up well.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run and cardio wake-up
description: Set off jogging from the residential compound, following a familiar route into Lujiazui Central Green Park. The morning air carried the fresh scent of grass and trees, and there were already plenty of early exercisers on the track. He completed a 4.5-kilometer run at a pace of 5 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer, working up a good sweat. He stretched thoroughly by the lawn, feeling his lungs open up and the pleasure of sweating. His worries seemed to be left behind, building up confidence for family communication and mental preparation.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shower, family heart-to-heart talk, and a warm breakfast
description: After his morning run, he took a warm shower to wash away the sweat, then picked a light-gray cotton T-shirt and dark-blue casual pants, feeling refreshed and comfortable. While his parents watched the morning news, he took the initiative to sit in the living room and poured three cups of warm water, candidly sharing his personal plans: he wanted to focus first on the clothing store upgrade and a self-drive trip to western Sichuan, and promised to have regular check-ups. His mother Wang Xiuying's eyes reddened but she nodded in understanding; his father Lei Jianguo patted his shoulder and said, "A real man keeps his word," and the atmosphere eased. Then his mother heated milk, fried eggs, and brought out fresh pork mooncakes, and the whole family had a comforting breakfast. Taking advantage of his father going to the balcony to tend to the plants, he quietly asked his mother what his father had recently liked but couldn't bear to buy, and learned that he had taken a liking to a dark-gray cashmere vest from TV shopping but thought it was too expensive.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go out and head to Century Link Mall
description: After breakfast, I changed into a linen shirt, took my phone and bank card, and said goodbye to my parents. Since the sunlight was just right, I decided to ride a shared bike to Century Link Mall in Pudong, which was both good exercise and convenient.
location: On the way from Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Century Link Mall, 179 Weifang Road

name: Carefully choosing a birthday gift for my father
description: Arriving at the men's clothing section on the second floor of Century Link Mall, he quickly identified several brands thanks to his experience in the clothing business. After carefully comparing the fabric composition, stitching details, and collar label design of cashmere vests, he finally chose a dark gray, 100% pure cashmere V-neck vest with a soft hand feel and classic silhouette. After paying by card, he asked the sales assistant to wrap it in an exquisite gift box with a silver-gray ribbon, preparing a birthday surprise for his father.
location: Men's clothing area, 2nd floor, Century Link Mall, 179 Weifang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Pre-order his father's birthday cake
description: Carrying the gift box, left Century Link, walked to La Parisienne Bakery on Zhangyang Road. Told the clerk that I needed to order an 8-inch classic fresh milk cake, asked for 'Happy Birthday, Dad' to be written in chocolate, agreed to pick it up tomorrow (May 11) at 10 a.m., and paid a deposit.
location: No. 88 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, La Parisienne Paris Sweet Words

name: Arrived early near the climbing gym.
description: Riding a shared bike, he arrived near Yushan Road following the navigation. After parking the bike, he found a refreshing little shop called Xianshu Light Food downstairs from the climbing gym. He decided to wait for Zhao Min there, reading the menu while sending a message to let her know he had arrived.
location: Near the Fiber Veggie Light Food Shop at No. 12 Yushan Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Light lunch with Zhao Min
description: Zhao Min arrived on time and joked as soon as they met that he was in good shape. They each ordered a chicken breast and avocado salad and fresh orange juice. He enthusiastically shared the morning's deep family conversation and the surprise for his father. Zhao Min praised him for being seemingly careless on the surface but actually thoughtful. They exchanged recent rock climbing training tips, and Zhao Min encouraged him to keep a calm mindset and conquer the V3 route.
location: Fiber & Veggie Light Meal Shop, No. 12 Yushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rock Climbing Training and Completing a V3 Route
description: After lunch, I went straight into Qingtian Climbing Gym. After a 10-minute warm-up, I went to the bouldering area and took on the yellow V3 route that had been stuck. Under Zhao Min's guidance, I adjusted the push-off point and footwork for the first move. After several attempts, climbing buddy Xiao Wang suggested starting from a higher foothold and using my waist and core. On the third attempt, my fingers hooked the last hold firmly and I topped the route, high-fiving Zhao Min excitedly. During the break, I chatted with Xiao Wang about climbing shoes and training methods, and we added each other on WeChat.
location: Qingtian Climbing Gym, No. 9 Yushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rest and return after rock climbing
description: Said goodbye to Zhao Min at the entrance of the climbing gym. After the exercise, my body felt slightly pumped but I was in high spirits. I rode a shared bike back home in Shanggang Community against the afternoon breeze.
location: Along the route from Yushan Road to Shanggang Community on Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area.

name: Returning home, hiding gifts, and resting
description: While his father was reading the newspaper in the study and his mother was picking vegetables on the balcony, he tiptoed back to the bedroom and hid the gift box in the seasonal bedding at the bottom of the wardrobe. Then he went to the kitchen to get some water, sprayed the potted plants while he was at it, and completely relaxed.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Accompanied mother in preparing dishes and chatted
description: He took the initiative to put on an apron and walked into the kitchen to help. His mother was preparing braised beef brisket with tomato; he was responsible for peeling garlic and cutting roll-cut chunks. While working, he recounted his afternoon experience of completing V3. Although his mother didn't fully understand, she listened with great interest and joked that he had been restless and bouncing around since childhood. The chat made his mother beam with joy, and he felt the benefits of family communication even more.
location: Kitchen, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and relaxed atmosphere
description: Dinner was served: the braised beef brisket with tomatoes was tender, along with stir-fried lotus root slices and tomato and egg drop soup. At the table, I vividly described the thrill of rock climbing, and my father rarely chimed in to ask whether the ropes were secure. The atmosphere was unprecedentedly relaxed. Tonight my father ate an extra half bowl of rice, and the harmonious dinner brought the reconciliation to a complete close.
location: Restaurant, 2-51 Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-meal walk to aid digestion
description: He took the initiative to do the dishes. After cleaning up, he brewed a cup of Longjing tea for his father, his favorite, and sat with him on the sofa watching local news for a while. He felt the warmth filling the air at home.
location: Living room, No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Planning evening activities
description: Back in the bedroom, I lay on the bed scrolling through my phone. I saw Han Dong post a photo of a billiard table in the group chat 'Pudong Three Musketeers' asking if anyone was up for a game tonight. I replied instantly, 'Same place as usual, I'll be there in 20 minutes,' got up, changed into a light jacket, and got ready to go out.
location: Bedroom, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Practiced billiards with buddies at World Square.
description: Walked about 10 minutes to World Plaza Pool Hall, where Han Dong had already set up a table. They played three games of American eight-ball, with the score staying close. He made several nice bank shots and draw shots and eventually won 2:1. As they played, he listened to Han Dong brag about his modified wheel rims, and they agreed to go see them in person next time.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Strolling home and life's little joys
description: After saying goodbye to Han Dong, he strolled home at a leisurely pace. The night breeze in Pudong was refreshing, and he felt at ease. Passing by the Lawson convenience store at the entrance of the neighborhood, he went in and bought a bottle of iced oolong tea.
location: The route along Pudian South Road in Pudong New Area to Shanggang Residential Area and the nearby Lawson convenience store.

name: Time for washing up and catching up on anime.
description: Went home, took a comfortable hot shower, changed into pajamas, and lay down in bed. Opened Bilibili and continued watching an episode of Demon Slayer: Swordsmith Village Arc. The brilliant battle scenes were a real treat.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bed socializing and wrap-up
description: After finishing the anime, he replied to climbing buddy Xiao Wang’s WeChat message. The other person invited him to the climbing gym next Saturday to try a new route, and he gladly agreed. Scrolling through Moments, he liked posts by Zhao Min and Han Dong. Then he opened A Song of Ice and Fire and read about ten pages, and drowsiness gradually set in.
location: Bedroom, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep check and gratitude
description: Turned off the bedside lamp, set the phone to silent, and put it on the nightstand. Reflected on the day: the iceberg of family communication melted, father's birthday surprise was quietly prepared, and I conquered a new difficulty in rock climbing. An unprecedented sense of ease and relief surrounded me. I adjusted into a comfortable sleeping position and whispered to myself, "You did well today, Lei Mingxuan," then quickly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning health planning and app settings
description: Waking up in the early morning, I leaned against the headboard and downloaded and registered on the Boohee Health app, entered my height as 172 cm, weight as 80 kg, and age as 31, and got a daily calorie target of about 1,800 kcal. I planned the day's dietary focus: reduce high-oil and high-salt foods, increase high-quality protein and vegetables, and sent a screenshot to the family group, telling my mother that I would start healthy meal planning from today.
location: Home bedroom at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning awakening yoga
description: After getting up, spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor, open the “Daily Yoga” app on your phone, and complete the 15-minute “Morning Spine Awakening” sequence, including Cat-Cow, Downward-Facing Dog, and spinal twists, to relieve the stiffness of the night. Then go to the balcony, take deep breaths, and watch the elderly doing morning exercises downstairs, feeling refreshed.
location: Bedroom and balcony at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shared family breakfast
description: After washing up, I went downstairs to the dining room. My mother had prepared boiled eggs, whole-wheat bread, and hot milk. My father was looking at his phone with reading glasses. While eating, I wished my father a happy birthday and suggested that the whole family go downstairs for a walk after lunch. Father agreed, mother smiled nearby, and the breakfast atmosphere was relaxed and warm.
location: Home Chinese Restaurant at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Going out to pick up cake and gifts
description: Rode the e-bike to the 'Mai Zi Shou Le' cake shop at No. 285 Pudian Road, picked up the pre-ordered 8-inch fresh milk cake using the order number, and the staff reminded me to keep it refrigerated. On the way, stopped by a nearby dry cleaner to pick up the dry-cleaned and shaped cashmere vest. After getting home, put the cake in the fridge and placed the cashmere vest in a gift bag on the living room coffee table.
location: Mai Zi Shu Le Cake Shop at No. 285 Pudian Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the nearby dry cleaner

name: Weighted stair climbing training.
description: After changing into workout gear, he packed several thick books into an old backpack as a load of about 8 kg, and climbed at a steady pace from the 1st to the 20th floor, completing 3 sets in total. During the second set, he was breathing heavily and his thighs were sore, but he pushed through. During each rest, he drank water by the window and enjoyed the view, burning calories to achieve his health goal.
location: Stairwell of Apartment Building 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (1st to 20th floor)

name: Helping in the kitchen and handling online customers.
description: After showering and changing clothes, went into the kitchen to help my mother. I was in charge of peeling garlic, trimming vegetables, and washing them. At the same time, I explained the healthy eating plan to her in detail, suggesting more steaming and less braising. Although she grumbled, she had already adjusted the menu. During that time, a customer sent WeChat messages asking about T-shirt sizes, and I replied to a few messages while trimming vegetables.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Father's birthday lunch and gift offering
description: The dining table was filled with dishes such as steamed sea bass, blanched choy sum, garlic broccoli, braised prawns, and pork rib and mushroom soup. He turned off the TV, lit the "62" birthday candles, and brought out the cake and gifts. Together with his mother, he sang the birthday song for his father, apologized for arguing with him a couple of days earlier, and gave him a cashmere vest while wishing him a long life. His father patted him on the shoulder, his eyes reddened, and he only said one word: "Good."
location: Home Chinese Restaurant at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Father and son take a walk and talk after dinner
description: After a half-hour rest following the meal, I walked with my father in the community garden to aid digestion. We talked about the hard climb up the stairs in the morning and our health plans. Father advised that when building a career, you can't just focus on the present; you also need to take care of your health. As we passed the flower bed, he pointed to an osmanthus tree and said it was planted the year I was born, and the atmosphere was warm. We ran into an elderly man out for a walk, and my father proudly introduced that I had come back specially to celebrate his birthday.
location: Community garden, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations and order processing
description: Rode the e-bike to Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall. First checked the Mother's Day promotion data and found that T-shirt size M was nearly out of stock, so instructed store clerk Xiao Lin to replace the 'Hot Selling' tag with 'Almost Sold Out' to create urgency. Then replied to customers' WeChat messages about shipping and returns/exchanges in batches, and hung the new arrivals in a prominent spot in the display window. Next, logged into the private-domain community backend, confirmed the orders for three flash sale events in the afternoon, printed 8 shipping labels, checked the items with Xiao Lin, inspected for defects, packed and sealed the boxes, and contacted the SF Express courier to pick up the packages at 17:30.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening family leisure time
description: After closing the shop, I rode my e-bike home, changed out of my work clothes, and sat on the sofa to watch Tiger Talk with my father. My mother brought over cut chilled watermelon. I took out my phone, scrolled through Xiaohongshu, looked at content from peers, and brainstormed the topic for my next short video.
location: Living room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: Mother reheated several dishes from lunch and also stir-fried a plate of tomato and eggs and made luffa egg drop soup. For once, Father opened half a bottle of yellow rice wine; I kept him company, chatting about store affairs and sharing today's stair-climbing pace and calorie burn. Mother felt sorry for me, while Father showed an approving expression.
location: Home Chinese Restaurant at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Evening personal care and social preparation
description: Because of the heavy exercise during the day, a hot shower made his whole body feel comfortable. Back in the bedroom, he dried his hair and, in the process, forwarded the WeChat contact of the MCN agency friend recommended by his friend Qian Duoduo to his cousin Shen Jie, ready to discuss Xiaohongshu collaboration details tomorrow.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Community interaction and catching up on anime.
description: Curled up in bed, first sent red envelopes in the WeChat group Xiafeiji Fan Club to thank people for their support, then shared photos from my father's birthday in the Pudong Three Musketeers group and received wishes from friends such as Zhang Wei and Li Na. Finally, I watched the latest episode of Jujutsu Kaisen on Bilibili, and at the exciting moments I took screenshots and discussed them with online friend Gao Yuan.
location: Home bedroom at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep review and bedtime
description: Turned off the anime, opened the 'Mint Health' app and logged the day's meals: steamed fish, broccoli, shrimp, and a little watermelon—perfectly within the calorie target. Looking back on the day: family relationships warmed up, the health plan got off to a good start, and store matters were all handled, leaving me feeling grounded. After setting the alarm for 8:00 the next morning, I regulated my breathing, turned off the lights, and went to sleep, ready for the new week.
location: Home bedroom at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run recovery training
description: In the morning it was cloudy. Starting from my home in Shanggang Residential Quarter, I jogged east along Pudong Avenue and turned back at Minsheng Road, covering about 6.2 kilometers at a pace of 6 min/km. My heart rate stayed around 140 and my breathing was smooth. After the run, I stretched for 5 minutes at the community fitness area, enjoying the lively breakfast stalls by the roadside, and felt happy.
location: From Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, to the area along Pudong Avenue and Minsheng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shower, pour-over coffee, and breakfast.
description: After running home, took a hot shower and changed into home clothes. Brewed a cup of pour-over coffee with pre-ground beans, and had it with the boiled egg and steamed sweet potato my mother had prepared as breakfast, logging the meal in the Mint Health app: coffee 5 kcal, boiled egg 70 kcal, sweet potato 90 kcal.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
