location: China, Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Unit A-208, Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

name: Plan new product display arrangement and tidy up workstation
description: After SF Express picked up the returned item, he drew a display layout in a notebook in the reorganized storage room, marking where the technical-style jackets, cargo pants, and tactical vests arriving at the end of the month should be placed. He then went back to the front desk, tidied up the various receipts, tape, markers, and other items, and prepared for normal business the next day.
location: China, Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Unit A-208, Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

name: Cycled home after work and confirmed the donation along the way.
description: After locking the shop, I rode my e-bike home. On the way, I detoured to the community charity donation point beside Lujiazui Central Green Park and confirmed with the uncle on duty that they would come to pick up the donated clothes after ten o'clock tomorrow morning. He responded warmly. Then I rode to the downstairs of my building and smelled the aroma of braised pork belly coming from home.
location: At the community charity donation point near Lujiazui Central Green Park, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, and on the way back to Shanggang Community

name: Helped prepare dinner and discussed weekend plans with my father.
description: After changing shoes at the door, he went to the kitchen to help his mother wash the greens and brought his father's brewed tea to the living room. When his father, Lei Jianguo, came home from work, he mentioned the donation tomorrow, and his father said he knew about it.
location: Kitchen and living room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family dinner, father volunteered to help at the store on the weekend
description: At dinner, he wolfed down the braised pork. His mother picked up food for him and told him to slow down. His father Lei Jianguo put down his chopsticks and offered to go to the store over the weekend to help with inventory and organize clothing racks, so that Mingxuan could catch his breath. Mingxuan felt a warmth in his heart and quickly agreed. Then he told his parents that next Saturday and Sunday he would instead go to Mogan Mountain for camping and physical training. His father expressed support and reminded him to be safe.
location: Dining table in the living room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family evening leisure, watching shows and chatting
description: After dinner, the three sat on the living room sofa watching the TV drama Like a Flowing River, chatting about the specific arrangements for the father to help out at the store over the weekend, such as how to organize clothes racks, help iron clothes, and receive regular customers. The mother brewed a pot of tea nearby, and the family talked and laughed together.
location: Sofa in the living room at home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Health recording, foot soaking, and learning operational skills.
description: After watching two episodes of a TV series, he went to the bathroom, poured hot water to soak his feet for 20 minutes, and while soaking, used his phone to scroll through Xiaohongshu posts about video operations, learning how to shoot outfit recommendation videos. After the foot soak, he returned to the bedroom, opened the Mint Health app, and recorded the day's diet and exercise (moving freight boxes counted as 1.5 hours of physical labor).
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Contacting the Pudong Three Musketeers online
description: Sent the short billiards video footage taken during the day and the before-and-after comparison photos of the warehouse to the “Pudong Three Musketeers” WeChat group, saying that his dad was going to be a shop assistant over the weekend and that he planned to go camping and training at Mogan Mountain next weekend, asking for gear recommendations. Zhang Wei reminded him to bring mosquito repellent, and Li Na suggested bringing hot pot base for a picnic on the mountain. He replied with a laughing emoji.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Planning the Mogan Mountain camping checklist and adding details to the novel
description: Opened the notes app on his phone to make a camping gear list for Mogan Mountain, including tent, sleeping bag, moisture-proof pad, mosquito repellent, quick-dry clothes, hardshell jacket, etc., and figured out what was still missing. Afterwards, he opened the document recording family stories and added details to the novel 'The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane' about how his grandfather's generation used carrying poles and oil-paper umbrellas when stocking goods.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Reading and bedtime preparation
description: Read a few pages of the bedside book Subei People in Shanghai, checking whether it had any descriptions of life in Xiafei Lane. Half an hour later, he closed the book, turned off the light, and lay down. His mind was still going over the weekend route to Moganshan and the need to buy another quick-dry shirt, and he gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Sleep
description: The busy, fulfilling, and heartwarming day came to an end, and he officially went to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning washing, weighing, and breakfast
description: In the morning, after his phone alarm rang, Lei Mingxuan woke up naturally, with sunlight streaming through the curtains into the room. He went to the bathroom, stepped on the scale, and saw 77.9 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday, which put him in a good mood. He quickly washed up, shaved, and applied moisturizer. Then, his mother had prepared white rice porridge, boiled eggs, and pickled vegetables for breakfast. As he sat down to eat, he greeted his father, who was watching the morning news, and opened the Boohee Health app to log his breakfast, reminding his mother that she didn't need to prepare lunch today.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Check the camping gear checklist
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan returned to his room and took the hiking backpack out of the storage room. Against the detailed gear list he had made in his phone's memo app the night before, he checked off each item: tent, sleeping bag, ground pad, headlamp, backup power supply, pour-over coffee kettle, action camera, power bank, change of clothes, and first-aid kit (containing Band-Aids, povidone-iodine, and antidiarrheal medicine). He arranged the roughly 15 kg of gear into a balanced load and packed it into the backpack.
location: Room 202, Building 6, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ride the electric bike to the Super Brand Mall store
description: Putting on his signature black tactical vest and tucking a folded umbrella into the side pocket, Lei Mingxuan started his e-bike at the door, rode west along Zhangyang Road for about 15 minutes, arrived at the staff entrance of Super Brand Mall, and parked the bike.
location: Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store tasks: open up, collect donated clothes, and shoot a short video
description: Lei Mingxuan unlocked the store's rolling shutter, turned on the lights and air conditioning, and tidied the clothing racks left from closing yesterday. He opened his computer and phone and quickly replied to three WeChat customer inquiries from the night before (asking about wide-leg pants sizes, reserving a sun-protection shirt, etc.). Then he got a call on his phone from the community donation point staff saying they had arrived at the mall's loading area. He and Xiao Lin used a handcart to move the three large woven bags of old clothes sorted yesterday to the loading area, checked the count with the staff, filled out donation forms, signed to confirm, and watched the goods be loaded and driven away. Back in the store, he had Xiao Lin handle online orders and customers while he used the newly arrived Korean-style loose T-shirts and techwear shorts to quickly put together three looks. Using a phone tripod, he shot four short video clips (15-20 seconds each) in the store's fitting room and by the display window, roughly edited them, and posted them to the store's WeChat customer group and Moments with the caption: "Final touches before the weekend escape — new gear on, set off with the right mood!"
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rode an electric bike home
description: After handing over the final tasks to Xiao Lin and confirming that she could manage the store on her own in the afternoon, Lei Mingxuan started his e-bike and returned home to Zhangyang Huayuan along the same route.
location: Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch (Old Shanghai Scallion-Oil Noodle House)
description: At the Old Shanghai Scallion Oil Noodle Shop near home, Lei Mingxuan ordered a bowl of the signature spicy pork noodles with a fried egg. After eating quickly, he logged it in the Boohee Health app. Then he sent a voice message in the Pudong Three Musketeers WeChat group: Done! Ready to set off! and attached a road-trip sticker pack.
location: Old Shanghai Scallion Oil Noodle Restaurant, 1130 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Final packing of camping gear and loading it into the car
description: Back home, Lei Mingxuan carried the prepared hiking backpack, a canvas bag containing food and pour-over coffee equipment, and a small cooler (with ice, sandwiches, fruit, and two bottles of water) downstairs. He opened the trunk of his white SUV, neatly arranged all the gear, and checked the spare tire and jack.
location: Parking space under Building 6, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Refuel and buy supplies for the road.
description: He drove out of the residential community and turned into the nearby PetroChina gas station on Yuanshen Road. Lei Mingxuan asked the attendant to fill up the tank with No. 92 gasoline. While waiting, he went to the convenience store next to the gas station, bought half a cut watermelon and two bottles of mineral water, and put them in the cooler.
location: PetroChina Yuanshen Road gas station and the convenience store next door, 388 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drive to Xingye Campground at Mogan Mountain
description: At 13:45 he officially set off from the gas station and set the destination as "Xingye Campground, Deqing County" through the navigation app. Heading west along the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway, he stopped for about 15 minutes at Taihu Service Area on the Changshen Expressway, got out to stretch his legs, went to the restroom, and bought a bottle of oolong tea. He also used his phone to reconfirm the reserved campsite and the entrance to tomorrow's hiking route. The view outside the window gradually changed from the city to rolling hills, and he finally arrived in Deqing County.
location: No. 388 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Xingye Camp, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, via the G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway and the Taihu Service Area on the G25 Changchun-Shenzhen Expressway.

name: Arrived at the campsite, checked in, and set up the tent
description: After arriving in Deqing County, he drove about 5 minutes along a country road to the Xingye Camp parking lot. Lei Mingxuan checked in at the camp service center by showing his reservation code and received a campsite card. He parked in the designated area, then walked 100 meters with his gear to the reserved site (near the stream, on flat ground). In the twilight, he skillfully pitched the double-layer tent, laid out the moisture-proof mat and the envelope-style sleeping bag, and hung the headlamp inside the tent.
location: Xingye Campsite, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Walking and exploring around the campsite
description: While it was not yet completely dark, Lei Mingxuan took a walk along the path beside the campsite for about 15 minutes, observing the surroundings and confirming the locations of the water source and restrooms. He casually took a few photos of the campsite and the distant mountain silhouettes with his phone and sent them to the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group and his Moments.
location: Around Xingye Camp, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Simple dinner
description: Back in front of the tent, he set up the folding table. Lei Mingxuan opened a box of self-heating rice (braised beef flavor). While waiting for it to heat up, he took a watermelon from the cooler and ate a few spoonfuls. After finishing the hot rice, he felt much more grounded.
location: Xingye Campsite, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Evening activities: researching hiking routes, making pour-over coffee, and shooting star time-lapse.
description: Putting on his headlamp, he spread the paper hiking map of Mogan Mountain he had printed out in advance on the small camp table (marked with classic routes such as “Jianggong Trail”), and used colored markers to highlight the departure route for the next morning, key intersections, and planned rest points (about 8 hours in total). After that, he took out his portable pour-over kettle and ground coffee, got some water from the stream beside the campsite (through a filter bag), brewed a cup of hot coffee, and sat outside the tent drinking it while listening to the insects chirp. Then he took out his action camera, mounted it on a tripod, set it to time-lapse mode aimed at the dark, unpolluted night sky (planning to shoot the stars for 1 hour), and went back into the tent to briefly record the day's itinerary and feelings in his phone memo: “Arrived, all went smoothly. Hiking tomorrow, good night.”
location: Xingye Campsite, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Washing up, letting friends know I'm safe, and reading
description: Wiped his face, hands, and feet with wet wipes, changed into clean quick-dry clothes, set the alarm for 6:00 tomorrow morning, and put his phone, power bank, headlamp, and water bottle in easy reach. Then Lei Mingxuan sent a voice message in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group: "Arrived safely, tent set up. About to sleep. Signal in the mountains may be bad tomorrow. Don't worry, good night!" He also attached a selfie with the tent light on. Then he opened the revised draft of 'Afternoon at Xiafei Lane' on his phone and read about ten minutes of the character dialogue descriptions before feeling sleepy.
location: Inside the tent at Xingye Camp, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang

name: Falling asleep
description: Crawled into the sleeping bag and put earplugs in my ears. Listening to the occasional birdsong outside the camp and the sound of the breeze rustling the tent fabric, with anticipation for tomorrow's hike and a sense of fulfillment from freedom, I gradually fell asleep.
location: Xingye Campsite, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Waking up in the early morning and the pour-over coffee ritual
description: At Hoshino Campsite on Mogan Mountain, I was woken by birdsong in the bamboo forest two minutes before my alarm. I unzipped the tent and looked out at the misty mountain view. I put on my outdoor jacket, boiled water to 85°C with a camping stove, and brewed a slow pour-over of Yirgacheffe coffee. With the rising sun and morning mist as a backdrop, I took a few photos with my phone and enjoyed the peaceful morning.
location: Xingye Campsite, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Social sharing and a quick breakfast
description: Shared the coffee photo on WeChat Moments with the caption: 'The first sip of clarity in the mountains, totally worth it!' Ate the remaining half watermelon from last night and two energy bars as breakfast. Saw friends Zhang Wei and Li Na instantly like it and comment, 'Stop showing off, stay safe.' Replied 'OK' to confirm he would pay attention to safety. Then packed up the cookware and trash.
location: Xingye Campsite, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Breaking camp and checking load
description: Quickly packed the sleeping bag and sleeping pad, carefully checked today's 15 kg of loaded gear: 4 liters of water, trail food, a first-aid kit, an action camera, a power bank, and a windbreaker. Tightened my hiking boot laces, took a departure photo of the car parked by the campsite and checked in at “Moganshan Xingye Campground,” then took a deep breath and headed into the mountains.
location: Xingye Campsite, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Weighted hiking: gentle slope section through the bamboo forest
description: At exactly 8:00, I stepped onto the stone path and began the weighted hike. The first half was a gentle bamboo forest trail, with a steady pace and even breathing. I stopped at the viewpoint and used the action camera to take an orbit shot, filming the village in the valley below. At the stream, I washed my face with the cool water and continued on.
location: Circular hiking trail in the Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Weighted trekking: continuous steep sections
description: After 6 kilometers, the road turned into continuous steep slopes, and my thigh muscles were severely tested. I slowed down, adjusted my breathing, and made every step solid. Sweat kept dripping, and my quick-dry shirt was soaked through. At noon, I reached a small platform at an altitude of about 800 meters, took off my backpack, sat on the ground, and replenished with beef jerky and whole-wheat bread.
location: Circular hiking trail in the Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Hitting a physical bottleneck and making a decisive retreat
description: After lunch continued climbing. Around 2 p.m., after a punishing slope, the quadriceps and calves were in severe pain, needing to stop and stretch every 200 meters. After assessing the final 2 km return section and physical limits, decided not to take any more risks. Stretched in place and rehydrated for about 20 minutes, then began a slow descent along the same route.
location: Circular hiking trail in the Mogan Mountain Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Rough descent and recovery at camp
description: The descent was more agonizing than the climb. My legs felt weak, my knees took the impact of the downhill slope, and every step was cautious. At 4 PM I saw smoke from the camp kitchen; at exactly 5 PM I collapsed onto the grass beside the tent, took off my hiking boots, and used cold mountain spring water to ice my calves. Back inside the tent, I lay down and consumed a packet of energy gel and a bottle of electrolyte drink.
location: Xingye Campsite, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Handle shop matters remotely
description: After catching his breath, he checked the store's surveillance playback on his phone; everything was normal. The shop assistant Xiao Lin sent a message reporting that in the afternoon a customer complained that a purchased T-shirt had faded and stained her clothes. Xiao Lin handled it calmly and proposed a solution of "return for refund + complimentary coupon". The customer left satisfied. Lei Mingxuan replied praising Xiao Lin, promised to treat her to a big meal when back in Shanghai, and checked his Alipay transaction records; operations were normal.
location: Xingye Campsite, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Deep reflection and fitness awakening
description: Xiao Lin's growth made Lei Mingxuan gratified, but the frustration from today's hike lingered. He realized that his physical fitness had seriously declined and could no longer support the planned self-drive trip in western Sichuan. In his phone memo, he wrote a resolution: “Must do aerobic plus strength training at least three times a week, and get BMI below 24 within three months!” He took a screenshot of the declaration and sent it to Xiao Lin as a form of supervision starting the next day.
location: Xingye Campsite, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Camp dinner and solo relaxation.
description: Just when he was physically and mentally exhausted, he took out the ultimate supply—a box of spicy beef self-heating hot pot and half a bottle of iced cola. Sitting outside the tent, bathed in the sunset glow, listening to the fellow campers playing guitar and chatting around him, he slowly enjoyed this simple but deeply satisfying dinner, and the muscle soreness seemed to ease considerably.
location: Xingye Campsite, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Evening packing and social goodbyes.
description: Used wet wipes to wipe down my body and changed into a clean T-shirt. Stepped on the scale, which showed 77.6 kg, 0.3 kg lighter than yesterday. In the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group, I sent a voice message mocking myself: 'Brothers, I almost kicked the bucket at Mogan Mountain today, I'm such a loser!' Zhang Wei and Li Na burst out laughing and teased me, and we agreed to catch up and review when we get back to Shanghai. Then I reported to my parents that I was safe, said it was cool in the mountains, and that I would return to Shanghai tomorrow afternoon.
location: Xingye Campsite, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Going to bed
description: After a tiring day, my mind went blank. I switched my phone to airplane mode and set an alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning. I got into the sleeping bag, listened to the rustling of bamboo leaves outside the tent, and recalled every step of today and my interactions with Xiao Lin. Feeling at ease, I soon fell asleep.
location: Xingye Campsite, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Morning camp teardown and a simple breakfast
description: Woke up at dawn to birdsong under a gloomy sky, with sore muscles all over but plenty of energy. He quickly took down the tent, packed up the sleeping bag, and bagged all the trash to practice Leave No Trace camping. Using hot water from his thermos, he made a bowl of oatmeal, along with the half pot of pour-over coffee left from the previous night, a simple meal to enjoy with the last bit of mountain tranquility.
location: Moganshan Xingye Campsite, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Inspect the campsite and prepare for the return trip
description: He carefully checked that all gear and trash had been loaded into the car, making sure the campsite was as clean as when he arrived. Then he started the car, set the navigation for home, with the destination of Zhangyang Road, Pudong, Shanghai.
location: Parking lot of Moganshan Xingye Campground, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Drive back and pass through Taihu Service Area
description: He drove along the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway toward Shanghai. There wasn't much traffic on the expressway on Sunday morning, so he turned on Bluetooth and played the playlist from his hike, feeling relaxed. After driving for about 2 hours, he stopped briefly at Taihu Service Area for 15 minutes, got out to stretch his stiff legs, and used his phone to take a photo of the misty Taihu Lake and sent it to the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group. Zhang Wei and Li Na instantly replied and teased him.
location: Taihu Service Area on the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway (Chongqing direction)

name: Got home, unloaded the gear, and hung it out to dry.
description: Got home safely and dragged the heavy hiking backpack, tent bag, and soaked hiking shoes into the bedroom. Mom and Dad weren't home; they had probably gone to the market. He quickly hung the wet tent and waterproof jacket on the balcony to dry, then found old newspapers and stuffed them into the hiking shoes, leaving them on the balcony to air-dry naturally.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Brief rest and refueling.
description: Took off his outdoor clothes and changed into comfortable loungewear. He checked the fridge, found last night's leftover xiaolongbao and some chilled milk. He heated up six xiaolongbao and ate them with the milk as a brunch, which settled his stomach.
location: Living room at home, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sparked writing inspiration and conceived a family story
description: Sitting on the bean bag in the balcony, while cleaning the inner compartment of the backpack, I touched the old-fashioned fountain pen cap left by my grandfather. The feel evoked countless memories: Grandfather's tobacco shop, the tiger stove, the back view of Father riding a 28-inch bicycle through the alley... I immediately took out my phone, created a folder named 'A Hundred Years of the Alley' in the memo app, and outlined the story of three generations: Grandfather fled to Shanghai and opened a tobacco shop; Father witnessed the development of Pudong; and I was born and grew up in Pudong, searching for self-identity amid the transition between old and new. The more I wrote, the more excited I became, and I was determined to carry this through.
location: Home balcony, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Have lunch with parents and share hiking experiences
description: Mom and Dad came back from shopping. Mom said with concern that he had lost weight and looked pale, while Dad offhandedly asked how things were on the mountain. Mom specially added Shanghai-style braised pork belly and bamboo shoot and salted pork soup. At the dinner table, he enthusiastically shared the starry sky from last night and the morning birdsong, and also admitted the frustration of his leg cramping in the last 2 kilometers. Dad put down his chopsticks and said, "Now you know your limits—don't do anything reckless in the future." Mom, while picking out meat with her chopsticks, kept saying, "Safety first. Next time, let your dad go with you."
location: Home dining room, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the clothing store and handling work
description: He changed into a clean T-shirt and jeans and rode an electric bike to the Super Brand Mall store. On the Sunday afternoon the traffic was moderate and a gentle breeze brushed his face. When he arrived, only Xiao Lin was there. She came up, made tea, and gave a detailed report on how she had handled the T-shirt color-fading complaint from the day before: from calming the customer down to offering a return and refund plus a 30-yuan no-threshold coupon, and the customer left satisfied. Lei Mingxuan was very pleased and on the spot gave Xiao Lin the authority to approve returns under 500 yuan per transaction and to make independent decisions on small compensations within 100 yuan, and they agreed to have a 10-minute work call every Monday morning. Then the two of them together checked the inventory of last week's online orders.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online store operations and personal content creation
description: After the authorization was done, he asked Xiao Lin to continue sorting the new arrivals, then took out his phone to edit the video footage shot yesterday at Mogan Mountain. He added the insert song from The Wind Rises, put in subtitles, and narrated his hiking reflections and the "Longtang Centennial" writing plan. After publishing it to Xiaohongshu and WeChat Moments, he received quite a few likes. His friend Zhao Min even sent a private message asking whether he was writing a book and recommended several official accounts of literary editors.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bought fruit and yogurt on the way home.
description: Locked up the shop early and rode my e-bike home. Passing the Pushang vegetable market, I remembered the fridge was empty, so I parked the bike, went in, and bought 5 yuan of bananas and a jar of old-style yogurt as extra snacks for the next few days.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Accompany my mother and interview her about family stories.
description: When I got home, my mom had already started preparing dinner. In the living room, I helped her pick vegetables, shelling edamame while chatting about the old neighbors in the alley. Seizing the moment, I took out my phone memo and began a "formal interview," asking about details such as the exact name and location of my grandfather's cigarette and paper shop and the plane trees at the entrance. My mother immediately opened up, talking from the shop layout to the neighbors; the vivid details made the outline of "A Century of the Alley" increasingly clear.
location: Living room at home, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner time
description: Dinner was carefully prepared by Mom: Shanghai-style braised pork belly (leftovers from noon, even more flavorful), salted pork and bamboo shoot soup, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and steamed sea bass. The family sat around the table, eating and chatting, from the sights of Moganshan to the 'Centennial Lane' plan. Dad asked about this month's revenue, and Lei Mingxuan showed him the bookkeeping app on his phone. Dad looked at it carefully, and his brow relaxed a lot.
location: Home dining room, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Foot soaking recovery and checking historical details.
description: After dinner, I quickly cleared the dishes, boiled a large pot of hot water and put in some mugwort packets, then moved a small stool to the living room to soak my feet while watching a TV drama with my parents. During the foot soak, I continued my 'interview' with my mother, confirming the exact location of the old tobacco-and-paper shop, Grandfather's supply route back then, and jotting down the names of a few old neighbors.
location: Living room at home, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handling Messages and Making Preparations Before Bed
description: After soaking my feet and returning to the bedroom, I saw the daily revenue report Xiao Lin sent, which was up 15% from last Sunday, and I felt gratified. I also saw the two official account cards for editors from publishing houses that Zhao Min had sent, and replied to thank her. I sent my mom a voice message: 'Tonight's story was wonderful, continue telling me tomorrow!' After that, I washed up briefly and changed into pajamas.
location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Going to bed and falling asleep.
description: Although it was only 9 o'clock, two consecutive days of physical exhaustion made his eyelids heavy. Turning off the light, listening to the patter of light rain outside the window, with scenes of Grandpa's tobacco shop still replaying in his mind, he soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bed in the bedroom at home, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Create a physical fitness enhancement plan
description: After the alarm went off, Mingxuan sat up and checked how his legs felt. After confirming there was no soreness, he created a document called "Physical Rebirth Plan" in his phone's memo app and set a schedule: a 5 km morning run on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, and 20 minutes of core training on Tuesday and Thursday evenings. He also checked the wear on his running shoes and decided to buy new gear. Then he entered his breakfast plan on the Boohee Health app: boiled eggs, unsweetened soy milk, and multigrain steamed buns.
location: Second-floor bedroom, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning wash-up, breakfast, and diet adjustment discussion
description: After washing up, he went downstairs. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared white rice porridge, pickled vegetables, and fried eggs. Mingxuan proposed a diet adjustment plan to his mother, explaining his reflections after turning back from the Mogan Mountain hike and his emphasis on health. His mother teased him verbally but showed support in her eyes, and agreed to buy chicken breast, broccoli, and fruit.
location: Home dining room at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Set off for the store.
description: Mingxuan changed into a black slim-fit short-sleeve T-shirt, khaki cargo pants, and canvas shoes, took his phone, power bank, and commuter bag, and set off on his e-bike, arriving at Super Brand Mall about 20 minutes later.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China to Super Brand Mall, No. 168, Lujiazui West Road

name: Arrive at the store and prepare for the weekly meeting
description: Arrived at the store at 8:40, opened up, turned on the air conditioning and cash register system, sorted out last week's sales data and return details, changed the T-shirts on the display mannequins, and notified the clerk Xiao Lin to hold the regular meeting earlier.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Held the weekly meeting
description: Xiao Lin arrived at the store on time and held the weekly meeting at the small round table next to the cash register. Xiao Lin reported last week's sales overview and new product feedback, and detailed the handling of Saturday's T-shirt color-fading return. She quickly refunded the money based on the previously granted authorization and gave the customer a coupon, and the customer was satisfied. Mingxuan formally confirmed the authority for refunds on individual orders under 500 yuan and compensation within 100 yuan, and asked Xiao Lin to verbally repeat it to confirm.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Handle the store's online tasks
description: After the regular meeting, Mingxuan handled the online orders that had accumulated over the weekend, printed the waybills to prepare for shipping, and contacted supplier Zhou Tao to ask about the delivery of new goods.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Visiting Huaihai Fang: “Seeking Roots”
description: Taking advantage of the light morning foot traffic, Mingxuan rode his electric scooter to Huaihai Fang to explore family history. Walking through the alley, he observed the architectural style and door plates, imagining that his grandfather's cigarette-and-paper shop had once operated here. He took many photos to document the alley environment and mottled walls, accumulating material for the family writing project "A Hundred Years of the Alleyway."
location: Huaihai Fang, No. 100 Maoming South Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China

name: Return to the store to receive goods and arrange displays.
description: Returned to the shop at 11:40. The courier delivered new goods. Mingxuan signed for them, unpacked them, hung the new T-shirts and shirts in the prime display area, adjusted prices with kraft paper tags, and while having Xiao Lin help, explained the styling highlights of the new items.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and purchasing sports equipment
description: After the noon rush, Mingxuan ate a bowl of ramen and a vegetable salad at the Japanese ramen restaurant in the IFC Mall on the B1 level of Super Brand Mall, and logged it in the Boohee Health app. Then he rode an electric bike to the Decathlon Huamu store, where he tried on several pairs of cushioned running shoes in the running section, picked a pair, and bought quick-dry short-sleeve shirts and shorts. He put on the new running shoes on the spot and bagged the old ones.
location: China, Shanghai, Pudong New Area, Super Brand Mall B1, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, the Japanese ramen restaurant at IFC Mall, and Decathlon Huamu Store, No. 393 Yinxiao Road

name: Afternoon store work and customer reception
description: Mingxuan returned to the store in his new running shoes, feeling light on his feet. He received several groups of afternoon customers, made styling suggestions for several short-sleeved shirts, and successfully sold three. During that time, he replied to regular customer Qian Duoduo’s WeChat inquiry about the arrival of new stock.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Handling online content and community interactions
description: With fewer customers in the store, Mingxuan selected the photos he had taken in Huaihai Fang that morning at the checkout counter, applied filters, and posted them with captions to his Moments and the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group, sharing the family stories he had gathered from the field trip. Then he browsed the "Art Toy Collector Circle" WeChat group.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: POP MART blind box draw yields a hidden figure
description: Mingxuan rode his electric bike to the Pop Mart store at Century Link Plaza, picked two blind boxes from the new series, and opened them in the rest area. The first was a duplicate; the second revealed the new series' hidden edition, "Mountain Stream Hermit." Overjoyed, he carefully confirmed it, then took a nine-grid close-up photo set and posted it to the collector friends group.
location: Pop Mart store, LG1 Floor, Century Link Mall, No. 1192 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Return to the store to share the joy.
description: Mingxuan carefully packed the hidden figure and returned to the store in high spirits, placing it on the display stand at the checkout counter to admire. The collector group and the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group were already buzzing; fellow collector Gao Yuan, with a sour tone, suggested a full-box blind box next time, and Mingxuan proudly replied with an emoji.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Store operation during evening rush hour
description: During the evening rush hour, more customers came in. Mingxuan greeted them energetically and shared with regular customers his lucky experience of drawing a hidden figure while promoting clothes. Business was good today, and he was in a good mood.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Closing up and meeting father at the vegetable market
description: After closing at 19:00, Mingxuan rode his e-bike to Pushang Vegetable Market to buy fruit for the next day, and ran into his father Lao Lei buying farm eggs. The two briefly talked about business and getting the hidden figure. Although his father said he was spending money recklessly, there was a smile in his eyes. He took the bag from Mingxuan's hand, and father and son rode home side by side.
location: Pushang Wet Market, 128 Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family dinner and fitness plan report
description: Back home, his mother had prepared steamed chicken breast, oyster sauce lettuce, and multigrain rice as planned. At the dinner table, Mingxuan formally reported his weekly fitness plan to his parents and showed off his new running shoes. His mother confirmed the menu details again, and Mingxuan used the Boohee Health app to record the nutritional data of dinner.
location: Home dining room at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Organize saved posts and complete the diet log
description: After dinner, back in the bedroom, Mingxuan cleared the center spot in the display cabinet for 'Mountain Stream Hermit,' adjusted the angle of the spotlights, and admired the new addition. He then opened the Boohee Health app to complete his dietary record for the day.
location: Second-floor bedroom, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Personal leisure and socializing
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, watched the latest episode of "Jujutsu Kaisen" on Bilibili in the bedroom. Then had a voice chat with Zhang Wei and Li Na in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group, sharing the day's highlights and receiving encouragement.
location: Second-floor bedroom, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest.
description: Mingxuan set the alarm for 06:30 the next day, placed his new running shoes and quick-dry clothes beside the bed, took deep breaths to relax, reviewed the fulfilling day, and turned off the lights at 23:00 to fall asleep.
location: Second-floor bedroom, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning core training and a quick breakfast
description: The alarm went off on time, and he did core strength training as planned. He laid out a yoga mat in the living room and completed 3 sets of planks (1 minute each), 3 sets of crunches (20 reps each), and 3 sets of bird-dogs (15 reps per side). After training, he took a shower and weighed himself: 77.6 kg. Afterwards, he said good morning to his mom, who was up early and busy in the kitchen. In the kitchen, his mom had prepared whole wheat bread and boiled eggs as agreed. He sliced the bread, peeled the eggs, poured warm water, and finished eating in five minutes. He logged the breakfast nutrition in the Boohee Health app, about 280 kcal.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Cycling commute and store opening preparation.
description: Put on his helmet and rode his e-bike from Zhangyang Road onto Pudong South Road, then turned right onto Lujiazui Ring Road, reaching Super Brand Mall in about 15-20 minutes. He parked in the non-motor vehicle garage and took the freight elevator to the second floor. He opened the door, turned on the lights and air conditioning, did a quick walkthrough of the store, then turned on the computer and opened the backend data. Staring at the store opening date 2020-05-20 on the screen, he was lost in thought for a while, reflecting on the five years that had passed. Afterward, he went to the warehouse, carried out three boxes of techwear T-shirts, opened the packages, and prepared to steam iron them.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Monthly data organization and new merchandise launch
description: Opened Excel and focused on pulling the sales details, inventory list, and employee attendance records from the backend for May 1 to 19. Marked the top 10 products and slow-moving items in red to prepare for the afternoon meeting with Xiaolin. Meanwhile, in spare moments, he pressed the 20 unpacked techwear short-sleeve shirts with a garment steamer and hung them on the shelves by color and size, brainstorming promotional copy for WeChat Moments and member groups as he cut off the tags.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and short break.
description: He took out the chicken breast salad his mother had prepared last night from the shop's fridge—lettuce base with pan-fried chicken breast and cherry tomatoes on top—and quickly ate it while sitting behind the cash register. He then scrolled Xiaohongshu posts tagged #TechwearOutfit and saved 3 inspiration images, one of which was recommended by his friend Zhao Min.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Research a self-driving trip plan for western Sichuan
description: In the afternoon the mall was not busy. While watching the store, he opened Amap and marked a loop route starting from Chengdu: Chengdu–Kangding–Xinduqiao–Litang–Daocheng Yading. In his phone memos, he recorded price comparisons between CAR Inc. and eHi Car Services at their Chengdu Shuangliu Airport locations, with an initial budget of about 8,000 yuan for car rental. He also replied to regular customer Feng Xiaoyu on WeChat and set aside a new UV-protection top for her.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Delegate authority to store staff and establish a weekly meeting system.
description: Asked shop assistant Lin Xiao to come to the sofa area. First affirmed her mature handling of a customer complaint yesterday, then formally told her: from today on, she will be in charge of daily scheduling during off-peak hours, handling returns and exchanges within 500 yuan, and preliminary inspection of new goods. Agreed to have a fixed 15-minute communication meeting every Tuesday afternoon. Together they looked through photos on their phones of the store's bare concrete interior during the 2020 renovation and marveled at the changes over five years. After the meeting, organized the permissions and responsibilities into a memo and sent it to Xiao Lin so she could familiarize herself with the process. He then continued researching accommodation for the Western Sichuan loop route, looked at several homestays in Daocheng Yading, and thought about bringing new inspiration to next week's visit to Huaihai Fang.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and financial bookkeeping
description: Several groups of customers came in the afternoon. I personally attended to two of them, recommended techwear-style pants, and successfully sold one pair. In between, I took a moment to open the bookkeeping app on my computer and recorded the shipping fees for the day's packed online orders and the purchase costs. Xiao Lin was beside me tidying up the clothes customers had tried on.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening rush-hour operations and the store's fifth-anniversary event
description: During the after-work rush, foot traffic increased significantly, and I stood at the door energetically greeting customers. Since it was the store's fifth anniversary that day, on a whim I put a small blackboard by the cash register with the promotion 'Fifth Anniversary Celebration: Spend 500 yuan, Get 50 yuan off.' Xiao Lin helped post it on Moments and in the membership group. This move successfully sold three more basic T-shirts.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store, going home, and buying groceries along the way
description: After the evening rush hour, he checked the revenue with Xiao Lin, turned off the lights, and locked up. He rode his electric scooter home, passed by Pushang Food Market on the way, went in and bought three bananas and a box of old-fashioned yogurt, planning to eat it with oatmeal tomorrow morning. He got home at exactly 19:45.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Discuss with father the store transformation and a western Sichuan road trip.
description: When I got home, Mom was setting out the bowls and chopsticks. Dinner was steamed sea bass, blanched okra, and multigrain rice. At the dinner table, I took out my phone to show my father Lei Jianguo the outdoor techwear outfit cases I had saved (such as the Arc'teryx and The North Face collab), pulled up the store's recent sales data, and explained the market potential of this style among younger people. Dad nodded and said he wouldn't stop me as long as I had a plan. Then, seizing the moment, I brought up the preliminary budget for a Western Sichuan self-driving trip, saying it would cost about 25,000 yuan. Dad immediately offered to sponsor 5,000 yuan, but I smiled and politely declined, saying I'd ask if I really went over budget. Dad then shifted to talking about road conditions in Western Sichuan and safety concerns about altitude sickness.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Create a savings plan for a western Sichuan trip
description: Back in his room, he locked the door, dug out a rarely used China Merchants Bank card, opened Excel, created a new workbook, and named it "Western Sichuan Special Savings Tracker." He entered the 25,000-yuan budget details (car rental 8,000 yuan, fuel 3,000 yuan, accommodation 6,000 yuan, meals 4,000 yuan, tickets 2,000 yuan, emergency reserve 2,000 yuan), and decided to transfer 3,000 yuan from store profit into this card on the 5th of every month. When he finished, he sent a screenshot of the saved records and the budget sheet to his father with the caption "Officially launched, absolutely no overspending." His father replied with a thumbs-up emoji.
location: Home Study, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Watching anime to unwind and getting ready for bed
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, I leaned against the headboard and opened my tablet to catch up on two episodes of the latest Jujutsu Kaisen. The fight scenes were awesome. At ten o'clock, I turned off the video and thought about what to follow up on at the shop tomorrow — remember to check the logistics for the techwear fabric that was just ordered. I set the alarm for 7 a.m., turned off the light, and went to sleep, actually falling asleep around 22:30.
location: Home bedroom at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 6:20 in the morning, the alarm went off on time, and Mingxuan got up quickly. He had laid out his newly bought quick-dry top and compression pants the night before, and was full of anticipation for his first morning run. After washing up, he stepped on the scale, which read 77.5 kg. He silently noted the number, then put on his new cushioned running shoes, feeling delighted.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: First morning run training session
description: Mingxuan left home and walked about 12 minutes to Gate 1 of Century Park. He put on his earphones, played the entrepreneurship podcast he hadn't finished the day before, and started jogging along the lakeside greenway. He deliberately kept his pace at about 7 minutes per kilometer, not aiming for speed, but focusing on completing 5 kilometers. After finishing the run, he stretched carefully on a lakeside bench for 10 minutes. Although the muscle soreness from his backpacking trip hadn't completely faded, the refreshing feeling after the run made him think that getting up early was well worth it.
location: No. 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; Century Park Gate 1 and the lakeside greenway

name: Shower and prepare breakfast and lunch
description: Back home, Mingxuan took a quick shower. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared breakfast: whole wheat bread, two boiled eggs, and a glass of warm milk. While eating, he packed the chicken breast and lettuce salad his mother had made last night into a lunch box and added some cherry tomatoes; it looked very appetizing. At the same time, he opened the Bohe Health app and carefully logged the nutritional data for breakfast.
location: Home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Cycling commute and work check
description: Mingxuan took his lunchbox and keys, got on his e-bike, and headed to Super Brand Mall. On the way, he checked WeChat: supplier Brother Tao told him the fabric samples had been shipped, and he replied to confirm; he also messaged store clerk Lin Xiao, saying he would arrive at the store around 8:15 and asked her to turn on the air conditioner first. After riding for about 15 minutes, he arrived at the mall.
location: Cycling route from Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Arriving at the shop and preparing to open
description: Arrived at the store on time at 8:15. Lin Xiao had already turned on the air conditioning and lights ahead of time. Mingxuan put his lunch in the staff area refrigerator, then turned on the cash register computer, quickly checked yesterday's sales data and the day's inventory alerts. He also wiped down the cashier counter and display area, ready to start a new day of work.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Summer new arrivals organizing and display
description: Mingxuan and Lin Xiao carried out the summer new arrivals that had arrived last week, including three boxes of techwear-style T-shirts and two boxes of cargo shorts. Lin Xiao hung and arranged them according to the display plan Mingxuan had designed last week, while Mingxuan supervised and gave adjustment suggestions. During the process, he used the store's spotlights as fill lighting and took photos of several cool looks with his phone, preparing to post them on WeChat Moments. The two efficiently completed the new product display and the window mannequin outfit change.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and nutrition log
description: When the customer flow slowed, Mingxuan asked Lin Xiao to watch the front desk and went to the break area to enjoy lunch. The chicken breast salad in the bento was very fresh, and the vinaigrette was exactly what he had asked for; his mother had done it perfectly this time. As he ate, he logged the grams and calories of each ingredient in the Boohee Health app. Seeing the green goal-completion prompt in the app, he felt satisfied with his sense of self-control.
location: Rest area of Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Competitor and market research
description: During the lunch break, Mingxuan went downstairs to the Uniqlo store on B1 of Super Brand Mall and took a look around. He focused on observing the fit, fabric, and price of the summer T-shirts and casually took photos of the displays and the main featured style posters. He found that the brand was focusing on cooling fabrics this year with bold color combinations, and compared them in his mind with his own store's techwear style, concluding that the differentiated positioning remained clear.
location: B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Uniqlo (Super Brand Mall store)

name: Afternoon business operations and VIP community management
description: Customer traffic was steady in the afternoon. Mingxuan looked after the store while editing the outfit photos he had taken in the morning with Xingtu and posting them to his Moments and VIP customer group. A VIP customer, Qian Duoduo, quickly asked about a pair of army-green cargo shorts. Mingxuan promised to hold them for her and invited her to come try them on when she had time. During a break, he shared his morning display ideas with Lin Xiao and encouraged her to try leading the display task independently next time.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Video call with the supplier
description: Mingxuan initiated a WeChat video call with supplier Zhou Tao at the Hangzhou factory. Zhou Tao held up sample swatches of the new fabric to the camera. They discussed the logistics progress in detail and learned that, due to a warehouse issue, delivery might be two days later than expected. After negotiation, they decided to send part of the goods via SF Express collect, splitting the extra shipping costs equally, and Zhou Tao readily agreed. Mingxuan also shared his recent observation of a trend blending 'mountain-style' and 'urban utility' styles, and Zhou Tao said he strongly agreed.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening peak business and proactive recommendations
description: As the evening rush hour arrived, foot traffic in the mall increased noticeably. Mingxuan changed the store music to songs with a stronger rhythm and proactively stood at the door introducing the new techwear T-shirts to passing customers. He successfully recommended a "T-shirt + cargo shorts" pairing to three male customers and one female customer, and one of the men even bought three at once. Lin Xiao, meanwhile, handled a regular customer who came to return an item and completed the process skillfully. Mingxuan noticed this and silently approved.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing up and sorting out data
description: It was closing time. Mingxuan and Lin Xiao tidied the fitting room together and counted the cash at the register. He turned on the computer to export the day's sales data and used Excel to record the transactions and inventory changes. The day's total revenue exceeded 3,000 yuan, which lifted his mood. After locking the store door, he greeted the duty security guard and left.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Market shopping on the way home
description: Mingxuan rode his electric bike away from Super Brand Mall and turned to the Pushang vegetable market in Pudong New Area. As planned, he bought two ripe bananas and a bottle of old yogurt, preparing for that evening and the next morning's breakfast. At the fruit stall, he ran into Aunt Zhu from the adjacent building. She chatted with him warmly and said he looked much more energetic lately.
location: Pushang Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Arrive home and have family dinner
description: Mingxuan returned home to find his father Lei Jianguo sitting on the sofa watching the news. He said hello and put the yogurt in the fridge. His mother had already made steamed sea bass and garlic broccoli, and the aroma was tempting. Mingxuan washed his hands and sat down at the table with his parents for dinner. As he ate, he shared what had happened at the store that day. His mother joked that his salad was too vegetarian, while his father nodded in approval of his approach to negotiating with suppliers.
location: Home dining room, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family rest after the meal
description: After dinner, Mingxuan helped clear the dishes, then sat on the living room sofa with his parents and chatted. The weather forecast on TV said tomorrow would be fine too. He told his father that the fabric logistics issue had been resolved, and his father reminded him that in business one must "mean what you say and keep your word." The three of them enjoyed a brief family reunion in a relaxed atmosphere.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; in the living room at home.

name: Exercise preparation and warm-up
description: Mingxuan returned to his bedroom, changed into loose workout clothes, and laid out his yoga mat. He opened the Keep app, selected the 20-minute 'Core Strength Training for Beginners' course, and carefully reviewed the key moves. Then he sent a voice message in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group saying he was training his core tonight. His friend Zhang Wei replied with a 'Go!' sticker.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Core strength training session
description: Mingxuan started training following the app's pace. He held the first set of planks for 40 seconds, gritted through 45 seconds in the second set, and in the third set his abs felt like they were burning, but he still held on. Then he did crunches and glute bridges, strictly completing 15 reps per set for each move. Although his form became a bit sloppy later on, he still completed all 3 sets. After training, he lay collapsed on the yoga mat, feeling an intense, satisfying soreness in his abs.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stretching and data recording.
description: After resting for 2 minutes, Mingxuan sat up and did a serious 10-minute stretch, focusing on his lower back and hips. Then he opened the Boohee Health app and filled in today's exercise data (5 km morning run + 20 minutes of core training) and dinner data. Seeing the day's activity ring close in the app, he felt a surge of satisfaction.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: Mingxuan went to the bathroom and enjoyed a comfortable hot shower. After returning to bed, he scrolled through Bilibili for a while, watching the latest clips of Jujutsu Kaisen, letting his brain completely relax. He quietly gave himself a score of 90 for today.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai: the bathroom and bedroom at home.

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Mingxuan turned off the light and put down his phone. With the sense of achievement from today's self-discipline and the hope of a lighter weight tomorrow, he soon fell asleep. This fulfilling day of practice brought him another step closer to the better version of himself in his heart.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake up, weigh in, and wash up
description: Got up early in the morning, went to the bathroom to weigh myself. My weight was 77.5kg, stable. Then I washed up, and my mother Wang Xiuying was preparing breakfast in the kitchen.
location: Bathroom at home, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Light family breakfast.
description: Had breakfast with his mother, eating skim milk, a whole-wheat sandwich, and mushroom tofu soup. His mother asked whether they would have braised pork on the weekend. Lei Mingxuan said he would prefer curry beef, and his mother agreed. After the meal, he took the initiative to clear the dishes and chopsticks.
location: Home dining room, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparation before going out
description: He changed into a white T-shirt and techwear-style cargo shorts, packed his homemade chicken breast salad lunch box into his backpack, checked his phone, power bank, keys, and e-bike key, said goodbye to his mother, and left.
location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Commuting by electric bike
description: Riding an electric bike along Zhangyang Road to Super Brand Mall in Lujiazui, while waiting at a red light on the way, I scrolled through Moments and saw an AI-generated avatar, and thought it could be applied to store promotion.
location: Along the route from Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Arrived at the store to organize the displays
description: Arrived at the store in Super Brand Mall; the sales assistant Lin Xiao was already on duty. Checked the display, re-hung the messy techwear T-shirts by color and size, and changed the mannequin outfit at the entrance to the best-selling cargo shorts.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Shoot outfit material for the new collection
description: Took photos of the new T-shirts and cargo shorts in front of the background wall at the store entrance. Due to lighting issues, he moved to the public rest area with floor-to-ceiling windows in the mall corridor, where Lin Xiao assisted in taking outfit photos in natural light. He posed professionally to show the silhouette and texture of the clothing.
location: No. A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the mall's public rest area

name: Online operations and community warm-up
description: Used the phone to color-grade the filmed footage, posted to WeChat Moments to promote the new arrivals with a caption, and used CapCut to edit a Xiaohongshu photo-text video for scheduled publishing. Replied to WeChat messages from regular customers and told friend Qian Duoduo that the new styles had arrived.
location: Cashier counter of Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lunch and online learning research
