name: Morning run on the Century Park greenway
description: Put on a quick-dry T-shirt and running shoes, and slipped out quietly. The early summer morning air was slightly cool. Lei Mingxuan ran at a steady pace along the greenway outside Century Park. Today's pace improved to 6 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, and the 5-kilometer run was completed easily. When he reached the small bridge over the Zhangjiabang River, he deliberately adjusted his breathing and pace, feeling strong in his legs and stable in his heart rate.
location: Outer greenway of Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Post-run stretching and breakfast
description: Returned home and did a 15-minute post-run stretch on the yoga mat in the living room, focusing on relaxing the calves and hips. After showering, my mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared breakfast: a bowl of oatmeal, two boiled egg whites, and a plate of cucumber salad. Had breakfast with my mother.
location: Home, living room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commute: buying a drink and walking to the store
description: Packed his commuting bag and walked out of the residential complex. At the nearby Yanqin Grocery Store, he picked up a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea, scanned the code to pay, and the proprietress Yanqin greeted him warmly; the two exchanged a few words about changes in foot traffic. He then walked to Super Brand Mall at No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, crossed the skybridge, entered through the side entrance of the mall, arrived 10 minutes earlier than usual, and enjoyed the quiet before opening.
location: Along the route from Yanqin Grocery Store on Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Pre-opening store check and contacting suppliers
description: He opened the store door, turned on the lights, and played light electronic music. He carefully checked the display area and refolded the T-shirts that customers had hung the wrong way after trying them on. Then he called the supplier Zhou Tao to confirm the details of next week's replenishment order and reminded him to double-check the new fabric barcode when shipping.
location: Inside the store at A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Morning business and browsing Xiaohongshu case studies
description: After the mall opened, he welcomed the first wave of customers, mostly young mothers pushing strollers and elderly people doing morning exercise. While tidying the checkout counter, he opened links to three Xiaohongshu accounts that his cousin Shen Jie had shared, and skimmed through them on his phone, noticing that the covers and graphic/text styles of the posts were quite different from one another.
location: Inside the store at A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Receiving customers and making a successful sale
description: Two young male customers were attracted by the techwear-style shorts on the mannequin at the store entrance. Lei Mingxuan enthusiastically introduced the water-repellent fabric and multi-pocket design, and brought out different sizes for them to try on. When they had questions about the zipper details, he used his key ring to demonstrate how smoothly it moved. In the end, both customers each bought a pair, successfully closing the sale, and he felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Inside the store at A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and Xiaohongshu Case 1 Analysis
description: As foot traffic gradually thinned, he brewed a cup of drip-bag coffee and took out his own tuna and lettuce salad as lunch. In the store's rest area, while eating the salad, he carefully analyzed the 'Commute Outfit' account from Case 1. He found that the account took mirror selfies in the fitting room with simple composition and precise tags, so he used his memo app to record its viral post patterns: keywords, posting time, and engagement copy. At the same time, he counted the morning's sales revenue.
location: Store rest area, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon customer reception and regular-customer relationship maintenance.
description: In the afternoon, there was a small peak in customer flow. Just after recommending couple hoodies to a young couple, regular customer Qian Duoduo pushed the door open and excitedly shared an interesting new anime she was watching, and sent a Bilibili link. Lei Mingxuan naturally set aside the coat she had asked about last week, and Qian Duoduo happily placed an order on the spot.
location: Inside the store at A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Organized a checklist of issues for the online transition
description: Taking advantage of a lull in customer flow, he organized a list of questions to discuss with his cousin Shen Jie in his phone memo the next day. He divided the questions into five categories: startup budget, content direction (street-scene styling vs OOTD transformations), division of labor, traffic conversion model (bringing 1,000+ offline regular customers online), and whether to launch a mini-program store at the same time. After organizing everything, he saved the note.
location: Inside the store at A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Review Xiaohongshu Case 3
description: Pulled up Case 3 (owner appearing in person + first-person perspective), carefully compared its editing rhythm and spoken copy, and found that videos emphasizing the owner's own styling approach had the highest completion and like rates. Took notes on common opening lines and interactive prompts in a notebook to accumulate material for future content creation.
location: Inside the store at A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Store closing wrap-up and sending the issue checklist.
description: In the evening, he turned off the shop lights and did a final check. He sent the prepared list of questions to his cousin Shen Jie via WeChat with the message: "Hey sis, I've prepped the questions for tomorrow's talk in advance. See if there's anything you'd like to add?" Shen Jie quickly replied, "Got it! Talk tomorrow!" and he felt at ease.
location: Inside the store at A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Walked home in the evening
description: Chose to walk home, along the bustling streets of Lujiazui, watching the after-work crowd and the gradually brightening lights, feeling the early summer evening breeze. Passing the small square under the Oriental Pearl Tower, he slowed down and took a photo of the tower spire in the sunset to post on Moments, with the caption, 'A summer evening stolen from a busy day.'
location: Along the way from Lujiazui West Road to Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family dinner
description: After arriving home, his mother Wang Xiuying had already cooked a meal, featuring her signature mushroom-braised chicken breast and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. His father Lei Jianguo asked about the online store idea, and Lei Mingxuan shared the results of the day's case analysis and problem sorting. His father nodded and suggested listening to more professional opinions.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, home, dining room

name: Doing dishes and family time
description: Volunteered to do the dishes, listening from the kitchen to the sound of his parents watching the news in the living room. After washing up, sat on the sofa, peeled apples for his parents, watched the local news together, chatted about neighborhood happenings, and enjoyed a peaceful family time.
location: Home, kitchen and living room, Shanggang Residential Quarter, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Study room work: case review and studying platform rules
description: Entering the study, he opened his laptop. He imported screenshots of the viral posts from the three cases into Feishu Docs and used a table to compare post style, tag word frequency, posting time, and engagement rate, finding that the save rate of “scenario-based outfits” was much higher than that of plain single-item showcases. Then he read Xiaohongshu’s store-opening guide and merchant entry requirements and found the process simpler than expected. Based on this research, he refined his question list, adding items about traffic support during the cold-start period for new accounts and the “Fries” promotion strategy, and sent it to Shen Jie again, making an appointment to discuss it in detail at Manner Coffee in the IFC Mall tomorrow evening.
location: Study, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: Did a 15-minute pre-bedtime stretch on the yoga mat in the living room, focusing on relaxing the thigh muscles and mentally reviewing the day's insights. Then stepped on the scale again; weight was unchanged. Took a hot shower, changed into loose pajamas, and prepared for sleep.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China — home, living room, bathroom, and bedroom

name: Reading and entertainment before bed.
description: Leaning against the headboard, he first watched half an episode of the latest anime update, then picked up 'Influence' from the bedside and read the last few pages of the 'Commitment and Consistency' chapter.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Fall asleep on time
description: Turning off the bedside lamp and closing his eyes, he thought about tomorrow's brainstorming session with Shen Jie, feeling full of anticipation, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning routine and breakfast
description: At 7 a.m., Lei Mingxuan was woken by his phone alarm and felt full of energy. He used the bathroom first, then stood on the digital scale and saw his weight was 77.1 kg. He was very satisfied with the results of his recent morning runs and sugar control. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared breakfast: oatmeal porridge, boiled egg whites, and cucumber salad. While eating breakfast, he quickly browsed customer group messages and industry official account posts on his phone. Since there were no urgent messages, he felt relaxed. After breakfast, he changed into a sports short-sleeve shirt and shorts and got ready to go out.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting ready and commuting
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to the bedroom and changed into the new techwear-style jacket he had picked out the night before; the fabric was light and water-repellent, perfect for rainy overcast days. He stuffed his tablet, the printed question list, a power bank, a water bottle and other items into a canvas tote bag. He left right on time at 7:55. A fine drizzle was falling outside, but he decided not to take an umbrella and walked straight to the store to enjoy the comfort of the new jacket in the damp air. The walk from home to the mall takes about 12 minutes.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store preparation and work startup
description: Arriving at the store at 8:10, Lei Mingxuan used his key to pull up the rolling shutter door, turned on the lights, turned on the cash register computer and sound system, and selected a lively post-rock playlist. He made his usual round to check whether the display left by the clerk Xiao Lin the night before was up to standard. After confirming everything was in order, he took the garment steamer from the front counter cabinet and removed wrinkles from several summer shirts hanging in the new arrivals area, getting ready for the day's business.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Weekly meeting with store clerk Xiao Lin.
description: Store clerk Xiao Lin arrived at the store at 8:45, and the two sat at the small round table by the cash register. Lei Mingxuan first affirmed Xiao Lin's progress and gave encouragement regarding last week's customer complaint handling. Then, together with Xiao Lin, he used the shift schedule and purchase orders on the tablet to go through the inventory, the goods inspection process, and the week's featured items. Regarding Xiao Lin's question, 'How should we deal with customers who try things on repeatedly but don't buy?' Lei Mingxuan shared a little technique: 'Hand them a glass of water, chat with them about styling scenarios, and shift their attention from price to what they actually need.' Xiao Lin took notes carefully.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organizing comparison data of online platforms
description: The store officially opened at 10:00, and Tuesday morning customer flow was steady. Lei Mingxuan opened his iPad near the cash register and organized the information he had previously collected about opening stores on WeChat Mini Programs and Xiaohongshu into a comparison table, divided into five dimensions: 'startup cost', 'operating difficulty', 'target customer match', 'content format requirements', and 'traffic generation potential', and scored and wrote notes based on his own field experience. At 11:00, he got up and greeted a young couple who came in to look at hoodies, and successfully sold one by analyzing the fit.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and leisure
description: At 11:40, Lei Mingxuan left the store and walked across the Lujiazui skyway toward a restaurant he had bookmarked for a long time in Jin Mao Tower at 88 Century Avenue. He ordered a signature set meal and sat on a bar stool by the window. He took a photo of himself in his new coat holding a spoon, captioned it “New coat debut—today’s lunch was ‘casual’,” and posted it on Moments, checking in at Jin Mao Tower. During the meal, he opened Xiaohongshu, browsed the official accounts of several leading outdoor brands, screenshotted a few of their post layouts using “flat-lay images + model try-on shots,” and saved them to his “Inspiration Library” folder.
location: Restaurant inside Jin Mao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Tended the store in the afternoon and wrapped up the spreadsheet.
description: At 12:40, he returned to the store, and the afternoon foot traffic gradually began. Lei Mingxuan greeted customers at the store entrance while using spare moments to complete the unfinished spreadsheet details on his iPad. He focused on analyzing two points: 'traffic support during the platform cold-start period' and 'Fries promotion strategy'. These insights came from his discussion with Shen Jie during last night's review. At 14:00, he finally exported the PDF and shared it with Shen Jie on WeChat, leaving a message asking her to look it over before the evening discussion.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handling matters with suppliers and regular customers
description: During the afternoon lull in customer traffic, Lei Mingxuan sat at the cash register and made a voice call to supplier Zhou Tao. The two confirmed that a batch of windproof fabric originally scheduled for delivery next week might be delayed by two days due to logistics, so they needed to coordinate the delivery schedule. Just after hanging up, regular customer Qian Duoduo sent a WeChat message, having seen Lei Mingxuan's midday Moments post asking where he bought the new coat. Lei Mingxuan replied with a smile that he had already reserved one for her in the store and invited her to come try it on when she had time.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing for the evening meeting and leaving work early
description: Lei Mingxuan said hello to shop assistant Xiao Lin and explained that he had an evening engagement and needed to leave early. He organized the materials he planned to show Shen Jie that evening (including printed hard copies of the forms and an iPad) and confirmed that the power bank was fully charged. At 16:00, he took off his new coat, changed into a lighter linen blazer from the store, slung on his canvas bag, finished the handover with Xiao Lin, and left work an hour early.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-work commute and shopping.
description: After leaving the mall, the sky was still gloomy. Lei Mingxuan did not go straight to the café; instead, he walked along Century Avenue toward Shanghai IFC Mall. Passing a newly opened outdoor brand store, he went in for a few minutes, looked at the pattern and design of the techwear vest in the display window, and secretly noted details worth borrowing. Then he walked on to IFC.
location: From Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanghai IFC Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, via Century Avenue.

name: Preparing the café and discussing an online branch with his younger female cousin.
description: At 16:15, Lei Mingxuan walked into Manner Coffee. There were not many people in the store, so he found a small round table in a corner with a power outlet and sat down, ordering a sugar-free oat milk latte. After sitting down, he carefully went through the compiled spreadsheet and question list once more, and in his mind-map software built a simple logic tree around core topics such as "Xiaohongshu startup strategy," "content planning," and "budget allocation." At 16:40, Shen Jie arrived, wearing a sharp beige trench coat. After a bit of laughter and small talk, they quickly got down to business. Shen Jie, with a buyer's professional perspective, systematically analyzed the spreadsheet and pointed out that given the "Xiafei Ji" trademark, Xiaohongshu was the better choice. She suggested first creating an account under the name "Xiafei Ji," attracting targeted followers in the early stage with 2-3 high-quality techwear outfit posts per week, and not rushing to add product links. Lei Mingxuan combined this with the store's customer base and discussed post topic ideas with Shen Jie. When the conversation turned to the specific launch time, Lei Mingxuan decided on the spot to launch in June and invited Shen Jie to plan the first three installments, with a year's worth of coffee as compensation. This decision excited both of them.
location: Manner Coffee, B1, Shanghai IFC Mall, 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dinner and a walk
description: After the discussion, both were hungry, so they found a Japanese ramen shop in the food court at IFC. Lei Mingxuan ordered a bowl of chashu ramen and a plate of seaweed, while Shen Jie ordered gyudon beef bowl. While eating, they chatted about their recent lives in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere. After the meal, Shen Jie left first because she had something to attend to. Lei Mingxuan walked alone along Lujiazui Ring Road for over ten minutes, enjoying the slightly damp evening breeze, reflecting on the discussion, and the blueprint for the online branch store became clearer.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant on the basement level of Shanghai IFC Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Lujiazui Ring Road

name: Cycling Home
description: At 19:00, Lei Mingxuan found a shared bike by the roadside, scanned the code, and rode home. After cycling about 12 minutes along Pudong Avenue, he arrived downstairs at Shanggang Community, locked the bike, and went upstairs.
location: Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Chatting with my parents.
description: When he got home, his parents were watching TV in the living room. Lei Mingxuan greeted them and briefly shared the evening's progress: 'Mom, I had a good chat with my cousin. We decided to start with Xiaohongshu and launch in June.' His father, Lei Jianguo, nodded and reminded him, 'Online is online, but the foundation of the physical store must not be loosened.' His mother asked whether he had eaten. The three chatted for over twenty minutes in a harmonious atmosphere.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Core strength training
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into athletic shorts and a tank top, laid out a yoga mat on the bedroom floor, set the timer on his phone, and began a 20-minute core workout: 4 sets of planks (1 minute each), 3 sets of crunches (15 reps each), and 3 sets of bird-dog (10 reps per side). He was fully focused, and sweat soon appeared. After finishing the last set, he felt a clear burning soreness in his abs and the tops of his thighs, and felt very fulfilled.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shower and tidy up
description: Lei Mingxuan went to the bathroom and took a comfortable hot shower, washing away the fatigue of the day. After changing into pajamas, he opened his phone, organized the key points from tonight's discussion with Shen Jie into a memo of about 100 characters, and sent it to himself as a reminder.
location: Bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading and digesting inspiration
description: Lei Mingxuan leaned against the headboard, picked up 'Influence,' and turned to the chapter on 'Social Proof.' He connected the book's theory with the IP co-branding and user-note product recommendations he had discussed with Shen Jie that evening. In the margin of the page, he wrote in pencil: 'Let customers tell customers, and let styling become the reason.'
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leisure, entertainment, and socializing
description: A new anime episode was released, so Lei Mingxuan opened Bilibili and watched an episode of a shounen action anime. Then he shared a night-view photo taken at Lujiazui Ring Road in the evening in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group, and said in a voice message: "Guys, the first step online is done. In June we'll do Xiaohongshu! Li Na, later you can help review the layout." Zhang Wei and Li Na quickly replied, and the group stayed lively for a while.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Turning off the light, Lei Mingxuan lay in bed reviewing the day: the morning meeting went smoothly, the spreadsheets were clear, and most importantly, he and Shen Jie had finalized the first tactical direction for the online branch. Everything was progressing at a steady pace. He felt grounded and full of momentum for the future. He dimmed the phone screen, checked tomorrow's weather, and after confirming it was fine, fell asleep peacefully at 22:30, drifting into dreams with a sense of achievement and anticipation.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and monitoring personal health data.
description: After waking up naturally, he measured his weight in the bedroom; the electronic scale showed 77.0kg. Satisfied, he recorded it in his phone memo and checked Xiaohongshu post data to mentally prepare for store operations.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

While stretching, I saw Xie Fei's shooting video in the ball group. I immediately @Xie Fei with a teasing reply, agreed to meet him tomorrow at 8 PM at the Yuanshen Sports Center basketball court for a game, and sent a private message explaining that I've been busy digitalizing the store lately.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stretching after a morning run and breakfast prepared by mother
description: After returning home, I used a foam roller on the floor to relax my calves and iliotibial band, then enjoyed the breakfast prepared by my mother Wang Xiuying: toasted whole wheat bread, boiled egg whites, and black coffee, while checking the online spreadsheet data as I ate.
location: Living room and dining room at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shared-bike commuting and VIP group interaction
description: Rode a shared bike to the Super Brand Mall store. On the way, he posted the mountain-style outfit photo to the VIP customer group with a caption to liven things up. Regular customer Qian Duoduo instantly replied to reserve a jacket.

description: Returning to the store, I rearranged the display zones. Regular customer Qian Duoduo came to pick up her pre-ordered jacket, and I recommended pairing it with techwear shorts, so she bought the set. During breaks, I replied to private messages on the online store and contacted SF Express to pack and ship online orders.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

description: Handed over with Xiao Lin and confirmed the day's revenue. Changed into casual sportswear, rode a shared bike home, and detoured to Yanqin Grocery Store to buy sugar-free iced oolong tea and ready-to-eat chicken breast to prepare for the evening training.

name: Anime binge-watching, in-depth study, and bedtime preparation
description: Leaning against the headboard, he used his iPad Pro to watch two episodes of Demon Slayer, occasionally scrolling through Moments to like Shen Jie's posts, and sent stickers in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat. Then he turned off the tablet and read the chapters on social proof and liking in Influence, marking them with a highlighter. Before going to sleep, he checked the next day's weather and calendar, closed his eyes, took deep breaths, and got ready for sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

description: Woken by his biological clock, he habitually touched his abdomen; the soreness from last night's core training was still there. He decided not to go for a morning run today and save his energy for the evening ball game. While washing up, he already ran through today's plan in his mind: the store is having a promotion, go home to learn how to make zongzi with his mom, and meet Brother Fei in the evening.

description: Mother Wang Xiuying had prepared breakfast early: whole wheat toast, boiled eggs, and a bowl of warm unsweetened soy milk. Sitting across from him, she peeled an egg and reminded Lei Mingxuan about the ingredients for making zongzi in the afternoon: "The glutinous rice and pork belly were marinated last night. Don't be late this afternoon." Lei Mingxuan smiled and nodded, feeling a warmth in his heart. After eating, he helped her clear the dishes.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Commute to the store
description: Changed into a loose linen shirt and shorts, put on his commuter bag, and went out. At the entrance of the residential area, he scanned a shared bike and rode to the metro station. On the way, he passed Yanqin Grocery Store, made a brief stop, and bought a bottle of iced unsweetened oolong tea to bring to the store. Then he parked the bike at the entrance of Century Avenue Metro Station, swiped his card to enter, and took Line 2 to Lujiazui Station.
location: Along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui West Road in Pudong New District, Shanghai (via Yanqin Grocery Store, Metro Line 2 from Century Avenue Station to Lujiazui Station)

name: Store preparation and Dragon Boat Festival promotion execution
description: At 08:40, arrived at store A-208 on the second floor of Super Brand Mall. Store clerk Xiao Lin was already waiting at the door. The two opened the roll-up door together, then turned on the air conditioning and the cash register system. Lei Mingxuan looked around and confirmed the display had remained tidy from last night. Then he divided the work with Xiao Lin: Xiao Lin was responsible for vacuuming the floor and wiping down the counter and shelves; Lei Mingxuan brought out the Dragon Boat Festival promotional materials from the storeroom and hand-drew a poster at the cash register that read “Spend 299 yuan and receive a mugwort sachet.” Though the handwriting was not neat, it was full of handmade sincerity. He then guided Xiao Lin in hanging zongzi-shaped ornaments at the store entrance and dressed a mannequin in a fresh summer outfit, placing a sign beside it that read “Recommended for holiday outings.” The promotional atmosphere immediately picked up. Lei Mingxuan took a photo of the poster and decorations and sent it to the VIP customer group and his Moments, with the caption: “Dragon Boat Festival is coming. I made a poster myself. Come by the store, and I’ll give you a summer that smells of mugwort.” The entire preparation process was compact and efficient.
location: Store A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handle communications with communities, customers, and suppliers.
description: After the promotion officially went live, Lei Mingxuan sat at the cash register and used his phone to push out a steady stream of promotional messages and photos of new outfit combinations in several WeChat groups. He replied to inquiries from several potential customers and successfully scheduled regular customer “Qian Duoduo” to come to the store for a fitting that afternoon. Then he sent a message to supplier Zhou Tao asking about delivery times for post-holiday restocking. Brother Tao quickly replied, saying the goods would arrive on the first day after the Dragon Boat Festival. After finishing his online work, Lei Mingxuan briefly left the store.
location: Store A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch
description: Lei Mingxuan felt that convenience store food was quick but a bit monotonous, so he decided to try something different. He went to the "Light Food Time" restaurant on B1 of Super Brand Mall. The air conditioning inside was very strong. He ordered a "Thai Spicy Chicken Salad" and a "Kale Apple Juice", which were refreshing and light, leaving plenty of room for the afternoon and evening activities. While eating, he scrolled through his phone and saw that several regular customers had already liked the promotional poster in his Moments, which gave him a sense of accomplishment. He finished eating at 13:15 and returned to the store.
location: Qingshiguang Restaurant, B1F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Tidied up the store and arranged the afternoon's tasks.
description: Back at the store, Lei Mingxuan had Xiaolin stay at the cash register for the afternoon. He counted the morning's takings, put them in an envelope, and prepared to take them home for deposit. He made final adjustments to the store display, making sure every garment hung crisply. He specifically went over the afternoon precautions with Xiaolin, especially that 'Qian Duoduo' might come, and told her to receive her carefully: 'This lady has high standards, so bring out several new styles for her to choose from.'
location: Store A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute back home
description: He took off his shirt, changed into a more comfortable T-shirt, waved goodbye to Xiao Lin, and left Super Brand Mall. He walked to Lujiazui Metro Station, took Metro Line 2 back to Century Avenue Station, and after exiting the station, walked back to Shanggang Residential Community.
location: From Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue (via Metro Line 2)

name: Make zongzi with his mother and share them with the neighbors
description: After returning home, he changed out of his coat, washed his hands, and went into the kitchen. His mother Wang Xiuying had already set everything out: a basin of soaked glutinous rice, a bowl of marinated pork belly, a basin of washed zongzi leaves, and cotton string for tying the zongzi. The two sat around the dining table. She first picked up two zongzi leaves, demonstrating and explaining the trick of wrapping zongzi to Lei Mingxuan. Lei Mingxuan tried to follow along, but his zongzi either leaked rice or came out in strange shapes, like oversized meat triangles. His mother laughed heartily, and Lei Mingxuan enjoyed it so much that he wrapped six 'highly personal' zongzi in one go. In the meantime, he took out his phone and, under his mother's guidance, took a few photos of the wrapping process and a short instructional video. Then the zongzi were put into the pot to cook. While waiting, Lei Mingxuan used a phone app to touch up the photos and posted them to his Moments with the caption: 'Today I learned to wrap zongzi with my mom. They may not look great, but they taste absolutely amazing! Are you ready for the Dragon Boat Festival?' When the zongzi were cooked, an irresistible aroma filled the air. His mother took out a few and had Lei Mingxuan put them on a plate to take to Aunt Zhu Xiuying next door. Aunt Zhu accepted the zongzi and, smiling, gave him a bowl of her own homemade fermented rice balls in return.
location: Home kitchen/dining area and neighbor Zhu Xiuying's doorstep, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Resting up and heading to the court
description: Back home, he quickly took a cold shower and changed into athletic clothes. At home, he ate an ugly zongzi he had wrapped himself—it tasted really good and replenished his carbs. Then he went out, got on a shared bike, and navigated to Yuanshen Sports Center. On the way, he bought a bottle of iced Pocari Sweat at a convenience store to stay hydrated for exercise.
location: Along the route from No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Residential Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 1458 Zhangyang Road

name: Basketball warm-up and light activity.
description: After arriving at the outdoor basketball court at Yuanshen Sports Center at 18:00, Lei Mingxuan warmed up alone on the empty half-court. He first did a set of stretches, then bounced and dribbled the ball to find his rhythm, shooting intermittently for about ten minutes until his body was loose. After that, after a deep talk with Xie Fei, the two began shooting practice. Xie Fei coached Lei Mingxuan while shooting, correcting his holding posture. Lei Mingxuan ran to catch passes and made layups, feeling that his cardiorespiratory function was much better than before, and enjoyed the pure joy of basketball for about thirty minutes.
location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Had an in-depth talk with good friend Xie Fei to mend their relationship.
description: After warming up, Lei Mingxuan was sitting by the court drinking water when he saw Xie Fei jogging in from the entrance. Xie Fei patted him on the shoulder and said with a smile, "I thought you were going to stand me up again today." Lei Mingxuan immediately stood up, his expression turning serious. The two sat down on a bench beside the basketball court. Lei Mingxuan frankly explained that because he'd been busy with store promotions and working out, he hadn't been in good shape, so he'd stood Xie Fei up several times and felt really bad about it. He also showed Xie Fei the photos of himself making rice dumplings that afternoon, saying, "To make it up to you, I specially learned to make rice dumplings from my mom this afternoon to bring you some good cheer." Xie Fei smiled and said understandingly, "No worries, bro. I know you've been busy with real stuff. Health is the foundation; it's good you're working out." The two then talked about Xie Fei's recent work and life. Lei Mingxuan took the initiative: "Brother Fei, next week we have to make it happen. I want to sign up for that amateur basketball tournament in June, and let's try to get a place together." Xie Fei readily agreed: "Sure! Then let's make it Wednesday? I'll see how you've recovered." They high-fived to seal the appointment, and the earlier awkwardness vanished in sweat and sincerity.
location: Rest area beside the basketball court at Yuanshen Sports Center, 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ended the activity and returned home
description: As it grew dark, the two decided to call it a day. Xie Fei said he wanted to get some late-night snacks, but Lei Mingxuan politely declined, wanting to go home and stretch. The two walked to the entrance of Yuanshen Sports Center, said "See you Wednesday!" to each other, and went their separate ways. Lei Mingxuan got on a shared bike and slowly rode back to Shanggang Community.
location: Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Home stretching and review
description: After arriving home, his parents were watching TV. Lei Mingxuan greeted them, then went to the balcony, laid out a yoga mat, and did 15 minutes of full-body stretching, focusing on relaxing his thighs and calves. After stretching, he took a warm shower and felt much refreshed.
location: Home balcony/bathroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading and social interaction before bed
description: Changed into pajamas and sat on the bed. Took out the book Influence and continued reading the "Social Proof" chapter, and thought that agreeing to play ball with Xie Fei today was also a way of building positive "social proof". After reading, he picked up his phone and scrolled through Moments; his post about making zongzi had already received over 30 likes, and friends had left teasing comments. In a good mood, Lei Mingxuan replied to a few. He also opened Bilibili and caught up on the new episode of Demon Slayer.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Daily logging, evening preparation, and sleep.
description: Turned off Bilibili, logged today's diet and exercise in the Health app on his phone, and recorded his weight and mood: "Relieved after repairing an important friendship, life returns to social balance. Looking forward to Wednesday's ball game and June's amateur tournament." Finally, he checked tomorrow's weather (Friday, May 30): cloudy, 23-28°C, good for running. He set the alarm for 7:15. At 23:15, he turned off the lights and fell asleep, soon drifting into dreamland.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning weigh-in and warm-up preparation
description: At 6:20 a.m., his phone alarm went off, and Lei Mingxuan woke up naturally. He stood barefoot on the digital scale, weighed himself, recorded his weight as 77.0 kg, and noted down his weight and wake-up time in his phone memo. Then he changed into a quick-dry short-sleeved shirt and shorts and running shoes, and did dynamic stretches on the living room mat, such as high knees, jumping jacks, and lunge stretches, to wake up his body before heading out for a morning run.
location: At home, No. 1, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run and post-run stretching.
description: Lei Mingxuan walked to Lujiazui Central Greenland Park and ran 5 km along the fitness trail, keeping a pace of about 6:05 per kilometer. Morning sunlight scattered down as he breathed steadily; he adjusted his rhythm at the 2.5 km turnaround point and sped up for a sprint in the final kilometer. After the run, he did 5 minutes of post-run stretching in the leisure area on the east side of the park, patted and relaxed his leg muscles, and drank some warm water.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Go home, wash up, and have breakfast
description: Lei Mingxuan walked home, took a hot shower, and changed into loungewear. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared breakfast: pan-fried buns, boiled eggs, and hot soy milk. He sat at the table to eat and had a brief chat with his mother, learning that she had already made a Dragon Boat Festival ingredient list and planned to shop in the evening.
location: At home, No. 1, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute on foot to the Super Brand Mall store
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into a light-gray cotton-linen shirt, khaki cargo shorts, and white sneakers, slung a canvas bag across his shoulder, and brought his store keys and power bank. After saying goodbye to his mother, he walked to Super Brand Mall. On the way, he went from Pudong Avenue to Century Avenue, crossed the overpass, entered the west gate of Super Brand Mall, exchanged greetings with the morning-shift security guard, then took the escalator to the second floor and opened the store's rolling door.
location: No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Super Brand Mall, West Gate to 2F, Unit A-208.

name: Morning store tidying and Dragon Boat Festival promotion check.
description: After entering the store, Lei Mingxuan turned on the air conditioning and lights, and checked conditions after yesterday's closing. He verified the previous day's revenue and prepared change. He adjusted the position of the Dragon Boat Festival promotional poster that staff member Xiao Lin had put up last night, tidied the mountain-style short-sleeve T-shirt display, and placed the newly arrived blind boxes in a prominent spot at the cash register, ready for business.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, "Xiafei Collection"

name: Morning routine business operations and customer reception.
description: The store opened on time at 9 AM. Lei Mingxuan and the clerk Xiao Lin stood throughout to receive customers. Morning foot traffic was decent. Around 11 AM, a regular customer, Qian Duoduo, came in and asked about the techwear hooded jacket reserved last week. Lei Mingxuan fetched it from the stockroom and helped her try it on, suggesting pairing it with cargo pants in the same color. This successfully closed a bundled sale of the hooded jacket and techwear shorts. During this, they also chatted about tomorrow's orienteering race arrangements.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, "Xiafei Collection"

name: Online order processing and supplier communication
description: During a lull in customer traffic, Lei Mingxuan logged into the backend of his online mini-store and processed 5 orders, 3 of which needed to be shipped that day. He checked the customer addresses and style numbers, and printed the shipping labels. He then contacted supplier Zhou Tao via WeChat and confirmed that the restock batch of new summer T-shirts had left Hangzhou and was expected to arrive the next day.
location: Cashier counter of "Xiafeiji" store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch: Light salad and rest
description: Lei Mingxuan temporarily left the store in Xiao Lin's care, walked to the KOKA SALAD light meal shop on B1 of Jin Mao Tower, and ordered a signature Cobb salad with vinaigrette and an iced Americano. While eating, he scrolled through local news and sports updates, and replied to group members' complaints in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group.
location: KOKA SALAD salad shop, B1, Jin Mao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sent a package after the meal and returned to the store
description: After leaving Jin Mao Tower, Lei Mingxuan strolled to the package collection point beside Exit 1 of Lujiazui Metro Station and handed the three packages packed in the morning to the courier for scanning and pickup. Then he slowly walked back to Super Brand Mall to walk off lunch and returned to the store.
location: Parcel collection point at Exit 1 of Lujiazui Metro Station, 158 Huayuanshiqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store shift and data analysis
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to the store and let Xiao Lin, the shop assistant, rest for half an hour. Sitting behind the cashier counter, he opened a tablet and analyzed the past week's sales data and inventory reports, studying the proportion of the mountain-style collection versus basic styles to prepare for future restocking and Xiaohongshu product recommendation content. During that time, he received two groups of walk-in customers and successfully sold a pair of denim shorts.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, "Xiafei Collection"

name: Father came to the store to discuss the Xiaohongshu promotion plan
description: At 2 p.m., his father, Lei Jianguo, rode an electric bike to the store. Lei Mingxuan poured tea and explained in detail the Xiaohongshu launch plan he had finalized with Shen Jie: register the account on June 1, post 2–3 outfit posts with photos and text each week, and keep the initial budget within 5,000 yuan. After listening, his father suggested giving it a try without investing too much. The two then discussed details on connecting online promotion with inventory. His father also helped wipe the display cabinets in the store and left on the electric bike at about 15:25.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, "Xiafei Collection"

name: Afternoon business and closing preparations
description: After his father left, Lei Mingxuan continued minding the store. In the afternoon, five or six groups of customers came in one after another. He and Xiao Lin split the duties of receiving them and closed two orders for matching couple outfits. Before 17:00, he had Xiao Lin tidy up the fitting rooms and hanging racks, while he confirmed the shopping time with his mother by phone. She replied that she was leaving now, and they agreed to meet at the west gate of Pushang Vegetable Market.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, "Xiafei Collection"

name: Closing the store and purchasing ingredients for the Dragon Boat Festival
description: Lei Mingxuan closed the shop early, and he and Xiao Lin pulled down the rolling shutter and locked up. He rode a shared bike along Pudong Avenue to the west gate of Pushang Food Market, where he met his mother Wang Xiuying. The two pushed a cart into the market and shopped according to the list: one large yellow croaker, two jin of pork belly, a bundle of bamboo leaves for zongzi, 20 salted duck eggs, five jin of glutinous rice, fresh shiitake mushrooms, and more, spending 158 yuan in total, paid by Lei Mingxuan via WeChat Pay. He also bought half a white cut chicken to add to dinner.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home to put away groceries and have family dinner
description: The mother and son walked home and put the ingredients into the refrigerator by category. Lei Mingxuan helped cut the pork belly and wash the bamboo leaves. His mother cooked green onion braised pork chops, stir-fried amaranth, and tomato egg soup, with white cut chicken. The family of three sat down to eat. Lei Mingxuan reported the next day's Dragon Boat Festival schedule and orienteering race arrangements to his parents, and his father once again reminded him to control spending on Xiaohongshu promotion.
location: At home, No. 1, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-meal rest and light housework
description: After the meal, Lei Mingxuan voluntarily cleared the table and put the dishes in the sink. He went back to his room, changed into loose athletic shorts and a T-shirt, rested for a while on the living room sofa, and drank a glass of warm water to recover his energy.
location: At home, No. 1, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Voice communication with Song Jia on orienteering race strategy
description: Lei Mingxuan cleared the coffee table and used his tablet and phone to make a WeChat voice call with his friend Song Jia. The two carefully went through the next day's orienteering race rules, checkpoint distribution, task types, and time limits. Based on their respective strengths, he was responsible for map navigation and route planning for fast movement, while Song Jia was responsible for checking in at checkpoints and taking photos of tasks. During the conversation, he recorded key points and worked out emergency strategies for getting lost or declining stamina. After hanging up, he spread out his trail running shoes, quick-dry long-sleeved T-shirt, tight workout pants, sports waist pack, energy gels, and other gear to make sure everything was complete.
location: Living room at home, No. 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening strength training and stretching to unwind
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into his training tank top and started strength training on the yoga mat in the living room. He completed 3 sets of squat jumps (15 reps each), 3 sets of dumbbell bench presses (12 reps each, with 12 kg dumbbells), 3 sets of planks (60 seconds each), and finished with 3 sets of standard push-ups (15 reps each), all to rhythmic music. After training, he had a protein shake and did 10 minutes of full-body static stretching, focusing on his legs, hips, and back, and his heart rate gradually calmed down.
location: Living room at home, No. 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Take a shower and pack the sports backpack for tomorrow.
description: Lei Mingxuan took a warm shower in the bathroom and changed into clean cotton loungewear. Back in the living room, he packed the previously checked sports gear into his backpack in order, tucked energy gels into the waist pack compartment, confirmed that his phone and power bank were fully charged, and got ready for tomorrow's orienteering race.
location: At home, No. 1, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Night reading and note-taking
description: Lei Mingxuan sat propped up in bed, read more than 20 pages of 'Influence', and updated his reading notes in his phone memo. Then he got up, brushed his teeth, and set the alarm for 6:20 tomorrow morning.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Socializing before bed and going to sleep
description: Lei Mingxuan turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp, and quickly scrolled through his Moments: he liked Xie Fei's basketball court photo and commented with a surprised emoji under Li Na's West Lake night view video. At 22:00 he exited all apps and set his phone to Do Not Disturb mode. At exactly 23:00 he turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning weigh-in and preparation
description: Woken by my biological clock, I went to the bathroom and weighed myself on the body fat scale, confirming my weight remained steady at 77.0kg. I felt good. While washing up, I mentally reviewed today's race schedule and made a 'stay steady' gesture to myself in the mirror. I changed into my prepared quick-dry sports T-shirt, shorts, and running shoes to get ready for the morning pre-race training.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-race adaptation morning run
description: Walk to Century Park in about 15 minutes. Considering the morning orienteering race was quite intense, I ran an easy 4 kilometers at a pace of 5:50/km as a pre-race warm-up activation. After the run, I did 10 minutes of dynamic stretching and joint mobility exercises by the lawn to make sure my body was fully activated.
location: Shanghai Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Supplies and gathering preparation.
description: After stretching, I went to a nearby convenience store and bought a bottle of electrolyte drink and a pack of chocolate energy gel to quickly refuel for the race. Then I walked to the meeting point at Gate 1 Plaza, messaging Song Jia on WeChat to confirm they had already arrived.
location: C-Store (Meihua 1), 919 Meihua Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Urban outdoor orienteering race
description: Lei Mingxuan met up with Song Jia and her friends Xiao Chen and Xiao Li, and received the mission map and punch card. Relying on his familiarity with Century Park's terrain and his sense of direction, he took on the role of 'navigator.' The team efficiently completed the tasks at 10 checkpoints, including solving the puzzle 'find the hidden sculpture on the map,' doing 30 team jump ropes on the lawn, and blindfolded crossing of a designated area. The team finished in 1 hour 50 minutes, ranking 8th. The four of them cooperated well, added each other on WeChat, and took a group photo after the race. Xiao Chen suggested trying indoor roller skating next time, and Song Jia responded enthusiastically.
location: Shanghai Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returned home to shower and change
description: After the game ended, I said goodbye to my teammates and walked home for about 15 minutes. Once home, I quickly took a shower and changed into clean casual clothes. While my mom wasn't paying attention, I grabbed a cup of unsweetened yogurt from the fridge and stirred in a scoop of protein powder to tide me over and store up energy for the afternoon basketball game.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Coordinated handling on workdays
description: Although the store is not open today, I can't completely let go of store matters. I opened the store inventory management system on my phone, quickly checked the Dragon Boat Festival promotion sales data sent by the shop assistant Xiao Lin, and sent screenshots of the low-stock alerts for several best-selling styles to the supplier Zhou Tao. At the same time, I replied to two VIP customers who asked about sizes on WeChat and reserved fitting times for them after the holiday.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday leisure and preparing the sneaker bag
description: After dealing with work, he felt a little sleepy. He leaned against the sofa in the living room and scrolled through Bilibili, watching half an episode of the new show that had just been updated today. Then he went back to the bedroom, took out his basketball bag, checked his sneakers, protective gear, and a spare T-shirt, and also stuffed two wafer biscuits and a pack of energy gummies into the bag.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Warm-up for the basketball game and lunch break
description: Set the alarm for 3:20 PM, then went to bed for about an hour and a half of a nap. After all, the morning had been quite draining, and he still had basketball in the afternoon; adequate rest was needed to stay in good shape.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went to Yuanshen Sports Center to play basketball
description: He got up, splashed cold water on his face, and packed his basketball bag. He rode a shared bike along Zhangyang Road for about 15 minutes and arrived at Yuanshen Sports Center. He met Xie Fei at the entrance to the court, and the two entered the venue chatting and laughing. Today they played half-court 3v3. Lei Mingxuan felt his stamina was much better than last week, his shooting touch had returned somewhat, and he made several drives and layups. He and Xie Fei were on the same team; when they miscommunicated, instead of blaming each other like before, they high-fived and encouraged each other. After the game, they sat courtside drinking sports drinks and reviewing the game, agreed to continue next Wednesday, and officially confirmed their registration for the amateur basketball tournament at the end of June.
location: Yuanshen Sports Center, 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Return home to help with cooking
description: After saying goodbye to Xie Fei, he rode his bike straight home. When he got in, he called out loudly, 'Mom, I'm home! Is there anything I can help with?' Then he washed his hands, went into the kitchen, and helped his mother Wang Xiuying peel garlic, trim vegetables, and do other prep work. While working, he recounted with great animation how he navigated and solved puzzles in today's orienteering event, making his mother laugh.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dragon Boat Festival family gathering
description: A sumptuous Dragon Boat Festival family dinner was ready: egg yolk and pork zongzi, steamed yellow croaker, braised pork, stir-fried amaranth, and a bowl of tomato and egg soup. Lei Mingxuan strictly followed his diet plan and ate half a zongzi, a piece of lean braised pork, half a yellow croaker, and plenty of vegetables. During the meal, he reported in detail on the day's match and the progress of the basketball game, and also showed off his May fitness results (weight dropped from 77.9 kg to 77.0 kg). His father Lei Jianguo brought out his own bayberry wine; the three of them had a small drink, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: After-dinner walk and shopping.
description: After the meal, he proactively cleared the table, then accompanied his father downstairs for a walk to aid digestion. The two walked two laps around the community garden, chatting about recent business and online plans. When passing Yanqin Grocery Store at the community gate, Lei Mingxuan suggested going in for a look and bought his father two bottles of his favorite time-honored yellow wine and some plastic food storage bags for the kitchen.
location: Inside Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the Yanqin Grocery Store next to the community

name: May diet and fitness review.
description: Back in his room, he opened his laptop and the Mint Health app. He carefully reviewed the weight trend chart, check-in records, and diet logs from May 1 to 31. Comparing with April’s data, he was pleasantly surprised to find that his energy score had improved from an average of 6 to 8. He took screenshots of several key data points and posted an illustrated summary post in the app’s community circle, titled “77.9/77.0, slow but steady,” sharing how he balanced the indulgence of Zongzi Festival with everyday discipline. The post soon received over ten likes and several encouraging comments.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Final confirmation of the online launch.
description: Turned off the fitness app and sent a WeChat message to his cousin Shen Jie. The two once again made final confirmations on the details of launching the Xiaohongshu account "Xiafei Collection_RAY" tomorrow (June 1), including the cover image, copy, and hashtags for the first post "Mountain-Tech Style Outfit Guide". Shen Jie sent a sticker saying "All ready", and Lei Mingxuan replied with "Go", feeling full of anticipation.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stretching and reading before bed
description: Back in the bedroom, I unrolled the yoga mat and did 15 minutes of pre-sleep stretching to relax the muscles from today's intense exercise. Then, leaning against the bed, I continued reading Influence. When I reached the "Commitment and Consistency" chapter, I thought of my May fitness routine and today's promise to my teammates about next roller-skating session, and made a few annotations. After that, I scrolled through Bilibili for a while and watched a designer toy unboxing video before reluctantly putting down my phone.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: Turned off the lights and fell asleep. Tomorrow is the first day of June, and the starting point of a new online chapter. With a full sense of accomplishment and anticipation for the future, I soon entered dreamland.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake-up and weigh-in
description: Woken by my phone alarm, outside the window was the quiet Sunday-morning sunlight. I stepped barefoot onto the scale, held my breath, and looked at the number: 77.2kg. It was slightly higher than yesterday's pre-race measurement of 77.0kg, which had been topped up by the post-race dinner and hydration—a normal fluctuation. I recorded it in the Boohee Health app and also glanced at yesterday's diet review.
location: Master bedroom bathroom, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning stretch and breakfast
description: In the living room, I unrolled the yoga mat and spent 10 minutes doing a wake-up stretching routine, focusing on the shoulders and knees that were sore from playing basketball yesterday. After washing up, my mother had already prepared breakfast: two boiled eggs, a slice of whole wheat toast with peanut butter, and a glass of warm milk. While eating, I scrolled through my phone and saw the orienteering race photos Zhang Wei posted in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat last night. I liked them and replied: 'I'm starting today too, see you online!'
location: Living room and dining room, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparation and planning before heading out
description: Went back to the room and changed into the store uniform: a clean white T-shirt, paired with work shorts and skate shoes. Since it was Sunday and the mall didn’t open until 10, I decided to leave early to get the store ready for opening. Meanwhile, I was quietly thinking through the afternoon meeting with Xie Fei. I took a deep breath and told myself: “Between brothers, there’s nothing that can’t be said—just be direct and settle it.”
location: In the bedroom at Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk to Super Brand Mall.
description: Walk out of the residential complex, take a deep breath of the fresh morning Pudong air. Turn from Pudong Avenue onto Binjiang Avenue, heading west, in a good mood. Passing the familiar jianbing stall, although I had already had breakfast, I still ordered a cup of freshly ground soy milk. There were not many pedestrians on the road, and the weekend sense of relaxation was at its fullest.
location: Walking from Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, along Binjiang Avenue to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road

name: Morning store preparation
description: Arrived half an hour earlier than the time notified to store clerk Xiao Lin. Walked around the store first, checking the exterior lighting and mannequin displays. Noticed that several corners of the hanging banners from yesterday's Dragon Boat Festival event were curled up, and smoothed and adjusted them one by one. Opened the cashier system, checked yesterday's sales data, and confirmed it was correct.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Make weekly work arrangements with store clerk Xiao Lin.
description: Xiao Lin, the part-time store clerk, arrived on time. They held a brief weekly meeting. He took out his phone and showed her the screenshot of the Xiaohongshu account that Shen Jie had sent last night (@Mingxuan's Outfit Diary), and told her, "The account officially goes live today! Next week, if someone takes photos in the store to attract traffic, you should be warmly cooperative—they might just be our online customers." He then reviewed this week's new arrivals checklist and the scripts for online customer inquiries with her, to make sure nothing went wrong when she ran the store alone on Monday.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Final confirmation before opening
description: There was still half an hour before the mall opened at 10. He connected his phone to the store's Bluetooth speaker and played an energetic remix of “Gotta Have You.” He also refolded the quick-dry T-shirts on the display stand at the entrance more neatly, making sure every detail was in place.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and publishing the first Xiaohongshu post.
description: The mall opened, and foot traffic gradually increased. Worked seamlessly with Xiao Lin; I recommended outfits for customers with clear needs, while Xiao Lin handled checkout and tidying clothes. Around 11 a.m., regular customer Qian Duoduo brought a friend to look for new arrivals. I recommended two pairs of techwear shorts, and her friend readily bought both. Taking advantage of a lull in traffic, I sat in the rest area and, following the details discussed with Shen Jie last night, downloaded the first Xiaohongshu image-and-text material she had made (the content shared a mountain-style workwear outfit), edited the copy, added tags such as #ShanghaiStyle, and clicked publish. At that moment, I felt the store's online journey had officially begun.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Simple lunch
description: Seeing that the morning business was going well, he let Xiao Lin go to lunch first. He strolled down to the B1 floor, bought a tuna sandwich and a bottle of oolong tea, and ate while scrolling through the Xiaohongshu post he had just published. Seeing that several people from the same city had liked it, he felt a sense of accomplishment.
location: Food court, B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon Peak Reception and Checkout Arrangements
description: Xiao Lin came back after lunch. From 1 to 2 PM was the weekend's small peak period; I continued to help attend to several family customers with children. Around 2 o'clock, I told Xiao Lin that I had personal matters to attend to in the afternoon and asked her to take full care of the store, leaving a WeChat message for any online inquiries she wasn't sure about. Then I tidied up my appearance, grabbed my keys and phone, and got ready to go out.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycle to Old Flavor Noodle House
description: After walking out of Super Brand Mall, I scanned a Hellobike. The sun was just right. I rode along Lujiazui Ring Road for about 10 minutes and arrived at Old Flavor Noodle Shop on Yuanshen Road. This road holds too many basketball memories, and also the beginning of a new life.
location: Cycled from Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Old Taste Noodle Shop, 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Honest conversation with Xie Fei
description: Xie Fei had already arrived and ordered two bowls of the signature spicy pork noodles. Lei started off by telling him very sincerely that recently he had become obsessed with new hobbies like camping and pour-over coffee, and the shop also had online plans to keep him busy, so he had cut back a lot on playing ball. Looking him in the eye, he said, "Brother Fei, it's not that I'm deliberately avoiding you. I really want to do everything well, but there isn't enough time. I don't want our relationship to go cold." Xie Fei was silent for a while, then sighed and said, "Brother, I understand. Life has its stages. As long as you still regard me as a friend, that's enough." The two clinked their cola bottles. Although they knew they would play ball less often in the future, their brotherhood had not changed—it was just continuing in a more comfortable way.
location: Old Taste Noodle House, 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Returned home and went shopping on the way.
description: After parting with Xie Fei, he walked home along Yuanshen Road. The breeze brushed his face, and the weight in his heart was lifted, making him feel especially relaxed. Passing by the Yanqin Grocery Store near home (near Yantai Road, Pudong New Area), he went in and bought a bottle of coconut juice. At the cash register was the familiar shopkeeper, and they chatted a bit about this morning's vegetable prices. Then he arrived home.
location: Walk from Old Flavor Noodle Shop, 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Yanqin Grocery Store on Yantai Road, then to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Morning weigh-in and Dragon Boat Festival breakfast
description: At 7:15 a.m. on June 2, 2025, Lei Mingxuan was woken by his alarm clock. After getting up, he weighed himself and was 77.5 kg, reminding himself to be moderate during the Dragon Boat Festival. After washing up, his mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared a Dragon Boat Festival breakfast: small wontons with fresh pork and a salted egg yolk pork zongzi. While eating breakfast, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu on his phone, saw mountain-style outfit inspiration, saved 3 styling templates, and planned to discuss them with his cousin Shen Jie today.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commuting and shopping
description: Lei Mingxuan wore a gray techwear vest from his own store as a walking advertisement and rode a shared bike from home to the clothing store at Super Brand Mall. Passing by Yanqin Grocery Store, he bought sugar-free oolong tea and two packs of zongzi candy, ready to entertain the store's regular customers. The ride took about 15 minutes, and he arrived at the mall on time at 8:30.
location: From Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, via Yanqin Grocery Store, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Store opening preparations and ambiance setup
description: After Lei Mingxuan and store clerk Xiao Lin arrived at the shop, they rolled up the rolling shutter door and inspected the displays. He was in charge of hand-painting the artistic lettering 'Dragon Boat Festival Special: 20% Off Any Two Summer Items' on the small blackboard by the entrance, while Xiao Lin hung the purchased mugwort and calamus bundles on the door handle and placed Dragon Boat Festival sachets at the cash register to create a festive atmosphere.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning business operations and promotional activities.
description: After officially opening at 9 a.m., Lei Mingxuan posted a promotional poster and voice message in the VIP group, announcing that customers who said the secret code in store would receive a camping storage bag. The first batch of customers was a family of three. The mother wanted to buy a quick-dry T-shirt, so Lei Mingxuan used the mountain-style outfit photos he had saved in the morning to recommend a complete set, and eventually closed three sales. During this time, he also handled two same-city flash delivery orders and checked online orders every half hour. The morning was busy and efficient.
location: Inside Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Warm interaction during lunchtime
description: At noon, his mother Wang Xiuying brought homemade egg-yolk and pork zongzi and tea eggs for lunch. Just then a regular customer came into the store. Lei Mingxuan warmly handed over a peeled hot zongzi and zongzi candy, wishing him a healthy Dragon Boat Festival. After tasting it, the regular customer took a liking to the sun-protection jacket on the mannequin and paid for it directly. Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin had a simple lunch with zongzi and felt very satisfied.
location: Inside Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-meal digestion and store tidying
description: After the meal, Lei Mingxuan went to the sports brand section on the third floor of Super Brand Mall to walk and aid digestion, secretly observing the new product displays and customer flow of competing brands. Back in the store, he imported the photos taken in the morning into his phone for simple retouching, and cleared the workbench in the back room to prepare for the in-depth content planning session with his cousin Shen Jie in the afternoon.
location: The sports brand area on the third floor of Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and store A-208 on the second floor.

name: Store operations and preparation during breaks
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic slowed somewhat. While replying to online inquiries, Lei Mingxuan continued refining the registration information for the Xiaohongshu account "Xiafeiji" on his laptop, and prepared 6 alternative note titles and 3 popular hashtags (#ShanghaiMenswearStore #MountainStyleOutfits #TechwearStyle). He then sent a WeChat message to his cousin Shen Jie, inviting her to come over and continue working on content creation together.
location: Workstation in the inner room of Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In-depth content planning and filming
description: At 2:30 PM, his cousin Shen Jie arrived at the store on time with coffee and began working with Lei Mingxuan. With the eye of a professional buyer, Shen Jie adjusted the shooting plan: she used a macro lens to shoot flat-lay detail photos of the best-selling mountain-style jackets and quick-dry pants, showing the fabric and pocket design; then, in the natural light at the store entrance, she directed Lei Mingxuan to wear the full outfit, shot several natural and casual lookbook photos, and recorded a 15-second short video of "New Arrivals Unboxing." The two also finalized the first-month posting calendar for Xiaohongshu: post outdoor camping gear recommendations next week and shoot pour-over coffee daily life at the end of the month.
location: The inner workbench and doorway area of Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Editing, publishing, and real-time feedback.
description: After the photo shoot, Shen Jie taught Lei Mingxuan how to use a mobile photo-editing app to adjust colors and add tags. Lei Mingxuan picked the most impressive try-on photo as the cover image, wrote a caption emphasizing the selling points of “sun protection, waterproof, multi-pocket”, and attached the store location. At exactly 4 p.m., they clicked publish together. Five minutes later, the first like came in, and Lei Mingxuan was so excited that he slapped the table; half an hour later, the likes exceeded 10, and comments like “want the link” appeared. He immediately guided people in the comments to follow and message him, and the two high-fived in celebration.
location: Workstation in the inner room of Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening rush-hour operations and closing
description: During the evening rush hour, waves of white-collar customers came into the store. Lei Mingxuan received them energetically while taking time to reply to new Xiaohongshu comments. He successfully recommended a stylish cotton-linen shirt to an office worker in a shirt and closed the sale. At 6:30 p.m., he handed over the evening shift duties to Xiao Lin, locked the cash register, and got ready to leave.
location: Inside Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-work commute and stocking up on daily necessities
description: Lei Mingxuan chose to walk home. He first walked through the bustling Lujiazui area, strolled along the tree-lined path of Lujiazui Central Green Park, enjoying the summer evening breeze, and used his phone to shoot a few b-roll street view videos for later use. He then turned to Pusheng Vegetable Market to buy yellow rice wine for his mother and blueberries for himself. Finally, carrying his purchases, he walked 15 minutes back to his home in Shanggang Community.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; Lujiazui Central Green Park (Lujiazui Ring Road); Pushang Vegetable Market (Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai); Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family Dragon Boat Festival dinner
description: When Lei Mingxuan came home, his mother had prepared a Dragon Boat Festival feast: steamed yellow croaker, braised pork, and meat zongzi. At the table, his father Lei Jianguo told stories about watching dragon boat races by the Huangpu River when he was young, while Lei Mingxuan excitedly showed his parents the results of the day's Xiaohongshu posts. His mother praised him repeatedly. He made an exception and ate an extra half a zongzi, feeling a little overfull but very satisfied.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, home dining room

name: Personal recharge and future planning
description: After helping his mother clear the table after dinner, Lei Mingxuan went into the study, opened his laptop, browsed the webpage of "Shanghai Cultural and Creative Studio" and carefully read the detailed information of the "Historical Fiction Writing Workshop" (4 weeks, classes every Sunday).
