Satisfied with the course syllabus and instructors, he decisively paid the 980 yuan registration fee via Alipay and soon received a confirmation email and a link to the student group. He joined the group chat and introduced himself: "Hello everyone, I'm new here, Lei Mingxuan. I like historical fiction and handwritten stories." He was full of anticipation for the upcoming studies.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Social sharing and bedtime prep
description: After a hot shower, Lei Mingxuan lay on the bed in his pajamas. He first shared screenshots of his Xiaohongshu results in the “Pudong Three Musketeers” WeChat group and received likes and teasing from his friends Li Na and Zhang Wei. Then he scrolled through trailers for new Bilibili anime for a while and opened the bedside book “Those Things About the Ming Dynasty” to read two chapters, enjoying a relaxed time before sleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Review and sleep
description: Lei Mingxuan reviewed his busy day: the store promotion worked well, the first Xiaohongshu attempt received a warm response, and he successfully signed up for a writing class — everything felt perfect. He set the alarm for 6:45 the next morning, briefly sketched tomorrow's running route and the listing plan for a new batch of techwear short-sleeved shirts. At 23:30, he turned off the lights and fell asleep peacefully.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting up and morning tidying.
description: At 6:55 a.m., the alarm went off and Lei Yu got up full of energy. He first stepped on the digital scale and saw he weighed 77.8 kg, realizing that he still needed to watch the effects of the Dragon Boat Festival rice dumplings. After quickly washing up, he changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and athletic shorts, ready to go out for his morning run. The sky outside the window looked a bit heavy, but it did nothing to dampen his enthusiasm for starting a new day.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Recovery morning run
description: Lei Yu walked briskly to the Lujiazui Central Green Park behind the residential complex for a recovery jog. He ran about 3 kilometers along the park trail, keeping a pace of around 5:40 per kilometer, worked up a slight sweat, and felt his whole body loosen up. After the run, he stretched for a few minutes in the park's stretching area, checked his phone, and confirmed there were no urgent messages.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and getting ready to go out
description: After running home, his mother Zhang Xiuying had already cooked small wontons and mixed them with sesame oil and pickled mustard. His father Lei Jianguo watched the morning news while asking about Lei Yu's plans for the day. Lei Yu chatted as he ate, mentioning his idea of going camping in Sheshan on Saturday. His father teased him for being "full of fancy tricks" but still reminded him to be safe. After the meal, Lei Yu changed into a black T-shirt and cargo shorts, rode out on his bike, stopped at the Yanqin Grocery Store near the community gate to buy cold bottled water, exchanged a few words with the owner Zhang Yanqin about business, then continued riding to Super Brand Mall.

participant.name: Zhang Yanqin
participant.relation: Neighbor who runs a grocery store

location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and competitor research
description: At exactly 9 o'clock, Lei Yu arrived on time at the clothing store on the second floor of Super Brand Mall. He first did a thorough check of the displays and hung the newly arrived techwear shorts in a prominent spot by the entrance. Morning foot traffic was light, so he had the clerk Lin Xiaohui restock while he sat behind the cash register scrolling through Xiaohongshu, focusing on the layout and outfit coordination styles of several outdoor-style menswear stores, and saved screenshots into a phone folder to gather material for the afternoon meeting with Shen Jie. In between, he served four or five groups of customers and successfully sold one T-shirt and one pair of shorts.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch recap and content planning prep
description: At noon, Lei Yu ordered two portions of shengjian buns for delivery and ate them quickly with Lin Xiaohui in the store's rest area. Together they reviewed the wrap-up of the Dragon Boat Festival promotion and confirmed the bestselling short-sleeved T-shirts that needed restocking. After the meal, customer traffic was light. Lei Yu sat on the high stool at the cash register, opened his phone memos, and organized the inspiration he had gathered in the morning into several content topic directions, such as "Beginner Camping Outfit Formula" and "One Jacket from the City to the Mountains." He also pulled up some store product selection photos saved on his computer to prepare fully for the afternoon content meeting with Shen Jie.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stocking shelves and welcoming customers in the afternoon
description: Lei Yu unpacked and organized the new arrivals from yesterday. He restyled the flat caps and sunglasses in the accessory area to make the store more attractive. When Shen Jie messaged that she had reached B1 of the mall, he wiped down the small table in the reception area and prepared pour-over coffee. Just then, a young couple came in looking for an outfit suitable for taking photos in the park. Lei Yu patiently recommended several sets and successfully sold two T-shirts.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Planning content and post-meeting socializing with Shen Jie
description: Shen Jie arrived at the store on time, and Lei Yu made her a pour-over coffee. The two got straight down to business. Opening the backend data on their laptops, they found that the first post's interactions were concentrated among men aged 30-40, so they adjusted their topic selection accordingly and settled on publishing a photo-text post on "gear and outfits for refined camping" before this Friday, and shooting an atmospheric video of "a clothing store owner's daily pour-over coffee" before next Tuesday. Shen Jie also taught Lei Yu how to use the grid lines and exposure lock features on his phone camera, and they agreed to have a regular online meeting every Tuesday afternoon. After the meeting, Lei Yu walked Shen Jie to the elevator. When he returned to the store, he happened to see the camping group discussing the weekend weather. He casually sent a photo of oden and coffee to the group with the caption "Gear is ready, just waiting for Saturday!" The group was lively, and everyone was looking forward to the upcoming trip.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening rush-hour shop operations
description: During closing time, the store saw a small rush. Lei Yu greeted in-store customers while packing several online orders with Lin Xiaohui, and checked the handling of return and exchange requests to ensure smooth operations.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store early, shopping, and family dinner
description: Lei Yu decided to close the shop early today and go home to sort out his camping gear. On the bike ride home, he stopped by Pushang Vegetable Market to buy some blueberries and mangoes to restock the fridge at home. When he got home, his mother Zhang Xiuying had already prepared the meal. Lei Yu formally announced to his parents his plan to go camping at Sheshan on Saturday. Though his father grumbled, he did not object, and his mother asked with concern about the preparation details, telling him not to leave anything behind.
location: Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the dining room at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Organizing camping gear and testing it
description: After dinner, Lei Yu moved his backpack and equipment box to the living room floor and checked everything one by one against the checklist on his phone: tent, tent pegs, guy lines, sleeping bag, sleeping pad, stove burner, gas canister, cookware, pour-over coffee set, and so on — not a single item was missed. He deliberately used the gas canister and burner to boil a pot of water, and the blue flame was steady, confirming the stove was working properly. He found that a portable water bucket was missing, so he immediately ordered a collapsible water bucket on JD.com, choosing "Next-Day Delivery" to make sure it would arrive before Saturday's departure.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Workout log and core strength training
description: After sorting out the list, Lei Yu recorded today's daily ledger and tomorrow's pickup code for self-collection on the sofa in the living room. Then he changed into sportswear, went to the bedroom, laid out the yoga mat, and started core training: 3 sets of 20 sit-ups, 3 sets of 15 push-ups (his arms trembled in the last set), and 3 sets of planks, each held for 45 seconds. His mother Zhang Xiuying pushed the door open to bring him fruit, and seeing him sweating profusely, she smiled and told him not to train too hard. After training, he used the app to log this training session.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cold meal after training, relaxation, and response to Song Jia's invitation.
description: Lei Yu, drenched in sweat from training, sat on the yoga mat and ate the chilled cantaloupe his mother had cut. The sweet and cool taste dissipated the soreness in his muscles. He leisurely scrolled through his phone and saw a photo of roller skates posted by his friend Song Jia on WeChat Moments. Thinking she might have plans for the weekend, he proactively sent a WeChat message: "Jiajia, do you have plans on Saturday? I'm going camping at Sheshan on Saturday. How about joining me?" Song Jia instantly replied, "Sure! You pick the time! I'm free anytime," which made Lei Yu feel much more relaxed and felt he had something to look forward to next week.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shower, bedtime reading, socializing, and sleeping
description: Lei Yu took a comfortable hot shower to wash away the fatigue of the day, put on his pajamas, and lay down in bed. He picked up "Those Things in the Ming Dynasty" and read it with great interest for about 20 minutes. Then he put the book down, confirmed the meeting time and place for Saturday morning in the camping group, and everyone agreed. He also glanced at the chat history with Song Jia and felt full of anticipation for the coming weekend. After turning off the light, he quickly fell asleep, storing up energy for the next day.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake up, weigh in, and wash up
description: After getting up early in the morning, he weighed himself in the bathroom: 78.1 kg, 0.3 kg heavier than yesterday. He guessed it was caused by the mung bean soup he drank last night and decided to watch his diet. Then he washed up, looking at himself in the mirror while thinking about dietary adjustments. Outside the window, the plum rain was falling in a drizzle.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and WeChat correspondence
description: Mother Wang Xiuying prepared steaming small wontons and fried eggs for breakfast. While eating, he used his phone to send a WeChat message to his friend Xie Fei, discussing canceling the evening outdoor ball game because of the rain. At the same time, he scrolled through WeChat Moments and saw an old song shared by Song Jia, and he liked it.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Bike commuting to work.
description: As the rain let up, he put on the newly arrived waterproof jacket and rode a shared bike from home to the store in Super Brand Mall. On the way, he received a JD.com delivery reminder that the portable water bucket he bought last night had arrived at the community parcel locker, and he planned to pick it up after work.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, No. 168, Lujiazui West Road

name: Store opening preparations and delivery sign-off
description: Arrived at Xiafeiji Clothing, Unit A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall. Turned on the lights, checked cleanliness, wiped the cashier counter, and completed opening preparations. At exactly nine o'clock, the courier delivered the spring restock and several prototype samples sent by Zhou Tao. After signing for them, I called over the newly arrived clerk Lin Feng to start unpacking together.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, Century Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Unpacking new products and setting up a photo studio for shooting
description: Together with store clerk Lin Feng, he unpacked the new arrivals and carefully ironed out wrinkles with a garment steamer. Then in the fitting room area at the back of the store, he set up a simple photo zone using two LED fill lights, a gray backdrop, and a phone tripod, and test-shot several outfit combinations of outdoor quick-dry pants and waterproof jackets. The outdoor light was poor, but after fill lighting the effect was acceptable. During this time, he received two or three groups of customers and recommended a tech vest to one customer.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, Century Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handle online promotional materials.
description: Taking advantage of the clerk Lin Feng going out for lunch, he stayed alone at the cashier counter and used a photo editing app on his phone to color-grade the test photos just taken, then saved the processed images into the 'Camping Images & Text' material folder, preparing for future promotion.
location: Cashier counter, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, Century Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lunch and fragmented reading.
description: He went to the Food Republic food court on the basement level of the mall and bought curry beef brisket rice at a fast-food stall. While eating, he opened the e-book sample chapters of 'The Song of Everlasting Sorrow' on his phone, quickly skimmed the first chapter, and highlighted several vividly descriptive sentences, looking for inspiration and topics for next week's book discussion group.
location: Food Republic Food Court, Basement 1, Super Brand Mall, Century Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and online engagement
description: After lunch, he returned to the store. The rain grew heavier and mall foot traffic was sparse. Sitting behind the cash register, he opened the Xiaohongshu creator account "Xiafei Ji" and saw a new comment on his previous outfit post. A follower asked about the rain jacket's waterproof rating, so he immediately replied with the specific specs and recommended pairing it with shorts. After replying to the private message, he browsed the #ShanghaiBookstores topic for scene inspiration for future novel writing. In between, he intermittently took care of two customers who came into the store.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, Century Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: A short rest and some fresh air
description: The store was minded by clerk Lin Feng. Taking advantage of the rain easing a little, I walked to the covered walkway outside the mall to get some air and stretched my shoulders and neck, which had become stiff from sitting for a long time. The air was humid and hot in the plum rain season, but after standing for a while I felt much more refreshed.
location: Sheltered corridor on the exterior of Super Brand Mall, Century Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Discussing the details of the camping article and photos with my cousin
description: Back at the store, he sat on the sofa in the reception area and made a WeChat voice call to his cousin Shen Jie. The two referred to the shot list compiled yesterday and confirmed one by one the details of the camping gear photos and text to be published before Friday. Shen Jie suggested replacing the flat-lay image of the gear with a real shot of it hanging on a tree trunk. Lei Mingxuan thought it was feasible and noted it down. The call lasted about fifteen minutes and was very efficient; afterward, he sent her the photos of the quick-dry pants he had taken in the morning for reference.
location: Reception area behind Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, Century Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening rush hour business and in-store tidying
description: As the school and work day ended, the store welcomed several waves of customers. He helped a mother with her child put together a matching parent-child outfit, while the clerk Lin Feng helped another young customer pack a T-shirt. After the rush, the two tidied the fitting room and shelves together, restoring the store to neatness.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, Century Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling home and picking up packages
description: Closed the shop on time at six in the evening; the rain had mostly stopped. I rode a shared bike back to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue. I first took the newly arrived portable water bucket from the community parcel locker, thinking that it would be perfect for Saturday's camping.
location: Parcel locker and surrounding area at Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: Back home, his mother Wang Xiuying was setting out bowls and chopsticks. Dinner was braised hairtail cooked by his mother. At the table, Lei Mingxuan talked about his new attempt to set up a photo area in the store today, saying the feedback was good. His father Lei Jianguo asked about the weather for Saturday’s camping trip, and he answered that the forecast showed cloudy skies, so it should be fine.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Literary writing and close reading
description: After dinner, he went back to his room, opened the paper edition of The Song of Everlasting Sorrow, and read closely from the first chapter. He used a highlighter to mark Wang Anyi's vivid descriptions of Shanghai's longtang alleys, and wrote down narrative ideas about the “pigeon's-eye view” in his notebook. When he reached about page 50, he also flipped through Shanghai: A City's Chronicle, found an old photo of Xiafei Fang from the 1940s, and, using the photo as a reference, sketched the first scene of his novel in his notebook—a street in the afternoon with a tram passing by.
location: In the bedroom-study area of the home at Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Indoor stretching to relax
description: After sitting for a long time, I felt tightness in my lower back, so I unrolled the yoga mat and did fifteen minutes of indoor stretching. I focused on relaxing the iliopsoas and hamstrings. Although I didn't sweat like when running, my body felt relaxed and stretched afterward, and I got rid of the sticky feeling brought on by the rainy day.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening washing up and handling affairs
description: Took a comfortable hot shower and changed into pajamas. While blow-drying my hair, I sent a WeChat message to my friend Xie Fei to confirm that tonight's outdoor basketball game was canceled. Xie Fei replied "OK."
location: Bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading before bed and browsing the internet
description: Lying in bed, I read a few pages of 'Those Things in the Ming Dynasty' on my Kindle and felt a little sleepy. Before going to sleep, I scrolled through the #ShanghaiBookstores topic on Xiaohongshu again and saved an old bookshop located in a lane, planning to visit it on my day off. Around 22:45, I turned off the bedside lamp and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Got up early, weighed myself, and went for a morning run.
description: The alarm rang at 6:25 a.m. Lei Mingxuan got up and first went to the bathroom to weigh himself. The electronic scale showed 78.3 kg, 0.2 kg heavier than yesterday, which made him realize that not running yesterday had indeed affected his weight, so he decided to step up his morning running today. At 6:36, he changed into his quick-dry clothes and running shoes and headed out. After a 2.5 km warm-up jog along Zhangyang Road, he arrived at Gate 2 of Century Park at 7:00. He completed a 5 km run on the outer track of the park in 29 minutes 10 seconds, at a pace of 5:50 per kilometer, feeling good. After the run, he stretched for 10 minutes on the lakeside boardwalk and bought a bottle of mineral water from the park vending machine to hydrate, enjoying the morning birdsong and breeze, in high spirits. He got home around 7:15.
location: Century Park (No. 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai): start from Shanggang Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, and jog along Zhangyang Road to the park.

name: Returning home, washing up, and family breakfast
description: After arriving home at 7:15, he showered and changed into a comfortable work shirt and khaki pants. At 8 o'clock sharp, he had breakfast with his parents. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had cooked small pork wontons and fried eggs. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan talked about the Saturday camping trip to Sheshan, mentioned that his girlfriend Shen Jie would also go, and showed his parents the new portable water bucket. His father, Lei Jianguo, reminded him to check the stove for safety, while his mother kept reminding him to mind the weather. The atmosphere at home was warm.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting, buying supplies, and payday money management
description: At 8:35, he left on a shared bike, heading along Pudong Avenue and turning onto Century Avenue toward the store at Super Brand Mall. On the way, he stopped at Yanqin Grocery Store (No. 120, Pudong Avenue) to buy Gatorade and two bottles of mineral water for the afternoon shoot. He arrived downstairs at Super Brand Mall at 8:55, greeted the security guard, and swiped his card to go upstairs. At exactly 9:00, the first thing at the store was checking the bank text message; salary plus operating income of 12,000 yuan had arrived successfully. He then used mobile banking: transferred 3,000 yuan to the fund account for scheduled investment in index funds and bonds, and transferred 3,000 yuan to the 'Western Sichuan Self-Drive Dream' Alipay Pocket. Then he opened his journal to record the income and checked the Tiantian Fund app, finding last month's portfolio return was +2.1%, beating inflation, and felt reassured.
location: The Xiafeiji store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations and daily maintenance
description: Opened on time at 9:35 and, together with shop assistant Xiao Lin, hung the newly arrived techwear shorts on the most prominent mannequin for display. Then messaged supplier Zhou Tao on WeChat to confirm the fabric delivery time next Tuesday, and replied to property manager Zheng Kai to thank him for helping coordinate the generator yesterday. Started serving the morning customers, recommending waterproof jackets with cargo shorts to two or three people, one of whom readily bought a set. In the middle, I also checked the restocked items Xiao Lin had put out and made sure they were neatly arranged.
location: The Xiafeiji store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and returning to prepare filming equipment.
description: At 11:40, I left the store in Xiao Lin's care and walked to the FamilyMart on B1 of Jinmao Tower, buying a chicken sandwich, a cup of unsweetened latte, and a box of watermelon cubes for lunch. Sitting by the window, I ate while scrolling on my phone, checking the same-city camping blogger account I had favorited last night on Xiaohongshu to learn composition and copywriting. At 12:20, after finishing eating, I returned to the store, opened the already-packed hiking backpack to check: tent, egg-crate foam pad, pour-over kettle, coffee beans, and two sets of outdoor clothing, all complete. I fully charged my phone, changed into quick-dry clothes and cargo shorts in front of the mirror, took a few "departure photos," and prepared to go to Century Park for shooting.
location: FamilyMart on B1 of Jin Mao Tower, No. 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, and the stores on the second floor of Super Brand Mall.

name: Century Park camping gear photo shoot
description: At 13:00 he set off by shared bicycle and entered Century Park at 13:15. He found a grassy spot under a beautifully shaped camphor tree as the shooting location. Following the techniques Shen Jie had taught him before, he first laid out the equipment flat against the tent as a backdrop and took 9 detail shots, then changed into outdoor clothing to take self-portraits of the upper body. Finally, he used a phone gimbal to record a 40-second time-lapse video of quickly setting up the tent. During the shoot, a young couple with a child came over to ask about the equipment. Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to hand them his store business card, chatted about camping tips, and added them on WeChat to expand his customer base.
location: Lawn under the camphor tree in Shanghai Century Park (No. 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai)

name: Returned to the store and published a Xiaohongshu note.
description: At 14:35, packed up the gear and rode back to the store, arriving at 14:50. He immediately used CapCut on his phone to edit the photos and video, titled it "Weekend Escape from the City | My Lightweight Camping System", wrote the gear list and purchase information, tagged two favorite camping brands, and published the Xiaohongshu post at exactly 15:00. Then he refreshed every ten minutes; within an hour he received more than 30 likes, and two comments asked about the egg-crate pad brand, which he replied to immediately and recommended a link. Shen Jie sent a WeChat message suggesting adding the store location, and he edited it right away.
location: The Xiafeiji store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations, replying to comments, and receiving regular customers
description: From 15:30 to 16:30, handled two online orders and packed them to put in the back. At 16:30, the evening rush began; Lei Mingxuan stood at the store entrance and proactively greeted customers, welcoming the busiest period of the day. Regular customer Feng Xiaoyu, passing through Shanghai on a business trip from Suzhou, came to visit the store on the way. Based on her figure and style, Lei Mingxuan recommended a set of new autumn arrivals, and Feng Xiaoyu bought it without hesitation. In between, he found time to reply to five comments on Xiaohongshu and scrolled through the #ShanghaiBookstore topic to gather inspiration for future content.
location: The Xiafeiji store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sign up for the reading group and prepare talking points
description: At 5:40 p.m., taking advantage of the quiet store, he opened Douban Events and found the notice for the “Old Shanghai Dreams” historical novel reading group posted by Jing'an District Library. Seeing that the first gathering was on Tuesday evening, June 10, to read The Song of Everlasting Sorrow together, he immediately clicked to sign up. Then he went through recent reading notes in his phone memo and organized three key points: longtang alley space as the container of the story, the symbolic meaning of the pigeon's perspective, and the Pudong longtang memories he wanted to write. He also wrote down an opening line in his memo: “The pigeon perched on the bamboo clothes-drying pole had witnessed all the secrets of the people in Xiafei Fang.”
location: The Xiafeiji store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After work, mail a package and buy groceries to take home.
description: After getting off work at 18:00, I first went to the parcel pickup point on the basement level of the mall to ship the two online orders from the afternoon. At 18:20 I rode a shared bike home. Passing the Pushang Vegetable Market (No. 100, Pudong Avenue), I stopped to buy two tomatoes and a bunch of scallions to prepare ingredients for mother's evening cooking. I got home at 18:45 and carried the hiking backpack and the packages received that day into the room.
location: Room 301, Building 2, Shanggang Residential Quarter, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (passing Pushang Vegetable Market on the way)

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: At 7 PM, dinner was served on time. Mother Wang Xiuying had made Shanghai-style braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato-egg soup, all of which were Lei Mingxuan's favorite dishes. At the table, he shared the gains of the day: the camping notes he filmed in the afternoon had received good feedback, he had successfully registered for the book club, and Saturday's store event plans were basically in place. Father Lei Jianguo reminded him to be careful with fire during Saturday's camping trip, while his mother said that Aunt Zhu, their neighbor, had brought over fermented rice ball soup and told him to remember to go and thank her tomorrow.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Playing billiards to relax and socialize
description: Right after finishing his meal, Lei Mingxuan received a WeChat invitation from his friend Han Dong. He changed into a T-shirt and went out, walking about ten-plus minutes to the billiard hall at World Plaza. The two played three games of American eight-ball; Lei Mingxuan won two and Han Dong won one. While playing, they chatted about the Saturday camping plan and the reading group for 'The Song of Everlasting Sorrow'. Han Dong said he was interested in joining. In between, they bought two cans of iced Coke and drank happily, in a lively and enjoyable atmosphere.
location: World Square Billiard Hall, B1 Floor, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening washing up, reading, and sleep
description: Returned home at 9:15 p.m., took a hot shower, and changed into pajamas. At 9:30 p.m., I laid out a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did 5 minutes of simple stretching, focusing on relaxing the muscles used for running and filming. Then I leaned back against the bed and read “Those Things in the Ming Dynasty” on my Kindle for about 15 minutes. Before going to sleep, I wrote a note in my phone memo to contact Shen Jie tomorrow to discuss topics for pour-over coffee videos. At 10:00 p.m., I turned off the main light and scrolled through Bilibili to catch up on the anime I hadn't finished watching yesterday. At 10:15 p.m., I put down my phone, thought about how my diet had not exceeded the limits that day, felt at ease, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, No. 2, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Getting up, morning preparations, and family breakfast.
description: The phone alarm rang twice before he got up. Last night before bed, he browsed Xiaohongshu and saw that his note metrics were good, which made him so excited that he had trouble falling asleep. The weather was clear and fine. After washing up, he put on a black quick-dry T-shirt. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had already made wontons and pan-fried buns. While eating, he replied to a regular customer on WeChat to schedule an afternoon visit, chatted with his mother, mentioned that he would bring back hawthorn slices in the evening, and checked the shopping list.
location: Home bedroom, bathroom, and dining room, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycle commute to the store
description: Riding a Niu electric scooter from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, he headed west along Zhangyang Road. The morning breeze was pleasant, and he passed familiar steamed bun shops and convenience stores, arriving at the Super Brand Mall employee parking area after about 25 minutes.
location: From the Shanggang Community at Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, along Zhangyang Road to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store opening preparations and morning store work
description: After arriving at the store, he held a morning meeting with Xiao Lin and emphasized the key handover points. He unpacked and ironed the new mountain-style cargo pants and functional-style jackets, and planned the display. He forwarded the store landline to his mobile phone. After officially opening, he greeted customers and personally taught Xiao Lin how to introduce functional-style items. He wrote styling ideas and sales scripts and posted them at the cash register. Zheng Kai, the property manager, came by to remind him about next week's fire inspection. Around 11 a.m., he sent a message in the regular customer group telling them that the new styles for weekend outings had arrived.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and exchange with store staff.
description: Went with Xiao Lin to the Yue Zhuangyuan Hong Kong-style barbecue restaurant on the basement level of Super Brand Mall, ordered the signature roast goose rice, and added a daily soup for Xiao Lin. While eating, chatted about his girlfriend's work situation, and reminded him to quickly adjust the storefront window in the afternoon, switching to a black techwear style with a crossbody bag.
location: Yue Zhuangyuan Hong Kong-Style Roast Restaurant, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store work and closing handover
description: Re-arranged the window display with Xiao Lin, personally adjusted the mannequin poses, dressed them in the latest mountain-style items, and printed Xiaohongshu screenshot notes for reference. At 2 p.m., regular customer Feng Xiaoyu arrived. He received her personally while Xiao Lin observed, recommending cargo pants with a fitted T-shirt. Feng Xiaoyu was satisfied and had it packed. During a lull, he contacted Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao to confirm the shipping time for the next batch of summer clothes. At 4:30 p.m., he started wrapping up, had Xiao Lin take inventory, and asked her to leave on time at 6, while he finished. He counted the day's takings of over 10,000 yuan and locked them in the safe, and watered the happy tree in the store. He closed up half an hour early and prepared to leave.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove to the supermarket
description: He took off his work apron, changed into a jacket, and drove out of the Super Brand Mall underground garage, heading along Pudong Avenue to avoid the evening rush hour. He arrived at the Carrefour Pudong Avenue store parking lot in about 20 minutes.
location: From the underground parking garage of Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Carrefour Supermarket (Pudong Avenue Store), Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Supermarket shopping for camping supplies
description: Pushed the shopping cart with a clear target and stocked up: from the fresh food section, he bought 2 bottles of 1.5L mineral water, instant pasta, smoked bacon, sweet corn, tomatoes, and olive oil; from the daily necessities section, he picked up charcoal fire starter blocks; in the snack section, he found the hawthorn slices his mother loves and grabbed mixed nuts for himself. He checked the list and checked out quickly.
location: Carrefour Supermarket (Pudong Avenue Store), Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Driving home and unloading supplies
description: Put the purchased items in the trunk and drove home, the whole trip took about 40 minutes. After arriving home, put the ingredients and snacks in the kitchen first, and placed the hawthorn slices in a prominent spot on the living room coffee table.
location: Returned from Carrefour supermarket on Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, to my home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Family dinner time
description: Mother made Shanghainese braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato egg drop soup. Father asked about tomorrow's camping preparations; Lei Mingxuan said he knew the route well and it was a 40-minute navigation drive to Sheshan. Mother urged him to eat plenty of vegetables. The family was warm and happy, and it was the most relaxing moment of the day.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Check the vehicle and load the equipment
description: After the meal, he went downstairs to check the tire pressure and appearance of the Volkswagen Touran, opened the trunk, took out the camping gear (tent, sleeping bags, ground mats, folding table and chairs, stove set with cookware) and the newly bought ingredients and fire starters, and repacked them tightly. His father came down to help and, after confirming everything was secure, went back upstairs.
location: Ground parking spaces and home in Shanggang Residential Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Taking out the trash and interacting with neighbors
description: He took the kitchen garbage downstairs along the way and met Aunt Zhu, a neighbor out for a stroll, in the fitness area of the community garden. Aunt Zhu playfully said he looked thinner and asked about tomorrow's camping. Lei Mingxuan replied with pleasantries and promised to bring back an outdoor knowledge brochure for her grandson tomorrow. Aunt Zhu thanked him.
location: Main road and fitness area inside Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening Xiaohongshu operations and communication.
description: After washing up back in his room, he sank into a chair and opened Xiaohongshu. The gear post had over 120 likes, nearly 50 saves, and followers had grown to 35. Excited, he screenshotted it and sent it to his cousin Shen Jie, who immediately replied, praising the momentum and offering to help shoot a store visit video next week. Lei Mingxuan carefully replied to comments asking about gear brands and noted down potential customer needs.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Finally, he checked the navigation route to Sheshan for tomorrow, confirmed the 7 a.m. departure, and set an alarm. He filled a thermos with hot water and placed it in the trunk. Back in the bedroom, he set several additional alarms to avoid oversleeping. After washing up, he lay in bed, thought back on a highly productive day, and felt excited about the camping and operations. He soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Shanggang Residential Quarter, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning pour-over coffee ritual
description: At 6 a.m., Lei Mingxuan made pour-over coffee in the kitchen using a Hario V60 dripper, savoring the citrus and caramel aromas. He filmed a slow-motion video and posted it on WeChat Moments with the caption "New toy's first use, wilderness flavors warming up," and wrote down his tasting notes.
location: Kitchen, Room 602, Building 6, Shanggang Residential Quarter, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Before departure, prepare and say goodbye to parents.
description: Lei Mingxuan ate the small wontons and fried egg his mother had prepared. His mother stuffed tissues and band-aids into his backpack and gave him instructions. He hugged her and said he would be back on Wednesday to eat braised pork. His father was watering flowers on the balcony; as he said goodbye, his father waved back.
location: Room 602, Building 6, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handle matters within the residential community
description: Lei Mingxuan went downstairs to the M&G Stationery Store at the neighborhood entrance and bought the pocket edition of A Pocket Guide to Common Birds of Shanghai. At the central flower bed, he met his neighbor Auntie Zhu Xiuying and gave her the book. Auntie Zhu was very happy and thanked him.
location: Inside Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, from Chenguang Stationery Store to the central flower bed.

name: Drive to Sheshan National Forest Park
description: Lei Mingxuan drove from Shanggang Community, along Pudong Avenue, the Inner Ring Elevated Road, and Husong Highway, to East Sheshan Park of Sheshan National Forest Park in Songjiang District. He listened to Li Jian's songs along the way and enjoyed the morning breeze. At 8:30 he arrived at the South Gate parking lot of East Sheshan Park, bought a ticket, and entered the park.
location: Along the way from Shanggang Community, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to East Sheshan Park, No. 9511 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District

name: Hiking up the mountain and searching for a campsite
description: Lei Mingxuan entered from the south gate of East Sheshan Park, avoided the main road, and hiked along the dirt path through the bamboo forest with a 15 kg load, using trekking poles, observing and photographing wildflowers, light beams, and long-tailed shrikes. After about 2 hours and 15 minutes, he found a flat grassy area at an elevation of 90 meters as a campsite, backed by a pine forest and away from the trail.
location: Ridge trail and dense forest area at East Sheshan Park, 9511 Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Setting up camp and gathering creative material
description: Lei Mingxuan laid the ground sheet, set up the tent, and secured the stakes and wind ropes at the chosen campsite, finishing in about 30 minutes. He then laid out the moisture-proof mat, inflatable pad, and sleeping bag. Using a tripod and phone, he shot a time-lapse video of the tent setup and close-ups of the stakes as Xiaohongshu content.
location: Campsite inside East Sheshan Park, 9511 Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: Lei Mingxuan sat on a folding chair in front of the tent, eating an energy bar, nuts, and milk for lunch while enjoying the mountain scenery. Afterwards, he closed his eyes and rested for 15 minutes, listening to the wind and birdsong.
location: East Sheshan Park Campground, No. 9511, Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Outdoor pour-over coffee and free time
description: Lei Mingxuan boiled water with a mini stove at the campsite and brewed Ethiopian Guji coffee with a V60 dripper, enjoying the blend of fruity acidity and pine resin aroma. He sat in a folding chair reading three chapters of 'Song of Everlasting Sorrow,' occasionally looking up at the clouds drifting and unfurling.
location: Beside the pine forest, East Sheshan Park Campground, 9511 Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Exploring around the campsite and documenting the environment
description: Lei Mingxuan took his phone and trekking pole and explored downstream along the stream near the campsite, where he found and tasted wild raspberries. He piloted the drone to shoot an aerial view of the campsite, recording from above the image of the small tent in a green sea of trees.
location: Within about 500 meters of the campsite at East Sheshan Park, No. 9511 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cooking dinner
description: At the campsite, Lei Mingxuan fried bacon in a skillet, added corn kernels and cherry tomatoes and stir-fried them, while boiling pasta. He made bacon pasta for dinner. After the meal, he cleaned the cookware with wet wipes and sealed the trash.
location: East Sheshan Park Campground, No. 9511, Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Dinner and sunset moments
description: Lei Mingxuan carried his dinner to a slope with a good view, watching the sunset while he ate. The sky was dyed orange-red, and the city skyline gradually blurred. He shot a time-lapse of the sunset on his phone, enjoying the breeze.
location: A sloped open space near the East Sheshan Park campsite at 9511 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Night reading in the tent and recording inspiration
description: Inside the tent, Lei Mingxuan turned on the LED camping lantern and continued reading Song of Everlasting Sorrow on his Kindle until page 200. Suddenly inspired, he used his phone's notes app to write down ideas for the store's autumn new arrivals and a marketing concept called 'Urban Youth Escape Plan'.
location: Inside the tent at the Dongshe Mountain Park campsite, 9511 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and a safety check-in call
description: Lei Mingxuan called his mother, Wang Xiuying, to let her know he was safe, told her about the conditions in the mountains, and said the stars were very bright. Then he wiped his face with a wet wipe, changed into pajamas, and organized his phone and power bank.
location: Inside the tent at the Dongshe Mountain Park campsite, 9511 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Fell fast asleep
description: Lei Mingxuan fell asleep in a sleeping bag in the tent, accompanied by the sound of wind and insects, feeling calm and content.
location: Inside the tent at the Dongshe Mountain Park campsite, 9511 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Cleaning up the campsite and heading back down the mountain.
description: After waking up at the campsite near the South Gate of East Sheshan Garden in Sheshan National Forest Park early in the morning, I quickly took down the tent and sleeping bag following Leave No Trace principles, wiped the ground stains with wet wipes, and put all garbage into heavy-duty trash bags. I took a panoramic photo of the lawn restored to its original state and posted it to the hiking group to share the results of Leave No Trace camping. Then I put on my hiking backpack, slowly descended the mountain along the morning running route, bought mineral water and energy bars from the vending machines at the South Gate to replenish energy, arrived at No. 1 ground parking lot on Sichen Highway at 7:30, put the backpack in the trunk, and checked the car condition.
location: East Sheshan Park, No. 9511 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, and Sheshan National Forest Park Ground Parking Lot No. 1, Sichen Highway.

name: Return by car
description: Drove from the Sheshan parking lot back home to Shanggang Community, Pudong. Took the G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway and then the Yan'an Elevated Road; traffic was good. On the way, connected to the car Bluetooth and listened to a podcast. While waiting at a red light, I checked the store's WeChat group, saw the sales message from staff member Xiao Lin at 7:50, replied by voice message saying I'd arrive around 10 and arranged lunch.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home to rest
description: After arriving home, my mother Wang Xiuying had prepared plain congee and shengjian bao. I quickly took a hot shower and changed into clean clothes, then took the sleeping bag and tent out to air on the balcony. While eating breakfast, I shared my experience of seeing fireflies at Sheshan last night with my mother, and she kept marveling at it.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Heading to the store and running errands along the way
description: While walking out of the neighborhood, I met Aunt Zhu Xiuying, a neighbor walking her dog. I greeted her and promised to put together an outdoor knowledge booklet for her grandson later. Then I went to the M&G stationery store on Shenjialong Road to buy transparent tape and folders, and rode a shared bike along Lujiazui West Road to store A-208 on the second floor of Super Brand Mall.
location: From M&G Stationery Store, No. 770 Shenjialong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Store walkthrough and morning review
description: After arriving at the store, checked the shelf display and found that clerk Xiao Lin had matched sun-protection jackets and T-shirts by color scheme, and praised her improvement. Then checked the weekend turnover to ensure the three accounts (WeChat Pay, Alipay, and cash) were consistent. Meanwhile, saw regular customer Feng Xiaoyu sharing photos of a café in the group chat, and replied with greetings in the group.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and online socializing
description: Walked to Ippudo Ramen on B1 of IFC Mall, ordered the signature Akamaru Ramen and pan-fried dumplings. While waiting, scrolled Xiaohongshu, liked a fashion blogger's video, and replied to comments on last night's camping video, saying he would put together a gear list.
location: Ippudo Ramen, B1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Recording the full pour-over coffee vlog process
description: In the afternoon, set up the phone tripod at the store's hand-drip coffee corner and adjusted the lighting angle. First recorded the opening introduction, explaining the citrus, berry, and dark chocolate flavors of the Colombian Huila beans and grinding them slowly. Cousin Shen Jie gave real-time guidance on composition and lighting via video call. Then formally demonstrated the single-pour water-pouring method, explaining the purpose of the bloom during the blooming stage, but had two botched takes midway due to shaky hands and forgetting the lines. After filming, used the CapCut app for a rough cut, removed the botched and blank clips, and compressed the highlights to under 3 minutes. Shen Jie guided online in adding light music and subtitles. Then adjusted overexposed shots, finally exported the video, paired it with heartfelt copy and hashtags, and published it on both Xiaohongshu and Douyin. After publishing, frequently refreshed the backend to watch the view count grow.
location: The pour-over coffee corner at Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store wrap-up and closing
description: In the evening, as customers gradually dwindled, I tidied up the tried-on clothes with Xiao Lin, cleaned the floor, and counted the cash in the register. I told Xiao Lin that tomorrow, Monday, she could rest and I would watch the store alone. After Xiao Lin left, I locked the rolling shutter door, confirmed the power was off, and walked to the parking lot.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shopping after work and heading home
description: Drove to Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road, bought skin-on pork belly at the pork stall and asked the vendor to cut it into mahjong-sized cubes, then picked up tender cucumbers, scallions, and dried hawthorn slices. After shopping, drove 10 minutes back home in Shanggang Community.
location: From Pushang Vegetable Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Family dinner and discussion of camping plans at Dianshan Lake
description: After arriving home, his mother Wang Xiuying made soup. Lei Mingxuan used the pork belly he had bought to cook red-braised pork, and his father Lei Jianguo helped by preparing chopped scallions and minced garlic. During dinner, he showed the night-view photos and aerial video of Sheshan. His father reminded him that it gets cold in the mountains at night and suggested bringing a hiking jacket next time at Dianshan Lake, and also shared an experience from his youth when he was sent to the countryside in Songjiang and encountered a snake. After dinner, the family sat together in the living room and discussed the Dianshan Lake camping trip two weeks later. His father said he could go along to fish and start fires, and his mother brought out an old large aluminum food container from home, saying it was more practical than a small pot. They initially agreed on the weekend after next.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family evening leisure and online interaction
description: Back in the bedroom, I found that the coffee vlog I had just published had received over 60 likes and more than a dozen comments. I replied to each one with recommendations on where to buy the beans and what tools to use, and forwarded the video link to my cousin Shen Jie to thank her. Later, I went to the living room to make tea with my parents. My father talked about the stargazing knowledge he had from serving as a militia member back then, and my mother peeled a pear and reminded me to stay hydrated during the camping trip.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wrap-up work and bedtime preparation.
description: Put the hawthorn slices bought at the market into an airtight jar to take to mother the next day. Turn on the computer to organize Vlog behind-the-scenes photos, use Lightroom to color-grade and select three, edit a photo-text Moments post titled "Urban Youth Escape Plan: Extra Chapter" and send it. Then wash up, and turn off the lights to rest at around 23:00.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking Yoga and Morning Pour-Over
description: At 6:45 in the morning, Lei Ming woke up naturally in bed. Because his body was still a bit sore from returning from camping the day before, he did a few simple yoga stretches in bed, such as Cat-Cow and Downward-Facing Dog, to relax his spine and hips. Then he got up, went to the kitchen, took out the pour-over dripper and a pour-over kettle, and brewed himself a cup of coffee. As hot water was poured over the coffee grounds, the aroma quickly spread through the kitchen, making him feel awake and refreshed.
location: Bedroom and kitchen at home, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preliminary online data review and family breakfast.
description: While sipping his coffee, Lei Ming opened the backend of the social media platform on his phone to check the metrics of the pour-over coffee short video he had posted last night. The video had received quite a few likes and new followers; his total follower count had grown, and the number of views had surpassed 2,000. In a good mood, he replied to some comments and private messages. At that moment, his mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared breakfast — plain congee, fried eggs, and pickled cucumbers — and called him over to eat. Lei Ming ate another half bowl of congee and chatted briefly with his mother.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute by Car
description: After breakfast, seeing the clear weather outside, Lei Ming decided to set off for the store a little earlier. He grabbed his keys and commuter bag, got into the car parked in the residential compound, connected the car system to play a podcast about Japanese clothing culture, and drove to Super Brand Mall while listening, getting warmed up for the upcoming work.
location: Drove from Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the Super Brand Mall parking lot, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Store opening preparations and communication with the shop assistant.
description: After Lei Ming arrived at the underground parking lot of Super Brand Mall, he took the elevator upstairs and opened the rolling shutter door of the 'Shanye Ji' clothing store. The staff member Xiao Lin had also just arrived and was tidying the cash register. Together, they moved the new batch of summer T-shirts that had arrived last night out of the storage room, hung them on display racks by color and size, and adjusted the mountain-style techwear vest on the mannequin at the entrance. Lei Ming checked the lighting and mirror in the fitting room and confirmed everything was ready.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Spring sales and online feedback summary
description: With few customers in the morning, Lei Ming used the time to focus on data analysis. He opened the backend of the cash register system and exported the sales reports from March to May this year. Using spreadsheet software, he compared the sales volume, color preferences, and size distribution of each style and found that khaki and military green utility vests sold best, while XXL size inventory was excessive. Then, combining user comments he had screenshotted from social platforms, he linked high-frequency words such as 'waterproof,' 'multiple pockets,' and 'makes legs look longer' to the best-selling styles and flagged six potential styles that fit the trends. For the next day's video conference with the supplier, he created a table with data and user feedback, using different colored icons to highlight items for discussion.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rest and online interaction
description: After working continuously, Lei Ming felt a bit tired. He walked to the store entrance to stretch and observed the mall foot traffic. Then he took out his phone and asked friends in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat if they were free Wednesday evening to play billiards. While waiting for replies, he browsed social platforms and saw a post sharing a 'Shanghai cycling route with few people and beautiful views,' which he saved in passing.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch: treating myself to Japanese ramen
description: After processing the data, Lei Ming felt hungry and decided to treat himself at a Japanese ramen shop in the nearby IFC Mall. He walked through the Lujiazui skyway to the shop and ordered a signature spicy tonkotsu ramen. The rich broth, soft-boiled egg, and chashu were very satisfying.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant, LG1 floor, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Daily store reception and online operation planning.
description: After lunch, he returned to the store, and customer traffic gradually increased in the afternoon. Lei Ming and Xiao Lin warmly received customers together, gave styling suggestions, and paid attention to feedback on colors and fits. At about 3:30 p.m., regular customer Feng Xiaoyu came to the store and was attracted to the newly launched olive-green outdoor-style vest. While helping her match it and chatting, Lei Ming learned that her company would have an outdoor team-building activity next month. He noted it as a potential business opportunity. Around 4 p.m., customers became fewer. Lei Ming sat down at the cash register, took out a notebook, and started planning his next short video. The theme was set as: A Day in the Life of a Shanghai Clothing Store Owner. He planned scenes from opening the store, arranging displays, receiving customers, to making pour-over coffee, and made a shooting outline, planning to carry it out on Wednesday.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wrapping up today and preparing for tomorrow
description: Toward evening, the stream of customers dispersed. Lei Ming and Xiao Lin checked the day's revenue. After confirming everything was correct, he helped Xiao Lin print the order forms for several online-store orders, and reminded her to arrive a little earlier tomorrow afternoon because they needed to have a video call with Zhou Tao, the supplier from Hangzhou, to select styles. Afterward, Lei Ming packed his backpack, turned off some of the lights, locked the rolling shutter door, and ended the day's work at the shop.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove home.
description: Lei Ming picked up his car from the parking lot and drove home. It was just before evening rush hour, so traffic was fairly smooth. He arrived at Shanggang Community about 7 minutes later.
location: Drive from the Super Brand Mall parking lot at No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Recovery jog and a stroll.
description: After returning home, Lei Ming changed into his workout clothes and walked about 14 minutes to Lujiazui Central Green Park. He ran a 2 km recovery jog along the park trail, with a steady pace of about 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer. His legs still felt slightly sore from the previous day's hike. After the run, he walked slowly for a while and did leg stretches on a bench to relieve muscle tension.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home and prepare family dinner
description: After finishing stretching, Lei Ming walked slowly back to the community. When he got home, he took a shower and changed into loungewear. His mother was already busy in the kitchen, and the aroma of food filled the air. Lei Ming asked if she needed help, and she told him to set the table and call his father for dinner.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dinner time with family
description: Dinner was stir-fried seasonal vegetables, cold cucumber salad, and tomato egg drop soup. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan chatted with his father about the day's work, focusing on the video call with the supplier the next day to select styles, and took out his phone to show a photo of the potential styles table. His father, with the eye of a retired technical worker, commented that the multi-pocket design was practical, which made Lei Mingxuan feel more confident.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: After-dinner leisure and chores
description: After dinner, Lei Ming took the initiative to help his mother clear the table and wash the dishes together. Then the family sat on the living room sofa, watched the news for a while, and chatted about everyday things. Lei Ming saw in the group chat that his friend Zhang Wei had replied that he was free on Wednesday, and Li Na said she would come back from Hangzhou and then think about it. He planned to confirm the time in the evening.
location: Living room and kitchen at home, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online review and creative time
description: Lei Ming returned to the study and began his evening of writing and learning. He opened the social platform creator backend and recorded fan growth and video view data. Then he polished the copy and storyboard for the video A Day in the Life of a Clothing Store Owner. Next he opened the novel The Song of Everlasting Sorrow to look for passages describing plants such as oleander and plane trees in Shanghai's alleys, accumulating material for his own writing, and in his phone notes he wrote down an inspired line about plum rain in the alleys.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Free time.
description: After finishing his studies and creative work, Lei Ming decided to relax. He took out the manga volume he had not finished reading from the study drawer and read it while leaning back on the bean bag sofa. At the same time, he opened his phone to browse previews of new designer toy releases. He found the next series very appealing and set a reminder for its launch.
location: Study and living room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime washing routine and sleep
description: After reading the comic, Lei Ming took a hot bath to wash away the day's fatigue. Back in the bedroom, he briefly planned the next day's work: meet Old Liu, a local fabric supplier, in the morning, video-call Zhou Tao in the afternoon to select styles, and consider preparing a discount package for the team-building needs of regular customer Feng Xiaoyu's company. He jotted these down in his memo app, set the alarm, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning activities: getting up, morning exercise, and breakfast
description: After the alarm went off, I got up, saw that it was overcast, weighed myself at 79.0 kg, drank some water, changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and athletic shorts, and went out. I walked to the Lujiazui Central Green Park and power-walked two kilometers along the loop path at a pace of about 9 minutes per kilometer, thinking about today's style selection data, the video shooting order, and Song Jia's roller-skating invitation. When I saw sparrows, I thought of the alleyway descriptions in 'The Song of Everlasting Sorrow' and decided to share it at the book club. When I got home, I showered and changed clothes. My mother had prepared boiled eggs, millet porridge, and cold dressed celtuce strips. I ate the eggs and porridge but didn't touch the pan-fried dumplings. My mother grumbled that I ate too little, so I helped her clear the table.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: Took his keys, phone, and power bank and left. Bought unsweetened oolong tea at Yanqin Grocery Store. Walked to Lujiazui Metro Station, took Line 2 to Lujiazui Station, and scrolled through Xiaohongshu on the subway, replying to comments. After arriving at the Super Brand Mall store, he turned on the lights, played a Lo-fi playlist, checked sales records and inventory on his tablet, and organized the weekend sales data. When store clerk Xiao Lin arrived, he arranged to make softshell pants the main promoted item and adjusted the display; he himself wiped down the sample mannequins and sorted returned clothes. Property manager Zheng Kai told him about the booth application for the mall's summer promotion event. Then he went to the back room, opened Feishu Docs on his iPad, compiled March-May sales data and high-frequency words from buyer reviews (waterproof, multiple pockets, makes legs look longer), brewed Lipton green tea, and replied to Song Jia's roller skating invitation from last night, politely declining the Saturday plan and offering to buy coffee next time as an apology.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Video style selection and brand maintenance
description: Held an autumn collection selection video call via WeChat with Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao, shared a spreadsheet highlighting the waterproof index and multi-pocket design, discussed fabric weight and cost draft by draft, and finally settled on 12 styles (3 windbreaker styles, including one with a highly breathable membrane fabric, 4 soft-shell pants, 3 quick-dry shirts, and 2 vests), negotiating the overall price down by 8 percentage points. Confirmed the first batch of 480 pieces with a delivery date of July 10. Zhou Tao agreed to send samples of the first 3 styles in July. After hanging up, compiled the selection list and payment information and sent a PDF for confirmation. Then, at the cash register, saw Song Jia’s reply of “Oh,” felt something was off, and sent a voice message inviting her to have Chaoshan beef hotpot on Saturday evening to make up for it, while scrolling through Xiaohongshu and replying to two comments.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and a visit to select shops.
description: After the handover with Xiao Lin, I walked to the Hakata Ikkousha ramen shop on B1 of the IFS Mall, ordered tonkotsu ramen (less oil and salt), and looked at the sample garment detail photos Zhou Tao sent while eating. After the meal, I browsed the accessories area on B1 and found the newly opened concept store 'LITTLE B'. The metal-buckle belts and high-top canvas shoes in the store could go with our own mountain-style techwear, so I took photos and saved a product selection recommendation plan.
location: B1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Order sorting and behind-the-scenes video recording of product selection.
description: Back at the store, I organized the purchase orders on the computer (style number, color, size allocation ratio) and sent them to Zhou Tao via WeChat; I received confirmation 15 minutes later. At 13:15, I set up my phone and started recording footage for a video titled “A Day in the Life of a Clothing Store Owner: Behind the Scenes of Selecting Styles”. First I filmed myself analyzing the data, then I unzipped a soft-shell pants sample and explained the pocket design (including a small zippered pocket for a transit card). I invited a regular customer, Feng Xiaoyu, to try on the new soft-shell pants and appear in the video. She praised the fabric for being crisp and not showing her belly, and we shot about 15 minutes of footage in total.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Video editing and publishing
description: Use CapCut for quick editing, pick out a 4-minute highlight, add a voiceover explaining the selection logic, add 'Neon Sweetheart' as low-volume BGM, and attach a guide sticker. After exporting, post it to Xiaohongshu and Douyin, with the title including the hashtags #DayInTheLifeOfAClothingStoreOwner #FallSelection #MountainStyleTechWear, and schedule it for 15:00.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon rest and video script brainstorming
description: Told Xiao Lin to keep an eye on video feedback, walked to the FamilyMart at Jin Mao Tower to buy unsweetened oolong tea. While resting outside the store, he browsed short plant-description phrases from 'Song of Everlasting Sorrow' in his phone memos and conceived the first 20 seconds of tomorrow morning's video. After returning to the store, he took out his phone and wrote tomorrow's shooting outline in his memo (morning yoga, pour-over coffee, subway commute, opening the store, tidying up, receiving customers, lunch, restocking, packing, leaving work and going home), adding the detail 'film a chance encounter with a customer at a bookstore and recommend an outfit.' He also sent the accessory photos from IFC Mall to Zhou Tao, suggesting pairing them with a belt and canvas shoes.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work wrap-up and politely declining Song Jia again.
description: Replied to Song Jia on WeChat; she agreed to meet again Saturday evening but her tone was flat. I won't keep pursuing it. Sent her a photo of soft-shell pants and invited her to the store for a fitting. Received a middle-aged customer asking about hardshell jackets and recommended the pre-order option for the high-breathability membrane fabric model. Afterwards, handed over the evening shift to store clerk Xiao Lin, updated the inventory list, printed the purchase order for filing, checked video feedback (17 likes, 4 favorites), and replied to two comments asking about the store. Turned off the computer and music, grabbed my bag, and left the store.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling commute home
description: At the mall entrance, I scanned the code to unlock a Meituan bike and rode home along Pudong Avenue. On the way, I stopped at Yanqin Grocery Store to buy Haitian Gold Label Oyster Sauce (7.9 yuan), paid via mobile, then rode on and locked the bike at the community.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Before and after the family dinner
description: After changing into home clothes, I helped my mother wash greens and break apart broccoli. My mother asked how much rice I wanted for dinner, and I said less rice since I'd be active later in the evening. My father came in from the balcony and asked about the camping plan. I said we'd go to Dianshan Lake at the end of June and buy snake repellent then. He grunted and drank beer. I put the dirty camping clothes into the washing machine for a quick wash. The whole family sat down for dinner: sweet and sour pork ribs, stir-fried broccoli, egg drop soup, and pickled mustard. I only had one bowl of rice and three ribs. During the meal we chatted about selecting styles. My father asked if the Hangzhou supplier was reliable, and I said Brother Tao is an old partner and gave us a discount. My mother asked what time I'd be back from the book club, and I replied around 9:30, no need to wait up. After dinner I washed the dishes and hung the washed clothes on the balcony.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing to depart and cycling to the library
description: Changed into a light gray cotton-linen shirt, black casual pants, and canvas shoes; put The Song of Everlasting Sorrow and other belongings into a canvas bag; said goodbye to his parents, and went out. At the community gate, he scanned a shared bike and rode about 4.5 kilometers following the navigation (via Pudong Avenue, Fuxing East Road Tunnel, North Xizang Road, and Xinzha Road), arriving at Jing'an District Library at 19:25, where he locked the bike and entered.
location: Jing'an District Library, Xinzha Road Branch, 1708 Xinzha Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: First gathering of the Old Dreams on the Sea reading group.
description: He attended a reading group in the seminar room on the second floor of the library. There were seven or eight members, aged 30 to 65. The facilitator, Teacher Hu, poured water for everyone. During self-introductions, he said he was in the clothing business and had read The Song of Everlasting Sorrow in order to understand the essence of the Shanghai dialect. After reading together the first chapter, "Wang Qiyao's Longtang," Teacher Hu asked everyone to share memorable passages. He raised his hand and, combining his childhood memories of the Pudong longtang, recited the short line: "That pigeon perched on the bamboo clothes-drying pole had feathers filled with the dust of the longtang," which won approval from the older members. The discussion then extended to Wang Qiyao's personality and Shanghai's regional culture, and the atmosphere was lively. It was originally supposed to end at 21:00, but they kept talking until 21:30. He added WeChat contacts with the organizer, Mr. Lin, and joined the "Old Dreams of Shanghai 2025" group (12 people).
location: Seminar room, 2nd floor, Jing'an District Library, 1708 Xinzha Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Cycling home and interactions at home
description: He cycled home from the library in a cheerful mood. After getting home, he put the oyster sauce on the kitchen counter. His mother was still watching TV and asked if it was fun. He said it was really interesting and everyone was cultured. His mother handed him a tangerine, and he ate two segments. Then he went back to the bedroom and changed into a sports tank top and shorts.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening workout and shower
description: I laid out a yoga mat in the bedroom and did core training: sit-ups, 3 sets of 20; push-ups, 3 sets of 17 (one more than last week); and plank, 3 sets of 50 seconds. After sweating heavily, I wiped the floor and stretched my thighs and calves. Then I showered, washed my hair, blow-dried it, weighed 78.7 kg, and changed into pajamas.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Review and relaxation before bed
description: At my desk, I reviewed the whole day: completed core training, selected 12 styles, the video received 28 likes, attended the reading group and joined it. In my memo, I recorded tomorrow's plan (shoot video footage for 'A Day in the Life of a Clothing Store Owner', decide on restocking based on results, and prepare content for Saturday's writing class). I browsed the alleyway passage of 'The Song of Everlasting Sorrow' and set it aside for the next sharing. I returned to the reading group, replied to Mr. Lin's announcement card, and checked in with '1'. Lying in bed, I scrolled Xiaohongshu. The video gained another 11 likes, total 28. I replied to the customer with a purchase link and guided them to send a private message to reserve. I scrolled Bilibili for 5 minutes of new anime. Feeling sleepy, I turned off the light and fell asleep at 23:50.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Early morning yoga and breakfast.
