description: Morning run canceled due to rain; did 15 minutes of spinal wake-up and cat-cow yoga in the living room. After washing up, had breakfast with mother Wang Xiuying, enjoying millet porridge, boiled eggs, and pan-fried dumplings. Only ate two dumplings due to weight management.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commuting and online socializing.
description: Drove from home to the store at Super Brand Mall, and on the way replied by voice to a Xiaohongshu follower's private message about softshell pants sizing. At the same time, I reflected that my indifferent response to Song Jia's roller-skating invitation last week was inappropriate and decided to deal with it later.
location: Drive from Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Store inventory count and display adjustments
description: At store A-208 on the second floor of Super Brand Mall, I conducted an inventory count with store clerk Xiao Lin. We found that M-size quick-dry tops were short in stock and XL-size hardshell jackets were overstocked. I immediately flagged restocking in the ERP system and made a summer clearance promotion plan, moving the overstocked jackets to the entrance mannequin display with a '40% off' clearance blackboard. I also organized video data on camping and product selection.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch time
description: Walked through the covered corridor to Ippudo Ramen on B1 of IFS Mall and ordered tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While eating, I browsed the buyers' window displays in neighboring stores for styling inspiration and to prepare for next week's selections.
location: Ippudo Ramen, B1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Shooting a promotional video
description: Returned to the store and asked Xiao Lin to help shoot a teaser video for the summer end-of-season clearance sale. He gave an impromptu speech in front of the styled display window, with only two NG takes. Then he edited it in CapCut, adding subtitles and BGM, scheduled it to go live at 3 PM on Xiaohongshu and Douyin, and gave a preview in the WeChat VIP group.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commuting home
description: After tidying up the shop, I drove home, playing jazz on loop to relax.
location: Drove back to Shanggang Community from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Reading and writing ideation
description: On the sofa in the study at home, I reread the passage on spatial transitions in the longtang in the first chapter of "The Song of Everlasting Sorrow," and jotted down creative inspirations on the whiteboard. I searched for a Republican-era map of Pudong, Shanghai, focused on Qichangzhan Ferry, and integrated geographical details into the concept, continuing for nearly two hours.
location: Home study, Shanggang Residential Quarter, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Communicating with Song Jia
description: Took the initiative to send a WeChat message to Song Jia to apologize for yesterday's attitude and explained that he had classes on Saturday and could not make the appointment. He recommended the new soft-shell pants and invited her to come to the store to try them on when she was free, offering to treat her to HEYTEA as an apology, replacing the fixed date with a flexible invitation in a sincere tone.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China (WeChat communication)

name: Stroll through the Qichangzhan Historic District.
description: Drove to near Qichangzhan Ferry and strolled through the old street in the rain. Walked along the abandoned railway tracks, photographed the mottled brick walls and rusty gates, and personally experienced the historical atmosphere of the lanes and the dock, searching for traces of the era from grandfather's stories.
location: Near Qichangzhan Ferry, No. 1 Dongfang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Helped his mother prepare ingredients and chatted
description: Returned to the kitchen at home and helped his mother, Wang Xiuying, chop scallions and crush garlic. During their chat, he mentioned what he had seen on his afternoon stroll at Qichangzhan, and his mother recalled that Grandpa used to carry sacks at the dock before learning the trade of repairing radios.
location: Home kitchen, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family dinner
description: Had dinner with parents, enjoying braised pork and seasonal vegetables. After learning about the afternoon visit to Qichangzhan, father Lei Jianguo excitedly recounted the story of his grandfather saving up in 1947 to buy an American radio that caused a stir in the alleyway; mother added details about it being hidden in the ceiling. Lei Mingxuan recorded the whole time.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Deep conversation about family history
description: Moved to the living room to continue the deeper conversation. His father took out an iron box and showed the old household register, grain coupons, and an old photo of his grandfather wearing work pants at the entrance of the alley. Lei Mingxuan took photos to record the details and felt the image of his grandfather as a young man becoming clearer. The family talked until nearly nine, and his mother urged them to rest.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Core activation training
description: Laid out a yoga mat in the study, opened Keep, and completed a 15-minute core activation and stretching course, including cat-cow pose, plank, sit-ups, etc., to make up for the morning workout missed because of rain. My body was slightly sweaty.
location: Home study, Shanggang Residential Quarter, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening writing
description: After washing up, he was refreshed and opened a Word document to write a first draft of a short story based on his grandfather. He typed out the scene from the summer of 1947, in which a teenager repairs a radio in the courtyard and hears the sound of bicycle bells in the alley during a thunderstorm. After repeatedly revising a 300-word sample, the story began to take shape.
location: Home study, Shanggang Residential Quarter, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening wash-up and review
description: After washing up in the bathroom and blow-drying his hair, he stepped on the scale, which showed 79.4 kg, 1.4 kg short of his goal. In Notes, he recorded the day's exercise, diet, and family material gains, and listed keywords for the next day's shooting. After setting the alarm for 7:15, he turned off the lights and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast.
description: At 7:15 in the morning, the alarm went off twice before he got up. After weighing in at 79.1 kg, he felt some pressure. He washed up quickly and brewed a high-concentration pour-over coffee with Colombian beans to refresh himself. Then he enjoyed a breakfast of white congee, fried eggs, and pickled vegetables made by his mother, together with his parents. During the meal, he chatted with his father about the new vegetable shop at the entrance of the community, while thinking about today's work arrangements at the store.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the store
description: He rode a shared bike west along Pudong Avenue toward Super Brand Mall. The morning breeze felt pleasant, and along the way he saw office workers hurrying to work. About 10 minutes later, he arrived at the Super Brand Mall underground parking garage, locked the bike, and took the escalator upstairs.
location: Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Store opening preparation and morning store operations
description: After arriving at the store, he opened the rolling shutter door, turned on the lights, and started the cash register system, then finished the pour-over coffee from the morning. He checked his email, processed the autumn order confirmation sent by supplier Zhou Tao from Hangzhou, printed it out, and filed it. Then he guided shop assistant Xiao Lin to place the newly arrived quick-dry socks on the golden shelf near the entrance, changed the price tags to the summer sale tags, and prominently marked the overstocked XL-size waterproof jackets. Throughout the morning, customers kept coming in, and he patiently recommended suitable outdoor outfits for them.
location: The Walker Style store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Midday break and industry research
description: For lunch, he ordered takeout from the Japanese ramen shop in Super Brand Mall. While eating, he browsed the new arrivals of popular Tokyo mountain-style brands on his tablet, studied their pattern details, sent screenshots to supplier Zhou Tao, and left a message suggesting that the autumn/winter styles could draw on them. At the same time, he rested a bit to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: Rest corner at the back of the 'Traveler's Style' store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and Xiaohongshu engagement strategy
description: In the afternoon, there were not many customers in the store. First, I handled orders on several online platforms using my phone and replied to customers' inquiries about sizes and delivery times. Then I carried my laptop to the corner sofa area and started seriously replying to comments under yesterday's Vlog. At exactly 3 PM, I made a WeChat video call to my cousin Shen Jie. As a fashion buyer, she said the account lacked interactivity and suggested running a giveaway. We immediately finalized the activity format: follow and comment "your most wanted mountain-style item," and 3 winners would be randomly drawn to receive a 50-yuan no-minimum coupon from the store. After hanging up, I quickly used a mobile app to create and publish the event poster. In the following half hour, I kept refreshing the backend and saw 17 new follows—the effect was obvious.
location: The Walker Style store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Evening shift handover and store closing
description: Thoroughly brief store clerk Xiao Lin on the Xiaohongshu event schedule and precautions, telling him to watch the afternoon customer flow and community messages. Confirm today's sales, tidy up the cash register counter, and check the display in the special-sale area. Complete the handover with Xiao Lin at exactly 17:00 and get ready to leave work.
location: The Walker Style store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Commute home
description: I put on my backpack, took a shared bike and rode back along the same route to Shanggang Residential Area. The traffic on Pudong Avenue was gradually increasing in the evening; as I cycled through it, I felt the day's work stress melt away with the wind.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Family dinner and exercise preparation
description: As soon as I entered the house, I smelled the aroma of braised shrimp; my mother had already cooked. I first watered the pothos on the balcony and chatted with my father, who was watching the news, about interesting things that happened at the store today. During dinner, we talked about Xiaohongshu's follower growth strategy. My father found it quite fresh, and my mother told me not to work too hard and to take care of my health. After dinner, I changed into quick-dry workout clothes and running shoes in the bedroom, drank a few sips of warm water, did a few simple stretches in the living room, and got ready to go out for exercise.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening workout: jogging and core training
description: Starting from the community gate, jogged west along Zhangyang Road, keeping a pace of about 6 minutes 30 seconds, turned back at the intersection of Yuenshen Road and Zhangyang Road, about 2 km in total. The evening breeze blew away the fatigue and my breathing gradually steadied. Back in the community garden, started core strength training: 3 sets of 18 push-ups, 3 sets of 20 sit-ups, 3 sets of 55-second planks. Although my form was a bit off, I gritted my teeth and finished.
location: Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (from Shanggang Residential Complex to Yuanshen Road) and the open garden area of Shanggang Residential Complex

name: Post-workout rest and financial video discussion
description: Returned home, took a shower, changed into loungewear, went to the study to pour a glass of water, turned on the laptop, and adjusted the webcam. I also opened the fund app to check the day's returns and got a clear picture. At 7:30 pm sharp, I made a WeChat video call to financial advisor Xu Feng, reported my current monthly auto-investment of 3,000 yuan, and expressed my concerns about market volatility. Xu Feng suggested adjusting the portfolio to a 60% stocks / 40% bonds ratio, and adding 1,000 yuan per month into a conservative bond fund to smooth volatility. After checking my cash flow, I thought the plan was feasible, adopted it on the spot, and asked him to send the bond fund code later.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening Leisure and Family Time
description: After the video ended, he went to the living room and watched some local news with his parents. Then he returned to the study and browsed the Xiaohongshu campaign posted that afternoon, finding that he had gained more than 20 new followers. In the comments, someone asked whether members could stack discounts, so he noted down the suggestion and planned to optimize the campaign rules tomorrow. He then organized today's work notes and read a few pages of The Song of Everlasting Sorrow, which he was reading, for inspiration for his lane novel.
location: Living room and study at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: Put down the book, washed up properly, and applied the hand cream his mother had given him. Lying in bed, he set the alarm for 6:45 the next morning and resolved not to stay up late again. After turning off the light and reviewing the fulfilling day, he felt at ease and quickly fell asleep with a simple plan for the next day's work.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake-up and financial adjustments
description: When the morning alarm went off, Lei Mingxuan woke up, checked the weather, and remembered he needed to adjust his fund automatic investment plan. Leaning against the headboard, he opened the mobile banking app, confirmed the 60% stock / 40% bond portfolio that took effect yesterday, and verified that the debit modification for the 15th had been submitted. He then transferred 1,000 yuan from his demand savings to the money market fund account to prepare for the new bond fund. In his ledger, he wrote: “June automatic investment adjustment complete, monthly investment 4,000 yuan, bond fund capital in place.”
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and walking to the store
description: After washing up, Lei Mingxuan went downstairs for breakfast. His mother Wang Xiuying had prepared millet porridge, boiled eggs, and steamed barbecue pork buns. While eating, they chatted, and Lei Mingxuan told her today's plan: go to the history museum at noon for writing inspiration, and play billiards with Han Dong in the evening. After breakfast, he changed into a white shirt and khaki shorts, put on his backpack, and walked from the neighborhood along Pudong Avenue for about 27 minutes to Super Brand Mall.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store work and departure preparation
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan turned on the cash register system and computer, sorted online orders with store clerk Xiao Lin, and planned the weekend special sale checklist. He replied to Xiaohongshu private messages, checked back-end inventory, and contacted Hangzhou supplier Tao Ge to urge delivery of the new sample clothes. Before leaving, he briefed Xiao Lin on the afternoon tasks, checked the battery levels of the camera and voice recorder, and sent his location in the “Pudong Three Musketeers” WeChat group, teasing Zhang Wei.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went to the Shanghai History Museum and immersed himself in the visit
description: Lei Mingxuan walked from Super Brand Mall to Lujiazui Metro Station, took Line 2 to East Nanjing Road Station, and after exiting the station walked along West Nanjing Road to the Shanghai History Museum. He went straight to the Old Shanghai Life exhibition hall on the fourth floor, carefully photographed the carved stone gateways, bluestone slab roads, and public telephone signs in the restored alleyway area, and recorded voice memos. In front of the Republic-era student uniform display case, he conceived outfits for his novel characters, spending more than two hours immersed in the scene gathering inspiration.
location: Shanghai History Museum, No. 325 West Nanjing Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and a stroll in the downtown area to collect material
description: After the visit, Lei Mingxuan ate curry pork cutlet rice at a Japanese-style casual restaurant on Huaihai Road. While waiting for the meal, he looked through photos and wrote down keywords for scenes in his novel. After eating, he returned to the museum's cultural and creative shop to buy postcards of old photographs from the collection, then strolled toward People's Square and on to Fuzhou Road, using his phone to shoot street views and record ambient sound as background white noise for his writing.
location: Huaihai Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: Return home.
description: Lei Mingxuan took Metro Line 2 from People's Square Station back to Lujiazui, then walked back to Shanggang Residential Area. Downstairs, he met his neighbor Aunt Zhu returning from grocery shopping, and they greeted each other.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Resting at home and brainstorming writing
description: Back home, Lei Mingxuan put down his backpack, drank some water, and rested for a moment before changing into a more casual black T-shirt and sweatpants. In his study, he opened his laptop and imported today's photos and recordings into a newly created source-material folder. He took out the novel The Song of Everlasting Sorrow, flipped through the longtang passages, and, drawing on what he had seen that day, wrote down several possible novel openings on paper to prepare for writing in the evening.
location: Study at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: Mother prepared steamed sea bass, garlic stir-fried water spinach, and tomato and egg soup. Father Lei Jianguo got off work early, and the family of three had dinner together. Lei Mingxuan shared photos and recordings of the longtang he took at the museum. His father recalled fond childhood memories of playing marbles in the longtang, and his mother added to the stories with a smile. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening Rest and Departure for an Appointment
description: After helping his mother clear the dishes, Lei Mingxuan returned to his room, browsed Xiaohongshu, and replied to fans' comments. He then sent a WeChat message to Han Dong to arrange meeting at the billiards hall at 8 p.m. Bringing his water bottle and power bank, he said goodbye to his family and set off from Shanggang Community, walking about 15 minutes along Pudong Avenue to the World Plaza Billiards Hall on South Pudong Road.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Billiards Night Chat and Agreement
description: Lei Mingxuan met Han Dong at the billiards hall in World Plaza. The two warmed up for half an hour playing American eight-ball, and Han Dong won two consecutive games. During a break, Han Dong teased that Lei Mingxuan's Moments feed was too much like a 'retired old man.' Lei Mingxuan admitted his interests had shifted but promised to meet here every Friday night, and that their friendship would not change. Han Dong readily agreed. They played five more games, each winning some, and posted a group photo in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat to mark the occasion.
location: World Square Billiard Hall, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Late-night snack and walking home
description: After billiards, Han Dong suggested getting barbecue. The two went to a barbecue restaurant they often visited on Yuanshen Road. Although Lei Mingxuan was watching his weight, he made an exception and ate a small amount of beef skewers, grilled mushrooms, and grilled eggplant, accompanied by unsweetened oolong tea. The two chatted about the funny story of Han Dong setting up a tent while camping and laughed a lot. After the meal, they said goodbye at the intersection, and Lei Mingxuan walked back to Shanggang Community along South Pudong Road.
location: BBQ Restaurant, Yushan Road and Yuanshen Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Diary and bedtime preparation
description: Lei Mingxuan washed up quietly and returned to the bedroom. Sitting at his desk, he opened his diary and recorded the insights from today's visit to the museum and his conversation with Han Dong about how interests change, reflecting on the balancing act of adulthood. After writing, he tidied the desk, turned off the light, put on his sleep mask, and went to sleep contentedly.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning pour-over coffee (Nicaragua Pacamara)
description: Saturday morning at 6:30, Lei Mingxuan was woken by his alarm clock and felt great. He was thinking about the new beans he had bought, so he deliberately switched to a new ceramic pour-over cone. He took out the Nicaraguan Pacamara coffee beans with a very fresh roast date, set the grinder one notch coarser, and heated the water to 92°C. He deliberately slowed down the pouring speed and watched the coffee bed in the cone slowly bloom, filling the air with aroma. The finished cup was rich and full-bodied, with a clear finish of dark chocolate and cocoa. Satisfied, he wrote “Perfect for a night by the campfire” in his phone memo. As he was rinsing the brewing equipment, his mother Wang Xiuying had already set out scallion oil noodles and seaweed egg drop soup on the kitchen table.
location: Home kitchen at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Enjoy breakfast and prepare to go out
description: Lei Mingxuan sat down and wolfed down the scallion-oil noodles his mother had made. The noodles were chewy, and the scallion oil was fragrant. His father, Lei Jianguo, also got up and said he was going to the market to buy a sea bass. Lei Mingxuan casually replied that he would come back for dinner. After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan changed into a khaki quick-dry shirt and dark gray cargo shorts, packed his backpack, and put in his writing notebook, pen, printed writing outline, and a camera.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Attend a historical fiction writing workshop.
description: After checking his backpack, Lei Mingxuan went downstairs, picked up a shared bike at the entrance to the residential complex, and rode west along Pudong Avenue. About 10 minutes later he arrived at the Pudong New Area Cultural and Creative Training Center near Century Avenue. At 9 a.m., the first class of the historical fiction writing workshop began in Room 302. Eight students sat in a circle. The instructor was a female writer, Teacher Li, who had published several novels set in the Republican era. She guided everyone to start with their most familiar historical space. Lei Mingxuan wrote down the Qichangzhan lane in Pudong on his draft paper and briefly told the story of the place that his grandfather had described to him when he was young. The instructor affirmed his choice and taught the group how to build geographic memory anchors. In the 15-minute quick scene sketch exercise, his ideas flowed freely, and he wrote a 500-character scene about a boy waiting for the mailman at the entrance to the lane. He titled the story Waiting.
location: Room 302, Pudong New Area Cultural and Creative Training Center, No. 200 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After class, a chance encounter at a specialty coffee shop
description: After class, Lei Mingxuan felt mentally fulfilled but hungry. He walked to the independent café Chuncui next to the training center and ordered a chicken sandwich and an Ethiopian pour-over coffee. The barista behind the counter was a seemingly talkative young man. Seeing the V60 dripper sticking out of the side pocket of Lei Mingxuan's backpack, he struck up a conversation. His name was Zhou Yang (Xiao Zhou). The two chatted about grind size and pouring technique, and Xiao Zhou also shared his experience volunteering at a coffee estate in Yunnan and demonstrated his original one-pour technique. They hit it off immediately and exchanged WeChat contacts. Xiao Zhou invited Lei Mingxuan to the Wednesday-evening cupping session. Lei Mingxuan gladly agreed and bought a bag of the café's house blend beans as a show of support.
location: 'Chuncui' Independent Café, 1st Floor, Podium Building, Cultural and Creative Training Center, No. 200 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning to the store to restock, and winning a mall grand prize.
description: After saying goodbye to Xiao Zhou, Lei Mingxuan cycled along Lujiazui West Road, passing by the Pudong riverside, and returned to his clothing store at A-208, Super Brand Mall. The store clerk, Xiao Lin, had already finished the afternoon preparations. Two boxes of new T-shirts arrived that day. He quickly checked and accepted them, scanned the codes into inventory, and put them on the shelves. At the checkout, Xiao Lin said that a purchase of 599 yuan or more qualified for the mall's anniversary raffle. He casually filled out a raffle ticket and dropped it into the box. At 2:15 p.m., the mall's broadcast announced the winning numbers. He didn't pay attention at first, but when the first-prize number was repeated, he looked down and found that his ticket matched exactly. Barely believing it, he ran to the prize stage in the first-floor atrium. After the staff confirmed, he took home a brand-new Dyson V10 vacuum cleaner. He took a photo and posted it on WeChat Moments: 'Unbelievable luck today! First prize at the mall anniversary! This will be the store's vacuum cleaner from now on!' His friend Zhang Wei replied instantly, 'Awesome, Boss Lei!' Han Dong teased that the color didn't quite match. After the excitement, he put the vacuum cleaner back in the store, changed into the mountain-style quick-dry T-shirt and shorts from his own store, grabbed a sample hiking backpack, and got ready to head to the riverside for promotional photos.
location: Own store, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon outdoor-gear photo shoot at the riverside.
description: Lei Mingxuan rode his bike for two minutes to Binjiang Avenue and found a lawn with good sunlight and greenery near the roller skating path. The afternoon sun cast light through the clouds onto the river, with excellent lighting. He set up the tripod and used a Bluetooth remote to take more than a dozen sets of outdoor poses, highlighting the multi-compartment design of the hiking backpack and the breathability of the quick-dry T-shirt. He also took a few funny outtakes using the Dyson vacuum cleaner he had just won as an "outdoor prop". After about an hour and a half, he had plenty of material.
location: Lawn near the roller-skating path on Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return to the store to process materials and close up
description: After taking the photos, Lei Mingxuan cycled back to the store and quickly processed the day's photos using Lightroom on his phone. He selected 6 photos and wrote the caption: “Even in Shanghai, you need a mindset ready to leave at any time #daily-mountain-style #Shanghai-camping #where-to-go-on-weekends”, added the location “Pudong Riverside Avenue”, and posted it on Xiaohongshu. The photos were of high quality, and as soon as they were posted, many regular customers liked and commented. Afterward, he finished the closing-up tasks and got ready to shut the store.
location: Own store, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bought groceries on the way and walked home
description: After the store closed, Lei Mingxuan didn't go straight home. Remembering that his father had said that morning he wanted to buy sea bass, he walked to Pushang Market. At the market, he picked out a fresh, live sea bass and also bought a bunch of amaranth greens his mother loved and a few scallions. Then he walked back to Shanggang Community, about 15 minutes. At the community entrance, he happened to run into Aunt Zhu Xiuying, a neighbor who was taking a walk downstairs. He patted the vegetables in his hand and said there would be an extra dish tonight.
location: From Pushang Vegetable Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Preparing and sharing a family dinner
description: After returning home, his mother Wang Xiuying was busy in the kitchen. Seeing the fish and vegetables Lei Mingxuan brought back, she smiled and said it saved her a trip. He vividly recounted today's lucky draw experience, and his father Lei Jianguo laughed heartily, saying he had great dumb luck. His mother was busy washing vegetables and cutting fish, and the kitchen was filled with the sweet aroma of braised pork. Dinner was plentiful, with braised pork, sweet and sour spare ribs, steamed sea bass, and stir-fried amaranth. The family of three chatted while eating. Lei Mingxuan talked about his feelings from the morning writing class, saying he had gained a lot and wanted to talk with his father that evening about family history. His father took a sip of rice wine, nodded, and said okay.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-dinner activities and an animated father-son talk about family history
description: After the meal, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes in the kitchen. Then he went back to the study, printed out the fragment of “Waiting” he had written that day, and organized the outline of his novel “Xiafei Lane.” He solemnly invited his father, who was watching the news in the living room, into the study. He handed his father the printed outline and the “Waiting” excerpt. Lei Jianguo put on his reading glasses and read very slowly. When he finished, he took off his glasses, the corners of his eyes slightly red. Without a word, he went into the bedroom and brought out a small iron box. Inside were Lei Mingxuan’s grandfather’s old belongings: a salt worker’s certificate from the Republican era, a hand-drawn map of Pudong, and a copy of “Romance of the Three Kingdoms” with a damaged cover. His father unfolded the map and pointed to a place near the Huangpu River, saying, “This was your grandfather’s rice shop. Before liberation, underground Communist Party members often came to buy rice here, and he gave them cover.” Lei Mingxuan felt as if he had found a treasure and quickly took photos and recordings with his phone. His mother, Wang Xiuying, came in carrying two glasses of hot milk. Seeing this scene, she quietly joined in and recalled that she had also kept a diary when she was young, writing about trivial everyday matters such as fuel, rice, oil and salt. His father laughed and said, “Those are the best historical details.” The family of three stayed in the warm study, recalling and discussing, until late at night.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wrap-up and relaxation
description: Satisfied, he ended the hearty conversation. Lei Mingxuan imported the scanned photos, audio recordings, and notes into his computer and created a new folder named "Family Memories." Tonight had been hugely rewarding: not only had he gained valuable writing material, but he also gained a deeper understanding of his family's history and warmth. He went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, letting his tense nerves fully relax.
location: Bathroom and study at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation and reflection
description: Lei Mingxuan lay in bed, still thinking about the old Pudong his father had described. He opened Boohee Health and logged his dinner. Today he had walked and cycled about 15,000 steps in total, so the exercise was decent. However, he had eaten quite a bit of braised pork belly while chatting happily in the evening, so his weight would probably go up a little — but he felt content. He set the alarm for tomorrow morning, turned off the light, and, carrying warmth toward his family and inspiration for his novel, gradually drifted off to sleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run and shooting Vlog footage
description: Woke up naturally at 6:20 and weighed 80.9 kg. Changed into a blue quick-dry T-shirt and black shorts, drank a couple of sips of warm water, and headed out. At 6:35, jogged along Zhangyang Road to Century Park, keeping the pace at 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, and finished the 5 km in 29 minutes 15 seconds. Along the way, using a phone holder attached to the running belt on his chest, he recorded 30 seconds of Vlog footage, including: "Today is Father's Day, let's start the day with a morning run and go home to make pour-over coffee for Mom and Dad." While stretching in the small plaza near Gate 1 of Century Park, he saw a few fellow runners chatting and greeted them.
location: Running route from Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Gate 1 of Century Park (No. 1001 Jinxiu Road) and back.

name: Pour-over coffee and a family morning.
description: I got home at 7:20, showered, and changed into home shorts. At 7:35, I boiled water in the kitchen and hand-brewed two cups of coffee using the Ethiopian Yirgacheffe beans opened yesterday. My mother took a sip and said, "Mm, much more fragrant than the ones from the bakery downstairs." My father, who usually drinks black coffee, just nodded. I specially used my phone to record this conversation and took a photo of my father holding his coffee and looking out the window, planning to incorporate it into a Vlog later. It's rare for the family to sit together so quietly in the early morning.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Shanggang Residential Community

name: Breakfast, shopping, and core training
description: At 8:15, her mother had prepared millet porridge and boiled eggs. She ate two egg whites and a bowl of porridge, and didn't touch the fried dumplings. At 8:45, she changed into outdoor clothes and walked 10 minutes to Pushang Vegetable Market. Following her mother's list, she bought rehydrated gluten, dried wood ear mushrooms, day lily flowers, and peanuts, as well as a bottle of time-honored soy sauce. She also bought a sea bass and a bunch of green vegetables to add to dinner. At 9:05, she returned home, put away the groceries, spread out a yoga mat in the living room, and did 15 minutes of core training, including 3 sets of planks (1 minute each) and 3 sets of sit-ups (20 reps each).
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Pushang Vegetable Market, Dongchang Road

name: Online historical fiction writing workshop
description: Joined the video conference at 9:25 sharp. Today was the second class of the workshop, with the theme 'Constructing the Story Background'. I shared my reflections from sorting through my grandfather's belongings last week. The mentor hit the nail on the head: 'Your strength lies in real-life experience. Don't fabricate—let the memories speak.' Inspired by this, I announced publicly that the novel's core setting would be named 'Xiafeifang', with the main storyline centered on the fates of three generations of a rice shop family in Qichangzhan alleyway in Pudong between 1947 and 1949. The mentor said this angle has great potential, and classmates also sent encouragement in the chat box. Class ended at 11:25, and I felt my thinking was clearer than ever before.
location: Home study, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cooked four-happiness braised gluten for his father
description: At 11:30, he put on an apron and officially started cooking. He blanched the wheat gluten, squeezed it dry, cut it into diamond shapes, and deep-fried it until the surface was golden and slightly crispy. His mother peeled garlic and sliced ginger beside him, occasionally correcting the heat: 'The oil needs to be hotter!' Ten minutes later, he heated a new wok with oil, stir-fried star anise and cinnamon bark until fragrant, added all the ingredients, poured in boiling water to cover the food, added dark soy sauce and two spoonfuls of sugar, then turned to low heat to simmer slowly. After 20 minutes, he lifted the lid and turned up the heat to reduce the sauce, finally drizzling a little sesame oil over it. The four-joy braised gluten, glossy red and with a perfectly balanced sweet-and-salty taste, came out of the wok. His father, smelling the aroma in the living room, came over and took a look, saying nothing but giving a thumbs-up.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Shanggang Residential Community

name: Father's Day lunch and gift giving
description: At 12:30, he had his parents get changed, and the three walked for 10 minutes to the Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant at Lujiazui Center near the community. He ordered his father's favorites: Shanghai-style braised pork, fish fillets in fermented rice wine sauce, pan-fried pork buns, and a stir-fried seasonal vegetable. When the atmosphere was warm and cozy, he took out the wrapped shirt gift box from behind. His father opened it and found a clean-cut light-blue non-iron shirt. He tried it on immediately, and the size was just right. His mother smiled, “You look so much more spirited than in your old shirts!” He raised his orange juice and toasted his father: “Dad, thank you, and Happy Father's Day!” His father's eyes reddened slightly, and after taking a sip, he said, “You focus on your own work; don't worry about home.” The three clinked glasses, enjoying a happy time together. The lunch was quite rich, so he restrained himself and ate only half a bowl of rice.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, 889 South Pudong Road, Lujiazui Center, Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant

name: Post-meal stroll and midday rest
description: After settling the bill at 1:30 p.m., he suggested walking home to help digestion. The family of three walked slowly along the sidewalk; his mother held his arm, his father walked ahead and turned back every now and then to say something. When they passed the convenience store at the community gate, they went in and bought three cups of sugar-free yogurt as an after-dinner dessert. They got home at 2 p.m. His parents went to take a nap, and he dozed on the living room sofa for 20 minutes to recharge for the afternoon.
location: Along the way from No. 889 South Pudian Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanggang Community (Lane 136, Pudong Avenue)

name: Go to the store and confirm the autumn orders
description: At 14:20, he picked up a shared bike and arrived at the Super Brand Mall store in 15 minutes. Sales clerk Xiaolin was tidying the shelves. At 14:30 he called Zhou Tao, the Hangzhou supplier. Based on pre-June sales data, he confirmed the size ratios for the 12 new fall styles item by item and size by size, finally settling on: M 40%, L 35%, XL 20%, XXL 5%. He also asked Zhou Tao to finish production and ship by July 5. Zhou Tao updated the system and sent the final Excel spreadsheet. Lei Mingxuan checked it, confirmed it was correct, saved it, and replied 'Agreed.'
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buying an additional gift for father
description: At 15:30, he remembered that the shirt originally planned as a gift for his father had already been bought online and wrapped, but he happened to pass a familiar menswear brand on the first floor of the mall and recalled that his father had mentioned needing a comfortable pair of thin summer trousers. So he went in, chose a pair of dark gray quick-dry trousers according to his father's waist size and inseam, paid 299 yuan with his membership card, and planned to surprise his father at home in the evening.
location: Men's wear counter, 1F, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dealt with a voice message from my friend Song Jia.
description: At 16:10, just as he got back to the front of the store, his phone vibrated with a voice message from Song Jia. Her tone sounded a little hurt: 'Mingxuan, honestly, you're so hard to reach these days... Did I do something wrong?' He froze for a moment, then realized that turning down her roller-skating invitations twice before was indeed inappropriate. Without hesitating, he called back: 'Jia, no way! It really was just a scheduling conflict—the camping and writing class were booked in advance. This is totally my fault. Next time, you pick the time, and I'll fully cooperate.' Song Jia was silent for a few seconds, then her tone softened: 'Mm, then I'll wait for you to ask me out.' After hanging up, he wrote in his phone memo: 'Before next Saturday, take the initiative to invite Song Jia on a night skating ride along the riverfront.'
location: Store rest area, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handling store sales matters and stocktaking
description: At 16:40, I started checking the weekend sales reports with Xiao Lin and found that a newly launched pair of vest pants was selling well, so I had Xiao Lin adjust their display position. Then I took a few photos of the store's new display with my phone and put them into the Xiaohongshu material library. At 17:20, I packed a few defective items in the warehouse that were to be returned next week with Xiao Lin, and attached the shipping labels. At 17:30, I handed over to Xiao Lin and reminded her to pay attention to the new accessories arriving tomorrow.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home and surprise Dad
description: At 17:35 I got on a shared bike and rode home, arriving 15 minutes later. My mother was in the kitchen preparing dinner ingredients, and my father was in the living room watching the news. I took out the new pants I had just bought and handed them to my father: “Dad, I passed a mall this afternoon and saw this pair of pants—they looked comfortable. Try them on.” My father said, “Wasting money again,” but with a smile in his eyes, he took the pants and went to his room to try them on.
location: Home at No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: During dinner, his mother reheated the dishes from noon, steamed the sea bass they had bought, and made a pot of tomato and egg soup. At the table they talked about how the day had felt. His father was very pleased wearing the new shirt and even took the initiative to ask about the writing class content. Lei Mingxuan briefly talked about the idea for "Xiafei Fang." His father was silent for a moment and then said, "Back in your grandfather's day, he really did run a grocery store near Qichangzhan." This piece of information made his eyes light up, and he felt the meal was worth it.
location: Home dining room, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Billiards group interaction and social sharing
description: At 19:30, he opened WeChat. In the "Pudong Billiards Sparring Group," his friend Han Dong was mentioning him again: "Boss Lei, how was Father's Day? Want to play billiards next week?" A smirk emoji followed, and several billiards buddies chimed in. He smiled and replied: "Sure! Friday at the usual place, loser pays for late-night snacks!" He also attached a self-made sticker of a coffee cup and a billiard cue stacked together, and the group burst into laughter. Afterward, he scrolled through his phone album and posted a Moments update with the photos he'd taken that day—his father's back, coffee latte art, and the finished four-treasure braised gluten—with the caption: "Today's dad doesn't just drink black coffee." It got a lot of likes.
location: Living room at home, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening yoga stretching
description: At 20:30, he unrolled his yoga mat and did a 20-minute Hatha yoga session, focusing on stretching the hip flexors, shoulders, and neck after the morning run. His body felt pleasantly sore, but overall he was in good shape. He weighed himself: 80.8 kg, slightly lighter than in the morning.
location: Bedroom floor, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Journal reflection and creative inspiration
description: At 9 p.m., he sat at his desk, opened his diary, and wrote today's reflections: 'Father's Day was very touching. The power of family is the foundation of writing. Song Jia's voice message was a wake-up call — when pursuing a new world, one must not forget the people of the old world. I need to learn to proactively maintain relationships.' After that, he quickly jotted down the new clue 'grocery store' that his father had mentioned in the afternoon, and excitedly sketched out a scene of his grandfather chatting with a neighbor in the grocery store, as supplementary material for 'Xiafeifang'.
location: Study desk, No. 12, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and reading
description: At 22:00, I showered and dried my hair. At 22:20, I leaned against the headboard and scrolled through some outdoor styling photos I took at the shop in the afternoon, thinking about the title for the next Xiaohongshu post. At 22:40, I picked up The Song of Everlasting Sorrow and read a short section, about 10 minutes. At exactly 23:00, I turned off the light and lay down. Recalling this fulfilling day, I felt calm inside and quickly fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Morning weigh-in and wake-up
description: Immediately after getting up, measured weight and recorded 80.7kg, down 0.2kg from yesterday. While washing up, saw through the window that it was cloudy turning overcast outside, and checked the weather forecast on my phone. After drinking a glass of warm water, did some simple stretching in the living room to activate the body.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Giving a vacuum cleaner and having a casual chat with family.
description: He took the Dyson V10 vacuum cleaner won in the lucky draw out of the car trunk and gave it to his mother, Wang Xiuying. His mother grumbled that he was wasting money, but she couldn't put it down and carefully stored it in the storage room. He chatted with his mother, and the atmosphere was pleasant.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and story sharing
description: The whole family sat around the table for breakfast of Shanghai wonton soup and scallion pancakes. They talked about the old items found while sorting Grandfather's belongings on Father's Day yesterday, such as grain coupons and land deeds, and felt they were inspiring for the novel 'Xiafei Fang'. Father Lei Jianguo added old stories about Qichangzhan, and Mother planned to do a big cleaning with the new vacuum cleaner.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Driving commute: home to Super Brand Mall
description: Starting from home, drive along Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Ring Road, and Century Avenue, arriving at the Super Brand Mall underground parking lot in just 6 minutes. Check the sample clothes in the trunk and plan the day's display.
location: Drove from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, No. 2-51, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Preparations for opening the shop and calling Song Jia.
description: Open the roll-up door, start the computer and POS machine, and air out the store. Leaning against the cash register, I called my roller-skating partner Song Jia, apologized for missing last week's appointment, and took the initiative to suggest making the nighttime skate along the riverside a regular activity, scheduling it for Saturday evening and offering to buy coffee as an apology. The other party's attitude softened and they agreed to meet up again.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations and video reconciliation with suppliers
description: He replied to customer messages in the backend and online orders, had a video call with supplier Zhou Tao from Hangzhou on his tablet, checked the size proportions and fabric details of the 12 new autumn styles one by one, reiterated that they must arrive before July 5, and finalized the quantities of sizes M and L. In between, he styled the new techwear shorts on the mannequin by the door and adjusted the lighting.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and inspiration gathering at a curated boutique.
description: Walk to IFC Mall and eat a teriyaki chicken thigh energy bowl at a casual Japanese restaurant on B1, while browsing Xiaohongshu outfit posts for sharing inspiration. After the meal, walk around the newly opened boutique and take a few photos of accessories and display styling for inspiration, paying attention to the season's trends.
location: Japanese casual restaurant and select shop on B1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returned to the store and collected market material
description: Walked back from IFC to Super Brand Mall; while passing the pet market in the mall's atrium, filmed short videos of cats and dogs, planning to share them in the client group in the evening to liven things up.
location: Walk from IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Customer group sharing and promotional interaction
description: In the customer group of about 200 people, he posted a photo of himself holding the box of a Dyson vacuum cleaner, sharing the joy of winning the prize, and the group was full of teasing. He then offered styling suggestions and a limited-time discount for two styles of techwear shorts, patiently answered questions for more than half an hour, and effectively boosted sales.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Xiaohongshu Data Review and Requirements Sorting
description: Brewed a cup of instant coffee, logged into RED's creator backend, and analyzed last week's Vlog and outfit post views, engagement data, and follower demographics. Found that practical tutorials and voting activities performed best. Recorded optimization needs in Excel, formed a copy optimization checklist for the voting activity, and prepared to hand it to my cousin Shen Jie.
location: Store rest area, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store, off work, and reviewing in the car
description: Tidied up the computer, turned off the air conditioning and lights, and pulled down the rolling shutter door to close for the day. Drove back along the same route to Shanggang Community, playing a historical audio novel to relax on the way, while reviewing the day's operational data and brainstorming optimization directions for next week's short videos.
location: Drive from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and sharing fun stories
description: At dinner, his mother made oil-braised wild rice stems and steamed sea bass. During the meal, he animatedly talked about the fun of sharing a vacuum cleaner in the group chat that afternoon and the fan feedback he noticed in data analysis. His parents were delighted, and his father praised the store for keeping up with the times.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Home strength training
description: After changing into workout clothes, he completed four sets of exercises on the yoga mat in the living room: standard push-ups (12 reps per set), wide-stance squats (20 reps per set), resistance band rows (15 reps per side per set), and plank (1 minute per set), with 45 seconds of rest between sets. After training, he stretched thoroughly and felt refreshed both mentally and physically.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Showering and discussing styling ideas with my cousin
description: After working out, I showered and changed into home clothes. In the bedroom, I sent the Xiaohongshu voting campaign requirements checklist and the outfit inspiration photos taken at IFC to my cousin Shen Jie via WeChat, asking her to polish the copy and give styling advice. We chatted by voice about daily life, and she said she was free on the weekend to come visit the store.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading novels and writing a bedtime diary.
description: Leaning against the headboard, he read a few pages of The Song of Everlasting Sorrow, while mentally developing the plot of the rice shop owner in the alley from his novel Xiafei Lane. At 23:00 he closed the book and wrote down the day's reflections in his phone notes: proactively repairing friendships felt easy, the data analysis was showing initial results, and his mother was satisfied with the gift. He set the alarm for 6:45 the next morning, turned off the light, and went to bed.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast
description: At 7:00 in the morning the alarm went off. The sky outside was overcast, and sensing rain, he put an umbrella into his commuter bag. He weighed himself: 80.7 kg, staying steady. After washing up, he went to the living room to share breakfast with his parents. His father had bought flatbread and fried dough sticks, and his mother had warmed up milk. They chatted over the meal. He told his parents that there was a book club in the evening. His father joked that he was busier than office workers, and his mother reminded him to wear an extra coat to keep warm.
location: Room 501, No. 10, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Drove to the store and inspected it
description: After leaving, I drove for 6 minutes to the Super Brand Mall parking garage, went upstairs to store A-208 'Xiafei Ji' on the 2nd floor. I quickly inspected the store, adjusted the rolled cuffs on the mountain-style shorts on the mannequin at the entrance to add a layered look. I had a morning meeting with store clerk Xiao Lin, emphasized that today's focus is promoting the mountain-style shorts, asked her to place them in a prominent spot, and told her that my cousin Shen Jie would come in the afternoon, so she should prepare two iced Americanos.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, No. A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commute to Jing'an District Cultural Center and prepare before class
description: Drove from Super Brand Mall via the East Yan'an Road Tunnel and the Yan'an Elevated Road to the Jing'an District Cultural Center, with slight congestion during the morning rush hour. Arrived at 8:30, bought water from the vending machine downstairs, went to the second-floor classroom, and sat in a window seat. Took out 'The Song of Everlasting Sorrow' and flipped through the last few chapters, penciling notes on the passages about the disappearance of Shanghai's alleyways to prepare for the evening book club discussion.
location: Classroom on the second floor of the Jing'an District Cultural Center, 459 Urumqi North Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai, China

name: Attended the historical fiction writing workshop class
description: The 9 a.m. writing class started on time, with the theme 'Character Dialogue and Scene Description.' The instructor used the opening longtang scene from 'The Song of Everlasting Sorrow' as an example and assigned an in-class exercise. Chen Yu wrote a dialogue set in a Qichangzhan longtang rice shop in 1948, imitating his grandfather speaking Shanghainese: 'Today's rice is really good, want some?' The instructor commented that the passage had a strong flavor of everyday life, the colloquial language was full of character, and encouraged him to continue mining his family material.
location: Classroom on the second floor of the Jing'an District Cultural Center, 459 Urumqi North Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch: a simple Shanghainese meal in the Jing'an Temple business district
description: After class, walked about 7 minutes to Jiuguang Department Store, and at the Wang Jia Sha snack shop on the basement level ordered a bowl of shepherd's purse wontons and two crab-shell pastries, quickly finishing lunch. While eating, he scrolled through his phone replying to customer messages on Xiaohongshu, and was glad that his mountain-style shorts outfit was liked.
location: Wangjiasha Snack Shop, B1, Jiuguang Department Store, 1618 Nanjing Road West, Jing'an District, Shanghai, China

name: Visit the "Chuncui" Cafe to refine pour-over brewing techniques
description: After the meal, he rode a shared bike for 6 minutes to the 'Chuncui' specialty coffee café on Fumin Road. The barista, Xiao Zhou, brought out lightly roasted Ethiopian beans and gave hands-on guidance on adjusting the spout angle and flow rate, correcting the water flow deviation during the bloom. After brewing two pots in a row, the sweetness and layering of the second pot improved noticeably. Chen Yu noted the brewing parameters in his phone memo and agreed to try new beans next week.
location: Chuncui Boutique Café, No. 7, Lane 182, Fumin Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai, China

name: Drove back to the store and worked with my cousin to optimize Xiaohongshu.
description: Driving back to Pudong from the Fumin Road café via the Yan'an Elevated Road and the East Yan'an Road Tunnel, about a 30-minute drive. On the way, he checked the Xiafeiji account and saw that yesterday's video views had exceeded 10,000. Arrived at the Super Brand Mall shop at 14:05; his younger cousin Shen Jie was already there, chatting with Xiao Lin over iced Americanos. He immediately opened his computer to discuss Xiaohongshu content optimization: showing user data analysis, confirming that fans prefer the "urban techwear style," and deciding to add interactive polls. Shen Jie suggested using lucky draws with vouchers to drive traffic, and the two reached an agreement. They each wrote a copy version for the "commute outfit" and "weekend store visit" scenarios; in the end they chose Shen Jie's version with slight tone adjustments, and finalized a trial shoot for next Tuesday, with Shen Jie contacting the local model.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, No. A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Close the store, drive to Jing'an Library, and prepare for class
description: After the collaboration ended, Shen Jie left first, and Chen Yu explained the store-closing matters to Xiao Lin. He then drove to Jing'an Library, taking Century Avenue, the East Yan'an Road Tunnel, and the Yan'an Elevated Road to Xinzha Road; during evening rush hour it took about 45 minutes. On the way, he ate a tuna rice ball in the car to stave off hunger. At 18:20 he arrived at the library, went to a quiet corner of the second-floor reading area, took out 'The Song of Everlasting Sorrow' and a notebook, reviewed previously marked passages, and wrote an outline for discussion.
location: Second-floor reading area of Jing'an District Library, No. 1708 Xinzha Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai, China.

name: Attend the “Old Dreams of Shanghai” reading group discussion
description: The discussion started on time, and the group read the second half of The Song of Everlasting Sorrow, focusing on the inevitability of Wang Qiyao's fate. Chen Yu, drawing on his observations in the alleyways of Pudong, shared how the older generation's lives changed from bungalows to public housing, and mentioned how neighborly relations have gradually disappeared in modern residential communities, which resonated with the group members and sparked lively discussion. The activity was extended until 9 p.m.
location: Seminar Room, Second Floor, Jing'an District Library, No. 1708 Xinzha Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai, China

name: Drove home, relaxed in the evening, and read before bed
description: After the book club ended, said goodbye to the group members and drove back to Pudong. The evening rush hour was over, and I got home in about 30 minutes. When I got home, my parents were already asleep, so I took a quiet shower. Afterwards, I organized the rice shop segment from the writing class and the alleyway insights from the book club into my material library, and edited a Moments post to share the day's gains. Did core stretching with a resistance band, then got into bed to read Blossoms, and turned off the light to sleep at 23:05.
location: Room 501, No. 10, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 6:45 in the morning, he woke up 15 minutes before the alarm and got out of bed quickly. Stepping on the electronic scale, he saw 81 kg, the same as the previous day, and felt relieved. While washing his face, he rubbed his face in the mirror, feeling refreshed. He changed into a loose-fitting athletic T-shirt and shorts and running shoes, ready to go out on an empty stomach for a physical exam.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 12, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Attended the free community health checkup
description: He left at 7 o'clock sharp and walked 10 minutes to Zhangyang Road Community Health Service Center. He registered in line with his reservation number and had the routine annual free physical exam, including a blood draw (three vials), blood pressure measurement (120/80), height and weight measurement, and an electrocardiogram. He felt no discomfort throughout and thought his health was quite good.
location: Zhangyang Road Community Health Service Center, 999 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast: pan-fried buns and soy milk.
description: After the health checkup, he walked to the nearby Xiaoyan Shengjian (Zhangyang Road branch). He ordered two liang of fresh pork shengjian (6 pieces) and a bowl of iced soy milk. The buns had crispy bottoms and fresh, juicy filling with rich broth, and paired with the slightly sweet soy milk, it quickly filled his empty stomach. While eating, he scrolled through his phone and saw that a customer had liked the store's new-product preview post from yesterday.
location: Xiaoyan Shengjian (Zhangyang Road Store), No. 951 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute: walk to get the car and drive to the store.
description: After breakfast, walked 10 minutes back to the underground garage of Shanggang Community, found his car, and turned on the air conditioning. Following Zhangyang Road, turned onto Lujiazui Ring Road and headed to Super Brand Mall. Traffic was a bit heavy during the morning rush, but the roads in Pudong were generally smooth. Arrived at the Super Brand Mall underground parking lot about 20 minutes later.
location: From the underground garage of Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the parking lot of Super Brand Mall, No. 168, Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area

name: Store work: new product stocking and display adjustment
description: After arriving at the store, I first boiled water and made tea, then got down to work. I opened the newly arrived package of mountain-style functional shirts, checked each one for flaws, and ironed them with a garment steamer. I conceived an "urban function" themed display plan, pairing the light khaki and military green new styles with cargo pants and bucket hats, arranging layered visuals in the window. It took about two hours before I was satisfied.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch: Japanese ramen and a mall walk-through.
description: At noon, customer traffic began to pick up. I locked the store and walked to the adjacent IFC Mall. I went down to the Menya Musashi ramen shop on B1 and ordered a rich tonkotsu-niboshi ramen with a soft-boiled egg, and devoured it heartily. Afterward, I took a quick stroll around B1, observing the summer displays of other menswear brands to pick up on fashion trends.
location: Menya Musashi Ramen, B1F, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunchtime business operations and customer reception.
description: After returning to the store and entering business mode, customer traffic increased in the afternoon. For an office worker looking for a versatile work outfit, he put together a navy functional shirt with khaki shorts, and the sale went through smoothly. At about 15:30, regular customer Qian Duoduo came to pick up a hat she had reserved. The two chatted about styling new arrivals, and he recommended his Xiaohongshu account to her. In the afternoon, he sold three items in total, with decent revenue.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online invitations and store wrap-up
description: Taking advantage of a lull after the customers left, he contacted his roller skating buddy Song Jia on WeChat, arranged to go skating at Binjiang next Saturday at 7 pm, and promised to treat her to milk tea as an apology, which she confirmed. Afterwards, he started closing-up preparations early and sat at the cash register brainstorming a plan with his cousin Shen Jie to shoot a Xiaohongshu feature on “urban techwear style” next week, initially selecting the Lujiazui footbridge, the Binjiang promenade, and the store window as check-in spots.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute: drive home.
description: At 17:30, he pulled down the store's rolling shutter door and drove home from the Super Brand Mall underground parking lot. The drive back on the elevated road was a bit congested, but traffic smoothed out near the community. At around 18:15, he parked in a space in Shanggang Community.
location: From the Super Brand Mall parking lot, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Family dinner and casual chat
description: When he got home, his mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared dinner, including braised pork chops, braised water bamboo in oil, and tomato and egg soup. His father Lei Jianguo was watching the news in the living room. During the meal, they shared today's physical examination results and the shop's business. His mother was happy to hear it, and his father reminded him to do business with care.
location: Home dining room, No. 12, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Catching up on anime and chatting online
description: After helping his mother clear the table, he returned to the bedroom, drew the curtains, opened Bilibili, and watched the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End while eating barbecue-flavored potato chips. After watching, he sent a message on QQ to his fellow fan Gao Yuan to discuss the plot, and Gao Yuan also recommended another new anime.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 12, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Core strength training
description: Changed into workout shorts, laid a yoga mat on the living room floor, and performed the daily core workout: 3 sets of sit-ups (20 reps each), 2 sets of planks (1 minute each), and finished with 1 set of Russian twists, leaving his abdomen with a strong tight feeling. After the workout, he wiped off sweat with a towel.
location: Living room at home, No. 12, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shower and bedtime reading
description: After training, took a warm shower, looked in the mirror and regretted eating potato chips, and decided to control his diet tomorrow. After drying off and blow-drying his hair, he changed into cotton pajamas, leaned against the headboard and read 'Blossoms' for about half an hour, and drowsiness gradually crept in.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Building 12, Shanggang Residential Complex, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: Before 22:30, he turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside night light. Recalling the day's smoothly completed work and the appointment with friends, he felt relaxed and gradually fell asleep after closing his eyes.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 12, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Health wake-up call and family breakfast
description: Waking up early in the morning, I habitually opened the Health Pudong app and found that the physical examination report showed high total cholesterol and a tendency toward mild fatty liver, which made me nervous. I immediately called the community contracted doctor for consultation. The doctor seriously advised me to control my diet, increase aerobic exercise, and have regular follow-ups. After hanging up, I immediately formulated a fitness plan of aerobic exercise 4 times a week, eating out less and avoiding fried food, and a follow-up check in one month, and firmly decided to buy commercial medical insurance. Then I took my phone and showed the examination results to my mother, Wang Xiuying. She kept muttering while rushing into the kitchen, cooked plain noodle soup with a poached egg and blanched spinach, with less oil and salt, and sat nearby supervising me until I finished. During that time, I again brought up insurance and the fitness plan.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: It was drizzling when he left. He walked 8 minutes with an umbrella to Pudong Avenue Metro Station, thinking repeatedly on the way about how to bring up buying insurance to his parents. At the same time, he opened Xiaohongshu to like and reply to comments on the 'Summer Techwear' post that had blown up overnight, warming up for afternoon fans coming to the store. He took the metro two stops to Lujiazui Station, and after exiting, walked to Super Brand Mall. After arriving at the mall, he ran into property manager Zheng Kai in the corridor and learned from him that there would be a joint promotional event next week. After noting down the key points, he entered the store, turned on the computer, opened the door, and started a new day of operations.
location: Along the route from Pudong Avenue to Super Brand Mall on Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and online content promotion.
description: At Mingxuan Wardrobe on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, he organized merchandise, adjusted displays, and handled online orders at the same time. Striking while the iron was hot, he used his phone to edit 3 inventory videos filmed in the store in the style of the viral
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch indulgence and self-discipline.
description: Feeling restless and excited, I somehow ended up at the Super Brand Mall food court and ordered a fried chicken rice dish. The pleasure of eating meat in big bites lasted only a few seconds; the moment I thought of the high cholesterol and fatty liver trend in my physical exam report, guilt flooded over me. While chewing, I wrote in red in my phone memo: "Lei Mingxuan, you need to watch your diet!" to remind myself.
location: Super Brand Mall Food Court, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon fan interaction and preparation for store visits.
description: Back at the store, he opened Xiaohongshu and found that in the direct messages for the 'Summer Techwear' note, two local fans kept asking about the address and business hours. He replied to each in detail, telling them that Mingxuan Wardrobe was on Level 2 of Super Brand Mall, and invited them to come try on clothes that afternoon. Then, via WeChat, he confirmed with fans Zhou Yue and Chen Li that they would arrive around 3 p.m. He carefully selected multiple summer techwear outfits in advance according to their body types and hung them near the fitting room to ensure a smooth try-on experience.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: First offline fan conversion
description: At 3 p.m., fans Zhou Yue and Chen Li arrived at the store on time. I warmly greeted them and, based on our online chat, helped them put together several looks. Zhou Yue picked a tactical vest with cargo shorts, while Chen Li preferred a multi-pocket techwear skirt. After trying them on, both were very satisfied and each bought a full outfit. I excitedly helped them pack and asked to take customer outfit photos, and they readily agreed.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Customer photo review posting and voting campaign launch.
description: After seeing the fan off, he immediately edited the customer outfit photos he had just taken on his phone. He selected the best nine, used the Xingtu app to add the text “Shanghai local fan checked in at the store,” and posted them to Xiaohongshu. Right after, he uploaded the five sets of model photos he had finalized with his cousin Shen Jie and launched a “You Pick This Week's Best Outfit” poll with a 48-hour deadline. He forwarded the link to his fan group and Moments, took a deep breath, and waited for feedback.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Real-time data operations and high spirits.
description: Holding his phone and hardly leaving the store, he refreshed Xiaohongshu updates in real time. Likes, comments, and saves rose quickly, and the number of participants in the voting campaign exceeded 100 within 30 minutes. The thrill of directly turning online traffic into revenue made his adrenaline surge again, and he was in a great mood.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Coffee time and impromptu exchanges
description: Strolled to the Starbucks on the first floor of Super Brand Mall and ordered a hot Americano. He happened to run into property manager Zheng Kai, so he handed him a cup, and the two chatted about details of next week's joint promotion. While talking, he was already figuring out how to confess to his parents about sneaking fried chicken at noon and planned to formally raise the matter of buying insurance.
location: Starbucks, 1st Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mall cardio and business research
description: Using picking up a package as an excuse, I started some active cardio—deliberately taking a longer route inside Super Brand Mall and briskly walking two laps back and forth for about 15 minutes. Then I dropped by ZARA and Uniqlo along the way, mainly to observe their main fall styles, fabrics, and new design trends. It counted as both exercise and market research.
location: Fast-fashion stores such as ZARA and UNIQLO at Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening rush-hour store operations and packaging.
description: Back at the store, online orders increased. I replied to customer messages while packing and shipping orders.
