Today's excitement made me not feel tired; instead, it gave me a sense of being in control of everything. Before closing, I also sent several regular customers on WeChat the link to the new voting event, inviting them to participate.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Late-Night Commute
description: After closing the store, he walked to Lujiazui Metro Station. The rain had stopped, and the air smelled of earth. He took the metro two stops to Pudong Avenue Station, then walked home. On the way, he reflected on the day: from the morning's anxiety, to the midday indulgence, to the afternoon's elation. He silently resolved that his career could be intense, but his health had to stay steady.
location: Along the route from Lujiazui West Road to Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Family meeting and health planning
description: Back home, my mother had prepared a healthy dinner—steamed sea bass, blanched okra, and multigrain rice. During the meal, I proactively came clean to my parents about the physical exam report and sneaking fried chicken at noon. My father nodded silently, and my mother scolded me for a while. Seizing the moment, I formally proposed buying commercial medical insurance and a weekly fitness plan. Though my parents grudged the money, they ultimately chose to support it when it came to health.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Insurance product comparison research
description: Back in the bedroom, I used my phone to compare two or three critical illness insurance plans on platforms like Shenlanbao, focusing on coverage amounts and claim scope. I saved screenshots of the products I liked, and planned to consult customer service in detail the next day. My decision to buy insurance was firmly made.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Late-night anime and conversations with friends
description: Still excited, he opened Bilibili and watched an episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End. During that time, his friend Gao Yuan sent messages to discuss the plot of the new anime. After a brief chat, Gao Yuan mentioned that he was also preparing an insurance policy recently, so the two agreed to talk more on the weekend.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep review and journaling
description: Opened the diary app and recorded today’s thoughts: “A key turning point! The first offline order on Xiaohongshu was successfully validated, and the emotional value was maxed out. The health alarm has sounded; fitness and insurance are the top priorities for July. Starting tomorrow, less oil and salt, and walk more.” With a complex mix of excitement and anxiety, he turned off the lights and went to sleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning weigh-in and preparation
description: The phone alarm went off at 6:50, waking him up 10 minutes earlier than usual. Lei Mingxuan stepped onto the scale barefoot; it showed 81.1 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday. He was secretly glad he hadn't had a late-night snack. He washed up quickly, got dressed, and reminded himself that he had to strictly follow the health plan today.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Healthy Breakfast and Physical Exam Confession
description: Mother Wang Xiuying prepared millet porridge, boiled eggs, and vegetable buns. After Lei Mingxuan sat down, he solemnly confessed to his mother yesterday's physical examination results: total cholesterol was slightly high, and there were signs of mild fatty liver. He asked his mother to use less oil and salt in cooking from now on, temporarily stop braised pork, and prepare more fish and vegetables. His mother seriously agreed and resolved to adjust her son's diet for his health.
location: Dining hall at Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Insurance consultation and records
description: Lei Mingxuan sat on the sofa in the living room, opened the Shenlanbao app, found the critical illness insurance product he had favorited the day before, and called customer service to ask in detail about the waiting period, health disclosure (especially how to declare his high total cholesterol and tendency toward mild fatty liver), renewal conditions, and premiums. He took notes in his phone's memo app while listening, and planned to compare other products on the weekend.
location: Living room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commute and purchase energy replenishment
description: Lei Mingxuan took a folding umbrella, walked to Pudong Avenue Metro Station, took Line 6 to Century Avenue Station, transferred to Line 2, and got off at Lujiazui Station. He then went around to the FamilyMart under Jin Mao Tower, bought a sugar-free oolong tea and an energy bar as an energy boost for the morning, and continued on to the shop at Super Brand Mall.
location: Convenience store at Jin Mao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning store operations and online promotion.
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at the store on time before 9 a.m., opened the roller shutter, started the cash register system, checked the previous day's sales report, and replied to customer messages on Xiaohongshu and WeChat. Noticing that the “Summer Techwear” post had gained many new positive comments, he seized the moment, selected customer photo reviews from followers Zhou Yue and Chen Li, carefully edited the photos, and published them with captions on Xiaohongshu and WeChat Moments, emphasizing that customers who checked in at the store could get the same style. At the same time, he shared the link to the “You Decide This Week's Best Outfit” voting event launched last night and reminded everyone that only 24 hours remained until voting closed.
location: Mingxuan's Wardrobe, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Healthy lunch and mall research.
description: Lei Mingxuan did not eat his usual fried chicken rice. Instead, he went to Lüye Light Meal on B1 of Super Brand Mall and ordered a chicken breast vegetable salad with vinaigrette and an American coffee. While eating, he used his phone to browse the mall app's materials list for next week's joint promotion with Zheng Kai. After the meal, he followed the mall's traffic flow to the UNIQLO and ZARA pop-up stores, observing the new autumn display arrangements and key promoted styles, and took photos for reference.
location: Green Field Light Meal, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon shop work, promotional liaison, social contact, and order packing
description: In the afternoon, several waves of customers came to the store in succession. Lei Mingxuan received them warmly, helped match outfits and arrange try-ons, and successfully closed two sales. He took a moment to send a WeChat message to property manager Zheng Kai, inviting him to come to the store at 3 p.m. to discuss the details of next week's 'Trendy Summer' joint promotion. Around 3 o'clock, Zheng Kai arrived as promised. The two talked at the store entrance for more than twenty minutes and finalized the event schedule, venue layout, and stocking requirements. After seeing Zheng Kai off, Lei Mingxuan estimated the time, found his roller skating partner Song Jia on WeChat, sincerely apologized for standing him up earlier, and invited him to that evening's night skating session along the Pudong riverside. Then, taking advantage of the lull in customer flow, he began checking the afternoon's online orders, comparing styles, sizes, and addresses one by one, and affixing shipping labels. In between, he also received two customers who looked like students and successfully sold a T-shirt. He planned to finish packing as early as possible so that he could leave directly after closing.
location: Mingxuan's Wardrobe, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Closed the store, joined the Binjiang Night Skate event, and repaired his friendship with Song Jia.
description: At 6 p.m., Lei Mingxuan placed the packed online orders at the designated spot by the door for courier pickup, tidied the fitting room, changed into a sports short-sleeve shirt and quick-dry pants, and put on his roller skating gear. At 6:50 he pulled down the rolling shutter door and locked it on time, scanned a shared bike on the roadside, and cycled about 15 minutes to the meeting point at Lujiazui Riverside Park. Song Jia had already arrived early. The two exchanged smiles, and the earlier unpleasantness melted away. At 7:30 p.m. the night skating officially began. More than twenty roller skating enthusiasts set off along the riverside promenade. Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia skated side by side, chatting as they went. Song Jia complained about a small incident in the hand-drip coffee class, and Lei Mingxuan shared funny stories about VIP customers in his store. During a rest stop at the Laobaidu Riverside Green Space, Lei Mingxuan once again sincerely apologized for standing her up last time. Song Jia graciously accepted, and the two agreed to go night skating every Friday from now on, and planned to sign up together for the roller skating orienteering race to be held at Shanghai City Beach next month. The whole route was about 10 kilometers. The two took a group photo at the finish line, and Lei Mingxuan felt a long-lost sense of ease and happiness.
location: Along the route from Lujiazui Riverside Park to Laobaidu Riverside Greenbelt, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Return: washing up and weighing in.
description: After the night ride event, Lei Mingxuan said goodbye to Song Jia, scanned the code to unlock a shared bike, and rode for 20 minutes back to his home in Shanggang Community. Once home, he immediately showered to wash off the sweat and fatigue, then stood barefoot on the digital scale. It read 81.0 kg, a little lighter than in the morning, which comforted him somewhat.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Discussed novel writing with my good friend Gao Yuan
description: After washing up, Lei Mingxuan saw Gao Yuan, a fellow anime enthusiast, send him a WeChat message asking about the progress of the novel. Leaning back in the chair in his study, he replied that he was unsure about the details of old Shanghai in the Republican-era business-war genre, such as street vehicles, rickshaw styles, and shop clerks' clothing. Gao Yuan was very interested and immediately shared a collection of old photographs of the Republican era and several e-books, which described the clothing, transportation, and street scenes of that era in great detail. The two discussed the story's worldview and character settings via voice while browsing the materials, and before they knew it, they had chatted until 11:30 at night.
location: Study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening review and going to sleep
description: After finishing the chat with Gao Yuan, Lei Mingxuan lay down on the bed and used his phone's memo app to briefly record the day's key items: insurance consultation still needs follow-up, Xiaohongshu promotion got good feedback, next week's promotion plan was basically settled with Zheng Kai, tonight's roller skating was a blast and he made up with Song Jia. He put down his phone, turned off the bedside lamp, and soon fell asleep feeling happy and grateful.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning coffee and stretching.
description: Got up at 6:30 in the morning, boiled water, and hand-brewed a cup of Costa Rican honey-processed coffee. Using a three-stage pour at 91°C, I tasted honey-like sweetness and nutty notes, and recorded the flavor profile in my June Coffee Log. Then I laid out a yoga mat on the floor and stretched to ease the soreness in my thighs from last night's roller skating. I loosened up with Cat-Cow and Downward Dog, followed by three sets of planks, building energy for today's lakeside hike.
location: Living room at home, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organized gear and said goodbye to mother
description: Loaded the camping gear packed the night before—the double-layer tent, sleeping bag, inflatable pad, gas stove, folding table and chairs, books, speaker, and more—into the SUV trunk in the underground garage. Just as he was about to leave, his mother Wang Xiuying leaned out of the kitchen and handed him a box of washed blueberries and cut cantaloupe, reminding him to put on extra clothes because it gets cold by the lake at night. Lei Mingxuan patted his mother on the shoulder to reassure her, and following the agreement from yesterday's diet adjustment, took a large bottle of water from the fridge, said goodbye to his mother, and got ready to drive off.
location: At home in Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the community underground parking lot.

name: Drive to Dianshan Lake and set up camp
description: He set off from Zhangyang Huayuan at 8:30, first stopped at a gas station to fill up, then got on the Yan'an Elevated Road and turned onto the Huqingping Highway. Along the way, he listened to a podcast on wilderness survival skills to ease the wait caused by weekend outbound traffic. About 1 hour 40 minutes later, he arrived at a quiet, flat grassy area near Meiyuan in the Dianshan Lake Scenic Area. After parking, he spent 20 minutes setting up the tent, putting up the canopy, laying out the ground mat, unfolding the folding table and chairs, and placing the small speaker, completing the campsite setup.
location: Grass near Meiyuan, Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Jinshang Highway, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Lakeside hiking and nature observation
description: Changed into hiking shoes, took binoculars, and started a roughly 4 km hike along the lakeside ecological trail. Slowing down, he watched egrets flying low over the lake and snapped photos with his phone; by the reeds he saw a little grebe diving to catch fish, lively and amusing. Along the way he jotted down observation details in his notebook, then sat on a stone bench by the lake to drink water and enjoy the lake breeze, feeling all the fatigue accumulated at the store melt away.
location: Dianshan Lake Lakeside Ecological Trail, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Simple camp meal and rest
description: After returning to the campsite, he wiped his hands clean with wet wipes and enjoyed the blueberries and Hami melon his mother had prepared, with whole wheat bread and energy bars as lunch—simple but satisfying amid the lake and mountain scenery. After the meal, he crawled into the tent, zipped down the rainfly, lay on his sleeping bag, and closed his eyes for about half an hour.
location: Meadow campsite near Meiyuan (Plum Garden), Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Jinshang Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Outdoor reading and a call with a friend
description: After the lunch break, he felt refreshed. Sitting on a folding chair, he read "The Biography of Zeng Guofan" recommended by Gao Yuan. He was deeply moved by the chapter "Failing Again and Again but Fighting On" and associated it with his persistence in business. When tired, he did sit-ups and squats on the moisture-proof mat to stretch. At around 2:30 p.m., he called his friend Gao Yuan on WeChat voice. They chatted for nearly forty minutes, sharing the waterbird scenes he'd observed in the morning. Gao Yuan told an anecdote about a comprador in Republican-era Shanghai, and Lei Mingxuan quickly noted it down, intending to use it as material for his novel "Plum Rain."
location: Meadow campsite near Meiyuan (Plum Garden), Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Jinshang Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Conceptualizing novel scenes
description: After hanging up, still in high spirits, he thought about the outline of the novel Plum Rain. Combining the morning lake view and the old Shanghai anecdotes provided by Gao Yuan, he began to conceive a scene of Republican-era literati meeting in secret by the lake on a summer night, and wrote in his notebook keywords such as lake water the color of diluted ink, wind-blown reeds rustling like the sound of fabric rubbing together, and faint mournful cries of distant waterbirds, making the scene come alive immediately.
location: Meadow campsite near Meiyuan (Plum Garden), Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Jinshang Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Camp dinner and cleanup
description: At 4:30 in the afternoon, the sunlight softened and the lake shimmered with golden light. Set up the small gas stove to boil water, cooked a pack of vegetable noodles, and pan-fried a few slices of luncheon meat. Sitting in a folding chair facing the lake, I ate and felt especially satisfied. After the meal, I carefully packed up all kitchen waste and utensils into garbage bags, determined to leave no pollution behind.
location: Meadow campsite near Meiyuan (Plum Garden), Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Jinshang Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Recording Inspiration and Novel Writing
description: The sky gradually darkened, and the lake shifted from gold to ink blue. I turned on my headlamp, spread open my notebook, and recorded the details I had observed all day one by one: the changing colors of the lake, the calls of distant waterbirds, the rustle of reeds in the wind, and the last trace of light on the horizon. I wove these sensory details into the Republican-era summer night secret meeting scene I had conceived earlier and wrote a highly vivid draft.
location: Meadow campsite near Meiyuan (Plum Garden), Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Jinshang Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Tell my mother I'm safe
description: After finishing the novel excerpt, he called his mother Wang Xiuying to tell her he had a great time by the lake today and that the noodles were delicious, and said he would return tomorrow afternoon, so she didn't need to worry. Hearing the relief in his mother's voice, Lei Mingxuan felt at ease.
location: Meadow campsite near Meiyuan (Plum Garden), Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Jinshang Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Stargazing and falling asleep peacefully
description: Night had fully fallen, and the starry sky, free of light pollution, was exceptionally brilliant. He spread out a moisture-proof pad and lay down, using the star chart app on his phone to easily identify the Summer Triangle—Deneb, Altair, and Vega—while imagining the novel's protagonist gazing at the same starry sky. All around were only insect chirps and occasional bird calls; his heart was at peace. At 8:30 PM, feeling a bit cold, he crawled back into the tent, zipped up his sleeping bag, drank a few mouthfuls of hot water, and fell sound asleep amid the white noise of insects and gentle waves lapping the shore.
location: Grassland campsite near Meiyuan, Dianshan Lake Scenic Area, Jinshang Highway, Qingpu District, Shanghai, and inside the tent.

name: Morning run of 5 km along the Dianshan Lake shoreline.
description: At 6 a.m. sharp, Lei Mingxuan crawled out of the tent. The air by the lake was fresh. He put on quick-dry clothes and running shoes, used his new sports watch to control his heart rate, and deliberately held a 5:50 per km pace along the Dianshan Lake lakeside road. Morning mist hung over the lake and the sun was rising. After finishing 5 km with an average heart rate of 155 bpm, he felt slight tightness in the back of his thighs while stretching, but he was fully awake.
location: Dianshan Lake Ring Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai (running track near Meiyuan Camp)

name: Homemade lakeside breakfast at the campsite.
description: After returning to the campsite, Lei Mingxuan fried two sunny-side-up eggs on the gas stove, heated a carton of whole milk, and served them with multigrain bread and fruit salad for breakfast. Sitting on the waterproof mat facing the lake, he ate slowly, and after exercise the food tasted especially good. After the meal, he wiped the utensils clean with wet wipes, took a photo, and posted it on WeChat Moments with the caption 'Good morning, Dianshan Lake'.

On the way, he listened to the podcast 'Now Left, Now Right'. He stopped at the G50 Qingpu service area for 5 minutes to buy an iced Red Bull for a pick-me-up, and finally arrived at the Zhangyang Road residential complex at 10:30.
location: During the drive from Meiyuan Campsite, Dianshan Lake Ring Road, Qingpu District, Shanghai, to No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rest and Dry Gear at Home

He threw the changed-out quick-dry clothes into the washing machine and weighed himself: 81.0 kg, the same as yesterday.

name: Had a light lunch with his parents

location: Home Chinese Restaurant at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

Last night's scheduled teaser post had received 62 likes and 19 comments. He replied to a few questions, then went to the study to pour a glass of plain boiled water, saving his energy for the afternoon lucky draw.

He also went over the copy he had finalized with Shen Jie and prepared screenshots of the store's new products and canned responses for customer interaction.

We'll draw one winner to receive a 300-yuan store voucher + a Pop Mart blind box! Follow + Like + Comment with the code phrase 'Summer refresh, here I come!' to enter!” He monitored the backend data in real time; the number of participants quickly exceeded 100, and in less than an hour it surpassed 300. He used the store manager account to reply to questions about using the prize, and by 15:30, interactions had exceeded 520.

location: Home Study, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

Xiao Lin replied instantly with praise and invited him to play basketball; Shen Jie sent a long voice message with dietary reminders and shared a low-fat recipe link. Lei Mingxuan felt warm inside.

Then he walked along Zhangyang Road to near the entrance of Lujiazui Central Greenland Park, and strolled for ten minutes on the path under the plane trees, relieving eye strain and neck discomfort.

Lei Mingxuan mentioned that the afternoon lottery event had received over 500 interactions. His mother smiled in approval and reminded him to bring fruit to the store. His father listened quietly nearby, occasionally nodding.
location: Home Chinese Restaurant at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Gear organization and next-day work preparation

location: Balcony and study at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

After finishing, he ranted about the plot with his friend Gao Yuan on WeChat. Gao Yuan replied with a crying-laughing emoji, and the two agreed to play online games together next week to relax and decompress.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

description: Lei Mingxuan decided to go to bed early. He took a comfortable hot shower and changed into loose cotton pajamas. After washing up, he weighed himself at 80.9 kg, slightly lower than yesterday, and felt satisfied.
location: Home washroom, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

description: Lei Mingxuan leaned against the headboard and reviewed the day: the morning run was comfortable, the campsite was packed up cleanly, the lucky draw was a hit, and his fitness plan won praise—he felt fulfilled. Then he read more than ten pages of The Biography of Zeng Guofan. When he reached the part about the Xiang Army's difficult early decisions, he gradually felt sleepy.

He gradually woke up fully.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

While eating, he shared amusing stories from yesterday's camping trip with his mother, such as the sounds of wild ducks at night and what he saw during his morning run. His mother listened with great interest and reminded him to pay attention to healthy eating even when busy at work.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

Next, he unpacked the newly arrived cargo shorts, hung and steamed each piece, and put them on display, while adjusting the fall new-product display to prepare for the coming sales season.

While waiting for the food, he opened Alipay and carefully compared million-yuan medical insurance products from companies such as Ping An Health. In the end, he chose a Ping An Health insurance plan with an annual premium of 800 yuan. He honestly checked the health disclosure items, added remarks about the slight abnormalities in last week's physical examination, completed the payment, and received the electronic policy.

Lei Mingxuan greeted them warmly, recommended the new functional cargo shorts for try-on, and brought up a Xiaohongshu operation tips sharing event. While waiting, he used WeChat to briefly confirm details of the next day's joint promotion with property manager Zheng Kai, such as the stage sound check time. After getting his coffee, he stopped briefly in the mall's atrium rest area, observed the foot traffic downstairs, then returned to the store.

After 6:30 p.m., foot traffic decreased, so he used the time to process the 6 online orders that had accumulated during the day, printing shipping labels and packing them one by one. Near closing time, he counted the day's cash and online payments, totaling about 4,200 yuan. At exactly 9 p.m., he turned off the store lights, pulled down the rolling shutter door, and closed for business.

The evening breeze brushed his face, blowing away the fatigue of the day. He stopped at the 'Yanqin Grocery Store' at the entrance of the residential community and bought two dragon fruits and a bunch of bananas as supplies for the next morning's breakfast and post-workout recovery.

He completed three sets of planks, three sets of 15 lying leg raises, and three sets of 20 Russian twists, followed by 10 minutes of high-intensity interval training, including jumping jacks and simulated jump rope, repeated for four rounds. After the workout he was drenched in sweat and felt thoroughly refreshed.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

He sent a thank-you message to Qian Duoduo, saw that the sports buddies group was planning to play ball on Wednesday, and replied that he would join. After browsing Moments for a while, he turned off the lights and went to bed around 11 PM.
location: Room 302, Unit 2, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

Lei Mingxuan got up, spread a yoga mat in the living room, warmed up for 5 minutes, then completed 3 sets of 25 sit-ups and 3 sets of 60-second planks, and successfully pushed through 3 sets of 20 push-ups, breaking his personal record. Drenched in sweat after the workout, he took a mirror selfie to record his body changes and posted a Moments post visible only to himself as a keepsake.

He told his mother about buying insurance the day before and his high cholesterol from the physical exam, saying he had started adjusting his diet and exercise. His mother reminded him to take care of his health.

location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

Then he sorted the newly arrived summer T-shirts, put them on the shelves by color and size, took photos, and posted them on the store's WeChat Moments.

He consulted the doctor in detail about next week's follow-up and the adoption process, and decided to adopt it. Then he drove back, thinking on the way about whether there was space at home for a cat tree. At 11:30 he returned to the Super Brand Mall parking lot.

He jotted down key data in his phone's memo app, planning to discuss it with his parents in the evening.

When I got home, my mother was cooking, and we had dinner together: stir-fried amaranth, loofah and egg soup, and braised beef. I deliberately didn’t eat rice and only ate until I was 70% full. After dinner, I went back to my room, changed into sports shorts, a quick-dry T-shirt, and running shoes, put on a sports armband, and put my phone and keys in it.

Then turned off the last light, locked the store door, took out the sports bottle, filled it with hot water, opened the Codoon app and set it to outdoor running mode. He took the opportunity to mention his plan to adopt a stray cat. Aunt Zhu warmly shared her experience and agreed to let him pick up an old cat tree from her house on the weekend.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai: the area along Zhangyang Road to Yuanshen Road and the garden at Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Go home, take a shower, and discuss insurance with his parents
description: After going home, taking a hot shower, and changing into loungewear, I sat down next to my parents, took out the insurance notes on my phone, and explained the pros and cons and premiums of the two products in simple, plain language. My father frowned slightly but listened carefully; my mother kept saying 'buying insurance is not as good as saving money,' but after the explanation they agreed in their hearts, and I left time for them to think it over.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Before-bed entertainment and contacting my cousin
description: Back in his room, he watched the latest Jujutsu Kaisen episode on his iPad and sent a WeChat message to his cousin Shen Jie saying he planned to adopt a stray cat. She replied, 'You've finally come around,' and sent links to reviews of several imported cat food brands.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Pre-bed review and planning
description: Turned off the iPad and reviewed the day: looked at cats, checked insurance, went for a run, and got cat toys from Aunt Zhu. Very productive. In the memo, noted tomorrow's tasks: go to Aunt Zhu's house to pick up cat toys and find Zheng Kai to get the promotion confirmation letter. Set the alarm, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Morning wake-up routine and breakfast at home.
description: He woke up naturally before the phone alarm rang. After a simple stretch, he weighed 80.9 kg, maintaining it well. While he was washing up, his mother had already prepared small wontons and cucumber salad. During breakfast, he chatted with his mother about the anime he watched last night and mentioned picking up the cat tree in the afternoon. After the meal, he watered the pothos on the windowsill, feeling pleasant.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Pick up the cat tree from neighbor Aunt Zhu's house.
description: Carrying a large eco-friendly bag, I walked to Aunt Zhu's place in the next unit. She had already disassembled a wooden cat tree that was 70–80% new and placed it at the door, along with a cat food bowl and a teaser wand as extras. Her British Shorthair blue cat, 'Mimi', curiously pawed at the connectors. We chatted about A Fu's situation, and Aunt Zhu enthusiastically recommended a cat food group-buy. After saying goodbye, I temporarily stored the cat tree in my own storage room.
location: Aunt Zhu's home, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the store
description: Decided to walk to the store, heading along Zhangyang Road toward Lujiazui for about 20 minutes. Passing by 'Old Wang's Potstickers', I was drawn in by the aroma. Arrived at the mall staff entrance shortly after 9 o'clock, clocked in with facial recognition, and entered.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store opening preparations and handling business affairs
description: Open the store door, check the cash register system and online orders; there are two orders that need to be shipped. Wipe down the fitting room, display stands, and cashier counter with disinfectant wipes. Confirm the weekend joint promotion with property manager Zheng Kai on WeChat, forward it, and confirm by voice message. Sort through the new batch of fall sample garments, steam them, style outfits, and adjust the displays. Brew a cup of drip coffee and sort out today's priorities.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the pet hospital
description: Asked Xiao Li, the clerk at the neighboring milk tea shop, to help watch the store, then walked out the back door of the mall to the pet hospital. Laoshan Road is not far, about a 15-minute walk. The weather was sunny and my mood was good.
location: Shanghai Youya Pet Hospital, No. 365 Laoshan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Visit the orange tabby A Fu and confirm the adoption.
description: At the hospital, I saw A Fu. It actively rubbed against my hand, purred, and rolled over to show its belly. I recorded a video and sent it to the "Happy Family" family group; Mom and Dad replied instantly in support. I discussed adoption with Dr. Wang, filled out the adoption intention form, and agreed to pick up the cat on Saturday at 10 a.m. Dr. Wang reminded me to secure the windows, transition the cat food gradually, and get vaccinated after one week. I noted all these reminders in my phone memo.
location: Shanghai Youya Pet Hospital, No. 365 Laoshan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return to the store
description: Walking back from the pet hospital to the Super Brand Mall store, in a great mood and with a brisk step.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch
description: After processing and shipping the online orders, I locked the shop door and went to 'Niushanfang' on B1 of IFC Mall, where I ordered a sukiyaki beef set meal with less oil and less sauce. While waiting, I scrolled through Xiaohongshu outfit notes, liking and saving autumn outfit inspiration.
location: Niushanfang, B1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Create a long-form story graphic for the store
description: He put up a sign that said 'Filming original content,' then took his laptop and phone to the sofa by the window on the second floor of the store. He sorted through store photos from opening to now: the bare concrete space, the first selfie when hanging clothes, a photo with the first customer, packing orders during the pandemic, the renovation, and so on. He used design software to make a long timeline image, adding heartfelt copy about his entrepreneurial journey and challenges. After nearly two hours of repeated polishing, he posted it to RED and WeChat Moments, tagging loyal customers and friends and family who had supported him.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations and content feedback interaction
description: A customer came into the store to try on clothes. While warmly greeting them, I managed to check the feedback. Within half an hour, the WeChat Moments post had over 100 likes, and the comments were full of emotion and support. Old customers on Xiaohongshu also shared memories. I carefully replied to each one. Qian Duoduo, a regular customer, saw the post and made a special trip to the store. She praised the long story graphic and discussed outfit suggestions for the weekend market.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing-up preparations and commuting to the billiard hall
description: At 17:30 he closed the store on time, packed up, and walked about 15 minutes from Super Brand Mall along Lujiazui Ring Road to World Plaza on South Pudong Road. On the way, he sent Han Dong a voice message to confirm the table reservation.
location: World Square Billiard Hall, B1 Floor, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Billiards activity
description: Played American 8-ball with Han Dong, with wins and losses on both sides. During the conversation, Lei Mingxuan mentioned that his fitness plan was going well and his body fat rate had dropped after controlling his diet. He then invited Han Dong for a 5 km morning run at Lujiazui Green the next morning, and Han Dong agreed.
location: World Square Billiard Hall, B1 Floor, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Light late-night snack
description: The two went to the Ippudo ramen shop on Shangcheng Road. Lei Mingxuan ordered the special soy sauce ramen with less oil and no broth, while Han Dong ordered the signature ramen. While waiting, they chatted about the anime Kaiju No. 8 and new-energy vehicles. Lei Mingxuan held back and did not drink the pork bone broth, only eating the noodles and toppings. Seeing this, Han Dong also said he would eat lighter next time.
location: Ippudo Ramen, 357 Shangcheng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk home
description: Said goodbye to Han Dong at the intersection and walked home to aid digestion, about 30 minutes. At the fruit shop by the neighborhood gate, I bought half a watermelon.
location: Near the home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Casual chat with father at night.
description: After getting home, his mother was watching a TV drama and his father was watering tomatoes and peppers on the balcony. Lei Mingxuan cut a watermelon and brought it to the balcony, then showed his father the feedback comments on the story graphic. His father put on reading glasses and read each one, his face full of gratification. He recalled his initial worries and support for Lei Mingxuan's business and advised him that the excitement and praise in business are temporary; he shouldn't get carried away, because health and reputation last, and steady work won't be treated unfairly. Lei Mingxuan nodded seriously and kept it in mind.
location: Home balcony, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening wrap-up and family time
description: Returned from the balcony to the living room to watch an urban drama with his mother and confirmed the plan to pick up A Fu together on Saturday morning. Back in his room, he screenshotted classic comments as promotional material, replied to Zhang Wei and Li Na in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat, chatted online with Gao Yuan about the latest Jujutsu Kaisen plot, and planned to play games on the weekend. At 22:40 he washed up, briefly reviewed tomorrow's to-dos (shipping, picking up the cat, putting new sample clothes on the shelves), and then went to sleep.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Morning fat-burning and tomorrow's plan
description: He set out at 6:50 in the morning and met his friend Han Dong at the entrance of Lujiazui Central Green Park. They warmed up for 5 minutes first, then jogged 4 km along the rubberized track at a pace of about 6:10 per kilometer while chatting. Lei Mingxuan told Han Dong that tomorrow morning he planned to go pick up his adopted orange tabby cat A Fu and wanted to ask him to drive over to help carry cat supplies. Han Dong readily agreed, and they arranged for him to come by car at 10:00 a.m. the next day. After the run, they walked another 5 minutes to cool down, and Lei Mingxuan felt great all over.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Resting at home and breakfast
description: After parting with Han Dong, Lei Mingxuan walked 8 minutes back to his home at Zhangyang Garden. At the door, he first stepped on the scale: 80.8 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday. He was satisfied with his fitness progress. After showering, he changed into a black techwear T-shirt and khaki cargo shorts. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had already prepared breakfast: pan-fried buns, multigrain porridge, and vinegar. As Lei Mingxuan ate heartily, he told his mother he was going to pick up the cat tomorrow. His mother smiled with crinkled eyes and said that having a little creature at home would make things much livelier, and that she would go buy some dried fish snacks tomorrow.
location: Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shop opening preparations and online order processing
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan rode a shared bike along Zhangyang Road for 10 minutes to reach Super Brand Mall. After arriving at the store, he first turned on the lights and air conditioning, then reorganized the clothes that had been hung up the night before. Then he sat at the cash register, turned on the computer, logged into the store backend, and processed the 12 online orders left from the previous night, checking styles and sizes one by one and printing shipping labels. Next, he replied to 23 new comments under the long-image post “My Store Opening Story” published yesterday, sent direct messages to several returning customers who placed orders to express thanks, and included a 10 yuan coupon as a little surprise.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Visited the orange cat for the third time and submitted a pre-adoption application.
description: After telling Han Dong on WeChat that he was on his way, Lei Mingxuan walked 8 minutes to Shanghai Youya Pet Hospital. As soon as he walked in, he saw Ah Fu, an orange cat, lazily licking his paw in the cage. Seeing Lei Mingxuan, Ah Fu immediately got up, trotted to the edge of the cage, and rubbed his head against Lei Mingxuan's hand. The veterinarian smiled and said Ah Fu already considered him one of his own. Lei Mingxuan talked carefully with the doctor, filled out the Initial Stray Animal Adoption Application Form, and asked about the specific arrangements for follow-up vaccinations, deworming, and neutering. Before leaving, he recorded a short video of Ah Fu and sent it to the family group chat and Moments with the caption "Bring home a new family member tomorrow, officially announcing it!" The post quickly received many likes and comments.
location: Shanghai Youya Pet Hospital, Shangcheng Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Store operations and warm-up for the official online announcement
description: Back at Mingxuan Wardrobe, Lei Mingxuan was in a great mood. As he unpacked a new batch of summer printed T-shirts and hung them on the shelves, he scrolled through Moments. The 'official announcement' video was already buzzing. His cousin Shen Jie sent a direct message asking if he needed a cat food brand recommendation and said she knew a lot about it. Regular customer Qian Duoduo also sent a WeChat message complimenting Boss Lei for managing both life and work well. Lei Mingxuan happily replied to each one.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and online socializing
description: At noon, he went to Wagas on the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall for lunch and ordered a grilled beef energy bowl and a glass of freshly squeezed orange juice. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan continued replying to comments on Moments on his phone and received a message from his friend Gao Yuan on QQ asking about the progress of his novel. Lei Mingxuan replied that if he felt inspired when he got home in the evening, he would write, and once finished, he would send it to him to read.
location: Wagas, B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Busy work at the store and inventory counting
description: After lunch he returned to the store. In the afternoon foot traffic increased noticeably, and several customers came specifically because of the long image he had posted the day before. Lei Mingxuan enthusiastically helped them put together outfits and was extremely busy. In the end, he closed four orders with total sales of about 850 yuan. In between, he managed to go to the warehouse and count the stock for the weekend "Summer Cool Special" event, confirming sufficient inventory. Around 3:30 pm, regular customer Qian Duoduo came to the store in person. She immediately spotted a new black functional-style vest on display, tried it on, was very pleased, and paid on the spot, telling Lei Mingxuan to send her photos of new arrivals first next time.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ordered pet supplies for Afu
description: Taking advantage of a lull with fewer customers in the store, Lei Mingxuan took out his phone, opened Taobao, and bought supplies for Afu, who was about to arrive home. He ordered a well-reviewed light-gray cat bed, a semi-enclosed litter box, a set of cat teasers with bells, and several plush mice. He entered the home address and chose next-day delivery to ensure the items would arrive tomorrow morning.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations and weekend promotion setup
description: Lei Mingxuan began setting up the weekend promotion, placing the standing sign reading “Summer Cool Special” at the store entrance. Property manager Zheng Kai passed by, and the two confirmed details about the booth location for the weekend’s joint mall promotion, chatting for about 10 minutes. Afterward, Lei Mingxuan also attended to several walk-in customers and handled the new online orders from the afternoon.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute after closing the shop and a simple meal on the way
description: Today, Lei Mingxuan decided to close the store half an hour early. He quickly tidied the checkout counter, checked the power, and pulled down the roller shutter. He then rode a shared bike along Lujiazui Ring Road to Binjiang Avenue. On the way, he bought a herb chicken bagel at the 'bread etc.' bakery. Without time to sit down, he munched on it while walking, just to take the edge off his hunger.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Meet Song Jia at Yicang Art Museum.
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at the usual spot in front of the Yichang Art Museum, where his friend Song Jia was already waiting. She was wearing a fluorescent green quick-dry top and black leggings, with protective gear on, leaning against the railing in the breeze. The two greeted each other with a high-five. While tying his roller skate laces, Lei Mingxuan excitedly told Song Jia that he had already filled out the adoption form for Afu and would go pick up the cat tomorrow. Song Jia happily patted him on the shoulder and congratulated him, saying that her cat Doudou would finally have a neighbor, and that she would share her cat-raising tips while skating tonight.
location: In front of Shanghai Art Warehouse, No. 4777 Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Night run along the riverfront and exchange of cat-raising tips.
description: Lei Mingxuan and Song Jia skated one after the other along the riverside rollerblading path, maintaining a speed of about 18 km/h. While skating, Song Jia imparted cat-raising knowledge to Lei Mingxuan – saying not to buy cheap low-quality cat food, to keep plenty of cat scratching boards to prevent the cat from scratching the sofa, and to avoid picking it up by force for the first three days at home so that it could get familiar with the environment on its own. They skated past the Laobaidu Riverside Greenbelt, and eventually looped around to under the Lujiazui Circular Footbridge, where they took a photo with the dazzling Oriental Pearl Tower as the backdrop. Lei Mingxuan posted the photo on Moments with the caption: “Tonight's roller-skating class was a cat-ownership experience exchange conference! Thanks, Teacher Song.”
location: From Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the Lujiazui Loop (from Shanghai Yicang Art Museum via Laobaidu Riverside Greenbelt to Lujiazui Ring Road)

name: Returning home and late-night creation
description: After saying goodbye to Song Jia in front of the Yicang Art Museum, Lei Mingxuan rode a shared bike home in 15 minutes. After taking a hot shower and changing into comfortable loungewear, he sat down at his desk, opened his laptop, and created a new document to continue writing his novel "Plum Rain". Inspired by the Republic-era atmosphere from last week's camping trip and this evening's pleasant mood, he wrote 1,600 characters in one go, delicately depicting the protagonist sorting through old belongings in the attic, even working out the details of the qipao's frog buttons. He sent the finished passage to Gao Yuan on QQ. Gao Yuan quickly replied and sent over a photo of an old Republic-era sewing machine, suggesting adding more period texture. The two discussed it for 20 minutes. Lei Mingxuan took the suggestion and felt the passage immediately became more vivid.
location: Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and bedtime
description: Having finished writing for the time being, Lei Mingxuan felt very satisfied. He turned off the computer, stretched, and saw new comments from Qian Duoduo and Song Jia on his Moments, so he briefly replied. Lying in bed, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu for a while and checked the logistics information for the cat bed he had bought for Afu; it showed the package had arrived at the Shanghai transfer station and would definitely arrive tomorrow morning. Satisfied, he turned off his phone, put his ID card and some change for tomorrow on the bedside table, then turned off the light and went to sleep. Thinking that he could bring Afu home tomorrow, he smiled and soon fell asleep.
location: Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning pour-over coffee and flavor notes
description: When the alarm went off, Lei Mingxuan got up and did 10 push-ups to wake himself up. He deliberately chose the newly purchased Yunnan Pu'er coffee beans and skillfully ground, bloomed, and poured. The kitchen filled with the aroma of coffee. After tasting, he recorded the brewing parameters and flavor notes in the memo app on his phone, and also took a photo of the steaming coffee cup as a keepsake.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Short morning run in the park to stay in shape.
description: Lei Mingxuan put on his running shoes and jogged toward Lujiazui Central Green Park. Given the tight schedule, he only ran 3 kilometers to stay in shape. On the park trail he ran into Aunt Zhu, a neighbor who was also exercising in the morning. Smiling, she asked about the preparations for picking up the cat and told him the cat tree had been placed in the storage room and could be taken anytime. Lei Mingxuan thanked her repeatedly, then easily completed the run at a six-and-a-half-minute pace. Refreshed and sweaty, he returned home.
location: Lujiazui Center Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Shower, breakfast, and confirming the items for picking up the cat
description: After running home, Lei Mingxuan took a quick shower and then had breakfast with his mother, Wang Xiuying. His mother had prepared wontons and fried eggs and asked with concern what time they would pick up the cat, joking about whether she should cook a fish to welcome it. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan checked his phone to confirm that the cat food, cat bed, and other packages he had ordered online had been signed for and stored in the community parcel locker, planning to pick them up on his way home.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Groomed and got ready to go out.
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into his newly bought mountain-style tech vest and dark gray casual pants, and carefully checked his appearance. He put the printed manuscript of the novel Plum Rain into his sling bag, then confirmed one by one that his phone, power bank, charging cable, and keys were all with him. Before leaving, he paused to glance at the corner reserved for the cat in the living room and couldn't help but smile.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Historical fiction writing workshop graduation showcase
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived on time at the Cloud Humanities Space on the 34th floor of the Shanghai World Financial Center for the final class and graduation showcase of the writing workshop. As a student representative, he went on stage and read an excerpt from his own work "Plum Rain," deliberately speaking slower in Mandarin with a slight Shanghainese accent, telling the ordinary stories of the alleyways with delicate warmth. After the reading, his instructor Teacher Zhao commented that it had "truthful details and restrained emotion, a very good opening." Many classmates proactively exchanged contact information with him and agreed to continue communicating online.
location: Cloud Humanities Space, 34th Floor, Shanghai World Financial Center, 100 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Celebratory dinner for completing the course, with a focus on healthy eating.
description: After class, Lei Mingxuan went downstairs with Gao Yuan, Li Hui, and two other like-minded classmates for a meal at Chao Niu Ji Beef Hotpot. He took the lead in ordering the clear broth base, and chose a vegetable platter and fresh beef tenderloin for himself, strictly following his principle of light oil and salt. As they cooked meat in the hotpot, they had a lively discussion about modern and contemporary Chinese history and the ideas for their own stories, and the atmosphere was pleasant.
location: Chaoniuji Beef Hotpot, B1 Floor, Shanghai World Financial Center, 100 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Coffee shop socializing and technical exchange
description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan walked to the coffee here café on Lujiazui Ring Road. As soon as he entered, he shared the joy of completing the course with barista Xiao Zhou, then proactively asked about advancing his pour-over techniques. Xiao Zhou used a Costa Rican black honey coffee bean to demonstrate water temperature control and how the fineness of the water stream changes during a three-stage pour. Lei Mingxuan watched closely, then brewed a pot himself and found that the sweetness and body had noticeably improved. The two added each other's personal WeChat and agreed to keep in touch for future exchanges.
location: coffee here (Huaneng Store), No. 958 Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Set off for the pet hospital to meet up with Han Dong.
description: Lei Mingxuan sent a WeChat message to his friend Han Dong in advance to arrange to meet at the pet hospital. Then he walked from the café to South Pudong Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 2 and transferred to Line 6 to reach Pudian Road Station, and then walked about 5 minutes to Shanghai Youya Pet Hospital. At the hospital entrance, he met Han Dong, who had already arrived by car, and the two entered the hospital together.
location: Shanghai Youya Pet Hospital, Shangcheng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Officially adopt Afu and bring him home
description: At the pet hospital, the veterinarian confirmed that the orange tabby Afu had recovered well and was ready for formal adoption. The nurse placed Afu in a carrier and handed it to Lei Mingxuan. The little fellow was a bit nervous but gently rubbed against his hand. Lei Mingxuan soothed it softly, and then Han Dong drove them home. Along the way, the two chatted about funny cat-raising stories. After arriving at the apartment building, Lei Mingxuan thanked Han Dong and promised to treat him to a meal another day.
location: From Shanghai Youya Pet Hospital, Shangcheng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road.

name: Settling A Fu and arranging the new home
description: After arriving home, Lei Mingxuan first took the cat bed, litter box, and toys out of the parcel locker, then opened the pet carrier and let Ah Fu slowly come out to explore the living room. His father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying stood around curiously, watching Lei Mingxuan quickly set up the cat bed in the corner of the sofa and put out cat food, water, and litter. After looking around, Ah Fu finally hid in the new bed, seemingly satisfied with the new home.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Accompanied parents for a walk in the park and shared the day's moments
description: While Afu was getting used to the new environment, Lei Mingxuan suggested accompanying his parents for a walk in Lujiazui Central Green Park. In the early evening, a gentle breeze was blowing. The family of three strolled slowly along the familiar paths. He told them in detail about being praised by the teacher in his writing class and even read a few lines from his novel to them. His mother, Wang Xiuying, though she could not quite understand it, kept saying it was good. His father, Lei Jianguo, praised him for being able to persist in what he loved. The family chatted about the funny moments of picking up the cat, and the atmosphere was warm and everyday.
location: Lujiazui Center Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Buy groceries on the way to prepare for dinner
description: On the walk back, Lei Mingxuan and his father Lei Jianguo stopped by the Pushang vegetable market on the way, bought some fresh vegetables and a crucian carp to prepare dinner, and also as a celebration of the new addition to the family.
location: Pushang Market on Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Dinner and family time
description: Dinner was cooked by mother Wang Xiuying: steamed sea bass, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. Afu finally came out of his bed while everyone was eating, cautiously circling around the table legs. Lei Mingxuan dipped his finger in the fish and let Afu smell it. The little one licked it and made a soft purring sound. Mother finally couldn't help but gently stroke him, her face beaming. The whole family enjoyed dinner together happily.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Personal organizing, online sharing, and creative interaction
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan returned to his room, selected photos from the writing showcase, the café, and picking up the cat, carefully arranged them, and posted a WeChat Moments update. Friends including Gao Yuan, Lin Jing, and Song Jia liked and commented one after another. He had an in-depth discussion with Gao Yuan on WeChat about the on-site feedback from the writing showcase and revised two paragraphs of his novel based on the suggestions. He replied to Lin Jing's comments about Afu and the blind boxes, and also sent a short video of Afu playing with a laser pointer to Song Jia, who had asked about cat care.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Free relaxation time
description: Lei Mingxuan came to the living room, and Ah Fu was pawing at the little fish toy. He sat down on the sofa, opened Bilibili, and browsed a few new videos from history-zone content creators and one episode of the anime Jujutsu Kaisen. Ah Fu, tired from playing, jumped onto the sofa, curled up beside his leg, and closed its eyes, making him feel the down-to-earth satisfaction after a busy day.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up and getting ready for bed
description: Lei Mingxuan turned off the video, carefully picked up Afu and put him back into the cat bed, checked the cat food and water, and then went to wash up. While brushing his teeth, he smiled at himself in the mirror, feeling that everything about the day was just right.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Sleep
description: Lei Mingxuan lay down on the bed, reviewed the perfect day, and felt full of new expectations for tomorrow and life ahead. He quickly fell asleep. His weight was stable at the target of 80.8 kg, his diet had been well controlled all day, and his step count was far above 8,000 steps; he was in good physical condition.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning wake-up, washing up, and weighing in
description: On Sunday morning, the alarm rang an hour later than usual. The first thing he did after waking up was step on the scale. Seeing 80.7kg, the same as yesterday, he felt a bit relieved. Then he went to the bathroom to wash up, looked at his complexion in the mirror, and felt full of energy.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, master bedroom/bathroom

name: Interact with pets and share on WeChat Moments
description: I opened the bedroom door, and the cat Afu was sharpening its claws on the scratching post. I squatted down and scratched its chin, and it immediately squinted and purred. I seized the chance to snap nine photos of it sunbathing on the balcony and playing with toys, and posted them on Moments to announce the arrival of a new roommate, with the caption “Welcome, new roommate! Please take care of me from now on, little Afu~” plus cute emojis.
location: China, Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, living room

name: Having breakfast with mother
description: Mother Wang Xiuying had prepared breakfast: pan-fried buns, boiled eggs, and a small bowl of multigrain porridge. After sitting down, she asked how A Fu was last night. I said there was some noise in the middle of the night, but it wasn't a big deal. Mother comforted me that a new environment takes a few days to get used to. As I ate, I habitually drained the excess oil from the pan-fried buns.
location: Restaurant, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Organizing writing materials and making a creation plan.
description: After tidying up the dishes and chopsticks, he brewed a cup of light tea and went to the study. He opened his laptop and organized yesterday's workshop notes, the stories his father told about the old Yangpu factories, and the Republican-era historical materials sent by Gao Yuan into three folders: Historical Background, Character Prototypes, and Plot Inspiration. Then he created a new document and roughed out a writing plan: write a 1,000-word first draft every Friday evening and revise it on weekends. Today's goal was to polish the Plum Rain excerpt to 2,500 words.
location: Study, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Buying coffee beans online and learning pour-over techniques
description: He opened the Taobao app, found the 'Chuncui Coffee' store recommended by his friend Zhou Kai, and ordered two bags of Colombian Huila coffee beans. Then he searched Bilibili for a 'three-stage pouring tutorial video' and, while watching, jotted down key parameters in a notebook: water temperature 92°C, coffee-to-water ratio 1:15, bloom 25 seconds, preparing for the afternoon pour-over coffee.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, study and living room

name: Living room time with family and pets
description: He played with Afu in the living room using a teaser wand. The cat lowered its body and pounced to bite, lively and adorable. Father Lei Jianguo laughed while reading the newspaper, and mother Wang Xiuying praised Afu for being smart as she folded clothes. The family sat together chatting casually, from the cat's food to the placement of the litter box, in a relaxed and warm atmosphere.
location: China, Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, living room

name: Had a healthy lunch together and rested at noon.
description: Lunch was steamed sea bass, blanched Chinese broccoli, and brown rice prepared by his mother according to the new recipe. It was comfortable to eat and light on the stomach. After the meal he voluntarily cleaned up the dishes, then went to his room and lay down for twenty minutes to rest up for the afternoon activities.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, restaurant and bedroom

name: Brewing pour-over coffee and writing tasting notes.
description: After the lunch break, I was full of energy. I went into the kitchen, boiled water, ground the beans, and warmed the cup, then brewed the Costa Rican black honey coffee beans strictly according to the parameters recorded in the morning. The water flow was steady and even, filling the room with caramel and nutty aromas. After tasting, I detected a dark chocolate finish with rich layers. Then I opened my notebook and compiled this month's tastings — Yunnan Pu'er, Brazilian Cerrado, and this black honey coffee — from acidity, sweetness, and body to personal notes, into the "June Coffee Log", feeling quite satisfied.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China; kitchen and living room

name: Chatting with friends in a group to share life.
description: Curled up on the sofa, I sent Ah Fu's photos and the coffee-making video to the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat. Zhang Wei instantly replied with envious comments, and Li Na also said she wanted to come over to pet the cat next time. We all chatted about how we've been, and agreed to get together on a weekend next month.
location: China, Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, living room

name: Reading on the balcony with the cat
description: Picked up "Blossoms" and went to the balcony; it was cloudy with a gentle breeze, perfect. Sitting in the rattan chair, he was immersed in Jin Yucheng's Shanghai-dialect narrative and couldn't help smiling at the parts that resonated. A Fu jumped onto the low stool beside him and lay down at his feet, its tail occasionally sweeping across his ankle. After about an hour, he got up to stretch, and A Fu also stretched lazily.
location: Balcony, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Go to the pet store to buy more cat toys
description: At 4:30 p.m., he took a taxi to Zorro's Pet Store on Jinyan Road. In the store, he picked out a cat teaser wand with a bell, a small catnip pillow, and a new-flavor nutritional hairball paste. At checkout, the clerk warmly reminded him to watch the cat's bowel movements during the initial period of cat ownership and to consult promptly if anything seemed abnormal. After shopping, he took a taxi home and arrived at 5:30 p.m.
location: Zorro's Pet House (Century Park Store), Jinyan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Took a walk around the neighborhood with the cat and met a neighbor
description: After getting home, he put a new leash on A Fu. It struggled at first but soon adapted after being soothed with cat treats. While walking around the residential complex, he met Aunt Zhu, a neighbor walking her dog. She affectionately gave him a small cat tunnel that her own cat had used. A Fu curiously sniffed Aunt Zhu's shoes, and Lei Mingxuan quickly thanked her.
location: Inside the residential compound, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Learning to cook healthy dishes with Mom.
description: He volunteered to learn cooking in the kitchen. Under his mother's guidance, he tried making blanched okra and prepared a dipping sauce with light soy sauce, minced garlic, and vinegar. Although his knife skills were clumsy, the finished dish was praised by his usually taciturn father as "looking decent", giving him a strong sense of accomplishment.
location: Kitchen, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family dinner and warm conversation
description: Dinner featured steamed sea bass, blanched okra, and brown rice. During the meal, my father recalled funny stories from his youth in the factory cafeteria, my mother shared neighborhood gossip, and Ah Fu circled around the table legs begging for food. I stopped my mother, who wanted to give him some fish, reminding her that cats shouldn't eat salty food. After dinner, I took the initiative to wipe the table, fulfilling my part in the family.
location: Restaurant, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening yoga relaxation
description: After resting for half an hour, he spread out the yoga mat, opened the Keep app, and selected a 20-minute flow yoga course. Accompanied by soothing music, he focused on stretching his legs and back that were sore from sitting for long periods and walking. Each movement was slow and focused, and the tension in his body was released with his breath, leaving him completely relaxed.
location: China, Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, living room

name: Binge-watching shows and chatting with friends online
description: After taking a shower, returned to the bedroom, opened the tablet and watched two episodes of the new anime Jujutsu Kaisen. Later, chatted with friend Gao Yuan on WeChat about the plot and shared the results of the afternoon's coffee brewing. Gao Yuan sent a thumbs-up sticker, agreed to come to Shanghai next week to taste the pour-over coffee in person, and planned to play online games together over the weekend.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, bedroom

name: Washing up before bed and going to sleep
description: Put down the phone and went to the bathroom to wash up, carefully flossing and applying moisturizer. Returning to the bedroom, he found Afu already curled up by the pillow purring. He gently stroked the cat, then turned off the light and lay down. He soon fell asleep amid Afu's soft purring, feeling at peace and ready for Monday's work at the clothing store.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning home activities
description: After the alarm went off, he immediately turned over and got out of bed, washed up briefly, and changed into sports shorts and a T-shirt. He walked to the window to tease Ah Fu and plugged in his phone. He spread a yoga mat on the living room floor and did 10 minutes of full-body dynamic stretching, focusing on the back of his thighs and on his neck and shoulders. His mother served boiled eggs, unsweetened soy milk, and two slices of whole-wheat bread for breakfast. While eating, he told his mother that his cousin Shen Jie would come to the shop today and that he would not be home for dinner. After breakfast, he washed the dishes and tidied the kitchen of his own accord, played with Ah Fu using the newly bought cat tunnel, filmed a video of Ah Fu darting all over the house, and posted it on WeChat Moments: "The last day of June, fully charged! I'm going to put in a good practice session tonight!"
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and monthly business review.
description: Put on a clean white T-shirt and dark cargo pants, grabbed a bag and water bottle, and headed out on foot to Super Brand Mall. Along the way, he passed a corner steamed-bun shop, bought a meat bun, and ate it while walking. He arrived at the store about 15 minutes later. He went into the warehouse alone, turned on the computer, and pulled up the June sales system data, purchase receipts, and expense lists. After carefully calculating in Excel, he concluded that June net profit was about 21,000 yuan, a slight 5% increase month-on-month. He analyzed that online traffic was the main reason for the higher average order value and decided to increase the social media budget in July. During the review, he checked his weight records and found that although it had dropped slightly from last week, overall it was up about 3 kilograms from the beginning of the month. He resolved to strictly control his diet and increase exercise in July, aiming to drop to 78 kilograms by the end of the month.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Opening the Shop and Online Operations
description: After officially opening, he fine-tuned the display plan he had conceived the night before, placing the camping-style utility vests and shorts in a prominent position at the entrance. During this period, he handled online order inquiries, packed two packages, and contacted the courier to pick them up. He also edited the video of A Fu he had taken in the morning and posted it to the store's Xiaohongshu account with the caption, 'Goodbye June, hello July! The shopkeeper's fur baby is on duty~'
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handle supplier and property management matters.
description: While the morning foot traffic was light, I called Guangzhou supplier Wu Fang to urge the delivery time of the ordered trendy toy items and asked her to send sample photos. Then on WeChat I finalized the booth application details for next week's Qixi Festival promotion with property manager Zheng Kai.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Review Xiaohongshu operations with his cousin
description: Cousin Shen Jie arrived at the store on time, and the two sat down in the lounge area, each ordering a healthy takeout salad for lunch. Shen Jie showed the Xiaohongshu analytics on her tablet: followers had surpassed 1,000 in one month, with good engagement. They analyzed all 10 posts one by one and found that outfit tutorial posts had the highest engagement rate. After brainstorming, they decided to increase the proportion of video content in July and planned a small offline outfit-sharing event. Shen Jie drew up an initial content calendar for July on her tablet on the spot.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday duty and client communication
description: After Shen Jie left, Lei Mingxuan took over for the staff member to go to lunch and stayed in the store alone. Regular customer Qian Duoduo sent a WeChat message saying she would bring friends to browse in the afternoon. While eating the leftover salad, Lei Mingxuan browsed industry news on his phone, followed several emerging outdoor techwear-style brands, and jotted down design inspiration.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Brainstorm the July marketing plan.
description: There were no customers in the store for the moment. Lei Mingxuan took out his notebook and, based on the morning's financial review and content analysis, drafted a framework for the July marketing plan: continue the camping-themed display, use A Fu's material to create pet-friendly store content, and plan to co-host with the reading group a sharing session on “historical fiction + outdoor functional wear,” with the goal of further driving traffic to the store.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Offline shooting and display adjustment
description: To coordinate with the online content, Lei Mingxuan personally used the store mannequins to set up a camping scene, styling them in the latest mountain-style techwear outerwear and cargo pants. He took more than 20 photos from different angles with his phone, plus a 15-second short video. Then he reorganized the display racks on the right side of the store, hanging the featured items together with matching pieces so customers could try them on easily.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon tea break.
description: Feeling a bit tired, he gave instructions to the store staff, then went downstairs to the Starbucks on the first floor of Super Brand Mall and bought a large iced Americano. He stood in the store, zoning out for a moment while watching the bustling crowd below, then carried the coffee back to the store.
location: Starbucks Coffee, 1st Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Store reception and online processing
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic increased. Lei Mingxuan received three waves of customers one after another, patiently recommending clothes based on their body shapes and styles, and successfully closed two deals totaling 750 yuan. At the same time, he squeezed in handling four or five online messages and after-sales inquiries, and packed the packages to be shipped the next day.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: End-of-shift handover and final inventory
description: Near the end of the shift, I handed over work to Xiao Lin, the clerk coming in for the shift change, and went over the key matters for tomorrow and the online customers still awaiting replies. Then I checked the warehouse inventory and confirmed that several best-selling items needed timely replenishment from the supplier Zhou Tao.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening commute and convenient dinner.
description: After changing out of my work clothes, I left the store, asked Xiaolin to mind the shop, and walked about 15 minutes to the convenience store at Jinmao Tower. There I bought a chicken sandwich and unsweetened yogurt, eating them as dinner while walking.
location: Convenience store, Jin Mao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Gym strength training.
description: He walked about 8 minutes from Jin Mao Tower to the gym at Standard Chartered Bank Tower. He first did 15 minutes of full-body stretching, focusing on relaxing the thighs and hips. Then, to make up for the recent lack of strength training, he did three sets of decline push-ups with drop sets, each set to failure; completed 4 sets of machine leg presses; and finally did several sets of seated rows with resistance bands.
location: Gym at Standard Chartered Bank Building, 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home to shower and weigh in
description: After the training, he walked about 8 minutes back home. After taking a hot shower and changing into loungewear, he couldn't wait to step on the new electronic scale: it read 80.5 kg.
