He took a photo and sent it to the fitness check-in group with the caption: "Last day of June, done! Although I've rebounded 3 kg, the ending is good. July goal: back to 78 kg!" and received likes from several group members.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and quality time
description: His parents had already had dinner, and his mother had kept a meal warm in the pot: a portion of stir-fried seasonal vegetables and a plate of braised pork ribs left over from last night. Lei Mingxuan sat at the dining table to eat. His father watched the news in the living room, and his mother played with A Fu on the sofa. While eating, he talked with his parents about the day's accounting, telling them June's earnings were decent; his father nodded with satisfaction.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Refining plans and writing in a diary
description: After dinner, he went to the study and opened his laptop to further refine the marketing plan framework he had conceived that afternoon: he confirmed that he would release one "Ah Fu's Store Adventure" themed video every Wednesday, and planned the first interactive game. Then he took out his diary and wrote a short entry by hand, summarizing the gains and losses of June and writing down the core goal for July: "Strictly follow the morning runs three times a week, and get weight down to below 80 kg." Ah Fu jumped onto the desk and lay down beside the laptop to keep him company.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leisure, entertainment, and online socializing.
description: After wrapping up that part of work, Lei Mingxuan moved to the living room and cast last week's latest episode of Jujutsu Kaisen to the TV. At the exciting parts, he sent voice messages to his friend Gao Yuan to discuss the plot, and also chatted about plans to play Riders Republic online over the weekend, agreeing to nail down the time on Friday evening.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation and relaxation
description: He turned off the TV, washed up, and returned to the bedroom. Lying in bed, he scrolled through RED on his phone for a while, checked the day's video data, and replied to a few friends' messages. A Fu jumped onto the bed and curled up at his feet. Lei Mingxuan turned off the light and gradually fell asleep listening to A Fu's snoring.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up in the early morning and weighing oneself
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the phone alarm went off right on time. Lei Mingxuan didn't linger in bed; he immediately turned over and got up, stepping barefoot onto the wooden floor and walking to the scale to weigh himself. The screen showed 80.5kg, the same as the previous few days. He patted his belly and resolved that starting in July he must strictly manage his diet.
location: Home bedroom at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run and check-in at Century Park
description: At 6:40, Lei Mingxuan put on his quick-dry clothes and running shoes, left home, walked to Zhangyang Road Metro Station, and took Line 2 one stop to Century Park Station. After exiting the station, he started his morning run along the familiar loop around the park. The morning breeze felt cool, and his pace stayed steady at around 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer. After running 4 kilometers, he did 10 minutes of stretching beside the lawn, took photos of sunlight shining through the leaves, and posted them on WeChat Moments with the caption “New month, new run!”. Then he returned home.
location: Outer running track of Shanghai Century Park, No. 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home, showering, having breakfast, and a conversation to pave the way for getting a cat
description: Arrived home at 7:35, and Lei Mingxuan took a cold shower. At the dining table, his mother Wang Xiuying had prepared fried eggs, whole wheat bread, and unsweetened soy milk. While eating breakfast, he casually mentioned that a friend had asked him to take care of a clean, vaccinated cat, and that he planned to bring it home in the afternoon. His mother frowned in opposition, but his father Lei Jianguo supported his idea. In the end, his mother temporarily stopped objecting, setting the stage for the afternoon pet adoption.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Organizing backpack and confirming online information
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan organized the items he needed to bring that day in his study, including a power bank, store keys, courier waybills, and a copy of 'Plum Rain', into a canvas bag. At the same time, he checked the store's WeChat group and Xiaohongshu backend on his phone, replied to two outfit inquiries from last night, and scheduled an afternoon courier pickup.
location: Home Study, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the store at Super Brand Mall
description: Leaving at 8:50, Lei Mingxuan walked to Century Avenue Metro Station, took Line 2 two stops to Lujiazui Station, exited from Exit 1 and walked through the connecting corridor. On the way, he bought a bottle of iced water at a convenience store, and finally arrived at B1 of Super Brand Mall at 9:20.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai: from Zhangyang Road to Century Avenue Station, take Metro Line 2 to Lujiazui Station, and finally arrive at Super Brand Mall.

name: Store opening preparations and organization
description: Arrived at his store Mingxuan Wardrobe at 9:25, pulled up the rolling shutter, and turned on the air conditioner. After checking yesterday's sales receipts, he organized the shelves, re-hanging and ironing the techwear T-shirts that customers had wrinkled from trying them on, adjusted the mountain-style outfit on the mannequin, and placed the book Plum Rain beside the cash register as inspiration material for the afternoon co-brand sharing event.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, Room A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online communication for planning the co-branded sharing session
description: At exactly 10 o'clock, Lei Mingxuan created a WeChat group called 'July Collab Go Go Go' and added his cousin Shen Jie and regular customer Qian Duoduo. Through long voice messages, he shared his idea for a collaboration campaign centered on the historical novel 'Plum Rain' combined with outdoor-style outfits. Both Shen Jie and Qian Duoduo expressed interest, and the three agreed to each be responsible for store materials, buyer resources, and new media promotion, and to meet up over the weekend to discuss details.
location: Inside the Mingxuan Wardrobe store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and contacting suppliers
description: After hanging up the voice call, Lei Mingxuan attended to in-store customers while processing online orders. He packed two items from yesterday's online orders and contacted the courier to pick them up. During this time, he called supplier Zhou Tao to ask about the delivery of the new Southeast Asian-style shirts. Zhou Tao replied that they would arrive no later than the day after tomorrow.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, Room A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and brainstorming for a co-branded outfit
description: At 11:35 I closed the store and walked to Ippudo at IFC Mall. I ordered a low-oil, low-salt soy sauce ramen and specifically asked not to drink the broth. While waiting, I jotted down outfit ideas for the co-branded event in my phone notes, planning to pair a khaki tech vest with a white linen shirt and olive-green cargo shorts for a striking visual effect.
location: Ippudo, LG1 Floor, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Returning to the shop at noon for a short rest
description: 12:35 returned to the shop. At this time there were no customers in the store. Lei Mingxuan leaned back on the bean bag sofa in the corner, scrolling through Xiaohongshu and Bilibili, watching replays of peers' live streams and replying to comments. At 13:00 he perked up and sat back down at the counter.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, Room A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store reception and after-sales service
description: In the afternoon, I mainly tended the store and communicated online. I received a young couple who came to look at techwear jackets. We chatted for half an hour; although no sale was made, I added them on WeChat. At the same time, I handled an online return/exchange request from yesterday where the wrong size was sent, and patiently reassured the customer Feng Xiaoyu.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, Room A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Confirm the Qixi Festival booth with the property manager
description: At 14:10, Lei Mingxuan left the store and went to the property management office on the 4th floor of the mall to find manager Zheng Kai, in order to finalize the booth for next week's Qixi Festival warm-up event. After offering cigarettes and chatting for about 20 minutes, they confirmed the location, cost, and promotional materials coordination for the 10-square-meter booth next weekend.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Super Brand Mall, 4th floor, mall property management office.

name: Return to continuous store operation and online promotion
description: Returned to the shop at 15:05. As afternoon foot traffic decreased, Lei Mingxuan started managing the Xiaohongshu account, shooting short videos of the new techwear vest with his phone, and scheduling posts with trending BGM and commute-outfit captions. At 17:30 he sorted the change at the cash register, counted the day's revenue, and prepared for closing.
location: Mingxuan Wardrobe, Room A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closed the store and went to the pet hospital to adopt Afu.
description: Closed the store on time at 17:35. Lei Mingxuan rode a shared bike to Lujiazui Metro Station, took Line 10 and transferred to Longxi Road Station, then walked 10 minutes to Yuchongyi Pet Hospital. After finding the doctor, he formally completed the adoption procedures for the orange tabby cat Afu, paid the remaining balance for vaccinations and neutering, and carefully bought the imported cat food, cat litter, toys, and scratching board that it was used to. The doctor advised not to force-hold the cat for the first few days and to let it adapt on its own.
location: Yuchongyi Pet Hospital (Shanghai Main Hospital), 680 Pucheng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Take a taxi home with Afu
description: At 19:05, Lei Mingxuan carefully picked up the pet carrier holding Afu and took a taxi home. On the way, he reached into the carrier and gently stroked the cat's back. Afu gave two soft meows and did not resist. He whispered soothingly, "Don't be afraid, we're going home."
location: By taxi from No. 201, Lane 3215, Hongmei Road, Minhang District, Shanghai, to No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area.

name: Afu arrives home: settling in and family meeting
description: Arrived home at 19:45; A Fu, startled, crawled under the sofa. His mother started nagging again. Lei Mingxuan didn't have time to comfort the cat at first; he first set up a temporary cat bed in the corner of the bedroom with a cardboard box and an old T-shirt, and put out cat food and a water bowl. Then he solemnly stated to his parents that he would take full responsibility for A Fu's hygiene and care. His father chimed in again, and his mother finally stopped objecting and turned to heat up the dishes.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Attended the advanced pour-over coffee course at Qiyun Café
description: At 20:20, Lei Mingxuan gently closes the bedroom door and walks 5 minutes to Qiyun Café to attend the first advanced pour-over coffee class, learning the flavor characteristics of coffee beans from different origins. In class he meets fellow student Lao Zhou; during small talk he finds out Lao Zhou works in Southeast Asian brand supply chains. Lei Mingxuan immediately shares his plan to introduce specialty brands to his store, and the two exchange WeChat and agree to discuss possible cooperation in detail next week.
location: Qiyun Café, on a side road off Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returned home to comfort A Fu and build trust.
description: Got home at 21:45; the living room lights were off and his parents had already gone to bed. Under the bedroom desk lamp, Lei Mingxuan found Afu had come out from under the sofa and was crouching beside the cat bed. He sat on the floor and spoke softly. When he reached out his hand, Afu hesitated but didn't dodge. He squeezed some cat treat onto his finger, and Afu came close and slowly licked it. This interaction made him feel deeply gratified.
location: Home bedroom at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime diary and new plans
description: At 22:35, Lei Mingxuan refilled A Fu's food and water, checked the balcony window, then sat by the bed and opened the notes app on his phone to record the day's events and reflections: morning run of 4 km, weight 80.5 kg; the preliminary concept for the co-branded sharing session was confirmed and the booth was successfully secured; A Fu was nervous when he first arrived but ate a cat treat, and trust was beginning to build; in the evening coffee class he met Lao Zhou, who might bring a new supply source. Finally, he set a goal of weighing under 80 kg tomorrow.
location: Home bedroom at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: At 23:00, Lei Mingxuan turned off the desk lamp and lay down. He vaguely heard Afu rustling and purring in the cardboard box. Though the day had been busy, he felt fulfilled. He closed his eyes and looked forward to a new beginning the next day.
location: At home, on the bed in the bedroom, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Early morning: Afu's progress and family morning
description: When the alarm went off, Lei Mingxuan got up quietly and noticed that Ah Fu's food bowl and water bowl had both visibly decreased, proving that it had finally dared to come out and eat last night. He crouched by the sofa and tempted it with a cat treat. Ah Fu hesitated for nearly a minute before carefully stretching out its head to lick and eat. Seizing the moment, Lei Mingxuan gently stroked the top of its head, and it did not flinch. When his mother, Wang Xiuying, got up and saw this, she still muttered, "This cat is finally being sensible," but her eyes had already softened a lot. Lei Mingxuan briefly discussed the day's arrangements with his mother, then ate the whole-wheat sandwich and fried egg she had prepared and drank an iced Americano.
location: Room 601, Building 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning rush hour commute: electric scooter and metro transfer.
description: Lei Mingxuan put on his helmet, got on his e-bike, rode along Pudong Avenue for about 5 minutes, and parked near Exit 2 of Lujiazui Metro Station. Then he walked through the station's internal passage and across a footbridge, arriving at Gate 1 of Super Brand Mall 8 minutes later.
location: From Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, passing Lujiazui Metro Station

name: Morning meeting and store preparation at the shop.
description: Lei Mingxuan was the first to arrive at the store. He opened the rolling shutter door, turned on the lights and the cash register system, and quickly checked the floor cleanliness and displays. After the staff member Xiao Lin arrived, the two held a brief morning meeting. Xiao Lin reported the previous night's closing inventory data and the arrival of new goods, and Lei Mingxuan assigned her the day's display adjustment tasks.
location: Xiafeiji store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning: In-depth brand research and store operations
description: With few customers, Lei Mingxuan brewed a pot of tea, opened his laptop, and began in-depth research on the Southeast Asian brands Lao Zhou had recommended. He carefully browsed their official websites and Instagram, and made detailed price comparison and style matching tables for Laos organic cotton workwear, Vietnam functional details, and Thailand tie-dye patterns. At the same time, he processed shipping information for several online orders and replied to supplier Zhou Tao on WeChat.
location: Cashier counter, Xiafeiji Store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch: online research at the ramen shop
description: Lei Mingxuan left the store, walked eight minutes through the connecting corridor to the Ippudo ramen shop in the basement of IFC, and ordered a bowl of Akamaru ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While waiting and eating, he opened Xiaohongshu and Douyin to search how those brands were being promoted in China, confirmed the word-of-mouth felt natural and authentic, and screenshotted and saved several highly liked outfit posts.
location: Online insurance policy application

name: Afternoon: tending the store and maintaining regular customers
description: Back at the store, the afternoon customer flow gradually increased. At two o'clock, regular customer and Xiaohongshu blogger Qian Duoduo arrived. Lei Mingxuan immediately pulled her aside, showed her the Southeast Asian brand designs he had researched that morning on his tablet, and asked, 'Duoduo, how do these brands go with your mountain-style look?' Her eyes lit up, and the two enthusiastically discussed outfit ideas for half an hour. After sending Qian Duoduo off, Lei Mingxuan returned to the work area, made a pour-over of Colombian Huila, and while drinking it, organized his research notes into text and sent them to Lao Zhou, making an appointment to discuss in detail next week. Meanwhile, store clerk Xiao Lin helped receive other customers.
location: Xiafeiji store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening: A Fu's surprise on the way home
description: After telling Xiao Lin to watch the shop, Lei Mingxuan rode his e-bike home. As soon as he entered, he was pleasantly surprised to find that A Fu had actually come out from under the sofa and was lying next to the cat scratching board in the corner of the living room. He quietly sat on the floor, took out a laser pointer and teased A Fu. A Fu began trying to chase the little red dot; the movements were clumsy, but it was a huge improvement. He fed A Fu another cat treat stick, and A Fu licked it in his hand, bringing the human-cat distance one step closer.
location: Room 601, Building 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner: probing Father's stance.
description: Mother Wang Xiuying made braised pork belly and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. At the dinner table, Lei Mingxuan picked up a piece of meat and pretended to bring it up casually: "Dad, today I looked into a Southeast Asian brand. The style is quite unique, and I haven't seen anyone doing it in China. If we introduced it, we could give our shop another upgrade." His father, Lei Jianguo, put down his chopsticks and said slowly, "I know what you're thinking. In this environment, keep what we have steady first and don't act rashly." Lei Mingxuan nodded and didn't argue, knowing in his heart that his father needed a more concrete plan before he would relent.
location: Room 601, Building 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening: playing billiards with friends to relax.
description: After eating and resting for a bit, Lei Mingxuan changed into a casual T-shirt and rode his e-bike for 5 minutes to the Superstar Billiards Club on B2 of World Plaza. His old friend Han Dong was already there. The two opened an American pool table and played three games. Lei Mingxuan had a good feel and won the first game, but Han Dong came back and cleared the table in one turn to win the second game. While playing, they chatted. Lei Mingxuan complained to Han Dong about his father's conservatism and was happy about A Fu's progress.
location: Juxing Billiards Club, B2, World Plaza, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go home and record data
description: Back home, Lei Mingxuan took a hot shower, changed into pajamas, and stepped onto the electronic scale in the living room. The screen showed '80.3kg', 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday. He opened the 'Qingniu' app on his phone and entered today's weight data and a mood tag: 'Steady progress, A Fu is reliable, and the business has promise.'
location: Room 601, Building 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Late night: time for creation and relaxation
description: Lei Mingxuan came to the study and opened his laptop. It was Wednesday. He opened the draft box on the 'Fengdu' platform and continued to polish the next chapter of his novel. Using the 'slow-motion description' technique he had learned last week, he wrote about 800 words about the scene where the protagonist runs into an old acquaintance in the Xiafeifang alley. When he got tired, he sat back on the sofa and scrolled through Bilibili, catching up on the latest episode of Demon Slayer. At some point, A Fu had jumped onto the other end of the sofa and was dozing off. He reached out and stroked A Fu's back, and it didn't pull away.
location: Room 601, Building 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (home study and living room)

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and goodnight
description: Lei Mingxuan put away his phone, got up, and went to the balcony to check the window. He added fresh dry food and water to Afu's bowl and said softly: "Good night, Little Fu." Seeing Afu curled up quietly in the cat bed, he felt a sense of relief. He turned off the light, lay down, and set tomorrow's alarm. He fell asleep at 23:00 sharp.
location: Bedroom, Room 601, Building 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Morning run and stretching
description: At 05:30, the alarm went off on time. Boss Lei quickly changed into his workout clothes and set off from Shanggang Residential Area, jogging along Pudong Avenue toward Lujiazui Central Green Park. He ran two and a half laps around the park, completing 4.5 kilometers in 32 minutes. The heart rate strap showed an average of 142 bpm, stable in the target range. After the run, he did a 10-minute stretch on a bench beside the roller-skating plaza in the park and felt completely refreshed.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Lujiazui Central Green Park

name: Morning health management and breakfast
description: After his morning jog home, A-Fu crouched at the corner of the entryway and glanced over, but didn't hide under the sofa. After showering, Boss Lei sat at the dining table to review his June physical examination report, circling warning items such as 'fatty liver tendency' and 'high cholesterol' with a red pen. Then he stepped on the electronic scale and recorded his weight as 80.1 kg, BMI 27.0, and high blood lipids. He wrote a goal in his phone memo: reduce weight to 75 kg and eliminate fatty liver. While eating the vegetable-and-pork wontons his mother had cooked, he used the Keep app's meal plan feature to create a one-week high-protein, low-fat diet. The system generated a menu centered on oatmeal, chicken breast, broccoli, salmon, and Greek yogurt based on his height, weight, and goals, and synced it to his phone calendar. Then he opened the refrigerator, made a shopping list based on the meal plan, and took out the cream his mother had stocked up on and the leftover braised pork from last night, planning to deal with them in the evening.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting and package pickup
description: After breakfast, Boss Lei checked A'Fu's cat food and water, put on his commuter bag, and rode his e-bike for 3 minutes to Pudong Avenue Station on Line 4. After parking the bike, he took the subway, got off at Lujiazui Station six stops later, exited from Exit 2, and walked 6 minutes to Super Brand Mall. Before that, he took out the three outgoing packages from the luggage locker at the metro station, where he had stored them the night before, and put them in his backpack.
location: From Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, passing by Lujiazui Metro Station

name: Morning store operations
description: After arriving at the store, Boss Lei held a ten-minute morning meeting with Xiao Lin, the early shift clerk, to arrange the day's priorities: restocking new items, customer follow-ups, and online order processing. Then he organized the shelves, hanging out the new mountain-style jackets and tech pants and adjusting the displays. During this time, Zheng Kai, the mall property manager, passed by to say hello and chatted about registration for the mall's upcoming “Summer Cool Season” event next week. Boss Lei opened his laptop, compiled the Southeast Asian brand materials discussed with Lao Zhou the previous night into a PDF, and emailed Lao Zhou to arrange a meeting at the store next week for detailed discussion. Around ten o'clock, he handled several online order address changes via his phone and set up a “Chubby Boyfriend Outfit Special” coupon in the backend.
location: Xiafei Collection, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch, grocery shopping, and leisure
description: At 11:30, Boss Lei closed the store's backend system and walked to Shanghai ifc mall. At 'GREEN & SAFE', a Western casual restaurant on the basement floor, he ordered a signature beef energy bowl for lunch. After the meal, he went down to City'Super supermarket and bought chicken breast, salmon, broccoli, unsweetened yogurt, and eggs according to the morning shopping list. After checkout, he took a check-in photo in front of the B&C Bakery on the basement floor and posted to Moments: 'From today on, I'm saying goodbye to rich oil and heavy sauces!'
location: Shanghai ifc Mall, 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon store work and wrap-up.
description: In the afternoon, he returned to the store and customer traffic increased. Boss Lei received regular customer Qian Duoduo, showed her the new functional-style vest that had arrived in the morning, and asked clerk Xiao Lin to help with the lighting while he shot several short styling videos and sent them to Qian Duoduo. She was very satisfied and placed an order on the spot. During this period, he also gave styling advice to two men in finance who asked about commuter outfits and sold one mountain-style shirt. When free, Boss Lei sent a WeChat message to his younger cousin Shen Jie, asking if she had any good niche brands to recommend. After 16:00, customer traffic decreased. He sat behind the cash register managing Xiaohongshu, used Butter Camera to lay out the B&C photos taken at noon and the new vest outfit images, and wrote a post titled 'The Weekend Outfit Evolution Theory of a Lujiazui Finance Man', scheduled to be published at 8 a.m. the next morning. Then he received a call from his mother, who said she had delivered Afu's new cat scratching board to the store in the afternoon and asked what he wanted for dinner. He told her to follow the recipe. At 18:00, Boss Lei handed over work to clerk Xiao Lin, packed his personal belongings, and prepared to leave work.
location: Xiafei Collection, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buying whole grains on the way home
description: After work, Boss Lei got on his little e-bike and rode along Puming Road for 15 minutes, stopping by the Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road on the way. Following the recipe list, he bought millet, brown rice, quinoa, and other whole grains, and also grabbed a handful of fresh mint leaves to brew in water. Finally, he arrived home at 7:10.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and interacting with Afu
description: As soon as he entered the house, A Fu ran out from the corner of the living room on his own initiative, rubbed against Boss Lei's ankle, and purred. Surprised and delighted, Lei Mingxuan squatted down to pet him for a while. Then he put on an apron and started cooking: he marinated chicken breast with black pepper and lemon juice, pan-fried it, blanched broccoli, and served it with lettuce and cherry tomatoes, drizzled with a homemade vinaigrette, and a bowl of multigrain rice. When he brought it to the table, his father Lei Jianguo complained, "There's not a drop of oil in this." His mother Wang Xiuying immediately supported her son and told a heartwarming story about A Fu coming near her on his own that afternoon. Under his mother's gaze, his father took a bite of the chicken breast and commented, "Hmm, not bad. But eating this, I'll probably be hungry in the middle of the night." Dinner ended with a harmonious discussion about A Fu and healthy eating.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Historical fiction writing and publishing
description: After finishing the meal and cleaning up the dishes, Boss Lei opened his laptop in the study at 8:30 and logged into the Fengdu platform. He read through and polished the first chapter of the novel The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane, which he had written last night, adding three detailed descriptions about the plane trees and the French bakery on 1930s Xiafei Lane (now Huaihai Middle Road). After checking it and finding no mistakes, he clicked Upload Chapter and scheduled it to be published at 22:00 that evening. Then, on the author dashboard for Longtang Xiao Lei, he browsed the homepage and added tags to his new book. That was when he noticed A Fu, who had jumped onto the corner of the desk at some point, lying there quietly.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening core strength training.
description: Boss Lei changed into athletic shorts, unrolled a yoga mat on the living room floor, and began core training: 3 sets of 20 push-ups (1-minute rest between sets), 3 sets of 45-second planks (30 seconds rest), and 3 sets of 20 sit-ups. He gritted his teeth and completed all the exercises; although the last few reps were slightly off-form, the overall quality was very good. While stretching, he recorded today's data in the Training Log app on his phone.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Relaxation and entertainment before bed
description: After training, he took a shower and felt refreshed. Back in the bedroom, Afu was already lying on the pillow licking his paws. Boss Lei scrolled on Bilibili for a while, caught up on the anime episodes updated that day, and replied to messages in the childhood friends group "Pudong Three Musketeers." Zhang Wei invited him to play American eight-ball at World Plaza Billiard Hall on Saturday night. At 10:40, he turned off the main light, left only the bedside lamp on, said goodnight to Afu, and rolled over to sleep. From health to career to writing and Afu, everything was back on track.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Early morning wake-up and preparation
description: Woken up by the alarm, I felt well rested. After washing up, I first added cat food to Afu's bowl and changed the water. Afu rubbed against my ankle and purred. My mother had already prepared breakfast. While eating a bowl of hot soy milk and two pan-fried buns, I browsed industry news on my phone and silently rehearsed my strategy for talking with my father that evening.
location: Room 404, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the Xiafei Ji store
description: After breakfast, he took his backpack with the printed brand materials and a folding umbrella (in case of afternoon thundershowers). Then he got on the electric scooter parked downstairs in the residential complex, rode along Pudong Avenue for about 15 minutes, arrived at Super Brand Mall, and parked in the mall's staff parking area.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store preparation and screening of Southeast Asian brand materials
description: After arriving at the store, I did the daily morning prep with the store clerk Xiao Lin: turning on the lights, cleaning, tidying the shelves, and checking the previous day's sales data. Then I sat at the cash register, opened my laptop, and carefully went through the detailed product catalog sent by Lao Zhou for Southeast Asian brands (including "EKONIA", "WILDTHINGS", etc.) from beginning to end. I picked out 12 styles that fit the store's mountain-style functional wear positioning and were competitively priced, organized them into a new document, formatted and printed it out, ready to show my father in the evening.
location: Xiafei Collection, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Customer reception and store operations.
description: The mall started to fill with customers, and he divided the work with Xiao Lin. He stood at the door greeting customers entering the store, and put together a light functional commute outfit suitable for the office for a white-collar man. At the same time, he sent a few photos of the newly arrived mountain-style vests to regular customer Qian Duoduo on WeChat, and she said she would come by Saturday morning. During this time, he took some photos of the store's new display and saved them to his phone, planning to send them to Shen Jie in the afternoon as Xiaohongshu material.
location: Xiafei Collection, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Healthy ingredients shopping at Lianhua Supermarket
description: Taking advantage of reduced mall traffic, I arranged for Xiao Lin to watch the store. I walked to Lianhua Supermarket on Pudong South Road, took out the one-week high-protein, low-fat meal plan I had made with a health app yesterday, and started shopping. I carefully selected chicken breast, salmon, broccoli, spinach, cherry tomatoes, sugar-free yogurt, and whole-wheat bread, and also bought a bag of mixed grains. In the yogurt section, I deliberately compared the calories and ingredient lists of three brands and chose the one with the highest protein content. After shopping, I walked back to the store.
location: Lianhua Supermarket (Yangguang Store), 1085 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Portioning and Temporary Storage of Ingredients
description: Back at the store, he used the small back storage room to divide the large bag of ingredients he had just bought into daily portions in the food containers prepared in advance. He split the chicken breast into 5 portions, washed and cut the vegetables, and labeled each container with the day of the week. After portioning everything out, he temporarily stored them in the store's small refrigerator, planning to take them home after work.
location: Xiafei Collection, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Video called with cousin Shen Jie to discuss the Xiaohongshu promotion plan.
description: Sat down on the sofa in the rest area and video-called my cousin Shen Jie, who works as a fashion buyer in Jing'an, via WeChat. I showed her the photos of the new product displays taken in the morning and explained in detail the two directions I wanted to focus on after the store upgrade: 'urban functional commuting menswear' and 'weekend outdoor styling.' Shen Jie agreed wholeheartedly and suggested using a consistent cover style of 'gray/cement background + dynamic half-body action shots,' and adding outfit comparisons and scenario-based tips to the content. We initially agreed to do the first test shoot at her studio this Saturday morning, and she said she would bring a few of her own accessories to match. The call lasted nearly an hour and we had a great conversation.
location: Xiafei Collection, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store wrap-up and mental preparation before the showdown
description: After finishing the call with Shen Jie, he continued to be busy in the shop. While tidying up the clothes that customers had tried on, he silently rehearsed the key arguments for the evening's showdown with his father: “market trends, changes in the customer base, Old Zhou's success story, and a Plan B (if he refuses, first try a small-scale renovation for one month).” He also flipped through the printed brand catalog to confirm it was correct. At almost 4 p.m., he gave Xiao Lin a few instructions about the next day's work and prepared to leave early.
location: Xiafei Collection, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home from work and picking up the delivery
description: Carrying the bagged ingredients and printed brand materials, he rode his electric scooter home. Fifteen minutes later, he arrived at the entrance of the residential community and remembered that the coffee beans he had bought online yesterday had arrived, so he picked them up from the Hive Box smart locker on the way.
location: Hive Box parcel locker, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home and spending time with parents
description: When he got home, he found his mother preparing dinner in the kitchen and his father Lei Jianguo watching the news in the living room. He said hi, then took the ingredients and the newly bought coffee beans into the kitchen and told his mother to cook with the new healthy ingredients tonight. His mother took them with a chuckle and said they'd have steamed salmon and broccoli tonight. His father just glanced over without saying anything; the atmosphere was a bit awkward.
location: Room 404, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking in the garden with my father and A Fu before the thunderstorm
description: The sky outside had darkened, and a thunderstorm was clearly on its way. I suggested taking Ah Fu downstairs for a walk, and my father picked up an umbrella and came along. In the central garden of the community, Ah Fu looked nervous on his first outing and just crouched under the bench. I sat side by side with my father, chatting casually about neighborhood matters, and the atmosphere was more peaceful than expected. This unexpected time alone together made me feel a bit more relaxed. When raindrops began to fall, I hurried back home with Ah Fu.
location: Central Garden, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: Dinner began, and on the table were the steamed salmon and cold broccoli salad he had bought, plus the sweet-and-sour pork ribs his mother had made (prepared for his father). Taking advantage of the whole family being together, he took a deep breath and formally spoke up: “Dad, Mom, there's something I want to discuss with you.”
location: Room 404, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family meeting: showdown and argument over the store upgrade plan
description: He took out the printed brand catalog and store upgrade plan from his bag and formally proposed to his father that they either use family savings or apply for a small loan to bring in new brands and upgrade the store's experience area. His father put down his rice bowl, silently read through the materials, and his face grew more and more serious. He took out a notebook densely recording the family's monthly income and expenses, and pointed to each item as he said: “The store's monthly profit is only this much now. Your mother's retirement salary is kept as reserve. The money on this list is our last safety cushion—why would you touch it!” You retorted that traditional retail was no longer viable and that change was necessary, your voice rising higher and higher. Your mother kept urging from the side, “Let's all talk nicely.” Finally, your father slammed the table: “If you want to do it, fine—we'll split up. Do it yourself. Don't drag the whole family into fear and worry!” This enraged you completely. You stood up, shouted “Fine, we'll split,” and stormed out, slamming the door.
location: Room 404, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going out to calm down, and Ah Fu comforting Mom.
description: Overflowing with anger and hurt, he slammed the door and went downstairs. In the community garden, he sat down in a secluded corner, breathing the slightly damp air deeply, trying to calm himself. Meanwhile, his mother, Wang Xiuying, sat sadly on the sofa with tears falling. A Fu jumped out from the corner, hopped into her lap of its own accord, rubbed its furry head against her hand, and purred contentedly. Touched by A Fu's behavior, the mother broke into a smile through her tears and gently stroked its back.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home to decompress and readjust
description: After standing outside in the wind for more than half an hour, he gradually calmed down. Thinking that his father was only doing it for his own good, he felt a little guilty. He walked home slowly. When he opened the door, he found his mother still in the living room, with Afu lying on her lap. He smiled at her awkwardly and said, "Mom, I was wrong just now." His mother sighed and said, "Your dad has gone back to his room too. You know his temper; he was mainly worried about you." He nodded, went to pour a glass of water, said in a low voice, "I'll go to my room first," and then returned to his room.
location: Room 404, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation: watching anime, writing, and group chatting.
description: Back in the bedroom, he still felt somewhat heavy-hearted. He opened his tablet and watched an episode of the new anime “Jujutsu Kaisen” on Bilibili to distract himself. After that, he opened the historical novel “The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane” on the Fengdu platform, which had been serialized since yesterday, and wrote 500 words with revisions, but his mind was unsettled and he was not satisfied with what he wrote. He simply turned off the computer, took out his phone, and sent a message in the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group: “I had a fight with the old man tonight, and I feel horrible.” Zhang Wei and Li Na soon popped up and comforted him a bit. Zhang Wei also teased: “Tomorrow's billiards game, I'll give you a three-ball handicap. Come out and clear your head.” That made him feel a little better.
location: Bedroom, Room 404, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepare for bed and confirm tomorrow's plan.
description: Took a hot shower to soothe my tense nerves. Lying in bed, I used my phone's memo app to confirm tomorrow's (Saturday) plan: go to my cousin's studio in the morning for a Xiaohongshu test shoot, and play billiards with Zhang Wei in the evening. I also thought about tonight's matter and decided to let both sides cool down for a couple of days, then find a chance on Sunday to have a calm talk with my father, emphasizing the controllable-risk plan of a "small-scale trial."
location: Room 404, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Say goodnight to Afu
description: I turned off the light and was about to go to sleep when a furry figure slipped in under the bedroom door — Afu had run in again. It jumped lightly onto the bed, rubbed against the pillow, found a comfortable position, and curled up. I reached out and gently scratched its chin, and the last bit of restlessness in my heart was smoothed away by the purring. Good night, Afu.
location: Bedroom, Room 404, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake up in the morning, pet the cat, and manage finances.
description: After the alarm went off, I didn't linger in bed. First I glanced out the window — cloudy and stuffy. I patted the orange tabby Ah Fu beside the pillow, and it purred and rubbed against my palm. I went to the bathroom to wash up, and while there used the mobile banking app to complete the routine monthly actions on the 5th: regular fund investment and savings for a self-driving trip to western Sichuan. I transferred 800 yuan and felt a bit more at ease seeing the account balance. Then I went to the living room to refill Ah Fu's automatic feeder and replace the water.
location: Room 302, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and atmosphere buildup
description: His mother had already cooked small wontons and steamed some buns. The atmosphere at the table was a bit tense; his father silently sipped his porridge. Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to break the silence, chatting with his mother while eating about making a healthy salad together in the evening, which made her very happy. After the meal, he cleared the dishes on his own and suggested to his father that they go through the ledger and receipts in the afternoon. His father grunted in agreement.
location: Room 302, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycle to M50 and do rock climbing training
description: After putting on a sporty hoodie and quick-dry pants, he packed his climbing gear and set off from home on his e-bike, following navigation to M50 Creative Park in Putuo District. With light traffic on the inner ring road on the weekend, the ride took about 30 minutes. When he reached the climbing gym, his college classmate Zhao Min was already warming up, and the two began their usual Saturday climbing training. He was in good shape and conquered several V2 routes in a row; his attempt at a V3 was unsuccessful, but he felt his upper-body strength had clearly improved. During a break, he chatted with Zhao Min about combining climbing with weighted camping training. Zhao Min recommended a trail running plus bouldering course, and Lei Mingxuan made a note of it.
location: Rock Point Climbing Gym, 1F, Zone B, M50 Creative Park, No. 50 Moganshan Road, Putuo District, Shanghai

name: Discussing fashion trends with my cousin over lunch.
description: After rock climbing, he said goodbye to Zhao Min and sent a WeChat message to invite his cousin Shen Jie. They agreed to meet for lunch at Funkadeli, an Italian bistro on Fumin Road. They ordered the signature beef carpaccio and creamy bacon pasta. During the meal, Shen Jie shared runway photos from Japanese mountain-style brands' fall/winter collections, analyzed next year's fabric and color trends, and affirmed the positioning of his outdoor equipment store, suggesting he continue to dig deeper. Lei Mingxuan quietly noted the key information.
location: Funkadeli (Fumin Store), 1st Floor, Fumin Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Returned home and held a family financial meeting
description: After saying goodbye to his cousin, he rode the e-bike back along the same route. Passing through Lujiazui, he bought an iced Americano at a convenience store to refresh himself. He got home a little after 1 p.m., rested briefly, and then had a face-to-face conversation with his father in the living room. His father had already spread out account books and a folder; Lei Mingxuan also took out the store's revenue records, purchase orders, rent receipts, and bank statements. They sat facing each other—Lei Mingxuan used his phone calculator, and his father put on reading glasses to check each item one by one. They first calculated the family's fixed expenses, then calculated the store's net income for half a year month by month, confirming that current savings could support basic operations for about six months. Next, he proposed a plan to take out a 200,000-yuan loan to upgrade the store and add a coffee corner, and calculated in detail the ratio of monthly payments to net income, making clear that he understood the risks. Although his father didn't fully agree, he sighed, patted him on the shoulder, and said, 'Better to be steady.' This time there was no argument; data and reason won out.
location: Room 302, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and helping in the kitchen before heading out
description: After talking with my father, I felt much more relaxed. Back in my room, I changed into a loose denim shirt and casual pants. In the kitchen, I helped my mother take the broccoli and chicken breast for dinner out of the fridge to thaw, and marinated the salmon with cooking wine and black pepper. Then I played with the orange tabby A Fu for over ten minutes with a cat teaser and stretched my limbs.
location: Room 302, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went to World Plaza to socialize with the guys over billiards.
description: He walked out of the neighborhood, took a shared bike, and rode along Pudong Avenue for ten minutes to reach World Plaza. On the third floor, he met his childhood friends Han Dong and Zhang Wei at the 'Gentleman Billiards' club, and the three opened an American eight-ball table and took turns playing. While chatting between shots, Lei Mingxuan complained about yesterday's quarrel with his father and the afternoon's account reconciliation. Zhang Wei joked, calling him 'Lei the Accountant.' He also shared his plan to add a coffee corner to the shop, and Han Dong gave advice from a market perspective: control the investment, first test it with a pop-up coffee corner, and make sure the coffee cups and design are consistent with the tone of the mountain-style clothing. Two hours of billiards had wins and losses, but his mood was much better.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, No. 855 South Pudong Road, World Square, 3rd floor, 'Shenshi Billiards' Club

name: Return home for a reconciliation dinner together.
description: After saying goodbye to the brothers, he rode a shared bike home. As soon as he entered the door, he smelled the aroma of steamed salmon. On the dining table were steamed salmon, blanched broccoli, chicken breast salad, and light winter melon soup. His mother had specially made a healthy meal with less oil and salt. His father silently picked up a piece of fish. He didn't praise it, but he didn't say it was bad either—already an improvement. Lei Mingxuan buried his head in eating the chicken breast on his plate and gave his mother a thumbs up. After the meal, he voluntarily stepped on the electronic scale, which showed 80.4 kg. His mother comforted him that it was because he had eaten something salty yesterday and retained water. His father, for once, was considerate enough to tell him he could heat up some milk if he got hungry at night.
location: Room 302, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening personal wind-down and novel writing
description: After helping his mother clean up the dishes, he curled up on the sofa with a can of diet Coke and sent voice messages in the childhood-friends group, reporting the rational results of the afternoon reconciliation and the billiards win, and formally putting the coffee corner plan on the agenda. Then he caught up on two new anime episodes. A bit later, he sat down at the desk, opened his tablet, and sorted out the outline for the next chapter of The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane on the Fengdu platform. The writing went smoothly; he wrote more than a thousand words and clearly laid out the details and background of the new characters. The orange tabby A Fu dozed beside the computer, keeping him company.
location: Room 302, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After turning off the computer, he did some stretches to relax, went to the bathroom to wash up, and took the newly bought tech vest out of the shopping bag and hung it up, planning to go back to the store tomorrow to put out the new arrivals. Lying in bed, he checked his phone memo to confirm Sunday's schedule: go to the store to handle online orders and refine the coffee corner plan. After turning off the light, the orange cat Afu jumped onto the bed and curled up beside the pillow. Listening to its purring, Lei Mingxuan reviewed the day: rock climbing, account reconciliation, billiards, and family dinner. Though tired, he had taken care of everything, and the weight in his chest had lifted. He closed his eyes and gradually fell asleep.
location: Room 302, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run and early-morning vitality
description: At 6 a.m., the sky was just beginning to lighten, and fine rain showers were falling outside the window. Lei Mingxuan changed into quick-dry clothes, put on his heart-rate monitor strap, and walked about 15 minutes to Gate 2 of Century Park with an umbrella. As the rain eased, he ran 4 km along the outer rubber track, keeping his heart rate steady at around 145, and finished in 28 minutes. After the run, he did 5 minutes of stretching and felt refreshed. Around 7 a.m., he returned to his home in Shanggang Community on Pudong Avenue, where his mother Wang Xiuying was already busy in the kitchen. He took a quick shower and changed clothes, then went to the balcony to play a while with Afu, the orange tabby, in good spirits.
location: Shanghai Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning commute and buying fruit
description: Lei Mingxuan told his mother he was going out to buy something, then rode his e-bike east along Pudong Avenue and arrived at Pushang Vegetable Market at the intersection of Dongchang Road in about 7 minutes. He picked out a fresh muskmelon at the market, planning to bring it home to share with his parents.
location: Pushang Food Market, 401 Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Helping in the kitchen and sounding out opinions.
description: Lei Mingxuan returned home with the newly bought yangjiaomi melon and took the initiative to help his mother Wang Xiuying in the kitchen. His mother was preparing ingredients for Shanghai-style braised pork belly (low-oil version) and steamed sea bass. While he was picking and washing vegetables, he tentatively asked whether his father would be home for lunch. His mother responded knowingly, telling him to get along well with his father. He nodded and helped chop the scallions, quietly figuring out how to apologize to his father naturally.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Welcoming father and family conversation
description: At 8:30, Father Lei Jianguo came back from his walk and noticed Lei Mingxuan's expression was a bit off. Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to greet him, cut up the freshly bought yangjiaomi melon, and served it to his father. The family of three sat down in the living room. He took the opportunity to bring up the coffee corner plan he had discussed with friends yesterday, saying he wanted to visit a coffee shop next week to learn from them and would prepare a budget report first. His father's attitude softened considerably. Although he didn't agree outright, he told him to think it through before taking action.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch Reconciliation and Father-Son Working Together
description: The lunch began, and the dishes were lavish. Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to pour yellow rice wine for his father and poured himself a glass as well. He solemnly apologized to his father for his impulsive tone and for banging the table the day before. His father's expression softened, and he admitted that he had been too stubborn, hoping his son would take steady steps. After clinking glasses, his father picked up a piece of braised pork for each of his mother and son, while his mother beamed from ear to ear. After the meal, Lei Mingxuan rushed to clear the dishes, and his father also stood up to help. The father and son washed and tidied up in the kitchen in tacit harmony.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and walking the cat
description: Feeling sleepy after the meal, Lei Mingxuan dozed off on the sofa for 40 minutes. When he woke up, the orange tabby A Fu was lying on his stomach purring. Seeing that it was cloudy and not raining outside, he took a cat teaser and played with A Fu in the hallway for ten minutes to help her burn off energy.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Planning camping and ordering gear
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to his study, opened his laptop, and started researching camping routes in Anji Bamboo Sea. Based on the voting results in the friends' group, he spent an hour reading guides and finalized the weekend hiking and camping itinerary for Anji Bamboo Sea and Longwangshan Ancient Trail. He then booked a parking spot and a tent site at the Anji Jiangnan Tianchi Camping Base for July 12 on a mobile mini-program, and ordered self-heating rice, energy bars, high-altitude gas canisters, and a foldable water bag. Afterward, he posted the route map to the group, and his friend Zhang Wei immediately replied with a like.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening roller skating and river view
description: Feeling pleased after the plan was implemented, Lei Mingxuan put on his roller skates and rode his electric scooter to the riverside promenade near Dongchang Road Ferry. He put on his earphones and skated along the red rubber track all the way to the Qichangzhan Ferry section near No. 1 Dongfang Road. The river breeze blew against his face. He slowed down, stopped at the riverside railing, looked out at the Bund buildings across the river, and took some scenery photos to save.
location: Riverside walkway, Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (section from No. 1 Dongchang Road to No. 1 Dongfang Road)

name: Evening stretching and relaxation
description: Lei Mingxuan walked about 16 minutes from the riverside and arrived home at 6:00. He first spread out his yoga mat and did 20 minutes of yoga following a video on his phone, using poses such as cat-cow, downward dog, and child's pose to relieve the soreness in his back and arms from rock climbing. Afterward, he showered, changed into loungewear, and felt fresh.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: Mother Wang Xiuying had prepared a light dinner: stir-fried snow peas, garlicky water spinach, tomato and egg drop soup, and the leftover steamed sea bass from lunch. After taking a shower, Lei Mingxuan ate and chatted with his parents. He showed the old couple the photos he had taken by the riverside in the evening and suggested taking them there for a walk and dinner next time. The old couple was very happy.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel writing and a burst of inspiration
description: Lei Mingxuan made a cup of tea and continued drafting the third chapter of his novel "An Afternoon in Xiafei Lane" in his study. He described the scene of the protagonist walking back to the lane after eating steak at Red House Western Restaurant, referring to a video of 1930s Shanghai concession night scenes, and focused on the gaslight under the streetlamps and the sound of a gramophone coming from the lane. Fully immersed, he wrote 1,500 words in one go.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Free time and shopping preparation.
description: After finishing his creative work, Lei Mingxuan lay on the sofa scrolling through Bilibili. He watched camping gear reviews and found that the gas canister kit he had bought before also came with a stove burner, which he felt was a great deal. Then he browsed Taobao and saw a recommendation for a gift box from a time-honored Shanghai pastry brand. Remembering that tomorrow was his father’s birthday, he quickly ordered a box of almond bars and seaweed crisps, and left a note for expedited delivery, hoping it would arrive tomorrow.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and pre-bed record
description: Lei Mingxuan finished washing up in the bathroom, looked at himself in the mirror, and felt that his complexion had been good these past two days. He returned to the bedroom, where the orange tabby Afu was already curled up asleep in its bed. Before getting into bed, he weighed himself: 80.2 kg, a little lighter than yesterday. He was in a great mood. After turning off the lights, he set the alarm for 8 a.m. the next morning, ready to end the weekend and welcome the new week.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run of 4.5 km and a quick record
description: Lei Mingxuan got up at 5:30 in the morning, changed into his workout clothes, warmed up briefly, and rode his electric bike to Shanghai Century Park. Starting at 5:45, he ran 4.5 kilometers along the outer track of the park, keeping his heart rate between 140 and 150 beats per minute. After finishing, he did dynamic stretching in the stretching area at the entrance and used his phone to record a short video of the park in the morning, planning to post it on social media in the evening to document a healthy lifestyle. Then he rode his electric bike home.
location: Shanghai Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home, breakfast, and family interaction
description: After the morning run, he returned home and took a shower. His father Lei Jianguo had already eaten breakfast and was watching the morning news, while his mother Wang Xiuying had prepared multigrain porridge and steamed Chinese yam. Lei Mingxuan went into the kitchen to prepare his lunch bento, including chicken breast, lettuce, cherry tomatoes, whole wheat bread, and vinaigrette. His mother nagged that he was eating too vegetarian, but helped him wrap the food in plastic wrap. Before going out, he went to the balcony to play with the orange cat Ah Fu, took a photo, and weighed himself. The scale showed 80.0 kg, and he felt happy.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting and package pickup
description: Rode the e-bike from home and headed to Super Brand Mall along Pudong Avenue for work. After arriving, first picked up a package from the express locker at the back door of the mall—a cat teaser wand and freeze-dried treats bought for Afu. Then entered the store through the staff passage and put the helmet in the back warehouse.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shop opening preparation and morning work
description: After arriving at the store 'Xiafei Ji', I opened the rolling shutter, turned on the air conditioner and background music. Together with shop assistant Xiao Lin, I cleaned the floor, wiped the shelves, and tidied the displays. I rearranged the newly arrived linen shirts and techwear vests by color, and used a tablet to take photos of new outfit combinations. Around 9:30, I contacted Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao via WeChat video to confirm the shipping status of the autumn mountain-style techwear new arrivals, and learned that the goods had been sent from the Hangzhou warehouse last night and were expected to arrive in Shanghai Pudong the day after tomorrow. Afterwards, I recorded the shipping screenshot and updates in the store's ERP system.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handle customer reception and online operations.
description: Customers came into the store one after another in the morning. Lei Mingxuan put together a look for a customer in the finance industry that combined commuting style with an outdoor feel. Around 10:30, regular customer Qian Duoduo arrived with a friend. Lei Mingxuan recommended newly arrived mountain-style items to them, and Qian Duoduo's friend was very interested in a gray-green tech vest and bought it. Afterwards, he asked them to take try-on photos in front of the fitting room to post on WeChat Moments, and gave them the store's newly designed canvas badge. Meanwhile, Lei Mingxuan used his spare time to manage Xiaohongshu, retouching the styling photos he had taken and scheduling them for posting.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and online chat.
description: During lunch, Lei Mingxuan went to the back storage room of the store and ate the chicken breast salad and whole wheat sandwich he had brought. Meanwhile, he contacted his pour-over coffee classmate Lao Zhou via WeChat. Lao Zhou shared lookbooks from several Southeast Asian designer brands. After browsing, Lei Mingxuan became interested in the plant-dyed series from a Chiang Mai brand, and the two agreed to discuss the possibility of collaboration in detail after the next pour-over coffee class or on the weekend.
location: Back storage room of Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handling orders and planning stock replenishment
description: In the afternoon, with fewer customers, Lei Mingxuan handled online platform orders at the cash register and printed shipping labels. He confirmed the logistics information again and sent a confirmation message to supplier Zhou Tao. Then he took out his notebook to brainstorm a preparation checklist for next week's 'pop-up coffee corner' trial run, taking stock of the coffee beans, disposable cups, and pour-over kettle models that needed to be purchased. He organized these points into an Excel sheet and sent it to the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group, asking friends Zhang Wei and Li Na for suggestions.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Personal recharge during the afternoon free time.
description: In the afternoon, when the store was idle, Lei Mingxuan asked Xiao Lin to watch the store and went downstairs to the Sisyphus Bookstore on B1 of Super Brand Mall. In a corner of the bookstore, he spent about half an hour flipping through Shanghai Made, a collection of urban architecture photography, looking for inspiration for his novel writing and store aesthetics. He also bought a cup of American coffee and observed the bookstore counter's traffic flow to gather ideas for a coffee corner. He returned to the store at about 15:45.
location: Sisyphe Bookstore, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Evening rush-hour business and customer reception
description: As foot traffic in the mall recovered, Lei Mingxuan returned to the store entrance to greet customers and successfully recommended new cargo shorts and basic white T-shirts to two college students. Regular customer Feng Xiaoyu brought colleagues to try on clothes, and Lei Mingxuan recommended several layering outfits suited to her slim, tall figure. At about 17:30, property manager Zheng Kai passed by. Lei Mingxuan talked with him about the upcoming "Digital Trendsetter" co-branded event at the end of the month, and asked about the approval process for placing a small coffee bar at the store entrance. Zheng Kai said he could help ask the investment promotion department.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing up the store and commuting
description: After closing for the day, Lei Mingxuan and shop assistant Xiao Lin closed up the store together: checked the day's revenue, tidied the fitting rooms, and counted inventory. After confirming everything was correct, they turned off the lights and locked the door. He then rode his e-bike from Super Brand Mall along Lujiazui Ring Road back home on Pudong Avenue
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Warm family dinner
description: He got home just in time for dinner. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had made steamed mandarin fish, blanched shrimp, and cucumber salad. His father, Lei Jianguo, rarely praised the fish, saying it was fresh and sweet. Lei Mingxuan shared his initial fitness results and his plan to set up a coffee corner at the store. His father did not directly oppose it but reminded him to think it through and take it step by step. The family also discussed next week's menu, and his father suggested winter melon and pork rib soup for the weekend.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-dinner relaxation and playing with the cat
description: After the meal, Lei Mingxuan cleared the dishes with his mother, while his father went to the balcony to water the flowers. His mother showed him a video of A-Fu, the orange cat, taken that afternoon. Lei Mingxuan added text to the video and posted it on WeChat Moments, then shared it to the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group. Afterwards, he played with A-Fu using the newly bought freeze-dried treats, and A-Fu happily rolled on the floor.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel writing time
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to his study, opened his laptop, and spent an hour updating chapter four of his novel The Afternoon of Xiafei Fang. Inspired by the photography collection he saw at the bookstore that afternoon, he deliberately revised the environmental description of the new supporting character, the alleyway tailor, adding details such as an old sewing machine, cheongsam paper patterns, and the smell of camphor wood, and also conceived the character's first encounter with the protagonist. The writing went smoothly, and he completed about 1,500 words.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and communication with friends
description: After finishing a chunk of his novel, Lei Mingxuan relaxed on the sofa in the living room, opened Bilibili and watched a commentary video on the latest episode of Jujutsu Kaisen. Then he replied to Zhang Wei's suggestion about the coffee corner checklist in the “Pudong Three Musketeers” WeChat group and made plans to play billiards with him on Wednesday evening. He also checked today's likes and comments on his Xiaohongshu post—the response was pretty good. Finally, he completed a 500-yuan fixed-amount fund investment on his phone.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: Lei Mingxuan got up to wash up and did a 5-minute simple stretch to relax his lower back. Before going to bed, he listed tomorrow's to-dos in the notes app on his phone: confirm the logistics arrival status, search for coffee bean roasters, and use the lunch break to ask property management about the coffee corner approval. He set the alarm for 5:30 the next morning. Then he flipped through the illustrations in Made in Shanghai, gradually felt sleepy, turned off the light, and went to sleep. The orange tabby A Fu lay quietly by his pillow, purring.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Morning wake-up, washing up, and breakfast
description: He woke up naturally at 7:00 in the morning without setting an alarm, noted “active rest day” in his phone training log, and paused the morning run. After lying in bed for 5 minutes, he sat up. The cat A-Fu jumped onto the pillow and rubbed against his palm, and he petted the cat for two minutes. After getting up, he drank a glass of warm water, stepped on the scale—79.9 kg—and took a photo to record that he had lost another 0.1 kg. Then he washed up quickly and changed into a dark gray cotton-linen T-shirt and black casual pants. His mother Wang Xiuying had already cooked mixed-grain porridge, steamed Chinese yams and eggs, and brought out the low-oil curry chicken breast marinated the night before. After tasting it, he praised the chicken for being tender and discussed lunch arrangements with his mother, who responded with a smile.
location: Room 102, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: Put on my helmet and Bluetooth earbuds, rode the e-bike from Shanggang Community along Pudong Avenue for about 8 minutes, passing Lujiazui Central Green and seeing morning exercisers. The sun was bright and I felt great. After arriving at Super Brand Mall, I went to Unit A-208 on the 2nd floor, turned on the lights and air conditioning, checked the clothing displays, boiled water for a cup of Yirgacheffe drip-bag coffee, opened the cashier system, and reviewed the previous day's sales ledger: 3 orders completed, 1.7 items per transaction, and revenue of about 2,200 yuan.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Hand-drew display sketches for the new autumn products.
description: Clear the workbench, and use an A3 sheet of white paper and markers to hand-draw the shop floor plan. Mark the roughly 12-square-meter area on the right side of the entrance as the “Mountain-Style Functional Gear Theme Zone”; draw in detail a 2-meter-high double-sided hanging rack, a glass display table, and a pegboard wall hanging area, and sketch artificial greenery and two vintage camping lanterns as accents. After finishing this part, take a photo and send it to the “Pudong Three Musketeers” WeChat group to get feedback from friends Zhang Wei and Han Dong. Zhang Wei suggested warm yellow lighting for the camping lanterns, and Han Dong suggested that the floor display table should not be too tall so as to appear more approachable. Adjust the sketch details based on their suggestions.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Brainstorm online teaser copy
description: Used the phone to take close-ups and try-on shots of the store's main autumn items: the gray-green tech vest, khaki work shirt, and black tactical pants. Used Meitu for simple color adjustments. Conceived copy for Moments and Xiaohongshu with the theme "Countdown to next week's new arrivals + preview of mountain tech style," saved the copy as a draft, and planned to refine and post it after returning home in the evening.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute home for lunch.
description: Packed up the workbench, rode the electric bike back from Super Brand Mall to Shanggang Community. On the way, I sent a WeChat message to mother telling her I was almost home and asked her not to make the dishes too spicy. She replied that she had only put in one chili pepper for flavor.
location: From 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Family lunch.
description: After arriving home, he washed his hands and sat down. On the table were a lower-oil version of curry chicken breast with brown rice, and steamed baby bok choy with garlic and vermicelli, carefully plated by his mother. He took a close-up photo with his phone and sent it to the family group. His father, Lei Jianguo, tasted it and said it was okay, but said to use less chili next time because his tooth ached. He smoothed things over and urged his father to eat the light baby bok choy. While washing the dishes after dinner, he agreed with his father that he would cook stir-fried seasonal vegetables and garlic lettuce himself on the weekend, and his father nodded in agreement.
location: Room 102, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break, playing with the cat, and returning to the shop.
description: After the meal, he leaned back on the living room sofa with his eyes closed to rest for 15 minutes. The cat A Fu jumped onto his lap and curled up; after petting it, he napped for ten minutes. When he woke up, his energy was restored. At 13:25 he got up, tidied up briefly, said goodbye to A Fu, and rode his e-bike back to Super Brand Mall. Passing Lujiazui Central Green, he decided to go for a walk there in the afternoon if he had time.
location: Room 102, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and online tasks
description: After returning to the store, he first tidied the clothes that had been messily hung in the morning and replenished missing sizes.
