At 14:10, regular customer Qian Duoduo brought a friend to the store. After trying on clothes, they bought two khaki cargo shirts. Qian Duoduo also took photos of the purchased items and posted them on Xiaohongshu. At 15:20, supplier Zhou Tao confirmed via WeChat that the autumn order had been shipped and was expected to arrive in Shanghai on July 10. Lei replied, 'Received, thanks for your hard work.' At 15:45, he noted in his phone memo the preliminary terms he planned to propose to Lao Zhou in the evening talk: a 15% revenue share. Sales revenue increased; today he had sold 4 orders with total revenue of 3,180 yuan.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Seeking inspiration at a bookstore
description: After greeting the owner of the neighboring shop, I took the escalator to the B1 level of Super Brand Mall and entered Sisyphe Bookstore. In the outdoor/travel section, I browsed Outdoor Exploration magazine, focusing on mountain-style outfit topics. I saw a feature on 'urban outdoor aesthetics' and took photos of three valuable layout pages with my phone as display references. After leaving the bookstore, I shot a few photos of dusk light in the mall corridor to warm up for tonight's hand-brewed coffee class and post on Moments.
location: Sisyphe Bookstore, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Tidying up the store and wrapping up
description: After returning to the store, I re-ironed the clothes that had been tried on in the afternoon and put them back, and updated the sales ledger (4 orders sold today, total revenue 3,180 yuan). At 17:15, I used my phone to take a photo of the sunset light and shadows in the store and posted it on Moments: 'Busy Tuesday, getting focused for tonight's pour-over coffee class.'
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After work, heading home to rest and prepare.
description: At 17:45, I closed the shop's rolling shutter door on time and rode the e-bike home. After arriving, I quickly changed into a black-and-white color-blocked polo shirt and dark blue jeans, and took a notebook and pen. After washing my hands, my mother asked about dinner; I told her there was a class at the coffee shop and I would eat after class. I took a bottle of cold brew coffee and a slice of whole wheat bread from the fridge to tide me over, waved goodbye to A Fu, and at 18:18 went downstairs, rode the e-bike, and headed to the café.
location: Room 102, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Attend an advanced pour-over coffee course
description: Cycled 10 minutes to arrive at July's Coffee Shop (Lujiazui branch); Lao Zhou was already smoking at the door. After exchanging pleasantries, we went inside together. The interior was decorated in a Japanese-style natural wood design, with a comfortable pour-over coffee bar. The course theme was advanced techniques for blooming and staged water pouring. After the barista, Mr. Li, demonstrated with Ethiopian natural-process Yirgacheffe, the students took turns practicing. When my third attempt came, Mr. Li commented that my pouring stability had improved but that my circling speed needed to be even, and suggested not lingering too long at the edges. I recorded the whole session with my phone and noted key parameters in my notebook. After class, I asked to practice one more time, and the teacher smiled and agreed.
location: July Coffee Shop (Lujiazui Branch), No. 545 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-class business discussion and heading home
description: After the class, he and Lao Zhou each got a cold brew and sat in a corner booth. Lao Zhou took out product catalogs and a list of cooperation terms for two Southeast Asian brands (Annex from Thailand, Urbanista from Vietnam). After flipping through them, he highly approved of the khaki techwear vest and the patchwork cargo pants. The two discussed for 40 minutes: Lao Zhou proposed to handle design control, while he himself would handle retail product selection, display, and sales, with an initial 15% commission on sales. He sincerely said that next week he would provide a selection and market positioning report based on the catalog, including customer profiles and feedback, and they would exchange proposals at the next class. Lao Zhou agreed, and they clinked their cold brew cups. After the meeting, he rode his e-bike home. The autumn night breeze brushed his face, and the soundtrack of Kikujiro's Summer played from his earphones; he was excited by the progress of the cooperation. He arrived home at 21:28 and took a deep breath to settle himself.
location: July Coffee Shop (Lujiazui Branch), No. 545 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel writing.
description: I went into the study and turned on the computer, looking for inspiration from the layout photos I'd taken at the bookstore in the afternoon. I opened the draft of Chapter 5 of The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane, writing the plot in which the protagonist has a custom qipao made for a tea party. I first described the tailor shop in detail: 'The old tailor wore silver-framed glasses. When measuring the bust, his fingers lightly touched the fabric, and he drew lines on the navy silk with chalk, the marks as thin as willow leaves. Outside the window, freshly dyed blue cloth was drying, and water droplets fell on the bluestone slabs with a crisp sound.' After completing 1,000 characters, I reviewed it and corrected two timeline errors. Then I used voice input on my phone to add a passage of about 500 characters describing the protagonist trying on the qipao. At 22:28, I published the update.
location: Study, Room 102, No. 2, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Residential Quarter, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and evening preparations
description: He took a shower and washed his face with cold water to refresh himself, then changed into a loose T-shirt and cotton pajama pants. On the living room sofa, he did five minutes of calf and back stretches, while the cat A Fu stretched and yawned beside him. At 23:00, he checked his phone; the Moments preview for the pour-over coffee class had received 30 likes. Qian Duoduo commented asking about new arrivals, and he replied, 'New products arrive tomorrow, and the mountain-style themed area will be finished the day after.'
location: Room 102, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep wrap-up and rest
description: Turned off the lights and lay down, with Afu curled up beside the pillow. Mentally reviewed the whole day: the store display sketch was finished, family lunch was warm, the pour-over coffee class was rewarding, the cooperation framework made progress, and I updated a chapter of my novel. Fell asleep within five minutes, with the phone set to charging mode.
location: Bedroom, Room 102, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
description: Left home at 5:30 in the morning, jogged to Century Park, completed a 5 km run along the lakeside greenway at a pace of 5:50 per km, with a steady heart rate around 145, beating his personal goal. After the run, he stretched seriously in the stretching area and took a photo of a park bench with his phone, planning to post it on Moments to commemorate the occasion.
location: Shanghai Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go home, wash up, weigh in, and have breakfast.
description: After jogging home, I took a shower and changed clothes. Weighing myself, I was 79.8 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than the previous day. My mother had prepared a whole-wheat sandwich and unsweetened soy milk for breakfast. I ate quickly while topping up cat food and water for my pet cat Ah Fu.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting by e-bike and changing the battery
description: Set off on an electric bike along Pudong Avenue, stopped at the PetroChina gas station on Yuanshen Road to swap in a fully charged battery in 5 minutes to ensure enough power for the day, then continued riding to the staff entrance at the back door of Super Brand Mall, locked the bike, and swiped a card to enter the mall.
location: PetroChina Yuanshen Road Gas Station, No. 388 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; destination: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store arrival preparation and display adjustments.
description: After arriving at the store, he turned on the lights and air conditioning and used a dusting wand to clean the shelves and clothes. Following the display sketch he had drawn the night before, he adjusted the mountain-style techwear theme area on the right side of the store, made the newly arrived multifunctional jacket the centerpiece, and found cardboard and markers to hand-write three story cards: “Lightweight Urban Adventure,” “Urban Techwear Aesthetics,” and “8 Hours of a Jacket.”
location: His own shop, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online social interaction and work communication
description: While patrolling the store, I kept an eye on my phone. I posted photos of the new display area in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group, @Zhang Wei to set up the Wednesday basketball game, and chatted briefly with Li Na. Then I sent a WeChat to the property manager, Zheng Kai, asking about additional items for the coffee corner approval, and was told that water and electricity point layout drawings were needed. I planned to have the designer rush them the next day.
location: His own shop, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning: tending the store, receiving customers, and processing orders
description: Received several groups of customers in succession. One office worker fell in love with the mountain-style techwear vest at first sight; after helping her pair it with cargo shorts and water sandals, the sale closed smoothly. During downtime, handled three online mini-program orders on her phone, printed shipping labels, folded the clothes, packed them, and put them into the express box at the door.
location: His own shop, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and buying camping gear at Decathlon
description: Asked a familiar staff member at the adjacent accessories store to keep an eye on the shop for half an hour, then rode an e-bike to the Decathlon Huamu store. In the camping section, carefully compared the weight, packed size, and setup difficulty of several lightweight tents, finally chose one, and also bought a titanium cutlery set and an ultralight moisture-proof mat to prepare for summer camping trips.
location: Decathlon (Shanghai Huamu Store), 393 Yinxiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Convenience store resupply on the way back
description: On the way back to the store, he stopped at a roadside Haode Convenience Store, bought a bottle of electrolyte drink and a chicken skewer to recharge for the afternoon.
location: Haode Convenience Store, Lane 750, Yanggao Middle Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Jinyang New Village Block 11 Store)

name: Afternoon store duty and work follow-up.
description: Back in the shop, he happened to hand over with Xiao Lin, the staff member on the next shift, and briefed him on the morning situation. In the break area, he ate chicken skewers and had a drink, scrolled through Xiaohongshu on his phone to reference the display layouts of other mountain-style stores, and at the same time drafted a note post about the 'first-generation R-value'.
location: His own shop, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Receiving regular customers and confirming the evening activity.
description: Regular customer Qian Duoduo brought a friend to the store and was full of praise for the new themed area. I personally styled an outfit for her friend with a functional shirt and introduced the fabric and craftsmanship story. While they were trying on clothes, I contacted my friend Han Dong on WeChat to confirm meeting at the World Plaza Billiards Hall at 8 p.m. that evening.
location: His own shop, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Coming home from work to a heartwarming scene
description: Just before 6, after completing the handover with Xiao Lin, he rode his e-bike home. Pushing open the door, he heard a cat meowing and found his father, Lei Jianguo, sitting on the sofa playing with A Fu using a cat teaser, while his mother, Lin Meihua, stood nearby laughing and recording with her phone. He put down his bag and quietly sat down, not disturbing the warm scene.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: Mother prepared healthy dishes such as steamed sea bass, stir-fried water spinach with minced garlic, and poached shrimp. At the dinner table, they talked about the afternoon's haul at Decathlon and the progress of the coffee corner. Father Lei Jianguo rarely took the initiative to ask how long the approval would take; his tone carried concern, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rest up and prepare to head out for the billiards appointment.
description: After dinner, helped clear the dishes, went back to the room and changed into a loose sports T-shirt and shorts, and checked the tip of the billiard cue to make sure it was fine. After saying goodbye to his parents, he walked out, passed through several alleys, and headed to World Plaza.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Playing pool with Han Dong and having a good chat about the coffee corner idea
description: Met Han Dong at the billiards club on B1 of World Plaza. First played two warm-up games, and while playing, shared in detail his concept for a coffee and clothing hybrid business, including bar layout, menu design, pricing strategy, and target customers. After thinking it over seriously, Han Dong said the idea had potential and told him to build it out first. Afterward they played two more exciting games, each winning one.
location: Billiards Club, B1, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home to wash up and update the novel
description: After saying goodbye to Han Dong, he walked home and took a quick shower. Sitting at the computer, he opened the document for the novel 'The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane' and incorporated the cozy, leisurely summer-lane feeling from his father's antics with the cat into Chapter 6, writing a scene of the protagonist chatting with neighbors at the lane entrance, about 1,500 characters. After checking for typos, he published it on the Fengdu platform.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: Lying on the sofa, I watched an episode of a new anime on Bilibili, gave Afu a late-night snack, and checked the balcony and the doors and windows. Watching Afu pace around the living room, I felt the day had been fulfilling. I returned to the bedroom, set the alarm for 7 a.m. the next day, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning weigh-in and recovery record
description: The phone alarm went off. Feeling soreness in his thigh muscles, Lei Mingxuan got up and weighed himself; the scale showed 79.7 kg. He took out his training log and wrote on the July 10, 2025 page: "Active recovery day. Morning run paused to let the body recover from yesterday's 5km PB." Then he did some light stretching and washing up, and began a new day.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, No. 5, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning family interaction and breakfast
description: The orange tabby A'fu called out by the food bowl, and Lei Mingxuan first added cat food and the freeze-dried treats bought yesterday. His mother, Wang Xiuying, prepared whole wheat pancakes wrapped with shredded chicken and lettuce, served with unsweetened soy milk, for breakfast. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan chatted with his parents about the day's plans, mentioning that Wu Fang would come to the store in the morning, the autumn new arrivals would arrive in the afternoon, and he wanted steamed sea bass for dinner. His father, Lei Jianguo, agreed, and his mother reminded him to bring an umbrella.
location: Living room and kitchen, Room 301, Building 5, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Commute and convenience store restock.
description: After checking his phone, keys, and other belongings, Lei Mingxuan grabbed a folding umbrella at the door and set off on his electric scooter. When he passed the Quick convenience store (Jimo Road branch) at the community entrance, he stopped to buy mint candies and a bottle of electrolyte drink. After riding about 25 minutes, he arrived at the non-motor vehicle parking area at Super Brand Mall and locked his scooter.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai: starting from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, passing by Kuai Ke convenience store on Jimo Road, arriving at Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Arrive at the store and prepare for online communication.
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at the store, opened the door, turned on the lights, and started the cash register system. He quickly walked around the store to make sure it was tidy. He opened WeChat and replied to his childhood friend Han Dong's message from last night about billiards. Then he wrote the key points of the autumn new arrivals display sketch on a sticky note, put it beside the cash register, brewed himself a cup of drip coffee, and started the day's work.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (“Xiafei Collection”)

name: Supplier Wu Fang's visit and product selection.
description: Supplier Wu Fang arrived at the store on time, bringing new accessory samples, including handcrafted silver jewelry with strong design (antique-style choker necklaces, geometric earrings) as well as woven bracelets and keychains. The style matched the store's “mountain-inspired tech-wear” vibe. Lei Mingxuan exchanged ideas with her about Guangzhou fashion trends, selected 8 silver pieces and 5 bracelets as trial orders based on customer feedback, and agreed to contact her later on WeChat to see more inventory.
location: Reception area of "Xiafeiji", Shop A-208, Level 2, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Organizing new accessories and sharing updates
description: After Wu Fang left, Lei Mingxuan used his phone to take photos and record short videos of the new accessories one by one, noting the item numbers and quoted prices. He shared the photos in the WeChat group 'Pudong Three Musketeers'. Zhang Wei replied with praise, and Li Na said she was interested in the second silver bracelet and wanted to come to the store to try it on over the weekend.
location: Workstation at Xiafeiji, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Daily store operations and regular customer reception
description: Customers came to the store one after another. Lei Mingxuan greeted customers while tidying the shelves. Feng Xiaoyu, a regular customer, passed by and entered the store. They chatted about the weather. Lei Mingxuan recommended several new quick-dry T-shirts to her. After trying them on, Feng Xiaoyu bought two and asked about the weekend camping trip to Anji. They had a pleasant conversation.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (“Xiafei Collection”)

name: Lunch and market observation.
description: After locking the shop door, Lei Mingxuan walked to the B1 floor of the neighboring International Finance Center. At the food court, he bought a teriyaki chicken and vegetable wrap and a sugar-free iced Americano, then sat in a corner eating while observing the customer flow and displays of the surrounding stores. He paid special attention to the window displays of a newly opened niche designer boutique for inspiration.
location: Food court, B1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return to the store for autumn new-product inspection and setup
description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan walked back to the Super Brand Mall store. Just after arriving, he got a call from logistics. He went downstairs and moved the Autumn New Arrivals cartons to the back storage room with the delivery worker. Wearing gloves, he opened the cartons and inspected the goods by himself, checking the styles, colors, and sizes of the hardshell jackets, softshell pants, and quick-dry shirts one by one, and carefully examining zippers and loose threads. After confirming everything was correct, he picked out the key styles and brought them to the front sale area, adjusted the display according to the morning sketch, inserted handwritten story cards, and initially completed the setup of the autumn mountain-style techwear theme area.
location: The back warehouse and display area of "Xiafei Ji" at Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Store operations and remote communication
description: When the store had no customers for the moment, Lei Mingxuan opened his phone to reply to his cousin Yang Fan's messages and chatted about the store's recent situation. Then, using the store Wi-Fi, he opened the memo app on his phone, reviewed the previously saved Anji camping supplies list, confirmed that the gear purchased at Decathlon on July 9 could all be used, and marked 'Gear check complete' on the list.
location: Cashier counter at Xiafei Collection, Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Store tidying and handover preparation
description: With one hour left before the evening shift handover, Lei Mingxuan began organizing today's sales records and checking the cash and mobile payment accounts. He carefully put away the accessory samples left by Wu Fang, tidied the hangers in the fitting room, and swept up loose threads and paper scraps on the floor.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (“Xiafei Collection”)

name: End-of-shift handover and commute
description: The evening shift clerk Xiao Lin arrived on time. Lei Mingxuan gave her a detailed handover of the day's work: the placement of new displays, regular customer information, and the jewelry samples left by Wu Fang needed to be properly kept. He also reminded her that there might be showers at night. After the handover, he grabbed his backpack, got on his electric moped, and rode toward home.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Buy groceries on the way.
description: On the way home, the cloud cover thickened. Lei Mingxuan remembered his mother's reminder, so he stopped by the Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road and bought 500 grams of live shrimp and two tomatoes.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Resting at home and having family dinner
description: When he got home, raindrops were beginning to fall. Smelling the aromas of home cooking, Lei Mingxuan put down the groceries, sat on the sofa, drank some water, and petted A-Fu for a while. Dinner followed the set menu: steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, tomato and tofu soup, plus the boiled shrimp he had just bought. His father, Lei Jianguo, fed A-Fu a piece of fish as usual. Lei Mingxuan shared the store's progress, and his parents were happy to hear it. After dinner, he weighed himself again: 79.7 kg. His mother wrote the dishes on the fridge recipe sticky note, noting: "Two-week trial successful, moved to the regular menu."
location: Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-meal rest and training preparation
description: Lei Mingxuan drank a glass of warm water to aid digestion. While scrolling on his phone, he saw Zhang Wei say in the group chat that the weather would be nice for the weekend camping trip, and he replied, "Got it, gear is ready!" Then he went upstairs, changed into a sports vest and shorts, and laid out his yoga mat in the living room to train.
location: Living room, Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Core strength training
description: Since it was an active recovery day and his muscles were sore, he kept the training intensity moderate. After a 5-minute warm-up, Lei Mingxuan did 2 sets of push-ups (20 reps per set, giving up on a third set when exhausted), 2 sets of planks (40 seconds each), and 2 sets of sit-ups (15 reps each). Though the plan was shortened, he reminded himself that pacing himself well was more important. Afterward, he stretched for 10 minutes and felt much better.
location: On the yoga mat in Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel writing and platform updates
description: After showering, Lei Mingxuan sat down at his desk, turned on his computer, and updated Chapter 7 of the serialized historical novel The Afternoon at Xiafei Lane on the Fengdu platform. He conceived a sudden downpour scene and wrote the details of the protagonist running in the rain with particular delicacy. After writing about 1,800 words, he checked it, added the chapter title, and clicked publish. He then browsed reader comments and replied to each one.
location: Study, Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxation, socializing, and preparation before bed
description: Lei Mingxuan lay in bed holding A Fu and opened Bilibili to catch up on the latest episode of Jujutsu Kaisen. Afterward, he replied to his cousin Yang Fan's message and, in the Pudong Three Musketeers group, made the final confirmation with Zhang Wei and Li Na about the weekend camping trip to Anji: meeting time and car arrangements. After finishing the chat, he set his alarm for 6:30 the next morning, got out of bed to check the window, confirmed A Fu's water bowl was full, turned off the light, and lay down. Reviewing the fulfilling day, he felt satisfied and gradually fell asleep looking forward to the weekend camping trip
location: Bedroom, Room 301, No. 5, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run 5 kilometers.
description: Woke up at 5:30 a.m. Since I had rested well the day before, I decided to go to Century Park for a 5 km morning run. After changing into a quick-dry shirt and running shoes, I rode my e-bike to Gate 1 of Century Park and started running at exactly 6:00. My pace held steady at 5:45 per kilometer, and I kept my heart rate around 140. After finishing the run, I stretched by the lake for 10 minutes, took a photo of the lake in the morning light and a selfie, and felt very happy.
location: Gate 1, Century Park, No. 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Morning home life and breakfast
description: After the morning run, rode the e-bike home, took a cold shower, and changed into clean loungewear. On the balcony, I kept company with the orange tabby A-Fu, brushed its fur, took photos, and posted a WeChat Moments entry with a caption. Then I enjoyed a breakfast of whole wheat sandwich and unsweetened soy milk prepared by my mother, and discussed the next day's camping plan in Anji with my father, who reminded me to stay safe. After the meal, I changed into cargo shorts and a techwear-style T-shirt, packed my essentials, and filled A-Fu's automatic feeder with cat food, ready to head out for work.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to work
description: Left on my e-bike at 8:00 sharp and headed to the store at Super Brand Mall. On the way, I swapped in a fully charged battery at the Yuanshen Road gas station, then rode west along Century Avenue through the buildings of Lujiazui, and arrived at the back entrance of Super Brand Mall to park. The whole process took about 20 minutes.
location: Along the stretch from Yuanshen Road to Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Morning store work: new merchandise display and online business
description: After arriving at the store at 8:20, he first checked the previous day's sales data and online orders. He unpacked the autumn new arrivals and the collaborative silver jewelry samples. Using a tape measure and hand-drawn sketches, he rearranged the 'mountain-style techwear' themed display wall at the store entrance, pairing techwear vests, titanium alloy buckles, and industrial-style silver bracelets together. At 9:00, after shop assistant Xiao Lin arrived, he assigned her to call back key customers, while he shot several sets of detail photos for Xiaohongshu content, edited them, and posted a new-arrival preview.
location: Xiafei Ji Clothing Store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday reading at Starbucks
description: When the store had few customers, he went to the Starbucks in the mall, ordered an iced shaken lemon tea, sat by the window, and continued reading the historical novel Those Things in the Ming Dynasty on his phone. In between, he also watched a video of A Fu snoring on his phone, enjoying a moment of peace.
location: Starbucks Coffee, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and fashion inspiration gathering
description: I walked to IFC Mall and enjoyed smoked salmon avocado eggs Benedict with an iced Americano at Pancake Paradise on the basement level. While waiting for the food, I browsed Xiaohongshu to research the latest “mountain techwear” styling trends and roughly edited the photos taken in the morning. After the meal, I observed the displays and lighting of other outdoor brands in the mall, looking for inspiration for the online promotion of camping outfits.
location: Pancake Paradise, Basement 1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon store duty and client reception
description: After returning to the store, I continued organizing Xiaohongshu content. At 14:30, regular customer Qian Duoduo visited with a friend. I welcomed them warmly and recommended new silver jewelry based on her style; Qian Duoduo bought a pair. Her friend took a liking to a techwear vest, and after pairing it with cargo shorts, also made a purchase. In the conversation, I mentioned the next day's Anji camping plan; Qian Duoduo expressed interest, and we agreed to meet up at the next event.
location: Xiafei Ji Clothing Store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home after work
description: After handing over store work to Xiao Lin at 15:30, I left work early and rode my electric bike home. On the way, I bought electrolyte water and compressed biscuits at the Lawson convenience store at the community entrance as camping supplies, and arrived home at 16:00.
location: From Super Brand Mall to Shanggang Residential Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organize camping gear and roller skating preparations.
description: After getting home, he first cleaned the living room, then took out all the camping gear: lightweight tent, titanium cookware, down sleeping bag, inflatable ground pad, first-aid kit, self-heating rice, Moka pot, coffee beans, and so on. He checked each item against the list, including the tent poles, stove ignition, power bank charge, and headlamp function. It took nearly an hour to sort everything into a 70L outdoor backpack. Then he changed into roller-skating protective gear, a casual T-shirt, and shorts, slung on a crossbody bag with water and his phone, told his mother he wouldn't be home for dinner, and went out directly in his roller skates to meet his appointment.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Night roller skating along the riverside with Song Jia.
description: He skated to Dongchang Road Ferry to meet Song Jia, then skated along the Pudong Riverside roller-skating path toward Nanpu Bridge. The summer evening river breeze was gentle, and the Bund was brilliantly lit. The two chatted while skating, sharing plans for the next day's camping in Anji—bamboo sea, starry sky, and camping coffee—and Song Jia was very drawn to the idea. After skating about 8 km, they turned back and returned to Dongchang Road Ferry at 19:20, ending the activity.
location: Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (near the Dongchang Road Ferry, 1 Dongchang Road)

name: Going home for dinner and washing up
description: After roller skating, I got home at 19:35. My mother had reheated the meal, including steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and white rice. After wolfing it down, I took a hot shower to wash off the sweat, changed into clean pajamas, and felt completely relaxed in body and mind.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening writing, equipment confirmation, and relaxation before bed.
description: After showering, reorganized the backpack again to make sure the headlamp, power bank, and first-aid kit were within easy reach. Sat at the desk and turned on the computer, logged into the Fengdu platform, and spent half an hour polishing the ending of Chapter 8 of the novel The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane and checking for typos. Scheduled posts for 8:00 a.m. on July 12 and 13 to ensure the updates wouldn't be interrupted even without internet. After finishing, stretched to relax. Seeing Afu already curled up asleep on the bed, turned off the main light, and under the night light replied to Moments comments on the phone. Scrolled through trail-running videos for a while, then set the alarm for 6:00 the next morning, gently moved Afu back to the cat bed, and closed his eyes looking forward to the Anji trip.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning family time and health monitoring
description: Woken by the 6:30 alarm, Lei Mingxuan listened to the patter of rain outside the window, lazed in bed for a while scrolling through his phone, and confirmed that it would rain in Anji all day. After getting up and washing up, his mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared the low-fat breakfast they agreed on last night: whole wheat bread, fried eggs, skim milk, and blueberries. His father, Lei Jianguo, changed into a long-sleeved shirt and cheerfully announced that he was joining the healthy lifestyle. The family of three ate breakfast and chatted, with the sound of rain as background. After breakfast, his father used the yarn ball from his mother's knitting to tease A-Fu, the orange tabby cat. Lei Mingxuan quickly recorded a short video and sent it to the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat, then joined in playing with the cat. Afterwards, following the new routine from yesterday, his father took out the electronic blood pressure monitor, measured his blood pressure, and recorded it carefully, while Lei Mingxuan reminded him to take his blood pressure medication on time.
location: At home in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Departure preparations, goodbyes, and refueling
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to his room, changed into a quick-dry T-shirt, waterproof hiking pants, and a waterproof jacket, and did a final check of the camping gear piled in the entryway: tent, ground cloth, sleeping pad, sleeping bag, stove head, gas canister, pour-over coffee set, self-heating rice, power bank, and headlamp. After confirming everything was correct, he carried loads into the elevator, went down to the underground garage, and stacked everything into the car trunk. Before starting the car, he sent his parents a WeChat message saying he was setting off. After leaving the community, he stopped by the Sinopec gas station on Pucheng Road to fill up. While waiting for the gas, he set the navigation destination on his phone—China Grand Bamboo Sea Scenic Area in Anji, Zhejiang.
location: Shanggang Community underground garage, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China to Sinopec Pucheng Gas Station, 370 Shangcheng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drive to Anji in the rain
description: Starting from the gas station, he drove west along the Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway. The rain came and went in intensity. Lei Mingxuan turned on a history podcast he had downloaded earlier and listened while driving. About 1.5 hours later (around 10:15), he stopped at the Huzhou service area, used the restroom, stretched, and bought a bottle of water and a pack of beef jerky at the convenience store. At 10:30 he got back on the road, continued toward Anji, and finally left the highway to enter Tianhuangping Town.
location: Expressway from Shanghai, China to Tianhuangping Town, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, and the Huzhou Service Area along the way.

name: Arrived at the scenic area and had lunch in the car
description: Arriving at the entrance of the China Grand Bamboo Sea Scenic Area, he rolled down the car window in the drizzle to buy a ticket and enter, then followed the signs to the parking lot of the bamboo forest camping base. After parking, Lei Mingxuan took out his outdoor folding table and chairs, along with the chicken breast sandwiches and yogurt he had brought, and had a simple lunch in the car to store up energy for the afternoon's physical work.
location: Parking lot, China Grand Bamboo Sea Scenic Area, Tianhuangping Town, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Hiking in the rain and setting up camp
description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan packed all his gear into a large hiking backpack and, carrying the backpack and holding an umbrella, walked about 15 minutes from the parking lot to the designated camping area deep in the bamboo forest. Raindrops rustled on the bamboo leaves. He chose a relatively flat open space on slightly higher ground and began setting up his newly purchased lightweight tent. He paid special attention throughout to whether the waterproof zippers were smooth and whether the tent stakes could be fully driven into the soft, wet soil. After more than half an hour of work, the tent stood firmly, the inner tent was dry, and he was very satisfied with its performance.
location: Bamboo Forest Camping Area, China Grand Bamboo Sea Scenic Area, Tianhuangping Town, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Pour-over coffee time in the bamboo grove
description: After setting up camp, Lei Mingxuan propped up a small tarp at the tent entrance and took out the gas stove, kettle and pour-over coffee set. He set up a folding chair and sat down, listening to the rain. He began grinding coffee beans, folding the filter paper, slowly pouring water to let it bloom, and brewed a cup of black coffee in one smooth flow. Sitting under the tarp, he held the cup and quietly enjoyed the bamboo sea in the rain, feeling peaceful and content. He took a few photos and a short video and posted them to Moments with the caption: 'Rainy mountain forest, one cup brings the soul back.'
location: Under the camp canopy at the campsite in China Grand Bamboo Sea Scenic Area, Tianhuangping Town, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Bamboo forest exploration and novel plotting
description: After finishing his coffee, Lei Mingxuan put on his raincoat and took a walk along the bamboo path around the campsite, breathing in the incredibly fresh air after the rain. He noticed the sound of the stream, the birdsong, and the subtle sounds of raindrops falling on different plants, taking it all in with full attention. He opened the memo on his phone and recorded these observed details and feelings, thinking about how to apply them to the later plot of his novel The Afternoon of Xiafei Fang, conceiving a unique experience for the protagonist in a rainy mountain forest.
location: Bamboo forest path around the campsite in the China Great Bamboo Sea Scenic Area, Tianhuangping Town, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Midday rest and reading in the tent
description: Back at the campsite, he crawled into the tent and unzipped the sleeping bag to use as a blanket. The sound of rain outside became the best white noise. Lei Mingxuan took out his Kindle and continued reading In the Thick of It, which he hadn't finished. When tired, he dozed off, enjoying an isolated, slow-paced afternoon.
location: Inside a camping tent at the China Great Bamboo Sea scenic area, Tianhuangping Town, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Outdoor dinner in the rain
description: In the early evening, as the rain gradually lightened, Lei Mingxuan felt hungry and began preparing dinner. He took out the gas stove and a self-heating rice pack, picked a box of twice-cooked pork flavor, added water according to the instructions, and waited. Meanwhile, he boiled some hot water in a small pot and made a bowl of seaweed soup. After 15 minutes, the rice was steaming hot. He sat under the tarp, accompanied by the last raindrops and the gradually darkening sky, and finished this uniquely flavorful outdoor dinner.
location: Under the camp canopy at the campsite in China Grand Bamboo Sea Scenic Area, Tianhuangping Town, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Nighttime writing and online entertainment.
description: The sky had grown completely dark. Lei Mingxuan crawled into the tent, zipped up the inner and outer layers, and clipped a headlamp to the top, creating a small warm world of light. He took out his notebook and began drafting a novel, trying to put into words what he had seen and felt in the bamboo forest that day—especially the loneliness and freedom of being wrapped in bamboo and rain. When he got tired of writing, he leaned against his sleeping bag and scrolled through his phone, checking likes and comments on the coffee photo in his Moments, then opened Bilibili to watch a new video from a mountain-style outdoor blogger.
location: Inside a camping tent at the China Great Bamboo Sea scenic area, Tianhuangping Town, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Handling online store matters
description: Lei Mingxuan remembered that this morning was the scheduled auto-publication day for Chapter 8 of his novel. He opened the "Fengdu" author dashboard and confirmed that it had been published on schedule at 8 a.m. Then he used mobile data to look at the data from the "Xiafeiji" online mini program. Seeing that several new online orders had come in that afternoon, he forwarded the order information to store clerk Xiao Lin and told her to ship them tomorrow.
location: Inside a camping tent at the China Great Bamboo Sea scenic area, Tianhuangping Town, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and falling asleep.
description: After 21:00, the sound of rain almost stopped and everything around was silent. Lei Mingxuan packed up his electronic devices, took out a power bank to charge his phone, stepped out of the tent, and simply brushed his teeth with mineral water at the edge of the campsite. Then he went back into the tent and climbed into his warm sleeping bag. He turned off his headlamp, and the world immediately plunged into darkness, with only the occasional bird call coming from far away. Listening to the wind in the bamboo grove and the faint sound of a stream in the distance, he felt peaceful and content inside, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Inside the tent at the campsite, China Grand Bamboo Sea Scenic Area, Tianhuangping Town, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Waking up and washing up.
description: Woke up to the sound of birds and rain at the Anji Bamboo Sea campsite; the rain had stopped, and the tent was filled with the damp scent of grass and trees. Lei Mingxuan simply wiped his face with a wet wipe, rinsed his mouth, and prepared to break camp.
location: Campsite at China Grand Bamboo Sea Scenic Area, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Packing up camp and breaking camp
description: Put on the shell jacket and systematically organized the camping gear. Packed away the raincoat and hiking shoes, separated the wet flysheet, inner tent, and groundsheet, dried them with a quick-dry towel, then folded and stored them. Checked and put away the sleeping bag, foam pad, cookware, and other items one by one, packed up all the trash, and restored the campsite to its original state.
location: Campsite at China Grand Bamboo Sea Scenic Area, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Breakfast and final checks.
description: He made instant coffee with hot water from the thermos, had it with compressed biscuits and energy bars for breakfast, and did a few simple stretches. Finally, he did a final check around to confirm he hadn't left behind his phone, car keys, wallet, or any other items.
location: Campsite at China Grand Bamboo Sea Scenic Area, Anji County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Drove back to Shanghai.
description: Set off from Anji and returned home in Pudong, Shanghai along the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway. On the way, listened to a podcast about Republican-era Shanghai cinema and modern life to find inspiration for novel writing. Stopped to rest at the Jiaxing service area, bought a cup of soy milk and tea eggs, and checked phone messages, learning that store assistant Xiao Lin had notified that the goods had arrived.
location: G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway (Anji to Shanghai section), passing through Jiaxing Service Area in Zhejiang Province.

name: Return home and reunite with family and pets
description: Back home in Shanggang Community, Pudong, beloved cat Afu greeted me behind the door, circling around my feet. Father Lei Jianguo poked his head out from the study, and mother Wang Xiuying greeted me with a smile from the kitchen. Lei Mingxuan put his hiking backpack at the entrance, picked up Afu and weighed him, and briefly told his parents about the camping trip. His father even teased him, "Are you testing your gear or working as a coolie?"
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Putting away equipment and cleaning up
description: Carry the hiking backpack to the balcony, spread out the tent and rainfly to dry, hang the sleeping bag and inner tent in a ventilated place, and toss the damp clothes into the washing machine. Then take a hot shower and change into a clean T-shirt and casual pants.
location: Balcony and bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Simple Family Lunch
description: Mother prepared tomato and egg noodles, stir-fried water spinach, and boiled shrimp. While eating, they shared camping photos and funny stories. Father teased him, saying 'wet behind the ears,' and asked about his blood pressure, then showed his record book to Lei Mingxuan.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting ready to go to the book club.
description: Checked the canvas bag, packed the notebook, pen, and phone, and messaged assistant Xiao Lin to confirm the display plan for tomorrow's new arrivals. After greeting his father, he rode his e-bike to the Yangjing Subdistrict Community Cultural Center.
location: On the road from Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the Yangjing Subdistrict Community Cultural Center, No. 717 Juye Road.

name: Participate in the history book club event
description: He attended the reading group for "The Social Life History of Republican Shanghai" in the reading room on the second floor of the Yangjing Subdistrict Community Cultural Center, where they discussed longtang (alley) life and everyday street food. Lei Mingxuan had an in-depth conversation with Zhao Xiaoyun, a group member who researches Republican-era clothing, and looked at her collection of calendar posters and magazine advertisement photos, obtaining many costume details about cloud-shawl collars and jade pendants. The two agreed to schedule an online interview the following week to gather material for his novel "Afternoon in Xiafei Fang". He took a full three pages of notes and photographed some of the materials.
location: Reading Room, 2nd Floor, Yangjing Subdistrict Community Cultural Center, No. 717 Juye Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shopping at the vegetable market.
description: After the book club, I rode the e-bike and stopped by Pushang Market on Dongchang Road on the way. I picked fresh sea bass, shrimp, asparagus, and tomatoes, planning to make a healthy dinner. Carrying the groceries home, Afu greeted me at the door by rubbing against my feet.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organize reading notes
description: In the study, he opened the tablet and organized the afternoon's reading notes into a mind map, focusing on sorting out details of Republican-era clothing. After his eyes felt a little strained, he went to the living room, chatted with his father who was watching stock market news, picked up Afu, and quickly replied to messages on the clothing store's work group chat with his phone.
location: Study and living room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk the cat with my father
description: His father suggested taking A Fu downstairs for some exercise, and Lei Mingxuan went along. His father put A Fu on the leash and walked around the neighborhood, with A Fu running joyfully. When neighbor Auntie Liu saw them, she praised A Fu for its shiny coat and good spirits. His father said modest things, but his face beamed with joy, and Lei Mingxuan captured the happy moment with his phone.
location: Inside Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Healthy family dinner
description: Using the ingredients Lei Mingxuan had bought, Mother made steamed sea bass, blanched shrimp, garlic asparagus, and tomato and egg soup. The whole family sat around the table, eating a light and satisfying meal. Mother teased Father about being complimented downstairs, and Father was rarely embarrassed. Lei Mingxuan ate two bowls of multigrain rice, while Afu kept rubbing against his feet.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-meal weigh-in
description: Habitually stepped on the electronic scale in the bathroom; it read 80.3 kg. Analyzed that it was due to high-sodium food and water retention from yesterday’s camping trip. Planned to resume a low-carb diet and morning running to control weight.
location: Bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening yoga relaxation
description: In the bedroom, I laid out a yoga mat, played soothing music, and did poses for post-hike stretching such as Cat-Cow, Downward Dog, and Butterfly, then did 20 minutes of yin yoga, which relieved the stiffness in my back and waist and the soreness in my legs.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Writing the novel “An Afternoon in Xiafei Lane”.
description: Sit at the desk and incorporate the Republican-era clothing materials from the daytime book club into Chapter 9. Describe the heroine encountering an old tailor specializing in yunjian capes in front of a Shikumen gate, and through memories bring out the longtang craftsmen's skills and clothing stories. Complete about 1,800 words of first draft, add a header image, and set it for scheduled publishing.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: WeChat Moments interactions and sharing
description: Shared the book club and dinner in the "Three Musketeers of Pudong" group chat and got replies from childhood friends Zhang Wei and Li Na. He replied to comments on last night's camping Moments post, selected camping photos with the caption "After the rain, bamboo grove, farewell. Life in the Magic City, I'm back." and published a new post. He forwarded the Republican-era clothing materials to his cousin Shen Jie and agreed to discuss them next week.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime routine and rest
description: A Fu was already lying on the pillow. He gently carried him off and changed into pajamas. He read a few pages of Those Stories of the Ming Dynasty, used his phone memo to record the items to confirm for tomorrow's new product display, then turned off the light and ended the day with A Fu's purring.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and low-carb breakfast
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the alarm went off. Lei Mingxuan got up and first weighed himself, and found that his weight had increased slightly due to the high-salt diet during the camping trip. He gently stroked his orange tabby cat A Fu, then enjoyed a low-carb breakfast prepared by his mother Wang Xiuying: a whole wheat sandwich and unsweetened soy milk. During breakfast, he sent a good-morning sticker in his close friends' group chat and made plans for a weekend gathering.
location: Home, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: At 6:55 a.m., Lei Mingxuan rode an electric bicycle from home, traveled along Pudong Avenue for about twelve minutes, and arrived at Super Brand Mall. He parked at the mall's back door, walked to the Xiafei Ji clothing store at No. A-208 on the second floor, unlocked the door, turned on the lights, checked the air conditioning, and completed the store opening preparations.
location: Xiafei Ji Clothing Store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and receiving regular customers
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan rearranged the mannequins at the entrance, dressing them in dark green tech-wear vests and cargo shorts to highlight an urban-mountain style. He then processed online orders, contacted Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao to confirm the logistics and sample progress of new products, and sent his cousin Shen Jie suggestions for a Xiaohongshu account name. At nine o'clock, after the mall opened, regular customer Feng Xiaoyu arrived. Lei Mingxuan received her warmly and styled her with a sun-protective hooded jacket, tapered pants, and a white T-shirt. Feng Xiaoyu was satisfied and bought the whole outfit. After seeing her off, he continued organizing the clothing racks and photographed the new store display to post on his Moments.
location: Xiafei Ji Clothing Store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch meeting with my cousin to finalize the Xiaohongshu operation plan
description: After finishing the morning work, Lei Mingxuan closed the shop door and walked to the Starbucks Reserve Store on B1 floor of Super Brand Mall. His cousin Shen Jie had arrived early and ordered coffee. The two chatted over coffee and discussed; Shen Jie showed the popular tags and viral notes for mountain-core functional style outfits on Xiaohongshu. They finally settled on the account positioning as 'urban functional style commuter menswear,' interspersed with outdoor camping vlogs, planning to update every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday, with unified high-saturation natural-light photos for covers. During the chat, Lei Mingxuan also ordered a chicken breast salad as lunch to stick to his low-carb diet.
location: Starbucks Reserve (Super Brand Mall), B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In-store try-on shooting and lunch break.
description: After the meal, the two returned to the clothing store. Shen Jie picked out three sample outfits in the urban functional style. Lei Mingxuan changed into them one by one, and Shen Jie guided him through poses such as walking naturally and looking at his phone. Using the natural light and white wall at the store entrance, they finished shooting forty photos in about forty minutes. After seeing Shen Jie off, Lei Mingxuan browsed the photos and felt the lighting was excellent. Then, taking advantage of the quiet afternoon in the mall, he lay down on a folding chair in the store for a twenty-minute nap to recover his energy, and replied to the property manager's WeChat message about the mall event.
location: Xiafei Ji Clothing Store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Researching commercial coffee machines for the in-store coffee corner
description: During the hot afternoon hours, there were few customers. Lei Mingxuan used his laptop in the store to compare several commercial coffee machines, recording prices, performance, and floor space, while planning a coffee corner for the store. He then contacted Zhou Yang, a barista at Qiyun Café, via WeChat to ask about the long-term maintenance of De'Longhi fully automatic and Nuova semi-automatic coffee machines. Zhou Yang suggested choosing the De'Longhi fully automatic model and promised to help ask about the channel price. After the conversation, Lei Mingxuan posted a try-on photo he had taken in the morning on Moments, with a caption promoting urban techwear outfits.
location: Xiafei Ji Clothing Store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the shop, market shopping, and heading home
description: At five p.m., Lei Mingxuan began tidying the store, shut down the computer, and organized sales receipts. Then he rode his electric bike home and passed the Pushang Market on Dongchang Road, where he went in to buy fresh ingredients such as seedless watermelon, blueberries, okra, and scallions to add to the family dinner.
location: Pushang Food Market (Rushan Road Branch), Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Family Time and Helping in the Kitchen
description: After returning home, Lei Mingxuan first played with the orange cat A Fu, who had rushed up to him, and then changed into loungewear. His mother Wang Xiuying was preparing dinner: blanched shrimp and garlic okra. He took the initiative to help peel garlic and trim vegetables. Mother and son chatted casually, while A Fu squatted at the kitchen door meowing for shrimp.
location: Home kitchen, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Healthy family dinner
description: During dinner, his father Lei Jianguo came out of the living room, and the family sat around the dining table. The dinner included boiled shrimp, garlic okra, cucumber salad, and multigrain rice. Lei Mingxuan shared the Xiaohongshu plan and the new photos he had made with his cousin Shen Jie that day. His mother was very interested, and his father listened quietly without objecting. After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the table.
location: Home dining room, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stroll and deep father-son talk
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan suggested accompanying his father downstairs to walk the cat. The two took A Fu on a stroll around the residential complex and nearby trails in a relaxed atmosphere. Lei Mingxuan talked about his camping experiences, and his father also recalled travel adventures from his youth. When they returned to the bench downstairs, Lei Mingxuan gathered his courage to show his father the Southeast Asian brand analysis PPT and chat records with suppliers he had prepared, and explained his shop upgrade plan. After reading carefully, his father unexpectedly relented and agreed to a small-scale trial, asking him to first order samples and prepare a budget and sales plan. Lei Mingxuan was excited inside, and A Fu rubbed against them both, making the atmosphere even warmer.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the walking paths inside and nearby

name: Evening family leisure time
description: After the walk, his mother had already sliced chilled watermelon and blueberries. The family sat in the living room; A Fu lay on Lei Mingxuan's lap and occasionally played with his father's hand. His mother joked that A Fu had become the family's “little mediator.” After father and son reached a consensus, the atmosphere at home was noticeably more relaxed. Lei Mingxuan ate a piece of watermelon, enjoying this comforting evening.
location: Living room at home, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Late-night writing to update the novel
description: Lei Mingxuan, in high spirits, returned to the study, opened his laptop, and began updating Chapter 10 of the novel 'Afternoon in Xiafei Lane'. Tonight's exchange with his father gave him inspiration. He had the protagonist receive a letter on a rainy night that resolved a long-standing knot in his heart. With delicate writing, he wrote about 2000 characters in about two hours. After writing, he polished it and scheduled the release, laying the groundwork in the novel for today's breakthrough with his father.
location: Home study, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime routine.
description: After posting the novel, Lei Mingxuan finished washing up and returned to the bedroom. He lay in bed scrolling videos on his phone and watched an episode of anime, then Ah Fu jumped onto the bed and curled up by the pillow. He gently stroked Ah Fu, turned off the light, and fell asleep looking forward to the store upgrade plan.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 3, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run in the heat and a new chapter in family health
description: At 6:15 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan went downstairs and walked to Lujiazui Central Green Park to start his morning run. The weather was muggy, so he lowered his pace to 5 minutes 45 seconds per kilometer and wore a heart rate strap to monitor his heart rate throughout at 140-150 bpm. After finishing 4 kilometers, he stretched by the lake and took a photo of his sweat-soaked vest to document it. He got home at 7:00 and saw his father Lei Jianguo studying the manual for a new blood pressure monitor. He immediately went over to guide him through the operation and encouraged him to record readings daily. His father's reading was normal, and Lei Mingxuan gave an exaggerated thumbs-up: 'Dad, with a body like yours, you'll be collecting your pension for another 50 years!' His father laughed in response, looking proud. At 7:15, he took out a whole-wheat sandwich and skim milk, and as he ate, he agreed with his father that after each morning run he would report his blood pressure results when he got home.
location: Lujiazui Central Greenbelt in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Shanggang Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue

name: Showering, Heading Out, and Commuting
description: After a quick shower, he changed into a black T-shirt and cargo shorts. Before leaving, he added food for the cat A Fu and interacted affectionately with him. At 8 o'clock he rode his e-bike along Pudong Avenue and turned onto East Lujiazui Road. Near Dongchang Road, he weaved flexibly through the non-motorized lanes during the morning rush hour, mentally planning his words for the afternoon showdown with friends. At 8:10 he arrived at the Super Brand Mall employee parking area, ending his commute.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, No. 168, Lujiazui West Road

name: Shop opening preparation and morning work
description: First went to the convenience store in Jin Mao Tower to buy an iced Americano for a pick-me-up, arrived at the 'Xiafei Ji' store at A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall at 8:20, and turned on the air conditioner and air purifier. Together with store clerk Xiao Lin, hung the newly arrived mountain-style techwear jackets on racks and adjusted the spotlight angles, then went through today's online orders, emphasizing that the pour-over kettle in the coffee corner should be placed at a 45-degree angle with a flavor card. There were not many customers in the morning. Lei Mingxuan checked the online shipping orders, synced inventory to the ERP, and took out a tape measure to repeatedly measure the reserved coffee corner area, drawing a traffic flow diagram based on the dimensions of the coffee machine recommended by the barista. In the middle of this, he received two batches of walk-in customers and successfully recommended a gray woven suit set.
location: Inside the "Xiafeiji" store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch: recharging alone.
description: At 12 o'clock sharp, he closed the shop and had Xiao Lin look after it. Lei Mingxuan walked across the footbridge to the newly opened Hakata Ikkousha ramen shop on LG2 of IFC Mall and ordered a bowl of rich tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While waiting, he checked the refined cover image for Xiaohongshu sent by his cousin Shen Jie and replied, 'This lighting is amazing—use it!' After the meal, he regained his energy and recharged for the afternoon's work.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant, LG2 floor, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store matters and key communications
description: Returning to the store in the afternoon, he first bought sugar-free cola to refresh himself. At 13:15, he sorted packages with Xiao Lin and scheduled a pickup. Sitting behind the cash register, he opened his laptop, browsed the official accounts of trail running and camping brands, noted co-branding ideas, and repeatedly watched coffee machine selection videos while recording specifications. At 14:30, his friend Han Dong arrived at the store in basketball shorts and fiercely questioned the rough prototype of the coffee corner. Lei Mingxuan served him pour-over coffee and calmly explained his business philosophy of 'giving customers a reason to sit down.' Han Dong still grumbled but softened his attitude, and before leaving, patted him on the shoulder and reminded him to control the risk. After seeing Han Dong off, at 16:10 he immediately called Li, the coffee equipment supplier, to discuss the price, warranty, and installation dimensions of the S-type semi-automatic coffee machine. After 15 minutes of bargaining, they reached a tentative agreement and scheduled a trial run at the Baoshan showroom next Tuesday afternoon. As soon as he hung up, his cousin Shen Jie called excitedly to say she had adjusted the Xiaohongshu photo-and-text publishing schedule and proposed an interactive topic of 'coffee + outfit styling.' While listening, Lei Mingxuan fixed his phone with a phone stand, moved the camping table, and planned the wall tool display, and together they finalized the shooting script for the next viral piece.

participant.name: Manager Li from the coffee equipment supplier

location: Inside the "Xiafeiji" store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Simple dinner

He ate quickly in the seating area outside the supermarket to keep his palate clear and prepare for the class.
location: ole' Fresh Supermarket, B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

Lei Mingxuan compared brewing by adjusting water temperature and grind size, recorded dry-aroma data, and finally distinguished differences in caramel, acidity, and body through sensory evaluation. After class, he found Lao Zhou, who was also drinking coffee in the shop, and once again confirmed the selection requirements and budget for Southeast Asian specialty beans. Lao Zhou readily agreed to send samples and a quote to the store the next week, and they agreed to finalize the plan after Lei Mingxuan reviewed the coffee machine prototype.
location: ideaPod reserved work cafe, 78 Huqiu Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

Stepping out of the studio with the smell of coffee on him, he reviewed the evening's brewing techniques and the day's exchanges with Han Dong and Lao Zhou in the evening breeze. While transferring from Line 10 to Line 2, his earphones played Lose Yourself. He jotted down inspiration in his phone's memo app, planning to incorporate it into the next chapter of his novel, and finally returned to Shanggang Residential Area on Pudong Avenue.
location: No. 78 Huqiu Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai to Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

He shared the day's coffee course insights with his parents, and after chatting about family matters, he went back to his room, turned on his computer, and updated Chapter 11 of his novel Afternoon in Xiafei Lane, cleverly weaving the sweetness from mid-temperature extraction into the scene of the protagonist negotiating a business deal in a café. After writing two paragraphs, he went to the living room to watch the evening news with his parents and listened to his father complain about the international situation. At 22:45 he washed up, at 23:15 he filled a cup with warm water for his father, then returned to his room and fell into a deep sleep.

At 8:05 he bought an iced Americano at the convenience store in Jin Mao Tower and chatted with the clerk about a newly launched energy drink. At 8:15 he continued riding, and at 8:25 he arrived at Super Brand Mall and parked the bike.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168, Lujiazui West Road, via the convenience store at Jin Mao Tower.

name: Store morning meeting and window display adjustment
description: At 8:25 entered the store at A-208 on Level 2 of Super Brand Mall, turned on the lights and air conditioning. At 8:30 held a morning meeting with store clerk Xiao Lin, assigning the day's tasks: promote the new mountain-style technical vests and work shorts, adjust the window mannequin outfits to light colors to highlight a summer cool feel, and remind Xiao Lin to pay attention to the safety of the morning coffee corner construction. From 8:45 to 9:00 the two worked together to change the window display, putting out the popular Japanese-style work shorts and gray-green technical vests, and adjusting the spotlights to emphasize the three-dimensional tailoring.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Coffee corner preparation and promotion plan review
description: 9:00-9:45 at the store, checked the coffee corner layout, equipment dimensions, and pipe positions on an iPad, and reviewed electrician Master Zhou's 1,200 yuan quote and construction team leader Lao Li's promises, sorting out the construction process. 9:45-10:00 handwrote the optimized promotion plan (spend 269 yuan and get a 5 yuan coffee voucher; repost on Xiaohongshu for a drip coffee bag) on a sticky note and put it on the cashier counter, so as to take customer flow into account when communicating with the construction team.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: On-site inspection of the coffee corner with the construction team
description: At 10:00, Lao Li from the construction crew arrived at the store on time. Lei Yang discussed in detail the electrical and plumbing renovation plan for the coffee corner, the bar counter construction, and the dimension requirements for the sintered stone countertop. The two re-measured length and depth on site with a tape measure, and Lao Li pointed out things to note for the drainage pipe routing. Finally, they confirmed on the spot a total price of 6,800 yuan for the electrical and plumbing renovation and the basic bar counter construction, settled on starting construction next Monday (July 21), and asked Lao Li to send the construction schedule and quotation via WeChat.
location: Coffee corner area of Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday walk to IFC
description: After seeing off Old Li at 11:30, refilled water in the store and briefed Xiao Lin on matters for watching the store during noon. At 11:45 walked to the adjacent International Finance Center mall. On the way, while browsing Xiaohongshu, saw that the outfit note posted by Xiao Lin yesterday had received 58 likes and over ten comments, feeling pleased. At 12:00 arrived at the Japanese ramen shop on B1 of International Finance Center.
location: From Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, to IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue.

name: Lunch and soft furnishing consultation with cousin Shen Jie
description: Had lunch with my younger cousin Shen Jie at the "Ippudo" Japanese ramen shop on B1 of IFC Mall, where we each ordered Akamaru ramen and a side of gyoza. During the meal, Lei Yang used an iPad to show the coffee corner renderings. With a buyer's eye, Shen Jie suggested using a pegboard on the bar wall to hang designer toys and pour-over kettles, and laying hexagonal patterned tiles with gray self-leveling flooring to separate the areas. Lei Yang recorded this in his memo. In addition, Lei Yang mentioned his plan to go camping on the Huangshan Ancient Trail over the weekend, and Shen Jie was interested, saying she could bring a drone to shoot a vlog.
location: Japanese Ramen Restaurant, B1, International Finance Center Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and customer maintenance
description: He returned to the store at 13:30 and rested briefly. From 14:00 to 16:30, the afternoon customer flow increased. Lei Yang wore the new arrivals and provided styling advice to customers. Returning customer Qian Duoduo came with her close friend, and with his recommendation, he successfully sold two couple-style sets of mountain vests and workwear shorts. From 16:30 to 17:00, during his spare time, he contacted supplier Tao Ge on WeChat to check the next week's technical fabric order and confirmed the accessory restocking time with Fang Jie. From 17:00 to 17:30, he arranged for Xiao Lin to wear the featured shorts and take photos and short videos in front of the store's green plant wall. Lei Yang did simple retouching, edited the captions, and posted to his personal Xiaohongshu and WeChat Moments.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handle online orders and send out packages.
description: From 17:30 to 17:45, he checked the backend and found three online orders that day. Lei Yang quickly packed the goods and affixed the shipping labels. At 17:45, he rode his electric bike to the Hive Box lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station, used the mini-program to open a locker and send the packages, then returned to the store.
location: From Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the luggage lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station, 158 Huayuanshiqiao Road

name: Evening store meeting and account handover
description: From 18:00 to 18:30, took inventory of the day's revenue with store clerk Xiao Lin, up about 15% compared with the same time yesterday. Lei Yang praised Xiao Lin for today's outfit recommendations and video shooting. From 18:30 to 18:40, held a brief evening meeting, summarized the survey of the coffee corner, informed of the construction crew's arrival on Monday, assigned Xiao Lin to clear the goods and clutter in the coffee corner area in advance, and organize warehouse space for next Monday's new mountain-style T-shirts.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buying fruit after work and calling mother
description: At 18:40, left Super Brand Mall on an electric bike and arrived at Xianfeng Fruit Store on Dongchang Road, Pudong at 18:55, spending more than 50 yuan on blueberries, cherry tomatoes, and peaches. While riding, called his mother Wang Xiuying to discuss the weekend camping plan. His mother reminded him to bring heatstroke medicine and insect repellent, and offered to cook tea eggs. At 19:10, returned home in Shanggang Residential Quarter and put the fruit in the refrigerator.
location: From Super Brand Mall at 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Xianfeng Fruit Store on Dongchang Road, then returned to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Family dinner and daily conversation
description: After arriving home at 19:10, greeted parents and helped wash vegetables and peel garlic to assist mother in preparing dinner. At the dinner table, Lei Yang reported on the construction team's inspection of the coffee corner and the plan to start work next Monday; parents expressed support. Mother reminded again to pack medicine for the camping trip, and father silently stuffed two bottles of Huoxiang Zhengqi water into Lei Yang's backpack.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Integrated coffee corner planning documents
description: After dinner, Lei Yang opened his MacBook in the study, organized the layout drawings he had made earlier, Lao Li's quotation and construction schedule, Master Zhou the electrician's quote, and cousin Shen Jie's soft furnishing suggestions into a new folder, and created a new Word document updating the copy and talking points for the promotion plan (spend 269 yuan and receive a coffee voucher; repost on Xiaohongshu and get drip coffee bags), forming a complete planning document with the equipment list, layout, and promotion plan. When finished, he sent it to Lao Li and Shen Jie on WeChat for feedback.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
