name: Update the serialized novel
description: At 21:00, Lei Yang sat in the study using his MacBook writing software to continue writing a new chapter, "The Aroma of Alley Coffee," of the novel "Afternoon in Xiafei Fang". He incorporated today's discussion with Shen Jie about pegboards, patterned tiles, and designer toys into the plot of the protagonist opening a community café. Full of inspiration, he completed 1,500 words. From 22:00 to 22:15, after saving the document and polishing it, he published the chapter on the fiction serialization platform.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and time with the cat.
description: At 22:15, left the study and saw the cat A Fu waiting by the bowl, so added freeze-dried treats as a late-night snack and picked up a feather wand to play with it for a while. At 22:30, sat on the living room sofa, scrolled through Moments on the phone and replied to comments, while listing items needed for the weekend camping trip in the memo app.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: At 22:45, after washing up and changing into pajamas, he did a simple stretching routine in the bedroom. Lying in bed, he reviewed the day: the coffee corner site check went smoothly, the planning document was consolidated, novel inspiration came, and the weekend camping trip was in sight. Life felt full and satisfying. At 23:00, he turned off the lights and went to bed, looking forward to a new day.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning tidying and departure preparation
description: Lei Mingxuan got up early in the morning, quickly washed up, and changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and hiking pants. He first took care of his pet cat A'fu, refilled the automatic feeder with cat food, changed the water, and opened a can of tuna. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had gotten up even earlier, preparing tea eggs and a Spam sandwich for him and putting them in an insulated bag. Lei Mingxuan carefully checked the gear in his large backpack: tent, sleeping bag, sleeping pad, camp stove, cookware set, first-aid kit, headlamp, power bank, hand coffee grinder, and Ethiopian Hambella coffee beans. The backpack weighed about 16 kg.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Loading the car and saying goodbye
description: Lei Mingxuan carried his big backpack to the underground garage and loaded it into the trunk of his car. His mother followed him to the garage and told him to be careful, watch out for the cold nights in the mountains, make sure the tent was secured, and send a message when he arrived. Lei Mingxuan laughed and replied. Before getting into the car, he sent a voice message in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group to tell his friends that he was going camping at Sheshan today.
location: Underground garage, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Drive to Sheshan
description: Lei Mingxuan set off from Shanggang Community by car, turned from Pudong Avenue onto the Inner Ring Elevated Road, and drove to Sheshan via the Humin Elevated Road and the Shanghai-Kunming Expressway. With little traffic in the early morning, he played the “Mountain Hip-Hop” playlist and watched the city skyline gradually fade, his mood bright. On the way, he used Voice Memos to record inspiration for the “Natural Café” in the novel “Afternoon in Xiafei Lane”: a glass roof, hanging vines, the aroma of coffee mixed with the smell of earth after rain, and an old piano in the corner.
location: From Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, to Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District (via Inner Ring Elevated Road, Humin Elevated Road, and Shanghai-Kunming Expressway)

name: Arrive at Sheshan Hill, sort out gear and breakfast.
description: Arrived at the West Sheshan Park parking lot; the air was fresh. Lei Mingxuan sat on a bench, ate the sandwich his mother had prepared, and drank water to restore energy. Then he spent 10 minutes adjusting his backpack's load-carrying system, tightening his laces, applying sunscreen and mosquito repellent, and confirming his phone and power bank were fully charged. He took a photo of the lush tree canopies behind the parking lot, checked in with a location tag on WeChat Moments: 'Escaping the concrete jungle, searching for my spiritual mine. Let's go!'
location: West Sheshan Park Parking Lot, 9260 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Ancient Trail Hike: A First Look at the Mountain Forest
description: Lei Mingxuan put on his big backpack and chose the 'Wild Trail' path to start his heavy-load hike. The trail consisted of gravel dirt paths and stone steps, evoking an ancient road. He breathed in the fresh air and listened to birdsong and cicadas. Along the way, he photographed mossy stones and dappled sunlight. After walking about 3 kilometers, he used a drone at the viewing platform to capture a panoramic view of Sheshan Hill, then made a short video with the caption 'Lightweight heavy-load hiking around Shanghai, a perfect experience!' and posted it to Xiaohongshu. On the way, he ran into an elderly man doing morning exercise.
location: No. 9260 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai, West Sheshan Park Trail and Wilderness Trail

name: Venturing into the forest and seeking the ancient bridge
description: Following the park map, Lei Mingxuan found a side path leading to the abandoned quarry ruins. It was rarely trafficked, giving it an even stronger sense of wilderness exploration. He observed ferns and rock textures along the way and took hardcore adventure-style photos. At the end of the quarry, he discovered an old stone arch bridge covered with moss and wild vines, its structure still intact. He rested for 20 minutes, drank some water, and used his notebook to work out a plot in his novel where the protagonist hides from pursuers on an abandoned old bridge; ideas flowed.
location: Trail and ancient bridge at the abandoned quarry site in West Sheshan Hill Park, 9260 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Forest lunch: wild cooking
description: By a flat stream near the quarry ruins, Lei Mingxuan set up a camping stove and cookset, boiled braised beef instant noodles with stream water, and added his mother's braised tea eggs and chicken sausages. Steam rose, and the aroma filled the valley. He recorded a Vlog sharing his experience of eating instant noodles in the wild, saying it smelled better than a three-star Michelin meal, and found the soul material for the 'wilderness survival' plot of his novel.
location: By the stream near the quarry site of West Sheshan Park, 9260 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon hike and ecology notes.
description: After strictly cleaning up all the trash, Lei Mingxuan headed west across the connecting trail to East Sheshan Park. The path had a gentle slope. He used a plant identification app to photograph unfamiliar wildflowers and mushrooms, and picked up a cool-shaped dead branch to bring back to the store as decoration. On an open slope, he saw a small squirrel nibbling a pinecone and snapped a photo.
location: Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai (connecting trail from West Sheshan Park to East Sheshan Park)

name: Arrive at the campsite and set up camp
description: At 2 p.m., arrived at the designated camping area in East Sheshan Park. It was sparsely populated and quiet. Lei Mingxuan chose a flat, open grassy area, skillfully set up the tent, hammered in the stakes, tightened the guy lines, and laid out the ground mat and sleeping bag. After finishing, he drank the iced cola from his thermos, lay down on the inflatable pillow to relax, and his fatigue dissipated.
location: Designated camping area, East Sheshan Park, 9511 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Free time: brainstorming and rest.
description: After resting for half an hour in the tent, Lei Mingxuan used his tablet to organize the morning's hiking notes and voice memos. Combined with photo materials, he drafted the next chapter of the novel, Stargazing Night in the Mountains, and wrote about 1,000 words in one go, describing the scene where the protagonist hears a mysterious sound in the forest and discovers an abandoned stone house. Afterward, he read Steve Jobs for 40 minutes, enjoying the peace of being cut off from the world.
location: Inside a tent in the camping area of East Sheshan Park, 9511 Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Campfire and dinner preparations
description: The sun was setting in the west, and the light was soft and warm. Lei Mingxuan lit a small campfire at the designated fire spot in the camping area using dry branches and kindling (with a safe steel barrel). He took a self-heating hot pot, two cans of beer, and some cherry tomatoes from the car. Watching the fire crackle, he felt this was what life was all about.
location: Designated campfire spot in the camping area of East Sheshan Park, 9511 Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai.

name: Campfire dinner time
description: The self-heating hot pot was boiling, and the aroma filled the air. Lei Mingxuan opened an ice-cold beer, sat in a moon chair facing the campfire and the golden-tinted mountain forest, and enjoyed dinner. During the meal, he had a 15-minute video call with his parents, showing the tent and campfire. His mother told him not to play with fire and to keep his sleeping bag wrapped around him at night. He reassured his parents and promised he would be home safe tomorrow morning.
location: Beside the campfire in the camping area, East Sheshan Park, No. 9511 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Outdoor pour-over coffee ritual and stargazing plan
description: The sky was not yet completely dark. Lei Mingxuan took out his camping coffee gear: he finely ground Huakui beans with a hand-cranked grinder, heated water to 92°C with a temperature-sensing kettle, and made pour-over coffee outdoors. The coffee aroma mixed with campfire smoke was especially enchanting in the mountain forest. Sipping his coffee and using his phone light to illuminate his notebook, he polished the latest chapter of The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane, A Night of Stargazing in the Mountain Forest, weaving in the abandoned ancient bridge, the quarry, and the ritual of pour-over coffee. He felt like a literary adventurer.
location: By the campsite table in the camping area of East Sheshan Park, No. 9511 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Evening walk and starry sky photography.
description: After dark, Lei Mingxuan put on a headlamp and took a walk near the camping area, enjoying the quiet and mystery of the mountain forest at night. With little light pollution, he could see quite a few stars, so he tried shooting the starry sky with his phone's pro mode. The results were mediocre, but it felt great. He shared the star photos and coffee in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group, drawing envy from friends and a flood of memes.
location: The area around the camping zone at East Sheshan Park, 9511 Waiqingsong Highway, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Washing up and safety check
description: After returning to the campsite, Lei Mingxuan wiped himself down with wet wipes and changed into a clean quick-dry T-shirt. Before bed, he carefully checked the tent: made sure the guy lines were tight, the stakes were secure, and all zippers were closed. He sealed all food scraps and trash in a waterproof bag and hung it on a tree branch a few meters away from the tent to avoid attracting wild animals. He placed spare water and a small flashlight inside the tent and felt at ease.
location: Public restrooms and tents, camping area, East Sheshan Park, No. 9511 Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Preparing for sleep
description: Lei Mingxuan crawled into his sleeping bag and zipped up the mesh layer, leaving a ventilation opening. After turning off his headlamp, he listened to the wind, the chirping of insects, and the distant barking of dogs, and reflected on the day's adventure. Even though he hadn't made it to Huangshan, the adventurous spirit of Sheshan had been more than enough. He remembered that he needed to get back to the store tomorrow to oversee the coffee corner installation, so he wrote in his phone memo: estimated weight 79.8 kg, today's loaded hike about 9.5 km, get up at 6:30 tomorrow, pack up camp, be home for a shower before 9, then head to the store. Satisfied, he fell into a deep sleep.
location: Inside a tent in the camping area of East Sheshan Park, 9511 Waiqingsong Road, Songjiang District, Shanghai

name: Resting at the Huangshan campsite.
description: In the early hours, he rested in a tent at a wilderness campsite on Huangshan. He was woken twice by the mountain wind, and the temperature had dropped to the low teens. The abrasion on his right wrist was throbbing faintly. Half asleep, he recalled the weightlessness of the daytime slip and the feeling of rock scraping over his skin. During the latter half of the night, he could not sleep deeply due to worry about wound infection and insufficient energy.
location: Wild campsite in Huangshan Scenic Area, Tangkou Town, Huangshan District, Huangshan City, Anhui Province

name: Striking camp and a simple breakfast.
description: Woke up at dawn. Despite sore shoulders and wrists, packed up the tent and sleeping bag. After washing up in the stream, ate an energy gel and compressed biscuits, and filled the thermos. Checked the wrist bandage and decided to play it safe, then hiked to the parking lot.
location: From the campsite in Huangshan Scenic Area, Tangkou Town, Huangshan District, Huangshan City, Anhui Province to the parking lot.

name: Continuing the climb and injured in a fall
description: Climbing the ancient path toward the main peak to the north, at around 9 o'clock he slipped and fell 2 meters on a wet steep slope due to exhaustion, scraping his right hand against the rock wall and drawing blood. After disinfecting and bandaging it himself, he rested in place for 20 minutes. For safety reasons, he gave up the summit attempt and began a cautious descent at 10.
location: Huangshan Scenic Area, Tangkou Town, Huangshan District, Huangshan City, Anhui Province - mountain area on the north side of the ancient trail toward the main peak.

name: Carefully descend and return to the parking lot.
description: Holding a trekking pole in his left hand, he carefully felt his way along, with heavy pressure on his knees. He rested twice by the stream and rinsed his legs with cold water. He arrived safely at the parking lot at the foot of the mountain at 2 p.m., unloaded his gear, changed into a dry T-shirt, and prepared to return to Shanghai.
location: Ancient trail in Huangshan Scenic Area, Tangkou Town, Huangshan District, Huangshan City, Anhui Province, to the parking lot at the foot of the mountain

name: Driving back to Shanghai
description: Drove from the Huangshan parking lot back to Shanghai via the G56 Hangrui Expressway. Because his right wrist was injured, he mainly controlled the steering wheel with his left hand. Along the way, he listened to podcasts to relax, stopped at a service area near Hangzhou for an iced Americano and chicken sausages, stretched his body, and sent a message to his parents to let them know he was safe.
location: From Huangshan City, Anhui Province to Pudong New Area, Shanghai (via G56 Hangrui Expressway and rest areas near Hangzhou)

name: Resting at home and family dinner
description: At 4:30 p.m., he arrived home. His mother was distressed about the wound on his wrist, and his father kept telling him to be careful. Lei Mingxuan jokingly explained it as a strategic retreat and shared photos from the mountain. Then he took a shower and changed clothes. His mother cooked noodles with vegetables and shredded pork, and his father re-disinfected and bandaged the wound. During dinner, he described the hiking experience in detail, downplaying the slip and fall as a minor incident. After the meal, he voluntarily washed the dishes, and his mother said she would make pork rib soup.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepare outfit and head to the store.
description: Returned to the bedroom to air out hiking gear and charge devices. Took out a black cotton-feel quick-dry T-shirt and gray multi-pocket cargo shorts to try on, posed in front of the mirror, and saved Huangshan landscape photos as material. Then rode the e-scooter to the Super Brand Mall store. Because of the wrist injury, I rode slowly and enjoyed returning to the lively atmosphere of the city.
location: From Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Shop photography and posting a Xiaohongshu note.
description: At the store, he took about 30 outfit selfies using the lighting and mirror, selecting full-body, detail, and “battle-worn” close-ups that exposed the wound. Using a mobile photo-editing app for simple color grading, he wrote a Xiaohongshu post titled “【After a Fall】From Huangshan to the Office: A Commute Outfit That Stays Cool Even When ‘Battle-Worn’,” emphasizing the urban techwear style, added multiple tags, and published it. After posting, he refreshed and saw likes and comments asking for the pants link, and his heart raced.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Taking a walk home and exchanging notes with my cousin.
location: Lujiazui Circular Pedestrian Bridge, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the home study at Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Bedtime yoga relaxation
description: Changed into workout pants and did 20 minutes of gentle stretching on the yoga mat in the bedroom, focusing on using a foam roller to relax the front and back of the thighs and the lower back. Totally relaxed during child's pose, and avoided the injured right wrist throughout.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Update novel chapter.
description: Although his body was exhausted, he incorporated the fear, pain, and frustration of the fall into the novel, writing about 800 characters with an iPad writing app to add a chapter to “Afternoon in Xiafei Lane”, turning the day's emotions into a creative outlet.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and evening review
description: Turned off the computer and iPad and got into bed. Checked tomorrow's coffee corner construction precautions and supplier equipment parameters, and confirmed that Lao Li from the construction crew would arrive at 8 a.m. Changed the dressing on his right wrist, made sure the gauze was dry, and set the alarm for 7. Recalling a day that went from the thrilling Huangshan trip to a warm home and then to small achievements on Xiaohongshu, he felt an unprecedented sense of fulfillment.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Early morning run and tidying up at home
description: After the alarm went off, got up, moved the right wrist, put on a quick-dry T-shirt and shorts, drank half a glass of warm water, put on a heart rate strap, and sprayed sunscreen. At 5:15 rode the e-bike to Century Park, started a 4 km morning run at 5:30 with a heart rate of 140. After the run, stretched in the shade, focusing on the right wrist and the back of the thighs, drank the electrolyte drink, and recorded the data. Then rode the e-bike home, took a shower, changed into a linen shirt and shorts, checked Xiaohongshu analytics, and replied to comments. During this time the wrist still felt sore and swollen, but the mood was good.
location: Century Park, No. 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai and Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and errands on the commute.
description: Ate the plain noodle soup my mom made together with my parents, and while eating, chatted with my father in the “Three Musketeers” group about Arsenal's transfers. After eating, I checked my commuter bag: power bank, sunglasses, electric bike key, and sunscreen spray. I added cat food and water for A Fu, the cat on the balcony. I left at 7:10 on the electric bike, first stopping at the convenience store on the B1 floor of Jin Mao Tower to buy an iced Americano and mints, then rode to the staff entrance of Super Brand Mall, locked the bike, swiped my card, and entered the mall.
location: At home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; the basement-level convenience store of Jin Mao Tower, No. 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; and Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Supervising store renovation and preparing to start operations
description: Arrived at Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, and met with Lao Li and two workers from the construction team to confirm the first-phase tasks of the coffee corner renovation: breaking the floor tiles and rerouting water and electrical lines. Using his phone, he showed the layout and pointed out the positions of the sockets and drain pipes. While the workers cut the floor, he asked the store clerk Xiao Lin to sort out the express delivery orders backlogged over the weekend, check sizes and colors, and pack them. Midway, the courier called, and he took the three packages to the delivery point outside the mall.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go home for lunch and take a friend's phone call
description: Because of the construction noise and dust, I rode my e-bike home for lunch. My mother made low-fat braised pork belly, and my father also praised it. Just as I picked up chopsticks, my friend Xie Fei called and asked why I hadn't been playing ball recently. I apologized sincerely, explained about the camping and roller skating plans, and agreed to arrange an old friends' farewell game at Yuanshen Sports Center on Sunday afternoon, July 27. After hanging up, I felt much more relaxed.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon nap
description: After helping my mother clear the dishes, went back to the bedroom, turned on the air conditioner, set a 25-minute alarm, and closed my eyes for a nap to recharge for the afternoon's work.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store supervision and customer maintenance.
description: Rode an electric scooter to the Super Brand Mall store. The construction crew did dust suppression and basic grooving, and the noise was reduced. Using an iPad, I logged into Xiaohongshu to analyze the data of the first note, and recorded the information of the young women asking for links in the comments. I sent greetings to the young woman who added me on WeChat yesterday, recommended two office outfits, and scheduled a fitting for Friday evening. I handled an old customer's WeChat inquiry, and sold a pair of mountain-style shorts and a quick-dry T-shirt. At 17:00 I checked the sales records with store clerk Xiao Lin, tidied the fitting room, and explained tomorrow's water and electricity renovation work and the communication method.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home to pick up equipment and head to the climbing gym
description: Rode the e-bike home, took a quick shower, changed into a loose climbing T-shirt, and grabbed his climbing shoes, chalk bag, and action camera. He told his mother he wouldn't be home for dinner. Then he took a taxi straight to the climbing gym.
location: At home in Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and on the way to Jibi Storm Climbing Gym, No. 729, South Yanggao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Rock climbing training with Zhao Min
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at the Extreme Wall Storm Climbing Gym; Zhao Min was already warming up. After completing a basic climbing warm-up together, they focused on challenging dynamic holds. After three attempts, they successfully finished the orange route at V3 difficulty, high-fiving at the top. He had Zhao Min record a few videos of his power moves with her phone, preparing them as material.
location: Extreme Wall Storm Climbing Gym (Pudong Branch), 729 Yanggao South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-climbing refueling and going home to rest.
description: Took a taxi with Zhao Min to the nearby FamilyMart convenience store, bought sports drinks and dried chicken breast, sat at the entrance eating and chatting, and agreed to invite climbing buddy Xiao Wang to try a new V4 route next time. Afterward, took a taxi home, soaked my feet in hot water to relieve soreness, sent Zhao Min a message to let her know I was safe, and exported the climbing video.
location: FamilyMart (Jinkui Road Store), No. 1-43, Lane 1315, Jinkui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and home at No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Shanggang Community

name: Novel writing.
description: After soaking my feet, I opened my MacBook and created a new chapter document, combining yesterday's thrilling fall on Mount Huangshan with today's excitement of airborne grabs during rock climbing, designing a new adventure segment for the protagonist. I wrote nearly 1,500 words in one go and was in excellent form.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Optimizing Xiaohongshu operations
description: He opened the Xiaohongshu drafts folder and planned the second post. Following the suggestion of his friend Shen Jie, he adjusted the tags of the first post, adding more specific tags such as #UrbanTechwear #CommuteStyle #DailyWorkout, and drafted a framework for the new post, themed 'Two States of the Weekend: The Stillness of the Mountain and the Burst of the Rock Wall'.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime family chat
description: Went to the living room to watch TV with his mother, shared today's sense of accomplishment from rock climbing and the reconciliation with Xie Fei by arranging to play ball together. His mother reminded him to pay attention to his wrist safety.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: After washing up, I set tomorrow's alarm on my phone, turned off the desk lamp, took a glance at the Pudong night view outside the window, and soon fell asleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: At 7 in the morning, sunlight wakes you through the gap in the curtains. You pick up your phone from the bedside table, turn off sleep mode, and check the weather—today's high is 37°C, so you decide to skip outdoor running. After a quick wash, you put on a quick-dry T-shirt and athletic shorts, ready to go out for a brisk walk to wake up your body.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Morning brisk walk
description: You walked along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui Central Green Park, about 14 minutes away. Under the shade, wearing earphones and listening to a podcast, you briskly walked about three kilometers at a moderate pace, sweating slightly and feeling your body stretch out. Midway, you rehydrated at the park's drinking fountain.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home for a shower and breakfast
description: After walking back home, you took a warm shower and changed into a clean T-shirt and light-colored shorts. Your mother, Wang Xiuying, had cooked you some plain noodles; the soup contained a poached egg and chopped scallions, light and refreshing. While eating the noodles, you chatted with your mother, told her you had class tonight, and asked her to keep some dinner for you to eat when you returned. Your mother reminded you to take your water bottle.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the store
description: You grab your keys and phone and ride an e-bike to the store. On the way, you stop at the FamilyMart convenience store at the base of Jin Mao Tower, where you use face recognition to buy a large iced Americano and a sandwich as a snack. Then you ride along Century Avenue to Super Brand Mall and park the bike in the designated spot in the underground garage.
location: Convenience store at Jin Mao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store duties and handling affairs
description: After you arrived at the store, you turned on the air conditioner and lights, took a sip of iced Americano, and checked the coffee corner construction progress: the electrical and water lines had been channeled, and the floor had protective film. After store assistant Xiao Lin arrived, you confirmed the construction details and sorted through the weekend's backlog of packages, then scheduled a courier pickup on your phone. Afterwards, you opened your computer and sent two regular customers high-resolution photos of the new products with styling suggestions, asking if they were interested.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Send a package and take a short break
description: After the courier picked up the two packages, you carried the samples to be sent to friends in other cities, walked to the Hive Box locker at Lujiazui Metro Station, and scanned the code to send them. On the way back to the store, outside the Manner Coffee shop on B1, you observed its bar counter design and took photos for reference for the soft furnishing of the coffee corner. Back in the store, you ate a sandwich, finished the remaining iced Americano, and rested for a while.
location: Hive Box lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station, 158 Huayuan Shiqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Super Brand Mall

name: Lunchtime
description: At noon, you went to the light-fare restaurant on B1 of Super Brand Mall and ordered a chicken breast salad and a zero-sugar Coke. While eating, you checked the data on your first Xiaohongshu post, saw new likes and a comment asking where the pants were from, and you replied and sent a direct message to that person.
location: Light meal shop, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon: minding the store, posting on Xiaohongshu, and stocking up.
description: In the afternoon, with few customers in the store, you opened your iPad to edit a Xiaohongshu draft. You changed the title to [Outfits] Great for Weekends and Commutes! A Week of Mountain-Style Boy Looks, added photos from yesterday's climbing gym and the Huangshan trip, retouched them, and published it. After that, you organized the newly stocked utility vests and cargo shorts, and attached hang tags and styling guide cards.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling to the café
description: After tidying up the store and telling Xiao Lin to keep an eye on it, you rode an electric scooter from Super Brand Mall in Pudong, crossed the river through the East Yan'an Road Tunnel, and headed to the Qiyun Coffee shop on Huqiu Road, Huangpu District. The weather was hot, but wearing a helmet and earphones, you listened to music and felt relaxed.
location: From Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Qiyun Café, 20 Huqiu Road, Huangpu District

name: Creative time at the café
description: You arrived at Qiyun Café, ordered a signature cold brew, and sat on the sofa by the window. Since there was still time before the class, you opened the notes app on your phone and continued writing your novel 'The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane,' incorporating the thrilling feeling of grabbing holds mid-air while climbing the day before and your thoughts on fear into the new chapter, writing seven or eight hundred words in one go.
location: Qiyun Café, 20 Huqiu Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: Chatting with students before class.
description: Half an hour before class, the other trainees arrived one after another. You saw that Lao Zhou, the channel distributor, had also come early, so you stepped forward to greet him. You chatted about the Southeast Asian coffee bean samples he had provided last time, and you gave feedback that the Ethiopian floral aroma and the acidity of the washed beans were suitable for pour-over, expressing your intention to cooperate. Lao Zhou gladly agreed, and the two of you exchanged business cards, agreeing to meet next week at his store in Baoshan for a detailed discussion.
location: Qiyun Café, 20 Huqiu Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: Advanced pour-over coffee course completed.
description: At 7 p.m., the last class began with the final assessment: independently making a V60 pour-over coffee. Following the teacher's guidance, you poured steadily, controlled the water flow, and the coffee bed gradually bloomed, releasing a rich aroma. Your technique was steady, and you finished pouring in 2 minutes 10 seconds; the result passed. After tasting, the teacher said, 'The bloom was spot on, the sweetness came through. Well done!' The teacher awarded you the completion certificate, and all the students took a group photo.
location: In front of the counter at Qiyun Café, No. 20 Huqiu Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: After-class chat and cycling home.
description: After the class ended, you chatted with Lao Zhou for another ten minutes about barista training and then said goodbye. You were in a great mood, so you got on your e-bike and headed back with the completion certificate. After a ride of more than 20 minutes, you returned to Shanggang Community and parked the bike.
location: Qiyun Coffee, No. 20 Huqiu Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai, to Shanggang Residential Quarter, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area

name: Dinner and family time.
description: After returning home, your mother had already warmed up the food for you, including your favorites: scrambled eggs with loofah, stir-fried amaranth, and braised pork belly. You sat at the table and showed her your coffee course completion certificate while eating, saying happily, "Mom, I've completed it! From now on, I'll take care of all the coffee!" Mother smiled and praised you.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Planning a basketball game with Xie Fei
description: Sitting on the living room sofa, you contacted your good friend Xie Fei via WeChat voice to discuss holding a farewell basketball game on the 27th at Yuanshen Sports Center. You were responsible for booking the court and notifying the other friends, while Xie Fei was responsible for counting participants and choosing the after-game dinner spot. You talked for about 40 minutes in a warm atmosphere, and the estrangement between you seemed to have completely melted away.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Communicating with parents about the ChinaJoy itinerary
description: You walk into your parents' bedroom and tell your father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying that you are going to the ChinaJoy expo at the New International Expo Center from the 29th to the 31st, and that you will need to leave early and return late, so you cannot go to the store. Your father reminds you to be careful in the crowds, and your mother tells you to bring your water bottle and hands you Huoxiang Zhengqi liquid, telling you to guard against heatstroke.
location: Parents' bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxing and tidying up before bed
description: You return to your room, open your laptop at the desk, and save the novel excerpt you wrote today. Then you check the Xiaohongshu post published this afternoon. It already has over a dozen likes and several comments, and you reply to each one to thank the commenters. After completing all this, you feel that today was very fulfilling.
location: His own room at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Caring for pet Afu before bed
description: You walked over to the cat bed in the living room and saw Ah Fu already curled up asleep, snoring softly. You stroked its head, made sure there was still water and food in the bowls, added some water, turned off the main living room light, left only a small night light on, and left quietly.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: After brushing your teeth and washing your face, you lie in bed and set the alarm for 7 a.m. tomorrow. Reflecting on the day—store, study, socializing, family—everything was handled well, and you feel grounded and content. You turn off the bedside lamp and soon fall asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning preparations and heading to Century Park
description: At 5:30 in the morning, the alarm went off. Lei Mingxuan quickly changed into quick-dry clothes and running shoes, grabbed his keys and phone, added some water to the bowl of his pet cat A Fu, then rode his electric scooter from his home in Shanggang Residential Quarter, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, along Pudong Avenue and Jinxiu Road for about 15 minutes to arrive at Gate 1 of Shanghai Century Park. After parking, he warmed up before the run.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanghai Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run at Century Park
description: Lei Mingxuan started his morning run on the lakeside path of Shanghai Century Park, maintaining a pace of about 5 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer and running 4.5 kilometers. After the run, he stretched by the lake for 10 minutes and used his phone to photograph the lake's reflection in the early morning.
location: Lakeside loop trail, Shanghai Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Returning home and taking care of the pet cat
description: After the morning run, Lei Mingxuan rode his electric scooter back home in Shanggang Residential Area. When he got inside, he found that his pet cat Afu was already awake. He fed Afu freeze-dried quail, petted the cat for a few minutes, then took a hot shower and changed into a cotton T-shirt and athletic shorts.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast conversation
description: At 7 a.m., Lei Mingxuan had breakfast with his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying. His mother made millet porridge, fried eggs, and stir-fried greens. While eating egg toast, Lei Mingxuan chatted with his parents about last night's rock climbing and asked about his father's blood pressure, learning that it was relatively stable at 128/84.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went to Jin Mao Tower to buy coffee and arrived at the store
description: After breakfast, he changed into work clothes and rode his e-bike about 10 minutes to Jin Mao Tower. At the FamilyMart convenience store on the basement level, he bought a large iced Americano with an extra shot and also grabbed a box of throat lozenges. Then he rode a few minutes to the back door of Super Brand Mall and went to his store on the 2nd floor.
location: FamilyMart at B1, Jinmao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Store opening preparations and inviting friends to play
description: Arrived at the store at 8:25, opened the door, turned on the lights and air conditioning, booked a half-court at the Yuanshen Sports Center basketball gym for the afternoon of July 27 and paid a 200 yuan deposit, then invited three basketball buddies, Lao Deng, Han Dong, and Lao Qian, via WeChat to the farewell game on Sunday and got confirmations. After store staff Xiao Lin arrived at 9, Lei Mingxuan had a brief morning meeting with him and arranged the day's work of organizing mountain-style work pants and window displays.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and customer reception
description: In the morning, at the Super Brand Mall store, he processed online orders and printed three shipping labels. Regular customer Qian Duoduo brought a colleague to the store looking for commuter wear. Lei Mingxuan recommended a set of a navy blue lightweight suit jacket paired with white wide-leg pants and closed two sales.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and novel brainstorming
description: At noon, Lei Mingxuan asked Xiao Lin to watch the shop and went alone to the Shaanxi noodle restaurant on the B2 level of Super Brand Mall for lunch, ordering a bowl of oil-splashed pulled noodles and a Bingfeng soda. While waiting, he used his phone's note app to jot down a novel idea that had come to him during the morning run, 'Lane Morning Light': damp stone paths, water droplets from laundry poles, the sound of an old man's radio.
location: Shaanxi Noodle Restaurant, Food Court, B2, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon store operations and refinement of the coffee corner layout
description: In the afternoon, Xiao Lin was responsible for receiving customers at the store while Lei Mingxuan used Procreate on his iPad Pro to refine the coffee corner layout, marking the locations of the coffee machine, grinder, water purifier, power outlets, and floor drain. Around 4:30 p.m., he sent the layout and reference photos to his cousin Shen Jie, asking for suggestions on the bar countertop material and the selection of patterned tiles.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sort and send packages after work
description: Near closing time, Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin checked the sales records, tidied the fitting room, packed the three online orders, and attached shipping labels. After locking the store, he walked about 10 minutes to the Hive Box smart locker next to the storage lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station and completed scanning to send the packages.
location: Hive Box express locker near the storage lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station, No. 158 Huayuanshiqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After work, bought groceries and returned home.
description: After mailing the packages, Lei Mingxuan rode his electric scooter home. He stopped at the vegetable stall in the community, bought a box of fresh shiitake mushrooms and a bunch of scallions for the evening soup, then went upstairs and returned home.
location: From the vegetable stall at the entrance of Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to home.

name: Healthy family dinner
description: Back home, his mother Wang Xiuying was already preparing dinner in the kitchen. Lei Mingxuan helped cut vegetables and talked about booking a basketball court and inviting friends to play. Dinner was the second meal of the healthy eating plan: stir-fried broccoli, carrots, black fungus and seasonal vegetables; the mushroom soup used freshly bought shiitake mushrooms, enoki mushrooms and firm tofu. His father Lei Jianguo suggested adding goji berries. The whole family was satisfied with the light and delicious dishes, and his father said he hoped every meal would have vegetables from now on.
location: Home (kitchen and dining room) in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Planning ChinaJoy route online
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan used his iPad in the study to have a WeChat call with Hangzhou fellow enthusiast Gao Yuan, casting the ChinaJoy exhibition electronic map onto the computer. Together they planned the four-day exhibition route from July 29 to August 1, agreed to meet at 10 a.m. on the first day under the 'Sword Art Online' poster in Hall 2 Entrance Lobby of Shanghai New International Expo Centre, and saved the daily route by taking screenshots.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel writing update.
description: After finishing the planning, Lei Mingxuan brewed some black tea and, on his MacBook Air, began updating his novel "The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane," turning the peaceful feeling from his morning run into a scene of the protagonist strolling through a lane. He wrote about 800 words, leaving a lingering, thought-provoking ending.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leisure and bedtime preparation
description: After closing his laptop, Lei Mingxuan went to the living room to chat with his parents, who were watching a documentary. While washing up, his pet cat Afu came over to be clingy, and he played with Afu for a few minutes using a new cat teaser wand. At 22:20 he got into bed and browsed Bilibili, watching new anime previews and funny videos to relax his mind.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Going to bed
description: At 22:50, he turned off his phone and put it on the nightstand, set the alarm for 5:30 the next day, and reviewed the day: morning run completed, venue for the game booked, playing buddies notified, and CJ route planned. He felt solid and expectant, and soon fell asleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Early Morning Yoga and Morning Ritual
description: Woke up naturally at 6:30; the sky was grey and the air was humid and stuffy. In the bedroom, I unrolled the yoga mat and opened Bilibili's morning yoga video, focusing on stretching my ankles, knees, and hips to prepare for the ChinaJoy walking marathon next week. The cat A Fu came over and rubbed against the mat, so I petted him while doing Cat-Cow pose.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and today's preview
description: After taking a shower and changing into a white T-shirt, I had breakfast with my parents. Mother made plain noodle soup with fragrant lard. While eating, I told my mother about the ChinaJoy plans for next week: I wouldn't be home for lunch and wanted stir-fried seasonal vegetables for dinner. My father Lei Jianguo reminded me to bring my ID card and mask, and I promised to get them ready tonight.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Electric scooter commute during morning rush hour
description: Riding an electric bike and carrying a folding umbrella, I first stopped at the FamilyMart downstairs at Jin Mao Tower to buy an iced Americano and a chicken sandwich, so as not to be rushed at noon. The light drizzle didn't matter; I rode along Pudong Avenue and arrived at the underground parking garage of Super Brand Mall at 8:40 on time.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Tending the store and arranging temporary management
description: After arriving at the store, he turned on the computer and the cashier system and drank an iced Americano to wake up. At exactly 9:00, he called employee Lin Yue into the fitting room and formally briefed her on running the store during ChinaJoy. He handed her a checklist covering opening and closing procedures, cashier operations, printing and packing online orders, filling out shipping labels, and emergency contact with property manager Zheng Kai. Lin Yue nodded and reassured him. Afterwards, he handled WeChat messages from regular customers, replied to Zhou Tao in Hangzhou about delivery, and put the new technical vests in the window display.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and blind box drawing at the mall
description: After closing the shop, walked about 10 minutes to the Konjiki Hototogisu Tokyo Ramen at IFC Mall and ordered a bowl of tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg. After eating, strolled around the mall, saw a POP MART vending machine, spent 69 yuan on a Space Travel series blind box, and got the hidden Astronaut figure. Excited, took a photo and sent it to the Pudong Three Musketeers group chat to show off. Then walked back to Super Brand Mall.
location: IFC Mall, 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon Operations and Novel Writing
description: Returned to the store and continued keeping it open. Around 2 p.m., regular customer Qian Duoduo came to try on two tech vests and ended up buying the gray-green one. Taking advantage of the quiet period, I walked downstairs with my iPad to the Starbucks in Super Brand Mall, ordered an iced shaken lemon tea, and updated my novel The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane. I wrote a passage about the protagonist packing a travel bag while on a trip, describing in detail the process of putting a power bank, folding stool, umbrella, notebook, and other items into the backpack—about 400 words. After returning to the store at 16:30, I sold one more quick-dry T-shirt.
location: Super Brand Mall and Starbucks Coffee at Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Riding the electric scooter home during evening rush hour
description: Closed the shop on time at 17:00, said goodbye to Lin Yue, then rode his e-bike home. The rain had stopped, the air was damp, and the roads were clear all the way. He arrived home at 17:40.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanggang Residential Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: Changed into home clothes and had dinner with parents. Mother made steamed sea bass, garlic stir-fried water spinach, and tomato egg drop soup. During the meal, I shared the surprise of getting a hidden figure from a blind box and showed photos to my parents. Father joked that young people like this. Also discussed the ChinaJoy itinerary, arranged the meeting time and place with friend Gao Yuan, and mother reminded me to be careful.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Watched the news with father and chatted online.
description: Watched the Xinwen Lianbo evening news program with his father Lei Jianguo and chatted about current events. Meanwhile, his phone vibrated: Gao Yuan asked in the group chat whether to go scout the trial-play area tomorrow. He replied that he couldn't leave the store and would go straight on the 29th. Later, he chatted with his cousin Shen Jie on WeChat, asking for outfit advice for ChinaJoy. She suggested a techwear style in mountain-tone colors.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Packing the ChinaJoy backpack
description: Back in the bedroom, he took out his techwear backpack and packed it according to the checklist: a fully charged power bank, a data cable, a large-capacity water bottle, a portable folding stool, sunscreen, an umbrella, small snacks such as beef jerky and nuts, and a wallet (cash and cards). He checked the battery levels of his mirrorless camera and phone, and put a notebook and pen into the backpack's outer pocket. His father passed by the door and reminded him again to bring his ID card and mask; he replied that they were already in there. After packing, he put the backpack on to test its weight and felt a strong sense of security, looking forward to ChinaJoy. Meanwhile, he browsed the Dewu app, liked a techwear waist bag, and added it to his shopping cart to compare prices.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel polishing and platform update
description: Went to the study, sat at the computer, polished the new passage of "Afternoon in Xiafei Lane" written at Starbucks in the afternoon, adjusted details and punctuation, then updated it to the serialization platform from the computer. After checking the updated data, he saw that a reader praised the delicate descriptions and felt content.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Foot soaking relaxation and outfit notes.
description: Boiled hot water and soaked his feet for 15 minutes to relieve fatigue. The weather in Shanghai was humid and stuffy, and he felt comfortable after soaking his feet. While soaking, he browsed Bilibili and watched techwear items recommended by a fashion vlogger, which matched the ChinaJoy gear ideas well, and he took notes. The cat A Fu lay at the bathroom door, wagging its tail to keep him company.
location: Bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and playing with the cat
description: After washing up, he played with his cat Afu using a teaser wand for ten minutes to burn off its energy. After lying down in bed, he placed the astronaut blind box he had drawn during the day on the bedside table and admired it for a while.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime reading
description: Opened the historical novel “The Qin and Han Empire,” which he hadn’t finished during the day, and read two chapters. With anticipation for ChinaJoy and a full sense of satisfaction from the day, his eyelids began to droop.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: Turned off the light and put the phone aside. Silently went over tomorrow morning's routine in his mind and fell asleep peacefully.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run at Century Park
description: The alarm went off at 5:30 in the morning. Lei Yu got up, drank half a glass of warm water, changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and shorts, and rode his electric scooter to Century Park. In the morning light, he completed a 5 km run along the loop track on Wutong Avenue, with a pace of 5:50 per kilometer and a heart rate stable at around 145. After the run, he did 15 minutes of stretching by the lawn, focusing on relaxing his calves and hips. He recorded the route with the Joyrun app and shared it to the Pudong Three Musketeers WeChat group with the caption: 'Today's 5K, feeling great, warming up for the weekend farewell match!'
location: Shanghai Century Park, No. 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China (enter through Gate 1, circular running track on Wutong Avenue)

name: Go home, wash up, and have breakfast
description: Rode his bike back from the park to his home in Shanggang Community and took a hot shower to wash off the sweat. His mother Wang Xiuying had already cooked plain noodles with a poached egg and blanched greens. While eating, Lei Yu chatted with his mother about the day's plans and mentioned that he needed to talk to his father about something important in the evening. After dinner, he played with the cat A Fu in the living room using a feather teaser. A Fu pounced energetically, and Lei Yu was in a good mood.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commute and convenience store shopping
description: Changed into a gray-blue techwear T-shirt and black cargo shorts, then set off on the e-bike. First went to the FamilyMart at the bottom of Jin Mao Tower to buy an iced Americano and a chicken sandwich. At checkout, I resisted buying a blind box, thinking about saving up for limited editions at CJ. Then rode to Super Brand Mall and parked in the mall's ground-level parking area.
location: FamilyMart, 1st Floor, Jin Mao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China; then head to Super Brand Mall

name: Morning store work
description: Arrived at Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, where store clerk Xiao Lin was already waiting. After opening the store, checked yesterday's sales and inventory together, and while drinking iced Americanos, sorted through last week's 'dark techwear' outfit photos, used the Xingtu app to retouch them, wrote copy, and posted to Xiaohongshu and WeChat Moments. Then on WeChat, confirmed next week's new goods arrival time with supplier Tao Ge from Hangzhou, and chatted online with Fang Jie from Guangzhou about the details of the new fabric. After 10 o'clock, regular customer Qian Duoduo came to the store with a friend for a fitting. Lei Yu recommended a mountain-style layered look based on their body type and temperament, successfully selling two jackets and a pair of cargo pants.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and mall inspection
description: At noon he had Xiao Lin watch the store and walked to the Ippudo ramen shop on LG1 of IFC Mall, ordered a classic tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg, and after eating strolled around the mall, observing the seasonal displays, foot traffic, and promotions of several streetwear and sports brands as market research.
location: Ippudo ramen restaurant and the public areas of the mall, LG1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: In the afternoon, worked on a novel idea at the store
description: Back at the store, there were few customers in the afternoon. Lei Yu took an iPad and sat on a chair in the corner, opened WPS, and continued writing his novel The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane. He reviewed what he had written the night before, conceived a new chapter, and tried to weave the subtle father-son complex into the protagonist's growth experience, writing about two to three hundred characters.
location: Inside the store on the 2nd floor of the Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Starbucks afternoon tea with Xiuwen
description: Feeling a bit stuffy, he asked Xiaolin to watch the store and went alone to the Starbucks on the first floor of Super Brand Mall, ordered an iced shaken lemon tea, and sat by the window. He scrolled through Bilibili on his phone to watch a streetwear expo vlog, then took out his iPad to polish a novel excerpt, completing a full paragraph of about 500 characters about the protagonist's reflections after running into an old neighbor in the alleyway.
location: Starbucks Coffee, 1st Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon store shipping and communication with property management.
description: Returning to the shop in high spirits, he learned that online customers had placed two orders. After checking inventory and packing the items with Xiao Lin, he rode his electric scooter to the Hive Box smart locker at Lujiazui Metro Station and shipped the packages. Back at the mall, he stopped by the property management office and chatted with manager Zheng Kai about the weekend joint mall activities.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China; Hive Box smart locker, Lujiazui Metro Station, 158 Huayuan Shiqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China; property management office of Super Brand Mall

name: Evening rush-hour operations and getting off work
description: There was a small peak during the after-work period. He and Xiao Lin received several groups of customers, styled two finance professionals with two looks—one for daily commuting and one for weekend casual—and successfully sold a quick-dry T-shirt. At 18:30, he checked the day's accounts and follow-up items, completed the handover with Xiao Lin, and locked the shop door.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Bought groceries on the way home.
description: Riding my electric scooter home in the sunset, passing by Mingkanghui Fresh Food Market on Yushan Road, I went in and bought fresh straw mushrooms and two small yellow croakers, planning to have my mother make a light meal. I felt both nervous and expectant, because I needed to have a deep talk with my father in the evening.
location: Mingkanghui Fresh Food Market (Lujiazui Garden Store), No. 1-50, Lane 308, Yushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family dinner
description: When he got home, his father Lei Jianguo was watching the news in the living room. He handed the groceries to his mother and changed into loungewear. Dinner included stir-fried eggs with straw mushrooms, baby yellow croaker with scallion oil, and stir-fried water spinach. Lei Yu took the initiative to talk about the day's sales at the store, praised Xiao Lin for being capable, and chatted with his father about the CJ schedule and the TV drama he had recently been watching. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Father and son heart-to-heart talk on the balcony
description: After dinner, Lei Jianguo smoked on the balcony. Lei Yu sat beside him with a glass of warm water and first apologized for his impatience in proposing the expansion plan last time, admitting he hadn't fully considered the family's financial stability. After Lei Jianguo expressed his concerns, Lei Yu took out his phone to show hand-drawn sketches of the store upgrade, explaining in detail the plan to upgrade from a 'trendy streetwear boutique' to an 'urban functional brand multi-store,' targeting white-collar workers and trend followers, with an estimated investment of 150,000 yuan and two or three new emerging brand agencies. He promised to start with a small-scale pilot and stop immediately if performance was poor after three months. After nearly an hour of communication, Lei Jianguo's expression softened. He stubbed out his cigarette, patted Lei Yu on the shoulder, and said, 'Alright, I know you have ideas. Let's see the results in autumn; if revenue is stable, Dad will support your pilot. This drawing isn't bad.' Lei Yu got up to brew Pu'er tea for his father, and the balcony atmosphere became relaxed.
location: Balcony of home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family Time and Novel Updates
description: After the heartfelt conversation, he was in a great mood and went back to the living room to play with Ah Fu using a teaser wand for over ten minutes. Then he went to the study, turned on the computer, and incorporated the emotional turn and sense of relief from tonight's conversation with his father into a new chapter of The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane, writing a passage where the protagonist, after reconciling with an elder, experiences the warmth of everyday life in the alleyway. He was very satisfied.
location: Living room and study at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Personal Time and Sleep
description: After washing up, changed into pajamas and lay in bed, browsing Bilibili to catch up on the latest episode of Spy x Family. The day felt fulfilling and steady. Glancing at the hidden astronaut figure on the nightstand, he felt a stronger sense of anticipation for the future. At 23:30, turned off his phone and drifted off to sleep with a relaxed mood.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Wake-up, breakfast, and departure preparation
description: The phone alarm went off right on time. After getting up, Lei Mingxuan first stepped on the scale and confirmed his weight was 79.9 kg, remaining stable. He filled his pet cat A Fu's bowl with cat food and fresh water, affectionately patted its head, and told it to stay home alone today. Then Lei Mingxuan sent a voice message to his mother, Wang Xiuying, asking her to help look after A Fu during the day. After a quick wash-up, he brewed a cup of black coffee and had it with two slices of whole-wheat toast as breakfast.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Car wash and business preparations
description: Lei Mingxuan drove to the JD Auto Care store on Dongfang Road and handed the car to the technician for a thorough interior and exterior cleaning. While waiting for the car wash, he sat in the rest area, opened his iPad, added the autumn pilot upgrade content discussed with his father the night before into the store upgrade plan, dealt with backlogged customer group messages, and recommended seasonally appropriate new outfits to several VIP customers.
location: JD Car Care (Dongfang Road Store), No. 1234 Dongfang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buy tea for father
description: After the car was cleaned, Lei Mingxuan drove to a time-honored tea shop on Zhangyang Road. Remembering that his father Lei Jianguo loved Cloud Mist tea, he went in and chose 250 grams of fine tea leaves. The shop owner also thoughtfully gave him a portable tea canister. The whole process took less than 15 minutes, and after buying the tea, he carried it back to the car.
location: Time-honored Tea House, No. 500 Zhangyang Road, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go home to put things away and make final preparations
description: Lei Mingxuan drove home to Shanggang Community, put the tea he had bought on the dining table, filled his water bottle, and shouldered the camping backpack he had already packed, ready for the upcoming trip.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organizing client materials, calling business partners, and archiving meeting minutes
description: After entering the study, Lei Mingxuan turned on his computer and organized the store's customer profile (ages 25-35, medium-to-high spending power, preference for mountain/outdoor functional style), price ranges, and screenshots of best-selling styles. At 10:15, he called his business partner Old Zhou on time, and the two had an in-depth discussion about introducing a Southeast Asian mountain/outdoor functional brand. Lei Mingxuan shared customer data, while Old Zhou introduced key information such as brand style, a supply cycle of about 45 days, and a minimum order quantity of 100 pieces per style. The two hit it off immediately and agreed to meet on the afternoon of August 2 at a coffee shop on Nanjing West Road with sample catalogs. After the call, he immediately noted the key points in his phone's memo, sent the store's product list to Old Zhou via WeChat, and saved the sample images Old Zhou had sent to the "Business Cooperation" folder. All materials were archived and organized.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Final confirmation and item check before departure
description: Lei Mingxuan checked his camping backpack again, making sure beef jerky, energy bars, nuts, two liters of water, a pour-over kettle, foldable table and chairs, and other gear were all in place, and additionally put in wet wipes and trash bags. Then he played with A Fu for a while using a cat teaser, said goodbye to it, and left home with his backpack.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove to Qingliang Peak in Lin'an, Zhejiang
description: At 11:45, Lei Mingxuan set his navigation for the Qingliangfeng Nature Reserve in Lin'an, Zhejiang, and got on the expressway. On the way, he listened to a podcast about multi-brand store operations and, while listening, pondered the channel plan he had discussed with Lao Zhou. He took a 10-minute break at the Jiaxing service area, bought a bottle of sports drink, and stretched his legs, then continued on his way and arrived at Qingliangfeng Town around 1:30 p.m.
location: Qingliangfeng Town, Lin'an District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province (departing from Shanghai, via G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, stopping at Jiaxing Service Area along the way)

name: Enjoying local specialty noodle dishes
description: After arriving in Qingliangfeng Town, Lei Mingxuan went to Axiang Noodle House on the old street and ordered a bowl of the signature dried bamboo shoot and duck noodles, costing 23 yuan. It was delicious, and he felt refreshed after finishing it. He rested in the shop for ten minutes and used his phone to look up the precautions for entering the Qingliangfeng Nature Reserve.
location: Axiang Noodle Shop, No. 32 Old Street, Qingliangfeng Town, Lin'an District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.

name: Mountain entry registration and supplies
description: After finishing the noodles, Lei Mingxuan drove to the Qingliangfeng Daochangping Protection Station, completed the mountain-entry registration procedures, and the staff reminded him of precautions such as fire safety and weather changes. Afterwards, he bought an extra liter of mineral water at the small shop next to the protection station to fully prepare for the hike.
location: Daochangping Protection Station, Zhejiang Qingliangfeng National Nature Reserve, Houlong Line, Lin'an District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Light-pack hiking toward Daochangping
description: With his light pack on and hiking pole in hand, Lei Mingxuan chose a less-traveled trail toward Daochangping and went deep into the forest. Birds sang and insects chirped among the trees, with lush greenery everywhere and a cool mountain breeze. Along the way, he took a 30-second Vlog of himself by a small stream to capture the moment. He walked about 6 kilometers in total and had an energy bar.
location: Mountain trail toward Daochangping, Qingliangfeng National Nature Reserve, Lin'an District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Camping and outdoor pour-over coffee
description: He found a flat woodland clearing with open views, sheltered from the wind. Lei Mingxuan set up the tent in just 15 minutes. Then he took out his beloved pour-over kettle, filter dripper, and freshly ground coffee beans, boiled water with a portable outdoor stove, and carefully brewed the coffee. Steam rose among the trees, the aroma of coffee filled the air, and the fatigue of the hike vanished.
location: Sheltered woodland near Daochangping, Qingliangfeng National Nature Reserve, Lin'an District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Watching the sunset and working on a novel
description: Holding his coffee and sitting on a folding chair, Lei Mingxuan quietly watched the setting sun slowly sink, the sky dyed orange-red. He took out his notebook and pen, and seizing the mood, began drafting a new chapter of the novel 'Afternoon at Xiafei Lane', weaving the insights from last night's heart-to-heart talk with his father and the quiet solitude of the mountains into the words. His thoughts flowed like a spring, and he filled four pages in one sitting.
location: Daochangping Campsite, Qingliangfeng National Nature Reserve, Lin'an District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Simple dinner and free time
description: After it was completely dark, Lei Mingxuan turned on his headlamp and had a simple dinner of the beef jerky, nuts, and energy bars he had brought. After eating, he read parts of "Steve Jobs" on his Kindle while reflecting on the podcast he had listened to that afternoon. His phone had a weak signal at that point, so he sent a message home to let them know he was safe.
location: Inside a tent at Daochangping Campsite, Qingliang Peak National Nature Reserve, Lin'an District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Stargazing and washing up at the campsite
description: Dimming his headlamp, Lei Mingxuan lay on the sleeping pad outside the tent, gazing at the starry night sky. The air was clear, and the Milky Way was faintly visible. Afterward, he washed up simply, organized the water supply and trash, and ensured the campsite was safe and tidy.
location: Daochangping Campsite, Qingliangfeng National Nature Reserve, Lin'an District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Pre-Bedtime Preparations
description: Crawling into his sleeping bag, Lei Mingxuan set his alarm for 6:30 the next day. The night breeze blew through the treetops, and his mood gradually shifted from the day's excitement to calm. Reviewing the day's itinerary, he saw that his energy had been managed well without overexertion. With a sense of satisfaction, he turned off his headlamp at 9 PM and fell asleep peacefully amid the sounds of insects.
location: Inside a tent at Daochangping Campsite, Qingliang Peak National Nature Reserve, Lin'an District, Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Take down the tent, clean up the campsite, and prepare to set off.
description: Woke up at 6 a.m. at the Qingliangfeng campsite, quickly packed up the sleeping bag, took down the tent and ground mat, and put all trash into a garbage bag to leave no trace at the campsite. Then I wiped my face with wet wipes, loaded the camping backpack and hiking shoes into the trunk, drank some water before getting in the car, set the navigation destination to home in Pudong, Shanghai, pulled up the hip-hop playlist downloaded last night, and got ready to head down the mountain.
location: Camping spot and parking lot, Daochangping Protection Station, Qingliangfeng National Nature Reserve, Longgang Town, Lin'an District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Driving back to Shanghai
description: Departed from Qingliang Peak at 7:00 sharp, drove along the Hangrui Expressway, S4 Shanghai-Jinshan Expressway, and the Middle Ring Road, stopping at the Jiaxing service area for 15 minutes to buy iced Mizone and stretch. Hip-hop music played the whole way to stay alert, and arrived at the surface parking space at Shanggang Residential Community on Pudong Avenue in Shanghai at 10:30.
location: Hangrui Expressway, S4 Hujin Expressway, Middle Ring Road to Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home to rest, take care of the cat, and set up the fitness app.
description: After entering the house, A Fu rubbed against his legs in greeting. He temporarily placed the camping gear in the entryway, filled A Fu's bowl with cat food, and replaced the water with fresh water. Then he quickly showered, changed into gray loungewear, sat on the sofa and petted the cat for 5 minutes, while scrolling through Moments and seeing the basketball shoe photo Xie Fei had posted. He then went to the study, downloaded a home strength training app rated 4.8, registered and entered his height of 172 cm and weight of 80.1 kg, and completed a 15-minute introductory fitness test. He customized his training plan: squats 3×15, push-ups 3×12, plank 3×45 seconds, and linked it to his phone calendar with reminders set for Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 9 p.m.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepare and enjoy a healthy lunch.
description: To store up energy for the afternoon basketball game, he opened the refrigerator and took out the chicken breast his mother had marinated, broccoli, and instant quinoa. He first cooked the quinoa over low heat and blanched the broccoli, then pan-fried the chicken breast in olive oil until both sides were golden. He ate at exactly 12 o'clock, and while eating, he looked at basketball strategy posts on his tablet to learn cutting routes after pick-and-rolls.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Communication with father and afternoon preparations
description: He soaked the dirty dishes in the sink and went back to the living room. His father, Lei Jianguo, was reading the Jiefang Daily with reading glasses, so he sat down and started talking about downloading a strength training app to lose weight. His father advised him to exercise gradually and not injure his lower back. After chatting for about 20 minutes, he went back to his room, changed into a jersey, shorts, and basketball shoes, put on knee pads, filled his large water bottle, and prepared to go out to play ball.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Rest, equipment check, and drive to Yuanshen Sports Center
description: Before leaving, I leaned against the bed scrolling through Bilibili and watched two low-fat meal prep videos, noting down a new chicken breast marinating method. Then I opened the Dewu app to check whether the techwear waist bag in my shopping cart had dropped in price. A Fu jumped onto the bed and squeezed under my arm, so I scratched his belly. At 13:50, I put on my sports backpack, went downstairs, and drove the white Volkswagen Tiguan, listening to hip-hop, arriving at the Yuanshen Sports Center parking lot in about ten minutes.
location: Yuanshen Sports Center parking lot at the intersection of Zhangyang Road and Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-game warm-up, gathering with basketball buddies, and a farewell basketball game.
description: After arriving, I jogged two laps around the court first, then did dynamic stretches like jumping jacks, high knees, and leg stretches. At 14:15 Xie Fei and Lao Deng arrived. Xie Fei showed off his newly practiced step-back move, and we set the 4-on-4 team split rules: play two games, half an hour each, losers buy water. At 14:30 the game started.
