I played power forward, fighting hard for rebounds and screens. We narrowly won the first game 20:18; in the second game we tightened our defense and I made two blocks, winning 55:48 in the end. Afterward everyone sat on the ground catching their breath. Xie Fei praised my stamina and we agreed to play again at the end of the month.
location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Catching up after the game, walking to a street-side food stall, and having dinner together
description: After playing ball, they were reluctant to part right away. They bought iced cola from the vending machine and sat on the steps by the court chatting, complaining about work, and swapping stories. Xie Fei complained about his boss again, making everyone laugh. Lao Deng suggested eating crayfish after the next game, and it passed unanimously. At 17:40, they got up and walked two or three minutes to the "Brothers BBQ" food stall on Yushan Road and sat at a roadside table. Lei Mingxuan ordered: 40 lamb skewers, a dozen grilled oysters, two grilled eggplants, a plate of stir-fried snails, and 6 bottles of iced beer. As they ate, they recalled funny moments from playing ball. Xie Fei raised his bottle to toast "the youth that never grows old," and they agreed to schedule a fixed weekend game every month. After Lei Mingxuan paid the bill, the group broke up at 19:00.
location: Brothers BBQ street-food stall, Yushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home and doing laundry
description: Drove home from the food stall. After arriving, I immediately took out the soaked jersey, shorts, and knee pads, put them in the washing machine, added detergent, and started the quick wash. Then I changed into clean loungewear, checked Ah Fu's food bowl, and added a few freeze-dried treats.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Showering and unwinding
description: He took a hot shower to wash away the fatigue, then collapsed on the sofa, put Ah Fu on his lap, and petted the cat. He scrolled Douyin to watch basketball dunk compilations to decompress, and at the same time used fingerprint payment to order the utility waist bag he had been wanting in his shopping cart.
location: Home bathroom and living room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Update the serialized novel
description: He opened his laptop, logged into the fiction platform, and wove the passion and brotherhood from the afternoon basketball court into a new chapter of "Afternoon in Xiafei Lane," describing the "final showdown" between the protagonist and his lane brothers for the basketball court. He typed about 1,800 words in one go and clicked publish at 21:00. Seeing a reader comment saying, "This part is so fucking lit!", he was very happy.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Playing with the cat, getting ready for bed, and washing up
description: I used a laser pointer to tease Afu into running around the whole house, then cleaned the litter box and added fresh cat litter. I tidied the desk and moved the camping gear into the storage room. Then I brushed my teeth and washed my face while checking the novel’s stats on my phone; I found 10 new favorites and 7 comments and replied to a few interesting messages. Afu lay by the bathroom door like a supervisor keeping me company.
location: Living room and bathroom at home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going to bed and falling asleep.
description: At 22:05, he turned off the light and lay down, reviewing a fulfilling day that went from the mountains of Qingliang Peak to the basketball court and then home. He decided to go for a run tomorrow morning at Lujiazui Central Green, and afterward go to the store at Super Brand Mall to organize the new stock. With a sense of being grounded, he soon fell asleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run and training reflection.
description: At six in the morning, Lei Mingxuan started his morning run in Century Park. Sunlight filtered through the leaves onto the running track, and he easily completed 4 kilometers with his heart rate steady between 135 and 140. After the run, he stretched on a wooden bench by the lake and reviewed his training plan from the past three weeks. He found that his strength training completion rate was not good, so he decided to schedule strength training at six o'clock every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday starting next week, alternating with his morning runs.
location: Path and bench beside the south parking lot at Gate 1 of Century Park, No. 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Weigh-in, breakfast, and family interaction
description: Lei Mingxuan weighed himself immediately after returning home; his weight was 80.0 kg, and his body had entered a stable phase. After showering, his mother Wang Xiuying had prepared red date porridge and fried eggs. During breakfast, he reported his weight to the family. His father Lei Jianguo reminded him again to eat more vegetables, while his mother enthusiastically said she was going to the vegetable market at noon to develop new dishes. He also gave his cat Afu an extra cat treat; the little one rubbed against his slippers. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: At home: No. 12, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and morning store preparation
description: Lei Mingxuan put on the store's mountain-style techwear short-sleeve shirt, rode his e-bike along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui Metro Station, parked the bike, and walked through the morning commuter crowd from the station into the B1 level of Super Brand Mall, then reached the Xiafei Ji store on the second floor. After arriving, he turned on the lights, switched on the air conditioning, checked the floor cleanliness, and counted the cash in the register, completing the opening preparations.
location: "Xiafeiji" store, 2nd floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing the coffee corner and communicating online
description: After the clerk Xiao Lin arrived at the store, Lei Mingxuan explained the new products to be highlighted in the day's display, then focused on setting up the coffee corner. He neatly arranged the pour-over kettle, electronic scale, and thermometer, took out Ethiopian Yirgacheffe beans, and tested the grind size. Meanwhile, he sent a WeChat voice message to his friend Zhou Tao, confirming a meeting at an independent café on West Nanjing Road, Jing'an District, at 2 p.m. on August 2, and reminded him to set a phone reminder.
location: "Xiafeiji" store, 2nd floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Manning the store, adjusting displays, and online marketing.
description: The mall had just opened and there were still few customers. Lei Mingxuan, following a Japanese-style display tutorial saved on Xiaohongshu, restyled the mannequin featuring the main push cargo shorts and quick-drying T-shirt, and took three live photos of the display to post on WeChat Moments and the 'Xiafeiji' Xiaohongshu account. Xiao Lin helped go to the Lujiazui subway station lockers to ship two online orders.
location: "Xiafeiji" store, 2nd floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Business lunch and market research.
description: At lunchtime, Lei Mingxuan walked to the Japanese ramen shop on the LG2 floor of IFC Mall and enjoyed tonkotsu ramen. While waiting for a seat, he carefully observed the shop's minimalist interior style and thought about how to apply similar elements to the rest area of the coffee corner in his own store.
location: Ramen Arena, LG2 Floor, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Noon shift at the store and preparing for customer reception
description: After returning to the store, Lei Mingxuan brewed himself a cup of Yirgacheffe to chase away drowsiness and confirmed the coffee flavor was stable. Then he sent a WeChat message to Han Dong to confirm their 3 p.m. meeting, wiped down the coffee corner counter, and tuned the speakers to an indie music station to create a cozy atmosphere for guests.
location: "Xiafeiji" store, 2nd floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Han Dong arrived at the store to check out the coffee corner
description: Good friend Han Dong arrived at the shop on time and looked around the coffee corner in surprise. Lei Mingxuan invited him to sit at the bar and brewed a cup by hand on the spot. After savoring the aroma and taking small sips, Han Dong praised, “Damn, Brother Xuan, you really got it going. The flavor is legit, and your execution is impressive!” The two chatted for nearly an hour. Han Dong offered to introduce designer friends for exchange, took photos, and posted on Moments with the caption “My buddy’s shop—the owner’s pour-over is amazing and stylish!” Lei Mingxuan thanked him for his earlier encouragement.
location: 'Xiafei Ji' store coffee corner, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wrapping up at the store and receiving customers.

He cited examples of fitness customers in the store and promised to go to the vegetable market with her and research recipes together. His mother was initially worried about the taste and the hassle, but after her son promised to take it step by step from the weekend, she finally agreed.

Then he put on his roller-skating gear, checked the knee pads, helmet and wheels, and sent Song Jia a WeChat message to confirm meeting at the usual spot by the river in the evening.

While skating, they chatted about Song Jia's recent graphic design project and the coffee corner at his store. He then sent Old Zhou a message confirming they would meet on Sunday, set his alarm for 6 a.m. the next day, turned off the light, and went to sleep.

He spread out the yoga mat in the living room and strictly followed the plan, completing 3 sets of 15 squats, 3 sets of 12 push-ups, and 3 sets of 45-second planks with proper form. He felt muscle soreness. After training, he checked in on the fitness app, then went into the bathroom to take a shower. Before showering, he stepped on the electronic scale, which showed 79.9 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday. Pleased, he recorded today's weight and how his muscles felt after training in his phone memo.

Several regular customers quickly responded and joined the discussion, and the group atmosphere became lively, further strengthening the connection between the store and its customers.

The mother and son ate and chatted, once again confirming the meal plan outline they were to finalize that day. Lei Mingxuan thanked his mother for her support, and she smiled and said they would officially start the new meal plan tomorrow. After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan took out his iPad and opened a healthy eating app, while his mother flipped through her old recipe notebook. Together they worked out a five-month high-protein, low-fat meal plan outline and listed a detailed shopping list: 2 kg of chicken breast, 1 kg of salmon fillet, 500 g of shrimp, plus various vegetables and seasonings, with an estimated total cost of about 480 yuan.

After arriving, Lei Mingxuan pushed the cart and carefully selected chicken breast, salmon fillets, and other items in the fresh food section, checking production dates carefully; his mother chose seaweed, wood ear fungus, and other dried goods in the dried goods section. At checkout, the total was exactly 480 yuan. Lei Mingxuan paid by credit card and arranged for the free delivery service, agreeing that it would be sent to the clothing store in the afternoon. After shopping, the two strolled home at a leisurely pace, enjoying the cool morning, and discussed the meal plan for the next three days.

He first explored Halls W1-W3 on his own, lingering in the anime merchandise and figure model areas. At 12:45, he met Gao Yuan in person for the first time at Entrance 2; the two had known each other online for a long time and hit it off right away. Gao Yuan gave him a boxed limited-edition Gundam figure as a welcome gift. Lei Mingxuan accepted it with delight and gave him an out-of-print Pop Mart figure in return. The two then explored the expo together in depth. Gao Yuan enthusiastically explained the background stories of the various limited-edition figures, while Lei Mingxuan shared his Pop Mart collection and how his clothing store was doing. At noon, they had a simple meal of boxed lunches and drinks inside the venue, and in the afternoon they continued visiting and photographing more design elements they could borrow from, until the expo closed.

When he arrived, he found that Xiao Lin had already neatly stacked the ingredients delivered by the supermarket in the storeroom. After checking and confirming everything was correct, he thanked Xiao Lin and briefly chatted about what they had seen at the expo. Then the two locked up and left work together. Lei Mingxuan continued riding his e-bike along Pudong Binjiang Avenue toward home, the evening breeze on his face, feeling pleased.

The IP collaboration designs are so inspiring. Starting tomorrow, my five-month healthy eating reboot officially begins — let's go!'

name: Washing up and going to bed.
description: Took a shower and washed up, then changed into pajamas. Before bed, sent a message to Gao Yuan and made plans to play online games together next week. After turning off the lights and lying down, I reviewed the day: the shop accounts were clear, I had a great time at the exhibition with friends, and family life was warm. The last day of July was fulfilling and complete, and I fell into a deep sleep with a full sense of satisfaction.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and stretching at the hotel.
description: He woke up early in the hotel room. Because his legs were sore from walking 20,000 steps at yesterday's expo, he skipped the morning run and did 15 minutes of full-body static stretching on the carpet, focusing on relaxing his calves and hips. Meanwhile, he used his phone to check the shop's early-bird customer group and replied to regular customers' questions about T-shirt sizes.
location: No. 1703, Lane 1883, Huamu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; guest room at Ji Hotel (Kerry City, Shanghai New International Expo Center)

name: Wash up, check out, and record inspirations.
description: Took a refreshing shower, recalling the combat feel of the indie game "Ink Realm" experienced yesterday. After drying his hair, he sat at the desk and quickly jotted down in his notebook the inspiration fragments that could be written into the novel "Afternoon in Xiafei Lane", including plot points about an exaggerated cosplay side character and chasing a clue in a rainstorm. At 7 o'clock sharp, he packed his luggage, checked out at the front desk, and collected the accommodation invoice.
location: Guest rooms and lobby front desk, Ji Hotel (Shanghai New International Expo Center Kerry Parkside), 1703, Lane 1883, Huamu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning commute and breakfast shopping
description: He walked about 10 minutes from the hotel to the Shanghai New International Expo Center, observing cosplayers who had already gathered in the square along the way. He bought an iced Americano and a tuna sandwich at the convenience store by the exhibition hall entrance, quickly finishing breakfast while also taking note of the surrounding character costumes to gather material for his creative work.
location: Outside the convenience store at the entrance of Shanghai New International Expo Center, No. 2345 Longyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Meeting Gao Yuan and picking up the handbook
description: Met up with friend Gao Yuan at the entrance of Hall W3 at the Shanghai New International Expo Center, and queued together to get the venue guide map and event schedule. Gao Yuan was especially excited about the cosplay stage arrangement, and the two agreed to arrive early to reserve spots for the dance performance.
location: Entrance of Hall W3, Shanghai New International Expo Center, 2345 Longyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Final-day in-depth exhibition visit
description: After the exhibition hall opened, he headed straight to the cosplay main stage in Hall W3, secured a good spot, and watched the two-hour performance, using his phone and action camera alternately to shoot lots of high-definition footage. Then he moved to the fan art exhibition area in Halls E5-E7, accompanying Gao Yuan to queue and chat at the booth of his favorite artist. Gao Yuan purchased a Frieren: Beyond Journey's End signed art board as a farewell gift, while he himself picked up a steampunk-style black-and-white line art collection that inspired his novel scene creation.
location: Halls W3 and E5-E7, Shanghai New International Expo Center, 2345 Longyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Farewell lunch with Gao Yuan
description: Because of the noonday sun, the two took shelter in a McDonald's next to the subway station and ordered an Angus beef burger combo and iced Coke. While eating, they eagerly discussed the gains from the morning, shared photos, and Gao Yuan shared news about new anime. Before parting, they exchanged gifts: Lei Mingxuan gave a convention-exclusive anime badge, and Gao Yuan gave a signed drawing board in return. They also agreed to watch Frieren: Beyond Journey's End together online next week and swap blind boxes.
location: Room 132, Ground Floor, 2100 Longyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, McDonald's (Longyang Road Restaurant)

name: Seeing off Gao Yuan and taking shelter from the rain
description: At the entrance of Longyang Road Metro Station, he said goodbye to Gao Yuan and reminded him to be safe on the way back. After watching Gao Yuan enter the station, large raindrops suddenly fell from the sky, so he hurried back under the station eaves to take shelter. Checking the weather forecast and learning that the thunderstorm would last until 5 p.m., he decided to take the metro home instead.
location: Longyang Road Metro Station entrance, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Working while commuting on the subway.
description: He took Metro Line 2 toward the city center and handled work with earphones on in a corner of the carriage. First, he posted a set of cosplay event photos taken in the morning in the customer group with captions for interaction, sparking lively discussion. Then he spent 20 minutes replying to multiple suppliers on WeChat, confirming the shipping dates and pattern details of the new autumn sample garments.
location: Shanghai Metro Line 2 car, between Longyang Road Station and Dongchang Road Station.

name: Sprinted home in the rain.
description: Exiting from Pudian South Road (formerly Dongchang Road) Metro Station, the rain had not let up. Holding an umbrella, he turned quickly onto Pudong Avenue and jogged all the way back to his home in Shanggang Residential Area. Although he had an umbrella, his trouser legs were still splashed wet by puddles. He quickly opened the door with the fingerprint lock and went inside.
location: Along the route from Pudong South Road Metro Station to Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home, tidying up, and interacting with Afu
description: Changed out of wet shoes and placed the brochures, art books, badges, and other items from the exhibition on the coffee table for photos. After a hot shower, changed into dry loungewear, refilled the cat Afu's food and water, and petted him. Then took some chilled watermelon slices from the fridge, sat on the sofa to browse today's photos, and selected the 9 best to post on Moments.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Business posts on WeChat Moments and showing off in group chats
description: Carefully crafted a WeChat Moments post, arranged nine highlight photos from the expo in a grid, and published it, expressing reluctance to leave ChinaJoy and the inspiration gained. Then took a screenshot of the post and sent it to the friends group 'Pudong Three Musketeers', tagging Zhang Wei and Li Na to show off the gains of the trip, which drew a flood of envious sticker replies. Felt very pleased.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Communicating with mother about healthy diet reform.
description: Seeing his mother picking vegetables in the kitchen, he went over to chat. The conversation moved from IP collaboration clothing designs at the expo to fashion sense, and then he took the opportunity to mention his slightly high BMI. He showed her the doctor's nutritional advice and a family high-protein shopping list, and in a gentle but firm tone persuaded her to adjust the diet starting with dinner—reducing high-oil and high-sugar dishes and adding chicken breast and fish. His mother, Wang Xiuying, eventually agreed to temporarily set aside the Shanghai-style braised pork and switch to steamed sea bass.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, kitchen at home in Shanggang Community

name: Helping mother clean the fridge and plan purchases
description: After his mother relented, he acted immediately. Putting on rubber gloves, he cleaned out the refrigerator with her, throwing away half a bottle of Coke, frozen meatballs, and expired salad dressing. Then he and his mother made a shopping list for tomorrow's trip to Pushang Food Market, including healthy ingredients such as skinless chicken breast, basa fish fillets, broccoli, and sugar-free yogurt. His father, Lei Jianguo, slipped into the kitchen, saw the discarded 'contraband,' and joked that his good eating days were over.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, kitchen at home in Shanggang Community

name: Enjoy the first meal of reform
description: Dinner started right on time. The table featured steamed sea bass, boiled prawns, garlic broccoli, and tomato and egg soup instead of the usual rich, heavy sauce dishes. Lei Mingxuan ate the fish and shrimp heartily and praised his mother's cooking. Although his father complained that the food was too light, his chopsticks honestly kept reaching for the fish. The family enjoyed a warm and happy meal together. Taking the opportunity, Lei Mingxuan said that after his BMI reaches the target, he would occasionally indulge in richer dishes to celebrate, calling it sustainable development.
location: In the dining room at home, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organizing inspiration and novel writing
description: After dinner, returned to the bedroom, opened the laptop, and sorted and organized today’s photos. Created a new Word document and outlined a side story for “Afternoon in Xiafeifang,” combining the exhibition’s steampunk art collection, the fan-art booth atmosphere, and the old Shanghai lane details my father recounted; typed over 2,000 words of story outline and opening paragraph, feeling very fulfilled.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Store community interaction and tomorrow's planning.
description: Switched to WeChat, posted a Moments screenshot with the store QR code to the VIP customer group, previewing tomorrow's exchange with a senior peer in the industry at a café in Jing'an District to seek co-branded product benefits, which drew likes and inquiries from regular customers. At the same time, I opened the phone calendar to confirm tomorrow's 14:00 meeting arrangement and mentally reviewed the talking points and required materials.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Soaking feet and catching up on anime
description: He soaked his feet in hot water to relieve the day's fatigue, and his cat Afu jumped onto his lap to keep him company. He opened Bilibili on his tablet to watch the latest downloaded episode of 'Frieren: Beyond Journey's End', enjoying the rare peace and quiet after the exhausting exhibition walk.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Moments interaction and bedtime preparation
description: After soaking his feet, he checked the nearly hundred likes and comments on his Moments and replied to the important ones. In the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat, he chatted with Zhang Wei and agreed to go sea fishing in Zhoushan at the end of the month. Then he set an alarm for 7:30 the next morning, put the materials for meeting Old Zhou into his commuter bag, and checked the e-bike's battery to ensure a worry-free trip the next day.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Turned off the bedroom ceiling light, left a bedside lamp on, and leaned against the headboard reading "Old News of Shanghai" from a secondhand book site as bedtime reading. When drowsiness came, closed the book, said goodnight to the cat Afu, turned off the light, and fell asleep quickly amid the satisfaction of the exhibition hustle and family warmth.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lazy morning wake-up and indoor dynamic stretching
description: At 8:20 on Saturday morning, Lei Mingxuan woke up naturally. The weather outside was sultry, and his phone showed afternoon thunderstorms, so he decisively gave up his morning run plan. He stayed in bed scrolling through the designer toy community on his phone, watched A Fu yawn on the bay window, and scratched under her chin. After getting up, he spread out a yoga mat on the balcony and followed a phone app to do a 15-minute dynamic stretching routine, as a small concession to his body.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (master bedroom and balcony)

name: Washing up and morning preparation.
description: After stretching, he took a warm shower and changed into comfortable cotton-linen loungewear. The 80.1 kg number on the scale reminded him that yesterday's dietary reform could not be relaxed. He patted his cheeks in the mirror and felt he was in good shape today.
location: Bathroom and dining room, Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: High-protein breakfast and family chat
description: Mother brought out breakfast prepared according to the new recipe — whole-wheat vegetable egg rolls, unsweetened soy milk, and a plate of blueberries. Father looked through old photos on his phone while drinking his soy milk. Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to share the steampunk art book he had seen at ChinaJoy yesterday. Father said that when he was young, he had worked on that kind of old-fashioned printer at a machinery factory, and it actually bore a striking resemblance to the mechanical elements in the art book. This unexpectedly sparked inspiration for a side story in the novel.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Quarter, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (dining room)

name: Advanced pour-over coffee certification hands-on session and home tasting event
description: Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop and logged into the 'Qiyun' Coffee Academy platform; his certificate of completion was ready to download. He printed two copies and sealed one in a transparent protective film for display. Then he eagerly brought out the V60 dripper, thermometer, pour-over kettle, and grinder. Strictly following the Golden Cup theory (coffee-to-water ratio 1:15, 92°C water temperature), he brewed the newly purchased Ethiopian Yirgacheffe using the swirling pour method. The first pot had an unsteady water flow and was slightly astringent; after adjusting the pouring rhythm for the second pot, the aroma filled the air. He invited his father, who was watching TV in the living room, and his mother, who was clearing the table, to taste it, and guided them to identify citrus and jasmine floral notes using the flavor wheel. His mother said, 'It tastes much better than last time, not so bitter,' and his father nodded approvingly.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (living room coffee corner)

name: Family Lunch and Afternoon Plan Discussion
description: Lunch was steamed turbot, blanched okra, and tofu mushroom soup, perfectly matching the healthy recipe. At the dining table, Lei Mingxuan briefed his parents on the afternoon plan: organizing exhibition materials and communicating with supplier Lao Zhou via WeChat about next Tuesday's meeting. His mother told him not to work too hard, and his father asked him to send some interesting pictures after finishing.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Quarter, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (dining room)

name: Pre-rain walk and neighborhood stroll
description: After dinner the sky grew dim, and faint thunder rumbled in the distance. Lei Mingxuan changed into his sneakers, went downstairs, and walked briskly around the neighborhood twice to help digest, feeling the humid breeze before the heavy rain. At the FamilyMart by the neighborhood entrance, he bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea, and got home just as the raindrops began to fall.
location: Inside Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the FamilyMart convenience store at the community entrance.

name: Systematically organize exhibition materials and business liaison
description: At one in the afternoon, thunder rolled outside the window and the rainstorm arrived as expected. Lei Mingxuan turned on the desk lamp in his study and first brewed a cup of chrysanthemum tea. He took out the large journal from yesterday's exhibition visit and sorted the exhibition brochures and business cards into four categories—“domestic trendy brands / overseas handicrafts / indie games / co-branded IP”—sticking colored sticky notes on each. He highlighted supplier Zhou Tao's business card and three Southeast Asian fabric brands with matching styles. Then he sent a message to Lao Zhou, sharing the trend photos of Southeast Asian floral and geometric patterns taken at the exhibition, and finally confirmed a meeting at the shop at 2 p.m. on August 5 (next Tuesday), asking him to be sure to bring the three latest print samples and the quotation for this fall/winter. Lao Zhou replied instantly and even said he would bring a few more fabric books to choose from.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (study)

name: Online customer group sharing and interaction
description: During a break while sorting materials, Lei Mingxuan picked out a few nice pictures of Chinese-style blind boxes and badges from the expo that didn't involve business secrets, and sent them to the WeChat customer group 'Boss Lei's Treasure Closet.' Caption: 'Treasures I found at ChinaJoy yesterday. I think these Chinese-style designs would look amazing with the tactical vests in the store. In a couple of days I'll show you the look I put together!' Several regular customers immediately liked and discussed it, and he took the opportunity to tease next week's new Southeast Asian-style items, warming up the crowd.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (study)

name: Compiling novel side stories and learning on Bilibili
description: The rain gradually let up, and the air outside the window was especially fresh. Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop and systematically integrated the old alleyway stories he had talked about with his father today, the steampunk elements from yesterday's exhibition, and the understanding of rules and aesthetics gained from coffee practice into the outline for the side story 'The Afternoon of Xiafei Fang'. He wrote about 800 words and felt his thinking had become much clearer. Afterwards, he spent some time on Bilibili, watched two practical videos about 'how store lighting affects customer flow paths,' and saved several brilliant ideas to prepare for next month's display renovation.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (study)

name: High-protein family dinner
description: After the rain cleared, his mother made dinner—poached shrimp, cold shredded chicken, and tofu mushroom soup—perfectly matching the meal plan. At the table, Lei Mingxuan shared the success of today's coffee tasting and the confirmation of a meeting with Lao Zhou. His father, while peeling shrimp, said, "This dietary change is great; my blood lipids seem to have gone down." His mother was happy to hear that. After dinner, he took the initiative to wash the dishes and let his mother rest.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Quarter, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (dining room)

name: Night skating in the residential community and interactions with neighbors.
description: After dinner, the sky was not completely dark yet, and it had been stuffy all day. Lei Mingxuan put on his roller skates and skated from his doorstep to the central square of the residential complex. He skated on the open square for half an hour, enjoying the coolness of the evening breeze. He ran into his neighbor Uncle Wang, who was walking his dog. Uncle Wang praised his skills, and Lei took the opportunity to recommend the benefits of roller skating to him, also making an appointment to learn a few tricks from Uncle Wang another day. This casual way of exercising relaxed him more than indoor workouts.
location: Central Square and internal roads of Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Foot-soaking relaxation and late-night chat in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group
description: After returning home, Lei Mingxuan soaked his feet in hot water to relieve the fatigue of the day. Picking up his phone, he saw Zhang Wei and Li Na chatting enthusiastically in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group. He shared his sense of accomplishment from working on his coffee certificate and novel outline at home today, and also complained about the afternoon thunderstorm. Li Na said she had just come back from a business trip and suggested that they all go play billiards at World Square one evening next week. Zhang Wei proposed going to his place next weekend to try the crayfish he had been experimenting with. The three of them casually chatted about this and that.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (living room)

name: Organizing collectibles and planning tomorrow's video
description: After soaking his feet, Lei Mingxuan went to the study, took out the rare limited-edition blind boxes he had traded for at ChinaJoy yesterday, rearranged them, adjusted the lighting in the display cabinet, and took a few photos. Then he browsed his memos, thinking about asking his cousin Yang Fan during tomorrow's video call for advice on using algorithms to optimize the store's online membership management, and also sending him the exhibition materials he organized today.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (study)

name: Caught up on anime, got ready for bed, and fell asleep.
description: Plugged his phone in to charge, closed his laptop, and set it aside. Lei Mingxuan leaned against the headboard and caught up on the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, enjoying a quiet before-bed moment. Halfway through, he remembered that all the important conversations today had been completed and felt very fulfilled. At 23:35, he turned off the light, put on his eye mask, and with satisfaction about the coming day and the gains of the week, quickly fell asleep.
location: Room 301, Building 5, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (bedroom)

name: Waking and Getting Up
description: Woken by the morning sunlight, I glanced at my phone—29, felt okay. Not in a hurry to get up, I first did 5 minutes of supine stretching in bed, including leg raises, neck turns, and arm stretches, to activate my body and avoid feeling groggy when getting up in the muggy weather.
location: Master bedroom at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Home strength training
description: After changing into sports shorts, I spread out the yoga mat in the living room. I did an indoor bodyweight workout: 20 squats, feeling my thighs engage and keeping my balance; 3 sets of 15 push-ups, switching to knee push-ups when tired; and 3 sets of 45-second planks. It took 25 minutes in total, I sweated quite a bit, and felt my body fully stretched out.
location: Living room, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shower and breakfast
description: Took a cold shower to shake off the summer heat, then changed into loose loungewear T-shirt and shorts. In the dining room, my father, Lei Jianguo, had already brewed tea, and my mother, Wang Xiuying, served breakfast: strictly following the new diet — two boiled eggs, a bowl of oatmeal soaked in skim milk, plus a small plate of cucumber salad.
location: Home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Morning planning and departure preparation
description: While drinking milk, I quickly scanned today's to-do list in my phone notes: store surveying and budget, a video call with Yang Fan, and a trip to the vegetable market in the afternoon. In the notes, I marked "bring a tape measure and grid notebook for the surveying," and put a question mark next to "coffee machine budget: 30,000 yuan" to remind myself to look into it later. Then I put the tape measure, laser distance meter, and grid notebook into my backpack.
location: Home dining room and entrance hall, 12 Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the store
description: At exactly nine o'clock, he rode a shared bike west along Zhangyang Road and arrived at Super Brand Mall 10 minutes later. The mall had just opened and the air conditioning hadn't fully kicked in yet, but the store was empty, so it was a good time to start surveying.
location: Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Lujiazui West Road

name: On-site measurement and cost estimation for the shop's pour-over experience area
description: Moved away the clearance clothing rack in the southwest corner, squatted on the ground and repeatedly measured the clear dimensions, sketched a draft with a pencil, and marked the power outlets and reserved positions for water supply and drainage. At exactly ten o'clock, made a video call to Lao Li, a contractor I had worked with before, showed him photos taken on the spot, and asked about the minimal feasible plan for knocking down walls, modifying electrical and plumbing, and waterproofing. Lao Li estimated the cost for labor and auxiliary materials at about 20,000 yuan. Afterwards, I also called two coffee equipment dealers with good online reviews, asked each for quotes for commercial grinders, pour-over bars, and water purification systems, and estimated the total investment in professional equipment at about 30,000 yuan. Opened the built-in spreadsheet app on my phone, entered all the data, and formed a preliminary budget sheet with individual items and total price.
location: Store A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute home
description: After completing the survey, he locked the shop door and left. The mall's air conditioning was strong, but as soon as he stepped outside, a wave of heat hit him. He walked quickly to the roadside, hailed a ride-hailing car, and arrived downstairs at home 5 minutes later.
location: From No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road

name: Lunch and a shower
description: When he got home, his mother had already prepared lunch: steamed sea bass, blanched shrimp, and lettuce with oyster sauce, a high-protein, low-fat meal. While eating, he casually reported to his parents the progress of the morning's surveying. After the meal, he went back to his room, took a quick shower, and washed away the sweat.
location: Home dining room and bathroom, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Free time and afternoon nap.
description: Feeling a bit sleepy after the meal, I lay on the living room sofa with the air conditioning on, covered myself with a thin blanket, and dozed for 40 minutes. After waking up, I took out my phone, scrolled through Bilibili for a while, and watched an educational video about how to use box-shaking techniques to tell hidden blind box models apart, thinking I should try it next time.
location: Living room, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Video call with cousin Yang Fan.
description: He opened the iPad on time and made a WeChat video call to his cousin Yang Fan. Yang Fan had just woken up with messy hair. The two quickly got down to business. Lei Mingxuan shared the design sketch of the coffee corner in the southwest corner of the store and the budget table he had calculated that morning. Yang Fan then showed him several AI product-selection tools on his phone, demonstrated through screen sharing how to use AI to analyze the consumption profile of office workers around the store, and suggested using AI to generate a few versions of "morning coffee, evening cocktail" style co-branded posters for drinks and clothing. Lei Mingxuan found it very inspiring, and the two talked for a full hour, agreeing that Yang Fan would help him set up the backend in detail when he was free next week.
location: Home study at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Free time at home
description: After hanging up the video call, feeling a bit overloaded, I decided to switch gears. I opened bilibili and tapped on an update of the anime I'm following, Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, and watched an episode straight through. Meanwhile, my left hand wasn't idle either: I took out the rare Pop Mart blind box I bought at ChinaJoy yesterday, snapped a photo, and sent it to the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat with the note: 'Loot secured!'

participant.name: Member of the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group

location: Bedroom/living room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Getting ready to leave for the vegetable market
description: He slung his crossbody bag over his shoulder, changed into sandals, checked his phone and wallet, and called out to his parents, who were already changing shoes: 'Dad, Mom, let's go, to the wet market!'
location: Home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Family market shopping day
description: At four in the afternoon, the sun was blazing. The three of them crossed two streets together and walked to Pushang Vegetable Market. Despite the air conditioning, the meat and seafood sections still smelled briny. Mother Wang Xiuying, holding a printed recipe, headed straight for the chicken and fish stalls. Lei Mingxuan picked a lively sea bass at the fish stall. Father Lei Jianguo bargained with the vegetable vendor and finally bought a big basket of asparagus, broccoli, and konjac noodles. The three divided the work clearly: mother decided what to buy, father carried the heaviest bags, and Lei Mingxuan was in charge of scanning QR codes to pay and comparing prices.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home, tidy up, and prepare dinner
description: Back home, his mother Wang Xiuying and father were busy in the kitchen together. Lei Mingxuan sorted the groceries he had bought and put them in the fridge, and tore the broccoli into florets with his hands. He opened the Boohee Health app and entered all the ingredients purchased today one by one to calculate calories. The kitchen was filled with steam from the steamed fish and the aroma of scallions and ginger.
location: Kitchen at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: The meal arrived: four dishes and one soup—steamed sea bass, boiled shrimp with dip, garlic broccoli, and cold shredded konjac salad, with multigrain rice as the staple. The family ate and chatted. His mother suggested making it a Sunday tradition to do a big family grocery run, and Lei Mingxuan readily agreed. The mood at the table was warm and relaxed.
location: Home Dining Room, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Father and son walked and talked heart-to-heart in the neighborhood.
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to suggest going downstairs for a walk. Father and son changed into sandals and walked two slow laps around the residential complex. In the community garden, elderly men and women gathered together to enjoy the cool air and chat. Lei Mingxuan walked side by side with his father. His father rarely brought up amusing anecdotes from when he was a young workshop director at a state-owned factory, and sighed at how fast the times were changing. Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to report the preliminary plan for the shop renovation, mentioning a budget of about 50,000 yuan. His father patted him on the shoulder and said, "If you run into any difficulties, just speak up. The family has saved some money over the years; we'll support you."
location: Internal road of Shanggang Community, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Free time and leisure
description: Walked home and rinsed my feet. Back in my room, I opened the wardrobe, took out the blind boxes I had bought one by one, rearranged them by series, and placed them into transparent boxes. Meanwhile, I watched two educational videos on Bilibili about how to use box-shaking techniques to identify hidden editions, and shared a little scene from today's vegetable market with fellow collector Lin Jing in the blind box chat group. At 21:00, after washing up, I lay in bed and scrolled through WeChat. Seeing the draft AI product-selection report sent by my cousin Yang Fan, I replied, "OK, I'll look it over carefully tomorrow."
location: Bedroom/living room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Bedtime preparations
description: Turned off all electronic devices and confirmed the alarm was set for 7:40 tomorrow morning. Lying in bed, I thought back on today: the surveying was completed smoothly, I had a great conversation with Yang Fan, and the evening walk with my father was especially nice. My body was a bit tired, but I felt at ease. I closed my eyes and fell asleep quickly.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, bedroom

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: He was woken by the alarm at 7 a.m. Because the weather was hot and muggy, he canceled the morning run and instead did 15 minutes of stretching and wake-up exercises on the balcony. After sweating, he took a shower and changed into a fresh cotton-linen shirt and shorts. He weighed in at 79.7 kg, and his weight remained stable.
location: Home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: High-protein breakfast for the whole family
description: Mother prepared a high-protein breakfast according to the recipe: fried eggs, unsweetened yogurt with blueberries, and whole wheat bread with smoked salmon. While eating, I chatted with my parents. Dad said he slept well last night, and Mom said she planned to buy mung beans to make soup in the afternoon. I told them I wouldn't be home for dinner and would bring back some snacks.
location: Dining room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Shanggang Residential Area, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: Left at 8:00, walked to Dongchang Road Metro Station, took Line 2 for two stops to Lujiazui Station, crossed the IFC skyway, and arrived at the Super Brand Mall store at 8:25. After arriving, he turned on the air conditioner, cleaned up, adjusted the window display, and placed the newly arrived mountain-style T-shirts in a prominent position.
location: Store at Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ran into property manager Zheng Kai and finalized the coffee area renovation process
description: When I went to the Starbucks on the first floor of the mall to buy an iced Americano, I ran into Zheng Kai, the property manager on patrol, at the freight elevator. I took the initiative to bring up my idea of renovating the coffee area in the southwest corner. After checking his phone, he told me that I needed to submit renderings and fire-protection filing, and that the whole process would take about two weeks. He also reminded me not to touch load-bearing walls. After thanking him, I felt more confident about the renovation.
location: Elevator hall, 2nd floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Daily storekeeping and serving walk-in customers
description: In the morning, I counted inventory with store clerk Xiao Lin and packed online orders. There wasn't much foot traffic, so I sipped an iced Americano while browsing streetwear news on my iPad, looking for inspiration for the afternoon's product selection. During that time, I attended to two male customers and successfully sold a linen blazer.
location: Store at Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Fat-loss lunch and meeting preparation.
description: Asked Xiao Lin to watch the store and went to Food Republic on the basement level of Super Brand Mall, where he ordered a vegetable salad with chicken breast and fresh juice, strictly following the fat-loss plan. After returning to the store, he wiped clean the small round table in the negotiation area, prepared the contract template, notebook, and two pens, and played low-volume electronic music through the Bluetooth speaker.
location: Food court and shops, Basement Level 1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Confirm sample garments and update their status.
description: Supplier Zhou Tao sent a WeChat message saying he would be at the store in fifteen minutes. I gave the clothing racks one last check, quickly flipped through the Southeast Asian fashion trend images I had saved in the morning, took a few deep breaths, composed myself, and waited for the meeting with Zhou Tao.
location: Store at Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Selected Southeast Asian designer brands with supplier Zhou Tao.
description: At 2 p.m., Zhou Tao arrived at the shop on time, pulling two large suitcases. In the discussion area, he showed me six sample garments and five fabric books one by one. We had an in-depth conversation for nearly two hours, focusing on trying on the Thai hand-dyed indigo shirt, the Vietnamese geometric-print two-way long pants, and the Balinese plumeria-embroidered short-sleeve shirt. I had Xiao Lin try them on, while I carefully examined the cut and fabric details and took photos for reference. In the end, we settled on these three pieces and signed a trial sales agreement for an initial batch of twenty pieces each—sixty pieces in total—with a 30% deposit and delivery before the 13th. I deliberately added a clause to the contract stating that items with more than 15% obvious color deviation or defects could be returned or exchanged unconditionally, and Zhou Tao understood.
location: Store consultation area, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: New product photoshoot and online teaser launch
description: After seeing Zhou Tao off, while the natural light was still good, he had Xiao Lin model and took detail shots and outfit photos with his phone in front of the store's floor-to-ceiling mirror and against the black wall by the entrance, capturing an indigo-dyed shirt and printed trousers. He then picked a few photos and posted three close-ups on the store's WeChat Moments, with the caption, 'After a long silence, a different seasonal wind will blow next month,' and the tag #niche designer brand#.
location: Inside and at the entrance of the store at Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting after work and bringing back snacks for his parents
description: After closing the store, he left Super Brand Mall, walked to Dongchang Road Metro Station, took Line 2 one stop to Dongchang Road Station, and after exiting walked to Baiyulan Food, a time-honored shop on Shangcheng Road. He bought the butter rolls his parents loved and two boxes of pork mooncakes, and added a cup of mung bean soup for himself. Carrying the pastries, he walked home. When he entered, he smelled the aroma of mung bean soup from the kitchen and felt especially happy.
location: Baiyulan Food, No. 123 Shangcheng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (purchased pastries during commute)

name: Warm family dinner
description: When I got home, my father was watching the news in the living room. I put the snacks on the table and asked them to try them. Dinner was steamed sea bass, blanched okra, and tomato and egg soup made by my mother. During the meal, I shared the good news about securing the new brand today and showed them photos of the sample clothes on my phone. My father said, "It looks quite fresh," and my mother advised, "Don't stock too much." The family chatted happily, and I drank two big bowls of mung bean soup.
location: Dining room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Shanggang Residential Area, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online evaluation: chatting with cousin Shen Jie and friend Gao Yuan.
description: Back in the bedroom, I opened my computer and sent the full sample photos and pricing plan from today's shoot to my cousin Shen Jie. She quickly replied by voice, pointing out that the dropped-shoulder design of the indigo-dyed shirt fits the cityboy trend, suggesting pairing it with loose mountain-style shorts for a set display, and reminding me to position the pricing as an 'affordable light-luxury alternative.' I recorded her professional advice in my memo. Then I also sent sample detail photos to my friend Gao Yuan in Hangzhou. He immediately replied, 'Awesome!' and said, 'Those techwear pants have real potential.' We agreed to video chat next week to discuss styling in detail.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Night skating in the evening breeze: a riverside date with Song Jia.
description: After handling online matters, I changed into my roller skating gear and arrived at Dongchang Road Ferry on Pudong Riverside Avenue at 8:40. My friend Song Jia was already stretching her legs. We skated along the riverside rubber track from Dongchang Road Ferry to Tangqiao Ferry and back twice. Despite the muggy weather, the river breeze felt pleasant. As we skated and chatted, she recommended an Instagram account that showcases niche designs, and I shared a funny story about getting paid today. We said goodbye around 9:30.
location: Binjiang Avenue near Dongchang Road Ferry, No. 1 Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening tidying and relaxation.
description: After roller skating and working up a sweat, I went home, took a shower, and changed into loungewear. I organized Shen Jie and Gao Yuan's suggestions into the 'Brand Collection Plan' memo on my phone and set a reminder for next week to adjust the displays with Shen Jie. I brewed a cup of hot tea, sat on the sofa, and watched an episode of 'Frieren: Beyond Journey's End' as a reward. At 11 p.m., I turned off the lights and went to sleep, looking forward to the new stock arriving at the store.
location: Home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting up and morning wake-up
description: The phone alarm rang on time, and outside the window it was already bright with high summer. Lei Mingxuan stretched and felt that he had slept well last night. He first drank the warm water his mother had prepared on the nightstand, then did 10 minutes of static stretching on the floor, focusing on loosening his shoulders, back, and hips that might have stiffened from sitting for long periods. The scale showed 79.6 kg, the same as yesterday, and he was satisfied with his diet and exercise control.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family breakfast and operations sharing.
description: His mother prepared boiled eggs, whole wheat toast, and a bowl of blueberry yogurt according to his fat-loss diet. While eating breakfast, Lei Mingxuan excitedly shared with his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying the details of the batch of Thai indigo-dyed shirts he had signed with Zhou Tao yesterday, describing the unique plant-dyed feel and asymmetrical cutting. His father said such distinctive products would have no trouble finding a market, while his mother was concerned about whether the partner was reliable and reminded him to be careful with the payment terms.
location: Home dining room, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commute to the store
description: At exactly 8:00, Lei Mingxuan put on his helmet, got on his Niu electric scooter, rode west along Pudong Avenue, turned left at the intersection of Pudong South Road, passed through Lujiazui Ring Road, and after riding about 3 km, arrived at Super Brand Mall 12 minutes later. He parked the scooter in the paid non-motorized vehicle parking shed on the east side of the mall, then entered through the employee entrance.
location: On the way from No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Store opening preparations and morning meeting.
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan quickly turned on the air conditioner, lights, background music, and cash register, and checked the previous day's cash and petty cash. After staff member Xiao Lin arrived, the two held a five-minute morning meeting. Lei Mingxuan emphasized two core tasks: to complete the phone notifications for member points redemption in the morning, and to initially set up the 'Mountain-style Camping' themed new-product area according to the display standards suggested by Shen Jie. Then he imported the detail photos of yesterday's sample garments into the computer and prepared to edit material for his WeChat Moments.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Store operations and membership maintenance
description: After the mall opened at 9, Lei Mingxuan gave Xiao Lin the list of regular customers who had points to redeem this week and asked her to start calling them at 9:30. He then went through the sample clothing photos taken yesterday, selected five to edit for his Moments post, highlighting the texture of the indigo-dyed shirt, the drape of the Vietnamese pants, the details of the plumeria embroidered short-sleeve top, an outfit-on-model photo, and the fabric samples Zhou Tao had brought. At 10 he published a new-product teaser on Moments, with the caption emphasizing the three keywords handmade, niche, and Southeast Asia, and left an element of suspense.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch break and starting Japanese study
description: On the afternoon of April 12, college classmate Zhao Min noticed that Lei Mingxuan had recently been too absorbed in sedentary coffee gatherings and was missing more basketball sessions, so she specially invited him to a newly opened climbing gym to regain a sense of adventure. Lei Mingxuan tried bouldering for the first time and, with excellent coordination, conquered a V2 route, experiencing the thrill of solving a challenging problem. He posted photos on Moments, which drew likes.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon golden-hour sales and display guidance.
description: As the afternoon customer flow gradually increased, Lei Mingxuan successfully sold a linen blazer and two new Korean canvas bucket hats from the new arrivals, and found time to coach Xiao Lin on display adjustments. He pulled up Shen Jie's suggestions on his phone and taught Xiao Lin how to use styling tricks, camping chairs, small green plants and other props to create a "weekend mountain getaway" atmosphere, repeatedly emphasizing that all in-store photos must maintain a unified color tone and composition to look professional.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Organizing and processing online orders
description: Taking advantage of the lull in customer traffic at 3 p.m., Lei Mingxuan tidied up the fitting room, checked the clothes customers had tried on but not bought, and put them back in place. He then logged into the backend and handled a return request from the regular customer Qian Duoduo, whose linen shirt was too big; he processed the refund readily.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Continuous operation and self-learning
description: In the afternoon, business entered a steady period. Lei Mingxuan stayed at the store, opened his tablet, and read again the Japanese study post he had saved at noon. In his memo, he wrote an action plan: “Starting tomorrow, use 15 minutes every morning and commuting time to memorize 5 kana.” During this time, several customers came in to check out the new items, and he was able to naturally introduce the design highlights and fabric features.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Closing the shop and heading out to exercise.
description: Considering Wednesday's evening rush hour, Lei Mingxuan decided to close the store half an hour early at 18:00. He changed into the quick-dry basketball jersey, shorts, and sneakers he had prepared, and told Xiao Lin to confirm the display details tomorrow morning. At 18:05 he rode his Niu electric scooter along Lujiazui Ring Road - Century Avenue - Zhangyang Road, about 15 minutes to the non-motorized vehicle shed at the east gate of Yuanshen Sports Center.
location: On the way from the Super Brand Mall store at 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Yuanshen Sports Center

name: Basketball Battle and Sports Socializing
description: When Lei Mingxuan arrived at the outdoor basketball court at Yuanshen Sports Center, his old basketball buddy Xie Fei had already reserved a half-court and brought two skilled young players. Five people played 3V3 with one rotating in, and played for a satisfying 90 minutes. Although Lei Mingxuan's shooting was a bit off, he actively fought for rebounds and delivered two beautiful blocks, earning cheers on the court. Drenched in sweat, a week's pressure seemed to evaporate with it.
location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Healthy meal experience and casual chat with friends
description: After playing ball, Xie Fei habitually wanted to grab some skewers at the barbecue stall nearby, but Lei Mingxuan decisively pulled him toward the newly opened Green Field Light Food outside the east gate of the Sports Center — a place he had come across on Dianping with high ratings. Lei Mingxuan ordered the signature quinoa, chicken breast, and avocado salad along with a fresh-squeezed grapefruit juice, while Xie Fei frowned and ordered a whole-wheat beef burger and vegetable soup. Sitting by the window, Xie Fei grumbled that Lei was eating too plainly. Lei Mingxuan smiled and showed the 79.6 kg weight record on his phone as proof that healthy eating worked. They agreed to take turns choosing where to eat after next week's game, but Xie Fei was not allowed to pick the barbecue stall.
location: Greenfield Light Food Restaurant, No. 1650 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Returning home to communicate with family
description: After saying goodbye to Xie Fei at the entrance of the Sports Center, Lei Mingxuan rode his electric bike home, arriving at 21:20. His parents were watching the news in the living room. He took a quick shower, changed into home clothes, and sat down in the living room to chat with them. He shared the favorable response to today's new-product teaser at the store, the private messages from people asking about it, and the fun time playing basketball and eating light meals with Xie Fei in the evening. When his mother heard he had started eating salads, she happily said she would put less sugar in the mung bean soup she was cooking that evening.
location: From Lvye Light Food, 1650 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to home at No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, including the route and the home living room.

name: Evening study and community interaction
description: Back in the bedroom, Lei Mingxuan brewed a cup of chrysanthemum tea, opened the video “Fun Memory Methods for the Japanese Syllabary” on his tablet, and followed along to read the written forms twice. Then he popped up in the “Pudong Three Musketeers” WeChat group and @Zhang Wei: “Wei Ge, this Saturday afternoon, same time, same place, World Square Billiards Hall — are you in? I haven’t played in a long time; my hands are itching.” Zhang Wei quickly replied, “No problem, same as usual.”
location: Bedroom at home, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pre-sleep preparation and relaxation
description: Lei Mingxuan turned off all his electronic devices and took a few deep breaths. Reflecting on the day, the store had operated smoothly, the new product warm-up had taken a key step, he had found two good places—Super Bowl and Green Field Light Food—his workout session with Brother Fei had gone ahead as scheduled, and he had taken the first step in learning Japanese. Feeling satisfied, he checked his alarm for the next day, turned off the lights on time at 23:30, and fell deeply asleep with the brilliant night view of both sides of the Huangpu River outside his window.
location: Bedroom at home, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Wake-up weigh-in and family healthy eating encouragement
description: After waking up naturally in the early morning, Lei Mingxuan used the smart scale in the bathroom to weigh himself. He recorded a body weight of 79.2 kg and a waistline of 96.5 cm, and showed these positive changes to his parents. His mother, Wang Xiuying, felt that eating chicken breast every day had become monotonous, so Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to suggest that they could enjoy braised pork in moderation every Sunday, but the total amount should be controlled. His father, Lei Jianguo, smiled and agreed, and the whole family was warm and harmonious.
location: Bathroom and dining room at home, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up, stretching, and in-store work arrangements
description: After finishing a simple breakfast (whole-wheat bread, boiled egg, skim milk), Lei Mingxuan went back to the room to wash up. Because the sky outside was gloomy and the phone forecast showed showers in the afternoon, he decisively canceled the morning run and instead did 15 minutes of full-body stretching on the balcony. Meanwhile, he notified Xiao Lin, the store clerk, via WeChat, asking her to organize the indigo-dyed shirt sample photos sent by supplier Zhou Tao after arriving at the store, to prepare for the afternoon verification work.
location: Bedroom and balcony at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the store
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into a linen shirt and cargo shorts, carried a folding umbrella, walked to Dongchang Road Metro Station, took Metro Line 2 two stops to Lujiazui Station, crossed the circular pedestrian bridge, and arrived at the store in Super Brand Mall at 9:10 on time.
location: On the way from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Handling store matters
description: After arriving at the store, checked yesterday's accounts with clerk Xiao Lin and, based on the photos provided by supplier Zhou Tao, confirmed that the newly arrived sample garments such as the indigo-dyed shirts in the warehouse were all correct. Then I inspected the renovation progress of the coffee experience area in the southwest corner of the store, discussed the socket locations and bar counter dimensions with the electrician, and compared the renderings to ensure visual consistency.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rode a shared bike home to prepare for making dumplings.
description: To make it home in time for making dumplings, Lei Mingxuan left the store early, rode a shared bike along Pudong Avenue for about 15 minutes back to his home in Shanggang Community, and arrived just in time to catch his mother Wang Xiuying seasoning the filling.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: The whole family pitched in to make low-fat dumplings.
description: Back home, his mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared the dumpling filling with minced chicken breast, shiitake mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms, and yellow wine, while his father Lei Jianguo was kneading dough and rolling wrappers on the dining table. Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to learn how to wrap dumplings. Though his technique was clumsy, the family chatted and laughed in the kitchen and dining room as they made three large plates of low-fat dumplings together.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Enjoy a low-fat dumpling lunch.
description: When the steaming hot dumplings were served, Lei Mingxuan tasted the ones he had made, stopped after eating exactly twelve as planned, and logged the calories in his phone app. His mother said the filling was a little dry; Lei Mingxuan humbly accepted the suggestion. His father praised the low-fat dumplings as refreshing, and the lunch atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Commuted back to the shop and used fragmented time to study Japanese.
description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan did not take a nap. He went out again and walked to Dongchang Road Metro Station, where he took Metro Line 2 back to Super Brand Mall. On the subway, he opened his Japanese-learning app and used the fragmented time to memorize five hiragana characters and practice pronunciation by repeating after the audio.
location: Inside a Line 2 metro car from Dongchang Road Station to Lujiazui Station, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon: mind the store, process orders, and study Japanese
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic in the store increased. Lei Mingxuan attended to customers trying on clothes while also handling online orders in spare moments, packing two T-shirts and a linen suit and filling out courier forms. During downtime, he took out his Japanese notebook behind the cash register, writing and silently reciting the kana he had memorized before, and tried to spell out product labels. The clerk Xiao Lin saw this and teased him that he was almost becoming a Japanese language expert.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home to pick up dumplings to prepare for sharing with neighbors.
description: As the time agreed with his neighbor to deliver dumplings approached, Lei Mingxuan left work early and rode a shared bike back to his home in Shanggang Community. He took the 20 dumplings he had set aside from the fridge and packed them into an insulated lunch box.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Neighbors sharing dumplings and warm exchanges
description: Lei Mingxuan carried an insulated lunchbox to Aunt Zhu Xiuying's apartment in the next building. Aunt Zhu thanked him and pulled him inside to chat, complaining about the noise from the elevator installation in the residential complex, and happily shared the good news that her grandson had scored over 600 on the college entrance exam and was planning to apply to Shanghai University. Lei Mingxuan congratulated her repeatedly, and as he left, Aunt Zhu gave him a box of homemade fermented rice balls, telling him he could have them as a late-night snack.
location: Zhu Xiuying's home, the unit next door to Shanggang Community at Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Roller skating along the riverside to relax after the rain.
description: The shower had stopped, the sky had cleared, and the air was fresh. After delivering the sweet fermented rice balls home, Lei Mingxuan put on his roller skates, walked five minutes to the riverside greenway near Dongchang Road Ferry, and skated along the path for 25 minutes. With the river breeze on his face, he felt refreshed and the day's fatigue melted away.
location: Riverside Greenway on Nanzhan Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Dongchang Road Ferry Section)

name: Return home to prepare dinner and spend time with family
description: After roller skating, Lei Mingxuan walked home slowly and took a shower. At dinner, he took out the fermented rice balls Aunt Zhu had given him to show his mother, who was moved by the old neighbor's kindness. The family ate the leftover steamed dumplings from lunch and a stir-fried seasonal vegetable dish, chatting about the next day's plans while watching the TV news.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening: prelude to personal study, socializing, and watching anime.
description: After cleaning up following the meal, Lei Mingxuan returned to his bedroom. He first reviewed the Japanese kana he had learned that day and previewed the new lesson, then watched a few videos on fashion design and coffee-making techniques. Meanwhile, in the friend group "Pudong Three Musketeers", Zhang Wei confirmed playing billiards on Saturday afternoon, and he replied "Got it." After that, he brewed a cup of jasmine tea and enjoyed it.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Deep Rest: Binge-Watching Anime and Soaking Feet
description: After his father went back to his room to rest, Lei Mingxuan moved to the living room, used the big TV to watch the healing anime Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, while using an electric foot bath to soak his feet, dimmed the lights, and enjoyed the quiet time alone.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up, reflection, and going to bed
description: After finishing foot soaking, Lei Mingxuan washed up carefully and applied a hydrating face mask. Lying in bed, he reviewed the day: weight down, harmonious family, friendly neighbors, smooth work, and felt warm inside. After setting the alarm for the next day, he put on his eye mask at 22:40 and fell asleep satisfied, listening to the cicadas chirping outside the window.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting up, morning preparations, and family breakfast.
description: The alarm went off at 7:15 a.m. After doing 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches in bed, I got up and weighed myself: 79.4 kg. A light drizzle was falling outside, so the morning run was cancelled. My mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared a low-fat breakfast: a whole-wheat chicken breast sandwich and skim milk. While eating, I mentioned that I wanted to learn Japanese. My mother smiled and encouraged me, but told me to stick with it and not give up halfway.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking to the subway station
description: Take an umbrella and head out, walking along the familiar Pudong Avenue. The streets are quiet on a weekend morning. After about 12 minutes on foot, arrive at Pudong South Road Station on Line 2.
location: From Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to South Pudong Road Metro Station (Line 2)

name: Subway commute and Japanese study kickoff
description: Entered Line 2 at Pudong South Road Station, and while waiting for the train downloaded the 'Duolingo' and 'Fifty Sounds Chart' apps from the app store. After boarding, I found a corner, opened the 'Fifty Sounds Chart' app, and read kana along with the audio. My tongue got a bit tangled, but I found it quite interesting.
location: Metro car from Pudong South Road Station (Line 2) in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Lujiazui Station (Line 2 / Line 14)

name: Pre-Work Preparation and Chance Encounter with Property Manager
description: After exiting from Exit 1 of Lujiazui Station, walked through the mall passage to the store in Super Brand Mall. On the way, bought an iced Americano at Starbucks. At the store entrance, met property manager Zheng Kai and asked him about the process for renovating the store's coffee area. Zheng Kai suggested first drawing a simple floor plan rendering and submitting it to the property office for filing. Then opened the door and entered the store.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Starbucks on the 1st Floor

name: Store morning business and Japanese study plan.
