description: After opening the store, turn on the lights and air conditioning, wipe the shelves and cash register with a damp cloth, and turn on the computer to check yesterday's sales data. While customers are few, neatly copy the five kana just learned in the notebook at the cash register, writing and reading them aloud. Open the phone calendar and set two study reminders: during the commute and before bed. When the occasional customer comes in, immediately switch roles and enthusiastically introduce the newly arrived basic T-shirts.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and study plan confirmation
description: After closing the store, went to the “Light Food Time” salad bar on B1 of Super Brand Mall and ordered a chicken breast avocado salad and a glass of lemonade. While eating, opened the phone and reviewed the pronunciation lesson on the app. Sent a WeChat voice message to Qin Lang, a hardcore sports buddy in Hangzhou, asking him to share quick tips for self-learning Japanese and recommend some good Japanese dramas.
location: Qingshiguang Salad Bar, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store duty, online coordination, and social arrangements
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic gradually increased. While attending to customers, I also handled online orders. On WeChat, I confirmed the shipping status of three trial-sale sample garments with supplier Zhou Tao (indigo-dyed shirt, geometric-pattern pants, embroidered short-sleeve shirt). They are expected to arrive at the Lujiazui Metro station storage lockers next Wednesday. In between, I sent my cousin Shen Jie a message asking her to come to the store next week to help with styling the new Bali-style embroidered tops.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Initial exploration of the coffee area renovation plan
description: Taking advantage of a time with few customers, he used a tape measure and his phone to measure the dimensions of an idle area of about 8 square meters in the southwest corner of the store, squatted on the ground to conceptualize a "pour-over coffee experience zone," and recorded keywords such as counter dimensions, outlet locations, and drain pipes in his phone memos. Afterwards, he went to the property management office on the second floor; Zheng Kai wasn't there, so he picked up the "Store Renovation/Remodeling Application Form" from the front desk clerk on duty and prepared to study it over the weekend.
location: The southwest corner of the shop and the property management office on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening store duty and receiving regular customers.
description: Continued minding the store. Regular customer Qian Duoduo came with a friend to try on clothes, and I enthusiastically gave styling advice. They ended up buying a solid-color shirt and a pair of detachable geometric two-way pants. At 18:00, I started sorting the day's receipts and cash, entered the sales figures into the system, and checked the display spots prepared for tomorrow's new arrivals.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closed the store, walked to the metro station.
description: Turned off the lights and locked up on time, then walked from Super Brand Mall to Lujiazui Metro Station, entered the station, and waited for the train.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Lujiazui Metro Station.

name: Metro commute and Japanese review.
description: Took Line 2 home. The carriage was quite crowded. I put on my earphones, opened the 'Gojūon' app, and reviewed the kana I'd learned that morning along with the audio. This time it felt much smoother.
location: Subway car from Lujiazui Station (Line 2) to Pudong South Road Station (Line 2) in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shopping on the way.
description: Got off at Exit 2 of South Pudong Road Metro Station, turned onto Laoshan Road to the familiar Ruhai Wholesale Store, and bought two bottles of unsweetened oolong tea to stock in the fridge.
location: Ruhai Wholesale Department, 36 Laoshan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Walk home
description: Carrying the freshly bought oolong tea, he strolled back to Shanggang Community, feeling especially relaxed about being home.
location: From Ruhai Wholesale Department, No. 36 Laoshan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanggang Community (Pudong Avenue, Lane 136, No. 2-51)

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: When I got home, my parents had already made dinner. My mother made stir-fried shrimp, tomato scrambled eggs, and cucumber salad. At the table, I excitedly shared that I had started learning Japanese that day and recited a few kana. My father smiled and said it's good to learn a foreign language, convenient for future trips to Japan; my mother reminded me not to overwork and to rest.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-meal rest and social interaction.
description: After dinner, he sprawled on the living room couch scrolling through Moments, liking friends' posts and replying to comments. Still brooding over the coffee area renovation, he pulled up the Japanese-style shop design images he had saved on his phone and took a look.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: In-depth exchange with billiards friend Qin Lang
description: Back in the bedroom, he called Qin Lang via WeChat voice. Qin Lang was especially surprised to hear that he had actually started learning Japanese, and enthusiastically shared his own experience of self-teaching Japanese to play games. He strongly recommended the textbook Standard Japanese and the healing Japanese drama We Are Made of Miracles, suggesting first watching the subtitled version to practice listening. The two agreed to meet at World Square on Saturday afternoon to play billiards, and also agreed to find an izakaya next time and order in Japanese.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Free relaxation: following and catching up on anime
description: After hanging up, he opened Bilibili and caught up on two episodes of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, which he had been following recently. The story about time and memory struck a chord, and he thought he might incorporate it into the little pieces he writes in his spare time.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening yoga stretching and pre-bed study
description: Feeling tightness in my shoulders and neck, I unrolled the yoga mat and followed the 'Yin Yoga' session on the workout app for a 20-minute stretch, focusing on releasing my shoulders, back, and thighs. I prepared hot water to soak my feet and, at the same time, took out my notebook to review the five sets of hiragana I had just learned by writing them from memory. Feeling satisfied, I took a photo and posted it to Moments as a check-in: 'Japanese study check-in Day 1, starting with five kana.'
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening washing up and bedtime preparation
description: Went to the bathroom to wash up and changed into pajamas. Set the alarm for 7:15 the next day, put down the bedside manga, dimmed the desk lamp, and quickly browsed tomorrow's simple plan. Then turned off the lamp and fell asleep in the stretched feeling after yoga and the satisfaction of learning new skills.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and Japanese study
description: The alarm went off right on time, and the sun was just right outside the window. Lying in bed, I first did 5 minutes of shoulder and neck stretches, and the lingering effects of last night's yoga made my body feel light. I weighed in at 79.3 kg; my weight was steadily dropping, which put me in a good mood. I opened the Duolingo app, spent 15 minutes reviewing the five kana I learned yesterday, and tried writing them out from memory in my phone memo. I was impressed by the opening line "adult, believe" from the Japanese drama Quartet that Qin Lang recommended yesterday, so I practiced it two more times today.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Healthy breakfast and getting ready to head out
description: After washing up, I came to the dining room. My mother had prepared breakfast: whole-wheat toast with a fried egg, a cup of unsweetened soy milk, and a small bowl of blueberries. I chatted with my mother about today's plan: "Mom, the store will be busy in the morning. In the afternoon I've arranged to play billiards at World Plaza with Qin Lang and some new friends, then go rollerblading along the riverfront with Song Jia. I'll definitely be back for dinner in the evening." Mother reminded me, "When you rollerblade, you must wear your protective gear, and don't hurt your knee like last time." I laughed and agreed. After finishing breakfast, I changed into a light linen-cotton shirt and sports shorts, put on my commuter bag, and wheeled my electric scooter out of the entryway.
location: Dining hall at Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Commuting and socializing on the way
description: Hopping on the e-moped, I rode along Pudong Avenue and turned onto Zhangyang Road, heading toward Lujiazui. While waiting at the red light at the intersection of Pudong South Road, I took a moment to send a voice message in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group: 'Guys, 3 p.m. at the usual spot in World Square, I'm bringing a new friend today!' Zhang Wei instantly replied with a 'Got it!' sticker. The breeze brushed my face on the way, and it felt like a perfect weekend.
location: Along the route from Pudong Avenue to Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Morning store duty and coffee area preparation.
description: After arriving at the store, I spent 20 minutes organizing the newly arrived indigo-dyed shirts and outdoor-style vests, adjusted the display on the west main wall, and featured a long linen trench coat as a focal item. At 9:45, the mall opened, and staff member Xiao Lin arrived. I took out the hand-drawn floor plan sketch of the coffee area I had made at home last night and shared my ideas for an island bar and display wall with Xiao Lin. Around 10:30, property manager Zheng Kai passed by on an inspection, so I quickly stopped him, showed him the sketch, and asked about water and electrical points and fire safety requirements. Zheng Kai gave some very practical advice, and we agreed that I would submit the final CAD drawing to him for filing next Monday. Afterward, I received two groups of customers and sold a pair of loose workwear shorts and a bucket hat.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and social preparation
description: As the store traffic gradually thinned out, I had Xiao Lin watch the front desk and went to the light-meal shop on B1 for lunch. I ordered a teriyaki chicken breast salad and an iced Americano. While eating, I opened WeChat and sent Qin Lang a message: "Brother Lang, 3 p.m., B1 of World Plaza, usual place! I'll bring my roller skates—after playing ball we can head to the riverfront." Qin Lang replied instantly: "OK, I'll bring a new friend. His name is Han Dong, my college roommate, here on a business trip from Beijing." I replied, "No problem, we can practice together." Then I scrolled through some Japanese street skateboarding videos on Bilibili for some sports inspiration.
location: WACASU Light Meal Store, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon store duty and shift handover
description: Back at the store, the afternoon customers started coming in one after another. A few young people came and were very interested in that mountain-style vest. I paired it for them with tapered workwear pants and a camping hat. They tried it on, were very satisfied, and bought it on the spot. After that, I used the gap to process two online orders and shipped them via the storage lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station. At 2:45 p.m., I handed over the afternoon reminders in detail to Xiao Lin, left him the manuscript for the coffee area, and confirmed the list of goods arriving tomorrow. Then I put on my roller-skating backpack and got ready to head out.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commute to the billiard hall
description: After exiting Super Brand Mall, I hopped on a shared bike and rode along Lujiazui West Road, turning onto Pudong South Road and heading south all the way. The whole trip was about 2.5 kilometers, and I arrived at the bottom of World Plaza in about ten minutes.
location: Along Lujiazui West Road to Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Billiards Session - Making Friends Through the Game
description: Met up with Qin Lang and his college roommate Han Dong at the entrance of the billiards hall. Qin Lang was his usual self, full of energy. Han Dong is an IT guy, wears glasses, and is quite talkative. We picked an American eight-ball table near the back. I was in good form and sank several long shots in a row; Qin Lang showed off some fancy positioning, and his escape shot was a showstopper. Han Dong played casually but was sharp-minded, and his defensive shots were well layered. We chatted while playing: Qin Lang shared the latest news from the Hangzhou internet circle, while I told them about learning Japanese and renovating the coffee area. The hour passed quickly, and I stopped on time because I still had a roller skating meetup in the evening.
location: Billiards hall, B1, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Changing clothes and commuting to the riverside.
description: After playing billiards, I quickly cycled back to Shanggang Community. Once home, I spent 10 minutes smoothly changing into roller skates and full protective gear (helmet, knee pads, elbow pads, wrist guards), and tied my sneakers and backpack onto the skate bag. Then I got on a shared bike again and headed straight for Binjiang Avenue.
location: Along the route from Shanggang Residential Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Binjiang Avenue.

name: Chasing the Wind Roller Skating Social and Light Dinner
description: At the gathering point on the Expo section of the riverfront, I spotted Song Jia at once. She was wearing a baseball cap, and her hair was dyed light flaxen, especially eye-catching in the sunset. After a quick warm-up, we skated one behind the other along the red cycling path toward Lujiazui. The river breeze brushed our faces, the sun hung low on the skyline, and the view was superb. We stopped from time to time to snap photos of the international-style buildings in the sunset with our phones. Song Jia excitedly told me about a retro ball she had attended a few days earlier—she had dyed her hair to match the makeup and styling for that event. I told her in detail why I had started learning Japanese and my idea of turning the café area in my shop into a community gathering space. When we skated to “CHIRPSBOWL,” the light-fare restaurant under the Lujiazui pedestrian bridge, we were both hungry. As planned, we went in and ordered the set for two that Song Jia recommended: avocado chicken wraps, kale salad, and two glasses of green grape sparkling water. We ate and chatted, and she invited me to go check out the Shanghai Roller Skating League with her next month. I happily agreed.
location: Binjiang Avenue, from the Expo section to the Lujiazui section, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, and the CHIRPSBowl light meal shop

name: Return trip and relaxation
description: After dinner, I said goodbye to Song Jia. I slowly rode a shared bike home along the riverside, stopping on the way at FamilyMart to buy a bottle of iced unsweetened oolong tea. Back home, I first put my roller skates and protective gear out on the balcony to air, then took a 15-minute hot shower and changed into loose loungewear, feeling the day's fatigue wash away.
location: Along Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Shanggang Community and at home

name: Family leisure and conversation
description: I went into the living room, where my parents were sitting on the sofa watching CCTV news. I sat down with them and shared the river views and new friends I had met while roller-skating this afternoon. Father was very concerned about the approval progress of the 'coffee area renovation'. I showed him the photos of the drafts on my phone and told him that Zheng Kai had given a lot of suggestions and that the drawings would be submitted next week. Mother said with a smile, 'Your friend knows how to have fun, and so do you. Young people should be like this. But when are you going to bring a girl home so we can meet her?' I laughed and changed the subject, and the family was happy and harmonious.
location: Living room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Health planning and mother's urging to get married
description: Back in the study, I opened the “Healthy Diet Tracking Sheet” on my computer. I spent 15 minutes filling in the detailed daily diet data for the week and calculated the weekly averages: average daily protein intake rose from 60 g last week to 95 g, fat dropped by 15 g, and carbohydrates were mainly whole grains—the structure had clearly improved. Satisfied, I saved it and began making a fat-loss bento menu for Monday through Wednesday, planning to swap the lunch carbs from mixed-grain rice to pumpkin and corn, and add pan-seared chicken breast for extra protein. Just then, my mother came in carrying a glass of warm water. She looked at my spreadsheet and suddenly sighed and said, “You take such good care of yourself—when are you going to take care of and bring home a girl?” I laughed and scratched my head, changing the subject with a “Mom, fate hasn’t arrived yet, why rush?” But I felt a familiar warmth inside.
location: Study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening entertainment and recharging
description: Settle down to relax. I lay on the sofa, opened Bilibili, and first watched two episodes of the new anime *Frieren: Beyond Journey's End*; the story is really getting into its stride. Then I scrolled through Xiaohongshu and saw that my friend Gao Yuan in Hainan had posted several new island photos, so I liked them and commented, "This is so beautiful!". After that, I opened the WeChat group "Pudong Three Musketeers" and posted a few sunset photos I'd taken by the riverside this afternoon, tagging @Zhang Wei and @Qin Lang: "Today's sunset was totally worth it! After playing billiards, I did another loop—easy and pleasant." Zhang Wei instantly replied with a thumbs-up emoji, and Qin Lang sent back a photo of himself eating crayfish in Hangzhou. The group got lively again.
location: Study and living room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: End-of-day foot soaking and bedtime preparation
description: Bedtime ritual. I filled a basin with hot water, added three drops of lavender essential oil, and soaked my feet. While soaking my feet, I finished today's overdue Japanese tasks on Duolingo, checked in for Day 2, and took a screenshot to post on WeChat Moments: “Day 2, the kana are getting smoother! Happy weekend!” After soaking, I did a few minutes of simple stretching, then put tomorrow's clothes by the bed. I set the phone alarm (a bedtime alarm at 23:20), turned off the light, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, and exercise in the neighborhood
description: The phone alarm woke him on time. He lingered in bed scrolling through Qin Lang's roller skating video in the WeChat group. After hearing his mother preparing breakfast, he got up, washed up, put on lounge shorts and a T-shirt, and mentioned to his mother that he wouldn't be home for lunch. He drank warm water, ate a boiled egg, and had whole-wheat toast. After breakfast, he changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and athletic shorts, put on earphones, went downstairs, and took a slow 15-minute walk around the neighborhood, listening to Japanese kana listening material and repeating the sounds aloud, considering whether to tackle katakana. It was a muggy August morning in Shanghai; the sky was overcast, and he figured it might rain in the afternoon.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Japanese katakana study
description: After the walk, I took a shower, changed into a dry T-shirt, and sat at my desk with a cup of instant black coffee, opening the Japanese learning app on my tablet. I reviewed yesterday's katakana from row to row for 20 minutes, then learned new content from row to row, using the stylus to trace and memorize. When I got tired of studying, I scrolled through Moments and saw Han Dong's stock market screenshot and gave it a like.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Research on Japanese coffee culture and buying equipment online.
description: Got sleepy studying Japanese, leaned back onto the sofa and opened Bilibili, and was drawn to the recommended video 'Exploring Japanese Kissaten'. I watched traditional flannel filter coffee brewing and Showa-era decor, then a documentary on handcrafted Kalita copper kettles and a Hario V60 brewing comparison video. Fascinated by the craftsmanship, I opened Taobao and ordered a Tsuki Usagi stainless steel pour-over kettle (retro red) and a Hario V60 glass server set, spending about 800 yuan, to upgrade the shop's experience area. I also saved several coffee brewing tutorial videos, planning to practice next week.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Family lunch and leaving for the commute.
description: His mother made a lunch of tomato scrambled eggs and stir-fried amaranth. The two ate together, and he helped clear the table. It was hot and muggy, so he changed into a navy linen shirt and khaki casual pants, slung on a canvas tote bag with a power bank, keys, and a notebook in it, and, after checking the sky, grabbed a folding umbrella. He walked out to the entrance of the residential complex, bought an iced Americano with less ice using his own cup at the Manner Coffee on the corner, and walked for 15 minutes to Super Brand Mall while sipping it.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store work and merchandise receiving and inspection
description: He arrived at the store, greeted Xiao Lin, the morning-shift staff member, checked the store's cleanliness and displays, and re-hung the clothes that had been rummaged through. In the warehouse, he did an inventory count and found the white T-shirts in size M were out of stock, so he sent a voice message to supplier Fang Jie to restock. At the register, he tracked the logistics; Zhou Tao in Hangzhou had four packages expected to arrive at 2 p.m. At 2:30, the delivery came, and he and Xiao Lin moved the boxes into the warehouse and opened them. Comparing with the sample photos, he found that most of the Vietnam-made two-way trousers had color differences at the hems and waistbands—the color was lighter with a grayish haze—and two of the Thai shirts had uneven stitching at the collars. His heart sank. He took high-resolution photos and videos, sent them to Zhou Tao, and called to discuss. Zhou Tao explained that it was due to batch differences in the hand-dyed natural dye vats and offered a discount or return. After weighing the options, he decided to accept the goods and asked Xiao Lin to hang the problem clothes and label the issues.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handmade color swatch cards and transparency strategy
description: Sitting at the cash register, he took out watercolor paints and white card stock, mixed standard colors and actual colors against the color swatches on the computer, and wrote down color names such as 'Deep Indigo (sample color)' and 'Grass-Gray Blue (actual color),' adding the process note 'natural dye, slight variation between batches.' He made about 20 small cards, ready to clip onto the tags of clothes with color differences. He asked Xiao Lin to post photos and text on Moments to sincerely explain the craft reasons, invite regular customers to come and see the clothes in the store, and win trust through a transparent approach.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store closing and rainy commute.
description: After finishing the color cards, he was tired and leaned back in a chair to rest. He had Xiaolin watch the store and left work early. As he walked out of the mall, it was drizzling. He opened his umbrella and walked to the World Plaza billiards hall. On the way, he passed a FamilyMart and went in to buy a sports drink and a tuna rice ball, eating while walking to take the edge off his hunger. The walk took about 30 minutes.
location: FamilyMart convenience store near South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Billiards warm-up and opening
description: Arrived at World Square Billiard Hall. Han Dong wasn't here yet, so I picked a table at the back and started warming up with American eight-ball. After a few shots, my aim was okay, but my mind kept drifting to the afternoon's shirt problem. Ten minutes later Han Dong arrived, we fist-bumped, chatted briefly about recent stocks, and officially started the game. On the break, I sank nothing and the cue ball was poorly positioned — I was obviously distracted.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening billiards and pouring out one's worries.
description: My performance was terrible all evening; in the second game, I drew the cue ball too far with a low shot and sent it into the bottom pocket. Han Dong offered a cigarette but I didn't take it; he asked why I was so distracted. I confided that in the afternoon I had discovered a color difference in the clothes, decided to make a color card, and worried it would affect my reputation. Han Dong comforted me, saying this was honest and would actually make customers feel reliable—a living signboard. After feeling relieved, my form recovered. We traded shots and played nine games total, finally winning narrowly 5:4.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midnight snack and chatting at a food stall
description: After playing, the two of them went to Xiao Song's BBQ stall downstairs from the billiard hall. Han Dong treated, and they ordered grilled lamb skewers, grilled eggplant, edamame, and two bottles of ice-cold beer. Drinking beer lifted his mood a lot. They talked about learning Japanese recently and wanting to visit a Japanese kissaten someday. They ate and chatted until the meal broke up around 9:30 PM. He called a ride-hailing car to go home. On the way, the rain stopped, and the streetlights reflected on the wet road.
location: Xiao Song BBQ food stall, near No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home and interacting with family
description: When he got home, his father had already gone to bed, and his mother was watching TV in the living room, waiting for him. He changed his shoes quietly, responded to his mother's question about whether he had eaten well, and was told to drink less. He walked over, hugged his mother, said he got it, and then washed up.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Studying Japanese before bed and going to sleep
description: After washing up, I lay in bed and reviewed katakana with a mobile app, then watched fifteen minutes of the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End on Bilibili as a reward. While mentally planning how to display the clothes with color differences tomorrow, drowsiness hit. I set the alarm for 8 a.m. the next day, turned off the light, and fell into a deep sleep with a small sense of achievement after the twists and turns.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Get up, wash up, and change clothes.
description: Woken by the sound of rain outside the window, I lingered in bed for a bit before getting up. I washed up and deliberately changed into the indigo-dyed polo shirt from my own store, fixed my hair in the mirror, and got ready for the new day.
location: Bedroom and washroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and store communication
description: Had breakfast with his parents. His mother cooked small wontons and pan-fried buns. During the meal, he mentioned to his parents the color difference issue with supplier Zhou Tao's batch of goods. His father reminded him that business should be conducted with honesty and integrity, which made Lei Mingxuan even more determined.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organized and checked the color swatches.
description: At the desk in the bedroom, rearranged the twenty color cards made last night by item number, checked each edge for creases or damage, and re-checked them against the color-difference areas of the corresponding trousers from memory, ensuring the accuracy of the in-store display.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking commute to the store
description: Carried a commuter bag with color swatches and an umbrella, left home holding the umbrella, walked across Pudong Avenue and Lujiazui Ring Road, and arrived at Super Brand Mall in about 27 minutes, entering the mall through the employee entrance.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai: walk from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Pre-opening preparations and display color swatches
description: After arriving at the store, he turned on the lights, opened the cash register, and wiped the shelves with a dry cloth. One by one, he clipped the finished color cards with small wooden clamps to the inside waistbands of the corresponding Vietnamese printed pants. Under the always-on light box, he took high-definition comparison photos of each pair with its color card, one full view and one close-up, ensuring the color differences were clear at a glance.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and handling color-difference inquiries
description: After opening at ten, three young office workers came into the store and questioned the color of the Vietnamese printed pants. Lei Mingxuan led them to the lightbox, patiently showed color swatches, and explained the characteristics of the plant-dye process, explaining the color difference as a vintage feel. The short-haired woman was persuaded and bought a pair, while the other two recorded a video praising the owner's honesty.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and foot traffic observation
description: Ask the staff of the neighboring store to keep an eye on the store, then go to the Bu'erjun Leshan Qiaojiao Beef restaurant on B1 and order a signature Qiaojiao beef. While eating, observe the mall foot traffic and notice that young people are gathering at the adjacent sporty trend-brand store, which inspires the idea of hosting an interactive event. After the meal, buy a cup of lemon tea from the milk tea shop and bring it back to the store.
location: Bu'erjun Leshan Cuisine Qiaojiao Beef Restaurant, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and replying to customer messages
description: Back at the store, he took a short rest behind the cash register, replied to inquiries from several regular customers on his phone, and posted the comparison photos taken in the morning to WeChat Moments with a message thanking them for their trust.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Receiving regular customer Qian Duoduo
description: Regular customer Qian Duoduo came to the store with a new hairstyle and showed great interest in the new products. After Lei Mingxuan told her about the morning's color difference incident, she deliberately picked out a pair of pants with obvious color difference, joking that they were one of a kind and she wasn't afraid of wearing the same outfit. At checkout, she also chatted about fashion bloggers.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Received regular customer Feng Xiaoyu
description: After Qian Duoduo left, regular customer Feng Xiaoyu unexpectedly dropped by; she was on a business trip to Shanghai and came to visit. Lei Mingxuan poured her water, introduced the newly arrived indigo-dyed shirt and mentioned the color card incident. After trying it on, she bought the indigo-dyed shirt and paired it with her linen suit trousers. As she left, she wished him good business.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Attend the shop in the afternoon and handle walk-in customers
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic was steady, with a few walk-in customers entering the store. Lei Mingxuan tidied the clothes that had been rummaged through while keeping an eye on the door. Several young men were interested in the cargo-style pants, and he gave styling suggestions based on their body types. Although no sale was made, he left a good impression.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-closing preparations and community operations
description: Organized the day's sales receipts and put the displayed clothes back in place. Posted an official announcement in the store's WeChat group, explaining that the new hand-dyed products may have color differences and attaching color swatch comparison charts and customer feedback screenshots. The group responded enthusiastically, with someone asking whether they were limited editions.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Close the store and walk home
description: Turned off the store lights and rolled down the shutter door, then walked out through the mall's main entrance. The air was fresh after the rain in the evening. Lei Mingxuan walked home, stopping at the convenience store near the residential community to buy a bottle of iced oolong tea, while organizing his thoughts for the evening communication with the supplier.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai, walking from Super Brand Mall at 168 Lujiazui West Road to Shanggang Community at Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: When he arrived home, the meal was already prepared. Lei Mingxuan gave his parents a detailed account of the day's business. His mother was very happy when he mentioned the enthusiastic support from Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu, and his father rarely praised him for being steady in handling matters. The family spent a pleasant time together.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening anime leisure.
description: After helping his mother clear the table, he curled up on the living room sofa, opened his laptop, and watched two episodes of the currently airing new anime Jujutsu Kaisen. Immersed in the passionate storyline, he temporarily forgot the trivialities of business and completely relaxed.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Call the supplier to discuss quality inspection.
description: In the bedroom, closed the door and called supplier Zhou Tao. First thanked him for the timely delivery, then tactfully suggested adding a manual color-calibration process in the future, and agreed on a color-difference tolerance standard acceptable to both parties. Zhou Tao readily agreed and proactively offered 5% of this payment as compensation for losses. After nearly an hour of communication, the problem was completely resolved.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Collecting designer toy news and design inspiration
description: In a great mood, I sat at my desk and browsed Pop Mart's new product updates on my phone, then watched display designs of foreign clothing stores on Behance and saved several inspiring images to build up material for the store's future visual creativity.
location: At the desk in the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washed up and went to bed
description: In the bathroom, I washed up carefully, applied toner, and looked back on the day, feeling fulfilled and meaningful. Back in the bedroom, I set the alarm for 7:20 tomorrow morning and fell asleep peacefully as the sound of rain gradually picked up outside the window.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, home bathroom and bedroom

name: Morning strength training
description: At 6 a.m., his phone alarm rang on time, and Lei Mingxuan turned over and got up briskly. He stepped barefoot on the bedroom floor, rolled out the yoga mat, and started the day's simplified strength training: 3 sets of 12 squats, 3 sets of 10 modified push-ups, and 3 sets of 40-second planks. Because he hadn't exercised systematically for a long time, by the third set of planks his arms and core were trembling uncontrollably, and beads of sweat dripped off his chin. He stood up panting and silently resolved to stick to this routine every Tuesday and Thursday morning and not let it lapse again.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning Washing and Dressing
description: After training, Lei Mingxuan went into the bathroom and took a cold shower to fully wake himself up. He studied his arms carefully in the mirror—the muscles were a bit sore, but the definition seemed more visible. After drying off, he changed into the outfit he had specially chosen today: a black pure-cotton T-shirt his own store often carried, paired with dark gray cargo shorts. Since he wasn't meeting suppliers today, it was both comfortable and sharp.
location: Bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Entering the dining room, his mother Wang Xiuying had already set out soy milk and fried dough sticks, and today she had specially added a plate of her signature shrimp scrambled eggs—golden egg wrapping tender pink shrimp, mouthwatering. His father Lei Jianguo was already seated at the table, wearing reading glasses and scrolling through news on his phone. Lei Mingxuan ate breakfast heartily while telling his parents about the progress he had made yesterday in resolving the color difference problem: the quality control files had been set up, and the supplier had agreed to compensation. His father looked up at him and muttered, “Handled it like a businessman.” Lei Mingxuan chuckled, knowing it was his father's approval. His mother, meanwhile, kept nagging him to take care of his health and not get too tired.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the store
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan carefully checked his backpack: phone, power bank, notebook, and keys, making sure nothing was missing. At 7:55 he left the house, walked about five minutes to the Zhangyang Road–Laoshan Road bus stop, and took Bus 81 heading to Lujiazui. After two stops he got off and walked another three minutes; at 8:15 he was standing at the employee entrance of Super Brand Mall.
location: Starting from Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, taking Bus 81 at the Zhangyang Road-Laoshan Road bus stop, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store opening preparation and planning
description: After swiping his employee card to enter the mall, Lei Mingxuan quickly climbed the fire stairs to the second floor and arrived at his own store, No. A-208. He turned on all the lights, set the air conditioning to a comfortable 24°C, started the cashier computer, and casually made a cup of Nescafé from instant coffee. While waiting for the computer to boot, he picked up a cloth and carefully wiped down the shelves and the checkout counter. Out of the corner of his eye, he noticed the 20 color swatches that had been clipped to his pants yesterday, and felt even more confident about the standardization work he was about to advance today.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Establish standardized color-difference sampling inspection files
description: In the morning, the store had few customers, making it a good time for desk work. Lei Mingxuan created a new Excel document and solemnly named it External Brand Quality Control SOP_V1.0. He systematically divided color difference issues into three levels: Level 1, a color difference visible to the naked eye, was subject to buyback compensation; Level 2, a slight difference, was sold normally with an explanation card; Level 3, a severe color difference, was returned or exchanged directly. He then entered the entire case of the two-way pants from Vietnam, from the records and photos to the handling result, into the file, and spent more than an hour typing in standard scripts for responding to customer objections word by word. Shortly before 11:00, he sent the completed file to store clerk Xiao Lin and supplier Zhou Tao via WeChat. Before long, Xiao Lin replied: Boss, you rock! A few minutes later, Zhou Tao replied: Professional, I've learned something. Looking at these messages, Lei Mingxuan felt very pleased.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Receiving pre-noon customers and presenting color swatches
description: Just as he finished sending the file, two young female office workers in professional skirt suits walked into the store, apparently coming over from nearby office buildings to browse. They were immediately attracted by the off-white wide-leg pants on the mannequin at the entrance. While checking the hang tag, one of them pointed to the color card he had specially sewn onto the pants and asked, "It seems like all your clothes have this?" Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to lead them to the cash register counter, took out the 20 physical color cards he had carefully made the day before yesterday, and explained, "Yes, these are color cards I made with the brand supplier. Since we work with natural fabrics, there can be a tiny bit of natural variation in dyeing between batches. With these cards, you can see the actual colors directly and avoid feeling disappointed after buying." The young women listened and nodded repeatedly. The one who asked ended up choosing that pair of wide-leg pants and proactively added the store's WeChat, saying she would bring her colleagues next time.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and online promotion interaction
description: After seeing off two customers, Lei Mingxuan opened Meituan and ordered takeout of Nanxiang steamed soup dumplings. While waiting for the delivery, he opened Xiaohongshu and found new activity on the science post he had published yesterday, 'Handcrafted Is Truly Different: How to Appreciate Natural Color Variations in Clothing.' Scrolling down, he saw that Lin Jing, a designer toy collector from Shenzhen, had reposted his article in a collecting group with the caption, 'This attitude is better than many big brands.' The comments section immediately became lively, with people constantly asking about the store's information. Lei Mingxuan hurriedly replied to each one, privately messaging the store's WeChat ID and address to interested netizens. When the delivery arrived, he ate the soup dumplings while refreshing the backend, and found that the account had gained more than twenty followers and received three private messages asking for the address. This wave of publicity turned out to be quite effective.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon: minding the store and making sales.
description: In the afternoon, as the mall crowd gradually thinned, Lei Mingxuan made himself a cup of drip bag coffee and opened his phone album to sort through the new product photos he planned to post on Moments. He had only picked out a few when a trendy young couple walked into the store. The guy asked as soon as he entered, “Do you have that color chart that shows what color clothes turn after they dry?” It seemed they had been drawn in by that note again. Lei Mingxuan nodded enthusiastically, picked up the hand-dyed indigo shirt they were interested in, and while showing the color chart, explained in more everyday language how the temperature and humidity of the plant dye vat affect the final color. The girl's eyes lit up when she heard that, and she turned to the guy and said, “This is the one! So interesting.” In the end, the couple bought two shirts directly, saying one was a gift for a friend. Closing this unexpected sale put Lei Mingxuan in a great mood.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Posting on Moments and replying to online inquiries
description: Just after receiving this interesting couple, Lei Mingxuan struck while the iron was hot. He lightly edited photos of the shirt details the woman bought, the newly made color swatch display, and the couple's backs as they listened attentively to his explanation, arranged them into a nine-grid post, and shared it on Moments with the caption: "Today a pair of trendy people with real taste came to the shop. The more we talked, the more we clicked. The charm of handcrafted plant dyeing—those who get it, just get it." Within less than ten minutes, likes and comments poured in. A regular customer also asked via WeChat about when the autumn collection would drop. He replied to each one, and also answered several private messages from people who added him via Xiaohongshu, while teasing the upcoming new arrivals.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Making plans with billiards friends and preparing to close up
description: Having handled the shop matters efficiently, Lei Mingxuan felt more and more relaxed. Remembering that his basketball buddy Han Dong had invited him on WeChat yesterday, he proactively sent a message: "Dongzi, the usual place tonight? 7 o'clock? My treat, to celebrate yesterday's crisis being perfectly resolved!" Han Dong replied instantly: "Great! I'm bored to death, see you at 7!" With the plan settled, he began closing up the shop early: tidying the fitting room, putting the scattered hangers back in place, and finally turning off the computer and background music, ready to close exactly at 6.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Coffee shop break and market observation
description: With half an hour left before the actual closing time, Lei Mingxuan strolled over to Manner Coffee on the first floor of Super Brand Mall, ordered an iced latte, and sat down by the window. He opened his phone's memo and refined a few details in the SOP document from the morning, then watched the mall's foot traffic while chewing on his straw: Tuesday wasn't too crowded, but the dining area on the fifth floor seemed to have some event and was noticeably livelier. After finishing the last sip of coffee, he felt his whole body relax.
location: Manner Coffee, 1st Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closed the store and left for the billiards hall.
description: At 5:00, he went back for one last check: the air conditioner was off, the lights were out, and the rolling shutter door was locked. After confirming everything was in order, he sent his mother a WeChat message: “Mom, I’m eating out with Dongzi tonight, don’t wait for me for dinner.” Then he went out the back door of the mall, scanned a shared bike, and rode north along South Pudong Road. About 15 minutes later, at 5:45, he arrived downstairs at World Square. It was still light.
location: Starting from Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, ride a shared bicycle along Pudong South Road to World Plaza, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Waiting and Warming Up at the Billiard Hall
description: At World Plaza Billiard Hall, Lei Mingxuan first went to the front desk to book a table, deliberately choosing a spot near the corner with good lighting and few distractions. Then he picked up the house cue, chalked it, and warmed up by practicing straight shots. After potting five target balls in a row, he felt quite good and gained more confidence for the upcoming match.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Billiards duel with Han Dong.
description: At 6:30, Han Dong strolled in, still wearing the blue work uniform from the auto repair shop. As soon as he entered, he shouted, "So that thing from last night is settled? Tell me all about it!" Lei Mingxuan smiled and briefly recounted setting up the file, Zhou Tao's reply, and today's viral effect. After hearing it, Han Dong slapped him on the shoulder and said, "Right, this calls for a celebration!" The two played five straight games of American 8-ball. Whether because Lei Mingxuan was in a particularly good mood or Han Dong was distracted, Lei Mingxuan played exceptionally well and ended up winning 4:1. After the game, the two exchanged their usual banter, and Han Dong kept shouting that he had to win it back next time.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Noodle shop dinner and casual chat
description: After nearly two hours of playing, both of their stomachs began to rumble treacherously. Han Dong, the local expert, took him straight to his usual spot, Haling Fresh Wok-Fried Shanghainese Noodles. Lei Mingxuan ordered a bowl of scallion oil noodles with a fried egg and a serving of vegetarian chicken, and Han Dong ordered the same. After the steaming noodles went down, the two chatted over the side dishes: Han Dong complained about a bizarre customer who had driven a supercar to get a tire changed, and Lei Mingxuan shared the story of the couple of buyers from the afternoon. As they talked, the hour hand unknowingly moved to nine o'clock.
location: Haling Freshly Stir-Fried Shanghai-Style Noodles (Laoshan Road Branch), No. 700 Laoshan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bought daily necessities on the way home
description: At the intersection, Lei Mingxuan parted with Han Dong and strolled home alone. Halfway there, he suddenly remembered that the body wash at home was almost used up. As it happened, he passed the Yan Qin Grocery Store at the alley entrance of the residential compound, so he turned in. The proprietress, Sister Yan Qin, was watching a TV drama; he greeted her, took a bottle of Dove body wash from the shelf, and chatted casually about the weather over the past couple of days while paying. After buying it, he walked for another three minutes and arrived home at 9:15.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store near Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening wash-up and family chat
description: When he pushed open the door, his parents still hadn't gone to bed — his mother was sitting on the living room sofa watching TV while waiting for him, and his father was in the room listening to the radio and flipping through the newspaper. Lei Mingxuan greeted his mother and briefly told her about having dinner with Han Dong that evening. Then he went back to his room, grabbed the shower gel he had just bought, and went into the bathroom for a comfortable hot shower. Only after washing away the sweat did a true sense of relaxation wash over him from all directions.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Catching up on anime and relaxing.
description: After changing into pajamas, Lei Mingxuan flopped heavily onto the bed, opened his iPad, and connected to the bedroom Wi-Fi. In the mood for something light, he clicked on the latest episode of Delicious in Dungeon, and watched with great interest as Laios's party figured out how to cook the giant slime. When the episode ended, he was relaxed from head to toe.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Browsing and summary before sleep
description: He turned off the iPad, then picked up his phone and scrolled through Bilibili for a while. He casually saved a few popular-science videos explaining color differences, planning to study them carefully later. Thinking back on the day—he had gained more than twenty followers online, closed two orders in the store, and smoothly set up the color-difference archive... he felt a strong sense of accomplishment. At 11:25 p.m., he put down his phone, turned off the bedside lamp, closed his eyes, and drifted slowly into sleep with that comfortable, grounded feeling.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and family breakfast
description: Woken up by his mother, he got up and washed up, and found his father already watching the morning news. Breakfast was hot wontons and a fried egg prepared by his mother. After the meal, he did some simple stretching in the living room, put the printed copy of the "Three-Level Color Difference File" organized last night into his bag, and interacted with the orange tabby cat Afu, who had jumped onto the sofa.
location: Room 102, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting and social interaction.
description: Changed into an indigo-dyed shirt and walked to the shop; the weather was muggy. On the way, he sent a WeChat voice message to sports buddy Han Dong about playing billiards the next day, and replied to friend Xie Fei's gym photo message, teasing him about his muscles.
location: Along the route from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Morning store work: preparation and operations.
description: Arrived at the store earlier than store clerk Xiao Lin and turned on the equipment. Went over the three-level color difference file and response scripts with Xiao Lin in the rest area, emphasizing guiding customers to appreciate the characteristic of unpredictability in hand dyeing. After opening, mainly promoted the newly arrived indigo-dyed shirts, explained the beauty of plant-dye color variations to a couple who came specifically because of the reputation, and closed the sale. During this time, adjusted the mannequin display at the store entrance and took photos of new products for later use.
location: Xiafei Collection, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and market observation.
description: Walked to Menya Musashi on B1 of the IFC Mall and enjoyed the signature tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While waiting and eating, he observed the outfits of the young office workers around him, thinking about what styles to stock for autumn and winter. During that time, he checked and replied to comments on an informational post about indigo dyeing care.
location: Menya Musashi, B1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon return trip and a short rest.
description: After dinner, strolled back to the store. On the way, I bought iced oolong tea at the convenience store in Jin Mao Tower. Back in the store's rest area, I organized my thoughts to prepare for the call with the supplier.
location: Convenience store at Jin Mao Tower, Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and on the way back to Super Brand Mall

name: Key business call: deepening cooperation with supplier Zhou Tao
description: In the store's rest area, he called supplier Zhou Tao, first thanking him for his support during the color difference incident, then asking in a consultative tone about source-level color difference control for handmade products. Zhou Tao sighed about the current state of old dyeing workshops in Wenzhou, and Lei Mingxuan then shared the story of his mother coming to Shanghai alone from Nantong and the family's current healthy living atmosphere, earning Zhou Tao's admiration. In the end, Zhou Tao promised to add spot checks to every batch and provide online preview rights for new products twice a season, and the two agreed to visit Hangzhou next week.
location: Rest area of the 'Xiafei Ji' store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon store operations and social media updates
description: Feeling happy after the call, he posted detail shots of the new products on WeChat Moments and in customer groups, with a caption mentioning his reflections on chatting about craftsmanship with an old master. In the afternoon, he received several waves of customers, and Xiao Lin successfully closed a sale on her own using the new sales script and received encouragement. He, for his part, edited the photos he had taken that morning and saved them to the store's asset library.
location: Xiafei Collection, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the shop and buying ingredients.
description: Closed the shop half an hour early, briefed Xiao Lin on the next day's tasks, then took a shared bike to Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road. He found a familiar vendor, Lao Zhang, selected fresh shepherd's purse and high-quality pork front leg meat, and Lao Zhang kindly gave him a bunch of spring onions.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling home
description: Humming a tune, he rode his bike home, with groceries hanging from the handlebars, weaving through traffic and enjoying the early evening.
location: From Dongchang Road to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Helped with food preparation and shared the good news.
description: Upon entering, he handed the ingredients to his mother, who happily tied on an apron and started preparing the food. After making tea for his father, he helped trim scallions on the side, and while doing so casually told his parents about the progress he had made in getting closer with the supplier that day.
location: Room 102, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: The family enjoyed the shepherd's purse wontons made by his mother; they were full of umami. During the meal, he talked with his father about the shop business and stable cooperative relationships. His mother reminded him to spend more time with his parents on weekends, and he readily agreed.
location: Room 102, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation and nurturing creative inspiration
description: After taking the initiative to do the dishes, he watched TV with his parents. Around 9 p.m., he went back to his room to watch two episodes of the anime "Delicious in Dungeon". Afterward, he took out his phone's memo app and quickly jotted down the "Wenzhou old dye workshop" and "mother drifting south" fragments from the phone call. The opening scene of the novel "An Afternoon in Xiafei Lane" gradually took shape.
location: Living room and bedroom, Room 102, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxing shower and creative preparation
description: Took a cold shower to wash away the day's stuffy heat, then made a cup of jasmine tea, sat down at the desk, and prepared for the evening's creative work.
location: Bathroom and desk at Room 102, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Writing the novel “An Afternoon in Xiafei Lane”.
description: Opened the computer and created a new document, diving into writing. Channeling into the text his mother's resilience in coming to Shanghai from Nantong and neighbor Aunt Zhu's longtang stories, the writing flowed smoothly, and before I knew it nearly two thousand words were done. The orange tabby Afu jumped onto the keyboard and broke my train of thought, and only then did I realize it was past midnight. I saved the file, turned off the computer, and went to bed contentedly.
location: At the desk in Room 102, No. 2, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Morning measurements and weight fluctuation analysis
description: After being woken by the 6:30 alarm, he took routine body measurements in the bathroom. Weight was 79.2 kg, body fat percentage was 26.1%, and waist circumference was 95 cm. He found that his weight was the same as last week but his waist had decreased by 1 cm. He speculated that the lack of weight loss was due to edema from staying up late, so he recorded the data in a memo and noted that he would strictly control water intake and observe tomorrow's changes.
location: Home bathroom at No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: After washing up, I had breakfast with my parents. On the table were plain congee, pickled vegetables, boiled eggs, and salted duck eggs. My father mentioned the new Shandong jianbing stall at the entrance of the residential community and suggested trying it another day; my mother reminded me not to stay up late and to eat more eggs. The atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Residential Quarter, 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Cycling commute to the store
description: After going out, he scanned a shared bike and rode along Pudong Avenue toward Lujiazui, enjoying the morning light and the shade of plane trees on the way, and stopped by Bingobox to buy unsweetened oolong tea. He arrived at Super Brand Mall 15 minutes later.
location: Along Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China (from Shanggang Xiaoqu to Super Brand Mall).

name: Store opening preparations and layout planning
description: After arriving at the store, I opened the windows for ventilation and checked the indigo-dyed shirts that arrived yesterday for color differences. Then I took out the store layout plan, used red and blue markers to optimize the positions of the bar counter, plants, and shelves, and annotated pricing strategies. I also envisioned adding a full-length mirror in the experience area so customers can try on accessories, and recorded the improvement points.
location: Xiafei Collection, A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Inquiries for store soft furnishing and communication on handmade leather goods procurement
description: Before the official opening at 10:00, I called three furniture factories to inquire about prices for custom bar countertops and shelving, and sent budget parameters via WeChat to await quotes. After 10:30, I had a video call with Guangzhou supplier Wu Fang to learn about new products such as handmade leather belts and wrapped-wire necklaces. I liked three designs suitable for mixing with techwear clothing, placed a small trial order, and asked shop assistant Xiao Lin to clear a display area. I also began preliminary ideas for the fall new-arrival plan.
location: Xiafei Collection, A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and market observation.
description: Went to the newly opened Chinai Curry Omurice on B1 of Super Brand Mall for a meal. While waiting in line, I observed the mall's foot traffic, elevator posters, and window displays of other clothing stores. During the meal, I scrolled through Xiaohongshu to check peers' posts, looking for display and product selection inspiration.
location: Chinai Curry Omurice, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Wrap up store affairs and hand over to staff.
description: Back at the store, he organized the morning's manufacturer quotes and sample feedback into an electronic document, spot-checked the newly arrived hoodie fabrics, and measured chest width and garment length, recording the data. In the afternoon, foot traffic was slow, so he briefed Xiao Lin in detail on color-difference handling scripts and the key customer reception arrangements for the afternoon, and told her he would leave early at 3 o'clock.
location: Xiafei Collection, A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Close the shop early and cycle home
description: Closed the shop right at 3 o'clock and rode a shared bike home along Pudong Avenue. The breeze brushed my face; although it was a bit hot, it was more comfortable than cramming into the subway. Arrived downstairs at Shanggang Residential Area in 15 minutes.
location: Along Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China (from Super Brand Mall to Shanggang Community)

name: Changing clothes and preparing before training
description: After arriving home, he first hydrated, changed into loose athletic T-shirt and shorts, cleared floor space in the bedroom, and prepared for home strength training.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Thursday family strength training
description: After completing the warm-up (jumping jacks, high knees, dynamic stretching), he did strength training in sequence: squats, 3 sets of 12 reps; modified push-ups, 3 sets of 10 reps; and planks, 3 sets of 40 seconds. Between sets he strictly controlled his drinking water, only moistening his lips. When the 25 minutes were up, he did static stretching and was drenched in sweat.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Shower and rest
description: Rest for 5 minutes until heart rate calms, then take a shower; washing off sweat stains makes you feel refreshed. Change into a dry T-shirt, drink warm water in the living room to rehydrate, then return to the room to tidy the desk and prepare for evening creation.
location: Bathroom and study at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Following casual anime updates and chatting online
description: In the study, on the computer, he watched the latest episode of the new Bilibili anime Spy x Family, then discussed the plot with his friend Yuanzi in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group, and vented to Jingjing about the frustration caused by today's weight fluctuation.
location: The study at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Family dinner and casual chat
description: Mother prepared braised pork, stir-fried amaranth, and tomato egg drop soup. During dinner, Father asked about the store's operations, and Lei Mingxuan shared the process of contacting suppliers and placing trial orders for handmade accessories. Mother brought up the neighbor's daughter returning from abroad, and Lei Mingxuan changed the subject by saying he needed to rush off to write his novel that evening. The atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Residential Quarter, 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: In-depth creative writing for Chapter 3 of the novel
description: Right after the meal, I sat down at my desk and reread Chapter 3, which I had only written halfway through the day before. I incorporated the detail of the 'old lady selling salty soda water at the alley entrance' that I had conceived during my morning bike ride, and combined it with the vegetable market auntie's gossip mentioned by my father at dinner. Inspiration struck, and I wrote nearly 3,000 characters in one go, vividly portraying the protagonist's childhood memories of a sultry afternoon in the alleyway.
location: The study at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Mother brought over sweet fermented rice balls
description: While he was deeply immersed in writing, his mother brought a bowl of steaming fermented rice wine balls and urged him not to stay up late and to get some rest. After thanking her, Lei Mingxuan ate the sweet snack while savoring his work, feeling deeply content. When he finished, he washed the bowl.
location: The study at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Finishing up writing and preparing for bed
description: After the late-night snack, he returned to the desk to polish the final few paragraphs, saved the document, and shut down the computer. Then he washed up and brushed his teeth. Before bed, looking in the mirror, he felt physically tired but filled with a sense of accomplishment and family warmth. He turned off the lights at 23:55 and went to sleep.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Morning surprise and breakfast sharing
description: Waking up early in the morning, Lei Mingxuan found that the novel "The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane" had been selected as a homepage recommendation by the "Fengdu" platform, and its readership was rising rapidly. Excitedly, he shared a screenshot in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat and video-called Zhang Wei and Li Na to celebrate for nearly half an hour. Then he washed up and had shepherd's purse and pork wontons for breakfast with his mother, Wang Xiuying, sharing his joy, and she felt proud of him.
location: Home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the store
description: Gave up the morning run, took along an iPad, keys, and other items, and rode a shared bike along Zhangyang Road to Super Brand Mall, enjoying the morning breeze.
location: Along the route from Shanggang Community, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Morning store work and online thank-yous
description: After arriving at booth A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, [Yichen], turned on the lights and tidied the clothes tried on last night. Posted a thank-you announcement on the store's Xiaohongshu and Moments, with detail photos of the newly arrived indigo-dyed shirts, to celebrate the novel being recommended. Then checked the inventory of newly arrived linen shirts with store clerk Xiao Lin, carefully compared colors using the color difference archive card, and took photos of the new outfits, planning the weekend promotion.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and Japanese study check-in
description: Enjoyed Vietnamese beef pho at the B1 food court of Super Brand Mall, with double lemon. After the meal, put on earphones and, in the noisy environment, completed the day's Japanese kana check-in study on his phone, staying disciplined.
location: Food court, B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pick up customized designer toy and confirm by phone at Century Link Plaza
description: From Super Brand Mall, took Metro Line 2 for two stops to Century Avenue Station and entered Century Link Plaza. At the B1-level designer toy custom shop, picked up the Q-version basketball action figure custom-made for Zhang Wei, was very satisfied with its details, paid, and asked the clerk to wrap it carefully in silver-gray frosted paper. Then, in the mall's rest area, called Jiujingze Fine Dining's Jinmao branch to confirm the evening private room reservation, specifically asking them to serve the cake at 8 o'clock and adjust the dishes to suit his friend's fitness needs.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai - Century Link Plaza, No. 1192 Century Avenue, B1 floor, trendy toy custom shop and public rest area.

name: Roller skating and relaxing at Lujiazui Green
description: Rode a shared bike to Lujiazui Central Green Park, changed into roller skates, and glided along the trail while listening to vaporwave music, brainstorming ideas for a multi-brand store. After an hour of skating, he bought Pocari Sweat at a nearby convenience store, sat on a bench to rest, and replied to reader comments in the novel section on Fengdu.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park and surrounding convenience stores, No. 15 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning to the store for shift handover
description: Cycled back to the store at Super Brand Mall, gave detailed instructions to the store clerk Xiao Lin about the weekend window-display concept drawings, lighting adjustments, and placement of featured items, told him that I needed to leave early, and asked him to contact me on WeChat if anything came up.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home, change clothes, and prepare for the dinner.
description: Rode back home to Shanggang Residential Area, took a shower, then changed into a light gray linen shirt and khaki casual pants. Put the wrapped designer toy gift and iPad into a canvas bag and tidied up my appearance.
location: Home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going to Jin Mao Tower
description: Rode a shared bike again, heading along Zhangyang Road toward Century Avenue, going to Jinmao Tower, and arriving about twenty minutes later.
location: Along the route from Shanggang Community, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Jin Mao Tower, 88 Century Avenue

name: Arrive early to browse the trendy toy store.
description: Arrived at Jin Mao Tower earlier than the agreed time, wandered around the first floor, then entered the Pop Mart store on level B1, browsed new IP collaborations and hidden figures, and thought about the possibility of bringing designer toy elements into the store for crossover displays.
location: Pop Mart, B1, Jinmao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Opening gift for the birthday celebration.
description: Zhang Wei arrived on time at the private room of Jiujingze Fine Dining Jinmao Branch. Lei Mingxuan handed him a carefully wrapped trendy toy figurine. Zhang Wei was pleasantly surprised to see a Q-version of himself doing a basketball move. The two took a photo together, and Zhang Wei immediately posted it to his Moments, praising their friendship.
location: Private room at Jiujingze Fine Japanese Cuisine, 3F, Jin Mao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Birthday dinner and video call
description: Lei Mingxuan used an iPad to video-call Li Na in Hangzhou, and the three of them sang the birthday song and blew out the candles across the distance. During the meal, they had a lively discussion about novel writing and store upgrades. Zhang Wei promised to help produce the first draft of the financial calculations, and Li Na agreed to contact food-review bloggers for promotion, until the restaurant closed.
location: Private room at Jiujingze Fine Japanese Cuisine, 3F, Jin Mao Tower, 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk home
description: After the dinner ended, he walked back to Shanggang Community along Century Avenue in a pleasant mood, feeling warm inside despite the cool autumn night.
location: Along the route from Jinmao Tower, No. 88 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road.

name: Father-son night walk
description: After entering, he found his father Lei Jianguo still reading the newspaper in the living room, and Lei Mingxuan invited his father to go downstairs for a walk. In the community garden, he fully explained his blueprint for a brand collection store for the first time. His father expressed support after listening and gave him great encouragement.
location: Shanggang Community Garden, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up, reminiscing, and falling asleep
description: After returning home, I washed up briefly and lay in bed reviewing the entire day: the novel recommendation, my brother's surprise, and my father's support. I felt utterly fulfilled and happy, and drifted off to sleep with confidence in the future.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning family time and breakfast
description: The alarm went off twice before I woke up. After getting up, I first filled the food bowl of the orange cat A Fu with cat food, then stood on the scale and saw a reading of 79.3 kg, reminding myself to eat less for lunch. After washing up, my mother had already prepared sheng jian bao and small wontons. During breakfast, I told my father that I was going to Yangpu District to referee a billiards league match today, and my father reminded me to officiate properly and not to argue with anyone.
