location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute by subway to Yangpu Billiards Club
description: I put on the backpack, packed with the referee whistle, stopwatch, scoreboard, and water, then walked to Century Avenue Station, took Line 2, transferred to Line 8, and arrived at Xiangyin Road Station, then walked to the club. On the subway, I repeatedly checked the referee team's WeChat group to confirm the schedule and group list, and reviewed key points of Chinese eight-ball rules.
location: Starting from Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, via Metro Line 2 and Line 8, to Hudong Financial Building, No. 1128 Xiangyin Road, Yangpu District, Shanghai

name: Pre-competition preparation and venue setup
description: After arriving at Hudong Billiards Club, he greeted Lao Zhao, the organizer, at the registration desk, and received his referee badge, group score sheets, and red and yellow cards. He then went to the lounge to change into a pure white polo shirt and black dress trousers, went to Zone 3, which he was responsible for, checked the flatness of the billiard tables and the tightness of the pockets, tested a Predator cue to confirm the tip condition, and flipped through the schedule booklet, marking next to the key matches.
location: Hudong Billiards Club, 3rd Floor, Hudong Financial Building, No. 1128 Xiangyin Road, Yangpu District, Shanghai

name: In the morning, strictly officiated the divisional competition.
description: The two morning matches were tense and closely contested. In the first match, he decisively called a foul for touching the ball with the non-cue hand. Although it sparked some controversy, he stuck with the call and patiently explained the rule, getting the player to accept it. In the second match, because sideline spectators' comments were affecting the players, he loudly warned them to keep order. During breaks, he quickly checked his phone, replied to clerk Xiao Lin's inquiry about weekend customer flow, handled customer Qian Duoduo's order, and confirmed the size and color of the mountain-style techwear set.
location: Zone 3, Hudong Billiards Club, 3rd Floor, Hudong Financial Building, No. 1128 Xiangyin Road, Yangpu District, Shanghai.

name: Lunch break and handling store matters remotely.
description: I went alone to Lao Shengchang Soup Bun House and ordered a bowl of mushroom and chicken congee and a serving of crab roe soup dumplings — light yet satisfying. While waiting, I took photos of my referee badge and scoring sheet and posted them on Moments with the caption, "Saturday limited skin unlocked: today I'm a referee, see you at the arena!" It attracted a lot of likes. I replied to Sister Feng Xiaoyu's message about the delivery time of the group-buy shirts, and reminded Xiao Lin to put the color card SOP file in a prominent place in the store. After the meal, while walking back to the club, I replied in the mall community to a member's question about late summer/early autumn outfits and gave professional styling advice.
location: No. 378 Minxing Road, Yangpu District, Shanghai, Lao Shengchang Soup Bun Shop, then walk back to No. 1128 Xiangyin Road, Yangpu District, Shanghai, Hudong Financial Building.

name: Afternoon officiating of key matches and experience sharing
description: The afternoon match directly determined qualification for the next round, so he officiated with extra focus. During halftime, he found an experienced veteran referee, offered a cigarette, and asked for advice on the controversial judging standard for balls frozen to the rail, gaining a lot. After the match, he sent a WeChat message to Xiao Lin to confirm Qian Duoduo's shipping address, and also posted a preview of tomorrow's 'Early Autumn Layering Inspiration' in the store community, with outfit photos taken at the club.
location: Zone 3, Hudong Billiards Club, 3rd Floor, Hudong Financial Building, No. 1128 Xiangyin Road, Yangpu District, Shanghai.

name: Billiards practice with good friend Han Dong after the match
description: After officiating ended smoothly, he changed into a sports T-shirt and played three games of pool with his friend Han Dong, who had come specially to watch the match, in the public practice area. While playing, they talked about the progress of preparing the store's multi-brand shop and the plot of the anime Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, and during the chat they agreed to go play at World Plaza again next week. Each of them won one game, and they parted fully satisfied.
location: Hudong Billiards Club public practice area, 3rd Floor, Hudong Financial Building, 1128 Xiangyin Road, Yangpu District, Shanghai

name: Evening metro ride back
description: After saying goodbye to Han Dong, he took Line 8 from Xiangyin Road Metro Station and transferred to Line 2 to return to Pudong. On the way, he posted an overhead photo of the match in the WeChat group "Pudong Three Musketeers," jokingly calling himself the "MVP of the match," and @-ed Li Na and Zhang Wei, asking if they could get together for dinner on the weekend.
location: From Hudong Financial Building, 1128 Xiangyin Road, Yangpu District, Shanghai, return via Metro Line 8 and Line 2 to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Warm family dinner
description: When he got home, his mother had already cooked braised pork belly, stir-fried vegetables, and tomato egg drop soup. At the dinner table, he showed his father the photos of him refereeing and gave a detailed account of a controversial call. His father listened attentively and commented a few times. While serving him food, his mother offered to prepare five-spice dried pork for tomorrow's visit to Zhou Tao in Hangzhou.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening personal recharge and creative work.
description: Back in the bedroom, I opened my laptop. First, I wrote about 800 characters of referee reflections, recording the penalty calls I encountered today and my exchange with the old professor. Then I opened the document for the novel 'An Afternoon in Xiafei Fang' and added a detail that had come to mind while chatting with Han Dong in the afternoon: the sound of a postman's bicycle bell in the alleyway. Next, I checked the bullet train ticket for tomorrow's trip to Hangzhou and the sample list for visiting Zhou Tao, confirming that the color card SOP, indigo-dyed shirt, and new fabric sample cards were all correct.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bathing, spending time with the pet, and preparing for the outing.
description: He first took a comfortable hot shower. After getting out, he carefully brushed the orange tabby cat Afu, took a photo of it squinting in enjoyment, and posted it on WeChat Moments with the caption, “Referee's off duty, life is 'meow'velous~” He then checked the backpack for tomorrow's trip to Hangzhou, packed all the samples and materials into it, and finally sent Zhou Tao a WeChat message confirming the factory visit at 2 p.m. tomorrow.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime company and falling asleep
description: From his room he went to the living room and watched a TV drama with his parents for a while, mentioning that his feet were a bit sore from standing all day. Before bed, he charged his phone and set an alarm for 8 a.m. the next day. Lying in bed, he quickly scrolled through the inspiration notes he had jotted down during breaks in refereeing, thinking about discussing the new design with Zhou Tao tomorrow. Though tired, he felt a strong sense of accomplishment and soon fell fast asleep.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Early morning family breakfast
description: Woken by his biological clock in the morning, sunlight streamed into the bedroom through the curtains. After getting up, Lei Mingxuan went to the bathroom to wash up, then weighed himself barefoot; the scale showed 79.4 kg, and he reminded himself to eat fewer carbohydrates today. He changed into a loose athletic T-shirt and shorts and headed to the dining room. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had already prepared pan-fried buns and white rice porridge, and his father, Lei Jianguo, was reading mobile news wearing reading glasses. Lei Mingxuan sat down to enjoy breakfast and told his father that after this afternoon's game he would come straight home, and that the samples for tomorrow's trip to Hangzhou had all been packed last night, so his father need not worry. His father nodded and told him to be safe on the road.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commute to the competition club.
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan put on his backpack (containing samples, blueprints, and the color card SOP for tomorrow's trip to Hangzhou), grabbed a power bank and keys, said goodbye to his mother, and left home. He got on his electric scooter, rode along Pudong Avenue, turned left onto South Pudong Road, and arrived at World Plaza about 15 minutes later. He parked the e-bike in the designated non-motor vehicle spot, then took the elevator down to B2.
location: Hudong Billiards Club, B2, World Plaza, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-competition preparation and registration.
description: After arriving at the club, Lei Mingxuan checked in at the front desk and received a referee badge and a scoreboard. He looked around the quiet venue; all the billiard tables were covered with dust covers. Then he went to the referee rest area, put on his white gloves, and began checking the scoring device and timer to make sure the equipment was working properly.
location: Hudong Billiards Club, B2, World Plaza, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Referee two morning knockout matches
description: The match started on time, and Lei Mingxuan was responsible for refereeing two elimination matches in the upper half. The atmosphere was tense. In the first match, a disputed shot came up: the attacking side thought the ball frozen against the cushion was a dead ball, while the defending side believed there was a clear path. Lei Mingxuan quickly leaned in to observe, clearly ruled it a blocked ball, and explained the reasoning. Both sides accepted the call. In the second match, a player made a beautiful break and run, and the whole crowd applauded. During halftime, Lei Mingxuan noticed many young spectators wearing anime collaboration T-shirts, such as Spy x Family and Demon Slayer, which inspired him to look for collaboration opportunities for his store.
location: Hudong Billiards Club, B2, World Plaza, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and handling store matters.
description: At noon, after the competition came to a pause, Lei Mingxuan went to the Lao Shengxing noodle shop across the street for lunch. He ordered a bowl of spicy pork noodles and specifically asked for less noodles to control his carb intake. While waiting, he replied by phone to shop assistant Xiao Lin's inquiry about the inventory of indigo-dyed shirts, and also sent photos to regular customer Qian Duoduo to confirm whether size S of the newly arrived workwear shorts was in stock. Qian Duoduo said she would come to try them on tomorrow. Then he quickly finished his noodles.
location: Laoshengxing Noodle Restaurant, streetfront, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Talked with the referee after the match
description: After finishing his noodles, Lei Mingxuan returned to the club and saw the event organizer, Zhang Ge, and other senior referees smoking and chatting in the rest area. He joined them and shared his insights from officiating in the morning. Zhang Ge patted him on the shoulder, praised his performance over the last two days, and hinted that the deputy head referee position was within his reach.
location: Hudong Billiards Club, B2, World Plaza, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Officiate two afternoon knockout matches.
description: At 1 p.m., the competition continued. Lei Mingxuan was responsible for the third and fourth elimination matches, which were more critical—the players were more skilled and the matches were intense. He was fully focused and made decisive calls. During the event, a spectator quietly questioned a positioning call, and he silenced them with a firm look. Throughout the afternoon, he barely sat except for two 10-minute breaks; his step count increased, and although his feet ached, he was full of energy.
location: Hudong Billiards Club, B2, World Plaza, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Collecting payment and post-match exchange
description: After the last match, Lei Mingxuan took off his white gloves and found the event organizer, Brother Zhang. Brother Zhang gave him 1000 yuan and a nicely designed commemorative badge. After thanking him, he didn't leave immediately but chatted with Brother Zhang about expectations for the next tournament. Brother Zhang said he would give priority to him for the role of deputy chief referee. He felt reassured.
location: Hudong Billiards Club, B2, World Plaza, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Looking for co-branding resources for the store.
description: Lei Mingxuan found a young contestant, Xiao Liu, in the audience wearing a Spy x Family collab T-shirt. He struck up a conversation and asked where the T-shirt came from, saying he also wanted to find similar collab items for his store. Xiao Liu told him he had a friend working in business development at an anime IP licensing company. Lei Mingxuan added Xiao Liu on WeChat and asked him to introduce his friend.
location: Hudong Billiards Club, B2, World Plaza, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shopping on the way home
description: After finishing his errands, it was already getting dark, and the weather forecast predicted rain. Lei Mingxuan quickly got on his electric scooter and hurried before the rain started. Passing the intersection of Zhangyang Road and Jinhe Road, he stopped at Yanqin Grocery Store and went in to buy a bottle of body wash and a bundle of toilet paper. The shopkeeper’s wife recognized him and recommended the newly arrived preserved plums, saying Lei’s mother liked them. So he also picked up a pack of preserved plums.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Warm family dinner
description: It started raining when Lei Mingxuan got home. His mother was cooking braised pork, and the aroma filled the air. He put down his things and helped his father bring the dishes to the table. During dinner, he animatedly described the highlights of the day's competition, including the rail-shot penalty call, the 1,000 yuan payment and commemorative badge he received, and the possibility of becoming the deputy chief referee. His father listened with great interest, while his mother asked whether he had packed everything for his business trip to Hangzhou the next day. He said he had it all ready. The family ate and chatted together in a warm atmosphere.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening review and social media operations
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan returned to the study and switched on the desk lamp. He took a close-up of the commemorative badge and a half-length photo of himself wearing white gloves, wrote a caption, and posted it to Xiaohongshu and WeChat Moments. The caption said that the weekend of refereeing had come to a successful end, thanked the organizers for their trust, and looked forward to the next tournament, adding the hashtags #BilliardsReferee #MySideHustleIsBusierThanMyMainJob. After that, he sent a message to Xiao Liu to ask for a friend's contact information, checked the high-speed rail time for the next day's trip to Hangzhou, and sent a WeChat message to supplier Zhou Tao to confirm a 2 p.m. meeting. He felt relieved after getting a reply.
location: Home study, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Residential Area)

name: Leisurely catching up on anime and writing fiction.
description: After finishing the important business, Lei Mingxuan relaxed, lying back in the ergonomic chair. The orange cat Afu jumped onto his lap and purred. While petting the cat, he watched new anime episodes on his tablet. Thinking that he could work on the follow-up to his novel The Afternoon of Xiafei Fang on the bullet train tomorrow, he opened an app and wrote more than 300 characters of dialogue.
location: Home study, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Residential Area)

name: Wash up and prepare for bed
description: After A Fu left on his own, Lei Mingxuan went to the bathroom to take a shower, washing away the day's fatigue. He noticed that the soles of his feet were a bit swollen after standing all day. He used the newly bought body wash, brushed his teeth, then went back to the bedroom, changed into pajamas, and set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Relaxation before bed and falling asleep
description: After lying down in bed, Lei Mingxuan scrolled through his Moments and saw that his post had received likes from several friends. Han Dong commented, 'Awesome! Deputy chief referee is in the bag!' He replied with a fist-and-palm salute emoji. He also saw Zhang Wei inviting people to play ball in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat, and replied that he had a business trip tomorrow and would join next time. After putting down his phone, he reflected on the day's experiences, felt fulfilled and satisfied, and looked forward to tomorrow's trip to Hangzhou, falling asleep with a smile.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Woke up, weighed myself, and washed up in the morning.
description: At 8 in the morning, Lei Mingxuan woke from sleep. The first thing he did was step on the body fat scale, which showed 79.4 kg. He thought helplessly that his weight still hadn't dropped. Then he went to the bathroom, carefully shaved his stubble in the mirror, quickly finished washing up, and got ready for the day's work.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family breakfast and discussion of the day's plans.
description: After washing up, Lei Mingxuan had breakfast with his parents Lei Jianguo and Wang Xiuying. His mother had prepared white congee, poached eggs, and shepherd's purse pork buns. At the table, Lei Mingxuan briefly explained today's plan to his parents: in the morning he would go to the clothing store at Super Brand Mall to handle the insurance purchase; in the afternoon he would have an online video conference with Zhou Tao, the supplier from Hangzhou, to resolve the color difference issue; in the evening he needed to prepare materials for tomorrow's CHIC expo. His father reminded him to take care of his health.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, home dining room

name: Store commute, daily management, and insurance purchase
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan changed into the store's indigo-dyed cotton-linen shirt, put on his canvas bag, and went out. He first used his phone to unlock a shared bike and rode from Lane 136, Pudong Avenue to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, arriving at his clothing store around 9:15. After arriving, he had a brief 10-minute morning meeting with store clerk Xiao Lin to review last week's sales data and inventory. Then he went into the back office, logged into the insurance company's website on his computer, compared commercial property all-risk plans from three companies, and finally chose a basic plan with an annual fee of 3,800 yuan covering fire, water damage, and theft. He completed the payment online and downloaded the electronic policy. Afterward, he and Xiao Lin did a stocktake of the inventory system and corrected the inventory data for several mountain-style shorts and indigo-dyed shirts.
location: Clothing store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Resting in the store, handling social media and customer inquiries
description: After completing the insurance and inventory check, Lei Mingxuan took a short rest. He made himself a cup of drip-bag coffee and sat down on a bean bag chair in the rest area. He opened his phone and saw a WeChat message from a regular customer, Qian Duoduo, who wanted to customize a couple-style mountain-inspired hardshell jacket. He replied that the design plan would be ready next week. At the same time, he also handled a follower's question about fabric composition on the Xiaohongshu backend, keeping up interaction with customers.
location: Rest area of the clothing store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Trying a new restaurant for lunch and taking care of chores afterward.
description: At lunchtime, Lei Mingxuan decided to have something different and went to the newly opened Yunnan Xiaoshi crossing-the-bridge rice noodle shop on B1 of Super Brand Mall. He ordered a bowl of hot-and-sour rice noodles with beef in a golden broth. The broth was rich and appetizing, and he ate until sweat formed on his forehead, enjoying a little Monday change of pace. After the meal, he deliberately walked a full lap around the mall to hit his step count before returning to the store. Back in the store, he filed the electronic insurance policy he had printed that morning into the store-specific folder and noted the insurance expiration date and customer service phone number in his phone memo. Then he took out the business cards and brochures for tomorrow's CHIC Expo and checked them carefully again to make sure there were enough and nothing was missing.
location: "Yunnan Xiaoshi" Crossing-the-Bridge Rice Noodle Shop and store, B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Video conference with Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao to finalize color difference compensation
description: At 1 p.m., Lei Mingxuan made a WeChat video call on time to supplier Zhou Tao from the office in the back of the store. He showed the 20 color card comparison charts made three days earlier and had an in-depth discussion about the color difference problem with a batch of goods from last week. Zhou Tao frankly admitted that it was caused by insufficient washing and color fixing after the fabric was dyed, and finally agreed to offset 8% of the goods' value as compensation. He also promised to arrange for the factory to prioritize rework and send new samples before next Monday. After hanging up, Lei Mingxuan felt as if a huge weight had been lifted from his shoulders.
location: Office of the clothing store, Shop A-208, Level 2, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-meeting rest and billiards technique practice
description: After the tense video conference, Lei Mingxuan felt a bit tired. He walked to the rest area, remotely added food to the automatic feeder for his cat A Fu at home, then opened his phone to watch billiards tutorial videos, focusing for 15 minutes on cue techniques for rail shots, preparing for his next game.
location: Rest area of the clothing store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing materials for tomorrow's CHIC Expo visit
description: At 3 pm, Lei Mingxuan left the office door ajar and began to focus on preparing materials for the CHIC Expo. He opened the expo's official app, carefully studied the exhibitor list and floor plan of the 'Streetwear & Designer Brands' zone, and highlighted 5 must-see booths with a highlighter. He checked the store brochures, business cards, and sample packs containing indigo-dyed cloth, linen, and new quick-dry fabrics, making sure quantities were sufficient and categories were clear. Finally, in the iPad Notes app he planned tomorrow morning's route through the exhibition: enter from the north entrance, visit Zone A first, then move to Zone C.
location: Office of the clothing store, Shop A-208, Level 2, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shop closing checks and work handover
description: As 5 p.m. approached, Lei Mingxuan and store clerk Xiao Lin began getting ready to close. Together they turned off the store's lights and air conditioning and checked that the doors and windows were secure. Lei Mingxuan told Xiao Lin that he wouldn't be in the store at all the next day, and if anything urgent came up she could call him directly; he would rely on her to take care of the store's sales work. Xiao Lin nodded to say no problem.
location: Clothing store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk home after work to relax
description: After closing, Lei Mingxuan chose to walk home. The sun was setting, and the air was still muggy but not as harsh as at noon. He put on his earphones, listened to the soundtrack of his favorite 'Delicious in Dungeon,' and strolled along Pudong Avenue all the way back to Shanggang Residential Area, treating the walk as his main aerobic exercise of the day.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Residential Quarter (en route)

name: Had dinner with parents and shared work progress
description: When he got home, his mother Wang Xiuying was busy in the kitchen. Lei Mingxuan washed his hands and helped serve the dishes. Dinner was stir-fried shrimp, cucumber salad, and tomato egg drop soup — light and soothing. At the dinner table, he gave his father Lei Jianguo a detailed report on the insurance he had bought for the store that day. After listening, his father recounted a story from his youth when an electrical fire broke out in the factory, and remarked that it pays to be prepared. Lei Mingxuan also shared the color mismatch compensation plan agreed upon in his video meeting with Zhou Tao. His father nodded repeatedly and praised him for putting harmony first.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, home dining room

name: Walk in the neighborhood and walk the cat after the meal.
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan proactively cleaned up the dishes, then accompanied his parents for a walk in the community garden, and also took the orange cat Afu downstairs for some fresh air. Afu chased butterflies on the grass while Lei Mingxuan sat on a bench and wrote several passages of novel ideas about 'color difference' on his phone, planning to incorporate them into a new chapter.
location: Garden, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Expo pre-event preparation and update of the novel Afternoon in Xiafei Fang
description: After returning from his walk and washing up, Lei Mingxuan entered his study and began the core work of the evening. He first drew tomorrow's expo visiting route by hand on paper, marking the booths to visit as priorities. Then he opened his laptop and organized the electronic versions of the brochures and fabric samples into folders by style. Starting at 9 PM, he turned to writing his novel 'Afternoon at Xiafei Lane,' skillfully weaving today's psychological handling of the color difference issue and his negotiation techniques into the protagonist's confrontation with the tailor shop owner. Ideas flowed freely, and by 10 PM he had written 2,200 characters, just in time before his existing drafts ran out.
location: Home study, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Residential Area)

name: Evening relaxation and washing up.
description: Leaving the study, Lei Mingxuan completely relaxed. He curled up on the living room sofa and spent a while browsing teaser videos on Bilibili about the 'cloud expo tour' of the CHIC Expo, getting himself motivated for tomorrow's visit. At around 11 p.m., he turned off his phone, went into the bathroom to wash up, and made a resolution to himself in the mirror: tomorrow at the expo he would absolutely not eat high-calorie fast food.
location: Living room and bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepared exhibition gear and did some bedtime reading.
description: After washing up, Lei Mingxuan returned to his bedroom. He picked out a navy blue linen casual blazer, a white T-shirt, and dark gray cropped trousers to wear the next day—a combination that looked both professional and fresh. Then he neatly placed the exhibition materials, power bank, and business card holder into a newly bought canvas tote bag and set it by the bed. At 23:45, he turned off the lamp and fell asleep peacefully to the faint sound of traffic outside, looking forward to the expo the next day.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning quick strength training and personal preparation
description: After the alarm went off on time, he did three sets of quick strength training on the bedroom floor, including squats, standard push-ups, and planks, to wake up his body. After training, he took a cold shower, put on a quick-dry T-shirt, cargo shorts, and sneakers, and prepared exhibition essentials in advance: sunscreen, wet wipes, a sports bottle filled with ice water, and a power bank.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Enjoying the breakfast my mother prepared
description: Mother got up early and made scallion-oil noodles with a soft-boiled egg with a runny yolk. While eating breakfast, I talked with her about the plan to go to Qingpu to see an exhibition and reassured her. After eating, I tucked the water bottle into my backpack and grabbed a pack of tissues.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drive to the National Exhibition and Convention Center and enter the venue.
description: Drove the white Touran from the residential compound, taking G40 Shanghai-Xi’an Expressway, G1503 Shanghai Ring Expressway, and S26 Shanghai-Changzhou Expressway to the National Exhibition and Convention Center. Traffic was moderate. While driving, I reviewed the day’s plan, focusing on the several exhibitors marked in my notes. After arriving, I parked, walked to the North Lobby, swiped my ID card through security under the scorching sun during an orange high-temperature warning, and once inside, went straight to the information desk to pick up a guide map and confirm the locations of the streetwear and designer-brand exhibition areas.
location: North Registration Hall, National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai), 333 Songze Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: In the morning, focus on visiting designer brand booths
description: Following the plan from the previous night, he accurately found the five booths marked in his phone memo. He made a key visit to the Hangzhou brand "Zhiji" and talked with the person in charge, Miss Chen, for about 25 minutes about the urban techwear design concept, fabric craftsmanship, and delivery lead time. He was very satisfied with several sample garments, and the other party agreed to send a full sample package the following week and added him on WeChat. Afterwards, he visited four other exhibitors focusing on outdoor functional and commuting styles, taking notes and photos at each.

participant.name: Miss Chen.
participant.relation: Head of the Hangzhou Zhiji brand

location: Streetwear and designer brands exhibition area, Hall 1.2, National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai), 333 Songze Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Quick lunch in the exhibition hall.
description: At the 'Lao Niang Jiu' fast-food restaurant in the exhibition hall's dining area, he ordered the meigan cai braised pork set meal and finished lunch in 15 minutes. While eating, he browsed through the dozen or so business cards he had collected, noted the key information in his phone contacts, and confirmed the time and place of the afternoon lecture.
location: Laoniangjiu, 2F dining area, National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai), 333 Songze Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon Sweep Through the Streetwear and Accessory District
description: In the streetwear exhibition area, found a brand making retro canvas shoes whose distressed finishing was outstanding, and left contact information. Then entered the accessories area and inspected several silver jewelry and handmade leather goods studios to reserve resources for adding high-margin small items to the store. The pace was efficient, spending 10-15 minutes at each key booth.
location: National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai), No. 333 Songze Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai, Hall 4.1 and the Accessories Area

name: Attend a lecture on autumn trends in technical fabrics.
description: Attended a lecture titled Trends and Commercial Applications of Tech Fabrics for Autumn/Winter 2026. The speaker introduced bio-based waterproof fabrics, recycled polyester fibers, and smart temperature-control materials, and presented the latest international trend color cards. I jotted down the Urban Outdoor and Functional Commute trends in my phone's memo app, which are highly consistent with the store's positioning for the second half of the year.

participant.name: Speaker
participant.relation: Technical Director of a textile technology company

location: Trend Release Zone, Hall 8.1, National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai), No. 333 Songze Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Exhibition wrap-up and material sorting
description: After the lecture, I quickly finished the small booths I had missed. In the rest area, I sorted the brochures, business cards, and sample cards collected that day into different document folders and affixed colored labels. I collected materials from 25 potential suppliers in total, had in-depth discussions with 4, and confirmed sample-shipping intentions from 2.
location: Rest area, Hall 8.1, National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai), No. 333 Songze Avenue, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Drove back to the store at Super Brand Mall and archived the documents
description: Left the exhibition hall fully satisfied, returning to Pudong via S26 Shanghai-Changzhou Expressway, G15 Shenyang-Haikou Expressway, Middle Ring Road, South Yanggao Road, and Century Avenue. Along the way, he called his mother to say he would be home for dinner but a bit late. After arriving at the store, he drank some cold boiled water, scanned and filed the day's business cards and brochures, and created folders by brand type, style, and level of interest. Key information such as the sample delivery date, contact person, and initial quote for Hangzhou's "Zhiji" was entered into the CRM system, and the lecture notes were organized into a document for reference in next week's product selection.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mall dinner: Yang's Pan-Fried Buns
description: I went down to Xiao Yang Sheng Jian on the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall, ordered a serving of fresh pork pan-fried buns and a bowl of curry beef vermicelli soup, and enjoyed the burst of juicy flavor to ease the day's fatigue.
location: Yang's Dumplings, B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing for the evening book club and sharing with the online history group
description: In the corner of the store, he browsed his mobile reading notes for The Collapse of the Celestial Empire, used a mind map to sort out the core arguments, and marked passages that touched him. At 8 p.m. sharp, he entered the Tencent Meeting channel "Pudong Three Musketeers" and was the first to speak. He shared his reflections, connecting the Qing government's institutional rigidity before and after the Opium War with ways to break through in business negotiations, and won the group members' approval. Members Fei Ge and Jingjing also shared their own views, and the discussion was lively.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking home and enjoying family time.
description: After the book club ended, he checked the store's power supply, doors, and windows, packed up the sample bag, and walked about twenty minutes home. Once home, he shared his impressions of the exhibition in Qingpu — including the partner brands and the technical fabrics lecture — with his father, who was watching sports news, and his mother, who was heating up mung bean soup. His father nodded as he listened. The orange cat A Fu came over, rubbed against his leg, and begged to be held. He picked up the cat and sat on the sofa, petting it while catching up on the latest episode of Spy x Family.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening wash-up, planning for tomorrow, and going to sleep
description: After saying goodnight to his parents, he washed up and planned the next day's work: contacting Hangzhou's 'Zhiji' to confirm sample shipment, organizing the exhibition weekly report, and confirming customer orders. After turning off the light, he lay in bed, reviewed the fulfilling day, affirmed his performance, and slowly fell asleep to the low hum of the air conditioner.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning strength training
description: Lei Mingxuan got up when the alarm went off, weighed 79.5 kg, laid out a yoga mat on the bedroom floor, and did a simplified strength workout: squats 3 sets x 15 reps, push-ups 2 sets x 12 reps, planks 3 sets x 45 seconds, moving gently so as not to wake his parents.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Made pour-over coffee for his mother to celebrate her birthday.
description: After taking a shower, Lei Mingxuan went into the kitchen and hand-brewed coffee for his mother using Yirgacheffe coffee beans and a V60 pour-over set. He weighed out 15 grams of beans, ground them, kept the water temperature at 92°C, and used a 1:15 coffee-to-water ratio for blooming and pouring. He served it in his mother's usual white porcelain cup and wrote a birthday greeting on a card. When his mother got up, she was surprised and touched. After tasting it, she praised him, and his father also came over for a sip.
location: Home kitchen, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Warm family breakfast
description: Lei Mingxuan also brewed a cup of coffee for himself. His mother cooked preserved egg and lean pork congee, served with the leftover soup dumplings and pickled mustard greens. The family sat together for breakfast, and Lei Mingxuan said he wanted to eat his mother's signature braised pork. His mother agreed and planned to add more potatoes, and his father chimed in that he wanted yellow wine. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, home dining room

name: Preparation before going out
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to his room, changed into a gray T-shirt, black cargo shorts, and white canvas shoes, checked his phone, wallet, power bank, and store keys, filled A Fu the orange cat's bowls with cat food and water, and got ready to go out.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Walked to the store for the commute
description: Wearing headphones, Lei Mingxuan walked for over 20 minutes, heading south along Zhangyang Road and crossing the Century Avenue overpass. Along the way, he played the Jujutsu Kaisen opening theme and felt invigorated.
location: From Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations: sample acceptance and brand follow-up
description: After arriving at the store, he turned on the lights, opened the cash register, and cleaned. Xiao Lin arrived on time, and Lei Mingxuan held a short morning meeting to assign the task of following up and contacting brands at the CHIC exhibition. Then he sat behind the cash register and opened his computer. From 9:00 to 10:00, he messaged the contact at the Hangzhou designer brand “Zhiji” to thank them for the samples, attaching a brief store introduction and environment photos. Next, he opened the express delivery to inspect the modified Zhongshan suits and cargo pants, checking the fabric, stitching, and details, and was initially satisfied. From 10:00 to 11:30, he sorted through materials on the other two interested brands, added them on WeChat, and sent the store introduction and collaboration intention. From 11:30 to 12:00, he chose three photos of the Zhongshan suits, retouched and color-corrected them, wrote promotional copy, and posted it to WeChat Moments with stickers displaying the samples.
location: Store Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and novel writing
description: At noon, when customer traffic in the store was low, Lei Mingxuan asked Xiao Lin to watch the store and went to the Hong Kong-style roast meat stall on the B1 floor, where he ordered char siu and soy chicken combo rice and iced lemon tea for lunch. While eating, he opened WPS on his phone and continued writing his novel The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane. Combining reflections from the previous evening's book club discussion of The Collapse of the Celestial Empire, he rewrote a passage in which the protagonist talks with old-school intellectuals on the eve of 1949, conveying confusion and hesitation, and completed about 400 characters.
location: Super Brand Mall B1 Food Court, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon rest and online interaction
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to the store, shared the watermelon sent by Xiao Lin's mother with Xiao Lin, sat in the rest area eating watermelon while scrolling through his phone, replying to online customer inquiries. At the same time, he recommended the new high-waisted slightly flared jeans to returning customer Sister Feng Xiaoyu, who said she would consider it.
location: Rest area of Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations: reception, organization, and community maintenance.
description: In the afternoon, the number of customers in the mall increased. From 14:40 to 16:00, Lei Mingxuan served two young couples and a businessman, successfully selling a printed short-sleeved shirt and a casual suit. From 16:00 to 17:00, foot traffic decreased. Behind the cashier counter, he used a tablet to sort through his notes on technology fabric trends from the CHIC exhibition, marked the key points suitable for the store's positioning, and noted down autumn selection ideas, such as launching antibacterial quick-dry polo shirts, and sketched drafts. From 17:00 to 17:30, he took photos of best-selling items and sent them to the VIP customer WeChat group 'Zhengda Fashion Circle', announcing next week's new arrivals. He also sent a voice message in the brothers' group 'Pudong Three Musketeers' saying he would not join tonight's basketball activity because of his mother's birthday.
location: Store Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After closing, head out to purchase supplies
description: Lei Mingxuan closed the shop on time, gave instructions to Xiao Lin, left the store, and walked to Pushang Market on Dongchang Road, planning to prepare an extra surprise for his mother.
location: From Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Pushang Vegetable Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shopping for a birthday surprise.
description: Entering the market, Lei Mingxuan picked out a bouquet of yellow sunflowers with white balloon flowers at the fruit stall, which carries a beautiful meaning, and then bought his mother's favorite Chinese bayberries at the next stall.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, Dongchang Road, Pushang Vegetable Market.

name: Evening walk and step-count check-in
description: Detoured from the vegetable market to Lujiazui Central Green Park, and walked briskly along the path for about 30 minutes in the sunset, enjoying the skyscrapers and greenery, while listening to a podcast about post-80s entrepreneurs. The health app on my phone showed the step count steadily rising, promising to reach the daily goal of 7,500 steps.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Walk home
description: After the walk, Lei Mingxuan strolled leisurely back to Shanggang Residential Community, hiding the bouquet and bayberries behind his back, ready to surprise his mother.
location: From Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Residential Quarter, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family Birthday Dinner
description: Upon entering, he smelled the aroma of braised pork belly. His mother was in the kitchen stir-frying the last vegetable dish, and his father was setting out bowls and chopsticks. Lei Mingxuan presented flowers and bayberries, and his mother was very happy. Dinner included braised pork belly, stir-fried asparagus, jellyfish skin with scallion oil, tomato and egg soup, and shengjian buns from the time-honored shop downstairs. At the table, Lei Mingxuan shared the day's samples and the progress with brand contacts. His parents listened intently. He ate two pieces of braised pork belly but quietly reminded himself about his fatty liver issue.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, home dining room

name: A heart-to-heart talk between mother and son
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to wash the dishes, leaving his father TV time. Then he brewed two cups of tea and sat down with his mother on the sofa, proactively asking about her story of coming alone from Nantong to Shanghai to take the teacher-training entrance exam. His mother recounted details from leaving home at 19, taking the ferry to Shiliupu, staying in a small hotel, and studying all night. Lei Mingxuan listened attentively and asked questions from time to time. This heart-to-heart talk lasted nearly an hour, deepened their mutual understanding, and dissolved the estrangement caused by earlier urging to get married.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation and petting the cat
description: After the heart-to-heart talk, Lei Mingxuan returned to his room, turned on his computer, and played the soundtrack of "Frieren: Beyond Journey's End." The orange tabby Afu jumped onto his lap and purred. He scrolled through WeChat Moments, replying to likes and comments on the morning's "Zhiji" sample post, and browsed Xiaohongshu notes on "store displays" and "autumn men's outfits" for inspiration.
location: Home study, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Residential Area)

name: Skill learning and daily novel updates
description: Lei Mingxuan opened WeChat Reading to read 100 Basics: Yataro Matsuura's Life Principles, taking notes on regular routines and health management. Then he opened WPS, revised the novel excerpt from noon by incorporating the story his mother told that evening, deepening the protagonist's psychological state in the predicament, and completed about 800 words, meeting his daily update goal.
location: Home study, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Residential Area)

name: Pre-sleep preparation and organizing reflections.
description: Closed the computer, washed up, and lay down in bed, then took out a notebook to record the three most important things today: 1. Followed up on the "Zhiji" sample and was satisfied; 2. Had an in-depth conversation with my mother; 3. Kept updating the novel. Felt fulfilled and set an alarm for 8:00 tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: To the low hum of the air conditioner, thinking that tomorrow he still had to think about the next round of product selection, Lei Mingxuan closed his eyes and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and health management sharing
description: After the alarm rang, he got up, walked barefoot to the bathroom to weigh himself. He weighed 79.3 kg, and a soft tape measure showed a waist of about 92 cm, 3 cm less than at the beginning of the month. He recorded the data in his phone memo and took a photo of the scale. After washing up, he sat at the dining table and posted the data with a photo of the early-autumn sky outside the window on Moments, with the caption “Steadily advancing toward 75 kg! Waist -3 cm, some results!” His childhood friend Zhang Wei commented, “Xuanzi, awesome!” He smiled and replied with a fist emoji. His mother Wang Xiuying walked over with a bowl of hot congee and, seeing the screen, showed a relieved smile.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Healthy breakfast and family interaction
description: Mother had prepared multigrain porridge and boiled eggs, and kept her promise not to add sugar to the porridge. I ate the simple, healthy breakfast while scrolling through WeChat Moments. I told Mother about my idea for a coffee corner in the store; she supported it and said she would ask Father to visit the store on the weekend. After eating, I added cat food for the orange tabby "A Fu" and patted its head.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Subway commute and daily news browsing.
description: He checked his crossbody bag to confirm his keys, phone, and power bank were all there, changed into comfortable casual clothes, said hi to his parents, then walked about 7 minutes to Zhangyang Road Metro Station and took Line 2 toward Lujiazui. There were not many people in the carriage, so he stood and browsed the anime news updated last night.
location: Inside the subway car on Metro Line 2, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (from Zhangyang Road Station to Lujiazui Station)

name: Store tidying and coffee corner planning discussion.
description: After arriving at the store, I opened the door for ventilation and simply mopped the floor. I took out a measuring tape and my phone memo, and measured the space in the northeast corner of the store planned to be converted into a coffee corner: 2.5 meters long and 1.8 meters wide. I turned on the computer and took detail photos next to the samples sent by the 'Zhiji' brand. At about 10:30, I called Lao Li from the renovation crew and explained the coffee corner renovation idea and dimensions. Lao Li suggested sending a floor plan sketch first, and said he could come for a survey next Wednesday. Then I opened the new mountain-style shorts that had arrived the day before, used a garment steamer to iron out the wrinkles, and rehung them on the racks by color. While organizing, I was also thinking about how to style them for Shen Jie to see in the afternoon.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and a stroll through the shopping district to gather inspiration
description: Leaving the shop, walked about 8 minutes to Super Bowl FOODBOWL, ordered an avocado chicken breast salad, and used my phone to photograph the street scene of nearby office workers eating quickly as observation material. After finishing, walked across the pedestrian bridge to Lujiazui Central Green Park, sat down on a bench, and while looking at the surrounding office buildings and lawns, inspiration rushed in. I took out my phone, opened the outline of the novel “The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane”, and wrote down my thoughts on “the afternoon light and shadows of a lane café”. Then I took photos of the sky and greenery in the park, preparing to post them on Xiaohongshu.
location: Super Bowl FOODBOWL (Citigroup Tower Branch), No. 33 Huayuan Shiqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sketching and business contact
description: Returning to the shop after a walk in the park, he drank some water, opened a drawing app on his phone, quickly sketched a floor plan of the coffee corner based on the measurements taken in the morning, and sent it to Lao Li from the renovation team. Lao Li replied that he would give a quote by tomorrow. Then he opened WeChat and sent a message to the Wenzhou accessories owner who had shown interest at the CHIC expo two days ago, re-expressing his interest in cooperation and attaching the latest store display photos.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cousin Shen Jie came to the store to try on clothes and engage in fashion trend interaction.
description: At around 2:30 p.m., his cousin Shen Jie skipped her elective course and arrived as promised. She was immediately attracted to the new store display. He took out the modernized Zhongshan suit from "Zhiji" and several cargo pants samples, and the two tried on and compared outfits in front of the mirror. Shen Jie paired an indigo work jacket with khaki wide-leg pants to create a Japanese-style look. Together they unboxed the newly bought SKULLPANDA designer toy blind boxes and pulled a hidden figure, making Shen Jie scream with joy. They chatted about the latest Jujutsu Kaisen anime and their hoarded designer toy figurines. Before leaving, Shen Jie said her classmates were recently looking for outfits for graduation photos and she would recommend them to come and take a look.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations and customer relationship maintenance
description: After Shen Jie left, he tidied up the clothes she had tried on and hung them back up. Turning on his computer, he took photos of the outfits Shen Jie had helped put together, added the caption 'Weekend shoot outfit inspiration,' and posted them to Xiaohongshu and WeChat Moments. He sent a voice message to regular customer Qian Duoduo, telling her that the new mountain-style shorts fit well and suited her camping plans, and also promised to keep an eye out for a folding chair for her. He packed an online order, planning to deliver it tomorrow to the lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station for shipping.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Subway commute after work and daily observations
description: Turned off the store's lights and air conditioner, confirmed everything was in order, and left. Walked from Super Brand Mall to Lujiazui Metro Station and took Line 2 back to Zhangyang Road. After exiting the station, he passed by Pushang Vegetable Market, but since he planned to do strength training in the evening, he did not go in to buy groceries and walked straight home in about 5 minutes.
location: Inside a Metro Line 2 train in Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Lujiazui Station to Zhangyang Road Station)

name: Family dinner and catching up on anime
description: When he got home, his parents had already prepared dinner. At the table, he shared funny stories about Shen Jie's visit to the store and his initial ideas for the coffee corner renovation. His father, Lei Jianguo, nodded as he listened, and his mother smiled and said she would go to the store tomorrow. After dinner, he helped clear the dishes, then rested on the living room sofa and caught up on the latest episode of Jujutsu Kaisen.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening novel writing and leisure.
description: Back in the bedroom, opened the laptop to update the novel "Afternoon in Xiafei Lane." Spending more than an hour, incorporating the feelings from the afternoon at Lujiazui Green, wrote a passage of about 600 characters of the protagonist's inner monologue while ordering at a lane café and observing pedestrians outside the window, with ideas flowing freely. Then browsed several billiards tutorial videos in preparation for possibly playing billiards with Dongzi on the weekend.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Routine strength training
description: He changed into a sports tank top and shorts and started the regular Thursday strength training on time. He laid out the yoga mat on the bedroom floor and carefully completed 3 sets of 12 squats, 3 sets of 10 slow push-ups (with the last few reps assisted by the wall), and 3 sets of planks, each held for 40 seconds. After the workout, he checked in on the fitness app, feeling slightly sweaty and energetic.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Late-night father-son talk on the balcony and emotional breakthrough
description: After taking a shower, he walked to the south balcony to enjoy the night breeze and found his father sitting alone in a rattan chair, holding black tea and gazing at the neon lights. He moved a small stool over and sat down beside him, and brought up that Shen Jie thought the coffee corner idea was quite trendy. His father took a slow sip of tea, opened up, and talked about his past in the state-owned factory, where he gave up a promotion opportunity to teach his apprentices hand by hand. He remarked that doing business is like practicing a craft: you have to hold on to your original heart. He admitted that he had initially worried about the risk of starting a business, but now watching the plans come together step by step, he felt that his son had truly grown and matured. A warm current surged in Lei Mingxuan's heart. He took his father's hand and said that in the future they should discuss important matters more. His father patted the back of his hand. The summer night breeze on the balcony was gentle, and the father-son relationship quietly warmed.
location: South balcony at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime reflection notes and falling asleep
description: Back in the room, lying in bed and reliving the conversation with my father, I felt a lot of emotion. I opened my phone's memo app and used voice recording to note down my thoughts: 'Dad talked about how he had once given up a promotion to teach an apprentice, and said that when starting a business, you must hold on to your original intention. I decided to write the theme "persistence and heritage" into "An Afternoon in Xiafei Lane" tomorrow.' After doing all this, I looked at the time, 23:45, turned off the light, and gradually fell asleep in a sense of steadiness and warmth.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake up, morning routine
description: The alarm went off at 8 a.m. After getting up, he weighed 79.2 kilograms and measured his waist circumference at 92 centimeters. It was drizzling outside and the temperature had dropped, so he changed into a long-sleeved T-shirt and a light jacket. After washing up, he went to the dining room. His mother Wang Xiuying had already made hot porridge, with pickled vegetables and fried eggs. His father Lei Jianguo was watching the morning news while eating breakfast and commented that the weather had become cooler. He had breakfast with his parents.
location: Home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and communication
description: Continued eating breakfast in the dining room, chatted with Father Lei Jianguo, and mentioned that he had arranged to have dinner with childhood friend Zhang Wei in the evening to discuss something, so he might come home late. Father told him to ride carefully in the rain, and Mother told him to bring an umbrella. After eating, he cleared the dishes and added cat food for the family's orange tabby A Fu.
location: Dining room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Shanggang Residential Area, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Contacting basketball buddies to confirm the Saturday basketball game
description: On the living room sofa, he opened the WeChat group chat Pudong Three Musketeers, @-mentioned Xie Fei and the other basketball buddies, and confirmed the 4-on-4 game at the outdoor basketball court of Yuanshen Sports Center on Saturday afternoon. Xie Fei immediately replied that he would take care of the court. Then he privately sent Zhang Wei a WeChat message to reconfirm meeting at the He Japanese restaurant in Lujiazui Center at 7 p.m. tonight. Zhang Wei replied with OK.
location: Living room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Shanggang Residential Community

name: Commute and Preparation
description: Putting on a waterproof shell jacket, he set off from home with his modified electric bike, rode 15 minutes in light rain to Super Brand Mall, parked the bike in the outdoor non-motor vehicle shed, swiped his employee card through the staff entrance, and went up to the store on the second floor.
location: Shanggang Residential Area, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area

name: Shop operations: stocking, new product launches, and customer maintenance
description: Arrived at 'Mingxuan Fashion', Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall. After opening the store, turned on the computer and logged into the backend system. Used a semi-dry cloth to wipe down the display area for the techwear vests that arrived two days ago, and took photos of the on-body effect to post on Moments and the VIP customer group. Replied via private message to regular customer Qian Duoduo, telling her that the XL cargo pants reserved for her had arrived today and that he had set aside a pair for her.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, 2F A-208, “Mingxuan Trendy Wear”

name: Lunch and inspiration gathering
description: At noon, he went to the "Super Bowl" restaurant on the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall and ordered a warm salad with pan-seared chicken breast for lunch. While eating, he used the Notes app on his phone to write a passage describing a rainy scene, as material for the novel "The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane" he was writing. After the meal, he strolled around the mall, observing people's outfits and looking for fashion inspiration.
location: Super Bowl Restaurant, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations: data analysis and customer reception
description: Returning to the store, during the quieter afternoon period, he opened the computer and organized the store's transaction records in an Excel spreadsheet for the past three months, extracting key data such as sales volume, average transaction value, and best-selling products for analysis. At around 14:00, a white-collar woman working nearby came in, hoping to find a casual suit suitable for commuting. Lei Ming paired her with the wide-leg suit trousers from the store, successfully completing an outfit sale.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, 2F A-208, “Mingxuan Trendy Wear”

name: Contact suppliers and work on novel writing
description: I contacted supplier Zhou Tao (Brother Tao) via WeChat to ask about the progress of last week's sample rework. Later, shop assistant Xiao Lin arrived for her shift, and Lei Ming handed over the store matters to her. After that, I opened my computer in the store and continued writing my novel The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane, writing about 900-plus words, mainly depicting the protagonist's mood on a rainy day. The writing went smoothly.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, 2F A-208, “Mingxuan Trendy Wear”

name: Closing preparations and departure
description: Organized the day's work notes in advance and sent goodnight messages to the VIP customer group. Packed up personal belongings, said goodbye to shop assistant Xiao Lin, and left the store ten minutes early to get ready for the appointment.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, 2F A-208, “Mingxuan Trendy Wear”

name: Evening walk and brainstorming before dinner
description: It was still early before the dinner appointment, and it was drizzling. Lei Ming decided to go to Lujiazui Central Green Park. Under the covered bridge in the park, he put on headphones to listen to music while thinking about the topics to discuss with Zhang Wei about the mixed-use project. With the green space in the rain and the three Lujiazui towers in the distance, he felt relaxed. At 18:00, after the rain stopped, he walked about 10 minutes to the restaurant.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dinner with Zhang Wei to discuss the mixed-use complex concept in detail
description: At the "Wa" Japanese restaurant in Lujiazui Center, he met with childhood friend Zhang Wei. They ordered the signature seafood rice bowl and a grilled platter, drinking sake as they ate. Lei Ming took out his phone memo and explained in detail to Zhang Wei his concept for a "coffee + trendy toys + clothing" complex, including using the northeast corner of the store to create a pour-over coffee bar, and inviting his cousin Shen Jie to co-operate the trendy toys section. After listening carefully, Zhang Wei did some calculations on a napkin, pointed out that the renovation would need at least 250,000 yuan, monthly operating costs would increase by 20,000 yuan, and daily sales would have to rise by 15% just to break even. He then asked Lei Ming how he could guarantee that growth. These words sobered Lei Ming considerably and made him think deeply.
location: Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant (“He” Japanese Cuisine), Lujiazui Center, No. 889 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shopping on the way and going home
description: After saying goodbye to Zhang Wei, he walked home. Passing by Yanqin Grocery Store at the intersection of Yuanshen Road and Zhangyang Road, he remembered that the tissues at home were almost used up, and planned to buy two dried fish snacks for the orange cat A Fu. Shopping in the store took about 10 minutes, then he continued walking home and arrived at 21:00. He greeted his parents, who were watching TV, and went to the balcony to add cat food for A Fu.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store at the intersection of Yuanshen Road and Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, then returned home to Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road.

name: Washing up and relaxing.
description: After a hot shower, changed into loungewear. In the bedroom, used the Xiaobudian app on his phone to record the day's steps, totaling more than 7,500. Brewed a strong cup of tea to stay alert for the upcoming overtime.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stayed up late sorting out financial data.
description: At the desk in his study, he opened his computer and pulled up the financial backup files for the whole year. In response to the questions Zhang Wei had raised at dinner, he began to go through the past year's sales records (by month and category), rent and utilities, purchasing costs, employee wages, and marketing expenses item by item. He reorganized and estimated the fixed and variable costs, and put together a quote list to consult with Lao Li from the renovation crew the next day. He was so focused throughout the process that he missed the daily check-in time for the Japanese-learning app.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Late-night wrap-up and planning for tomorrow.
description: It was already past midnight. Lei Ming looked at the data and sketches on his computer; his body was tired, but his mind was especially clear. After saving the files, he sent Zhang Wei a WeChat message: "Wei, I've finished sorting the data. Want to find some time tomorrow to keep talking?" Then he shut down the computer, stretched his neck, recorded his thoughts from the night, and turned off the light before heading back to his bedroom to sleep.
location: Study and bedroom at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community)

name: Getting Up and Daily Maintenance
description: The alarm went off, and Zhang Ming turned over and got up. He first added cat food for his pet cat Afu and watched it eat. Then he washed up and took a shower, washing away the fatigue of staying up late. He weighed himself at 79.4 kg, lighter than last night, and was in a good mood.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Fragmented information gathering
description: Zhang Ming brewed a cup of black coffee, leaned back on the sofa, and, while eating toast with peanut butter, scrolled through Xiaohongshu and Dianping. He searched for "average customer spending at coffee shops in the Lujiazui business district" and "Gen Z trendy toy consumption trends," saved a few analysis posts, and noted key data—"45-60 yuan per cup of coffee" and "35% repurchase rate for trendy toy blind boxes"—in his phone's memo app, gathering intelligence for his business plan.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organize financial notes
description: Zhang Ming sat at his desk, took out the handwritten profit flow draft from last night, opened the mobile bookkeeping app, and entered the core data for the store's past 12 months — average daily revenue, gross profit margin, fixed costs, and so on, which he had calculated late last night — into a new Excel spreadsheet to prepare for the business plan.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family interaction and outing preparations
description: When his parents came back from grocery shopping, Zhang Ming paused his work and chatted with them a bit. His father asked what time he went to bed last night, and he gave a vague answer. Then he went back to his room, changed into loose Nike basketball jersey and shorts, checked his sneakers and knee pads, and prepared his sports gear in advance.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday light meal
description: His mother made his favorite tomato and egg noodles and specially added a poached egg. Zhang Ming wolfed them down, replenishing carbohydrates to store energy for the afternoon ball game. While eating, he quickly browsed the afternoon's ballmates group chat on his phone, confirmed that Xie Fei, Zhang Wei, and others could all make it, and arranged to meet at the court.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going to Yuanshen Sports Center
description: Zhang Ming shouldered his sports bag, said goodbye to his parents, and drove from Pudong Avenue, turning onto Minsheng Road, then onto Zhangyang Road, arriving at Yuanshen Sports Center after about a 20-minute drive. He parked in the parking lot and walked straight to the outdoor basketball court.
location: Yuanshen Sports Center, 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Free warm-up and waiting for fellow players
description: Zhang Ming arrived earlier, and the two players who had arrived before him were already shooting baskets. He joined them, jogged two laps around the court, then did a set of stretches, and then practiced three-pointers and mid-range jump shots for 20 minutes. Zhang Wei, Xie Fei, and others arrived one after another. Everyone greeted each other and chatted briefly about last night's game.
location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: High-intensity team match
description: The six of them split into three teams and played pickup games to 21 points (winners stay). Zhang Ming felt full of energy, moved actively on offense, sank three three-pointers, and created several assists with drive-and-kick plays. During good teamwork, everyone high-fived and cheered, and the atmosphere was lively. During the game he finished a whole bottle of sports drink and, during a break, told Xie Fei that he hoped the shop would open a coffee bar in the future and that Xie Fei should come and support it. Xie Fei agreed with a smile, while Zhang Wei reminded him to first calculate the payback period for the 250,000-yuan renovation cost.
location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-match exit and recovery.
description: After the match ended, everyone was drenched in sweat. Zhang Ming and his teammates wiped off sweat with towels on the sideline and drank some water. They agreed to go eat at a familiar barbecue restaurant nearby, packed up their gear, and set off on foot.
location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking to the barbecue restaurant
description: Zhang Ming and his basketball buddies walked along Laoshan Road for about 10 minutes. On the way, Xie Fei joked with Zhang Ming, saying that since his family was about to open a coffee shop, could they make a 'buddies-only limited edition'?
location: Laoshan Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Post-match dinner and sharing of ideas
description: We found a long table at the Northeastern barbecue restaurant under the bridge. Zhang Ming ordered grilled lamb skewers, grilled squid, chicken wings, chives, and a few bottles of ice-cold beer. As we ate and chatted, the conversation gradually shifted from the game's highlights to Zhang Ming's shop plan. He took a sip of beer and explained in detail his idea of transforming the store into a 'streetwear + designer toys + specialty coffee' complex, including a 250,000 yuan renovation cost and an additional 20,000 yuan in monthly operating costs. Xie Fei got excited and said he would come to the store for coffee and buy a blind box on the side; Zhang Wei reminded him to calculate the payback period carefully. Zhang Ming nodded seriously and said that was exactly his motivation for collecting data, and joked that once the plan was written up, Zhang Wei would be the first venture capital advisor. The two clinked glasses and drank heartily.
location: Under-the-Bridge Northeast Barbecue (Laoshan Road Branch), No. 255 Laoshan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking back to pick up the car
description: After the dinner gathering, Zhang Ming said goodbye to his ball friends and walked back alone to the Yuanshen Sports Center parking lot to help digest the meal.
location: Laoshan Road to No. 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Driving home
description: Zhang Ming drove home along Zhangyang Road, turned onto Minsheng Road, and then Pudong Avenue. On the way, music played on the car radio. He was in a good mood, feeling that the afternoon exercise and socializing had significantly eased last night's anxiety.
location: Roads in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home to relax and having dinner
description: Zhang Ming got home, took a shower to wash off the sweat and smell, and changed into clean loungewear. His mother had already prepared dinner: braised pork ribs, stir-fried water spinach, and tomato-and-egg soup. He sat down and enjoyed a comfortable meal with his parents, chatting about amusing moments from the afternoon's ball game, but he didn't bring up the store renovation again.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing the first draft of the business plan.
description: Zhang Ming returned to his study, opened his laptop, and integrated the report screenshots collected during the day about the average customer spend at nearby coffee shops and art toy brand trends, along with the financial data entered in the morning, into a new PowerPoint. He also built a preliminary profit-and-loss calculation model based on the “payback period” question raised by Zhang Wei, setting up the skeleton of the business plan.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening chores and relaxation
description: Zhang Ming got up to pour a glass of water, then opened a can of food for his pet cat Afu as a late-night snack. He sat on the sofa, watching Afu eat while scrolling through Bilibili on his phone to relax with funny videos.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Japanese study check-in and pre-bedtime preparation
description: Zhang Ming remembered that he had forgotten to do his Japanese check-in last night, so he opened the Duolingo app and spent 15 minutes completing the day's study tasks. After washing up, he lay in bed and used his iPad to watch two episodes of an anime he had not finished before, and gradually felt sleepy.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rest
description: Zhang Ming turned off the lights and electronic devices. The day had been fulfilling and well-paced; anxiety dissolved through action, and the new business plan had taken initial shape. With expectations for the future, he soon fell asleep.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation and cycling to the riverfront.
