description: He woke up naturally in the morning, weighed 79.2 kg, changed into a quick-dry T-shirt, athletic shorts, and neon green roller skates, and put on knee pads and wrist guards. He stuffed a bottle of water, an energy gel, and his phone into his waist pack, then rode a shared bike east along Pudong Avenue toward Pudong Riverside Promenade. The morning breeze was cool. He arrived in about 15 minutes, parked the bike, and did a set of dynamic warm-ups to fully activate his body.
location: Pudong Riverside Avenue (Lujiazui Section), Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Inline skating date with Song Jia along the river
description: Song Jia showed up on time, wearing a black speed skating suit. The two skated east from Lujiazui. The first 5 kilometers had a tailwind, so they skated fast while chatting. Song Jia mentioned an amateur inline skating invitational next weekend and asked whether to form a team. At the Houtan rest stop, they sat on a riverside bench, drank water, and reapplied sunscreen spray. Lei Mingxuan showed her the designer toy designs he had saved in his phone and shared his idea of turning the store into a streetwear + designer toys + coffee complex. Song Jia thought it was cool and recommended a select shop in Hangzhou. After a 10-minute rest, they turned back the same way. In the second half, they adjusted their pace against the headwind and completed the full route of about 10.2 km at 8:10.
location: Pudong Riverside Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Lujiazui section to Houtan section)

name: Breakfast gathering at a café after roller skating.
description: After skating until they were drenched in sweat, the two strolled to the "Riverside Moment" café by the river. Lei Mingxuan ordered an iced Americano and a whole-wheat chicken panini, while Song Jia got a flat white. As they ate, they reviewed the skating route and talked about the camping equipment project Song Jia's company had been working on recently. Song Jia invited him to join next week's night skate along the Bund. Lei Mingxuan said he would definitely go if time allowed.
location: The "Riverside Moment" Café, Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycled home and rested.
description: He rode a shared bike from the coffee shop, braving the sun that was starting to get a bit strong, and arrived home in 10 minutes. He took a warm shower and changed into clean loungewear. He added cat food and water for his pet cat Afu, who circled around his ankles rubbing against them. While at it, he threw the quick-dry shirt, sports shorts, and other gear from the morning's roller skating into the washing machine.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Take the car for maintenance and inspection.
description: Drove to Shanghai Chejiang Auto Care Center, handed the car to mechanic He Zhiqiang, and asked for a full-vehicle inspection covering oil, brake pads, tires, air conditioning filter, etc., to prepare for the end-of-month self-driving trip to western Sichuan. Master He readily agreed, raised the car, and got to work. Lei Mingxuan sat in the rest area drinking tea, replied to several WeChat messages from store customers on his phone, and browsed a few outdoor gear review videos on Bilibili.
location: Shanghai Chejiang Auto Maintenance Center, Zikang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking home and family lunch
description: After confirming with He Zhiqiang to pick up the car around 3 p.m., I walked home, about 1.5 kilometers, with dense plane tree shade along the road. Passing the fruit stall at the entrance of the residential community, I saw the newly arrived Wuxi honey peaches looked good, so I bought a few jin to give my parents a taste. When I got home, I smelled the aroma of braised pork and had lunch with my father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying. Lei Mingxuan vividly described his stroll along the river with Song Jia. My father asked about car maintenance, and upon hearing that the car had been sent for maintenance and that a self-driving trip to western Sichuan was planned, he urged safety first and said the route had to be well planned.
location: Home and surrounding area, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Midday nap
description: After eating and drinking well, he returned to the room, drew the curtains, and set a 30-minute alarm. Having gone to bed late the night before and done aerobic exercise in the morning, he felt drowsy and soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon wake-up and systematic planning for the western Sichuan road trip
description: After the alarm went off, I sat up to clear my head, went to the kitchen, cut a few pieces of iced watermelon, and brought them to the study. I turned on the computer, prepared markers, a notebook, and a phone charger, brewed a cup of strong tea, and officially started the Western Sichuan travel guide. First, I designed the route, deciding on the 'Western Sichuan Small Loop Plus' with Chengdu as the starting point, passing through Kangding, Xinduqiao, Tagong Grassland, Seda, Ganzi, Litang, and Daocheng Yading, then returning to Chengdu, for a total of 8 days. Next, I marked core attractions on the mobile map, including Yuzixi Starry Sky Campground, Moshi Park, Seda Wuming Buddhist Academy, Letong Ancient Town, and the Daocheng Yading Scenic Area, optimizing the route to avoid crowded spots. Finally, I made a detailed supply list in an Excel spreadsheet, including vehicle supplies, high-altitude medicine, outdoor equipment, etc. At the same time, I saved featured guesthouses in Daocheng and Seda on Ctrip, focusing on ones with parking lots and underfloor heating.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Picking up the vehicle.
description: After finishing most of the planning, he walked to Shanghai Chejiang Auto Care Center to pick up the car. He Zhiqiang handed over the list and said the car was in good condition: the oil and oil filter were changed, the cabin filter was a bit dirty so it was also replaced, the brake pads could still last about ten thousand kilometers, and everything was fine. He also topped up the windshield washer fluid and checked the tire pressure. The total was 850 yuan. Lei Mingxuan quickly transferred the money via WeChat and drove home.
location: Shanghai Chejiang Auto Maintenance Center, Zikang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wrap-up guide, exercise and relaxation, and family dinner
description: After returning home, Lei Mingxuan gathered the information compiled in the afternoon into the same folder and wrote a summary in his phone memo: “8-day trip, total driving mileage about 2,200 kilometers, averaging about 300 kilometers per day; core visits to Danba Tibetan Village, Seda night view, Litang Changqing Chunke'er Temple, and hiking in Daocheng Yading; budget about 12,000 yuan per person.” Then he picked up dumbbells and did 3 sets of simple stretches and shoulder activation in the study to relieve the soreness from sitting too long. Later, he had dinner with his parents. The meal was steamed sea bass, garlic water spinach, and tomato egg soup. Lei Mingxuan showed his parents the planned western Sichuan route and diagrams, explaining the daily itinerary. His father, wearing reading glasses, reminded him to be careful about altitude sickness when crossing Zheduo Mountain and to bring enough oxygen canisters; his mother told him not to forget to bring thick clothes.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stroll around the neighborhood with Father
description: After dinner, I accompanied my father Lei Jianguo downstairs and strolled around the community to help digest the meal. It had cooled off a bit on that late summer evening. In the central garden, we ran into Aunt Zhu Xiuying, a neighbor, who was walking her Bichon Frise. When Aunt Zhu heard that Lei Mingxuan was going to drive to western Sichuan, she smiled and asked him to take lots of photos for her. Father and son walked and chatted, and my father talked about his days of technical innovation at the factory. Time seemed to slow down.
location: Shanggang Community Garden, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Evening recharge and self-improvement
description: After the walk, took a comfortable hot shower, put on a loose T-shirt, and returned to the study. Printed out the detailed itinerary made in the afternoon and marked several key supply points and gas stations with a red pen. Then watched two guide videos on Bilibili, “10 Essentials for Self-Driving in Western Sichuan” and “How to Prevent Altitude Sickness,” and noted the useful information in his memo. Afu jumped onto the desk and curled up next to the computer to keep him company. Finally, he scrolled through outdoor outfit bloggers on Xiaohongshu and saved looks that were both stylish and practical for long road trips, thinking they could provide inspiration for the clothing store's product selection when he returned.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Japanese study and pre-sleep relaxation.
description: Opened the Duolingo app, completed today’s Japanese check-in, and reviewed verb forms and the past tense. After that, opened Netflix and watched an episode of the third season of the travel documentary “Planet Earth” about alpine meadows, as cultural preparation for a road trip in western Sichuan.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep journaling and preparing to fall asleep
description: Putting down his phone, he picked up the journal by the bed and jotted down: '10K roller skating done, first draft of the western Sichuan guide complete.' Then he wrote the keywords for tomorrow: 'Monday, open the store. Handle online orders in the morning, and follow up on that new batch of goods from Sister Fang.' Then he checked the doors and windows, gave A Fu a little late-night snack, turned off the light, and lay down. He went over the western Sichuan itinerary in his mind once more, feeling fulfilled and full of anticipation, and soon fell asleep to the gentle breeze and the soft hum of the air conditioner.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Get up, wash up, and have breakfast
description: The alarm went off in the morning, and it was gloomy outside. After staying in bed for five minutes, he got up and washed up. He weighed himself and saw 79.5 kg, slightly lighter than yesterday. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had already prepared soy milk and pan-fried pork buns for breakfast. While eating, he checked the inquiry messages from regular customers last night on his phone and thought about the important things he needed to do today.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rode an electric bicycle to the East Branch of Renji Hospital
description: After breakfast, changed into a comfortable T-shirt and sweatpants, brought a light jacket in case of thundershowers, and rode my e-bike from home to the East Branch of Renji Hospital. The morning breeze was cool, and I arrived at the hospital about 15 minutes later.
location: Along the route from Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the East Branch of Renji Hospital, No. 160 Pujian Road.

name: Hospital blood draw follow-up and handling online work.
description: Arrived at the physical examination center at the East Campus of Renji Hospital, and after a short wait in line, had blood drawn. Then he sat down in the waiting area and handled work via WeChat: first replying to several clients' inquiries about sizes and styling advice, then sending a voice message to Guangzhou supplier Wu Fang to ask about photos of the new sample products, and then confirming with regular customer Qian Duoduo the time she would come to the store on the weekend to see the new arrivals.
location: Health Examination Center, Renji Hospital (East Campus), Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, No. 160 Pujian Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return to the shop, open up, and handle store tasks.
description: After leaving the hospital, he rode his electric scooter back to Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall. After opening the door, he turned on the air conditioner, re-hung the clothes that had been covered with dust covers, ironed a few wrinkled shirts, and counted the inventory of best-selling styles. Then he sent a WeChat message to the property manager Zheng Kai to schedule a meeting that afternoon about the store renovation. Zheng Kai replied to meet at the property office at 3:30 PM.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Had lunch at Super Brand Mall food court.
description: Feeling hungry after a busy morning, he went to the food court on the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall and chose a newly opened mala xiangguo restaurant. He ordered broccoli, chicken breast, and mushrooms with less oil and salt, along with a bowl of rice, and ate until about 70% full. While eating, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu to keep up with recent outfit trends.
location: Food court, B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Staying at the store and sketching out renovation ideas.
description: After lunch, back at the store, customer flow was sparse during the midday break. I took out A3 paper and a pencil, recalled the ideas discussed with friends earlier, and began sketching a store renovation plan: on the drawing, place the coffee bar on the south side, reserve a lounge area with bar stools by the window, move the original display shelves northward, leaving a wider aisle to the fitting room. Mark dimensions, socket locations, and electrical load, and circle the fire escape area in red pen.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pick up the health check report and receive the doctor's health warnings.
description: In the afternoon, he rode his bike again to the East Branch of Renji Hospital, picked up his physical examination report, and went into the consultation room. A serious middle-aged Dr. Li pointed at the arrows on the report and said his blood lipids were still elevated, warning that if he still did not step up his exercise, it could develop into moderate fatty liver disease. That remark made Lei Zhen feel heavy-hearted, and he resolved on the spot to truly start working out.
location: Consulting room, Renji Hospital (East Campus), affiliated with Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine, 160 Pujian Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buy coffee and discuss the renovation matters with the property manager
description: After leaving the hospital, I felt heavy-hearted. Passing by the Starbucks on the first floor of Super Brand Mall, I went in and bought an extra-large iced Americano without sugar. I brought the coffee back to the store, stayed for a bit, and then went to the mall’s property management office. I spread out the renovation sketch I had drawn in the morning and showed it to the property manager, Zheng Kai, explaining in detail the coffee bar’s power requirements and the plan for reserving the fire-exit route. Zheng Kai looked it over carefully and pointed out places that needed adjustment, such as the routing of the drainage pipes, but he agreed to the renovation in principle and asked me to submit a formal renovation application.
location: Starbucks and property management office, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Revising the renovation sketches and handling online orders
description: After returning to the store, I revised the sketch details based on Zheng Kai's suggestions. Then I focused on processing the accumulated online orders for the day, packing products, printing shipping labels, and contacting the courier for pickup. In the afternoon, customer traffic gradually increased, and I also received two groups of customers, successfully selling one new jacket.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycled home after work.
description: After tidying up the items in the store and confirming that the power and the roller shutter door were both off, he rode his electric bike home. The sky was getting dark, and it felt like it might rain at any moment, so he sped up to get home before the rain.
location: Along the route from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Family dinner
description: When he got home, his mother Wang Xiuying had already made steamed sea bass, stir-fried greens, and tomato egg soup. His father Lei Jianguo asked about the physical exam results. Lei Zhen truthfully said his blood lipids were still high and the doctor had advised him to exercise more. His father sighed and reminded him that health is the foundation of everything. To ease the mood, Lei Zhen changed the subject to the store renovation plan, and his father's brow gradually relaxed.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Played billiards with friend Han Dong
description: After dinner, he cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks, then sent a WeChat message to his friend Han Dong to meet at their usual spot. At World Square Billiards Hall, he rented an American eight-ball pool table. While playing, he told Han Dong about how the doctor had warned him during today's physical exam. Han Dong cracked jokes, and the two chatted and laughed, easing the stress through a relaxed game of pool.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Write the first draft of the business plan
description: After playing billiards, he went home, took a shower, then walked into the study and turned on his computer to formally start writing the business plan for the "trendy apparel + trendy toys + coffee" complex. Referring to the PPT he had made earlier, he entered the vision, target customer groups, market analysis, operational strategies, and financial forecasts including a 250,000 yuan renovation cost and a monthly increase of 20,000 yuan in costs, item by item into the document. His thoughts were clear and progress was good. He wrote until after 10 p.m., saved the document, and set an alarm for 6 a.m. the next day.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bed stretching and relaxation
description: After turning off the computer, lay out the yoga mat on the floor and do a full-body stretch for 15 minutes, especially to loosen up the neck, shoulders, and lower back tension caused by cycling and long periods of sitting. Then brush your teeth and wash up, and place the sportswear for the next day by the bedside.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading before bed and going to sleep
description: Lying in bed, he read a few WeChat public account articles about trendy toy displays in stores on his phone. Gradually feeling sleepy, he set his phone to Do Not Disturb mode, turned off the light, and fell asleep peacefully, looking forward to tomorrow morning's jog and the store renovation.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: First morning run and planning the evening schedule.
description: The alarm clock rang at 5:50 in the morning. After changing into quick-dry clothes, Lei Mingxuan jogged from the residential complex to Lujiazui Central Green Park, about 3.5 kilometers in total. He used the Keep app to record his pace and heart rate and listened to a podcast while running. After arriving at the park, he stretched and relaxed on a bench while planning the evening's novel writing time on his phone memo, settling on 21:00 to 23:00 for updating the novel, setting a self-disciplined tone for the new day.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning strength training
description: After running home and resting briefly, he spread out a yoga mat on the bedroom floor and did simple fat-burning strength training. It included bodyweight squats, 3 sets of 12 reps, slow push-ups, 3 sets of 10 reps, and planks, 3 sets of 45 seconds. The movements were standard, with focus on tightening the core. After finishing, he took a shower and felt refreshed.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and store renovation preparation
description: After showering, I went downstairs and had breakfast with my parents. Mother had prepared vegetable rice soup, fermented tofu, fried dough sticks, and poached eggs; Father was watching the morning news. While eating, I discussed the clothing store renovation with Father, and he advised me to be steady. After breakfast, I went back to my room and put the renovation sketches, draft budget, and key communication points into a kraft paper bag. Then in the study, I looked over the sketches again, marked the fire escape route with a red pen, and checked the preliminary budget of about 250,000 yuan. Finally, I put on my backpack, grabbed the e-bike keys, and left, fully prepared for the meeting at the mall.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling commute and buying things on the way
description: Rode the electric scooter along Pudong Avenue to Super Brand Mall. On the way, I made a brief stop at the FamilyMart at the Minsheng Road intersection to buy unsweetened oolong tea and a sandwich as a snack. About 15 minutes later, I arrived at Super Brand Mall, parked at the ground-level non-motor vehicle spot, entered through the staff passage, and prepared to meet property manager Zheng Kai.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Discussing the renovation plan with the property manager.
description: Arrived at the property management office on the basement level of Super Brand Mall ten minutes early, and gave Property Manager Zheng Kai a detailed introduction to the store renovation plan, including the layout of the coffee experience area and the design for a seamless connection with the clothing display area. Zheng Kai specifically asked about electrical load and smoke exhaust, emphasized that fire escape routes must not be occupied, and set time restrictions on construction noise. The two sides agreed to keep the construction period within two weeks and aim to finish before National Day. Zheng Kai helped contact the mall's registered renovation team and put Lin Feng in direct contact to simplify the approval process.

participant.name: Zheng Kai
participant.relation: Property manager of Super Brand Mall

location: Property management office, B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Contact the renovation crew
description: After leaving the property management office, found a seat in the mall atrium and called Wang, the head of the renovation team. After explaining that he was recommended by Manager Zheng Kai, Wang readily agreed to come to the store at 10 a.m. the next day for measurements and to discuss quote details on site. After the call, Lin Feng felt a weight off his shoulders and became more confident about the renovation progress.
location: Rest area, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and work record
description: The morning's work was efficient, so he rewarded himself with a steaming bowl of Chaoshan beef kway teow, with beef balls and blanched lettuce on the side. While eating, he didn't forget to record in his phone's notes app the specific requirements Zheng Kai raised regarding fire safety, construction access, and noise hours, as well as the contact information of Lao Wang from the renovation crew, so that he could refine the application materials back at the shop in the afternoon.
location: Chaoshan Beef Kway Teow Shop, B1 floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return to the store to process orders and refine renovation materials
description: Returning to Shop A-208 on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, he first turned on the air conditioner and put up the open sign to start business. In the afternoon, customer traffic was light, so he browsed industry news while processing 3 online orders, packing and shipping them, and contacting a courier for pickup. Then, at the cashier counter, he opened his laptop to integrate property management feedback and refine the formal application materials for the store renovation. Meanwhile, regular customer Qian Duoduo came to the store, tried on a new printed T-shirt and bought it on the spot, and chatted with Lin Feng about the future coffee bar plan, saying she was looking forward to it.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon strength training and cardio.
description: After packing up my computer, I asked the shop assistant next door to look after the store, then rode an electric bike for a few minutes to the gym at Standard Chartered Bank Tower. After changing, I did consolidation training for the back (lat pulldown, seated row) and biceps (dumbbell curl), all for 4 sets of 12 reps with 1 minute rest between sets. After training, I added 20 minutes of cycling cardio to reinforce the morning workout.
location: Gym at Standard Chartered Bank Building, 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and progress sharing.
description: After the gym, I rode the e-bike straight home. As soon as I got in, I put the dirty clothes in the washing machine. Mom had prepared scallion-braised pork chops, stir-fried water spinach, and tomato egg drop soup. At the dinner table, I reported to my parents on today's progress: I had reached an agreement with the property management, and the renovation crew would come tomorrow to take measurements. Dad reminded me to move forward steadily, while Mom, feeling sorry for me, kept adding food to my bowl and urging me to eat more.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening family walk
description: After the meal, he took the initiative to accompany his parents downstairs to Lujiazui Central Green Park for a walk. The three of them walked two laps along the path. He showed his parents the store renovation sketches on his phone. His mother didn't quite understand but praised her son for having a good head on his shoulders, while his father offered a few suggestions on optimizing the traffic flow; though not professional, they were pertinent and practical.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Write a business plan.
description: After walking home and washing up, I went into the study and started writing the business plan for the store upgrade. I analyzed the homogeneous competition facing the clothing store, elaborated on the advantages of a trendy clothing + designer toys + specialty coffee complex, cited the average transaction value data collected at the Lujiazui coffee shop last week, and imported the financial data into Excel to build a break-even analysis model. Ideas flowed like a spring.
location: Study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Update urban supernatural novel
description: Following the morning plan, he closed the business plan document on time and switched to the novel draft. He focused on writing more than 4,000 characters, completing a fight scene conceived yesterday, and felt he was in good form. After writing, he posted the new chapter to the novel forum and replied to several reader comments to stay engaged with online readers.
location: Study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and preparation before bed
description: After shutting down the computer and finishing washing up, he lay in bed scrolling through short videos and Moments. He saw his friend Han Dong's check-in at a billiards hall, and liked and interacted with it. After confirming that Lao Wang from the renovation crew would arrive at the store at 10 a.m. the next day for measurements, he put down his phone at 10:30, put on his sleep mask, and got ready to sleep, ending a fulfilling day.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run workout and park check-in
description: At 6:15 in the morning, the alarm went off. Lei Mingxuan got up without hesitation, changed into workout clothes, and jogged along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui Central Green Park. He opened his workout app to track, ran two laps around the outer loop of the park, a total of 3 kilometers, in 20 minutes, at a pace of 6 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer, 5 seconds faster than the day before, and felt his cardiovascular fitness improving. After the run, while cooling down, he took a selfie of the park in the morning light and sent it to the WeChat group named 'Pudong Three Musketeers' with the caption 'Day 2 check-in, setting a flag first!' Then he walked home, took a shower, and started the new day feeling refreshed.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and casual chat
description: After taking a shower, Lei Mingxuan went to the dining room, where his mother, Wang Xiuying, had already set out steaming white porridge, fried eggs, and pickled vegetables. He sat down and, while eating, told his parents that the renovation crew would come to the store to take measurements in the morning, and if all went well, construction could start next week. His father, Lei Jianguo, put down his phone and carefully confirmed the budget and schedule with him. His mother reminded him that it was Wednesday and the market had fresh river shrimp; she would buy some after work to make oil-braised shrimp for dinner. The family finished breakfast in a warm and harmonious atmosphere.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling commute and store opening preparation.
description: Lei Mingxuan put on his helmet, hopped on his e-bike, and rode along Pudong Avenue toward Lujiazui. A dozen or so minutes later, he arrived at the employee parking area of Super Brand Mall. After entering the store, he deftly rolled up the shutter door, turned on the air conditioner, and checked the previous day's sales data. Then, using last night's order records, he packed three express packages and waited for the SF Express courier to pick them up. After the courier collected the packages, he sat back down at the cash register, opened the "Renovation Requirements List" memo on his phone, and added the key points of the fire safety renovation that he had discussed with Zheng Kai the previous night. He also searched for several reference images of a "back bar glass rack" based on the suggestion he had heard at the whisky bar and saved them to his photo album. He organized all the materials and prepared for the next important matter.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning in-store work and on-site measurement by the renovation crew.
description: With an hour to go before opening, Lei Mingxuan used this quiet time to do several things: he sent a WeChat message to his childhood friend Zhang Wei, arranging to play billiards at World Square Billiards Hall on Thursday afternoon, and @-mentioned Han Dong to finalize a four-person game; he turned on his computer and organized the snippets he had heard the night before at the alley entrance from the 'old ladies' mahjong game' (such as 'Aiya, I pong!' and 'What are you in a hurry for?') into a document, accumulating material for his novel The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane; he pulled out the draft business plan and sorted out the data source directory for the financial forecasts he needed to fill in that afternoon. At 10:00, Lao Li, the head of the renovation crew, and his assistant Xiao Liu arrived at the store on time. Lei Mingxuan greeted them warmly, took out the printed renovation requirements list and hand-drawn sketch, and pointed at the left wall inside the store, explaining: 'From here to the window, partition off an area of about 8 square meters as a coffee experience area, with the bar counter set by the window... Water supply and drainage need to be reserved here, and the circuit needs a separate 4-square-millimeter wire pulled from the mall's electrical panel.' Lao Li carefully measured every dimension with a laser rangefinder while Xiao Liu took notes beside him. The two sides communicated for more than an hour over details such as coffee machine drainage and custom bar counter. Finally, Lao Li gave a preliminary handwritten budget, and the total was about the same as Zheng Kai's estimate. Lei Mingxuan was satisfied and agreed to sign the formal contract tomorrow.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and coffee market information collection.
description: After seeing off the renovation crew, Lei Mingxuan felt hungry. He had intended to go straight to his usual Chaoshan beef kway teow shop, but remembering that he wanted to gather inspiration for the coffee bar, he walked about five minutes and turned into the Japanese ramen shop at IFC Mall, where he ordered a bowl of the signature tonkotsu ramen. While waiting, he opened Dianping, searched for 'Lujiazui coffee shop,' quickly browsed several stores specializing in signature coffee drinks, and focused on their cup designs and drink names, sketching out the coffee menu for his own store in his mind. After finishing the noodles, he stopped by the Starbucks at Super Brand Mall on the way and redeemed an unsweetened iced Americano with points, drinking it as he walked back to the store.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant at IFC Mall, Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Minding the store, writing, and resting before exercise
description: In the afternoon, there were not many customers in the shop, so Lei Mingxuan put on his earphones, opened his laptop, and began seriously working on the financial forecast section of his business plan. He called up the backend sales data, imported the past year's sales, costs, and profits into Excel, and built a break-even model together with the coffee bar investment budget, estimating the gross margin and payback period of the new model. Midway through, a regular customer, Qian Duoduo, came by the shop. Lei Mingxuan paused his work to chat with her about the new outfit video she had made, and asked her for suggestions on the coffee bar that could be quickly assembled and dismantled. Qian Duoduo said: “Boss, you definitely need cups that look good in photos, and you could also add some low-fat light meals.” Her ideas inspired Lei Mingxuan, and he immediately wrote them down on his phone. He kept working until nearly 4 p.m., and when he felt his lower back was stiff, he got up, walked around the shop, and checked the displays. Then he took his sports bag out of the storage locker, changed into a quick-dry tank top and athletic shorts, and said hello to the girl selling milk tea next door before going out.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Back strength training
description: Lei Mingxuan walked to the Standard Chartered Bank Tower and entered the gym using facial recognition. Today's goal was to strengthen his back. He completed 4 sets of pull-ups (assisted by a machine), 4 sets of seated rows, and 3 sets of single-arm dumbbell rows. After strength training, he rode a spinning bike for 15 minutes as cardio, with his heart rate steady at around 145. After exercising, he felt completely refreshed, and his fatigue was swept away.
location: Gym at Standard Chartered Bank Building, 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-work cycling and errands on the way
description: After leaving the gym, Lei Mingxuan returned to the store, changed into dry clothes, and rode home on his electric scooter with his sports bag on it. On the way, he stopped at the FamilyMart branch on Pudong Avenue at the entrance to his neighborhood and bought a large bottle of Suntory oolong tea and a bag of corn chips to refuel for the evening's writing.
location: FamilyMart convenience store near Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Family dinner and home renovation progress update.
description: When Lei Mingxuan arrived home, the aroma of oil-blasted shrimp was already wafting from the kitchen. At the dinner table, he excitedly shared the important progress with his parents: "I've settled it with Old Li. We can start next week! I've drawn the blueprint for my coffee bar. After the renovation, our little shop will look much more stylish!" His father Lei Jianguo said, "Good, just make sure you calculate your accounts clearly." His mother Wang Xiuying handed him a bowl of fish soup and said with concern, "Have some soup. Look how busy you've been." The three of them ate and chatted, and the conversation shifted from the shop renovation to his father's old comrade-in-arms coming to Shanghai next weekend.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening plan refinement and material organization
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan returned to his study and turned on the computer. He first further refined the financial forecasting model he had built at the store that afternoon, adding the two key variables of 'coffee raw material cost' and 'additional labor' to make the profit-and-loss analysis more realistic. Then he opened the writing notes for Afternoon at Xiafei Fang and jotted down the 'light meal idea' Qian Duoduo had mentioned, thinking about how to weave such modern elements into the novel. Finally, he searched a secondhand platform for 'vintage coffee cup ornaments' and picked up a Showa-style small plate, planning to use it as decoration in the store later.
location: Study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel writing and interaction with book friends
description: Lei Mingxuan made a cup of hot tea, turned off phone notifications, and opened his writing software to continue working on The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane. Inspired by the alleyway mahjong game materials he had sorted through that afternoon, he vividly described how the protagonist observed the ways of the world at the mahjong table, and used this to deftly resolve a neighborhood dispute. His creative flow surged, and he wrote nearly 3,000 words in one sitting. At 22:30 he published the new chapter to the fiction forum and replied one by one to the several readers who had commented on the first two chapters, thanking them for their encouragement.
location: Study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wind-down relaxation and planning for tomorrow
description: Lei Mingxuan stretched and turned off the computer. He washed up first, then did a 15-minute full-body stretch with a foam roller, focusing on relaxing his back, which had been trained that day, and his waist, which had been sitting for a long time in the afternoon. After lying down in bed, he opened WeChat and saw that Zhang Wei and Han Dong had both replied, confirming the billiards game at World Plaza Billiards Hall tomorrow at 4:30 PM. He also set an alarm for 6:15 the next morning and added two reminders on his calendar: “Billiards” and “Sign Contract”.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: Lei Mingxuan turned off the bedside lamp and set his phone to silent. He looked back on this busy but fulfilling day: he had kept up his morning run, taken a substantial step in the store renovation, made progress on the business plan, and received fan feedback on his novel. Looking forward to tomorrow, he soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning weight log
description: Lei Mingxuan was woken by the alarm clock and got up immediately. He stepped on the scale and weighed 79.0 kg, with his waist circumference down 1 cm. As usual, he updated the four-week weight and waist measurement chart on the whiteboard, took a photo, and sent it to his friend Zhang Wei to share his weight-loss results. He received a teasing reply from Zhang Wei. He checked his condition in the mirror and felt satisfied with his energy and spirit today.
location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Morning run and strength training
description: Lei Mingxuan rode his e-bike to Century Park, arrived at the lakeside running track at 6:35, and completed a 3 km morning run at a pace of 6:20 per kilometer. Then he did strength training in the park pavilion: squats 3 sets of 12 reps, push-ups 3 sets of 10 reps, and planks 3 sets of 45 seconds, recording the whole session with the Keep app.
location: Lakeside running track and pavilion, Century Park, No. 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home for breakfast and chatting with family.
description: Lei Mingxuan rode his e-bike home at 7:20. After taking a shower, he enjoyed the breakfast his mother had prepared: boiled eggs and milk oatmeal porridge. During the meal, he told his mother that the store renovation plan had been finalized that morning and that they would sign the contract the next day. His mother reminded him to watch his expenses. In his mind, he was calculating the issue of the coffee bar potentially exceeding the budget.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: Lei Mingxuan left home on his e-bike at 8:00, arrived at Super Brand Mall at 8:10, parked the bike, and opened the store at 8:15. He first turned on the computer and the POS terminal and exported the previous night's online orders. Then he adjusted the shelf displays, hanging the newly arrived mountain-style shell jackets in a prominent spot and spraying them with waterproof spray to enhance the texture.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, from the B2 parking garage to Shop A-208 on the 2nd floor

name: Designing back-to-school season activity plans and communicating with suppliers
description: Lei Mingxuan used his MacBook and MarginNote in the store to refine the proposal for the 'mountain-style functional clothing + stationery and designer toy co-branded gift box'. The gift box theme was set to 'Mountain-style new semester, full functionality on'. He contacted supplier Wang Lei on WeChat, sent the accessory list and design drawings, and requested a quote. At the same time, he sent a voice message to Sister Ding, the Hangzhou coffee bean supplier, asking for samples and quotes for two tasting beans, Colombian Huila and Ethiopian Yirgacheffe. The samples were to be sent to the store by SF Express expedited delivery and were expected to arrive tomorrow. He recorded the key points of the communication in the memo app on his phone.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Staying at the store, receiving customers, and handling online orders
description: In the morning, customers kept coming to the store. Lei Mingxuan greeted them while replying to suppliers on WeChat. Regular customer Qian Duoduo took a liking to the mountain-style jacket, and Lei Mingxuan paired it with cargo pants. After trying it on, Qian Duoduo was full of praise and voluntarily signed up for the beta test of the "Mountain-Style Back-to-School" gift box, reserving two sets. Meanwhile, Lei Mingxuan also packed and affixed shipping labels for three online orders.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and inspiration gathering
description: Lei Mingxuan locked the store door, walked about 10 minutes to Wagas on B1 of the International Finance Center, and ordered a Thai Bowl shrimp salad and pineapple coconut water. While eating, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu and Douyin, observing other stores' back-to-school activities for inspiration and taking notes.
location: Wagas, LG1 Floor, Shanghai ifc Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store duty and risk analysis for the business plan
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to the store at 13:15. There were not many customers in the afternoon, so he brewed a cup of drip-bag coffee to refresh himself and focused on improving the "Risk Analysis and Countermeasures" and "Financing Plan" sections of the business plan, with emphasis on contingency plans for lower-than-expected foot traffic or coffee business losses after the renovation. He felt the logic was rigorous.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went to the pool hall and checked the contract.
description: Before leaving at 16:00, Lei Mingxuan first checked the renovation contract to be signed tomorrow, put the documents away after confirming everything was correct, changed into his sneakers, and walked about 31 minutes from Super Brand Mall to the Gentleman's Billiards Club at World Plaza, treating the walk as a way to relax and aid digestion.
location: Gentleman Billiards Club, B1, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Played billiards with friends
description: Lei Mingxuan and his friend Han Dong played 4 games of American eight-ball at the Gentlemen's Billiards Club, and Lei Mingxuan won 3-1. Between games, he talked about the plan to renovate the coffee bar. Han Dong agreed with the idea and proactively offered to introduce him to a friend who designs coffee shops.
location: Gentleman Billiards Club, B1, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returned to the store and checked the contract materials.
description: After playing ball, Lei Mingxuan walked back to the Super Brand Mall store, arriving around 17:35. It was the time when mall foot traffic was increasing, so he minded the store while double-checking the terms, budget sheet, and drawings needed for tomorrow’s contract signing, and sent a WeChat message to Lao Li to confirm the signing time the next day.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-work commute and fruit shopping
description: Lei Mingxuan closed the store on time at 18:00 and rode his e-bike home. Passing the fruit shop at the entrance of the residential compound, he bought half a watermelon and a bunch of grapes, thinking that his father loved to eat them.
location: On the way to Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and report on contract details
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived home at about 18:45; his mother had prepared dinner: stir-fried seasonal vegetables, braised hairtail fish, and steamed egg. At the dinner table, he gave his parents a detailed briefing on the details of signing the contract the next day, and mentioned that the coffee bar counter might need an additional budget. His father said that as long as the numbers added up, money that should be spent couldn't be saved. After dinner, he washed the fruit and watched the news with his parents.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Refine the business plan and send it out for feedback
description: In the study, Lei Mingxuan finished writing the 'Financing Plan' section of the business plan and reviewed the whole document, completing the final draft at 21:15. He sent the PDF version to Zhang Wei and his cousin Yang Fan, asking them to help polish the financing section over the weekend, and also messaged Han Dong to thank him for the billiards session.
location: Study at home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure reading and next-day planning
description: Lei Mingxuan made a cup of hot tea, read parts of One Hundred Years of Solitude on the bean bag sofa in his study, and then spent half an hour browsing Xiaohongshu for outfit inspiration for the new semester. He used the memo on his phone to list tomorrow's to-dos: sign the contract with Lao Wang from the renovation crew, handle the coffee bean samples that would be arriving soon, and so on.
location: Study at home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Lei Mingxuan soaked his feet in hot water to relieve fatigue. After washing up, he checked his phone and saw that Zhang Wei had replied, “Got it, I’ll take a look on the weekend.” He set an alarm for 6:15 the next morning and put on his fitness band, ready for the new day.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Early morning run and family breakfast
description: At 06:15 in the morning, the alarm went off. After getting up, Lei Mingxuan stepped on the scale and was relieved to see his weight had dropped to 78.8 kg. At 06:25 he changed into his workout gear and rode his e-bike to Gate 5 of Shanghai Century Park. He jogged about 3 km along the park's running track, with a steadier breathing rhythm than the previous few days, then did static stretching on the lakeside boardwalk, took a photo of the sky, and sent it to the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group as a check-in. At 07:00 he returned home for a shower and felt much fresher. His mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared breakfast: boiled eggs, whole-wheat bread, and red bean porridge. As they ate and chatted, his mother mentioned in a probing tone that today was Qixi Festival. Lei Mingxuan steered the conversation toward the store's couple outfits promotion and suggested making something nice for dinner. Meanwhile, he checked the shipping status of the tea set ornament he had ordered two days earlier; it showed that the package had arrived at the delivery station and was expected to reach the store that day.
location: From Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanghai Century Park, No. 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and then back home

name: Morning commute and store operations
description: At 08:00, Lei Mingxuan put on a mountain-style techwear vest and rode his e-bike to Super Brand Mall. While waiting at a red light, he replied to Master He, the repairman, on WeChat and scheduled a car maintenance appointment for the following week. After arriving at the mall, he parked, then went to store A-208 on the 2nd floor. He first turned on the computer to process two online orders and print shipping labels. At 09:00, property manager Zheng Kai passed by and chatted about the mall's event arrangements. At 09:15, Lei Mingxuan posted a Qixi Festival couple-outfit 10% discount promo on WeChat Moments and Xiaohongshu, accompanied by photos of mountain-style couple outfits. After that, he adjusted the in-store display, placing the couple items in prominent positions. After 10:00, foot traffic increased and many couples came into the store. He warmly received them and successfully sold two sets of mountain-style couple hardshell jackets and one set of couple T-shirts. Around 11:00, regular customer Qian Duoduo brought a friend to the store. Lei Mingxuan recommended the newly arrived techwear vests to her and showed her the renderings of the coffee bar counter. Qian Duoduo suggested using camping chairs to enhance the atmosphere.
location: From Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Store A-208, Level 2, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and afternoon store work
description: At 12:00 Lei Mingxuan locked the shop and walked to PINTXOS, a Spanish bistro on the B1 floor of the neighboring IFC Mall, for lunch. He ordered their signature seafood paella and a glass of sangria. The flavor was authentic, and the rice had a pleasantly firm, chewy texture. While eating, he scrolled through his phone to check competitors' Qixi promotions and jotted down a few feasible ideas. Around 13:00 he returned to the shop and started the afternoon work. At 13:45 Lao Li, the head of the renovation crew, arrived on time. The two went over the contract details: a 14-day construction period, the budget was within range, and they clarified the water and electrical points for the coffee bar along with the adjustment plan for the customer flow. After checking carefully, Lei Mingxuan signed to confirm. After seeing Lao Li off, taking advantage of the quiet period, he wrote down keyword inspirations for the coffee bar in his notebook and browsed Xiaohongshu store renovation cases. Around 16:00 he received an SF Express package notification, went downstairs to the SF Express locker on B1 of Super Brand Mall, picked up the tea set ornament sample, and opened the box to inspect it. The Japanese-style rough ceramic feel was rustic and matched the store renovation style perfectly.
location: PINTXOS Spanish Bistro, B1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; then returned to store A-208 on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the SF Express locker on B1.

name: Leaving the store in the evening, housework, and family dinner
description: At 16:30 Lei Mingxuan tidied the store and organized the fitting room in preparation for closing. At 16:45 he rode his e-bike to the self-service banking area at HSBC Building, deposited part of the day's sales proceeds into the company account, and checked the balance. Then, on the way, he stopped at the Jujiaqiao Farmers Market and bought freshly arrived Dandong 99 strawberries and jasmine grapes from a fruit stall. He got home at 17:30; his mother was busy in the kitchen, and he helped peel garlic. At 18:00 the family dinner began. His mother had made braised pork belly, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. At the dinner table, when Qixi Festival posts appeared on his phone, his mother once again brought up the topic of urging him to get married. Lei Mingxuan picked up a piece of braised pork belly to change the subject, praised his mother's cooking, and reported on the store's couple outfit sales and the news that the renovation contract had been signed and construction would start next week, successfully steering the conversation toward his career plans. After dinner, he took the initiative to clear and wash the dishes and told his mother to rest early.
location: Starting from Super Brand Mall at 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, passing by the HSBC Building ATM at 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai and the Jujiaqiao Farmers' Market at 2507 Jujiaqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and returning home at the Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening movie time
description: After showering and changing into home clothes, Lei Mingxuan returned to the bedroom, closed the door, drew the curtains, and turned on the projector to play the movie In the Mood for Love, which he had saved in his favorites for a long time but never got around to watching. He brewed a cup of Longjing tea brought back from Hangzhou, curled up in a beanbag chair, and focused on the film. When he saw the classic scene of Zhang Manyu and Liang Chaowei passing each other in the alley, he felt something. During the film, he scrolled through WeChat Moments and saw friends posting flowers and gifts, and a flicker of envy crossed his mind, but he was soon drawn back by the film's visual language, immersed in Wang Jiawei's world of light and shadow.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Late-night inspiration planning and bedtime preparation
description: After the movie ended, Lei Mingxuan was still immersed in thought. He turned on his computer, created a new folder called 'Store Upgrade Coffee Corner Plan', and used XMind to draw a mind map, organizing scattered inspiration from modules such as the bar counter flow, camping-style plus Japanese rustic pottery soft furnishing, and surrounding tie-ins (discount with cup sleeve). Then he ordered the elementary volumes 1 and 2 of 'Standard Japanese' on Taobao, and looking at the order, felt the fulfillment of a new life about to begin. At 22:30 he turned off the computer, went to the bathroom to wash up, and while brushing his teeth chatted with friends in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group. Zhang Wei invited him to play ball on the weekend, but he rescheduled to next week because he had to watch the renovation crew start work. After finishing his pre-sleep stretching, he lay down in bed, set the alarm for the next day, turned off the light to calm down, and prepared for the busy weekend and the store renovation.
location: Home study and bedroom, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run check-in and self-disciplined morning.
description: I woke up naturally at 6:15 a.m., changed into quick-dry clothes and running shoes, and walked from home to Lujiazui Central Greenland Park for a 3-kilometer jog, keeping a pace of about 6:15 per kilometer. During the run, I saw a golden retriever holding a frisbee on the lawn and felt happy. After finishing, I checked in on the fitness app, completing the goal for five consecutive days, and shared morning photos in the health check-in group with the caption “Day 5, check-in, happy weekend!” My college classmate Zhao Min immediately replied in the group and teased me. Then I stretched to relax.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home to shower and have an energizing breakfast
description: After jogging, he trotted home, took a hot shower, and changed into loose athletic shorts and a T-shirt. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared breakfast: white rice porridge, fried eggs, handmade pork buns, and Xiaoshan dried radish. While eating breakfast, he chatted with his mother, told her about the renovation crew arriving in the afternoon and about his cousin Shen Jie making plans to go out with him, and asked his mother and father to arrange their own lunch.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sort out equipment and confirm renovation matters at the store.
description: After breakfast, checked the backpack, packed phone, power bank, store keys, notebook and pen, and also brought a loose cotton-linen shirt for emergencies. Rode a shared bike to Store A-208 on the second floor of Super Brand Mall. After arriving, turned on the lights, checked payment records and online orders, took out the coffee bar sketch, and waited for the renovation crew to arrive.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Renovation crew arrival and on-site briefing
description: Foreman Wang and his assistant Xiao Liu from the renovation team arrived on time. Lei Mingxuan showed them the coffee bar sketch and explained in detail the partition positions, bar height, and plumbing and electrical routes, emphasizing the coffee machine drainage and the load-bearing capacity of the bar. After measuring with a tape measure, Foreman Wang said that the washbasin drainage pipe might need to be connected from the neighboring cake shop. Lei Mingxuan promised to coordinate with the property management himself and asked the renovation team to first knock down the walls without piping issues, buy auxiliary materials in the afternoon, and they agreed to start formal construction tomorrow.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Emergency rescue: roped in by his younger female cousin
description: Just after finishing a conversation with the renovation crew, his cousin Shen Jie sent a WeChat voice message saying her improv theater event was short-handed because her regular partner had acute gastroenteritis, and she asked Lei Mingxuan to fill in. Lei Mingxuan agreed at once, quickly told store clerk Xiao Lin to watch the store and handle online orders and customers, then grabbed a cotton-linen shirt and took a taxi to Huangpu Theater.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: First improv theater experience, unleashing my inner drama queen
description: After rushing to the small theatre of Huangpu Theatre and changing into a cotton-linen shirt, he joined the improvisational theatre activity led by Shen Jie's drama group. Guided by the facilitator, they played warm-up games such as mirror imitation and emotional roller coaster, gradually loosening up. In the story-building segment, he played an unreliable detective and delivered his lines in Shanghainese, making the whole audience laugh, which released the stress from his recent startup and renovation.
location: Small Theater of Huangpu Theatre, 780 Beijing East Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: Lunch gathering and store operations brainstorming
description: After the improv theater ended, Shen Jie took Lei Mingxuan to ALLORA Italian restaurant on the 3rd floor of Taikang Food for lunch. They ordered lasagna with meat sauce, Parma ham salad, and sparkling water. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan shared suggestions for Qixi Festival camping chairs and his idea of combining a coffee bar with designer toys. As a professional buyer, Shen Jie suggested choosing space-saving camping chairs and turning the coffee bar into a "lifestyle corner in the clothing store," decorated with a vinyl record player or camping lanterns. Lei Mingxuan immediately recorded it in his phone memo.
location: ALLORA Italian Restaurant (The Bund Branch), 3rd Floor, Taikang Food, No. 150 East Nanjing Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: Return to the store to follow up on materials and launch online marketing.
description: Took Metro Line 2 from the Bund back to the Super Brand Mall store, first checked Xiao Lin's work, then began preparing the back-to-school promotion. Contacted Guangzhou supplier Wu Fang via WeChat to ask about the delivery time of the gift box accessories and learned they would arrive around next Tuesday. Following Shen Jie's suggestion, used a mobile photo-editing app to revise the event poster, changing the main title to New Semester, Mountain-Style Theme Display and adding the line Check in at the store and receive an exclusive badge. After finishing the poster, sent it to the store's VIP WeChat group and Xiaohongshu account, and started an interactive lucky draw.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online interaction and optimizing tomorrow's plan.
description: After posting the poster, I answered questions from regular customers in a WeChat group about coupon usage rules, while also checking Xiaohongshu readership; I received more than 60 likes within half an hour. Then I opened my phone calendar to plan Sunday's schedule: check event materials at the store in the morning, and in the afternoon invite my friend Han Dong to play billiards at World Plaza.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leisurely browsing stores and buying Japanese study books.
description: After finishing work, he first bought a few highlighters at the MUJI store in Super Brand Mall, intending to use them for Japanese study notes. Remembering that “Standard Japanese” had already been ordered and shipped home, he took a shared bicycle to the independent bookstore “Dreams from Afar” at 535 Pudong Avenue. In the warm light and with two cats around, he picked up a copy of “An Illustrated Encyclopedia of Japanese Culture” and a manual for Japanese business conversation.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Faraway Dream (Lujiazui Store), No. 535 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Home-style dinner and family conversation
description: Carrying the books, I walked home; my parents had already started dinner. Mother had made scallion-braised pork chops, garlic water spinach, and tomato egg drop soup. While eating, Lei Mingxuan reported the day's itinerary: the renovation crew had arrived and would officially start next Monday; in the morning, he and Shen Jie did improvisational theater; in the evening, they visited the newly opened bookstore. Father was concerned about the renovation funds, Mother was concerned about whether he had fun, and Lei Mingxuan answered them one by one.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Japanese learning plan officially launched
description: After dinner, returned to the room, spread out the newly bought books and notebook, downloaded and registered for the Duolingo and HelloTalk apps. Opened the first volume of Standard Japanese, highlighted the gojūon chart with a marker, and made a mind map for the September study plan: use the app to practice pronunciation for 30 minutes every day in the first week, master all the kana in the second week, and try to find a language partner on HelloTalk to practice self-introductions in the final two weeks. Also set an 8:30 p.m. study alarm.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime relaxation and social interaction
description: After studying Japanese, lay on the sofa and scrolled on the phone: checked that the Xiaohongshu poster likes had passed two hundred, replied to customers who messaged privately about coupons; replied to Zhang Wei's drinking invitation in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group and arranged a gathering next week; watched a Cowboy Bebop mashup video as a reward. Then washed up, set the alarm for the next day, and went to sleep before midnight.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run 4 km + park stretching
description: The alarm went off at 6:10 in the morning. Lei Mingxuan felt in excellent form, quickly changed into his running shoes, and walked five minutes to Lujiazui Central Greenland Park. He warmed up for 3 minutes, then put on earphones, listened to music with a strong rhythm, and started running. He deliberately controlled his breathing rhythm and accelerated in the last kilometer, completing the 4 km morning run in 25 minutes 30 seconds, with a pace of about 6 minutes 15 seconds per kilometer, successfully achieving this week's upgrade goal. He checked in on the app and took a photo of the morning light in the park to post to the sports buddies group with the caption “Weekend extra mileage at no extra cost.” After the run, he did a 10-minute stretch on a bench by the river while browsing the Xiaohongshu backend. Seeing that the very “mountain-style techwear” outfit post he had published last night had received some new likes, he felt in a great mood.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home for a shower and breakfast.
description: Walked about 15 minutes to get home, greeted my mother who was busy in the kitchen as I entered. Took a comfortable hot shower and blow-dried my hair. Mother had prepared hot scallion pancakes, boiled eggs, and millet porridge. While eating, I replied to messages on my phone and saw that my friend Zhang Wei had liked my morning run Moments post and joked, “Boss Lei is on a roll today!”
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Learning the Japanese kana chart and joining a study group
description: After breakfast, he returned to the study and took out the newly purchased Elementary Volume 1 of Standard Japanese and its accompanying audio. He followed the audio and read aloud the first two lines of kana, copying them repeatedly in his notebook while reading. Then he found a Japanese study check-in mutual-help QQ group on Baidu Tieba and applied to join. In the group, he introduced himself as a new member: "Minasan, a Shanghai newbie checking in. My goal is to pass N5 by the end of the year. Please take care of me!" He received a warm welcome from the group members. After learning the check-in rules (a voice recording or handwritten picture is required every day), his motivation to study doubled. After studying for over an hour, his throat felt a bit dry.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Riding the e-bike to the shop
description: Packed his backpack, took the business plan document and the fruit box his mother had prepared, went downstairs, rode his e-bike along Zhangyang Road and Pudong South Road for about 15 minutes to reach Super Brand Mall, and parked the bike in the mall's designated non-motor vehicle parking area.
location: Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store renovation coordination and back-to-school event release
description: After arriving at the store, he met up with Foreman Wang from the renovation team. The two crouched in the bar area and checked the blueprints, marking the embedded water and electrical positions for the coffee bar with chalk on the floor. After confirming, Master Wang led the workers to start work. Next, he adjusted the display lighting with store clerk Xiao Lin, aiming the spotlights at the main back-to-school gift box promotion to highlight the display. Then he picked nine promotional poster photos taken yesterday from his phone album, added captions and tags, and at exactly 11 o'clock published the
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Had lunch with my cousin Shen Jie and brainstormed
description: At noon, I locked the store and went to the newly opened light-fare restaurant on B1 of Super Brand Mall to meet my cousin Shen Jie. We each ordered an avocado chicken breast salad and a chia seed yogurt bowl. Over the meal, we had an in-depth discussion about the store's "lifestyle corner" concept, fleshing out the ideas of camping chairs and a vinyl record player. Shen Jie showed me several entry-level turntables from her collection, recommended an Audio-Technica model, and suggested pairing it with camping lanterns and greenery to enhance the atmosphere. The two of us hit it off really well.
location: Salad and light meal shop at B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mind the store, serve customers, and handle online matters
description: Back at the store, there weren't many customers. While watching the store, I handled online orders on my phone and replied to several size queries. Around 2 p.m., regular customer Qian Duoduo came in and immediately took a liking to the back-to-school gift box. Lei Mingxuan introduced in detail the techwear storage bags and customized journals inside the box, and Qian Duoduo promptly bought three sets as gifts for friends. After seeing her off, I greeted Xiao Lin with the Japanese phrase “” I had just learned, which made her laugh. Meanwhile, I also checked the arrival of the renovation materials, and everything went smoothly.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycle home and buy groceries on the way
description: After telling Xiao Lin to mind the store, he rode his electric bike away from Super Brand Mall, deliberately taking a detour to Pushang Market on Dongchang Road to buy some cooked dishes to add for dinner, then continued riding home to Shanggang Community.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Pushang Vegetable Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, then to Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Report the business plan to his father
description: After going home and washing his face, Lei Mingxuan took the printed business plan and proactively went to the study to find his father, saying, "Dad, are you free? I'd like to talk to you about my coffee bar." His father put down his teacup and nodded. Lei Mingxuan spread out the business plan and explained it one by one, from market analysis (the spending power of nearby office workers and tourists) and financial projections (input-output ratio and payback period) to risk assessment (construction risks and off-season impact), and also mentioned that the property management had already agreed. The renovation budget was kept within 50,000 yuan, and his personal savings plus the 20,000 yuan contributed by his mother were enough as start-up capital. His father carefully flipped through the pages with reading glasses on, nodding from time to time, and finally looked up and said, "Well done, it's really taking shape. If you're short on money, just tell me." This affirmation put Lei Mingxuan's mind at ease.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: After the conversation with his father ended, his mother had already prepared dinner. On the table were braised pork belly, garlic water spinach, tomato and egg soup, and the ready-made dishes he had brought back—a hearty spread. During dinner, Lei Mingxuan mentioned that the store renovation had started and the 'lifestyle corner' idea he had discussed with Shen Jie. His mother praised, “That girl Xiaojie is quick-witted,” while his father listened and sipped his soup. name: Store renovation confirmation and gift box inventory
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan met directly with Foreman Lao Wang, who had been waiting for him. He pulled up several bar counter tile swatch photos on his phone and compared them repeatedly under the construction site lights, finally settling on a light gray matte sintered stone tile that looked more luminous and had a better texture under the light, and confirmed the details of starting the tiling today. At 9:00, shop assistant Xiao Lin arrived, and the two began taking stock of the Mid-Autumn Festival gift boxes. Xiao Lin recorded inventory on a tablet, while Lei Mingxuan, based on sales trends, decided to move the best-selling 'Mountain Explorer' gift box from the corner to the prime display spot next to the cash register, and rearranged the vinyl record player and camping lanterns in the 'lifestyle corner' to make it more appealing for photo check-ins.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and online business communication
description: At 11:30, after telling Xiao Lin, I went downstairs to Wagas on B1 and ordered a classic Thai Bowl and an iced Americano. During the meal, I called my mother at home, confirmed that I would be home for dinner, and specifically told her not to make anything too greasy. After hanging up, I opened WeChat and replied to a message from supplier Zhou Tao sent last night about allocating a batch of samples, confirmed the quantity and time for transferring three basic T-shirt styles, and asked about the sampling progress for the new autumn styles.
location: Wagas, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store duty and sales
description: At 13:00, he returned to the store and, together with Xiao Lin, moved the gift boxes selected in the morning to near the cash register and rearranged the display. Then he sat behind the counter, handling sporadic online orders while keeping an eye on customers entering the store. Whenever a customer showed interest in the gift boxes, he would proactively introduce them and guide them to the store's lifestyle corner. During this time, he successfully recommended a 'Rose & Camping' themed gift box to a young woman choosing a birthday gift for her best friend, added her on WeChat, and promised to notify her as soon as new products arrived.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Inventory check and confirmation
description: At 15:00, customer flow gradually decreased. Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin began a formal inventory count of the gift boxes. They checked against the purchase-sales-inventory data in the computer system, counting box by box, which took about an hour. Results: 32 gift boxes remaining, matching the system data. He recorded the results in his work memo and confirmed with Xiao Lin the quantity to restock tomorrow.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handle the day's revenue and take a short break.
description: At 16:00, after finishing the inventory count, Lei Mingxuan counted the cash revenue accumulated over the past few days and left the store. Following Amap's recommendation, he walked about 9 minutes to the ATM on the first floor of HSBC Tower and deposited the cash into the bank card account linked to the store. After the deposit, he bought a bottle of sports drink at the convenience store next door, stood at the building entrance for a short rest, enjoyed the air conditioning, and glanced at the time on his phone.
location: ATM on the first floor of HSBC Tower, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking back and shopping
description: At 16:30, he walked back home from the HSBC Building. He deliberately slowed down and chose a route that passed a small food market. At his usual 'Chen's Fruit Stall,' he bought fresh blueberries, and then picked a few okra from the next-door vegetable stall, just enough to add an extra dish for dinner. Around 17:00, he arrived home.
location: Along the way from HSBC Tower, 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, including Chen's fruit stand.

name: Evening family time and conversation
