description: After arriving home, he handed the fruit to his mother, who was busy in the kitchen. Feeling a little tired, he decided not to go to the gym tonight and to enjoy family time instead. Dinner was served promptly at 18:00. His mother had cooked steamed fish, dressed okra that he had bought, and a tomato and egg soup — light and healthy. During the meal, he shared amusing store anecdotes (such as the girl who bought a gift box for her best friend), and mainly talked with his father about his preliminary ideas from his future business plan on "store + coffee + lifestyle." His father, Lei Jianguo, listened attentively and, from the perspective of an old engineer, gave the pragmatic advice: "Cash flow must be stable; don't expand by taking on debt." After dinner, he proactively cleaned up the dishes and chopsticks.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Second update: novel writing and reader interaction
description: At 19:00, he entered the study. He opened the author dashboard and began the day's second update of the novel (about 2000 characters). Before the update, he replied to the new reader comments that had emerged in the afternoon, and he also made a point of checking the messages under the interactive Q&A post; there were about 10 new replies, and he answered them one by one, creating a friendly 'author online' atmosphere. At 20:00, the second update was published on time, and at the end of the chapter he again emphasized the foreshadowing for what lay ahead to maintain reader engagement.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Physical fitness recovery and online socializing
description: At 20:00, his shoulders still felt a bit sore, so he spread out the yoga mat and did about 15 minutes of static stretching focused on the shoulders, back, and core. After that, he turned on the tablet and cached the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End and a billiards tutorial video on a video site. While watching the anime, he browsed the designer toy community app, checked today's new product news, and chatted with several netizens in a 'Pudong Designer Toy Swap Group' about the newest blind boxes. The netizen 'Jingjing', who had previously agreed to swap blind boxes with him, said she could meet in person next week.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Washing up and daily review
description: At 21:00, went to the bathroom to wash up and soak his feet. While soaking his feet, he quickly went through today's to-do list in his phone memo, confirming that the three tasks—bar counter tile, replying to Zhou Tao, and family discussion—were all completed. He felt very satisfied; although his body was a bit tired, his mind was relaxed.
location: Bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and bedtime
description: After drying his feet, he finished watching the rest of the anime and placed an order on the trendy toy community for a color-variant blind box that he could pick up at the store tomorrow. At 23:00, he turned off the light on time, set the air conditioner to sleep mode, and put on an eye mask. Thinking that he still had new orders to handle and renovation follow-ups to deal with tomorrow, he fell into a deep sleep within 5 minutes. Daily step count: approximately 11,200 steps.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and breakfast.
description: After waking up naturally, I did 5 minutes of stretching in the bedroom to wake up my muscles. After washing up, I had breakfast with my mother at the dining table: a bowl of white porridge, a boiled egg, and a plate of stir-fried seasonal vegetables, in line with my mother's healthy eating plan. While eating, I listened to her mention that she would make my favorite Shanghai-style braised pork for dinner, and I smiled and promised to come back for it. After the meal, I weighed myself and recorded the day's data.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Morning novel writing
description: Opened the writing app on my phone and updated my novel The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane by about 2,000 words, focusing on describing the heroine's outfit and accessory details at a Republican-era ball. After updating, I deliberately set up an interactive question at the end of the chapter: 'Does anyone know the prototype of the jadeite earrings the heroine wears? Hint: they come from the collection of a Republican-era socialite.' This encouraged readers to interact in the comments, both answering yesterday's question and adding scholarly fun to the writing.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Commuting to work
description: I took the commuter bag containing a notebook, power bank, and today's promotional materials checklist. Before leaving, I stroked the orange cat "A Fu" on the head and said goodbye. I walked 7 minutes to the intersection of Zhangyang Road and Fushan Road, rode a shared bike west along Zhangyang Road, and arrived at Super Brand Mall after about 15 minutes.
location: Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (cycling section from Shanggang Community to Super Brand Mall).

name: Store morning preparation.
description: Arrived at the store before the mall's business hours, turned on the lights and the cash register system, and gave the display counters a quick wipe. According to the plan from last night, he restyled the featured tech-wear T-shirts with summer trousers and put them on the most eye-catching mannequins. He checked the gift box inventory for the 'Buy two, get trendy toy stationery' event and made sure all 30 gift boxes had intact packaging. He nodded to the mall property manager Zheng Kai passing by and, as a favor, helped the cleaning auntie move the goods blocking the way.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store hours
description: Morning mall foot traffic was average; mainly received a few walk-in customers browsing the mall. I patiently recommended several work outfits to a white-collar woman and successfully closed a two-piece bundled sale. Using the downtime, I distilled the techwear outfit notes I had browsed on Xiaohongshu last night into a WeChat Moments post, paired with photos of new products in the store, to warm up for the afternoon promotion.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning sales and interactions with regular customers.
description: Near noon, customer traffic increased. Returning customer Qian Duoduo sent a WeChat message saying she was passing by and wanted to see if there were any new T-shirts suitable for the music festival. While attending to her, I brought out several newly arrived printed styles for her to choose from. She finally picked two and added items to qualify for the buy-and-gift promotion, happily taking away a trendy toy and stationery blind box. After seeing Qian Duoduo off, I jotted down the morning's sales in the ledger.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and coffee equipment shopping
description: After hanging up the 'On Lunch Break' sign, he set out on foot, heading south along Lujiazui West Road, crossing Pudong Avenue via the pedestrian overpass, then continuing south along South Pudong Road. He arrived at the specialty coffee equipment store on B1 of World Plaza in about 17 minutes. Following his advance research, he carefully compared the spout designs of several pour-over kettles and finally chose a cost-effective model (298 yuan). He also bought matching V60 filter papers (35 yuan), a professional coffee scale with 0.1 g precision (180 yuan), two tasting cups (60 yuan), and a bag of Ethiopian sun-dried specialty coffee beans (128 yuan). After discussing water temperature and pouring techniques with the shop assistant, he walked back the same way to Super Brand Mall, satisfied, and arrived at the store around 13:13.

participant.name: Shop assistant.
participant.relation: Store clerk at a coffee equipment specialty shop.

location: Coffee equipment specialty store, B1, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon: shop promotion and operations
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic increased noticeably. Standing energetically at the store entrance to greet customers, he enthusiastically promoted to passing young shoppers: "Welcome in! Today, buy two items of clothing and get a limited-edition trendy stationery set!" Thanks to the event's appeal, the rate of customers entering the store rose significantly. He flexibly placed the "Functional Refresh Gift Box" next to the cash register as the main push, and told customers waiting to check out that they could redeem a free coffee experience voucher with their receipt, drawing traffic to the in-store coffee corner.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Promotion sprint and a small gathering with old friends
description: Sales remained brisk. When he noticed the gift boxes were about to run out, he immediately restocked 10 from the back warehouse. Around 4 p.m., his good friend Han Dong, who was running errands nearby, stopped by the store to visit. While entertaining him, Mingxuan used his newly purchased pour-over equipment to brew a cup of Ethiopian coffee at the store's coffee corner, excitedly sharing the techniques he had just learned. The two chatted about tomorrow's billiards match, and Han Dong agreed to play a couple of practice rounds with him tomorrow afternoon. Han Dong's visit allowed him to enjoy a bit of social pleasure amid the busy work.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the in-store coffee corner

name: Preparation before the evening rush hour
description: Customer traffic briefly dropped. I quickly checked the distribution of the afternoon event giveaways and the inventory of best-selling styles. I found that some T-shirt sizes were understocked, recorded the data, and planned to restock with supplier Brother Tao next Monday. I confirmed again that there were enough coffee experience vouchers left, preparing for the final sales peak of the day.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening customer reception
description: The evening customer flow consisted mainly of family shoppers and young couples off work. He patiently recommended casual pants suitable for a mother's daughter's return to school, and gave styling suggestions to a young couple. Despite being continuously busy, he handled it with ease and maintained an efficient closing rate. While waiting for customers to try on clothes, he quickly replied to several loyal readers in the novel's comment section who were discussing the background of the jade earrings, thanking them for their wonderful comments.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing inventory
description: Put up the "Temporarily Closed" sign, turned off some of the lights, and began the day's closing work: counted the cash, checked the POS machine records, and entered the sales data into the computer ledger. Sold 18 gift boxes in total, gave out 60 coffee experience vouchers, and total sales far exceeded a normal Friday, showing a significant promotional effect. Sealed the cash and prepared to deposit it in the bank the next day.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting home and interacting with readers.
description: Locked the store door and bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea at the convenience store near the mall exit. On the bike ride home, while waiting for a red light at an intersection, took out his phone and sent private messages to thank the three readers who had left the highest-quality comments in today's comment section. He also browsed the comment sections of similar novels and noticed that "Republican-era style" was a hot genre recently, providing reference for plotting later chapters.
location: Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (arrived via commute)

name: Family dinner time
description: As soon as I got home and walked in, I smelled a familiar aroma. After changing into home clothes, I sat at the dining table and enjoyed the braised pork, stir-fried pea shoots, and tomato and egg soup my mother had specially kept for me. The whole family chatted while eating. I excitedly shared the news of today's successful store promotion with my parents and showed them the coffee equipment I had just bought. Although my father said, "Wasting money again," he still picked it up and looked at it carefully. After dinner, I leaned back on the sofa and played for a while with A Fu, the orange tabby dozing on my lap, enjoying a relaxing family time.
location: Living room and dining room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening relaxation and rest
description: Back in the bedroom, he opened the iPad and browsed the official information for the Pujiang Cup billiards tournament, confirming tomorrow afternoon's training location with Han Dong (World Plaza Billiards Hall). He also watched several professional eight-ball match highlights to learn break shots and defensive techniques. After that, he heated water to soak his feet after a long day of walking, and casually scrolled through social media on his phone. He set the alarm for 07:30 tomorrow morning, turned off the light, and went to sleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake-up and morning routine
description: Woke up naturally at 7 am on Saturday, sunlight streaming through the curtains onto the bed. Lei Mingxuan lay in bed checking the store's backend and novel data on his phone, and got up after confirming everything was normal. After a quick wash, he splashed cold water on his face to wake himself up. Passing through the living room, his mother Wang Xiuying was already busy in the kitchen and asked him what he wanted for breakfast.
location: The bedroom and bathroom at home in Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning novel update
description: Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop in the study and quickly updated a chapter of about 2,500 words in the novel The Afternoon at Xiafei Lane. Through the protagonist's inner thoughts and dialogue, he skillfully responded to earlier readers' controversy over the protagonist's unreasonable motivations. After the update, he selected representative comments and replied patiently, sincerely explaining his writing approach, and gained support from longtime readers.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Enjoy breakfast and confirm the itinerary
description: His mother made small wontons with thin wrappers and generous fillings, with seaweed and egg ribbons. Lei Mingxuan ate them comfortably. While eating, he chatted with his mother about today's plans and said he wouldn't be back for lunch. After eating, he helped his mother clear the dishes, then sent a WeChat message to Han Dong (Dongzi) to discuss the afternoon billiards training time and confirmed changing it to 2 o'clock.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuted by bike to the lecture.
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into a beige casual linen shirt, dark cargo shorts, and dad sneakers, grabbed his notebook and power bank, and headed out. Downstairs, he scanned a shared bike, rode along Zhangyang Road to Longyang Road, and arrived at the Shanghai New International Expo Center in about 25 minutes, ready to attend the lecture on appraising designer toys.
location: From Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, he cycled to Shanghai New International Expo Center, No. 2345 Longyang Road.

name: Attended a designer toy appraisal lecture and met fellow collectors.
description: Lei Mingxuan attended the lecture 'Authentication and Value Opportunities in the Designer Toy Secondary Market' in the conference hall of Hall E3 at the New International Expo Center, sitting in the front row to make it easier to ask questions. The lecture was information-rich; he took 7 pages of detailed notes, covering coating reflective characteristics, limited-edition numbering fonts, and more. During the tea break, he proactively chatted with nearby fellow collectors and got to know Wang Lei (Daxiong), who researches Molly and BE@RBRICK market trends, and the owner of a designer toy store. They exchanged WeChat contacts, and Wang Lei also offered to introduce a reliable box-opening purchasing agent.
location: Conference hall, Hall E3, Shanghai New International Expo Center, 2345 Longyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and socializing with fellow collectors
description: After the lecture, Lei Mingxuan and Wang Lei went together to the Food Republic food court outside the exhibition hall. He ordered spicy meat noodles, and Wang Lei had braised beef rice. The two continued discussing the details of telling authentic Molly figures from fakes, and Wang Lei showed comparison photos on his phone. Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to introduce his store and his plan to add a designer toy category. Wang Lei expressed interest and said he might visit the store later to see the possibility of cooperation. After the meal, they said goodbye and agreed to stay in touch.
location: Food plaza outside the Shanghai New International Expo Center, 2345 Longyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuted by metro to the billiards hall
description: Lei Mingxuan took Metro Line 2 from Longyang Road Station, two stops to Dongchang Road Station, then walked to World Plaza and took the elevator to the Sniper Billiards Club on B1. On the way, he sent Dongzi his location.
location: From Longyang Road Metro Station to B1, World Plaza, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area

name: Practice for the billiards tournament
description: Lei Mingxuan and Han Dong conducted targeted training at Table 6 of Sniper Billiards Club, playing two race-to-7 matches that completely simulated competition tempo, focusing on connection points after the break and defensive cue-ball positioning. Han Dong recorded with his phone and noticed that Lei Mingxuan's body weight shifted to the right when striking the ball. After reviewing the playback and practicing with empty strokes, the problem improved significantly. The two also practiced jump shots and curve-ball escapes; although the success rate was not high, it boosted their confidence in actual play. They extended practice until 4:30, reinforcing break connections and defensive details. Afterward, they stretched and relaxed at the side of the table.
location: Sniper Billiards Club, B1, World Plaza, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return trip and buying groceries on the way
description: After saying goodbye to Han Dong, Lei Mingxuan rode a shared bike home. Passing Pushang Vegetable Market, he remembered that his mother needed scallions and ginger for steamed sea bass, so he went in and bought some scallions and a piece of ginger. The vegetable vendor auntie recognized him and gave him two extra sprigs of cilantro.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organize lecture notes and fellow collectors' information
description: After returning home and greeting the orange cat Afu, Lei Mingxuan used a highlighter in his study to mark key points in his lecture notes, and set WeChat remarks for his newly added collector friends, such as "Wang Lei - Trendy Toy Collector", "Mr. Qian - IP Select Shop", "Linda - Pop Mart Promotions", etc. He recorded their suggestions (e.g., trendy toy displays require strong lighting, set up transparent display cabinets) in his memo, and began thinking about how to apply the knowledge and connections he had gained to the store's "Coffee + Trendy Toys" experience area.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Practice pour-over coffee
description: Lei Mingxuan took out his newly purchased pour-over equipment and Ethiopian Yirgacheffe coffee beans in the kitchen. He brewed with 16 grams of coffee grounds, water at 92°C, a 30-second bloom, and pouring in stages for about 2 minutes 10 seconds. The first brew tasted a bit weak, with bright acidity but insufficient body. After adjusting his technique, the second brew was much richer in flavor, with prominent citrus and floral aromas. Satisfied, he took a photo to send to the owner of the equipment shop.
location: Home kitchen at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: Mother made steamed sea bass, garlic stir-fried water spinach, and Shanghai-style braised pork. At the dinner table, Lei Mingxuan shared what he had seen and heard at the day's designer toy lecture, explaining young people's IP culture and the business logic behind it. His father, Lei Jianguo, didn't quite understand but listened seriously and supported his son, saying it's good as long as he has a clear understanding.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leisure and group chat interaction
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to do the dishes, then collapsed on the sofa and scrolled through his phone. In the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group chat, he posted photos of his billiards practice. Li Na instantly replied, calling him the “involution king.” Zhang Wei invited him to play half-court basketball at Century Park tomorrow, and he replied that he could probably go. He also replied to some reader and customer messages and felt that life was fulfilling.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Second novel update and reader interaction
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to the study for the day's second update and wrote about the protagonist's daily life and reflections after handling the crisis, about 2,000 words. After updating, he posted a rewarded discussion thread asking readers to vote on a choice between love and career; the two with the most likes would receive new T-shirts from the store. The post quickly sparked heated discussion, and he found the wide variety of comments more interesting than simply writing.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening review and relaxation
description: Lei Mingxuan reviewed the day in his mind: the lecture was rewarding and he made useful contacts; his billiards skills improved with targeted practice; his novel-writing task was completed and he successfully steered the community discussion; his pour-over practice was up to standard. He felt the day had been efficient and fulfilling. Then he took a shower and listened to light music to wash away the fatigue.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, Pudong Avenue, Lane 136, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Home Study and Bathroom

name: Preparing for bed and planning for tomorrow
description: Lying in bed, Lei Mingxuan sent a WeChat message to supplier Tao Ge (Zhou Tao) to arrange checking the restocking list on Monday morning, saying he would organize the new sizes and send them over tomorrow. He thought about how he could sleep in a little on Sunday, and might go to the store in the afternoon to prepare for Monday's business. He set the alarm for 9 o'clock, petted the orange cat A Fu who jumped onto the bed, said goodnight, and gradually fell asleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Get up, wash up, and have breakfast
description: After the alarm rang in the morning, I stayed in bed for a while and only got up at 7:10. After washing up, my mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared steaming hot pan-fried buns and soy milk for breakfast. While eating, I scrolled through readers' comments on last night's novel chapter on my phone, thinking about what to update this morning.
location: Room 501, Building 2, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning writing and work preparation
description: After breakfast, in the dining area, he used the Writer Assistant app to update about 2,000 words of the novel 'The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane,' and pinned a weekly summary titled 'An intense first week of updates comes to a successful close' to thank readers. He quickly browsed and replied to several comments and private messages that had piled up from last night, ensuring timely interaction. Then he took out the new batch of fabric sample cards sent by supplier Zhou Tao, photographed close-ups with his phone, and organized them into notes needed for tomorrow's restocking confirmation. He sent a WeChat message to his friend Han Dong, telling him that the store was busy wrapping up today and they could arrange to play ball another day.
location: Room 501, Building 2, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking commute.
description: Put on lightweight sneakers and went out. The weather was cloudy, 24-29°C, and felt comfortable. I walked along Zhangyang Road toward Super Brand Mall, listening to a podcast episode about community coffee shop operations with earphones on the way, and used a voice memo on my phone to review the fabric notes I had just organized so I could reinforce them on the road.
location: Along the route from Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Store visit and promotion execution
description: Arrived at the store at 8:18, first quickly checked the previous day's sales report and displays, and pulled the clearance gift boxes from the warehouse to the most prominent spot on the promo stand. At 9:00, staff member Lin Xiao came on duty, and the division of tasks was made clear: Lin Xiao was responsible for guiding customers to scan the QR code to join the WeChat group and receive a 10-yuan no-threshold coupon, while he personally received regular customers and key high-value clients, mainly promoting the event offering a sample of hand-brewed coffee beans for every 300 yuan spent. During peak hours, he received familiar customers including Qian Duoduo, who quickly picked out four new autumn styles and happily chose an Ethiopian coffee bean sample after reaching the full-spend gift threshold. Lin Xiao successfully brought 30 new customers into the group. Near 10:30, the last few discount gift boxes sold out completely, bringing the promotion to a successful close. After 10:30, he took time to send WeChat messages to regular customers who hadn't visited that day, informing them of the new-product benefits, and briefly recorded the sales data.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and preparation for the coffee area renovation
description: He ordered takeout from the Japanese ramen shop at IFC—tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg—and had it delivered to the store. While eating lunch, he used a tape measure and marker to sketch the coffee experience area renovation on A4 paper, carefully measuring the length, width, and height of the existing counter, marking the locations of electrical outlets, and planning the layout of the pour-over station, storage rack, and display cabinet. At the same time, he opened the phone calculator and estimated the budget item by item for wood panels, metal racks, shelves, storage boxes, and pour-over accessories. After repeated calculations, he strictly controlled the total cost within 50,000 yuan. Just after finishing lunch, store manager Lin Xiao sent the initial draft of the beverage menu, including 3 classic single-origin beans and 2 blends, with suggested prices of 28–45 yuan. Lei Mingxuan proposed splitting the cup sizes into large/medium and setting aside a 'Today's Recommendation' area with pairing suggestions. The two agreed to use a handwritten card style. Then he took a short break, drank a glass of water, checked the purchase list and budget sheet, and got ready to go out after confirming everything was correct.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going out to buy materials for the coffee area renovation
description: Took a taxi from the entrance of Super Brand Mall to Tongfu Yijiali Building Materials Mall, and purchased 5 paint-free wood boards, 2 galvanized metal frames, plus accessories such as light steel keels and expansion bolts according to the list. I asked the store to cut them to size and carefully checked each purchase to stay within budget. Then I took another taxi to Red Star Macalline Pudong Hunan Mall, where I picked out 2 black wrought-iron shelves and 3 rattan storage boxes, and found a wooden pour-over stand and a probe thermometer with 0.1 precision. After bargaining with the shopkeeper, I paid with satisfaction, and the total cost did not exceed the budget.
location: Tongfu E-Jiali Building Materials Mall, Pusan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Red Star Macalline Hunan Mall, No. 518 Linyu Road

name: Return to the store to sort out purchasing and take inventory.
description: At 4 p.m., he returned to the store, sorted the purchased wood boards, metal frames, shelves and other materials by area, and took photos for records. Together with store clerk Lin Xiao, he inventoried the unsold gift boxes for the day; only 7 remained. They opened and counted all of them, and put them back into storage. Then he thoroughly cleaned the coffee corner, removing extra clutter around the old coffee machine to make space for the renovation next weekend.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Final sales push and closing up the store
description: Taking advantage of the last weekend rush hour, they continued to receive walk-in customers. Lin Xiao printed the newly added QR code standing sign for the community group. Lei Mingxuan spent half an hour making the final sales tally for the week: total sales were about 32,000 yuan, 70 gift boxes were sold out, and over 500 coffee experience vouchers were handed out. The event exceeded expectations. At exactly 6 p.m., he posted a Moments update with a nine-grid photo to celebrate the successful wrap-up of the promotion, and announced that the countdown to the coffee area renovation had begun. When closing the store at 6:30 p.m., he greeted Zheng Kai, the property manager on patrol, and briefly chatted about the day's activities.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Gone home after work and had dinner with the family.
description: Walked home from Super Brand Mall. On the way, I replied one by one to all the new comments under the chapters updated today on the Writer Assistant app, liked or briefly replied to a few frequent readers, and finished the last few private messages, completing all the interaction tasks for the novel's first week of high-intensity serialization. When I got home, my mother had already prepared a table of dishes: Shanghai-style braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. I had dinner with my parents and excitedly shared about the conclusion of that day's promotion and the start of the coffee area renovation, and showed them the renovation sketch. My father, who rarely praised, said, 'This little plan of yours really clicks!' My mother smiled and told me not to work too hard.
location: Room 501, Building 2, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening rest and social group chat
description: After dinner, he helped his mother clear the dishes, then curled up on the living room sofa to pet the cat (the orange tabby Afu). Opening his phone, he saw in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group that his childhood friend Zhang Wei was inviting people to play basketball at Century Park tomorrow, and Li Na shared check-in photos of a newly popular store in Hangzhou. Lei Mingxuan replied that he had already walked 13,000 steps today and that he was too big, so he'd only be free tomorrow evening to hang out. Then he scrolled through short videos on Bilibili about Shanghai café interiors for inspiration.
location: Living room, Room 501, Building 2, Shanggang Community, 12 Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel's second update
description: Back in the bedroom, he opened his laptop, logged in to Writer Assistant, and started the second update of the day. Since this wrapped up the first week, he wrote a warm closing chapter and added a thank-you note, thanking readers for their companionship and interaction over the week. After publishing, he replied to every new comment under the chapter, making sure he engaged with all of them.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, Building 2, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and relaxing with TV
description: After handling the novel matters, I took a shower. I changed into loose pajamas, returned to the living room sofa, turned on the TV and casually watched sports news for a while to relax.
location: Room 501, Building 2, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening exercise and stretching
description: Put on basketball shoes, walk to the outdoor lighted basketball court at Yuanshen Sports Center, and practice spot shooting alone for half an hour, focusing on mid-range jump shots and free-throw consistency. After working up a light sweat, stroll home. Once home, spread out the yoga mat, open the Keep app, and follow a 20-minute bedtime yoga video to stretch, focusing on relaxing the hips, spine, and shoulder muscles that were heavily used in repeated shooting, relieving the day's fatigue.
location: Outdoor basketball court at Yuanshen Sports Center, 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Room 501, Building 2, Shanggang Community, 12 Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Pre-sleep planning and bedtime
description: After stretching, he lay down on the bed and listed Monday morning's work checklist in the notes app on his phone: at 9 a.m., video call with supplier Zhou Tao to go over the restocking order; sort out fabric sample card notes; arrange for Lin Xiao to laminate the new drink menu cards. He went through the purchase list again, confirming the sizes and quantities were correct. He set the alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning, put down his phone, and thought back on how the day's promotion had ended successfully, the renovation was taking shape, and the novel update and reader interactions had all been handled neatly. Filled with a sense of fulfillment, he soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 501, Building 2, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and weight record
description: Woken by the phone alarm; the sunlight was just right. He got out of bed barefoot, stepped onto the electronic scale in the living room, which read 78.4 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday. After a quick wash, he recorded the data in the 'Weight Notebook' app.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: High-protein breakfast
description: Mother Wang Xiuying prepared breakfast: two boiled eggs, a glass of skim milk, a small plate of blanched broccoli, and half a corn cob. During the meal, she told him to rest today and not stay cooped up at home, reminding him that the weather was cool and he could go out for a walk. He scrolled through Xiaohongshu posts about checking out local places.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Novel update and interaction.
description: In the study, opened the laptop, logged into the author backend, and quickly browsed reader comments — there were 10 new comments and 50 new favorites. Focused on writing and publishing the 2,000-character chapter of Afternoon at Xiafei Lane, then launched a vote on a character's fate at the end: 'Who will send the protagonist the anonymous package in the next chapter? A. The mysterious landlord B. The former lover C. The old bookstore owner.' After publishing, carefully replied to 10 thoughtful long comments and liked 20 new messages.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Video conference preparation and communication
description: He brewed a cup of jasmine tea, opened the documents '0907 Promotion Review Preliminary Data' and 'Autumn New Arrivals Replenishment Requirements List' on the computer, and checked his appearance with his phone, making sure the background was a clean bookshelf. At the scheduled time, he initiated a WeChat video call with supplier Zhou Tao in Hangzhou to confirm the urgent replenishment schedule for the best-selling linen-cotton shirts and wide-leg pants from yesterday's promotion. They discussed the new season's fabrics in detail, especially the 'high-density Tencel cotton' swatch card recommended by Zhou Tao, its feel, and wrinkle resistance. Zhou Tao promised to send the swatch card before this Friday and arrange the reorder as soon as possible. At the same time, he shared the drink menu layout designed by store clerk Xiao Lin, and Zhou Tao praised, 'This clerk really has ideas.'
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting ready to go out.
description: Ended the video call, changed into a white linen shirt and khaki casual pants, put on a baseball cap and Bluetooth earphones, and checked his wallet, keys, and phone. Remembering that he hadn't replied to Zhang Wei's billiards invitation last night, he sent a voice message: "Wei, is the weekend billiards game set? You pick the time, I'm free anytime." Then he slung on his canvas bag and headed out.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk to First Yaohan.
description: Leaving Shanggang Community, he turned onto Zhangyang Road from Pudong Avenue and strolled toward Century Avenue in the direction of First Yaohan Mall. The weather was clear, 26-30°C, with a cool autumn breeze, and it felt comfortable. While walking, he listened to a podcast about the spatial aesthetics of business operators.
location: Along the route from Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to No. 501 Zhangyang Road.

name: Mall shopping and lunch
description: I entered the First Yaohan Mall at 501 Zhangyang Road and went straight to the women's clothing area on the third floor to pick a Teacher's Day gift for my mother. Remembering that my mother wanted a cashmere shawl, I carefully compared two well-regarded counters and selected a classic camel-colored, 100% cashmere long shawl with tassel details, soft and warm to the touch, and a versatile color. I asked the sales assistant to wrap it in an exquisite gift box with a greeting card, on which I wrote by hand, 'Mom, Happy Teacher's Day! Love you always.' After checking out, I strolled through the menswear and trend-collection store areas, carefully using my phone to photograph window displays, model outfits, and lighting arrangements as reference material for my store's autumn displays. Passing by a Pop Mart vending machine, I scanned to buy a blind box from a new series and got a hidden astronaut figure, which put me in a great mood. Afterwards, at the B1 food court, I ordered a chicken avocado mango salad and a freshly squeezed pear juice. While eating a healthy lunch, I observed the young people around me, kept an eye on social trends, and used my phone to reply to several questions in the store manager group chat about the afternoon data table.
location: Shanghai No. 1 Yaohan Mall, 501 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: An afternoon stroll to Greenland Park
description: After exiting First Yaohan, I walked along Century Avenue toward Lujiazui Central Green Park. Passing the entrance of Shanghai IFC, I saw young people queuing at a newly opened cosmetics store and marveled at Shanghai's consumption vitality. After entering Lujiazui Central Green Park, I walked two slow laps on tree-lined paths, breathing fresh air and feeling the tranquility amid the dense high-rises.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Home review and menu confirmation
description: Walk back to the Shanggang residential community, take a shower, and change into loungewear. In the study, turn on the computer and start working: carefully analyze all sales data from yesterday's promotion, calculate the bundling rate and find that the 'buy two get a trendy toy blind box' strategy increased the bundling rate by 15%; sort through customer feedback, noting some customers suggested adding plus-size women's clothing. Spend more than two hours writing a detailed '0907 Promotion Review Summary Report', save it to the team's shared document, and add at the end a preliminary framework for the 'trendy toys + drinks' model implementation plan and an outline for a customer satisfaction survey questionnaire before National Day. Then use WeChat to send a voice message to shop assistant Xiao Lin: 'Xiao Lin, if you have time today, make a laminated initial version of the coffee beverage menu we discussed earlier, using the reference layout I shared with you, with design software. I'll come to the store tomorrow to take a look. Don't forget to bring the hand-drawn style layout you designed yesterday.'
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Brisk walking workout
description: Changed into sports shorts and running shoes, then set out from Shanggang Community and power-walked along Pudong Avenue toward Yuanshen Sports Center. After about 15 minutes, I arrived at the perimeter of Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area. Without entering the stadium, I power-walked for 45 minutes on the rubber walkway around it, soaking in the athletic atmosphere inside. I completed the 10,000-step goal; at this point my phone showed 11,000 steps.
location: Outside Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 1458 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Simple dinner
description: Back home, his mother had prepared dinner: steamed sea bass, blanched okra, a bowl of tomato egg-drop soup, and a small bowl of multigrain rice, all in line with the high-protein, low-fat diet. As they ate, he chatted with his mother and said that tomorrow is Teachers' Day and he would give her a surprise.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Set off for coffee class
description: After eating, packed the notebook, pen, voice recorder, and thermos into a canvas bag, and used his phone to message the coffee training institution to confirm the course. He walked about 15 minutes to tonight's coffee course location: Luckin Coffee (Shengkang Liaoshi Building), 738 Shangcheng Road, Pudong New Area.
location: Luckin Coffee (Shengkang Liaoshi Building), 738 Shangcheng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Beginner pour-over coffee course
description: Arrived at the training classroom on time. The instructor started with the principles of water temperature control, explaining in detail how coffee beans of different roast levels differ in sensitivity to water temperature, and then demonstrated the standard pour-over brewing technique. Under the instructor's hands-on guidance, I did my first practical brew of washed Yirgacheffe. Although my hand trembled a bit while pouring and the water stream was not stable enough, the brewed coffee had a clear aroma complexity that was obviously different from instant coffee. I took three pages of careful notes and felt I had gained a lot.
location: Training room at Luckin Coffee (Shengkang Liaoshi Building store), 738 Shangcheng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walked home after class
description: After class, I was in an excited mood and discussed what I had learned with my instructor. The night was already deep and a cool breeze was blowing. Walking home, I savored the rhythm of "blooming" and "pouring" in my mind. Passing a fruit shop, I went in and bought a box of cut cantaloupe as a snack.
location: Along the route from No. 738 Shangcheng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Evening cleanup and getting ready for bed
description: Back home, while things were still fresh, I organized the scribbled class notes into a computer document, marking key points and questions with a red pen. I touched up a few classroom photos and photos of the coffee I brewed tonight, then posted to Moments: "【Introduction to Hand-Brewed Coffee】Lesson 1: Start by controlling the water temperature and touch the soul of coffee. First time brewing Yirgacheffe — my pouring was a bit clumsy, but the aroma doesn't lie. Looking forward to the next practice!" Afterwards, I took out the gift box I bought during the day to confirm the card was intact, shared my impressive blind-box luck in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat, said goodnight to my mother and reminded her not to go out tomorrow morning, and set my alarm for 7:00 AM. After lying in bed, I opened the diary app and checked off today's completed items: gift shopping, novel update, coffee class, data review, step goal met, healthy eating — and felt the day was fulfilling and meaningful. I planned to give my mother her Teacher's Day surprise first thing tomorrow morning, then head to the shop to open for business, and close my eyes to fall asleep at 23:00 sharp.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning Home Preparation and Creative Work
description: At exactly 6 a.m., Lei Mingxuan got up, washed up in the bedroom, then laid out a yoga mat in the living room for strength training, including push-ups, planks, and squat jumps. The 30-minute workout fully woke up his body. After training, he showered and prepared breakfast: toasted whole wheat bread, boiled eggs, and black coffee. While eating breakfast in the dining room, he opened the backend of the novel platform, updated the latest chapter of The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane, replied to readers' comments—especially addressing speculation about the French Concession café—and posted a fun guessing contest. After breakfast, he washed the dishes, changed into a carefully matched off-white casual shirt and black tapered cargo pants, sprayed on woody-scented perfume, organized his belongings, and got ready to head out to work at the shop.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walked to Super Brand Mall for work.
description: Lei Mingxuan left Shanggang Community and walked along Pudong Avenue toward Lujiazui. On the way, he stopped at the convenience store at the community gate and bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea. The fragrance of osmanthus in the autumn morning and the crisp air invigorated him. He arrived at the Super Brand Mall store about 27 minutes later.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store morning operations and Teacher's Day plans
description: After opening the store, Lei Mingxuan first played jazz and reviewed the previous day's sales report. Once Xiao Lin, the store clerk, arrived, the two cleaned the dust off the shelves, adjusted the mannequin outfits, and displayed the newly arrived techwear vests in a prominent spot. Then Lei Mingxuan sat alone at the workbench, used WeChat and a notepad to contact the flower shop and order a Teachers' Day bouquet, choosing a combination of carnations, lilies, and eucalyptus leaves for his mother, a retired teacher. He also called Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant at Lujiazui Center to book a private room for the family dinner the next evening and customized a menu of Shanghai-style dishes his mother liked. After everything was arranged, he sent his mother a greeting via WeChat, then took out his iPad and continued revising the renovation sketch for the store's coffee experience area, optimizing the bar layout and the positions of outlets and drains.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations and supplier follow-up.
description: Customers gradually entered the store during the morning. Lei Mingxuan enthusiastically introduced the new autumn coats. In between, he sent voice messages to fabric supplier Tao Ge to follow up on the progress of new samples and ensure smooth ordering later.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch at IFC Mall and afternoon stroll
description: Taking advantage of a temporary lull in store foot traffic, Lei Mingxuan walked through the Lujiazui skywalk to Shanghai ifc mall. At Wagas on the B1 floor, he ordered a Doctor Salad and freshly squeezed juice as a light lunch. While eating, he checked the backend data for his morning novel post; views were up 10% from the previous day, and the guessing-game post drew a strong response. After lunch, instead of returning immediately, he took a leisurely stroll through the mall's walkways and atrium, stopping by several sportswear brands and designer toy concept stores to observe the latest display designs for inspiration for his own store. Once his step count reached the target, he walked back from ifc to Super Brand Mall along the same route.
location: B1 floor and interior areas of Shanghai ifc Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and project progress
description: In the afternoon, customer flow increased slightly. Lei Mingxuan successfully sold a women's techwear vest to a white-collar customer. He used his free time to complete a detailed sketch of the coffee corner renovation on his iPad, labeling dimensions and a materials list, and shared it to the "Store Renovation Trio" WeChat group for his partners' reference.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Starbucks coffee break
description: Feeling a little drowsy, Lei Mingxuan locked the store door, went downstairs to the Starbucks on the first floor of Super Brand Mall, ordered a large iced Americano, and relaxed for a while on a bar stool, watching the stream of people on the Lujiazui circular footbridge through the window. During the break, he texted his friend Han Dong to invite him to play billiards in the evening and quickly got an affirmative reply.
location: Starbucks, 1st Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store evening rush-hour operations and closing
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to the store and, before the evening rush, took out the materials from the previous hand-brewed coffee course, closed his eyes, and mentally simulated the 'single-pour' water-filling technique, memorizing key points such as water temperature and coffee-to-water ratio. In the evening, mall traffic surged. He served customers together with staff member Xiao Lin, during which he helped a mother choose suitable matching outfits for her child, and the transaction went smoothly. At 18:30, he did the daily inventory check on time and completed the handover with Xiao Lin, ensuring that all store matters were properly closed out.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home for dinner and family conversation.
description: Lei Mingxuan finished work at the shop and walked home. When he arrived, his parents had already eaten dinner but had specially kept a meal for him. He ate quickly while telling his mother that a bouquet would be delivered to the house tomorrow and that he had already booked a restaurant for dinner to celebrate Teachers' Day for her. His mother complained about wasting money, but the smile in her eyes was impossible to hide. After the meal, he spent a few minutes changing into light sportswear to prepare for the evening's billiards activity.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Billiards, socializing, and relaxation.
description: Lei Mingxuan rode a shared bike along Pudong Avenue to Pudong South Road and arrived at the billiard hall on level B1 of World Plaza after 8 minutes, where he met his friend Han Dong. The two played three games of American eight-ball, chatting about recent news while playing. Lei Mingxuan shared his plans for Teacher's Day for his mother, and Han Dong teased him for being a 'mama's boy'. The relaxed atmosphere helped him release the fatigue of the day. After the games, he cycled back home, took a shower, and handled private messages from winning readers of the novel quiz event, confirming that prizes would be mailed the next day.
location: Billiard hall, B1, World Square, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure at home and catching up on anime.
description: Back in the bedroom, Lei Mingxuan changed into loungewear, curled up in the bean bag chair, and used his iPad to catch up on two episodes of a popular new anime that had just updated last Sunday. Between episodes, he chatted casually with his childhood friends in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group, enjoying the relaxing time alone.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and review
description: Lei Mingxuan turned off the iPad, went to the bathroom to wash up, applied toner, and returned to bed. He briefly reviewed the day's achievements: his strength training target was met, the novel's interactive feedback was positive, the Teachers' Day surprise was properly arranged, and he had enjoyed a satisfying billiards session. He set the alarm for the next day, turned off the light, and soon fell asleep contentedly.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning stretching
description: On Teacher's Day, Lei Mingxuan got up 5 minutes earlier than usual, filled with excitement at the thought of preparing a surprise for his mother. After washing up, he did 15 minutes of full-body dynamic stretching by the bedroom window, focusing on his shoulders, back, and wrists, to prepare for the billiards competition in the evening. The sun was shining brightly outside, and he felt cheerful, starting a day full of energy.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family breakfast and confirming the Teacher's Day surprise
description: Mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared pan-fried pork buns, soy milk, and fried sticky rice cakes. While eating breakfast, Lei Mingxuan used his phone to confirm the delivery order from the flower shop 'Encounter Blossoms' (No. 999, Pudong South Road). He ordered a bouquet of carnations and white lilies, scheduled for delivery between 10:00 and 11:00 a.m. He also checked the private room reservation at Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant in Lujiazui Center and once again confirmed his mother's favorite dishes: braised pork, stir-fried shrimp, and osmanthus cakes. His father Lei Jianguo was reading the newspaper on the balcony, so Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to ask about going out to dinner together in the evening, and his father nodded in agreement. The family shared a calm and warm morning.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Walking to work
description: Lei Mingxuan put on his new techwear vest, listened to a fashion podcast on his earphones, and walked through the lane to Super Brand Mall for work. Lujiazui in the early morning had not yet fully awakened, and most people on the road were residents doing morning exercise. When he arrived at the mall's employee entrance, he greeted Lao Liu, the familiar security guard, and started the new day's work with energy.
location: Along the route from Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Morning store operations and online work
description: After arriving at his clothing store on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, Lei Mingxuan first checked the previous night’s display, then processed 5 backlogged online orders, printed shipping labels, and packed them. At 9:00 the mall opened, and staff member Xiao Lin came on duty. The two had a brief morning meeting, confirming they would continue promoting the new techwear jacket, and rearranged basic T-shirts by color. Next to the fitting room, Lei Mingxuan used his iPad to make final adjustments to the renovation sketch of the coffee experience area, confirming the bar counter dimensions and socket positions. At 10:30, he had a video call with supplier Zhou Tao, showed the newly arrived fabric samples, and urged him to send the new fabric swatch cards before the 12th. The work arrangements were well organized.
location: Clothing store, No. A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Off-peak lunch and group chat interaction
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived alone at Ippudo Ramen in the B1 food court of Super Brand Mall before the lunch rush, and ordered the signature Akamaru ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While waiting, he took detail photos of his new jacket and sent them to his close-friend group chat "Three Musketeers of Pudong" with the caption: "Brothers, new arrival! How about wearing this for a night run after playing ball tonight?", which prompted teasing from group members Zhang Wei and Li Na. He quickly finished lunch in a relaxed atmosphere and rested for a while.
location: Ippudo Ramen, food court, B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon store duty and serving regular customers.
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic increased. Lei Mingxuan divided the work with clerk Xiao Lin, personally receiving customers who were interested in buying. Around 2 p.m., the regular customer Feng Xiaoyu (HR at a foreign company in Suzhou) came to the store to look at autumn clothing. Lei Mingxuan warmly received her, introduced the season's popular 'old money' and 'quiet luxury' styles, and, based on her workplace needs, recommended a high-thread-count cotton white shirt and flowing wide-leg pants. After trying them on, Feng Xiaoyu was very satisfied and bought two shirts and a pair of pants. She also added him on WeChat to receive new arrival updates in the future. As it approached 4 p.m., Lei Mingxuan prepared to close early.
location: Clothing store, No. A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Close the store early.
description: Lei Mingxuan briefly passed on the evening duties to the shop assistant Xiao Lin, leaving her to handle the remaining online orders, then pulled down the rolling shutter door and closed up early, his mind full of anticipation for the family dinner that evening.
location: Clothing store, No. A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Picking up flowers and walking home
description: Lei Mingxuan walked quickly to the Yujian Huakai Flower Shop at No. 999 Pudong South Road to pick up the reserved bouquet for Teacher's Day. The pink-white carnations and white lilies were elegantly arranged. He scanned the QR code to pay the balance, and happily walked home holding the bouquet, planning to surprise his mother.
location: On the way from Yujian Huakai Flower Shop at No. 999 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Shanggang Community.

name: Arrive home to present gifts and reveal the Teacher's Day surprise
description: Lei Mingxuan returned home to find his parents watching TV in the living room. He handed his mother a bouquet of carnations and lilies and wished her a happy Teachers' Day. She was startled at first, then her eyes reddened, but she scolded him for spending money recklessly. His father, Lei Jianguo, walked out of the room with a smile on his face. Lei Mingxuan then brought out a gift box from behind him — a soft camel-colored cashmere shawl. When his mother opened the box, she was moved to tears, and Lei Mingxuan stepped forward to hug her. His father urged his mother to change into something nice for going out to dinner. The family atmosphere was warm and touching.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family dinner for Teachers' Day
description: The family of three drove to the reserved private room at the Lujiazui Center Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant. The private room was quiet and serene, and through the floor-to-ceiling windows one could enjoy the Lujiazui night view. When ordering, Lei Mingxuan let his mother choose. She ordered her favorites — braised pork and steamed shad. Father and son added two signature dishes and osmanthus rice cakes. During the meal, the family chatted about the students his mother had taught, his father's chess life after retirement, and interesting stories from the clothing store. Lei Mingxuan poured osmanthus wine for his mother and accompanied his father in drinking bayberry liquor. His father rarely praised his son for being thoughtful, his mother was in a great mood, and the family atmosphere was warm and harmonious. Lei Mingxuan temporarily set aside his fat-loss plan and enjoyed the meal.
location: Private room, Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant, Lujiazui Center, 889 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Returning home and arranging the flower bouquet.
description: After the banquet ended, the family of three drove back home in Shanggang Community. Along the way, his mother kept stroking the cashmere shawl, unable to put it down. After arriving home, Lei Mingxuan helped his mother trim the lilies, put them in a vase in the living room, and placed it in a prominent spot. His parents sat on the sofa chatting with great relish, enjoying the warm family time.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Rest and state transition
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to his bedroom. He first replied to congratulatory messages from the shop and friends on his phone, then changed into a quick-dry athletic hoodie and lightweight sneakers, drank a few sips of warm water, and ate a banana for energy. Then he took out his phone and did a final read-through and polish of the already written novel chapter "Afternoon at Xiafei Fang," preparing for the evening billiards match and the novel update.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Practice for the billiards tournament
description: Lei Mingxuan rode a shared bike to the billiard hall on the B1 floor of World Plaza, 855 Pudong South Road. His friend Han Dong was already practicing thin cuts on the side pocket. After exchanging greetings, they began their third training session for the Pujiang Cup. To simulate a real match, they played five games of American eight-ball, and after each game they reviewed the recorded video, discussing offensive and defensive strategies and positional errors. Han Dong said Lei Mingxuan's long-distance potting was good but his defensive awareness could be improved, and he spent 20 extra minutes practicing kick shots and thin cuts on balls frozen to the rail. Throughout the session, they both paid attention to stretching to avoid fatigue.
location: Billiards hall, B1, World Plaza, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Go home to update the novel
description: After the practice, Lei Mingxuan and Han Dong agreed on the next training time, then he cycled home. His parents had already rested. He washed up quietly, went back to his bedroom, turned on the computer, and uploaded the polished novel chapter Afternoon at Xiafei Lane on time.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Reader Interaction and Blind Box Mailing
description: After updating the chapter, Lei Mingxuan browsed the comments section and replied to new messages. He made a point of contacting the core reader 'Old Bookworm,' thanked him for his long-term support, and had an in-depth discussion about subsequent plot development; Old Bookworm offered valuable suggestions. After that, Lei Mingxuan found the packaged blind-box parcel for the novel's first print run, scheduled an online pickup, and sent the tracking number to the winning reader via private message. Finally, he edited and posted an FAQ thread, pinned it to the work's discussion area, and answered readers' common questions about the timeline and character relationships.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pre-bedtime relaxation and journaling.
description: After handling all the matters, Lei Mingxuan lay in bed, filled with satisfaction. He opened his phone diary and recorded today's feelings: 'Teacher's Day, mom was very happy, worth it. Dongzi said my defense has improved, so I need to keep practicing. The novel's comment section is lively again, so nice.' Then at 23:30 he turned off the light and fell asleep with a smile.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Getting up, washing up, having breakfast, and publishing a call for novel ideas
description: Got up at 6:10 a.m. After washing up, I ate the fresh pork wontons my mother had cooked in the kitchen, while my father read Xinmin Evening News at the dining table. While eating, I used the memo app on my phone to sketch out today's novel event. At 7:00, I used my iPad to post a plot idea solicitation for 'An Afternoon in Xiafei Fang' in the novel's reader group and the app's comment section, explaining the activity rules, submission directions, and prizes, and pinned the post. I saw that loyal fans had already left supportive comments.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning commute preparation and cycling to work.
description: Changed into a techwear-style thin jacket, dark gray T-shirt and cargo pants, put on wireless earbuds, checked phone, keys, power bank and ID card, and quickly went over the day's important items in the phone memo. Left at 7:50 and rode a shared bike to work. Passing the old alleyway on Pudong Avenue, stopped to take photos of dappled light and shadows on fallen leaves and the sidewalk as the image for a post titled "The Taste of Early Autumn in Shanghai". After about 12 minutes of cycling, arrived at Super Brand Mall.
location: Along the route from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Arriving at the shop and preparing to open
description: Arrived at the store at 8:02; employee Lin Xiao was already cleaning and tidying. Prepared to open the store together: turned on the lighting system, re-hung some new items according to today's display plan, and checked the cash register and POS system. Told Lin Xiao the key tasks for today: she is responsible for ironing the new shirts and helping set up the gift box display area.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Inventory and planning of materials for the coffee area renovation.
description: Put on gloves, and together with Lin Xiao, carried out all the materials purchased over the weekend from the warehouse: wooden boards, metal brackets, shelves, storage boxes, and accessories such as pour-over kettles and filter cups. Checked the brand, quantity, and condition of each item against the purchase list and confirmed everything was fine. Then took out the iPad, opened the renovation sketch, and planned the specific construction positions in the store's coffee area based on the actual items. Used a measuring tape to roughly measure the layout dimensions and made marks on the wall with a pencil.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Set up the new gift box display area
description: Together with Lin Xiao, moved the newly arrived techwear gift boxes to the low cabinet in the corner, cleaned it, laid a new linen tablecloth, placed the gift boxes leaning diagonally by color, decorated with dry branches and dried flowers, and put handwritten price tags and DM flyers beside them, making it the visual focal point of the store.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and community management
description: Morning foot traffic increased. While inspecting the store, I received several young office workers looking at techwear jackets. At 10:30, I called supplier Zhou Tao to follow up on the shipment of new fabric swatch cards. After learning that SF Express would send them that afternoon and they would arrive the day after tomorrow, I felt relieved. Then I replied to online customers' size inquiries on WeChat. After that, I checked online orders to prepare for afternoon packing. Meanwhile, regular customer Qian Duoduo sent a WeChat message asking about commuter ankle-grazing cigarette pants. I sent matching photos and real-life shots and invited her to come to the store for a fitting after work. At 11:45, I took photos of the new gift box area and posted them to the store's WeChat Moments and VIP customer group.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch
description: At noon, asked Lin Xiao to watch the store, walked 5 minutes to the Japanese ramen shop on B1 of IFC Mall, ordered a bowl of signature special tonkotsu ramen and a serving of Japanese pan-fried dumplings. While eating, used my phone to reply to novel readers' comments and direct messages about the creative submission event, and selected some wonderful content to interact with.
location: Japanese Ramen Restaurant, B1, International Finance Center Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and shipping
description: In the afternoon, returned to the store, and customer flow was steady. On WeChat, chatted with Feng Xiaoyu, the key account manager in Suzhou, about styling advice; she said she would visit the store when she comes to Shanghai before National Day. During that time, received several phone calls asking about the pour-over coffee event. Afterwards, packed the online orders checked in the morning together with Lin Xiao: folding clothes, placing tags and gift cards, bagging, and attaching shipping labels. At the cash register, used the computer to organize the day's receipts and inventory, while also attending to walk-in customers, patiently giving styling advice, and successfully sold one pair of work pants and one techwear vest.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing up the shop, commuting home, and shopping
description: In the afternoon, customer flow gradually decreased. At the cashier, I checked the comment section of the novel platform's creative solicitation post. There were already more than 20 high-quality suggestions. I read them carefully and replied to a few, and sent a private message to the core reader "Old Bookworm" to thank him for his in-depth suggestions and encourage him to keep participating. Afterwards, I tidied up the shop with Lin Xiao: put clothes back in place, wiped the fitting room mirrors, and vacuumed the carpet. At 17:30, I settled the day's revenue, had Lin Xiao clock out and register, and told her to take care of the coffee area plants tomorrow and keep an eye on the gift box area inventory. I turned off the lights, pulled down the rolling shutter door, clocked out, and left. On the way home on foot, I detoured to Yanqin Grocery Store and bought imported pure milk, whole wheat bread, and organic vegetables. I arrived home at about 18:25.
location: Commute route from Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Evening family time
description: When you walked in, you smelled braised pork ribs. After putting the groceries in the fridge, you flopped onto the sofa and drank water, chatted with your father about the stock market, and shared with your mother today's store situation and the novel event. The family had dinner together; your mother made ribs and green vegetables. At the table, you shared funny stories from the store and your weekend plan to renovate the coffee area, and your father said he would be willing to help.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening stretching.
description: After resting for half an hour after the meal, I opened the Keep app on my phone on the yoga mat in the living room and followed a 15-minute full-body stretching and neck-and-shoulder relaxation routine. Considering the heavy physical labor over the weekend, I skipped strength training. After stretching, the fatigue in my body clearly faded.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Novel Community Operations and Engagement
description: After showering, he logged into the novel's backend on his laptop. First, he posted an update under the creative contest thread to encourage everyone to keep participating. Then he found his core reader, Old Bookworm, and had an in-depth private chat about the issue he raised regarding the male protagonist's personality development, again thanking him for his support. After that, he popped into the reader group and chatted with active members.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Planning weekend renovation construction steps
description: He opened the iPad, pulled up the material photos taken in the morning and the original renovation sketches, and used a note-taking app to refine the weekend coffee area renovation construction steps based on the morning's measurements: remove the old cabinet, install metal brackets, fix the shelves, install a pour-over coffee equipment storage rack, and listed the items to buy at the hardware store on Saturday, including a spirit level, electric drill, expansion screws and other tools.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wash up, write in my diary, and get ready for bed.
description: After finishing the planning, he wrote a short diary entry in his phone's memo app, recording the day's work highlights (the gift box area display effect, number of event replies) and to-do items. At 11 p.m., he turned off the bedside lamp, put on an eye mask, and prepared to sleep, planning to fall asleep before 11:10.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and interaction in the novel's comment section
description: He woke up naturally at home in the early morning, and the morning light outside the window was perfect. He picked up his phone and checked the comment section for the novel “Afternoon at Xiafei Fang”, and was delighted to find more than 20 comments. He got up, opened the curtains, used his iPad to share his carefully prepared writing playlist in a pinned comment, and added a message to interact with readers. He replied to his core reader “Old Bookworm” and praised his imaginative ideas. The comment section's activity kept rising.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and daily planning
description: Washed up briefly and tidied hair in the mirror. While brushing teeth, reviewed the day's key tasks: confirm the sample card order number with supplier Tao Ge, put the designer toys in the coffee corner, and coordinate the trouser-fitting time with regular customer Qian Duoduo. Clear mind, full of energy.
location: Bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast chat.
description: Had breakfast with my parents. Mom prepared fresh pork wontons and pan-fried buns. During the meal, I discussed with my father Lei Jianguo the plan to talk about the coffee area electrical renovation in the evening. He expressed support and said he would prepare the electrician's manual. We also talked about the enthusiastic response from readers of my novel to the playlist. Mom found it interesting and heartwarming.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting by bike and contacting suppliers
description: Before going out, checked phone and keys, walked to Zhangyang Road, unlocked a shared bike, and rode to Super Brand Mall. On the way, called supplier Zhou Tao to ask for the tracking number of the fabric sample card. Zhou Tao promised to send it to WeChat within half an hour. After hanging up, sped up the cycling.
location: Pudong Avenue to Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai (commute route).

name: Store opening preparation work
description: Arrived at the Super Brand Mall store, pulled up the rolling shutter door, and turned on the cash register system and spotlights. Staff member Xiao Lin arrived on time.
