After exchanging morning greetings, he briefed the day's work priorities, especially the display adjustments for the afternoon foot traffic increase and the implementation of the trendy toy and coffee crossover plan.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Adjust store displays and bring trendy toys into the coffee corner
description: Divided the work with Xiao Lin. I moved goods and adjusted the main display rack, hanging the tech vests and cargo pants in a prominent position near the entrance. Xiao Lin moved four popular designer toy blind boxes from the low cabinet to the new shelf beside the coffee corner, adjusting their height and angle so customers could see them at a glance while waiting for coffee. After that, I took a photo of the new coffee corner layout and sent it to the VIP customer group.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online logistics confirmation and customer communication.
description: Sitting at the register drinking an iced Americano, he checked his phone. He received an SF Express tracking number from Zhou Tao, copied and saved it, and thanked him. Regular customer Qian Duoduo sent a message asking about a time to try on the pants, and they agreed she would come to the store around 1:30 p.m. He immediately took out a pair of khaki commuter pants from inventory and hung them on the rack in the rest area to hold them for her.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Light lunch and browsing industry news.
description: Turned off the store music, told Xiao Lin, then walked to Wagas on B1 of IFC Mall to eat, ordering a Supermodel Salad with grilled chicken breast. While eating, he browsed autumn styling trends shared by fashion industry bloggers and sent messages to interact in the friend group "Pudong Three Musketeers", preparing for the weekend renovation.
location: Wagas (ifc Store), B1, Shanghai ifc Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Served regular customer Qian Duoduo for a fitting and closed the sale.
description: Back at the store, Xiao Lin was still having lunch. At about 13:30, Qian Duoduo arrived on time wearing a commuter shirt and skirt. Lei Mingxuan warmly invited her to try on the khaki commuter pants he had reserved for her. After trying them on, she was very satisfied with the cut and the fabric and immediately bought them. She said she hoped to be the first to be notified once the coffee corner renovation was complete.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and novel comment section maintenance
description: Customer traffic increased in the afternoon. He and Xiao Lin used chat-based selling and experience-based guidance respectively. Standing beside the coffee corner, he introduced trendy toy pairings to customers waiting for their coffee and successfully closed sales. During work breaks, he repeatedly refreshed the novel's comment section, selected creative replies, and sent voice messages in the reader group to thank readers for their support; the number of comments rose steadily.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening rush-hour service and closing review
description: In the evening, the mall foot traffic peaked. He received multiple batches of customers and successfully cross-sold tech-wear vests and baseball caps to two young men who were interested in cargo pants. After the mall played the closing announcement at 18:00 and the crowd thinned out, he arranged for Xiao Lin to clean up while he opened the sales report to review the day: today's sales were about 12% higher than a usual Friday, with the trend toys clearly driving the boost. He acknowledged Xiao Lin's work, gave instructions for the next day, and then turned off the main power switch.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bought supplies at a hardware store on the way home.
description: After leaving the store and walking to Zhangyang Road, I turned into the Xianying Home Decor & Hardware Store near Pudian Road. I found that I still needed three-core sheathed cable and 86-type surface-mounted socket back boxes. During the selection process, I discussed the wiring plan with the boss, who suggested buying a hole saw. I accepted and bought it together with the rest.
location: Xianying Home Decor & Hardware Store, Pudian Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and discussion of electrical rewiring plan
description: After getting home, put the hardware materials in the corner of the living room. Mother had prepared steamed sea bass, garlic stir-fried water spinach, and braised beef brisket. During dinner, I described the coffee area renovation plan to my father in detail, including the idea of adding a floor outlet on the side of the bar. Father agreed to run the wiring through the ceiling and bring it down along the wall corner to keep it looking neat.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening yoga stretching and relaxation.
description: After the meal, I rested for half an hour, laid out the yoga mat in the living room, opened the Keep app, and selected the “Bedtime Body Relaxation” course. I did 20 minutes of yoga stretching, focusing on relaxing the shoulders, neck, and lower back, to prepare for tomorrow's physical work. My body and mind felt relaxed.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Novel platform interactions and author updates
description: After stretching, I took a shower, changed into pajamas, and lay in bed opening the novel's dashboard. New comments today had already exceeded 45, beating the interaction target. I carefully replied to 10 high-quality plot discussions and sent private messages thanking the core reader 'Old Bookworm' for the long review. I published a skit-style 'Author's Note' and hinted that there might be occasional updates during weekend construction, hoping readers would keep following.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Plan tomorrow's construction plan and wash up.
description: He took out his laptop, opened the coffee area renovation sketch, and used a red pen to mark the circuit routing plan that had been confirmed with his father. He organized the construction steps and tool list, and confirmed that all materials were ready. Then he brushed his teeth and washed his face, and encouraged himself in the mirror.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading and rest before bed
description: I set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning, picked up “Those Stories from the Ming Dynasty” from the bedside, and after reading a few pages, drowsiness set in. I turned off the lamp and mentally rehearsed tomorrow's construction process. I fell into a deep sleep with the satisfaction of thorough planning, drifting off before 11 p.m.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: The alarm clock rang on time. Lei Mingxuan woke up in his bedroom at home in Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. It was cloudy, 24–29°C, and cool. After stretching, he weighed himself at 79.0 kg—slightly heavier than yesterday, which was normal given the physical work. After washing up, he changed into a T-shirt and work pants, and confirmed his tool bag had everything: cordless drill, screwdrivers, spirit level, and so on.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast.
description: Lei Mingxuan came to the dining room at home to have breakfast with his parents Lei Jianguo and Wang Xiuying. His mother had prepared fresh pork wontons, fried eggs, and pickled vegetables. While watching the news, his father reminded him to be careful to avoid the drain pipe in the floor slab when drilling holes today and recommended using a metal wire duct. Lei Mingxuan noted the suggestion and felt more confident.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the store
description: Lei Mingxuan put on his backpack loaded with tools and materials and went out. At the entrance of the residential community, he scanned the code to unlock a shared bike, rode along Pudong Avenue, turned right onto Lujiazui Ring Road, and arrived at the side parking spot of Super Brand Mall about 8 minutes later. Along the way, he took a photo of a plane tree, intending to use it in today's interactive novel post.
location: Cycling route from Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Preparations for opening the store and construction planning
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan unlocked the door, ventilated the space, tidied the checkout counter, and unboxed the 86-type surface-mounted socket back boxes and metal wire ducts that arrived last night. At 8:15, Xiao Lin, the store assistant, arrived. Together they moved aside the clutter in the coffee corner and laid down dust cloths. Then Lei Mingxuan explained the day's construction process to Xiao Lin: set up the frame in the morning, run the wiring in the afternoon. He then led a brief morning meeting, checked appointment orders and online rush orders, arranged for Xiao Lin to mainly handle reception during the afternoon peak hours, and decided the day's Moments post would mainly promote the autumn jacket paired with cargo pants. At 9:05, preparation for construction began. Lei Mingxuan neatly placed the tools on the silicone mat in the coffee corner work area, plugged in the electric drill, counted the screws and expansion anchors, and rechecked the shelf dimensions.
location: Inside the clothing store at A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: First phase of the coffee corner construction — framework building
description: Started work on time at 9:15. Lei Mingxuan snapped a chalk line with a level, drilled six expansion bolt holes with a hammer drill, and Xiao Lin assisted by passing screws and wiping away dust. By 9:50 the vertical posts were fixed. At 10:05 he began installing the birch wood shelves. At 10:50 a screw was stripped, so he replaced it with a spare screw. By 11:20 all three shelves were in place, and the coffee corner frame had begun to take shape. Lei Mingxuan took photos to document the work and covered the construction area with a dust cloth.
location: Coffee corner construction area inside the clothing store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations and online responsiveness
description: After the morning rush hour, there were few customers. Lei Mingxuan used the free time at the cash register to reply to 5 reader comments on the novel's backend, telling them there would be an interactive summary in the evening. Xiao Lin greeted a female customer who was looking at trench coats. Lei Mingxuan went over and talked with her, successfully selling one. Meanwhile, he processed 3 small online orders and packed them for afternoon shipment.
location: Cashier area inside clothing store A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and post-meal cleanup
description: Because he was covered in construction dust and didn't want to go out, Lei Mingxuan asked Xiao Lin to go to the Mong Kok Cafe on B1 of Super Brand Mall to bring lunch back to the store. The two quickly ate char siu and scrambled egg rice and curry beef brisket rice with iced lemon tea in the rest area. Lei Mingxuan took photos of the meal boxes and sent them to the "Pudong Three Musketeers" friends group. After the meal, he cleaned up the boxes, wiped his hands with wet wipes, and put the electric drill and steel tape measure back into the tool bag.
location: Rest area of the clothing store at Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online novel interaction and summary
description: Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop in the store's rest area / in front of the cashier counter and began the online interaction for his novel "The Afternoon in Xiafei Lane". He first replied to each of this week's 15 comments and 8 private messages, then sorted the voting results and created a public announcement graphic. At 13:40, he published a new chapter of 1,800 characters. At 13:55, he posted the weekly interaction summary, attached the photo of plane trees taken this morning, and announced that next week's side story would feature the option that came in first place as the protagonist. After posting, he replied to several new comments and sent a summary link to the readers' group.
location: Cashier counter / rest area, Clothing Store A-208, Level 2, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Coffee corner second-phase construction — wiring and installation.
description: The construction work continued. Lei Mingxuan first checked the sturdiness of the shelf boards, laid out materials such as wires, metal wire ducts, and the hole saw, and marked the routing path with a pencil. At 14:30, he turned off the main power switch of the coffee corner. Xiao Lin steadied the ladder while Lei Mingxuan used a hole saw to drill wire holes in the outlet cover plate. He then fixed the wire ducts and used a wire puller to feed the wires down to the bottom of the post. At 15:30, he secured the socket back boxes. He briefly paused while Xiao Lin was serving customers. After installation, Lei Mingxuan used a test pen to check the circuit and confirmed the back boxes were secure. At 16:00, the main circuit installation was completed, with the final connections left for a professional electrician the next day. Afterwards, the two used a vacuum cleaner to clean up the dust, put away the tools, and folded the dust sheets.
location: Coffee corner construction area inside the clothing store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening peak operations, revenue review, and closing
description: After 16:10, customer traffic increased. Lei Mingxuan changed into a clean shirt and actively greeted young customers. At 17:10 he sold two pairs of collaborative cargo pants. At 17:30 Xiao Lin recommended trendy hoodies to a middle school student, and Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to promote the store's upcoming coffee experience event. After 18:00, customer traffic gradually decreased. He exported the day's revenue records: total sales were about 4,200 yuan, with online orders accounting for 30%, better than an ordinary Saturday. From 18:30 the two closed up, turned off the spotlights and air conditioning, and checked the doors and windows. Lei Mingxuan told Xiao Lin that he would come to the store the next afternoon to do the final wiring work and suggested she keep the regular schedule. He then locked up and sent the construction photos to his father.
location: Inside the clothing store at A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking home and buying groceries
description: Lei Mingxuan walked home from Super Brand Mall. He followed Lujiazui Ring Road to Pudong South Road and arrived at Pushang Vegetable Market after about 19 minutes. At a familiar stall, he bought 4 yellow lemons, a bunch of scallions, and a few eggplants. The stall owner, Auntie Wang, gave him an extra bunch of cilantro. Then, carrying the vegetables, he continued walking for 15 minutes back to his home in Shanggang Community. His manual step count was about 7,500 steps.
location: From Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, via Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Home arrival report and family dinner
description: When Lei Mingxuan got home, his parents were busy in the kitchen. After putting down the groceries, he immediately took out his phone and showed the construction photos to his father sitting on the sofa in the living room. His father looked carefully and praised the shelving for being level and the conduit runs for being neat, and suggested buying another five-hole outlet so they could use the coffee machine and pour-over kettle at the same time later. The family of three then had dinner together. His mother made braised beef, scrambled eggs with tomatoes, stir-fried water spinach with garlic, and winter melon and spare rib soup. While eating, Lei Mingxuan chatted about the funny things that happened during construction, and his mother remarked that he really enjoyed it. He had a hearty appetite and ate two bowls of rice, after which he volunteered to clear the table.
location: Living room and dining room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Light stretching and relaxation
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into shorts, spread out a yoga mat in the living room, and stretched. For the shoulder and knee soreness caused by that day's construction work, he did 15 minutes of wall-assisted shoulder stretches, seated forward folds, and cat-cow poses, then spent 5 minutes on three sets of calf stretches. He felt much looser, and his fatigue was relieved.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Bathing and rest
description: Lei Mingxuan took a hot shower, washing off the wall dust and sweaty smell, changed into cotton loungewear, and went back to the bedroom. He browsed the reader group on his phone, saw that the interactive summary post had received 20 likes, and replied to a die-hard fan's question. After that, he scrolled through renovation videos on a video platform for a while and learned a small trick for threading steel wire through embedded conduits.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading and journaling before bed.
description: Lei Mingxuan was reading Volume 2 of Those Things in the Ming Dynasty on his bed in his bedroom. He found the content about Emperor Jiajing and Xu Jie very interesting. At 21:45, he closed the book and wrote today's summary in the notes app on his phone: completed the coffee area framework and wiring, published the interactive summary post for the novel, the family dinner was warm, and he received professional guidance from his father.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing for bed and thinking about the novel
description: Lei Mingxuan first set an alarm for 07:00 the next day and added the reminder 'Arrive at store by 09:00, confirm wooden board delivery', then sent a voice message to Brother Tao asking about the delivery time of the wooden boards. He also sent a message in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat saying that work was finished today, and Li Na reminded him to watch his lower back. After that, leaning on the bed, he used his tablet to draft the outline for next week's extra episode. Centering on the clue from the interactive post, he conceived the synopsis of 'The Secret Letter in the Pavilion', in which the protagonist discovers an unsent letter from his late mother in a lane in 2002. He wrote an outline of about 700 characters and saved it.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and going to sleep before bed.
description: Lei Mingxuan went to the bathroom to brush his teeth, wash his face, and apply a simple moisturizing lotion. After turning off the living room light, he returned to the bedroom, dimmed the desk lamp, placed the alarm clock farther away, and confirmed that his phone had been switched to sleep mode. Lying down, he reviewed the day: construction progress had exceeded expectations, the novel's interactive feedback was positive, and dinner had been hearty. Satisfied, he closed his eyes and fell asleep.
location: The bedroom and bathroom at home in Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake-up and morning exercise
description: Lei Mingxuan woke up to the sound of his alarm, feeling some muscle soreness from yesterday's construction work. He walked to the electronic scale in the living room and weighed himself; it showed 79.1 kg. After a quick wash, he changed into a sports vest and shorts, spread out a yoga mat on the bedroom floor, and began a 15-minute restorative strength training session: 3 sets of push-ups (12 reps each), 2 sets of squat jumps (15 reps each), and 1 set of plank (held for 90 seconds), to resume his morning exercise habit that had been interrupted for several days.
location: At home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and planning for the day.
description: After training, he took a shower and changed into casual T-shirt and shorts. His mother Wang Xiuying had prepared breakfast: white rice porridge, fried eggs, several small dishes, and two meat buns. While eating breakfast, Lei Mingxuan reported today's plan to his parents: the electrician would arrive at the store at nine to connect the main line for the coffee area, the wood boards would be delivered in the morning, and everything could be installed by the afternoon, so in the evening he could invite family and friends to drink the coffee he made. His father Lei Jianguo reminded him not to forget to install the splash-proof box, and his mother told him not to forget to eat lunch at noon.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan put on his backpack, which held a replacement razor head for his father and a notebook on hand-brewed coffee, and walked 27 minutes to Super Brand Mall. The morning sunlight shone on the high-rises of Lujiazui, and roadside trees cast dappled shadows. Just after 8 a.m., the shop assistant Xiao Lin had already opened the door. Lei Mingxuan greeted him briefly, then checked the tools and materials left from yesterday's construction and confirmed everything was ready. He then opened the logistics app on his phone to check the morning delivery status of the wooden boards; it showed they were out for delivery. He also checked the accessory package sent by Sister Fang from Guangzhou, and the tracking number showed it had arrived at the Pudong sorting center and was expected to be delivered in the afternoon.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Main Circuit Construction in the Coffee Area
description: Just after 9, the electrician he had booked, Master Zhang, arrived on time. Lei Mingxuan took out the wiring plan drawing confirmed with his father yesterday and discussed the specific cable routing path with Master Zhang, emphasizing that the splash-proof boxes purchased earlier should be installed on the outlets. Master Zhang skillfully ran the wiring through the ceiling, connected the main electrical box to the main line of the coffee area, and installed an air switch and outlets with splash-proof boxes. It took about 50 minutes.
location: 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Store A-208, Coffee Experience Area

name: Countertop assembly and equipment display adjustment
description: Just as the electrician left, the delivery worker arrived with the custom-cut wooden boards. Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin carried the boards to the work area together. After checking them, Lei Mingxuan put on gloves and began the final assembly and fixing of the countertop and decorative panels. He first used a level to calibrate, then used an impact drill to drive expansion bolts into the wall, moving with skill. Around 11:00, the wooden countertop and two decorative panels were firmly fixed on the wall. After assembly, Lei Mingxuan took out his treasured Kalita copper kettle, Hario cloud kettle, and other equipment from the storage room, and carefully placed them on the newly built shelf and countertop according to the layout he had planned. He plugged in the power and briefly tested the coffee machine — everything was normal. Then he called Xiao Lin over and gave a quick demonstration of how the pour-over kettle and water thermometer work together, and told Xiao Lin that he would explain the follow-up maintenance and cleaning procedures in detail in the afternoon.
location: 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Store A-208, Coffee Experience Area

name: Lunch and work exchange
description: It was already past noon, and both were hungry. Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin came to the Mong Kok Tea Restaurant on the B1 floor of the mall. Lei Mingxuan ordered a pineapple sweet-and-sour pork rice and a glass of iced lemon tea. While eating, he chatted with Xiao Lin about display ideas for next week's new products and how to use the new coffee area to attract customers, and mentioned how to coordinate the display with the accessory samples that Wu Fang would deliver in the afternoon.
location: Mong Kok Cafe, B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Detail finishing and sample acceptance
description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan returned to the shop and began the final touches. He used sandpaper to round off the edges of the wooden boards, cleaned up the dust left from the construction, and then wiped the entire countertop and display shelves with a damp cloth. He again checked that every power outlet was secure and pressed the steam button on the coffee machine to confirm it was working properly. At that moment, he received a delivery notification from Wu Fang in the WeChat group, saying that the accessory samples had been received by the parcel locker on the first floor of the mall. Lei Mingxuan went downstairs and retrieved the accessory samples Wu Fang had sent. Back in the shop, he opened the package; inside were several delicately designed shell earrings, woven bracelets, and a metal necklace. He placed them on the newly installed shelf in the coffee area, creating a combination of “curated finds + hand-drip coffee” with the coffee equipment nearby, and the effect pleased him. He immediately took photos and sent them to the VIP customer group, announcing that they would be available next week.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pour-over coffee demonstration and community sharing.
description: Lei Mingxuan put on an apron and formally demonstrated the complete pour-over coffee process to Xiao Lin. While operating, he explained: "The water temperature should be controlled at 90 degrees. First, bloom for 30 seconds to let the coffee grounds release carbon dioxide..." He showed how to control the water flow speed, pour in circles, and after finishing, how to clean the filter paper and maintain the equipment. Xiao Lin listened carefully and tried it herself once. After the demonstration, Lei Mingxuan took several finished photos of the coffee experience area with his phone from different angles and lighting, and sent the one he was most satisfied with to his clothing store renovation exchange group and VIP customer group. In the group, he wrote: "Months of hard work finally came to fruition today. Thank you all for your suggestions and support! Welcome to the store, and I'll make you a cup." He also added a few coffee and flower emojis.
location: 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Store A-208, Coffee Experience Area

name: Walk to the supermarket for shopping
description: Lei Mingxuan greeted Xiao Lin, took off his apron, picked up the shopping bags, and set off on foot for the Jiadefu Supermarket where he had agreed to meet his mother that evening. At 4:30 p.m., Lei Mingxuan and his mother met at the supermarket entrance and began their weekly family shopping trip. Pushing a shopping cart and following his mother's list, they focused on buying high-quality proteins such as chicken breast, beef tenderloin, and salmon, along with healthy vegetables like broccoli, avocado, and cherry tomatoes. In the electronics section, Lei Mingxuan found the replacement heads for a certain brand of razor his father needed. After finishing the shopping, the two headed home carrying bags of all sizes.
location: No. 537 Pucheng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Jiadefu Supermarket (Pucheng Road Store)

name: Return home, tidy up, and have family dinner
description: The two of them carried large and small bags and strolled home slowly. The plane trees along the way cast shade, and familiar music came from a barbershop by the road. His mother greeted the fruit stand owner downstairs and bought some tangerines. Back home, Lei Mingxuan and his mother sorted the purchased ingredients into the refrigerator. He gave the new razor head to his father, who happily replaced and tried it on the spot. Dinner was steamed sea bass, boiled prawns, and garlic broccoli made by his mother, in line with Lei Mingxuan's fat-reduction plan. The family ate and chatted; Lei Mingxuan excitedly shared the day's completion of the coffee area.
location: At home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening writing and novel update
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan helped clear the dishes. Back in his room, he opened his laptop and logged into the novel platform. He first published today's new chapter of "The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane", then began writing this week's writing summary. He wrote: "This week, we received a lot of creative ideas about lane life... Special thanks to 'Old Bookworm' for the magnolia clue, and 'Money More' for the suggestions on hairstyle descriptions..." He pinned the weekly summary to the top of the comments section and @ed several core readers.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, home bedroom.

name: Stretching, washing up, and rest
description: After completing the update, Lei Mingxuan felt a strong wave of fatigue wash over him. Rather than forcing himself to stay awake, he turned off the computer and did a few simple yoga stretches on the bedroom floor to relieve the day's fatigue. Then he went to the bathroom to wash up and changed into pajamas. With the major renovation of the coffee area successfully completed, his mind relaxed, and combined with several days of physical exertion, Lei Mingxuan felt an unprecedented exhaustion. He drew the curtains, lay down on the bed, and recalling the fulfilling day, smiled with satisfaction and soon fell asleep.
location: At home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and stretching
description: The alarm went off at exactly 6 a.m. The sky was cloudy outside, and a 26-degree breeze blew into the room with the coolness of autumn. Lei Mingxuan got up and first went to the bathroom to wash up, then stepped on the body fat scale and weighed himself: it read 79.2 kg. He thought that bite of tiramisu last night had indeed taken effect, and he decided to control his diet today. Then he spread a yoga mat on the balcony and did 10 minutes of full-body static stretching and a few cat-cow stretches to activate his body, preparing for his walking commute. He also mentally planned to walk at least 10,000 steps today.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Breakfast and reviewing the Japanese gojūon
description: Mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared breakfast: a steaming bowl of buckwheat noodles, with a boiled egg and a few cherry tomatoes. Lei Mingxuan, while eating, opened the "Kana Chart Listening and Sound Discrimination" module of the Japanese learning app on his phone. The standard pronunciation came through his earphones. As he chewed, he silently repeated "、、、、", using this precious fragmented time to do a final listening review of the kana chart. His mother watched him from the side and said with a smile, "You can't sit still even at meals. Study is study, but you should still eat properly."
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Walking commute and practical Japanese review.
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into an off-white workwear shirt and khaki casual pants, grabbed his commuter bag and the coffee area renovation notes, and left on time at 6:50 to walk to the shop. He followed Pudong Avenue east, then turned onto West Lujiazui Road. On the roughly 1.8-kilometer route, he deliberately slowed his pace and kept an aerobic cadence, arriving in about 22 minutes. On the way, he used the time for a final practical review of the gojūon: without looking at his phone, he silently recited hiragana and katakana, and tried to spell out shop signs he saw on the roadside using katakana, such as Starbucks and FamilyMart, to deepen his memory.
location: Walking route from Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to No. 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Store opening preparation and sample receiving and shipping
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan first opened the rolling shutter door and all the spotlights to brighten the space. He then checked the coffee area that had just been renovated the day before, confirmed that the power switch was responsive and the countertop was clean, and felt at ease. Next, he told staff member Xiao Lin the day's priorities and arranged for Xiao Lin to go to the property management office on the first floor to pick up a package. At around 08:15, Xiao Lin returned with a courier box containing samples sent by Wu Fang. Lei Mingxuan opened the package and found several exquisite silver ornaments paired with baroque pearls, full of design flair. After photographing each piece, he took out a bag of Yunnan natural-process coffee beans he had bought during last week's training from the cabinet under the bar counter, packed it in a prepared coffee gift box, and attached a handwritten thank-you card: “Sister Fang, the samples arrived and the quality is great! Try these beans—they're freshly roasted. Come visit Shanghai when you have time.” Then he called SF City Direct to send the gift box to Guangzhou.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Normal business operations and display adjustments
description: On Monday morning, the mall wasn't crowded. Lei Mingxuan took advantage of the relatively quiet time to create a coordinated display combining the newly arrived accessory samples with the coffee area. He picked out a few wine glass racks, hung necklaces and bracelets on them, and placed them at the corner of the coffee counter, with a pour-over kettle and a few coffee magazines nearby, creating a scene full of everyday life. He then walked around the store to make sure all the clothes were hanging in the same direction. Around 10 o'clock, he sent a message in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group: "Guys, the coffee area in the store is ready. It's absolutely classy. Come try my brew this weekend @everyone." His friend Han Dong replied shortly after: "Weekend? I'm afraid you'll drink me into the hospital. Let's warm up with a game of billiards on Saturday afternoon first." Lei Mingxuan replied with a "No problem" emoji sticker.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and Japanese language app test
description: Near noon, Lei Mingxuan asked Xiao Lin to watch the store while he went downstairs to Mong Kok Cafe on B1 of Super Brand Mall for lunch. He ordered the signature curry beef brisket rice and a cup of iced lemon tea. While waiting for the food, he took out his phone, opened the Japanese learning app, and took the "Comprehensive Test on the Fifty Sounds Chart." The questions covered listening and choosing the correct sound, adding kana to kanji, and writing kanji from kana. He concentrated fully and finished in 15 minutes. After submitting, he saw a perfect score of 100 and felt a surge of satisfaction. He took a screenshot and posted it in the Japanese learning group with the caption: "Fifty Sounds Chart, cleared! Next up: verb conjugation!" Someone in the group immediately replied, "The boss is awesome!"
location: Wangjiao Tea Restaurant, B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon business and novel inspiration notes
description: After eating, they returned to the store, and the afternoon customer flow gradually picked up. A regular customer, Qian Duoduo, pushed the door open and immediately spotted the newly arranged coffee area. Excitedly, she said, 'Brother Lei, this spot of yours is amazing! Can I also drop by for a cup of coffee next time I buy clothes?' Lei Mingxuan smiled and waved: 'Of course, today I'll treat you to a cup first—give me your thoughts!' He then used the store's pour-over kettle to brew a cup of washed Yirgacheffe for Qian Duoduo. The two chatted as they drank. Qian Duoduo was also interested in the newly arrived accessories and bought a bracelet. After seeing Qian Duoduo off, Lei Mingxuan sat behind the counter, took out his phone's memo app, and began to outline a new chapter for his novel 'The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane' that he needed to update today. He incorporated the 'coffee and outfit pairing' inspiration from his chat with Qian Duoduo into the plot, writing the scene where the female lead happens to meet a fashion blogger at a lane coffee shop.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Business operations and National Day promotion ideas
description: Business went smoothly in the afternoon. Lei Mingxuan greeted new and regular customers while jotting down preliminary ideas for the National Day promotion in his phone memo during spare moments. He came up with two directions: one was a 'spend-threshold mystery box draw,' where customers who spent a certain amount could draw a popular mystery box, tying in nicely with the store's designer toys; the other was to hold a small 'Autumn Limited Coffee Tasting' event in the coffee area, inviting VIP customers and regulars, featuring several different pour-over coffees and autumn special drinks on site. He also sent these ideas to his cousin Shen Jie for her opinion on feasibility. Shen Jie replied, 'The mystery box idea is good, but for the tasting event, it's best to cap the number of attendees and make it reservation-only to make it feel more exclusive.'
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Closing the store early and walking home.
description: At exactly 17:00, Lei Mingxuan pulled down the rolling shutter door on time, briefed Xiao Lin on the next day's work priorities, and reminded him to turn off the water and electricity. He then walked home. This time he did not deliberately slow down but walked at a normal pace, which also helped digest the meal and make room for the evening family dinner. After 28 minutes, he arrived at the entrance of Shanggang Community.
location: Walking route from Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Morning strength training
description: At six in the morning, the alarm went off on time. Lei Mingxuan spread out his yoga mat on the bedroom floor and followed the workout app for the third strength-training session of the month. He completed squats, push-ups, planks, and other exercises in turn, resting fully between sets, feeling his muscles activate and fill. After the workout, he recorded the data in the app, took a sweaty selfie, and sent it to the friends' group chat, humorously announcing that he was starting his day full of energy.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up, breakfast, and family communication
description: After training, took a quick shower, changed into comfortable cotton clothes, and went to the dining room to have breakfast with his mother. Mother had prepared boiled egg whites, whole wheat bread, and warm milk. While eating, Lei Mingxuan excitedly described to his mother the plan to officially open the coffee experience area today. Mother listened with a smile and urged him to rest well and eat regularly. He also confirmed the dinner menu agreed upon last night with his mother. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online warm-up and bouquet confirmation
description: Before leaving, Lei Mingxuan took photos of the green plants in the morning light on the living-room balcony, added a warm good-morning greeting, and posted them to the book club readers group and the VIP customer group as a warm-up promotion for the upcoming coffee experience area. Then he called the online flower shop to confirm that the carnation and lily bouquet he had ordered yesterday had been delivered and signed for by his mother. Relieved, he looked forward to starting the new day.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Walking commute and morning rush hour observations
description: Lei Mingxuan set off from the residential community on time, walked along Pudong Avenue, turned onto Lujiazui West Road, and headed to Super Brand Mall on foot. Along the way, he used his phone to record the clear blue sky of early autumn, the skyscrapers of Lujiazui, and the plane trees along the road, feeling the city waking up. Elderly people doing morning exercise and hurried office workers formed a vivid street scene. He walked briskly, blending into the energetic morning.
location: Along the walking route in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, from Shanggang Residential Community (Lane 136, Pudong Avenue) to Super Brand Mall (No. 168 West Lujiazui Road)

name: Final adjustments and preparation for the coffee experience area
description: After arriving at the shop, Lei Mingxuan and staff member Xiao Lin divided the work: Xiao Lin cleaned the coffee bar and arranged the handmade cookies and coffee cups; Lei Mingxuan debugged the newly arrived Italian espresso machine, tried making pour-over coffee with Yunnan small-bean coffee beans, and adjusted the grind size until the taste was optimal. He placed the pre-made promotional standee reading "Buy clothing + 9.9 yuan to get a pour-over coffee" at the entrance in a conspicuous spot. Everything was ready, waiting for opening.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Officially launching the coffee experience area and morning market operations
description: At exactly 9 a.m., the shop opened for business and the new coffee experience area officially made its debut. Lei Mingxuan gave the first customer, who was browsing jackets, a free tasting cup of Yirgacheffe pour-over coffee and explained in detail the origin characteristics and flavor of the coffee beans. The customer was pleasantly surprised, immediately bought an autumn knit sweater, and accepted the invitation to share her store-visit notes on social media. During a break in business, Lei Mingxuan handled scattered messages from suppliers Zhou Tao and Wu Fang. The opening day got off to a great start.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepare to welcome Qian Duoduo and host a visit
description: After receiving word that regular customer Qian Duoduo was about to arrive, Lei Mingxuan quickly prepared the pour-over equipment at the coffee bar and reserved a spot for her. Qian Duoduo arrived as promised and was delighted to discover the new coffee corner in the shop. Lei Mingxuan brewed her a complimentary pour-over, and the two chatted over coffee about commuting outfits for the new autumn styles. Qian Duoduo excitedly took photos and posted them on WeChat Moments, praising the atmosphere and coffee quality while voluntarily promoting the shop. They also exchanged thoughts on new items such as the khaki trench coat, and the conversation went very well.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday operations and online promotion
description: After Qian Duoduo left, customer traffic in the store leveled off. Lei Mingxuan asked Xiao Lin to watch the store while he focused on replying to online customers' inquiries. He also sent screenshots of Qian Duoduo's Moments to the store's member group, leveraging them to promote the coffee experience area, with a caption thanking her for the recommendation and inviting more people to come and rest at the store. This relatively quiet midday period was efficiently used for online customer acquisition.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and a short rest
description: Lei Mingxuan walked to the Japanese ramen shop on B1 of IFC Mall, ordered a bowl of signature tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg, and quickly finished his lunch. While eating, he browsed industry news and the day's social media feedback to adjust his thinking for the afternoon's work. After a short rest, he bought an iced Americano in the mall to refresh himself for the afternoon.
location: Japanese Ramen Restaurant, B1, International Finance Center Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Return to the store and revise the afternoon operation and promotion plan
description: After walking back from IFC to the store at Super Brand Mall, Lei Mingxuan used the relatively quiet afternoon hours with light foot traffic to open his laptop and revise the first draft of the National Day promotion plan. He refined the “blind-box draw on reaching a spending threshold” to: spend 399 yuan to enter the draw, with a prize pool including accessories, coffee tasting vouchers, and discount coupons for new autumn styles. He also detailed the rules and execution process for “buy 399 yuan and get a pour-over coffee tasting voucher,” fully preparing for the upcoming holiday event.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Feng Xiaoyu arrived at the store, and the joint event plan was initially confirmed.
description: At three in the afternoon, Feng Xiaoyu, a regular customer from Suzhou, arrived at the store on time and was full of praise for the coffee experience area. The two sat at the coffee bar, savoring pour-over coffee while discussing her promotional idea: “spend 399 yuan and get a pour-over coffee tasting voucher.” Lei Mingxuan took out his phone memo and recorded each point, finally settling on the core rule: customers with a single purchase of 399 yuan or more receive a coffee tasting voucher, which can be redeemed on the next visit for a free tasting of a designated pour-over coffee. Many of Feng Xiaoyu's constructive ideas were fully adopted, bringing new ideas for improving customer loyalty at the store.
location: Coffee Area, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening peak operations and online engagement
description: The evening rush hour brought the store its busiest period of the day. Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin were busy among the shelves, receiving a constant stream of customers. While introducing the new autumn styles, he noticed that Qian Duoduo's Moments promotion was working well—several groups of new customers came straight to ask about the coffee bar and added a hand-drip coffee for 9.9 yuan after shopping. At the same time, he handled several online orders and replied to Qian Duoduo's good news. The combined effect of sales and the coffee experience area was gradually becoming apparent.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store, settling accounts, and checking in on a 10,000-step walk
description: At 6:30 in the evening, the shop closed. Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin counted the day's revenue together, locked the door after confirming it was correct, and reminded Xiao Lin to stock up on more coffee cups and milk the next day. Then he changed into sneakers and walked home along Lujiazui West Road, deliberately slowing down to enjoy the night view and the autumn flowers by the roadside, using WeChat Sports to record his steps. When he got near Pudong Avenue, his steps successfully exceeded 10,000, so he took a screenshot and sent it to his friend group to celebrate, ending the day's work with a great sense of accomplishment.
location: Along the walking route from Super Brand Mall (168 Lujiazui West Road) to Shanggang Community (Lane 136, Pudong Avenue) in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and coffee area feedback review.
description: Back home, his mother had prepared a light and delicious dinner: boiled shrimp, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato egg drop soup. While eating, Lei Mingxuan excitedly gave his parents a detailed report on the first day of the coffee experience area — foot traffic was good, customer feedback was positive, and the promotional activities were beginning to show results. His usually stern father rarely praised him, saying he was "finally running a real business," while his mother smiled and put food on his plate, telling him to eat more. After dinner, he took the initiative to help his mother clear the dishes, and the family of three enjoyed a harmonious time together.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel material brainstorming and daily review
description: Entering the study, Lei Mingxuan opened the outline of The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane. Drawing inspiration from his daytime interactions with Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu, he added to his memo a plot about the heroine brewing coffee for customers at her own tailor shop and thereby meeting a writer who also loves coffee. Afterwards, he briefly reviewed the day's revenue and the data from the coffee experience area, confirmed that the overall results met expectations, and sent a summary message about the day's activities to the friends' group chat.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation, social interaction, and falling asleep
description: After washing up, Lei Mingxuan lay in bed scrolling through his Moments, replying one by one to friends' likes and comments on the coffee area promotion. He specifically tapped into his mother's Moments post about a bouquet of carnations, liked it, and left a message: “Mom, happy Teacher's Day! I hope you like it.” After putting down his phone, he felt fulfilled and content, turned off the light just after 11, and fell asleep, storing up energy for a brand-new day.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: Lei Mingxuan woke up to the sound of his alarm clock and felt energetic because he was looking forward to meeting his childhood friend Li Na in the evening. He first weighed himself and recorded 79.3 kg, then washed up quickly, changed into a quick-dry T-shirt and sports shorts, and got ready to go out.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Walking and morning exercise in the park
description: Lei Mingxuan walked to Lujiazui Central Green Park for his morning exercise. Considering the possibility of showers, he didn't run far. Instead, he did about 30 minutes of aerobic exercise in the park, alternating between jogging and brisk walking, and stretched the tight muscles from the previous day's strength training. He felt refreshed and energized.
location: Lujiazui Center Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family breakfast and confirm package delivery
description: After his morning workout, he went home. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared breakfast: shepherd's purse and pork wontons and soy-pickled cucumbers. His father, Lei Jianguo, ate while watching the morning news. Lei Mingxuan sat down to have breakfast with his parents and mentioned that he would be having dinner with his childhood friend Li Na in the evening and would not be home for dinner. After the meal, he remembered the coffee beans and handwritten card he had sent to Wu Fang in Guangzhou. Checking SF Express, they had been signed for last night, but there was no reply yet, so he refreshed WeChat and decided not to disturb her for now.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Walking commute to the store
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into a navy blue cotton shirt and black casual pants, put on his watch, and walked to the store at Super Brand Mall. On the way, he listened to a podcast while observing the street crowd and mentally working through the details of the National Day promotion.
location: On the way from Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to the Super Brand Mall at 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Store operations and detailed activity planning.
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan completed preparations such as turning on the lights, organizing the clothes, and wiping down the cashier counter. When staff member Xiao Lin came on duty, the two of them refined the ‘buy clothes, get coffee’ joint promotion proposed by Feng Xiaoyu, and finally set the rules: from now until October 7, a single purchase over 399 yuan earns one hand-brewed coffee tasting voucher (redeemable for a designated hand-brewed coffee at the adjacent coffee experience area; the voucher is valid until the end of October). Lei Mingxuan also hand-wrote a reminder card at the cash register with the tagline, “Taste in clothes is like taste in coffee; good taste deserves to be savored slowly,” and told Xiao Lin to write a few more.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and online socializing
description: Lei Mingxuan walked to the Ippudo ramen shop on the basement floor of IFC Mall and ordered a bowl of the signature Shiromaru Motoaji ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While waiting for the food, he checked WeChat and saw a message from Wu Fang sent 15 minutes ago. She said she was touched by the coffee beans and handwritten card he had sent, and promised to give a 7% discount on the next bulk accessory order. Lei Mingxuan immediately replied with a smiley face and a thumbs-up emoji, saying that what mattered most was that Sister Fang liked it. While eating the noodles, he also replied to a few regular customers asking for autumn outfit recommendations.
location: Ippudo Ramen, LG1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Midday walk and brainstorming.
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan walked around the Lujiazui circular footbridge to aid digestion. Seeing the hurried white-collar workers around him, he pulled out his phone memo and, incorporating readers' feedback that the plot was 'too slow,' conceived the cliffhanger for the next chapter of the novel 'An Afternoon in Xiafei Lane' — having the protagonist discover an anonymous old letter that leads to a long-buried past.
location: Lujiazui Circular Pedestrian Bridge, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Store operations and management.
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic increased. Lei Mingxuan greeted customers while keeping an eye on sales of the new autumn knitwear. He successfully guided a young office worker to pair a scarf and sold a complete look. During a break, he called his father Lei Jianguo to confirm there was food in the fridge at home, so there was no need to save him dinner. Around 14:50, he sent a WeChat message to Li Na asking about her trip. When he learned she had gotten off the high-speed train and was on Line 4, he replied, "Great, I'll wait for you at the usual place!" and was in a great mood.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Close the store early and handle the final details.
description: Because he had an appointment in the evening, Lei Mingxuan closed the shop early. He and Xiao Lin tidied up the clothes that had been tried on in the afternoon, counted the change in the cash register, and explained to Xiao Lin what to pay attention to the next morning, then locked the rolling shutter door.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Go home and change clothes.
description: Lei Mingxuan walked home, took a quick shower, and changed into a dark gray casual blazer over a white T-shirt. He tidied his hair in the mirror and sprayed a little cologne, preparing for his meeting with an old friend.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Cycling to an appointment and reading at a bookstore.
description: Lei Mingxuan set off from home and rode a shared bicycle to the main store of the Foreign Language Bookstore on Fuzhou Road, Huangpu District. After arriving, he browsed magazines about outdoor camping and used his phone to photograph a few pages of practical gear checklists, gathering material for the autumn camping trip he was about to discuss with Li Na. Around 18:20 he left the bookstore, rode a shared bicycle to Wukexing Charcoal Barbecue Buffet on Zhangyang Road, and arrived at about 18:35, waiting for Li Na at the restaurant.
location: The main store of Foreign Language Bookstore at 390 Fuzhou Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China, and the route while cycling to Zhangyang Road

name: Dinner with old friends and agreeing on a camping trip
description: Li Na arrived after a tiring journey, and the two greeted each other with a warm hug. Over charcoal barbecue buffet, they chatted about their recent lives: Li Na shared her camping experience and scenery photos from Mogan Mountain, while Lei Mingxuan recounted the coffee area renovation at the shop and amusing stories from his novel writing. The more they talked, the more they hit it off, and they finally settled on a preliminary plan—to go on a two-day, one-night autumn camping trip to Dianshan Lake in Qingpu, Shanghai, on the third weekend of October (October 18-19). Li Na would handle equipment and reservations, while Lei Mingxuan would take care of food and photography.
location: Wukexing Charcoal Grill Buffet, 5F, Pudong International Food City, 601 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Walk back home
description: After the dinner, the two said goodbye at the entrance of the restaurant. Li Na took a taxi back to her parents' home, while Lei Mingxuan walked back to Shanggang Community. The street was quiet at night; he was slightly tipsy but clear-headed, and full of anticipation for the finalized camping plan.
location: On the way from No. 601 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Shanggang Community

name: Revise and update novel chapters.
description: After returning home, Lei Mingxuan washed his face, sat at the desk, and opened his laptop. Entering the novel's reader group, he saw several comments about the slow pacing. He took the advice and skillfully wove the suspense of the 'anonymous old letter' he had conceived that afternoon into the end of the chapter to be released that night, making the story's direction increasingly intriguing. After editing and proofreading, he uploaded and published it, then left a message in the reader group: 'At the end of tonight's chapter, I planted a little hook. Everyone guess who the letter is from?'
location: Home study, Shanggang Residential Quarter, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: To make up for not having a formal workout that day, Lei Mingxuan did 10 minutes of planks and full-body stretching before bed. Then he washed up, changed into pajamas, and lay down, scrolling through WeChat Moments for a while. He saw Qian Duoduo's outfit photo and liked and commented on it. Because he had consumed caffeinated drinks at the dinner, plus he was excited about the camping plan, he tossed and turned in bed and did not turn off the light and fall asleep until nearly midnight.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning routine and exercise
description: At 6:05 a.m. on September 18, 2025, Lei Mingxuan was woken by his alarm. He quickly got up, washed up, and did some simple stretches. He then put on his running shoes, left his home in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, and jogged along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui Central Green Park. He ran about 3.5 km around the park at an average pace of 5:30 per kilometer. During the run, he got an idea for a plot in his novel. After the run, he stretched on a park bench and took photos of the morning light. Around 7:30 he returned home, showered, and had breakfast with his parents. His father Lei Jianguo had bought freshly made pan-fried buns and soy milk, while his mother Wang Xiuying, serving porridge, complained about rising pork prices. Lei Mingxuan took the chance to ask his father to buy pork ribs tomorrow to make soup.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Daily schedule confirmation at home and bike commuting
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan sat on the sofa and replied on his phone to the message left by his childhood friend Li Na last night, confirmed her departure time from Shanghai the day after tomorrow, and settled on the approximate date for the late-October camping trip in Qingpu. He then sorted out today's work priorities and prepared for restocking the coffee corner, community maintenance, and billiards training. Afterward, he put on his crossbody bag, got on a shared bike, and set off, riding about 3 kilometers along Pudong Avenue and Century Avenue. Amid the morning rush-hour traffic, he arrived at his Super Brand Mall store before 9 a.m., pulled up the rolling shutter door, and got ready for business.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Take stock of and restock the coffee corner materials.
description: Lei Mingxuan entered the store, turned on the computer and the cash register system, then squatted in the coffee corner to carefully count the inventory of coffee beans, filter papers, disposable cups, and straws. Noticing the coffee beans were being consumed faster than expected, he immediately contacted the Hangzhou supplier “Brother Hai” on WeChat, confirmed the restock order, and added two cases of oat milk to meet customer demand.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Solo Lunch and Market Observation
description: Lei Mingxuan left the shop in the care of Sister Wang, a neighboring merchant who had dropped by, and walked through the Lujiazui connecting walkway to Tonkotsu Ramen Kin in the basement of the IFC Mall. He ordered a bowl of the signature tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While waiting, he scrolled through a group chat and saw his high school classmate Chen Hao showing off a newly acquired limited-edition designer toy figurine, so he replied with a teasing comment, telling him to bring it next time to a physical store in Hangzhou to go toy-hunting.
location: Tonkotsu Ramen Kin, LG2 Floor, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store community upkeep and promotion
description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan returned to the Super Brand Mall store, saved the screenshot of regular customer Qian Duoduo's WeChat Moments post checking in at the coffee corner, and posted it to the store's VIP customer group with the caption “Newly set up rest area, everyone is welcome to come check in and have coffee.” The caption had just been sent when a regular customer popped up saying they wanted to come on the weekend. Taking advantage of the momentum, he announced the “Pujiang Cup” billiards contest in the group and joked that they would come back to the store for a discount celebration after the match, keeping the group lively.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and online order shipping
description: In the afternoon, customers were sparse. Lei Mingxuan sat behind the counter and opened the novel outline he had revised the previous night on his tablet, using annotations to mark the passages that needed adjustment based on reader feedback. During this time, he handled two matters online: he replied to regular customer Shen Jie's WeChat message and took photos of the newly arrived techwear accessories and hoodies for her; Shen Jie praised them and said she would bring friends over on the weekend. He also took a call from his friend Zhao Min, who wanted to come find him for fun and help him choose drinkware for the coffee corner; Lei Mingxuan readily agreed. Around 3 p.m., he sorted out several online orders, packed the goods into eco-friendly express bags, rode a shared bike to Lujiazui Metro Station, sent three packages using the self-service lockers, and bought a bottle of electrolyte drink at the convenience store in Jinmao Tower. He then returned to the store, cleaned up, organized the shelves, wiped down the coffee corner counter, replenished coffee cups and straws, and sat in the rest area using his phone's memo app to record inspirations for revising the novel and to think of an angle for the official account article.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store, billiards special training, and review
description: When it was almost 5:30, Lei Mingxuan began closing up the store: he counted the day's takings, half-lowered the roller shutter, hung up the "Temporarily Closed" sign, checked the power, and locked the store door. Then he got on his bicycle and rode against the evening rush-hour breeze toward World Plaza on Pudong South Road. When he arrived at the billiard hall on time, his friend Han Dong was already waiting and handed him a sports drink. After warming up, they got down to the main training, focusing on safety-shot positioning and cue ball control. Han Dong used his phone to record the shots from multiple angles and called a halt to analyze whenever he made a mistake. After an hour and a half of training, they reviewed the footage together. Han Dong pointed out that Lei Mingxuan habitually raised his right elbow slightly when striking the cue ball, and also analyzed the strengths of another potential opponent in the "Pujiang Cup", telling him to pay special attention to defending against jump shots. Finally, they did 15 minutes of shoulder and back stretches.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling home and family dinner
description: After the workout, in a good mood, Lei Mingxuan rode home, deliberately taking a detour along Yuanshen Road as a cooldown. At the entrance to the residential complex, he stopped to chat with Aunt Zhu, a neighbor cooling off outside, and she asked whether he had eaten. As soon as he entered the house, the rich aroma of braised pork filled the kitchen. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had made braised pork belly and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Lei Mingxuan washed his hands, served rice, and dug into the glossy, tender braised pork, praising his mother's cooking while eating. At the table, he talked with his father, Lei Jianguo, about the day's training and mentioned that there was a billiards competition next week. His parents reminded him to be careful and avoid injury.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organizing notes and engaging with the reader group
description: After dinner, he washed the dishes on his own initiative. Lei Mingxuan returned to his room, opened the memo app on his phone, organized the key billiards training points into the 'Pujiang Cup Preparation' folder, and marked today's useful feedback from the community. Then he teased Tuesday's plot twist in his novel's reader group, and active readers immediately popped up in anticipation.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure and contact with family and friends
description: During his bedtime relaxation, Lei Mingxuan lay in bed scrolling through Bilibili and watching the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End. After that, he took the initiative to video chat with his younger cousin Yang Fan, learned that he was still working overtime, they chatted briefly, and agreed to meet up after Yang Fan returned to Shanghai. Finally, in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat, he posted 'I absolutely crushed Dongzi at pool today — the video is proof!' Zhang Wei instantly replied, 'You brag without batting an eye,' and Li Na sent a cry-laughing emoji, making the group lively.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and reading before bed to fall asleep.
description: After putting down his phone, Lei Mingxuan went to the bathroom to wash up. While brushing his teeth, he moved his right shoulder in front of the mirror and felt it was much more relaxed than in the morning. Back in his room, he neatly organized the things he needed to bring out the next day: a power bank, keys, wallet, and a billiard cue bag. Then he turned off the main light, switched on the bedside reading lamp, and flipped through a book on brand operations. Around 23:30, drowsiness set in. He turned off the light, lay down, quickly reviewed the fulfilling scenes of the day in his mind, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run and stretching
description: Woke up naturally at 6:10 a.m., changed into quick-dry clothes and running shoes, and went to Lujiazui Central Green Park for a morning run. To address tightness in his right elbow, he first jogged 2 kilometers as a warm-up, adjusting his breathing and cadence. On the third kilometer he accelerated and deliberately improved his center of gravity to coordinate with his billiards cueing technique. After the run, he did 10 minutes of stretching by the lake, focusing on relaxing the right side of his shoulder and back, and finally did 20 calf raises to prepare for the evening roller skating activity.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and breakfast at home
description: After the morning run, took a shower and changed clothes. Mother Wang Xiuying had prepared small wontons and secretly added a poached egg at the bottom of the bowl. During the meal, discussed today's plan with her, said he would cook for his father personally in the evening, and suggested bringing pan-fried buns for his father as a breakfast snack on the way. Mother smiled and reminded him to use less sugar when cooking.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bought breakfast for dad and commuted.
description: Ride an electric bike first to Pushang Farmers Market on Dongchang Road. At the time-honored window, buy a serving of freshly made pan-fried pork buns (8 pieces), wrap them in oil paper, and put them in the backpack. Then continue riding to the Super Brand Mall store, put the buns away, and deliberately arrive early at the restroom in the Park Hyatt Hotel lobby on the first floor to freshen up, keeping a good appearance for the upcoming video conference.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store management and coffee corner operations meeting
description: After arriving at the store, he first browsed industry news, then held a morning meeting with staff member Xiao Lin. Based on the coffee corner data compiled the night before, they decided to adjust the coffee area's operating hours to 10:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00, with Xiao Lin handling cleaning, restocking, and autumn/winter specialty drink development during the gaps. He immediately wrote the "New Operating Hours SOP" and posted it at the water bar. During the inventory check, he found several co-branded hoodies were in short supply, so he immediately contacted supplier Zhou Tao to reserve 50 pieces.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday rest and recharge
description: He left the store and went to the basement level of IFC Mall, choosing a newly opened Japanese tonkatsu set meal restaurant to reward his body after the heavy workout. While eating, he watched videos on Bilibili to learn store traffic flow design tips and jotted down ideas as they came to him.
location: Shanghai ifc Mall, 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon store operations and personal matters
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic increased. I personally served a young couple choosing matching outfits and successfully recommended a hoodie and a baseball cap. While Xiao Lin was busy, I took the three packed online orders (jackets and hoodies) to the Hive Box locker at Lujiazui Metro Station and shipped them. Then I went to the ATM in HSBC Building, transferred 30,000 yuan from the store debit card to the wealth management account, and set aside funds for weekend restocking. Before returning to the store, I stopped by Qingmei Fresh Food to buy drip-bag coffee for an afternoon pick-me-up.

participant.name: Xiao Lin
participant.relation: Store clerk (helping to mind the shop)

location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leaving the store early and buying ingredients
description: On Friday, foot traffic was steady. After instructing Xiao Lin to close at 16:00 and clean up, he rode his e-bike to Zhuyuan Vegetable Market. At his regular black-pork stall, he picked up the preordered square-cut pork belly and asked the owner, Lao Li, to grind coarse front leg meat on the spot as filling for shengjian buns. After that, he bought ginger, scallions, baby bok choy, tomatoes, and spring onions, and returned home fully loaded.

participant.name: Lao Li
participant.relation: Friend who is a vendor at the vegetable market

location: Zhuyuan Vegetable Market, Fushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Cooking for father's birthday
description: After getting home and changing into loungewear, his mother was picking vegetables in the living room. First blanch the pork belly and caramelize yellow rock sugar for color, then add rice wine and slowly braise the red-braised pork. Meanwhile, use a stand mixer to knead and rest the dough; during the resting time, prepare the pan-fried bun filling, adding minced pork skin jelly and ginger water and stirring until sticky. After wrapping 16 pan-fried buns, reduce the braised pork sauce to an amber color. Pan-fry the buns until the bottoms are golden and sprinkle with sesame seeds and chopped scallions. The aroma filled the room. His mother remarked approvingly that Dad would definitely have a couple of drinks today.
location: Home kitchen at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family birthday dinner and business planning
description: Braised pork, pan-fried buns, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato egg drop soup filled the table. Father was pleasantly surprised when he came back from playing chess. We raised a toast to celebrate Father's birthday and wished him good health in a warm atmosphere. During the meal, I showed the store's backend data, explaining that the coffee corner's average order value had increased by 20% and had also driven cross-selling. I brought up the idea of opening an online Douyin branch and consolidating warehouse inventory. Father listened carefully, reminded me to control risks, and volunteered to help organize the warehouse inventory the next day. The three of us enjoyed a rare family moment together.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-dinner quality time and cleanup
description: Cleared the dishes with my mother while my father watched TV news in the living room. I made tea and cut fruit for my father, and the three of us sat chatting about family matters and planned to take my parents to Hangzhou next weekend to visit my cousin Yang Fan. At 20:30, my parents went back to their room to rest.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Late-night novel writing and community management
description: Returning to the study, I made tea, turned on the computer, and wove today's feelings about cooking for my father and clinking glasses with him into the novel *The Afternoon at Xiafei Lane*, rewriting the chapter where the protagonist cooks longevity noodles for his father and completing a 2,500-word update. After publishing it, I browsed reader comments and was deeply moved by one sentence: "The details of the noodles touched my heart."
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxing stretches before bed
