description: After showering, my legs felt tired, so I did 10 minutes of yoga stretching, focusing on relaxing my calves and back. I set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning to get ready to catch the high-speed train to Hangzhou, and put the phone back on the bedside table.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: After turning off the lights, I reviewed the fulfilling day of my father's birthday, the breakthrough in store operations, and my creative achievements, and drifted off to sleep with a solid sense of satisfaction.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up, morning run, and breakfast
description: After getting up at 7 a.m., he went to Lujiazui Central Green Park for a 4 km jog to exercise. He came home around 7:40, took a shower, and then had breakfast with his mother Wang Xiuying, including white congee, fried eggs, and pickled vegetables, and discussed the afternoon's competition arrangements.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park on Lujiazui Ring Road, and home in Shanggang Community, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: At 7:55, he walked from home to the Super Brand Mall store. After arriving at 8:10, he prepared to open: turned on the lights, started the air conditioning, checked online order packages, watered the plants, and adjusted the display of the featured styles, waiting for his father Lei Jianguo to arrive.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organizing the warehouse with my father
description: At 8:25, his father Lei Jianguo arrived at the store with pears. The father and son then organized the overstocked old-style clothing in the warehouse together, and his father shared moisture-proofing experience. During this time, Lei Mingxuan explained his online branch store plan to his father. When he used his old phone to take inventory photos, it felt laggy, prompting him to decide to get a new phone.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go to the computer mall to buy a new phone
description: Left the store at 10, took a shared bike to New Continent Computer Plaza, tried out and bought the latest camera flagship phone at the brand experience store, spending 7,999 yuan and paying with Huabei, and received a phone gimbal as a gift. At 10:30, biked back to the store.
location: New Continent Computer Plaza, 588 Nanquan North Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: New phone data migration and testing
description: After returning to the store, he migrated important chat records, operation apps, contacts, and product photos from the old phone to the new one, and tested the scan-and-upload speed of the store management software, and was very satisfied with its smoothness. After erasing the old phone, he put it in the drawer as a backup phone.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Meeting and lunch with trendy toy collector Lu Yao
description: At 11:20, trendy toy collector Lu Yao visited. They exchanged Pop Mart blind boxes in the store's coffee corner. Lu Yao suggested holding a collectors' offline meetup here next month, and Lei Mingxuan agreed. Then he called his father, and the three of them walked to the Japanese ramen shop in IFC Mall for tonkotsu ramen. After the meal, they strolled back to the store.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the Japanese ramen restaurant at IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue

name: Midday rest and pre-competition preparation
description: After returning to the shop, he checked the equipment for the afternoon billiards training (chalk, water bottle, towel), confirmed that his friend Han Dong could come at 2:30 p.m., and used his new phone to test the video recording function for technical review. Then he closed his eyes and rested on the recliner for 20 minutes while his father helped watch the shop at the front desk.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-match billiards simulation training
description: At 1:40 p.m., he walked to the billiard hall at World Plaza and played a 'race to 7' simulated match against Han Dong. Lei Mingxuan was in excellent form, with high accuracy in long-distance attacks, while Han Dong was excellent at defense. location: From Lane 136, Pudong Avenue (Shanggang Community), Pudong New Area, Shanghai to No. 168 Lujiazui West Road (Super Brand Mall)

name: Preparations for opening the shop
description: Arriving at the store on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, Lei Mingxuan opened the door, turned on the computer, and preheated the coffee machine. Taking advantage of the quiet morning, he sorted out the 3 online orders from last night and checked the inventory in the coffee corner. He found the osmanthus sauce and oat milk were almost used up, so he noted them in his memo to restock. After that, he opened the system to review last week's sales data, gaining a clearer plan for the upcoming 'camping-style' outerwear.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Collect fabrics and samples.
description: The SF Express courier delivered two boxes of goods on time. One box was the waterproof nylon and fleece fabric sent by Zhou Tao from Hangzhou; the other was two sample garments sent by his cousin Shen Jie via Flash Delivery. Lei Mingxuan put on gloves, carefully opened the packages, and felt the texture and details of the fabrics. Then he had a video call with Shen Jie to discuss them. The two confirmed the fabric weight and the feasibility of the sample garments, and finally settled on these two fabrics and one sample garment as the core materials for the November featured launch, taking detailed photos for records.
location: Work area, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Product selection records and customer reception
description: After the video call ended, Lei Mingxuan entered the finalized fabric and sample garment details into the product selection table on his tablet, including hand feel, color, weight, and styling suggestions. He paired the new fabric with the store’s autumn jackets and cargo pants, and put together two outfits to post on Moments. Around 11 o'clock, a guy pushing a skateboard came into the store and showed strong interest in the waterproof nylon fabric. The two chatted for over ten minutes, and Lei Mingxuan added him on WeChat, agreeing to meet next week to see the finished product.
location: Work area, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and a stroll in the park
description: Lei Mingxuan locked the store door and walked to the IFC Mall just one street away. At the newly opened 'A Ping's Chaoshan Beef Kway Teow' on the B1 floor, he had a bowl of the signature set meal. The soup was fresh and the meat tender, leaving him very satisfied. After the meal, he took a detour to Lujiazui Central Green Park for a walk to aid digestion. The autumn sunlight filtered through the plane tree leaves. He picked up two perfectly shaped fallen leaves and tucked them into his phone case as today's little joy.
location: B1, Shanghai IFC Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon reception and new product launch
description: Back at the store, regular customer Feng Xiaoyu came to pick up the Pop Mart co-branded T-shirt she had ordered last week. Lei Mingxuan chatted with her and showed her the fabric photos he had taken in the morning. Feng Xiaoyu excitedly said that once the camping-style jacket was launched, she would definitely be the first to buy it. After seeing off the guest, Lei Mingxuan edited the footage he had shot in the morning, added a carefully written caption, “Late autumn outdoor inspiration starts with a good fabric,” and posted it to his Moments and VIP customer group. It quickly received a large number of likes and private messages asking about prices.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Coffee corner ambiance optimization.
description: In the afternoon, two or three customers were sitting in the coffee corner drinking coffee. Lei Mingxuan felt the background music was a bit random, so he took out his tablet, opened NetEase Cloud Music, and created a new playlist named "Autumn Afternoon". He added works by Tom Misch, Lisa Ono, and others, set it to repeat, and adjusted the volume to just the right level. He also rearranged the dried flowers and fashion magazines in the corner, making the coffee corner feel even more cozy and pleasant.
location: Coffee corner at Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Online order handling and store chores
description: Foot traffic in the store was sparse. Lei Mingxuan logged into the online backend, printed out shipping labels for 3 orders, sealed the packed clothes and designer-brand earrings, then walked 5 minutes to the Lujiazui Metro Station locker, scanned the code, and dropped them off. After returning, he entered the day's sales records, inventory changes, and coffee corner consumption into the system, and checked store cleanliness to prepare for closing in the evening.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; Luggage locker, Lujiazui Metro Station, 158 Huayuanshiqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: 10,000-step challenge and workout at the sports center
description: The weather was clear and sunny, so Lei Mingxuan decided to start his 10,000-step plan for the day early. He changed into his running shoes, set off from Super Brand Mall, followed Lujiazui Ring Road and turned onto Yuanshen Road, and walked about 40 minutes to reach Yuanshen Sports Center. The sun was setting in the west, and the rubberized track shone golden. He power-walked on the empty track, wearing earphones and listening to the podcast “Left and Right.” About 40 minutes later, his phone notified him that he had reached 12,000 steps. He stopped to stretch by the track, smiled and nodded at several elderly neighbors who were also exercising, and felt refreshed all over.
location: Yuanshen Sports Center, 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store and walking home
description: After the workout, Lei Mingxuan felt refreshed and walked home from Yuanshen Sports Center, about 20 minutes in total. On the way, he notified Xiao Lin, the part-time worker at the store, via WeChat to help lock up, saying he would not return to the store today. After arriving home, he changed into a loose old T-shirt and prepared to start dealing with old clothes.
location: Room 602, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Donate old clothes
description: Lei Mingxuan used the family handcart to haul the 8 boxes of old clothes he had already packed to the Zhangyang Road community's smart used-clothing recycling bin at the west gate of the residential complex. As he was dropping them in 1 box at a time, he ran into his neighbor Aunt Zhu, who was returning from square dancing. Aunt Zhu asked curiously, and Lei Mingxuan explained that he was "decluttering." She gave him a thumbs-up and praised him for being environmentally conscious and fashionable. The two chatted for a while about waste sorting. After the donation, he felt a sense of mental relief.
location: Smart old-clothes recycling bin, Zhangyang Road Community, West Gate of Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Family dinner
description: When Lei Mingxuan got home, his father Lei Jianguo, for once, praised, 'This outfit style is well chosen' — probably because he had heard his mother mention it. At the dinner table, the aroma of braised pork belly filled the air. He shared his experiences of handling new fabrics, donating old clothes, and exercising at the sports center. His mother complained that he was always running around and not eating properly, but she kept a smile on her face. The family atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Dining Room, Room 602, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel update and reader interaction
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan slipped into his small study, opened his laptop, and updated his novel Afternoon in Xiafei Fang. He incorporated into the new chapter the inspiration from handling fabric during the day and fragments of his chat with regular customer Feng Xiaoyu, writing about 2,300 words centered on the protagonist's memories triggered by sorting out the wardrobe for the season change. After updating, he wrote an author's note at the end, thanking readers for their votes and revealing that the next chapter would bring a turning point about "farewell" and "reunion." Later, he replied to the heartfelt comments from two readers, "Bookworm Ahua" and "Shengang Xiaopang."
location: Study, Room 602, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure and socializing.
description: After closing his laptop, Lei Mingxuan moved to the living room sofa to relax. He scrolled through Bilibili, watching several camping gear reviews and aerial videos of Qinghai, and made a mental note of several items he wanted. Then, in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat, he arranged with Han Dong and Zhang Wei to play basketball at Yuanshen Sports Center on Saturday afternoon, and also chatted briefly with his cousin Yang Fan on WeChat, roughly agreeing on a trip to Hangzhou at the end of the month.
location: Living room, Room 602, Building 3, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and planning for tomorrow
description: After washing up, Lei Mingxuan applied the Dabao face cream his mother had pressed on him and lay down in bed. He opened the memo on his phone and quickly listed the plan for tomorrow: place the order with Zhou Tao for the selected fabric; prepare the gear for Saturday's basketball game; organize the photos of the novel scenes taken today. The weather forecast showed it would still be nice tomorrow, so he set the alarm to 6:15.
location: Bedroom, Room 602, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Night reading
description: Before bed, Lei Mingxuan picked up “The Practical Brand Operations Manual” from his bedside, read the chapter “How to Wrap Products in Stories,” and circled several key points, feeling that they fit his store’s operational thinking quite well. When drowsiness hit, he put the book down, turned off the lamp, and got ready to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 602, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: The room was dark, and the faint sound of traffic on Zhangyang Road came through the window. Lei Mingxuan thought back on the day: there was new progress at work, donating the old clothes felt lightening, and the novel had been updated on time. This full and clean feeling quickly lulled him into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 602, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, weighing, and breakfast
description: Mother Wang Xiuying knocked on the door at 7:30 sharp to wake Lei Mingxuan. After getting up, he first used the bathroom and took care of personal hygiene, then stood barefoot on the scale and recorded his weight as 79.9 kg, the same as yesterday. After washing up, he changed into an old T-shirt and went to the living room. Mother had already cooked wonton soup, one bowl for each person, and fried two golden fried eggs. While eating, Lei Mingxuan explained today's cleaning plan to his mother, focusing on clearing out the bedroom wardrobe and the storage room. Mother said she would help and mentioned that she had saved some bags and could make rags from old clothes.
location: Bedroom and dining room at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Create a cleaning checklist and prepare the tools
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan used his phone's memo app to make a cleaning checklist, putting the bedroom wardrobe first and the storage room second. Then he and his mother looked for tools: a few large cardboard boxes, five or six extra-large garbage bags, a pack of wet wipes, and three woven bags. He used a marker to label the woven bags as 'Donate,' 'Second-hand,' and 'Discard.' In the meantime, he corrected a typo he'd found in last night's novel.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Thoroughly cleaned out the bedroom wardrobe.
description: Lei Mingxuan opened the bedroom wardrobe door and piled all the clothes, pants, and hats on the floor. He dug out several old items: a printed T-shirt bought in 2019 with a frayed collar, ripped jeans whose holes grew bigger with each wash, and shirts with yellowed collars. Clothes that were still in good condition but no longer worn were put into a 'Donate' woven bag, while yellowed or pilled ones were thrown directly into a 'Discard' bag. He also found two pairs of old sneakers with cracked soles in the drawer and discarded them.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mother helped with sorting and organizing
description: Wang Xiuying brought scissors from the kitchen and cut off the buttons and zippers from old clothes to keep as spares. Then she sat down to help Lei Mingxuan sort through the blind boxes. The two found fifteen or sixteen duplicate blind boxes with intact packaging. His mother held up a few and teased him for buying impulsively. Lei Mingxuan picked out the Pop Mart limited edition and hidden figures and put them back onto the transparent display shelf in the bookcase. As she worked, his mother grumbled that blind boxes just collected dust and were better off dealt with, and Lei Mingxuan quickly said he would only buy what he liked from now on and not waste money.
location: Living room floor of the home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family lunch and chat
description: Mother prepared scrambled eggs with tomatoes, sautéed bok choy, and pork rib soup with radish. Father Lei Jianguo bought some small yellow croakers from Pushang Vegetable Market. Seeing the bags of cleared-out items piled up in the living room, he praised that they should have tidied up long ago. Lei Mingxuan said he would wipe the medals on the bookshelf to show his father. The family of three chatted while eating. After the meal, Lei Mingxuan helped clear the dishes.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dealing with extra blind boxes and clutter
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan sat at the desk, lined up 15 blind boxes in good condition, used his phone as a light to take close-up shots from various angles, then edited product descriptions one by one on Xianyu, pricing them at 15 to 30 yuan. The more than ten damaged blind boxes and packaging boxes were stuffed into garbage bags, ready to be thrown away. While rummaging through a drawer, he found a college billiards tournament medal with a tarnished surface; he polished it with a damp cloth and placed it in a prominent spot on the second shelf of the bookcase. After the cleanup, the bedroom became more spacious, and his mood lifted.
location: Living room and desk at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Setting spending principles and bookkeeping, taking a short break and replying to messages
description: Lei Mingxuan opened the notes app on his phone and wrote the “Consumer Principles Memo”: ask yourself three times before buying whether something is really necessary; collect at most three blind boxes of the same type; declutter idle items once a month. After writing it, he handwrote “Ask three times before buying” on a yellow sticky note and stuck it on the corkboard next to his desk. Then he opened the budgeting app and entered the estimated Xianyu income under “Pending Income,” expecting to recover three or four hundred yuan. During a short break, he slumped on the living room sofa and looked at his phone. In the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group chat, Han Dong asked about the time for Saturday basketball, and he replied from 2 to 4 p.m., suggesting they have dinner with Zhang Wei afterward. Zhang Wei instantly replied that he would book a table at Jinqiao BBQ Restaurant in advance. Lei Mingxuan also sent a voice message to his cousin Shen Jie saying he would bring two new fall styles to show her on the weekend. Finally, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu and liked a post about seasonal storage tips.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, Yangjing Subdistrict, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, home study and living room

name: Catch-up check-in and quick household chores
description: Lei Mingxuan remembered that the new product poster for the coffee corner had not been released yet, so he found the saved teaser image "Coffee Corner This Week's New Products" on his phone, confirmed the copy and layout were correct, and planned to post it to WeChat Moments tomorrow morning. Then he went to the kitchen to wash and dry the breakfast dishes, and went to the balcony to fold the clothes his mother had taken down, carrying them back to the bedroom closet to organize.
location: Balcony, kitchen, and bedroom at home in Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walked to the Lujiazui circular footbridge to hit the 10,000-step goal
description: Lei Mingxuan put on his jogging shoes and wireless earbuds to listen to the podcast “Decluttering and Minimalist Living.” He set out on foot from home along Pudong Avenue, crossed the intersection of Century Avenue, and first entered Lujiazui Central Green Park for a lap, breathing fresh air. Then he walked to the Lujiazui Circular Pedestrian Bridge. He stopped in the middle of the bridge for about 15 minutes, looking down at the traffic and gazing into the distance at the Oriental Pearl Tower and Jin Mao Tower looming faintly under the clouds. He took a photo with his phone of the sky and the skyscrapers in the same frame, and posted it on Moments with the caption: “A brisk walk after decluttering—13,000 steps! White clouds in the sky, feeling refreshed.” Afterward, he walked back the same way, and his sports watch showed exactly 13,000 steps.
location: Lujiazui Circular Footbridge, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home to shower and change into comfortable clothes
description: After exercising, feeling sweaty and sticky, Lei Mingxuan went straight to the bathroom, took a hot shower, and changed into the soft pure cotton white T-shirt and cotton shorts he had set aside. He took out some iced lemonade from the fridge and drank freely. While taking a short break, he opened Xianyu again to check whether the pricing of the 15 blind boxes was reasonable.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Simple housework and cleanup
description: Lei Mingxuan and his mother first moved the three woven bags to a corner of the hallway, planning to take the 'donation' bag to the community recycling bin on the weekend and pack the 'second-hand' bag once an order came in on Xianyu. Then the two of them lifted the folding table that had been blocking the corridor, placed it against the wall, and used a broom to sweep up the paper scraps and dust in the cleared area. Lei Mingxuan went back to the bookshelf to rearrange the blind boxes, and suddenly thought of the scene in the novel he was writing, 'Afternoon in Xiafei Lane,' where the protagonist cleans out a warehouse. Inspired, he quickly used his phone's memo app to jot down the scene concept.
location: Home living room and storage room, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: Mother cooked braised pork, steamed sea bass, and cucumber salad for dinner. While eating, Lei Mingxuan showed his parents the photos he took on the overpass in the afternoon. His father praised the clouds and mentioned that he had seen a new ping-pong table at the retirees' activity center, suggesting that next time he would take Lei Mingxuan to play a couple of games. Lei Mingxuan readily agreed to take his father there after playing basketball on the weekend.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Updated the novel 'Afternoon in Xiafei Fang' and incorporated today's reflections.
description: Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop in his study and used writing software to write a new chapter, completing about 2,500 characters. In the plot, the protagonist Chen Ming, while renewing a warehouse lease, clears out an overstock of old-style blind boxes and faded T-shirts, hesitating as he throws things away but finally choosing to donate them in bulk and take photos as records. He incorporated every detail of today's decluttering—sorting, labeling, polishing medals, and obsessive-compulsive arranging—into the novel, making the scene rich with the warmth of everyday life. After finishing, he browsed the reader comments and replied to a young woman who, touched by the story, had donated her unused items, responding with a smiley face and "mutual encouragement."
location: Study at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Scrolling Bilibili and chatting in groups for leisure
description: Lei Mingxuan opened Bilibili and first watched the billiards tutorial video "Eight-Ball Cue Ball Positioning Techniques" to prepare for going to the billiards hall at World Plaza with Han Dong on the weekend. Then he watched the latest episode of "Frieren: Beyond Journey's End" and thought about whether to introduce Frieren co-branded blind boxes in the coffee corner. In the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat, Zhang Wei sent a screenshot confirming the Saturday basketball court reservation and asked if he should bring a drone for a countryside flight. Lei Mingxuan replied that they should play basketball first and talk later. His cousin Yang Fan invited him via WeChat to go to Hangzhou together on the weekend, but he politely declined, saying he had been busy with both the store and household chores lately.
location: Study and bedroom at home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stretching and relaxing, recording expenses, and writing tomorrow's to-do list.
description: Lei Mingxuan spread a yoga mat in the bedroom and did a full-body loosening and stretching routine, moving his legs, waist, and shoulders. At the same time, he opened his expense-tracking app, recorded today's zero spending (excluding family meals), and logged the estimated income from the blind boxes to be sold. Then, in his memo app, he wrote tomorrow's to-do items: 1) go to the Super Brand Mall store to enter last week's sales data; 2) send Zhou Tao a message to order two more fabrics; 3) confirm the number of people for Saturday's basketball game and notify Han Dong.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Read Brand Operations: A Practical Handbook.
description: Lei Mingxuan leaned against the headboard and flipped through the Brand Operations Field Manual, focusing on the chapter "Vertical Category Community Building." He was thinking to himself that he could form a small community by combining the customers from the coffee corner with blind box enthusiasts, hold offline themed exchanges quarterly, and sell limited and co-branded items to boost the store's popularity.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep relaxation and transition to sleep.
description: After turning off the lights, Lei Mingxuan put in his earphones and played soothing light music. In his mind, he reviewed the day's decluttering results: the wardrobe was tidy, the bookshelf was neat, and the novel had gained real material, making him feel relaxed overall. He then thought about the store data still waiting to be processed tomorrow, but his mind was organized and full of satisfaction. He finally fell asleep at around 23:30, a bit later than planned, but felt the day had been fulfilling.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting up and morning exercise
description: At 6 a.m., my mother Wang Xiuying woke me up. After getting up, I did some simple stretching on the bed and weighed myself at 79.8 kg. Then I washed up and shaved. Afterward, I walked about 15 minutes to Shanghai Century Park, walked two laps around Jingtian Lake at a comfortable pace, about 7,000 steps. I took photos of the withered lotuses and posted on WeChat Moments to record "pre-race pace adjustment".
location: Shanggang Residential Area, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Shanghai Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area

name: Breakfast and e-bike commute.
description: Returned home and took a shower, then changed into a casual shirt and jeans. Mother had prepared breakfast: pan-fried soup buns, white congee, and pickled vegetables. He chatted with his father Lei Jianguo over breakfast about today's training schedule. After the meal, he checked his phone, power bank, and e-bike key. Then he rode the e-bike along Pudong Avenue to Super Brand Mall, arriving in about 20 minutes, and parked at the non-motor vehicle parking area behind the mall.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, No. 168, Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area

name: Morning work at the shop and Xianyu transactions
description: After arriving at the clothing store, A-208 on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, I turned on the lights, turned on the computer, and checked the coffee machine. I unpacked and ironed the newly arrived autumn new arrivals, and photographed outfit combinations to post on Moments and in the VIP group. Then, during business hours, I photographed 12 duplicate Pop Mart blind boxes and listed them on Xianyu, priced at 20-50 yuan. I received several customers and successfully sold one coat. After 11 o'clock, 3 blind boxes were purchased on Xianyu, so I replied to buyers and adjusted prices. Then I went to Starbucks on B1 to buy a medium American coffee, took a short break, and scrolled through my phone.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai — Shop A-208 on Level 2 and Starbucks on B1.

name: Japanese ramen lunch
description: Left the store and strolled to the Japanese ramen shop in IFC Mall, ordering a bowl of their signature tonkotsu ramen. While eating, I thought about the afternoon practice plan and confirmed the evening dinner with Han Dong over WeChat.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant, ifc Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon shipping and store wrap-up.
description: Returned to the clothing store, wrapped the three blind boxes sold this morning in bubble wrap, locked up, and hurried to the luggage lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station to ship them, then filled in the tracking number on Xianyu. After returning to the store, I sorted the purchase orders, confirmed inventory, and handled online orders. Wrapping up, I sent a message in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group to rally for basketball practice, tidied the desk, changed into sneakers, and got ready to leave.
location: Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; and the luggage locker at Lujiazui Metro Station, 158 Huayuanshiqiao Road.

name: Billiards practice and stretching at World Plaza
description: He rode his e-bike along Pudong South Road to the World Square billiard hall to meet his pool buddy Han Dong. The two practiced cue angles and mental approach, and Han Dong recorded several sets of shot videos for him. They played a friendly match, working on defense and capitalizing-on-mistakes tactics. After practicing, his shoulders and thighs were sore, so he did 15 minutes of static stretching in the rest area. Han Dong picked out videos of problem movements and sent them to him.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Debriefing with Han Dong over barbecue
description: The two walked to the nearby Lao Shandong BBQ restaurant and ordered lamb skewers, grilled beef tendon, chives, and beer, eating dinner early. While eating, they used their phones to analyze the billiards video frame by frame, discussing stroke stability and the strategy for tomorrow's basketball game: they decided that I would do more off-ball running, and my teammates would feed me the ball for fast-break counterattacks. They added chicken wings and finally split the bill, 65 yuan each.
location: South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Old Shandong BBQ Restaurant)

name: Relaxing with the night view of the Lujiazui overpass.
description: After saying goodbye to Han Dong, he rode his e-bike around to the Lujiazui circular footbridge, enjoying the dazzling night view of Lujiazui's "Three Piece Set." He shot a time-lapse with his phone and posted it on Moments with the caption: "Practice is over, adjust my mindset, get ready for tomorrow." Then he rode home.
location: Lujiazui circular footbridge, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening home creation and leisure
description: After arriving home, he greeted his father and rested for a while. Then he conceived a new chapter of the novel "The Afternoon at Xiafei Lane," incorporating today's experience of a tense state of mind. Next, he went downstairs to charge his electric bike and prepared clothes and protective gear for tomorrow's basketball game. Back in the study, he used his computer to publish a new chapter of about 1,200 words, and received comments from readers urging him to update. Then he chatted with Zhang Wei and others in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group, discussed tomorrow's basketball game and gathering arrangements, and watched a billiards tutorial video on Bilibili. After 21:00, he washed up, used a foam roller to relax his muscles, and read over a dozen pages of "Brand Operations Practical Handbook" to look for autumn marketing inspiration. Finally, he recorded today's preparations in his memo, turned off the light, and got ready to sleep.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sleep
description: Lying in bed, he thought about tomorrow's game plan. Though his body was tired, his mind felt fulfilled, and he gradually fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and energy-boosting breakfast
description: At 7 a.m. on Saturday, his biological clock woke Lei Mingxuan right on time. Lying in bed, he stretched, felt how relaxed his body was, and ran through the day's match tactics in his mind. Then he got up and weighed himself: 79.9 kg, which was well managed. He drew the curtains, sunlight poured in, and his mood brightened. At 7:15, he changed into athletic shorts and a T-shirt and went out. First he walked two slow laps around the community to loosen his joints, then walked eight minutes to Lujiazui Central Green Park and did 15 minutes of brisk walking. Nearby, elderly people were practicing tai chi. The morning air was fresh, his watch showed his heart rate rising to about 110, and his body was fully warmed up. At about 7:40 he returned home, and his mother Wang Xiuying had prepared small wontons and fried eggs. While eating, Lei Mingxuan briefed his mother on the schedule: “Mom, there's one match this morning. If we win, there's another in the afternoon. I'll bring you good news in the evening.” His mother told him to be careful.
location: Huayang Yuan, No. 1-8, Lane 2100, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the nearby Lujiazui Central Green Park

name: Pre-event equipment check and venue familiarization
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan returned to his room to check his billiards equipment. He carefully wiped down his custom cue, checked the chalk, and packed a red T-shirt with the store logo, wristbands, a towel, and energy drinks into his cue bag. At about 8:05, he put on his helmet and rode his e-bike along Pudong Avenue, turning onto Pudong South Road, and arrived at World Square Billiards Hall 15 minutes later. Because he arrived early and the match did not start until 9:00, he first used his own cue to try out a few match tables and get a feel for the cushion response and cloth speed. His friend and sideline coach Han Dong also arrived on time. The two practiced together for half an hour, finding the feel of their shots and adjusting their breathing.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Came from behind to advance in the first round of the Pujiang Cup
description: At exactly 9 o'clock, the first round of the Pujiang Cup officially began. The opponent played steadily, and Lei Mingxuan was slow to find his rhythm, falling behind 2:4 at the start. During the break after the fifth frame, he paused for water to adjust. Han Dong handed over his phone with the replay and pointed out, "Your stroke rhythm was too fast just now, and your right shoulder was a bit loose in the bridge; your breathing wasn't keeping up." After returning to the table, Lei Mingxuan steadied his mentality, reduced mistakes, and won five straight frames, finally completing a comeback victory at 7:5. Han Dong clapped excitedly from the sideline. The match was exhausting—his T-shirt was completely soaked.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch refueling and match video review
description: After the match ended near noon, Lei Mingxuan and Han Dong walked 15 minutes to the Japanese ramen shop they often visited on B1 of IFC Mall. Lei Mingxuan ordered the signature tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg and a serving of fried chicken. While waiting, Han Dong used his phone to replay key moments from the match. As they ate, they analyzed the defensive play, weighing what worked and what didn't, and discussed tactics for the afternoon game.
location: Japanese Ramen Restaurant, B1, International Finance Center Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Pre-match mental and physical preparation
description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan returned to the rest area of World Square Billiards Hall and sat down on a bench. He put on his earphones, listened to a light electronic playlist, and rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes, mentally simulating the afternoon's offensive and defensive tactics. Then he got up and did 5 minutes of full-body dynamic stretching, focusing on loosening his shoulders, neck, and wrists to make sure his body was in top form for the high-intensity match in the afternoon.
location: Rest area, World Square Billiard Hall, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pujiang Cup 32-to-16 round: narrow defeat in the deciding game.
description: At 1:30 p.m., the round of 32 to 16 match began, and the intensity clearly increased. His opponent Liu Zihao looked calm and composed, wearing a Pop Mart co-branded T-shirt. The two were evenly matched, and the score went back and forth to a 6:6 tie, forcing a deciding game. In the deciding game, Lei Mingxuan took the first shot, but when hitting the 8-ball, his right hand trembled slightly under pressure, and the cue ball lost its position and fell into a pocket, drawing sighs from the audience. Lei Mingxuan was stunned for a moment, then calmly took off his wrist guard, stepped forward, and shook hands with Liu Zihao.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-match technical review and making new friends
description: After the match, Lei Mingxuan's heart rate was still high. He and Han Dong sat in the rest area and spent 15 minutes on a thorough stretching routine to relax. Then he opened the video on his phone and replayed the missed shot in the deciding game frame by frame. Han Dong analyzed, 'When you took the shot, your bridge hand was unstable, your center of gravity was to the right, and you need to work on your core strength.' Lei Mingxuan nodded and started planning his follow-up training. As they were getting ready to leave, Liu Zihao walked over and said approvingly, 'Dude, you played really well; the last shot was just a bit unlucky. With your T-shirt and the way you talk about cue maintenance, you know your stuff!' The two went from billiards skills to designer toy collections, hitting it off more and more. Liu Zihao was very interested in the coffee corner at Lei Mingxuan's shop, so Lei Mingxuan invited him on the spot: 'Next week, if you have time, come by my store and I'll make you a coconut latte.' Liu Zihao agreed readily, and they added each other on WeChat.
location: Rest area and vacant pool tables at the billiard hall, World Plaza, No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking 10,000 steps and restocking daily necessities.
description: At 5 p.m., Lei Mingxuan decided to walk home and hit his 10,000-step daily goal along the way. He put on earphones and walked north along Pudong South Road, taking a detour to the Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road. The cool early-summer evening breeze blew away the restlessness from the game. At the market, he bought two dragon fruits and a carton of fresh milk, planning to make a smoothie in the evening. After leaving the market, he walked through the Lujiazui Central Green. His step count reached exactly 10,123 steps, and by the time he got home, he felt completely relaxed.
location: Pushang Vegetable Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and along the way

name: Family dinner and sharing of competition results.
description: As soon as he walked in, Lei Mingxuan smelled braised pork belly. His father Lei Jianguo had already served the rice and poured the beer. At the dinner table, Lei Mingxuan recounted the day's match in detail, from the morning comeback to the mistakes in the afternoon's deciding game. Although he lost, his tone was calm, and he enthusiastically talked about meeting his new friend Liu Zihao. His father comforted him: "Victory and defeat are all in a day's work for a soldier; just practice your strength more later." His mother Wang Xiuying put the biggest piece of braised pork belly into his bowl.
location: Dining room at home, Huayang Yuan, No. 1-8, Lane 2100, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel update and reader interaction
description: After taking a quick shower and changing into loungewear, Lei Mingxuan sat at his desk and turned on his computer. He spent 30 minutes sorting through the day's emotions and material, then focused on updating his novel "An Afternoon in Xiafei Lane." He cleverly wove in the loss in the competition and the episode of meeting Liu Zihao, depicting the protagonist's fluctuating mindset during a key match, and wrote 1,800 characters in one go. The comments section became lively immediately after publishing. One reader commented, "This is so real, my heart was racing too!" Other readers also encouraged him, and Lei Mingxuan replied one by one, feeling delighted.
location: In the home study at Huayangyuan, No. 1-8, Lane 2100, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening socializing and information recharge
description: After finishing the novel update, Lei Mingxuan had some free time. He scrolled through Bilibili and saved a video about 'cue stability auxiliary training.' Then he messaged the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group: 'Guys, we lost the match today, but I met a really nice designer toy buddy, and I'll invite him to my shop next week.' His friends Zhang Wei and Li Na immediately popped up to tease and comfort him. Afterward, he also reviewed the match details with his billiards buddies in the group chat and had a great time chatting.
location: Home at Huayang Yuan, No. 1-8, Lane 2100, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime stretching and plan for tomorrow
description: At exactly 10 p.m., Lei Mingxuan put down his phone and did a set of pre-bedtime stretches to relax his tense muscles. While washing up, he quickly reviewed tomorrow's plan in his mind: go to the store in the morning to handle daily matters, and go to Yuanshen Sports Center in the afternoon to play basketball with friends Xie Fei and the others. He used his phone memo to note what to bring tomorrow: basketball shoes, knee pads, and a change of clothes.
location: Bedroom at home, Huayang Garden, No. 1-8, Lane 2100, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading business books and going to sleep
description: Before turning off the light, Lei Mingxuan picked up The Song of Everlasting Sorrow from the bedside table and read for 30 minutes, focusing on the chapter "Store Experience Design", planning to use Liu Zihao's suggestions to optimize the coffee corner in his shop. At exactly 23:00, he turned off the light, closed his eyes, savored the fulfilling day, and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Huayang Garden, No. 1-8, Lane 2100, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning stretching and weighing after waking up.
description: On the bedroom floor, I stretched my neck, shoulders, and wrists to relieve muscle tension from the previous day's billiards match, then weighed myself and recorded 80.0 kg.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Having breakfast with father
description: At home in the dining room, he ate the fresh pork wontons made by his mother together with his father Lei Jianguo. His father shared his experience of buying cheap swimming crabs at Pushang Vegetable Market and planned to make stir-fried crabs with scallions and ginger for lunch. The family chatted in a relaxed atmosphere.
location: Restaurant, Room 301, Building 12, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Check shop accounts and coffee corner supplies
description: In the study, he used his phone to check the previous day's store sales and online order data, and communicated via WeChat with coffee bean supplier Zhou Tao about the arrival time of the thick coconut milk and custom cup sleeves needed for next week's new coffee corner product Coconut Latte, to make sure the materials would be in place.
location: Study, Room 301, Building 12, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Finalized cooperation with Liu Zihao via video call
description: Had a detailed WeChat video call with friend Liu Zihao about the collaboration plan between designer toys and the store's coffee corner, and confirmed that Liu Zihao would bring his illustrator friend to the store for a site visit next Saturday; they also talked about the previous day's billiards match.
location: Study, Room 301, Building 12, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Browse designer toy news and process online orders.
description: In the study, used Bilibili and Xiaohongshu to catch up on the latest trendy toy IPs and popular blind boxes, while replying to buyer inquiries on Xianyu, and packed a Pop Mart 'Molly's Day' blind box order, preparing to take it to the store in the afternoon for shipping.
location: Study, Room 301, Building 12, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and confirm a classmate's wedding
description: At home, I had lunch with my parents, including my mother's stir-fried crab with scallion and ginger. During lunch, I checked the wedding invitation sent by my college classmate Wang Lei (October 19, Hangzhou) on my phone, congratulated him in the class group chat, confirmed attendance via private message, and asked whether he needed help coordinating transportation.
location: Restaurant, Room 301, Building 12, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and replying to friends' messages.
description: In the study, share the progress of the cooperation reached with Liu Zihao in the morning with Zhang Wei and Li Na in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group, and reply to roller skating partner Song Jia's WeChat to confirm meeting at the usual place on Binjiang Avenue at 4 p.m.
location: Study, Room 301, Building 12, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rode the e-bike to Super Brand Mall.
description: Changed into athletic clothes, packed roller skates and protective gear into a backpack, rode an electric bike from home via Zhangyang Road to Super Brand Mall, and parked it in the underground non-motor vehicle garage.
location: Along the stretch from Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Practice coconut milk latte art and handle orders in the store.
description: Arrived at the coffee corner of her own clothing store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, and practiced latte art with the newly arrived thick coconut milk and coffee beans, successfully making a heart pattern and taking a photo to send to Liu Zihao. Then gave the blind boxes packed in the morning to the store assistant Xiao Li, asking her to use the locker at Lujiazui Metro Station to ship them on the way.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Cycled to the riverside roller skating meeting point
description: Rode an e-bike from Super Brand Mall along Lujiazui West Road to the viewing platform near Dongchang Road, with the river breeze blowing, to prepare for inline skating.
location: Along the route from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the Dongchang Road Pier viewing platform on Binjiang Avenue

name: Walking along the river to warm up and capture footage.
description: Put on roller skates and warmed up with a slow skate along the riverside walkway. I shot a time-lapse of the river view and sent it to my cousin Yang Fan for composition advice. I called my parents to tell them I would eat at the night market and not come home. Meanwhile, Song Jia notified me that she would arrive a bit later.
location: The section of Binjiang Avenue from Dongchang Road Pier to Pudong South Road in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go roller-skating with Song Jia along the river and share updates.
description: Started from Dongchang Road Wharf with Song Jia, skated along the Riverside Greenway to Nanpu Bridge and back, about 8 km in total; during breaks they shared updates about their lives: showed each other the billiards comeback video from the previous day, Song Jia showed off the 'Night Shanghai' series posters, and they discussed the possibility of future collaboration.
location: Section of Binjiang Avenue from Dongchang Road Pier to Lupu Bridge, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Visited a night market and ate pan-fried pork buns
description: After exercising, went with Song Jia to the 'Lujiazui Market' night market behind Super Brand Mall, waited in line to buy Da Huchun pan-fried pork buns and beef vermicelli soup; after eating, browsed handmade accessories and designer toy stalls. Song Jia bought a pair of handmade enamel earrings, and Lei Mingxuan picked up a vintage Shanghai miniature tin tricycle model.
location: Lujiazui Market, food court behind Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Walked home to hit the 10,000-step goal
description: After parting with Song Jia at the entrance to the night market, he chose to walk home and briskly walked along Century Avenue and Zhangyang Road for fifty minutes, covering about 11,500 steps in total, exceeding his exercise goal.
location: From No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, via Century Avenue and Zhangyang Road, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Wash up and update the novel.
description: After returning home, he showered, changed into loungewear, and continued writing the novel The Afternoon at Xiafei Lane on the computer in his study. He incorporated the feelings from the day's roller skating, the night market, and the invitation to an old friend's wedding into a new chapter, and left a cliffhanger at the end.
location: Study, Room 301, Building 12, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep review, reading, and stretching.
description: Checked that all of the day's to-dos were completed, read The Brand Operations Field Manual and recorded product selection ideas for the coffee corner; did ten minutes of leg stretches in the bedroom to relieve roller skating fatigue, turned off the light and went to bed, reflecting on the fulfilling day.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Building 12, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake-up and weigh-in
description: The alarm went off. Lei Mingxuan got up, went to the bathroom to wash up, and then stepped on the electronic scale. His weight showed 80.1 kg, roughly the same as yesterday. He tidied his hair in front of the mirror and felt in good spirits.
location: Home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning Stretching and Planning
description: Spread a yoga mat on the living room floor and did 10 minutes of shoulder, neck, and leg stretches to wake up the body. Then sat on the sofa, opened the phone memo, quickly browsed today's to-do list, including the friendly match closing, National Day promotion plan, and communication with property management, etc., and silently planned the morning route.
location: Living room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Shanggang Residential Community

name: Breakfast with parents.
description: Mother Wang Xiuying prepared breakfast: pan-fried pork buns with hot soy milk and a small plate of pickled vegetables. Father Lei Jianguo had just returned from Pushang vegetable market and, while eating, kept talking about how fresh the greens were, and mentioned bumping into Aunt Zhu, a neighbor. Lei Mingxuan scrolled through Moments while eating, saw the roller-skating group photo Song Jia had posted, and casually replied with an emoji sticker.
location: Dining room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Shanggang Residential Area, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk to the shop.
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan put on his commuting crossbody bag and chose to walk to the store as a morning warm-up. Along Zhangyang Road and Century Avenue, basking in the morning sun, he walked about 15 minutes to reach Super Brand Mall.
location: Along the route from Zhangyang Road to Lujiazui West Road in Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Store morning meeting and package handling
description: After arriving at the store, he turned on the computer and the cash register system. After store clerk Xiao Lin arrived, Lei Mingxuan held a brief morning meeting, emphasizing that Monday should be used to warm up for the National Day promotion, requiring the shelves to be tidied and the selling points of the new products to be memorized. He then handed Xiao Lin the Pop Mart blind box parcel he had packed the night before, asking her to go to the lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station and send it out.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Attending the friendly match closing ceremony and social wrap-up
description: Walking from Super Brand Mall, he arrived at the World Plaza billiards hall around 9:00. The closing event had a relaxed atmosphere, with award presentations and open networking. Lei Mingxuan chatted with his opponent from yesterday, Liu Zihao, who confirmed that he would bring friends to the store to experience the coffee corner on October 4. Lei Mingxuan proactively exchanged WeChat contacts with the organizer in charge and expressed interest in future cooperation; the organizer said he appreciated his billiards skills and enthusiasm.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organize contacts and send greetings
description: After the event, Lei Mingxuan sat on the sofa in the rest area, entered the 12 new contacts collected from the friendly match into his phone's contacts, and grouped them by tags such as 'billiards circle' and 'mall cooperation.' He then composed a WeChat greeting: 'Glad to meet you at the Pujiang Cup, and I look forward to more exchanges in the future! [Handshake]' and sent it to each one.
location: Rest area, World Square Billiard Hall, 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walked back to the shop and did some shopping
description: After dealing with the networking matters, Lei Mingxuan left the billiard hall and strolled slowly along South Pudong Road back to Super Brand Mall. On the way, he passed a newly opened trendy milk tea shop. Remembering that staff member Xiao Lin likes it, he bought two cups of signature lemon tea to bring back to the store.
location: Along the way from No. 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to No. 168 West Lujiazui Road

name: Shop work: order processing and National Day stocking.
description: Back at the store, Lei Mingxuan handed a cup of lemon tea to Xiao Lin and started drinking one himself. He logged into the online backend to process 5 unshipped orders, checked sizes and addresses, and printed the shipping labels. Then he went into the stockroom and, according to the stocking list, counted the inventory of the National Day best-selling new autumn T-shirts and lightweight hoodies, confirmed it was sufficient, and wrote down the styles that needed replenishment in his notebook.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and lunch break: brainstorming promotion plans.
description: Lei Mingxuan went alone to the Japanese ramen restaurant on Level B1 of the IFC Mall, ordered a bowl of signature tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg, and while eating, scrolled through competitors' National Day marketing posts on his phone for inspiration. After lunch, he returned to Store A-208 in Super Brand Mall. Sitting behind the cash register, he opened a note-taking app on his tablet and began drafting the National Day promotion plan based on that inspiration, listing core ideas such as 10% off all new autumn items, a coffee voucher for purchases over 500 yuan, and blind box raffles.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant, Level B1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Store A-208, Super Brand Mall

name: Finalized the National Day promotion plan with the store clerk.
description: In the afternoon, when foot traffic was light, Lei Mingxuan called store clerk Xiaolin over to the shop's rest area, took out his tablet, and discussed the National Day event he had been planning. Xiaolin suggested setting the blind-box lottery to one entry for every 300 yuan spent, with no upper limit, to stimulate consumption. After discussing it, the two finalized the full details of the promotional plan, including discount intensity, gift-with-purchase thresholds, lottery rules, and visual poster requirements. Lei Mingxuan decided to adopt part of Xiaolin's proposal.
location: Rest area, Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Visit the property manager
description: Lei Mingxuan went downstairs to the property management office on B1 of Super Brand Mall and found the property manager, Brother Zheng Kai. He offered him a cigarette (even though he doesn't smoke himself) and asked whether the mall would extend business hours during National Day and about security and logistics arrangements. Brother Zheng Kai told him in detail and reminded him to prepare enough change and shopping bags in advance to cope with the customer flow. The two agreed to have coffee together during their duty shift on October 5 and chat about the holiday.
location: Property management office on B1 of Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In-store reception and online warm-up
description: Back at the store, the flow of customers gradually increased. Lei Mingxuan switched into an upbeat mood and personally received several young customers, enthusiastically recommending fall new arrivals based on their body shapes and styles. While the customers were trying on clothes, he used his phone to put together outfits with the newly arrived American-retro-style hoodies and cargo pants, took photos in front of the full-length mirror, edited them, and posted on WeChat Moments with the caption: 'Holiday countdown—is your travel outfit ready? [Clever]' as a warm-up for the National Day promotion.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Close up shop and finish work.
description: As evening approached, the mall traffic thinned. Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin tidied up the fitting rooms together, sorted and hung up the clothes that had been left lying around, and used a vacuum cleaner to remove threads from the floor. He instructed Xiao Lin to finish up the remaining tasks, while he packed his personal items and got ready to leave work.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking home and the step count challenge
description: To reach today's goal of 10,000 steps, Lei Mingxuan did not ride his e-bike and chose to walk home. He deliberately took a detour through Lujiazui Central Greenland Park, listening to a podcast on his earphones and walking briskly along the park trail. An early autumn breeze brought the fragrance of osmanthus. He slowed down and breathed deeply, feeling his fatigue dissipate. When he reached the bottom of his building, his phone showed that his steps had reached 10,500.
location: Route from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road (via Lujiazui Central Green Park)

name: Dinner and casual family chat.
description: When he got home, his mother had already made dinner: scallion-roasted crucian carp, stir-fried spinach, and tomato and egg soup. The family of three chatted while eating. His father asked about the store business, and Lei Mingxuan shared the National Day promotion plan. His mother asked whether he had met any new girl, and Lei Mingxuan laughed it off with 'too busy making money,' then volunteered to help clear the dishes.
location: Dining room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Shanggang Residential Area, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel update and interaction.
description: Lei Mingxuan returned to the study, opened his laptop, and prepared to update his short story 'Afternoon in Xiafei Fang'. He recalled how he felt when he received Wang Lei's wedding invitation, and wove it into tonight's chapter, describing the protagonist's complex feelings when hearing good news from an old friend amid urban life. After writing 1,800 characters, he published it on the platform with a note: 'Tomorrow is the final chapter; let's talk about stories of farewell.' Then he quickly browsed and replied to a few readers' comments.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening rest, review, and planning
description: Lei Mingxuan collapsed on the living room sofa watching a recorded billiards broadcast on the sports channel, while scrolling through Bilibili on his phone and ranting about the salesperson in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group. Zhang Wei and Li Na popped up and chatted a few lines. Afterwards, he went back to the study and reviewed the day's affairs: the friendly match had initially built connections, the promotion plan was finalized, and the novel had been updated. Then he did 10 minutes of shoulder, neck, and leg stretches, and made a to-do list in his phone memos: confirm the production progress of promotional materials, contact Zhou Tao to urge the autumn fabrics, and reply to Wang Lei about transportation arrangements for the Hangzhou wedding.
location: Living room and study at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Professional reading and relaxation
description: Before bed, Lei Mingxuan took out the Brand Operations Practical Handbook and read for forty minutes, focusing on the 'Holiday Promotion Campaign Review' chapter to cross-check against his own plan. Then he opened Bilibili to watch a saved training video on 'precision long-shot offense' in American eight-ball, pondering power techniques.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Putting down his phone, Lei Mingxuan went to the bathroom, brushed his teeth carefully, and washed his face with facial cleanser. Back in the bedroom, he set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, turned on the bedside lamp, and read a few pages of a book. Feeling drowsy, he turned off the light, lay down, and soon fell asleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home in Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning strength training and fitness check-in
description: Woke up naturally before the alarm, clear-headed. After getting up, I spread out the yoga mat in the living room and started the fifth strength training session of the month, completing in order 3 sets of 12 squats, 3 sets of 10 push-ups, and 3 sets of 45-second planks. I recorded all the data throughout with the fitness app, took a screenshot and sent it to the fitness group 'Pudong Iron Triangle' with the caption: 'September final training, check-in! The weight is steady, but the muscle tone is tighter!' Soon I received likes and teasing from friends Zhang Wei and Li Na. After training, I stretched and relaxed, feeling slight soreness in my muscles but a full-body sense of ease.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Washing up, breakfast, and getting ready to go out
description: Took a hot shower, then changed into a clean white T-shirt and khaki cargo shorts. When I walked out of the room, my mother Wang Xiuying had already made breakfast - shepherd's purse and fresh pork wontons, with egg ribbons and seaweed floating in the soup. Sitting at the table, I chatted with my father Lei Jianguo about the fresh vegetables he had bought this morning at Pushang Market. After eating, I checked my phone, wallet, and keys, put on my commuter bag, and got ready to leave.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycle commute to the store
description: Walked out of the residential complex and felt the fresh morning breeze. Scanned a shared bike, rode along Pudong Avenue onto Century Avenue, and arrived at Super Brand Mall about 15 minutes later. Parked the bike in the designated area and took the elevator to unit A-208 on the 2nd floor.
location: Along the route from Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store National Day promotion preparation and morning operations.
description: After arriving at the store, he first turned on the computer and the coffee machine and reviewed yesterday's sales data. He took out his phone and carefully shot combo photos of the coffee corner and the fall new arrivals: the techwear vest and neon green T-shirt. He handed the phone to store clerk Xiao Lin and asked him to go to a print shop to print the National Day promotional poster designed yesterday and post it at the entrance. Then they went into the warehouse together to check stock of best-selling items and found that a few fall-fabric outerwear jackets and co-branded hats were low in stock. He immediately called Zhou Tao, a supplier in Hangzhou, urging him to arrange SF Express air freight shipment that same day. After handling the order rush, he sent a WeChat message to regular customer Qian Duoduo, telling her that tomorrow's National Day event would feature a blind box lucky draw grand prize, and invited her to come.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and novel writing ideas
description: I turned off the shop computer, said hi to Xiao Lin, and walked through the connecting skybridge into the IFC Mall. Familiar with the place, I found the Japanese ramen shop on B1 and ordered the signature rich tonkotsu fish broth ramen, plus a soft-boiled egg. While waiting for the food, I opened the notes app on my phone and started outlining the monthly summary of the novel to be published that evening, reviewing the chapters updated in September and drafting it in my head.
location: Japanese Ramen Restaurant, B1, International Finance Center Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and social interaction at Lujiazui Green
description: After finishing the ramen, he didn't go straight back to the store. He walked slowly along the pedestrian bridge for about 12 minutes to reach Lujiazui Central Green Park. He sat down on a bench, put on earphones, and played upbeat City Pop music. Opening WeChat, he replied to university classmate Wang Lei's private message about the October 19 wedding in Hangzhou, saying he would go, and asked if he should help organize Shanghai friends to go together. After sending the message, he took a stroll around the green space.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and receiving regular customers
description: Back at the store, the afternoon foot traffic gradually increased. He put on his work apron and started receiving customers. Regular customer Qian Duoduo came in with two of her girlfriends. Lei Mingxuan greeted them warmly and recommended the latest street-style T-shirts and tech-wear vests. They tried them on and were very satisfied, each buying one. He also made each of them a cup of his signature coconut latte. They took photos and posted them on Moments, serving as free advertising for the store. In the gap between customers, he sent Zhou Tao a WeChat message to chase up the order, confirming that Zhou Tao had arranged shipment and obtained the SF Express tracking number.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store, tidying up, and online warm-up promotion.
description: In the evening, as customers gradually dwindled, I started tidying the shelves that had been messed up by shoppers during the afternoon, re-hanging the clothes by color. Using my phone, I processed the photos of the coffee corner and new items taken in the morning, along with the National Day event poster, and edited a WeChat Moments post as a preview. Then I walked 9 minutes to the storage lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station and placed the waybill numbers and packages for several online orders into the lockers one by one. After handling everything, I sent a WeChat message to my cousin Shen Jie: "Girl, any plans for National Day? My store will have an event starting tomorrow. Want to come join the fun? I got a new batch of trendy accessories."
location: Luggage lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station, No. 158 Huayuanshiqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shopping on the walk home
description: He turned off the store's main power switch, put on his backpack, and walked home. He deliberately walked through the old neighborhoods near Lujiazui, savoring the lively everyday atmosphere after work. Passing by the familiar Yanqin grocery store, he went in and picked out a box of Hongyan strawberries and a few ripe kiwifruit, planning to have them as a late-night snack. Once home, he washed the fruit and put it in the fridge.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and casual chat
description: Mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared dinner: Shanghai-style braised pork belly, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg drop soup. The family of three sat around the table, eating and chatting. He shared funny things from the store today with his parents, such as Qian Duoduo coming by again to show support and tomorrow's National Day promotion. His father, Lei Jianguo, nodded and reminded him to take care of his health and not get too tired. After dinner he took the initiative to help his mother clear the table, then sat on the living room sofa and browsed a video site for a while, watching several billiards technique videos.
location: Dining room and living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Monthly novel recap post and fan interaction
description: I went into the study, opened the laptop, and logged into the novel platform. I turned the monthly summary I had conceived at noon into a long illustrated post, reviewing the emotional journey of the work "Afternoon in Xiafei Lane" in September, thanking readers for not giving up on it, and at the end teasing that the protagonist would receive a mysterious invitation in October to begin a new chapter. After checking it several times, I published it at exactly 8 p.m. The readership and comments quickly climbed. I patiently replied to comments from several loyal readers and, as promised, drew three lucky fans in the comment section, sent them private messages to get their addresses, and prepared to send them exquisitely designed bookmarks I had created.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Japanese study review and listening test
description: After smoothly finishing the interactive novel session, I switched to the language learning app HelloTalk and started today's Japanese study. Instead of learning new content, I opened the “Simulated Ordering” dialogue module and completed several rounds of practice. I found that everyday greetings and dish names came fairly fluently, but I still stumbled on honorifics, so I noted in my notebook to focus on ordering honorifics in October. As a reward, I watched one episode of the previously saved anime “Frieren: Beyond Journey's End” without subtitles to test my listening. Although I couldn't keep up in some places, I could understand the vast majority of the dialogue, which was very fulfilling.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Weight measurement and monthly fitness summary sharing.
description: Walking from the study to the bedroom, he stepped onto the body fat scale, and the electronic screen showed 80.0 kg, 1.5 kg heavier than at the beginning of the month. Although his weight had increased slightly, he pinched his solid arms and chest and felt that his strength and muscle definition were better. He opened his phone album, stitched together the past 30 days of WeChat Steps screenshots into one long image, and captioned it: '[September Wrap-up] Still walking; weight may be back to 80, but my body is more solid. September, perfect finish. Good night.' After sending it, he quickly received over a dozen likes and comments, with Zhang Wei, Li Na, and other friends teasing or encouraging him.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stretching and full-day review before bed
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, I sat on the edge of the bed and did a set of leg stretches and waist twists to relieve the fatigue of sitting and walking all day. While stretching, I briefly reviewed in my mind: strength training done, store stocking and order follow-ups done, replied to Wang Lei's wedding, sent the novel summary, and reviewed Japanese. Everything planned got done smoothly, and the last day of September felt very fulfilling. Satisfied, I turned off the lamp.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepare for sleep and confirm tomorrow's goals.
description: He picked up his phone for one last look at tomorrow's goals: welcoming the National Day holiday customer traffic and kicking off October perfectly. He set the alarm, closed his eyes, and fell into a deep sleep with a sense of satisfaction.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run and family breakfast
description: On the early morning of National Day, just after dawn, I put on my running shoes and went out, jogging 3 km at the Lujiazui Central Green Park near home, finishing in 18 minutes 42 seconds, then stretched and relaxed on a bench. After running home, my mother had already cooked small wontons, served with seaweed, egg sheets, and chopped green onions. After showering, I enjoyed breakfast with my mother; my father was tending to flowers on the balcony and also greeted me. The whole family happily began the National Day holiday.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Study and health planning
description: After breakfast, I went into the study and opened the Huawei Health app to review September data: weight 80 kg, running volume reaching the target.
