I made an October health plan: strength training twice a week (at the gym in Standard Chartered Bank Building), a monthly cumulative run of 15 km, a target weight of 79 kg by the end of the month, and set daily reminders. Then I opened the Duolingo app for a staged Japanese self-test, covering the gojūon chart, word dictation, beginner grammar, and verb conjugation. Listening scored 53, grammar 40, and verb conjugation still needs improvement. To practice speaking, I recorded my National Day plan and sent it to the study group leader, receiving pronunciation feedback. As a self-reward, I ordered a bag of Japanese dark-roast coffee beans on Taobao, keeping them for the afternoon activities.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go to the shop and prepare for business
description: Changed into an off-white workwear-style shirt, put on a canvas bag, and walked 20 minutes along Pudong Avenue to the store at Super Brand Mall. After arriving, immediately set up the National Day promotional roll-up banners and posters. Then measured a roughly 2.5-square-meter empty corner in the store and used SketchBook on a tablet to draw a draft display for Japanese ukiyo-e style blind boxes. During this time, contacted regular customer Qian Duoduo via WeChat to ask about popular Pop Mart items. She recommended the "Sweet Bean Autumn Camping Series", which I considered using for the blind box area.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Planning the Autumn Story trend tasting event
description: In the store's rest area, opened the laptop and refined the plan for the October 3 Autumn Story Trend Preview event. Referring to the fashion trend report provided by cousin Shen Jie, set the theme as Retro Futurism and designed an Outfit Change Challenge interactive segment, where participants could enter a raffle to win limited-edition shopping bags. Listed the material checklist: sign-in desk decorations, wayfinding signs, themed posters, special discount coupons, wine glasses, and sparkling water, making sure the event would be well-presented.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Purchased supplies for the event and enjoyed lunch.
description: After telling the shop assistant Xiao Zhang to keep an eye on the store, he rode a shared bike to Huamu Road Market. He first went to the coffee bean stall to buy Japanese dark-roast coffee beans and filter paper, then browsed the accessory area for Bohemian-style headscarves and ethnic-style ornaments as reserves for the tasting event's styling display. After shopping, he had lunch at the nearby Yixing Noodle Shop Japanese ramen restaurant, ordering a rich tonkotsu and fish broth ramen and karaage chicken. While eating, he watched a commentary video of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End on his phone, enjoying a pleasant midday break.
location: Huamu Road Market, No. 1388 Huamu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Refine the blind box area plan and organize merchandise.
description: After returning to the store, he used Procreate on his iPad to refine the sketch of the blind box area, designing three layout options: a central island counter, wall-mounted rotating racks, and themed container units. At the same time, he matched the headscarves and ornaments bought in the morning with the store's autumn clothing, shot several look photos, and hung them in prominent positions, adding freshness to the tasting event and daily sales.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Setting up personal and store financial ledgers
description: In the store's rest area, he used WPS Office to create two Excel ledgers: “Lei Mingxuan Personal Ledger” and “Xiafeiji Store Ledger.” The personal ledger was divided into categories such as dining, transportation, entertainment, and health; the store ledger included daily revenue, inventory costs, operating expenses, and online logistics columns. He carefully entered the end-of-September inventory data, the early-October cash balance, and the relevant documents from suppliers Zhou Tao and Wu Fang, checking each item to ensure the accounts were clear and accurate.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home and having a family dinner
description: After giving the shop assistant Xiao Zhang instructions half an hour in advance about things to note during the National Day holiday, he walked home. Passing Yanqin Grocery Store, he bought aged vinegar and the Nanhui peaches his mother loved. When he got home, his mother was in the kitchen preparing dinner, and the aroma of braised pork filled the air. He washed the peaches and helped set out the bowls and chopsticks. Dinner was Shanghai-style braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. The family sat around the table, talked about the day's experiences, and his father reminded everyone to balance work and rest, enjoying a warm time of family togetherness.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Socializing and leisure entertainment
description: After a short rest following the meal, he proactively contacted his billiards buddy Chen Jie, sent photos of the store's designer toys and coffee corner, gave a detailed introduction to the positioning of 'Xiafei Ji', and invited him to come to the store on the afternoon of October 5 to try the new cue. Chen Jie readily agreed. Then he curled up in the gaming chair in the study, opened Bilibili to catch up on 'Frieren: Beyond Journey's End', and enjoyed some anime time.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening study and ledger review
description: After watching the anime, he organized the wrong words and grammar points from the morning Japanese self-test into an electronic notebook and made 20 digital flashcards to reinforce his memory. Then he reopened WPS and reviewed the financial ledger he had set up in the afternoon from the beginning, confirming that all amounts and categories were accurate, ensuring that the store's and personal finances were in good order.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Home fitness and pre-bed washing up
description: Changed into workout clothes, did a 20-minute HIIT fat-burning session with Keep in the living room, then completed a 15-minute full-body stretch, sweating buckets. After exercising, drank protein powder to replenish energy, then took a hot shower and changed into pajamas, feeling completely relaxed.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening social relaxation and falling asleep.
description: After getting into bed, scrolled through the Pudong Three Musketeers group chat. Zhang Wei shared funny highlights from the company basketball game, and Li Na complained about having to work overtime during National Day. I chatted with them briefly, and we agreed to go rollerblading along the riverside the day after tomorrow. Then I looked out at the Pudong night view, turned off my phone, set the alarm for the next day, and fell asleep, ready to welcome the upcoming holiday.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning strength training
description: At six o'clock in the morning, the alarm went off, and Lei Mingxuan immediately got up. He did 10 minutes of dynamic stretching on the yoga mat in his living room, then started his first strength training session of October. As planned, he completed push-ups, squats, dumbbell curls, and shoulder presses, each for 4 sets of 12 reps, with 1-minute rests between sets. At the end of the workout, he jumped rope on the balcony for 10 minutes, about 1,000 jumps, and his undershirt was soaked with sweat. After exercising, he took a selfie and posted it on WeChat Moments with the caption "Day 2 of National Day, start with strength. Target 79kg, steady progress!" and attached a screenshot of his Keep training data.
location: Living room and balcony at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Breakfast and guest confirmation for the tasting event
description: After exercising and showering, his mother Wang Xiuying had prepared small wontons with shepherd's purse and fresh pork for breakfast. While eating, Lei Mingxuan used WeChat voice messages to contact his cousin Shen Jie and regular customers Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu, confirming that they could arrive on time at 2 p.m. tomorrow for the 'Autumn Story Trend Appreciation Event', and told them the event agenda. He then sent verbal invitations in the 'Pudong Trendy Toys Group' and 'Coffee Friends Club', and left voice messages for Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao and Guangzhou supplier Wu Fang, inviting them to join online and asking whether they could provide seasonal new arrivals for display or as lucky draw prizes. The whole process was efficient and smooth.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute, purchase event materials, and go to the store
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan changed into a cream work shirt and khaki casual pants, grabbed his crossbody bag, and headed out on foot to Dongfang Road Stationery Wholesale Market. On the way, he thought about the sign-in wall design. About 30 minutes later, he arrived at the market and quickly picked out materials for the sign-in wall at his usual stall: cream cardstock, gold markers, colorful balloons, dried flowers, and small gift bags. After bargaining, he scanned a QR code to pay and loaded everything into an eco-friendly bag. He then walked about 15 minutes from the stationery market to Super Brand Mall at No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, sorting out his afternoon work checklist along the way. After reaching the mall, he clocked in with his fingerprint at the staff entrance and took the freight elevator to Store A-208 on Level 2, the “Trendy Look at Me” store.
location: Walk from Shanggang Residential Quarter, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to M&G Stationery at No. 217 Pudian Road, Pudong New Area, then walk to Super Brand Mall at No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area

name: Comprehensively invite customers and suppliers
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan turned on his computer and logged into his work WeChat and personal WeChat. First, he edited a promotional Moments post with images and text, featuring a new store display photo and the caption: 'Tomorrow's tasting event, limited gifts for you, see you at 2 p.m.!' Then, using the tag group feature, he filtered VIP regulars and frequent customers and sent personalized private messages one by one, such as: 'Brother Li, a new batch of cargo pants arrived tomorrow. They'll match perfectly with the jacket I recommended last time. Why not come to the store tomorrow and try them?' Meanwhile, he replied by voice message to suppliers Zhou Tao and Wu Fang—Zhou Tao promised to send samples, and Wu Fang provided the latest accessories as a highlight for the event. After counting the replies, more than 20 regular customers had expressed interest in attending, and he was very satisfied.
location: Chaowokan clothing store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Install blind box display shelves.
description: After finishing a cup of pour-over coffee, Lei Mingxuan began assembling the display shelves for the blind box area. He brought out the white modular shelving and acrylic display boxes he had bought online from the warehouse, assembled them with a hex key according to the instructions, and repeatedly adjusted the shelf heights to fit Pop Mart blind boxes of different sizes. He arranged the acrylic boxes in a staggered, layered way to create a layered lighting effect. Finally, he cleaned up the packing foam and paper scraps on the floor, leaving the blind box area neat and tidy.
location: Blind box display area at the “Chao Wo Kan” clothing store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lunch and arrangement with friends to go roller skating
description: At noon, Lei Mingxuan locked up the store, went downstairs to the B1 food court of Super Brand Mall, and chose a newly opened Hong Kong-style tea restaurant. He ordered a plate of char siu rice and a glass of iced lemon tea. While waiting for his food, he saw in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group that his childhood friend Zhang Wei proposed going roller skating along the riverside tomorrow afternoon. He immediately replied that he would join and @Li Na to confirm the time. The three of them quickly agreed to meet at Binjiang Avenue at 3 p.m. the next day. After the meal, he went to the mall restroom to wash up and refresh himself.
location: Hong Kong-style tea restaurant, B1 food court, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Tasting venue setup and mid-session break
description: Soon after lunch, his good friend Xie Fei arrived at the store with an iced Americano. The two got busy: Lei Mingxuan arranged the new autumn clothing from the warehouse under the theme of "retro-futurism," while Xie Fei helped adjust the wall lamp angles and set up posters. Together they hand-painted a check-in wall, using cardstock and gold markers, in a simple, striking style. Around two in the afternoon, they sat on the sofa for a 20-minute break, drinking coffee and chatting. Afterwards, Lei Mingxuan took advantage of the lull to walk two laps around the mall from the 1st floor to the 6th floor, completing part of his 10,000-step goal. After returning to the store, he connected his phone to the speaker via Bluetooth and played a City Pop playlist to set the mood. Remembering his mother's water chestnut cake, he sent a WeChat message reminding her to bring some tomorrow. Then he called the milk tea shop and ordered 20 cups of their signature milk tea, arranging for delivery tomorrow at 3 p.m.
location: The "Chao Wo Kan" clothing store and the mall interior, Unit A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store closing and inspection
description: After Xie Fei left, Lei Mingxuan did the final wrap-up alone. He checked the stability of the sign-in wall, the flatness of the posters, and the lighting and placement of the blind box area, then opened his phone's memo to check the materials list. After confirming nothing was missing, he felt satisfied with the final effect of the event space.
location: Chaowokan clothing store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store and shopping on the way home
description: After turning off the store's main power and pulling down the rolling shutter door, Lei Mingxuan walked home. The evening breeze was still warm, so he deliberately took a detour to his usual Yanqin Grocery Store to buy the aged vinegar his mother had asked for, to make up for the lack of vinegar flavor in last night's sweet-and-sour ribs. After buying it, he walked another two minutes back home in Shanggang Community.
location: Walk from Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, passing Yanqin Grocery Store in Pudong New Area, and return to Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Family dinner
description: Back home, his mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared Shanghai-style braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and winter melon and pork rib soup. At the dinner table, Lei Mingxuan told his mother that her water chestnut cake would be the “secret weapon” at tomorrow's tasting event, and invited his father to come to the store tomorrow. His father Lei Jianguo replied calmly, “Got it. Tomorrow I'll have Chen Jie accompany me for chess. You handle it yourself.” The dinner atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening activity check and Japanese study
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan returned to his room, opened his laptop, and used mind-mapping software to sort out the flow of tomorrow's appreciation event and check for gaps. After that, he opened a Japanese learning app and used the flashcard feature to review verb conjugations for 15 minutes, focusing on mastering the rules for changing the 'form,' writing and reading aloud to deepen his memory.
location: At the desk in his room, Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepare tomorrow’s outfit and confirm plans
description: Lei Mingxuan stood in front of the wardrobe choosing an outfit for tomorrow's event, finally settling on a new dark blue workwear jacket with a white printed T-shirt underneath and matching workwear pants. He also put on the silver metal necklace and bracelet sent by supplier Wu Fang, and checked in the mirror to confirm his look was sharp and befitting a shop owner's temperament.
location: In front of the wardrobe in his room at 2-51 Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime relaxation and early rest
description: After lying down in bed, Lei Mingxuan chatted with his childhood friends Zhang Wei and Li Na in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group and confirmed the meeting point for tomorrow afternoon's 3 p.m. roller skating. Just after 9:30, he felt drowsy, so he set an alarm for 7 a.m., put his phone on airplane mode, turned off the light, and got ready to sleep, planning to enter deep sleep before 11 p.m. to save energy for tomorrow's activities.
location: On the bed in his own room, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and morning run.
description: Woke up naturally at 6:40, first filled the pet cat A Fu's food and water bowls, then changed into quick-dry clothes and running shoes. Left at 6:50, walked 14 minutes to Lujiazui Central Green Park, and after 5 minutes of dynamic stretching, started a 3-kilometer tempo run at a pace of about 5:30 per kilometer. Finished at 7:25, then stretched on a park bench until 7:30. Watching the National Day morning sunlight shine on the Lujiazui skyline, he was in a good mood.
location: Lujiazui Center Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Shower, breakfast, and dressing up the cute pet
description: At 7:30, he walked home and arrived at 7:44. He first took a cold shower and changed into a retro patchwork shirt and cargo pants. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had already cooked small wontons and fried eggs, and they had breakfast together. Afterward, he put a small bow tie and a leash on Afu, took a photo, and posted it on WeChat Moments: 'Best employee of the day, ready for work!'
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Set off by car, taking A Fu to the store
description: Packed Afu's pet carrier, snacks, and water bowl, and checked the Bluetooth speaker and poster scrolls for the tasting event. Departed at 8:20, drove about 7.5 minutes, and arrived at the underground parking lot of Super Brand Mall around 8:28. After parking, carried Afu's cat carrier and bags through the staff passage up to the store on the 2nd floor.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Final store layout and posting of materials
description: Arrived at the shop at 8:35, first settled A Fu on the pet mat beside the designer toy area and set out water and toys. Then did the final setup: hung the exotic-style tapestry on the background wall of the coffee experience area, adjusted the angle and lighting of the vinyl record player, and arranged the pour-over coffee kettle and coffee beans. At 9:15, started putting up the Blind Box Explorer promotional poster and price tags in the front window and prominent shelf positions, and added a few doodles to the check-in wall with a marker. Everything was done right at 10:00.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Check equipment and conduct a final inspection
description: Check the audio equipment again, connect the phone, and play Bossa Nova music. Re-iron and reorganize all the displayed autumn clothing, and adjust the placement of accessories. At 10:40, my cousin Shen Jie arrived early and brought delicate tasting snacks. The two went over the event flow again, confirming the outfit showcase and pour-over coffee explanation segments.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and food tasting at a new restaurant
description: Went to the newly opened 'Tangwu Sugar Water Shop' on B1 of Super Brand Mall and ordered a bowl of mango pomelo sago and a curry fish ball cart noodle. While eating, I scrolled through my phone, checked the status of the milk tea order that needed to be delivered to the riverside at 3 p.m., and in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat, I @Zhang Wei and @Li Na and sent a location: "As usual, see you at the riverside boardwalk at 3 p.m. Milk tea is on me."
location: Tangwu Dessert Shop, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Team assembly and final preparations for the opening.
description: Back at the 'Xiafei Collection' shop, Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu arrived one after another around 12:30. We assigned tasks: Shen Jie was responsible for doing a styling display with Lei Mingxuan, Qian Duoduo was the pour-over coffee barista, and Feng Xiaoyu was in charge of guiding customers and taking photos. Together we set up the sign-in table with coffee bean samples, a mystery box raffle box, and small event gifts. Afu yawned lazily on the pet mat and became the center of attention.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Tasting session (first half)
description: The tasting event officially began. Lei Mingxuan wore a retro patchwork shirt, and Shen Jie changed into a modified techwear vest, and they did a styling showcase in the store. Qian Duoduo explained the flavor of Ethiopian Guodingding coffee beans while brewing pour-over coffee, and the aroma filled the air. The VIP customers who attended responded enthusiastically, taking photos, trying on clothes, and placing orders. A-fu walked gracefully in the designer toy area, attracting female customers to take photos with him. Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to introduce designer toy blind boxes, and the atmosphere at the scene was excellent.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Squeezing in roller skating and milk tea delivery
description: While the event momentum was strong, at 14:45 he greeted Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu, put on his roller skates, skated out of the southeast gate of Super Brand Mall, and headed north along Lujiazui Ring Road to the meetup point on the riverside promenade. Friends Zhang Wei and Li Na were already waiting. Lei Mingxuan skated over, stopped sharply, and high-fived them. The delivery rider happened to arrive with 20 cups of milk tea, which were given to Zhang Wei and Li Na to distribute to the friends. The three skated along the river for 20 minutes, chatting and hanging out, and returned at 15:20.
location: Lujiazui Riverside Promenade, Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China (near Super Brand Mall)

name: Return to the store
description: Skated back from the riverside walkway to the 'Xiafei Ji' store in Super Brand Mall, quickly removed my roller skates and changed back into work shoes. When I entered the store, there were still many customers chatting and trying on clothes. Qian Duoduo was explaining pour-over techniques to two men, and Ah Fu was on the small sofa, surrounded by female customers taking photos of him, looking like a little internet celebrity.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Tasting event (second half) and the blind box raffle highlight
description: Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie guided customers into the lucky draw session. They used their phones to demonstrate on the spot the store's check-in activity on Xiaohongshu and WeChat Moments, with prizes being 'Xiafei Collection' limited canvas tote bags and hidden-edition blind boxes. Customers were enthusiastic and joined in one after another. A young man won the grand prize limited shopping bag and happily took a photo with Lei Mingxuan. Around 4:30 p.m., sales had already exceeded expectations.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Event wrap-up and venue cleanup.
description: The event ended successfully, half an hour earlier than expected. Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie saw off the last batch of customers. Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu helped wash the coffee equipment and tidy up the tables and chairs. Lei Mingxuan hung the displayed sample garments back on the racks and cleaned up the garbage and posters on site. Shen Jie collected the wonderful moments of Afu interacting with customers into a phone album and sent it to Lei Mingxuan.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Team light meal and review
description: To express his gratitude, Lei Mingxuan treated the team to Hunan cuisine at 'Fei Dacang Chili Fried Pork' on the 5th floor of Super Brand Mall, ordering the signature chili-fried pork, fish head with chopped chili peppers, and more. At the table, Qian Duoduo shared the customer preferences she had observed that day, Shen Jie suggested incorporating more hand-brewed coffee activities in the future, and Feng Xiaoyu proposed turning A-Fu into a regular IP. They ate and chatted, and the atmosphere was harmonious. Lei Mingxuan replied to messages from Zhang Wei and Li Na in the group chat; they had also had a good time that day.
location: Chef Fei's Stir-Fried Pork with Chili Peppers, 5/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Drive Ah Fu home.
description: After dinner, I went to the parking lot to get the car at 18:50 and got home around 18:58. Afu was drowsy in the cat carrier; as soon as he came out, he ran to the litter box.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Publish Afu mascot content
description: Leaning back on the sofa, he opened his phone photo album and spent 20 minutes selecting nine photos: Afu wearing a bow tie, Afu with a customer, the tasting event scene, product displays, and a candid shot of a rollerblading figure from behind. He edited a lively caption and posted it to his Moments and the store's Xiaohongshu account, instantly receiving dozens of likes and comments.
location: Living room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Sharing today's achievements with family
description: Walked to the living room and shared the success of today's event with my father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying; sales hit a new high. My father, though quiet, said with a smile, 'Not bad, steady and solid.' My mother told me to rest more. Then I opened the shop's finance ledger app on my phone on the coffee table, quickly checked today's revenue and transfer records, and let out a long sigh of relief after confirming everything was correct.
location: Living room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Free relaxation time
description: Back in the room, I opened Bilibili and caught up on the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End for this week. Feeling a bit tired, I didn't play games. I opened the Japanese language app and did 15 minutes of verb conjugation practice.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Organizing photos and checking accounts
description: Import today's photos from the camera into the computer, select the 50 best event photos, and prepare to turn them into a WeChat official account post tomorrow. Use WPS to carefully check today's store income and expense records, reconcile them with the cash, and then enter them into the financial ledger. Looking at the record-breaking sales figures, I feel very at ease.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Took a comfortable hot shower and changed into pajamas. When I walked out of the bathroom, Ah Fu had already jumped onto the bed and curled up to sleep. I stroked its fur, set the alarm for 8 a.m. tomorrow, turned off the light, and went to sleep. Today was truly a fulfilling and perfect day.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning wake-up and cozy breakfast
description: At 7 a.m., Lei Mingxuan got up at home, did some simple stretches to wake up his body, washed up, and changed into loose athletic wear. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had specially prepared a breakfast of small wontons with seaweed and egg crepe. During breakfast, his mother asked how A-fu, the family pet, had done at yesterday's tasting event. As Lei Mingxuan described how popular A-fu was, he texted his colleague Qian Duoduo on WeChat to confirm the 10 a.m. video release. Qian Duoduo instantly replied with an OK gesture—everything was ready.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the store
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan changed into his work vest, said goodbye to his parents, walked about 5 minutes to Pudong Avenue Metro Station, took Metro Line 2 to Lujiazui Station, and after exiting the station crossed the Lujiazui circular pedestrian bridge, arriving at Super Brand Mall right at 9:02.
location: From Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, via Metro Line 2.

name: Store tidying and new arrivals in the blind box area
description: After arriving at the 'Xiafeiji' store at A-208, 2nd floor, Super Brand Mall, Lei Mingxuan turned on the air conditioning and the lights and cleared away the leftover materials from the previous night. Then he took out blind boxes of popular IPs such as Pop Mart and Spy × Family from the cartons, carefully placed them in the newly installed acrylic display boxes, repeatedly adjusted the angles and lighting to ensure an attractive display, and took several 'final look' photos for later promotion. At exactly 10:00, his colleague Qian Duoduo posted the highlights video of yesterday's event online. Amid the busy morning, Lei Mingxuan quickly liked it on his phone, commented 'The ambiance team is ready!', and forwarded it to his Moments, bringing initial buzz to the store.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online promotion and event warm-up
description: As the video gained popularity, direct messages with inquiries kept increasing. Lei Mingxuan focused on replying to online questions, and posted a final photo of the blind box area with the caption "Blind box area officially open today! Draw a blind box for orders over 299!" on Xiaohongshu and other social platforms to drive more traffic. Then he began setting up the KT boards for the afternoon's "Limited-Time Style Challenge" event, and used blind boxes to build a layered display tower in the prize area to create an event atmosphere.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Business lunch and rest.
description: At noon, as foot traffic in the store decreased, Lei Mingxuan went to Songhelou Suzhou-style Noodles on the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall and ordered a bowl of braised pork noodles. While eating, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu and saw that Qian Duoduo's video metrics kept rising. He also chatted with his friend Zhang Wei in the WeChat group 'Pudong Three Musketeers'. Zhang Wei told him that his wife would come to the store in the afternoon, and Lei Mingxuan responded warmly, saying he would make arrangements.
location: Songhelou Suzhou-style noodle soup, B1 level, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: "Autumn Story" Limited-Time Outfit Challenge Event
description: The event started at 1 p.m. Lei Mingxuan guided customers at the store entrance and explained the rules: use three in-store items to put together an OOTD, take a photo and post it on Xiaohongshu or Moments to draw a blind box. He personally gave styling demonstrations for several young people. Around 2 p.m., Zhang Wei came with his wife. Lei Mingxuan chose a black-and-white contrasting casual couple style for them. The couple was very satisfied, and after posting the photo on Moments, it attracted even more attention. Many new young faces drawn by the blind boxes came into the store, and Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to add them on WeChat and collect outfit feedback. His colleague Qian Duoduo was also there helping record video clips. Throughout the afternoon, the store was lively and the event was a clear success.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Event wrap-up and data review
description: As the event came to an end, Lei Mingxuan began packing up the materials and putting the leftover blind boxes from the raffle back into storage. He then quickly tallied the day's cash register receipts, the number of new WeChat customers (over 30), and online consultation conversions, and recorded it all. The data showed a clear increase in revenue compared to a normal weekend, and the new products and blind boxes had a significant driving effect, which made him feel a solid sense of reassurance.
location: Xiafei Ji Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the shop and heading to a dinner gathering with his basketball buddies.
description: Before closing, Lei Mingxuan sent a WeChat message to his ball-playing friend Xie Fei, saying they would meet at Wood House BBQ on Century Avenue at 7 PM; Xie Fei replied to confirm. He pulled down the roller shutter, checked the power, and left Super Brand Mall. He took a ride-hailing car along Lujiazui Ring Road toward Century Avenue, arriving at Wood House BBQ about 17 minutes later.
location: From Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Muwu BBQ, 1198 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Late-night snack gathering with friends from the sport
description: When Lei Mingxuan arrived at Muwu BBQ, Xie Fei and Han Dong were already seated and had opened beers. After joining them, he ordered ice-cold Tsingtao beer, edamame, and signature dishes such as roast lamb chops, roast oysters, and stir-fried clams. The three chatted freely. Lei Mingxuan talked about the social performance of his pet A Fu at yesterday's tasting event, Xie Fei talked about a snooker match, and Han Dong focused on designer toy selection and profit, showing interest in the store's designer toy section. Eating and chatting, the atmosphere was lively and enjoyable.
location: Muwu BBQ (Century Avenue Branch), No. 1198 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Taking a taxi home and tidying up in the evening
description: After the late-night snack, Lei Mingxuan took a taxi back to Shanggang Community. When he got home, it was already past 10 o'clock, and his parents had gone to bed. He quietly changed shoes, washed up, and took a hot shower to wash away the smell of barbecue and fatigue.
location: From Muwu BBQ, No. 1198 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime review and sound sleep
description: Lying on the bed in the bedroom, Lei Mingxuan opened his phone to check the day's Moments posts and the store's Xiaohongshu feedback. There were many likes and comments, and he felt satisfied. He reviewed in his mind the outfit feedback from several customers and things to follow up on the next day, then put down his phone, turned off the light, and fell asleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, and commute.
description: Woke up naturally at 7:30 in the morning; it was cloudy outside. No strenuous exercise planned on Sunday. After washing up, had breakfast with mother Wang Xiuying, who had bought steaming hot pan-fried buns and soy milk. While eating, thought about today's plans, focusing on the wedding gift for Wang Lei and the details of taking Afu to the store to 'work' in the afternoon. After breakfast, went to the balcony to check on Afu and confirm it was in high spirits. Then changed into a hoodie and work pants, put on a helmet, and rode the electric scooter from Shanggang Community along Pudong Avenue and Century Avenue for about 10 minutes to reach the store in Super Brand Mall.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store work: opening the blind box area and optimizing displays
description: The first thing upon arriving at the store was to set up the blind box area that I hadn't had time to refine last night. I rearranged the popular items delivered yesterday, including the Pop Mart Wedding series and classic Molly, by color and theme in acrylic display cases, and put handwritten labels reading "Trendy Toy Guru's Pick" on them. Then I brought out co-branded hoodies and cargo pants from the warehouse with clerk Xiao Lin, created a "Trendy Toy Streetwear" themed display next to the blind box area, and hung up a striking "National Day Special" poster. I took a panoramic photo and sent it to the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group; Zhang Wei instantly replied, "Full display! Great opening!"
location: A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Finalized the wedding gift plan for Wang Lei through online communication.
description: In the store, Lei Mingxuan opened WeChat. His cousin Shen Jie sent a voice message suggesting giving Wang Lei a set of rare blind boxes from Pop Mart's wedding series, wrapped in the store's exclusive gift box — a heartfelt gesture. The two instantly agreed. Shen Jie checked online which hidden figures were in high demand, while Lei Mingxuan picked the most complete set from the store warehouse and confirmed with photos.
location: A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online communication with suppliers and sample handling
description: He opened the express samples sent by suppliers Zhou Tao and Wu Fang. First, he had a video call with Zhou Tao, touching the new autumn-winter fabrics that had been sent. The texture was great, and he considered using them as the next season's main push. The two discussed fabric costs and minimum order quantity, and agreed that more samples would be sent next week. Then he opened the accessories from Wu Fang. Several functional-style pocket clips and chokers had a particularly strong feel, so he immediately put them on the display rack with the co-branded hoodie, and the effect was excellent.
location: A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In-store operations preparation and new customer reception
description: Near the lunchtime rush, Lei Mingxuan had Xiao Lin place the VIP-member-exclusive discount standing sign at the store entrance. Soon, small groups of young customers were attracted into the store by the opening poster for the blind box area. Lei Mingxuan personally stepped up to introduce the newly arrived blind box series and co-branded outfit styles and answered questions about collecting. A young woman immediately fell for the necklace that had just been put on display and placed an order directly.
location: A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Hosted fellow player Chen Jie and facilitated his purchase
description: Billiards buddy Chen Jie arrived at the store on time. Lei Mingxuan took him straight to the newly decorated 'Trendy Play Outfits' section, introducing the co-branded designs while recommending cargo pants paired with blind box charms. After trying on several pieces, Chen Jie finally picked a co-branded hoodie, a pair of cargo pants, and two sets of blind boxes, spending over 800 yuan and becoming a VIP customer. The interest-based customer acquisition model proved very effective.
location: A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Simple lunch
description: After seeing off Chen Jie, he asked Xiao Lin to watch the store and went to the tea restaurant on B1 of Super Brand Mall to quickly have lunch, ordering a char siu rice set. While eating, he scrolled through his phone and found that the warm-up video for the blind box area released last night had gained more new comments. Several potential local customers from Shanghai were asking about the address and business hours; he replied to them one by one, feeling that the online traffic conversion was also good.
location: Tea restaurant at B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Friend visits and offline promotion
description: At 1 p.m., childhood friend Li Na and college classmate Zhao Min arrived at the store one after another, specifically to see the mystery box area. Lei Mingxuan let them browse freely and gave them the staff price. Zhao Min suggested making the mystery boxes in the form of 'lucky bags' to increase the sense of mystery and attract customers to pick their own. Lei Mingxuan thought it was a good idea and took careful notes. During this time, several customers who had seen the store on Moments also came to check it out, and Li Na took the initiative to help receive them, introducing the clothes and accessories.
location: A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go home to pick up Afu and handle Afu's business promotion.
description: Before the afternoon customer rush, he rode his electric bike home to pick up Afu. Afu was sleeping on the sofa; after putting a yellow bow tie on Afu, the cat obediently followed him out. Back at the store, Afu was placed on the cat tree next to the blind box area and immediately became the center of attention, especially drawing young girls to gather around and take photos. The cross-promotion effect was excellent; many customers bought blind boxes and merchandise while taking photos of Afu. Capitalizing on the buzz, he filmed short videos of best-selling outfits and Afu's ‘patrol’, and posted them to Xiaohongshu and the WeChat regular-customer group with the caption “National Day special: even Afu is watching! Last day for VIP-exclusive discount!” Online orders surged, and several popular styles went out of stock in certain sizes. Li Na and Zhao Min stayed until about 4 p.m. before leaving, and each also took a set of blind boxes.
location: A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wrap-up work and data review
description: As the evening crowd gradually thinned, I began wrapping up. I wrapped the wedding series blind box gift set carefully selected for Wang Lei with the best wrapping paper and ribbon, took a photo, and sent it to Shen Jie for confirmation. Then I exported the day's sales data, focusing on the blind box section and out-of-stock sizes, recorded it in my phone memo, and prepared to contact Zhou Tao tomorrow about restocking.
location: A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-work commute, buying fruit, and family dinner
description: Lei Mingxuan asked Xiao Lin to close up the shop and left early himself. Riding his e-bike along Century Avenue and Pudong South Road, he made a detour to the Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road to buy the fresh strawberries and grapes his mother had been mentioning. Satisfied, he went home and made it just in time for dinner. At the table, he told his father Lei Jianguo and mother Wang Xiuying about the shop's situation that day: the blind box area was especially popular, and A Fu had drawn in a lot of customers, with revenue reaching a recent high. His mother tasted the strawberries he bought and beamed with joy. The family ate and chatted, and all their fatigue melted away.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation and entertainment
description: After dinner, I collapsed on the sofa and opened Bilibili to watch the latest episode of Spy x Family. After finishing, I scrolled through Xiaohongshu and checked the comments on the video I posted during the day. I found that discussions about Ah Fu and blind boxes were very popular, and several outfit-and-color-matching posts got especially many likes. I took screenshots to save for later feature content. Then I surfaced in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat, told Zhang Wei and Li Na that business was good today, and asked if they wanted to meet up tomorrow. Zhang Wei suggested having a late-night snack, and Li Na said she was available anytime.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and daily review
description: At 21:00 I started washing up. After my shower, I weighed 80.1 kg, 0.1 kg less than yesterday. Although I didn't run, I kept my diet under control. I plan to resume my morning run tomorrow, Monday. After lying in bed, I went over tomorrow's to-do list in my head: contact Zhou Tao about restocking, send Wang Lei's wedding gift box, and study the 'lucky bag' proposal put forward by Li Na and Zhao Min.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest.
description: I set the alarm for 23:30 and opened the sleep app on my phone. Mentally planning tomorrow's schedule, feeling a sense of accomplishment, growing drowsy, I drifted into sleep.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and mobile socializing
description: At 7:00 in the morning, he was woken by his phone alarm. After stretching in bed, he checked WeChat and saw that his friend Zhang Wei had posted in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group in the early hours, sharing the mooncake gift box from his company and complaining it was 'sickly sweet'. He smiled and replied. Then he got out of bed, walked to the window, admired the osmanthus trees in the neighborhood, breathed in the sweet morning air, and started a new day.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and holiday greetings
description: After washing up, I put on loungewear and went to the kitchen, where my mother Wang Xiuying was busy preparing braised pork for dinner, with the aroma of meat filling the air. I complimented my mother's cooking, and she urged me to ladle out some porridge and eat fresh pork mooncakes. I served myself some plain porridge and ate two mooncakes with pickled radish peels, confirmed with my mother what dishes I wanted for dinner, and told her I would come back in the afternoon to help.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Riding the e-bike to the shop
description: He shouldered his commuter bag, took the shop keys and phone, went downstairs to the bicycle shed in the residential compound, and wheeled out his electric bike. He rode west along Pudong Avenue, crossed Dongfang Road, and waited at a red light at the Lujiazui Ring Road intersection. In the early morning, traffic in Pudong was light, and a gentle breeze brushed his face. About 12 minutes later, he arrived at the back entrance of Super Brand Mall, parked the e-bike in the non-motorized vehicle parking area, and went upstairs through the staff entrance.
location: Along the route from Pudong Avenue in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Wrap-up of the store tasting event and customer follow-up
description: Arrived at the shop early and unlocked the door with the key; the interior still retained the layout from yesterday's 'Autumn Story' tasting event. After staff member Xiao Lin arrived at 8 o'clock, the two divided the work: I dismantled the background KT boards while Xiao Lin sorted and stored the floral decorations by category, and within half an hour the shop was restored to its usual display. Then I opened the shop's work phone, logged into WeChat, and, referring to the event sign-in list, sent each guest a personalized thank-you message and an exclusive electronic discount coupon one by one, along with a feedback survey link. After that, I entered the information of the 37 new customers into the CRM system and tagged them as 'Tasting Event - Autumn Story'.
location: Lei Chao Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Daily store operations and inventory count
description: After finishing the wrap-up of the tasting event, started handling daily operations. Used a tablet to check the inventory management system and took stock of the blind box area, found that the 'Molly's Day' series and the latest 'SKULLPANDA' styles were missing sizes, and made a note to restock after the holiday. Then organized the change at the cash register and reconciled accounts with store clerk Xiao Lin. Xiao Lin went to the warehouse to pack the remaining 6 online order parcels from the previous day, and contacted the courier to arrange a pickup.
location: Lei Chao Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Went to IFC to eat
description: Feeling hungry, he told the shop assistant to watch the store, then rode his e-bike along Lujiazui Ring Road to Century Avenue, turned right to reach IFC, parked in the ground-level non-motor vehicle parking area, entered through the side door of the mall, and headed straight to the food court on basement level 2.
location: From Lujiazui Ring Road to IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Enjoyed Japanese ramen as a treat.
description: Entering the ramen shop, the rich aroma of pork bone broth hit my nose. I ordered a special Akamaru ramen with a soft-boiled egg and Japanese pan-fried dumplings. While waiting, I checked the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat. Li Na had posted a photo of herself eating a sandwich while working overtime, captioned 'The sorrow of an office drone,' and Zhang Wei replied with a crying-with-laughter emoji. I replied that I would have my mother's braised pork for dinner and posted a tempting preview. When the ramen arrived, I took a sip of the soup first; the thick bone broth coated my tongue, and the whole bowl wiped away the morning's fatigue.
location: Ramen restaurant at LG2, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returned to the store for the pre-holiday wrap-up and closed up.
description: After finishing the noodles, he cycled back along the same route to the Super Brand Mall store. After checking the doors, windows, and power, he did the post-holiday handover with shop assistant Xiao Lin: the new online orders from the afternoon would be shipped together tomorrow, October 7, and the shipping labels had been filled out in advance and placed in the drawer. He told Xiao Lin to call if anything unexpected came up. At 12:45 he pulled down the rolling shutter door exactly on time, locked it with a U-lock, exchanged Mid-Autumn Festival greetings with the owner of the next-door milk tea shop, and closed early.
location: Lei Chao Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buy vegetables on the way home.
description: He rode the e-bike with a light heart. Passing by the Dongchang Road food market, he stopped. Remembering that his mother had mentioned in the morning that she wanted to stir-fry spinach in the evening, he went into the market and bought a bundle of fresh short-stemmed spinach and a bunch of spring onions. The vegetable vendor also gave him two sprigs of cilantro, and it cost less than 8 yuan. After buying the vegetables, he got back on the bike and turned into Shanggang Community two minutes later.
location: From Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Afternoon family gathering, rest, and table setting
description: After arriving home, he changed into slippers and handed the groceries to his mother. Back in his room, he changed into a loose T-shirt and shorts, then went to the living room to greet his father, who was watching the noon news, and chatted about the highway congestion news. He then returned to his room, turned on the air conditioner, half-reclined on the sofa, and scrolled through video sites watching fashion outfit videos and anime clips. Growing drowsy, he dozed off for half an hour. When he woke up and went to the living room, his father had turned off the TV and was drinking tea while reading the news. He poured himself a glass of water, sat down next to his father, and talked about the results of the store's tasting event and the operation of the blind box area. His father asked about changes in mall rent. Later, he suggested setting the table, took out a light blue cotton-linen tablecloth his mother had collected from the cabinet, laid it out, brought out the blue-and-white porcelain bowls and dishes used for holidays, and bamboo chopsticks, and arranged them according to the number of people.
location: No. 2-51, Shanggang Xiaoqu, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mid-Autumn Festival reunion dinner
description: At dusk, my mother served up her signature dishes: glossy red Shanghainese braised pork belly, rich but not greasy; steamed hairy crabs full of roe; stir-fried spinach; and tomato and egg soup. At the corner of the table there were also pork mooncakes and water caltrops cooked in syrup. My father opened a bottle of five-year-aged yellow wine, and the three of us sat around the table. He talked about how he and his fellow workers used to admire the moon by the seaside when he was young, while my mother asked whether I was having breakfast on time. I picked the best piece of belly pork for each of my parents. The atmosphere was heartwarming.
location: Restaurant, 2-51 Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Kitchen cleanup after dinner
description: After dinner, he proactively washed the dishes, squeezing dish soap to clean the plates and bowls, rinsing and draining them, and wiping down the stove and dining table. He put the leftover braised pork and mooncakes into fresh-keeping boxes and placed them in the refrigerator. When his mother tried to help, he persuaded her to go to the living room and watch a TV opera program with his father.
location: Kitchen and dining room, No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Video call with cousin Yang Fan.
description: I went to the balcony and saw the full moon already hanging above the Oriental Pearl Tower. I made a WeChat video call to my cousin Yang Fan in Hangzhou. After he answered, Yang Fan was gathering with friends on a terrace by West Lake, with Leifeng Pagoda visible in the moonlight in the background. The two of them exchanged Mid-Autumn Festival greetings. Yang Fan showed off the crab roe xiaolongbao and osmanthus wine on the table, while I turned the camera to my own window and the full moon, showing off the braised pork belly. After chatting for about twenty minutes, his friends called him, so we said goodnight and agreed to meet again next time.
location: Balcony No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Enjoying the moon on the family balcony
description: After hanging up the video call, he called his parents to the balcony to admire the moon. His mother brought out the remaining water caltrops and egg-yolk lotus seed paste mooncakes, and his father brewed a fresh pot of Longjing tea. He sat in the rattan chair, took a bite of the mooncake with its fine lotus seed paste and oozing egg yolk, and looked up at the moon, its clear light spreading everywhere. His father sipped tea and recounted how he had spent Mid-Autumn Festival at the machinery factory when he was young, drinking beer with coworkers on the rooftop of the production building. His mother and he listened with great interest. The scent of osmanthus drifted through the neighborhood, autumn insects chirped, and they spent a pleasant time.
location: Balcony No. 2-51, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store event review and group chat sharing.
description: After moon viewing, his parents went back to their room to rest. Back in his own room, he opened the store's sales dashboard on his phone and reviewed the data from the "Autumn Story" tasting event: total revenue was 15% higher than a normal week, 37 high-quality customers were added, and average order value grew 22% year-on-year. He felt confident about the store's future. Then he opened the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group and saw Zhang Wei and Li Na sharing photos of the moon from their homes. He uploaded photos of the moonlight on his balcony and of the ramen shop, and sent a message: "Today's standard of living is maxed out." The group was full of lively interaction.
location: Bedroom, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening personal leisure time.
description: Putting down his phone, he went to the bathroom to take a hot shower, then changed into clean boxer briefs and an old T-shirt as pajamas. Lying in bed, he opened a music app to play soothing light music, picked up the second volume of A Song of Ice and Fire from the bedside, and read two chapters about Jon Snow at Castle Black. Around 10 p.m., he opened a video site to watch the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, and was moved by its delicate emotions and beautiful art, feeling relaxed.
location: Bedroom and bathroom, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: I turned off my phone, stepped on the scale, and it showed 80.3 kg, 0.2 kg lighter than yesterday. I was in a good mood. I opened the calendar to confirm that the store would be open as usual tomorrow, October 7, and set my phone alarm to 07:15. At 22:45, I turned off the bedside lamp, pulled up the covers, and, feeling fulfilled and happy, soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning structured workout
description: As soon as the alarm went off, I got up promptly. First I laid out the yoga mat in the living room and used the new dumbbells to do bent-over rows, dumbbell presses, and leg raises, four sets of each exercise, with one-minute rests between sets, strictly controlling my breathing and form. After the strength training, I picked up a jump rope and jumped for 15 minutes on the balcony; the smart band recorded my heart rate staying between 140 and 160 beats per minute. Finally I did a full-body stretching routine to cool down and felt thoroughly invigorated. I stepped on the scale and confirmed my weight was still 80.3 kg, then took a satisfying post-workout selfie and sent it to the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Nutritious breakfast and review.
description: After showering, I felt full of energy. Mom had already prepared breakfast: a glass of hot milk, two boiled eggs, two slices of whole-wheat bread, and a small bowl of blueberries. While eating, I opened the memo on my phone and reviewed the details of yesterday's Mid-Autumn family gathering and the successful tasting event, focusing on the entire conversion path of Chen Jie from a playing partner to a VIP customer, to prepare for the next round of thinking.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Draft a multi-channel social media operation plan
description: After breakfast, brewed a cup of Japanese dark-roast coffee. Opened the laptop at the desk and created a new document titled “Social + Private Traffic Conversion Plan.” Carefully reviewed the entire process from meeting Chen Jie at the billiards tournament to closing the deal, and distilled two core insights: “Build trust > direct selling” and “Circle attributes > broad traffic.” Then, drawing on my activity in the billiards, roller skating, and basketball circles, wrote the first draft of a multi-channel social operations plan, intending to manage friends from different circles by tier and maintain relationships through content and events. In the middle of this, Wu Fang sent a WeChat message, and I briefly replied, “Haha, not bad, talk later.”
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting ready to go out and commuting to the store
description: Packed up the schoolbag, brought the laptop, accounting book, and water bottle, and synced the draft operations plan to the phone's memo app for easy additions anytime. Then got on the e-bike and rode along Pudong Avenue-Zhangyang Road. The morning breeze felt pleasant. Passing Yanqin Grocery Store, I greeted Aunt Zhu Xiuying. Arrived at Super Brand Mall 15 minutes later and parked the bike in the mall's non-motor vehicle parking area.
location: Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Store inventory check and restocking order
description: After arriving at the store, he first greeted Xiao Lin, the staff member who had been on duty yesterday, and briefly asked about the morning foot traffic. Then he did it himself: with the inventory sheet, he carefully checked the missing sizes for Molly’s Day and SKULLPANDA after the showcase event and took clear photos of the styles with missing sizes. Next, he contacted supplier Zhou Tao via WeChat voice, saying that for the fall/winter jackets in the photos, he wanted 20 more pieces each in sizes M and L, with the other sizes adjusted accordingly; Zhou Tao quickly replied to confirm. He then sent the accessories restocking list to Wu Fang, who instantly replied, “Got it, I’ll arrange it this week.” For both orders, he asked the other party to provide electronic statements to make bookkeeping easier.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday walk and a short rest.
description: After placing the restock order, I strolled around the mall. While walking off the meal, I observed other stores' displays and customer flow, thinking about what could be improved in my own store. I sat for a while in the ground-floor atrium rest area, casually scrolled through RED and WeChat Moments, and liked a few interesting posts.
location: Inside the Super Brand Mall at No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and online replies.
description: He walked from Super Brand Mall to IFC and headed straight to Ippudo on B1. The waiter Lao Zhou recognized him and said with a grin, "Brother Lei, it's the last day of the holiday!" He ordered a spicy pork miso ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While waiting for the food and eating the noodles, he took out his phone and replied to a few messages from online customers, recommended pants suited to an old customer's body type, and quickly made a sale. Before leaving, he noted tomorrow's financial reconciliation tasks in his phone memo.
location: Ippudo, B1, ICC Mall, 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organize salon notes and browse group messages
description: After eating the noodles, he found a quiet corner in Starbucks and sat down. He opened his laptop, reorganized the operations plan he had written that morning, and, drawing on what he had learned at the earlier salon, added some thoughts on 'how to provide differentiated guidance across different interest circles.' Then he quickly skimmed the announcements of the historical fiction group that Qian Duoduo had recommended and the highlighted discussion archives from the past week, discovering that last week they had focused on 'how to balance historical research with narrative pacing.' That topic happened to address a sticking point in his writing, and he felt it was very rewarding.
location: Starbucks rest area inside IFC Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Attended a fashion art salon
description: Arrived at the salon venue on foot 15 minutes early. The event officially started at 2 p.m.; it was an appreciation session on "cross-disciplinary collaboration between seasonal fabric trends and artistic illustration." Throughout the session, he listened attentively and took notes on his phone's memo app, recording several very practical fabric and color palette options. During the break, he ran into an old customer, Qian Duoduo. She was wearing a sharply tailored structured suit and praised how well the event was organized. The two chatted for a while. She saw the novel excerpt in his memos and was very interested. Upon learning that he was writing a Republican-era alternate-history novel, she immediately and enthusiastically recommended a WeChat group for alternate-history fiction enthusiasts. He scanned the QR code on the spot and submitted the application, and the review was approved 5 minutes later. He immediately posted a self-introduction in the group: "Hello everyone, I'm Lei Mingxuan from Shanghai. I enjoy writing alternate-history stories set in the Republican era. Please feel free to advise me." Several group members immediately replied with welcomes, and he also browsed the group announcement to understand the discussion rules.
location: A cultural salon venue near the Standard Chartered Bank Building, No. 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Post-salon stroll
description: After the salon ended, he didn't leave immediately. He strolled along the small street, taking in the tranquil atmosphere of the holiday afternoon. His mind was still replaying the design trends he had just heard, and he added a few useful points to his to-do list. This solitary stroll felt relaxing and inspiring.
location: The neighborhood near the salon venue on Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Supplementary store work and personal time
description: He walked back to the store, changed into a hoodie, and organized the new fabric trends and styling inspiration he had noted at today's salon into the store's material library and product tags, preparing for future recommendations. Then he sat at the cash register counter and used his phone to jot down a few flashes of inspiration for the novel's plot, inspired by the walk and the group discussion.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting ready for the appointment and commuting to the billiards hall
description: After packing up my things and closing the shop, I rode my e-bike to World Plaza on Pudong South Road. On the way, I contacted my billiards buddy Han Dong and confirmed we'd meet at the usual place at 7 p.m.; he quickly replied with a 'got it'. I also bought a bottle of water at a roadside convenience store.
location: No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to No. 855 South Pudong Road

name: Playing American 8-ball with Han Dong
description: Han Dong arrived before me. The two opened a table and played American eight-ball for nearly two and a half hours. Han Dong was in hot form today; he ran the table in the first rack, putting Lei Mingxuan under a lot of pressure. They chatted while playing. Han Dong said the tasting event went well, and he saw from Chen Jie's Moments that the clothing and designer toys were all well received. Lei Mingxuan invited him to drop by next time and offered him a rock-bottom price; Han Dong smiled and agreed. During a water break, his phone buzzed — a message from Wu Fang saying the National Day numbers were good, the wholesale price of popular models could drop a few points further, and the payment terms could be up to 60 days, asking if he was interested in discussing it. Lei Mingxuan's eyes lit up. He wiped off some sweat and typed back: "Sister Fang, this is so generous! I've made a note. I'll talk through the details with you tomorrow!" Han Dong leaned over, glanced at it, and joked that business was booming. Lei Mingxuan replied that they should help each other succeed, and he'd treat him to a meal at the end of the month.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycle home and buy fruit.
description: After saying goodbye to Han Dong, he rode his e-bike home. A gentle breeze brushed his face, and he felt happy. Passing the fruit stall at the entrance of the residential complex, he bought some winter dates and kiwifruit, planning to give them to his parents as fruit for tomorrow's breakfast.
location: From 855 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Washing up and family time
description: After arriving home and taking a shower, he felt refreshed. His mother was still watching TV in the living room. He put the washed fruit on the table and casually shared with her what he had seen and heard at today's salon and the purchasing discount Wu Fang offered. His father was reading the newspaper in the study, so he went in and said hello to him too.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organized to-dos and winded down at night.
description: Back in the study, I turned on my computer, opened my notebook, and wrote down several core ideas from today's salon notes about the 'social media operation plan' on my to-do list, and clarified the priorities for tomorrow: reconciling accounts with Zhou Tao, discussing payment terms with Wu Fang, and having Xiao Lin organize the blind box area. After finishing all the chores, I lay in bed, opened my phone and scrolled through the new messages in the historical novel group. Seeing them discussing tram routes during the Republic of China era immediately sparked the urge to write some new material, so I quickly jotted down an interesting passage in my notes. Finally, I opened Bilibili and quickly watched two episodes of a funny new anime I've been following, completely relaxing.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Getting ready for bed
description: Set tomorrow's alarm (8:00, because the holiday is over and I need to go to the store to handle daily work), and turned off the bedroom light. My mind was still savoring the fulfilling day: fitness, business, socializing, Lifestyle — not one missing. A perfect wrap-up!
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run and HIIT training in the underground garage
description: After waking at 06:45, because of rain he switched to running 3 kilometers in the underground garage of Shanggang Community, at a pace of about 5 minutes 40 seconds per kilometer, plus 10 minutes of HIIT and stretching, maintaining his exercise routine.
location: Underground garage, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Shower and family breakfast
description: After exercising, he went home and took a hot shower. His mother had prepared small wontons with shepherd's purse and fresh pork, soft-boiled fried eggs, and freshly ground soy milk. He chatted with his mother while eating, then changed into a work shirt and black pants, ready to go out.
location: Home, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Cycle commute to the store
description: Put on a windproof and waterproof jacket, rode an electric bike from home along Pudong Avenue, turned onto Lujiazui West Road, and rode about 15 minutes in light rain to Super Brand Mall, entering the store through the staff entrance.
location: China, Shanghai, Pudong New Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area

name: Store opening preparation and morning tasks
description: After arriving at the store, turned on the lights, started the cash register system, cleaned up, flipped through the inspiration notebook from the alternate-history fiction group, replied to VIP customer inquiries and logistics updates, and posted business updates in the community. At 9 o'clock, clerk Xiao Lin arrived, and I arranged for her to tidy the fitting rooms and shelves.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Online business negotiation and contract signing with suppliers
description: In the rest area of the back storage room, he made pour-over coffee. First, he finalized the supply terms for the Southeast Asian brand with Lao Zhou (Zhou Zhiqiang) over the phone, including supply price, a 45-day trial sales period, and return/exchange policy for non-human damage, and also raised requirements on the delivery date for linen shirts before signing the electronic agreement and paying the deposit. Next, he had a video negotiation with Wu Fang about price reduction and payment terms for blind boxes. After several rounds of negotiation, he finally got an additional 2% discount on two models, Molly's Day and SKULLPANDA Night City, with an initial order of 100 units, and payment terms set at 35 days. He signed the agreement and placed an additional order for 200 blind boxes.
location: Rest area in the back storage room of Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Mountain-style techwear research and autumn selection and order cuts
description: Using a fashion news app and the electronic catalog sent by supplier Zhou Tao, he researched windproof fabrics and seam-sealing techniques for the October 10 mountain-style techwear feature, and referred to blogger recommendations to lock in a gray-green 3-in-1 shell jacket and two cargo pants as the main promotions. Then he took out the list of 30 sample garments for October's new arrivals, applied the "buy only what's necessary" principle, and cut the trendy hoodies with thin fabric and structured jeans with exaggerated cuts to reduce inventory costs.
location: Office area of Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and a walk around the mall.
description: After the rain stopped, he went downstairs to Xinwang Restaurant on B1 of Super Brand Mall, ordered curry beef brisket rice and iced lemon tea, and replied to a VIP customer's inquiry about the Autumn Story event during the meal. After eating, he walked around the mall atrium to aid digestion, observing other stores' displays for inspiration.
location: Xin Wang Café, B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Receiving and inspecting trial-sale styles and setting up the autumn new-arrival display.
description: SF Express delivered 3 boxes with a total of 50 Southeast Asia trial-sale items. After opening the boxes and counting them at the store entrance, he moved them to the back warehouse and checked each piece for fabric, stitching, etc. One shirt had a stitching problem at the armpit, so he photographed it and requested a replacement. Then, he mixed and matched the intact items with the store’s existing products under the theme “Southeast Asia Hidden Realm Exploration”, set up a separate display rack in the prime spot near the entrance, hung up outfit combinations, and printed trial-sale labels. Finally, he scanned and entered all 50 items into the SKU system to keep inventory in sync.
location: Store A-208 and back stockroom, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Receive regular customers and close the store to go home
description: Regular customer Qian Duoduo came into the store, attracted by the embroidered jacket. Lei Mingxuan enthusiastically introduced it and paired it with a techwear vest, ultimately completing a sale of nearly 2000 yuan. Afterward, he fine-tuned the display based on the styling effect, putting the featured hardshell jacket in a more prominent position. Because foot traffic had decreased, he closed early, turned off the lights, tidied the fitting room, and rode his electric bike home. On the way, he made a detour to Yanqin Grocery Store on Zhangyang Road to buy Nanhui honey peaches and osmanthus cake to take home.
location: Store A-208, 2nd floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, passing Yanqin Grocery Store at No. 255 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, and returning to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area

name: Family dinner time
description: After arriving home, his mother was cooking. Lei Mingxuan put the fruit and pastries on the table and chatted with his father. He helped set the table and shared the day's work achievements: completing the contract signing, receiving new goods, and making a sale. Dinner included steamed sea bass, garlic water spinach, and tomato and egg soup. The family of three ate and chatted, and the atmosphere was warm.
location: Home, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Evening review, planning, and leisure
