description: After returning to the bedroom, I entered the day's signed contract amounts in Excel, updated inventory costs, and created a new Word document listing the next day's to-dos: confirm the production schedule and fabric swatch cards for the featured mountain-inspired functional wear styles, arrange the weekend blind box area layout, and join the novel group discussion to find activity inspiration. Afterwards, I watched Cross-Strait with my father in the living room, went back to my room to binge-watch Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, and shared photos of the newly arrived trial-sale styles in the friends group, interacting with my friends Zhang Wei and Li Na.
location: Bedroom and living room at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up, weighing in, and going to bed
description: After stretching, he weighed 80.3 kg, 1.3 kg away from his goal, and reminded himself to watch his diet. He took a shower and changed into pajamas, scrolled through WeChat and current events before bed, didn't set an alarm, turned off the lights around 23:00, and rested up for the next day.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Morning structured workout
description: After getting up at 6 a.m., I spread out a yoga mat in the living room and did circuit training: squat jumps, push-ups, burpees, and dumbbell rows, 3 sets each, with 45 seconds of rest between sets, then jumped rope for 12 minutes, with heart rate reaching 160. After stretching, I weighed myself at 80.5 kg. I was slightly worried about the effect of the braised pork my parents made last night, but I was full of determination.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Breakfast and getting ready to go out.
description: After working out, he showered. His mother had prepared shepherd's purse and fresh pork wontons and soft-yolk fried eggs, with hot soy milk. While eating, he chatted with his parents about the day's promotion plan for the Southeast Asia test-sale items in the store, and said he would come home for dinner in the evening. After the meal, he changed into cargo pants and a T-shirt, put on a baseball cap, and checked his backpack: phone, power bank, keys, tape measure, and printed styling photos of the test-sale items prepared for potential wholesale client Jake.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rode an electric bike to the store for the commute.
description: Riding an electric bike from Shanggang Community, I went west along Pudong Avenue, turned onto Lujiazui Ring Road, and reached Super Brand Mall in about 15 minutes. I parked in the usual spot in the underground garage.
location: On the way from Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store work and preparation
description: After arriving at the store, he turned on the lights, cleaned the floor, and cleared the cash register records. He called supplier Lao Zhou to confirm that the next day's 'mountain-style techwear' featured products would be sent via SF Express in the afternoon and arrive tomorrow morning. Then shop assistant Xiao Lin arrived, and he held a brief meeting to arrange today's focus on recommending the Southeast Asian trial-sale items, also reminding that Qian Duoduo might visit on the weekend. Afterwards, he personally checked the trial-sale display racks and organized the selling points of each item. During this time, he replied to Gao Yuan's question about the book "The Municipal Council and the Silk Factory" in the alternate history fiction group, and took detail photos of the trial-sale items to share in the group.
location: Inside Lei Mingxuan's Clothing Store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning business operations and customer interactions
description: The mall was getting busier, and the newly arrived trial-sale styles attracted quite a few young customers. I personally served more than ten customers, using insights from their outfits to introduce the Southeast Asian designers' backgrounds and tie-dye craftsmanship, successfully guiding try-ons and purchases. A total of 7 trial-sale items were sold in the morning, validating the selection strategy.
location: Inside Lei Mingxuan's Clothing Store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break
description: I had the clerk watch the store while I went to the B1 level, ordered curry beef brisket rice and iced lemon tea at Xinwang Tea Restaurant. While waiting for the food, I sent a WeChat message to Jake, a potential wholesale client, inviting him to check out the new arrivals. He replied that he would come to the store at 2 p.m.
location: Xinwang Tea Restaurant, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon business and wholesale intention discussion
description: At 2 PM, Jake arrived at the shop. Lei Mingxuan showed him the best-selling items, actual photos of the supplier's factory, and quality inspection reports, and discussed fabric, minimum order quantity, and delivery time in detail. He offered a flexible minimum order plan of 300 pieces, and Jake said he would check his channels and reply on Monday. Meanwhile, he continued serving occasional customers.
location: Inside Lei Mingxuan's Clothing Store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Customer record organization and weekend blind box area planning
description: After seeing Jake off, he entered his intentions and contact information into the CRM system. Then he checked the original blind box area with the staff, and based on the new product list and promotion plan sent by Wu Fang, instructed Xiao Lin to complete the removal and rearrangement tomorrow, and emphasized the key points for putting up POP posters.
location: Inside Lei Mingxuan's Clothing Store, Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing up the store and buying groceries on the way home.
description: Starting at 17:00, checked the sales data, organized customer WeChat notes, and prepared the daily sales report. After confirming the petty cash and business takings were correct, locked the cash drawer, turned off some of the lights, and pulled down the rolling shutter door. At 17:30 I biked home. Passing Yanqin Grocery Store near Pudong Avenue, I bought fresh lychees and osmanthus cake as evening snacks for my parents, then returned to Shanggang Neighborhood.
location: On the way from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, passing Yanqin Grocery Store

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: When I got home, my mother had already finished cooking. At the dinner table, I shared the great sales results from today's Southeast Asia trial sales and the progress with wholesale client Jake. My father reminded me to keep steady in business, and my mother kept serving me food while urging me to take care of my health.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Spending time with family and resting
description: After dinner, he watched the news with his father and, at the same time, sent today's store photos to the Pudong Three Musketeers group on his phone. Li Na said she would come to support on the weekend, and there was a brief interaction in the group.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Novel writing and reference research
description: In the study, he opened his laptop, checked the growth data for yesterday's chapter, then continued writing about 2,000 words of “The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane”, depicting the scene of the protagonist discovering a Republican-era diary in a lane bookstore, incorporating the old-city descriptions from “Shanghai Modern”. After uploading the chapter, he sent a message to Gao Yuan to exchange reading impressions, and browsed “The Municipal Council and the Silk Factory” to accumulate creative material.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up, weighing in, and going to bed
description: At 22:00 I finished writing. After showering and washing up, I weighed 80.4 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than in the morning, and was satisfied with the day's exercise and diet control. After lying down, I quickly reviewed the day's affairs: the promotion of trial-sale items went smoothly, wholesale customers made progress, and the novel was updated as usual. I was looking forward to the launch of tomorrow's mountain-style functional wear feature, and turned off the lights and fell asleep around 23:00.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: 4 km morning run
description: The alarm went off, and it was already a sunny day outside the window. Putting on running shoes and quick-dry clothes, he walked from home to Lujiazui Central Green Park. Today his pace stayed steady at 6:10 per kilometer, and he finished a 4-kilometer run in about 24 minutes. After the run, he did several sets of pull-ups and stretches on the pull-up bar in the park's fitness area to fully warm up his body.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and changing clothes
description: After arriving home and taking a shower, he felt refreshed. His mother had already cooked fragrant small wontons; the soup base had seaweed and dried shrimp, and there was a soft-boiled poached egg. While eating, he casually mentioned to her that the new collection had gone on sale today. She told him not to work too hard. After eating, he changed into a carefully styled mountain-tech sample outfit, which served as both work clothes and a walking advertisement.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the store by electric bike
description: Hopping on his beloved e-scooter, he rode south along Pudong Avenue, then turned onto Lujiazui Ring Road. The morning breeze brushed his face and the battery was full. He reached the employee parking area of Super Brand Mall at 7:50, locked the scooter, and entered the mall through the side door. Because he arrived early, the mall was very quiet.
location: Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: New arrivals display and window arrangement
description: After arriving at the store, he first turned on the audio system and played an upbeat electronic track. He unpacked all sixteen boxes of mountain-style functional clothing that had arrived yesterday and steam-ironed each piece one by one with a garment steamer. As planned, he hung the flagship three-in-one gray-green hardshell jacket on the mannequin at the entrance C-position, pairing it with a tactical vest and cargo pants; beside it, the display table used a "pocket system" theme, with multi-pocket cargo pants and functional vests folded to highlight the details. He rearranged the window display, using waterproof fabric and climbing rope as the backdrop to create an urban-outdoor feel. Finally, he used a label printer to print and replace all the price tags.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Publish an online preview and invite customers.
description: He wiped his hands, took out his phone, and shot nine photos of the carefully arranged display details. He posted on WeChat Moments: 'This year's mountain-tech functional style is comfy and photogenic. The lightweight shell jacket is finally here, with so many pockets it can hold the whole weekend! Come to the store this weekend for a surprise.' Then he privately messaged regular customer Qian Duoduo on WeChat, sent her the photos, and introduced the highlights and details of the new collection via voice message, inviting her to come try them on when she had time in the afternoon. Just then, shop assistant Xiao Lin also arrived. He briefly instructed Xiao Lin to keep an eye on the store in the afternoon and to prepare the materials for the weekend blind box area and the 'lucky bag' event.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning operations and client reception
description: The mall foot traffic began to pick up. It was a workday, so there weren't many customers, but those who came in knew exactly what they wanted. He mainly patrolled the store and proactively introduced functional fabrics and tailoring to several customers interested in the mountain-style look, successfully closing an order for a hardshell jacket paired with cargo pants. In spare moments, he organized yesterday's sales data on the computer at the register and found that the tech vest had been well received.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch
description: His stomach growled right on time. He locked the store and went downstairs to Xin Wang Tea Restaurant on B1. Instead of his usual curry beef brisket rice, he ordered a fresh tomato pork chop rice with iced lemon tea. While waiting, he scrolled through his phone and mentally planned the afternoon's tasks.
location: Xinwang Tea Restaurant, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday rest and contacting suppliers
description: After eating, returned to the store and grabbed a bottle of oolong tea. Entered the morning's sales data and online consultation records into the store management system. Then called supplier Zhou Tao to confirm the reshipment time for the trial-sale item with split stitching under the armpit. Afterwards, replied to several online customers on WeChat; one of them was very interested in today's featured hiking jacket and agreed to come to the store tomorrow. Then picked up the roller skates and protective gear, checked they were in good condition, and prepared for possible activities in the afternoon.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Received regular customer Qian Duoduo
description: There weren't many customers in the afternoon. At 13:40, Qian Duoduo arrived at the store on time. She was dressed very casually today and immediately took a fancy to the hardshell jacket in the window. Based on her figure, I styled three outfits for her: a hardshell jacket, multi-pocket cargo pants, and a utility vest. After trying them on, she spent a long time taking photos in front of the full-length mirror, and she was satisfied with all of them, especially the gray-green hardshell jacket, saying the color looked high-end. In the end, she decided to buy all three outfits. After checkout, I took some detail shots of her outfits for her to make a product recommendation post on Xiaohongshu. She said she would post it tonight, so I reminded her to tag the store account.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handling store affairs and preparing to go out
description: After Qian Duoduo left, I had Xiao Lin keep an eye on the store. I quickly checked the materials needed for tonight's historical novel discussion group, and backed up the excerpt of 'The Afternoon of Xiafeifang' and a few questions in my phone's memo. Then I swapped in a fully charged battery for the electric scooter and got ready to head to the billiard hall.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Playing billiards with friends
description: Rode his electric scooter to World Plaza; it took 15 minutes. Han Dong was already there, practicing. The two went straight into a game of American eight-ball, chatting while playing. Han Dong was very interested in the new mountain-style collection in the store and asked a lot of questions about fabrics and design, saying he wanted to bring his girlfriend next weekend. His shooting was mediocre today, and he ended up losing 3 games, but he got both exercise and conversation and felt completely relaxed.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returned to the shop to inspect operations and verify the day's accounts.
description: After playing ball, I went straight back to the store. Xiao Lin had already finished rearranging the weekend blind-box area—it looked good—and had also printed new price stickers. I checked it over and adjusted the positions of two building blocks. Then I started organizing the day's business accounts: reconciling Alipay and WeChat payments, counting the cash, and entering the figures into the system. Today's sales were pretty good thanks to Qianduoduo's big order.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-work commute and shopping on the way
description: After closing the store, I rode the e-bike home. Passing Yanqin Grocery Store at No. 55 Dongchang Road, I went in and bought some seasonal crisp persimmons and the seaweed-twisted dough sticks my dad loves, spending 45 yuan. Carrying the shopping bag, I rode home slowly.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store, No. 55 Dongchang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, via Lujiazui West Road to Pudong Avenue.

name: Family dinner
description: Arrived home just in time for dinner. At the table, he shared how the new collection launched today had been received, that Qian Duoduo had tried on and bought three sets, and that Han Dong was also interested in the new arrivals. His parents were happy to hear it; his father said, "Be steady in what you do," and his mother helped him to a few pieces of braised pork.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-meal rest and group chat warm-up
description: After dinner, I helped clear away the dishes. I flopped onto the sofa and scrolled through my phone. I saw that Qian Duoduo had posted a Xiaohongshu note half an hour ago. The photos were really beautiful, and the likes were already starting to increase. I immediately commented to interact. Then I opened the "Shanghai Historical Fiction Fans" group link that Qian Duoduo had shared in the afternoon, checked the group announcement and group files, and lurked for a while to observe the members' style of discussion, warming up for the 8 p.m. discussion.
location: Living room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepare for the online discussion of the historical novel
description: Back in the study, he opened the computer. After taking a sip of water, he looked over the section of 'Afternoon in Xiafei Lane' written yesterday. In his phone memo, he sorted out several questions about the longtang of Republican-era Shanghai and literariness, preparing to raise them during the discussion later.
location: Study room, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Participated in an online discussion among historical fiction fans in Shanghai.
description: The discussion officially began, and tonight’s theme was “Republican-Era Shanghai and Literary Imagination.” Group members shared their views freely; someone shared obscure details from Shanghai Modern, and someone mentioned the changes in the longtang alleys in The Song of Everlasting Sorrow. I read every message carefully and, based on my own novel’s background, raised a question about “how to reproduce the daily street sounds of Shanghai in literary works,” which led to discussion and recommendations from several experienced group members. I jotted down several book titles in my memo, including Beyond the Neon Lights and The Municipal Council and the Silk Factory.
location: Study room, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Meeting new book friends
description: After the discussion ended, the atmosphere was still lively. He took the initiative to add two out-of-town book friends whose remarks had been especially brilliant and insightful: Chen Siyuan, a middle school history teacher from Suzhou, and Liu Ming, an independent writer from Hangzhou. After they accepted the friend request, they briefly exchanged their favorite works set in the Republican era and recommended books to each other. He felt it was very rewarding.
location: Study room, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and weighing in
description: After the social event ended, I was still a bit excited. Went to the bathroom and took a quick shower. After showering, I stepped on the scale; it read 80.3 kg, 0.2 kg lighter than yesterday. It seems the exercise and diet control are starting to show results.
location: Bathroom, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Before-bed review and reading
description: After drying my hair, I lay in bed, opened the notes app on my phone, and looked through the new book friends I'd met today and the book list I'd recorded. Reviewing the day — from morning running, adding new products, receiving regular customers, playing ball, to online discussions — it was very fulfilling. I turned off the overhead light, left a bedside lamp on, and read the e-book of "The Song of Everlasting Sorrow" for a while until drowsiness set in. I set the alarm for 7:00 a.m. the next morning and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run in Lujiazui.
description: On Saturday morning, set off from home and walked to Lujiazui Central Green Park for a 5-kilometer jog at a 6-minute-per-kilometer pace, enjoying the moist air of the morning dew. While running, he browsed messages from friends about evening activities. After the run, he stretched on the wooden boardwalk by the lake while listening to Chen Siyuan's voice message in the historical novel group sharing his reading reflections on "Song of Everlasting Sorrow", and felt his analysis was quite insightful.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast time at home
description: After jogging home, took a shower to wash away sweat. Mother Wang Xiuying had prepared steaming shepherd's purse wontons and soft-yolk fried eggs. While eating breakfast, he chatted with his mother and mentioned that Han Dong was coming to the store today. His mother said with relief that the two brothers should have a good talk.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the store by electric bike
description: Changed into today's featured gray-green techwear workwear jacket, checked my phone and keys, then rode the e-bike west along Pudong Avenue to Super Brand Mall, parked, and went upstairs to my clothing store.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation work for the store.
description: After arriving at the store, he adjusted the lighting to warm tones and played a Jay Chou playlist to create a weekend atmosphere. He held a morning meeting with staff member Lin Xiao, clarifying today's priorities: recommend the newly displayed functional vest and the newly arrived Southeast Asia trial-sale items. He personally styled a printed workwear short with a mountain-style short-sleeve T-shirt and put them on the mannequin at the entrance. He checked the cashier system and replenished inventory of best-selling sizes M and L.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and WeChat Moments promotion
description: As the morning crowd grew, I successfully recommended a mountain-style shell jacket paired with a techwear vest to a young customer, who closed the deal on the spot. During downtime, I took photos of the store's new displays and live photos of the Southeast Asia trial-sale items, and posted them to Moments and the VIP customer group with the caption 'Open all weekend, new hot styles waiting for you to try.' A regular customer, Qian Duoduo, replied saying she would come take a look in the afternoon.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and planning a self-drive trip to Western Sichuan
description: He asked Lin Xiao to mind the store, then walked alone to the Ippudo ramen shop on B1 of the IFC Mall and ordered a bowl of the signature tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg and two portions of minced garlic. While eating, he took out his phone, opened Amap, imported the Western Sichuan guide given by his friend Lao Zhou into Notes, marked key points such as Kangding, Xinduqiao, and Daocheng Yading, calculated daily driving distance and elevation gain, and initially formed a 7-day loop route. He felt very excited.
location: Ippudo Ramen, B1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon rest and preparation to receive Han Dong
description: After returning to the store, there were few customers, so he sat on the sofa in the break area and used his laptop to make simple markers on the 'LiangBuLu' app for the western Sichuan route, and created a supply checklist memo recording cold-weather clothing, altitude sickness medicine, energy supplements, etc. Then he stood up and tidied several techwear items, hanging them in accessible places to prepare for Han Dong's visit.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Welcoming old friend Han Dong
description: When Han Dong pushed the door open and came in, I immediately stood up to greet him, warmly patting his shoulder and making small talk. Han Dong said the store had become trendier and mentioned that Qian Duoduo often talked about it in her Moments. I led him to the beverage bar and hand-brewed a cup of Yirgacheffe for him myself. In the seating area, we first chatted about how his business had been recently. The atmosphere was harmonious.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Resolving past differences and experiencing the techwear style.
description: The previous sense of distance completely dissipated. He took Han Dong to the techwear new-arrivals section and introduced in detail the gray-green 3-in-1 waterproof jacket and the magnetic-clasp multi-pocket cargo pants. After trying them on, Han Dong repeatedly praised his keen eye and said the store had been upgraded to a higher level. The atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. He casually suggested going to World Plaza next week to play a couple of games, and Han Dong readily agreed and offered to treat.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Han Dong's departure and order handling.
description: After seeing Han Dong off, I was in a good mood. Back at the computer, I recorded the gravel road conditions on the western Sichuan route we had discussed into the trip notes. Then I handled several online orders, packed the goods, and handed them to Lin Xiao to arrange shipping.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening business peak
description: The store experienced a small rush. I recommended commuter pants with lightweight hardshell jackets for a couple. Qian Duoduo arrived as promised, tried on two Southeast Asian trial-sale styles, took photos and posted them on Xiaohongshu, and I gave her styling advice. Watching the crowd come and go, I felt quite fulfilled.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing the store and shopping along the way
description: Starting at six, he wrapped up with Lin Xiao: checked the day's sales records and tidied the shelves; overall today's revenue was pretty good. After work he rode his electric scooter and stopped by Yanqin Grocery Store on the way, buying Nanhui crispy persimmons that his parents love and a box of fresh pork mooncakes.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Biking home
description: Rode the e-bike home from the grocery store, arriving at Shanggang Community in about 15 minutes. Parked the bike, then carried the freshly bought fruit and mooncakes upstairs.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family reunion dinner.
description: When I got home, my mother was making braised pork belly and my father was watching Xinwen Lianbao. I washed some fruit and brought it to the table, then told them in detail how Han Dong came to the store on his own initiative and invited me to play ball next week. My mother was very relieved and remarked that brothers shouldn't have overnight grudges. For dinner, we enjoyed Shanghainese-style braised pork belly, stir-fried asparagus, and my mother's pickled sweet garlic, which were especially to my taste.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: A walk around the neighborhood after a meal.
description: After the meal, the family of three went downstairs to walk off the meal in the community's central garden. They talked about Han Dong's matter. His mother casually asked how much he planned to give for the wedding gift for Wang Lei's wedding. He said he planned to give 2000 yuan, and his mother agreed. After a long walk, his watch step count easily exceeded 10,000, completing today's exercise KPI.
location: Shanggang Community Central Garden, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening planning and group chat
description: Back in my room, I turned on my computer and further refined the self-driving route map and supplies list for western Sichuan, adding a “car oxygen concentrator” and a “thermos cup.” Then I checked WeChat and saw a new message from Chen Siyuan in the historical novel group. I joined the discussion for a bit, sharing my thoughts on “1587, A Year of No Significance.” Finally, I opened the notes app on my phone and recorded today's insights from my conversation with Han Dong, plus new ideas for store operations, to build material for future writing.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Personal Free Time
description: Watched two episodes of 'Frieren: Beyond Journey's End' on Bilibili to fully relax, then browsed the Pop Mart mini program to check the new series preview and enjoyed some leisure time.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep preparation and review
description: After washing up, he stepped on the scale and recorded his weight as 80.6 kg, unchanged from yesterday. He quickly reviewed the day: Han Dong's matter had been resolved satisfactorily, the store was doing good business, and the Western Sichuan plan had taken initial shape—efficient and pleasant. He set tomorrow's alarm and turned off the lights at 23:00.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up, morning wake-up, and weighing myself
description: The 7 o'clock alarm rang right on time; he turned it off and stayed in bed for a while longer. He opened the curtains — it was cloudy, and the sunlight was not strong. Stepping on the electronic scale, his weight was 80.5 kg, the same as yesterday, so he was in a good mood. Then he brushed his teeth and washed his face, drank a glass of warm water, and felt fully awake.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and house-cleaning kickoff
description: Mom made small wontons stuffed with shepherd's purse and minced pork, and each person had a fried egg. During breakfast, Dad confirmed the spring-cleaning division of labor again: Lei Mingxuan was in charge of the bedroom and the living room figurine cabinet, Dad would fix the leaking kitchen faucet, and Mom would take care of all the curtains.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Clean personal bedroom
description: Removed the bed sheets and duvet cover, threw them into the washing machine on the balcony, and added fabric softener. Tidied up the desk, wardrobe, and under-bed storage boxes; threw away two T-shirts with stretched collars and a pair of outdated jeans. Wiped the desktop and cabinets clean with a wet cloth. Finally, refolded the hoodies, jeans, and jackets he frequently wore by color category and put them back into the wardrobe.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organize the designer toy display cabinet in the living room.
description: Carefully took out the limited-edition figures, POP MART blind boxes, and finished Gundam models from the glass display cabinet, and dusted them thoroughly with a soft brush and lens cloth. Rearranged them according to the 'cyberpunk' and 'Chinese style' themes, and adjusted the angle of the built-in light strips; the effect was excellent when the lights came on.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Help parents do a thorough cleaning
description: Dad was fixing the faucet in the kitchen; he helped hand over tools and held the pipe steady. He helped Mom take down the heavy curtains and stuffed them into the washing machine. While the washing machine was running, he used a rag to wipe the living room window frames, baseboards, and air-conditioner vents.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Simple lunch and rest.
description: Mom cooked vegetable and egg noodles and added three soft-boiled eggs. The family sat around eating and chatting. Dad said the faucet was fixed, Mom said the curtains were washed very clean, and Lei Mingxuan said the figure display cabinet looked brand new. After the meal, they rested for a while and drank water to replenish their energy.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Final touches on the big cleaning and a refreshed home
description: After the meal, he took the packed old clothes and miscellaneous items to the garbage station at the entrance of the residential compound in two trips. When he came back, Dad had already re-hung the dried curtains, and Mom had mopped the floor until it shone. When he turned on the ambient light in the figurine cabinet, the whole living room looked much brighter, and the whole family felt satisfied looking at the results of their hard work.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Set out for the court and arrange a game online.
description: He changed into athletic shorts, a T-shirt, and basketball shoes, and brought knee pads and a water bottle. He unlocked a shared bike at the neighborhood gate and rode to Yuanshen Sports Center. On the way, he called out in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group to arrange a game, and privately messaged the basketball buddy he had arranged to meet last week to confirm the number of attendees and team division.
location: Cycling from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Yuanshen Sports Center.

name: Community Basketball Fun Game
description: Ride a bicycle for 20 minutes to the outdoor basketball court at Yuanshen Sports Center. Xie Fei and Chen Hao are already there. This is the community's monthly self-organized recreational game, with about ten people coming, split into four-on-four. Lei Mingxuan teams up with his old partners Xie Fei and Chen Hao; the game focuses on running and teamwork, relaxed and fun. He makes a few mid-range shots, breaks a sweat, and relieves the fatigue from the store over the past few days. During a break, he meets a young man who lives nearby, and they add each other on WeChat; the other person says he has visited Lei's store in Super Brand Mall before.
location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Court socializing and stretching to relax
description: After the game, I drank water on the sideline with Xie Fei and Chen Hao, and we agreed to go play billiards at World Plaza in a couple of days. I did simple stretches for the thighs, calves, and Achilles tendons to avoid soreness the next day.
location: Yuanshen Sports Center, 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bought fruit on the way home.
description: He rode a shared bike home and passed Yanqin Grocery Store. Remembering that the crispy persimmons at home were finished, he parked his bike and went in to pick some. He bought a few fresh crispy persimmons and a box of blueberries, and also bought a pack of Old City God Temple rock-sugar preserved bayberries for his mom. It was the weekend and the store was crowded, so he queued to pay.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store, Zhangyang Road near Pudian Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Exercise recovery and relaxation after getting home
description: After returning home, first drank water, then spread out the yoga mat in the living room and used a foam roller to focus on rolling out the front of the thighs and calves, which were used the most during today's basketball game. Then did 15 minutes of yoga stretches, mainly to relax the hips and back, relieving post-exercise fatigue.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Shower and family dinner
description: I took a hot shower and changed into loose loungewear. Dinner was the egg fried rice my mom made, served with seaweed and dried shrimp soup. I washed a plate of the candied bayberries I’d bought as an after-dinner snack, and the family sat together chatting about the funny moments from the afternoon ball game, in a relaxed and pleasant atmosphere.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening leisure: watching anime and planning a western Sichuan road trip
description: In the study, I turned on the tablet, connected it to a Bluetooth speaker, and caught up on episode 28 of this week's update of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, immersing myself in the atmosphere and music of the animation. After watching, I opened a map app and refined the previously saved self-driving route in western Sichuan, focusing on comparing gas stations and altitudes along the way from Kangding to Xinduqiao. I also noted the models of the car oxygen concentrator and thermos cup I liked in my memo, planning to place an order at the store next week.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening washing, weighing, and review
description: Brushed teeth and washed face, did basic skincare. Weighed myself again before bed, 80.4 kg, about the same as in the morning. Today's exercise was enough, and the water weight was flushed out. Quickly reviewed the day: the cleaning was done neatly, the afternoon ball game was enjoyable, and in the evening I caught up on an anime and made travel plans. There is a sense of fulfillment from getting things done one by one.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lights out, bedtime
description: Set the phone to airplane mode and put it on the bedside table. Closed my eyes and thought back to the new layout of the figure cabinet today, feeling very happy. Although my body was a bit tired, I soon fell asleep after relaxing.
location: Room 301, No. 2, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: At 6:30 in the morning, as soon as the alarm went off, Lei Mingxuan got up immediately and first weighed himself. Seeing that his weight of 80.7 kg was the same as yesterday, he felt satisfied. Then he rushed to the bathroom, splashed cold water on his face, and washed up to freshen up. He changed into a loose gray T-shirt and sweatpants to prepare for Monday. At 7:10, his mother Wang Xiuying had already placed small wontons and pan-fried buns on the table. Lei Mingxuan sat down to have breakfast with his parents, telling them while eating that he would go to a play with Shen Jie tonight and would not come home for dinner. His father Lei Jianguo asked with concern about the shop business, and he replied that the trial-sale items were selling well and he was having the supplier restock.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the store
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan quickly grabbed his backpack and power bank, went downstairs, got on his e-bike, and rode along Pudong Avenue toward Lujiazui. The morning traffic was not yet heavy, and a cool breeze brushed his face. More than ten minutes later, he arrived at the back door of Super Brand Mall, locked his bike, and got ready to start the day's work.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store opening preparation and online consultation
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan turned on the lights, started the computer, and logged into the cashier system. Taking advantage of the mall not yet being open, he hurriedly rearranged the unfinished displays from yesterday, especially styling a batch of Southeast Asia trial-sale items as the main promotion to attract customers. Then he opened his phone and replied one by one to more than a dozen customer inquiries on Xiaohongshu and WeChat. For several customers who showed strong interest in the technical vest and trial-sale items, he directly sent size charts and outfit matching photos.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning supplier communication and restocking
description: Lei Mingxuan first called Lao Zhou, a supplier in Hangzhou, and urgently asked for an additional 40 pieces of the Southeast Asia trial-sale items that were selling well. After confirming stock, he hoped they could arrive within the week. Then he opened the after-sales records and sent a voice message to a customer who had exchanged an item, asking whether the new item was satisfactory. Next, he contacted accessories supplier Wu Fang to restock several popular earrings and necklaces and to select new styles. In between tasks, he carefully checked yesterday's Sunday sales revenue from WeChat, Alipay, and cash, making sure the accounts were exactly right.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-noon customer interaction
description: With the store traffic slowing down, Lei Mingxuan scrolled through WeChat Moments and saw a photo from regular customer Qian Duoduo. He tapped a like and commented that the clothes fit her well, then sent her a private message inviting her to check out the new techwear vests at the store. Qian Duoduo replied that she would come if she had time this week.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and midday break
description: Feeling hungry, Lei Mingxuan asked clerk Xiao Lin to mind the store, took the elevator to the B1 level of Super Brand Mall, went to Ippudo, and ordered a bowl of signature pork bone broth ramen with a soft-boiled egg, for a total of 15 yuan. While waiting for the noodles, he scrolled through anime commentary updates on Bilibili. After finishing his meal, he returned to the store, leaned back in a chair, and rested with his eyes closed for twenty minutes. When he woke up, he searched the app for 'Republican-era Shanghai street cries,' noting down vivid phrases and scenes for inspiration for his evening drama and novel writing.
location: Rest area of Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and customer service
description: In the afternoon, foot traffic increased. Lei Mingxuan personally stepped in and styled a young couple with a gray-green outdoor jacket and cargo pants, successfully closing the sale. Meanwhile, he received a message from Shen Jie, arranging to meet at the theater entrance at 7 p.m. He told Shen Jie to wear a qipao, and Shen Jie told him to dress with Republican-era flair.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon tea time and group chat
description: Lei Mingxuan asked Xiao Lin to watch the store while he went to the nearby Luckin Coffee and redeemed points for a coconut latte, bringing it back to the shop to sip slowly. He sent a voice message in the Pudong Three Musketeers WeChat group, telling his brothers Xie Fei and Chen Hao that he would not game with them tonight because he had to accompany Shen Jie to a play. Xie Fei instantly replied asking about their billiards appointment the next afternoon. Lei Mingxuan readily confirmed they would meet at four o'clock at their usual spot in World Plaza.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home, freshen up, and change clothes
description: Considering that going home to change would take time, Lei Mingxuan decided to close the store early and let the shop assistant Xiao Lin handle closing up. He took off his work clothes, checked the phone, power bank, and wallet in his backpack, and rode his electric scooter home. On the way, he sent his mother a voice message saying he would be home to change. After arriving home, he took a quick shower to wash off the sweat, then took out from the wardrobe a vintage Republic-era long gown made of indigo jacquard fabric and a matching gentleman's hat. He dressed carefully in front of the full-length mirror, adjusted the brim of the hat, and took a satisfied selfie to send to Shen Jie, saying: "I'm in position, waiting for your qipao!"
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Took a bus to the theater.
description: Lei Mingxuan put on a bowler hat, slung on a retro canvas bag, and walked to the bus stop at the entrance of Shanggang Residential Community. He took Bus 981 or Tunnel Line 6 to Century Avenue. On the bus, he put on earphones and listened to Zhou Xuan's "Night Shanghai," immersing himself in the Republican-era atmosphere in advance. After getting off, he walked about five minutes to the entrance of Storm Island Immersive Game Theater under Bailian Century Shopping Center.
location: Storm Island Theater, Bailian Century Shopping Center, No. 1217 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Meeting at the theater, taking photos, and early entry.
description: Lei Mingxuan waited under the Republic-era illuminated sign. Shen Jie arrived on time, wearing a modified dark-patterned cheongsam with a knitted cardigan over it. The two took photos of each other and selfies in front of the old movie posters and rickshaw backdrop at the theater entrance. Their Republic-era outfits drew a lot of looks in the mall. Near seven o'clock, they entered early after having their tickets checked. The exquisite Republic-era bank, dance hall, and alleyway sets inside the theater completely immersed them. They even mimicked the street vendors' calls in the alley set, shouting, 'Gardenias, white orchids!' and laughed heartily.
location: Storm Island Theater, Bailian Century Shopping Center, No. 1217 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Immersive Republic of China-era drama experience.
description: The performance started on time, and Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie were completely drawn into this world of dazzling extravagance and hidden undercurrents. As an ESTP, he boldly improvised with the actors during the interactive segment, and his ad-libbed lines kept the surrounding audience laughing; Shen Jie laughed and patted him on the shoulder while she focused on observing every detail of the props and set. Both of them enjoyed it wholeheartedly.
location: Inside the Storm Island Theater, Bailian Century Shopping Center, 1217 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-performance exchange and commemoration
description: During the post-show talk after the performance, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to approach the director to share his love for the lighting and sound effects in the play, and talked about his research on Republican-era street culture and street vendor calls. The director was pleasantly surprised by his observation skills, gave him a signed poster, and welcomed him to come often and share his opinions.
location: Rest area of Storm Island Theater, Bailian Century Shopping Center, 1217 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Recorded inspiration on the way back
description: Lei Mingxuan and Shen Jie took a photo together at the theater entrance and said goodbye. Shen Jie hailed a taxi back to Jing'an, while he took the Tunnel Line 6 bus home. On the bus, he opened the memo app on his phone and quickly jotted down the director's inspiration and the plot and atmosphere descriptions for the novel in his mind, accumulating material for his work 'Afternoon in Xiafei Lane'.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening journal and review.
description: After getting home, Lei Mingxuan quietly opened the door and returned to his room. Seeing that Shen Jie had already posted a nine-grid photo set in the group chat, he selected a few and saved them. Then he took out his diary and wrote in detail about the scenes, dialogue, and his exchange with the director that had moved him in tonight's play, focusing on characterization and background details, providing good material for his novel writing.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Group chat interaction before bed
description: After washing up and lying in bed, Lei Mingxuan saw Xie Fei still asking about tomorrow's billiards game in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat. He sent the photo and confirmed: 'Tomorrow at 4 PM, the usual place at World Plaza, I'll be there on time! Let me show you tonight's look!' The photo sparked a lively discussion in the group, and the three chatted until 11:30 PM before gradually calming down.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going to bed and falling asleep.
description: Lei Mingxuan turned off the light, closed his eyes, and savored the fulfilling day in his mind. Thinking that tomorrow he would need to urge Old Zhou to ship the goods and play billiards with Xie Fei, he suddenly felt life was full of promise, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning structured fitness training (4th session)
description: The alarm went off at 6 a.m., with a light drizzle outside the window. Lei Yu laid out the anti-slip mat in the living room and did his fourth systematic strength training session: assisted pull-ups, 4 sets of 10 reps; dumbbell bench press with 12 kg per side, 4 sets of 12 reps; bicep curls with 8 kg per side, 4 sets of 15 reps, with 1-minute rests between sets. After strength training, he jumped rope for 10 minutes, with his heart rate steady at around 140. Finally, he did a 15-minute full-body stretch, focusing on releasing the front of the thighs and hips, and felt his joints loosen up.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Washing up, breakfast, and getting ready to leave
description: After working out, I took a warm shower to wash away the sweat. My mother Wang Xiuying had already heated up small wontons, with seaweed and egg strips floating in the bowl. After breakfast, Lei Yu changed into a steam-ironed off-white work shirt and black casual pants, checked the iPad and store keys, and took a long-handled umbrella before heading out.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the store at Super Brand Mall
description: Lei Yu walked with an umbrella for about 8 minutes to Pudong Avenue Station on Metro Line 14, rode 4 stops to Lujiazui Station, exited from Exit 2, and walked 3 minutes to Super Brand Mall. Along the way he bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea at a convenience store. The total commute time was about 25 minutes.
location: From Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and Singles' Day warm-up
description: After arriving at the store, he hung the umbrella in the drip-dry area behind the door. First he boiled water and brewed a drip-bag coffee, then opened the iPad Pro and used Procreate to draft a poster for 'Autumn Special Offers', using warm orange and olive green as the theme colors and doing visual design for autumn jackets and hoodies. Then he sent a WeChat voice message to Tao Ge, a supplier in Hangzhou, to confirm the restocking progress of several cargo pants. Next, he went through the sales records of the past week and sent private messages to three regular customers, including Qian Qian and Sister Xiaoyu, asking for their feedback on the mountain-style tech-outerwear jackets they had ordered a few days earlier, with outfit suggestion images attached.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai 'Xiafei Ji'

name: Maintained relationships with regular customers
description: While replying to customer messages, she exported the list of recent customers from Excel and sent each one a caring WeChat message: “Hi dear, it’s gotten colder recently. The XXX you bought last time goes perfectly with a basic top~ Here’s a small discount coupon for you; you can use it when you drop by the store next time!” She also attached a few outfit photos of the new styles. After finishing, she prepared to go to lunch.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai 'Xiafei Ji'

name: Lunch at Isshin Seimen, IFC Center.
description: As the rain gradually weakened, Lei Yu walked about 9 minutes from Super Brand Mall to IFC Mall and arrived at the familiar Ikkou Seimen. He ordered a rich tonkotsu-fish broth ramen, and added a portion of chashu and a soft-boiled egg. The hot soup warmed him up and dispelled the midday chill. After eating, he slowly walked back to the store in the mall, treating it as a stroll to aid digestion.
location: Ikko Seimen, Basement 1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Communicated with Zhao Min by phone about the pop-up exhibition planning
description: Back in the store, he charged his phone first. Then he sat on the sofa in the rest area and had a WeChat voice call with his college classmate Zhao Min. He succinctly proposed the idea of combining the store's hot-selling mountain-style techwear items with an offline pop-up exhibition in the downstairs atrium or a trendy café, and wanted to draw on her experience in curation. Zhao Min said she was very interested and found the direction fresh, and the two agreed to meet offline sometime next week to discuss the plan in detail.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai 'Xiafei Ji'

name: Afternoon store operations and refining the Double 11 plan
description: In a good mood, he started the afternoon's work. Using the store computer, he opened the inventory management system and carefully sorted through all fall/winter inventory, especially the sizes and colors of waterproof jackets and cargo pants. Then he had a final confirmation with supplier Brother Tao on WeChat regarding the styles, quantities, and shipping times of the new batch of orders. After finishing, he opened a WPS document and refined the Double 11 campaign plan for the coming week, covering the specific discount logic and gift list for the pre-sale and peak periods, and came up with several backup plans for unexpected situations.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai 'Xiafei Ji'

name: Closed up shop and cycled home
description: Closed the store right at 5:30 and checked the power supply and doors and windows. Used the mobile app to scan a shared bike at the bike-sharing station near Super Brand Mall, rode about 15 minutes back to Shanggang Community. Parked the bike in the designated area and walked upstairs.
location: From Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In the evening, tried running and confirmed the knee injury
description: After getting home, he changed into a sports T-shirt and shorts. After a brief warm-up, he started jogging from the entrance of the residential quarter along Pudong Avenue, aiming to test whether he could complete 4 kilometers. Just after passing the Pudong South Road intersection, about 1 kilometer in (about 2 kilometers total), the familiar soreness returned to the outside of his right knee, and it was more obvious than in the morning. He immediately stopped, switched to brisk walking, and turned back toward home. He internally confirmed his previous judgment: this week he must completely stop running.
location: Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (from the entrance of Shanggang Community to near the intersection of Pudong South Road)

name: At-home icing and injury treatment
description: I walked home and immediately took an ice pack out of the fridge, wrapped it in a towel, and applied it to the outside of my right knee for 15 minutes. After that, I used my phone browser to search for "causes of lateral knee pain from running" and, based on my own situation, initially concluded it was iliotibial band friction syndrome. Looking at the article's advice to rest for 2-3 days, I felt a bit helpless, but I knew I couldn't push it, or it would affect the western Sichuan self-driving trip. I put the ice pack back in the fridge and went to the bathroom for a warm shower.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and conversation
description: After taking a shower, the aroma of the Shanghai-style braised pork cooked by his mother, Wang Xiuying, drifted from the kitchen. He served rice and sat at the dining table with his parents. At the table, his father, Lei Jianguo, asked about the store business, and Lei Yu briefly explained the Double 11 warm-up plan. His mother complained that it was rainy and humid today and told him not to keep walking barefoot on the floor. When the conversation turned to his knee problem, his mother looked worried, and his father, drawing on his own experience, advised him to rest for a couple more days. The family ate and chatted, at a slow pace.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening reading and Duolingo Japanese study.
description: After the meal, helped his mother clear the dishes. Returning to the bedroom, he leaned against the headboard and opened Wang Anyi's “The Song of Everlasting Sorrow” to continue reading the passages depicting the warmth of everyday life in Shanghai's alleyways. After an hour of reading, he found some inspiration for his novel from the Shanghai stories. Then he set a 15-minute countdown, opened the Duolingo app, completed a consolidation exercise on Japanese verb conjugation, and maintained his learning momentum.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Foot Soak Relaxation and Early Rest
description: Went to the bathroom and soaked his feet in hot water for 15 minutes to promote blood circulation and relax his knees. Then he lay back on the bed, scrolled through Xiaohongshu for a while, browsed several outfit bloggers' notes, and did not comment.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going to bed and falling asleep.
description: Turned off the desk lamp and put the bedside water cup and phone in their places. Although the knee discomfort was still there, thinking that the pop-up exhibition with Zhao Min was taking shape and the store's Double 11 plan was progressing smoothly, I felt fairly calm. I closed my eyes and got ready to sleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning stretching and washing up
description: After the 6:45 alarm went off, I got up and felt that the soreness in my right knee had basically disappeared. After washing up, I did 10 minutes of leg stretches and glute bridges in the living room, focusing on the iliotibial band on the outside of the right knee, and it felt relaxed.
location: Room 504, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and getting ready to go out.
description: Wang Xiuying had prepared white congee and fried eggs. While eating breakfast, Lei Mingxuan replied to a regular customer's WeChat messages about the sizing of the new hoodie. After eating, he checked his commuter bag, put in a power bank, a folding umbrella, and The Great Qin Empire, changed into cushioned running shoes, and got ready to leave.
location: Room 504, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking commute.
description: The sun was nice, so he walked to work at Super Brand Mall. Via Pudong Avenue and Lujiazui Ring Road, it took about 15 minutes to arrive. On the way, he listened to a podcast with an in-depth analysis of 'The Qin Empire' and Shang Yang's reforms, warming up for his evening reading.
location: From Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Morning store operations and Double 11 warm-up
description: After arriving at the store, opened the computer with Xiao Lin, cleaned up, and sorted the packages. Lei Mingxuan sent a WeChat message to new customer Chen Jie recommending the mountain-style techwear workwear jackets. The message said: "Chen, this batch of new mountain-style techwear workwear jackets is absolutely top-notch. I saved an oatmeal-colored L size for you. You can try it on at Saturday's event — it'll look great in photos!" Chen Jie said he was looking forward to the Saturday trendy toy exchange. Afterward, he used the iPad to adjust the color scheme and copy for the Double 11 warm-up poster, enlarged the font for the spend-based discount promotion, and sent it to the part-time designer for refinement.
location: Mingchaoshe Clothing Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Lunchtime
description: Mindful of my knees and weight, I chose a newly opened healthy light-meal restaurant on the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall and ordered a seared salmon avocado bowl and kale apple juice. While waiting for my food, I took part in a discussion about Shang Yang's reforms in the "Shanghai Historical Novel Fans" WeChat group.
location: Super Brand Mall B1 Floor "HARU KITCHEN Spring Kitchen", 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing a wedding gift for Wang Lei
description: Back in the store's storage area, he took out a limited-edition Pop Mart "Forever Love" wedding series blind box and checked that the box was intact. He wrote a blessing on a beige greeting card, put it and the blind box into a custom gift bag, and prepared for Saturday's wedding.
location: Rear-area storage room of the Mingchao Club clothing store, Room A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon Store Operations and Inventory Count
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic gradually increased. Lei Mingxuan provided styling suggestions to customers and, in the gaps between customers, took stock of the mountain-style functional wear and classic workwear series inventory, using a mobile inventory management app to record out-of-stock sizes and colors of hot-selling items.
location: Mingchaoshe Clothing Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Focus on replying to customer messages
description: After customer traffic decreased, Lei Mingxuan replied one by one at the cash register to regular customers' WeChat messages about returns, exchanges, and new arrivals. He also sorted through Chen Jie's chat history and made a note that Chen Jie would bring friends on Saturday and is a sneaker collection enthusiast, for easier follow-up later.
location: Mingchaoshe Clothing Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Starbucks break and final poster confirmation
description: Go sit at the Starbucks on the first floor of Super Brand Mall, use the iPad to confirm the final Double 11 poster sent by the designer, make a few changes, and then notify that it is finalized for printing.
location: Starbucks, 1st Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-work walk and shopping
description: After closing the store, Lei Mingxuan walked home and made a detour to Yanqin Grocery Store to buy a pair of flannel hot-compress towels. The shopkeeper, Sister Chen, recommended Thai medicated patches, but Lei Mingxuan said he would first follow the doctor's advice and apply heat and stretch.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: When he got home, Wang Xiuying had prepared steamed sea bass, garlic broccoli, and tomato and egg soup. Lei Mingxuan told them he had prepared a blind box gift for Wang Lei, and his father Lei Jianguo teased him about it, creating a warm atmosphere.
location: Room 504, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening knee care
description: After the meal, rest for half an hour. Apply a hot towel compress to the outside of the right knee, then gently perform iliotibial band stretches, such as side-lying leg raises and glute bridges. Hold each position for 15 seconds. There should be no pain.
location: Room 504, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Advancing the novel illustration collaboration and joining the creative group.
description: In his study, he checked the click data of his serialized novel, and the new reader comments made him happy. After contacting his partner Gao Yuan, he added illustrator Lu Ming on WeChat, introduced the project, and agreed to send a sample chapter and trial draft before the weekend. Then he joined a novel writing exchange group via QR code, introduced himself, and followed senior authors.
location: Study, Room 504, Building 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading The Qin Empire and gathering material
description: In the study, took out the first volume of The Great Qin Empire and read the preface and the first three chapters. Recorded plots such as Shang Yang's reforms and Duke Xiao of Qin seeking talented people, drew a power relationship chart for the Qin nobility, and marked expandable side-story nodes.
location: Study, Room 504, Building 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation and socializing
description: Soaked his feet for 15 minutes to fully relax, and scrolled through his phone seeing messages from group friends. After lying in bed, he replied to comments on Moments and browsed designer toy news. In the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group, he chatted with Zhang Wei, Li Na, and others, topics ranging from Wang Lei's wedding to Saturday's designer toy exchange meetup. Lei Mingxuan invited them to come and support the store on the weekend. He only put down his phone and fell asleep at 00:15.
location: Bedroom, Room 504, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning preparation and commute to open the store
description: Got up at 7 a.m., did glute bridges and stretches in bed for 5 minutes, then washed up and ate the breakfast my mother had prepared: white congee, pickled vegetables, fried egg, and scallion pancake. While talking with my parents, I told them I was about to go on a retreat at Mogan Mountain. My mother told me to bring a jacket and a power bank. After breakfast, I took my commuter bag, grabbed the wedding blind box gift for Wang Lei, walked to Dongchang Road Station on Metro Line 2, took the train to Lujiazui Station, crossed the elevated corridor, and arrived at Super Brand Mall. After entering the store, I turned on the fresh air system, checked the cash register and coffee machine, and confirmed the sales report and inventory data.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China (commute to Super Brand Mall)

name: Store display adjustment and contacting an illustrator
description: Together with store clerk Xiao Lin, adjusted the 'outdoor techwear' display area, mixing outdoor vests with designer toy blind boxes, and guided styling and traffic flow techniques. Repeat customer Qian Duoduo asked via WeChat about newly arrived hoodies; he took photos of the new display and sent them to the VIP customer group. Then he contacted high school classmate Liu Yang to find illustrator resources, and Liu Yang recommended freelance illustrator Chen Yu. He accepted Chen Yu's friend request, introduced the novel's theme and style, and agreed to send sample chapters before the weekend.
location: Lei Mingxuan's Store, Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Store operations and online community engagement
description: Customer flow increased; he greeted customers and handled online orders. In the middle of it, he joined a discussion in the historical alternate-history fiction enthusiasts group and, drawing on "The Garments of the Great Ming", shared detailed descriptions of Ming Dynasty commoners' clothing. At 11:30, Xiao Lin went to lunch, and Lei Mingxuan brewed a drip-bag coffee while exchanging novel ideas with Hangzhou netizen Gao Yuan in the anime fan group. Gao Yuan offered a lot of ideas and said he would be in Shanghai on a business trip next week and could talk in person.
location: Lei Mingxuan's Store, Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Lunch
description: After Xiao Lin took over the shift, he changed into his own clothes and walked to the Rikyu Tonkotsu Ramen restaurant on basement level 1 of the IFC Mall, where he ordered a rich tonkotsu ramen with soft-boiled egg and chashu and enjoyed his lunch.
location: Lijiu Tonkotsu Ramen, B1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Running training and recovery rest
description: Returned to the shop, changed into quick-dry sportswear and running shoes, grabbed a running belt, phone, and water, and did dynamic warm-ups. Arrived at the riverside trail at 13:00, opened the running app, set a 5 km goal with a pace of 6:10 per kilometer, and finished in 31 minutes. While running, enjoyed the riverside view of Pudong's three landmark skyscrapers. After the run, sat on a bench, applied an ice pack to my right knee, and stretched for 10 minutes; the knee felt fine. Took a photo and posted it on WeChat Moments, then walked back to the shop, bought a sports drink on the way, wiped my face with a wet wipe upon returning, and discussed the afternoon plan with Xiao Lin.
location: The Lujiazui section of the riverside walkway near No. 2967 Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China (round trip to Super Brand Mall)

name: Afternoon store operations and closing preparations
description: Customer traffic was stable. He greeted customers, handled online orders, and arranged the next day's shipping. With Xiao Lin, he cleaned the store and handed over the work for the retreat period. Around 17:30, he sent messages to Tao Ge, the supplier in Hangzhou, and Fang Jie, the supplier in Guangzhou, letting them know that Xiao Lin would be the emergency contact during the retreat.
location: Lei Mingxuan's Store, Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: After-work commute and shopping
description: Closed the store at 6, and after giving instructions to Xiao Lin, went to the Ole' boutique supermarket on the basement floor of Super Brand Mall to buy snacks, bread, and energy drinks for the train. Then he walked to Lujiazui Station on Metro Line 2, took the train back to Dongchang Road Station, and walked home.
location: Ole’ Premium Supermarket, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China (commute to Shanggang Community)

name: Family Dinner and Warm Conversation
description: After arriving home, had dinner with his parents. His mother prepared steamed sea bass, stir-fried water spinach with garlic, tomato and egg soup, and sweet and sour spare ribs. At the dinner table, he shared how running helped him relax and how his knees were recovering. His mother reminded him to bring thick clothes for the retreat, and his father asked if he was joining a group tour; after learning it was a small group organized by his cousin Shen Jie, he felt reassured.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pack for Mogan Mountain
description: After a half-hour rest following the meal, go back to the bedroom and pack according to the equipment list sent by cousin Shen Jie: yoga clothes, quick-dry T-shirts, hiking pants, and a windbreaker; clean the hiking shoes. Check the toiletry bag, sunscreen, and common medicines (band-aids, stomach medicine, mosquito repellent), and make sure the power bank and charger are packed. Put all items into the outdoor backpack by category, and leave the backpack and hiking shoes at the entryway.
location: Home bedroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening reading and inspiration notes
description: After showering, he leaned against the headboard and read the 'Scene Design' chapter of Story: Substance, Structure, Style, and the Principles of Screenwriting. When he came across the technique of 'reversible reversal,' inspiration struck, and he conceived a scene in his novel set in an old longtang alley: the sound of pingtan drifting out from a half-open wooden door, while moss outside the door hinted that no one had lived there for a long time. He immediately used his phone's notes app to record the idea, adding details about the light, shadow, and sounds of the alley on rainy days.
location: Home bedroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Bedtime relaxation and social interaction
description: Closed the book, lay down and scrolled on the phone. The daytime running Moments post received many likes and comments, so I replied to all messages. In the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat, I told them I was going into the mountains for a retreat. Then browsed new designer toy product info and noted the flash-sale events.
location: Home bedroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: He got up, went to the living room to pour some warm water, and checked the door lock and gas. Back in the room, he set his phone to airplane mode and placed it on the nightstand. After turning off the light, images of the meditation retreat surfaced in his mind. Looking forward to tomorrow's trip to Moganshan, he tossed and turned for a while before falling asleep.
location: Home bedroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Getting Up and Morning Preparation
description: At 6:30 in the morning, his biological clock woke him up right on time. He did five minutes of abdominal breathing in bed and felt that his knees were in good shape. After getting up and washing up, he changed into loose cotton-linen pants and a T-shirt. His mother was busy in the kitchen, and the aroma of wontons and pan-fried buns drifted into the room. He checked the backpack he had packed last night—the yoga mat, power bank, and Story were all there.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Breakfast and Farewell
description: Mother brought a bowl of steaming small wonton soup and two golden-brown pan-fried pork buns. As I ate, I told my father that I was going to Mogan Mountain today, and that the signal might be poor in the afternoon; if anything came up, he could call the store's phone. Father nodded calmly and told me to drive slowly on the mountain road and not to rush. I smiled and agreed. After eating, I wiped my mouth, put on my backpack, grabbed my keys, and went out.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Driving to Jing'an to pick up Shen Jie
description: Went downstairs to the surface parking spot in the residential complex, started the car, and set the navigation to his cousin Shen Jie's home in Jing'an District. He drove along the Inner Ring elevated road. There were quite a few cars in the early morning, but traffic was still smooth. He listened to 97.7 Music Radio. About 30 minutes later, he arrived downstairs at Shen Jie's place and sent her a WeChat message to let her know.
