location: Along the route from Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shen Jie's residence in Jing'an District (via roads including the Inner Ring Elevated Road, etc.)

name: Picked up my cousin Shen Jie
description: Shen Jie wore a white cotton-linen long dress and carried a canvas tote bag downstairs. I helped her put away her luggage. She sat in the passenger seat and joked that the car was kept quite clean, asking if I was really planning to go cultivate immortality. I smiled and replied that today I was a Mogan Mountain villager.
location: Downstairs from Shen Jie's residence in Jing'an District, Shanghai (exact address unknown)

name: Self-driving from Shanghai to Mogan Mountain
description: Starting from Jing'an, he took the Yan'an Elevated Road and turned onto the G50 Shanghai–Chongqing Expressway. About an hour later, he stopped at Fengjing Service Area for 10 minutes and bought mineral water and beef jerky. Shen Jie played folk songs in the car, and the two talked about her job as a buyer and their expectations for the meditation retreat. In the latter half of the trip, he focused on driving and arrived at the Mogan Mountain Retreat Center parking lot at 10:50 a.m.
location: From Jing'an District, Shanghai, to Moganshan Retreat Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province (via G50 Shanghai-Chongqing Expressway and Fengjing Service Area)

name: Check-in and camp opening ceremony
description: After parking the car, Shen Jie and I dragged our luggage into the retreat center. The front desk verified our information and handed over the room card and the "Mountain Retreat Autumn Edition" activity booklet. The room was in a wooden cabin on the back hill, with a bamboo forest outside the window. After putting down our luggage, we went to the multi-function hall for the opening ceremony. The instructor introduced the schedule in a soft voice, including morning meditation, yin yoga, silent walking, and more.
location: Reception desk and multi-function hall, Mogan Mountain Retreat Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Free time and exploring the center
description: After the camp opened, there was free time. Shen Jie pulled me to stroll around the small courtyard and the surrounding trails. The mountain air was fresh, and bamboo groves were everywhere. Some participants were copying scriptures, and some were drinking tea in a teahouse by the bamboo grove. I joked that those people looked so ethereal, and I was like a husky barging into a fairyland. Shen Jie teased me, saying I just shouldn't snore during class later.
location: The small courtyard and surrounding trails of Mogan Mountain Retreat Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Enjoyed a vegetarian lunch.
description: At noon, the restaurant served an all-vegetarian buffet with roasted pumpkin, quinoa salad, mushroom and tofu soup, and more. It tasted great. I ate a whole plate of roasted pumpkin and felt comfortable in my stomach. The dining atmosphere was quiet, and everyone talked in soft voices.
location: Mogan Mountain Retreat Center Restaurant, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Midday rest
description: After lunch I returned to the room. Opened the window to let in the mountain breeze, lay on the bed and scrolled through Moments for a while. Seeing a photo posted by Xiao Lin, an employee, showing good customer traffic at the shop, I liked it. Then I put down my phone, listened to the birds outside the window, closed my eyes, and rested for half an hour to recharge for the afternoon yoga class.
location: Room at the Moganshan Meditation Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Pre-yoga class preparation and Thangka meditation
description: Arrived early at the yoga studio beside the bamboo grove; the light was clear and bright, and the floor felt warm. Changed into yoga pants and, under the instructor's guidance, did 15 minutes of thangka meditation. Sitting cross-legged, gazing at the Vajrapani thangka, I tried to empty my mind and gradually felt my own breathing and heartbeat, even hearing the wind in the bamboo grove.
location: Yoga Room, Mogan Mountain Retreat Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: First yin yoga class
description: After the meditation, the class officially began. The instructor had each pose held for 3–5 minutes, relaxing the body through deep breathing. I completed dragon pose, butterfly pose, and seal pose. The backs of my thighs and hips were stretched until they ached wonderfully, and after persisting, my body felt a sense of clarity. Afterward, lying on the mat, I felt an unprecedented relaxation and realized that I usually lack deep stretching after intense exercise.
location: Yoga Room, Mogan Mountain Retreat Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Free exploration and note-taking after class
description: After class, he took a solo walk along the back-hill trail at the center. The light in the mountains was soft. He took photos of the bamboo sea with his phone and sent them to the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group. Zhang Wei immediately replied with a teasing remark. He sat down on a wooden bench at the viewing platform and read Story for about 20 minutes, but his attention was drawn by the mountain air, so he simply put the book away and stared blankly at the mountain ridges.
location: Mountain trails and rest area at the Moganshan Retreat Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Returned to the room to rest and freshen up.
description: After the walk, I was sweating all over. I went back to the room, took a quick shower, and changed into a clean linen shirt. Feeling refreshed, I put my phone on the table for a while and enjoyed some offline time.
location: Room at the Moganshan Meditation Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Enjoy a vegetarian dinner.
description: At 6 p.m. came back to the restaurant; the vegetarian buffet dinner had mushroom clay pot and corn chowder. Sat quietly with Shen Jie while eating, occasionally exchanging thoughts about the class in low voices. I said yin yoga really tests patience, and Shen Jie said that's exactly the point—to make you slow down.
location: Mogan Mountain Retreat Center Restaurant, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Post-meal rest and socializing
description: After dinner, as I stood with Shen Jie on the restaurant's outdoor corridor to digest, the sky slowly darkened and only the outlines of the distant mountains remained. I noticed a girl in an indigo-blue cotton-linen shirt; the fabric dyeing was very distinctive, with a natural gradient.
location: Outer corridor of the restaurant at Moganshan Retreat Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Silent walking
description: At 7 p.m., the staff organized a silent walking session, requiring everyone to remain quiet and focus only on the road underfoot and their breathing. The group walked along the mountain trail shrouded in dusk for 30 minutes. I walked in the middle of the group, trying hard to suppress the urge to speak, focusing on the gravel underfoot and the weeds by the roadside. By the end, my mind had calmed down a lot.
location: Mountain trail at Moganshan Retreat Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang, China

name: Unexpectedly met designer Chen Xiao
description: After the silent walking session ended, in the rest area people were chatting freely. I noticed the girl in the indigo shirt reading a fabric book. I went over to strike up a conversation and complimented the beautiful dyeing of her shirt. She smiled in response. It turned out she was Chen Xiao, an independent fashion designer from Hangzhou who specializes in plant dyeing. We hit it off and talked for over an hour, from traditional plant dyeing techniques (indigo, madder) to the simple and natural style of modern apparel design. I was very interested in the combination of plant dyeing and techwear, and showed her photos of the store display on my phone. We eventually exchanged WeChat and agreed to work together on a limited edition in the future.

participant.name: Chen Xiao
participant.relation: A newly made friend (independent clothing designer).

location: China, Zhejiang Province, Huzhou City, Deqing County, Moganshan Town, Fatou Township, Moganshan Retreat Center, rest area (tea room entrance)

name: Recording inspiration and going back to the room to wash up
description: After saying goodbye to Chen Xiao, his heart was racing with excitement. He hurried back to his room and could not wait to jot down the inspiration in the notes app on his phone: "Botanical dye + mountain-style techwear." He planned to try using plant ash as the base color and local indigo tie-dye, and to apply it to the pockets of an outdoor vest and so on. Then he washed up thoroughly and applied a cold towel to his knee, feeling that it was also relaxed.
location: Room at the Moganshan Meditation Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Reading before bed and preparing to sleep early
description: With an hour left before lights out, I leaned against the headboard and continued reading Story, jotting down the narrative inspiration I'd discussed with Chen Xiao in the margins. After about 40 minutes of reading, I set an early-morning alarm on my phone. The night in the mountains was extremely quiet, and drowsiness set in.
location: Room at the Moganshan Meditation Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Going to bed
description: At 10 p.m., he turned off the lights and went to bed on time. Outside the window there were only the sounds of wind and insects, no city noise. Recalling the day's events, from initial resistance to perseverance in class to unexpectedly making new friends, he felt calm. His breathing gradually deepened, and he soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room at the Moganshan Meditation Center, Fatou Township, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Morning meditation and walking meditation.
description: The morning mist had not yet dispersed. Wrapped in my coat, I sat cross-legged on the inn's lawn with the meditation instructor. The mountain air was cool, carrying the fresh scent of bamboo leaves and soil. The 20-minute meditation let me, for the first time, 'hear' the ensemble of my heartbeat and the wind. During the walking meditation that followed, I stepped barefoot on the stone path, dew wetting the soles of my feet, each step real and slow. This ultimate stillness unexpectedly brought a sense of peace to me, a person who is usually always in a hurry.
location: Lawn and flagstone path at Moganshan Shanyu Inn, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

name: Liaising online with the illustrator about clothing pattern design
description: After meditating, taking advantage of the quiet, I went to a corner of the inn's tea room, connected to the WiFi, and video-called illustrator Chen Yu. I showed her the passages from the novel about the 'dormer windows' and 'clothes-drying poles' in old Shanghai alleys. As she listened, she quickly sketched lines in her sketchbook and drew two concept sketches with completely different styles on the spot. We both felt that the 'Shanghai nostalgia style where old and new interweave' was spot on, and she promised to produce a complete sample draft within a week.
location: Tea Room, Shanyu Inn on Mogan Mountain, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Have a vegetarian breakfast with my cousin
description: Breakfast was warming millet porridge, soft multigrain steamed buns, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. My cousin Shen Jie and I sat at the same table. She laughed and said that during meditation her legs had gone numb from sitting cross-legged, but her mind had indeed become much calmer. I shared with her the little episode of seeing a squirrel jump over the stone steps during walking meditation, and the relaxed atmosphere swept away the seriousness of the early morning.
location: Restaurant at Shanyu Inn, Mogan Mountain, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou, Zhejiang Province

name: Pack luggage and take a short rest before checkout
description: After breakfast I went back to the room, rolled up the yoga mat and put it back in the storage cabinet, and packed all my personal items into my backpack. Before checking out, I sat on the bamboo-woven sofa in the common lounge, opened the guestbook, and wrote a message: "Thank you to this mountain for letting me take away a bellyful of peace to slowly digest back in Shanghai." Then I took a photo of the bamboo sea outside the window and posted it on Moments: "The quiet of the mountains, packed up, brought back to Shanghai."
location: Room and public lounge at Moganshan Shanyu Inn, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

name: Second yin yoga class.
description: Today I adapted much better than yesterday. With the instructor's assistance, I focused on Half Lord of the Fishes Pose and Caterpillar Pose, holding each pose for at least three minutes. That slow stretching made my back and hips feel more open than ever, and the knee discomfort from yesterday's long drive eased considerably. After the class, my body felt as if it had been reassembled, and I felt refreshed.
location: Yoga room at Moganshan Shanyu Inn, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Discussed a collaboration on plant dyeing with a designer.
description: After yoga class, Shen Jie and I were drinking tea and resting in the tea room when plant dye designer Chen Xiao came over to greet us. I took out my phone and showed her photos of several best-selling techwear jackets and cargo pants from my store. Chen Xiao was very excited about the "mountain-style ink painting" concept we were discussing, and immediately jotted down ideas like "chestnut shell dyed pocket patchwork" and "sappan wood dyed lining" in her phone notes. We agreed that after returning to Shanghai, she would bring more fabric samples to my store to see how well they matched in person.
location: Tea Room, Shanyu Inn on Mogan Mountain, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Check out and leave Mogan Mountain.
description: Shen Jie and I settled our tea snack bill at the lobby and returned the room card. Before leaving, we took a photo in front of the wall covered with greenery at the inn's entrance. After the photo, I started my car, gave Shen Jie a ride, and drove away from the place that had calmed my mind for two days.
location: Lobby and parking lot of Shanyu Inn, Mogan Mountain, Moganshan Town, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province

name: Tasting vegetarian noodles in Deqing county town
description: To avoid the lunch rush, I suggested going directly to Deqing county town. At Yuyingfang, we found a noodle shop called 'A Bowl of Vegetarian Noodles'. I ordered mushroom soup noodles, and Shen Jie had yam noodles. While waiting, we talked about the pottery teacher we met at the meditation retreat center yesterday, and both felt that this unexpected retreat experience had given us far more than expected.
location: The noodle shop called A Bowl of Vegetarian Noodles, Building 42, Yuyingfang Commercial Street, Wukang Subdistrict, Deqing County, Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province.

name: Return trip to Shanghai via expressway.
description: I drove onto the expressway. At around 13:58 I stopped at the Jiaxing service area for 15 minutes. I filled up with gas and went to Starbucks for an iced Americano to refresh myself, while Shen Jie bought a latte and two bags of Jiaxing meat zongzi. Once we got back on the road, we talked about the new-season selections for her select shop. I joked that she could do a co-branded pop-up in my store, and she thought it was a good idea.
location: Jiaxing Service Area on the Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, Xiuzhou District, Jiaxing City, Zhejiang Province (Shanghai direction) and the expressways along the route

name: Escorted my cousin Shen Jie home
description: After getting off the highway, I drove directly to the residential complex on North Shaanxi Road where Shen Jie lives. As I helped her take her suitcase out of the trunk, she patted me on the shoulder and said, 'Bro, next time something this good comes up, make sure to call me again!' I smiled and told her to remember to stretch when she got back, and not to just lie around.
location: Entrance to the residential community at Lane 640, North Shaanxi Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Handle shop work messages.
description: After arriving home, I opened my phone in the study to handle business matters. The shop assistant Xiao Lin sent today's sales report and a photo of a customer trying on clothes, asking for styling advice. The supplier 'Brother Tao' also sent color swatch photos of a batch of newly arrived fabrics. I replied to each one, and confirmed that tomorrow, Sunday, Xiao Lin and another shop assistant would be covering the store as usual, since I would be heading to Hangzhou to be a groomsman.
location: Home study, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Having dinner with my parents and sharing my retreat experience
description: Mom and Dad deliberately waited for me to have dinner. Mom cooked my favorite oil-braised shrimp and braised pork. At the table, I gestured animatedly as I told them about the strange experience of the silent walking trip at Mogan Mountain and about meeting Chen Xiao, a plant-dye designer. My dad laughed and teased, 'You can actually sit still? The sun must be rising from the west.' My mom, however, listened with great interest and was very intrigued by plant-dyed clothes.
location: Dining room at home, No. 12, Shanggang Residential Area, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wrap wedding gifts and handwrite greeting cards
description: I took out the Pop Mart Molly wedding series hidden blind box I had prepared long ago, carefully placed it in a dedicated transparent box, and put it into a canvas bag printed with my store's logo. Then I drew out a piece of ink-wash style letter paper and wrote with a fountain pen: "Dear old classmate, happy wedding! May your life together be just like this limited edition—full of surprises and uniquely yours. I've been hiding this gift for a long time. — Lei Mingxuan."
location: Lei Mingxuan's bedroom, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Check the vehicle and prepare for tomorrow's trip
description: After dinner, I took a walk to help digestion, then went downstairs and walked carefully around my SUV, squatted down to check the tires, opened the hood to check the dipstick, and added a bottle of windshield washer fluid. Once everything was done, I sat in the driver's seat, opened the phone navigation, set the route to Wang Lei's home in Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou for tomorrow, estimated traffic congestion, and set the departure time for 7 a.m.
location: Ground parking space, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Resting at home and getting in touch with friends
description: Curled up on the sofa, I first sent a photo of a bamboo sea in the mountains to the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group, with the caption: 'Brothers, I had a taste of being a hermit. Tomorrow I'm going to Hangzhou to get your groom drunk!' Then I scrolled through the WeChat group for tomorrow's wedding to confirm the process. Finally, I sent a private message to Wang Lei: 'I'll set off at 7 a.m. and expect to get to your place by 10. Keep the groomsman suit for me, and don't let it be too small after I've gained weight.' He replied instantly: 'Waiting for you. When you get here, hit three cups first!'
location: Living room sofa at No. 12, Shanggang Community, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up
description: The hot water washed away the day's fatigue, and I changed into comfortable pajamas. After brushing my teeth, I simply applied some moisturizer to my face and felt my whole body relax.
location: Bathroom at home, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stretch before bed and confirm tomorrow's itinerary.
description: On the carpet in my bedroom, I did 10 minutes of leg stretches and glute bridges to relax the muscles after the long drive. Before going to sleep, I sent Wang Lei a voice message to confirm the exact meeting point for tomorrow and the best man reminders. He replied with a voice message, sounding very excited, and told me to wear the dark blue shirt prepared for everyone.
location: Bedroom 12, Shanggang Community, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Turned off the lights and went to bed
description: Turned off the light and lay down. Scenes of the morning mist in the mountains and reuniting with old friends flashed through my mind. The sense of fulfillment soon sent me into a deep sleep. Tomorrow will be another wonderful day.
location: On the bed in the bedroom of No. 12, Shanggang Community, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake up, wash up, and tidy up
description: Woken by the alarm at 6:30 a.m., I quickly washed up and tidied, changed into the pre-ironed casual suit, and prepared to attend Wang Lei's wedding, making sure to bring the designer toy gift for Wang Lei.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family breakfast and farewell.
description: In the dining room, he enjoyed the plain congee, fried eggs, and pickled vegetables his parents had prepared. His mother told him to “drive slowly on the road,” and his father handed him goji berry tea. After saying goodbye to his parents, he prepared to leave.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Pre-departure preparation and vehicle inspection
description: In the underground parking garage, he walked around the car to check the tires and bodywork. After confirming the car was in good condition, he started the engine, connected his phone via Bluetooth to play jazz, put his driver's license on the center console, and set navigation to Hangzhou Huagang HNA Resort Hotel.
location: Underground garage, Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Driving alone to Hangzhou
description: Starting from Pudong, take the S32 Shanghai-Jiaxing-Huzhou Expressway and then the G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway toward Hangzhou. Traffic was slow along the way, so we stopped at Jiaxing Service Area for 15 minutes, bought a bottle of water, and took a photo to send to friend Shen Jie, joking, 'Let's go, we're going to steal the groom's thunder!' Then we continued on the road.
location: Jiaxing Service Area, G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, Jiaxing, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Arrive at the hotel, park, and check in.
description: Following the navigation, arrived at the underground parking lot of the Hangzhou Huagang HNA Resort Hotel. After parking, took the trendy toy gift for Wang Lei and walked to the check-in area. Seeing Wang Lei surrounded by classmates, he handed him the gift box and congratulated him on his marriage. Wang Lei opened the gift and thanked him excitedly; everyone laughed and then took a group photo.
location: Hangzhou Huagang HNA Resort Hotel, No. 1 Yanggong Causeway, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China

name: Attend the outdoor wedding ceremony and take group photos
description: Attended the warm wedding ceremony of Wang Lei and the bride on the hotel lawn. Stood in the viewing area with old classmates such as Zhao Min, witnessing the exchange of vows. When the bride said "I do," they led the applause and cheers. After the ceremony, took various photos with the couple and classmates, and photographed the wedding decoration details to send to the designer Chen Xiao for reference.
location: Lawn wedding area at Hangzhou Huagang HNA Resort Hotel, No. 1 Yanggong Causeway, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China

name: Attended a wedding banquet and came up with a new project idea at the table
description: Seated at the wedding banquet, sharing a table with classmates Zhao Min, Liu Qiang, and others, they enjoyed dishes such as braised pork belly and lotus root in sweet osmanthus syrup while reminiscing about funny college stories. When Zhao Min mentioned the "urban functional style" pop-up event her company was planning at the mall, I immediately chimed in, linking it to my own store concept. We discussed everything from the pop-up theme to visual presentation and agreed to refine the plan after returning to Shanghai. The conversation only paused when Wang Lei came over to toast.
location: Banquet Hall, Hangzhou Huagang HNA Resort Hotel, No. 1 Yanggong Causeway, West Lake District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China

name: Toured West Lake with old classmates, relaxed and chatted.
description: After the wedding banquet, he took a stroll along West Lake's Bai Causeway with Zhao Min, Liu Qiang, and a group of six, chatting about their careers and families in the lake breeze. Passing a small shop by the lake, he bought a cup of pour-over coffee and snapped candid shots of his classmates' smiles and the lake view, then posted them to Moments.
location: Hangzhou West Lake Scenic Area, Longjing Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China (Broken Bridge - Bai Causeway section)

name: On standby in the hotel lounge, staying in touch online.
description: After the walk, the other classmates returned to their rooms or went shopping. I sat down alone in a quiet corner of the lobby lounge. First, I sent a WeChat message to illustrator Chen Yu, telling her that the sample chapters had been sent and asking her to read them when she had time. Then I called my cousin Yang Fan and invited him to meet for coffee in Hangzhou, but Yang Fan couldn't make it because he had to work overtime, so we agreed to meet in Shanghai next time. After hanging up, I opened my memo and wrote down the key points of the pop-up collaboration discussed with Zhao Min.
location: Lobby lounge area, Hangzhou Huagang HNA Resort Hotel, No. 1 Yanggong Causeway, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China

name: Say goodbye to classmates and prepare for the return trip.
description: Agreed with Zhao Min on a specific time to meet after returning to Shanghai, and warmly hugged his classmates to say goodbye. Then he went to the parking lot, picked up his car, adjusted the seat, set the return navigation, and prepared to drive back to Shanghai.
location: Parking lot of Hangzhou Huagang HNA Resort Hotel, No. 1 Yanggong Causeway, Xihu District, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China.

name: Drove back to Shanghai alone and contacted the designer along the way.
description: Started the return trip. Road conditions were fairly smooth. Stopped at Chang'an Service Area for a 15-minute rest, ate a bowl of instant noodles to refresh, and while resting called designer Chen Xiao on WeChat, sharing wedding experiences and Zhao Min's flash mob idea. Agreed to visit her studio on Wednesday afternoon to see plant-dye samples. After the call, continued driving. As the sky darkened, turned on the headlights and drove steadily.
location: Chang'an Service Area, G60 Shanghai-Kunming Expressway, Jiaxing City, Zhejiang Province, China

name: Arrived in Shanghai and shopped at a community convenience store.
description: Returned smoothly to downstairs of my home in Shanghai. After parking, I felt thirsty, so I went to the Lianhua Supermarket at the entrance of the residential complex and bought a bottle of electrolyte drink and two cans of iced soda water to relieve the fatigue of the long drive.
location: Lianhua Supermarket (Shenjialong Branch), 1683 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Walked home and rested after arriving
description: Walked home carrying the things I bought (the residential community is about a 30-minute walk from the supermarket). When I got home, my parents were still watching TV. I handed them the wedding favor boxes I'd brought from the wedding, briefly reported on today's situation, and my mother urged me to go take a shower and rest quickly.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Wash up and record key inspirations
description: After a quick hot shower, he changed into home clothes and felt relaxed in both body and mind. He sat at his desk, took out his phone memo, and recorded in detail the core ideas of the "Urban Functional Style X Exhibition Pop-up" discussed with Zhao Min, as well as several co-branded product ideas that came to mind, including initial timelines and division of work.
location: Home study, Shanggang Residential Quarter, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Bedtime stretching and reflection
description: Spread out the yoga mat in the living room and did 15 minutes of deep stretching for the legs and back to relieve the lower-back soreness from a day of driving. While stretching, I mentally reviewed the tasks to handle at the shop tomorrow. Afterward, I drank half a glass of warm water and got ready for bed.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Reading and rest before bed
description: After getting into bed, he picked up the unfinished Story on the nightstand and flipped through a few pages. Then he browsed Moments for a while and liked the wedding photos posted by classmates. As sleepiness came over him, he put his phone aside, turned off the bedside lamp, and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning wake-up and stretching
description: At exactly 7 a.m., Lei Mingxuan's body clock went off on time. The sun was shining brightly outside the window, promising a beautiful day. Instead of getting up right away, he did some simple torso twists and neck-and-shoulder stretches in bed to ease the fatigue from the long drive the day before, starting his new year of life with gentle movements.
location: Bedroom No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and morning preparation.
description: After getting up, Lei Mingxuan went to the bathroom to wash up. Looking in the mirror, he felt he looked energetic. After brushing his teeth, he deliberately styled his hair with wax to look sharper, because today was his 31st birthday and he wanted to start the day in top form.
location: Bathroom, No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and birthday wishes
description: Lei Mingxuan walked out of his room, and a familiar aroma came from the kitchen. His mother had already cooked small wontons and deliberately added a fried egg. His father sat at the dining table and handed him a bowl of longevity noodles. Although he said, 'Eating noodles in the morning staves off hunger,' Lei Mingxuan knew it was his father's reserved birthday blessing. The family of three sat together and enjoyed a simple but warm breakfast, and the morning sounds from the neighborhood outside the window made the atmosphere even more peaceful.
location: Restaurant at No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-departure preparations and replying to greetings
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan went back to his bedroom and changed into a gray Japanese-style work shirt and black casual pants. He picked up his phone and saw that several birthday wishes had already come in on WeChat. He quickly replied to the messages from his college roommate “Lao Zhang” and his cousin Shen Jie, then grabbed his backpack and got ready to go out to start a new day.
location: Bedroom No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning exercise: walking to the park and jogging
description: Lei Mingxuan left home and decided to start his new year of life with exercise on his birthday. He changed into running shoes, walked out of the neighborhood along the familiar sycamore-tree path, and after about 27 minutes arrived at Lujiazui Central Green Park. After entering the park, he jogged two laps along the trail, lasting about 15 minutes. After finishing, he did a few stretches by a bench and felt refreshed and full of energy.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Lujiazui Central Green Park (Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai)

name: Walked to the store and ran into a neighbor
description: After the workout, Lei Mingxuan walked from the park to his clothing store in Super Brand Mall; the walk took about 25 minutes. On the way, he met his neighbor Aunt Zhu, who was returning from morning exercise. Aunt Zhu warmly called out, 'Xiao Lei, happy birthday!' He smiled back and felt very happy.
location: Along the route from Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to No. 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Store opening preparations and morning work
description: After arriving at the store located at Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, Lei Mingxuan skillfully turned on the lights, started the cashier system, and wiped down the shelves. The sales records and inventory sheets that staff member Xiao Lin had organized the day before were clear. He first checked online orders to make sure nothing was missed, then, based on last week's sales, moved several newly arrived autumn jackets to more prominent positions, getting ready for the new day's business.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sharing wedding and receiving birthday wishes
description: While tidying the shelves, Lei Mingxuan opened his phone's photo album and picked three good photos from yesterday's wedding in Hangzhou (one group photo with friends Wang Lei and Zhao Min, one of the wedding scene setup, and one scenery shot of West Lake). He composed a Moments post: “Attended my good brother's wedding and soaked up some happiness. Also wishing myself a happy 31st birthday. In the new year, keep charging ahead!” Shortly after posting, his phone began ringing frequently with notifications as likes and comments poured in. Zhao Min commented, “I'll come by your shop for coffee someday.” He happily replied, “Always welcome, come talk about collaboration whenever.” And he kept that promise in mind.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mind the store, receive customers, and handle matters.
description: The mall was not crowded in the morning. Lei Mingxuan continued replying to comments and private-message greetings on WeChat Moments while keeping an eye on customers entering the store. Then two young women who looked like office workers came in and were attracted to the newly arrived techwear jackets. He enthusiastically introduced the fabric and tailoring features, and in the end they happily bought one. For the rest of the time, he handled the store's routine affairs.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Received and Previewed the Initial Illustration Draft
description: Just as he was about to go to lunch, Lei Mingxuan received a WeChat message from illustrator friend Chen Yu. She sent an initial draft of a city street scene illustration based on a sample chapter of his novel. The details of the alleyway, the characters' clothing, and the handling of light and shadow in the image were so precise that he was pleasantly surprised. He was completely absorbed, carefully studying every brushstroke and line, feeling deeply excited. He immediately replied: 'Amazing!! This is exactly the feeling I wanted, the details are superb!' and added a few thumbs-up emojis to express his appreciation.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch: healthy light meal.
description: After looking at the illustration draft, he felt great. In order to enjoy his mother's red-braised pork belly guilt-free at night, Lei Mingxuan decided to have a light lunch. He walked to the Wagas restaurant on the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall and ordered a signature chicken avocado salad and a glass of freshly squeezed orange juice. While eating, he scrolled through his phone and saw that the birthday wishes on his Moments had nearly 50 likes. His ball friends Han Dong and Xie Fei also sent red packets in the WeChat group. He accepted them and replied, 'I appreciate the thought—see you on the court this weekend!'
location: Wagas, B1 floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In the afternoon, I tended the store, communicated, and worked on collaboration ideas.
description: Afternoon is the peak time for mall foot traffic. Lei Mingxuan received several waves of customers in a row, patiently recommending outfits and introducing fabric materials. The afternoon sun shone into the store, warm and cozy. During a lull with fewer customers, he pulled out his phone memo and began organizing the initial ideas for the "urban techwear" pop-up collaboration he had discussed with Zhao Min, from the theme "Alleyway Youth" to target customers, then to preliminary budget and venue concepts, gradually sorting scattered ideas into a structured framework to lay the groundwork for future cooperation.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closed the store early and walked home
description: Because today is his birthday, Lei Mingxuan decided to give himself a little break and close the shop half an hour early. After greeting the owner of the neighboring shop, he locked the door and slowly walked home. The evening breeze was pleasant; thinking of his mother's braised pork, his steps became lighter.
location: Along the route from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Helping in the kitchen and family interaction
description: Stepping through the door, the aroma of rich oil and dark soy sauce floated from the kitchen. His mother was busy at the stove. Lei Mingxuan washed his hands and took the initiative to help peel garlic and pass plates. "There's just the three of us today, so I'll make you a nice meal," his mother said while stir-frying. He didn't say much, but felt warm inside, enjoying this simple yet precious family interaction.
location: Kitchen, No. 2, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family birthday celebration dinner
description: The dinner began, and the table was filled with Lei Mingxuan's favorite dishes: his mother's signature Shanghainese braised pork belly, glossy red and bright, rich but not greasy; a steaming pot of longevity noodles with a poached egg nestled in it; and stir-fried clover and sweet-and-sour pork ribs. The whole family raised their glasses. His father said, “Son, you're 31 years old now, with a steady career — health comes first.” The three clinked glasses in a warm and happy atmosphere. Lei Mingxuan took a big bite of the braised pork belly; it tasted exactly as it did when he was a child, and his heart was filled with happiness.
location: Restaurant at No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Accepting birthday gifts from the family.
description: After dinner, his father mysteriously took out a box and handed it to Lei Mingxuan, saying it was a birthday gift. Lei Mingxuan unwrapped it and found a set of professional outdoor sports knee pads and ankle braces. "Haven't you been saying that you want to go on a self-driving trip to western Sichuan? These will come in handy on the road." His father spoke with unusual seriousness. The gift was practical and thoughtful. Lei Mingxuan felt a surge of warmth in his heart and nodded firmly as he thanked him.
location: Restaurant at No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In-depth research on illustrations and thinking about collaborations
description: After dinner, back in his bedroom, Lei Mingxuan couldn't wait to open his phone and carefully studied Chen Yu's initial illustration draft again; the more he looked, the more satisfied he was. In his notes app, he wrote down his idea: if the elements in the painting—the longtang alleys, plane trees, and skateboarding teenagers—could be made into hoodie prints or co-branded themed T-shirts, the effect could be great. So he sent Chen Yu a long message describing his co-branding idea in detail and asking about her interest in apparel merchandise: "Your draft is fantastic! I have a bold idea—I'd love to discuss it with you!"
location: Bedroom No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening stretching and quick notes
description: After sitting for a long time, Lei Mingxuan stood up to loosen up. He did 15 minutes of leg stretches and core exercises on the yoga mat to relieve the day's fatigue. Refreshed after the workout, he sat back down at his desk and, in a notebook, hand-wrote and refined the draft ideas for the 'Urban Techwear' pop-up that he had organized in the afternoon, including possible collaboration methods, timelines, and a preliminary budget, to prepare for tomorrow's detailed discussion with Zhao Min.
location: Bedroom No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Scrolling on his phone and interacting with friends.
description: Before sleeping, Lei Mingxuan lay in bed scrolling through WeChat Moments. Seeing the birthday photos everyone posted, he felt it was lively. He also chatted for a while in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group with his friend Zhang Wei and Li Na, who was far away in Hangzhou. Li Na said she would send him some Hangzhou specialty snacks. After that, he talked with his sports buddies Han Dong and Xie Fei about plans to play ball at World Plaza on the weekend. Chatting with friends made him feel relaxed and happy.
location: Bedroom No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime thoughts and delayed sleep.
description: After turning off the lights, Lei Mingxuan lay in bed as scenes from the day flashed through his mind: the blessings in Moments, Chen Yu's surprise drawing, the warm family dinner with his parents, and the knee pads his father gave him... His heart was full of emotion. He briefly imagined the sweetness of a wedding, but soon the plans to upgrade the clothing store, the goal of a self-driving trip to western Sichuan, the pop-up collaboration with Zhao Min, and the co-branding idea with Chen Yu all surfaced clearly. He became even more determined to establish his career before starting a family. His thoughts surged and he found it hard to calm down. Only when it became completely quiet outside the window did he gradually feel sleepy and drift off into a dream.
location: Bedroom No. 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning exercise and family breakfast.
description: Got up at 7:30 in the morning, did some light stretching, changed into workout clothes, laid out the yoga mat in the bedroom, and followed a fitness app for 30 minutes of strength training, including dumbbell squats, overhead presses, bicep curls, and planks, breaking a sweat and energizing the body. After training, took a shower and changed into a dark khaki work shirt and black casual pants. Mother had prepared wontons and freshly squeezed soy milk. He chatted with her while eating, told her he'd be home for dinner, then grabbed his commuter bag and car keys, ready to head out.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: He drove from the residential community to Super Brand Mall. On the way, he bought four shengjian buns and soy milk at the shengjian stall near the community gate as supplies. After arriving at the underground parking garage of Super Brand Mall, he took the elevator to the store on the second floor, swiped his card to open the rolling shutter door, turned on the spotlights, cash register computer, and sound system one by one, connected his phone via Bluetooth to play rap music, and wiped the display counters and clothing racks to prepare for the new day's business.
location: “Mingxuan Collection,” Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning store affairs and reading before noon
description: After arriving at the store, he first checked inventory and found that the popular designer toy blind boxes were understocked, so he placed a replenishment order in the system. Then he called supplier Zhou Tao to confirm the delivery time for the second batch of fall techwear fabrics. After that, he arranged the newly arrived mountain-style techwear into a dedicated display area, changed the mannequins' outfits, and set up a photo scene with a portable backdrop cloth and stand in the store corner. Near noon, he sat on the sofa and studied "Story: Substance, Structure, Style, and the Principles of Screenwriting" for writing inspiration at night, until preparing lunch.
location: “Mingxuan Collection,” Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and discussion about member activities
description: He went with store clerk Xiao Lin to the food court on B1 of the mall for malatang, each picking their own ingredients. While waiting, he asked Xiao Lin about recent customer traffic. Xiao Lin said that after National Day foot traffic had been flat, and suggested using soon-to-expire member points to run a redemption event to boost consumption. Lei Mingxuan agreed and asked Xiao Lin to draft a simple plan quickly for launch.
location: B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Shooting new products, online promotion, and tending the store.
description: Changed into a mountain-style techwear outfit - gray-green multi-pocket cargo pants and a black quick-dry long-sleeve shirt. In front of the arranged backdrop, took dozens of selfies with the new phone and had Xiao Lin help take live photos. After selecting about a dozen, edited them to adjust brightness and contrast, then sent them to friend Qian Duoduo for Xiaohongshu promotion advice. At the same time, made personalized WeChat recommendations based on regular customers' dressing styles, such as recommending mountain-style pants to Liu Ge, who likes sporty looks. In the afternoon, as customer traffic increased, brainstormed the promotion plan while watching the store.
location: “Mingxuan Collection,” Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Closing the store and buying groceries on the way home
description: He checked the sales records and inventory, turned off the cash register system, checked the power supply and the rolling door, and locked up the shop. On the way home on foot, he went to Pushang Food Market and bought pork ribs, fresh vegetables, and spring onions to add to dinner. After about 5 minutes' walk from the market, he returned to Shanggang Community.
location: Pushang Market on Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family dinner and after-dinner rest
description: After returning home, he handed the ingredients to his mother and changed into loungewear. Dinner included sweet and sour pork ribs, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and braised pork. The family of three sat around the table. Lei Mingxuan poured yellow rice wine for his father as they talked about the day's business and photo shooting plans. His father asked about his knee condition. After dinner, they cleared the dishes together and watched the news with his parents, during which he checked Qian Duoduo's professional advice on the photos and agreed to send the original images the next day.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Immersive novel writing
description: I entered the study, opened the laptop, played ambient sound, and focused on continuing the second chapter of 'The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane,' adding an inner monologue for the protagonist and writing nearly 3,000 words in one go. Afterwards, I used a voice recorder to replay an interview with my neighbor Aunt Zhu in the Shanghai dialect, and noted vivid details such as 'cobblestone street,' 'briquette stove,' and 'public telephone' as material for future writing.
location: Study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Communicating with the illustrator about revision directions
description: He opened the tablet to review the first draft of Afternoon at Xiafei Lane sent by illustrator Chen Yu, and used WeChat voice messages to explain two revision comments: the protagonist's side profile should be softer with a hint of melancholy, and the old houses in the background should have a more retro, yellowish tone. After receiving Chen Yu's confirmation that the revised draft would be submitted tomorrow evening, he ended the conversation.
location: Study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening stretching and bedtime preparation.
description: Do a full-body stretch on the yoga mat in the bedroom, focusing on relaxing the lower back, shoulders, and neck, then wash up. Open the wardrobe to pick clothes for tomorrow's trip to the designer's studio to see samples. After lying in bed, browse Moments and customer service messages, reply to birthday wishes, review the fulfilling day, and turn off the lights to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning stretching and right knee care
description: After being woken by the 7 o'clock alarm, I stayed in bed for another five minutes to wake up my body. Then I spread out the yoga mat on the bedroom floor and first did ten minutes of full-body stretching, focusing on using a foam roller to relax my right calf and quadriceps. Next I completed three sets of single-leg glute bridges. I could feel the muscles around my right knee being activated, and the stiffness from the old injury basically disappeared.
location: Bedroom, Room 603, Building 11, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up, changing clothes, and preparing to go out.
description: After washing up, he changed into a black quick-dry T-shirt and gray athletic tapered pants, and put on the new cement-gray techwear vest from the store. He checked his phone, keys, wallet, and power bank, and confirmed that the iPad with the sales data outline was in his bag. He greeted his mother, Wang Xiuying, who had just gotten up, and told her that he had a date tonight and would be back late, so she didn't need to save him a meal.
location: Room 603, Building 11, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and commute to the store
description: Queued at the Ada Shengjian stall at the entrance of the residential community and bought four pork shengjian and a cup of soy milk, eating while walking. Then he walked to Dongchang Road Station on Metro Line 2, took the metro two stops, got off at Lujiazui Station, and arrived at Super Brand Mall at 8:25.
location: From the roadside stall at the entrance of Shanggang Community, No. 136 Lane, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Dongchang Road Station on Metro Line 2, take the metro to Lujiazui Station, then exit and go to Super Brand Mall at No. 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Morning Store Tidy-up and Check
description: After arriving at Shop A-208 on the second floor of Super Brand Mall, he opened the rolling shutter door with the key and started the cash register system. He walked around the store and reorganized the messy displays left after customers tried on clothes, by color and style. Then he opened the safe, took out the previous day's takings, and checked the cash, QR code payments, and membership card amounts against the cash register shift receipts one by one. After confirming the accounts and actual amounts matched, he entered the sales data into Excel. During this time, he ran into the mall's cleaning lady.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In-depth review of monthly business data
description: In the office area behind the store, he brewed a drip-bag coffee, opened his computer, and pulled up the sales reports for September and the first half of October. He analyzed the sales share of each category, inventory turnover days, and cash flow details item by item. He found that the techwear vest category had grown 15% in early October compared to September, but there was heavy inventory pressure on trousers. With a pencil, he wrote a preliminary estimate on a sticky note: Q4 rent about 85,000 yuan, and at least 200,000 yuan needed to be set aside for winter stock.
location: Office area behind Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Receiving customers and discussing the plan with store staff
description: Customers gradually began arriving at the shop. He received two young female customers who came together, recommended a gray-green mountain-style workwear outfit, answered their questions about the fabric's waterproof performance, and finally closed a sale of one jacket and one vest. After the flow of customers dwindled, he pulled the shop assistant Xiao Lin over to the coffee area, handed him a hot Americano, and asked about the progress of the draft loyalty points redemption plan Xiao Lin had proposed yesterday. Xiao Lin promised to send it before 3 p.m.
location: Coffee area, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch: healthy light meal
description: Went downstairs alone to FitMonkey, a casual restaurant on B1 of Super Brand Mall, and ordered a lemongrass chicken breast quinoa bowl for a change of taste. While waiting, he scrolled on his phone and saw his friend Qian Duoduo had posted a photo of yesterday's new product on WeChat Moments with a praising caption. He smiled and liked it.
location: FitMonkey light meal shop, B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lunch break and preparation for meeting guests
description: Returning to the store's coffee area, he rested on the sofa with his eyes closed for fifteen minutes. After waking up, he tidied the coffee table and deliberately hung several new techwear sample pieces that Zhao Min might like, including the "graphite black detachable techwear vest" and the "urban commuter tactical pants," on the clothing rack near the reception area for easy display.
location: Coffee area, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online customer communication and solution follow-up.
description: In the office area at the back of the store, I replied to online customer messages. Customer Chen Jie sent a photo of himself hiking in the store's outdoor jacket, complimenting him on looking handsome in it, and took the opportunity to invite him to the store's member day event on Saturday; he agreed. Then I received the 'Points Redemption Event Draft' sent on time by store clerk Xiao Lin. After a quick look, I thought the idea of 'spend 800 yuan and add 39 yuan to redeem a limited camping cup' was good, and replied on WeChat that the framework was feasible and would be refined in the afternoon.
location: Office area behind Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Finalized the pop-up exhibition collaboration with Zhao Min
description: At 2 p.m., Zhao Min, a planner at an exhibition company, arrived at the store on time, wearing a khaki trench coat and carrying a large laptop bag. The two sat down in the store's coffee area, and Zhao Min showed cases her team had handled at Jing An Kerry Centre and THE HUB. Combining the store's urban functional style and the "Lane Memory" idea they had discussed before, they hit it off even better, and proposed finding a trendy illustrator who understands old Shanghai longtangs to lead the visual design. They finally agreed orally to hold a two-week pop-up exhibition called "Urban Functional Style × Lane Memory" in the atrium of Super Brand Mall in mid-December. Zhao Min would be responsible for planning resources and venue approval, and Lei Jun would be responsible for product samples and liaising with the illustrator. Before leaving, Zhao Min took a liking to and bought a graphite-black functional vest. They agreed to meet next Wednesday at 2 p.m. at Cross Tower near Jing'an Temple to review case details and sign an MOU.
location: Coffee area, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Refine the event plan and prepare for store closing
description: After seeing off Zhao Min, he jotted down the plan details in his memo. Then he called over shop assistant Xiao Lin, and the two spent an hour refining the points-redemption plan, determining the activity rules, promotional poster design requirements, and materials list, and asked Xiao Lin to send out the finalized version the next day. At 5:15 he began closing-up preparations: tidying the cash register, stapling together that day's sales receipts, turning off the air conditioning and display lights, and instructing Xiao Lin to clear the store and lock up, then he left first.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk home
description: Put on a light jacket, put on earphones and listened to Li Zongsheng's Hills, crossed the footbridge from Super Brand Mall, walked along Lujiazui Ring Road to Pudong Avenue, and returned to Shanggang Community in about twenty minutes. The autumn evening breeze was pleasant, and while walking, planned the questions to ask at dinner with Lao Zhou tonight.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: At-home HIIT training, stretching, and shower
description: After arriving home, I greeted my mother, changed into a tank top and shorts, spread out the yoga mat in the living room, and followed a fitness app for an hour of high-intensity interval training: five circuits of jumping jacks, high knees, mountain climbers, burpees, and squat jumps, each set 40 seconds with 20 seconds rest. By the end, I was sweating profusely and my heart rate hit 170. After that, I did full-body stretching, especially fully stretching my right knee. Then I took a quick shower, changed into a clean navy blue polo shirt and khaki pants, put on a bit of woody-scented light perfume, and got ready to go out for my appointment.
location: Living room and bathroom, Room 603, Building 11, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commutered to the restaurant.
description: Starting from home, walk to Dongchang Road Station on Metro Line 2, ride one stop to Century Avenue Station, transfer to Line 6 to Pudian Road Station, then walk about five minutes after exiting to reach Lao Jishi Shanghainese Restaurant on Laoshan Road. The whole trip takes about fifteen minutes.
location: Starting from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, taking Metro Line 2, transferring at Dongchang Road Station to Line 6, arriving at Pudian Road Station, and then reaching Old Jesse Restaurant at 642 Laoshan Road.

name: Hosted Lao Zhou for dinner and asked him about his experience with self-driving trips in western Sichuan.
description: The outdoor expert Lao Zhou, met in the Pudong Three Musketeers group, came as invited. They ordered the signature braised pork, oil-braised shrimp, scallion-oil noodles, and stir-fried clover with pork intestine. They poured huangjiu for Lao Zhou and humbly asked about self-driving trips in western Sichuan. Lao Zhou recommended the classic route of Chengdu-Danba-Xinduqiao-Litang in detail, explained ways to deal with altitude sickness (take Rhodiola one week in advance, and don't wash your hair or take a shower on the first day after arrival), emphasized the importance of essential gear (tow strap, air pump, recovery boards, pulse oximeter), and specifically told him to go on a 5 km morning run every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday from now on to build up physical fitness. Lei Jun carefully took notes in his phone's memo. Lao Zhou said with satisfaction that he would send a self-made equipment list later. They had a great conversation, and Lei Jun rushed to pay the bill.

Then I went to my mother Wang Xiuying, who was watching a TV series, and seriously explained the physical fitness requirements of the Western Sichuan plateau, hoping to adjust the family's diet structure to a low-salt, low-oil, light diet with more vegetables and chicken breast. Mother readily agreed, saying she would start tomorrow with steamed fish and blanched vegetables and put away the dark soy sauce.

After returning home, I threw all the potato chips, cookies, and cola from the coffee table into the trash, keeping only the glass jar with nuts and goji berries.
