description: In the store, brewed a latte and called Zhou Tao, a fabric supplier in Hangzhou. Honestly explained the reasons for the decision to postpone the brand upgrade, communicated that the original big order at the end of the year would be cut in half and postponed to March 2026, with the 30,000 yuan deposit already paid converted into a prepayment for new goods. Both parties added each other on WeChat and confirmed the delivery time of the new contract template. The conversation lasted about 20 minutes, and Zhou Tao expressed understanding.
location: 'Xiafeiji' Store, Level 2, Unit A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Handled order adjustments with the Guangzhou supplier
description: After hanging up with Zhou Tao, he contacted Guangzhou accessories supplier Wu Fang via WeChat voice and sent a long voice message clearly expressing the request to postpone the accessories order originally scheduled for late November to February next year. Wu Fang readily agreed, saying she didn't want to stock up at the end of the year either. All order adjustments with the two suppliers were completed before 11 o'clock.
location: 'Xiafeiji' Store, Level 2, Unit A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Online store maintenance and community marketing
description: Opened the Xiaohongshu backend to check Qian Duoduo's preheating post data (158 new saves, 43 likes). Posted a nine-grid techwear-style photo set in WeChat groups and tagged @Qian Duoduo for interaction, with the caption 'Monday hustle vibe'. Also reposted his cousin Shen Jie's pop-up exhibition teaser poster on Moments, adding the comment: 'See you at the end of the month, Boss Lei's new stuff!'
location: 'Xiafeiji' Store, Level 2, Unit A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Healthy lunch and industry learning
description: At 12:00 he locked up the shop and walked to Youse Healthy Light Food on B1 of the IFC, ordered a set meal of mixed grain rice, stir-fried zucchini with shrimp, and blanched broccoli, and ate it standing up. He then returned to the Starbucks on the 1st floor of Super Brand Mall, bought a tall Americano, and sat by the window browsing content from top outdoor influencers on Xiaohongshu on his phone, learning techwear styling and shooting ideas, and reading reports on Tokyo Fashion Week.
location: B1 of Shanghai IFC, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China — “Youse Healthy Light Food”, and Starbucks on the 1st floor of Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Afternoon store operations and display updates.
description: Back at the store, he changed the summer sample displays, steamed the two newly arrived boxes of autumn clothing, and put them on the shelves. He received three groups of customers and successfully sold a techwear windbreaker and two base-layer tops. At 3:30 p.m., he ran into Zheng Kai, the mall's property manager, and briefly discussed the renovation delay. Zheng Kai said he would keep an eye on the renovation filing window in the first quarter of next year.
location: 'Xiafeiji' Store, Level 2, Unit A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Wrap-up preparations
description: Checked the day's sales records, confirmed the cashier was correct, and shut down the computer. Counted the roller-skating backpack and placed it in a visible spot at the front desk, then left a message for the neighboring store owner about leaving half an hour early.
location: 'Xiafeiji' Store, Level 2, Unit A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Going home to change clothes and heading to the riverside roller skating spot
description: Rode the e-bike home, quickly changed into a thin long-sleeve sports top, sports shorts, and roller-skating protective gear, and drank half a glass of water. Replied to Song Jia on WeChat to confirm meeting by the riverside at 5:15. Then rode the e-bike along the riverside greenway to the meeting point near Yichang Art Museum and joined up with Song Jia.
location: The road section near Yicang Art Museum at 4777 Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Roller skating and exchanging tips with good friend Song Jia by the riverside
description: The two of them put on their protective gear and skated at a moderate pace along the riverside path, chatting as they went. Song Jia shared the details of last weekend's Suzhou urban inline skating marathon, while Lei Mingxuan talked at length about his initial ideas and route for the western Sichuan self-driving trip, asking Song Jia, an outdoor enthusiast, for advice on building up physical stamina. They skated for about 1 hour and 15 minutes and burned a lot of calories.
location: The road section near Yicang Art Museum at 4777 Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Family dinner and informing parents of the decision to postpone the brand
description: After saying goodbye to Song Jia, he rode his electric bike home, took a shower, and changed into loungewear. After a short rest in the living room replying to WeChat messages, he had dinner with his parents. His mother had prepared braised beef brisket with tomatoes, stir-fried asparagus, steamed purple sweet potatoes, and stir-fried clams. At the dinner table, Lei Mingxuan calmly told his parents in a relaxed but formal tone about the decision to postpone the brand flagship store upgrade, the reasons (cash flow safety, avoiding vicious year-end competition), and future plans (pop-up exhibition, online operations). His father, Lei Jianguo, said, 'Where there's life, there's hope,' and his mother reminded him that the most important thing in business is longevity and that he shouldn't overwork himself. With his family's understanding, Lei Mingxuan felt a weight lifted from his mind.
location: Home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening online interaction and fiction writing.
description: After dinner, while scrolling on his phone in the living room, he saw that Shen Jie's flash exhibition preview Moments posts and the buyer group invitation data were doing well, so he immediately replied, "Thanks, top buyer Shen! Go for it!" and reposted them in his own Moments and on social groups. Then he went back to the bedroom, opened his laptop, and updated his historical novel Afternoon in Xiafei Lane, focusing on the details of watching posters on the street in the autumn of 1937, writing about 1,500 characters. Afterward, he browsed Bilibili and watched a recommended video for a Tibet self-driving route to relax.
location: Home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Exercise recovery and pre-sleep preparation
description: Before bed, I used a foam roller on my thighs and calves for 15 minutes of deep relaxation after roller skating, then drank a glass of warm water and replied to a few friends' WeChat messages.
location: Home Bedroom, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Tidy up and wash up before bed
description: He organized his sports backpack and placed the items to bring the next day by the door, then took a shower, brushed his teeth, and did a simple evening skincare routine. At 22:45 he lay down and reviewed the day: the supplier issue was resolved, family communication went smoothly, and the outdoor activity was refreshing, leaving him feeling grounded. He opened the health app on his phone to record the day's exercise, and at 23:00 turned off the lights and went to bed on time.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning Strength Training and Breakfast
description: Woke up naturally at 6:55 a.m., drank half a glass of warm water on an empty stomach, then started strength training, including pull-ups on the door frame, 18kg dumbbell rows, bent-over lateral raises, and crunches, followed by stretching after the workout. After showering, changed into camel cargo pants and a black quick-dry T-shirt. For breakfast, ate the oil-free fried eggs, multigrain porridge, and black coffee prepared by his mother, while using his phone to check today's to-do list and illustration materials.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuted to the store by electric bike
description: He put on his helmet and Bluetooth earphones, rode an electric bike from Shanggang Community on Pudong Avenue, turned right from Pudong Avenue into Lujiazui West Road, and arrived at the parking area behind Super Brand Mall in about 15 minutes. The weather was clear, 19–24°C, with a light breeze.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai, along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui West Road.

name: Store Preparation, Online Order Handling, and Illustration Collaboration Communication
description: After arriving at the store, he turned on the system and the lights, checked the displays, wiped the shelves with a dry cloth, and adjusted the way the mountain-style jacket was styled on the mannequin. He processed the three online orders from last night (two jackets, one set of quick-dry top and pants), printed the shipping labels, and packed them. Then he brewed a pour-over coffee, contacted illustrator Chen Yu, and sent photos of functional details for reference for her second illustration. They chatted by voice for 40 minutes about the composition (the main character sitting on a bamboo chair at the entrance to the alley drinking coffee, with an old wall and graffiti in the background), and he transferred a 1,000 yuan advance payment.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations: morning customer reception and community engagement
description: In the morning I received several groups of customers. I styled a couple in soft-shell jackets and tactical vests, added them on WeChat, and sent them outfit photos. I took pictures of the newly arrived bright-colored jackets and posted them to the VIP community and Moments together with illustrator Chen Yu's first illustration draft, with the caption: 'When traditional alleyways meet modern techwear, a new season of styling inspiration is live.'
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and banking errands
description: Went to Ippudo on B1 of Shanghai ifc mall for Japanese ramen (signature Akamaru ramen with less oil and a soft-boiled egg), and meanwhile checked the Xiaohongshu backend to see interactions on the store's posts. After the meal, rode an electric scooter to Standard Chartered Bank Tower to handle a time deposit passbook: deposited 10,000 yuan from the 11,000 yuan rent that arrived yesterday into a 6-month fixed deposit with automatic renewal. Then consulted financial manager Xu Feng and transferred the remaining 1,000 yuan into a T+0 money fund as an emergency reserve for the store. After everything was done, rode the electric scooter back to the Super Brand Mall store.
location: B1 Level, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; 1F, Standard Chartered Bank Tower, No. 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations: received regular and new customers in the afternoon
description: In the afternoon, regular customer Sister Xiaoyu (Feng Xiaoyu) brought a friend to the store, and he brewed pour-over coffee to host them. Sister Xiaoyu tried on a softshell jacket and made a purchase, and her friend chose a techwear vest. Then a young man named Xiao Zhao from Yangpu District came into the store. He had seen Shen Jie's recommendation on WeChat Moments and was clearly looking for a windproof vest. After the recommendation, he was successfully converted, and he also added a bucket hat to his purchase.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leisure time: drinking coffee and replying to messages
description: Taking advantage of the quiet store, he went to the Starbucks on the same floor to buy a latte and sat on a high stool at the store entrance to rest. He replied to Song Jia, who he went roller skating with yesterday, and they talked about strength training and interval running plans.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations: evening peak and closing procedures
description: During the evening rush, he served several groups of customers and closed two sales. After the foot traffic thinned, he began closing up: tidying the clothes that customers had left messy after trying them on, counting the day's sales of about 3,800 yuan, and noting the niche-brand T-shirts that needed restocking the next day.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buy tea leaves, pick up cousin Shen Jie and take her home.
description: He closed the store early, first walked to the Bama Tea Poly Plaza store to buy two cans of Tieguanyin for his father. Then he met up with his cousin Shen Jie and rode his electric bike to take her back to her place near Pudong Avenue. Shen Jie sat on the back seat and shared the latest progress of the pop-up exhibition, mentioning that an outdoor photographer friend might come and support. When they said goodbye downstairs, Shen Jie laughed and said, 'Bro, you're really filial.' After that, he rode home.
location: Bama Tea (Shanghai Poly Plaza Store), 18 Dongfang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai; Shen Jie's residence near Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and father-son chess and conversation.
description: After arriving home, I enjoyed the dinner my mother had made: braised pork ribs, steamed sea bass, and lettuce with garlic. I gave the Tieguanyin tea to my father. At the dinner table, I reported on depositing the travel fund in the bank and the pop-up exhibition plan with Shen Jie. My father nodded and said, “Steady.” My mother told me not to get too tired. After dinner, my father took the initiative to invite me to play chess. While playing, we discussed the idea for a self-driving route through western Sichuan and drew the route Chengdu–Kangding–Xinduqiao–Litang–Daocheng Yading–Chengdu. My father asked about road conditions and altitude sickness. After he lost the game, he put away the chess pieces and said, “When doing things, it’s better to be steady. Once you’ve thought it through, go.”
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening washing up, relaxation, and bedtime preparation
description: Used a foam roller for deep relaxation on my back and arms, then took a shower and changed into loungewear. Flossed while listening to a podcast. Leaning on the bed, I scrolled through Xiaohongshu, saved a post about a niche weekend hiking route in Shanghai, and watched two episodes of the anime "Frieren: Beyond Journey's End." I opened my phone's notes app to review today: illustration communication went smoothly, bank matters were handled, new customer conversion was good, and I talked with my father about the Western Sichuan plan. I updated the "Western Sichuan Self-Drive Preparation Checklist" and added "check rental car company." Lights out at 22:30, and I fell asleep with a sense of fulfillment.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run and return home
description: In the morning, he jogged 3 km at Lujiazui Central Green Park, lowering the intensity to let his body recover and keep his mind clear. After the run, he stretched on a park bench, then walked through the alley back to his home in the Shanggang community, greeting neighbors who were doing morning exercise downstairs.
location: From Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Family breakfast.
description: After getting home, he showered and changed into clean clothes. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared a healthy breakfast: a whole-wheat sandwich (with lettuce, tomato, and fried egg) and homemade almond milk. During the meal, he chatted with his mother and mentioned the important cooperation negotiation that afternoon. His mother reminded him to pay attention to his appearance.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and store preparation
description: He walked to Lujiazui Metro Station, took Metro Line 2 to Lujiazui Station, and after exiting walked to Super Brand Mall. Passing the mall bulletin board, he noticed that the reserved "Autumn Renewal Season" promotional space was not yet live. After arriving at the store, he opened the door, turned on the lights, played music, dusted the display shelves with a duster, and received a package from Lao Zhou containing five spring samples from Southeast Asian niche brands, including two tie-dye shirts.
location: Xiafei Collection, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sample quality inspection and online operations
description: In the store, I spread the samples flat on the worktable, carefully inspected the fabric composition, stitching, and button firmness, and used my phone's macro mode to photograph the details of the tie-dyed shirt, sending them to my cousin Shen Jie for feedback. At the same time, I handled 3 online orders (entering order details and printing shipping labels), posted a new-product preview with images in the customer WeChat group, and had a voice chat with Shen Jie to discuss her evaluation of the samples.
location: Xiafei Collection, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Noon break and pre-meeting preparation
description: Ate the homemade bento in the store: roasted pumpkin, pan-seared chicken breast, and boiled chickpeas with vinaigrette. While eating, he checked mobile banking and saw that the net value of the money market fund he had purchased yesterday rose to 1,010.23 yuan. Then he called his father, Lei Guoqiang, to ask about dinner; his father reminded him to use less oil. After the meal, he changed in the fitting room into a light blue oxford shirt and white pants, organized the mall floor plan and the USB drive with budget materials for the afternoon discussion, then locked the store door and went to the basement garage to pick up his car.
location: Xiafei Collection, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Visit the partner company and take a tour.
description: Drove from Super Brand Mall to Shanghai International Convention Center, calling Zhao Min along the way to inform her of the itinerary and reviewing materials. After arriving, Zhao Min led a tour of the company's materials warehouse and 3D-printed miniature models of past pop-up exhibitions, then in the meeting room used the mall floor plan to roughly sketch the booth circulation route and main light source positions.
location: Shanghai Jingchen International Exhibition Co., Ltd., 18th Floor, Shanghai International Convention Center, 2727 Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pop-up exhibition project negotiation and cooperation signing
description: In the meeting room, had an in-depth discussion with Zhao Min on key details of the December pop-up exhibition, including the budget sharing ratio, booth traffic flow design, and main lighting arrangement. After two hours of efficient communication, they reached a consensus, drafted and printed a preliminary memorandum of understanding on the spot, and both parties checked and signed it, marking the official launch of the project.
location: Shanghai Jingchen International Exhibition Co., Ltd., 18th Floor, Shanghai International Convention Center, 2727 Binjiang Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return trip and closing up the store
description: On the way back to Super Brand Mall, he shared the good news of the successful contract signing with Shen Jie via car Bluetooth. After arriving at the store, he hung the quality-inspected tie-dyed shirts in the display window, told the part-time clerk Xiao Chen to organize the online-order packages for shipment the next day, then counted the day's cash revenue and recorded it in the accounts.
location: Xiafei Ji, Unit A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and along the way

name: Shopping on the bike ride home
description: After tidying my outfit, I rode a shared bike home. Passing Yanqin Grocery Store on the way, I stopped to buy a bottle of aged vinegar to restock the seasonings at home.
location: From near Yanqin Grocery Store, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Residential Quarter, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Family dinner and leisure time.
description: When I got home, Mom had already made dinner: stir-fried spinach, shrimp steamed eggs, cucumber salad, and multigrain porridge. We sat around the table eating, and I excitedly shared my successful contract signing experience from the afternoon. My father, Lei Guoqiang, was happy for his son, and my mother, Wang Xiuying, lovingly told me to rest. After dinner, I rested on the sofa, checked the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group, and voice-replied to my friend Han Dong's invitation to have hotpot over the weekend, politely declining by citing my recent fitness routine and joking around.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: High-intensity interval training and stretching at home
description: Changed into workout clothes, laid out the yoga mat in the living room, and did a HIIT fat-burning workout: 4 rounds of 30 seconds of jumping jacks and high knees, followed by 3 sets of push-ups (15 reps each) and 3 sets of weighted squats (12 reps each with a 20 kg kettlebell). After training, I carefully stretched the front and back of my thighs and my back muscles, then weighed myself at 79.8 kg, down 0.3 kg from the previous day, one step closer to my goal, and satisfied with the gradually clearer abdominal definition.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Shower and muscle relaxation
description: Took a hot shower to wash off the sweat, then used a foam roller in the bedroom, focusing on the outer thighs, inner thighs, and back muscles to relieve deep muscle tension from the workout.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Planning and journaling before bed.
description: Leaning on the bed, I organized key ideas for the pop-up exhibition in my phone's memo app, saved "tie-dye + techwear" outfit inspiration on Xiaohongshu, confirmed sample feedback with Shen Jie via WeChat (she agreed that the tie-dye fabric could go into a small trial order), and chatted about weekend plans. Then I set an alarm for 7 a.m. the next day, dimmed the lights, reviewed the fulfilling and disciplined progress of the day, felt grounded, and fell asleep before 11 p.m.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Run 5 km in the morning and achieve the monthly goal
description: Woken by the alarm at 6:30 in the morning, I saw that it was already bright outside. Without hesitation, I changed into quick-dry clothes and running shoes, took a sip of water, and walked 10 minutes to Gate 1 of Century Park. The morning temperature was about 17°C, slightly cool on the skin, perfect for running. I deliberately increased my cadence and kept a pace of 5:20 per kilometer, steadily completing 5 kilometers along the outer loop track, and it felt easy. After finishing, the phone app showed that this month's running mileage had hit exactly 30 kilometers, reaching the small goal I set at the start of the month, and I felt a real sense of accomplishment. I stretched carefully for 10 minutes by the lakeside flower beds, took photos of the track and morning light, and sent them to the family group chat. My father, Lei Jianguo, liked it immediately.
location: Running track inside Gate 1 of Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go home, wash up, and have a nutritious breakfast
description: Walked home at a leisurely pace. After entering, I took a hot shower to wash off the sweat from the morning run and felt refreshed. The scale showed exactly 80.0 kg, and my body fat percentage was stable—a good sign. Mother Wang Xiuying had prepared breakfast: two fried eggs without oil, a piece of steamed pumpkin, and a cup of nonfat yogurt—simple and healthy. Sitting at the table, I ate while chatting with my father Lei Jianguo, who was watching the morning news, and my mother, who was about to go out to buy groceries. I told them I needed to go to the store today to finalize the winter new-arrival stocking, and they both approved.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Commute and store opening preparation
description: Put on a casual blazer and a crossbody bag, walked 5 minutes to Century Avenue Metro Station, took Metro Line 2 to Lujiazui Station, bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea at FamilyMart when exiting the station, then walked 7 minutes to his own clothing store on the second floor of Super Brand Mall. After arriving, he skillfully opened the rolling shutter door, started up the cash register system, and checked the lighting and displays. He then spent 15 minutes packing the previous day's online orders (3 items: one techwear vest and two pairs of cargo pants) and affixed the shipping labels. After that, he opened his laptop and organized the week's sales data in Excel, focusing on analyzing the try-on rate and inquiry volume of the new techwear down jacket from last week. The data showed it had the potential to become a bestseller, boosting his confidence in stocking up.
location: Own clothing store, Super Brand Mall, 2F, A-208, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Discuss winter stocking over the phone.
description: In the store, he called Zhou Tao, the fabric supplier in Hangzhou, and got straight to the point. Based on the data analysis, he decided to increase the stocking quantity of the two winter functional down jackets by 30%, and requested the latest upgraded fabric color cards and inspection reports. Zhou Tao readily agreed, promised to complete the first batch of delivery before November 15, and emphasized that the upgraded fabric had better warmth and water resistance. The two sides finalized the key contract terms. After hanging up, he noted a to-do item in his memo: "Remind Zhou Tao to send samples before November 5."
location: Own clothing store, Super Brand Mall, 2F, A-208, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: In-store display adjustments and customer transactions
description: After the shop assistant Xiao Chen arrived, Lei Mingxuan had him handle online messages and assist customers with trying on clothes. He personally adjusted the 'Autumn Techwear Theme Display' in the center of the store, styling the few new sample pieces that had just arrived, using adjustable stands and props to create an outdoor urban feel. During this time, a young man working at Pudong Software Park was attracted into the store by the display at the entrance. Lei Mingxuan went up and recommended a lightweight techwear jacket paired with tapered pants. After trying them on, the customer was very satisfied and paid on the spot, with a transaction amount of 1,850 yuan, making a good start to the day.
location: Own clothing store, Super Brand Mall, 2F, A-208, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lunch and writing ideas
description: He had Xiao Chen watch the store, then took out the healthy bento he had prepared that morning: quinoa rice, stir-fried beef, and stir-fried okra. After heating it up in the employee rest area on level B1 of Super Brand Mall, he found a corner and sat down. While eating, he recalled the mental journey of writing his novel off and on for over a month, noted down a few key time points and feelings in his phone memo, and sketched out the rough framework for the short essay "The Literary Dream of a Clothing Store Owner" that he planned to write in the evening.
location: Staff rest area, B1 floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon shop chores and shipping orders
description: After lunch, he returned to the store and let Xiao Chen go out to eat. There were not many customers during this period, so he sat behind the cash register and scrolled through Xiaohongshu for a while, browsing the winter clothing launch updates and outfit notes of several peer stores, and saved a few nice outfit photos. Then he took the three parcels packed at noon to the designated courier pickup/drop-off point in the mall downstairs and sent them out. After coming back, he checked the store's utility and property management bills for the week, confirmed they were correct, and filed them away.
location: Own clothing store, Super Brand Mall, 2F, A-208, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Arranged a billiards game with friend Han Dong.
description: At around two in the afternoon, his good buddy Han Dong sent a WeChat asking if he was free in the evening to play billiards, saying it had been a long time since they last played together. Realizing he hadn't touched a cue much this month, he readily agreed and arranged to meet at Pudong Billiards Club at 7 PM. The two then chatted for a while over voice messages. Han Dong complained about the grind of recent overtime, while he shared the good news that he had finalized stocking up with Zhou Tao that day, and Han Dong was happy for him. The whole exchange took place in the store without affecting his normal work.
location: Own clothing store, Super Brand Mall, 2F, A-208, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Wrapping up work and preparing to leave
description: Started sorting through the several returned items that arrived in the afternoon, inspected them, and put them back in place. Gave Xiao Chen, the store clerk, clear closing duties: mop the floor, count the cash register, and turn off the power. After everything was arranged, I changed out of my work uniform around 4:30 p.m. and ended the day's store shift early.
location: Own clothing store, Super Brand Mall, 2F, A-208, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Going home, picking up packages, and family dinner
description: Walked from Super Brand Mall to Century Avenue Station, took Metro Line 2 back to Century Avenue Station, then walked home after exiting the station. On the way, I stopped by the Cainiao parcel station at the entrance of the neighborhood to pick up the package that arrived the day before yesterday (a box of seasonal fruit air-freighted from Yunnan). I got home just at 5 p.m. My mother, Wang Xiuying, had already prepared dinner: specially made low-oil pan-fried buns stuffed with shrimp, and a light green vegetable and tofu soup, which fit perfectly with my diet plan. While eating, I told my mother about the sense of accomplishment from finishing the morning run and hitting the monthly goal, as well as the good news about finalizing the stock replenishment in the afternoon. She was happy too and reminded me not to overwork myself.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, home at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Rest and change clothes
description: After dinner, I helped my mother clear the dishes. Then I returned to my room, changed into a loose athletic hoodie and casual pants, and prepared for the evening billiards activity. I also lay down for fifteen minutes, browsed anime news sites, checked updates on new anime episodes, and relaxed.
location: Home bedroom at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Played billiards with Han Dong.
description: Arrived at Pudong Billiards Club 10 minutes early and got a standard American eight-ball table. At 7 pm, Han Dong arrived right on time. The two of us played for nearly two hours, and we both had a good feel for the game, with each of us taking some wins. Drawing on the relaxed state after my run, I made several precise long shots, and Han Dong praised that my ball sense was still on. During breaks, we drank sports drinks, talked about our work and relationship updates, and agreed to find a weekend in November to play longer.
location: Pudong Billiards Club, 588 Nanquan North Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Write and share a personal article
description: After billiards, I walked home, took a shower, and felt full of energy. I went into the study and opened my laptop. Following the outline I had conceived at noon, I began writing the short essay “A Clothing Store Owner’s Literary Dream.” In it, I reviewed the real feelings of trying to write a novel this summer, being urged by readers for updates, and drawing business inspiration from creation. The full text was about 800 words. After careful proofreading, I published it in the novel-lovers group and on Moments, with a photo of the desk corner where I usually write. Within minutes of posting, I received likes and encouraging comments from over ten friends; some even left messages urging me to update, which was very uplifting.
location: Home Study, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Body stretching and relaxation
description: After completing the writing task, both mind and body felt fulfilled. To relieve the muscle fatigue from this morning's jogging and billiards, I took out a yoga mat and foam roller and carefully rolled my calves, front thighs, and lower back in the living room, about three minutes per part. Then I did several rounds of cat stretch and child's pose, feeling the tight muscles completely relaxed.
location: Living room at home, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparations
description: Turned off the living room's main light and returned to the bedroom. Set the alarm for 6:40 tomorrow, checked tomorrow's weather forecast on my phone, and confirmed it would be sunny. Plugged in my phone and put tomorrow's clothes by the bed. Lying under the covers, I reflected on the day's efficiency and fulfillment — I'd hit my monthly running target, finalized the winter stocking plan, played a great ball game with friends, and completed a personal creative piece that received positive feedback. I felt calm and content, and soon fell asleep.
location: Home bedroom at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and family breakfast
description: After the phone alarm rang, Lei Mingxuan got out of bed and stepped on the smart scale; it read 80.0 kg, the same as the day before. After washing up, he sat by the window and wrote in his diary, reviewing his October fitness results: he ran 30 kilometers, did 9 strength-training sessions, and his weight dropped steadily from 81.5 to 80.0. His November plan was to run 4 times a week plus one 10-kilometer run. Then he changed into a T-shirt and went to the dining room, where his mother had prepared pan-fried pork buns and freshly ground soy milk. While eating, he told her that today was the last day of the month and the final day of the pre-sale warm-up, so he might be home late, and he promised to bring his parents milk tea in the evening.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and online warm-up review
description: Lei Mingxuan walked to Century Avenue Metro Station and took Metro Line 2 to Super Brand Mall. On the platform, he checked Xiaohongshu data: Qian Duoduo's new product preview video had over 300 likes with positive comments; his cousin Shen Jie's WeChat Moments check-in and sticker giveaway had over 100 interactions. The online warm-up was going well, which made him feel more at ease.
location: On the way from Century Avenue Metro Station (Line 2) to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store work and receiving business partners.
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan first turned on his computer to handle online orders and pack express parcels for Hangzhou and Nanjing. He went over the 10 featured sample garments in mountain-style techwear for the next day's pop-up show with store clerk Xiao Lin, tidied the displays, and hung the co-branded T-shirt Shen Jie had given him on the most prominent center island. At 9:30, Shen Jie arrived on time and handed him the belated birthday gift, a techwear co-branded T-shirt. After Lei Mingxuan tried it on, the two chatted over pour-over coffee. Shen Jie shared her impressions of the Beijing buyers' show and gave professional suggestions on the lighting and customer flow of the pop-up show. Lei Mingxuan made notes on each one and confirmed her arrival time for the next day. During the morning rush that followed, Lei Mingxuan personally attended to regular customers, recommending khaki cargo pants paired with a hardshell jacket in the same color and closing about 1,200 yuan in sales. He also updated the WeChat group that the number of reservations had exceeded 30, urging Xiao Lin to arrive at the store early the next day. Qian Duoduo responded that she would post Stories again in the afternoon to build more buzz.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: The delivery arrived. Lei Mingxuan enjoyed his usual Super Bowl FOODBOWL quinoa chicken warm bowl and unsweetened oolong tea behind the cash register. While eating, he watched a high-energy animated PV shared by Gao Yuan on Bilibili. Though there were no subtitles, the music and visuals drew him in. Inspired, he immediately searched Zhihu and Douban for learning Japanese from zero on your own and bookmarked two highly upvoted experience posts. He learned about the Standard Japanese textbook and the Duolingo app, and decided that starting tomorrow he would memorize five kana each day during his commute and the ten minutes before opening the store.
description: Taking advantage of the midday lull, Lei Mingxuan went to a Japanese casual restaurant on the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall and ordered tonkotsu ramen and fried dumplings, while starting an online WeChat group meeting with Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie. The total number of reservations had exceeded 30. Qian Duoduo suggested posting another Story in the afternoon to boost interest, and Shen Jie reminded everyone to check tomorrow's material kit (stickers, display stands, QR codes). The three quickly reached an agreement.
location: Japanese casual restaurant, B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon customer reception and supplier follow-up
description: In the afternoon, he walked around the store observing customer reactions and proactively introduced techwear backpacks to three young customers. Around 2:30 p.m., he went to the Starbucks on the same floor, ordered an iced Americano, and sat down to handle messages from fabric supplier Lao Zhou: urged the winter down jacket samples to be shipped before November 10, and confirmed the sizing and fabric details for the additional 30% order. Afterwards, he replied to customer DMs about the flash exhibition reservation and shared a transportation guide for tomorrow morning.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the Starbucks on the same floor.

name: Evening peak operations, financial bookkeeping, and closing
description: During the evening rush, Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin served customers with full effort. Together with customers who had made online appointments and come to the store, they closed two high-ticket transactions: a classic functional-style shell jacket and a full outdoor outfit, totaling about 4,000 yuan in revenue. At 20:00, after seeing off the last customer, he let Xiao Lin get off work. He pulled down the rolling shutter door alone, opened his laptop at the cash register, and did the October financial review: he pulled up electricity and rent transfer vouchers, entered them into the online accounting software, and generated a profit-and-loss statement and a cash flow trend chart. The data showed that net profit this month had increased 8% over last month, and the mountain-style techwear category contributed 45% of gross profit. He also noted that the roughly 12,000 yuan invested in the pop-up exhibition was expected to break even and turn profitable in November. Afterwards, he went to the warehouse, opened the “Tiger Head” sample garment, checked the workmanship and fabric, took photos and sent them to Sister Fang in Guangzhou for confirmation, left a message asking for the logistics version to be sent before November 5, and hung it back in the ventilated area.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Cycling home and calling Dad
description: After leaving Super Brand Mall, Lei Mingxuan scanned a shared bike by the roadside and cycled home along Zhangyang Road. On the way, he called his father to let him know he would be home around 9:30, and decided to bring two cups of hot milk tea and fried chicken.
location: On the way home from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, riding a shared bike along Zhangyang Road.

name: Family Evening Talk and Online Review
description: After arriving home, his parents were still watching TV in the living room. Lei Mingxuan put the milk tea and fried chicken on the coffee table and briefly shared the day's shop performance and the month-end financial situation. His parents were happy for him. Then, wearing Bluetooth earphones and eating fried chicken, he joined an online review meeting with Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie. They summarized a week of pre-promotion data: Xiaohongshu posts had 15,000 total exposures, WeChat group interactions exceeded 200 messages, and 32 people had booked via private messages. The pre-promotion results exceeded expectations. Qian Duoduo proposed a live stream tomorrow, which was unanimously approved.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Before-Bed Stretching and Monthly Fitness Report
description: Lei Mingxuan did 5 minutes of pre-sleep stretching on the yoga mat in the bedroom, focusing on relaxing his shoulders, back, and hips. Then he lay in bed and opened Keep to check his October workout monthly report: total exercise time 14 hours, about 8,500 kcal burned, noticeable improvement in endurance, and a drop in body fat percentage that pleased him. He wrote his November plan in his phone notes: run four times a week, add one 10 km long run, and focus fully on building physical reserves for Western Sichuan.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: End-of-day journal and preparation for tomorrow
description: Lei Mingxuan sat on the bed and wrote his end-of-day diary in a leather notebook: 'October 31, closing day. Weight stable at 80 kg, store profits steady, and the pop-up exhibition warm-up exceeded expectations. November plan: execute the pop-up exhibition, prepare camping festival gear, and train for the western Sichuan plan. For a better self, move forward!' After finishing, he opened WeChat to remind Xiao Lin to arrive at the store one hour earlier tomorrow, sent a message to Shen Jie, then turned off the light and went to sleep.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and exhibition preparation
description: After waking up naturally, he felt refreshed. He first weighed himself: 80.0 kg, staying stable. Using the newly bought Ethiopian single-origin beans, he made pour-over coffee; the aroma woke up his brain. He then opened Duolingo to complete his daily Japanese check-in and reviewed camping-related words. He added food and changed water for his cat A Fu, then ate the breakfast of fried egg and toast his mother had left. He changed into his own store's functional workwear-style outfit, packed the samples needed for the exhibition, pour-over coffee equipment, live-streaming gear, and laptop. After checking everything, he said goodbye to his mother and headed out.
location: Inside the residence at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Subway commute and pre-exhibition planning.
description: Walk to Zhangyang Road Metro Station and take Line 6, transfer to Line 2 at Century Avenue Station, and go to Century Link Plaza. On the way, I wore earphones and listened to a fashion podcast. While standing, I rehearsed the booth layout in my head: tent setup, folding chair placement, and coffee equipment display positions. I also drafted the livestream opening and thought about how to blend outdoor life with online interaction.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, from Zhangyang Road Metro Station via Century Avenue Metro Station to Century Link Mall, 1192 Century Avenue

name: Morning exhibition and demonstration at the outdoor camping festival
description: Arrived at outdoor booth A-16, 'Xiafei Ji', at Century Link Plaza at 8:30. After confirming the power supply, he quickly set up a complete camping scene: pitched a tent, placed a folding table and chairs, laid out an ethnic-style moisture-proof mat, and decorated it with plants. When the venue opened at 9:00, he displayed pour-over equipment on the folding table and brewed coffee on site; the aroma attracted trendsetters and families. He demonstrated the water resistance of the techwear jacket by pouring water to show droplets rolling off, guided visitors to touch the fabric and scan a QR code to join the store's community, and promoted the 4 PM livestream. His colleague Qian Duoduo coordinated online by posting updates. The booth saw a steady stream of visitors through the morning, receiving about 200 people.
location: Booth A-16, Xiafeiji, Outdoor Plaza, Century Link Plaza, 1192 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and scouting the exhibition area
description: After the morning session ended, he had a teriyaki chicken cutlet set meal at a Japanese set meal restaurant in the B1 food court of Century Link Plaza, observing the surroundings while eating. After lunch, he walked around the outdoor exhibition area to visit other brand booths, focusing on outdoor cookware and inflatable tent designs. He noted down booth numbers and contact information, thought about possible cooperation, and gathered information for future store product selection.
location: B1 Food Court and Outdoor Exhibition Area, Century Link Plaza, No. 1192 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Afternoon Rest and Social Media Interaction
description: When the crowd at the booth thinned out a little, he spread a mat on the nearby artificial turf and half-lay in the sun, scrolling through Xiaohongshu. He found that netizens had already posted photos of the booth and were asking where to buy the shell jacket. Delighted, he replied to some comments at random, using the spare moments to maintain the online buzz.
location: Lawn near the Xiafeiji booth in the outdoor plaza of Century Link, No. 1192 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Rain shower emergency response and brand cooperation negotiation
description: At 2:30 in the afternoon, a sudden shower came down. He quickly reinforced the canopy seams with the spare double-layer tent fabric and guided customers into the tent to take shelter. After the rain lightened, he proactively lifted the door flap and gave an on-site waterproof and breathable demo using his own hardshell jacket, with humorous commentary that attracted more than ten onlookers. A middle-aged man in an outdoor vest watched the whole process and then handed him a business card. He was Manager Liu, East China regional representative of the Wild Walker camping coffee equipment brand. The two talked deeply in the tent for half an hour about the clothing + coffee hybrid model. Manager Liu expressed interest in a consignment partnership and agreed to visit the store next week for detailed discussion.

participant.name: Manager Liu
participant.relation: East China regional representative of the 'Wilderness Walker' brand

location: Xiafei Ji booth at the outdoor plaza of Century Link Plaza, No. 1192 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Exhibition wrap-up and gathering with friends
description: After the rain shower, colleague Qian Duoduo came to the booth to review the reception and community traffic generation, affirmed the results, and suggested posting a recap that night. Roller-skating friend Song Jia brought a hot oat milk latte and jokingly praised it. Lei Mingxuan updated his Moments and official account, posting a nine-grid selection of photos with the caption: Camping Festival first experience—even a rain shower couldn't dampen the enthusiasm. Before leaving, Manager Liu scanned the display shelves again and nodded in acknowledgment.
location: Xiafei Ji booth at the outdoor plaza of Century Link Plaza, No. 1192 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Dismantled the exhibition and returned the display props on the way
description: Starting at 4:30 p.m., dismantled the exhibition. Sorted and stored tents, tables and chairs, samples, and coffee equipment, then confirmed with the organizer that the venue was undamaged before taking a taxi to leave. Since the store would be operating the next day, went first to the Xiafeiji store at A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, Lujiazui West Road, put the large display items in the warehouse, reminded store clerk Xiao Lin about the next-day morning shift, and then returned home with the valuable samples.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, from Century Link Plaza, No. 1192 Century Avenue, via Store A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, to No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road

name: Return home, tidy up, and relax with a bath
description: After arriving home, I first hung up the sample clothes to air out and cleaned all the coffee equipment. I took a nice hot shower to relieve fatigue, changed into loungewear, then sat on the sofa to deal with unread phone messages and exhibition cooperation inquiries. My father came over and asked about the day; I kept him in suspense and said I would tell him in detail at dinner.
location: Living room and bathroom of the residence at No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Warm family dinner
description: Mother prepared braised pork ribs, stir-fried asparagus, and father's signature salted edamame. At the dinner table, he talked animatedly about dealing with the rain at the exhibition, attracting brands to reach out proactively, and having friends come to show support. Father praised his adaptability, while mother kept serving him food and urging him to eat more. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Night work review and next week's plan
description: After the meal, he went to the study and entered Manager Liu's business card information into his phone, noting 'consignment cooperation'. He opened Excel and created a spreadsheet to quantitatively review the expo data: about 200 people received, 37 new WeChat contacts, about 100 grams of coffee beans consumed, and a peak of 62 online viewers in the livestream, ready to share with colleagues. He also marked the preparation milestones for next week's pop-up exhibition on the calendar: confirm the logistics of the winter new sample clothing before November 10, and have all materials ready before the 15th.
location: Home study, No. 12, Lane 1589 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Living room relaxation and stretching exercises
description: After brewing tea, curled up on the sofa and watched two episodes of the Japanese anime *Frieren: Beyond Journey's End*. Then spread out a yoga mat and did 15 minutes of full-body stretching to relieve the fatigue of a day of standing and walking. During this time, scrolled through Xiaohongshu and saved several outdoor equipment designs to stay sensitive to fashion trends.
location: Living room, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Reading before bed and emotional reflection.
description: After washing up, he leaned against the headboard and read excerpts from Decisive Moments in History, then used his phone to select photos and videos from the exhibition, posted a WeChat Moments update summarizing his takeaways and thanking friends. Finally, he set his phone to sleep mode, reviewed the day's highlights in his mind, and looked forward to next week's collaboration.
location: Bedroom at the residence, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Sleep soundly.
description: After the lights were off, images flashed through my mind: the aroma of coffee by the tent, the smiling faces of the crowd in the rain, and Manager Liu handing over a business card. Though my body was tired, my heart felt full. My breathing gradually evened out and I soon fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at the residence, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning wake-up and Japanese check-in
description: After getting up in the morning, I did leg stretches and joint mobility exercises and weighed in at 80.1 kg. In the living room, I brewed hand-poured Yunnan small-bean coffee while completing a Japanese task on Duolingo and reviewing outdoor gear vocabulary.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (own living room)

name: Breakfast and departure preparation
description: Had breakfast with mother Wang Xiuying, eating white rice porridge, fried eggs, and osmanthus cake. While eating, browsed Xiaohongshu posts related to the camping festival on his phone and read comments on the booth's rain-proofing test video. Checked the items in the backpack, including a power bank, coffee cup, notebook, business card holder, and client list, and got ready to go out.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (family restaurant)

name: Commuting to the exhibition venue
description: He walked from home to Zhangyang Road Station on Metro Line 2, rode to Century Avenue Station, and went to Century Link Plaza. Along the way, he sent WeChat messages to Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie to confirm the evening gathering, and both replied that they were looking forward to it.
location: Century Link Plaza, LG1, Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Commute starting point: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, via Metro Line 2)

name: Exhibition setup and display adjustment
description: At the "Xiafei Collection" booth, dragged out the stored sample garments and gear, moved the best-selling gray-green waterproof jacket and black quick-dry pants to a prominent position, set up a standing sign reading "Scan the QR code to join the group and enjoy the launch discount price," and displayed bucket hats and sports sunglasses on hooks to enhance professionalism.
location: Xiafei Collection booth, outdoor plaza on LG1, Century Link Plaza, Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Camping Festival Day 2 exhibition
description: Received customers enthusiastically all day, introduced the clothing's waterproof and breathable fabrics, guided them to add him on WeChat and noted their preferences; added more than ten new contacts in the morning; went to the B1 food court at noon for beef brisket noodles; Manager Liu of Wild Walker passed by, and he had a detailed talk with him, agreeing to discuss in detail the consignment cooperation of clothing and coffee equipment at the Super Brand Mall store next Wednesday.
location: The Xiafei Ji booth on the LG1 outdoor plaza and the B1 food court at Century Link Plaza, Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dismantle the exhibition and return supplies to the shop
description: Closed the stall on time, packed up all the clothing, display racks, and roll-up banners, and moved them in batches with a small cart to the freight elevator; then rode a shared bike for about 15 minutes back to the store in Super Brand Mall, put the supplies back in place, and took inventory.
location: 'Xiafeiji' Store, Level 2, Unit A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (starting point: Century Link Plaza, cycling)

name: Rest and information organization
description: After drinking water and resting in the store, he organized the more than 80 WeChat customer notes accumulated over the past two days and classified them with tags such as "Techwear style" and "Mountain commute"; on Dianping, he reserved a private room for 7 PM at Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant in Lujiazui Center and sent the location to Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie; later, he browsed Bilibili to relax and tagged key customers on WeChat for follow-up.
location: The “Xiafei Collection” store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the celebration banquet.
description: After locking the store door, he walked to the Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant at Lujiazui Center; on the way, he worked on the “Trendy Outfit Livestream” plan, noting key points and key questions in his phone memo, ready to discuss with friends.
location: Lujiazui Center, No. 889 South Pudong Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (walking start: Super Brand Mall)

name: Celebration dinner and trend livestream brainstorming session
description: Gathered in a private room with Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie, toasting with tea instead of wine to celebrate the success of the expo, and tasting Shanghai-style clay pot dishes and braised pork. They had a lively discussion about launching a trendy outfit livestream while the iron was hot. Shen Jie suggested contacting niche techwear accessory designers for a collaboration. During the meal, they shared funny stories from the expo.
location: Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant (private room), Lujiazui Center, No. 889 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walked home and shopped at the convenience store.
description: After the gathering, he politely declined a friend's offer of a ride and walked home to aid digestion. Passing by FamilyMart, he bought unsweetened oolong tea. He shared group photos of the gathering in the “Pudong Three Musketeers” WeChat group and teased his friend Zhang Wei.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai (walking from Lujiazui Center at No. 889 South Pudong Road to No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, passing by FamilyMart)

name: Relaxing before bed and catching up on anime.
description: After getting home, took a hot shower, changed into pajamas, and lay in bed. Opened Bilibili to watch the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End; posted a Moments recap of the day with the caption “Sunday done! So fulfilling! Thanks everyone for the support! More exciting things next week!”; scrolled through comments and replied to messages, then turned off the lights and fell asleep around 11 p.m.
location: Home (bedroom), No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake-up and weigh-in
description: He got up after the alarm went off twice, still feeling the excitement of last night's celebration dinner with Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie, but he was clear-headed overall. The first thing he did was step on the scale and weigh himself; it showed 80.0 kg, his weight remained stable, and he was in a good mood.
location: Master bedroom at home, Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning commute and breakfast purchase.
description: Because I got up late, there was no time for pour-over coffee. I washed up quickly and went out. I walked to the FamilyMart convenience store at Lane 400, Yushan Road, bought a tuna sandwich and a bottle of water for breakfast. Then I walked to Pudong South Road Metro Station, took Line 2 to Lujiazui Station, and used a mobile app in the carriage to check in for that day's Japanese study.
location: FamilyMart (Yushan Road Store 2), No. 1-2, Lane 400, Yushan Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China, via Pudong South Road (formerly Dongchang Road) Metro Station to Lujiazui Metro Station

name: Arriving at the store, preparing, and morning meeting
description: At 8:20 a.m., I arrived at the Xiafeiji store on the second floor of Super Brand Mall. The shop assistant Xiao Lin had already opened up and started organizing the merchandise. Lei Mingxuan asked Xiao Lin to go to the Starbucks on the same floor to buy a large iced Americano, while he quickly walked through the store, checked the sample garments brought back from last Sunday's trade show, and adjusted the angle of the techwear vest on the mannequin at the entrance to make the display more visually striking.
location: Xiafei Collection store, No. A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Plan the camping itinerary and communicate with Shen Jie
description: After Xiao Lin brought back the coffee, Lei Mingxuan entered the store office, turned on the computer, and created a new PPT titled “11.22-23 Team Camping Plan (Xiafei Collection Edition)”, beginning to refine the itinerary based on the campsite materials previously collected. At 10 a.m., he made a video call via WeChat to his cousin Shen Jie, and the two discussed campsite scenes suitable for taking cool techwear-style photos. Shen Jie recommended the graffiti wall on the abandoned shipping container at the campsite, and suggested bringing a reflector and a tactical flashlight to create a cyberpunk feel. Lei Mingxuan quickly noted down these ideas, and the call lasted about 15 minutes.
location: Xiafeiji Store Office, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Refined and printed the camping itinerary.
description: After hanging up the call with Shen Jie, Lei Mingxuan added a reflector and a tactical flashlight to the equipment list in the PPT based on her suggestions. He then spent 40 minutes carefully polishing the layout to ensure the fonts and colors of the itinerary were professional and clear. Finally, he printed 10 copies, placed them neatly in clear document folders, and fully prepared for the camping trip at the end of the month.
location: Xiafeiji Store Office, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Midday meal and relaxation
description: After putting the printed documents away, Lei Mingxuan went downstairs to the Hakata Ikkousha ramen shop on B1 of Super Brand Mall for lunch and ordered a bowl of the signature tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While eating, he scrolled through his phone, shared a photo of the ramen in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group, and left the message: "Working hard today, camping trip at the end of the month!" Qian Duoduo immediately replied with an emoji.
location: Hakata Ikkousha Ramen Shop, B1 Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Entering exhibition customer information into the CRM system
description: After returning to the store, Lei Mingxuan sat at the computer at the cash register, pulled up the 47 new WeChat friends he had added at the exhibition, and viewed each one's Moments one by one. Based on their profile pictures, backgrounds, and content, he categorized the customers and imported them into the store's CRM system, creating three groups: "Potential wholesale - camping equipment," "High-end retail - techwear style," and "General interest - outdoor enthusiasts." He also added personalized tags for each customer for future follow-up.
location: Xiafei Collection store, No. A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Compose and send a personalized thank-you WeChat message
description: After completing customer classification, Lei Mingxuan carefully wrote different thank-you messages for each segment. For customers with wholesale potential, he sent partnership invitations; for other customers, he expressed gratitude and promised to share information about new arrivals. Before sending, he also manually revised the opening lines for several key customers to make them more sincere, consolidating the customer relationships gained at the exhibition.
location: Xiafei Collection store, No. A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Handle online business and customer inquiries.
description: Lei Mingxuan logged into the store's mini-program backend and found two pending orders. He immediately printed the shipping labels and arranged for staff member Xiao Lin to send them out via SF Express, with the packages dropped off at the locker at Lujiazui Metro Station. Then he replied to private messages from three customers, answering questions about sizing and outdoor waterproof performance in detail. One of them showed strong purchase intent.
location: Xiafei Collection store, No. A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Industry trend research and relaxation
description: After handling urgent work, Lei Mingxuan went to Starbucks on the 1st floor of Super Brand Mall for a short break. He ordered a medium latte, found a seat by the window, opened Xiaohongshu, followed several top bloggers in the outdoor and techwear style fields, browsed the latest outfit trends, and saved designs of two creative camping lanterns, planning to introduce them to the store in the future.
location: Starbucks Coffee, 1F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Store inspection and detail upkeep
description: After returning to the store, Lei Mingxuan took advantage of the low-traffic period to do a full inspection, checking that display props were tidy and clothes were neatly arranged, and personally wiped the underside of the display stands. At the same time, he began planning the in-store try-on rehearsal for the end-of-month camping event, intending to use the store's tent display area for a scene simulation.

At the dinner table, Lei Mingxuan excitedly talked about what he saw and heard at the weekend camping festival, focusing on the intention to cooperate with Manager Liu from 'Wild Walker,' and showed the printed camping itinerary to his father Lei Jianguo. His father put on his reading glasses and read it carefully, then confirmed the route and equipment arrangements, while also reminding him about outdoor fire safety, stressing that for the bonfire segment they need to confirm the fire prevention permit and arrange a dedicated person to keep watch. Lei Mingxuan listened carefully and kept the advice in mind.

description: Lei Mingxuan voluntarily cleared the table and washed the dishes. Afterward, the family of three sat on the living room sofa—his mother knitting a sweater, his father reading the newspaper—and together watched CCTV News. Lei Mingxuan posted a photo of dinner in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group, telling Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie that the exhibition results had been reported and the end-of-month camping trip was confirmed. His friend Zhang Wei replied with praise.

description: After returning to the bedroom, Lei Mingxuan opened Bilibili to watch two new episodes of Jujutsu Kaisen, and completed his daily commissions in Genshin Impact. Then, in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat, he shared in detail with Qian Duoduo and Shen Jie the camping lighting ideas he had seen at Starbucks that afternoon. Shen Jie said she also wanted to find time to visit those foreign-brand camping gear stores.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Bath and relaxation before bed
description: Lei Mingxuan took a refreshing shower in the bathroom, changed into pajamas, and used a foam roller to briefly relax his right leg (about 8,000 steps that day; his knees felt good). He set his phone to Do Not Disturb mode, lay in bed, and reviewed the day: the camping itinerary was set, customer information had been entered and maintained, and he had discussed camping safety with his father. He felt grounded and at peace.
location: Bathroom and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Journaling and going to sleep.
description: Lei Mingxuan recorded the day's weight and important matters: “Nov 3, Monday, exhibition follow-up is done, camping plan is underway, weight held steady at 80 kg, will resume exercise tomorrow.” Then he turned off the lights, put on an eye mask, and fell asleep right on time at 22:45, ending a fulfilling and peaceful day.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning wake-up and breakfast
description: The alarm went off right at 6:00. He had planned to go to Lujiazui Central Green Park for a 5 km morning run, but after several exhausting days at the expo, he dismissed the alarm, turned over, and fell asleep again. When he opened his eyes again, it was nearly 7:00. At exactly 7:00 he dragged himself out of bed and weighed himself: 80.2 kg, the same as yesterday. After washing up, his mother Wang Xiuying had already prepared breakfast: white congee, pan-fried buns, and scrambled eggs. As he ate quickly, he felt guilty and told his mother that the expo had been too tiring and he had not gotten up to run, but he would definitely make up for it tomorrow. His mother advised him to take care of his health and not push himself too hard.
location: Room 301, Building 12, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai.

name: Commute by E-Bike
description: He put on his helmet and rode his electric bike from Zhangyang Huayuan to Super Brand Mall. While waiting at a red light, he checked his phone and saw in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat that Wang Lei had mentioned last night the goods were stuck at the logistics park, so he made a note to follow up. He crossed Century Avenue and arrived at the Super Brand Mall employee parking area at 7:45.
location: Zhangyang Road to Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (riding an electric bike)

name: Daily store preparation and review
description: Swiped his card to enter the Xiafei Ji store on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, turned on the lights, and opened the cashier system. Conducted a store walk-through, checking cleanliness and displays. Found a pair of pants in the fitting room not hung properly, probably because staff member Xiao Lin was in a hurry last night. Afterwards, sat at the cash register, opened the CRM system, and carefully reviewed the customer information collected at yesterday's exhibition, especially revisiting the product materials related to Manager Liu from 'Wild Walker,' while mentally drafting what to say when contacting him later.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Proactively contacted Manager Liu of Wild Walker
description: He took a deep breath, opened WeChat, and sent a message to Manager Liu: Brother Liu, good morning! I am Lei Mingxuan from Xiafeiji at Super Brand Mall. We talked at the Century Link camping festival last week. I just finished sorting the exhibition materials, and your camping coffee equipment left a deep impression on me. Is it convenient this morning? I would like to have a brief chat to see if there is a chance for cooperation. After sending, he tidied the front desk while waiting for a reply.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Handling customer inquiries and preparing cooperation materials
description: Manager Liu quickly replied and agreed to a video call at 2 p.m. Lei Mingxuan immediately confirmed the time. Then, at the cash register, he handled online customer inquiries: answering questions about hardshell jacket sizing, reassuring customers with urgent orders, taking pre-orders for new hoodies, and packing an order that needed to be shipped the next day and placing it on the storage shelf. After handling customer matters, he went into the back office, opened the store profile PPT, and focused on revising the 'Store Customer Analysis' page, adding screenshots from the camping festival store livestream from last week to highlight the proportion of 25–35-year-old urban outdoor enthusiasts. He also cleaned up the computer desktop to ensure a tidy background for the afternoon video call.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lunchtime phone call with logistics
description: He walked about 15 minutes to the Songhelou Noodle Restaurant on the B1 floor of Shanghai Zhipin Mall, ordered a bowl of the signature Suzhou-style noodle soup with braised pork, and while waiting for the meal, called Wang Lei on WeChat to ask about the stalled logistics of that box of waterproof caps. Wang Lei said the system data did not match up but could be resolved in the afternoon. Lei Mingxuan urged him to make sure the goods reached the store before the weekend. The noodles cost 34 yuan. After the meal, he paid by scanning the QR code and walked back to the store.
location: Songhelou Noodle Restaurant, B1, Shanghai Zhipin Mall, 501 Yincheng Middle Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and video call preparation.
description: After returning to the store, with sparse noon customer traffic, he organized the key points for the afternoon negotiation on the sofa in the rest area: consignment cooperation, initial stocking of 20 sets, proposed profit split of 4:6, supply and settlement cycles, display and promotion support, etc., and recorded them in a notebook. Then he leaned back on the sofa and rested with his eyes closed for 20 minutes. After waking up, he moved the vest display rack at the store entrance half a meter to ensure the video background could show the "Xiafei Ji" light sign and the featured hardshell jacket. He tested the network signal and microphone pickup with his phone and placed a cup of warm water beside him.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Video call to finalize the cooperation outline
description: At 2 p.m. on the dot, he made a WeChat video call and, after exchanging pleasantries, got straight to the point: through screen sharing, he showed the store's customer traffic video from last week's livestream. Manager Liu introduced their flagship products—the military-grade titanium pour-over kettle and the portable drip filter cup. The two sides initially agreed: the first consignment would be 20 sets, with the supply price at 60% of the retail price, settled monthly; if monthly sales were fewer than 5 sets, the cooperation would end. Manager Liu agreed to send samples within a week. After the call, Lei Mingxuan immediately used voice-to-text on his phone to record the meeting minutes, saved screenshots of the product photos and chat records, and wrote a note in his notebook: 'After the samples arrive, unbox, take photos, and post them on Moments.'
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Plan the camping coffee corner display area
description: He picked up a tape measure and measured the empty wall to the right of the store entrance (about 2 m wide and 1.5 m high), and took photos for the record. Back at the checkout counter, he drew three display sketches on A4 paper: the top level used a natural wood-colored shelf to display coffee bean sample jars and a logo light box; the middle level used a metal grid rack to hang pour-over kettles and drip filters; the bottom level had folding chairs and a roll-up table display set, accented with green plants, creating an outdoor café atmosphere overall.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Store operations and store management
description: Store clerk Xiao Lin came on duty at 4 p.m., and Lei Mingxuan briefed Xiao Lin on the coffee equipment collaboration. In the evening, he received two groups of customers in succession: a nearby office worker bought a silver-gray lightweight down jacket for inner wear at 1,299 yuan; another young tourist bought a printed T-shirt. During that time, he handed the online orders that needed shipping to Xiao Lin, who took them to the express point on the basement level to send out, and again reminded Xiao Lin to follow up tomorrow on the logistics of that box of waterproof caps.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Metro commute home and group chat

On the metro, in the Pudong Three Musketeers group chat, he @Wang Lei to ask about the logistics resolution for the box of hats, and mentioned the coffee equipment cooperation just finalized that afternoon. Zhang Wei joked that he would come to the store later to mooch some pour-over coffee.
location: Take Metro Line 2 (Super Brand Mall Station), transfer to Line 6 at Century Avenue Station, go to Yuanshen Sports Center Station, and walk to Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road.

At the dinner table, Lei Mingxuan excitedly told his parents about how he had reached a consignment cooperation with the manager of a camping coffee brand that afternoon and planned to create a pour-over coffee display area in the store. His father, Lei Jianguo, reminded him that he should have ideas but also do the math to avoid overstocking; his mother, Wang Xiuying, said he should be willing to drink the coffee himself too, not just focus on selling. The atmosphere was harmonious.

During this, he replied to a product quality inspection report sent by Manager Liu. Then he switched to the Three Musketeers group chat and saw Wang Lei say the logistics were handled, arriving in Shanghai tomorrow afternoon and delivering the day after, so he replied with an OK hand gesture. He also responded to a customer inquiry in the shop's customer WeChat group about weekend weather recommendations.

After washing up, I went back to the bedroom, lay in bed, and used the memo app on my phone to write down tomorrow's to-dos: follow up on the sample delivery tracking number, design the official display plan for the camping coffee corner, and check the shipping progress for online winter clothing. I also browsed outdoor outfit notes on Xiaohongshu, then set the alarm for 7 a.m. the next day, put down my phone, turned off the light, and gradually fell asleep with a sense of security.
