As he read the feedback, he jotted down key points in his notebook and felt a surge of inspiration.

participant.name: Old Shanghai gentleman at Jing'an Temple

location: Living room, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove back to the store at Super Brand Mall.
description: Dressed neatly, put fabric samples into his bag, and drove from home back to Super Brand Mall, thinking about the layout plan for the coffee corner.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Store closing-up work and on-site shooting
description: After arriving at the store, he listened to Xiao Lin's feedback on the afternoon sales, put the fabric samples given by Zhou Tao into the office, and inventoried the camping-related stock. At around 17:15, he took multiple angled shots of the coffee corner and sent them to Manager Liu, while also complaining in the friends' group about the fabric price increase. Li Na offered to help find an alternative supplier.
location: No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Unit A-208, Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store

name: Closing up and returning home for family dinner
description: At 17:30, he closed the shop on time and checked the shop door and power supply. Xiao Lin drove home after work. The smell of braised pork filled the house. During dinner, he reported the day's gains to his parents: equipment procurement, fabric negotiation with Zhou Tao, and progress on the coffee equipment samples. His father told him to take shoulder training seriously and emphasized the importance of health.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-dinner games and group chat with friends.
description: After helping clear the dishes, he collapsed onto the sofa, opened Genshin Impact, finished the daily commissions, and used up the resin. Then he complained about fabric price increases in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat. Zhang Wei pressed him about the blind box contents, but he kept it a mystery and delayed the reveal until the camping trip. At nearly 10 p.m., feeling sore in the shoulders and neck, he decided to rest early.
location: Living room and bedroom, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake-up and morning routine
description: After the alarm went off, he felt the light rain outside the window and the soreness in his shoulders and neck, so he decided to skip the morning run to save energy for the trail race. He weighed himself at 80.1 kg and recorded it. After washing up, he ate the scallion oil noodles his mother had prepared. He heard his mother say the shepherd's purse was fresh, so he suggested they make dumplings together in the evening. After the meal, he briefly tidied up the dishes.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Commute and buying pain-relief patches
description: He put on a waterproof jacket and rode an electric bike to work. On the way, he bought mint patches at the Guangyuyuan Chinese Medicine Hall on Zhangyang Road and applied them immediately to the right side of his neck and shoulder to relieve soreness. Then he continued riding, arrived at the non-motor vehicle parking area of Super Brand Mall at 8:30, locked the bike, and walked to Shop A-208 on the 2nd floor.
location: Guangyuyuan Chinese Medicine Hall, No. 1518 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, then arrived at Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road

name: Store operations and supplier communication.
description: After arriving at the store, I played music and communicated with the shop assistant, Xiao Lin, about the plan to close early. I walked around the store and checked inventory, and found that two fleece sweatshirts were missing sizes. I contacted supplier Zhou Tao via WeChat, sent him a video of the missing sizes, and asked for an urgent restock of 5 pieces each in M and L, confirming they would arrive next Tuesday. I adjusted the window mannequin, changed it into next spring's sample pieces, styled it with mountain-style cargo pants to create an early spring mountain-inspired mix-and-match look, and adjusted the spotlights. I also recorded customers' inquiries about winter clothing and planned to launch a lightweight down liner next week.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and information browsing
description: Leaving the store, I walked through the circular corridor to IFC Mall. At Menya Musashi, I ordered tonkotsu ramen with less oil. While waiting, I used Dianping to book a restaurant for after tomorrow's trail race, scrolled through Xiaohongshu and WeChat Moments, liked posts about trail gear, and replied to a running buddy's private message about the meet-up time.
location: Menya Musashi, B1, Shanghai IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Online order processing and advancement of the camping coffee corner plan
description: Back at the store, I opened the laptop to process online exchange requests and shipping orders and generate shipping labels. I took out a measuring tape and a sketch to measure the size of the camping coffee corner area in the store and compare it with the display shelf design. I took photos of the actual scene, marked the position of the backdrop cloth on my phone, and sent it to Manager Liu via WeChat, suggesting enlarging the backdrop cloth to 2 meters by 1.5 meters. Then I sorted and recorded the day's revenue and inventory changes and completed the daily financial report.
location: A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Closed early and returned.
description: After confirming that store matters were handled, I told Xiao Lin to close at 3 p.m. I left the store, bought a hot Americano to go in the mall, then rode my electric bike home.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Pre-match stretching and relaxation.
description: After arriving home, he changed into loungewear, put the coffee on the coffee table, turned on the projector but did not play anything, and instead did 10 minutes of static stretching, focusing on the shoulders, neck, back of the thighs, and hips, to prepare for the trail race.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Watching anime and journaling
description: Leaning on the sofa, he used the projector to watch episodes 5 and 6 of Cowboy Bebop in a row, immersed in the adventure story. At nearly 5 o'clock, he took out his diary and wrote down his feelings for the day. He felt that his shoulder was much better and that he should be in good shape tomorrow. He also detailed the item list for tomorrow's trail race: trail running shoes, hardshell jacket, hydration pack, energy gels, salt tablets, headlamp, GPS watch, sun hat, sunscreen, windproof gloves, dry T-shirt, and so on. During this, his mother came in to check on him, and they chatted briefly.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Family dumpling-making dinner
description: Mother bought fresh shepherd's purse and pork. Lei Mingxuan joined in the kitchen and took charge of mincing the meat and rolling out wrappers. Mother and son chatted while wrapping; mother mentioned she might be the lead singer in the choir, and Lei Mingxuan praised her. After father came home, they cooked the dumplings together. At the table, father advised him to put safety first in the competition. Lei Mingxuan promised his mother he would fill in the food diary tomorrow and take more photos. The family of three enjoyed shepherd's purse and pork dumplings with a chili-vinegar dipping dish.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Trail race gear preparation and food log
description: After the meal, I proactively cleared the dishes and helped my mother take out the trash. Back in my bedroom, I checked the gear for tomorrow's trail race one by one: charged the GPS watch, organized the energy gels and hydration pack, and folded the finisher T-shirt and waterproof shell jacket on the bed. Then I opened the diet tracking app, backfilled the blank lunch and dinner entries for this week, and took a photo of the dumplings as a record.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Interacting with running buddies in the group and relaxing
description: In the trail race WeChat group, he sent a gathering reminder, telling everyone to meet at Expo Source Square at 7 o'clock tomorrow, and that he would bring homemade ginger tea. He also discussed the course elevation gain and aid station information with group members. Later, he brewed a pot of hot tea, and while drinking it, listened to jazz and hip-hop music, completely clearing his mind.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: He took a hot shower, letting the hot water run over his shoulders and neck. After drying his hair, he set an alarm (6:00). His mother knocked and brought hot milk. Lei Mingxuan took it and said he would bring roast duck home after tomorrow's competition. His mother smiled and patted his shoulder (exactly where the medicated patch was), and he let out a soft hiss. At 22:10, he turned off the light, put on an eye mask, listened to the sound of rain outside gradually fade, took a few deep breaths, and fell asleep.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Morning preparation and cycling to the race venue
description: On Saturday morning, his biological clock woke him. He first weighed himself: 80.0 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday. After a quick wash, he put on a running T-shirt and compression tights. His mother Wang Xiuying had prepared a sandwich with lettuce and ham, along with warm milk. Lei Mingxuan ate quickly, checked the energy gels and salt tablets in his hydration backpack, put on his Bluetooth earphones, and left. At the community gate, he scanned a QR code to unlock a Hellobike, rode south along Pudong Avenue, turned onto Pudong South Road, and cycled for 30 minutes to Expo Source Square while listening to electronic music.
location: Along the route from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Expo Source Plaza, No. 1368 Expo Avenue.

name: Pre-competition assembly and warm-up
description: Arrived at the central fountain of Expo Source Plaza and met teammates Lao Zhang, A Jie, and Xiao Chen to pick up race bibs, finger cards, and task sheets. We followed the event's warm-up leader through dynamic stretching and a jogging warm-up. Captain Lao Zhang emphasized the order of checkpoints and safety precautions. Lei Mingxuan used the interval to open the Duolingo app and complete his daily Japanese check-in.
location: Assembly area at the central fountain of Expo Source Plaza, 1368 Expo Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Participating in the urban orienteering race
description: After the 8 a.m. starting gun, Lei Mingxuan's team of four set off at full strength. Lei Mingxuan was responsible for planning the route with his phone map. They completed an architectural sketch check-in at Pudong Shipyard 1862, recreated firefighter poses in a group photo at the former Lujiazui Fire Station, then took a ferry across the river to Puxi, wove through the historic buildings of the Bund, and finally found the hidden checkpoint at the Cool Docks. With tacit teamwork, they completed all 10 checkpoints and 2 additional tasks in 2 hours and 17 minutes, ranking fifth among 28 teams.
location: Starting and ending at Expo Source Plaza, 1368 Expo Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, passing along both banks of the Huangpu River, including Shipyard 1862, the former Lujiazui Fire Station site, and the old dock warehouse cluster.

name: Post-race rest and celebration
description: After the race, the four of them collapsed onto the plaza lawn, panting and drinking big gulps of water to rehydrate. Lei Mingxuan took out his phone and, with the Oriental Pearl Tower in the background, took a winning group photo of his sweaty teammates. Lao Zhang suggested celebrating with Chaoshan beef hot pot next weekend, and everyone agreed. A Jie lamented that he was physically exhausted, and Xiao Chen said he wanted to join again next time.
location: Lawn in the finish area of Expo Source Plaza, 1368 Expo Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Returned home and had lunch.
description: After saying goodbye to his teammates, Lei Mingxuan decided to cycle home as a cooldown. He rode slowly along Pudong South Road and bought a small watermelon at the Yanqin Grocery Store on the roadside, planning to chill it to beat the heat. When he got home, his mother had already gone out for choir rehearsal. He cooked himself a bowl of clear noodle soup with scallions, topped with two poached eggs, and paired it with shredded preserved mustard greens to quickly regain energy.
location: Room 302, No. 8, Shanggang Residential Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: WeChat Moments sharing and social interaction.
description: After eating his fill, Lei Mingxuan curled up in the beanbag chair in his bedroom, used Meitu to pick 9 group photos and apply a film tone, and posted to Moments with the caption: 'Finished in 2h17min, half-marathon distance along both sides of the Huangpu River. My lungs and heart are cursing me. But following teammates past century-old buildings made the sweat worth it! #UrbanOrienteering #OldFriendsNewTrack.' While eating chilled watermelon, he replied to likes and comments from friends like Han Dong and Song Jia, with lively interaction.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 8, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break, gear organization, and reflection
description: After posting to Moments, drowsiness washed over him, but Lei Mingxuan didn't go to sleep right away. Instead, he opened Bilibili and watched some Cowboy Bebop clips and urban exploration vlogs to relax his mind. Once his energy revived, he changed out of his damp clothes, cleaned his trail running shoes and hydration pack, and charged his GPS watch. While hanging his gear on the balcony to dry, he looked at his abdomen in the mirror and checked his workout history on his phone, finding that this month only today and the expo on the 2nd counted as real exercise. He then opened his fitness goals written at the beginning of the year and wrote in his notes: 'The orienteering race proves my fitness hasn't completely collapsed, but regular training must resume. From December, run at least three times a week.'
location: Bedroom and balcony, Room 302, Building 8, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handled the clothing restocking work.
description: After drinking some water, Lei Mingxuan remembered that before next Monday he needed to confirm the shipping of the winter version and the delivery status of the reordered fleece sweatshirts. He then contacted supplier Zhou Tao by WeChat voice message: “Brother Tao, can the M and L fleece we talked about yesterday be shipped today? It must reach my store by next Tuesday at the latest.” He also confirmed the shipment time for the final winter-version sample garment. Zhou Tao replied that he could arrange to send it out that afternoon.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 8, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Share the competition experience with parents
description: Mother Wang Xiuying came home after rehearsal, and father Lei Jianguo also returned from fishing. In the living room, Lei Mingxuan took out his phone to show his parents the race photos and medal. His father praised him for running with spirit, and his mother asked about his knee. Then Lei Mingxuan asked about the selection of a lead singer for his mother's choir. Wang Xiuying happily talked about rehearsing the lead part of 'Jasmine Flower' and said she had a good chance of being chosen. Lei Mingxuan teased that he would post on WeChat Moments to celebrate for his mother.
location: Living room, Room 302, Building 8, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Dinner with the family
description: His father cooked steamed white fish, stir-fried water spinach with garlic, and tomato scrambled eggs. The family of three chatted as they ate. Lei Mingxuan shared funny stories from the competition, and his parents reminded him to rest. His mother said she had made shepherd's purse and pork wontons in the afternoon and frozen them in the refrigerator for his breakfast next week. The table was filled with harmony and joy.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, Pudong Avenue, Lane 136, No. 2-51, Shanggang Residential Area, Building 8, Room 302, Dining Room

name: Rest after meal and handling work
description: After helping his mother clear the dishes, Lei Mingxuan leaned on the living room sofa and watched the evening news with his father to help digestion. Then he went back to the bedroom and turned on the computer. First, he left a message for Manager Liu from Wild Walker, thanking him for the sample display rack design he sent and saying he would take photos after seeing the actual display in the store on Monday. He also received a message from his cousin Shen Jie asking about the competition. While replying by voice message, he mentioned the winter version design that needed to be confirmed next week. Shen Jie said she could come to the store on Monday to help give advice.
location: Living room and bedroom of Room 302, Building 8, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation, reading, and reflection
description: After shutting down the computer, Lei Mingxuan filled the bathtub with hot water, added tea tree essential oil, and soaked. The warm water soothed his sore, heavy legs. After the bath, he changed into loose loungewear, picked up the paperback “Eight Square Meters in Tokyo” and read a few chapters, thinking about his fitness and store expansion goals from the beginning of the year. Then in his phone memo, he marked “Run three times a week starting in December” as a to-do and wrote: “Occasional passion is easy; sustained discipline is precious.”
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 302, Building 8, Shanggang Residential Quarter, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparation and sleep
description: He turned off the main light and left the bedside lamp on, said goodnight to his parents, set the alarm for 7:30 the next morning to get up early on Sunday to check the arrivals at the store, put on an eye mask and earplugs, and quickly fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 302, Building 8, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Natural wake-up and post-game muscle relaxation
description: Woke up naturally at 8:30 a.m. Because yesterday's orienteering race left the back and outer sides of my thighs sore, I went to the living room in loose pajamas and used a foam roller on a yoga mat for targeted deep-pressure relaxation, pressing each sore spot for over 30 seconds. After ten minutes, my muscles relaxed and I felt happy.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pour-over coffee and Japanese morning check-in.
description: After relaxing, he took a shower and changed into loungewear. In the kitchen, he made pour-over coffee using the Guatemalan coffee beans bought from COSTA the day before yesterday, enjoying the nutty aroma. Then he sat on the living room sofa, opened the Duolingo app to do his Japanese study check-in, and reviewed words related to traveling in Japan such as “museum” and “reservation.”
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Exploring interests and preparing for Double 11 shopping rush
description: Leaning on the sofa, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu and saved a post about the “Steampunk Mechanical Heart” offline pop-up event; he also checked the discussion in the designer toy QQ group about the two-account flash-sale strategy. Then he took out his primary iPhone and spare Huawei phone, logged into the flash-sale platform accounts using home Wi-Fi and a mobile data card respectively, and ran a simulated operation. After ensuring the network was smooth, he charged both phones to keep them as backups.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family lunch and conversation
description: Around noon, the aroma of his mother's signature sweet-and-sour pork ribs wafted from the kitchen. Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to help set the table. The whole family had lunch together. His father, Lei Jianguo, talked about the community choir's upcoming performance at the nursing home next week. Lei Mingxuan suggested his mother wear the camel coat from his store on stage, and also shared the fun story of sprinting to fifth place in yesterday's orienteering race along the Pudong riverside. His father reminded him to take care of his health.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon rest and organizing basketball gear.
description: After dinner, cleared the table and half-reclined on the sofa in the living room, digesting with World Football on the TV via screen mirroring as background sound. Checked the basketball bag to confirm the sneakers, knee pads, and towel, and added an extra quick-dry sports T-shirt to prepare for the afternoon basketball activity.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drive to Yuanshen Sports Center
description: After calling his basketball buddy Xie Fei in advance to confirm, he changed into sports gear, grabbed his basketball bag and car keys, drove from home for just over ten minutes to Yuanshen Sports Center, and listened to a podcast along the way to relax.
location: Yuanshen Sports Center, 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Community basketball 4v4 recreational game
description: Played a 4v4 half-court game at the outdoor basketball court of Yuanshen Sports Center with regular ball buddies Xie Fei, Da Liu, and others. Although his thighs still felt sore, his driving steps were quick and agile; he used screens to cut into the paint, and hit three three-pointers from the top of the arc and the corner, drawing cheers from teammates and fellow players. After the game, Da Liu joked that yesterday's match had opened up his Ren and Du meridians, and everyone burst out laughing.
location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-match rest and walking to the barbecue restaurant
description: After the game, they rested by the court and drank water. Xie Fei suggested going to their usual spot, Avanti Barbecue, for a group meal, and everyone agreed. Lei Mingxuan changed into a dry quick-dry T-shirt. The billiards buddies decided not to drive and walked together for seven or eight minutes to the barbecue restaurant on Zhangyang Road, letting their bodies cool down in the wind along the way.
location: Afanti BBQ (Zhangyang Road Branch), 1208 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-basketball dinner: beer, barbecue, and bragging
description: In a private room on the second floor of Afanti BBQ, six basketball buddies gathered for dinner. They ordered three jin of lamb skewers, two handfuls of beef tendon, grilled chives, potato slices, and a spicy-sour tripe pot, and opened ice-cold Tsingtao Draft. They ate and chatted, with topics ranging from the ball game to NBA Lakers trade rumors. Xie Fei complained about the company's new director, and Big Liu shared funny stories about hunting for a second-hand road bike on Xianyu. Everyone teased each other and burst into laughter. Lei Mingxuan drank less than two glasses of beer to stay sober for driving.
location: Private room on the second floor, Afanti Barbecue (Zhangyang Road branch), No. 1208 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Taking a slightly tipsy walk and driving home
description: After the dinner gathering, he said goodbye to his billiards buddies and walked alone back to the Yuanshen Sports Center parking lot to get his car. The cool evening breeze was blowing, carrying the lingering smell of barbecue and beer, making him feel very comfortable. Because he had drunk very little, he was clear-headed and drove safely back to Shanggang Residential Community, parking in his designated spot.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bathing and relaxing after returning home
description: After getting home, exchanged a few words with my mother, went into the bedroom to change into loungewear, then took a hot shower to wash away the barbecue smell and sweat stains, feeling refreshed.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Designer toy group 'tactical meeting': Steampunk blind box rush-buying strategy
description: Leaning against the headboard, two phones ready, I joined the lively discussion in the "Steam Playland" WeChat group. Lin Jing, a core member of the group, used voice messages to analyze the material features and official probability of the "Steampunk Mechanical Heart" co-branded hidden edition. Lei Mingxuan uploaded factory-leaked PU leather detail photos he had saved earlier and shared his insights. Another collector, Mushroom, pointed out tips for preventing lag on the platform. Everyone discussed until 10 PM, and Lei Mingxuan noted down key points such as "dual accounts, simultaneous grabbing, and testing the network in advance."
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening stretching and pre-bedtime preparation
description: After the group chat ended, I got a glass of warm water and lay back in bed. I did neck stretches to relax, holding my head with both hands and stretching left, right, and forward to relieve muscle stiffness. Then I set the alarm for 8 a.m. the next day, checked that the door was locked, and dimmed the bedside lamp.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Turned off the lights and went to sleep.
description: Turned off the bedside lamp, reviewed the day's fulfilling activities, felt content, and fell asleep peacefully. End state: at home, feeling happy and looking forward to the future.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
description: After the alarm went off, Lei Ming stretched out in bed, feeling the soreness in his thighs and waist from yesterday's exercise and missing the thrill of the court. After getting up, he did 5 minutes of neck and shoulder circles to relieve stiffness. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared rice porridge, pickled cucumbers, and fried eggs, and he had a simple breakfast.
location: Room 603, Building 4, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and going out to shop
description: Lei Ming sat on the edge of the bed, opened Duolingo to complete the beginner Japanese "Shopping" theme check-in, then searched Xiaohongshu for real-time information on Double 11 steampunk blind boxes, confirming that his friend Lin Jing's dual-account strategy was feasible. At 7:45, he put on an off-white work shirt and went out. He walked to Yanqin Grocery Store at the entrance of the residential complex, greeted Aunt Zhu Xiuying who was stocking shelves, and bought Zhenjiang balsamic vinegar and two bottles of sports drinks to prepare for an evening run and shopping rush.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store at the entrance of Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning run recovery training
description: He walked from Yanqin Grocery Store to Lujiazui Central Greenland Park, changed into running shoes, and jogged along the park trail. Since his thighs were still sore, he only ran for 25 minutes at a 6:30 pace. After finishing, he stretched. As his body gradually loosened up, his spirits were lifted as well.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting and store arrival preparation
description: After running, Lei Ming walked back to his home in Shanggang Community, took a quick shower, and changed into clean clothes. He left before 9 o'clock, walked about 27 minutes to Super Brand Mall, and on the way used his phone to send a WeChat message to clerk Lin Xiao, asking her to prepare the materials for the day's Double 11 sales.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store stocking and promotion preparation for Double 11
description: Lei Ming arrived at the store at 9 o'clock. After a brief morning meeting with staff member Lin Xiao, they divided the work: Lin Xiao hung the new autumn/winter items in layers by category, including main-push styles, discount styles, and co-branded styles, and attached promotional tags for the spend 399 yuan, get 50 yuan off offer. Lei Ming focused on checking the online mini-program pages, manually simulating orders to ensure discount coupons and flash-sale links were working properly. At 10:30, he contacted supplier Zhou Tao via WeChat voice call to confirm the restocking and payment process for the next day, so as to prevent stockouts during the major promotion. Zhou Tao also praised the good buyer-show feedback on last week's new fabric.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Healthy Lunch and Catching Up on Anime
description: Lei Ming left the store and walked to the Japanese ramen restaurant on the basement level of the IFS mall, where he ordered a bowl of clear pork bone ramen with a soft-boiled egg and asked for less oil and salt. While waiting, he put on his earphones and watched the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End. As he ate, he sent a WeChat message to his cousin Shen Jie, inviting her to come to the store on the weekend to see the co-branded hoodies. Shen Jie readily agreed.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant, basement level 1, ICC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work and literary creation.
description: After returning to the store, customer flow remained steady. Lei Ming stood behind the counter and took out his Kindle to read the first two chapters of "Anecdotes of Sichuan Cuisine in the Republic Era." The book's depiction of how an old Sichuan restaurant at the Chongqing docks balanced relationships among various parties inspired him. He immediately noted in his phone memo: "A historical novel must write deeply about how institutions alienate human nature. The web of human relationships behind Republican-era Sichuan cuisine is worth exploring. The protagonist's experiences in Xiafeifang can be blended with details of the Sichuan restaurant." Then he conceived the plot for the next chapter of "Afternoon in Xiafeifang," imagining the protagonist running into a detective from the police station at the Sichuan restaurant and using the rules of the jianghu to resolve the crisis. Every 20 minutes or so, he got up and walked around the store to stretch his neck and shoulders.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Final recheck and social interaction before the flash sale
description: Feeling his neck starting to stiffen again, Lei Ming put down his Kindle and picked up his phone. He sent a WeChat message to his friend Lin Jing in Shenzhen to confirm the dual-account strategy at midnight on Double 11, and Lin Jing replied OK. Then, in the 'Steam Playland' group, he reminded members to check their devices and network, simulated the countdown and payment process, and tested with the main phone and backup phone in two network environments to ensure everything went smoothly.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Leaving work early and going home
description: At 17:00, Lei Ming left work early after telling store clerk Lin Xiao the precautions for opening the next day, and walked home. On the way, he bought a few sugar tangerines at the Pushang Vegetable Market near the community entrance. As soon as he entered the stairwell, he smelled the aroma of braised pork coming from home.
location: Room 603, Building 4, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: As soon as Lei Ming entered, he praised the fragrant braised pork his mother had made, and his father, Lei Jianguo, also sat down at the table. His mother, Wang Xiuying, brought out the braised pork, glossy and deep red in a rich, oily sauce. Lei Ming had originally planned to eat only two pieces, but he ended up eating four and adding half a bowl of rice, mixing the meat sauce into the rice and enjoying it immensely. His mother, feeling sorry for how hard he worked, kept putting more food on his plate. After the meal, he helped clear the dishes and chatted with his father about last week's fishing trip to Chongming, listening to his father excitedly describe catching a big bream.
location: Home dining room, Room 603, Building 4, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Network and equipment testing for the flash sale
description: After returning to his room, Lei Ming charged his phone and laptop, then tested the internet speed by connecting his phone to 5G and his computer to broadband. Download speeds both exceeded 50 Mbps, confirming the network was stable. He then set a 23:55 alarm on his phone and synced it to his computer. In the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat, he sent a voice message announcing tonight's blind box hunting and tomorrow's store battle. His friends replied with teasing messages.
location: Bedroom, Room 603, Building 4, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Recovery night run
description: After changing into workout clothes and running shoes, Lei Ming went downstairs to the open area of the residential complex and jogged for 30 minutes along the internal paths and surrounding streets. The soreness in his thighs was much lighter than in the morning. After the run, he stretched for 10 minutes by the flower beds, and his body completely loosened up.
location: Internal walking paths and surrounding roads of Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and social small talk
description: Lei Ming went home, took a hot shower, changed into loose pajamas, and lay in bed scrolling through his phone. In the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group chat, Zhang Wei shared a funny basketball video and Li Na complained about overtime. He replied that tomorrow the store would be holding its Double 11 promotion and he would need to grab blind boxes at night, so he had to conserve his energy, drawing teasing from his friends.
location: Room 603, Building 4, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Reading, brainstorming, and writing the initial draft
description: Feeling fairly energetic, Lei Ming finished the second chapter of 'Anecdotes of Republican-Era Sichuan Cuisine' on his Kindle and took notes. Combining that with his afternoon ideas, he opened the memo app on his phone and wrote a draft of the next chapter of 'Afternoon at Xiafei Lane'. The protagonist hides from the police detectives in an old Sichuan restaurant, stalls for time by following the customers' rules, and finally escapes through the back door after a hint from the boss. He wrote nearly a thousand characters, full of vivid imagery.
location: Bedroom, Room 603, Building 4, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Final preparations before the Double 11 shopping rush.
description: Lei Ming kept his phone and computer charged, and turned on the Bluetooth speaker to play BGM to refresh himself. In the 'Steam Funland' group, he once again emphasized the key points of using dual accounts, preventing lag, and copying the payment password in advance. He urged everyone to pay immediately once midnight hit, and to restart instead of refreshing the page if there was lag. All group members replied 'received.'
location: Bedroom, Room 603, Building 4, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rushed to buy a co-branded blind box during the midnight flash sale
description: At 23:55, the alarm went off. Lei Ming sat up straight, placed his hands on his phone and the trackpad, and stared at the clock on the computer screen. At exactly midnight, he decisively clicked “Buy Now” while quickly switching accounts and entering his password on his phone. After a brief lag, the screen showed “Payment Successful,” and his phone also received a notification. Excitedly, he took screenshots of the two orders and sent them to the “Steam Toyland” group, celebrating that he had secured both boxes, and thanking Lin Jing for the dual-account strategy. The group was full of congratulations.
location: Bedroom, Room 603, Building 4, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Late-night socializing and going to bed.
description: The excitement of successfully grabbing the items left Lei Ming wide awake. He held his phone and shared the speed moment with friends in the group chat, agreeing to do an unboxing livestream tomorrow. Then he checked the store backend for pre-orders, confirmed positive reviews and restock notifications. At 0:45, his eyelids were heavy, so he put down his phone and fell asleep with satisfaction and fatigue, storing up energy for tomorrow's Double 11 battle in the store.
location: Bedroom, Room 603, Building 4, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and a first flash of inspiration
description: The alarm went off. Lei Mingxuan had only slept a little over six hours, but thinking about the blind box he had grabbed last night, he felt especially excited. While brushing his teeth, he noticed his face was puffy and decided to eat light today. He brewed a cup of pour-over coffee, and while drinking it, used his phone to sketch the steampunk mechanical castle display concept he had thought of in the early hours. Then he completed his Duolingo Japanese daily check-in and did 10 minutes of neck stretches to relieve discomfort.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute Cycling and Inspiration Logging
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into a black techwear vest and cargo pants, went out, and took a shared bike to Super Brand Mall. He unlocked the bike at the intersection of Zhangyang Road and rode for about 15 minutes. While waiting at a red light on the way, he used a mobile app to add supplementary notes on lighting and ceiling height details to the display sketch.
location: Cycling route from Shanggang Residential Community (No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai) to Super Brand Mall (No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai)

name: Store opening preparations and Double 11 mobilization
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at the store half an hour earlier than usual and opened the rolling shutter door with part-time employee Xiao Lin, then turned on the air conditioning and lights. He showed Xiao Lin photos of the blind boxes he had grabbed the night before and sent him the sketch for the steampunk corner. The two checked the express waybills, cardboard boxes, and tape, confirmed inventory, and prepared for the Singles' Day order boom.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Double 11 order battle
description: From 10 a.m., online orders surged, three times more than usual. Lei Mingxuan and Xiaolin split the work: Xiaolin was responsible for picking and packing, while Lei Mingxuan quickly replied to size inquiries and reviewed orders at the computer. During this period, he put on a neck patch because of cervical discomfort. After receiving a group booking for 20 outdoor jackets from a Suzhou company introduced by Feng Xiaoyu, he immediately called supplier Tao Ge to confirm stock and arranged delivery on Thursday.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch Break Dining and Trend Research
description: Lei Mingxuan walked alone to IFC Mall, ordered a bowl of light ramen at a Japanese ramen shop, specifically asking for less oil and no scallions. After eating, he browsed ZARA and Uniqlo in the mall, studying their fall/winter displays for inspiration. He then posted photos of the blind boxes to the Steam Play Kingdom collectors group, announced the unboxing livestream at 9 p.m., and privately thanked Lin Jing for her purchase strategy.
location: The Japanese ramen restaurant at the IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, and the mall interior

name: Afternoon order processing and stocking follow-up.
description: After returning to the store, a new wave of order peak arrived. Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin continued packing, and finalized the shipping details and payment method for the outdoor jackets with Brother Tao, while also following up on the camping gear ordered last week and learning that some of the goods had arrived at the Shanghai warehouse. They neatly stacked dozens of packed parcels and waited for the courier to pick them up at 3 o'clock.
location: Shop A-208, 2/F, Super Brand Mall, 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Billiards appointment and business strategy
description: Lei Mingxuan walked about 15 minutes to the World Square billiard hall and played American eight-ball with his good friend Han Dong for an hour. He was in good form today and won two games in a row. During a break, he showed Han Dong the blind box and mentioned the tight budget for store renovation. Drawing on his own experience running an auto repair shop, Han Dong advised him not to rush a full renovation but to first recover funds, upgrade in modules, and start with a steampunk corner. This advice made Lei Mingxuan suddenly see things clearly and eased his anxiety. The two then played for about another two hours and agreed to meet again next week.
location: World Plaza Billiard Hall, 855 Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go home for dinner with family
description: Lei Mingxuan walked home. As soon as he entered, he smelled the aroma of his mother's braised pork, but he said he was trying to lose weight today and asked her to prepare a salad and steamed fish. Although she grumbled, she happily prepared new dishes. During dinner, Lei Mingxuan shared the exciting news of the shop being flooded with orders on Double 11 and amusing stories about playing ball with Han Dong, and the family enjoyed a warm and happy time together.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Livestream setup and equipment testing
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan returned to the bedroom and began preparing for the evening's unboxing livestream. He wiped down the table, adjusted the angle of two desk lamps to highlight the reflections on the blind boxes, arranged the unopened blind boxes, a small knife, and card stock, set up the phone stand and connected it to power, and repeatedly tested the network and sound for about 20 minutes to make sure the livestream went off without a hitch.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Blind box unboxing livestream and community interaction.
description: After the livestream officially began, Lei Mingxuan first showed the camera two complete boxes of steampunk co-branded blind boxes, and reminisced with old friends in the collector group about the thrill of last night's rush purchase. He carefully opened the boxes. When he unboxed a hidden or rare version, he excitedly showed the mold and paint details, sharing the collection prospects and tips for distinguishing genuine from fake. The livestream room was lively and lasted about an hour.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime review and inspiration immersion
description: After turning off the livestream, Lei Mingxuan lay in bed reviewing the day: the Double 11 sales data, his conversation with Han Dong, and the group members' expectations for the new display during the livestream. He used the memo app on his phone to note down the key points for implementing the steampunk corner, including warm-light spotlights and stepped display cases, and reminded himself to follow up on the quality inspection report for the outdoor jacket group-buy and confirm the camping gear arrival list with Tao Ge. Afterward, he did 15 minutes of neck stretches, set a 23:00 sleep alarm, and turned off the lights and fell asleep right when it rang.
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and study
description: Woke up at 7:30 in the morning, put on workout clothes, and jogged to Lujiazui Central Green Park. I jogged on the park path for 20 minutes to relieve the stiffness in my shoulders and neck and breathe fresh air. Then I walked home, took a hot shower, and applied a hot towel to my sore neck. Mother had prepared breakfast: plain congee with pickled vegetables and a fried egg. While eating, I opened Duolingo and studied Japanese for 15 minutes, reviewing vocabulary about 'stores' and 'prices' to build a foundation for the store's future international operations. The whole process awakened both body and mind.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and home in Shanggang Community (No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue)

name: Commute and morning store work
description: Walked across the Lujiazui pedestrian bridge to the store at Super Brand Mall, arriving in about 8 minutes. After arriving, first handled the Suzhou company group-buying order introduced yesterday by Sister Feng Xiaoyu, confirmed the colors and sizes of the 20 windbreakers, and checked the shipping list from supplier Zhou Tao to arrange shipment on time tomorrow. Then he opened his laptop and began working on the “Xiafei Collection Brand Store Upgrade Plan,” spending over two hours sketching customer flow and functional zones on a CAD drawing and calculating a total budget of about 270,000 yuan. After working at the desk for a long time, his neck became uncomfortable; he reminded himself to get up and move, and walked around the store, imagining what it would look like after the renovation. During this time, store clerk Xiao Lin helped handle store affairs.
location: Unit A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and browsing industry news
description: Walked 8 minutes to the Ippudo Japanese ramen restaurant on the basement level of the IFC Mall and ordered a bowl of tonkotsu ramen. While waiting and eating, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu, browsing the displays and new-arrival updates of similar multi-brand clothing stores, quietly comparing them with his own upgrade plan in search of ideas he could borrow. He used the fragmented time to stay sensitive to industry trends.
location: Japanese ramen restaurant, ifc Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparation of store upgrade requirements and the designer's on-site survey.
description: After lunch, I returned to the store, took out my memo pad, and wrote down the key points I wanted to discuss with the designer in the afternoon: keeping the industrial style, layered lighting design, custom display racks that can be flexibly combined, and reserving space for the coffee bar. Then I used my phone to take detailed photos of every corner of the store, especially the walls and lighting areas that needed renovation. At 1:50 p.m., the designer Liu Tao arrived on time with his tool bag. I led him around the store and explained the requirements in detail. Liu Tao quickly took measurements with a laser distance meter and then verbally gave a comprehensive plan that included custom stainless steel racks, a coffee bar, and a movable wooden-crate activity area. The all-inclusive budget was about 350,000 yuan, far higher than my expected 270,000 yuan. I showed no change in expression, asked him to produce detailed renderings and a bill of materials first, and in my mind began working out how to reallocate the funds.
location: Unit A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Plan recording, inventory counting, and customer reception
description: After seeing off designer Liu Tao, he sat down at the small table in the store and wrote down the key points of the verbal proposal just discussed, thinking about how to make trade-offs and control costs based on his own budget framework. When his head felt overwhelmed, he got up to count inventory to prepare for going to the bank to deposit money in the evening. During this time, a regular customer came in to try on a new type of hardshell jacket. He went over to greet him and successfully closed a deal, which improved his mood.
location: Unit A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Financial processing and energy replenishment
description: I gathered yesterday's cash revenue, about several thousand yuan, from the shop drawer. I walked about 9 minutes to the HSBC Building, deposited the cash into the company account at the ATM. Then I walked to the Lawson convenience store next door, bought a sports drink and a pack of nuts for energy, and returned to the shop. The round trip took about 45 minutes.
location: ATM at HSBC Tower, 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Lawson convenience store at 200 Yincheng Middle Road

name: Store tidying and customer service
description: Back at the store, she re-hung and ironed the clothes that customers had tried on and left in disarray. She opened her phone, took screenshots of the logistics information for the group-buy orders of outdoor jackets to be shipped the next day, and sent them to the customer group to reassure customers. Before closing, she received several customers browsing the mall and patiently recommended products.
location: Unit A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking home and helping with dinner.
description: Walked home for about 27 minutes before the evening rush hour. When I got home, my mother was busy in the kitchen and my father was watching the news in the living room. After washing my hands, I went to the kitchen to help my mother pick vegetables, and while chatting, I told her about today's progress with the designer and the 350,000 yuan quote. She reminded me to take care of my health.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and store upgrade budget discussion
description: Dinner included my favorite braised pork belly. At the table, I proactively brought up the designer's 350,000 yuan quote. Father put down his chopsticks and analyzed it seriously, suggesting not to take too big a step. He recommended first renovating the lighting and part of the display racks with simple materials to see the effect, as cash is king. His words steadied me a bit, but the pressure remained. Mother kept putting dishes on my plate, concerned about my health.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Foam roller stretching and meditation exploration
description: After the meal, he rested for a while, returned to his bedroom, took out a foam roller, and lay on the floor rolling it back and forth over his stiff shoulders and neck. Although it hurt, his muscles relaxed. Then he opened Bilibili and searched for a stretching video about relieving neck soreness and stiffness, and followed along for a few sets. After saving the video, out of curiosity he searched for meditation, found several 10-minute guided audio sessions, and planned to try one before bed.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Friends group chat and plan review
description: In the Pudong Three Musketeers WeChat group, he sent voice messages saying he was feeling low because the designer's quote was 350,000 yuan, 80,000 yuan over budget. His friends Zhang Wei and Li Na teased him and offered suggestions; one told him to go raise investment, and the other told him to pay in installments. The lively atmosphere in the group relaxed his tense nerves a little. Later, lying alone on the recliner, he re-examined the reference images Liu Tao had sent on his phone, mulling over which projects he could DIY and which had to be outsourced. He anxiously calculated the costs in his mind, trying to find a compromise.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Unable to fall asleep due to budget anxiety
description: After turning off the lights and lying down, the numbers and plans in his mind lingered, and he couldn't stop thinking. He tried to play a meditation audio and follow deep breathing, but his thoughts wandered. He turned off the audio, opened the stock app for a look, and finally just played a few rounds of mobile games. After tossing and turning until 12:30 a.m., physical exhaustion finally overcame mental anxiety, and he fell asleep in a daze, ending a stressful day with expectations for the store upgrade and anxiety about the budget.
location: On the bed in the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, stretching, washing up, and Japanese study
description: After the alarm went off, I got up quickly and stretched my neck and shoulders. I heard my bones crack and felt relaxed. Then I washed my face with cold water, sat down at my desk, and used the Duolingo app to study Japanese for 15 minutes. I learned the usage of ‘～’ and considered using it in the future when buying art toys in Japan.
location: Room 303, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: His mother served steaming-hot small wontons with seaweed and egg ribbons. While eating breakfast, he listened to his father grumbling about the waste sorting downstairs. Noticing that Lei Mingxuan was distracted, his father reassured him that there was no point in worrying about money and that health was more important. Lei Mingxuan nodded and drank all the soup.
location: Room 303, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Working from home: financial accounting, loan decisions, and online booking
description: He opened his computer and made an Excel spreadsheet. He calculated that the store's demand deposit of 100,000, personal savings of 50,000, and parental support of 50,000 came to a total of 200,000. He then found that the renovation plan required 350,000, leaving a shortfall of 150,000. After discussing it with his father, he decided to go through a formal bank loan; his father suggested using their old family house as collateral. He then used his phone to book an appointment with an account manager through the SPD Bank app for the next morning, noting that he wanted to inquire about a self-employed business loan, and cached an office neck stretching video.
location: Room 303, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: On the way out to the store, shopped at a convenience store.
description: After the rain stopped, he went out wearing a black hardshell jacket and walked to the Xiafei Collection store in Super Brand Mall. Passing Yanqin Grocery Store, he bought a bottle of Suntory unsweetened oolong tea and exchanged a few words with Aunt Zhu, who was watching the store. Then he walked along Pudong Avenue, sipping the tea as he continued toward Lujiazui, enjoying the fresh air after the rain.
location: Near Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, around Yanqin Grocery Store and along Pudong Avenue.

name: Store tasks: collect loan materials and process online orders
description: After arriving at the Xiafeiji store, he confirmed with clerk Xiao Lin that there was no new arrival today. He took the business license copy, the last six months of bank statements, and the rental contract photocopy from the safe under the desk and put them into a document folder. Xiao Lin asked whether he was planning something big again; Lei Mingxuan said he was going to the bank to handle some matters. Then he used the store computer to process a few pending online orders from the previous day and sent a WeChat message to regular customer Feng Xiaoyu, telling her that a hard-shell jacket in size M had been reserved for her.
location: Xiafei Ji store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go to IFC for lunch
description: After locking the store door, he walked across Lujiazui Ring Road to IFC Mall, and at the Ippudo ramen shop on the B1 floor ordered a bowl of the signature Akamaru ramen with a soft-boiled egg. The steaming tonkotsu broth revived him, and he checked the latest updates in the industry group on his phone while eating.
location: Ippudo Ramen, B1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Return home and fully prepare the bank loan materials.
description: After lunch, the sun was just right, so I walked back to my home in Shanggang Community. I immediately started organizing the loan application materials, pulling out my personal credit report, a copy of the property ownership certificate, copies of my father's and my ID cards, a single status certificate, and so on. I sorted them in order and marked them with label stickers. In the middle of this, I called my friend Zhang Lei, who works in finance, to ask in detail about business loan rates, limits, and collateral requirements. I learned that a pure unsecured credit loan is hard to get, while with collateral the interest rate could be negotiated to around 3.8%, though the procedures are rather cumbersome. After hanging up, I felt a bit heavy-hearted, but I still carefully put all the documents into a kraft paper file folder.
location: Room 303, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Helping with household chores and a short rest
description: After sorting materials for two hours, his neck was sore. He went to the living room to drink water, saw his mother picking vegetables in the kitchen, and took the initiative to help wash scallions. His mother worried about the risk of taking out a loan against the house; Lei Mingxuan reassured her that he knew what he was doing.
location: Room 303, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon tea and online socializing
description: Brewed a cup of drip-bag coffee and collapsed onto the sofa to scroll through my phone. First, in the 'Trendy Toy Intelligence Bureau' group chat, I saw people showing off the new LABUBU figures and felt a bit tempted. Then I scrolled Xiaohongshu to learn about outdoor techwear styling trends, looking for inspiration for the store's product selection.
location: Room 303, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast, dinner, and family time
description: Mother made Shanghai-style braised pork belly and stir-fried crown daisy. Lei Mingxuan had dinner with his parents early. At the table, they chatted about the amusing incident of someone finding a cat in the community group. The atmosphere was relaxed, and the loan was not mentioned again. He ate two bowls of rice.
location: Room 303, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-dinner walk and evening preparations
description: Changed into sneakers, went downstairs, and took a 20-minute walk around the community to aid digestion. After returning home, he turned on the computer and prepared the novel document and the previously cached neck stretch video, getting ready for the evening's writing and physical therapy.
location: Shanggang Community and Room 303, Building 7, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel writing: Chapter 8 of 'The Afternoon at Xiafei Fang'.
description: Putting on headphones and playing white noise, he began writing Chapter 8 of 'The Afternoon in Xiafei Lane'. It depicts the scene on the eve of the Spring Festival in 1946, when the protagonist's family returns home after buying New Year goods and finds the house in a mess. He tried to use delicate writing to capture the warmth of everyday life and the sense of crisis of that era. He wrote about 2,000 characters and was gradually hitting his stride.
location: Room 303, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Neck hot compress and stretching physiotherapy
description: After writing for a long time, his neck felt uncomfortable. He saved the document and went to the living room, soaked a towel in hot water to apply a warm compress to his neck for 5 minutes, then followed a cached video on his tablet to do 10 minutes of targeted neck-and-shoulder yoga stretches. The muscle stiffness was relieved.
location: Room 303, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Continued writing the novel and brought it to a close
description: After physical therapy, my spirits improved. Back in the study, I wrote the scene that had stalled earlier in one go. By 10:30, I counted about 2,400 words written today, exceeding my writing goal.
location: Room 303, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Social relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: After turning off the computer and lying down on the bed, he sent a voice message in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group chat saying that the loan was making progress and he would go to the bank tomorrow to dig into the details. Zhang Wei and Li Na instantly replied, teasing and comforting him. Then he put on his eye mask, opened the meditation app, and followed the guided instructions to relax his mind.
location: Room 303, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: Adjusted into a comfortable sleeping position, silently told himself to take one step at a time and handle the bank matter tomorrow first, then fell asleep.
location: Room 303, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: On the rainy morning, Lei Mingxuan gave up his morning run. After lying in bed for a short while, he did 15 minutes of morning stretching, focusing on relieving stiffness in his shoulders and neck. Then he took a hot shower, changed into a white shirt, dark gray trousers, and a navy blue tie, and then completed a 15-minute Duolingo Japanese check-in on his phone in the bathroom. His mother had prepared noodles with shredded pork and greens and a fried egg. Lei Mingxuan chatted with his father about the day's plans while eating. His father encouraged him, 'Don't be too anxious. Just do your best.' After breakfast, he checked the loan documents once more, put on a dark blue suit jacket, tidied himself up at the entryway, mentally rehearsed the conversation with the account manager, gave himself a pep talk, and got ready to leave.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute by taxi to Shanghai Pudong Development Bank
description: Rainy conditions made the roads bad, so Lei Mingxuan took a taxi to SPD Bank's Lujiazui Sub-branch. In the car, he turned off the music, looked at the rainy view outside the window, and repeatedly rehearsed the key points for communicating with the account manager, making final psychological preparations for the loan application. About 30 minutes later, he arrived at the entrance of SPD Bank at 710 Dongfang Road.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community to No. 710 Dongfang Road, SPD Bank (Lujiazui Sub-branch)

name: Submitted a loan application and was rejected
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived early and waited in the credit department waiting area; at 9:30 he met the account manager. He handed over carefully prepared documents and clearly explained the use of funds and repayment plan. After flipping through them, the manager noted that the cash flow over the past six months had been volatile and that there was no stable collateral, so it would be difficult to pass the bank's risk control, and politely refused. After sitting blankly in the bank lobby for five minutes, Lei Mingxuan quickly adjusted his mindset, told himself "there's still Plan B," and calmly walked out of the bank.
location: SPD Bank (Lujiazui Sub-branch), 710 Dongfang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking in the rain as an emotional buffer.
description: After being rejected, Lei Mingxuan decided not to go back to the store for now and walked in the rain along Dongfang Road toward Century Avenue. The cool air and the sound of light rain tapping his umbrella gradually cleared his chaotic thoughts, and he began to think about how to adjust his plan in the afternoon, shifting the focus to online business.
location: Dongfang Road to Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Healing lunch
description: Lei Mingxuan walked into Ippudo Ramen on LG1 of IFC Mall and ordered a bowl of special tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg. As the hot soup went down, both his body and mood warmed up. He used his phone's memo app to note down the tasks he had to do in the afternoon: confirm new requirements with Chen Lei, overturn the old budget, and calculate the renovation costs for the coffee area.
location: Ippudo Ramen, LG1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk back to the store indoors
description: Walked back to Super Brand Mall through the indoor walkway, observing the weekend foot traffic and the mall's new pop-up booth posters, and assessing how the public areas might be utilized.
location: Shanghai IFC Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Handle Double 11 orders and emotional eating.
description: Back at the YOURS fashion store, Lei Mingxuan took off his jacket and used his computer and phone to handle leftover address changes and return/exchange orders from Double 11. He felt inexplicably restless during the process, and the feeling grew stronger after finishing. He took out potato chips and imported chocolate from the snack cabinet, sat on the rest chair, and silently ate them all, using this 'guilty' way to temporarily release his stress.
location: YOURS fashion clothing store, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online solution restructure and developer communication.
description: After calming down, Lei Mingxuan threw designer Liu Tao's full-house renovation sketch into the shredder and used a new notebook to replan: first, the development of an online mini program (budget 100,000 yuan, to be completed before mid-December); second, the renovation of a combined coffee experience and designer toy display area (budget within 50,000 yuan). He then called freelance developer Chen Lei and explained in detail the new mini program features: membership points, appointment check-in, and second-hand trading of designer toys. After more than 20 minutes of discussion, Chen Lei said the new requirements were doable, quoted 12,000 yuan, and said the schedule could be coordinated. Lei Mingxuan gritted his teeth and agreed to the price.
location: YOURS fashion clothing store, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Daily store sales and inventory count.
description: After hanging up, a weight was lifted from his heart. In the afternoon, a few customers came in one after another. Lei Mingxuan received them warmly and successfully sold one hoodie and one beanie. During the lull, he checked the store's inventory of outdoor jackets and designer toys, preparing for the Suzhou company order and regular restocking.
location: YOURS fashion clothing store, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Unexpected visit from the property manager
description: While tidying the shelves, the property manager Zheng Kai (Brother Kai) came by for an inspection. Lei Mingxuan seized the opportunity to bring up his idea of renovating the coffee area at the back of the store and said he would submit a detailed non-structural renovation plan. Brother Kai readily replied that as long as load-bearing walls were untouched and fire safety was not affected, just submitting the required documents would be enough, and reminded him to watch out for nighttime renovation noise. This unexpectedly smooth signal lifted Lei Mingxuan's spirits.
location: YOURS fashion clothing store, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Refining coffee area design and contacting suppliers.
description: Lei Mingxuan used iPad drawing software combined with cafe inspiration to hand-draw the coffee area size zoning and display wall style. Then he contacted supplier Tao Ge from Hangzhou via WeChat, discussed the restocking progress of the windbreakers, and forwarded Feng Xiaoyu's delivery address. He also contacted a retro industrial-style lighting supplier via Taobao to ask for quotes on pendant lamps and wall lamps, preparing in advance for the coffee area atmosphere.
location: YOURS fashion clothing store, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Close the store and walk home
description: After closing, he locked the store door and walked home along Lujiazui West Road toward Pudong Avenue. The rain had stopped and the air was fresh. Lei Mingxuan listened to light jazz on his earphones, reviewing the day's gains and losses while walking, and his mind became completely calm. He had told the family group chat in advance that he would be home for dinner.
location: Shanggang Community, Pudong Avenue, from Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and heart-to-heart
description: When he got home, his mother had already prepared dishes such as braised shrimp. Lei Mingxuan did not hide anything and told them about the loan rejection in the morning and the process of adjusting the plan in the afternoon. His father put down his chopsticks and said seriously, 'Heaven never leaves a man without a way out. Growing the online business is also a way forward. Dad will figure something out for the funding gap.' His mother urged him not to be too anxious and to take care of his health. Their support made him feel deeply warm.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-meal leisure and pour-over coffee
description: After helping my mother clear the dishes, I returned to my room, changed into loose loungewear, and hand-brewed Colombian coffee with a drip kettle, filling the room with aroma. I prepared the ice glasses and projector, and selected the movie "Cowboy Bebop: Knockin' on Heaven's Door".
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Movie night and neck healing
description: Turned off the lights, drew the curtains, projected the movie onto the white wall, and immersed myself in the animation while savoring iced pour-over coffee. The classic jazz soundtrack dispelled the afternoon's worries. After it ended, I savored the moment for a while, then followed a phone video to do 15 minutes of deep neck stretching and meditation, which greatly relieved the soreness in my shoulders and neck.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Vented to his younger cousin over a voice call to relieve stress
description: After relaxing his body and mind, Lei Mingxuan sent a long voice message to his cousin Shen Jie, who works as a fashion buyer, pouring out his frustration over the rejected loan and his new idea of shifting online. Shen Jie quickly replied, saying this was a “blessing in disguise” opportunity, encouraging him that doing well online would give him a much wider reach, and calling him the trendiest online brand owner in Pudong. He was greatly encouraged.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Planning for tomorrow and updating WeChat Moments
description: After hanging up the voice call, Lei Mingxuan listed Saturday's plan in his notebook: go to the store in the morning, then go to Yuanshen Sports Center in the afternoon to play basketball and completely unwind. Later, he uploaded a screenshot of Spike giving a thumbs-up at the end of the movie to WeChat Moments, with the caption: 'Every obstacle is tough, but you get through them all; walk the night road too often and you'll run into ghosts, haha. Sleep well tonight.' After posting, he turned off his phone.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Getting ready for bed and falling asleep peacefully
description: Set the next day's alarm, put the phone on Do Not Disturb, and lay down in bed. Reflecting on the day, although the start was rough, the ending was acceptable, and he felt the calm of having done his best. At 12:30 a.m., he fell into a deep sleep looking forward to the weekend.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and trip preparation
description: On Saturday morning, Mingxuan woke up naturally at 6:45, and after washing up, he did neck stretches. He hand-brewed a cup of Yirgacheffe, checked in on Duolingo for Japanese, and fed his cat A Fu. Then he weighed himself and found he was 81.0 kg, 0.2 kg heavier than yesterday, so he decided to adjust his mindset and walk more today. He picked out a techwear vest and cargo pants, had breakfast with his parents, eating soup dumplings, soy milk, and half a boiled egg, and then checked his backpack for his phone, power bank, store upgrade plan, and other items.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walked to the store and prepared to open and receive goods.
description: Mingxuan wore earphones playing vaporwave music and walked about 25 minutes from Shanggang Residential Area to the REALMIND clothing store in Super Brand Mall. After arriving, he turned on the lights, tidied the shelves, and prepared the coffee machine. Then a SF Express courier delivered two packages of the Steampunk co-branded blind boxes purchased during the Double 11 shopping event. He signed for them and brought them to the counter.
location: REALMIND Clothing Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mystery box unboxing and Xiaohongshu content creation
description: Mingxuan opened the blind box packaging and was surprised to find a hidden "Steam Owl" figure numbered 067, with brass gears that could turn and rich detail. He immediately decided to use it as the theme, pairing the hidden figure with his techwear outfit for photos. He added a gear filter and retro border in the Xingtu app and wrote the caption, "The steampunk collaboration I grabbed during Double 11 has finally arrived! The hidden figure's brass gears actually turn, and they surprisingly go with my techwear vest..." He posted it to Xiaohongshu to attract customers. The whole creation and posting process lasted from 9:30 to 11:00.
location: REALMIND Clothing Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online interaction and store display adjustments
description: Shortly after the Xiaohongshu post was published, it received 73 likes and a few comments. Someone asked about the price of the vest, and Mingxuan replied immediately and guided them to send a private message. While checking the backend data, he rearranged the designer toy area and the blind box display area to optimize the visual presentation, getting ready for customers who might stop by in the afternoon.
location: REALMIND Clothing Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and online socializing
description: Mingxuan locked the store door, walked through the underground passage to Ippudo Ramen in IFC Mall, and ordered a bowl of the signature Akamaru ramen. While eating, he browsed Xiaohongshu and replied to comments, shared photos of blind boxes in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group, interacted with Zhang Wei and Li Na, and also checked messages in the camping group and answered questions about equipment. After the meal, he returned to the store the same way.
location: Ippudo Ramen, LG1, International Finance Center Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return to the store for a brief rest and video meeting
description: Back at the store, Mingxuan drank some water and rested with his eyes closed for ten minutes, then proactively video-called his childhood friend Zhang Wei. He showed Zhang Wei the "Travel Light" version of the upgrade plan. Zhang Wei suggested making changes step by step: first, use the existing shelves and concentrate funds on the online mini-program and coffee pop-up event. He also promised to introduce a contact at the contract manufacturer. The two discussed the pop-up details until 15:30.
location: REALMIND Clothing Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: In-person client reception
description: Shortly after the video ended, a young couple came into the store and showed great interest in the techwear collection.
