Mingxuan enthusiastically introduced the fabrics and designs and put together a few looks for their reference. In the end, the guy bought a black hardshell jacket and the girl bought a bucket hat. Lei Mingxuan felt that today had gotten off to a great start and was in a good mood.
location: REALMIND Clothing Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Final camping activity roster confirmed.
description: While the store was empty, Mingxuan posted a final confirmation thread in the WeChat camping group and @mentioned each registrant one by one, finally confirming a list of 12 people (including himself, Zhang Wei, Chen Hao, Han Dong, Xie Fei, Song Jia, Qian Duoduo, etc.). He privately messaged each person the electronic itinerary and equipment suggestion list, and began coordinating a carpool plan for the November 22 departure.
location: REALMIND Clothing Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Novel Sharing
description: Taking advantage of the quiet in the shop, Mingxuan posted an excerpt from Chapter 9 of 'The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane'—which he had revised in his notebook the previous night—to the 'Shanghai Historical Pen Friends Club' WeChat group, asking everyone for their comments. This was his daily sharing of his personal creative interests.
location: REALMIND Clothing Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mini-program development schedule confirmation and payment.
description: Mingxuan contacted freelance developer Chen Lei, received the mini-program development schedule and reviewed it carefully. The total development period was compressed to four weeks, and the test version was expected to be delivered on December 15. He confirmed the schedule with an electronic signature via DingTalk and paid the first installment of 6000 yuan.
location: REALMIND Clothing Store, A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 West Lujiazui Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closed the shop and bought supplies on the way home.
description: After finishing work, Mingxuan tidied up the store, turned off the power and the rolling shutter door, and walked home. On the way, he stopped by Yanqin Grocery Store, greeted Aunt Zhu, whom he knew well, bought two bags of whole wheat toast and a bottle of unsweetened yogurt, and then returned to Shanggang Residential Complex.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area, from Super Brand Mall back to Shanggang Community via Yanqin Grocery Store (near Lane 136, Pudong Avenue)

name: Family dinner
description: After arriving home, his parents had already prepared dinner: Shanghainese braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and hot soup. While reheating the dishes, Mingxuan told his parents about pulling the hidden figure, and his father gave rare praise. After enjoying dinner by himself, he helped his mother put the dishes into the dishwasher.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Nightly review and foot soaking
description: Mingxuan soaked his feet in hot water while opening an expense-tracking app to record the day's income and expenses: income from selling two pieces of clothing, 62 yuan for lunch, 16 yuan for bread, the first 6,000 yuan installment for the mini-program, and so on. He reviewed the day's achievements: unboxing a hidden figure, attracting traffic via Xiaohongshu, an in-depth conversation with Zhang Wei, finalizing the camping list, and launching the mini-program — he felt very fulfilled. Then he took a photo of the steaming owl and posted a WeChat Moments entry visible only to himself: "Every hurdle was hard, but I cleared them one by one. Today is a good day."
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and follow-up
description: After soaking his feet, his body was tired but his heart was content. Mingxuan remembered that Zhang Wei had promised to recommend a contract manufacturer, so he sent him a WeChat reminder to keep it from going cold. Then he turned off the main light, left the bedside lamp on, lay on the bed doing neck stretches, set the alarm for 8:30 the next morning, and began working on the initial plan for next weekend's pop-up event.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: Mingxuan put his phone on the nightstand and turned off the light. Scenes from the day flashed through his mind. He no longer felt anxious about the loan and, with expectations for the future and ideas for the pop-up event, he fell asleep fairly quickly. His sleep quality was much better than the night before.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning stretching, washing up, and Japanese study
description: The phone alarm went off. Feeling a sore, swollen neck, I didn't get up immediately; I stayed in bed and followed the 'Morning Neck Relief' course on a phone app to do a 10-minute stretch. Then I got up and went to the bathroom. While brushing my teeth with an electric toothbrush, I completed my Japanese check-in on the Duolingo app (day 4). After washing up, I styled my hair with hair wax, changed into a loose white T-shirt and athletic shorts, and got ready to go out.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buy breakfast and arrange a game with the ball-buddy group.
description: He walked to the Yanqin Grocery Store near the community entrance, greeted Aunt Zhu, the owner, and ordered a soy milk, two pan-fried pork buns, and a shredded radish pancake, to go. While waiting, he called out in the 'Yuanshen Basketball Brothers' WeChat group, organizing a 4v4 basketball game at Yuanshen Sports Center at 2 PM, and Xie Fei and others quickly signed up.
location: Yanqin Grocery Store near Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Walked to the store and carried out blind box promotion work.
description: Walking and eating breakfast, I crossed the Lujiazui Central Green and reached the side entrance of Super Brand Mall in about 15 minutes. After arriving at the store, I opened the door, started the cash register system and the speakers, and played Funk music. I took out the “Steam Owl” hidden edition blind box unboxed the day before, and rearranged the display cabinet at the store entrance, placing it on the central wooden steps with the same series' regular edition and gear props, lit by spotlights. I took multiple close-up shots, unboxing process shots, and panoramic display photos, as well as three 15-second short videos. After carefully editing nine images, I added the caption, “The steampunk owl has arrived at our store! The joy of unboxing at midnight — if you know, you know!”, and posted it to Moments, Xiaohongshu, and three designer toy collector WeChat groups. Afterwards, I notified the mini-program developer Chen Lei online and confirmed that the UI draft had been received.
location: Xiafeiji Clothing Store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and online feedback interaction
description: He left the store and walked to the Ippudo ramen restaurant on B1 of the IFC. He ordered a signature tonkotsu ramen and a serving of pan-fried dumplings. While waiting for the food, he checked the morning's social media feedback: the Xiaohongshu post had received 15 likes and 3 comments; he replied to a comment asking about blind box purchasing, and in the collector friends group he had a lively discussion about the video he had just posted.
location: Ippudo Ramen, LG1 Floor, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Return to the store to handle online inquiries and pick up sports equipment.
description: After lunch, he returned to the store in Super Brand Mall. Two online collector friends privately messaged him on WeChat to ask about the hidden figure and the store's co-branded T-shirt. He replied patiently and took the opportunity to pitch the products; one of them showed interest, so he noted down the size. After tidying up the front desk, he picked up the pre-packed sports backpack (containing a basketball jersey, basketball shoes, knee pads, a towel, and a large bottle of water), locked the store, and took the elevator down to the basement level 2 parking lot.
location: Xiafeiji Clothing Store, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove to Yuanshen Sports Center and warmed up
description: Drove from the Super Brand Mall parking lot, set the navigation to Yuanshen Sports Centre, and arrived about 20 minutes later. After arriving, changed into a jersey and basketball shoes, and with basketball buddies including Xie Fei, Wang Lei, and Zhao Qiang, did high knees, lunge stretches, and dynamic stretching. In pairs, they practiced passing and layups, and discussed today's tactical assignments and rotation plan
location: Outdoor basketball court, Yuanshen Sports Center, 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Community basketball game and post-game rest
description: The two teams started a half-court 4v4 rotation game. During the game, I received a clever pass from Xie Fei, stopped and hit a jump shot that swished through the net, then made a successful steal and quickly dribbled to the basket, scoring with a Euro step layup. After the game, I was drenched in sweat, sat on a courtside bench to rehydrate, and reviewed the highlights with the guys while teasing each other. I suggested playing again in the middle of next month, and Xie Fei started a poll in the group to confirm the approximate date.
location: Outdoor Basketball Court and Rest Area, Yuanshen Sports Center, 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Xinjiang Afanti Barbecue dinner gathering
description: He changed clothes and walked to the newly opened Avanti BBQ near the court. Sat around a square table with basketball buddies and ordered grilled lamb skewers, baked naan, big plate chicken, and iced Wusu beer. They ate and chatted, from on-court performance to their respective jobs, and shared the joy of successfully using the hidden figure to draw customers that morning.
location: Afanti Barbecue near 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Drove home, washed up, and changed clothes
description: After saying goodbye to his buddies, he drove home. Once home, he took off his sweat-soaked sportswear, took a shower, and changed into a clean, simple casual shirt and jeans.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family celebration dinner and walk
description: Walking out of the bathroom while drying his hair, he told his parents in the living room that they should go out to eat to celebrate the morning's successful customer traffic and project progress. His father smiled, closed the newspaper, and praised him; his mother patted him on the shoulder and said they would do as Mingxuan said. The family of three walked about 10 minutes to the Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant at Lujiazui Center, chose a window-side booth, poured yellow rice wine for his parents, and ordered a Coke for himself. They ordered the signature Shanghai-style braised pork belly, steamed pomfret, braised spring bamboo shoots, and the daily soup. During the meal, he recounted in detail how, after the loan was rejected, he switched to a pop-up coffee area and a mini program, and how the day's display-based customer traffic had succeeded. His father raised his glass and said, "Take steady steps," while his mother kept adding food to his plate and telling him to take care of his health. After the meal, they walked home along Lujiazui Ring Road, bought a pack of cigarettes for his father at a convenience store on the way, and after arriving home, chatted on the sofa and watched the news for a while.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, 889 South Pudong Road, Lujiazui Center, Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant

name: Contact the designer to adjust the store renovation plan
description: Walking into the study, he called designer Liu Tao and explained that the original 350,000-yuan plan needed to be adjusted in phases: the coffee experience area would be changed into a pop-up spot, with the budget kept under 30,000 yuan and equipment rented; the custom display racks in the designer toy zone would be replaced with ready-made metal shelves, with costs kept under 10,000 yuan; the total budget would be kept to 280,000 yuan, and the first phase would start with the coffee pop-up and the online mini-program. Liu Tao agreed to produce the proposal and new construction drawings within a week.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handle follow-up online matters for the shop.
description: After hanging up, he sent a WeChat message to supplier Zhou Tao, telling him that the previous Suzhou company’s group-buy customers for the hardshell jackets had given excellent feedback, and that he would schedule the weekly plan and start the financial process next week. Then he checked the latest UI design draft screenshots sent by mini-program developer Chen Lei and confirmed they met the requirements.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Soaked his feet, kept accounts, and reviewed Japanese
description: His mother had already boiled hot water. She took out the foot bath bucket and soaked her feet in the living room. Meanwhile, she reviewed the day's expenses on her phone's expense-tracking app (breakfast, lunch, barbecue dinner, treating others to dinner), and noticed that the store had made two offline sales of the co-branded T-shirts that day, with dozens of online inquiries as well. After finishing her foot soak, she returned to the study and completed the small Duolingo unit she had missed earlier that day, ensuring her Japanese check-in streak was not interrupted.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxing in bed and winding down to sleep
description: He lay in bed scrolling through Bilibili for half an hour, watching designer toy unboxing videos and basketball highlights. Then he lurked on a designer toy forum for ten minutes and replied to two posts about the “Steam Owl”. When his eyes felt tired, he put down his phone, turned on the bedside lamp, and read a few pages of a historical novel.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Falling asleep
description: Turned off the light, reviewed the day in the dark, and thought about the next day's plans (confirmed there was a basketball game on Wednesday afternoon and that last week's custom order from a client needed to be dealt with in the morning). Then turned over and gradually fell asleep listening to the traffic outside.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning routine and family breakfast
description: The 7:00 alarm went off. Lei Mingxuan woke up feeling his neck was a bit looser. Leaning against the headboard, he followed a 10-minute neck stretching routine on his phone. After washing up, he had breakfast with his mother, Wang Xiuying, at 8 o'clock: boiled eggs, whole wheat bread, and hot milk. While eating, they chatted about yesterday's hidden edition blind box trend and the afternoon basketball game. His mother reminded him to take care of his health.
location: China, Shanghai, Pudong New Area, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, home bedroom and dining room.

name: Walking commute
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan changed into casual clothes and left at 8:15. He walked along Pudong Avenue to Super Brand Mall for work. The weather was cloudy, 13-17°C. With his step counter on, he walked about 15 minutes and bought a bottle of unsweetened oolong tea at the Lawson convenience store at the intersection along the way.
location: Along the route from Shanggang Community on Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Lujiazui West Road.

name: Store opening preparation and online maintenance
description: At 8:30, Lei Mingxuan arrived at the store, unlocked "Mingxuan Trendy Goods" with his key, and first checked WeChat to reply to late-night customer inquiries and noted down their needs. Then he organized the displays, restocked, wiped the hidden edition "Steam Owl", adjusted the spotlights, took photos, and posted them to three designer toy interest groups and his WeChat Moments with a promotional caption.
location: 'Mingxuan Trend', Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Daily operations and coordinated outfit sales
description: After the store opened, several groups of customers came in. Lei Mingxuan first chatted with them about the blind box series, without rushing to sell. When the customers showed interest in the clothes, he naturally introduced outfit combinations and successfully sold a pair of techwear shorts, a beanie, and several regular blind boxes.
location: 'Mingxuan Trend', Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and online socializing
description: At 12:00, he locked the store and went to IFC Mall for Akamaru Ramen at Ippudo. While waiting for the food, he researched camping tents on his phone, compared prices, and settled on a cotton pyramid tent from a certain brand. He also sent a WeChat message to his cousin Shen Jie, inviting her to the store on the weekend.
location: Ippudo, LG1, IFC Mall, 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Meeting with Mr. Lin, a fellow collector from online.
description: At 1:45, Mr. Lin, an online collector friend, arrived at the store as promised. Lei Mingxuan introduced the design inspiration, painting process, and numbering details of the hidden edition "Steam Owl" in detail, letting the customer feel it with his own hands. He then took the opportunity to recommend gear-shaped earrings and a necklace. Mr. Lin bought a regular steampunk blind box and the earrings, and added the store's WeChat.
location: 'Mingxuan Trend', Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Receiving regular customer Qian Duoduo
description: Qian Duoduo saw the hidden edition in her Moments post and was attracted to come. Lei Mingxuan took out the hidden edition for her to handle, and they talked about its collectible value. When her interest was high, he recommended the co-branded hoodie. Qian Duoduo bought it and said she would help promote it on her social media Moments.
location: 'Mingxuan Trend', Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Customer reception and sales inventory check.
description: After the key customers left, three groups of new customers came into the store. Lei Mingxuan continued to naturally steer the conversation toward selling by talking about blind boxes, and successfully converted several sales. After the number of customers decreased at 17:00, he checked the day's sales on his mobile app and found that blind boxes and designer toys contributed 65% of revenue, reinforcing his confidence in the combined “designer toys + clothing” display strategy.
location: 'Mingxuan Trend', Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Close the store and walk home
description: At 17:30 he turned off the lights, pulled the door closed, and walked home. His step count for the day exceeded 10,000. In the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group, he sent a voice message sharing stories from customer reception and sales data, and friends gave him likes.
location: On the walking path from Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Family dinner
description: Arrived home at 18:00; his parents were already waiting at the dining table. Dinner included his mother's Shanghai-style braised pork and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. Lei Mingxuan told his father about the day's sales, and his father approved of his idea of 'using hobbies to drive business' and reminded him to keep the accounts clear. His mother served him food and told him not to get too tired.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Evening leisure and fruit shopping
description: After dinner, he rested for half an hour. At 19:30, he accompanied his father downstairs for a walk in the community and went to Xianfeng Fruit Store at the community gate to buy blueberries and apples. After returning home, he opened his laptop and ordered his desired tent on JD.com, paying in installments with JD Baitiao. Delivery is expected the day after tomorrow. Then he relaxed and watched the latest episode of 'Frieren: Beyond Journey's End' on Bilibili.
location: Xianfeng Fruit (Shanghai Pudong Dongchang Road store), Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, and home at Shanggang Residential Community

name: Personal growth and social interaction
description: Had a voice call with childhood friends Zhang Wei and Li Na in the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group, discussing new game strategies. Li Na analyzed Xiaohongshu data trends and suggested making unboxing review videos; Lei Mingxuan jotted down notes. After hanging up, he made tea and did a 15-minute full-body relaxation stretch with a foam roller.
location: Study and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Pre-bed preparation and rest.
description: At 22:00, after washing up and changing into pajamas, I leaned against the headboard, checked tomorrow's weather as overcast 13-16°C, and sent outfit photos in the VIP customer group to preview new arrivals. After handling the messages, I set my phone to Do Not Disturb and set an alarm for 7 a.m. the next morning. At 23:00, I turned off the lights and went to sleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China.

name: Morning routine and family breakfast
description: At 7 a.m., Lei Mingxuan was woken by his phone alarm. After getting up, he did ten minutes of stretching in bed, moving his neck. Then he washed up, and while brewing coffee, used a mobile app to complete a 15-minute daily spoken Japanese check-in. After that, he went to the dining room. His father Lei Jianguo was already sitting at the table watching the morning news, and his mother Wang Xiuying served steaming white congee, fried eggs, and xiaolongbao. Lei Mingxuan chatted with his parents while eating breakfast, mentioning that a customer who found the store via Xiaohongshu came in the day before and that they had a pleasant chat. His father reminded him that honesty is the most important thing in business, while his mother nagged him to drink less coffee and take better care of his health.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking commute and store-opening preparation
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan put on his commuter bag, put on his new techwear jacket, and put in a Bluetooth earbud, then walked from home to Super Brand Mall. The weather was nice. He walked along Pudong Avenue, crossed several intersections, and arrived at Super Brand Mall about 25 minutes later, slightly sweaty. When he got to the store, he opened the rolling shutter door, turned on the lights and music, quickly checked the displays, restocked the empty spaces left by yesterday's sales, and used a duster to clean the display box for the "Steam Owl" hidden figure. Then he made himself a pour-over coffee and got ready for the new day's business.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai: walking from Shanggang Residential Area, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, to Lei Mingxuan's clothing store, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road.

name: Phone call with fabric supplier about brand upgrade
description: At 9 a.m., Lei Mingxuan called Zhou Tao, a supplier in Hangzhou, on time, and discussed in detail the plan to upgrade the store into a brand collection store, adding high-quality fabrics and co-branded styles. Zhou Tao expressed support, but suggested meeting at his factory next March, and stressed that new orders would require a 30% deposit in advance to lock in production capacity. Lei Mingxuan quickly calculated the store's cash flow in his mind, felt a bit tight, and replied that he needed to carefully recalculate costs. The two agreed to confirm the initial order quantity in early December. After hanging up, he wrote in his work notebook, 'Find alternative suppliers (for example, can Sister Fang in Guangzhou provide similar fabrics?)' and marked it.
location: Office of Lei Mingxuan's clothing store, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Create a blind box interest group and interact online
description: Online buzz was good, so Lei Mingxuan pulled more than a dozen trendy toy collectors who had been most active on the store's WeChat and Moments into a newly created "Boss Lei's Trendy Toy Flash Group." In the group, he shared a photo from yesterday of the hidden "Steampunk Owl" figure paired with a tactical vest, and told the story from the designer's background to the limited release. To liven up the atmosphere, he started a game of "guess the blind box weight and win a 15%-off coupon," and the group quickly became lively. Lin Jing from Beijing also joined in. Qian Duoduo privately messaged him that the group was a good idea.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Enjoyed Japanese ramen for lunch.
description: There were no customers in the store for the moment. Lei Mingxuan locked the shop door, walked 8 minutes to the basement level of IFC Mall, and ordered a bowl of signature tonkotsu ramen at Ippudo, adding a soft-boiled egg. He ate quickly and felt his energy largely restored.
location: Ippudo Ramen, B1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Received regular customer Feng Xiaoyu and facilitated a clothing sale.
description: After lunch, when he returned to the store and had just tidied the checkout counter, regular customer Feng Xiaoyu showed up right on time. Dressed professionally, she said she was on a business trip in Shanghai and came by to take a look. Lei Mingxuan received her warmly, placed the hidden "Steam Owl" figure on the counter, and vividly talked about everything from the artist's resume to steampunk culture. Feng Xiaoyu was delighted to listen. Although she didn't buy any blind boxes, she was very interested in the new autumn dresses in the store. On Lei Mingxuan's suggestion, she tried on a beige trench dress and a navy blue knitted dress, and ended up buying both. She promised to help promote the store among her colleagues after returning to Suzhou, and invited Lei Mingxuan to be sure to have a meal with her next time he went to Suzhou.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Receive new customers from Xiaohongshu and boost sales of designer toys and clothing
description: Just after Feng Xiaoyu left, three fashionably dressed young women came into the store. They said they had come specially after seeing Lei Mingxuan's Xiaohongshu post about “hidden style + techwear outfits.” Lei Mingxuan received them warmly and, based on their figures and temperaments, focused on showing how the “Steam Owl” blind-box pendant could be layered with a utility vest and tapered pants to create a sense of depth. Two of the women each bought a set of jacket plus pants, while the other bought three regular blind boxes. When ringing up the sale, Lei Mingxuan quickly calculated that, including Feng Xiaoyu's order, today's revenue had already exceeded 1,300 yuan, showing that trendy toys were driving clothing sales very well.
location: Lei Mingxuan Clothing Store, A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store closing tasks and depositing the day's revenue.
description: After the store quieted down, Lei Mingxuan took advantage of this time to count the day's sales revenue and check the accounts. Then he picked up the cash to be deposited and a coin purse, walked to the nearby Huifeng Building, and deposited the cash into the store's settlement account using the first-floor ATM, keeping only a small amount of change for backup.
location: HSBC Tower ATM, 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Close the shop, walk home, and buy pastries.
description: Back at the store, Lei Mingxuan checked the power supply and the doors and windows. After confirming everything was fine, he turned off the lights and pulled down the rolling shutter. The air was fresh, so he chose to walk home. On the way, he passed a bakery and, attracted by the smell, went in to buy freshly baked butterfly pastries and pork floss sponge cakes to bring home for his parents to try.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai: from Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, walk to Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, passing a bakery.

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: When he got home, his mother Wang Xiuying was cooking in the kitchen, and his father Lei Jianguo was watching sports news in the living room. Lei Mingxuan handed the pastries to his mother, and she said with a smile, "You do have a conscience." Dinner was his mother's signature dishes: braised pork, braised eggplant with oil, garlic broccoli, and tomato egg drop soup. The family chatted while eating. Lei Mingxuan told them about how regular customer Feng Xiaoyu had come to the store specially to buy clothes while on a business trip, and his parents were happy to hear it. His mother reminded him not to focus only on work and to make sure he got enough rest.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Contact a college classmate and book a coffee course.
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan helped his mother clean up the kitchen and then returned to his room. On WeChat, he contacted his college classmate Wang Lei to ask about the specific location and course details of the coffee studio Wang Lei had recommended earlier. Wang Lei quickly replied and shared the WeChat business card of the studio manager. Lei Mingxuan added him and immediately called to learn the details of the introductory pour-over coffee course, including content, tuition, and schedule. He was very satisfied and immediately confirmed enrollment in the two evening courses on November 19 (Thursday) and November 26 (Thursday), and transferred the deposit via WeChat.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening study, leisure, and bedtime relaxation
description: After finalizing the course, Lei Mingxuan was in a good mood. He brewed a cup of Pu'er tea and sat down at the computer. He first searched Bilibili for videos such as 'Hand-brewed Coffee Beginner's Guide' and 'Differences in Taste Between Different Drip Filter Cones' to preview, and jotted down key points like grind size and coffee-to-water ratio in his phone memo. After watching the videos, he took out a foam roller and lay on the yoga mat to stretch his calves and back, relieving the fatigue of standing all day. Then he glanced at the WeChat group 'Pudong Three Musketeers', saw Zhang Wei asking about the weekend camping sign-up, and replied that they would count the number of people in a couple of days. Around 21:30, he turned off the computer and went to the bathroom to take a shower. After washing up, he lay in bed, browsed a designer toy forum on his phone, and checked the latest second-hand market prices for hidden styles. Thinking that he would attend his first coffee class tomorrow evening, he felt a bit excited. At 22:30, he put down his phone, turned off the light, and soon fell asleep.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning stretching
description: At 7 a.m., Lei Mingxuan was woken by his alarm clock, with a light drizzle falling outside the window. He felt his neck and shoulders had improved significantly today and credited his persistent stretching for the effect. After washing up, he laid out a yoga mat in the living room, focused on completing a 10-minute neck stretch, and checked in using a mobile app.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and commute
description: After stretching, his mother Wang Xiuying brought out steaming hot wontons. Lei Mingxuan ate while telling his parents that he had a pour-over coffee class tonight and would be home later. His father Lei Jianguo reminded him to be careful on the slippery roads, and he smiled in agreement. At exactly 8:00, he put on his waterproof jacket, drove to Super Brand Mall, and arrived at the parking lot at 8:15 sharp.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Store opening preparations and community activity warm-up
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan opened the door, turned on the lights, and played music in one smooth flow. He quickly wiped the display cabinets, rearranged the blind box area, and styled popular items with matching clothing into small life-scene displays. Then he turned on the computer to organize the participant list from yesterday's "Guess the Weight" event, sent a 10-yuan no-threshold coupon to five group members who had guessed correctly via private message, and announced that a "Share Your Order, Get a Gift" event would start at noon.
location: Lei Chao Society, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Online cloud shopping guide and customer service.
description: At 8:45, Mr. Lin, a collector friend from Hangzhou, initiated a video call. Lei Mingxuan used the rear camera to give him a virtual tour of the store, showing the steampunk blind boxes in detail. Based on Mr. Lin's low-key but design-conscious clothing style, he recommended black-gray techwear shorts and a metal gear bracelet. Although Mr. Lin did not place an order on the spot, he approved of the recommendations and said he would definitely visit the store next time he came to Shanghai. Lei Mingxuan then took a screenshot of the call to use as material for a Moments post.
location: Lei Chao Society, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Small in-person unboxing exchange event
description: At 10:30, three local group friends arrived at the store as promised. Lei Mingxuan warmly greeted them and organized a small exchange meetup. Everyone gathered around the blind box cabinet. He shared tips on shaking boxes to tell the contents by sound and his experiences of impulsively buying full cases. The atmosphere was lively. He spontaneously suggested that everyone pick a blind box on the spot and open it to compare luck. Although no hidden figure appeared, laughter was nonstop. During the event, two passing girls were attracted into the store. Lei Mingxuan introduced the basic gameplay to them, and they each picked a series to buy.
location: Lei Chao Society, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Lunch and online group activity went viral
description: By noon the rain had gradually let up. Lei Mingxuan went to Ippudo at the International Finance Center and ordered a bowl of Akamaru ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While waiting for the noodles, he officially posted the 'Share Your Order and Get a Gift' campaign announcement in the WeChat group: anyone who buys a blind box at the store, takes a photo, posts it on Moments or Xiaohongshu with the store tagged, and sends a screenshot via private message will be among the first three to receive a mystery fridge magnet. As soon as the message went out, the group became lively instantly. He replied while eating, and the group atmosphere was completely energized.
location: Ippudo, LG1 Floor, IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Organize upgrade preparation summary and traffic conversion
description: After dinner, he strolled back to the store. A new customer happily shared after unboxing a desired style, and Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to recommend a matching co-branded T-shirt, successfully closing the sale. Later, when the store was quiet, he sat back down at the cashier counter, opened his laptop, and carefully organized a "store upgrade preparation summary," covering designer Liu Tao's render progress, self-raised funds after the loan rejection and alternative small-loan options, suggestions for speeding up mini-program development (contacting developer Chen Lei to accelerate UI design), and a summary of communication results with supplier Zhou Tao.
location: Lei Chao Society, A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Closing the store and heading home
description: While there were no customers, Lei Mingxuan prepared for closing, reviewed sales data, and sorted the cash. At 15:00 he pulled down the rolling shutter door and drove home. Considering that he needed to talk with his parents in the evening, on the way he stopped at Yanqin Grocery Store at the entrance of Shanggang Community and bought salt-and-pepper fried chicken keel and fries, planning to bring them home as an extra dish to ease the atmosphere. He arrived home at 15:20.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (passing Yanqin Grocery Store)

name: Family dinner and financial discussion
description: When he got home, his mother Wang Xiuying was busy in the kitchen and his father Lei Jianguo was watching TV. Lei Mingxuan put the fried chicken on the table as an extra dish. The dinner atmosphere was harmonious. When the conversation turned to the store's situation, he took the opportunity to bring out the upgrade preparation summary he had organized in the afternoon, explained the store renovation plan and the fact that the loan had been rejected, honestly stated the funding gap, and proposed temporarily borrowing 50,000 yuan from the family, promising to repay it once the coffee area revenue picked up. His mother put down her chopsticks and said she had long been prepared to support him but wanted a plan; his father also nodded in support. Lei Mingxuan felt a huge weight off his mind.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preview the pour-over coffee course
description: After dinner, Lei Mingxuan helped clear the dishes. Then he went back to his room, opened Bilibili, and quickly watched two beginner pour-over coffee tutorial videos to familiarize himself with the basic process and equipment as preparation for the evening class. At 17:50, he grabbed his canvas bag and headed to the coffee studio.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: First pour-over coffee class
description: At exactly 6 o'clock, Lei Mingxuan arrived at the coffee training studio on Zhangyang Road, where Teacher Chen taught the class. Teacher Chen first introduced the flavor differences among coffee beans from Colombia, Ethiopia, and other origins, then demonstrated the full process of grinding, blooming, and pouring water. When Lei Mingxuan tried it himself, the first pot had poor water-flow control and came out bitter. Under the teacher's patient guidance, he adjusted the pouring speed and height, and the second pot improved noticeably. In the end, he completed a pot on his own; the coffee was clear, with balanced acidity and bitterness and a faint fruity aroma. It felt wonderful, and he was full of anticipation for next week's class.
location: A coffee training studio on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking home and sharing joy
description: After class, Lei Mingxuan walked home. The drizzle had stopped and the air was fresh. In the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group, he shared photos of his hand-brewed coffee results. Zhang Wei teased him for playing at being a petty bourgeois, and Li Na asked him to bring some coffee to the shop next time for a taste. He felt delighted, and the day's stress from rushing around melted away in this cup of self-brewed coffee.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening review, washing up, and stretching.
description: After arriving home, his parents had already gone to bed. Lei Mingxuan tiptoed back to his room and used his phone's memo app to note down key points from the coffee class. Then he took out a foam roller and did 15 minutes of deep relaxation on his calves and back, because he had walked over 10,000 steps that day. Next, he took a hot shower and hand-washed his techwear-style jacket.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Free time and bedtime
description: After drying his hair and lying down on the bed, Lei Mingxuan first checked the feedback for the "order-sharing" activity in the WeChat group and saved screenshots of several customers' Moments posts; then he browsed a designer toy forum to keep up with the latest hidden figure news and second-hand prices. At 23:30 he turned off the lights and fell into a deep sleep, looking forward to next week's three-day holiday and the coffee class.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and family updates

location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
