After the meal, I scanned the code to pay and walked back to the store.
location: Ippudo, B1, IFC, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon keeping the store and confirming the roller skating appointment.
description: In the afternoon, with fewer customers, she opened the chat history with Song Jia again behind the cash register, took a screenshot to save the roller skating plan for next week, and listed a checklist of equipment maintenance tools in the phone's memo.
location: Inside store A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store work and customer reception
description: In the afternoon, he focused on looking after the shop and proactively introduced techwear crossbody bags and tactical vests to customers. A couple tried them on and bought an olive-green tactical vest, so he took the opportunity to remind them about next week's pop-up exhibition.
location: Inside store A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing to close the store and walking home
description: Entered sales records, checked inventory, and edited the reminder message for tomorrow's camping trip in the phone memo. At 16:50, he locked the store and walked home. On the way, he called his father Lei Jianguo to let him know he was almost home and arranged to move the equipment after dinner.
location: Walking from Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136 Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Roller skating gear maintenance and cycling route confirmation
description: Take out the roller skates and protective gear from the balcony storage cabinet, clean them with a damp cloth, disassemble the wheels, clean the bearings with a toothbrush, and apply special lubricating oil for maintenance. Then use the map app to plan a shared-bike route for Tuesday's ride to the Riverside Greenway and take a screenshot.
location: Balcony at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Had dinner with parents.
description: The family of three had dinner; mother Wang Xiuying made braised pork belly, sautéed seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. I shared my experience of selling a technical vest during the day. My father praised my communication skills, and my mother reminded me to be safe while camping.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Carrying camping gear with his father and checking the vehicle.
description: Went with his father to the underground garage and securely loaded camping gear such as a tent, sleeping bags, folding table and chairs, camping stove, ingredients, and first-aid kit into the SUV trunk. Then checked tire pressure, engine oil, and coolant, and secured the cooler and the braised dishes and fruit prepared by his mother.
location: Underground garage, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Send the final camping notice and wash up
description: Rested for a while on the living room sofa, posted the edited camping assembly notice to the activity group, and reminded group members to confirm the grouping and itinerary. Then went to the bathroom to wash up.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Browsing guides and interacting in group chats before bed
description: After changing into pajamas and lying in bed, he watched a self-driving Vlog of western Sichuan, then opened the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group, saw Li Na's photos of her new home, replied with emojis, and agreed to meet again after returning from camping.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading and bedtime
description: Read the bedside book The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry for about 20 minutes, then turned off the light, mentally reviewed the next day's camping item list, and fell asleep.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and stretching
description: Lei Mingxuan was woken by his internal clock in the early morning, 15 minutes before his alarm. Feeling a bit stiff in the neck and shoulders, he did a 5-minute neck stretch in bed before getting up to relieve the stiffness caused by the previous night's excitement. Feeling the crisp early-winter air outside the window, he encouraged himself: "Hey, Boss Lei, today you are the team leader!" This injected positive energy into the day's activities.
location: Home bedroom, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and checking gear
description: After quickly washing up, Lei Mingxuan changed into the black shell jacket and cargo pants he had prepared in advance. Before heading out, he carefully checked on his phone the camping gear checklist that his father had helped load into the car, making sure items such as walkie-talkies, a drone, folding chairs, and Kenyan coffee beans were all packed, leaving nothing to chance.
location: Home: Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family Breakfast and Warm Preparation
description: His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared a hearty breakfast for Lei Mingxuan — double-portion large wontons and fried eggs. His father, Lei Jianguo, was already sitting at the table checking the weather on his phone. While eating the substantial breakfast, Lei Mingxuan reported to his father that the vehicle was ready and asked him not to worry. His mother reminded him to wear more clothes because the night was cold. After the meal, he took a bottle of his father's favorite Chongming rice wine from the fridge and tucked it into his backpack as a family gift to bring to the campsite.
location: Home dining room, Room 301, Unit 2, Building 1, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Process online orders and set off
description: Before going out, Lei Mingxuan used his phone to log into the store backend, quickly processed 3 online orders generated last night, and notified the warehouse assistant to ship them that afternoon. Then he went downstairs, drove off from Pudong Avenue, and headed to the Century Park meeting point.
location: Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to the parking space on Pudong Avenue

name: Gathering warm-up and heartwarming coffee
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived at the parking lot of Gate 1, Century Park, at 8:00 sharp. Two teammates, Zhang Wei and Han Dong, had already arrived early. He warmly confirmed the vehicle status with them, then quickly walked to the nearby FamilyMart (Science and Technology Museum Station Store 2), bought 5 hot American coffees at his own expense, and gave them to the early-arriving friends as a surprise, instantly bringing the team closer.
location: Parking lot at Gate 1, Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and FamilyMart (Science and Technology Museum Station Store 2)

name: Fleet briefing and departure mobilization.
description: All 12 teammates and three cars gathered at the parking lot. As the team leader, Lei Mingxuan used a walkie-talkie to briefly introduce the day's itinerary, formation, and safety precautions, especially emphasizing the strong winds at Chongming Dongtan and the need to follow instructions. After distributing the walkie-talkies, he led the lead car to set off first, and the convoy drove toward Chongming along the route of Century Avenue, the Inner Ring Elevated Road, Xiangyin Road Tunnel, Wuzhou Avenue, and the Yangtze River Tunnel-Bridge.
location: Parking lot at Gate 1 of Century Park, 1001 Jinxiu Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Joyful road trip and walkie-talkie interactions.
description: During the drive to Chongming, Lei Mingxuan took on the responsibility of keeping the mood lively, playing light rock songs over the intercom and organizing a "Name That Song" game. When the convoy crossed the Yangtze River Bridge, he reminded everyone to enjoy the wetland scenery on both sides, shouting, "Friends, our Happy Island has arrived—get ready for the wind of the wilderness!", pushing everyone's anticipation to a peak.
location: On the expressway and the Yangtze River Bridge from Pudong New Area to Chongming District, Shanghai.

name: Camp building and leadership display
description: The convoy arrived at the RV campground at Shanghai Dongtan Wetland Park, and Lei Mingxuan directed everyone to unload according to the pre-assigned tasks. He took out the public large conical tarp first, skillfully drove in the stakes and inserted the poles, then directed a few strong guys to raise the main tent. His efficient and organized actions set the tone for the entire campsite setup.
location: Shanghai Dongtan Wetland Park RV Campground, Dongwang Road, Chongming District, Shanghai

name: Lunch, aerial photography, and social media sharing.
description: When everyone was sharing their dry rations, Lei Mingxuan ate a sandwich quickly while launching a drone, and took an aerial view of the camp's initial scale and the distant reed marshes around the campsite. He spent 15 minutes editing a 30-second short video with the caption “2025 Chongming Camping Festival, Opening!” and posted it on WeChat Moments and Xiaohongshu. After that, he chatted and laughed with Zhang Wei, Han Dong, and others, joking about how he had checked his gear until midnight the night before.
location: Inside the campsite at Shanghai Dongtan Wetland Park, Dongwang Road, Chongming District, Shanghai

name: Wetland hiking and birdwatching knowledge sharing
description: Lei Mingxuan led the group willing to hike along the waterfront wooden boardwalk deep into the wetland. Thanks to his prior preparation, he explained to everyone that this was an important stopover on the East Asian-Australasian Flyway for migratory birds, and used binoculars to observe egrets and wild ducks in the distance. Zhao Min kept pressing her camera shutter, and he also took several well-composed photos with his phone. Along the way, when he saw Suaeda salsa, he marveled at the pristine beauty of the wetland.
location: Waterfront wooden boardwalk, Shanghai Dongtan Wetland Park, Dongwang East Road, Chongming District, Shanghai

name: Free time at camp and handling work matters.
description: After returning to the camp, Lei Mingxuan sat on a folding chair and used his phone to handle messages in the store's VIP group, replying to a regular customer's inquiry about the new hoodie. Then he checked his Moments and Douyin posts from that morning and felt happy after seeing dozens of likes and comments. Afterward, he began preparing for the bonfire party, curating songs for the Bluetooth speaker, and confirmed with the teammate in charge of chopping wood that there was enough firewood.
location: Inside the campsite at Shanghai Dongtan Wetland Park, Dongwang Road, Chongming District, Shanghai

name: Evening light-and-shadow photography and device charging
description: As it got dark, Lei Mingxuan again used the drone to shoot a time-lapse of the campsite at sunset, with golden light spilling over the tents and creating an atmospheric scene. After shooting, he charged three power banks to ensure the electronic devices would not run out of power during the evening party and late-night coffee session.
location: Inside the campsite at Shanghai Dongtan Wetland Park, Dongwang Road, Chongming District, Shanghai

name: Hosting the campfire party and leading interactive games
description: As night fell, the bonfire was lit, and Lei Mingxuan used a flint to start the fire for extra ceremony. He walked to the center of the bonfire site and hosted the evening party with a relaxed, humorous opening: 'Welcome, everyone, to the 2025 Lei Mingxuan Camping Awards Ceremony.' He organized one round of 'Who Is the Undercover?' and two rounds of 'Werewolf,' acting as the judge himself. With exaggerated lines and a 'death stare,' he mimicked the werewolf players and made everyone burst out laughing. During breaks between games, he played soft music, and the atmosphere was warm and friendly.
location: Bonfire area, campsite, Shanghai Dongtan Wetland Park, Dongwang Road, Chongming District, Shanghai

name: Late-night coffee and heart-to-heart talk under the stars
description: The campfire was dying down, and most of the team had returned to their tents to rest. Lei Mingxuan took out a portable pour-over kettle, a thermometer, and Kenyan washed coffee beans, used the remaining heat of the campfire charcoal to boil water, and brewed a cup of pour-over coffee for Zhang Wei and Han Dong each. The three sat around drinking coffee, looking up at the clear starry sky in the Chongming countryside, and talked softly about their career confusion and future travel plans. At that moment, Lei Mingxuan felt all the pressure of his loans and the trivialities of the store temporarily dissolve.
location: Next to the campfire area of the campsite at Shanghai Dongtan Wetland Park, Dongwang Road, Chongming District, Shanghai

name: Late-night reflection and sound sleep.
description: Back in the tent, Lei Mingxuan got into his sleeping bag and opened his phone memo to jot down his feelings: "Starry sky, coffee, old friends—this is freedom." He added another line: "My mother's wontons and my father's wine are all in today." After setting the alarm for 7 a.m., he fell into a deep sleep with tired yet contented joy.
location: Inside the tent at the campsite, Shanghai Dongtan Wetland Park, Dongwang Road, Chongming District, Shanghai

name: Camp cleanup and breakfast
description: Woke up early in the morning at the RV camping site in Chongming Dongtan Wetland Park, and used a portable stove to boil water, cook white congee, and toast sliced bread. Organized all 12 teammates for breakfast, and at the same time organized breaking camp according to the Leave No Trace principles, checking each campsite one by one to ensure all garbage was sorted and bagged, and wiping grease off the shared tabletops with wet wipes. While counting the public equipment, I found that the shovel had been mistakenly stuffed into the trunk by teammate Wei Ge.
location: Shanghai Dongtan Wetland Park RV Campground, Dongwang Road, Chongming District, Shanghai

name: Final campsite cleanup and aerial photography
description: After breakfast, he organized his teammates to put the tent, sleeping bags, canopy, and other equipment back in place by vehicle type and load them into the cars. Using the morning light, he launched the drone to shoot the camp panorama and the convoy lineup as the opening of a commemorative video. Teammate Zhao Min used her phone to record the back view of him controlling the drone. Later, he walked around the camp to check for left-behind items, found a power bank, and returned it to teammate Li Ang.
location: Shanghai Dongtan Wetland Park RV Campground, Dongwang Road, Chongming District, Shanghai

name: The convoy set off for the farmhouse restaurant
description: At 9:45 a.m., all equipment was loaded into the vehicles. After confirming via walkie-talkie that all cars were ready, he organized the convoy to leave the campsite in order and drove along Yingbin Road, Dongwang Road, and Chenhai Highway for about 15 minutes to Dalong Farmhouse, which they had scouted in advance.
location: On the way from Dongwang Road to Chennan Highway, Chongming District, Shanghai

name: Lunch gathering at a farmhouse restaurant
description: After arriving at Dalong Farm Stay, the 12 people sat around a large round table and, based on a vote, ordered specialty dishes including signature white-cut chicken, braised Chongming lamb, shredded golden pumpkin, and hairtail fish wontons. During the meal, he thanked everyone for their cooperation over the past two days, announced that he would edit a commemorative video and share it in the group next week, and encouraged everyone to share good photos. He deliberately sat next to Zhao Min and chatted about her cousin doing Xiaohongshu, and they exchanged contact information. After the meal, they scrambled to pay the bill with Alipay.
location: Dalong Farmstay, No. 8 Chennan Highway, Chongming District, Shanghai

name: The convoy returns to Pudong
description: At 11:30, they set off from the farm stay for the return trip, with Han Dong in the car and the back seats piled with gear. They took Chenhai Highway and then turned onto the G40 Shanghai-Shaanxi Expressway, stopping at the Changxing Island service area to rest, use the restroom, and buy sports drinks to refresh themselves. At 1:15 p.m., the convoy arrived at Shanggang Residential Area in Pudong, and the teammates said goodbye and went home.
location: En route from Chongming District, Shanghai to Pudong New Area via the G40 Shanghai-Shaanxi Expressway, stopped at Changxing Island Service Area

name: Air out gear after arriving home
description: After getting home, I first parked the car in the underground garage, then carried the duffel bag and gear bag upstairs. Once inside, I immediately spread out the tent, sleeping bag, and sleeping pad, carried them to the balcony to let them air, and hung up the hardshell jacket and inner layer as well, trying to get rid of as much outdoor dampness as possible. My parents were at home and warmly welcomed me.
location: The balcony and indoor areas of the home at Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Gear cleaning and categorized storage
description: Carefully washed the portable stove burner, cookware set, and utensils by the kitchen sink, and dried them with a dry cloth; wiped the mud spots off the folding table and chairs and the camp lantern with a wet cloth. After inventorying, placed compression bags, tent peg bag, first aid kit, and other items into the balcony storage cabinet by category. Stored one bent tent peg separately and labeled it 'needs replacement' as a reminder to go to Decathlon next week to get a new one.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area - home kitchen and balcony, Shanggang Residential Area, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue

name: Resting, stretching, and replying to messages
description: After finishing the housework, he sat down on the living room sofa, drank jasmine tea brewed by his mother, ate fresh strawberries his father had bought from Pushang vegetable market, and chatted with his parents about camping fun, such as Wei Ge snoring like a tractor. Later, still feeling a bit sore, he did 5 minutes of stretching. Then he went back to the bedroom to check his phone, added the WeChat contact of the younger female cousin introduced by Zhao Min, and saw the Sunday sales data query on the store's POS backend; he decided to wait and go to the store tomorrow.
location: Living room and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organize camping photos
description: Sitting at the computer, I imported the contents of the SD cards from the camera and phone, quickly browsed more than 200 photos taken over the two days, selected about 60 high-quality ones, and created folders for three categories: "Scenery", "People", and "Behind the Scenes". I also dragged the aerial video clips into the computer. In the meantime, my mother called me to dinner, and I replied, "Almost done."
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing dinner and family dinner
description: He washed his hands early and went to the kitchen to help his mother set out bowls and chopsticks. His mother was cooking large wontons stuffed with shepherd's purse and pork; the water was bubbling with steam, and the aroma filled the room. His father brought out his homemade bayberry wine, saying they should celebrate the camping trip's success. The family sat around the table, eating wontons and soup with gusto and toasting one another. After the meal, he volunteered to wash the dishes and clean up the kitchen.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Personal rest and light housework
description: After the meal, he made a cup of tea for his father and sat on the sofa to digest. Noticing that the gear drying on the balcony was beginning to dry, he turned the hardshell jacket inside out and let it continue airing. Then he went back to the bedroom, took out the notebook and pen from his backpack, and prepared to take notes for a video later.
location: Living room, balcony, and bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Collecting Feedback and Photos from the Event Group
description: He opened the event group chat and sent a message of thanks, thanking everyone for their tolerance and cooperation over the past two days, and attached three favorite photos of the campsite morning view and the campfire party group photo. Then, according to the folders sorted in the afternoon, he sent the selected photos to the group album in batches, which instantly triggered enthusiastic responses; everyone shared behind-the-scenes photos with each other. Zhao Min reminded in the group to remember to add her cousin on WeChat.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Initial video editing and documenting on Xiaohongshu
description: Opened the CapCut app, dragged in the aerial footage, and quickly edited a 20-second opening with the soundtrack "The Wind Rises". At the same time, opened the store's Xiaohongshu backend, saw that the data from the past two days was decent and one photo-text note had gone a bit viral, so casually wrote new copy: "This weekend, I took 12 people camping on Chongming and exchanged life stories over a cup of hand-drip coffee and the starry sky." Paired it with the stargazing photo taken earlier, saved it as a draft, and prepared to publish it tomorrow.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime preparation and going to bed early
description: After washing up in the evening, he applied a hot towel to his sore shoulders. While scrolling through short videos, he saw content about using camping outfits as everyday fashion and saved it. He sent a friend request to Zhao Min's cousin with the note "Brother Mingxuan, camping team leader + clothing store owner." After drinking a glass of warm water, he turned off the light and lay in bed reading several posts about "Leave No Trace in the Mountains," planning to share the new ideas he learned with the group. He also mentally ran through tomorrow's store opening preparations. At exactly 9:00 p.m., he put down his phone, dimmed the bedside lamp, and slowly drifted off to sleep in a state of relaxation and anticipation.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning exercise and riverside stroll
description: Woke up naturally at 7 a.m., did some simple stretching at home, changed into sportswear, and went out. Walked 15 minutes to Lujiazui Central Green Park, briskly walked two laps along the trail to loosen up, took photos of the morning river view with his phone, and posted them on Moments.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and breakfast
description: After morning exercise, I went home, took a shower, and changed into loungewear. Mother Wang Xiuying had prepared fried eggs, soy milk, and scallion-oil noodles for breakfast. While eating, I shared camping stories with my parents, Lei Jianguo and Wang Xiuying—about the wind outside the tent and the snoring from the neighboring tent—which made them laugh.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the coffee shop
description: After breakfast, he put on a backpack containing a laptop, power bank, and a folder of exhibit photos, and left. He walked 8 minutes to Dongchang Road Metro Station, took Line 2 toward Xujing East, got off at Nanjing West Road Station, walked 5 minutes, and arrived at the Gray Space Café on Changshu Road in Jing'an District. Along the way, he browsed Xiaohongshu and saw that his camping post had exceeded 100 likes.
location: Gray Space Café, Changshu Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Online work and preparation
description: Arrived at the coffee shop an hour early, ordered a flat white, and sat in a corner to handle work: confirmed the photos of the new products sent by clerk Xiao Zhao and posted them to the community group; replied to a regular customer's styling questions; checked the backend sales data and found that the tech-wear windbreaker he had previously recommended was selling well.
location: Gray Space Café, Changshu Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Discussed the pop-up exhibition plan
description: Zhao Min, a college classmate, arrived on time with draft plans. The two chatted over coffee about the 'Urban Functional Style' pop-up exhibition, covering venue zoning, traffic flow design, and lighting plans. Mingxuan showed the exhibit list and photos of trendy toys. They finalized the division of work: Mingxuan would be responsible for garment exhibits and on-site display, while Zhao Min would handle overall planning and venue negotiations. The goal is to launch by mid-December, and they plan to visit the venue next week.
location: Gray Space Café, Changshu Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: For lunch, he enjoyed braised fish noodles.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhao Min, he walked about 15 minutes to the Old Lane Exquisite Fried Fish Noodle Shop on Jiashan Road, Xuhui District. He ordered the signature exquisite fried fish noodles with a fried egg. The noodles were chewy, and the fried fish was crispy and sweet.
location: Old Alley Exquisite Fried Fish Noodle Shop, No. 53 Jiashan Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Browsing trendy toy stores for inspiration
description: After lunch, I dropped by the X11 designer toy store on Julu Road. I saw many newly released collaboration items and steampunk statues, took photos of the displays for reference, and bought a blind box to use as decoration in the store. On the way, I also bought a cup of Four Seasons Spring tea from Yidiandian.
location: X11 Designer Toy Store, Julu Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the Riverside Greenway.
description: Left Jing'an District, took Metro Line 2 to People's Square Station, transferred to Line 8, and headed to China Art Museum Station. On the train, sent a voice message to Song Jia saying he was almost there.
location: China Art Museum Station, Expo Boulevard, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Arrive at the Riverside Greenway and meet up with Song Jia.
description: After getting out at China Art Museum Station, I walked quickly to the entrance of the Expo Riverside Greenway, saw my friend Song Jia warming up, and the two of us greeted each other with a high five.
location: Riverside Greenway entrance on Expo Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (near China Art Museum Station)

name: Riverside rollerblading to catch up
description: The two put on their protective gear and skated along the wide riverside asphalt road. The early winter river breeze brushed their faces as they skated and chatted about their recent lives: Mingxuan's clothing store had integrated a coffee business, and Song Jia was learning pour-over coffee. They agreed to go ice skating at an indoor rink once it got colder. Halfway through, they rested for 15 minutes at a viewing platform near Houtan Park, enjoying the river view. Song Jia shared her plan to join an inline skating marathon in Suzhou over the weekend, and Mingxuan shared his insights on building physical stamina for a self-driving trip to western Sichuan.
location: Shanghai Pudong New Area Expo Riverside Greenway (China Art Museum - Houtan Park section)

name: Packing up gear and saying goodbye
description: Skated back to the starting point at Houtan Park, used wet wipes to wipe the dust off the roller skates and protective gear. The two said goodbye at the park entrance and agreed to meet at the indoor ice rink next time, or to bring beans to the store to exchange pour-over experience.
location: Houtan Park, 2200 Expo Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Take the subway home.
description: Carrying the gear, walked to World Expo Avenue Station, took Line 13 to Dongchang Road Station, then walked back to Zhangyang Garden. On the way, at Laiyifen by the community gate, bought walnut kernels and preserved plums for his parents.
location: Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organizing gear and preparing for work
description: After arriving home, he cleaned his roller skates and protective gear and hung them on the balcony to dry. He organized the meeting content discussed with Zhao Min that day into an electronic version and uploaded it to a shared document. He replied to online order messages and took photos of the new products arriving at the store tomorrow, sending them to the work group.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: Mother made braised pork ribs, garlic lettuce, and tomato, pickled mustard, and egg soup. Mingxuan shared the pop-up exhibition plan and the proposal from his old classmate. Father Lei Jianguo affirmed his steady approach, and Mother Wang Xiuying reminded him to take care of his health.
location: Home dining room, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rest and brainstorming content for Xiaohongshu
description: After dinner, he curled up on the sofa and used a foam roller to relax his calves while selecting photos from the weekend camping trip. He conceived a Xiaohongshu photo-text note centered on the theme 'my first time leading a 12-person camping group,' drafted it, and planned to publish it tomorrow.
location: Living room at home, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Soaking my feet and catching up on anime
description: Brewed a pot of hot tea, soaked his feet in a foot bath bucket, and watched an episode of this week's popular anime Jujutsu Kaisen on the tablet.
location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Washing up and reading
description: After washing up and changing into pajamas, I read two chapters of 1587, A Year of No Significance, gaining a sense of calm and tranquility after a busy day.
location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Going to bed
description: Turned off the lights and went to sleep, preparing to go to the store tomorrow to check the newly arrived goods.
location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Morning wake-up, breakfast, and weight record
description: After being woken by the alarm clock, he quickly washed up, changed into sportswear in the living room, and did some simple stretching. His father, Lei Jianguo, had already gone to Pushang Vegetable Market to buy fresh pork, and his mother, Wang Xiuying, served yangchun noodles and a fried egg. While eating breakfast, he browsed the store's overnight online messages and WeChat messages on his phone, replying to questions about sizes and delivery times. Before going out, he weighed 80.7 kg and decided that today's step target was 10,000 steps and he would eat fewer staples at dinner.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting on foot to the subway station
description: Put on a thin tech-style jacket, took a commuter bag and earphones, and left. Walked 15 minutes to Dongchang Road Metro Station. There were few pedestrians on the way, the air was damp and cold, and plane tree leaves covered the ground. Opened WeChat Sports to check the step count, and mentally calculated that he needed to walk at least 10,000 steps today.
location: From Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Pudong South Road (formerly Dongchang Road) Metro Station

name: Metro commute and browsing Xiaohongshu
description: Take Metro Line 2 from Dongchang Road to Lujiazui, two stops. Standing in the carriage, I used my phone to browse Xiaohongshu, checking out trending outfits and designer toy news for inspiration for a camping note.
location: Pudong South Road (formerly Dongchang Road) (Metro Station) to Lujiazui (Metro Station)

name: Walk to the store and buy coffee.
description: After exiting Lujiazui Station, he walked across the circular footbridge to Starbucks on B1 of Super Brand Mall, queued to buy a tall latte to go. While waiting, he texted his mother back that he wouldn't be home for lunch.
location: Starbucks, B1 Level, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparations before opening the store
description: Arrived at Leidong Urban Utility, Store A-208 on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, opened the door, turned on the lights and the computer, checked yesterday's sales revenue, and verified the sales records. Found the stock of the camping-style utility pants insufficient and noted the need to reorder. Then sprayed cleaner on the cashier counter, watered the plants in the display area, and prepared for business.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organizing meeting minutes and preparing materials.
description: Based on yesterday's discussion with Zhao Min at the 'Gray Space' café in Jing'an District, I organized the detailed meeting minutes for the pop-up exhibition, covering the exhibit list, venue layout, material requirements, task assignment table, and timeline. I incorporated the 'modular display rack' idea I got from camping in Chongming, and in the 'exhibit style' column, I noted that metal mesh and tie straps could be added to echo the deconstructed urban functional feel while keeping costs manageable. Then I contacted supplier Zhou Tao via WeChat to ask about samples and prices for waterproof twill and matte nylon fabric, and searched Taobao and 1688 for prices of artificial plants, metal grid racks, and spotlights for the exhibition, adding promising sellers to the cart.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and posting camping notes
description: There were not many customers in the store. While serving the occasional customer, he also processed online orders, packed two pieces of clothing, and affixed the shipping labels. Then he selected 9 camping photos from his phone album, adjusted the colors with a photo-editing app, added the hashtags "#BeginnerLeaderGuide#" and "#UrbanFunctionalOutfits#", polished the previously drafted Xiaohongshu note text, and clicked publish.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Interact with the historical fiction group over lunch
description: Went downstairs to Xijiade Shrimp Dumplings on B1 of Super Brand Mall and ordered a serving of celery and shrimp dumplings. While waiting, he participated in the third November discussion in the historical novel enthusiasts WeChat group, posted a passage from his revised novel 'The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane' in the group, and @-mentioned several group members to ask for feedback. The group members offered more professional textual research on the heroine's 'boat-neck long-sleeved qipao' style and shared links to old photos of 1930s Shanghai calendar girls, which he immediately saved for later revision.
location: Xijiade Shrimp Dumplings, B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 55 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Exploring information about vintage coffee shops in Osaka.
description: After lunch, he sat in the seating area by the window in the food court, opened Instagram, and searched for tags such as #OsakaVintageCoffeeShops and #kissaten. He found several Showa-era coffee shops, such as one whose vintage siphon pot, hand-cranked coffee grinder, and celluloid toys excited him. He then saved this shop and two other similar shops mentioned in reviews to Google Maps, and marked them in a collection called "Future Treasure Hunter."
location: Rest area, B1 Food Court, Super Brand Mall, 55 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations, display adjustments, and receiving regular customers
description: Back at the shop, the afternoon foot traffic increased. While attending to customers trying on couple-style techwear vests, he opened Xiaohongshu and checked the camping note he had posted that morning; it already had likes and favorites. During this time, he also exchanged a size for a regular customer and introduced the new backpacks. After the crowd eased, he rearranged the blind box display cabinet, placing the travel-themed hidden editions—such as the “Explorer” and “Photographer”—in prominent positions, with small cards representing Tokyo, Shanghai, and Paris beside them to spark customers' curiosity. During afternoon tea time, regular customer Qian Duoduo brought two friends, Ms. Li and Ms. Wang, to the shop. He welcomed them warmly, starting by complimenting the patchwork hoodie Qian Duoduo was wearing, then naturally leading them to the blind box area and telling the story behind the hidden editions—a backpacker who had traveled alone around the world—and recommended urban commuting outfits. Qian Duoduo bought a new patchwork hoodie, while Ms. Li and Ms. Wang each bought a “City Exploration” steampunk-style blind box set, and they added the shop's WeChat.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Order processing and inventory check
description: After seeing off the customer, I first logged into the online platform to handle three return or exchange requests and replied to two inquiries about the new fabric. Then I went to the warehouse area, checked the inventory of popular camping items and pop-up exhibition props against the plan, and marked them on the iPad. I took the two previously packed online orders downstairs to the mall's central courier point and shipped them.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the mall's express delivery point

name: Walk home to boost step count.
description: Today's step count had just passed 7000, so to reach the 10,000-step goal, he decided to walk home. Leaving Super Brand Mall, he walked west along Lujiazui Ring Road, crossed Century Avenue, and turned onto Pudong Avenue. Wearing earphones, he listened to the podcast Left and Right about the history of banned books in Nazi Germany. After 25 minutes of brisk walking, he arrived at the entrance of the Zhangyang Huayuan residential complex, with the step count exceeding 9000.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area

name: Dinner with family and a walk
description: When he got home, his mother was preparing dinner. That evening there were braised bamboo shoots, stir-fried asparagus, and red-braised pork. He took the initiative to help peel garlic. At the dinner table, he shared the amusing story of Qian Duoduo bringing a new friend to the store and his experiences finding an interesting coffee shop in Japan. His father was very interested in the type of coffee shop. After dinner, he took the initiative to invite his father downstairs for a walk to help digest. The father and son walked around the neighborhood, passing by the gatehouse and chatting with the neighbor uncle. By the time they got home, his step count had exceeded 10,000 steps. He also picked up a parcel at the neighborhood gate: an outdoor folding water bottle he had bought last week.
location: Home and residential area of Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening relaxation and Japanese study
description: After showering, he changed into loungewear and half-reclined on the bed watching the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End on his iPad. During the episode, he checked his Xiaohongshu camping notes and saw they had received over a dozen likes; there was a comment saying “Same campsite, so nostalgic.” He happily liked it and replied “Let's go again sometime!” Afterwards, inspired by photos of an Osaka vintage store, he put down the iPad and started learning Japanese, using Duolingo and a kana chart app to repeat kana aloud, repeatedly practicing “” and “？” and writing kana by hand in his notebook.
location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Planning a Japan store-visit route
description: After studying, he opened Google Maps again, carefully checked the locations and business hours of the shops he had marked in the afternoon, and used the distance measurement and route planning features to design an “Osaka Coffee Treasure Hunt” route: starting from Tenmabashi Station on the Tanimachi subway line, he would walk to three vintage coffee shops with different styles, passing by Namba Shrine, which has a 150-year history, along the way. He saved a screenshot of the route to the “Japan Plan” album and wrote in his notes: “Stop 1: 10:00; also ask the shopkeeper if there are any special items that are not for sale.”
location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening stretching and washing up
description: Spread a yoga mat on the floor and do 15 minutes of full-body stretching, especially kneading the calves that were tight from roller skating. Afterward, wash up, soak your feet, and apply moisturizer to your skin.
location: Bedroom and bathroom at home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep reading and next-day planning
description: Lying in bed, I read Chapter 7, "Li Zhi—A Self-Contradictory Philosopher," from "1587, A Year of No Significance" for about 20 minutes. Feeling sleepy, I closed the book and turned off the light, then quickly ran through the next day's plan in my mind: confirming the shipping progress of fabric samples for the pop-up exhibition, and replying to Zhao Min's comments on the meeting minutes. Then I fell sound asleep.
location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Morning wake-up, stretching, breakfast, and getting ready to go out.
description: It was drizzling in the early morning. After waking up, I did core activation and neck-and-shoulder stretches on the yoga mat in the bedroom, while using the Duolingo app to review Japanese kana and shopping phrases. After washing up, I had breakfast with my mother Wang Xiuying in the living room, with white porridge, fried eggs, and meat buns. During breakfast, I told my parents that I would attend a coffee class in the evening and come home late. My father reminded me to be careful on the slippery rainy roads. After breakfast, I weighed myself: 80.8 kg. Then I packed my backpack with a laptop, power bank, folding umbrella, water bottle, and The Complete Guide to Coffee Latte Art, and opened the chat windows with Zhou Tao and Zhao Min in advance to prepare for the day's work.
location: Home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the store
description: I walked with an umbrella to Minsheng Road Metro Station, took Line 6 to Century Avenue Station, transferred to Line 2, and arrived at Lujiazui Station. I wore earphones the whole way, listening to Japanese listening practice to drill the gojūon kana. After exiting the station, I walked through the B1 level of Super Brand Mall, bought a hot Americano at Starbucks, then went up to the second floor and headed to the store.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning work: opening the store, adjusting displays, and communicating with suppliers.
description: Upon arriving at the store, he opened the door, turned on the lights, and checked water and electricity safety. He used his iPad to review yesterday's revenue and online orders, then listed the day's key tasks after confirming everything was normal. Next, he rearranged the new accessories sent by Sister Fang (techwear belts, outdoor-style hats, tactical chest bags) on the mannequins at the entrance and the display counter to enhance the visual layering. After that, he contacted supplier Zhou Tao via WeChat to ask about the progress of the waterproof breathable fabric samples; the other party replied that SF Express would likely ship them tomorrow. Meanwhile, he used Feishu to urge Zhao Min to provide the minutes of the pop-up exhibition meeting as soon as possible, so that the display plan could be adjusted.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch
description: Went to the 'Simple Kitchen' healthy food bar on B1 of Super Brand Mall and ordered a grilled chicken breast brown rice set meal with a side salad. While waiting, did two sets of neck lateral flexion stretches, which relieved the stiff neck and the discomfort almost disappeared.
location: Jianchu Healthy Dining Bar, B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Midday Japanese study and order processing
description: Back at the store, he sat behind the cash register, reviewed Japanese kana and shopping phrases, and mentally simulated a conversation with a Japanese café owner. Then he processed online orders, packed clothes, printed shipping labels with a thermal printer, and prepared to send them out.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon work: customer reception, inventory counting, and online operations
description: In the afternoon, he first took inventory of the techwear pants and new blind boxes and recorded them in Excel. Qian Duoduo, a regular customer, brought two friends to the store. Mingxuan warmly helped them try on the outdoor vests, and one of her friends bought one on the spot. Qian Duoduo was very interested in the recommended camping hat, so Mingxuan explained the water-repellent and storage design in detail, and she posted a praise on her Moments. Then he chatted with them for about half an hour about light outdoor outfits and new blind box releases, and recommended matching shirts and cargo pants. After seeing the customers off, he replied to private messages on Xiaohongshu about camping outfit ideas, checked the best-selling items that were about to run out of stock, took photos, and contacted the supplier Fang Jie to confirm a restock. His weight measured in the store remained at 80.8 kg.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing preparations and energy replenishment
description: He started packing up, turned off the computer, and closed the shop. To have a quick bite before the upcoming coffee class, he bought a red bean pineapple bun at Yamazaki Bakery on the B1 level of the mall, and used his own cup to get a latte at Manner Coffee, saving 5 yuan.
location: Super Brand Mall and B1, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuted to Tian Coffee Studio.
description: While eating a pineapple bun, he walked to Lujiazui Metro Station, took Line 2 to People's Square Station, transferred to Line 1, and got off at Changshu Road Station. After exiting, he walked along Xinle Road and arrived at Tian Coffee Shanghai Studio, located on the first floor of an old villa. On the way, he continued listening to Japanese vocabulary on a mobile phone app.
location: Tian Coffee Shanghai Studio, Lane 70, Xinle Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Arrive at the studio early to discuss with the instructor
description: Arrived 45 minutes early. Teacher Chen was adjusting the equipment, and Mingxuan helped arrange the practice espresso cups. During the conversation, he mentioned that he wanted to focus on latte art and felt that frothing milk was the hardest. Teacher Chen smiled and encouraged him to practice that as today's focus.
location: Tian Coffee Shanghai Studio, Lane 70, Xinle Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Basic Latte Art Course
description: Teacher Chen taught the basics of latte art, first demonstrating how to steam milk with the steam wand and stressing the temperature of 60-65°C and the angle of insertion. Mingxuan's first two attempts produced milk foam that was too thick, too thin, or even splattering. After guidance, he got ideal foam on the third try. Next he learned to pour in the milk and work the wiggling motion. His first cup had a vague, abstract heart shape, but he kept working at it and, after drinking more than a dozen cups, finally managed a recognizable heart pattern. He immediately took a photo to remember the moment.
location: Tian Coffee Shanghai Studio, Lane 70, Xinle Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Post-class discussion and equipment cleaning
description: After the other trainees left, Mingxuan helped Teacher Chen wash the equipment and shared his idea of setting up a coffee corner in the store, combining outdoor camping with coffee. Teacher Chen suggested using an Aeropress or V60 in the early stage, as they are low-cost and easy to operate, and recommended several brands of dark-roast beans suitable for outdoor brewing. Before leaving, Mingxuan was given a small bag of practice beans and a few plastic measuring spoons to practice at home.
location: Tian Coffee Shanghai Studio, Lane 70, Xinle Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai

name: Walking to Ramen Family
description: Left the studio with an umbrella, walked north along Xinle Road, crossed Huaihai Middle Road, and arrived at 'Ramen Family' on Renmin Road, Huangpu District, after about fifteen minutes.
location: Ramen Family, 399 Renmin Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: Treat dinner: Japanese ramen.
description: At a somewhat empty ramen shop, he ordered a bowl of signature tonkotsu ramen with a soft-boiled egg and chashu. After downing the piping-hot noodles, his fatigue vanished. At checkout, he thought his weight might rise slightly tomorrow, but the joy of learning a new latte art skill was more precious.
location: Ramen Family, 399 Renmin Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai

name: Commute home
description: After eating, he walked with an umbrella to Dashijie Station, took Line 8 to People's Square Station, transferred to Line 2, then transferred to Line 6 at Century Avenue Station, and finally got off at Minsheng Road Station and walked back to Zhangyang Huayuan. Along the way, he used the memo app on his phone to record in detail the coffee bean brands and brewing suggestions recommended by Teacher Chen, and continued listening to Japanese.
location: Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Sharing latte art results and family interaction
description: After getting home, his mother Wang Xiuying asked how the class had gone, and Mingxuan excitedly showed her the photo of the heart-shaped latte art. He posted on WeChat Moments: 'Rainy day, latte art class. After ruining more than a dozen cups, a little heart finally appeared—blurred on the edges but clear in outline. Keep practicing!' The post was paired with photos of the latte art result and the workbench, and it received likes from customers such as Qian Duoduo.
location: Living room at home, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime stretching, reflection, and falling asleep
description: Still thinking about the ramen matter, he did 15 minutes of full-body stretching, focusing on relaxing his legs and neck, then washed up and changed clothes. After lying down, he browsed WeChat Moments and liked posts, then reviewed the whole day: the pop-up exhibition meeting notes still needed follow-up, Zhou Tao's fabric samples were to be shipped tomorrow, inventory had been counted, and he had mastered the basics of latte art. He planned tomorrow's tasks: follow up with Zhao Min about the meeting notes, confirm the sample logistics, and practice latte art with the new coffee beans. With a sense of accomplishment, he fell asleep peacefully to the sound of rain outside the window.
location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Morning home workout and breakfast.
description: At seven in the morning, Lei Mingxuan was woken up by his alarm clock. Because it was overcast and cold outside, he gave up his outdoor morning run, laid out a yoga mat in the bedroom, and did 15 minutes of core strength training and full-body stretching. After exercising, he weighed himself and found he was 81 kg, reminding himself to watch his diet. After working out, he took a quick shower, changed into a casual hoodie and sweatpants, and went to the dining room. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared white rice porridge, fried eggs, and the leftover pan-fried buns from the previous night. The three chatted while eating. Lei Mingxuan mentioned that he planned to close the store early at 4:30 p.m. and come home to prepare Thanksgiving dinner together. His mother smiled and said she had already bought pork belly and flour in the morning. His father, Lei Jianguo, put down his newspaper and nodded in agreement.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walking commute to the store
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan shouldered his commuter bag, put on his windbreaker, said goodbye to his parents, and walked out alone. He walked along the familiar Pudong Avenue, passed the Dongchang Road metro station entrance, and arrived at the side entrance of Super Brand Mall about 25 minutes later. On the way, he passed a flower shop and bought a carnation, planning to give it to his mother that evening as a small Thanksgiving gift.
location: Along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui West Road in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store work and latte art practice.
description: After Lei Mingxuan arrived at the clothing store on the second floor of Super Brand Mall, he first turned on the computer and the cash register system. Then he handled two important tasks: at 8:45 he sent a WeChat message to supplier Zhou Tao to confirm whether the fabric samples promised yesterday had been shipped, and asked for the SF Express tracking number; the other party replied instantly that they had been sent half an hour ago. At 9:15 he again urged partner Zhao Min to send the pop-up store meeting minutes, and Zhao Min replied that they would be sent before noon. After dealing with these matters, the store traffic gradually thinned at 10 a.m. Lei Mingxuan took out practice coffee beans and a measuring spoon, and concentrated on practicing latte art behind the counter, focusing on the “top finish” technique. He made six cups in a row, and the last cup successfully produced a relatively symmetrical leaf pattern. He immediately took a photo to record his progress. Staff member Xiao Lin helped watch the store nearby.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and a stroll through the mall
description: At noon, Lei Mingxuan turned off the music in the store, told Xiao Lin to keep an eye on the shop, and walked alone across the pedestrian bridge to Shanghai ifc mall. At a light food shop on the basement level, he ordered a teriyaki chicken breast salad and an American coffee. After a quick meal, he wandered around the mall for about ten minutes, specifically observing the window displays of other menswear stores to find decorating inspiration for his own clothing store.
location: B1, Shanghai ifc Mall (International Finance Center Mall), No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and wrap-up
description: Back at the store, Lei Mingxuan packed two online orders, then had Xiao Lin take the packages to the courier point on the first floor of the mall to send them out. During his free time, he checked this month's inventory data, found that several basic T-shirts needed restocking, and jotted them down in his memo. At 2:30 pm, returning customer Qian Duoduo sent a WeChat message asking whether the weekend's new techwear jacket had her size. Lei Mingxuan checked the stock and reserved one for her. After that, foot traffic in the store remained quite light.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing early and buying fruit
description: After 3:30 in the afternoon, there were almost no new customers in the shop, so Lei Mingxuan decided to close early. He told Xiao Lin the next day's priorities and the precautions for Saturday's new arrivals, counted and settled the day's revenue, then locked the shop door. On the walk home, he deliberately took a detour to Guobo Urban Fresh Fruit Shop on Zhaoyuan Road, picked out a large box of imported cherries and a bag of fresh tangerines, and the proprietress threw in a few extra kumquats. Lei Mingxuan continued home carrying the fruit.
location: Guobo City Fresh Fruit Store, Zhaoyuan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Thanksgiving family meal preparation and dinner
description: Lei Mingxuan arrived home at about 4:20 p.m. The kitchen was already filled with a rich meaty aroma. His mother Wang Xiuying was cooking Shanghai-style braised pork belly at the stove, and his father Lei Jianguo was reading a newspaper in the living room. After washing his hands, Lei Mingxuan went into the kitchen to help, peeling garlic and cutting cabbage to prepare the borscht. Meanwhile, his father came into the kitchen with some hot tea and asked about the blind box sales at the shop. Lei Mingxuan told him the good news that Zhou Tao had shipped the goods and Qian Duoduo had placed a pre-order. His father told him not to let up on his online business and to update his personal Xiaohongshu account regularly. At exactly 6 p.m., dinner was served. The table was filled with glossy braised pork belly, golden and crispy pan-fried buns, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and steaming borscht. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan poured a cup of tea for each of his parents, stood up, raised his cup, and solemnly expressed his gratitude: "Today is Thanksgiving, and the people I want to thank most are you. Without your support, my shop wouldn't be going so smoothly." His father patted him on the shoulder and said in a low voice, "We're family, so don't talk like that. Getting your career on track is the best reward for us." His mother's eyes grew slightly red, and she smiled while constantly picking up food for him with her chopsticks. The atmosphere was warm and touching.
location: Home (kitchen and dining room) in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After-dinner walk and quality time at home
description: As dinner was winding down, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the dishes and chopsticks, then suggested that the family of three take a walk in the community garden to help digestion, and his parents readily agreed. The three walked along the dimly lit paths in the community, with his mother linking her arm through his father's and Lei Mingxuan keeping them company. They chatted about the shepherd's purse wontons that Aunt Zhu next door had brought yesterday, and the arrangement for his mother's choir's community performance next month, laughing and talking all the way. After the walk, back home, Lei Mingxuan and his mother sealed the leftover pan-fried buns and braised pork in plastic wrap and put them in the fridge. Then he washed the dishes and plates, scrubbed the pot, and wiped down the stove by himself, while his mother wiped the table beside him, the two chatting casually as they did the chores. When everything was cleaned up, Lei Mingxuan went to the living room and kept his father company watching the evening news. Pointing at a report on the real economy, his father again suggested that he refer more to other successful cases of transformation.
location: Garden of Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the living room and kitchen at home

name: Pre-Sleep Wind-Down Preparation
description: After washing up, Lei Mingxuan brought a basin of hot water to soak his feet. The full twenty-minute soak relieved the fatigue of the whole day. During this time, he scrolled through Xiaohongshu on his phone and saw that Qian Duoduo, a regular customer, had commented under the post about the reserved coats that she would come pick them up tomorrow; he gave it a like. Then he opened WeChat and replied to Thanksgiving greetings from several friends.
location: Bathroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-bedtime reading and recording insights
description: After soaking his feet and changing into pajamas, Lei Mingxuan leaned back on the bed. He first carefully went through the pop-up exhibition meeting minutes sent by Zhao Min and jotted down several action points in the phone memo. Then he picked up '1587, A Year of No Significance' from the bedside and read for half an hour. As it approached 10:30, he turned off the main light, leaving only the bedside lamp, and wrote in his memo: 'My latte art has improved, and it feels so good to be with family on Thanksgiving. Starting tomorrow, I need to increase the frequency of online content updates.'
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Early bedtime
description: At 10:40, Lei Mingxuan turned off the bedside lamp and put his phone aside. Reflecting on the fulfilling and warm day, especially the satisfaction brought by the Thanksgiving dinner with his parents, he soon fell into a deep sleep, storing up energy for the busy day ahead.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning bodyweight training and stretching
description: After the 7 o'clock alarm went off, Lei Mingxuan got up and did his morning workout. He spread a yoga mat on the bedroom floor, first did 10 minutes of dynamic stretches for the neck, shoulders, and hips to wake up his body, then attempted 15 standard push-ups and a 30-second plank. Although his strength had declined, his core still got an effective workout, and he felt refreshed afterward.
location: Bedroom at home, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: After training, Lei Mingxuan showered and changed into loungewear, then had breakfast with his parents. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared plain congee, fried eggs, pickled vegetables, and shepherd's purse and pork buns. During the meal, he told his parents he would not be home for dinner, as he planned to play billiards with Han Dong and eat out. His father, Lei Jianguo, encouraged him to enjoy some recreation, while his mother reminded him to keep warm.
location: Home dining room, Building 2, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Cycle commute to the store
description: After breakfast, Lei Mingxuan put on his hardshell jacket, helmet, and gloves, unlocked a shared bike, and rode along Pudong Avenue onto Zhangyang Road toward Lujiazui. The weather was cloudy, with temperatures of 8 to 12 degrees Celsius, making the ride comfortable. Along the way, he listened to a podcast and arrived at the side entrance of Super Brand Mall at about 8:50, parking the bike in the designated area.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Tended the store and handled orders in the morning
description: After arriving at the store, Lei Mingxuan opened the rolling shutter door, started the cash register system, and checked product displays and cleanliness. He handled the printing of the previous night's online orders and prepared items for shipment, placing them all in the mall's express delivery point. He then exported the sales data for designer toys and co-branded apparel from November 1 to 27, pre-classifying it for the afternoon analysis. During this time, he also replied to regular customers' WeChat inquiries about when new items would arrive.
location: 'ChillWave', Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Lunch and collecting Christmas display inspiration.
description: At noon, Lei Mingxuan closed the shop and walked to IFC Mall. At the Ippudo ramen shop, he ordered a bowl of signature Akamaru ramen with a soft-boiled egg. While waiting and eating, he carefully observed the mall's Christmas decorations—large glowing gift boxes, hanging colored crystal balls, and other lighting displays—took photos with his phone to record the design techniques, and sent them to the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group to share inspiration. He also invited his friend Zhang Wei to play billiards in the evening and got his confirmation.
location: "Ippudo" ramen restaurant, LG1 Floor, International Finance Center Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Browsing the mall on the way back to the store
description: After lunch, Lei Mingxuan walked back from IFC to Super Brand Mall. Instead of going straight back to the store, he took an extra loop around the mall's first floor and atrium, noting the display techniques of other trendy clothing stores and multi-brand stores and observing color combinations and traffic-flow design, to gather useful ideas for his own store's Christmas-season setup.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China

name: Sales data analysis and recording
description: Back at the checkout counter in the store, Lei Mingxuan opened Excel to conduct an in-depth analysis of November sales data. He compared this month with the same period in October, calculated a month-over-month growth of about 15.2%, and found that the hidden-style blind box campaign with the steampunk collaboration was notably effective, driving sales of the related techwear T-shirts and camping hats, with the conversion rate rising nearly 20%. In his business journal, he summarized that the combined strategy of 'scarcity of hidden styles + Xiaohongshu preheating + in-store slow livestreaming' had worked, planned to replicate and upgrade it for the Christmas season, and generated a bar chart with a trend line for use when discussing pop-up events with Zhao Min.
