name: Evening leisure and reading
description: Leaning on the living room sofa, he sent voice messages in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group, complaining about the negative review appeal and Japanese study, and got responses from Li Na and Zhang Wei. After the group chat, he curled up on the sofa and read Chapters 3 and 4 of '1587, A Year of No Significance,' focusing on the conflict between the civil official class and Emperor Wanli.
location: Living room and study at home, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai, China

name: Washing up and preparing for bed
description: Set an alarm for 8 a.m. the next day, then go to the bathroom to wash up. In the phone calendar, set a countdown reminder for the tooth extraction surgery at 3 p.m. on December 5. After returning to the bedroom, check that the balcony doors and windows are closed.
location: Home bathroom and bedroom at Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going to bed
description: Turned off the light and lay down, replaying the day in my mind: the negative review appeal made progress, I learned Japanese numbers and ukulele chords, my fitness plan was praised by friends, and I felt fulfilled and at ease. Fell asleep to the occasional sound of cars outside the window.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning indoor stretching and breakfast.
description: After the alarm went off a second time, he got up. Since it was raining and he couldn't run outdoors, Lei Mingxuan did 15 minutes of indoor stretching on the bedroom carpet (including cat-cow, downward dog, plank, etc.) and bodyweight training (15 push-ups, 3 sets of 30-second squats). After washing up, he went to the dining room to enjoy the breakfast prepared by his mother Wang Xiuying: millet porridge, a fried egg, and two small steamed buns. While eating, he scrolled through WeChat group chats and saw feedback from group members on yesterday's progress in the negative review appeal. The encouraging messages from Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu lifted his mood.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and Japanese study check-in
description: He put on a windbreaker, took a folding umbrella, and left. After walking about 8 minutes to Lujiazui Metro Station, passing Dongchang Road on the way, he took Metro Line 2 toward Xujing East, about a 14-minute ride. On the subway, he opened the Duolingo app on his phone to complete his daily Japanese check-in task, focusing on reviewing katakana such as "、、" and reading several example sentences aloud to lay the groundwork for future study.
location: Lujiazui Station, Metro Line 2, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (from Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui Station)

name: Store opening preparations and finalizing the negative review appeal
description: Arriving at the Mingxuan Trendy Clothing Store in Super Brand Mall, Lei Mingxuan took off his jacket and worked with shop assistant Xiao Lin to tidy the window display, making sure the clothes on the mannequins were smooth and wrinkle-free. He checked the packing lists for yesterday's online orders, arranged today's key displays, implemented the display concept of camping lanterns and pinecone strings, and adjusted the mannequin outfits to emphasize the outdoor functional style. Then he opened his tablet and logged into Xiaohongshu to check the appeal results for a negative review. Finding that the platform had determined the malicious review was valid and deleted it, he breathed a long sigh of relief, immediately took a screenshot and sent it to the customer group, and privately thanked regular customers such as Qian Duoduo and Feng Xiaoyu for their support.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Shop A-208, Mingxuan Trend Clothing Store

name: Open in the morning
description: Light J-pop music was playing in the store, and customers were served as usual. Lei Mingxuan focused on sales, introducing the waterproof and windproof features of the newly arrived techwear jackets. He successfully sold a gray size M hardshell jacket and a baseball cap. Xiao Lin was responsible for organizing shelves, restocking, and guiding customers. Meanwhile, Lei Mingxuan jotted down new ideas for the camping market display in his notebook at the cash register. Around 11:00, the neighboring store's renovation began moving materials in, and faint noise could be heard, but the impact was limited. By 11:30 the noise had grown louder. He still insisted on finishing with the customers at hand and did not take action for the time being.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Shop A-208, Mingxuan Trend Clothing Store

name: Lunch, Japanese test, and rest
description: After telling Xiao Lin to watch the store, Lei Mingxuan went down to Green & Fresh, a light-food restaurant on B1 of the mall, and ordered a chicken breast avocado salad and a hot Americano. While eating, he opened the gojūon chart test app for an overall test. His hiragana responses were fast, but the katakana “、、” still caused confusion. He ended up with an 85% accuracy rate. He felt satisfied, noted down the confusing kana, and planned to review them in the evening. After eating, he walked back to the store, and Xiao Lin had already returned. He checked the items in the online orders to be shipped that afternoon and confirmed everything was correct. Then he browsed the basketball group chat and learned that because of the rain, the outdoor court had been closed, and Xie Fei had changed the venue to Court 6 in the indoor arena at Yuanshen Sports Center. He replied, “Got it, I'll be there on time!”
location: Green & Fresh light meal shop and store, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Coordinate with the neighboring store about renovation noise
description: Around 2 p.m., the sound of electric drills and hammering from the neighboring shop suddenly intensified, seriously affecting customers' fitting experience. Lei Mingxuan felt irritated, asked Xiao Lin to reassure customers, and hurried to the property management office on the fourth floor, where he found the property manager Zheng Kai. He explained the impact of the noise on peak customer traffic and hoped the construction crew, in addition to stopping during lunch breaks, could schedule large jobs after closing time. Zheng Kai said he would coordinate with the foreman immediately and promised to minimize the noise as much as possible. After thanking him, Lei Mingxuan returned to the shop.
location: Property management office, 4th floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Afternoon store operations and display optimization.
description: Back at the store, the noise had clearly subsided. Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin put the morning's display ideas into practice: they set up camping tables and chairs on the central island, hung strings of pinecones and vintage camping lanterns, creating an "indoor camping" atmosphere. Two female customers took photos and posted them on Moments; he warmly gave them store-customized keychains. Between serving customers, Lei Mingxuan opened the notes app on his phone and further refined the camping market display plan, jotting down details such as "use wooden hangers" and "handwritten price tags."
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Super Brand Mall, 2nd Floor, Shop A-208, Mingxuan Trend Clothing Store

name: Closing-up tasks before the store closes
description: When closing time came, Lei Mingxuan helped Xiao Lin check the day's revenue and inventory and confirmed everything was correct. He packed and sealed the two online orders that had been prepared in the afternoon (a fall/winter coat and a scarf) and a pair of pants reserved for a customer. Then he took the packages, said goodbye to Xiao Lin, walked about 9 minutes to the luggage lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station at the entrance of the subway passage on B1 of Super Brand Mall, put the packages in, and scanned the code to place an order for the courier to pick them up.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the luggage lockers at Lujiazui Metro Station (158 Huayuanshiqiao Road)

name: Going home and picking up packages
description: Entered the metro station from level B1, took Line 2 home, and rode for about 12 minutes. I picked up the small butane canister bought the day before yesterday for camping (backup fuel for the camping lamp) at the Cainiao Station near the residential community, confirmed the package was intact, and walked home.
location: Cainiao Station, South Gate, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and sharing.
description: When he got home, his mother had already prepared dinner: braised pork ribs, garlic broccoli, and tomato and egg soup. The family sat around the table, and Lei Mingxuan shared the day's fun events: a negative review was removed, he successfully coordinated the noise issue, passed the kana test, and had ideas for the weekend camping market. His father Lei Jianguo listened with great interest and reminded him to reserve enough circulation space for activities in the mall. The whole family enjoyed chatting.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Japanese vocabulary study and ukulele practice
description: After dinner, taking a short break, Lei Mingxuan began studying in the study. He opened his Japanese notebook and studied the shopping phrases unit, writing down the Japanese equivalents for S, M, L, and XL (S, M, L, XL), as well as sentence patterns like 'What color is this?' and 'I'd like a size M, thank you.' He practiced for about 20 minutes using a self-question-and-answer method. Then he picked up the ukulele and focused on practicing the C-Am-F chord changes, trying to play the first few bars of 'The Meaning of Travel.' Although there was the occasional buzz, his fluency improved.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Indoor stretching and heading to the basketball court
description: He changed into athletic shorts and a T-shirt, unrolled a yoga mat in the living room, and did a 10-minute full-body stretch, focusing on loosening up his shoulders, neck, and legs. After taking a sip of water, he packed his basketball shoes, jersey, and sports towel into his backpack. He put on a windbreaker, went out, and called a rideshare via a mobile app at the neighborhood gate to go to the indoor basketball court at Yuanshen Sports Center. On the way, he sent a message to Xie Fei: 'Brother Fei, I've set out, I'll be there in about ten minutes!' The car radio was playing the evening news, and he arrived at the destination about 15 minutes later.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Shanggang Community, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Indoor Basketball Gym, Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 656 Yuanshen Road

name: Indoor basketball session and returning home.
description: After arriving, he quickly changed clothes and warmed up, then formed two teams with Xie Fei and six other ball-playing friends for a full-court game. Lei Mingxuan used his weight advantage to actively post up inside, grab rebounds, and deliver several assists. During halftime, he talked with Xie Fei about taking Japanese lessons in the evening; Xie Fei joked, 'Now you can yell fouls in Japanese.' He played six periods in total, making a key mid-range shot in one of them. After exercising, he did simple stretches on the sidelines for his hamstrings and calves, changed into dry clothes, said goodbye to his teammates, and walked about 15 minutes home. On the way, the evening breeze gently blew, and his body felt comfortable.
location: Indoor basketball gym at Yuanshen Sports Center, No. 656 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and on the way home

name: Washing up and pre-sleep relaxation
description: After getting home, he threw his sports gear into the laundry basket, took a quick shower to wash off the smell of sweat, and changed into loose pajamas. Lying in bed, he scrolled through Bilibili for a while, found that Frieren: Beyond Journey's End had an update today, and decisively watched the latest episode, enjoying quiet time before sleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime preparations
description: After watching the anime, Lei Mingxuan turned off the light and reviewed the day in his mind: he had reached his study goals (passed the Japanese test, started learning vocabulary), solved the store's problems (negative review, noise), and completed his exercise plan (basketball and stretching). He felt fulfilled and satisfied. He set the alarm for 7:45 the next morning and reminded himself to fast before his tooth extraction at 3 p.m. on Friday. He put his phone on the nightstand, closed his eyes, and fell asleep.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up, getting ready, and breakfast
description: The alarm went off at 7:30 a.m. Because he had gone to bed late the night before, he woke up a bit drowsy, but since it was the last free day before the tooth extraction, he hurried to get up. While washing up, he weighed himself at 80.3 kg and did a set of stretches. Then he went to the dining room to have breakfast with his parents, Wang Xiuying and Lei Jianguo, eating plain rice porridge, fried eggs, meat buns, and pickled cucumbers. At the same time, he told them today's plan: first go to the supermarket to buy ingredients for liquid food, then go to the store to meet with the shop assistant Xiao Lin and go over the weekend arrangements. His mother felt gratified, and his father reminded him to rest well after the tooth extraction.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walked to Lianhua Supermarket to buy ingredients for liquid meals.
description: After breakfast, he put on a hoodie and earphones, and walked from home to Lianhua Supermarket. During the commute, he opened the Duolingo app to review shopping-themed Japanese and practiced sentences about asking for sizes. After arriving at the supermarket, he went straight to the grain and oil section and bought organic millet, instant oatmeal, plain milk, and fresh eggs; then he went to the bread section to get soft toast, plain yogurt, and bananas, preparing for a liquid diet after tooth extraction. At checkout, he chatted with the cashier auntie and said he was stocking up for tomorrow's tooth extraction.
location: Lianhua Supermarket (Zhangyang Road Store), 1255 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the store, studying Japanese, and preparing in the store
description: Took a taxi from the supermarket to the store at Super Brand Mall. In the cab, handled online order messages, replied to a regular customer's inquiry about the techwear jacket, and marked new orders. After arriving at the store, greeted clerk Xiao Lin and put the purchased ingredients in the break area. Then found a quiet corner and spent 25 minutes completing a Japanese unit test, focusing on practicing sentences for asking about larger sizes. After studying, made tea and drafted an outline for the afternoon meeting with Xiao Lin, listing key points.
location: Mingxuan Trendy Toys Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Signing for fabric swatches, tidying the store, and handling customer inquiries.
description: The courier delivered fabric sample cards from supplier Zhou Tao. I went downstairs, signed for them, and opened the package. Inside were waterproof nylon, brushed cotton, and tech fabric. I repeatedly touched them to feel the texture and thickness, and came up with ideas for new designs. I then asked Xiao Lin to mind the store while I sorted and put out new T-shirts. During this time, two college students came in and took a liking to the knit caps. I went over, introduced styling ideas, and successfully made a sale.
location: Mingxuan Trendy Toys Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch at Gutian Daoxiang
description: Considering that he had a tooth extraction scheduled for tomorrow and couldn't eat spicy food, he walked to Gutian Daoxiang on B1 of Shangyue Bay and ordered a light clay pot dish set with meat and vegetables, and the rice was soft and sticky. While eating, he overheard the table next to him discussing a Disney trip plan and found it interesting.
location: Gutian Daoxiang Clay Pot Cuisine (Shangyue Bay Store), B1, Shangyue Bay Plaza, 66 Yincheng Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon in-store operations and initial tidying
description: After the meal, I returned to the store and took a short nap. In the afternoon, I reorganized the meeting outline and opened the inventory system to check popular shoe models that might need restocking over the weekend, making notes.
location: Mingxuan Trendy Toys Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Held a meeting with store clerk Xiaolin to go over weekend arrangements.
description: Brewed two cups of tea and held a meeting with Xiao Lin beside the cash register. Because I have a tooth extraction tomorrow and won't be able to come to the store on the weekend, I explained four key tasks in detail: the plan for adjusting the mannequin display at the entrance—following the sketch, replace the autumn clothes with the new techwear jackets and arrange them by color; demonstrate online order processing, printing shipping labels, and material locations; specifically explain VIP customer preferences and the return/exchange process; formally authorize Xiao Lin to handle all store affairs over the weekend, and if anything uncertain arises, he can send a WeChat message but should avoid disturbing me as much as possible. Xiao Lin carefully recorded everything in his phone's memo.
location: Mingxuan Trendy Toys Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After washing up, Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop and typed a 300-word trial scene in a new Word document, Xiafeifang Manuscript: On a summer afternoon in 1947, a 14-year-old boy, modeled on his grandfather, was squatting in the courtyard fixing a second-hand radio when a sudden thunderstorm broke. As he hurriedly packed things up, he heard the postman's bicycle bell coming from the entrance of the alley... After writing it, he read it over three times, feeling that the language was still a bit stiff, but the story had begun to sprout. He planned to bring it to Saturday's writing class to ask his teacher. The writing lasted about 1.5 hours and ended around 22:40, after which he washed up and went to bed.
description: Right after the meeting, the scheduled customer came to try on the techwear jacket. He received the customer personally and gave a complete sales demonstration covering fabric performance, fit, and styling suggestions, while letting Xiao Lin observe the process. The customer was satisfied and paid immediately. Afterwards, he took time to check Xiao Lin's response to a stock-out situation and confirmed that he had mastered the method.
location: Mingxuan Trendy Toys Store, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closed up the shop and walked home
description: Near closing time, I let Xiao Lin leave first. I checked the cash register by myself, turned off the lights, and finally confirmed the inventory. After everything was in order, I put on my backpack and left the shop. Today's steps had already exceeded 10,000, reaching the exercise goal, so I didn't plan to go to the gym. I walked home along Lujiazui Ring Road, enjoying the evening breeze and feeling clear-headed.
location: Walk from Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue.

name: Family dinner and conversation.
description: After getting home, my mother was simmering tomato beef brisket soup, filling the house with aroma. Dinner was stir-fried seasonal vegetables, sweet-and-sour pork ribs, and tomato beef brisket soup. The three of us ate and chatted; I updated them on today's store meeting and tomorrow's tooth extraction appointment. Dad insisted on coming along, but I said I could handle it myself. Mom reminded me to go to bed early.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening Japanese audio study and note organization.
description: In the study, he used a Bluetooth speaker to play basic Japanese teaching audio, focusing on dialogues about asking for sizes and haggling in shopping scenarios. He repeatedly read along, correcting his pronunciation and intonation. He wrote down newly learned sentences such as 'Can you make it cheaper?' in his notebook, and also drew cartoons to aid memorization.
location: Home study, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Prepare tooth extraction supplies and relax
description: After studying, I helped my mom wipe the table, then went back to my room to prepare the items I need for tomorrow's tooth extraction: medical insurance card, X-ray film, power bank, and data cable, all placed into my shoulder bag. Afterwards, I leaned against the headboard and scrolled through Bilibili, watching the latest episode of 'Frieren: Beyond Journey's End' to relax.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Stretching and relaxing in the living room and having casual chats with family.
description: I spread out the yoga mat in the living room and did 20 minutes of full-body stretching and foam roller relaxation, focusing on relieving my legs from too much walking and my stiff shoulders and back. Mom was watching a TV drama nearby, Dad was scrolling on his phone, and I confirmed tomorrow's arrangements with them again, telling them not to worry.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Washing up, bedtime preparation, and falling asleep
description: Before washing up, he again confirmed that fasting was required for the tooth extraction and set an alarm for 7:30 the next morning. After washing up, he returned to bed and left only the bedside lamp on. Although he was a little nervous about the tooth extraction, he felt that everything for the day had been handled properly and was at ease. As planned, he turned off the lights and went to sleep at exactly 10 o'clock, and soon fell asleep in the night.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wake-up, breakfast, and work schedule
description: Got up at 7:20 and felt my throat dry from the heating. After washing up, my mother was already preparing in the kitchen; on the table was a specially cooked bowl of soft noodles with greens and minced pork in a thick broth. Mother told me to eat more since I was going to have a tooth pulled today. After breakfast, I opened my phone on the sofa to check the weather (blue gale warning) and store surveillance, saw store manager Xiao Lin had already arrived and opened the store, and sent a voice message telling him to keep a close eye on online orders and that I wouldn't be in the afternoon, so he would be fully in charge.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Immersive Japanese learning
description: Sitting at the desk, he put on headphones and opened the Duolingo app, focusing on the shopping scenario module. He repeatedly read aloud sentences like 'Do you have this in size L?' and 'Can I try it on?' and wrote them from memory in his notebook. His mother came in to pour warm water and, seeing how serious he looked, muttered, 'As if you're really going to open a shop in Japan.' He smiled and continued studying.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Rest and writing-group discussion
description: After finishing his Japanese lessons, his eyes were sore. He got up, paced around the house to loosen his shoulders, and went to the balcony to see the strong wind outside, with pedestrians tightening their coats and hurrying by. He decided to stay home for the rest of the day. Then his phone buzzed: the writing group was having a lively discussion about year-end sprint goals. He joined in and shared that his historical novel 'The Afternoon at Xiafei Lane' had reached two chapters, with the outline 80% complete, and his goal was to finish the first drafts of the first four chapters by the end of the year. Group members gave likes, and someone asked for tips on creating a Republican-era atmosphere; he shared his methods of writing scenes using smells and light.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Preparations before tooth extraction
description: After ending the group chat, he took out his medical insurance card and medical records booklet from the drawer, wiped them with alcohol wipes, and put them in the inside pocket of his coat. He re-confirmed his 2:30 p.m. appointment and the address at Arrail Dental, then called the clinic to confirm he could arrive on time.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Helped mother prepare lunch
description: Took the initiative to help my mother in the kitchen. She was simmering bone soup with the bones she bought yesterday, meant for her to drink after surgery. I helped peel garlic and wash greens while chatting about everyday things. Mother grumbled that she should have had the tooth pulled long ago to avoid the repeated inflammation and extra expense. I laughed and agreed.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Simple lunch
description: For lunch, he had small wontons in clear soup. He ate a dozen or so and didn't dare get too full, fearing discomfort from the anesthesia in the afternoon. His mother stir-fried vegetables to go with rice. After the meal, he voluntarily cleared away the dishes and set the bone soup aside to cool, preparing to drink it after the surgery.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Midday meditation
description: Returned to the bedroom, put on an eye mask, opened the meditation app, and did a 15-minute breathing meditation about relaxation and acceptance to calm the slight nervousness before the tooth extraction. After it ended, I felt much calmer.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Japanese review and departure preparation
description: Continued using the app's listening challenge to do blind listening on dialogues and answer questions; got 8 right and 2 wrong. Afterwards, changed into a loose hoodie to make the post-surgery cold compress easier, put on a thick coat, and checked the mask, earphones, phone, and power bank.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Cycling to the dental clinic
description: I said goodbye to Mother and went out; the cold wind hit my face. At the entrance of the residential complex, I scanned a shared bike, rode along Pudong Avenue, turned onto Fushan Road, and arrived at the clinic in about ten minutes.
location: Along the route from Lane 136, Pudong Avenue to No. 388 Fushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Right-side wisdom tooth extraction surgery
description: Arrived at the clinic at 14:15, registered and waited. Entered the consultation room at 14:30. After the doctor confirmed the plan, anesthesia was given; I felt my gums swell and the tip of my tongue go numb. The operation took about 30 minutes with no pain. It ended at 15:00. The doctor instructed me to bite on a cotton ball for 30 minutes and showed me the two extracted teeth. I paid out of pocket to cover the shortfall from the medical insurance balance.
location: Arrail Dental (Century Avenue Clinic), 388 Fushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Post-Operative Return Home and Initial Recuperation
description: After resting for 15 minutes at the clinic, the doctor checked that the bleeding had stopped. I put on a mask, rode a shared bike home, and the cold wind hit my face, but I felt reassured. When I got in, my mother came over to ask what happened. After giving a vague reply, I lay down on the sofa, and my mother took a towel-wrapped ice pack from the fridge and applied it to my right cheek. I got up, spit out the cotton ball, and took the cephalosporin anti-inflammatory medication as prescribed.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Post-surgery recovery and ice compress
description: Half-lying in bed scrolling through his phone. As the anesthesia gradually wore off, the right side of his face felt a dull pain and was swollen. Following the doctor's orders, he applied an ice pack for 15 minutes and then rested for 5 minutes. He replied to store group messages on his phone; the staff reported the sales revenue and special-size inquiries.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Liquid dinner and Japanese sharing session
description: Mother brought over steamed buns soaked in cooled bone broth and soft tofu. When Father came home from work and saw it, he said the tooth should have been pulled out long ago. While drinking the soup, she said “oishii” in Japanese; while drinking the soup, she said “”. Mother found it amusing and taught her to say “haochi” (“delicious”). The atmosphere was warm.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Evening rest and online life.
description: He continued cold-compressing his face on the living room sofa; his face was still swollen and painful. He scrolled through short videos and watched Bilibili videos about self-driving camping in western Sichuan for travel inspiration, changing the cold compress towel in between.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Online socializing and following doctor's orders
description: Lying in bed, he sent an ice-pack selfie with the caption "Today's warrior medal" to the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group. Zhang Wei instantly replied with a sticker, and Li Na asked if we could have hotpot on the weekend. He replied, "Sunday should work, let's order a yuanyang pot." He set an alarm to take the anti-inflammatory medicine before bed.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Evening skincare routine and getting ready for sleep
description: My face felt sticky, so I went to the bathroom to gently wash it with warm water, avoiding the right side, and patted it dry with a cotton towel. Mother reminded me not to wash too early for fear the wound would be uncomfortable. I changed into pajamas and prepared a bedside water cup, medicine, and an ice pack.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Reading before bed and social check-ins
description: I picked up “A Community Beyond Boundaries” and read a few pages, but the swelling from my tooth extraction made it hard to concentrate. I put the book down, looked at my phone, and popped into the writing group to say, “Had a tooth extraction today, combat power -50%.” Group members sent a “get well soon” sticker.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Bedtime medication and lights out
description: At 21:00, he got up to take the last two anti-inflammatory and painkiller pills, and put the ice pack back in the fridge. He got back into bed, drowsiness came over him, he set the alarm for the next day, and turned off the lights to sleep at 21:30.
location: No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Shanggang Community).

name: Waking up and morning care after surgery
description: Lei Mingxuan woke up to the 8 o'clock alarm, feeling that his right cheek was still swollen but had improved. He carefully walked into the bathroom and rinsed his mouth with warm water, avoiding the wound. His mother Wang Xiuying had prepared an ice pack wrapped in a dry towel for him. He applied it for 15 minutes, and during that time he set a medication reminder on his phone for every two hours.

I carefully rinsed my mouth with Listerine mouthwash to avoid irritating the wound. I walked slowly around the bedroom for 5 minutes, moving my shoulders and neck, and felt in good shape.
location: Room 302, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (bedroom and bathroom)

name: Eat breakfast with his mother and chat about family matters.
description: Mother had prepared a light breakfast: millet and pumpkin porridge, a boiled egg, and stir-fried seasonal vegetables. While sipping porridge, he listened to his mother complain about his father secretly smoking, smiled and reassured her, saying that after the stitches are removed next week he would take his father for a checkup. Mother was very satisfied.
location: Room 302, No. 12, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (restaurant)

name: Check store accounts, plan inventory and displays
description: Opened his MacBook Air and logged in to the store's backend system. First, he compared last month's total revenue with Alipay and WeChat payment records one by one, and after confirming everything was correct, calculated the net profit. Then he checked the inventory, focusing on hoodie and jacket SKUs, and marked reserved stock in a cloud Excel. He wrote a sticky note reminding himself to notify Xiao Lin tomorrow to restock the classic black hoodie, and thought about using a 2,000 yuan budget to add a mannequin stand with light strips to the store.
location: Room 302, Building 12, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Study)

name: Lunch, tasting mother's specialty Shanghai-style braised pork
description: Mother had braised Shanghai-style red-braised pork with rich sauce, and she picked out four small lean pieces, served with green vegetable and tofu soup and half a bowl of rice. Father asked about the road trip in western Sichuan, saying they should plan the route carefully after the stitches are removed and he has recovered. They listened to Father tell amusing stories of driving long distances in his youth, and the family had a warm and happy time together.
location: Room 302, No. 12, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (restaurant)

name: After-dinner digestion, replying to messages, and handling work.

In the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group, I told Zhang Wei that we should be able to arrange a ball game next week, depending on how my recovery goes. I also sent store manager Xiao Lin a voice message asking him to prioritize the transfer request for the black hoodie after arriving at the store tomorrow and to keep an eye on the logistics.
location: Room 302, No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (living room)

Excitedly, she panned her camera across several 'mountain-style techwear' jackets, explaining highlights such as their paneled fabrics, detachable designs, and multi-functional pockets. While listening, I wrote down keywords on an A4 sheet: 'color-block outdoor jacket, utility vest, detachable hood brim'—and we agreed that next time she returned to Pudong, she would bring some samples to the store for a more detailed discussion.
location: Room 302, Building 12, Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Study)

description: Put on a jacket, went downstairs and walked three minutes to the Cainiao Station at the entrance of the community, gave the pickup code and received the package sent by Shen Jie. After returning home, she couldn't wait to open it; it was a beautifully printed illustrated tutorial called Learn Ukulele from Scratch. Leaning against the headboard, she read the first two chapters, learned about the structure of the ukulele, and tried pressing the chord diagrams for the four basic chords C, Am, F, and G7. It felt quite interesting.
location: Room 302, No. 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (bedroom)

name: Rest, catch up on anime, and fully relax
description: He felt a bit tired and lay down in bed to rest. He opened Bilibili and saw the comments section on the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End discussing the heartbreaking scene, and laughed along. Then he watched two episodes of the funny daily-life anime Dandadan; he laughed so hard that his wound hurt a bit, so he quickly drank some water. In between, he got up and paced around the room a few times.
location: Room 302, No. 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (bedroom)

name: Helped Mom prepare dinner and caught up on family news

His mother said young people have different taste. They also discussed whether to use the group-buying voucher for Xiangfang Chinese Restaurant in Lujiazui Center to treat relatives to a meal next week.

name: Dinner

Listened to my father talk about international news he follows, and then heard him tell the good news about his old colleague's child getting married. My mother chimed in beside him; the atmosphere was warm.

Picked up A Song of Ice and Fire and read for half an hour, immersed in the power struggle between the Lannister and Stark families. Then set his phone to sleep mode and briefly reviewed what needed to be followed up tomorrow (Wednesday): Xiao Lin's stock transfer, Zhang Wei's invitation to play ball, and sending Shen Jie a new product photo for reference. At 23:15, turned off the light and fell asleep peacefully.
location: Room 302, No. 12, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (bedroom)

name: Morning care routine and breakfast
description: The alarm went off at 7:10 a.m. A light rain was falling outside, and the temperature was 3 to 7 degrees. After getting up, Mingxuan went to the bathroom and rinsed his mouth with warm salt water. He weighed 79.8 kg, 0.1 kg more than yesterday, and suspected it might be because of last night's braised pork. He found that the swelling at the tooth extraction site had basically gone down, and the wound no longer hurt. He then walked slowly in the living room for 5 minutes and did some simple upper-body stretches. His mother, Wang Xiuying, had prepared breakfast: white congee, steamed egg custard, and fermented bean curd. Mingxuan ate slowly, and his mother brought over cut-up banana, telling him to eat more fruit.
location: Home, Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Remote Work and Social Entertainment
description: After dinner, Mingxuan returned to his study, opened his laptop and logged into the store backend to check the logistics information for the batch of black hoodies he had asked store manager Xiao Lin to transfer yesterday. It showed they had been shipped and were expected to arrive at the store tomorrow. He sent Xiao Lin a WeChat message to confirm the delivery. Then he chatted on WeChat with his childhood friend Li Na. When Li Na learned that his tooth extraction was nearly healed, she urged him to go to Hangzhou for a visit, and he replied with a laugh. After that, he switched to Bilibili to watch a new episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End. Midway through, he received a WeChat message from Qian Duoduo, a VIP regular customer, asking about the progress of the group-purchase hoodies. He replied that everything was going smoothly and delivery would be before December 22.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Home - Study)

name: Deep thinking on store decisions
description: After catching up on the anime, Mingxuan began preparing for the afternoon mall meeting. He searched for keywords such as 'Super Brand Mall 2025 Spring Festival event' and 'mall floor renovations, store relocations, customer traffic impact,' read news and merchant discussions, and learned about cases where customer traffic dropped during renovations. He opened the calculator on his phone and simulated two options: moving to a less visible location with a 30% rent reduction but a possible 35% decline in customer traffic, or staying at the original location with a 15% rent increase but a chance to keep sales stable. He recorded the analysis in his memo, ready to discuss with property manager Zheng Kai in the afternoon.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Home - Study)

name: Lunch and lunch break.
description: At lunchtime, Mother made steamed sea bass and tofu with shepherd's purse soup, light and easy to digest. Mingxuan ate slowly, avoiding the fish bones. After the meal, he helped Mother clear the table, then went back to his bedroom, set a 25-minute alarm, and took a short nap to recharge for the afternoon meeting.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Shanggang Community, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Home - dining room, bedroom)

name: Online meeting
description: After waking from his lunch break, Mingxuan splashed cold water on his face, returned to the study, opened Tencent Meeting, confirmed that the network and microphone were working, and checked his memo. At 13:40 he entered the meeting room early, saw some colleagues already online, greeted them, and waited on mute. At 13:45 the meeting officially began. Property manager Zheng Kai introduced the Spring Festival activity plan and the floor renovation plan, showing that half of the area around Mingxuan's store would be converted into dining space. Two options were given: move to a corner unit on the third floor near the bathroom with a 30% rent reduction, or renew the lease at the original location with a 15% rent increase. Mingxuan took careful notes. When it was his turn to speak, he did not make an immediate statement but asked about the new unit's foot traffic, renovation duration, and transitional period rent. Zheng Kai answered vaguely, so Mingxuan said he needed to discuss with his family before replying.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (Home - Study)

name: Post-meeting affairs and package pickup
description: After the meeting, Mingxuan's mother poured him a glass of water, and he rubbed his temples. He proactively sent Zheng Kai a WeChat message requesting a deeper conversation, and then they had a phone call. During the call, he learned that the rent for the new store space was 30% lower, but the property management fee was unchanged, and the renovation period was expected to last 2 months after the Spring Festival. After hanging up, Mingxuan opened Excel to do a return-on-investment analysis and found that both options were very risky. He decided to set the matter aside for the moment, stood up to stretch his neck, remembered that he had a package to pick up in the afternoon, so he put on his jacket, took his access card, and went out with an umbrella. After walking 8 minutes to the Cainiao Station at the entrance of the residential complex, he picked up the sample package sent by his younger cousin Shen Jie. The Cainiao Station is located at No. 808 Shenjianong Road, Minsheng Road, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.
location: No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (home - study), then went to Cainiao Station at No. 808, Shenjianong Road, Minsheng Road, Yangjing Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

Though she didn't understand business well, she was very concerned. When his father Lei Jianguo got off work and came home, Mingxuan discussed it with him as well. As an old ISTJ, his father calmly pointed out that while staying at the original location meant a rent increase, the opportunities were still there; the key was whether they could withstand the cost pressure. His father's words made Mingxuan feel more secure.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 12, Lane 1589, Zhangyang Road, Lujiazui Subdistrict, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (home - kitchen, living room)

name: Morning store work: inspection, pop-up plan meeting, consultation, and operations
description: After arriving at Store A-208 on the 2nd floor of Super Brand Mall, I checked the day's deliveries and yesterday's sales report with store manager Xiao Lin, walked around and adjusted the display of the main recommended items to make sure the store was clean and attractive, and then prepared the PPT for discussion with Zhao Min. At 9:00, my college classmate Zhao Min arrived at the store on time. The two of us used an iPad and a notebook to have an in-depth discussion in the rest area, and finally finalized the plan for the 'Urban Techwear Pop-Up Exhibition': the clothing would feature mountain-style techwear main pieces (waterproof shell jackets, multi-pocket vests, etc.); the coffee equipment partner brands were confirmed as Bialetti (Moka pot) and Timemore (pour-over kettle), with Zhao Min responsible for contacting the suppliers; they planned a complete experience flow from equipment display to coffee tasting to placing an order; and the division of labor was clear, with Zhao Min responsible for purchasing coffee equipment and venue arrangement materials, and Lei Mingxuan responsible for transferring sample clothes from the warehouse and from his cousin Shen Jie. During a break in the meeting, Lei Mingxuan went to the store entrance for some air, watched the increasingly busy flow of people, estimated the pop-up exhibition's ability to drive foot traffic, and used his phone's memo app to note down the purchase list. Afterwards, he contacted his cousin Yang Fan, who was in Hangzhou, via WeChat video to consult about mini program development. Yang Fan analyzed the pros and cons of building a self-developed mini program in detail: development cost of about 3,000 to 5,000 yuan, low annual maintenance cost, and the ability to accumulate private domain traffic. He suggested using a mini program rather than a Taobao store in the early stage, and shared successful cases. Lei Mingxuan agreed with the direction and was determined to move forward, asking Yang Fan to help keep an eye out for a reliable development team. After the video call, he handled operational matters: he checked the employee schedule for next week to confirm staffing, logged into the order backend to review online orders, and proactively sent a WeChat message to property manager Zheng Kai to ask about the lease renewal progress.
location: Unit A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

Then he walked around the mall with the sample clothes, focusing on the weekend displays in the 3rd-floor trendy sportswear area, and photographed inspiring presentation methods with his phone. On a bench in the public rest area, he contacted the property manager Zheng Kai again via WeChat. Zheng Kai replied that the leadership was still considering the 8% increase, but personally he felt there was still room to negotiate. Lei Mingxuan reiterated the store's positive role in driving foot traffic to the mall, and both parties agreed to formally discuss the lease renewal next Monday.

Lei Mingxuan made tea for them, and sitting in the living room, sincerely thanked his parents for their careful care over the past week, especially mentioning that his mother had varied the light dishes every day and his father had proactively shared the housework. He announced that he would fully resume his normal daily routine starting tomorrow. He then went into the study, opened his laptop, and carefully reviewed the store's next week's schedule and online orders again, and marked 'end of recovery period' on the calendar. Afterward, he returned to the bedroom, changed into a sports T-shirt and shorts with a loose hoodie over them, set the alarm, and took a 20-minute nap on the bed to store up energy for the high-intensity personal training session in the evening.
location: No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycle to the fitness studio.

The winter sunshine was pleasant; the ride took about 18 minutes and made me slightly warm.

description: Arrived at Zhongtian Fitness Studio on time. His personal trainer conducted a full InBody body composition test. The results showed 27.0% body fat, 79.9 kg body weight, an elevated visceral fat level, and a risk of mild fatty liver. The trainer explained the report in detail and customized a "strength + cardio" recovery training plan, patiently correcting Lei Mingxuan's faulty force application during squats and deadlifts. When the formal training began, the trainer guided him through every movement hands-on. Lei Mingxuan deeply appreciated the value of professional guidance and decided on the spot during a break to purchase a 10-session personal training package for 4,800 yuan, paid via WeChat transfer. After paying, he immediately adjusted his budget in his phone memo, cutting this month's entertainment spending by 1,500 yuan and recording it under the "Health Investment" ledger. After training, he stretched and relaxed in the rest area, wiped off sweat, confirmed next week's class time with the trainer, opened his mobile banking app again to verify the transfer and saved a screenshot, and finally packed up his workout gear.
location: Zhongtian Fitness Studio (Nanquan Road Branch), No. 88 North Zhangjiabang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling home

location: From Zhongtian Fitness Studio, No. 88 North Zhangjiabang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (cycling)

His mother, Wang Xiuying, had made light Shanghai-style home dishes: scallion oil noodles, shrimp and tofu, and stir-fried Hangzhou cabbage. Lei Mingxuan had dinner with his parents and excitedly shared the results of that evening's workout and his body fat percentage data, saying that from now on he would “watch his diet and exercise more.” His father, Lei Jianguo, praised his initiative, while his mother reminded him to balance work and rest. After dinner, Lei Mingxuan took the initiative to clear the table and wash the dishes. While doing the chores, he chatted with his mother about preparing a pop-up store at the shop. Although she didn't quite understand, she said she fully supported him.

He took notes and read aloud in front of the mirror, focusing on strengthening the pronunciation of easily confused words. After studying, he moved to the bedroom, used the Bilibili app to watch the latest episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, immersed himself in the story, and briefly discussed his thoughts with netizens in the danmaku comments and the comment section.
location: No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

Then I changed into pajamas, lay in bed, and checked tomorrow's (Saturday) store work plan and weather on a phone app; everything was confirmed. I picked up *A Song of Ice and Fire: A Game of Thrones* from the bedside table and read two chapters. Afterwards, I briefly reviewed the day in my mind: the pop-up store plan was finalized, the mini-program direction was clarified, the initial renewal communication was completed, and the health investment was put into practice. I felt especially fulfilled and confident about a full return next week. At 21:30 I turned off the lights, played white noise to help me sleep, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
location: No. 12, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

I stretched for 5 minutes first, then jogged along the park trail for 30 minutes at a pace of about 6 minutes per kilometer, covering 5 kilometers. My post-surgery recovery feels good, and the tightness in my shoulder has eased a lot. After getting home, I took a shower. My mother, Wang Xiuying, had already prepared breakfast according to my fitness meal plan: a bowl of oatmeal porridge, a boiled egg, and a small plate of dressed wood ear mushrooms. I said to her, “Mom, please keep lunch and dinner on the plan for today—thank you!” She smiled and agreed.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park and the Shanggang residential community on Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Online communication, itinerary confirmation, and cycling commute to the store

He replied instantly: "OK, see you at 2. My office is on the 5th floor." I also opened the weather app and confirmed that it would be sunny today, with temperatures of 2-8, so I decided to ride my electric scooter to the store later. At 7:50 I put on a windbreaker, helmet, and gloves, then set off on my NIU electric scooter, along Pudong Avenue and onto Century Avenue, arriving at Super Brand Mall 15 minutes later. I entered the mall through the staff entrance and arrived at the store at 8:10.

participant.name: Zheng Kai
participant.relation: Head of the leasing department at Super Brand Mall

location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

I officially started work mode. I spent 40 minutes checking the inventory list to confirm whether the batch of mountain-style jackets and cargo pants I'd requested from Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao the day before yesterday had already been pre-allocated in the system. I processed 3 online orders, packed them, and printed the shipping labels. Around 10 a.m., there were almost no customers, so I took out my phone, opened the Japanese-learning official account I follow, and focused on learning phrases for communicating sizes with customers, such as 'A little bigger? (Do you have a larger size?)', and carefully wrote them in my notebook. It took about 20 minutes.

They must arrive in Shanghai by the 18th." Zhou Tao confirmed the list over the phone: 5 mountain-style jackets and 5 pairs of cargo pants. He said he would send them via SF Express same-day express today and give me the tracking number in the evening. I quickly thanked him and added, "Brother, please rush it — this exhibition is really important to me!" After hanging up, I felt a weight lifted off my shoulders.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

description: At 11:00, I locked the store door and walked 5 minutes to Wagas on the basement floor of IFC Mall. I ordered an "Italian Bolognese Energy Bowl" with vinaigrette. While waiting for the meal, I opened the memo on my phone and went over the key points for the afternoon negotiation with Zheng Kai in my head: use prepaying half a year's rent in exchange for a lower rent increase, and also volunteer to take part in the mall's "Trend Market" to prove my value through actual event contributions. While eating the light quinoa and beef, I silently rehearsed what to say. I finished at 11:50 and walked back to the store.
location: Wagas, B1, IFC Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

Then I walked out of the store and took a lap around the first-floor atrium of the mall, observing the weekend customer flow, paying special attention to The North Face and Columbia displays to see what was being promoted for the season. At 13:00 I returned to the store, tidied the desk, and got ready for the appointment.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Internal Commute and Lease Renewal Negotiation
description: At 13:00, I locked up the shop and took the staff elevator to the 5th floor. I arrived half an hour early and stood by the window at the end of the hallway, organizing my thoughts and looking out at the Lujiazui view to psych myself up. At 13:30, I knocked and went in on time. Zheng Kai warmly invited me to sit down and poured me a cup of hot tea. I got straight to the point: 'Kai, I am truly sincere about renewing the lease. Here is my proposal: I will pay the rent for the second half of the year in one lump sum to help the mall's cash flow. In addition, I will fully participate in the Trend Market event, providing free clothing and on-site styling advice, which will definitely bring a younger crowd to the mall. On the rent increase, could you be a little more flexible?' After hearing my proposal, Zheng Kai smiled and said: 'Lao Lei, your proposal shows real sincerity. I think the direction is right, and personally I initially agree. Wait until Monday when I report to my superiors; barring any surprises, it should not be a problem.' At 14:30, we shook hands and parted on very good terms.

participant.name: Zheng Kai
participant.relation: Head of the leasing department at Super Brand Mall

location: Leasing Department Office, 5th Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling to the gym, confirming the training plan, and structured training
description: After leaving the Investment Promotion Department, I hopped on my electric scooter and headed straight to Zhongtian Fitness Studio on Century Avenue. At 15:00, after changing clothes, I met my personal trainer Zhang Qiang. I asked him, "Brother Qiang, are we still doing the mixed training plan we agreed on today?" He said, "Right, today we're stepping up the intensity: strength first, then cardio, to get your body adapted." I did a 10-minute dynamic warm-up with Zhang Qiang (jumping jacks, high knees, lunge twists). Then the formal training: squats 3 sets x 10 reps (50 kg load), deadlifts 3 sets x 10 reps (60 kg load), bench press 3 sets x 8 reps (40 kg load), with 90 seconds of rest between sets. Zhang Qiang guided me throughout, correcting my lower back engagement to prevent compensatory movement after surgery. After strength training, I did a 30-minute jog on the treadmill at a pace of 6:00/km. Finally, I stretched for 5 minutes. Sweat soaked through my gym clothes, and my cardio was really challenged, but the muscle activation felt explosive. It was great!
location: Zhongtian Fitness Studio (Century Avenue Branch), Weifang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: After training: refuel on the way back, shower and rest, and study in short bursts.
description: After training, felt completely drained. Bought a bottle of Pocari Sweat at the convenience store nearby and drank it in one go. Then rode the e-bike slowly home, enjoying the rare sense of relaxation after exercise. Once home, took a hot shower and changed into comfortable loungewear. Lay on the bed and rested for 20 minutes, scrolled on the phone for a while, looked at some fashion brand mini-programs, such as UOOYAA, and screenshotted several interfaces that I thought were well-designed.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dinner and family conversation

While eating, I shared with them the progress of today's workout and negotiation. I said, 'The talk with Zheng Kai went well today; it feels promising! I've also resumed training.' Father nodded: 'Steady and sure, don't be impatient.' Mother, feeling sorry for me, put a large piece of fish belly in my bowl: 'Eat more, nourish yourself.' I smiled and said, 'Mom, that's enough nutrition; health is what matters most!'
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

Following my cousin Yang Fan's suggestion, I began systematically researching clothing brand mini-programs. I carefully browsed the homepage layouts, product categories, shopping flows, and coupon designs of bosie and UOOYAA. I used Evernote to take screenshots and jot down insights, such as "UOOYAA's 'Outfit Recommendations' section allows direct add-to-cart, reducing user drop-off" and "bosie's product detail page includes model size suggestions." This process lasted an hour and a half. When I closed the computer, my concept for our own mini-program had become much clearer.
location: Study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening study, socializing, and reading

After that, I pinged the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' group: 'Brothers, I'm back in training today! Who's up for basketball at Yuanshen Sports Center on Wednesday night?' Zhang Wei replied instantly: 'I'm in! My knee is much better!' Xie Fei also said he could come. After contacting them, I took out my notebook and recopied the shopping-related Japanese words and sentences I had learned at the store this morning, then made example sentences to deepen my memory, such as 'L size, please. (Please show me this shirt in size L.)' I also opened a Japanese podcast on my phone and listened to 15 minutes of everyday conversation to reinforce my feel for the language. At 22:00, after washing up, I boiled a pot of hot water to soak my feet. While soaking them, I picked up A Song of Ice and Fire from the bedside table and read a chapter about Jon Snow at the Wall, feeling my mind grow calm.
location: Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Review and bedtime plan
description: After soaking my feet, I lay in bed and used the memo app on my phone to do a quick review of today: Completed: morning run, work, sample transfer, lease renewal negotiation (went smoothly), systematic training, mini-program research, Japanese study. Not completed: none. Plan for tomorrow: go to the store for the afternoon shift and keep an eye on SF Express tracking information. After making the plan, I put on a steam eye mask, adjusted my breathing, and got ready to sleep. I feel very fulfilled and satisfied today. Life is getting on track as planned, and both my health and career are improving!
location: Bedroom, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Final pre-exhibition check and warm-up
description: After arriving at the booth in the atrium of Century Link Mall, I divided tasks with Zhao Min: she handled clothing display, fitting room details, and scan-code scripts; I checked the coffee equipment, sample tags, and display presentation. I turned on the Bluetooth speaker to play Lo-fi Hip Hop to create a relaxed atmosphere, walked through the guided customer flow route together, distributed walkie-talkies to the staff, and completed all the preparations before the opening.
location: Atrium, Century Link Mall, 179 Weifang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Peak operations at the pop-up exhibition
description: At 10 a.m., mall foot traffic increased. The booth attracted many customers with its outdoor style and coffee aroma. I explained the jacket fabric technology to customers and demonstrated quick packing, while brewing coffee by hand. Taking the tasting opportunity, I handed out membership cards and guided them to follow the official account and visit the store. Zhao Min handled mountain-style outfit recommendations and QR code traffic attraction. The scene was lively, gaining more than ten new WeChat friends and many customers interested in visiting the store.
location: Atrium, Century Link Mall, 179 Weifang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rotating lunch breaks and a quick review
description: At noon, customer flow declined, and I took turns having meals with Zhao Min. I stayed at the booth first while Zhao Min went to B1 to eat, then she came to replace me so I could go downstairs. At the Subway on B1, I bought a teriyaki chicken sandwich and sugar-free sparkling water and ate quickly while standing. When I met up with Zhao Min, we exchanged notes on the morning's results: over ten people added on WeChat, and seven or eight people came to the store for consultations—beyond expectations.
location: Subway, B1 Level, Century Link Mall, No. 179 Weifang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: The pop-up exhibition continued operating in the afternoon.
description: In the afternoon, the foot traffic consisted mainly of young couples and parent-child families. I recommended matching outdoor hoodies for couples, had an in-depth discussion with an outdoor enthusiast about waterproof breathable membrane technology, and added him on WeChat. During breaks in operations, I observed other brands' displays, customer flow, and lighting design in the mall to gather inspiration.
location: Atrium, Century Link Mall, 179 Weifang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Brief rest and inspiration
description: Taking advantage of a lull in foot traffic at the booth, I rode my e-bike to Shanghai ifc mall for some fresh air. At Manner Coffee on the B1 floor, I ordered an iced latte and, sitting on a bar stool, took out my notebook to record display details and customer feedback on the product design for later optimization.
location: Manner Coffee, B1, Shanghai ifc Mall, No. 8 Lujiazui East Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Wrap-up and review
description: Returning to the booth, I started wrapping up with Zhao Min. She used her tablet to categorize and annotate the WeChat contacts and business cards added today, while I shot empty booth footage and payment moments for publicity. Together we packed up the clothing samples, counted the coffee supplies, and organized the light strips, restoring the venue to its original state.
location: Atrium, Century Link Mall, 179 Weifang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: On the way home.
description: As night fell, I rode my e-bike from Century Link Plaza back to Zhangyang Garden, weaving nimbly through rush-hour traffic. With the Cowboy Bebop soundtrack playing through my earphones, I reviewed the day's highlights and what could be improved, feeling fulfilled.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai, from Century Link Mall to Zhangyang Garden

name: Family dinner
description: Arrived home and had dinner with my parents. My mother had specially prepared high-protein dishes such as steamed sea bass and blanched prawns. I told my parents about how popular the pop-up exhibition was, and received my father's approval and my mother's concern. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Home dining room, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dietary adaptation period review
description: After dinner, he reviewed the week's food photos with his mother in the living room, analyzing how well the low-oil, low-salt, high-protein diet had worked; his weight dropped 0.1 kg. After thanking his mother for her efforts, they planned next week's menu together, adding vegetables such as okra and broccoli and proteins such as basa fish and chicken breast. Ah Fu the cat stayed by their side.
location: Living room at home, Zhangyang Huayuan, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Working in the study: finalizing the mini-program service provider
description: After washing up, I went into the study and compared three mini-program service providers. I chose one with a moderate price and a backend that met our needs. After paying the first installment, I put together a detailed implementation plan document, including product image style, copy outline, testing and launch timeline, etc., and noted that my cousin Yang Fan would need to help with code optimization. I encrypted the file and uploaded it to the cloud drive, and set an execution reminder in the calendar for 10 a.m. on December 22.
location: Study at home, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxation and bedtime preparation
description: After finishing work, I lay in bed, scrolled through the Moments of some newly added customers to learn their preferences, then caught up on an episode of Frieren: Beyond Journey's End to relax before sleep.
location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Meditation reflection and peaceful sleep
description: Turned off all electronic devices, put on noise-canceling earplugs, and reviewed tomorrow's pop-up exhibition notes and new-customer follow-up plan in his mind. Feeling reassured, he turned off the light and fell asleep at 23:30, saving energy for the bigger weekend crowd.
location: Home bedroom, Zhangyang Garden, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Morning meditation and Japanese study
description: On Saturday morning it was cloudy. The alarm rang on time, and Lei Zhenhua got up promptly, took a 30-second deep breath by the bedroom window, then sat cross-legged on the bay window cushion, meditating with mindfulness breathing for 20 minutes as he felt the warm indoor heating and the slightly cool air outside. After meditating, he opened his Japanese notebook and spent 20 minutes focusing on the confusing points among the rows of the gojūon chart, then used his phone's voice recorder to practice greetings by imitating a Tokyo accent, repeatedly correcting his pronunciation.
location: Own bedroom in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Personal stretching and family breakfast
description: Lei Zhenhua came to the living room and, while his mother was still getting breakfast ready, did 15 minutes of stretching and jumping jacks to loosen up. His mother, Wang Xiuying, served her signature small wontons and fried eggs. As he ate, he told her that he had a basketball farewell game in the afternoon and would bring good news home in the evening. He strictly controlled his diet, drinking only a bowl of soup and eating one egg, and helped himself to 50 grams of lettuce and cherry tomatoes as a vitamin supplement, chatting easily with his mother.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Residential Quarter, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Brand Multi-Store Upgrade: Budget Precision Calculation and Printing
description: After breakfast, Lei Zhenhua went into the study and first spent 10 minutes reviewing the sales data and new WeChat friends from yesterday's pop-up exhibition, noting potential preferences. Then he opened the Excel spreadsheet for the "Brand Collection Store Upgrade Project," carefully checked the expenses, confirmed a funding gap of about 80,000 yuan, and adjusted the phased investment plan. He decided to start with contract signing, renovation, and equipment procurement first, and the latter two phases would be decided later based on circumstances. Finally, he printed two copies of the budget, one to carry with him and one as a backup.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to Century Link Plaza, pop-up exhibit operations, and literary acceptance notice
description: Lei Zhenhua, wearing a dark gray casual blazer and carrying a printed budget sheet, rode an e-bike along Pudong Avenue toward Century Link Mall. On the way, he bought a copy of Xinmin Evening News at a newsstand. After arriving at the B2 atrium pop-up booth at Century Link Mall, he confirmed with the collaborating store staff that the materials were properly set up. The mall was crowded, and he enthusiastically introduced the new styles to customers and guided them to scan QR codes to add him on WeChat. At about 10:45, he checked his email and found an acceptance notice from the editor of Shanghai Literature for his essay. Overjoyed, he immediately went to a corner to call his mother and share the good news. The rest of the morning he was full of energy and especially devoted to the booth operations.
location: Pop-up booth, B2 atrium, Century Link Mall, 179 Weifang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and energy replenishment
description: At noon, Lei Zhenhua handed the booth over to his colleague and walked to the Lao Xiang Ji fast-food restaurant on the basement level of the mall. For the afternoon physical training, he ordered skinless chicken with scallion oil, garlic broccoli, steamed egg, and mixed-grain rice. He chewed slowly, replying to messages in the 'Pudong Three Musketeers' WeChat group, hinting that something big would be announced in the afternoon.
location: Laoxiangji (Shanghai Metropolis Store), No. 312 Fushan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: High-intensity mixed training
description: After lunch, he cycled 5 minutes to the gym on the 5th floor of the Standard Chartered Bank Building. Lei Zhenhua changed into sportswear and warmed up fully, then completed strength training including squats, deadlifts, and bench presses, resting 70 seconds between sets. After strength training, he ran for 30 minutes on the treadmill at an incline of 2 and a speed of 11 km/h, with a pace of 5 minutes 30 seconds per kilometer, and finally stretched for 5 minutes to relax. When the session ended, he was soaked in sweat and mentally pumped. After replenishing with a sports drink, he messaged his playing partner Xie Fei to get ready for the appointment.
location: Gym, 5th Floor, Standard Chartered Bank Building, 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Yuanshen farewell basketball game.
description: Lei Zhenhua changed out of his wet T-shirt into clean sportswear, rode his electric bike along Century Avenue and onto Yuanshen Road, and arrived at the indoor basketball court at Yuanshen Sports Center 10 minutes later, changing into his jersey ahead of time. The game started promptly at 2 p.m., and the competition on court was intense. He scored on a layup off a pick-and-roll, and Xie Fei hit a three-pointer. The game lasted until 4 p.m., and his team eventually won 105 to 101. Afterward, everyone sat around resting. Lei Zhenhua seriously announced that because he was in the final push for the new store project, he couldn't guarantee showing up every week. After a few seconds of silence, Xie Fei patted him on the shoulder and expressed understanding and support. All his basketball buddies offered their best wishes, and they said goodbye with firm high-fives and hugs.
location: Indoor basketball gym, Yuanshen Sports Center, 655 Yuanshen Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buying sample magazines, family reunion, and celebration dinner
description: After the race, Lei Zhenhua deliberately rode his bike to the newsstand on Pudian Road that he usually went to, bought the latest issue of Shanghai Literature, and flipped through it on the spot to confirm that his essay "Morning Mist in the Alleyway" had been published. When he got home, he placed the magazine in the center of the dining table and opened it to the page with the article. His father, Lei Jianguo, put on his reading glasses and read the first paragraph aloud word by word, while his mother, Wang Xiuying, stood behind him, watching closely with reddened eyes. The three of them started by talking about the details of the old Pudong alleyways described in the article, reminiscing about old times such as "well-water watermelon" and "cooling off on summer nights." At 6 p.m., his mother brought out a specially prepared hearty dinner, including sweet-and-sour pork ribs and stir-fried shrimp. Lei Zhenhua made an exception and ate a piece of ribs. At the dinner table, the conversation revolved around the article and future writing plans. His father offered encouragement, and his mother kept putting food on his plate. The whole family was immersed in a warm and proud atmosphere.
location: Home dining room and living room, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening online socializing and writing group exchange
description: After dinner, having helped clear the dishes, Lei Zhenhua curled up on the living room sofa and opened his phone. In the "Pudong Three Musketeers" WeChat group, he took a photo of the magazine cover and sent it, announcing, "Now we're rich in spirit first." Zhang Wei commented, "Damn, a literary giant!" Zhao Min sent a sticker saying, "Boss Lei has nailed the dual identity!" He proudly replied to each one. Afterwards, he went into his study, logged into QQ, and in the historical fiction writing group, a group member had posted a draft about Shanghai business wars in the 1930s and asked for feedback. He spent nearly an hour patiently giving over 2,000 words of specific suggestions from three angles: protagonist motivation, plot conflict design, and historical detail research. The group admin and members all liked and approved.
location: Home study and living room, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Manuscript fee confirmation and healthy meal plan.
description: Lei Zhenhua opened his mobile banking app, confirmed that the 600 yuan manuscript fee had arrived, and took a screenshot. He created a new memo in his notes called '2025 Milestones' to record the day. Later, in the living room, he verbally finalized the healthy meal plan for the coming week with his mother, who was watching TV. He asked for more fish and shrimp, such as steamed sea bass and boiled shrimp, and asked to ensure broccoli, lettuce, and other vegetables every day. He also planned to buy salmon the next day. He specified at least 80 grams of protein and 500 grams of vegetables per day, and his mother wrote it all down carefully in her notebook.
location: Home study and living room, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime review and wash-up
description: Lei Zhenhua returned to the bedroom and reviewed the whole day's experiences: the quiet morning, the good news about his writing, the passion on the basketball court, the warmth of family, and recognition from the writing community. He felt an unprecedented sense of fulfillment. After washing up, he wrote a short diary entry in his phone memo: "December 20, cloudy. Said goodbye to the court, but welcomed a new chapter in the literary world. Life is really damn wonderful." Then he set the alarm for the next day.
location: Own bedroom in Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxing before bed and falling asleep
description: Lei Zhenhua turned off the bedside lamp, put on his earphones, and watched an episode of the healing anime Laid-Back Camp on Bilibili. Halfway through, he began to feel sleepy, so he closed the video. In the dark, he closed his eyes and recalled the day: his mother's teary eyes, the hug from his basketball buddies, Xie Fei's receding back, and the cover of Shanghai Literature magazine. With satisfaction and tiredness, he slowly drifted into sleep.
location: On the bed in his own bedroom, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Waking up and morning preparation
