description: After the alarm went off, got up, washed up and checked his figure, weighed 79.5 kg, drank warm water in the living room, looked out at the gloomy sky, and thought about the day's plans.
location: At home in Zhangyang Huayuan Residential Complex, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Open-awareness meditation
description: Meditated cross-legged on the yoga mat in the bedroom, letting thoughts drift. He recalled the exhibition teardown checklist, his dreams, and the joy of having an essay accepted; when his mind wandered, he pulled it back. After finishing, he recorded his feelings in the phone memo.
location: At home in Zhangyang Huayuan Residential Complex, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Weekly comprehensive Japanese review
description: At my desk, I used a Japanese learning app, did dictation of the gojūon chart and got it all right, reviewed this week's mock dialogues and wrote Chinese translations, checked off new words, and planned next week's focus on 'ordering at a restaurant' and 'number expressions.'
location: At home in Zhangyang Huayuan Residential Complex, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and casual family chat
description: Had breakfast with parents, eating white rice porridge, pan-fried buns, pickled vegetables, and oranges. Mother recalled the essay “Morning Mist in the Alleyway,” and Father asked about the progress of the pop-up exhibition. The family atmosphere was warm.
location: Home dining room, Zhangyang Huayuan Community, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycle to Century Link Mall
description: He changed into a hoodie and windbreaker, rode his electric bicycle along Zhangyang Road to Century Link Mall, and prepared for the last day of the pop-up exhibition.
location: From Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Century Link Mall at No. 179 Weifang Road

name: Pop-up exhibition final operations
description: Met partner Zhao Min in the first-floor atrium of Century Link, drank a hot Americano, tidied the display rack and booth, shot B-roll footage, handled light customer traffic, and kept the exhibition running.
location: First-floor atrium of Century Link Mall, No. 179 Weifang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Three-person casual lunch chat.
description: Had lunch with Zhao Min and mall property manager Zheng Kai at the Hakka beef noodle restaurant on B1, discussing the foot-traffic results of the pop-up exhibition (more than 40 new members) and the possibility of future cooperation, and thanking Zheng Kai for his support in coordinating the venue.
location: Hakka Beef Noodle Restaurant, B1 Floor, Century Link Mall, 179 Weifang Road, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Afternoon pop-up exhibition operations and post-teardown review
description: In the afternoon, received several batches of customers one after another; the last customer left at 15:00. At 15:30, began dismantling the exhibition with Zhao Min and Zheng Kai, packed up the clothing and accessories, returned the lighting and props, and restored the venue. Did a review based on foot traffic and sales data, concluded that mid-to-high-end customers had specific preferences, and felt that next time the merchandise selection could be bolder and interaction could be strengthened.
location: First-floor atrium of Century Link Mall, No. 179 Weifang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Cycled to buy salmon
description: Ride an electric bicycle along Pudian Road to Pushang Vegetable Market to buy fresh salmon for the family dinner.
location: From Pudian Road to Dongchang Road Pushang Vegetable Market, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Purchase fresh ingredients.
description: At Pushang Market, picked a middle cut of salmon and had the vendor slice it. Also bought asparagus and cherry tomatoes. Seeing that the small yellow croakers were fresh, I bought six on the spot, planning to steam them the next day.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home and take a short rest
description: Returned home, handed the ingredients to Mother, drank water, changed out of the sweat-soaked hoodie, rested by the bed in the bedroom and browsed the phone.
location: At home in Zhangyang Huayuan Residential Complex, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Healthy family dinner
description: The family of three enjoyed pan-seared salmon, roasted asparagus and cherry tomatoes, mushroom tofu soup, and seasonal vegetables prepared by the mother. To stick with the health plan, they had only half a bowl of rice. During the meal, they shared the good news that the exhibition teardown went smoothly.
location: Home dining room, Zhangyang Huayuan Community, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ukulele chord transition practice
description: In the bedroom, he practiced switching between C, Am, F, and G chords, starting slowly with a metronome and gradually keeping up with 80 beats per minute. He successfully played the first two phrases of 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star,' recorded a video, and sent it to the sports buddies group, where Xie Fei liked it.
location: Bedroom at home, Zhangyang Huayuan Residential Community, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Unexpected good news: publication interest.
description: His close friend Liu Yang sent a voice message saying that Mr. Chen of Moxiang Culture, a friend in Liu Yang's cultural circle, was very interested in the first three chapters and the table of contents of the work Afternoon in Xiafei Fang and was willing to give a preliminary publishing indication and discuss cooperation. Lei Mingxuan excitedly told his parents and replied to Liu Yang to arrange a time.
location: At home in Zhangyang Huayuan Residential Complex, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Share the joy and plan for tomorrow.
description: The family excitedly discussed the news of the publication. His father praised him for making something of himself, and his mother planned to buy a new shirt. Lei Mingxuan then confirmed tomorrow's mini-program development schedule in the study and added an appointment with Teacher Chen to his to-do list.
location: At home in Zhangyang Huayuan Residential Complex, Lane 2228, Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening review and relaxation
description: In the bedroom, he used his phone memos to record the day's feelings and publishing plans, scrolled through WeChat Moments to like and comment, checked fashion industry news, set the alarm for 7 a.m. the next day, and then fell asleep, ending the day with satisfaction and anticipation.
location: Bedroom at home, Zhangyang Huayuan Residential Community, Lane 2228 Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning meditation and washing up
description: The alarm went off. Sitting cross-legged on the bed, he did 15 minutes of breathing meditation, focusing on adjusting his thoughts and disconnecting from the pop-up exhibition and investment matters, feeling inner calm. Then he got up and took a hot shower to wash away his drowsiness. Passing through the living room, he exchanged a few brief words with his mother, who was busy in the kitchen. Back in the bedroom, while applying skincare, he picked up his phone to check messages. He replied to Liu Yang's message about the publishing house, saying Wednesday had been confirmed, and politely declined a college classmate's invitation to play ball, explaining that he had important matters in the evening. Afterward, he got ready for breakfast.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast.
description: Had breakfast with my parents. On the table were the pan-fried pork buns, plain rice porridge, and pickled vegetables my mother had prepared. My father sat across from me reading news on his phone. While eating, I told them my plans for the day, mentioning that I'd go to the gym in the afternoon and wanted to discuss the store upgrade with my father in the evening. He agreed. During the meal, I had already started thinking about my evening communication strategy. I had a good appetite and felt full of energy.
location: Dining Room, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Quarter, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Working in the study and contacting the publisher
description: He entered the study, turned on the computer, and printed out the brand upgrade budget sheet; the data was clear. He then contacted Editor Chen at Moxiang Culture Press via WeChat and sent this message: Hello, Editor Chen. This is Lei Mingxuan. Liu Yang told me about your interest in The Afternoon at Xiafei Lane. I'm very honored! Would two o'clock this Wednesday afternoon be convenient? I'll come to the publishing house to chat with you then. After sending it, he felt pleased and considered it a good start to the day.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rode the e-bike to the store.
description: Putting on a windbreaker and helmet, I rode my e-bike from home, turned from Pudong Avenue onto Century Avenue, weaved through the morning rush-hour traffic, arrived on time at the designated non-motor vehicle parking area at Super Brand Mall, and got ready to start work in high spirits.
location: Along Pudong Avenue to Lujiazui West Road in Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store operations and closing procedures
description: After opening the door, I turned on the lights, checked the displays, and verified the inventory report. I hung the newly arrived basic T-shirts on the wall, replied to a long-time customer's WeChat message on my phone and helped hold the items for her, processed two online orders, and after packing them, took the opportunity to ride my e-bike to the Lujiazui Metro Station locker to ship the packages. I ran into Zheng Kai, the mall property manager, and discussed next Monday's fire drill. I received a reply from Teacher Chen confirming a meeting at 2 p.m. on Wednesday, and felt delighted. I called Zhou Tao, a supplier from Hangzhou, to urge him to ship the new spring clothing; I learned the goods had been sent and were expected to arrive at the store the day after tomorrow, and I got the tracking number and recorded it in the inventory ledger. Around 11 a.m., I decided to close early and go home to enjoy the steamed sea bass my mother had prepared.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return home and enjoy a healthy lunch
description: Rode the electric scooter for 10 minutes to get home. As soon as he entered, he smelled the aroma of steamed sea bass. His mother had already prepared boiled prawns, blanched broccoli, and multigrain rice. While eating, he praised his mother's cooking and told her that he was going to meet the publishing house editor on Wednesday. His mother was very happy and repeatedly urged him to dress appropriately and mind his manners.
location: Dining Room, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Residential Quarter, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break and workout preparation.
description: After dinner, he leaned back on the living room sofa to rest and scrolled through Bilibili videos of "old Shanghai villa tours" for display inspiration for the store upgrade. He received a message from Zhao Min confirming a meeting at "Yourong Coffee" in Century Link at 4 p.m. and replied "OK". Then he went back to the bedroom, changed into a loose quick-dry T-shirt, sports shorts, and running shoes, put on a sports backpack containing a towel, a large water bottle, and a change of clothes. Stretching his shoulders and neck in front of the mirror, he felt he had plenty of energy.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute to the gym at Standard Chartered Bank Tower
description: He set off from home on his electric scooter, rode east along Pudong Avenue, then turned onto Century Avenue. The weather was sunny, and he arrived at Standard Chartered Bank Tower in less than 10 minutes. He parked in the non-motor vehicle area of the underground garage and took the elevator directly to the gym on the 4th floor.
location: Along the route from Pudong Avenue to No. 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Gym mixed training and tidying up
description: First, 10 minutes of dynamic stretching and a slow jog to warm up. Strength training: squats at 60 kg, 3 sets of 10 reps; deadlifts at 70 kg, 3 sets of 10 reps; bench press at 50 kg, 3 sets of 8 reps; rest between sets was strictly kept at about 70 seconds. Core strength was solid. Then 40 minutes of aerobic running on the treadmill at a pace of 5 minutes 20 seconds per kilometer, with heart rate maintained around 155; the run felt exhilarating. Afterward, 5 minutes of stretching to cool down. Once his heart rate settled, he took a hot shower, changed into a clean knit sweater and dark casual pants, put the sweaty workout clothes into his backpack, and looked in the mirror to see himself refreshed and energetic.
location: Fitness Center, 4th Floor, Standard Chartered Bank Building, 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Go to Century Link Café
description: Rode the electric scooter south along Century Avenue, reached Century Link Mall in 5 minutes, parked in an empty spot on the roadside, entered the mall and went down to the basement level, found the usual "Yourong Café", ordered an iced Americano, sat in a booth by the wall, took out phone and waited for Zhao Min.
location: Along the way from No. 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to No. 179 Weifang Road

name: Reviewed the pop-up exhibition data with Zhao Min
description: Zhao Min arrived on time and immediately took out her computer and a detailed Excel spreadsheet. The two reviewed the foot traffic data, sales conversion rate, best-selling co-branded items, and customer feedback comments from last weekend's pop-up exhibition. Zhao Min's analysis was thorough. They finalized the follow-up collaboration promotion plan: selected three co-branded hoodies, confirmed cooperation with a local pour-over coffee equipment brand, divided the online promotion tasks (Zhao Min would handle Xiaohongshu, and Lei Mingxuan would handle WeChat Moments and VIP regular customer groups), and tentatively scheduled the first wave of warm-up for mid-January. The two-person team was becoming increasingly in sync.
location: Yourong Café, B1, Century Link Mall, 179 Weifang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buy fruit on the way.
description: After saying goodbye to Zhao Min, he rode his little e-bike home. On the way, he stopped by Pushang Market, remembered that his mother had mentioned strawberries and cherries were very sweet recently, so he picked a box of Dandong 99 strawberries for 38 yuan and bought half a jin of Chilean cherries for 60 yuan, thinking his parents would be happy.
location: Pushang Food Market, Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Going home, family dinner, and cleaning up after the meal
description: He walked in carrying the fruit. His mother was stir-frying in the kitchen, and his father was watching the news. He washed the strawberries and cherries, put them on the coffee table, and his father praised them after tasting. Then the family of three had dinner together. His mother had made braised pork belly, stir-fried pea shoots, and tomato and egg soup. As they ate, they talked about his afternoon training experience and the co-branding plan finalized with Zhao Min. His father was very interested in the publishing matters and asked many questions about the process details; the atmosphere was relaxed and harmonious. After the meal, he took the initiative to help clear the dishes, then returned to the study to check the budget sheet again, preparing for a formal conversation with his father. He took a deep breath, poured himself a cup of tea, and walked into the living room.
location: Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Formally discuss the store investment with his father.
description: In the living room, he formally presented the brand upgrade budget to his parents, explaining in detail the concept of the multi-brand store, its market positioning, and expected returns, and directly confronted the 80,000 yuan funding gap. His father put on reading glasses and carefully reviewed it, repeatedly asking about the use of funds, payback period, and risks; he answered each question clearly and logically. An hour later, his father took off his glasses, gave a relieved smile, and decided to contribute 50,000 yuan from family savings as an investment, asking for dividends based on store profits; his mother added that she had already given 20,000 yuan earlier, so the funds were basically in place. He felt a great sense of responsibility, but also full of drive.
location: Living room, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Study room planning and recording.
description: Filled with excitement, he returned to his study, opened his notebook, and recorded the consensus reached with his father item by item: the funding timeline, equity ratio, and dividend mechanism. Then he listed the subsequent steps for the brand upgrade in his plan — contacting a designer for renderings, finding new shelf suppliers, and putting up new product previews on the mini program. Every action was written out clearly and specifically.
location: Study, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening entertainment and socializing
description: After washing up, he lay down on the bed and opened Bilibili, where he watched a content creator from Hangzhou's Gundam model modification video with great interest. Then he sent a WeChat message to his friend Liu Yang to thank him and confirm that the appointment with Teacher Chen from the publishing house had been made for Wednesday at 2 p.m. He also announced in the college classmates group that all the funds for the concept store were in place, and the group immediately erupted with congratulations.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Relaxing and reading before bed
description: He did a few simple stretches to relax the muscles that had been trained and kept busy during the day, then lay down, closed his eyes, and reviewed the day's key moments: morning meditation, the strength breakthrough at the gym, finalizing the co-branding plan with Zhao Min, and gaining his father's approval and financial support. He felt every step was solid. Afterward, he picked up “Houses in the City” and read a chapter about location value, mulling over the possibility of buying property in a core area of Pudong in the future. Around 22:30, drowsiness set in. He turned off the bedside lamp and fell asleep in the dazzling night of Pudong.
location: Bedroom, Room 502, Building 3, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning meditation
description: After the morning alarm went off, I didn't stay in bed. I put on a jacket, sat cross-legged on the bedroom window cushion, and meditated for 15 minutes. Outside, the sky was just beginning to lighten and the glass was foggy. I closed my eyes and took deep breaths, focusing on my breathing. Thoughts of the day's tasks flashed through my mind, but I pulled them back. When I finished, I felt clear-headed and relaxed. I could hear birdsong and distant traffic.
location: Bay window in the bedroom of the residence, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Wash up, weigh in, and help Mom prepare breakfast
description: After meditating, he went to the bathroom to wash up and splashed cold water on his face to fully wake up. He weighed 79.3 kg, the same as yesterday. As he left the room, he smelled the aroma of his mother steaming shengjian buns. He went over to say hello and helped bring the porridge to the dining table.
location: Bathroom and kitchen of the residence, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and investment signing
description: Sat down at the dining table with Father Lei Jianguo and took out two simple investment agreements printed in advance: Father would invest 50,000 yuan for a 10% dividend right in the new brand collection store. Father put on reading glasses, carefully reviewed the terms, and after hearing the explanation, stamped and signed them himself. Mother served porridge and joked that family members were making things so formal. Father transferred 50,000 yuan through mobile banking and received a text message confirming the transfer. He solemnly promised to use the money well. The family of three ate pan-fried buns, white porridge, and pickled vegetables while discussing plans for upgrading the store, and Father offered advice on the lease contract.
location: Dining room at residence, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling to work
description: After breakfast, put on a thick coat, helmet, and gloves, and rode the electric bike to the store at Super Brand Mall. At 8 a.m., traffic on Pudong Avenue was gradually increasing, but the distance was short; arrived in 8 minutes and parked the bike in the mall employee parking area, locking it.
location: The road section from Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Store opening preparations and internal and external communication
description: After arriving at the store, turn on the lights and the cash register system, and check the cleanliness after closing. Send a WeChat message to the interior designer scouted earlier, with the store floor plan and style reference images, and arrange an on-site visit Saturday afternoon. Call the mall property manager, Zheng Kai, to explain the renovation plan and ask about the latest renovation regulations. Zheng Kai told him in detail that he must first submit renderings for review and follow the construction time regulations; he carefully noted the key points.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store operations and creative preparation
description: Starting at 9:30, organized the newly arrived fall-winter stock and logged it into inventory with a barcode scanner. Received two regular customers and sold one fleece-lined hoodie and one pair of cargo pants. Then sat behind the cash register and organized the co-branded hoodie design sketches that had been finalized with Zhao Min, editing the style requirements, fabric, and sizes, and sent them to Hangzhou supplier Zhou Tao to evaluate the pattern-making timeline and cost. Zhou Tao replied that he would give an answer in the afternoon. Taking advantage of the lull before the lunch rush, opened the laptop, found the folder for the novel 'Afternoon in Xiafei Lane', quickly scanned the first three chapters to check for awkward phrasing, and organized the outline and topic ideas document, syncing it to the phone, to prepare for meeting Editor Chen from the publishing house tomorrow afternoon.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch
description: Feeling hungry, he locked the store door, went downstairs, crossed the circular footbridge, and walked to the B2 level of IFC Mall, where he ordered a salmon avocado energy bowl at Green & Safe to healthily replenish protein. While eating, he used his phone to watch the new anime trailers updated on Bilibili.
location: B2, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon store operations and order processing.
description: After lunch, he got a hot latte to go from the % Arabica coffee shop on the first floor of IFC, then walked back to the Super Brand Mall store. At the store, he energetically greeted customers and recommended outfits according to their needs. He handled several WeChat orders from regular customers, packed two down jackets and a scarf, and rode an electric scooter to the Hive Box locker beside Exit 2 of Lujiazui Metro Station to send the packages.
location: Shop A-208, Second Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and along the way

name: Personal training session and round trip
description: I cycled to the Standard Chartered Bank Building, took the elevator to the 5th-floor gym, and changed into training clothes 10 minutes early. Coach Wang, my personal trainer, was already waiting. The focus was on learning the proper mechanics for squats and deadlifts. After warming up, we started with bodyweight movement breakdowns, correcting my knees caving inward and my back rounding. Then we added weight, gradually increasing from the empty bar. He kept reminding me to keep my chest up, brace my core, and sit my hips back. After an hour of training, my hamstrings and glutes were sore, and I learned a different muscle activation pattern than before. After the session, I bought a tub of the muscle-building protein powder Coach Wang recommended, then showered and changed back into my clothes. I felt refreshed, though my thighs were slightly shaky, and cycled back to the store.
location: Gym, 5th Floor, Standard Chartered Bank Building, 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening store operations and confirmation of co-branding matters.
description: Back at the store, it was the evening rush hour around 5-6 p.m. Several groups of customers came in one after another, and in the busyness he managed to sell two coats and several accessories. Taking a moment to check his phone, Zhou Tao had replied that the co-branded hoodie could be made, but the embroidery craft details needed to be confirmed. He forwarded the question to Zhao Min, and after discussing on WeChat, they decided on a 3D computer embroidery solution. After that, he made a mind map on his phone for the next day's meeting with the publisher, making sure his thoughts were clear.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Dinner
description: At 7 PM, when there were fewer customers in the shop, he asked the staff at the next-door milk tea shop to keep an eye on the store. He went down to the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall to Lao Shengchang Soup Bun House, ordered a bowl of scallion-oil noodles, a basket of fresh pork soup buns, and a bowl of seaweed egg drop soup, and quickly ate to settle dinner.
location: Lao Shengchang Soup Bun Restaurant, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening store management and closing.
description: After dinner, he returned to the store, tidied up the clothes that had been rummaged through in the afternoon, hanging and ironing them one by one. Then he checked the day's revenue and inventory, and organized the cash. At 9 o'clock, the mall's closing music played; he turned off the store's lights and power, pulled down the rolling shutter door, and locked it. Before leaving, he sent a WeChat message to property manager Zheng Kai, confirming the deadline for submitting the renovation renderings next week.
location: Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling Home
description: At 9 p.m. the temperature was near 3°C, and cold wind blew straight in. He put on his helmet and rode his e-bike home; there were few cars on the road, and he reached the community gate in 15 minutes. Passing a 24-hour convenience store, he bought a carton of milk to drink tomorrow morning.
location: 24-hour convenience store near Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and along the route

name: Ukulele singing and strumming practice
description: After going home and greeting his parents, he went back to his bedroom, took out his ukulele, tuned it, and started practicing. Focusing on mastering the F chord, he repeatedly pressed and plucked the strings using the techniques his cousin Shen Jie had taught him: moving the thumb position down and keeping the fingers upright. After a dozen or so tries, he could play a clean sound. Seizing the moment, he played and sang the C major version of "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star" in one go. Although he stumbled a bit, he still recorded it and sent it to Shen Jie. He quickly received a reply: she praised his rapid progress, said the F chord no longer sounded muffled, and suggested adding a strumming rhythm next time. He was over the moon.
location: Bedroom in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading in the study.
description: After practicing the piano, I took a hot bath, and my fatigue was completely washed away. In my pajamas, I sat at the desk, turned on the lamp, and started reading Houses in the City. This book was recommended by an old customer and is about urban development and the logic of real estate. I took notes and thought about knowledge that might be useful for store expansion site selection. I read for about fifty minutes.
location: Home study room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Turned off the lights and rested.
description: Glanced at the phone; it was exactly 11 o'clock. Set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow. Looking back on the day: the agreement was signed, the class was attended, the hoodie is coming along, and the piece was practiced — I feel at ease. Turned off the light, emptied my mind, and fell asleep quickly.
location: Bedroom in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning meditation
description: After waking up in the morning, I sat cross-legged at the head of the bed and followed a guided meditation app, focusing on my breath for fifteen minutes. Facing tasks such as the Christmas promotion, meeting the editor at the publishing house, and a thorough house cleaning, I regarded them as waves in the Huangpu River, letting them come and go. Finally, in calm, I set today's mental anchor for myself.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning preparations and family breakfast
description: After meditating, I washed up and changed into athletic clothes. In the kitchen, I heated milk and toasted bread, while placing the printed first three chapters and synopsis of the novel on the counter for a quick review, marking with a pen the questions I wanted to ask the editor. Then I had breakfast with my parents. Mother made scallion oil noodles and soft-boiled eggs. Father encouraged me to drop the boss attitude and listen and ask more, while Mother told me to wear the navy wool coat. The family chatted warmly.
location: Home in Shanggang Residential Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Cycling commute to Super Brand Mall
description: Putting on my navy wool coat and carrying my canvas bag with the manuscripts, I rode my e-bike along Pudong Avenue toward Super Brand Mall in Lujiazui. The winter wind hit my face, so I pulled my scarf tighter. I arrived at the underground parking lot at about 8:20, locked my bike, and took the elevator up to the second-floor store.
location: From Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Launch and operation of the store's Christmas promotion
description: After arriving at the store, I set up Christmas hanging lights and a 10%-off promotional standee with staff member Xiao Lin. Xiao Lin sent a photo-text promotion in the VIP customer group. I personally arranged the newly arrived hoodies by color and style. At 10 a.m., regular customer Qian Duoduo came to shop, and I gave her a pair of Christmas limited-edition socks; she happily promoted it on her Moments. Meanwhile, I also confirmed with property manager Zheng Kai about the reporting process for the designer's weekend site survey to ensure the store upgrade went smoothly.

participant.name: Zheng Kai
participant.relation: Property manager of Super Brand Mall

location: URBAN OUTFITTERS, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch break
description: I asked Xiao Lin to go eat first, and went to the Japanese ramen restaurant Jiakang Bieguan on the B1 floor of the mall myself, where I ordered a bowl of tonkotsu ramen and fried dumplings. While eating, I reviewed the key points from the afternoon meeting. After the meal, I returned to the store, checked inventory, noted the styles that needed restocking, and put the tote bag with sample clothes and manuscripts within reach, ready for the afternoon departure.
location: Jiakang Bie Guan at B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and the 2nd-floor store

name: Commute to Grayscale Space Café in Jing'an District
description: After telling Xiao Lin to watch the store, I chose my favorite adventurous route: first riding a shared bike to the Dongchang Road Ferry Terminal, taking the ferry across the Huangpu River, and enjoying the changing views from Pudong to Puxi on the deck. After disembarking, I transferred to Line 2 to Nanjing West Road Station, and walked five minutes to Grayscale Space Café.
location: Dongchang Road Ferry Terminal, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Grayscale Space Cafe, West Nanjing Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Meet with publishing house editor
description: I arrived twenty minutes early, ordered a hand-brewed Geisha at a window seat on the second floor of the café, and organized my thoughts. Editor Chen arrived on time. We talked about the novel set against the backdrop of Xiafei Lane, and I shared my idea of weaving the urban emotions of the shop's customers into the story. Editor Chen approved of my writing style, gave me professional advice that the character transformations needed to be more nuanced, and encouraged me to contact her after finishing the 200,000-character first draft. The meeting left me feeling motivated.
location: Window-side booth on the second floor of Grayscale Space Cafe, Nanjing West Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai

name: Return trip and shopping along the way.
description: After saying goodbye to Teacher Chen, I took Metro Line 2 back to Pudong in a good mood, sending messages along the way to ask about the store and telling my mother I would be home soon. After getting off at Dongchang Road Station, I stopped by Pushang Vegetable Market to buy scallions and ginger for dinner, and also bought a pot of narcissus to add to the festive New Year atmosphere, before walking home.
location: From West Nanjing Road, Jing'an District, Shanghai, to Pushang Vegetable Market on Dongchang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, then to Shanggang Community.

name: Family spring cleaning (dusting the living room and study)
description: Back home, the radio was playing Shanghai opera, filling the air with a strong New Year vibe. I changed into old clothes, put on a hat, and used a long-handled feather duster to first clean the dust from the chandelier and ceiling corners in the living room. While my father was organizing old books and newspapers in the study, he called me over and showed me my elementary school Merit Student certificate and an old photo of me riding on his shoulders at age four. The whole family laughed and reminisced about the past.
location: Home living room and study in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Discovered a camphor wood chest in the storage room.
description: While cleaning the storage room, I found a dusty old camphorwood chest in the corner. When I opened the lid, inside were a few 1980s-style novels and a thread-bound notebook with delicate handwriting. My mother came over, looking a bit surprised. She gently closed the notebook and took it into the bedroom, saying only that it was old history. This made me even more curious about the stories in the chest.
location: Home storage room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Finish the big cleanup and put up New Year pictures
description: The spring cleaning was almost done, and the house was spotless. I took out the Year of the Rat New Year painting I had bought in advance and, with my father's help, neatly pasted a pair of cartoon mice holding gold coins above the main door of the living room. My mother stepped back to admire it, praised the placement, and said it would be a good omen for the coming year. The whole family looked at the refreshed home with great satisfaction.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Family dinner
description: After the big cleaning, my mother prepared dinner, including Shanghai-style braised pork, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, and tomato and egg soup. At the dinner table, I excitedly talked about my meeting with the publishing house editor in the afternoon. My father rarely praised me for being enterprising, while my mother was concerned about my energy for the evening workout and urged me to eat more meat.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Evening gym workout
description: After a short rest after lunch, I changed into my workout gear, grabbed protein powder and a towel, and walked eight minutes to FitMonster gym on the third floor of the Standard Chartered Bank Building. My personal trainer Allen was ready. The second personal training session focused on explosive power training, including box jumps, medicine ball slams, and kettlebell swings. I gritted my teeth and finished all sets. Afterward, I got on the treadmill myself and ran for 25 minutes at a 5:30 pace as the cardio finale. My whole body was sore but full of strength.
location: FitMonster Gym, 3rd Floor, Standard Chartered Bank Building, 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returned home and chatted with family.
description: After working out, I showered, changed into clean clothes, and walked home. When I entered, my parents were watching the news. I sat on the sofa and joined them, talking about the old photos we found during today's thorough cleaning, the takeaways from seeing the editor, and the new story I am developing. Outside the window, Lujiazui's lights were brilliant; inside, it was warm and cozy, ordinary yet happy.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Ukulele practice
description: Back in the bedroom, I picked up the ukulele and solidified the F chord and the C-G7 transition I practiced yesterday. In a good mood, I tried playing the intro of "Qili Xiang". Though my fingering was rough, I could feel the beauty of the melody. While playing, my mind drifted, and I enjoyed a calm beyond creativity.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Pre-sleep reading, review, and preparing for sleep.
description: After showering, I leaned against the headboard and read 'The House in the City'. The space renovation cases in the book sparked ideas for upgrading the store, and I promptly wrote them down in the notes on my phone. Looking back on the day, everything had been completed as expected. I sent my mother and Xiao Lin goodnight and next-day to-do messages respectively, set the alarm for 6:30, and fell asleep peacefully with a sense of fulfillment.
location: Bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning meditation and body data recording
description: At 6:00 a.m., the alarm went off. He sat cross-legged on the bedroom bay window and did 15 minutes of focused breathing meditation to clear his mind. Then, barefoot, he stepped onto the body-fat scale for a fasting measurement: weight 79.2 kg, waist 89 cm, estimated body fat rate about 24%. He recorded the data in his phone memo and took a photo for reference.
location: Master bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and changing
description: Washed up quickly, shaved his stubble clean, and changed into a dark red casual blazer, white T-shirt, black cargo pants, and Martin boots, ready to start the festive day.
location: At home, master bedroom and living room, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Have Christmas breakfast with parents.
description: Mother Wang Xiuying prepared fried eggs, plain congee, stir-fried shredded pork with preserved mustard greens, and freshly fried dough sticks. The family sat around the dining table, eating and chatting, sharing the store's Christmas event, plans for the evening gathering, and the good news that the novel had ended that day. His parents were happy for Lei Mingxuan.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ride an electric bicycle to the store
description: Put on a black overcoat, put on a helmet, and rode the e-bike west along Pudong Avenue. The December morning temperature was about 5-9°C. Arrived at the Super Brand Mall service passage after about 20 minutes.
location: Pudong New District, Shanghai, from Shanggang Community on Pudong Avenue to Super Brand Mall on Lujiazui West Road

name: Christmas promotional operations and customer service
description: After arriving at the store, he checked the Christmas promotional materials with Xiao Lin and put on a red Christmas-themed apron. After opening at 10, customer traffic surged. He recommended outfits to customers, told design stories, and used his phone to take real photos of the reserved functional coat for regular customer Qian Duoduo and sent them via WeChat. Property manager Zheng Kai came in and wished everyone a Merry Christmas.
location: “Xiafei Collection”, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch: light salad
description: He had Xiao Lin watch the store while he went to Wagas on the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall and ordered a salmon avocado salad and freshly squeezed orange juice, controlling calorie intake and preparing for the midday novel upload.
location: Wagas, B1, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Completing and publishing the novel
description: At a corner seat in Wagas, I used my laptop to connect to Wi-Fi, logged into the novel platform, uploaded the final chapter (Chapter 120) of "The Afternoon at Xiafei Lane," checked for typos, and published it. I added a "Completed" tag and wrote a completion message thanking editor Liu Yang, Teacher Chen from the publishing house, and the readers. Within minutes of publishing, I received dozens of reader comments.
location: Corner seat at Wagas, B1, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return to the store
description: Took the mall elevator from B1 back to the “Xiafei Ji” store on the second floor.
location: Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, from Wagas on B1 to 'Xiafei Collection' on the second floor

name: Sharing the joy of finishing and discovering the shortlist notification
description: After returning to the store, he took screenshots of the backend data and reader comments and sent them to Liu Yang, his childhood friend and editor. He then logged into the platform homepage and found a system notification: The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane had been shortlisted for the annual newcomer candidate list. He immediately took a screenshot, saved it, and informed Liu Yang again.

participant.name: Liu Yang
participant.relation: Friend and editor, contacted remotely via WeChat

location: “Xiafei Collection”, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Afternoon Christmas operations and publishing intention discussions
description: The afternoon was busy. While receiving customers and recommending the new hoodies in Christmas gift sets, I also handled leftover inquiry calls from the online pop-up exhibition. At around 16:00, through Liu Yang, I received initial publication interest feedback from Teacher Chen of Moxiang Culture Publishing House. Excited, I told the clerk Xiao Lin, "I'm going to publish a book!" Then I replied to Liu Yang to express my gratitude.

participant.name: Liu Yang
participant.relation: Friend and editor, contacted remotely via WeChat

participant.name: Zheng Kai
participant.relation: Mall property manager, may have passed by

location: “Xiafei Collection”, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Closing and sales data summary
description: Counted inventory and cleaned up with Xiao Lin, and summarized the day's revenue through the POS system. The Christmas promotion was very effective, with sales up nearly 50% compared with an ordinary Sunday. Put the day's takings in a special envelope to deposit in the bank tomorrow.
location: “Xiafei Collection”, Shop A-208, 2nd Floor, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walk to the dinner venue
description: After taking off his work uniform and putting on a black overcoat, he said goodbye to Xiao Lin and walked to Meilongzhen Restaurant on Pudong South Road, about 800 meters away, to have dinner with his childhood friends Zhang Wei and Li Na.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai: walk from Super Brand Mall to Meilongzhen Restaurant on South Pudong Road.

name: Christmas dinner and celebration
description: Had dinner with Zhang Wei and Li Na in a private room on the second floor of Meilongzhen Restaurant. The table was set with crystal shrimp, sizzling eel paste, braised pork, and a three-delicacy casserole. The three toasted each other and said Merry Christmas. Lei Mingxuan shared the good news that his novel was complete, had been shortlisted for the newcomer list, and had a publication interest. His friends toasted and congratulated him one after another, and he drank one extra small glass of red wine more than planned.
location: Private room, 2nd floor, Meilongzhen Restaurant (Pudong South Road Branch), Pudong South Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Walked home to aid digestion.
description: After the dinner gathering, slightly tipsy, he declined his friends' offer to call a ride and walked home alone along Pudong Avenue. The cold wind brushed his face, and streetlights cast dappled light through the plane tree branches. Replying to congratulatory WeChat messages as he walked, he reached home in about 25 minutes.
location: Pudong New Area, Shanghai: from Meilongzhen Restaurant on Pudong South Road to Shanggang Community on Pudong Avenue

name: Share the good news with his parents
description: Returning home, I sat on the living room sofa, slightly tipsy, and told my parents the good news: the novel was finished, it had been shortlisted, and a publisher had expressed preliminary interest. My mother kept saying yes, and my father, with a rare smile, patted me on the shoulder and said 'Well done.' We chatted warmly as a family.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Shower before bed and weight management memo.
description: Took a hot shower to sober up, changed into pajamas, lay against the headboard, set the alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning, and noted in the phone memo: 'Light meal at Wagas tomorrow noon to burn off tonight's red wine calories,' lamenting how easy it is to gain weight during the holidays.
location: Master bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading and falling asleep
description: Stopped looking at electronic screens, picked up the bedside book 'A House in the City' and read quietly for about half an hour, calming the excitement. After turning off the light, I reviewed the fulfilling and surprising day and fell asleep peacefully with satisfaction and anticipation.
location: Master bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning routine
description: I woke up at 6:30 in the morning and completed an 18-minute meditation on the yoga mat in my bedroom. This was my 12th consecutive day, and I felt I could get into the zone more quickly with focused thoughts. After meditating, I washed up and weighed myself: 79.1 kg, 0.1 kg lighter than yesterday, so I was in a good mood. While brushing my teeth, I looked in the mirror and planned the day's priorities: finalize the store's spring promotion plan in the morning, buy camping supplies in the afternoon, and share the news of my novel being shortlisted with my parents in the evening.
location: Room 602, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family breakfast and camping group confirmation
description: He had a light breakfast with his parents, including white congee, stir-fried seasonal vegetables, boiled eggs, and pickled cucumbers made by his mother. His father, Lei Jianguo, reminded him to drive safely. While eating, he browsed industry news on his phone. After the meal, he sat on the living room sofa, opened WeChat, and sent a message in the 'Camping Squad' group to confirm tomorrow's gathering arrangements. Group members Zhang Wei, Li Na, and Shen Jie all replied positively, confirming their respective tasks.
location: Room 602, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and pre-opening preparations
description: He changed into the store’s outdoor-style casual jacket, rode an e-bike along Pudong Avenue to Super Brand Mall, and arrived 8 minutes later. After entering, he turned on the lights, played indie music, asked store clerk Xiao Lin to check the shelves and wipe down the mannequins, and opened his computer to check the online shipping list and the revenue from yesterday’s Christmas promotion.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store spring promotion rehearsal
description: He called over the store assistant Xiao Lin and began shooting material for the Xiaohongshu 'Mountain Style' outfit series after New Year's Day. He had Xiao Lin try on three newly arrived techwear jackets in khaki, army green, and off-white, directed him to pose with natural outdoor movements inside and outside the store, and took photos and short videos from multiple angles with his phone. At the same time, he noted down copywriting inspiration in his memo, such as 'Urban techwear, weekend escape.'
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Process feedback on the novel being shortlisted
description: After wrapping up the photo shoot, I sat behind the cash register, drinking water and resting. I opened the writing app to reply to comments from enthusiastic readers under the completion message of The Afternoon of Xiafei Lane, and privately sent the screenshot of being shortlisted for the new author list to the publishing house editor Liu Yang, sharing the good news. Liu Yang quickly replied with congratulations and said the list was very valuable for future publication plans and would keep following it. This news lifted my spirits.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch and confirmation of camping responsibilities
description: I walked through the mall's connecting corridor to Wagas on the basement level of IFC and ordered a salmon avocado salad and a freshly squeezed celery apple juice. I sat by the window, eating while scrolling through Bilibili videos by outdoor camping bloggers recommending gear. After eating, I didn't leave. During the lunch break, I made a voice call to Zhang Wei to confirm that he was responsible for bringing the grill, charcoal, and lighter; sent a WeChat message to Li Na asking her and Shen Jie to handle drinks, fruit, and snacks, with a reference list attached; and finally sent a separate message to Shen Jie to meet at 2 p.m. on the first floor of Super Brand Mall to purchase equipment and ingredients. Everyone confirmed their assignments, and the arrangements were well organized.
location: Wagas, B1, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return to the store and wait for Shen Jie
description: Walking back from Wagas to Super Brand Mall, he passed the snack street outside the first floor and was attracted by the smell of egg waffles. He bought an original-flavor one and ate it while walking, saving it as a snack for tomorrow's camping. Back at the store, he checked the morning's photo results, told Xiao Lin to retouch the images, packed his backpack, and then went down to the first-floor atrium early to find a seat and wait for Shen Jie. While waiting, he checked tomorrow's camping weather on his phone: cloudy, 3–8°C, looking good.
location: 1F Atrium, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Buy camping gear and ingredients with Shen Jie.
description: At 2 p.m., Shen Jie arrived on time, wearing a hoodie and cargo pants from her own shop, looking sharp and energetic. The two first went up to the fourth floor to Decathlon, and following the checklist in her memo, picked out a portable first-aid kit containing iodine, gauze, band-aids and other everyday items. Then they went down to the basement level to Carrefour, pushed a cart straight to the fresh food section. Lei Mingxuan chose grain-fed ribeye steak, chicken wings, ham sausage, and potatoes, while Shen Jie excitedly grabbed vegetables, corn, foil containers, disposable utensils, seasonings, mineral water, and oranges. The cart was piled high, and the two chatted and laughed, looking forward to the next day's camping trip.
location: Decathlon on the 4th floor and Carrefour on the B1 floor of Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning to the store to wrap up and getting off work
description: After finishing the shopping, he said goodbye to Shen Jie and carried several large bags of supplies back to the store himself. He first stored the perishable steaks and chicken wings in the store refrigerator, and piled the other supplies in a corner of the storeroom. Then he caught up with Xiao Lin on the afternoon customer situation, checked the business revenue, and handled an inquiry from a regular customer on WeChat. Once everything was in order, he got ready to leave work early.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Organized camping gear and checked the vehicle.
description: Rode the electric bike back to Shanggang Community, went straight to the parking lot, opened the car trunk, and loaded today's purchased supplies (except the meat in the fridge) into the car along with the tent, sleeping bag, and moisture-proof pad from home. Used empty boxes to neatly arrange small equipment such as the first-aid kit, headlamp, raincoat, and folding chairs. Then checked the car condition, confirmed the tire pressure was normal and the fuel level was sufficient, and felt much more at ease.
location: Shanggang Community Parking Lot, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner and sharing the good news of the novel being shortlisted
description: He arrived home early and saw his mother preparing dinner, so he took the initiative to help peel garlic and wash potatoes. On the dinner table were steamed sea bass, garlic lettuce, and corn and pork rib soup. While eating, he casually took out his phone and showed his parents the screenshot of his novel "The Afternoon at Xiafei Lane" being shortlisted as a candidate for the annual newcomer award, along with editor Liu Yang's praise. His father Lei Jianguo, rare to smile, grinned and said "good" repeatedly. His mother Wang Xiuying was so happy she could hardly close her mouth and kept praising, "My son has made something of himself!" She told him not to be proud and to keep writing well. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
location: Room 602, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening reading and relaxation
description: After dinner, he helped his mother clear the table, then sat back down on the living room sofa, picked up the half-finished book Houses in the City and continued reading. From time to time, he mulled over the rough concept of the store renovation, gradually relaxing both physically and mentally, enjoying this quiet time.
location: Room 602, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Riverside cycling and shopping
description: To relieve the boredom of sitting for too long, I changed into sweatpants and running shoes and went downstairs. I rented a shared bike and rode along Lujiazui Ring Road toward the riverside greenway for half an hour. At night, Pudong was dazzling with lights, and with the cool river breeze, I felt quite content. After the ride, I bought a bottle of mineral water and a pack of tissues at Yanqin Grocery Store near the entrance of the residential community to stock up for tomorrow's camping.
location: Riverside Greenway, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (near Nanzhan Avenue) and Yanqin Grocery Store

name: Washing up, relaxing, and preparing for bed.
description: After returning home, took a hot shower, changed into dry pajamas, curled up on the sofa and scrolled through camping videos by outdoor bloggers on Bilibili. Watching scenes of making fire, cooking, and stargazing made him look forward to tomorrow's camping even more. Then he set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, confirmed the meeting time with Zhang Wei and Shen Jie in the WeChat group, checked the power bank, and set the navigation. Lying in bed, he reviewed the fulfilling day: the novel being shortlisted, the promotion rehearsal, material procurement, and family warmth — everything was perfect. He closed his eyes with satisfaction and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Room 602, Building 7, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning meditation after waking up, breakfast, and pre-departure check
description: At 6:30 in the morning, the alarm went off. Lei Mingxuan got up and first stepped on the electronic scale; it showed 79.1 kg, down from yesterday. Then he took a hot shower, changed into sportswear, and sat cross-legged on the carpet. He opened the meditation app and did a 16-minute mindfulness meditation, including 5 minutes of breath focus and a body scan. During it, his thoughts occasionally drifted to today's camping plan, but he gently brought his attention back. After finishing, he felt calm. Then he had breakfast with his mother, Wang Xiuying, enjoying the white porridge and pan-fried buns she had prepared, and talked about the day's schedule. After the meal, he carefully checked the camping equipment checklist: tent, canopy, folding table and chairs, barbecue grill, food box, first-aid kit, pour-over coffee kettle, and so on, then went to the garage to confirm the tire pressure and fuel level. The trunk supplies were fully ready.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ride to the meeting point and prepare for the group departure.
description: After saying goodbye to his parents, Lei Mingxuan got on his e-bike, rode east along Pudong Avenue then turned onto Zhangyang Road, and reached the meeting point—the entrance of a light-fare cafe—in about 15 minutes. The morning wind was a bit chilly, but the sunshine was nice. His friend Zhang Wei was already waiting in an off-road vehicle; then Shen Jie and Li Na arrived one after another, with Shen Jie carrying a professional camera bag. The four of them moved their food ingredients and equipment from Lei Mingxuan's vehicle to Zhang Wei's off-road vehicle, checked that they had warm clothing, and, with everything ready, prepared to drive off.
location: In front of a light-fare coffee shop on Zhangyang Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (near Century Avenue)

name: Drove to the campsite
description: Zhang Wei drove the SUV. Lei Mingxuan sat in the front passenger seat, while Shen Jie and Li Na sat in the back. Light music played in the car. They drove along the Middle Ring Expressway and Hujin Expressway to Shanghai Bay National Forest Park in Fengxian District. The drive took about 1 hour and 35 minutes, and they chatted happily: Shen Jie shared her newly purchased camera lens, Li Na complained about her year-end summary troubles, and Lei Mingxuan and Zhang Wei discussed last night's Champions League match.
location: Expressway section from Pudong New Area to Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Campsite setup and lunch break
description: After arriving at Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, the four chose a flat campsite near the water. Lei Mingxuan and Zhang Wei set up the tent and canopy, while Shen Jie and Li Na laid out ground mats, arranged folding tables and chairs, and prepared a light lunch (smoked salmon sandwiches, fresh strawberries, nuts, etc.). Nearly two hours later, the outdoor living room was ready and camp lanterns were hung. Everyone then sat under the canopy to enjoy lunch, drinking hot tea from insulated cups, chatting and laughing. The simple food was especially delicious after the outdoor exertion.
location: Camping area, Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Camp exploration and photography
description: After the meal, Shen Jie suggested exploring the forest trail behind the campsite. The four of them strolled together. Lei Mingxuan used a portable camera to photograph the winter woods, birds, and tents in the distance; Zhang Wei flew a drone and shot a spectacular panoramic aerial video. Along the way they spotted wild mushrooms and squirrels, and everyone immersed themselves in nature.
location: Forest trail in Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, No. 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Camp fitness training and forest cross-country run
description: Back at camp, Lei Mingxuan changed into quick-dry athletic wear and used the conditions at the campsite for training: he completed 3 sets of wide-grip push-ups (20 reps each), 3 sets of bodyweight squats (25 reps each), and did one set of resistance band rows. Inspired, Zhang Wei joined in and did several sets of planks. Then the two took a roughly 2-kilometer trail run along the forest path, weaving through the winter woods and breathing crisp air, which took about 15 minutes. After the run, Lei Mingxuan wiped himself down with wet wipes and changed into a clean sweatshirt.
location: Camping Area and Forest Trails of Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, No. 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Free time at the campsite and equipment testing
description: After the trail run, Lei Mingxuan wiped himself down and changed into a clean hoodie. Shen Jie was studying the new camera and tripod to shoot close-ups of the campsite, while Li Na lay on a lounge chair reading the copy of West with the Night she had brought along. Lei Mingxuan and Zhang Wei, meanwhile, tested the newly purchased outdoor stove and cookware together, boiled water to make a cup of hot tea, and chatted casually about work and life.
location: Camping area, Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Camp sketching and frisbee games
description: Lei Mingxuan took out his sketchbook and charcoal pencil and drew a simple sketch of the distant tree shadows and twilight. Then Zhang Wei took out a frisbee, and the four of them ran to the big lawn nearby to play frisbee. Though they were out of breath, they were full of laughter, as if back in their teenage years. The sun was setting, and the sky turned a beautiful orange-red.
location: Camping area and adjacent lawn, Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, No. 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Preparing and enjoying a barbecue dinner, plus some pour-over coffee time
description: As it grew dark, Lei Mingxuan skillfully lit the charcoal briquettes and started a campfire. Shen Jie took out her portable pour-over coffee kit and ground coffee beans to make pour-over coffee. As the fire blazed, Lei Mingxuan took over as chef and began grilling; steaks, chicken wings, and lamb skewers sizzled on the grill. Zhang Wei helped sprinkle seasonings, while Shen Jie and Li Na brought out salads and a fruit platter. Everyone sat around the campfire under the canopy and devoured the food. After the meal, Shen Jie made pour-over coffee for everyone. The rich aroma of coffee blended with the smell of wood smoke. Li Na showed great interest and agreed to try it again tomorrow morning.
location: By the campfire in the camping area of Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, No. 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Campfire chatting and late-night talk.
description: Adding more firewood made the campfire blaze brighter, and the orange-red glow shone on everyone's faces. Topics ranged from embarrassing childhood stories to relationship experiences, then to confusion and expectations for the future. Zhang Wei shared his idea of switching careers to become an outdoor guide; Li Na complained about her eccentric colleagues at work; Lei Mingxuan shared the joy of his novel being shortlisted and about to be published, and everyone was happy for him. As the night deepened, only the crackling of burning wood and the chirping of insects in the distance remained.
location: By the campfire in the camping area of Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, No. 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Evening washing up and campsite tidying
description: As the campfire gradually died down, the four of them got up to pack up the utensils and trash, sorting the garbage into bags. Lei Mingxuan went to the public washing area for a quick wash, splashing cold water on his face to refresh himself. Returning to the tent, he changed into thick thermal pajamas and climbed into his sleeping bag; from the neighboring tent came Zhang Wei's voice saying goodnight.
location: Public washing area and tent at the camping zone of Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, No. 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Stargazing at night and falling asleep
description: Lying in his sleeping bag, Lei Mingxuan pulled open a corner of the tent and looked up at the night sky. Away from city light pollution, the stars were especially bright. He used his phone to jot down his feelings for the day: wilderness, campfire, old friends—everything perfect. Then he set the alarm for the next day and fell asleep peacefully, content and relaxed, accompanied by the chirping of insects and the sound of the wind.
location: Inside the tent in the camping area of Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Morning wake-up and farewell to the campsite
description: At 6:30 in the morning, he naturally woke up in the tent, hearing birdsong and the gentle lapping of the lake outside. After tidying up briefly, he walked to the lakeside, admired the morning mist over the water, and felt the crisp, fresh air, injecting energy into the start of the day.
location: Campsite (lakeside) at Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, No. 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Morning pour-over coffee and time with a friend.
description: Shen Jie brought out a professional pour-over coffee set and demonstrated the pour-over technique. It was Li Na's first time trying pour-over, and she was very focused. Everyone boiled water and took photos, sitting together in the morning light to enjoy the coffee and the view of the lake and sky. Lei Mingxuan photographed his companions' backs as they brewed coffee and took a group photo with raised cups, then posted them to his friend group and Moments, geotagged at Fengxian Bay National Forest Park.
location: Campsite at Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, No. 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai (under the canopy).

name: Teamwork in breaking camp
description: The four divided the work to pack up the camping gear: Lei Mingxuan took down the tent and canopy, Zhang Wei carried the equipment to the trunk, and Shen Jie and Li Na cleaned and sorted the trash, making sure to leave the campsite without a trace.
location: Shanghai Bay National Forest Park Campground, No. 1677, Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Checkout from camp and checking equipment
description: Started the vehicle, checked tire pressure and fuel level, confirmed all equipment was loaded correctly, and drove out of the forest park at exactly 10:00, ending the camping activity.
location: Parking lot, Shanghai Bay National Forest Park, 1677 Suitanghe Road, Fengxian District, Shanghai

name: Chatted with good friends on the way back
description: Drove back via the coastal highway in Fengxian District, S4 Hujin Expressway, and Middle Ring Road, finally arriving at Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area. In the car, the companions shared starry-sky photos and the pour-over coffee experience, and planned the next camping trip to Anji Bamboo Sea. The whole ride was relaxed and pleasant.
location: Shanghai (from the coastal road in Fengxian District to Zhangyang Road in Pudong New Area, via S4 Shanghai-Jinhua Expressway and Middle Ring Road)

name: Saying goodbye and unloading the gear.
description: Arriving downstairs at Shanggang Community, everyone helped each other unload personal gear and sleeping bags, said brief goodbyes, and agreed to look at photos next time. Lei Mingxuan carried the large equipment such as the tent and canopy back to the balcony at home.
location: Downstairs of Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and at home

name: Family lunch.
description: Back home, his mother had prepared dishes such as braised pork ribs. At the dinner table, while eating, he told his parents amusing stories about the camping trip, including the morning mist over the lake, hand-brewed coffee, and chatting around the campfire. His parents listened with great interest.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, Pudong Avenue, Lane 136, Shanggang Residential Community, home (dining room).

name: Putting away gear and an unexpected discovery
description: After organizing the camping gear, he laid the tent and sleeping bag out on the balcony to dry. Then he cleaned up the corner of the bedroom. When he moved the old camphor wood chest aside, he found a hardcover diary written by his mother in 1987 at the bottom. The flyleaf read "Wang Xiuying 1987".
location: At home in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (bedroom, balcony)

name: An in-depth heart-to-heart talk with my mother
description: Holding the diary, he asked his mother, which led to a deep conversation. His mother talked about the language barriers she faced when she first arrived in Shanghai, her clumsiness in learning to cook Shanghainese cuisine, and the joy and anxiety she felt while pregnant with Mingxuan. Lei Mingxuan expressed his gratitude and his idea of writing a novel, and his mother was moved to tears.
location: At home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (living room sofa)

name: Inspiration notes and novel planning
description: At the computer, I recorded my mother's account and my own feelings, with the tentative title "The Nantong Bride," and quickly wrote an outline starting from the Bund in 1987, feeling that this was the most vibrant creation.
location: At home, Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (at the desk in the bedroom)

name: Coffee time and annual review
description: Brewed a cup of drip coffee and went to the balcony to check the gear drying outside. Opened the climbing log app and looked at the yearly data: climbed 23 times, highest difficulty V3. Although I didn't break through, I felt it was okay. Wrote next year's goal V4 in the memo, and sent a screenshot of the summary to the climbing enthusiast group, asking for supervision and guidance.
location: Home at Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (living room, balcony)

name: Family dinner time
description: Enjoyed the dinner prepared by his mother, including stir-fried seasonal vegetables, tomato and egg soup, and salt-and-pepper pork strips, Lei Mingxuan's favorite. The atmosphere at the table was warm. His mother kept putting food on his plate. Lei Mingxuan shared his ideas for "The Nantong Bride," and his father praised that writing a book is not easy.
location: Shanghai, Pudong New Area, Pudong Avenue, Lane 136, Shanggang Residential Community, home (dining room).

name: Cat moments and everyday reflections
description: After dinner, watched two news programs with my parents, then returned to my room. The cat Afu was already waiting on the bed. After showering, Afu came over and rubbed its head against me asking for pets. Through spending time with the cat, I felt patience and responsibility, and felt at peace inside.
location: At home in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (living room, bedroom)

name: Evening meditation
description: He put on his headphones, dimmed the lights, and spent 20 minutes in loving-kindness meditation. He prayed in turn for the camping companions, his parents, and Afu, and also prayed for the 'Nantong bride' in the diary who was struggling alone. After the meditation, he felt peaceful at heart.
location: At home in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (on the bed in the bedroom).

name: Health reflections and bedtime reading
description: Leaning against the headboard, he read his mother's diary and noted his health feelings: the camping trip was physically demanding but left him energetic, and after 8 consecutive days of healthy meals he no longer needed coffee in the afternoon and his complexion had improved. Afterwards, he read the book Houses in the City to relax.
location: At home in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (on the bed in the bedroom).

name: Archiving and getting ready for bed
description: He organized and archived today's mood, photos, and novel inspiration into his phone notes. At 22:30, he turned off the lights to go to sleep. A Fu adjusted its position beside him. Although he was thinking about tomorrow's hoodie warm-up plan, he fell asleep peacefully.
location: At home in Shanggang Community, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (on the bed in the bedroom).

name: Morning meditation and journaling
description: At the first light of dawn, Lei Mingxuan sat on the meditation cushion on the bedroom floor and began his 14th consecutive day of meditation practice. He set a 20-minute countdown on his phone and, between breaths, felt the soreness and heaviness in his body as it recovered from the weekend camping trip. His thoughts occasionally drifted to today's shop arrangements and his mother's diary from last night, but they were soon pulled back to his breathing. After the meditation, he wrote down his reflections in the black journal on the nightstand, recording his state of mind as he returned from the wilderness to the city.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Building 6, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Breakfast and family chat
description: Lei Mingxuan walked into the dining room wearing a gray hoodie, and his mother, Wang Xiuying, had already prepared shengjianbao and plain rice porridge. As he ate, he chatted with her about the diary from 1987 that he had read the night before, asking about the details of the first time she accompanied his father back to Nantong to meet his grandparents. His mother smiled and recalled how his grandfather had specially gone to the river to catch crucian carp, then used a carrying pole to carry two red suitcases to see her off as she boarded the bus. The suitcases contained hand-sewn quilts. This warm conversation almost made him lose track of time.
location: Restaurant, Room 301, Building 6, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Commute and package pickup.
description: Lei Mingxuan put on his old leather jacket, put on his helmet, and set off from home on his electric bike. On a sunny early-winter morning, he first made a detour to the smart locker on B1 of Lujiazui Metro Station, entered the pickup code, and took out the foldable outdoor stool he had bought during the camping trip three days before. Holding the stool in one hand and controlling the bike with the other, he continued riding and soon arrived at the staff entrance of Super Brand Mall.
location: Smart locker, B1, Lujiazui Metro Station, 158 Huayuan Shiqiao Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning store management and spring stocking
description: After entering the store, Lei Mingxuan turned on the lights, started the POS system, and greeted the clerk Xiao Lin, who had arrived early. He opened the computer to check the weekend sales report and found that camping-style hiking jackets and quick-dry T-shirts were selling well, and the "mountain-style outfits" display area performed excellently. He then contacted supplier Zhou Tao, who told him that logistics were tight at the end of the year and suggested confirming the spring new product orders as soon as possible. After weighing his options, he ordered a portion of the spring key styles and urged that the styles with missing sizes be shipped urgently.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Client maintenance and material organization for 'Nantong Bride'
description: There weren't many customers in the morning. Lei Mingxuan sorted the shelves while replying to VIP customer messages on his phone. A regular customer, Feng Xiaoyu, asked about the size of a wool-blend coat. After confirming the inventory, he took photos and sent them to her, promising to ship it the same day via SF Express. Later, sitting by the cash register, he wrote down inspirations for the novel "The Nantong Bride" in the notes app on his phone. The keywords included '1987 Nantong dowry boat lane first night,' and he added details his mother had mentioned: her grandfather carrying red boxes on a shoulder pole to see her off, her surprise at the gas stove when she first arrived in Shanghai, and the scene of her crying alone. The beginning of the story gradually became clear.
