location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Lunch
description: Lei Mingxuan locked the store door and walked three minutes to Wagas on the basement level of IFC Mall, where he ordered a salmon avocado salad and a glass of fresh orange juice. He found a booth against the wall and scrolled through Xiaohongshu while eating. He noticed a newly opened camping-style coffee shop and silently noted its name, planning to visit it on the weekend.
location: Wagas, Shop LG1-12, IFC Mall, 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: End-of-day store wrap-up and online order processing
description: Back at the store, Lei Mingxuan began packing Feng Xiaoyu's jacket and two other online orders. After carefully checking them, he affixed the SF Express waybills. He then organized his gym bag, packing training clothes, sneakers, a towel, and a water bottle, to prepare for the afternoon workout.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Going to the gym
description: Lei Mingxuan changed into his training clothes, put on his backpack, told the store clerk Xiao Lin what to do, and then rode his e-bike to the gym at the Standard Chartered Bank Tower. The trip took less than five minutes, and he parked his bike in the non-motor vehicle parking area on the ground floor of the building.
location: Standard Chartered Bank Tower, 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Mixed training at the gym
description: The gym wasn't too crowded in the afternoon. Lei Mingxuan warmed up with a 10-minute jog, then did strength training: squats at 67.5 kg for 3 sets of 10 reps, deadlifts at 77.5 kg for 3 sets of 10 reps, and bench presses at 57.5 kg for 3 sets of 8 reps, with rest between sets kept to under a minute. The soreness in the back of his thighs reminded him of the lingering effects of camping. After strength training, he ran on the treadmill for 50 minutes at a pace of 4:50 per kilometer, chatting with the coach nearby about the arrival of New Year's new products. After running, he stretched for 5 minutes. His sweat-soaked shirt showed how hard he had worked, and he ended the training feeling satisfied.
location: Fitness center, B1, Standard Chartered Bank Tower, No. 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Return to the store
description: Lei Mingxuan cycled back to Super Brand Mall. On the way, he bought an iced Americano at the Starbucks on the first floor, took a big gulp, then went back to the store through the staff passage, feeling completely refreshed.
location: Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store wrap-up and closing
description: In the afternoon, customer traffic in the store increased. Lei Mingxuan and Xiao Lin received customers together and offered styling suggestions. Near 5:30, the flow of customers gradually thinned, and they began closing preparations: counting cash, tidying the fitting rooms, returning clothes to their places, checking the displays, and filling in the business records. After confirming everything was in order, Lei Mingxuan pulled down the roll-up door, and the day's work ended smoothly.
location: Shop A-208, 2F, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Shopping on the way home
description: Lei Mingxuan rode his electric bike around to the Pushang Food Market on Laoshan Road and bought a box of seasonal strawberries, 500 grams of sugar tangerines, and 500 grams of pork ribs, planning to have the fruit as snacks in the evening and to have his mother make soup with the ribs the next day. On the way home, the streetlights gradually came on; he merged into the evening rush-hour traffic, feeling grounded and calm.
location: Pushang Farmers Market, Laoshan Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family dinner
description: As he opened the door, the aroma of food hit his nose. His mother had made Shanghai-style braised pork, stir-fried snow peas, and tomato and egg soup. His father poured him a glass of warmed yellow rice wine and asked how things were at the shop. At the dinner table, the conversation again turned to his mother's 1987 diary. Lei Mingxuan asked how she had felt about marrying alone into the family back then. His mother slowly recalled how she had feared not understanding the Shanghai dialect and not being a good enough Shanghai daughter-in-law. His father silently put a piece of braised pork on her plate. It was a warm and touching scene.
location: Restaurant, Room 301, Building 6, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New District, Shanghai

name: Organizing camping photos and social interactions
description: Lei Mingxuan turned on his computer, imported the photos and videos from the weekend camping trip, selected nine photos, adjusted brightness and saturation, arranged them in a 3x3 grid, and posted them to WeChat Moments with the caption 'Escaping the city for 48 hours, then returning with a full charge. Next stop, see you in the mountains.' He also sent the photos to the 'Outdoor Shenanigans Squad' WeChat group, which sparked lively discussion. Zhang Wei proposed hiking the Hui-Hang Ancient Trail after New Year's Day, Li Na enthusiastically seconded, and Shen Jie left a comment on Moments looking forward to the next gathering. Lei Mingxuan replied to each one, already starting to plan his next adventure.
location: Study, Room 301, Building 6, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Free relaxation and reading.
description: Leaving the computer, Lei Mingxuan leaned back on the bed and flipped through “The House in the City,” thinking about dreams of city life. After reading for a while, he picked up his phone and browsed Bilibili, paying attention to new videos by travel and outdoor content creators for new inspiration.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Building 6, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Ukulele practice
description: Lei Mingxuan took out his vintage-colored ukulele and practiced switching between C, Am, F, G, and Dm chords; his fingers felt much more flexible. He opened the strumming-and-singing app and tried to play and sing through the whole score of 'The Meaning of Travel,' repeatedly working on the transition from F to Dm to G7. After seven or eight attempts, it flowed smoothly. Thinking that he could perform at the New Year's Day gathering, he felt secretly pleased.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Building 6, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Washing up and bedtime review
description: Lei Mingxuan took a hot shower, washing away the fatigue of the day. After lying down in bed, he took out his diary and wrote down today's reflections: the store is operating normally, spring stock has been ordered; his fitness level is recovering; the conversation with his mother gave him new ideas for his novel; and the ukulele practice is going smoothly — all is well. With a sense of satisfaction, he got ready to sleep.
location: Bathroom and bedroom, Room 301, Building 6, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading and getting ready for bed
description: Lei Mingxuan dimmed the desk lamp and continued reading the chapter on community commercial renovation in 'The House in the City', and was inspired to incorporate outdoor elements into the store display. His phone vibrated; it was his buddy Chen Hao inviting him to a gathering after New Year's Day. He didn't reply for now. Sleepiness came over him, so he put down the book, turned off his phone, set the alarm for 6:30 the next morning, and got ready to sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Building 6, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lights Out, Went to Sleep
description: Lei Mingxuan turned off the desk lamp, and the bedroom fell into darkness. Listening to the occasional passing cars outside the window, he replayed today's conversation with his mother and fragments of the novel's opening in his mind. After a few deep breaths, he fully relaxed and fell into a deep sleep.
location: Bedroom, Room 301, Building 6, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning meditation and outdoor morning run.
description: In the early morning, did a meditation consolidation session in the bedroom, focusing on breathing and visualization of 'sustained action,' and felt it was easier to gather his thoughts. Then changed into sportswear and went to Lujiazui Central Green Park, completed a 2 km warm-up jog and about 3.5 km aerobic run, stretched, and went home to shower.
location: Home bedroom in Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, and Lujiazui Central Green Park

name: Family breakfast and casual chat
description: After taking a shower, had breakfast with his mother Wang Xiuying in the dining room, eating plain rice porridge, pan-fried pork buns, and pickled vegetables. They chatted about family matters while eating; his mother reminded him to keep warm, and he checked his phone messages at the same time.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commute and bank reserve deposit
description: Left home on an electric bike, stopped at the ATM in HSBC Building on the way to deposit 8,000 yuan of reserve cash into the store account, confirmed the receipt, then went on to Super Brand Mall, parked, and entered the mall.
location: Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai to HSBC Tower, 8 Lujiazui East Road and Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road

name: Opening the shop and morning preparations
description: Arrived at the clothing store at A-208, Super Brand Mall. Together with shop assistant Xiao Lin, I turned on the lights, checked yesterday's sales report, verified inventory, opened new packages, adjusted the displays, and got ready at the cash register to handle online orders.
location: Store A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Year-end sales data organization and client communication
description: At the cash register, he used his laptop to organize December sales data and entered it into Excel by category. During this, he processed a 100 yuan deposit refund for a regular customer, transferred the money via WeChat, kept the receipt, and continued communicating with online customers.
location: Store A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Home lunch, weight measurement, and family communication
description: After instructing Xiao Lin to watch the store, I rode my electric bike home. I weighed myself on an empty stomach: 78.3 kg, down 0.8 kg from last time. I recorded the data, took a screenshot, and shared it with my friend Zhang Wei, who gave his approval. Then I had a light lunch with my mother—steamed sea bass, blanched broccoli, and other light dishes—and we chatted about daily life and fitness progress. After a short rest, I rode back to the store.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Year-end accounting and annual bonus distribution
description: After returning to the store, he threw himself into the afternoon work: used financial software to set up the annual accounting framework, checked the December income statement against last month's report; calculated Xiao Lin's year-end bonus plan with him and told him the amount; mall property manager Zheng Kai came by and briefly discussed the New Year's Day event program. After continuous work, he took a short break, drank some water, and relaxed by browsing news on his phone.
location: Store A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Evening sales prep and VIP customer maintenance
description: After the break, he adjusted the store lighting with Xiao Lin and checked product displays to welcome customers in the best condition. He sent new-arrival notifications and real photos with styling suggestions to several VIP regular customers via WeChat, and received an enthusiastic response from Feng Xiaoyu.
location: Store A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Light dinner and hydration.
description: In the store, I used my phone to order a chicken breast vegetable salad and an Americano for dinner. While eating, I called my mother to let her know I had already eaten, so she didn't need to save any food for me. I deliberately increased my water intake to prepare for the next day's physical fitness test.
location: Store A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Handling evening peak customer flow and sales
description: In the evening, foot traffic in the mall increased. He displayed caramel-colored techwear jackets at the store entrance to attract customers, proactively recommended jackets and cargo pants to young customers, and patiently explained the fabric features. He successfully closed sales on one jacket, two hoodies, and a blind box.
location: Store A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Store closing and stocktaking
description: Pulled down the rolling shutter door, counted the day's revenue with Xiao Lin, checked the cash and electronic payments, signed for confirmation, then reminded Xiao Lin to arrive a bit later the next day, as he would take care of opening the store himself. Turned off the power, locked the door, and left.
location: Store A-208, Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Rest and gaming relaxation on the way home
description: Rode his electric bike home in the gentle evening breeze. After arriving home, he changed into loungewear, lay on the sofa, and played The Legend of Zelda for about twenty minutes, releasing stress in the game world.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Reading review and Q1 creation plan
description: In the study, he opened his laptop, reviewed the eight books he had read over the past few months (such as 1587, a Year of No Significance and Houses in the City), and set reading goals for the first quarter of 2026: focus on reading four history books and nonfiction works on ancient warfare. At the same time, he planned to finish the first five chapters of The Nantong Bride, based on his mother's diary, and try submitting it. He felt that reading had broadened his perspective for writing.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Bedtime personal care and falling asleep
description: After finishing reading, I took a hot shower, blow-dried my hair, set the alarm for 6:30 the next day, drank warm water, and organized my book notes. I turned off the main light and, under the bedside lamp, recalled the day's fulfilling experiences, gradually falling asleep to the audiobook 'Houses in the City'.
location: In the bedroom at home, Shanggang Community, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Morning balcony meditation and year-end review.
description: At dawn, with the sky barely light, Lei Mingxuan sat upright on his yoga mat on the balcony, facing east with his eyes closed in meditation. He set today's theme as 'Year-End Echoes,' replaying key moments of the past year in his mind—the store's style transformation, the investment synergy with his father, the publication of his essay, and the publication interest in his novel. His inner state shifted from early-year anxiety to calm gratitude. In the final five minutes, he focused on his breathing and felt the cool Pudong air. After finishing, he noted 'being present' in his phone's memo.
location: Balcony at home, Shanggang Residential Area, 2-51 Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Report on the results of the family's healthy breakfast and dietary reform.
description: Mother prepared a healthy breakfast for Lei Mingxuan: a whole wheat sandwich, boiled eggs, and sugar-free yogurt with blueberries. During the meal, Lei Mingxuan excitedly showed his parents the data on the Weight Notebook app: his weight had dropped from 80.0 kg to 77.5 kg, his waist circumference had decreased by 2.5 cm, and his body fat percentage had dropped by 1.2%. His mother encouraged him to keep it up, while his father looked stern and told him to take care of his health. Lei Mingxuan took the opportunity to propose his New Year's goal: get his weight below 75 kg and BMI below 24 within three months, and asked his mother to serve more vegetables and high-protein dishes for dinner.
location: Home dining room, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Commuting to the store at Super Brand Mall
description: Lei Mingxuan put on his newly bought "mountain-style" technical vest, took his iced Americano, and hummed "Chengdu" as he went out. The winter sun had not fully risen. He walked quickly toward Changyi Road Station on the metro, passing the already open Pushang Vegetable Market, and planned to ask his father to buy sea bass in the evening. The commute took about 20 minutes. He scrolled through the Billboard charts along the way. At 8:15 he arrived at the second floor of Super Brand Mall on time, used his key to open the rolling shutter door of Shop A-208, and as the lights came on, a new day began.
location: Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai, to Super Brand Mall, 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai (by metro)

name: Annual summary of shop finances.
description: Lei Mingxuan opened his laptop at the cash register and entered December's sales transactions, purchase orders, and coffee area consumables one by one. He spent half an hour reviewing the effects of the 'Rational Consumption Principle': personal non-essential spending fell 15% year-on-year, and inventory turnover rose 8%. By combining the October and November reports, he obtained the fourth quarter's total revenue and net profit. Full-year net profit edged up 3%, and personal net income was about 140,000 yuan. Property manager Zheng Kai passed by and greeted him, wishing him a prosperous New Year. Lei Mingxuan returned the New Year wishes and asked him to continue his support in the coming year.
location: Store A-208, Super Brand Mall, No. 168 Lujiazui West Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Lunch at International Finance Center and browsing at a trendy toy store
description: After work, Lei Mingxuan walked to the IFC Mall, and at a highly rated Japanese ramen restaurant he ordered a super-spicy tonkotsu ramen and fried dumplings to reward himself. While eating, he browsed designer toy communities and became interested in a newly released mechanical blind box. After the meal, he stopped by a designer toy collective store on the way, paused to admire the design details of the new blind box series. Although he was tempted, he did not buy it and quietly resolved to save his anticipation for 2026.
location: IFC Mall, No. 8 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai: Japanese ramen restaurant and designer toy store

name: Stroll and recharge at Lujiazui Central Green Park
description: Lei Mingxuan, holding a hot Starbucks latte, strolled along the Lujiazui Central Green trail, enjoying the warm winter sun. He sat on a bench, watched pedestrians walking dogs, pushing strollers, and running, and looked out at the “three-piece set” in the distance, feeling a rare sense of relaxation. He opened WeChat, and his childhood friend Li Na shared a cat video in the group. He liked it and replied by voice message that he would bring his own cat Afu to pay a New Year's visit on New Year's Day.
location: Lujiazui Central Green Park, Lujiazui Ring Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Gym fitness test and ukulele wrap-up
description: Lei Mingxuan completed a 25-minute staged physical fitness test with his scheduled personal trainer at the gym in the Standard Chartered Bank Building. He successfully bench-pressed 50 kg (3 sets of 8 reps) and ran 5 km on the treadmill at a pace of 5 minutes 50 seconds per kilometer, achieving his goal set at the beginning of the month. The trainer praised his progress and developed a muscle-building and body-shaping plan for the first quarter of 2026. Afterward, he stretched on his own for 20 minutes, then sat in a corner of the rest area and smoothly played and sang "The Meaning of Travel" on the ukulele. He recorded the audio and posted it to his Moments with the caption: "2025 personal skill finale achievement unlocked. See you in Western Sichuan next year!"
location: Gym at Standard Chartered Bank Building, 201 Century Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Returning home and taking care of the orange tabby A Fu
description: Lei Mingxuan walked home from the gym. After entering, he first interacted with the orange tabby Ah Fu as it ran over, squatting down to pet it, refilled the cat food and water, and muttered to himself about taking it for a ride to Li Na's house. Then he wiped his face with a wet towel, changed into comfortable loungewear, and switched back to relaxed home mode.
location: Home in Shanggang Community, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Monthly comprehensive review of Japanese and summary of reading and creative writing.
description: In his study, Lei Mingxuan opened the Duolingo app and completed simulated dialogues for scenarios such as December shopping, asking directions, and ordering at a restaurant. He wrote out 50 key vocabulary words from memory and self-assessed his accuracy at 90%. Then he took out his reading journal and reviewed the 12 books he had read over the year (including 4 historical novels) and reading notes of no fewer than 5,000 characters. For his new novel The Nantong Bride, he wrote a red-pen note at the end of the 3,000-character outline: 'The opening is set for January 4, 2026.'
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Annual review and 2026 goal setting.
description: In his study, Lei Mingxuan drew a timeline on A4 paper and marked key events of 2025: the successful store transformation, the shift from conflict with his father to cooperative investment, publication of his essay, publication interest in his novel, losing 10 jin, and shelving the plan for western Sichuan. He also consolidated data (BMI 26.2 to 23.8, 152 kilometers of running for the year, 32 days of meditation, etc.). Then he wrote down five major goals for 2026: a road trip to western Sichuan in January, completing the upgrade of the multi-brand store and selecting a mini-program service provider by the end of March, activating the gym annual pass and working out three times a week, passing Japanese N5 by June, and starting "The Nantong Bride" and finishing the first five chapters. He took a photo to keep as a record.
location: Home study, Shanggang Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Preparing and enjoying the New Year's Eve family dinner
description: Lei Mingxuan put on an apron and went into the kitchen to help his mother. He peeled garlic and trimmed scallions, took out the wood ear mushrooms his father had soaked, and suggested adding a healthy dish: tomato beef brisket. His father brought out Shaoxing rice wine and wanted to drink a toast to wish him a thriving business. The dinner was lavish: steamed sea bass, tomato beef brisket, mixed wood ear mushroom salad, and the salt-and-pepper pork ribs his mother specially made filled the table. His father raised his glass to wish Lei Mingxuan smooth sailing in the new year, and his mother told him not to stay up late. Lei Mingxuan served his parents and shared his bench press score of 50 kg from the fitness test. After dinner, he set up a tripod in the living room and shot a timed family photo of the three of them, sending it to the relatives group and the “Pudong Three Musketeers” group, where it received countless likes.
location: Kitchen and dining room at home, 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Shanggang Community, Pudong New Area, Shanghai

name: Family watching the New Year's Day gala and chatting
description: After washing the dishes, Lei Mingxuan sat between his parents and watched the CCTV New Year's Day Gala together. His father occasionally hummed along to old songs, and his mother leaned on his shoulder, commenting on the hosts' outfits and transition lines. He also spread a small mat for A Fu at his feet. The music and dancing from the TV blended with the warmth of family, and Lei Mingxuan felt a total relaxation that required no social interaction, thinking that this was the most comfortable way to ring in the New Year.
location: Living room at home, Shanggang Residential Complex, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai.

name: Make a wish at midnight, welcome 2026, and prepare for bed
description: Outside the window, Lujiazui was brightly lit, and the glass curtain wall of the tallest building was counting down to "2026" in scrolling text. Lei Mingxuan led his parents to the balcony, and the three of them waited in the gentle breeze of the winter night. From the TV inside came the countdown "5, 4, 3, 2, 1, Happy New Year!" A few fireworks rose in the distance. He silently wished his family health and safety, career and creative work advancing together, and all goals fulfilled. His father patted him on the shoulder, and he said Happy New Year to his parents. Back in his room, he replied to Gao Yuan with a link for western Sichuan gear, sent Zheng Kai a New Year red envelope, and invited the "Pudong Three Musketeers" group to "fly together in 2026." After washing up, he put away One Hundred Years of Solitude, turned off the light and lay down. A Fu curled up at his feet, and he sank into sleep with gratitude and anticipation.
location: Balcony and bedroom at home in Shanggang Residential Community, No. 2-51, Lane 136, Pudong Avenue, Pudong New Area, Shanghai
